translations.translation: 1) ma allAha taAlAko nAma liMdai uhA~ko maddata mAgdai ra barakata khojdai kurAnako pATha zubhArambha gardachu | bismillAhamA allAhakA 3 vaTA uttama nAmaharUko ullekha bhaeko cha, tI nimnalikhita hun; ka) ‘allAha’ satya rizvara | yo uhA~ko viziSTa nAma ho | uhA~ bAheka arU kasaiko allAha nAma rAkhine chaina | kha) ‘arrahmAna’ atyanta dayAlu | uhA~ dayA ra karuNAkA khAnI hunuhuncha | ga) ‘arrahIma’ atyanta kRpAlu | uhA~ AphnA momina (AsthAvAna) bhakta lagAyata anya bhaktaharUmadhye jasalAI cAhanu huncha dayA garnu huncha |

2) pUrNa prazaMsA ra sabai kisimakA sundara tathA mahAna guNagAnaharU mAtra eka allAhakA lAgi hun, arU kasaiko lAgi hoina | kinabhane allAha nai sampUrNa sRSTikA sraSTA, pAlanakartA tathA prabandhaka hunuhuncha | AlamIna: Alama zabdako bahuvacana ho | allAhabAheka sampUrNa sRSTiharUlAI Alama bhanincha |
3 aghillo AyatamA allAhako prazaMsA ra yasa AyatamA guNagAnako bakhAna garieko cha |

4) allAhako mahAnatA ki uhA~ nai kiyAmata (mahApralaya) ko dina sabai vastuharUkA mAlika hunuhuncha | tyo dina kasaile kasaikA lAgi kehI pani garna sakne chaina | tasartha ‘yaumuddIna’ ko tAtparya hisAba kitAba ra badalA diine dina ho |

5) (he allAha!) hAmI kevala timro upAsanA garchauM ra timro upAsanAmA arU kasailAri sAjhedAra ThaharAudainauM | hAmI hareka mAmilAmA kevala timro sahayoga khojchauM | sampUrNa bhalAriko zrota mAtra timro hAthamA cha ra timI bAheka kohI hAmro sahayogI chaina |

6) (he allAha!) hAmIlAI sIdhA mArga dekhAU | tyasaimA hi~Dne ra aDiga rahane kSamatA pradAna gara ra mArgadarzanamA baDhottarI gara | ‘sidhA mArga’ ko tAtparya islAma dharma ho, juna allAhale muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) dvArA paripUrNa garnubhayo | kinabhane yasamA kunai TeDhopana chaina |

7) hAmIlAri tI mArgadarzana prApta garekA bhaktaharUko mArgamA hi~DAU, jasamAthi timro kRpA bhayo, jastai sandeSTA, satyavAdI, zahIda ra satkarmIharU | yinIharU kati rAmrA sAthIharU thie | tI mAnisaharUko mArgamA nahi~DAU, jasamAthi timro prakopa bhayo, jastai yahUdIharU; yinIharUle satya cinekA thie, taipani tyasako anusaraNa garenan | tyasaigarI risAriharUko mArgamA pani nahi~DAU; yinIharUle satyako khojI ra tyasako anusaraNalAI bevAstA garekAle bATo birAera pathabhraSTa huna puge |

1 alipha0 lAma0 mIma0 | yI varNamAlAkA tI akSaraharUmadhye hun jasabATa kurAnakA kehI sUraharUko suruvAta garieko cha | chuTTai prayoga bhaemA yasako kunai artha lAgdaina, (jastai aliph, bA, tA ityAdi) | kurAnamA kunai kurA binA uddezya nabhaekole yahA~ yI akSaraharUko mahatvapUrNa uddezya bhaneko kAphiraharUlAI diieko cunautItarpha saMketa garnu ho | kurAnakA AyataharU yinai akSaraharUbATa banekA chan, juna akSaraharUlAI yinIharU cindachan ra boldachan, taipani Ajasamma kasaile kurAnako cunautI svIkAra garna A~Ta gareko chaina | sambhavataH yasai kAraNale yI akSaraharUpachi kurAna karImako varNana garieko ho, jasto ki yasa sUrahamA pani |

2 yasa mahAna kurAnamA kunai sandeha chaina | na allAhako tarphabATa avataraNa bhaeko kurAmA, na zabdamA, na arthamA nai | yo kurAna allAhako vANI ho | yasale Izabhaya rAkhneharUlAI sIdhA mArgadarzana garcha |

3. 4 yastA AsthAvAnaharU juna gaiba (parokSa) mA AsthA rAkhdachan | adRzya raheko ra indriyadvArA mahasusa garna nasakine kurAharUlAI gaiba bhanincha | jasako bAremA allAha vA uhA~kA rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) le jAnakArI dinubhaeko cha, jastai- paralokakA kurAharU | yastA mominale nai salAha (namAja) paDhdA arkAna (AdhAra) vAjiba (anivArya) ra sunnata (atirikta ra puraka) anusAra salAha kAyama garchan | yinIharUle nai allAhale pradAna garnubhaeko dhanasampattibATa anivArya ra atirikta dAna allAhako khuzIko lAgi dine garchan | he nabI (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! yinIharU nai tapAIMmAthi ra tapAIMbhandA pahilekA sabai sandeSTAharUmAthi avatarita vahI (prakAzanA) mA binA bhedabhAva vizvAsa garchan | yinIharU nai Akhirata (paraloka), tyahA~ diine puNya ra sajAyamAthi dRDha vizvAsa rAkhchan |

3. 4 yastA AsthAvAnaharU juna gaiba (parokSa) mA AsthA rAkhdachan | adRzya raheko ra indriyadvArA mahasusa garna nasakine kurAharUlAI gaiba bhanincha | jasako bAremA allAha vA uhA~kA rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) le jAnakArI dinubhaeko cha, jastai paralokakA kurAharU | yastA mominale nai salAha (namAja) paDhdA arkAna (AdhAra) vAjiba (anivArya) ra sunnata (atirikta ra puraka) anusAra salAha kAyama garchan | yinIharUle nai allAhale pradAna garnubhaeko dhanasampattibATa anivArya ra atirikta dAna allAhako khuzIko lAgi dine garchan | he nabI (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! yinIharU nai tapAIMmAthi ra tapAIMbhandA pahilekA sabai sandeSTAharUmAthi avatarita vahI (prakAzanA) mA binA bhedabhAva vizvAsa garchan | yinIharU nai Akhirata (paraloka), tyahA~ diine puNya ra sajAyamAthi dRDha vizvAsa rAkhchan |

5 uparyukta guNaharU bhaekA mAnisaharU nai sIdhA mArgamA chan | yinIharU nai loka ra paralokamA saphala hune chan | yinIharUle apekSA garekA varadAnaharU pAune chan ra DarAiekA yAtanAbATa mukti pAune chan |

allAhale vAhya tathA Antarika duvai rUpamA saphA bhaekA AsthAvAnaharUkA guNaharUko varNanapachi vAhya tathA Antarika rUpamA bhraSTa bhaekA kAphira (avajJAkarI) harUko euTA samUhakA avaguNaharUko varNana gardai bhannubhayo:
6 juna mAnisaharUko bAremA allAhako tarphabATa ImAna nalyAune Adeza lAgu bhaisakeko cha tinIharU avazya nai nirantara Aphno pathabhraSTatA ra zatrutAmA nai kAyama rahanechan | ataH unIharUlAI khabaradAra garnu vA nagarnu duvai samAna cha |

7 kinabhane allAhale tinIharUkA muTumAthi mohara lagAI dinubhaeko cha | tyastai tinIharUkA kAna ra A~khAharUmA pardA lagAI dinubhaeko cha, jasale gardA tinIharU satya kurA mAnne garI sundainan ra spaSTa satyalAI dekhdainan | tinIharUkA lAgi Akhirata (mRtyu pazcAtako jIvana) mA du:khadAyI yAtanA cha |

vAhya tathA Antarika duvai rUpamA bhraSTa bhaekA kAphiraharUko varNanapachi allAhale vAhya saphA tathA Antarika bhraSTa bhaekA munAphika (kapaTI) harUko varNana gardai bhannubhayo:
8 kehI mAnisaharUle AsthAvAnaharUlAI dhokA dina ra Aphno jIudhana jogAunako lAgi AphUlAI AsthAvAna ThAndachan | tara vAstavamA tinIharU munAphika (kapaTI) hun |

9 Aphno ajJAnatAle gardA tinIharUle ImAna jAhera garera ra kuphralAI lukAera allAha tathA AsthAvAnaharUlAI dhokA dirahekA chan bhanne ThAndachan tara yasa kurAlAI mahasusa gardainan ki allAha gopya kurAharU jAnnuhuncha tyasaile tinIharUko avaguNa ra kartutaharUsita AsthAvAnaharUlAI sUcita garnubhaeko cha |

10 tinIharUko manamA zaMkAko roga cha | allAhale tinIharUko zaMkAmAthi zaMkA thapnubhayo | kinabhane mAnisale jasto kArya garcha badalA tyastai kisimako huncha | tinIharUle allAha tathA mAnisaharUsa~ga jhUTho kurA bolekole ra muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) le lyAunu bhaeko sandezalAI jhUTho Thahara garekole tinIharUlAI narkako sabai bhandA tallo staramA pIDAdAyI yAtanA diinecha |
11 jaba tinIharUlAI kuphra tathA pApadvArA dhartImA AtaMka ra bhraSTAcAra maccAunabATa manAhI garincha taba tinIharU asvIkAra garchan ra AphUlAI bhalAdamI tathA sudhAraka ThAndachan |
12 vAstavamA bhanne ho bhane tinIharU AtaMkakArI ra bhraSTAcArI hun, tara tinIharU yasa kurAlAI mahasusa garirahekA chainan |

13 jaba tinIharUlAI muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) kA sAthIharUle ImAna lyAe jhaiM ImAna lyAune AhvAna garincha, taba inkAra ra ThaTTA gardai javApha dinchan− ke hAmIharU manda buddhi bhaekA vyaktiharUle ImAna lyAe jhaiM ImAna lyAune? yadyapi vAstaviktA ke cha bhane tinIharU nai murkha hun tara tinIharU jAndainan |

14 munAphika (kapaTI) harU AsthAvAnaharUsa~ga bheTa hu~dA DarAera bhanchan, tapAIMharUle ImAna lyAe jhaiM hAmIle ImAna lyAyauM | tara ekAntamA AphnA aguvAharUsa~ga bheTdA bhanchan, hAmI ta vAstavamA timIharUko sAthamA chauM ra AsthAvAnaharUsa~ga kevala ThaTTA garirahekA chauM |

15 jasarI tinIharU AsthAvAnaharUsa~ga ThaTTA gardaichan allAhale tyasarI tinIharUsa~ga jastAlAI tyastai garI (Aphno zAna anusAra) ThaTTA garirAkhnubhaeko cha | duniyA~mA muslimaharU jhaiM vyavahAra garincha tara AkhiratamA tinIharUle Aphno pApa, kuphra tathA kapaTako sajAya pAune chan | allAhale tinIharUlAI bhraSTatAmA andho bhaI hairAna tathA dvividhAmA yatAuti barAlirahana chuTa dinubhaeko cha |

16 ukta guNaharU bhaekA monAphikaharUle nai mArgadarzanako saTTA kuphra ra pathabhraSTatAlAI rojekA chan | allAhamAthi ImAna nalyAera ghATAko saudA garekole tinIharUko vyApArale na kehI nAphA die na tinIharUle sIdhA mArga pAuna sake |

17 allAhale munAphika (kapaTI) harUko duI kisima; Ago ra pAnIko upamA dinubhaeko cha | Agoko upamA kasarI diieko cha bhane eka janA vyaktile varaparako vAtAvaraNalAI prakAzamaya banAune uddezyale Ago bAlyo, tara tyasabATa phAidA uThAuna nasakdA prakAza samApta bhayo ra Agole mAtra poli rahyo ani tinIharU yasto ghora andhakAramA pare jasamA na ta kehI pani dekhna sake, na sIdhA mArga nai pAe |

18 kinabhane munAphikaharU bahirA hun, satyalAI svIkAra garne garI sundai sundainan | lATA hun, satya kurA boldai boldainan | andhA hun, satya kurA dekhdai dekhdainan | tinIharU kahilyai sIdhA mArga pAune chainan |

19 pAnIko upamAH tinIharUlAI musaladhAre varSAle upamA diieko cha | yasto bAdala jasamA megha garjana, ghora andhakAra ra bijulIko camaka thiyo, jasale gardA mAnisaharU nikai nai tarsie | ani tinIharUle kaDA megha garjanako kAraNa ra mRtyuko Darale kAnamA au~lA ghusArirahekA chan | yadyapi allAhale kAphiraharUlAI Aphno gherAmA linubhaeko cha ra tinIharUle allAhalAI vivaza pArna sakdainan |

20 bijulIko camakale tinIharUko hAlata yasto bhairaheko cha− mAnauM tyasale chiTTai nai tinIharUko A~khAko jyotilAI khosera laijAnecha | jaba-jaba prakAza phailincha tinIharU tyasamA hiMDna thAlchan ra jaba tinIharUlAI a~dhyArole chopdacha taba tinIharU andhakAramai rokinchan, agADi baDhanai sakdainan, na ta hallina nai sakchan | nitAnta satyamA AsthA nalyAeko kAraNale allAhale cAhanubhaemA Aphno pUrNa zaktibATa tinIharUko kAna tathA A~khAharU kahile napharkane garI khosna saknuhuncha | yasa udAharaNamA pAnIko abhiprAya kurAna ho | bijulIko kaDakako abhiprAya Dara ho ra bijulIko camakako abhiprAya satya prakaTa hunu ho | kAna thunnuko abhiprAya satyabATa anuhAra pharkAunu ho |
uparyukta duvai udAharaNa ra munAphikaharUbIca juna kurA mela khAncha tyo ho phAidA nauThAunu | Ago sambandhI udAharaNamA Ago bAlnele andhakAra ra DaDhAune bAheka kehI pAena bhane pAnIko udAharaNamA unIharUle bijulIko camaka ra kaDaka jastA hairAna pArne kurAharU bAheka kehI pAenan | ThIka tyastai munAphikaharU islAmamA kruratA ra kaThoratA bAheka kehI pAu~dainan |

momina, kAphira tathA munAphika tInai kisimakA mAnisaharUko varNanapachi allAhale sabailAI mAtra Aphno bhaktitarpha bolAu~dai bhannubhayo:
21 he mAnava ho! AphnA pAlanakartAko mAtra bhakti gara | kinabhane uhA~le nai timI ra timIbhandA pUrvakA sampUrNa samudAyaharUko sRSTi garnubhayo | AzA cha timIharUle allAhakA AdezaharUko pAlanA garera tathA varjita kAryaharUlAI tyAgera AphUlAI narkabATa jogAuna saknechau |

22 allAhale nai timIharUkA lAgi dhartIlAI samatala bichyaunA ra AkAzalAI baliyo chAnA banAunubhayo | uhA~le nai timIharUko jIvikopArjanako lAgi AkAzabATa pAnI barsAera dhartIbATa aneka prakArakA phalaphUlaharU umArnubhayo | ataH jAnIjAnI allAhasa~ga kasailAI sAjhedAra nabanAU | allAhabAheka kohI sRSTikartA chaina bhanne kurA timIharUlAI rAmrarI thAhA cha |

23 he mAnava ho! hAmIle AphnA sevaka muhammada (sallllAhu alaihi va sallama) mAthi avataraNa gareko grantha kurAnako bAremA timIharU sandehamA chau bhane kurAna jhaiM euTA sUraha (adhyAya) racanA garI lyAU bhanne cunautI dinchauM, cAhe tyo kurAnako sabaibhandA sAno adhyAya kina nahos | yadi timIharU Aphno dAbImA saccA chau bhane allAhabAheka AphnA anya sahayogIharUlAI pani guhAra |

24 yadi timIharU yaso garna sakdainau ra kadApi garna sakdainau bhane tyasa narkako AgobATa DarAU jasako indhana manuSya ra tI vibhinna DhuGgAharU hune chan jasako bhakti mUrtipUjakaharU garne garchan | allAhale yo Ago kAphiraharUkA lAgi tayAra pArnu bhaeko cha |

25 aghillo AyatamA kAphiraharUkA lAgi dhamkI thiyo | aba he nabI! allAhamAthi ImAna lyAune tathA satkarma garneharUlAI zubhasUcanA dinuhos− vAstavamA unIharUlAI prasanna pArne yastA bagaiMcAharU chan jasakA mahalaharU tathA rUkhaharUko talatirabATa nadIharU kalakala bagirahekA hune chan | tyasa bagaiMcAbATa kunai phala tinIharUlAI khAna dii~dA saMsArakA phalaharUsita mildojuldo bhaekole bhannechan– yastai kisimakA phalaharU hAmIharUlAI yasaaghi duniyA~mA pani pradAna garieko thiyo | tinIharUlAI yasa saMsArakA phalaharUsita mildojuldo thapa phalaharU diine chan | tI phalaharUko rUpa tathA nAma saMsArakA phalaharUsita mildojuldo bhaekole svargabAsIharUle cinnechan, tara tyasakA svAda cAhi~ pharaka hunecha | unIharUkA lAgi tyahA~ pavitra joDIharU hune chan, jo mana naparAune sabai kisimakA truTi tathA phoharabATa pavitra hune chan | svargabAsIharU tyahA~ sadAsarvadA kRpAmA rahane chan, tyasako tulanAmA duniyA~ko varadAnaharU kehI pani chaina |

26 nissandeha allAha kunai upamA dina saGkoca mAnnuhunna | uhA~ lAmakhuTTe vA tyasabhandA ThUlo vA sAno cIjako pani upamA dinuhuncha | mAnisaharU duI kisimakA chan; momina ra kAphira | mominale yo upamA pAlanakartAko tarphabATa Aekole satya mAndachan ra yasamA uhA~ko kehI uddezya ra rahasya rahekocha bhanne kurAlAI vizvAsa gardachan | tara kAphiraharU ThaTTA gardai sodhchan– allAhale lAmakhuTTe, jhiMgA, mAkurA ityAdi jastA sAnA kurAharUko upamA kina bayAna garnubhaeko ho? yasako javAphamA allAhale bhannubhaeko chaH vAstavamA yI upamAmA mAnisaharUkA lAgi mArgadarzana, nirdezana ra parIkSA cha | yasa upamAbATa pATha linelAI satmArga dekhAunuhuncha ra vimukha hunelAI pathabhraSTa garnuhuncha; jastai munAphikaharU |

27 jasale allAhasa~ga gareko vAcA; mAtra eka allAhako bhakti ra uhA~kA rasUlako AjJApAlana garne dRr3ha pratijJAlAI toDyo | tyasaigarI allAhale joDna Adeza dinubhaeko sambandhalAI toDchan, jastaiH nAtedAraharUsita nAtA toDchan ra pApa karma garera dhartImA AtaMka phailAune prayAsa garchan, tinIharU nai vAstavamA loka ra paralokamA ghATA behorne chan |

28 he kAphiraharU ho! acammako pArA cha, timIharU AphUbhitra allAhakA zaktikA pramANaharU dekhdA pani kasarI allAhako inkAra garchau! jaba timIharUko kunai astitva thiena, taipani uhA~le sRSTi garnubhayo ra jIvana pradAna garnubhayo | pheri uhA~le nai timIharUlAI dosro paTaka mRtyu dinuhunecha ani pheri dosro paTaka jIvita pArnuhunecha | antataH punaH uhA~tira pharkera jAnechau ani uhA~le timIharUko hisAba linuhunecha |

29 allAhale eklai timIharUkA lAgi dhartImA rahekA nadI, nAlA, rUkha, ityAdi lagAyata anagintI vastuharU sRSTi garnubhayo | timIharU yI vastuharUbATa phAidA uThAi rAkhekA chau ra Aphno adhInamA rahekA cijaharUlAI prayoga garirahekAchau | tyasapachi uhA~le AkAzaharU sRSTi garne irAdA garnubhayo ani sAtavaTA saTIka tathA santulita AkAzaharU sRSTi garnubhayo | uhA~ nai sampUrNa cIjakA jJAtA hunuhuncha |

30 allAha taAlAle phariztAharUlAI bhannubhayo− ma dhartImA mAnavako sRSTi garna cAhanchu | ekapachi arko piDhI Aune chan ra dhartIlAI allAhako bhaktibhAvale AbAda garnechan | taba phariztAharUle bujhnako lAgi sodhe– mAnavalAI kina sRSTi garna cAhanuhuncha? kinabhane unIharUle dhartImA AtaMka ra raktapAta maccAune chan | hAmI tapAIMko AjJApAlana, prazaMsA ra pavitratAko varNana garchauM ra tyasamA kunai kami pani garirahekA chainauM? allAhale javAphamA bhannubhayo– ma unIharUko sRSTi tathA dhartImA khaliphA (uttarAdhikArI) banAunumA rahekA rahasya tathA ucca uddezyalAI jAndachu jo timIharU jAndainau |

31 Adama (alaihissalAma) ko sthAna batAunako lAgi allAhale unalAI janAvara, vanaspati ityAdiko zabda ra arthasahita sampUrNa nAma sikAunu bhayo ani tI kurAharU phariztAharUsamakSa prastuta gardai sodhnubhayo– yadi timIharU Aphno kurA; hAmI mAnava bhandA zreSTha prANI hauM bhanne dAbImA saccA chau bhane yI kurAharUko nAma batAU |

32 phariztAharUle AphnA alpa jJAna svIkAra gardai ra allAhako kRpAko varNana gardai javApha die– he hAmrA pAlanakartA! tapAIM ekadamai pavitra tathA mahAna hunuhuncha | hAmIlAI ta tyati mAtra jJAna cha jati tapAIMle hAmIlAI sikAunubhaeko cha | nissandeha tapAIM nai sarvajJa ra tatvadarzI hunuhuncha, tapAIM Aphno apAra jJAna ra zaktile sabai kurAharUlAI tyasako ucita sthAnamA rAkhnuhuncha |

33 tyatikhera allAhale AdamalAI tI nAmaharU batAuna bhannubhayo | jaba Adamale unIharUlAI tI nAmaharU batAe taba allAhale phariztAharUlAI bhannubhayo– ma AkAzaharU ra pRthvImA lukekA, timIharUle vyakta garne garekA ra lukAune garekA sabai kurAharUlAI jAndachu |

34 allAha taAlAle phariztA (devadUta) harUlAI Adeza dinubhayo– AdamalAI sammAnako lAgi sajdA (Dhoga) gara, taba iblIsa (zaitAna) bAheka sabaile sajdA gare | iblIsa jinnamadhye thiyo | usale allAhako AdezalAI ThADai inkAra garyo ra Adamasa~ga ghamaNDa gardai sajdA garena | yasarI U allAhako inkAra garne (kAphira) harUmadhye banyo |

35 hAmIle bhanyauM– he Adama! timI ra timrI patnI havvA duvai svargamA basa ra jahA~bATa je cAhanchau aghAuJjela khAU | tara maile phala khAna manAhI gareko rUkhanajika pani najAU hai, natra bhane timIharU mero Adezako ullaGghana garera atyAcArI Thaharinechau |

36 zaitAnale duvai janAlAI nirantara bahakAuna thAlyo ra tyasalAI AkarSaka banAera dekhAuna thAlyo | antataH zaitAnale dubailAI manAhI garieko rUkhako phala khuvAera galtI garAyo | ani allAhale sajAya svarUpa duvai janAlAI tyasa svargabATa nikAlnubhayo | allAhale Adama ra havvA duvai janA ra zaitAnalAI bhannubhayo– yahA~bATa orlera jAU | timIharU dubai mAnava ra zaitAna eka arkAkA zatru hau | timIharU dhartImA jIvikopArjana gara ra mahApralayasamma basa |

37 allAhale AdamalAI kehI zabda ra duAharU sikAunubhayo | yasa duAko varNana sUraha ArAphamA yasarI garieko cha− he hAmrA pAlanakartA! hAmIle AphUmAthi atyAcAra garyauM, yadi tapAIMle mApha garnubhaena ra hAmImAthi dayA garnubhaena bhane hAmI ghATA behorneharUmadhye hunechauM | ani allAhale unako taubAlAI svIkAra garnubhayo tathA kSamA garnubhayo | vAstavamA, uhA~ bhaktaharUko taubA svIkAra garnuhuncha ani kSamA pradAna garnuhuncha |

38 hAmIle bhanyauM− timIharU sabai svargabATa orlera dhartImA jAU | timIharUsamakSa merA sandeSTAharUle mArgadarzana liera Au~dA ja-jasale tyasalAI mAnchan, tyasako anusaraNa garchan ra tyasamA dRDha vizvAsa rAkhchan unIharUlAI AkhiratamA kunai Dara hune chaina ra duniyA~mA gumAekA kurAharUko pani cintA hune chaina |
39 hAmrA nizAnIharUlAI jhUTlAuneharU nai narkabAsI hun | tinIharU narkabATa kahilyai umkana sakne chainan |

40 he nabI yAkUbakA santAnaharU ho! allAhakA nirantara kRpAharUlAI yAda gara ani tyasaprati kRtajJa hoU | ma ra merA rasUlaharUmAthi ImAna lyAunechau ra mero zarIata anusAra karma garnechau bhanne vAcAlAI purA gara | timIharUle vAcA purA garchau bhane ma pani Aphno vAcA purA garchu, timIharUlAI duniyA~mA rAmro jIvana dinchu ra mahApralayako dina rAmro badalA dinchu | ataH timIharU mAtra masa~ga DarAU ra masa~ga gareko vAcA bhaMga nagara |

41 muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) mAthi avatarita kurAnamAthi ImAna lyAU | yasamA rahekA tauhIda (ekezvaravAda) tathA muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) ko IzadUtatvako bayAna sandeSTA mUsAmAthi avatarita taurAtamA cha, tara tinIharUle pherabadala gare | sAvadhAna! yasalAI inkAra garne pahilo samUhamadhye nabana | maile avataraNa garekA AyataharUlAI Aphno pratiSThAko lAgi tuccha mUlyamA nabeca | mero risa tathA prakopasita DarAU |

42 maile AphnA rasUlaharUmAthi avatarita gareko nitAnta satyalAI Aphno managaDhante kurAsita namisAU | muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) bAre timIharUkA kitAbamA AekA satya tathya jAnIjAnI nalukAU |

43 pUrNarUpamA sabai stambhaharU (arkAna), anivArya kAryaharU (vAjibAta) tathA ecchika (naphila) kAryaharU sameta namAja kAyama gara | allAhale dinu bhaekA dhanasampattiko jakAta deU | muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) kA samudAyakA tI mAnisaharUmadhye bana jo allAhako lAgi rukUa ani sajdA garchan |

44 chi chi, kati narAmro, arUlAI ta ImAna tathA bhalo kAma garne sallAha dinchau tara AphUlAI birsera ImAna tathA satkarmabATa TADhA bhAgchau, jabaki timIharU taurAta paDhchau, allAhako dharma tathA kAnunako pAlanA garnuparcha ra rasUlaharUko anusaraNa garnuparcha bhanne kurAharU rAmrarI jAndachau | ke timIharUko dimAga caldaina ॽ

45 hareka kisimakA dhArmika tathA sAMsArika samasyAmA dhairya ra namAjadvArA maddata mAga | namAjale timIharUlAI allAhasita najika pArcha ra uhA~sita joDcha | yaso garemA allAhale timIharUko maddata garnuhunecha, surakSA garnuhunecha ra kaSTalAI TArnuhunecha | nissandeha salAha yastA muslimaharUkA lAgi sajilo tathA sahaja cha jo Aphno pAlanakartA allAhasa~ga DarAu~chan |
46 kinabhane unIharU mahApralayako dina allAha samakSa pugnechan, uhA~sa~ga bheTnechan ra allAhale unIharUkA karmako badalA dinuhunecha bhanne kurAko vizvAsa rAkhchan |
47 he nabI yAkUbakA santAnaharU! maile timIharUmAthi garekA sAMsArika tathA dhArmika varadAnaharUlAI ra saMsAra bAsIharUmAthi pradAna gareko prAthamikatA tathA sattAlAI yAda gara |

48 allAhakA AdezaharUko pAlanA garera tathA varjita kAryaharUlAI tyAgera AphUlAI mahApralayako yAtanAbATa jogAU | tyo yasto dina hunecha juna dina kohI kasailAI alikati pani bacAva garna sakne chaina ra allAhako anumatibinA kohI kasaiko siphArisa garera na ta phAidA puryAuna sakcha na kaSTa TArna sakcha | kasaile pRthvI barAbara suna die pani svIkAra garine chaina | jaba kunai upAya kAma lAgne chaina bhane bhAgera kahA~ jAnechau ta ॽ

49 he isrAIlakA santAnaharU! tyasa samayalAI yAda gara, jaba hAmIle timIharUlAI phiraaunakA samarthakaharUbATa mukta garAyauM | jasale timIharUlAI vibhinna kisimakA kaThora yAtanA diera satAune garthe | timIharUkA vaza miTAunako lAgi timrA chorAharUlAI mArne garthe ra Aphno dAsI banAuna ra timIharUlAI beijjata garna timro chorIharUlAI jIvita choDne garthe | phiraauna ra usakA mAnisaharUbATa timIharUko muktimA timIharUkA pAlanakartAko tarphabATa utkRSTa parIkSA thiyo, tAki timIharU allAhaprati AbhAra prakaTa gara |

50 merA anya varadAnaharUlAI pani yAda gara, hAmIle samudramA timIharUkA lAgi sukhkhA bATo banAyauM ra timIharUlAI sakuzala pAra garAidiyauM, ani timIharUko A~khA agADI timIharUkA zatru phiraauna ra usakA mAnisaharUlAI curlummai DubAidiyauM |

51 hAmrA anya varadAnaharUlAI pani yAda gara, hAmIle vAcA anusAra sandeSTA mUsA (alaihissalAma) lAI taurAta pradAna garnako lAgi cAlIsa rAtakA lAgi (tUra pahADamA) bolAyauM | juna sabaiko lAgi prakAza ra mArgadarzana ho | tara timIharUle tyasa avadhimA bAchAlAI upAsyako rUpamA grahaNa garera AphaiMmAthi ThUlo atyAcAra garyau |
52 timIharUle taubA garepachi hAmIle mApha garyauM ra timIharUko pakaDa garenauM, tAki timIharU rAmro tarikAle bhakti tathA AjJApAlana garera mero AbhAra vyakta gara |

53 hAmro tyasa varadAnalAI pani yAda gara, hAmIle mUsA (alaihissalAma) lAI taurAta pradAna garyauM | jasale satya ra asatyabIca pharaka chuTyAucha, mArgadarzana ra pathabhraSTatAbIca pahicAna garAu~dacha | tAki timIharU satyamArgamA hi~Dna saka |

54 hAmro tyasa varadAnalAI pani yAda gara, allAhale timIharUlAI bAchAko pUjApachi tyatikhera taubA (prAyazcita) garne tauphIka (maukA) dinubhayo jaba mUsA (alaihissalAma) le timIharUlAI bhane– he merA samudAyaharU ho! nizcaya nai timIharUle bAchAlAI upAsya banAera AphUmAthi ThUlo anyAya garekA chau, tasartha timIharU taubA (prAyazcita) gara ra AphnA sRSTikartAtarpha pharka; ekale arkAko hatyA gara | yasarI taubA garemA timIharUko sRSTikartA allAhako dRSTimA timIharUko bhalo hunecha | sadhaiM kuphramA rahyau bhane sadhaiMko lAgi narkamA phyA~kinechau | timIharUle allAhako kRpAle nai taubA garyau ani allAhale timIharUlAI kSamA garidinubhayo | nissandeha uhA~ bhaktaharUlAI ati nai mApha garnuhuncha tathA dayA garnuhuncha |

55 yAda gara, jaba timIharUkA pUrvajale A~Ta garera mandeSTA mUsA (alaihissalAma) lAI bhanekA thie– he mUsA! hAmI allAhalAI sAkSAta nadekhesamma timImAthi kadApi vizvAsa gardainauM, ani timIharUlAI DaDhAune Agole samAtyo, ani timIharU eka arkAlAI herdA herdai mAriyau |
56 timIharU murdA bhaepachi punaH hAmIle timIharUlAI jIvita paryauM tAki timIharU kRtajJa hoU |

57 hAmrA kRpAharUmadhye yo pani thiyo− hAmIle timIharUmAthi tyatikhera bAdalako chAyA~ pAryauM jaba timIharU ghAmamA bhauMtArirahekA thiyau | timIharUmAthi maha jasto svAdilo peya ra baTTAI (titrA raMgako bha~gero) jasto dekhine sAno carAko svAdilo mAsu avatarita garyauM ra bhanyauM– hAmIle timIharUlAI pradAna garekA pavitra bhojanaharU khAU | tinIharUle hAmro kRpAko anAdara garera hAmro kunai hAni garenan baru Aphno bhAgyako puNya kama garera tathA AphUlAI pApako bhAgIdAra banAera AphaiMmAthi atyAcAra gare |

58 allAhakA tI kRpAharUlAI pani yAda gara jaba hAmIle bhanekA thiyauM− baitul-makdisa bhitra praveza gara ra jahA~bATa je pavitra khAnekurAharU cAhanchau aghAuJjela khAU | DhokAbhitra allAhako lAgi nihurera praveza gara ani yasarI prArthanA gara−he hAmrA pAlanakartA! hAmrA pApaharU mApha gari dinuhos | hAmI timrA prArthanAlAI svIkAra garnechauM ra sukarmIharUkA satkarmako puNya ajha thapera dinechauM |

59 tara tinIharUmadhye atyAcArIharUle karma tathA bhanAi duvailAI pherabadala garidie | nihurera praveza garnuko sATo ghasrera praveza gare ani bhanAimA pani parivartana garera allAhako bhanAi “hittatun” zabdalAI majAka uDAu~dai habbatin phI zaaratin (bAlImA dAnA) bhane | ani ta hAmIle tinIharUko zarIatako avajJA tathA Adezako ullaGghanako kAraNale AkAzabATa prakopa paThAyauM |

60 allAhakA yI kRpAharUlAI yAda gara jaba timIharU tIha nAmI maidAnamA thiyau, dherai tirkhAle byAkula thiyau, mUsA (alaihissalAma) le bintI garera prArthanA gardai timIharUkA tirkhA miTAuna pAnI mAge | hAmIle mUsA (alaihissalAma) lAI unako laurolAI DhuGgAmA hAnne Adeza diyauM | jaba unale Aphno laurolAI DhuGgAmAthi hAne taba timIharUkA 12 vaTA samUhakA lAgi 12 vaTA muhAna phuTe ra tyasabATa pAnI niskana thAlyo, hAmIle pratyeka samUhalAI tinIharUkA ghATa cinAyauM tAki tinIharUbIca jhagaDA nahos | hAmIle bhanyauM− binA mehanata allAhadvArA pradatta khAnekurA khAnapina gara tara dhartImA AtaMka maccAu~dai nahiMDa |

61 yAda gara jaba timIharUle allAhaprati kRtaghnatA prakaTa garekA thiyau, euTai khAnA (manna ra salvA) khA~dA khA~dai vAkka bhaekA thiyau ra bhanekA thiyau– he mUsA! hAmI ekai kisimako khAnAmA kadApi santoSa garna sakdainauM, AphnA pAlanakartAsa~ga hAmro lAgi jaminakA anna, sAgapAta, kAMkrA, lasuna, dAla ra pyAja umAridine prArthanA gara | mUsA (alaihissalAma) le timIharUko mAgalAI mana parAekA thienan ani bhanekA thie– ke timIharU manna tatha salvA jastA utkRSTa bhojanako saTTAmA tyasabhandA tallo starako khAnAko mAga garchau? jaba ki yo bhojana binA mihineta pAi rahekA chau | tyaso bhae yahA~bATa niskera kunai gAu~mA jAU, timIharUle khojekA kurAharU tyahA~kA kheta tathA bajAramA pAunechau | nirantara Aphno manacAhI garekole ra allAhako cAhanA viparIta garekole tinIharUmAthi apamAna ra daridratA thopAriyo | tinIharUle allAhakA dharmalAI namAnekAle, uhA~kA nizAnIharUko inkAra garekAle tathA anAhaka ra atyAcArapUrNa tarikAle sandeSTAharUko hatyA garekAle tinIharU allAhako prakopamA gherie | yI sabai tinIharUle garne garekA allAhako avajJA ra sImAharUko ullaGghanako pariNAma thiyo |

62 nissandeha muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) ko anuyAyI, tyasaigarI uhA~ bhandA aghikA samudAya jastai yahUdI, irsAi, tathA sAbieha (kehI anya sandeSharUkA samudAya) madhye jasale allAha tathA AkhiratamAthi AsthA (ImAna) lyAe ra satkarma gare, unIharUkA lAgi rAmro pratidAnako vyavasthA cha | unIharUlAI AkhiratamA kunai kurAko Dara hunechaina ra duniyA~mA garna napAekA kurAharUprati kunai pachuto hunechaina |

63) yAda gara tyasa pakkA vacanalAI jo hAmIle allAha tathA uhA~kA rasUlaharUmAthi ImAnako bAremA timIharUsa~ga liekA thiyauM ra tUra nAmaka pahADalAI timIharUlAI DarAunako lAgi tathA karma evaM vAcAprati sAvadhAna garAunako lAgi timIharUmAthi uThAekA thiyauM ra Adeza diekA thiyauM ki taurAta jasto juna kitAba hAmIle timIharUlAI diekA chauM tyasalAI binA DhIlA sustI balapUrvaka samhAla; tyasamA je cha tyo samjhirAkha, kaNTha gara tathA tyasamA socavicAra gara tAki timIharU allAhako prakopabATa bacna saka |

64 tara timIharU pakkA vAcA pazcAt pani Aphno vAcAbATa vimukha bhayau | timIharUmAthi allAhako kRpA ra timIharUko taubA svIkAra garera mAphI nadieko bhae timIharU Aphno avajJAle gardA kSati grasta hune thiyau |

65 timIharU Aphno pUrvajako bAremA rAmrarI jAndachau− tinIharUkA lAgi zanivArako dina zikAra garnu avaidha garieko thiyo, tara tinIharUle calakhela garera zanivAra bhandA pahilA jAla rAkhera aitavArako dina jAla haTAera mAchAko zikAra garna thAle | allAhale yI bahAnA garera niyama ullaGghana garneharUlAI bA~daramA pariNata garnubhayo |

66 hAmIle yasa atyAcArI gAu~lAI variparikA gAu~harU tathA bhaviSyamA Aune sabaikA lAgi pATha banAidiyauM tAki bhaviSyamA kasaile yaso garera prakopako hakadAra nabanos | hAmIle yasalAI yasatA Izabhaya rAkhneharUkA lAgi upadeza banAyauM jo allAhako prakopa tathA sImA ullaGghana garneharUko pariNAmabATa DarAu~chan |

67 yAda gara AphnA pUrvaja tathA sandeSTA mUsA (alaihissalAma) bIca bhaeko vAda vivAdalAI, jaba mUsA (alaihissalAma) le unIharUlAI allAhako yo Adeza sunAe− timIharU euTA gAIlAI vadha (jabaha) gara, Adezako pAlanA garnu kahA~ ho kahA~, ulTai tinIharUle Adezako ullaGghana gardai bhane– ke timI hAmIsita ThaTTA gardaichau? mUsA (alaihissalAma) le bhane– ma allAhamAthi jhUTo bolne tathA mAnisaharUko khillI uDAunabATa allAhako zaraNa cAhanchu |

68 unIharUle mUsA (alaihissalAma) lAI sodhe– tyo badha garine gAImA ke kasto guNa hunuparcha bhanne kurA allAhalAI sodha | mUsA (alaihissalAma) le bhaneH allAha bhannuhunchaH tyo gAI na baDhI umerako hos na kama umerako, baru madhya Ayuko kalilo bAchI hos | ataH timIharU khurukka Adezako pAlanA gara |

69 tinIharUle yo bhandai mUsA (alaihissalAma) sa~ga vAdavivAda gari rAkhe− tyo vadha garine gAIko raGga kasto hunuparcha bhanne kurA allAhalAI sodha | mUsA (alaihissalAma) le bhane– allAhale bhannubhayo– tyo nikkhara pahe~lo hos jasale sabailAI ekai najaramA mana paros |

70 tinIharUle ajhai vivAdalAI lambyAu~dai bhane– hAmro nimti Aphno pAlanakartAsita tyasa gAImA ajhai ke-ke vizeSatAharU hunuparcha bhanne kurAlAI spaSTa pAridinakA lAgi prArthanA garideU kinabhane hAmIle kuna gAIlAI vadha garauM bhanI chuTyAuna gAhro bhairaheko cha | allAhale cAhanubhaemA hAmI ThyAkkai cAhieko gAI bheTTAuna saknechauM |

71 mUsAle tinIharUlAI bhane– allAha bhannuhuncha– tyo gAI na kAmamA lagAieko hos; na kheta jotne ra na khetamA siMcAi garne kAmamA nai ra tyasamA pahelo raGgabAheka arU kunai raGga misieko nahos | tinIharUle bhane– timIle balla spaSTa guNa batAyau jasale gardA ThyAkkai cAhieko gAI cinna sajilo bhayo | antataH tinIharUle tyasalAI vadha gare jabaki tinIharU vAdavivAdako kAraNale yaso garne mAnasikatAmA thienan |

72 yAda gara jaba timIharUle eka janAko hatyA garI hatyAko Aropa eka-arkAmAthi lagAuna thAlekA thiyau ra AphUlAI tyasabATa bacAuna ApasamA jhagaDA garna thAlekA thiyau, tara timIharUle tyasa nirdoSako hatyAbAre juna kurA lukAirahekA thiyau allAhale tyasalAI avazya nai prakaTa garnuhunecha |

73 ani hAmIle bhanyauM– mRta vyaktilAI tyasa vadha garieko gAIko sinole hirkAU | allAhale tyasalAI jIvita pArnuhuncha ani usale hatyArAko bAremA bhanne cha | unIharUle tyastai gare, ani usale hatyArAbAre batAyo | allAhale jasarI tyasa murdAlAI jIvita pArnubhayo tyasarI nai mAnisaharUlAI mahApralayako dina jIvita pArnuhuncha | allAha Aphno sAmarthyakA pramANaharU dekhAunuhuncha tAki timIharUle vivekale kAma liera allAhamAthi pUrNa vizvAsa gara |

74 yI prabhAvakArI upadezaharU tathA spaSTa camatkAraharUpachi timIharUko hRdaya kaThora huna pugyo DhuGgA jastai vA tyobhandA pani kaThora; yinIharUko avasthAmA parivartana Au~daina jabaki DhuGgAharUmA parivartana Auna sakcha | kehI yastA DhuGgAharU pani hunchan jasabATa kholAharU bagirahekA hunchan ra kehIbATa pAnIko dhArA niskancha jasabATa mAnisa tathA janAvarale lAbha uThAu~chan | kehI allAhako bhayale pahADako ucAibATa jharirahekA hunchan | tara timIharUko dilamA kunai parivartana Airaheko dekhidaina | allAha timIharUko kriyAkalApabATa anabhijJa hunuhunna, uhA~ ta parokSako jJAna pani rAkhnuhuncha ra avazya nai timIharUko kAryako badalA dinuhuncha |

75 he mominaharU ho! yahUdIharUko avasthA ra zatrutA dekhepachi ke timIharUlAI azA cha, isrAIlakA santAnaharUle ImAna lyAunechan ra timIharUko kurA mAnnechan? jabaki kehI yahUdI dharmaguruharU yastA pani thie jasale taurAtamA allAhako vANIlAI bujhisakepachi pani jAnIjAnI tyasakA zabda ra arthaharUmA pherabadala garthe | tinIharU jAnIjAnI kati ThUlo aparAdha garirAkhekA chan |

76 yahUdIharUko virodhAbhASa tathA calakhela kasto cha bhane AsthAvAnaharUsa~ga bheTa hu~dA tinIharU bhanchan– muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) allAhakA saccA ra pakkA rasUla hun bhanne kurA hAmI mAnchauM, yasa kurAko puSTi taurAtale pani garcha | tara ekAntamA ApasamA bheTdA yasarI svIkAreko kurAprati eka arkAko nindA garchan, kinabhane muslimaharU yasai kurAlAI AdhAra banAera hAmrai viruddha tarka garchan ra muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) allAhakA saccA rasUla hun bhanne kurA pramANita garchan |

77 yI yahUdIharU kati calakhela garna jAnekA chan, tinIharUle gopya rAkhekA ra jAhera garekA kriyAkalApadekhi allAha anabhijJa hunuhunna | uhA~ cA~Dai yI kurAharU jAhera garera yahUdIharUlAI apamAnita garnuhuncha |

78 yahUdIharUmadhye euTA yasto samudAya pani cha jo taurAta paDhcha tara bujhdaina | yinIharUsa~ga agrajaharUbATa liekA jhuTA kurAharU mAtra chan | yinIharUle AphnA agrajaharUbATa liekA jhUTA kurAharUlAI nai allAhako tarphabATa avatarita taurAta ThAnekA chan |

79 barbAdI yastA mAnisaharUko pratIkSAmA cha jo Aphno hAtale taurAta lekhchan ani sAMsArika dhanasampatti tathA pada jasto tuccha lAbha prAptiko lAgi yo allAhako tarphabATa Aeko ho bhanera jhUTo bolchan | tinIharUkA hAtale allAha viruddha jhUTo kurA lekhekole ra yasabATa dhanasampatti tathA pada Arjana garekAle tinIharUkA lAgi barbAdI ra kaThora yAtanA cha |

80 tinIharUle jhUTo boldai tathA ghamaNDa gardai bhane– hAmIlAI narkako Agole kadApi chuna sakdaina; choihAlyo bhane pani kehI dinako lAgi mAtra ho | he nabI (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! yinIharUlAI sodhnuhos– ke timIharUle allAhasita kunai pakkA vAcA liekA chau ॽ yadi liekA chau bhane allAhale tyasako ullaGghana garnuhune chaina | vA allAhako bAremA yasto managaDhante kurA bhandaichau jasako jJAna timIharUlAI cha~dai chaina?
81 tinIharUle soce jasto kahA~ huncha ra! nissandeha allAhale kuphrako pApa kamAune tathA kukarmamA lipta rahane mAnisaharUlAI narkamA hAlera yAtanA dinuhuncha, jahA~ tinIharU sadhaiM rahane chan |
82 allAha ra uhA~kA rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) mAthi ImAna (AsthA) rAkhne tathA satkarma garne mAnisaharU svargamA praveza garnechan; jahA~ unIharU sadA rahane chan |

83 he isrAIlakA santAnaharU! hAmIle lieko tyasa pakkA vAcAlAI yAda gara, timIharU allAhabAheka anya kasaiko upAsanA garne chainau, AmA-buvA, nAtedAra, anAtha tathA dIna-duHkhIharUsa~ga rAmro vyavahAra garnechau, mAnisaharUsita mITho bolI bolnechau, namratA pUrvaka satkarmako Adeza dinechau, duSkarmabATa roknechau, hAmro Adeza anusAra pUrNarUpamA namAja kAyama garnechau ra khusI-khusI jakAta hakadAraharUsamma puryAunechau | tara pachi timIharU sabai hAmIle lieko vAcAbATa vimukha bhayau | a~ timIharUmadhye kehI vyaktiharUlAI allAhale jogAunu bhayo ani unIharUle allAhako lAgi vAcA purA gare |

84 yAda gara tyasa pakkA vacanalAI jo hAmIle timIharUsa~ga taurAtamA liekA thiyauM− timIharUle ApasamA raktapAta garne chainau tathA AphnA mAnisaharUlAI gharabATa nikAlne chainau | timIharUle yasalAI svIkArekA thiyau jo ThIka ho bhanne kurAko sAkSI timIharU AphaiM hau |

85 pheri timIharU nai hau jasale vacana bhaMga garera ekaarkAlAI hatyA garchau ra zatruharUko sahayogabATa Aphnai samudAyamAthi pApa evaM atyAcAra gardai ghara nikAlA garchau | tinIharU bandI bhaera Au~dA timIharU harjAnA tirera tinIharUlAI mukta pani garAu~chau, jabaki tinIharUlAI niSkAsita garnu nai timIharUkA nimti avaidha thiyo | timIharU kasarI kaidIharUlAI mukta garAera IzvarIya kitAbako kehI aMzamAthi AsthA rAkhdachau, ani raktapAta garera tathA tinIharUlAI tinIharUko gharabATa nikAlera kehI aMzaprati kuphra garchau?! yasto ghRNita kArya garnelAI duniyA~mA apamAna ta cha~daicha ra mahApralayako dina atyanta kaThora yAtanA diinecha | allAha timIharUle garne garekA kAryaharUbATa aceta hunuhunna | uhA~ tyasalAI rAmrarI jAnnuhuncha ra timIharUlAI tyasako badalA dinuhuncha |

86 yinIharU nai hun jasale Akhirata (paraloka) ko sATo sAMsArika jIvana kharida garekA chan ra sadAsarvadAko jIvanamAthi kSaNika maujalAI prAthamikatA diekA chan | AkhiratamA tinIharUko yAtanAmA na ta kamI garinecha, na kasaile tinIharUlAI sahayoga garnecha |

87 hAmIle sandeSTA mUsA (alaihissalAma) lAI taurAta pradAna garyauM | uhA~pachi lagAtAra rasUlaharU paThAirAkhyauM | maryama-putra IsA (alaihissalAma) lAI spaSTa camatkAraharU pradAna garyauM; jastai murdAlAI jIvita pArnu, koDha tathA kuSTha rogalAI niko pArnu | phariztA jibraIladvArA unalAI sahAyatA garyauM | tara, he isrAIlakA santAnaharU! timIharUko yo ke cAlA ho ki timIharUsamakSa kunai rasUla timro cAhanA viparIta kunai kurA liera Au~dA timIharUle jahile pani ghamaNDa garyau, ani kehI rasUlaharUlAI jhUTho Thahara garyau ra kehIko ta hatyA nai garidiyau |

88 hAmI muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) ko anusaraNa gardainauM bhanne kurAko yahUdIharUle ke tarka dinchan bhane– hAmro hRdaya kholamA banda cha, tyasamA kehI pani pasdaina, timIharU je bhanchau tyo hAmI bujhdainauM | vAstavikatA yo hoina, baru tinIharUko kuphrale gardA allAhale tinIharUlAI Aphno kRpAbATa vaMcita garnubhayo | tyasaile tinIharU allAhale avataraNa garnubhaeko AyataharUmA biralai ImAna (AsthA) lyAu~chan |

89 muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) ko Agamana aghi yaharUdIharU bhanne garthe− jaba muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) ko Agamana huncha taba hAmI uhA~mAthi ImAna lyAunechauM, uhA~ko anusaraNa garnechauM ra bahudevavAdIharUmAthi vijaya prApta garnechauM | taurAtamA ullekhita guNakA sAtha jaba muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) ko Agamana bhayo ra kurAna avatarita bhayo taba tinIharUle cinera pani nacine jasto gare ani jAnIjAnI inkAra gare | allAha tathA uhA~kA rasUla muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) lAI inkAra garneharUmAthi dhikkAra cha |

90 tinIharUle gareko saudAbAjI ekadamai tuccha cha | tinIharUle allAha tathA uhA~kA rasUla muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) mAthi ImAnako saTTAmA kuphralAI kharIda gare | tinIharUle allAhale avataraNa garnubhaekA kitabAlAI inkAra gare ra rasUlaharUlAI jhUTo Thahara gare | yo kurAna muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) mAthi avatarita irSyAle unIharUle asvIkAra gare | ataH tinIharU muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) ko inkAra ra yasaaghi taurAtamA pherabadala gareko kAraNale allAhako dobbara krodhako zikAra bhae | muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) ko Izadutatvako kAraNale yinIharU mahApralayako dina apamAnajanaka yAtanA bhognechan |

91 jaba yahUdIharUlAI allAhadvArA muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) mAthi avatarita satya dharma mAthi ImAna lyAuna bhanincha taba tinIharU bhanchan– hAmIle hAmrA sandeSTAharUmAthi avatarita kitAbamAthi mAtra ImAna rAkhchauM | yasarI tinIharU muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) mAthi avatarita kurAna ra satya dharmalAI inkAra garchan | yadyapi yo kurAna pUrNarUpamA satya ho ra tinIharUsa~ga rahekA kitAbaharUsa~ga mildojuldo ho | yadi tinIharU sA~ccikai tI kitAbaharUmA AsthA rAkhchan bhane tinIharUle yasa kurAnamA pani AsthA rAkhnu parne thiyo | he nabI (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! bhanidinuhos– yadi timIharU vAstavamA AsthAvAna hau bhane yasa aghikA sandeSTAharUko kina hatyA garyau, yadyapi unIharU nitAnta satya liera AekA thie?!

92 nissandeha timIharUkA rasUla mUsA (alaihissalAma) le timIharUsamakSa unI saccA hun bhanne spaSTa pramANaharU liera Ae, tara jaba unI kehI dinako lAgi aphnA pAlanakartAsita vAcA garieko sthAnamA gae, timIharUle bAchAlAI devatA banAera tyasako pUjA garna thAlyau | timIharUle zirka garera AphUmAthi atyAcAra garyau, jabaki allAha mAtra bhakti yogya hunuhuncha, uhA~ bAheka kohI bhakti yogya chaina |

93 yAda gara jaba hAmIle timIharUsa~ga pakkA vAcA liekA thiyauM− timIharUle sandeSTA mUsA (alaihissalAma) ra allAhabATa avatarita sampUrNa Adezako anusaraNa garnechau | hAmIle timIharUlAI DarAunako lAgi timIharUmAthi tUra nAmaka pahADalAI hAtamA uThAekA thiyauM ra Adeza diekA thiyauM− taurAtamA diiekA nirdezanalAI dRDhatApUrvaka samAta ra tyasamA rahekA kurAharUlAI svIkAra ra manan garne garI rAmrarI suna | yaso garenau bhane timIharUmAthi pahADa khasAli dinechauM | ani timIharUle bhanyau– hAmIle kAnale sunyauM tara avajJA garyauM | timIharUko kuphrale gardA nai bAchAko bhakti huna thAlyo | he nabI (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! bhanidinuhos– yadi timIharU AsthAvAna hau bhane, ke timIharUko AsthAle allAhako inkAra garna Adeza dincha ra! yadyapi saccA ImAna ra kuphra ekasAtha hunai sakdaina!

94 he nabI (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! bhanidinuhos– he yahUdIharU ho! yadi Akhiratako ghara (svarga) mA timIharU mAtra jAnchau ra anya mAnisaharU jA~dainan bhanne kurA ThAnekAchau ra timIharU Aphno yasa dAbImA saccA chau bhane timIharU mRtyuko kAmanA garera dekhAU, tAki timIharU saMsArakA cintA tathA samasyAharUbATa mukta bhaera svargamA arAmadAyI jIvana bitAU |

95 tara tinIharUle allAha ra rasUlaharUko inkAra ra kitAbaharUmA pherabadala jastA kukarmaharUle gardA kahilyai pani mRtyuko kAmanA garne chainan | allAha atyAcArIharUlAI rAmrarI jAnnuhuncha ra pratyekalAI karmaanusAra badalA dinuhuncha |

96 he nabI (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! euTA yahUdIle yo duniyA~mA jatisukai ghaTiyA jIvana yApana gare pani anya mAnisaharUbhandA baDhI bAcne tinIharU nai lAlAyita chan | baru muzrika (bahudevavAdI) harUbhandA pani baDhI, jo punarjanma (mRtyu pazcAtako jIvana) tathA hisAba kitAbamA AsthA rAkhdainan | jabaki yinIharU yahUdI ra IsAI punarjanma tathA hisAba kitAbamA AsthA rAkhchan | tinIharUmadhye pratyeka vyakti hajAra varSasamma bA~cna cAhancha | Ayu jati lAmo bhae pani usalAI allAhako yAtanAbATa bacAuna sakdaina | tinIharUle garirAkheko kriyAkalApadekhi allAha avagata hunuhuncha | uhA~bATa kunai pani cIja lukeko chaina ra uhA~le cA~Dai nai tyasako badalA dinuhuncha |

97 he nabI (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! phariztA (devadUta) harUmadhye jibrIla hAmro zatru ho bhanne yahUdIharUlAI bhanidinuhos– jo jibrIlako zatru ho usale thAhA pAirAkhos− jibrIlale nai allAhako AdezAnusAra yasa kurAnalAI mero hRdayamA avataraNa garekA hun, jasale pahiledekhi vidyamAna taurAta tathA injIla jastA kitAbaharUko puSTi gardacha | yo momina (AsthAvAna) harUlAI bhalAItarpha mArgadarzana garcha ra unIharUlAI allAhale tayAra pArnubhaeko svargako zubhasUcanA dincha | jibrIlasa~ga duzmanI garne mAnisaharU pathabhraSTa hun |

98 juna kAphiraharU allAha, uhA~kA phariztAharU, uhA~kA rasUlaharU tathA allAhakA duvai nikaTatama phariztA jibrIla evaM mIkAIlako zatru hun, allAha pani tyastA kAphiraharUko zatru hunuhuncha | jasale allAhasa~ga duzmanI garcha, U pakkai pani barbAda huncha |

99 he nabI (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! tapAIMko IzadUtatva tathA tapAIMlAI pradAna garieko vahI (prakAzanA) ko puSTi garna hAmIle tapAIMlAI spaSTa nizAnIharU pradAna garyauM | yastA spaSTa kurAko inkAra kAphiraharUle mAtra garchan |

100 yahUdIharUko beImAnIko euTA pramANa yo pani ho; jaba jaba tinIharUle vAcA gare, jastai taurAtamA varNana garie anusAra muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) ko IzadUtatvamAthi ImAna lyAunu, taba tinIharUmadhyeko euTA samUhale tyasalAI bhaGga garyo | vAstavamA tinIharUmadhye dheraijaso allAhale avataraNa garnubhaeko kitAbamA ImAna nai rAkhdainan, kinabhane tinIharUsa~ga ImAna bhaeko bhae vacana purA garnethie |

102 jaba tinIharUle allAhako satya dharmalAI choDe taba tyasako saTTAmA allAhako nabI sulaimAna (alaihissalAma) bAre zaitAnale bhaneko jhUTho kurAko anusaraNa garna thAle | sulaimAna (alaihissalAma) ko zAsana jAdU-mantaramAthi kAyama raheko kurA tinIharUle ThAne | sulaimAna (alaihissalAma) le kuphra garenan, jasto ki yahUdIharUle ThAnekA chan | zaitAnaharUle mAnisaharUlAI jAdU sikAera kuphra gare | irAkako bebIlonamA hArUta ra mArUta nAmaka duI janA phariztAharUmAthi mAnisaharUko parIkSAko lAgi avatarita jAdU zaitAnaharUle sikAu~the | duvaile kasailAI pani tyasako zikSA di~dA spaSTa pArne garthe– hAmI mAnisaharUkA lAgi parIkSA mAtra hauM, ataH yasalAI sikera kahilyai kuphra nagarnu | tI duvai phariztAharUko upadeza namAnneharUle jAdU sike | tinIharU jAdUko mAdhyamale zrImAna-zrImatIbIca jhagaDA lagAera sambandhaviccheda garna thAle | tI jAdUgaraharU allAhako anumatibinA kasailAI pani kunai hAni puryAuna sakdainathe | tinIharU tyo kurA sikdathe jo tinIharUkA lAgi hAnikAraka thiyo; lAbhadAyaka thiena | tI yahUdIharUlAI rAmrarI thAhA thiyo− jo allAhako kitAbako saTTAmA jAdUko anusaraNa garcha Akhirata (paraloka) mA usako lAgi kunai aMza hune chaina | allAhako kitAba ra islAmI kAnunako saTTAmA jAdUlAI anusaraNa garera tinIharUle AphUlAI kati tuccha mUlyamA becekA chan | spaSTa pathabhraStAmA pArne yasa kAryale tinIharUlAI kunai phAidA puryAena | yasa kurAlAI tinIharUle jAnekA bhae besa hunthyo |

103 yadi yahUdIharUle allAhamAthi pakkA ImAna lyAekA bhae, uha~ko Adezako AjJApAlana ra varjita kAryabATa jogiekA bhae, tinIharUle rAmro pratidAna pAune thie | tinIharUlAI phAidAkA kurAharU thAhA bhaidieko bhae besa hunthyo |

106 jaba allAhale kurAnako kunai Adeza vA kunai AyatalAI radda (mansukha) garnuhuncha, ani mAnisaharUle tyasalAI birsAi dinchan, taba uhA~le tyasako sthAnamA tyo bhandA utkRSTa vA kamasekama tyastai Adeza vA AyatalAI Aphno jJAna ra vivekale cA~Dai vA DhIlai lyAunuhuncha | he nabI! tapAIMlAI thAhai cha, allAha sabai kAryako sAmarthya rAkhnuhuncha, uhA~ je cAhanuhuncha garnuhuncha ra je cAhanuhuncha niNarya garnuhuncha |

107 he nabI! tapAIMlAI thAhai cha− AkAza ra dhartIkA pAlanakartA allAha nai hunuhuncha | uhA~ je cAhanuhuncha garnuhuncha | uhA~ AphnA bhaktalAI kehI kurAko Adeza dinuhuncha bhane kehI kurAbATa manAhI garnuhuncha | zarIata (vidhividhAna) madhye je cAhanuhuncha bA~kI rAkhnuhuncha ra je cAhanuhuncha radda garnuhuncha | suna, uhA~ bAheka timro mAmilA hala garne nata kohI timro mitra cha, nata timro du:kha ra pIDAlAI samApta pArne kohI sahayogI nai | baru timro heracAha ra sampUrNa kAma garne sAmarthya rAkhnevAlA allAha nai hunuhuncha |

108 he mominaharU ho! AphnA rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) sa~ga virodha ra Apattijanaka prazna garnu timIharUlAI suhAu~daina | suna, timIharU bhandA pahilA sandeSTA mUsA (alaihissalAma) ko samudAyale ‘hAmI allAhalAI sAkSAta dekhna cAhanchauM’ bhanera uhA~sita prazna garekA thie | (sUraha annisA- 153) jo kohI ImAnako saTTA kuphra (nAstika hunu) lAI AtmasAta garcha, U madhya mArgabATa pathabhraSTa huna pugcha |

109 dheraijaso yahUdI ra IsAIharU timIharUprati raheko DAhAko kAraNale ImAnapachi pani timIharUlAI punaH kuphra ra mUrti pUjAtirai pharkAuna cAhanchan | nabI (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) le prastuta garnubhaeko kurA satya ra allAhako tarphabATa ho bhanne spaSTa bhaisakdA pani tinIharU yasto kAmanA garchan | he mominaharU ho! allAhako Adeza naAesamma yinIharUkA kAlA kartuta, mUrkhatA tathA pApalAI kSamA garideU | allAhako Adeza Aipugyo, aba kAphiraharUle islAma, jijyA (surakSA kara) ra yuddhamadhye kunai euTA kurA cayana garnuparcha | nissandeha allAha sampUrNa kAryako zakti rAkhnuhuncha, tinIharUle uhA~lAI kahilyai pani hairAna pArna sakdainan |

allAhale kaSTamA dhairya garne Adeza diepachi aba islAma dharmamA aDiga rahane tathA ImAnalAI baliyo pArne Adeza diMdai bhannuhunchaH
110 pUrNarUpamA salAha (namAja) kAyama gara | Aphno dhanasampattibATa jakAta nikAlera hakadAra vyaktiharUsamma puryAU | jIvanamA jejati satkarma garchau tyasako pratiphala allAhakahA~ mahApralayako dina pAunechau | nissandeha timIharUle garirAkheko kurAdekhi allAha avagata hunuhuncha, uhA~ harekalAI karma anusAra avazya badalA dinuhunecha |

111 yahUdI ra IsAIharU ke dAbI garchan bhane svarga vizeSarUpamA tinIharUkai lAgi ho | yahUdIharUle bhane– hAmIharU mAtra svargamA praveza garnechauM ra IsAIharUle bhane– hAmIharU mAtra svargamA praveza garnechauM | yI yinakA jhUTA kAmanA ra vyartha vicAra mAtra hun | he nabI! tinIharUko khaNDana gardai bhanidinuhos– yadi timIharU Aphno dAbImA saccA chau bhane AphnA pramANaharU prastuta gara |

112 jasale mAtra allAhako lAgi nabI sallallAhu alaihi va sallamako anusaraNa gardai rAmro tarikAle satkarma garekA hunchan, tinIharU nai svargamA praveza garnechan, cAhe unako sambandha juna sukai samudAyasa~ga hos | yasto vyaktile allAhakahA~ Aphno pratiphala pAunecha | Akhiratadekhi usalAI kunai Dara hunechaina ra duniyA~mA gumAekA kurAharUprati kunai pachuto hunechaina | smaraNa rahos, antima sandeSTA muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) ko Agamanapachi yI guNaharU mAtra muslimaharUmA pAinchan |

113 yahUdIharU bhanchan– IsAIharU sahI dharmamA chainan | IsAIharU bhanchan– yahUdIharU sahI dharmamA chainan | yadyapi harekale Aphno dharmagrantha pATha gardA eka arkAlAI adharmI nabhanna ra binA vibheda sampUrNa nabIharUmAthi ImAna rAkhna Adeza pAu~chan | tyasobhae tinIharUmA ra tI muzarika (bahudevavAdI) harUmA ke pharaka bhayo jasale sampUrNa rasUla tathA allAhadvArA avatarita kitAbaharUlAI jhUTo Thahara gare | tyasaile mahApralayako dina allAhale tinIharUmA nyAya-nisAphakA sAtha phaisalA garnuhunecha | allAhale pahilA nai sUcita garnubhaeko cha−uhA~le avataraNa garnubhaeko sampUrNa kurAharUmAthi ImAna rAkhneharU mAtra saphala hunechan |

114 sabai bhandA ThUlA atyAcArI tI vyaktiharU hun, jo allAhakA ghara (masjida) harUmA uhA~kai nAma linamA bAdhA puryAu~chan, mAnisaharUlAI salAha (namAja) kAyama garna, jikra garna, tilAvata garna, bhakti ityAdibATa manAhI garchan ra tI masjidaharUlAI dhvasta pArera naSTa pArchan | tinIharU ta masjidamA praveza pAune yogya nai thienan; praveza garihAle pani DarAera basun | tinIharU duniyA~mA mominaharUko hAtabATa apamAnita hunchan bhane paralokamA kaThora yAtanA bhognechan |

115 pUrvadekhi pazcimasamma sArA jagatamA allAhakai zAsana caldaicha | uhA~le AphnA bhaktaharUlAI je jasto Adeza cAhanuhuncha dinuhuncha | jatAtira anuhAra pharkAu~chau tyasaitarpha allAhalAI pAunechau | baitul-makdisa vA kiblAtira anuhAra pharkAunu vA kiblA katAtira cha bhanne kurA jAnnamA galtI garchau vA kiblAtarpha anuhAra pharkAuna apThyAro huncha bhane kunai Apatti chaina, kinabhane sabai dizAharUkA pAlanakartA allAha nai hunuhuncha | nissandeha allAha ekadamai vizAla hunuhuncha | AphnA bhaktaharUlAI sahajatA pradAna garna cAhanuhuncha | uhA~ bhaktaharUko manasAya tathA karmaharUsita avagata hunuhuncha |

116 yahUdI, IsAI tathA bahudevavAdIharUle bhane– allAhale santAna grahaNa garnubhaeko cha | yo vAhiyAta kuro ho, uhA~ yasto kAryabATa pavitra tathA mahAna hunuhuncha | uhA~ ekadamai sampanna hunuhuncha ra uhA~lAI santAna grahaNa garne kehI AvazyakatA nai chaina | khA~co bhaekole po santAna grahaNa garcha | AkAza ra dhartI tathA tyasamA bhaekA sabai prANI ra cIjabIjaharU uhA~kai dAsa hun | uhA~ jasarI cAhanuhuncha rAja garnuhuncha |

117 allAhale binA kunai udAharaNa yI vizAla AkAzaharU, dhartI tathA tyasamA rahekA sampUrNa cijabIjaharUlAI sRSTi garnubhayo | uhA~ jaba kunai kArya garna cAhanuhuncha, taba ‘bhaihAla’ bhanera Adeza dinuhuncha ani ThyAkkai uhA~le soce jastai tathA khoje jastai hunapugcha | uha~ko nirNaya tathA AdezalAI ullaGghana garne A~Ta kasailAI pani chaina |

118 ajJAnI yahUdI, IsAI tathA bahudevavAdIharUle nitAnta satyaprati zatrutA vyakta gardai bhanchan– allAha hAmIsa~ga pratyakSa kina kurAkAnI garnuhunna vA hAmrai lAgi kunai dekhine cinha ra nizAnIharU kina paThAunu hunna? aghillA rasUlaharUlAI namAnne samudAyaharUle pani yastai kurA garekA thie | yinIharU sabai chuTTA chuTTai yuga tathA sthAnaharUmA bhae pani yinIharU bhitra rahekA avajJA, jiddI tathA zatrutAmA AdhArita manovRtti samAna cha | satyamA vizvAsa rAkhne mAnisaharUkA lAgi hAmIle dherai nizAnIharU prastuta garekA chauM | unIharU satya spaSTa bhaepachi zaMkA nagarikana bhitrI manale turuntai svIkAra garchan |

119 he nabI! hAmIle tapAIMlAI satya dharma (islAma) diera paThAekA chauM, jasamA zaMkA garne kunai ThAu~ nai chaina | mominaharUlAI svargako zubhasUcanA dinuhos ra kAphiraharUlAI narkabATa DarAunuhos | tapAIMko jimmevArI islAmatarpha ahvAna garnu mAtra ho | islAma dharmamA vizvAsa nagarera narkamA jAne mAnisaharUko sambandhamA tapAIMsa~ga kunai sodhapucha garine chaina |

120 allAha AphnA nabI (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) lAI sambodhana tathA sAvadhAna gardai bhannuhuncha− jabasamma tapAIMle islAma dharma choDera yahUdI ra IsAI dharma anusaraNa garnuhunna tabasamma tinIharU tapAIMsa~ga paTakkai khusI hune chainan | bhanidinuhos– nissandeha allAhako kitAba ra tyasamA raheko zikSA nai asala mArgadarzana ho | tinIharU juna dharmako anusaraNa gardaichan tyo nitAnta asatya ho | yo spaSTa satya Aisakepachi yadi tapAIMle vA tapAIMkA anuyAyIharUmadhye kasaile tinIharUko anusaraNa garcha bhane allAhabATa kunai sahayega ra saMrakSaNa pAunuhunna | satya dharmalAI choDera jhUTo dharmalAI apanAunuko duSpariNAma yahI huncha |

121 yahUdI ra IsAImadhye euTA yasto samUha cha jasale allAhako kitAbalAI rAmrarI samAtcha, ani pUrNa tarikAle anusaraNa garcha | muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) saccA sandeSTA hun bhanne kurAko pramANa pAepachi uhA~mAthi jhaTTa ImAna (AsthA) lyAu~cha | tara arko yasto jiddI garne samUha cha, jo ahilesamma kuphramai aljhera ghATAmA cha |

122 he isarAIlakA santAnaharU ho! maile timIharUlAI pradAna gareko dhArmika tathA sAMsArika varadAnalAI yAda gara | maile timIharUko vaMzamA nubuvvata (IzadUtatva) ra zAsana pradAna garera anya vyaktiharUmAthi dieko prAthamikatAlAI pani yAda gara |

124 tyasa samayalAI yAda gara, jaba allAhale ibrAhIma (alaihissalAma) lAI kehI Adeza tathA jimmevArIharU diera parIkSA linubhayo ra unI tyasamA pUrNarUpamA saphala bhae | allAhale Aphno sandeSTA ibrAhIma (alaihissalAma) lAI bhannubhayo– ma timIlAI mAnavako lAgi imAma (aguvA) ra euTA namunA banAuna cAhanchu, tAki mAnisaharUle karma tathA AcaraNamA timro anusaraNa garun | ibrAhIma (alaihissalAma) le bhane– he merA pAlanakartA! merA santatilAI pani aguvA banAi dinuhos tAki mAnisaharUle tinIharUko anusaraNa garun | uhA~le javAphamA bhannubhayo– timro santAnamadhye atyAcArIharUle islAmako imAma (aguvA) banna sakne chainan |

125 tyasa samayalAI yAda gara, jaba allAhale kAbAlAI mAnisaharUkA lAgi kendra bindu ra DhukaDhukI banAunubhayo | tyahA~bATa pherkepachi punaH kAbAko darzana garne manamA cAhanA hos | bhaktajanaharUmAthi jyAdatI nahos bhanera allAhale tyo pavitra ThAu~lAI zAnti-sthala ghoSaNA garnubhayo | uhA~le Adeza dinubhayo− juna DhuMgAmAthi caDhera ibrAhIma (alaihissalAma) le kAbAko nirmANa garnubhayo, tyasalAI salAha (namAja) paDhne sthAna banAU | hAmIle ibrAhIma evaM unakA chorA ismAIla (alaihimassalAma) lAI masjide harAmalAI tavApha (parikramA), eatikApha (ekAntamA upAsanA), rUkUa (jhukne) tathA sajdA (daNDavat) garne bhaktajanaharUkA lAgi sabai khAle phohorabATa pavitra rAkhna upadeza diyauM |

128 he hAmrA pAlanakartA! hAmI duvai janAlAI saccA muslima banAunuhos ra hAmrA santatiharUmadhye euTA AjJAkArI samudAya banAunuhos | hAmIlAI upAsanAko vidhi sikAi dinuhos, ani hAmro taubA (prAyazcita) svIkAra garnuhos | nissandeha tapAIM taubA svIkAra garnuhuncha ra AphnA bhaktaharUprati param dayAlu hunuhuncha |

129 he hAmrA pAlanakartA! unIharUko mArgadarzanako lAgi sandeSTA ismAIla (alaihissalAma) ko santAnabATa rasUla (sandeSTA) paThAunuhos, jasale unIharUlAI tapAIMle avataraNa garnubhaekA AyataharU paDhera sunAun; kurAna tathA sunnatakA zikSA deun, zirka tathA anya sabai kisimakA phohorabATa unIharUlAI pavitra pArun | nissandeha tapAIM zaktizAlI ra AphnA kArya tathA AdezaharUmA tatvadarzI hunuhuncha |

130 ibrAhIma (alaihissalAma) ko dharma (islAma) lAI choDera anya dharmaharUlAI aMgAlneharU mUrkha, pathabhraSTa, atyAcArI tathA apamAnalAI manaparAuneharU mAtra hun | nissandeha hAmIle unalAI duniyA~mA rasUla tathA ghaniSTa mitrako rUpamA cayana garekA thiyauM ra unI Akhirata (paraloka) mA AphnA jimmevArIharUlAI purA garera ucca sthAna prApta garekA satkarmIharUmadhye hunechan |

131 islAmalAI AtmasAta gardA dekhAeko agratAle gardA allAhale ibrAhIma (alaihissalAma) lAI tyatibelA cayana garnubhayo, jatikhera pAlanakartAle unalAI bhannubhayo– mAtra mero bhakti gara ra mero sampUrNa Adezako pAlanA gara | ibrAhImale javAphamA bhane– maile allAhaprati AphUlAI samarpita garidie~ | tapAIM nai sabai bhaktaharUkA sRSTikartA, pAlanakartA tathA prabandhaka hunuhuncha |

132 ibrAhIma (alaihissalAma) le AphnA santAnaharUlAI ke upadeza diekA thie bhane maile AphUlAI sampUrNa jagatakA pAlanakartA samakSa samarpita gareM | yAkUba (alaihissalAma) le pani AphnA santAnaharUlAI yasai vANIko upadeza diekA thie | duvai janAle AphnA santAnaharUlAI bhane– he merA santAna! allAhale timrA lAgi islAma dharma rojnubhaeko cha, tyasaile timIharU marunjela vAhya tathA Antarika duvairUpamA AjJAkArI (muslima) bhaera yasa dharmalAI samAti rAkha |

133 ke timIharU sandeSTA yAkUbako mRtyu bakhata upasthita thiyau? unale AphnA santAnaharUlAI sodhekA thie– timIharU mero mRtyupazcAta kasako upAsanA garnechau? unIharUle javAphamA bhanekA thie– hAmIharU eka mAtra allAhako bhakti garnechauM, jasako kohI sAjhedAra chaina, jasako bhakti tapAIM tathA tapAIMkA pUrvajaharU ibrAhIma, ismAIla evaM ishAka (alaihimussalAma) le gardai Aunubhaeko cha | hAmI uhA~kai AjJAkArI banera uhA~prati samarpita bhaekA chauM |

134 tyo euTA samudAya thiyo jo anya samudAya jhaiM bitisakyo | unIharUle garne garekA rAmrA, narAmrA karmako phala unIharUlAI ra timIharUle garne garekA rAmrA, narAmrA karmako phala timIharUlAI nai prApta hunecha | unIharUle garne garekA karmabAre timIharUsa~ga ra timIharUle garne garekA karmako bAremA tinIharUsa~ga sodhine chaina | kasaile kasaiko pApako bhArI bokne chaina | pratyeka vyaktile AphUle gareko karmako badalA pAunecha | arUle gareko karmamA cAso naleU, baru Aphno karmamA dhyAna deU | tyo dina allAhako dayA binA kunai mAnisako satkarmale phAIdA puryAune chaina |

135 yahUdI muslimaharUlAI bhanchan– yahUdI bana, ani mAtra satyamArga pAunechau | IsAI bhanchan− IsAI bana, ani mAtra sIdhA mArga pAunechau | he nabI! bhanidinuhos– hAmI yI sabai jhuTA dharma choDera ibrAhIma (alaihissalAma) ko satya dharmako anusaraNa garnechauM | unI eka mAtra allAhako bhaktimA ekAgra thie ra uhA~sa~ga kasailAI sAjhedAra Thahara gardainathe |

136 he mominaharU ho! yastA jhuTA dAbI garne yahUdI ra IsAIlAI bhana– hAmI eka allAha ra kurAnamAthi ImAna (AsthA) lyAyauM | tyasaigarI ibrAhIma, ismAIla, ishAka, yAkUba evaM yAkUbakA santAnaharUmAthi avatarita granthamAthi ImAna lyAyauM | mUsA (alaihissalAma) lAI pradAna garieko taurAta, IsA (alaihissalAma) lAI pradAna garieko injIla tathA anya sabai sandeSTAharUlAI pradAna gariekA kitAbaharUmAthi ImAna (AsthA) lyAyauM | hAmI yinIharUbIca kunai bheda bhAva gardainauM | kehImAthi ImAna rAkhne ra anya kehImAthi narAkhne gardainauM, baru sabaimAthi ImAna rAkhchauM | hAmI allAhakA saccA ra AjJAkArI bhakta hauM |

137 yadi yahUdI, IsAI tathA anya kAphiraharUle timIharUle jhaiM ImAna lyAe bhane allAhale mana parAunubhaeko satmArga prApta garnechan | yadi tinIharUle sabai nabI vA kehI nabIlAI jhUTo Thahara garera ImAnabATa vimukha bhae bhane vibheda tathA vidrohamA parnechan | he nabI! cintita nahunuhos, tapAIMkA lAgi allAha nai paryApta hunuhuncha | uhA~le tinIharUkA duSkarmabATa bacAera sahayoga garnuhuncha | uhA~ tinIharUkA kurAkAnIlAI sunnuhuncha ra tinIharUkA manasAya tathA karmaharUlAI jAnnuhuncha |

138 allAhako dharmalAI vAhya tathA Antarika pUrNatAkA sAtha grahaNa gara | vAstavamA, allAhako dharma (islAma) bhandA utkRSTa arU kunai dharma cha~dai chaina | yo nai prAkRtika dharma ho | hareka kisimakA phAidAjanaka kurAlAI vaidha gareko cha tathA hareka kisimakA galata kurAlAI avaidha gareko cha | he AsthAvAnaharU ho, bhanideU−hAmI ta mAtra eka allAhako upAsanA garchauM ra uhA~sa~ga kasailAI sAjhedAra Thahara gardainauM |

139 he nabI! bhanidinuhos– he yahUdI ra IsAI! ke timIharU allAhako sambandhamA hAmIsita jhagaDA garchau, timIharUko dharma ra grantha purAno bhaekole allAha tathA uhA~kA dharmako baDhI hakadAra chau bhanne dAbI garchau | jabaki uhA~ hAmro pani pAlanakartA hunuhuncha ra timIharUko pani | yasto dAbIle timIharUlAI kunai phAidA diMdaina kinabhane allAha mAtra timro hoina, hAmro pani pAlanakartA hunuhuncha | hAmro lAgi hAmrA karmaharU chan, jasako bAremA timIharUsita sodhapucha hunechaina ra timro lAgi timrA karmaharU chan, jasako bAremA hAmIsa~ga sodhapucha hunechaina | sabailAI usako karmaanusAra badalA diinecha | hAmI ta uhA~ko mAtra bhakti garchauM ra uhA~sa~ga kasailAI sAjhedAra banAu~dainauM |

140 he yahUdI ra IsAI ho! ke timIharU ibrAhIma, ismAIla, ishAka, yAkUba tathA yAkUbakA santAnamA AekA sandeSTAharU (alaihimussalAma) yahUdI dharma vA IsAI dharma mAndathe bhanne dAbI garchau? he nabI (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama! bhanidinuhos– ke timIharU allAha bhandA baDhI jAnakAra chau? yadi tinIharU yasto dAbI garchan bhane tinIharU jhUTo bolchan | kinabhane unako Agamana ta taurAta tathA injIlako avataraNabhandA pahilai bhaeko thiyo! tyaso bhae tiniharU jhUTo boldai allAhabATa prApta satyatAlAI lukAu~dai chan | spaSTa gavAhI lukAune vyaktibhandA ThUlo atyAcArI arU ko holA? allAha timIharUle garirahekA karmaharUbATa anabhijJa hunuhunna, uhA~le timIharUlAI tyasako sajAya avazya dinuhunecha |

141 tyo euTA samUha thiyo jo timIharU bhandA aghi bitisakyo | unIharUkA karmako phala unIharUlAI nai prApta hunecha ra timIharUko karmako phala timIharUlAI nai | timIharUsa~ga unIharUko bAremA ra unIharUsa~ga timIharUko bAremA kehI sodhinechaina | kasaile gareko pApako saTTA anya kasaiko pakaDa hunechaina, tyastai kasaile gareko satkarmako phAidA anya kasailAI hu~daina | baru sabaile AphUle garekai karmako badalA pAunechan |

142 yahUdI tathA munAphika madhyekA manda buddhi bhaekA vyaktiharUle bhannechan– muslimaharU ta pahilA baitul-makdisatarpha pharkera namAja paDhne garthe, aba kina tyasalAI choDera kAbAtarpha pharkera paDhna thAlekA chan? he nabI! yinIharUlAI javAphamA bhannuhos– pUrva tathA pazcima lagAyata sampUrNa dizAharUkA pAlanakartA allAha nai hunuhuncha | uhA~le AphnA bhaktaharUlAI jatAtira cAhanuhuncha pharkAunu huncha | ho, uhA~le AphnA bhaktaharUmadhye jasalAI cAhanuhuncha, sIdhA mArga dekhAunu huncha, jasamA kunai TeDhopana chaina |

143 jasarI hAmIle rojeko kiblA timIharUlAI pradAna garyauM tyasarI nai timIharUlAI sampUrNa samudAyaharUmadhye AsthA, bhakti tathA mAmilAmA madhyamArgI banAyauM | sAthai nyAya premI ra utkRSTa samudAyako rUpamA rojyauM | rasUlaharUle mAnisaharU samakSa allAhako sandezalAI rAmrarI puryAi die bhanne kurAko timIharU mahApralayako dina sAkSI hoau | tyasaigarI muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) le allAhako sandeza timIharU samakSa rAmrarI puryAunu bhayo bhanne kurAko sAkSI bannuhunecha | timIharUmadhye kasale rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) ko anusaraNa tathA AjJApAlana gardai zarIatako pAbandI garcha ra kasale manaparI tathA zarIatako ullaGghana gardai islAma dharmabATa vimukha (murtada) huncha bhanne kurAlAI jAnnako lAgi kiblA parivartana gariyo | vAstavamA yo kiblA parivartana mominaharUkA lAgi sajilo thiyo, tara anya mAnisaharUkA lAgi kaThina kArya thiyo | smaraNa rahos, allAhako hareka AdezamA kehI na kehI tatvadarzitA lukeko huncha | timIharUko allAhamAthiko ImAna tathA purAno kiblAtarpha pharkera paDhekA namAjaharUlAI allAhale kadApi khera phAlnuhunna | uhA~ mAnavaprati atyanta snehI ra parama dayAlu hunuhuncha | na ta uhA~ kasaimAthi baDhI bojha hAlnuhuncha na kasaiko satkarmalAI khera phAlnuhuncha |

144 he nabI! kiblA parivartana hos bhanne manazAyale ghari-ghari AkAzatira hernu ra vahI (prakAzanA) ko pratikSA garnulAI hAmIle dekhisakyauM | tapAIMlAI mana parne kiblA (masjide harAma) lAI nizcaya nai hAmIle nirdhArita garnechauM ani tapAIMko anuhAra tyasaitarpha pharkAi dinechauM | lau ta abadekhi Aphno anuhAralAI baitul-makdisabATa haTAera makkAmA avasthita masjide harAma tira pharkAunuhos | he AsthAvAnaharU ho! timIharU jahA~sukai bhae pani salAha paDhdA Aphno anuhAra tyasaitarpha gara | kiblA parivartana, allAhakai Adezale bhaeko kurA yahUdI ra IsAIlAI rAmrarI thAhA cha, kinabhane yo kurA tinIharUko kitAbamA lekhieko cha | yinIharUko calakhela ra aniyamitatAbATa allAha anabhijJa hunuhunna | uhA~lAI sabai thAhA cha ra uhA~ tinIharUkA karmako badalA cA~Dai nai dinuhuncha |

145 he nabI! kiblA parivartana satya ho bhanne kurA prAmANita garnako lAgi yahUdI ra IsAIharUlAI junasukai nizAnI ra jati pramANa lyAe pani tinIharUle zatrutA tathA ghamaNDale gardA tapAIMko kiblAko anusaraNa kadApi garne chainan | aba tapAIMle pani tinIharUko kiblAko anusaraNa garna sambhava chaina | na tinIharUle ApasamA ekaarkAko kiblAko anusaraNa garnechan | kinabhane harekale ekaarkAlAI kAphira ThAndachan | satya spaSTa bhaisakepachi pani tapAIMle kiblA vA anya islAmI kurAmA tinIharUko anusaraNa garnubhayo bhane nizcaya nai tapAIM pani atyAcArIharUmadhye hunuhunecha | yo AyatamA uhA~lAI sambodhana garera uhA~ko anuyAyIlAI zikSA diieko cha, kinabhane allAhale uhA~lAI yastA kAryabATa surakSita rAkhnubhaeko cha |

146 IzavarIya kitAba pAekA yahUdI ra IsAI dharmaguruharU kiblA parivartana prasa~galAI tyasarI nai cindachan, jasarI AphnA santAnaharUlAI cindachan | kinabhane kiblA parivartana hunu muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) ko nubuvvata (IzdUtatva) ko mahatvapUrNa cinha ho | tara tinIharUmadhye euTA samUha jAnIjAnI mAtra DAhAko kAraNale yasa satya tathyalAI lukAu~chan |
147 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! yahI satya ho, tapAIM yasamA paTakkai sandeha nagarnuhos |

148 pratyeka samudAyako euTA dizA huncha, juna dizAtira unIharU pharkane gardachan, cAhe tyo vAhya hos vA Antarika | vibhinna samudAyako kiblA tathA zarIata allAhako Adezale alaga-alaga cha bhane kehI pharaka pardaina | he mominaharU ho! satkarma garnamA agrasaratA dekhAU | timIharU jahA~sukai bhae pani allAhale sabailAI mahApralayako dina ekatrita garnuhunecha ani timIharUko karmako badalA dinuhunecha | nissandeha allAha sampUrNa kAryaharUko sAmarthya rAkhnuhuncha | timIharUlAI ekatrita garna tathA badalA dinamA uhA~lAI kunai kaThinAI hu~daina |

149 he nabI! tapAIM tathA tapAIMkA anuyAyIharU jahA~sukaibATa niske pani ra jahA~ bhae pani salAha (namAja) paDhdA Aphno anuhAra masjide harAma (kAbA) tarpha pharkAunuhos | nissandeha yo allAhako tarphabATa Aeko Adeza ra nitAnta satya ho | allAha timIharUle garirahekA kAryaharUbATa anabhijJa hunuhunna, baru uhA~ avagata hunuhuncha ra timIharUlAI rAmro badalA dinuhunecha |

150 he nabI! ra he mominaharU ho! tapAIMharU jahA~sukaibATa niske pani ra jahA~ bhae pani salAha (namAja) kAyama garne nIyata gardA Aphno anuhAra masjide harAma (kAbA) tarpha pharkAunuhos | tAki mAnisaharUkA lAgi timIharU viruddha kunai tarka bA~kI narahos | tara atyAcArIharU Aphno zatrutAmA kAyama chan ra timIharU viruddha ekadamai kamajora pramANale tarka vitarka garirahanechan | tara tinIharUsita naDarAU | allAhako Adezako pAlanA garera ra uhA~le manAhI garnubhaeko kAma tyagera mAtra Aphno saccA pAlanakartAsa~ga DarAU | kAbAlAI kiblA banAera uhA~le timIharUmAthi Aphno varadAna purA garnubhayo ra sabai bhandA rAmro kiblA pradAna garera timIharUlAI anya samudAyamAthi zreSThatA pradAna garnubhayo |

151 hAmIle timIharU madhyebATa eka janA rasUla muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) lAI paThAera arko upakara garyauM | jasale timIharUlAI hAmrA AyataharU paDhera sunAunuhuncha, satkarmako Adeza dinuhuncha ra duSkarmabATa roknuhuncha, kurAna ra sunnatako zikSA dinuhuncha ra timIharUlAI thAhai nabhaekA bhautika tathA AdhyAtmika kurAharU sikAunuhuncha |

152 timIharU tana manale malAI yAda gara, ma timIharUmAthi dayAko varSAta garne chu ra timIharUlAI zaraNa diera samjhI rAkhchu | jati rAmro garnechau, tyati rAmro badalA pAu~nechau | merA varadAnaharUprati AbhAra prakaTa gara ra tyasalAI inkAra vA harAma kAma garera baigunIpana nadekhAU |

153 he mominaharU ho! salAha (namAja) tathA dhairyadvArA mero ibAdata ra AjJApAlana garera maddata prApta gara | nissandeha allAha dhairyavAnaharUkA sAtha hunuhuncha | unIharUlAI satkarma garne kSamatA pradAna garnuhuncha ra maddata garnuhuncha |

154 he mominaharU ho! allAhako mArgamA jihAda (dharma-yuddha) gardA zahIda huneharUlAI murdA nabhana | unIharU allAhakahA~ jIvita chan | tara timIharU tyasako vAstavikatAlAI mahasusa garna sakdainau | kinabhane tinIharUko jIvanako vAstavikatA vahI (prakAzanA) binA thAhA pAuna sakinna |

155 hAmIle nizcaya nai vibhinna prakArakA saMkaTadvArA timIharUko parIkSA linechauM, jastai zatruharUko trAsa, khAne kurAko abhAva, garibI vA kamAimA kaThinAile gardA dhanasampattimA kamI, prAkRtika prakopale gardA mRtyu vA yuddhamA zahAdatale gardA jyAnako kamI, jaminabATa umrane anAja tathA phalaphUlako kamI | he nabI! yI saMkaTaharUmA dhairya garneharUlAI loka ra paraloka duvai ThAu~mA khusI pArne zubhasUcanA sunAunuhos |

156 jasale yI saMkaTaharUmadhye kunai saMkaTa pardA khusIkA sAtha samarpaNa gardai bhanne garchan– nissandeha hAmI allAhakai adhInamA chauM, uhA~le jasarI cAhanuhuncha hAmIlAI prayoga garnuhuncha | mahApralayako dina uhA~tarpha nai pharkera jAnechauM | uhA~le nai hAmIlAI sRSTi garnubhayo, nAnAtharIkA varadAnaharU dinubhayo ra antataH uhA~tarpha nai pharkera jAnucha |
157 yastA guNaharU bhaekA mAnisaharUko prazaMsA allAhale phariztAharUko bIcamA garnuhuncha, unIharUmAthi kRpAko varSA huncha ra unIharUle nai mArgadarzana pAekA chan |

158 nissandeha kAbA najika rahekA saphA ra marvA nAmaka duIvaTA prasiddha pahADaharU allAhakA cinArIharU madhyekA hun | jo pani haja vA umrAko nIyata garera allAhako ghara kAbA jAne garcha, usale yadi yI duvai pahADabIca dagurcha bhane usalAI kunai pApa lAgdaina | pApa lAgdaina bhanne kurA yasa kAraNale bhanieko cha, kehI muslimaharU yasalAI islAma pUrva garine kAma ThAnera yasalAI pApa ThAndathe | yahA~ tyasai kurAko radda garieko cha ra spaSTa pArieko cha, yo hajako aMza ho, yasamA pApa hoina puNya milcha | allAha atyanta dayAlu hunuhuncha, jasale nisvArtha bhaera satkarma garcha uhA~le tyasalAI svIkAra garera tyasako purA badalA dinuhuncha | uhA~ sarvajJa hunuhuncha, kasale kuna satkarma gareko cha ra ko kati puNyako hakadAra cha bhanne kurA rAmrarI jAnnuhuncha |

159 yahUdI, IsAI ityAdi lagAyata jasale muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) allAhakA saccA sandeSTA hun bhanne khullA pramANaharUlAI lukAu~chan, jabaki tI kurAharU tinIharUko kitAbamA spaSTasa~ga lekhieko cha, tyastA mAnisaharUlAI allAhale Aphno kRpAbATa TADhA pArnuhuncha | tyasaigarI allAha, phariztA, sandeSTA tathA sabai mAnisaharUle pani tyastAlAI dhikkArne garchan ra zrApa dinchan |

160 tara tinIharUmadhye jo taubA garchan, galtIprati pachuto garchan, vAhya tathA Antarika karmaharUko sudhAra garchan ra lukAekA satya tathA mArgadarzana spaSTasa~ga varNana garchan, tyastA mAnisaharUko taubA ma svIkAra garnechu | ma taubA svIkAra garnevAlA tathA param dayAlu hu~ |

161 kuphra (avajJA) kai avasthAmA taubA nagarikana kasaile mRtyuvaraNa gare tinIharUmAthi allAha, phariztAharU tathA sampUrNa mAnavajAtiko dhikkAra tathA sarApa cha | allAhako kRpAbATa tinIharU TADhA houn bhanne sarApa dinchan |
162 tinIharU dhikkAriekai avasthAmA sadAsarvadA rahane chan | tinIharUko yAtanA eka dinako lAgi pani kamI hunechaina, na tinIharUlAI mahApralayako dina kunai chuTa nai milnecha |

163 he mAnava! timIharUko Izvara eka mAtra allAha hunuhuncha | uhA~ Aphno astitva tathA guNamA ekalai hunuhuncha | uhA~ bAheka kohI upAsya chaina | uhA~ atyanta dayAvAna tathA parama kRpAvAna hunuhuncha, tyasaile AphnA bhaktaharUmAthi anaganti kRpA garnubhaeko cha |

164 nizcaya nai AkAza ra dhartIko sRSTi, tyasamA rahekA anauThA sRSTiharU, rAtale dinalAI ra dinale rAtalAI pachyAune krama, khAne kurA, vastra tathA mAnisaharUkA lAgi khAne kurA, lugA, vyApAra tathA anya lAbhadAyaka sAmagrIharU liera samudramA hi~Dne DuGgAharU, AkAzabATa allAhale barsAeko pAnI jasabATa uhA~le murdA bhUmilAI jIvita pArnuhuncha, dhartImA aneka prakArakA bAlI nAlIlAI umArnu, vibhinna kisimakA jIva-jantu, vibhinna dizAmA hAvA calnu tathA AkAza evaM pRthvIbIca niyantraNamA rAkhiekA bAdalamA allAha eka mAtra hunuhuncha bhanne kurAko pramANa tathA nizAnIharU chan‌, yastA buddhimAna mAnisaharUkA lAgi jo pramANamA vicAra garchan ra tarkalAI bujhchan |

165 yati spaSTa nizAnIharUkA bAvajuda kehI mAnisaharU arUlAI allAhako sAjhedAra banAu~chan ra tinIharUlAI yasarI prema garchan, jasarI allAhalAI mAtra garnu parne ho | tara mominaharU allAhalAI sabai bhandA baDhI prema garchan | uhA~sa~ga kasailAI sAjhedAra Thahara gardainan, du:kha ra sukha duvai avasthAmA mAtra allAhalAI pukArchan | tara kAphiraharU khusIko avasthAmA tI asatya pUjyaharUlAI pukArchan ra du:kha tathA saMkaTamA mAtra allAhalAI pukArchan | zirka, pApa ra atyAcAra garneharUko AkhiratamA kasto bhayAvaha pariNAma hunecha bhanne kurA tinIharUle ahile nai thAhA pAekA bhae zirka ra pApa choDne thie ra sampUrNa zaktikA mAlika allAha hunuhuncha bhanne kurAmA vizvAsa garne thie |

166 mahApralayako bhayAvaha yAtanA dekhepachi pUjya ThAniekA asatya pUjya tathA aguvAharUle AphnA anuyAyIharUsa~ga kunai sambandha naraheko dAbI garnechan | tyatibelA tinIharUko mokSa tathA saphalatA prAptiko sampUrNa AzA nirAzAmA badalinecha |

167 anuyAyIharUle bhannechan– pheri duniyA~mA pharkina pAe hAmIharU pani tinIharUsita kunai sambandha rAkhne thienauM, jasarI yinIharU hAmIsita gardaichan | allAhale tinIharUlAI Akhiratako yAtanA dekhAunu hunecha ra tinIharU nirAza hunechan, kinabhane tinIharUle asatyamA tI aguvAharUko anusaraNa gare | tinIharU narkako AgobATa kahilyai umkana pAune chainan |

168 he mAnava! dhartImA rahekA janAvara, bAlInAlI, phalaphUlamadhye vaidha evaM pavitra vastuharU khAU, apavitra vastuharU nakhAU ra kunai pani zaitAnI cAlako anusaraNa nagara | nissandeha U timro khullama-khullA zatru ho | allAhale timIharUlAI zaitAnI cAlako anusaraNa garna DhIla dinubhaeko cha | buddhimAnale Aphno yasto zatruko anusaraNa kadApi gardaina jo kaSTa dincha ra pathabhraSTa pArcha |

169 usale timIharUlAI kevala ThUlA pApa tathA azlIla kAryaharU garna lagAu~cha ra AsthA tathA zarIatamA allAhabAre timIharUlAI jJAna nai nabhaekA kurAharU bhanna lagAu~cha, jasako bAremA allAha tathA uhA~kA rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) ko tarphabATa kunai jJAna prApta bhaeko chaina |

170 jaba yI kAphiraharUlAI allAhadvArA avatarita mArgadarzana tathA prakAzakò anusaraNa garna bhanincha, taba tinIharU haThadharmI gardai bhanchan– hAmI ta tI AsthA tathA prathAharUko anusaraNa garnechauM jasamAthi AphnA pUrvajaharUlAI pAekA chauM | ke tinIharU AphnA purkhAharUkai anusaraNa garnechan cAhe tinIharUle katti pani mArgadarzana tathA prakAzalAI nabujhekA houn ra na allAhale rojnubhaeko satmArga nai prApta garekA houn?

171 pUrvajaharUkò andhò anusaraNa garnebAre kAphiraharUko upamA yasto cha– euTA goThAlole janAvaraharUlAI DAkdacha ra tI janAvaraharUle goThAloko pukAra, karAi ra cicyAi ta sunchan tara tAtparya bujhdainan | ThIka tyastai yinIharU pani satya kurA sundai nasunne bahirA hun, lATA hun, jibròbATa satya kurA niskadaina, satya kurA nadekhine andhA hun; tyasaile tapAIMle ahvAna garnubhaekò nitAnta satyalAI bujhdai bujhdainan |

172 he mominaharU ho! allAhale pradAna garnubhaekA tathA halAla Thahara garnubhaekA pavitra khAne kurAharU khAU ra uhA~le pradAna garnubhaekA varadAnaharUprati vAhya tathA Antarika duvai rUpamA AbhAra prakaTa gara | uhA~prati AbhAra antargata yo kurA pani Au~cha, uhA~kai upAsanA gara ra uhA~ko avajJAbATa baca, yadi sA~ccikai uhA~ko bhakti garchau ra uhA~sa~ga anya kasailAI sAjhedAra Thahara gardainau bhane |

173 allAhale timIharUkA nimti jabaha nagarikana mareko jantu, bagAieko ragata, suMgurako mAsu ra allAha bAheka anya kasaiko nAma liera vadha garieko janAvaraharU khAna harAma (avaidha) garnubhaeko cha | tara, jo bAdhya cha tyasale jyAdatI nagarikana AvazyakatA bhandA baDhI prayoga gardaina bhane usalAI kunai pApa lAgne chaina na U kunai sajAyakai hakadAra huncha | nissandeha taubA garne bhaktaharUprati allAha atyantai kSamAzIla tathA parama kRpAvAna hunuhuncha | AvazyakatA pareko belA harAma khAne anumati pani uhA~ko kRpAmadhye ho |

174 allAhale Aphno kitAbamA avataraNa garnubhaeko satya tathya tathA muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) ko IzadUtatvako pramANalAI jasale lukAu~cha ra pada, maryAdA tathA dhanasampatti jastA thorai sAMsArika lAbha prApta garnakA lAgi yI kArya garcha, jasarI yahUdI ra IsAIharUle gare, tinIharU Aphno peTamA yasto khAnA bhardaichan jo tinIharUkA lAgi yAtanAko kAraNa bancha | mahApralayako dina allAhale tinIharUko hakamA kurA garnuhunna baru tinIharUko viruddhamA kurA garnuhuncha | tinIharUlAI pavitra pArnuhunna, tinIharUko prazaMsA garnuhunna ra tinIharUkA lAgi du:khadAyI yAtanA cha |

175 mAnisaharUlAI khA~co rahekA jJAnakA kurA lukAune yI tyastA mAnisaharU hun, jasale satmArgalAI choDera pathabhraSTatA ra kSamAlAI choDera yAtanA rojekA chan | yI mAnisaharUle AgomA jalne kasto dussAhasa garchan ta! mAnauM yinIharUlAI yati bhayAvaha Agoko pani paravAhai chaina |

176 ho, yo jJAna ra satya kurA lukAeko pariNAma ho | kinabhane allAhale prakAza ra AkAzIya kitAbalAI mAnisaharUko mArdarzanako lAgi satyakA sAtha avataraNa garnubhaeko thiyo | yasalAI jAhera garnu parne thiyo, lukAuna nahune thiyo | tara yinIharU AkAzIya kitAbamA matabheda gare ra yasako kehI bhAgamA ImAna lyAe ra kehI bhAgako inkAra gare | yasarI unIharU virodha, jhagaDAmA satyatAdekhi dherai TADhA puge |

177 pUrva vA pazcimatira anuhAra pharkAunu vA yasamA vibheda garnu allAhalAI mana parne satkarma hoina | baru sabai kisimakA bhalAiharU yastA mAnisaharUkA lAgi hun jo eka allAha, mahApralayako dina, sabai phariztAharU, Iza-granthaharU tathA bhedabhAva nagarikana sabai nabI (sandeSTA) harUmAthi ImAna rAkhchan | sampattiprati moha mAyA hu~dA hu~dai Aphanta, buvA gumAekA nAbAliga anAtha, gariba, alapatra baTuvA, mAgna bAdhya bhaekA mAnisa tathA dAsaharUlAI mukta garna kharca garneharU, pUrNarUpamA vidhi anusAra salAha (namAja) kAyama garne, jakAta (dAna) dine, vAcA purA garne, saMkaTa, vipatti, garibI tathA roga lAgemA dhairya garne, yuddhako avasthAmA raNa-bhUmi choDera nabhAgneharU | yastA guNaharU bhaekA mAnisaharU nai AphnA ImAna tathA satkarmako dAbImA saccA hun ra yinIharU nai asala bhaktaharU hun | kinabhane yinIharU allAhakA sabai AdezaharUko pAlanA garchan ra varjita kAryaharUbATa rokinchan |

178 he mominaharU ho! yadi kunai vyaktile jAnIjAnI atyAcArapUrNa tarikAle kasaiko hatyA garcha bhane hatyArAlAI usako arAdha anusAra kisAsa (mRtyudaNDa) anivArya rUpamA dinuparcha | kunai svatantra vyaktile hatyA garemA badalAmA svatantra vyaktiko, dAsale hatyA garemA dAsako ra nArIle hatyA garemA nArIko pani hatyA garinecha | tara mRtakale mRtyuaghi mApha garcha vA usako abhibhAvakale rakta mUlya liera hatyArAlAI kSamA garna cAhemA garna sakcha | rakta mUlya bhaneko hatyArAle mAphI pAeko badalAmA tirnu parne rakama ho | mApha garne vyaktile kaSTa nadiikana ra paropakAra najatAikana rAmro tarikAle mAga garnuparcha ra hatyArAle AlaTAla nagarikana rakta mUlya tirnu pardacha | yo mAphI tathA rakta mUlya diera kisAsa (mRtyudaNDa) bATa bacnu timrA rabako tarphabATa ThUlo dayA ho | jasale rakta mUlya svIkAra garepachi hatyArAmAthi anyAya garcha, usako lAgi duHkhadAyI yAtanA rahekocha |

179 kisAsa (mRtyudaNDa) ko islAmI kAnunamA timIharU sabaiko lAgi jIvana cha, kinabhane yasale gardA hiMsA tathA atyAcArako anta huncha | buddhi tathA Dara rAkhneharUle yI kAnunaharUlAI mAnera vyavahAramA lyAunu parcha |

180 yadi timIharUmadhye kasaiko mRtyuko saGketaharU dekhAparcha ra kehI dhanasampatti choDdaicha bhane AmA-buvA tathA nAtedAraharUkA lAgi niyamaanusAra eka tihAisammako vasiyata garnu timIharUmAthi anivArya garieko cha | yo allAhasa~ga bhaya rAkhneharUko kartabya ho | virAsata (paitrika sampattiko bA~DaphADa) sambandhI allAhako Adeza avatarita hunuaghiko yo kurA ho | virAsata sambandhI AyataharU avatarita bhaepachi kasa kasale kati aMza pAunecha bhanne kurA spaSTa bhaisakeko cha |

181 jasale vasiyata sunepachi tyasamA thapaghaTa vA pherabadala garcha, tyasako pApa pherabadala garnevAlAlAI lAgcha, vasiyata garnevAlAlAI lAgdaina | nissandeha allAha bhaktaharUkA kurA sunnuhuncha ra unIharUkA karmaharUlAI jAnnuhuncha, kunai pani kurA uhA~bATa lukeko chaina |

182 yadi kasaile vasiyatakartAle vasiyata gardA pakSapAta vA jyAdatI gareko thAhA pAyo ani vasiyatanAmA sacyAera ra vasiyata pAuneharUvIca milApatra garidiyo bhane usalAI kunai pApa lAgne chaina, baru puNya milnecha | nissandeha allAha taubA garne bhaktaharUprati atyanta kSamAzIla evaM parama dayAlu hunuhuncha |

183 he mominaharU ho! allAhale timIharUmAthi vrata (rojA) anivArya garnubhaeko cha, jasarI timIharU bhandA aghikA samudAyaharUmAthi anivArya garieko thiyo | AzA cha, timIharUbhitra takvA (Izabhaya) utpanna hunecha | vrata tathA anya satkarmaharU garera timIharUle AphUlAI narkabATa jogAunechau |
