184 varSakA kehI dinaharU mAtra siyAma (vrata) basnu anivArya garieko cha | yadi tI nizcita dinaharUmA timIharUmadhye kohI yasto birAmI parcha, jasale gardA vrata basna gAhro huncha vA yAtrA garcha, jasale gardA vrata basna kaThina huncha bhane tI dinaharUmA vrata nabasne ani ThyAkkai tyati dinaharU pachi purA garnupardacha | yadi kasaile vrata basne kSamatA rAkhdA rAkhdai pani basena bhane usale pratyeka vrata bApata eka janA garibalAI khAnA khuvAunu pardacha | yadi kasaile AphUkhusI ekabhandA baDhI janAlAI khAnA khuvAu~cha vA vrata pani rAkhcha ra garibalAI khAnA pani khuvAu~cha bhane tyo usaiko hakamA rAmro hunecha | yadi timIharU vratako mahatvalAI jAndachau bhane vrata rAkhnu vrata narAkhnu bhandA besa cha ra phidayA (artha daNDa) dinubhandA pani besa cha | vrata anivArya garieko belA suru surumA yastai Adeza thiyo | icchA anusAra kohI vrata basthyo bhane kohI vrata nabasera tyasako badalAmA ekajanA garibalAI khAnA khuvAune garthyo | yasa nayA~ Adezale pratyeka bAliga sAmarthyavAnamAthi vrata rAkhnu anivArya gariyo |

185 ramajAna mahinAko kadrako rAtamA nabI (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) mAthi kurAna avataraNa zuru bhayo; yasamA sabai mAnavajAtikA lAgi mArgadarzana ra satya ra asatyabIca pharaka chuTyAune spaSTa pramANaharU chan | ataH timIharUmadhye jasale yasa mahinAlAI pAu~cha usale anivAryarUpamA yasako vrata (rojA) rAkhos | jo birAmI cha vA yAtrAmA cha ra vrata rAkhna kaThina cha bhane usale tI dinaharUmA vrata narAkhe pani huncha, tara tI dinaharUmA narAkhekA vrata anivAryarUpamA arU dinaharUmA rAkhos | allAha timro lAgi suvidhA cAhanuhuncha; timIharUlAI kaSTamA pArna cAhanuhunna tAki timIharUle eka mahinAko saMkhyA purA gara | mahinA anta hu~dA Idula phitrako dina allAhu akabara bhandai uhA~ko prazaMsA vyakta gara, kinabhane uhA~le timIharUlAI purA mahinAko vrata basna maddata garnubhaeko cha | AzA cha, allAhabATa prApta sIdhA mArga tathA islAmaprati timIharU AbhArI hunechau |

186 he nabI! merA bhaktaharU mero nikaTatA tathA duA sunnebAre tapAIMlAI sodhchan bhane bhanidinuhos– ma unIharUdekhi ekadamai najika chu, unIharUko avasthAsita avagata chu ra bhitrI manale pukArnevAlAko pukAra svIkAra garchu | nata kunai mAdhyama cAhincha nata malAI guhArdA karAunu parcha | ataH unIharUle maprati AtmasamarpaNa garnuparcha, mero Adezako pAlanA garnuparcha ra ImAnamA aDiga rahanuparcha | yahI lAbhadAyaka mAdhyama ho | unIharUle yaso garemA maile cA~Dai unIharUko duA svIkAra garchu | AzA cha unIharUle dhArmika tathA sAMsArika sabai mAmilAmA ThIka tarikA apanAune chan |

187 suru surumA mAnisaharUkA lAgi ramajAna mahinAmA rAti sutepachi phajraaghi jAgemA khAnapina garnu ra patnIsa~ga sahavAsa garnu avaidha thiyo | tara allAhale yo AdezalAI radda garnubhayo ra bhannubhayo– he mominaharU ho! aba timIharUko lAgi phajrasamma khAnapina garna ra patnIharUsa~ga sambhoga garna allAhale vaidha garnubhayo | patnIharU timIharUkA lAgi ra timIharU patnIharUkA lAgi pozAka ra sammAna hau | timIharU eka arkA binA rahana sakdainau | allAhalAI thAhA cha, timIharU manAhI garieko kArya garera AphaiMsa~ga kapaTa garirahekA thiyau tara allAhale timIharUmAthi dayA garnubhayo, timIharUlAI kSamA garnubhayo ra bhAralAI halukA pArnubhayo | aba timIharU AphnA patnIharUsa~ga sahavAsa gara ani allAhale timIharUkA lAgi je jati santAna lekhnu bhaeko cha tyasalAI mAga | bihAnIko seto rekhA rAtiko kAlo rekhAdekhi spaSTa hounjela khAnapina gara | ani phajradekhi sUryAstasamma dinabharI vrata basa | timIharU masjidamA eatikAphamA baseko samayamA patnIharUsa~ga sambhoga nagara, natra eatikApha khera jAncha | yI harAma halAlabIca allAhakA sImAharU hun | ataH tyasako nikaTa najAU natra harAmamA parchau | yasarI mAnavajAtikA lAgi allAha AdezaharU spaSTarUpamA bayAna garnuhuncha, tAki unIharU uhA~sa~ga DarAu~dai, uhA~le diekA AdezaharUko pAlanA garun ra manAhI gariekA kAmaharUbATa bacun |

188 timIharU ekaarkAkA sampatti corI, beimAnI, dhokA jastA anAhaka tarikale nakhAU | tyasaigarI nyAyakartAharUsa~ga chala garera arkAko sampatti jAnIjAnI nakhAU | jAnIjAnI harAma kAryatira agADi baDhnu ghRNita kArya ra ThUlo pApa ho | yasako sajAya pani ThUlo nai huncha |

189 he allAhakA rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! mAnisaharUle tapAIMsa~ga candramAko bAremA sodhdachan; yasako rahasyabAre bhanidinuhos– yo mAnisaharUkA lAgi tIthi nirdhAraNa garne ra bhaktiko samaya thAhA pAune mAdhyama ho | jastai- haja, ramajAna, varSa bitepachi jakAta dine samaya | yo muddA mAmilAko samaya thAhA pAune mAdhyama pani ho | jastai- RNa tathA blaDa manI cuktA garne samaya | haja tathA umrAko eharAma lagAepachi gharamA pachADibATa praveza garnu satkarma hoina jasto timIharU islAma pUrva ThAnekA thiyau, baru allAhasita vAhya tathA Antarika rUpamA Darnu tathA parahejagAra hunu nai ThUlo satkarma ho | gharabhitra DhokAbATa praveza garna sajilo huncha, tyasamA apThyAro hu~daina | allAhale timIharUlAI apThyAromA pArna cAhanuhunna | satkarma garera AphUlAI allAhako prakopabATa bacAU | tAki timIharUle cAheko tathA rojeko svarga pAera tathA bacna khojeko narkabATa mukti pAera saphala hoU |

190 allAhako vANIlAI ucca pArnako lAgi tI kAphiraharU viruddha yuddha gara, jo dharmabATa rokna timIharUsa~ga yuddha garchan | tara sImA ullaGghana nagara ra yuddhako maidAnamA baccA, mahilA tathA vRddhavRddhAlAI namAra | hera, zavalAI TukrA pArera (chinnabhinna garera) jyAdatI nagara | nissandeha allAha yastA mAnisaharUlAI kadApi mana parAunuhunna, jo uhA~ko Adeza tathA kAnuna toDera sImA ullaGghana garchan |

191 yuddhAvasthAmA tinIharUlAI jahA~ pAu~chau tyahIM hatyA gara ra tinIharUlAI tyahA~bATa nikAla jahA~bATa tinIharUle timIharUlAI nikAlekA thie; arthAta makkAbATa | kinabhane mominalAI islAmabATa roknu tathA kuphratarpha pharkAunu ThUlo AtaMka ra hatyAbhandA pani jhan khataranAka ho | pratiSThita masjida kAbAko Adara gara, tyahA~ tinIharUsa~ga yuddhako zuruvAta nagara | yadi tinIharUle zuruvAta gare bhane timIharU pani yuddha gara | jastAlAI tyastai, yadi kAphiraharUle timIharUlAI hatyA garna khojchan bhane timIharU pani kAphiraharUko hatyA gara |

192 yadi tinIharU yuddha tathA kuphralAI tyAgchan bhane timIharU pani ruka | allAha atyanta kSamAzIla hunuhuncha ani taubAlAI svIkAra garnuhuncha | ataH aghillA pApaharUko sajAya dinuhunna | parama kRpAvAna hunuhuncha, sajAya dinamA hatAra garnuhunna |

193 zirka, kuphra ra mAnisaharUlAI allAhako mArgabATa rokne kAmako samApti tathA islAma dharma kAyama nahunjela kAphiraharUsa~ga yuddha gara | yadi tinIharU zirka, kuphra tathA islAmako bATomA bAdhA utpanna garna chADchan bhane tinIharU viruddha yuddha virAma gara | kuphra garne tathA islAmabATa rokne atyAcArIharU bAheka kasaimAthi kunai kAravAhI hune chaina |

194 sAtauM varSako harAma (pratiSThita) mahinA jasamA timIharU kAbA Aera umrA garne maukA pAyau, tyo chaiThauM mahinAko badalA ho, jasamA bahudevavAdIharUle kAbAmA praveza garnabATa rokekA thie | pratiSThita zahara, pratiSThita mahInA ra eharAmako avasthAmA pani atyAcArIharUmAthi kisAsako niyama lAgU huncha | yasto avasthAmA jasale jyAdatI garcha Usa~ga tyastai mAmilA gara, usalAI usale gareko jyAdatI barAbara nai javApha deU, javAphamA usale gareko bhandA baDhI nagara | allAha jyAdatI garnelAI mana parAunuhunna | uhA~le dinubhaeko anumati bhandA baDhI garne mAmilAmA uhA~sita Dara mAna, ani jAnirAkha allAhale uhA~sita DarAuneharUlAI maddata garnuhuncha |

195 allAhako AjJApAlana jastai jihAda ityAdimA Aphno dhanasampatti kharca gara | jihAda tathA uhA~ko bATomA kharca nagarera vA AphUlAI galata bATomA lagAera barbAda nagara | uttama DhaMgale bhakti, mAmilA tathA vyavahAra gara | vAstavamA allAha hareka kAma uttama DhaMgale garneharUlAI prema garnuhuncha, dherai puNya dinuhuncha ra ajhai satkarma garne maukA dinuhuncha |

196 allAhalAI khuzI pArnako lAgi pUrNa tarikAle haja tathA umrA gara | yadi timIharU roga vA zatru ityAdi kAraNale haramasamma pugna sakenau bhane eharAma phukAlnako lAgi upalabdha U~Ta, gAI, bAkhrA ityAdi janAvara kurbAnI (bali) gara | kurbAnIkA janAvaraharU kurbAnI sthalasamma napugesamma AphnA TAuko munDana nagarAU | haramasamma pugna pAenau bhane rokieko ThAu~mA kurbAnI gara | rokienau bhane haramamA 10 jilhijjA (nahara) ko dina vA tyasapachikA tazrIkakA dinaharUmA kurbAnI gara | timIharUmadhye jo birAmI cha vA jasako TAukomA jumrA ityAdi cha, jasale gardA usale pahilA nai TAuko munDana garAyau bhane usale phidayA (jarivAnA) ko rUpamA tIna dinako vrata rAkhos vA haramakA 6 janA garibalAI bhojana garAos vA euTA bAkhrA jabaha garera haramakA garibaharUmA vitaraNa garos | jaba timIharU surakSita avasthAmA hunchau, tyatibelA jo hajakA sAthai hajakA dinaharUmA nai umrAbATa pani lAbhAnvita huna cAhancha vA manAhI garieko kunai kAma garcha bhane usale kSamatAanusAra ki ta euTA bAkhrA ki ta U~Ta vA gAImA eka bhAgako kurbAnI garnupardacha | jasale kurbAnI garna sakdaina usale hajakA dinaharUmA tIna dina ra pharkepachi sAta dina vrata rAkhnu pardacha | yI jammA dasa dina bhae; yo chuTa tinIharUkA lAgi ho jasako gharabAra haramako paridhimA chaina, zarIata (islAmI kAnuna) ko pAbandI gardai ra sImAko maryAdAko kadara gardai allAhasa~ga DarAU | jAni rAkha, Adeza namAnneharUlAI allAha kaThora daNDa dinuhuncha |

197 hajakA mahinAharU nirdhArita chan | zauvvAla mahinAbATa zuru bhaera jil hijjAko 10 tArikhamA samApta huncha | jasale yI mahinAharUmA haja garne nirNaya garcha ra eharAma lagAu~cha usale sahavAsa ra anya manAhI gariekA kriyAkalApalAI tyAgnu parcha | sAthai hajako mausama ra pavitra sthAnako Adarale gardA pApa, risa tathA laDAi-jhagaDAsamma puryAune vAdavivAda tyAgnu parcha | timIharUle juna satkarma garnechau allAhalAI thAhA huncha ra uhA~le tyasako rAmro badalA dinuhunecha | hajako lAgi yAtrA gardA AvazyakatA anusAra khAnapinakA sAmagrIharU ra bATo-kharca liera jAU | jAnirAkha, hareka avasthAmA kAma lAgne sababhandA utkRSTa bATo-kharca takavA arthAta allAhako Dara ho | he buddhimAnaharU ho! masita DarAera mero Adezako pAlanA gara tathA manAhI gariekA kAryabATa baca |

198 haja avadhimA vyapAra ityAdile halAla rojIroTI kamAi garemA kunai Apatti chaina | araphAtabATa mujadalephAko lAgi prasthAna gardA (navauM jil hijjAko dina araphAtamA bitAepachi tyahA~bATa dasauM jil hijjAko rAta) bATomA ra mujadalephA avasthita mazare harAma mA subhAnallAha, alhamdo lillAha, lA ilAha illallAha bhandai allAhalAI khuba yAda gara ani duA gara | uhA~le nai timIharUlAI islAma dharmako vidhividhAna ra hajako tarikA sikAunu bhayo, jabaki timIharU yasabhandA pahile zarIata (islAmI kAnuna) jAndaina thiyau |

199 timIharU araphAtabATa yasarI prasthAna gara jasarI ibrAhIma (alaihissalAma) lAI anusaraNa garne mAnisaharU garne garthe | pachi islAma pUrva tyahA~ dina na bitAune mAnisaharU jhaiM nagara | haja garne kramamA kamI kamajorIprati allAhasa~ga mAphI mAga | nissandeha allAha taubA garne bhaktaharUprati atyantai kSamAzIla tathA parama kRpAvAna hunuhuncha |

200 hajakA sabai prakriyAharU purA garisakepachi allAhako khuba prazaMsA gara | jasarI timIharU AphnA pUrkhAharUko samjhanA tathA prazaMsA garne garthyau tyasarI nai vA tyasabhandA pani baDhI allAhalAI yAda gara tathA uhA~ko prazaMsA gara | kinabhane timIharUle ramAune sampUrNa kurAharU uhA~kai varadAnaharU hun | mAnisaharU vibhinna khAlakA chan, kohI momina ta kohI kAphira tathA muzrika | kAphira muzrikaharU mAtra yasa sAMsArika jIvanamA vizvAsa garchan, mAtra yahA~kA mojamastI, svAsthya, dhana, sampatti tathA santAna mAgchan | momina bhaktaharUkA lAgi tayAra pAriekA AkhiratakA ghara svargamA yinIharUko kunai aMza hunechaina | kinabhane yinIharUle mAtra yasa duniyA~mA cAso liekA thie, AkhiratamA kunai cAso liekA thienan |

201 kehI mAnisaharU allAha tathA AkhiratamAthi ImAna rAkhchan, unIharU yasa saMsArakA kRpA tathA satkarma garne avasara pani mAgchan ra Akhirata (paraloka) mA svarga tathA narkabATa mukti pani mAgchan |
202 loka ra paraloka duvaimA bhalAi mAgne mAnisaharUle duniyA~mA sukha zAnti tathA AkhiratamA rAmro phala pAunechan | allAhale cA~Dai nai karmako hisAba kitAba linuhuncha |

203 jil hijjAkA 11, 12 ra 13 kA dinaharUmA allAhu akbara, lA ilAha illallAha bhandai allAhako atyAdhika guNagAna gara | jo allAhako bhaya rAkhdai hatAra garI 12 jila hijjA kai dina jamarAtalAI roDA hAnera minAbATa pharkancha usamAthi kunai pApa chaina, allAhako tarphabATa chuTa cha | jo 13 jil hijjAko dina jamarAtalAI roDA hAnera minAbATa pharkancha tyo usakai hakamA rAmro huncha ra tyasamA pani kunai pApa hu~daina | baru usale purA kAma garyo ra nabI (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) ko anusaraNa pani garyo | allAhako Adezako pAlanA gardai tathA varjita kAryaharUlAI tyAgdai uhA~sa~ga Dara | jAnirAkha, timIharU uhA~ko pAsamA nai pharkera jAnuparnecha, ani uhA~le timIharUko karmako badalA dinuhunecha |

204 he nabI (sallallahu alaihi sallama)! yasa sansAramA kehI munAphika (kapaTI) harUko kurA tapAIMlAI atyAdhika rAmro lAgcha | baDo rAmro tarikale miTho kurA garchan, mAnauM kati saccA tathA hitaiSI hun | tara tinIharUko uddezya Aphno jyAna tathA dhanako rakSA garnu mAtra huncha | allAha gavAha hunuhuncha ki ImAna tathA bhalAiko dAbImA tinIharU jhUTA hun | muslimaharUprati manabhitra ati ghRNA tathA zatrutA pAlekA chan |

205 kapaTI tapAIMko pAsabATa pharkepachi duSkarmadvArA dhartImA vidhvaMsa gardai, khetI bAlIlAI naSTa pArera tathA janAvaraharUlAI mArera AtaMka maccAuna thAlchan | allAhale dhartImA vidhvaMsa ra vidhvaMsakArIharUlAI kadApi mana parAunu hunna |

206 jaba tyasa vidhvaMsakArIlAI allAhako AdezaharUko pAlanA garera tathA manAhI garieko kArya tyAgera uhA~sa~ga bhaya rAkhna upadeza diincha taba usako mapAIM tathA ghamanDale usalAI pApamA lipta pArdacha ra satyalAI svIkAra garna bAdhaka bancha | usako sajAyako lAgi narka nai paryApta huncha | yo tinIharUkA lAgi ati narAmro vAsasthAna ho |

207 mAnisaharUmadhye kohI momina chan, jo svayaMlAI allAha samakSa becidiekA chan, uhA~ko AjJApAlana, yahA~ko mArgamA jihAda tathA uhA~ko prasannatA prApta garnako lAgi saMgharSa garirAkhekA hunchan | allAha bhaktaharUprati atyantai dayAvAna tathA snehI hunuhuncha |

208 he mominaharU ho! islAmamA pUrNarUpamA praveza gara, kunai pani AdezalAI nachoDa | yahUdI ra IsAIle gareko jhaiM nagara, tinIharU kitAbako kehI aMzamAthi ImAna rAkhthe ra kehI aMzako inkAra garthe | zaitAnako anusaraNa nagara, kinabhane U timIharUko khullama khullA zatru ho |

209 spaSTa pramANaharU Aisakepachi pani yadi timIharUmadhye kohI bahakiyau bhane jAnirAkha allAha Aphno zaktimA atyanta prabhutvazAlI ra kAnuna lAgU garnamA ati tatvadarzI hunuhuncha | ataH uhA~sa~ga DarAU ra uhA~ko mahAnatA varNana gara |

210 zaitAnako anusaraNa garne tathA satya dharma islAmabATa TADhA bhaekA yI mAnisaharU ke yasa pratIkSAmA chan, mahApralayako dina allAha Aphno zAnaanusAra tinIharU samakSa bAdalako chAnAmA prakaTa houn ra phariztAharU tinIharUlAI cArai tirabATa Aphno gherAmA liekA houn, ani allAhale tinIharUko phaisalA garun | antataH sabai prANIkA sArA mAmilA allAhakai sAmu pesa garine chan |

211 he nabI (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! isrAIlakA santAnalAI sodhnuhos, allAhale timIharUlAI kati dherai spaSTa nizAnIharU pradAna garnubhayo, tara timIharUle uhA~kA nizAnI ra rasUlaharUlAI jhUTlAyau ra vimukha bhayau | allAhako varadAnalAI jhUTlAuneharUkA lAgi kaDA sajAya cha | allAhale kAphiraharUlAI kaThora yAtanA dinuhunecha |

212 kAphiraharUkA lAgi yo saMsAra ra yasamA rahekA bhautika Ananda ra kSaNika mojamastIlAI sundara evaM AkarSaka banAiekA chan | yinIharU AsthAvAnaharUko ThaTTA garchan | Izabhaya rAkhneharU nai mahApralayako dina tinIharUbhandA ucca sthAna pAunechan ra sadhai~ rahane svargamA jAnechan | allAha jasalAI cAhanuhuncha anagintI pradAna garnuhuncha |

213 zurumA sampUrNa mAnavajAti euTai samudAya thie | sabai Aphno purkhA Adama (alaihissalAma) ko dharma tathA mArgadarzanamA kAyama thie | pachi zaitAnako bahakAvAmA Aera matabhedamA parera muslima ra kAphiramA bA~Die | tasartha allAhale nabIharUlAI AsthAvAnaharUkA lAgi zubha-sUcaka tathA kAphira (allAhalAI namAnne) harUkA lAgi yAtanAko sacetaka banAera paThAunubhayo | mAnisaharUbIca raheko vidyamAna matabhedalAI khatama pArna nabIharUlAI satyamA AdhArita AkAzIya granthaharU pradAna garnubhayo | tara yahUdIharUle jAnIjAnI taurAtamA matabheda gare | tinIharUle spaSTa nizAnIharU pAisakepachi pani paraspara atikramaNa garne uddezyale mAtra satyalAI choDera bhinna mArgaharU apanAe | allAhale mominaharUlAI satya bATo dekhAunu bhayo | allAhale jasalAI cAhanuhuncha sIdhA mArga arthAta ImAnako mArga dekhAunuhuncha, jasamA kunai TeDhopana chaina |

214 he mominaharU ho! ke timIharU binA jA~ca tyasai svargamA praveza garnechau bhanne ThAnekA chau jabaki timIharUbhandA pahilekA mAnisaharUko jasto saGkaTa timIharUmAthi Aekai chaina? unIharU ThUlAThUlA kaThinAI, roga, garibI tathA duHkhamA pilsie ra yasarI ghacghacyAie ki tyasa bakhatakA rasUla (alaihissalAma) tathA unakA sAthamA rahekA momina (AsthAvAna) harUle sameta bhanna thAle– allAhako sahAyatA kahile Aune ho ta? suna, nizcaya nai allAhako sahAyatA uhA~mAthi bharosA garne mominaharUdekhi najika cha |

215 he nabI (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! tapAIMkA sAthIharUle AphUsa~ga bhaeko vibhinna khAle dhanasampatti kahA~ ra kasarI kharca garau~ bhanera prazna sodhachan? bhanidinuhos– Aphno halAla tathA pavitra dhanasampatti mAtA-pitA, nikaTatama nAtedAra, anAtha, gariba, asahAya tathA alapatra baTuvAharUmAthi kharca gara | he mominaharU ho! thorai vA baDhI je jati dhanasampatti timIharU kharca garchau, allAhale tI sabailAI jAnnuhuncha ra tyasako badalA dinuhunecha |

216 he mominaharU ho! timIharUmAthi allAhako mArgamA yuddha garna anivArya garieko cha | yasamA jIudhanako kSati hunAle timIharUlAI apriya lAgnasakcha | timIharU juna kurAlAI apriya ThAnirahekA chau, tyo timrA lAgi rAmro hunasakcha, jastaiH allAhako mArgamA yuddha garnu, yasamA jihAdako puNyakA sAthai zatruharUmAthi vijaya prApta huncha ra allAhako vANI (tauhIda) sarvatra phailinecha | timIharU juna kurAlAI priya ThAnirahekA chau, tyo timrAlAgi narAmro hunasakcha, jastaiH jihAda choDera gharamA basnu | yasamA apamAna pani cha ra zatruko saphalatA pani cha | kuna kAmamA phAidA cha, kuna kAmamA hAni bhanne kurA allAhale jAnnuhuncha; baru timIharU po jAndainau | ataH uhA~ko pUrNa anusaraNa gara, yasaimA timIharUko kalyANa cha |

217 he nabI! mAnisaharUle tapAIMlAI harAma (pratiSThita) mahinA jula-kAdaha, jila-hijjaha, muharrama tathA rajaba mA yuddha garne hukuma sodhirahekA chan | bhanidinuhos– tI mahinAharUmA yuddha garnu ThUlo pApa ho | tara bahudevavAdIharUle mominaharUlAI allAhako mArga tathA masjide harAmabATa roknu tathA mAnisaharUlAI tyahA~bATa niskAsita garnu allAhako dRSTimA harAma (pratiSThita) mahinAmA yuddha garnubhandA pani ThUlo pApa ho | tyasaigarI unIharU juna zirkamA laDibuDI khelirahekA chan, tyo yuddha garnubhandA pani ThUlo pApa ho | he mominaharU ho! yinIharU timIharUsita nirantara yuddha garirahane chan; yahA~samma ki sAmarthya pugemA timIharUlAI satya dharma islAmabATa nai nikAlera Aphno galata dharmamA lagnechan | timIharUmadhye jo pani Aphno dharmabATa niskancha ani kuphrakai avasthAmA tyasako nidhana huncha, tyastA mAnisaharUkA karmaharU khera jAnecha | tinIharUko vAsasthAna narka hunecha, jahA~ tinIharU sadAsarvadA rahanechan |

218 nissandeha jo mAnisaharUle allAha tathA uhA~kA rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) mAthi ImAna lyAe, Aphno gharabAra tathA dezalAI tyAgera allAha tathA uhA~kA rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) ko lAgi hijrata gare ra allAhako vANIlAI ucca pArnako lAgi yuddha gare, tinIharU nai uhA~ko kRpA tathA mAphikA ummedavAra hun | allAha AphnA bhaktaharUkA pApaharUkA lAgi ati kSamAzIla evaM parama kRpAvAna hunuhuncha |

219 he nabI (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! tapAIMkA sAthIharU jA~Da raksI khAne, piune tathA yasako kArobAra garne ra juvAtAsa khelne bAre sodhchan, bhanidinuhos– yI duvaimA sAMsArika tathA dhArmika duvai dRSTakoNAle ThUlo hAni noksAnI cha | yasale gardA dimAga kharAba huncha, dhanasampatti khera jAncha ra paraspara zatrutA ra ghRNA pani utpanna huncha | yasamA kSaNika phAidA tathA kehI kamAi pani bhaihAlcha | tara tinakA ghATA ra noksAnIharU tinakA lAbhabhandA dherai chan | ataH juna kurAmA lAbhabhandA baDhI ghATA huncha, buddhimAnale tyasto saudA gardainan | yasa AyatamA allAhale raksIlAI harAma garne bhUmikA bA~dhnu bhaeko cha | he nabI (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! tapAIMkA sAthIharU tapAIMsa~ga ke kati dhanasampatti kharca garne bhanera sodhchan | bhanidinuhos– juna timIharUko AvazyakatAbhandA baDhI cha tyo kharca gara (zurumA yo Adeza thiyo, pachi vastu tathA dhana sampattimA parimANa tathA mAtrA anusAra jakAta anivArya gariyo) yasa prakAra allAhale timIharUkA lAgi Aphno Adeza spaSTa pArnuhuncha | AzA cha timIharU viveka prayoga garnechau |

220 allAhale halAla harAmako kAnuna banAunubhayo; tAki timIharU vicAra gara ki loka ra paraloka duvaiko lAgi kuna vastumA phAidA cha ra kuna vastumA hAni | he nabI (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! tapAIMkA sAthIharUle anAthaharUko heracAha tathA unIharUko Arthika kArobAra, khAnapina, basne ra lAune ityAdimA Aphno dhanasampatti misAunebAre sodhchan | bhanidinuhos– unIharUko Arthika kArobAramA Aphno kArobAra namisAikana binA jyAlA sahayoga garchau bhane yo jhana rAmro kurA ho | allAhale timIharUlAI rAmro pratiphala pradAna garnuhunecha | yo unIharUko lAgi pani rAmro hunecha, kinabhane yasale gardA tinIharUko dhana surakSita rahanecha | tara yadi unIharUko dhanamA Aphno dhanasampatti misAu~chau bhane yasako pani anumati cha, kinabhane unIharU timIharUkA dhArmika dAjubhAiharU hun | dAjubhAi eka arkAko sahayoga ta garchan nai | allAha anAthako dhanamA hinAminA garneharUlAI pani jAnnuhuncha ra bhalo garneharUlAI pani jAnnuhuncha | allAhale anAthako mAmilAmA timIharUlAI kaThinAimA pArna cAhekomA pArna saknuhunthyo tara uhA~le kaThinAimA pArnubhaena baru anAthaharUsa~ga mAmilA garna sajilo pArnubhayo, kinabhane islAmI kAnuna sajilo cha | nissandeha allAha prabhutvazAlI hunuhuncha kohI uhA~mAthi prabhutva kAyama garna sakdaina | allAha Aphno sRSTi, prabandha tathA kAnunamA tatvadarzI hunuhuncha |

221 he mominaharU ho! jabasamma muzrika (bahudevavAdI) mahilAharU ImAna lyAera islAmamA praveza gardainan; tabasamma tinIharUsa~ga bihe nagara | nissandeha allAha tathA uhA~kA rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) mAthi ImAna rAkhne dAsI svatantra muzrika nArIbhandA zreSTha chan | cAhe tyasako sundaratA ra dhanasampattile timIharUlAI laThTha kina napArun | tyastai jabasamma muzrika puruSaharU ImAna lyAu~dainan; tabasamma tinIharUsa~ga muslima mahilAharUko vivAha nagara | momina dAsa svatantra muzrika puruSabhandA zreSTha chan | cAhe tyo muzrika timIharUlAI laThTha kina napArun | yinIharU mUrtI pUjA garchan ra AphnA kurA tathA karmabATa narkatarpha bolAu~chan | tara allAha ImAna tathA satkarmatarpha bolAunuhuncha | tAki timIharUlAI svarga evaM kSamA prApta hos | uhA~le AphnA Ayata tathA zikSAharU spaSTa rUpamA batAunuhuncha tAki tinIharUle upadeza grahaNa garera satkarma garUn |

222 he nabI (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! tapAIMkA sAthIharU tapAIMsa~ga haija (mahinavArI) ko bAremA sodhdachan | bhanidinuhos– yo prAkRtika ragata ho jo strIko pAThe gharabATa vizeSa dinaharUmA niskancha | yo puruSa ra strI duvaikA lAgi hAnikAraka huncha | tasartha mahinAvArIko avasthAmA sahavAsa nagara | mahinavArIko ragata banda nahounjela ra tinale na nuhAunjela sahavAsako lAgi tinako najika najAU | jaba tinIharUko raktazrAva banda huncha ra tinIharU nuhAera saphA hunchan, taba tinIharUsa~ga allAhale jAyaja garnubhaeko tarikAanusAra tinIharUko yonImA sahavAsa gara | nissandeha allAhale dherai taubA (prAyazcita) garne tathA saphAsugghara rahaneharUlAI mana parAunuhuncha |

223 timrA patnIharU timIharUkA nimti khetI saraha hun | jasarI khetamA biu chardA tyasale anAja tathA phala dincha, tyastai timIharUle sahavAsa garera virya skhalana gardA unIharUle timrA baccAharUlAI janma dinchan | unIharUko yonI mai sahavAsa gara | sahavAsa garna agADi pachADi jatAbATa pani ra junasukai AsanabATa pani garna sakchau, tara yonI mai garnuparcha | Aphno lAgi satkarma agADi paThAU, arthAta allAhako khusI prApta garne tathA satkarmI santAna pAune manasAyale sambhoga gara | mahilAharUsa~ga sambandhita allAhakA AdezaharUko pAlanA gardai tathA varjita kAryaharUlAI tyAgdai uhA~sa~ga DarAU ani jAnirAkha– timIharUle allAhasa~ga bheTnucha, uhA~ samakSa ubhinu cha ra uhA~le timIharUko karmako badalA dinuhuncha | he nabI! AsthAvAnaharUlAI svargamA rahekA varadAnaharU tathA allAhako darzana garnebAre zubhasUcanA dinuhos |

224 timIharU satkarma, Izabhaya tathA mAnisaharU bIcako sambandha sudhArne kAryamA allAhako nAmamA khAeko kasamalAI bAdhaka nabanAU | yadi timIharUle puNya nagarne kasama khAekA chau bhane tyasa kasamalAI toDa ra tyasako jarivAnA deU | allAhale timIharUkA sampUrNa kurAharUlAI sunnuhuncha, jAnnuhuncha ra tyasako badalA dinuhuncha |

225 binA uddezya mukhabATa niskeko kasamaharUprati allAhale timIharUko pakaDa garnuhune chaina | jastai- allAhako kasama! hoina, allAhako kasama! kina nahunu ityAdi bhannu | yo thego jhaiM bolekomA na ta jarivAnA tirnuparcha na uhA~le sajAya nai dinuhuncha | nIyatakA sAtha kasama khAemA allAhale pakaDa garnuhuncha | allAha kSamAzIla ra sahanazIla hunuhuncha | bhaktaharUkA pApaharUlAI mApha garnuhuncha ra tatkAlai unIharUlAI sajAya dinuhunna |

226 AphnA patnIharUsa~ga sahavAsa nagarne kasama khAneharUle kurnuparne antima muddata kasama khAeko dinadekhi cAra mahinA ho | jasalAI “IlA” bhanincha | yadi tinIharUle cAra mahinA vA tyo bhandA kama avadhimA kasama toDera sahavAsa garchan bhane allAha kSamAzIla ra parama dayAlu hunuhuncha | unIharUle gareko galtIlAI allAhale kSamA garnuhuncha | uhA~le yasa saMkaTa (kasama) bATa bAhira niskane upAyako rUpamA kphphArA (jarivAnA) ko zaraI tarikA batAera kRpA garnubhaeko cha |

227 yadi unIharUle tinIharUsa~ga sahavAsa nagarera tathA kasamabATa napharkera talAka dine (sambandha viccheda garne) nirNaya garchan bhane allAha sarvazrotA ra sarvajJAtA hunuhuncha | allAhale talAka lagAyata unIharUko sampUrNa bhanAIharUlAI rAmrarI sunnuhuncha ra unIharUko manasAya ra avasthAbATa avagata hunuhuncha ra tyasako badalA dinuhuncha |

228 talAka (pArapAcuke) diiekI mahilAharUle tIna paTaka mahinAvArI nabhaesamma pratIkSA garUn ra yasa avadhimA bihe nagarUn | tyasaigarI garbha dhAraNa bhaeko kurAlAI nalukAun | yadi unIharU satyavAdI chan ra allAha evaM AkhiratamAthi AsthA rAkhchan bhane | yadi unIharUkA patiharUle sambandha viccheda hune kAraNalAI samApta garI sumadhura sambandha rAkhne vAcA garcha bhane tinIharUle iddata (tIna mahinA) bhitra unIharUlAI phirtA line baDhI adhikAra rAkhchan | mahilAharUlAI pani puruSaharU jastai calanacaltI anusAra haka, adhikAra tathA jimmevArI cha | tara puruSaharU abhibhAvaka bhaekole ra talAka dine adhikAra rAkhekole unIharUmAthi eka darjA prAthamikatA prApta cha | allAha zaktizAlI hunuhuncha, uhA~lAI kasaile vivaza pArna sakdaina | niyama kAnuna banAuna ra tyasako saMcAlanamA tatvadarzI hunuhuncha |

229 yasto talAka jasapachi zrImAnale zrImatIlAI phirtA lina sakcha, duI paTaka mAtra huncha | jastai- talAka diyo ra nizcata avadhibhitra phirtA liyo, pheri talAka diyo ra pheri phirtA liyo | dosro talAkapachi zrImAnale sAmAnyataH zrImatIlAI dAmpatya jIvanamai rokirAkhna sakcha vA tesro talAka diera unako hakaadhikAra diera sammAnakA sAtha vidA pani garna sakcha | he zrImAnaharU ho! vidA gardA timrA lAgi tinIharUlAI dieko kunai cIja vA mahara phirtA linu jAyaja chaina | tara yadi zrImatIle zrImAnako AcaraNa ra raMga rUpa mana naparekole gardA choDpatra (khulaa) garna cAhanchan bhane tyasto paristhitimA zrImAnale dieko cIjabija phirtA linu jAyaja cha | jastaiH duvaimA nirvAha huna sakdaina bhanne kurA duvailAI mahasusa bhaemA duvai janAle Aphno mAmilA nikaTatama nAtedAra vA abhibhAvakaharU samakSa peza garnuparcha | duvaimA nirvAha huna sakdaina bhanne kurA abhibhAvakaharUle mahasusa garemA zrImatIle zrImAnalAI nizcita dhanasampatti diera sambandha viccheda (khulaa) garAuna milcha | zarIatakA yI AdezaharU halAla tathA harAma bIcakA sImA hun, yasalAI ullaGghana garne dussAhasa nagara | allAhakA kAnunaharUko ullaGghana garneharU nai atyAcArI hun | kinabhane yastA mAnisaharU AphUlAI barbAda garchan tathA AphUlAI allAhako risako hakadAra banAu~chan |

230 yadi patile tesro paTaka talAka diyo bhane tyo mahilA aba usakA lAgi halAla (vaidha) hune chaina | yahA~samma usale anya puruSasa~ga Aphno icchAanusAra halAlA garAune manasAya narAkhera vivAha garos ra vivAha gareko zrImAnasa~ga sahavAsa pani hos | tyasapachi yadi usako samabandhamA raheko dosro zrImAnako mRtyu bhayo vA duvaimA khaTapaTa bhayo, ani talAka bhayo bhane mAtra aba tyo mahilA ra pahileko zrImAna duvai janAle allAhako kAnunako pAlanA gardai ApasamA nayA~ mahara diera punaH vivAha garna sakchan | yI allAhakA kAnuna tathA sImAharU hun | yI kAnunaharUko ullaGghana garneharU atyAcArI hun kinabhane tinIharU AphUlAI barbAdImA pArchan ra allAhako risalAI nimatyAu~chan |

231 jaba timIharU mahilAlAI talAka dinchau ta iddata (nizcita avadhi) bhitra yA ta pharkAi hAla vA pracalita tarikA anusAra bidA garideU | tara unIharUlAI kaSTa dine ra atyAcAra garne uddezyale dAmpatya jIvanamA naroka, jasto islAma pUrva garinthyo | jasale mahilAlAI kaSTa dine manasAyale rokcha usale AphUmAthi atyAcAra garcha | allAhakA nizAnI ra AdezaharUlAI khyAla-ThaTTA nabanAU | allAhale timIharUlAI pradAna garnubhaekA anekauM varadAnaharUmadhye mahAna varadAna; kurAna tathA sunnatalAI samjhi rAkha | allAha timIharUlAI prerita garna tathA DarAunako lAgi yasto upadeza dinuhuncha | allAhakA AdezaharUko pAlanA garera tathA varjita kAryaharUlAI tyAgera uhA~sa~ga DarAU | jAnirAkha– allAha sarvajJAtA hunuhuncha | uhA~bATa kunai kurA lukeko chaina | uhA~le timIharU sabailAI karmako badalA dinuhunecha |

232 yadi timIharUle zrImatIlAI tInabhandA kama talAka diekA chau ra iddata purA bhayo bhane he abhibhAvakaharU ho! yadi tI mahilAharU purAnai zrImAnaharUtarpha pracalita tarikA anusAra rAjIkhusI nayA~ nikAha garera pharkana cAhanchan bhane unIharUlAI naroka | allAha evaM AkhiratamAthi AsthA rAkhne sabailAI bihe garna roka nalagAune Adeza diieko cha | yasarI timIharU samRddha hunechau ra timIharUko ijjata tathA satkarma jogine cha | sampUrNa mAmilAkA vAstavikatA tathA pariNAmalAI allAhale rAmrarI jAnnuhuncha; timIharU po jAndainau |

233 stanapAna garAune AmAharUle AphnA zizuharUlAI duI varSasamma dUdha khuvAun | talAka pAekI dUdha khuvAune AmAharUko nirvAha-vyaya tathA pAlana-poSaNa kharcako jimmedArI pracalita tarikA anusAra zizuko pitAmAthi huncha | duI varSako avadhi tyasako lAgi cha, jo purA avadhisamma dUdha khuvAuna cAhancha | allAhale kunai pani vyaktilAI tyati mAtra jimmevArI dinuhuncha jati usako sAmarthya huncha | AmA bAbumadhye kasaile pani zizulAI eka arkAlAI kaSTa dine hatiyAra nabanAun | pitAko mRtyu bhaeko khaNDamA tyo jimmevArI vArisa (abhibhAvaka) mAthi Au~cha | duvaile ApasI samajhadArI evaM sallAhamA duI varSako avadhi purA nagarikana pahilA nai dUdha chuTAuna cAhemA unIharUmAthi kunai Apatti chaina | yadi timIharU AphnA zizuharUlAI AmAbAheka anya mahilAko dUdha khuvAuna cAhanchau bhane yasamA pani kunai Apatti chaina | yadi samjhautA anusAra kamI tathA DhIlA nagarikana mahilAlAI bhuktAnI garchau bhane | allAhakA AdezaharUko pAlanA garera tathA varjita kAryaharUlAI tyAgera uhA~sa~ga DarAU | jAnirAkha, allAha timIharUle garekA sabai kAryalAI dekhirAkhnu bhaeko cha, kunai kurA uhA~bATa lukeko chaina ra uhA~le timIharUko sabai karmako badalA dinuhuncha |

234 timIharUmadhye kasaiko mRtyu huncha ra AphU pachADi garbha dhAraNa nagarekI patnIharU choDcha bhane tI patnIharUle cAra mahinA dasa dinasamma patikai gharamA parkhanuparcha ra yasa avadhimA banAva siMgAra garnu, ghara bAhira niskanu tathA bihe garnu hu~daina | he abhibhAvakaharU ho! iddata purA garepachi unIharUle zarIata tathA pracalita tarikA anusAra banAva siMgAra tathA bihe garemA timIharUlAI kunai pApa lAgne chaina | timIharU je gardaichau tyasako khabara allAhale rAkhnuhuncha ra tyasako badalA dinuhuncha |

235 talAka vA patiko mRtyuko kAraNale gardA iddatamA rahekI mahilAlAI sAGketikarUpamA viheko sandeza dina vA iddata purA bhaepachi bihe garchu bhanne kurA manamA lukAera rAkhna milcha | duvai avasthAmA timIharUlAI kunai pApa lAgne chaina | khullA rUpamA nabhanikana sAMketika rUpamA yasarI bhanna milcha– iddata purA bhaepachi malAI batAunu holA | timIharUko manamA mahilAharUko ati cAhanA bhaekole avazya unIharUlAI manamA yAda garnechau bhanne kurA allAhalAI rAmrarI thAhA cha | tara tinIharUle iddata bitAi raheko avasthAmA gopya rUpamA kunai pani vacana nadeU | yadi kunai kurA garnucha bhane sAmAnya rUpamA gara ra iddatako avadhimA vivAha pakkA nagara | jAnirAkha, allAha timIharUko manakA sampUrNa kurAharU jAnnuhuncha | uhA~sa~ga DarAU ra uhA~ko Adezako ullaGghana nagara | jAnirAkha– nissandeha allAha taubA garne bhaktaharUprati ekadamai kSamAzIla ra sahanazIla hunuhuncha ani bhaktaharUlAI turuntai sajAya dinuhunna |

236 timIle kunai mahilAsa~ga nikAha (vivAha) mAtra garekA chau, unIsa~ga sahavAsa ra mahara nirdhAraNa garekA chainau, yasto avasthAmA AphnA tI patnIharUlAI talAka diemA timIharUmAthi kunai doSa lAgdaina | yasto avasthAmA talAka diemA mahara tirnu pardaina tara kehI na kehI avazya dinuparcha | sampanna vyaktile Aphno sAmarthya anusAra baDhI ra garibale Aphno sAmarthya anusAra thorai die pugcha | satkarmIharUmAthi yo eka prakArako jimmevArI ho jo unIharUle vyavahArika rUpamA garnuparne huncha |

237 yadi timIharUle sahavAsa garnuaghi tara mahara nirdhAraNa garisakepachi talAka dinchau bhane timIharUle nirdhArita maharako AdhA tirnuparcha | yadi mahilAharUle mahara li~dainan bhane jAyaja cha ra patile namratA apanAera purA mahara dinchan bhane yasako pani anumati cha | duvai pakSale eka arkAko hakalAI mApha garnu rAmro kurA ho | namratA apanAunu Izabhaya rAkhneharUkA lAgi rAmro ho | he mAnava! timIharUbIca ekalAI arkAmAthi juna zreSThatA prApta cha tyo nabirsa | timIharU je garchau allAhale dekhirahanu bhaeko cha, tasartha baDhI bhandA baDhI puNya prApta garnako lAgi ajha rAmro garne prayAsa gara |
238 allAhako Adeza anusAra pUrNarUpamA salAha (namAja) kAyama gara | vizeSa rUpamA bIcamA parne asra salAhako rakSA gara ani ekAgra tathA namra bhaera allAhako lAgi ubhane gara |

239 zatru ityAdiko Darale gardA pUrNarUpamA salAha (namAja) paDhne avasthA nabhaemA paidala, ghoDA vA U~TamA savAra bhaekai avasthAmA jasarI huncha namAja paDhne gara | trAsako avasthA samApta bhaisakepachi uhA~ko Adeza anusAra allAhakA vibhanna tarikAle jikra tathA smaraNa gara ra uhA~kA upakAralAI yAda gara | vizeSagarI pUrNarUpamA yasarI salAha (namAja) kAyama gara jasarI allAhale timIharUlAI sikAunubhayo, jaba ki timIharU prakAza tathA mArgadarzanabATa anabhijJa thiyo |

240 tI mAnisaharU jasako mRtyuko samaya Au~cha tinIharUle AphnA pachADi choDekA AphnA patnIharUkA lAgi eka varSasamma khAnA kharca diine tathA gharabATa jabarajastI nanikAline vasiyata (antima Adeza) garUn | unIharU Aphno icchAle svayaM eka varSa purA nagarikana niskanchan ra sAmAnya niyamAnusAra Aphno banAva siMgAra ityAdi garchan bhane tyasako lAgi na timIharUlAI kunai pApa lAgcha na unIharUlAI | allAha atyanta prabhutvazAlI hunuhuncha, anya kohI uhA~mAthi hAvI huna sakdaina, uhA~ Aphno sampUrNa kAryaharUmA tatvadarzI hunuhuncha | vyAkhyAkAraharUmadhye adhikAMzako mAnyatAanusAra yasa AyatamA raheko Adeza yasai sUraha 2 ala bakaraha Ayata 234 bATa radda garIeko cha, jasamA bhanieko chaH timIharUmadhye kasaiko mRtyu huncha ra AphU pachADi patnIharU choDcha bhane tI patnIharUle cAra mahinA dasa dinasamma patikai gharamA parkhanuparchaM |

241 talAka (pArapAcuke) pAisakekI mahilAlAI talAka dieko zrImAnale pracalita tarikA tathA Aphno kamAianusAra baDhI vA thorai khAnA, kharca, lugA dinuparcha, tAki talAkale gardA TuTeko hRdayalAI sAntvanA milosa | allAhakA AdezaharUko pAlanA garera tathA varjita kAryaharUlAI tyAgera uhA~sa~ga DarAune saMyamIharUmAthi yaso garnu anivArya cha |

242 he mominaharU ho! yasa aghikA AyataharUmA allAhale timIharUlAI spaSTa rUpamA AphnA kAnuna tathA sImAharU batAunubhayo | AzA cha timIharUle rAmrarI bujhera, samjhera tathA vyavahAramA lyAera loka ra paraloka duvaiko bhalAi prApta garnechau |

243 he nabI (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! ke mRtyuko Darale Aphno gharabAra choDera bhAgekA banI isrAIlako bAremA tapAIMle khabara pAunubhayo? tinIharU saruvA roga ityAdiko Darale bhAgekA thie ra tinIharU ThUlo saMkhyAmA thie | allAhale bhannubhayo– mari hAla, ani tinIharU marihAle | allAhale tinIharUlAI punaH jIvita pArnubhayo, tAki tinIharU samakSa yo kurA spaSTa hos ki allAha nai sabai vastukA mAlika hunuhuncha | tinIharU AphnA nAphA ra ghATAkA mAlika hoinan | allAha nai mAnisaharUmAthi kRpAvAna hunuhuncha | tara adhikAMza mAnisaharU uhA~prati AbhAra prakaTa gardainan |

244 he mominaharU ho! allAhako kalimA (vANI) ucca pArna tathA uhA~ko dharmalAI gharadailosamma puryAunako lAgi uhA~kA zatruharU viruddha yuddha gara ani jAnirAkha– allAha timIharUkA kurAharUlAI sunnuhuncha ra timIharUko manako kurAlAI rAmrarI jAnnuhuncha ani yasako badalA dinuhunecha |

245 kohI cha jasale allAhako bATomA puNyako nIyatale RNa dine? ani allAhale tyasalAI kaiyauM guNA baDhAera phirtA garnuhuncha | uhA~le nai Aphno viveka tathA nisAphale kasailAI atyAdhika rojIroTI, jIvikA tathA svAsthya ityAdi pradAna garnuhuncha, ani kasailAI dhau-dhau pArnuhuncha | paralokamA timIharU uhA~tarpha nai pharkAera laginechau ani uhA~le timIharUkA karmako ucita badalA dinuhunecha |

246 he nabI! ke tapAIMle mUsA (alaihissalAma) pachi banI isrAIlakA aguvAharUko bAremA jAnakArI pAunu bhaena? jaba unIharUle AphnA sandeSTAlAI bhanekA thie– hAmro lAgi ekajanA zAsaka niyukta garidinuhos, hAmI uhA~ko sAthamA allAhako lAgi yuddha garnechauM | sandeSTAle bhane– allAhale yuddha anivArya garepachi timIharUle yuddha gardainau ki bhanne Dara cha | unIharUle bhane– hAmIlAI allAhako mArgamA yuddha garnabATa kohI pani rokna sakdaina, kinabhane zatruharUle hAmIharUlAI hAmrA dezabATa nikAlekA chan ra hAmrA santAnaharUlAI kaida garekA chan | hAmI Aphno dezalAI mukta garna ra santAnaharUlAI choDAunako lAgi avazya yuddha garnechauM | tara jaba allAhale yuddha anivArya garnubhayo taba kehI mAnisaharU bAheka sabai vimukha bhae | allAha atyAcArI tathA avajJAkArIharUlAI rAmrarI jAnnuhuncha ra tinIharUko karmako badalA avazya dinuhunecha |

247 unIharUkA sandeSTAle bhane– allAhale tAlUtalAI timIharUkA lAgi zAsaka niyukta garnubhaeko cha, timIharU unako jhaNDAmuni yuddha gara | unIharUkA aguvAharUle inakAra gardai ra virodha janAu~dai bhane– unalAI hAmImAthi kasarI zAsana prApta huna sakcha? zAsanako baDhI hakadAra ta hAmI hauM | unI rAja parivArakA pani hoinan ra dherai dhanI pani chainan ki rAja kAja calAuna sakun | sandeSTAle bhane– allAhale unalAI cayana garnubhaeko cha ra baDhI jJAna evaM zArIrika zakti pradAna garnubhaeko cha | allAha jasalAI cAhanuhuncha Aphno viveka tathA kRpAbATa rAjya sattA pradAna garnuhuncha | allAha mahAna hunuhuncha jasalAI jati cAhanuhuncha pradAna garnuhuncha ra sarvajJa hunuhuncha, sattAko baDhI hakadAra ko ho bhanne kurA jAnnuhuncha |

248 unIharUkA sandeSTAle bhane–tAlUta timIharUko rAjA niyukta garieko ho bhanne kurAko pahicAna ke hunecha bhane allAhale timIharUko tAbUta (unIharUbATa khosieko pavitra peTI) phariztAdvArA phirtA paThAunuhuncha | yo tyo peTI ho jasalAI isrAIlakA santAna dherai kadara gardathe | jasabhitra timIharUkA lAgi zAnti sAmagrI ra mUsA evaM hArUna (alaihimassalAma) kA santatile choDekA vastuharUko zeSa aMza hunechan, jastai laThThI, kehI pATIharU ityAdi | nissandeha yasamA timIharUkA nimti nizAnI cha, yadi timIharU pakkA AsthAvAna hau bhane |

249 jaba tAlUta senAharUlAI liera Aphno dezabATa prasthAna gare taba unale bhane– nizcaya nai allAhale euTA nadIdvArA timIharUko parIkSA linuhunecha | jasale tyo nadIbATa pAnI khAnecha U mero mArgamA rahane chaina ra ma sa~ga yasa yuddhamA bhAga lina pAune chaina | tara jasale bAdhya bhaera eka-Adha aJjulI khAncha usamAthi kunai Apatti chaina | tara unIharUmadhye kehI vyakti bAheka sabaile tyasako pAnI khAe | kehI vyaktiharUle ati tirkhAlu bhae pani pAnI khAenan | tAlUta tathA unIsa~ga ImAna lyAekA mAnisaharUle jaba nadI pAra gare taba kehI sainikaharUle bhane– Aja jAlUta evaM usakA senAharU viruddha yuddha garne zakti hAmImA chaina | tara unIharUmadhye mahApralayako dina allAhasa~ga sAkSAta hunecha bhanI vizvAsa rAkhneharUle bhane– katipaya mominakA sAnA samUhale allAhako AjJAdvArA kAphirakA zaktizAlI samUhamAthi vijaya prApta garekA chan | allAhako maddata uhA~mAthi vizvAsale gardA Au~cha ThUlo saMkhyAko mAnyatA hu~daina | allAha dhairyavAna bhaktaharUkA sAtha hunuhuncha ra unIharUko maddata garnuhuncha |

250 unIharUle jAlUta evaM usakA senAviruddha yuddhako lAgi tayAra bhaepachi allAhasita prArthanA gare– he hAmrA pAlanakartA! hAmIlAI dhairya garne kSamatA pradAna garnuhos, hAmrA pAuharUlAI majabuta pAridinuhos tAki zatruharU viruddha aDiga bhaera laDauM ra maidAna choDera nabhAgauM | kAphiraharUko viruddha laDnamA hAmIlAI sahayoga pradAna garnuhos |

251 antataH mominaharUle allAhako kRpAle tinIharUlAI parAjita gare ra dAUdale zatruharUko senApati jAlUtako hatyA gare | allAhale unalAI zAsana tathA nubuvvata (IzadUtatva) pradAna garnubhayo ani loka ra paraloka duvaimA kAma lAgne jJAna pradAna garnubhayo | allAhale mAnisaharUlAI ekaarkAdvArA parAsta garI haTAune niyama nabhaeko bhae dhartImA pApIharUko rAjale gardA vidhvaMsa phailine thiyo | tara allAha sabai sRSTiharUprati udAra hunuhuncha |

252 he nabI! yI allAhakA spaSTa nizAnIharU hun, jasalAI hAmI tapAIMsAmu paDhera sunAu~daichauM | juna satya sUcanA tathA nyAyapUrNa AdezaharUmA AdhArita chan | nizcaya nai tapAIM allAhakA sandeSTA hunuhuncha |

253 hAmIle varNana garekA rasUlaharUmadhye kehI rasUlaharUlAI vahI, anuyAyI tathA sthAnamA zreSThatA pradAna garekA chauM | jastai- sandeSTA mUsA (alaihissalAma) sa~ga allAhale kurAkAnI garnubhayo | antima sandeSTA muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) lAI sampUrNa mAnavajAtikA lAgi vizvavyApI sandeSTA ra sampUrNa sandeSTAharUkA samApaka banAera paThAunubhayo | tyasaigarI uhA~ (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) ko samudAya (anuyAyI) lAI anya sabai samudAyaharUmAthi zreSThatA pradAna garnubhayo | hAmIle maryama-putra IsA (alaihissalAma) lAI unako nubuvvatalAI puSTi garne spaSTa camatkAraharU pradAna garyauM, jastai murdAlAI jIvita pArnu, andho tathA kuSTha rogIlAI niko pArnu | allAhako AdezalAI kAryAnvayana garnamA jibrIla (alaihissalAma) dvArA unako maddata gariyo | yadi allAhale cAhanu bhaeko bhae tinIharUle spaSTa nizAnIharU pazcAt ApasamA jhagaDA garne thienan | tara tinIharUbIca matabheda bhayo ra tinIharU vibhinna samUhamA vibhAjita bhae | tinIharUmadhye kehI momina bhae bhane kehIle kuphra gare | allAhale cAhanu bhaeko bhae tinIharU ApasamA jhagaDA garne thienan | allAha je cAhanuhuncha garnuhuncha, jasalAI cAhanuhuncha Aphno kRpAle mArgadarzana dinuhuncha ra jasalAI cAhanuhuncha nisApha tathA vivekako AdhAramA pathabhraSTa pArnuhuncha |

254 he mominaharU ho! hAmIle pradAna gareko vibhinna khAle halAla dhanasampattibATa mahApralaya hunu pUrva nai kharca gara | tyo dina nata kasaile kina beca garera nAphA kamAuna sakcha; nata tyo kaThina ghaDImA mitratAle kAma dinecha | nata kasaiko pahu~ca vA siphArisale allAhako anumati binA kasailAI phAidA puryAuna sakcha na hAni nai | allAhako inkAra gareko kAraNale kAphiraharU atyAcArI hun |

255 allAhabAheka kohI vAstavika pUjya chaina | uhA~kai lAgi paripUrNa jIvana cha | uhA~lAI mRtyule chuna sakdaina | uhA~ Atma-nirbhara hunuhuncha | uhA~lAI sRSTimadhye kasaiko sahayoga cAhieko chaina | tara sampUrNa sRSTiharU uhA~mAthi nirbhara chan | uhA~ko kRpAbinA eka kSaNa pani kohI Tikna sakdaina | uhA~lAI na ta uMgha lAgcha na nindrA nai | AkAzaharU tathA pRthvIkA sampUrNa sRSTi ra tyasa bhitra bhaekA cIjaharU uhA~kai hun | uhA~ko anumati ra cAhanA binA kasaile pani kasaiko siphArisa garna sakdaina | vigatamA ghaTekA ra bhaviSyamA ghaTine sabai kurAharU rAmrarI jAnnuhuncha | uhA~le nacAhesamma kasaile pani uhA~ko jJAnako sAno aMza jAnna sakdaina | uhA~ jati cAhanuhuncha tyati mAtra jJAna pradAna garnuhuncha | uhA~ko kursI (khuTTA rAkhne sthAna) le yo vizAla AkAzaharU ra pRthvI sabailAI ghereko cha | AkAzaharU tathA pRthvIko saMrakSaNale uhA~lAI thakita tulyAu~daina | uhA~ Aphno astitva, zakti ra zAsanamA mahAna hunuhuncha |

256 islAma dharmamA kunai jabarajastI chaina | islAma satya ra ekadamai spaSTa dharma ho | tyasaile yasamA pravezako lAgi kasaimAthi jabarajastI garne kurai chaina | kinabhane pathabhraSTatAbATa mArgadarzana spaSTa rUpamA alaga bhaisakeko cha | nizcaya nai jasale allAha bAheka sampUrNa pUjyalAI asvIkAra garera eka allAhamAthi ImAna lyAyo, usale mahApralayako dina saphalatA pradAna garne ani kahilyai na TuTne baliyo mAdhyama samAtyo | allAha AphnA bhaktaharUkA kurAharU sunnuhuncha, unIharUkA karmaharUlAI jAnnuhuncha ra tyasako ucita badalA dinuhunecha |

257 allAha mominaharUkA mitra hunuhuncha | unIharUlAI rAmro kurAko zakti pradAna garnuhuncha ra sahayoga garnuhuncha | unIharUlAI kuphra tathA ajJAnatAko andhakAraharUbATa nikAlI ImAna tathA jJAnako prakAzatarpha DoryAunuhuncha | tara kAphiraharUkA mitra jhuTA bhagavAna tathA mUrtIharU hun | jo tinIharUko kuphralAI AkarSaka banAu~chan | tinIharUlAI ImAna tathA jJAnako prakAzabATa nikAlI kuphra tathA ajJAnatAko andhakAraharUtarpha DoryAu~chan | vAstavamA, tinIharU narkabAsI hun, jahA~ sadAsarvadA rahanechan |

allAhale duIvaTA samUhako varNana garepachi unIharUkA duIvaTA udAharaNa pani bayAna garnubhaeko chaH
258 he nabI! ke tapAIMle tyasa atyAcArIko bAremA thAhA pAunu bhaena, jasale ibrAhIma (alaihissalAma) sa~ga allAhako bAremA vAda vivAda gareko thiyo | allAhale tyasalAI rAjya pradAna garnubhaeko thiyo? jaba ibrAhIma (alaihissalAma) le Aphno pAlanakartA (allAha) kA guNaharU bayAna gardai bhaneH mero pAlanakartA uhA~ hunuhuncha, jasale jIvana ra mRtyu dinuhuncha | taba usale ghamaNDa gardai bhanyoH ma pani kasailAI mAphI diera jIvana dinchu ra kasaiko hatyA garera mRtyu dinchu | ibrAhIma (alaihissalAma) le tyasa bhandA ThUlo tarka diMdai bhaneH allAhale pUrva dizAbATa sUrya udAunu huncha; timIle pazcima dizAbATa udAera dekhAU | yati ThUlo tarka sunera tyo atyAcArI Azcarya cakita ra anuttarita bhayo | allAha atyAcArIharUlAI mArgadarzana garnuhunna |

259 vA tyo vyaktiko bAremA thAhA pAunu bhaena, jo yasto gAu~bATa gujriyo, jahA~kA gharaharU chAnA tathA parkhAla sahita bhatkera ghopTo parekA thie ra tyasakA sabai bAsindAharU marekA thie | tyo vyaktile Azcarya vyakta gardai bhanyoH allAhale yahA~kA bAsindAharUlAI kasarI jIvita pArnuhuncha? allAhale tyo vyaktilAI mRtyu dinubhayo ra punaH eka saya varSapachi jIvita pArI uThAunu bhayo | ani sodhnubhayo– timI tyasa avasthAmA kati samayasamma basyau? usale bhanyo– eka dina vA AdhA dina holA | allAhale bhannubhayo– hoina, timI eka saya varSasamma mRta avasthAmA thiyau | timro khAdya ra peyapadArthatarpha hera, cA~Dai saDne yI vastu saDekA chainan | tara cA~Dai nasaDne mRta gadhAtarpha hera tyo ta saDisakeko cha | timIlAI mAnisaharUkA lAgi cinha tathA nizAnI banAuna hAmIle yasto garekA hauM tAki mAnisaharUlAI marepachi allAhale kasarI jIvita pArnuhuncha bhanne kurA charlaGga hos | gadhAko hADaharUtarpha hera hAmI kasarI tinIharUkA DhA~cA khaDA garchauM ra tyasamA mAsu caDhAu~chauM! jaba sabai kurA usako sAmu spaSTa bhayo taba usale pukArdai bhanyo– avazya nai, allAha hareka kAryako sAmarthya rAkhnuhuncha bhanne kurA maile thAhA pAe~ |

260 he nabI! yAda garnuhos, jaba ibrAhIma (alaihissalAma) le bhaneH he merA pAlanakartA! tapAIM mRtakalAI kasarI jIvita garnuhuncha, ma Aphno A~khAle dekhna cAhanchu | allAhale bhannubhayoH ke timIlAI vizvAsa chaina? ibrAhIma (alaihissAma) le bhane– ho, malAI vizvAsa cha, tara mero Atma-santuSTiko lAgi mAtra yo nivedana gareko hu~ | allAhale Adeza dinubhayo– cAra vaTA paMkSIharU lyAU ra tinIharUlAI TukrA pArera tI TukrAharUlAI timro varipari rahekA pahADaharUmA rAkha, ani tinIharUlAI DAka | tinIharU timItarpha jIvita bhaera dagurdai Aune chan | he ibrAhIma! jAnirAkha allAha Aphno zAsanamA prabhutvazAlI ra Aphno Adeza, kAnuna tathA sRSTimA tatvadarzI hunuhuncha |

261 allAhako mArgamA AphnA dhanasampatti kharca garneharUko udAharaNa tyasa biu jasto cha, jasalAI kisAnale khetamA charcha ani tyasabATa sAtavaTA bAlAharU utpAdana hunchan; jasakA pratyeka bAlAmA saya-saya vaTA dAnAharU hunchan | allAha AphnA bhaktaharUmadhye jasalAI cAhanuhuncha kaiyauM guNA baDhAera puNya pradAna garnuhuncha ra unIharUlAI behisAba badalA dinuhuncha | allAha ati mahAna ra kRpAvAna hunuhuncha | baDhI puNyako hakadAra kuna bhakta ho bhanne kurAlAI rAmrarI jAnnuhuncha |

262 jo mAnisaharUle allAhako khuzIko lAgi AphnA dhanasampattiharU kharca garchan ra kharca garepachi upakAra garera vA kaSTa diera puNyalAI barbAda pArdainan, unIharUko puNya unIharUkA pAlanakartAkahA~ surakSita cha | unIharUlAI na bhaviSyamA kunai Dara hunecha na vigatamA garekA kAryaprati cintA hunecha |

263 mominalAI khuzI pArne kurA garnu ra citta dukhAunelAI mAphI dinu tyasa sadakA (dAna) bhandA uttama cha jasapachi dAnabATa lAbhAnvita bhaeko vyaktilAI upakAra jatAera kaSTa diincha | allAha AphnA bhaktaharUmAthi Azrita hunuhunna | uhA~ sahanazIla hunuhuncha, yAtanA dinamA hatAra garnuhunna |

264 he AsthAvAnaharU ho! dAna dieko vyaktimAthi upakAra jatAera tathA kaSTa diera tyasa dAnabATa milne puNyalAI barbAda nagara | yasto garne vyakti tyo kAphira jasto cha, jo mAnisaharUlAI dekhAuna tathA tinIharUko prazaMsA baTulnako lAgi dAna dincha tara allAha ra Akhirata (mRtyu pazcAta) ko jIvanamA ImAna rAkhdaina | mAnauM, euTA cillo caTTAna cha jasamAthi mATo jameko cha ra jaba tyasamAthi musaladhAre pAnI parcha taba sabai mATo bagera jAncha ra caTTAna cillo ra khAlI rahancha | dekhAvaTI garneharUko puNya tathA kharca pani ThIka tyastai khera jAncha ra allAhasamma pugdaina | allAha kAphiraharUlAI sIdhA mArga dekhAunu hunna |

265 allAhako prasannatA prApta garne tathA uhA~ko vAcAlAI saccA mAnera khusIle dAna dine mominaharUko udAharaNa ucca sthAnamA raheko yasto bagaiMcA jasto cha, jasale musaladhAre varSA bhaemA dobbara phala dincha | musaladhAre varSA nabhae pani sAmAnya varSA nai phalaphUlako nimti paryApta huncha | yasarI nai allAha asala bhaktaharUko sadakA (dAna) lAI svIkAra garera tyasako puNyalAI khubai baDhAunu huncha, cAhe tyo dAna thorai kina nahos | allAhale timIharUlAI rAmrarI herirAkhnu bhaeko cha | timIharUmadhye ko asala bhakta ra ko kapaTI ho tyasalAI pani rAmrarI jAnnuhuncha ra sabailAI karmaanusAra badalA dinuhunecha |

dekhAvaTI kharca garneharUko udAharaNa–
266 ke timIharUmadhye kunai vyaktile yo kurA mana parAu~cha– buDhesakAlamA usako khajura ra aMgurako bagaiMcAlAI euTA DaDhelole jalAera sakhApa pAros?! yasto bagaiMcA jasako pheda hu~dai nahara bagiraheko hos ra jasamA usako lAgi sabai prakArakA phala houn, jabaki usakA santAnaharU ahile kamajora ra sAnA sAnA houn | yahI ho dekhAvaTIko lAgi kharca garneharUko udAharaNa | mahApralayako dina eka eka puNyako khA~co bhaeko avasthAmA tinIharUlAI allAha samakSa binA puNyako hAjira garinecha | allAha loka ra paraloka duvaimA kAma lAgne AphnA kurAharU spaSTarUpamA varNana garnuhuncha tAki timIharUle cintana-manan gara |

267 he AsthAvAnaharU ho! timIharUle Arjana garekA halAla tathA pavitra kurAharUmadhye ra hAmIle timIharUkA nimti bhUmibATa utpanna garekA uttama vastu kharca gara | kharca garnako lAgi yasto kharAba vastu nachAna juna timI svayam linakA lAgi tayAra hune chainau | yo arkai kurA ho ki tyasako kamI-kamajorIlAI jAnera pani liihAla | juna vastu timIharU svayam Aphno lAgi rucAu~dainau tyo allAhako lAgi kasarI rucAu~chau ॽ jAnirAkha allAhalAI timIharUko sadakAko kunai khA~co chaina | uhA~lAI ta kasaiko AvazyakatA hu~daina | uhA~ Aphno astitva tathA kAryamA prazaMsanIya hunuhuncha |

allAhale uttama vastu kharca garne Adeza diepachi zaitAnako cAlA tathA bhramabATa saceta gardai bhannubhaeko cha–
268 zaitAnale timIharUlAI garibIko Dara dekhAu~cha | kanjusyAi~, pApa tathA duSkarma garna prerita garcha | tara allAhale timIharUlAI mahAna kSamAyAcanA tathA prazasta jIvikA ra sukhamaya jIvanako vacana dinuhuncha | allAha apAra kRpAvAna hunuhuncha ra bhaktaharUkA avasthAlAI rAmrarI jAnnuhuncha |

269 allAha AphnA bhaktaharUmadhye jasalAI cAhanuhuncha tatvadarzitA pradAna garnuhuncha | jasalAI tatvadarzitA pradAna gariyo, mAnauM usalAI sampUrNa bhalAI diiyo | mArgadarzana pAekA buddhimAnaharU mAtra allAhakA nizAnIharUbATa upadeza grahaNa gardachan |

270 timIharU allAhako prasannatA prApta garnako lAgi thorai vA baDhI kharca garchau | vA anivArya nagarieko kehI atirikta puNyalAI AphUmAthi anivArya garchau, jastai bhAkala garnu, tI sabailAI uhA~ jAnnuhuncha ra kunai pani karma khera jAne chaina | allAhale tyasako ati rAmro badalA dinuhunecha | atyAcArI tathA sImA ullaGghanakArIharUko lAgi du:khadAyI yAtanA cha | mahApralayako dina kohI jogAune vAlA sahayogI hune chaina |

271 timIharUle khullArUpamA sadakA (dAna) dinchau bhane yo rAmro kAma ho, tara yadi gopya rUpamA nirdhanaharUlAI dinchau bhane jhan rAmro | kinabhane yasamA baDhI ikhlAsa (nisvArtha) huncha | nisvArthIharUko sadakAlAI allAhale svIkAra garnuhuncha | unIharUko pApalAI kSamA garnuhuncha tathA unIharUko pApamAthi pardA hAldinuhuncha | timIharUle garirahekA kAryaharUko uhA~le khabara rAkhnuhuncha, uhA~bATa kehI pani gopya rahana sakdaina |

272 he nabI! mAnisaharUlAI satya dharma islAma svIkAra garAune ra tyasamAthi hi~DAune jimmevArI tapAIMko hoina | tapAIMko jimmevArI satya mArga batAunu ra tyasako paricaya garAunu mAtra ho | satya mArgalAI AtmasAta garne ra yasaimA aDiga rahane zakti pradAna garne allAhako hAtamA cha | uhA~ jasalAI cAhanuhuncha satmArgamA hi~DAunuhuncha | jejati dhanasampatti timIharU kharca garchau tyasako phAidA timIharUle nai pAunechau kinabhane allAhalAI kasaiko AvazyakatA chaina | timIharUle allAhakai prasannatA prAptikA lAgi kharca garnuparcha | kinabhane vAstavika mominaharUle allAhakai prasannatA prApta garnako lAgi kharca garchan | timIharU je pani kama bezI dhanasampatti kharca garchau timIharUlAI kunai kamI nagarikana pUrNarUpamA tyasako badalA diinecha | uhA~ kasaimAthi atyAcAra garnuhunna |

dAnako varNanapachi dAna line hakadAra vyaktiko bayAna–
273 sadakAlAI tyastA garibaharUmAthi kharca gara jo allAhako mArgamA jihAdamA vyasta bhaekole jIvikopArjanakA lAgi dhartImA kunai bhAgadauDa garna sakdainan | unIharUko svAbhimAnale gardA ra kasaisita namAgeko kAraNale najAnekA mAnisaharUle unIharUlAI sampanna ThAndachan | unIharUko vAhya avasthA jastai lAekA purAnA lugA tathA magante jasto jiddI garera namAgne bAnIbATa unIharUlAI cinna sakchau | timIharU jejati dhanasampatti kharca garnechau tyasalAI allAha avazya nai jAnnuhuncha ra tyasako rAmro badalA dinuhunecha |

274 jo mAnisaharU allAhako khusIko lAgi khullama khullA ra gopya tarikAle dina-rAta kharca garchan, tinIharUlAI allAhale mahApralayako dina rAmro puNya dinuhunecha | unIharUlAI kunai prakArako Dara trAsa hunechaina ra duniyA~mA garna nasakekomA kunai pachuto hunechaina |

muslimaharUbIca paraspara sahayogako lAgi dAna tathA kharcamA joDa diepachi ApasI sambandhalAI bigArne byAjI kArobArabATa manAhI gardai allAhale bhannueko chaH
275 byAjI kArobAra tathA lenadena garne mAnisaharU mahApralayako dina zaitAnale choera baulAhA banAieko mAnisa jhaiM cihAnabATa uThnechan | kinabhane tinIharUle byAjalAI halAla gare | tinIharUle byAja ra halAla vyApAramA pharaka garenan | tinIharUle bhaneH vyApAra jastai byAja pani halAla ho | yI duvaibATa dhanasampatti Arjana huncha | allAhale tinIharUko kurAlAI radda gardai bhannubhayo– vyApAramA sabaiko phAidA bhaekole yo halAla ho | tara byAjamA pIDitamAthi atyAcAra ra usale kaiyauM guNA baDhI rakama anAhaka tirnu parekole yo harAma ho | ataH jasale allAhako Adezapachi byAjako kArobAra tyAga garcha ra taubA garcha, usale pahilA khAeko byAjalAI allAhale mAphI dinuhuncha | usako bhaviSyako mAmilA allAhako hAtamA cha | tara jasale byAja khAnu avaidha ho thAhA hu~dA hu~dai pani byAja khAna choDena, U narkabAsI ho; tyahA~ U sadAsarvadA rahanecha | sadAsarvadA rahanuko artha yo pani hunasakcha ki usale byAjalAI halAla ThAnera khAncha vA yo artha pani hunasakcha ki yasto vyakti lAmo samayasamma narkamA rahanecha | kinabhane mAtra kAphiraharU sadAsarvadAko lAgi narkamA rahanechan | tauhIda (ekezvaravAda) ko dhAraNA rAkhekA muslimaharU sadAsarvadAko lAgi narkamA ra~hadainan |

allAhako mArgamA kharca garnu tathA byAjako kArobArako pariNAma–
276 allAha byAjI kArobArabATa prApta bhaeko dhanasampattilAI samApta pArnuhuncha ra meTAunu huncha | yA ta vAhya rUpamA barbAda pArnuhuncha, yA Antarika rUpamA tyasamA vRddhi nagarera samApta pArnuhuncha | allAhale sadakA (dAna) mA baDhottarI garnuhuncha | tyasako puNyalAI kaiyauM guNA baDhAunu huncha | euTA satkarmako puNya dasa guNAdekhi sAta saya guNAsamma baDhAunu huncha ra tyo bhandA baDhI | sadakA garneharUko dhanasampattimA barkata dinuhuncha | harAmalAI halAla garne tathA avaidha kArobAramA ramAune kaTTarapanthI kAphiraharUlAI allAha kadApi mana parAunu hunna |

277 nizcaya nai jo mAnisaharUle allAhamAthi ImAna lyAe, uhA~kA rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) ko anusaraNa gare, satkarma gare, uhA~ko Adeza anusAra pUrNarUpamA namAja kAyama gare ra hakadAralAI jakAta die, unIharUkA nimti pAlanakartAko pAsamA puNya cha | unIharUlAI kunai prakArako Dara trAsa hune chaina ra duniyA~mA garna nasakekomA kunai pachuto hunechaina |

278 he AsthAvAnaharU ho! allAhakA AdezaharUko pAlanA garera tathA varjita kAryaharUlAI tyAgera uhA~sa~ga Dara | byAjako bakyautA phirtA namAga, yadi timIharU sA~ccikai eka allAhamAthi ImAna rAkhchau tathA byAjalAI manAhI garieko AdezamA AsthA rAkhchau bhane |

279 yadi timIharUle mero Adezako pAlanA garenau bhane allAha evaM rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) sa~ga yuddhako lAgi tayArI gara | yadi timIharUle taubA (prAyazcita) garchau ra byAjalAI tyAgchau bhane timIharUkA lAgi timIharUle RNa dieko mUladhana cha~daicha | sAvA bhandA baDhI liera kasaimAthi atyAcAra nagara ra timIharUlAI mUladhana bhandA kama diera kasaile atyAcAra nagarun |

280 yadi timro RNI garibIle gardA RNa phirtA garne avasthAmA chaina bhane tyasalAI ajhai maukA deU ra usako myAda thapI deU | yadi timIharU RNa phirtA garne mAga choDera usailAI dAnasvarUpa dinchau vA tyasako kehI aMza mApha garchau bhane timIharUkA lAgi jhan rAmro ho | yadi timIharU allAhakahA~ yasako mahatva kati cha bhanne kurA jAndachau bhane |

281 juna dina timIharU allAhako darabAramA ubhine chau, tyasa dinako yAtanAbATa Dara | pratyeka mAnisalAI usale gareko karmako badalA diinecha, rAmro karmako rAmro badalA ra narAmro karmako narAmro badalA | na ta kasaiko puNyamA kamI garera usamAthi atyAcAra garinecha na kasaiko duSkarmamA thapera usalAI baDhI sajAya diinecha |

282 he AsthAvAnaharU ho! yadi timIharU ApasamA RNako lenadena garchau vA kasaile kasailAI nirdhArita samayako lAgi RNa dincha bhane tyasalAI lekhne gara | lekhanadAsale nyAya-nisApha ra islAmI kAnuna anusAra lekhos | lekhanadAsale RNako lenadenalAI allAhale pradAna garnubhaeko jJAnako prakAzamA nyAya-nisAphakA sAtha lekhna asvIkAra nagaros | RNa line vyaktile bhane bamojima lekhanadAsale lekhos, tAki yo usako tarphabATa manjurInAmA hos | usale allAhako bhaya garos ra RNako mAtrA, kisima vA kaiphiyatamA kunai kamI nagaros | yadi RNIko umera pugeko chaina vA Arthika kArobAra samhAlne kSamatA chaina vA mAnasika santulana ThIka chaina vA lATA bhaekole svayam lekhAune avasthAmA chaina bhane usako abhibhAvakale satya tathA nyAyapUrvaka lekhAos | timIharUle duIjanA imAnadAra ra satyavAna puruSaharUlAI sAkSI banAU | duIjanA puruSa upalabdha nabhaeko khaNDamA ekajanA puruSa ra duIjanA imAnadAra mahilAlAI sAkSI banAU | ekale birseko khaNDamA arkole smaraNa garAuna sakos | RNako lenadena garne kramamA sAkSIharUlAI bolAu~dA Auna asvIkAra nagarUn | RNa sAno hos vA ThUlo, timIharUle tyasako avadhi tokera lekhna alchI nagara | RNa lenadena gardA lekhnu allAhako dRSTimA nyAyapUrNa tarikA ho | RNalAI lekhemA gavAha juTAuna ra RNa cuktA garnamA pani sahAyaka huncha | bhaviSyamA RNako kisima, mAtrA ra samaya-avadhibAre utpanna huna sakne zaGkAko DhokA pani lekhne kAryale banda garcha | tara nagadI kArobAramA lekhne AvazyaktA nabhaemA nalekhe pani huncha | jhagaDAbATa joginako lAgi gavAha khaDA garne Adeza diieko cha | sAkSI, lekhanadAsa vA gavAha DAknelAI kunai kaSTa dinu vaidha chaina | yasto garemA timIharU allAhako avajJA garnechau | he mominaharU ho! allAhakA AdezaharUko pAlanA garera ra varjita kAryaharUlAI tyAgera uhA~sa~ga DarAU | uhA~le loka ra paralokamA phAidA puryAune kurAharU sikAunu huncha | uhA~ sarvajJa hunuhuncha | kunai pani vastu uhA~bATa lukeko chaina |

283 yadi timIharU yAtrAmA chau ra RNako lenadena gardA lekhanadAsa bheTAu~dainau bhane RNadAtAko pAsamA dhito rAkha | tyo dhito RNa phirtA garne eka prakArako jamAnata vA pratyAbhuti huncha | yadi RNadAtAle RNImAthi bharosA garcha bhane na ta lekhnu parcha, na gavAhI cAhincha ra na dhito rAkhnuparcha baru tyo RNa, RNImAthi amAnata (nAso) huncha, jasalAI RNIle RNadAtAlAI phirtA garnuparcha | yasto avasthAmA RNIle yasa amAnatako bAremA allAhasa~ga DarAunuparcha | bhaviSyamA inkAra garna mildaina | yadi RNIle inkAra garyo bhane RNako lenadena gareko belA upasthita gavAhale naDhA~Tikana gavAhI dinuparcha | yadi gavAhale kurA lukAyo bhane U pApI huncha | timIharUle garne garekA sabai kAryaharUlAI allAha jAnnuhuncha | uhA~bATa kehI pani lukeko chaina | uhA~le timIharUko karmaharUko badalA dinuhunecha |

284 AkAzaharU ra pRthvImA rahekA sabai prANI, vastu tathA vyavasthApana allAhakai hun | timIharUle manamA rAkhekA kurA prakaTa gara vA gopya rAkha, allAhale tI sabailAI jAnnuhuncha ra timIharUsa~ga tyasako hisAba linuhunecha | tyasapachi uhA~le jasalAI cAhanuhuncha Aphno kRpA tathA dayAle mApha garnuhunecha ra jasalAI cAhanuhuncha nisApha tathA vivekako AdhAramA daNDa dinuhunecha | allAha sabai kAryamAthi sAmarthya rAkhnuhuncha |

285 IzadUta muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) le AphnA pAlanakartAko tarphabATa avatarita kurAharUmAthi ImAna lyAunu bhaeko cha ra mominaharUle pani tyastai ImAna lyAekA chan | yinIharU sabai allAha, uhA~kA sabai phariztAharU, uhA~le AphnA sandeSTAharUmAthi avataraNa garnubhaekA granthaharU evaM paThAunu bhaekA sabai rasUlaharUmAthi yo bhandai ImAna lyAe– hAmI allAhakA rasUlaharUbIca kunai bhedabhAva gardainauM | mominaharUle bhane– hAmIle tapAIMkA AdezaharU tathA varjita kurAharUlAI sunyauM | AdezaharUko pAlanA garera tathA varjita kurAharUlAI tyAgera tapAIMko AjJApAlana garyauM | he hAmrA pAlanakartA! hAmI kSamA yAcanA garchauM | hAmI jIvanakA sampUrNa mAmilAharUmA tapAIMtarpha nai pharkine garchauM |

286 allAha kunai pani vyaktimAthi usako kSamatA bhandA baDhI bojha dinuhunna | islAma ekadamai sajilo dharma ho | yasamA kehI apThyAro chaina | jasale jati rAmro karma garcha tyasako puNya usaile pAunecha, tyasamA kunai kaTauti garine chaina | jasale jati pApa garcha tyasako daNDa usaile bhognuparne huncha, anya kasaile bhogne chaina | rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) tathA mominaharUle bhane– he hAmrA pAlanakartA! anjAnamA hAmIbATa kehI galtI huncha bhane tyasako kAraNa hAmIlAI sajAya nadinuhos | he hAmrA pAlanakartA! sahana nasakne bojha hAmImAthi narAkhnuhos, jasto tapAIMle hAmIbhandA aghikA samudAyaharU, jastai yahUdImAthi rAkhnu bhaeko thiyo | he hAmrA pAlanakartA! hAmIle sahana nasakne Adeza ra jimmevArIharUko bojha hAmImAthi narAkhnuhos | hAmrA pApaharUlAI mApha garnuhos, kSamA pradAna garnuhos ra Aphno kRpAbATa dayA garnuhos | tapAIM hAmro svAmI tathA sahayogI hunuhuncha | ataH kAphiraharU viruddha hAmIlAI sahayoga pradAna garnuhos |

1 alipha0 lAma0 mIma0! yastA akSaraharUko vyAkhyA sUraha al-bakarahako ArambhamA bhaisakeko cha | yasa sUrahamA arabakA mahAkavi ra sAhityakAraharUle kurAnako cunautIlAI svIkArne A~Ta garna nasakeko kurAtarpha saMketa gariekocha | yadyapi kurAnakA AyataharU tyahI akSaraharUbATa banekA chan, juna akSaralAI joDera timIharU kurA garchau |

2 allAhabAheka kohI vAstavika upAsya chaina | uhA~ sadA jIvita rahane pUrNa jIvana hunuhuncha | na ta mRtyule uhA~lAI chuncha, na kunai kamIkamajorIle | uhA~ AphaiMmA Atmanirbhara tathA paripUrNa hunuhuncha | uhA~lAI sRSTimadhye kunai prANIko kehI AvazyakatA chaina | baru sabai sRSTiharU uhA~mAthi Azrita chan ra uhA~ko kRpA binA eka pala pani Tikna sakdainan |

3 4 he nabI! allAhale tapAIMmAthi kurAna avataraNa garnubhayo jasamA satya sUcanAharU tathA spaSTa ra nyAyapUrNa AdezaharU chan | yasale AphUbhandA pahilekA granthaharUko samarthana garcha | tI kitAbaharUbIca kunai virodhAbhASa chaina | tapAIMmAthi kurAna avataraNa garnuaghi uhA~le sandeSTA mUsA (alaihissalAma) mAthi taurAta tathA sandeSTA IsA (alaihissalAma) mAthi injIla avataraNa garnubhayo | yI sabai kitAbaharUmA mAnavajAtikA lAgi mArgadarzana, nirdezana, loka ra paralokakA bhalAiharU chan | uhA~le phurkAna avataraNa garnubhayo jasabATa satya ra asatyabIca ra mArgadarzana tathA pathabhraSTatAbIca pharaka spaSTa huncha | nizcaya nai allAhakA nizAnIharUlAI asvIkAra garneharUkA lAgi kaDA yAtanA cha | allAha ati prabhutvazAlI hunuhuncha, uhA~mAthi kohI vijaya prApta garna sakdaina | rasUlaharUlAI jhUTlAune tathA uhA~ko Adezako ullaGghana garneharUsita badalA linuhuncha |

3 4 he nabI! allAhale tapAIMmAthi kurAna avataraNa garnubhayo jasamA satya sUcanAharU tathA spaSTa ra nyAyapUrNa AdezaharU chan | yasale AphUbhandA pahilekA granthaharUko samarthana garcha | tI kitAbaharUbIca kunai virodhAbhASa chaina | tapAIMmAthi kurAna avataraNa garnuaghi uhA~le sandeSTA mUsA (alaihissalAma) mAthi taurAta tathA sandeSTA IsA (alaihissalAma) mAthi injIla avataraNa garnubhayo | yI sabai kitAbaharUmA mAnavajAtikA lAgi mArgadarzana, nirdezana, loka ra paralokakA bhalAiharU chan | uhA~le phurkAna avataraNa garnubhayo jasabATa satya ra asatyabIca ra mArgadarzana tathA pathabhraSTatAbIca pharaka spaSTa huncha | nizcaya nai allAhakA nizAnIharUlAI asvIkAra garneharUkA lAgi kaDA yAtanA cha | allAha ati prabhutvazAlI hunuhuncha, uhA~mAthi kohI vijaya prApta garna sakdaina | rasUlaharUlAI jhUTlAune tathA uhA~ko Adezako ullaGghana garneharUsita badalA linuhuncha |
5 pRthvI tathA AkAzamA rahekA kunai pani cIja allAhabATa ojhelamA chaina | uhA~ sabai vastuko vAhya tathA Antarika kurAharU rAmrarI jAnnuhuncha |

6 uhA~le nai Aphno cAhanA anusAra garbhAzayabhitra timIharUkA zarIrakA vibhinna rUpa banAunuhuncha | kasailAI puruSa, kasailAI mahilA, kasailAI sundara, kasailAI kurUpa, kasailAI seto, kasailAI kAlo | uhA~ bAheka anya kohI vAstavika upAsya chaina | uhA~ prabhutvazAlI hunuhuncha, kohI uhA~mAthi vijaya prApta garna sakdaina | uhA~ sRSTi, kArya saJcAlana tathA kAnuna lagAyata hareka kurAmA tatvadarzI hunuhuncha |

7 he nabI! uhA~le nai tapAIMlAI kurAna pradAna garnubhayo jasamA kehI AyataharU ekadamai spaSTa chan, juna mUla kitAba hun ra kurAnakA atyAdhika AyataharU yastai chan | matabheda hu~dA yinai AyataharUdvArA phaisalA garnuparcha | kehI AyataharU anekArtha bokekA chan | jasako artha sabaile bujhna sakdainan | jo mAnisaharUko hRdayamA TeDhopana cha, tinIharU muhakama (spaSTa) AyataharUlAI choDera mutazAbiha (aneka artha lAgne) AyataharUko pachi lAgchan | yasarI tinIharU zaGkA utpanna garI mAnisaharUlAI pathabhraSTa pArchan ra AphUle mAndai Aeko jamAta (majhaba) ko dhAraNA anusAra manaparI DhaMgale tI AyataharUko artha lagAu~chan | vAstavamA, yI AyataharUko vAstavika artha ra sArthakatA allAhabAheka kohI jAndainan | tara asala ra paripakva dharmagurU bhandachan– hAmIle yasa pUrai kurAnamAthi ImAna lyAyauM, kinabhane yI sabai hAmrA pAlanakartAko tarphabATa hun | mutazAbiha (anekArtha lAgne) AyataharUko vyAkhyA spaSTa AyataharUdvArA garchan | vAstavamA buddhimAnaharU mAtra upadeza grahaNa garchan |

8 asala ra paripakva dharmagurU bhandachan– he hAmrA pAlanakartA! tapAIMle hAmIlAI mArgadarzana garepachi hAmrA hRdayalAI satyabATa naphernuhos | satyabATa pheriekAharUbATa TADhA rAkhnuhos | hAmIlAI ati dherai kRpA pradAna garnuhos | Aphno kRpAbATa hAmrA hRdayalAI sIdhA mArgamA rAkhnuhos ra pathabhraSTa nagarnuhos | he hAmrA pAlanakartA! nissandeha tapAIM mahAdAtA hunuhuncha |

9 he hAmrA pAlanakartA! nizcaya nai tapAIMle sampUrNa mAnisaharUlAI hisAba kitAbako lAgi ekatrita garnuhunecha | tyo dina avazya nai Aunecha, tyasamA kunai zaGkA chaina | tapAIM kahilyai pani vAcA toDnuhunna |

10 nissandeha allAha tathA uhA~kA rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) lAI inkAra garne mAnisaharUlAI tinIharUkA dhanasampatti tathA santAnaharUle uhA~ko yAtanAbATa jogAuna sakdainan | na ta yasa lokamA na ta paralokamA | yastA avaguNaharU bhaekA mAnisaharU mahApralayako dina narkako indhana bannechan |

11 yI kAphiraharUko durgati phiraaunakA anuyAyI tathA tinIharUbhandA pahilekA kAphiraharU jhaiM hunecha | unIharUle allAha tathA uhA~ko rasUlalAI jhUTo Thahara gare ani allAhale tinIharUlAI prakopadvArA sajAya dinubhayo | tinIharUkA dhanasampatti tathA santAnale tinIharUlAI jogAuna sakenan | allAhalAI inkAra garne tathA uhA~kA AyataharUlAI jhUTlAune mAnisaharUlAI kaDA daNDa dinuhunecha |

12 he rasUla! kAphiraharUlAI bhanidinuhos– cA~Dai nai mominaharU timIharUmAthi vijayI hunechan | timIharU kuphrakai avasthAmA marnechau | uhA~le timIharUlAI ekatrita garI narkatarpha liera jAnuhunecha | vAstavamA, narka ekadamai nikRSTa sthAna ho |

13 badra nAmI yuddhamA yuddharata duvai jamAtamA timIharUko nimti zikSA cha | euTA samUha allAhako mArgamA yuddha garne AsthAvAnaharUko thiyo | yinIharUko uddezya allAhako vANI (tauhIda) lAI ucca pArnu ra kAphiraharUko vANI (kuphra) lAI tala pArnu thiyo | arko samUha makkAkA kAphiraharUko thiyo | unIharUko uddezya ghamaNDa, dekhAvaTI tathA zatrutAko Ago phailAunu thiyo | unIharUlAI mominaharU AphUbhandA duIgunA zaktizAlI dekhirahekA thie | allAhale AphnA bhaktaharUko maddata garnubhayo | uhA~ jasalAI cAhanuhuncha maddata garnuhuncha | nizcaya nai yasamA buddhimAnaharUkA lAgi ThUlo pATha tathA zikSA cha | tAki unIharUle jAnun– avazya nai vijaya mominaharUko lAgi ho yadyapi yinIharUko saMkhyA~ kama hos ra parAjaya kAphiraharUko lAgi cha yadyapi tinIharUko saMkhyA~ dherai hos |

14 allAhale sUcita garnubhayo– uhA~le mAnisaharUko parIkSAkA lAgi unIharUle mana parAekA sAMsArika kurAharUlAI AkarSaka banAunubhayo, jastai mahilAharU, santAnaharU, sunacA~dI, dhanasampattiharU, ghoDA, U~Ta, gAI, bAkhrA jastA janAvaraharU ra khetI bADI | yI ta kSaNika sAMsArika jIvanakA sAdhanaharU mAtra hun | kehI dinako lAgi mAnisaharU mojamastI garchan ani pheri sabai samApta huna pugchan | mominale yI kurAharUmA lipta hunuhu~daina | uttama bAsa-sthAna ta allAhakahA~ nai raheko cha, tyo ho svarga, jasako lambAi cauDAi AkAza tathA pRthvI barAbara cha |

kSaNika sAMsArika kurAharUko varNanapachi tyo bhandA rAmrA kurAharUko varNana gardai allAhale bhannubhaeko cha–
15 he rasUla! bhanidinuhos– ke ma timIharUlAI yI mana parne vastubhandA uttama vastuko bAremA jAnakArI diU~? allAhakA AdezaharUko pAlanA garne tathA varjita kAryaharU tyAgera Izabhaya rAkhne mAnisaharUkA lAgi ThUlA mahala ra bagaiMcAharU hunechan | jasamA sabai kisimakA phalaphUla ra boTabiruvA ra rukhaharU hunechan | jasako talatirabATa nadIharU kalakala bagirahekA hunechan, tyahA~ sadAsarvadA rahanechan, mRtyu Aunechaina, yastA zrImatIharU hunechan jasakA banoTa tathA AcaraNamA kunai truTi hunechaina | allAhako prasannatA sameta milnecha, kahile risa milnechaina | allAha AphnA bhaktaharUbATa anabhijJa hunuhunna, kunai cija uhA~bATa lukeko chaina ra uhA~le tyasako rAmro badalA dinuhunecha |

16 svargabAsIharU yasarI duA garchan– he hAmrA pAlanakartA! hAmIle tapAIMmAthi ra tapAIMle AphnA rasUlaharUmAthi avataraNa garnubhaekA kitAbaharUmAthi ImAna lyAyauM ra tapAIMkA zarIata (kAnuna) ko pUrNa anusaraNa garyauM | kRpayA hAmIle garekA pApaharUlAI mApha garnuhos ra hAmIlAI narkako yAtanAbATa jogAunuhos |

17 unIharU satkarma gardA, pApalAI tyAgdA ra satkarmako ahvAna gardA pareko du:khapIDAmA dhairya garchan | yinIharU nai Aphno bhanAI ra garAImA satyavAn ra allAhako ibAdatamA pUrNa AjJAkArI chan | yinIharU nai uhA~ko mArgamA kharca garchan | rAtakA antima praharaharUmA kSamAyAcanA garchan | kinabhane tyatikhera duA baDhI svIkAra huncha |

18 allAha bAheka kohI vAstavika pUjya chaina bhanne kurAko sAkSI svayam allAhale dinubhaeko cha | yasa kurAlAI islAmI zAstra ra jagatamA sarvatra phailiekA uhA~kA adabhUta nizAnIharUle pramANita gardachan | yasa kurAko gavAhI phariztAharUle pani dinchan | yasa kurAko gavAhI dharmagurUharUle pani tauhIda (ekezvaravAda) ko varNana garera tathA tyasatarpha arU mAnisaharUlAI AhvAna garera garchan | sabai bhandA mahAna kurA arthAta tauhIdako gavAhI unIharU sabaile dinchan | uhA~le Aphno sampUrNa sRSTiharU tathA unIharUko zarIatamA nisApha kAyama garnuhuncha bhanne kurAko gavAhI unIharUle dinchan | uhA~ bAheka kohI satya pUjya chaina | uhA~ prabhutvazAlI hunuhuncha | uhA~lAI kasaile pani parAjita garna sakdaina | sRSTi garne, kArya saJcAlana garne tathA kAnuna banAune sampUrNa kAryaharUmA uhA~ tatvadarzI hunuhuncha |

19 nissandeha allAhako dRSTimA islAma mAtra svIkArya dharma ho | islAmako artha ho allAhako AjJApAlana tathA bhakti garera uhA~samakSa Atma-samarpaNa garnu | antima sandeSTA muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) sameta sabai sandeSTAharUmA AsthA rAkhnu | allAhale muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) mAthi risAlata (IzadUtatva) samApta pArnubhayo | aba uhA~ (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) ko zarIata mAtra mAnya hunecha | yahUdI ra IsAIharUle jJAna tathA pramANako Agamana pazcAt, eka-arkAmAthi atyAcAra garne uddezyale sAMsArika lobhamA parera matabheda gare ra vibhinna samUhamA vibhAjita bhae | allAhale je jati nizAnIharU AphnA rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) mAthi avataraNa garnubhayo, jasale pani tyasalAI inkAra garcha ra uhA~kA rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) lAI jhUTo Thahara garcha tyasalAI thAhA hunuparcha ki allAha cA~Dai nai hisAba linuhunecha |

20 he rasUla! yadi yinIharUle satya dharma islAmabAre vAda-vivAda garchan bhane, bhanidinuhos– maile ra merA anuyAyImadhye mominaharUle AphUlAI allAhaprati samarpita garekA chauM | he rasUla! yahUdI tathA bahudevavAdIharUlAI sodhnuhos– ke timIharUle AphUlAI niSThApUrvaka tathA maile lyAeko zarIatako anusaraNa gardai allAhaprati samarpita garekA chau? yadi tinIharU AphUlAI allAhaprati samarpita garchan ra tapAIMko zarIatako pAbandI garchan bhane tinIharUle satmArga pAunechan | yadi tinIharU islAma dharmabATa vimukha hunchan bhane tapAIMko jimmevArI mAtra sandeza puryAunu ho ra tinIharUko mAmilA allAhako hAtamA cha | allAha AphnA bhaktaharUlAI rAmrarI nirIkSaNa garnuhuncha ra tinIharUlAI karma anusAra badalA dinuhuncha |

21 allAhakA nizAnIharUlAI asvIkAra garne, nabIharUlAI anAhakamA tathA atyAcArapUrNa tarikAle hatyA garne, nyAya-nisApha tathA satkarmako Adeza dine ra duSkarmabATa rokne mAnisaharUko pani hatyA garne kAphiraharUlAI duHkhada yAtanAko zubhasUcanA sunAi dinuhos |

22 yastA avaguNaharU bhaekA mAnisaharUkA karmaharU barbAda bhae | allAhamAthi AsthA narAkheko kAraNale na lokamA kunai phAidA uThAuna sake na paralokamA nai | tinIharUlAI yAtanAbATa jogAune kohI sahayogI hune chaina |

23 he nabI! ke tapAIMle yahUdIharUko avasthA hernubhaena? jasalAI allAhale taurAtakA kehI jJAnaharU dinubhaeko thiyo, jasamA tapAIMko IzadUtatvabAre sUcanA thiyo | ApasI matabhedalAI tyahI taurAta anusAra samAdhAna garna ahvAna gariyo | tara kehI dharmaguru tathA aguvAharUle Aphno icchA viparIta phaisalA bhaekole allAhako phaisalAlAI bevAstA gardai vimukha bhaera pharke | vAstavamA, tinIharUle allAhako AdezalAI jharko namAnikana mAnnu parne thiyo |

24 mahApralayako dina narkako Agole tinIharUlAI chune chaina, vA choihAlyo bhane kehI dinako lAgi mAtra ho | pheri svargamA praveza garnechan bhanne kurA ThAnera tinIharU satyabATa vimukha bhaekA thie | vAstavamA tinIharUle allAhamAthi mithyA ropana garera bhramamA pare ani allAha tathA uhA~ko dharmako virodha garne dussAhasa gare |

25 jaba hAmI hisAbako lAgi ekatrita garnechauM tyasa samaya tinIharU ekadamai bijogamA hune chan ra lajjita pani | mahApralayamA kunai sandeha chaina | pratyeka mAnisalAI usako karmako badalA purA-purA diinecha ra tinIharUprati anyAya garine chaina | na ta tinIharUkA puNyabATa ghaTAinecha ra na pApamA kehI thapinecha |

26 he rasUla! allAhako prazaMsA gardai bhannuhos– he allAha tapAIM nai loka ra paralokako pAlanakartA hunuhuncha! tapAIMle AphnA sRSTiharUmadhye jasalAI cAhanuhuncha rAjya pradAna garnuhuncha ra jasabATa cAhanuhuncha rAjya khosnuhuncha | jasalAI cAhanuhuncha sammAna pradAna garnuhuncha ani jasalAI cAhanuhuncha Aphno jJAna tathA nisAphale apamAnita garnuhuncha | sabai bhalAi tapAIMkai hAtamA cha | nizcaya nai tapAIM sabai kAryako sAmarthya rAkhnuhuncha |

27 tapAIMkA spaSTa nizAnIharUmadhye ke ho bhane rAtalAI dinamA praveza garAunuhuncha jasale gardA dina lAmo huncha | dinalAI rAtamA praveza garAunuhuncha, jasale gardA rAta lAmo huncha | tapAIM nirjIvabATa sajIvalAI nikAlnuhuncha, jastai kAphirabATa mominalAI ra biubATa biruvA | sajIvabATa nirjIva nikAlnuhuncha, jastai mominabATa kAphira ra kukhurAbATa aNDA | tapAIM jasalAI cAhanuhuncha anagintI dhanasampatti pradAna garnuhuncha |

28 he mominaharU ho! AphnA momina sAthIharUlAI choDera kAphiraharUsa~ga kadApi mitratA nagA~sa | jasale tyaso garcha allAhasa~ga usako kunai sambandha rahane chaina ra na allAhale Usa~ga kunai sambandha rAkhnuhuncha | yadi timIharU tinIharUko zAsanamA hunchau ra DarAu~chau bhane namra zailImA kurA garera tathA namra vyavahAra garera zatrutAlAI manamA lukAera AphUlAI jogAuna sakchau | allAha timIharUlAI svayaMsa~ga DarAuna sAvadhAna garnuhuncha | pApa garera AphUlAI uhA~ko risako hakadAra nabanAU | mahApralayako dina bhaktaharUle AphnA karmako badalA pAunako lAgi uhA~tarpha nai pharkera jAnucha |

29 he nabI! bhanidinuhos– allAhale manAhI garnubhaekA kurAharU; jastai kAphiraharUsa~gako mitratA, cAhe tyasalAI timIharU gopya rAkha vA prakaTa gara allAhalAI tyasako jJAna cha | uhA~bATa kunai pani kurA lukeko chaina | uhA~ AkAzaharU tathA pRthvImA rahekA sabai kurAharUlAI jAnnuhuncha | allAha sabai kurAko sAmarthya rAkhnuhuncha | uhA~lAI kasaile pani hairAna pArna sakdaina |

30 pratyeka mAnisale AphUle Arjana gareko puNya ra pApako bhArI binA kunai kamI mahApralayako dina avazya pAunecha | Aphno pApalAI herdA U ra usako pApabIca lAmo dUrI bhaidieko bhae hunthyo bhanne kAmanA garnecha, tara tyo kAmanA purA hunechaina | allAhale timIharUlAI pApa garera AphUlAI uhA~ko risako bhAgIdAra nabanAuna saceta garnuhuncha | uhA~ bhaktaharUprati ati dayAlu hunuhuncha tyasaile khabaradAra ra saceta garnuhuncha |

31 he rasUla! bhanidinuhos– yadi timIharU vAstavamA allAhasa~ga prema garchau bhane vAhya tathA Antarika duvai rUpamA maile lyAeko zarIatako anusaraNa gara | uhA~le timIharUlAI mAyA garnuhuncha | timIharUkA pApalAI pakhAli dinuhuncha | uhA~ taubA garne bhaktaharUlAI mAphI dinuhuncha ra uhA~ param dayAlu hunuhuncha |
32 he rasUla! bhanidinuhos– allAha evaM uhA~kA rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) ko AjJApAlana gara | yadi tinIharU vimukha hunchan bhane ullaGghanakArI kAphiraharUlAI allAha mana parAunuhunna |

33 allAhale Adama (alaihissalAma) lAI rojnubhayo ani phariztAharUlAI sajdaha garna lagAunu bhayo | nUha (alaihissalAma) lAI rojnubhayo ani dhartImA prathama rasUla banAera paThAunu bhayo | ibrAhIma (alaihissalAma) ra uhA~kA santAnaharUlAI rojnubhayo ani unIharUko santatimA nabI-rasUla prazastai banAunu bhayo | tyasaigarI Ale-imarAnalAI rojnubhayo | allAhale unIharUlAI Aphno yugakA sampUrNa mAnavajAtimAthi zreSThatA pradAna garnubhayo |

34 uparyukta sandeSTA tathA unIharUlAI anusaraNa garne santAnaharU nirantara tauhIda (ekezvaravAda) mA kAyama rahe | eka-arkAbATa ucca AcaraNa ra satkarma sike | allAhale AphnA bhaktaharUkA sampUrNa kurAharU sunnuhuncha ra karmaharU pani rAmrarI jAnnuhuncha | unIharUmadhye jasalAI cAhanuhuncha cayana garnuhuncha |

35 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! smaraNa garnuhos, jaba maryamakI AmA imrAnakI zrImatIle bhanekI thiin– he merA pAlanakartA! maile mero garbhamA raheko zizulAI sabai kAryabATa mukta garera tapAIM ra tapAIMko gharako sevAko lAgi arpaNa garekI chu | kRpayA yasalAI svIkAra garnuhos | nizcaya nai tapAIM mero duAlAI sunnuhuncha ra mero nIyatalAI jAnnuhuncha |

36 jaba unako garbhako samaya purA bhayo ra unIkahA~ chorIko janma bhayo (yadyapi unalAI chorA hune AzA thiyo) taba unale mAphI mAgdai bhanin– he merA pAlanakartA! makahA~ ta chorIko janma po bhaecha! nava AgantukabAre allAhalAI rAmrarI thAhA thiyo | chorI mAnche banoTa ra zaktimA chorA jasto hu~daina | maile unako nAma maryama rAkhidie~ | unalAI ra unakA santAnaharUlAI tiraskRta zaitAnabATa jogAuna tapAIMko zaraNa cAhanchu |
