37 allAhale unako bhAkalalAI khusI-khusI svIkAra garnubhayo ra unalAI rAmrarI hurkAunu bhayo | satkarmIharUko hRdayalAI unItarpha AkarSita garnubhayo | jakariyyA (alaihissalAma) lAI unakA abhibhAvaka banAunu bhayo | jaba-jaba jakariyyA (alaihissalAma) unale ibAdata garne ThAu~mA praveza garne garthe taba-taba unI samakSa rAmro khAne kurA pAu~the | jakariyyA (alaihassalAma) le sodhe– he maryama! yo timro lAgi kahA~bATa Au~cha? unale javAphamA bhanin– yo allAhako tarphabATa ho | nizcaya nai uhA~le jasalAI cAhanuhuncha anagintI khAne kurAharU pradAna garnuhuncha |

38 imrAnakI putrI maryamalAI binA mausamamA pradAna garieko phalaphUla ra rojIroTIlAI dekhepachi jakariyyA (alaihissalAma) le AphU vRddha ra zrImatI bA~jho bhaepani euTA chorAko kAmanA gardai allAhasita yasarI duA gare– he merA pAlanakartA! malAI pani euTA asala chorA pradAna garnuhos | avazya nai tapAIMle duA sunnuhuncha ra tyasalAI purA garnuhuncha |

39 prArthanAsthalamA ubhiera namAja paDhdai gareko avasthAmA phariztAharUle unalAI sambodhana gare– allAhale tapAIMlAI yahayA nAmI chorAko zubhasUcanA dinuhuncha, jasako euTA guNa ke hunecha bhane unI allAhako euTA vANIko puSTikartA hunechan | vANI bhaneko maryama putra IsA (alaihissalAma) hun, kinabhane unako janma vizeSa tarikA (allAhako vANI) bATa bhayo | tyasaigarI unI jJAna tathA bhaktimA Aphno samudAyako saradAra hunechan | allAhako bhaktimA tallIna rahanechan ra sandeSTA evaM satkarmIharU madhyekA hunechan | Aphno kAmavAsanA ra nArIbATa TADhA rahanechan |

40 phariztAharUbATa chorAko zubhasUcanA sunepachi jakariyyA (alaihissalAma) le bhane– he merA pAlanakartA! mero kasarI putra hunasakcha? jabaki ma buDho bhaisakeko chu ra merI patnI bA~jhI chin, santAna janmAune avasthAmA chainin? allAhale javAphamA bhannubhayo– timI buDho tathA timro zrImatI bA~jhI bhae pani allAhale timIlAI chorA pradAna garnuhuncha | allAha hareka kAryako sAmarthya rAkhnuhuncha | Aphno viveka tathA jJAnako AdhAramA je cAhanuhuncha garnuhuncha |

41 jakariyyA (alaihissalAma) le bhane– he merA pAlanakartA! mero zrImatIle mabATa garbha dhAraNa garekI chin bhanne kurAko kunai nizAnI nirdhAraNa garidinuhos | allAhale bhannubhayo– timro nizAnI ke cha bhane, timI mAnisaharUsa~ga tIna dina tIna rAtasamma mAtra saGketale kurAkAnI garna saknechau | yo kunai rogale gardA hoina, nizAnI mAtra ho | yasa avadhimA sA~jha-bihAna allAhako atyAdhika guNagAna gara |

42 he rasUla! yAda garnuhos, jaba phariztAle bhane– he maryama! nizcaya nai tapAIMbhitra rAmrA guNaharU rahekAle allAhale cayana garnubhaeko cha | kamI-kamajorIbATa pavitra garnubhaeko cha ra tapAIMko yugamA rahekA mahilAharUmadhye tapAIMlAI chAnnu bhaeko cha |
43 he maryama! namAja paDhdA lAmo kayAma gara, AphnA pAlana kartAko lAgi sajdA (Dhoga) gara ra rUkU garne satkarmIharUsa~ga rUkU gara |

44 he rasUla! uparyukta jakariyyA tathA maryama (alaihimussAma) kA sUcanA gaiba (adRzya) kA sUcanAharUmadhyekA hun juna hAmI vahI (prakAzanA) dvArA tapAIMlAI batAu~daichauM | maryama (alaihassalAma) ko saraMkSaka ko hunecha bhanne kurAmA dharmaguru tathA satkarmIharUle jhagaDA garekA thie tyatikhera tapAIM tyahA~ hunuhunnathyo ra unIharUle golAprathA dvArA ciThThA nikAle ani jakariyyA (alaihissalAma) lAI ciThThA paryo |

45 he rasUla! smaraNa garnuhos, jaba phariztAharUle bhane– he maryama! allAhale tapAIMlAI euTA yasto chorAko zubhasUcanA dinuhuncha jo binA pitA janma linecha | allAhale bhannuhunecha bhaihAla, ani uhA~ko anumatile chorA bhaihAlcha | jasako nAma masIha maryama-putra IsA hunecha | loka evaM paraloka duvaimA unako lAgi ucca sthAna hunecha | allAhako ekadamai nikaTatama bhaktaharUmadhye hunechan |

46 unI navajAta zizukai avasthAmA mAnisaharUsa~ga kurA garnechan | tyasaigarI paripakva bhaepachi mAnisaharUlAI dharma tathA satkarmako upadeza dinechan | unI Aphno karma tathA bhanAimA satyavAdI hunechan |

47 maryamale binA zrImAna putra pAune samAcAra sunera Azcarya cakita bhaera sodhin– makahA~ kasarI putra hunasakcha, jabaki malAI kunai puruSale choeko chaina, na ta jAyaja tarikAle na nAjAyaja tarikAle nai?! phariztAle uttara die– allAha je cAhanuhuncha garnuhuncha | uhA~ pracalita ra sAmAnya tarikA viparIta timIlAI chorA pradAna garnuhuncha | uhA~ kunai kurAko nirNaya gardA bhaihAla (kun) bhannuhuncha ani tyo huna pugcha | uhA~lAI kasaile pani vivaza pArna sakdaina |

48 allAhale IsAlAI lekhna, paDhna, kurA tathA karma garne zakti tathA dRDhatA pradAna garnuhunecha | unale sandeSTA mUsA (alaihissalAma) mAthi avatarita taurAta tathA svayam IsA (alaihissalAma) mAthi bhaviSyamA avatarita hune injIlako zikSA dinechan |

49 allAhale unalAI isrAIlakA santAnaharUkA nimti rasUla (IzadUta) banAunu hunecha | unale unIharUlAI bhannechan– ma timIharUkA lAgi allAhako rasUla hu~ ra yasto camatkAra liera Aeko chu, jasale ma saccA nabI hu~ bhanne kurAko puSTi gardacha | ma timIharU samakSa mATobATa carA jasto euTA AkRti banAera tyasamA phuknechu ani tyo allAhako AjJAle jIvita carA hunapugcha | ma allAhako AjJAle andhAko upacAra garnechu, ani usale dekhna thAlnecha | ma kuSTha rogIharUlAI nirogI tulyAunechu | mRtaharUlAI jIvita pArnechu, tara yI sabai kurAharU allAhako Adezale mAtra huncha | jo timIharUle khAnchau ra juna khAne kurA AphnA gharaharUmA jogAera rAkhchau, tyasako bAremA sUcanA dinechu | yI mahAna kArya ra camatkAraharU ma timIharUkA lAgi allAhakA rasUla hu~ bhanne kurAko spaSTa cinha ra nizAnIharU hun | kinabhane yI kAryaharU Ama mAnisale garna sakdaina, yadi timIharU ImAna rAkhchau ra yI pramANaharUlAI saccA mAnchau bhane |

50 tyasaigarI ma AphU aghi avatarita taurAtako puSTiko lAgi Aeko chu | mero uddezya timIharUko sahuliyatako lAgi kehI kurAharUlAI vaidha tulyAunu ho juna yasa aghi avaidha gariekA thie | maile je jati bhaneko chu tyasalAI pramANita garna spaSTa pramANa liera Aeko chu | ataH allAhakA AdezaharUko pAlanA garera tathA varjita kAryaharUlAI tyAgera Izabhaya rAkha ra maile bhaneko kurAko AjJApAlana gara |

51 kinabhane allAha mero pani pAlanakartA hunuhuncha ra timIharUko pani | uhA~ nai vAstavika pUjya hunuhuncha | mAtra uhA~kai upAsanA gara | uhA~ko upAsanA garne tathA uhA~sa~ga DarAune Adeza nai sIdhA mArga ho ra yasamA TeDhopana chaina |

52 jaba IsA (alaihissalAma) le tinIharU kuphramA jiddI gariraheko thAhA pAe taba isrAIlakA santAnaharUlAI sambodhana gardai bhane– allAhatarpha ahvAna garne kAryamA ko mero sahayogI bannechan? unakA anuyAyIharUmadhye rAmrA mAnisaharUle bhane– hAmI hauM allAhako dharmako sahayogI | hAmI allAhamAthi ImAna lyAekA chauM ra tapAIMko anusaraNa garekA chauM | he IsA! tapAIM sAkSI basnuhos ki hAmI allAhako mAtra bhakti tathA AjJApAlana gardachauM |

53 havArI (sahayogI) harUle pani tyastai bhane– he hAmrA pAlanakartA! tapAIMle avataraNa garnubhaeko injIlamAthi hAmIle ImAna lyAyauM ra IsA (alaihissalAma) ko anusaraNa garyauM | ataH tapAIM ra tapAIMkA rasUlaharUmAthi ImAna lyAune sAkSIharUmA hAmIlAI pani samAveza garnuhos |

54 isrAIlakA santAnaharUmadhyekA kAphiraharUle sandeSTA IsA (alaihissalAma) lAI hatyA garne calakhela gare | allAhale pani jukti lagAunubhayo ra tinIharUlAI pathabhraSTatAmA choDnubhayo | IsA (alaihissalAma) sa~ga mildo-juldo arko ekajanAlAI banAunubhayo | jukti lagAuneharUmA allAha nai uttama hunuhuncha | kinabhane uhA~ zatruharUlAI kaDA yAtanA dinuhuncha |

55 allAhale tinIharU viruddha tyatikhera pani jukti garnubhayo jaba uhA~le IsA (alaihissalAma) lAI sambodhana garera bhannubhayo– he IsA! ma timIlAI binA mRtyu uThAunechu | timro zarIra tathA AtmAlAI AphUtira lyAune chu; kAphiraharUko phoharabATa pavitra ra unIharUdekhi TADhA garnevAlA chu | timI (ra muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) mAthi ImAna lyAune timrA anuyAyIharUlAI timIlAI inkAra garne (kAphira) ko tulanAmA mahApralayako dinasamma mAna sammAnakA sAtha ucca sthAnamA rAkhnevAlA chu | pheri timIharU mahApralayako dina mAtra matarpha pharkera Aunechau | tyasa belA ma timIharUbIca bhaekA matabhedaharUko phaisalA garnechu |

56 ani timI tathA timIle lyAeko satyalAI inkAra garneharUlAI ma yasa lokamA hatyA, kaida tathA apamAna ityAdi dvArA ra paralokamA narkako Ago dvArA kaDA yAtanA dinechu ra tinIharUlAI yAtanAbATa jogAune kohI sahayogI hunechaina |

57 jo mAnisaharUle timI tathA timIle lyAeko sandezamAthi ImAna lyAe ra namAja, jakAta, rojA, rAmro vyavahAra ityAdi satkarma gare allAhale unIharUko karmako pUrNa badalA pradAna garnuhunecha ra tyasamA kunai kamI garnuhune chaina | yo kurA muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) ko IzadUtatva aghi bitekA masIha (alaihissalAma) kA anuyAyIharUkA lAgi hun | masIha (alaihissalAma) le svayam unIharUlAI yo zubhasUcanA dinubhayo | allAhale atyAcArIharUlAI mana parAunuhunna | sabaibhandA ThUlo atyAcAra allAhasa~ga kasailAI sAjhedAra banAunu tathA rasUlaharUlAI jhUTo Thahara garnu ho |

58 IsA (alaihissalAma) sa~ga sambandhita yI kurAharUle tapAIMmAthi avatarita sandezalAI pramANita gardachan | yasamA Izabhaya rAkhneharUkA lAgi upadeza chan | yI yati Thosa AyataharU hun, yasamA asatya misina sakdainan |

59 IsA (alaihissalAma) ko sRSTiko udAharaNa allAhakahA~ Adama (alaihissalAma) ko sRSTi jastai cha | allAhale Adama (alaihissalAma) lAI binA AmA buvA mATobATa sRSTi garnubhayo | uhA~le bhannubhayo– timI, mAnava bhaihAla ta, ani uhA~ko cAhanA anusAra bhaihAle | IsA (alaihissalAma) ko janma binA pitA bhaekole IsAIharU unalAI Izvara ThAndachan jo nirAdhAra kurA ho | yadyapi Adama (alaihissalAma) ko sRSTi binA AmA buvA bhae tA pani unalAI mAnava ThAndachan |

60 IsA (alaihissalAma) ko bAremA yo asala satya kurA ho jo tapAIMmAthi tapAIMkA pAlanakartAko tarphabATa avatarita ho | ataH tapAIM zaGkA tathA sandeha garneharUmadhye nabannuhos | baru tapAIM Aphno satya kurAmA aDiga rahanuhos |

61 he rasUla! satya jJAna Aisakepachi najrAnakA IsAIharUle IsA (alaihissalAma) ko bAremA unI allAhakA bhakta hoinan bhanera juna tarka vitarka gardaichan, tinIharUlAI bhannuhos– AU hAmI tathA timI svayama pani hAjira hoauM ra A-AphnA santAna tathA mahilAlAI hAjira huna bolAauM ani milera namratAkA sAtha prArthanA garauM ki hAmI tathA timIharUmadhye jhUTAharUmAthi allAhako dhikkAra (lAnata) hos!

62 IsA (alaihissalAma) ko bAremA aghi je jati varNana garekAchauM tI sabai satya ghaTanAharU hun, yasamA kunai jhUTo tathA zaGkA chaina | allAha bAheka kohI vAstavika pUjya chaina | nizcaya nai allAha Aphno zAsanamA prabhutvazAlI ra Aphno kArya saMcAlana, mAmilA tathA sRSTimA tatvadarzI hunuhuncha |

63 taipani tinIharU tapAIMbATa vimukha hunchan ra tapAIMko anusaraNa gardainan bhane yo tinIharUko badamAsI ho | allAha vidhvaMsakArIharUlAI rAmrarI jAnnuhuncha ra tinIharUlAI tyasako sajAya dinuhunecha |

64 he rasUla! bhanidinuhos– he yahUdI ra IsAIharU ho! nisAphamA AdhArita samAnatA rahekA vANImA hAmI sabai ekamata hoauM– hAmI allAha bAheka kasaiko bhakti nagarauM, uhA~ bAheka anya kasailAI Aphno pAlanakartA naThAnauM ra uhA~sa~ga kasailAI sAjhedAra nabanAauM cAhe U jati mahAna hos | yadi tinIharU satya tathA nisAphabATa vimukha hunchan bhane, he mominaharU ho! bhanideU– timIharU sAkSI basa; hAmIharUle AphnA sampUrNa icchA tathA AkAMkSAharU allAhaprati samarpita garidiekA chauM | hAmI uhA~kai bhakti garnechauM |

65 he yahUdI ra IsAI ho! timIharU ibrAhIma (alaihissalAma) ko dharmako sambandhamA kina tarka-vitarka garchau ॽ yahUdIharU ibrAhIma (alaihissalAma) lAI yahUdI ra IsAIharU unalAI IsAI ThAndathe | jabaki yahUdI ra IsAI dharma duvai ibrAhIma (alaihissalAma) ko mRtyuko dherai dinapachi banAiekA dharma hun | timIharUko socAi tathA bhanAi galata ho bhanne kurA bujhdainau?!

66 he yahUdI ra IsAI! hera! timIharUle nabI (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) sita Aphno dharma tathA kitAbaharUko bAremA AphUle jJAna rAkhekA kurAharUmA vAda-vivAda garisakyau | aba ibrAhIma (alaihissalAma) tathA unako dharmako viSayamA kina tarka-vitarka gardaichau? jasako varNana na timIharUko kitAbamA cha, na timIharUkA sandeSTAharUle batAekA chan! yasa bAremA sahI kurAko jJAna allAhalAI mAtra cha, timIharUlAI chaina |

67 ibrAhIma (alaihissalAma) na ta yahUdI thie na IsAI | unI mAtra eka allAhako AjJAkArI (muslima) tathA ekezvaravAdI thie | unI muzrika (bahudevavAdI) ta paTakkai thienan, jasto ki arabakA bahudevavAdIharUle ThAnekA thie |

68 ibrAhIma (alaihissalAma) mero purkhA hun bhanne kurAko sabaibhandA baDhI adhikAra tI mAnisaharUlAI cha, jo unako yugamA raheko izvarIya dharmako pAlanA gare | tyasaigarI nabI (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) ra muslimaharUlAI cha | allAha mominaharUkA maddata garnevAlA tathA saMrakSaka hunuhuncha |

69 he mominaharU ho! yahUdI ra IsAIharUkA dharmaguruharU timIharUlAI kunai na kunai tarikAle allAhabATa prApta satya dharma; islAmabATa pathabhraSTa garna cAhanchan | tara tinIharUle AphaiMlAI pathabhraSTa gardaichan | mominaharUlAI pathabhraSTa garne prayAsale tinIharU kai pathabhraSTatAmA vRddhi garcha | tinIharU Aphno pariNAmalAI jAndainan |

70 he yahUdI ra IsAIharU ho! timIharU allAhakA nizAnIharUlAI kina asvIkAra gardachau? jasamA muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) allAhakA saccA nabI hunuhuncha bhanne kurAkA nikai spaSTa pramANaharU chan | jabaki tyo vAstaviktAlAI timIharUko kitAbale pani puSTi gareko cha |

71 he yahUdI ra IsAI ho! timIharU AphnA kitAbaharUmA avatarita bhaekA satyamA Aphno tarphabATa asatyalAI kina misAu~chau? ani thAhA hu~dAhu~dai pani tyasamA rahekA satya tathA mArgadarzanalAI kina lukAu~chau? jasamadhye muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) ko nubuvvata pani ho | yadyapi timIharU satya ra asatya ra mArgadarzana tathA pathabhraSTatAbIca raheko pharakalAI jAndachau!

72 yahUdI dharmaguruharUko euTA samUhale bhanyo– mominaharUmAthi avatarita kurAnamAthi bihAna ImAna lyAU ani sA~jha napardai inkAra garideU tAki timIharUle gareko yasa kAryabATa unIharU zaGkAmA parun ra yo bhandai Aphno dharmabATa vimukha houn ki tinIharU dharmagranthako bAremA hAmI bhandA baDhI jAndachan |

73 tinIharUle yo pani bhane– timIharU Aphno dharmamA rahekA mitraharU bAheka anya kasaimAthi vizvAsa nagara | he rasUla! tinIharUlAI bhanidinuhos– vAstavika mArgadarzana ta allAhako mArgadarzana mAtra ho | timIharUko jhUTho Aropa ra DAhA hoina | timIharUlAI pradAna garieko kRpA arU kasailAI prApta nahoos vA unIharUle timIharU viruddha allAhako darabAramA kunai Thosa pramANa liera naAun bhanne kurAbATa DarAu~chau | he rasUla! bhanidinuhos– kRpA ta allAhako hAtamA raheko cha | uhA~le AphnA bhaktaharUmadhye jasalAI cAhanuhuncha pradAna garnuhuncha | uhA~ko kRpA kunai euTai samudAyamA sImita chaina | allAha vizAla kRpAvAna tathA sarvajJa hunuhuncha | kRpAko vAstavika hakadAralAI jAnnuhuncha |
74 uhA~ AphnA bhaktaharUmadhye jasalAI cAhanuhuncha mArgadarzana, nubuvvata (IzadUtatva) tathA anya varadAnaharU pradAna garnuhuncha | uhA~ ati mahAna ra kRpAvAna hunuhuncha |

75 yahUdI ra IsAImadhye kohI yastA chan, jasamAthi tapAIMle bharosA garera dhanasampattiko thupro nai nAso svarUpa dinuhuncha bhane pani tinIharUle tapAIMlAI pharkAune chan; tara tinIharUmadhye yastA pani chan jasalAI thorai dhana mAtra nAso svarUpa dinuhuncha bhane pani paTaka-paTaka namAgunjela pharkAune chainan | tinIharUko yasa anaitikatAko kAraNa yo galata dhAraNA ho ki arabIharUko dhanasampatti khAemA pApa lAgdaina, allAhale yasalAI hAmro lAgi vaidha garnubhaeko cha | tinIharUle jAnIjAnI allAhamAthi jhUTo Aropa lagAirahekA chan |

76 tinIharUle ThAne jasto kahA~ huncha ra? tinIharUlAI avazya pApa lAgcha | tara jasale allAha tathA uhA~kA rasUlaharUmAthi ImAna lyAera uhA~sa~ga gareko vAcAlAI purA garcha | mAnisaharUko nAso phirtA garera unIharUsa~gako vAcA purA garcha | allAhakA AdezaharUko pAlanA garera tathA varjita kurAbATa bacera Izabhaya rAkhcha, allAhale yastA Izabhaya rAkhneharUlAI mana parAunu huncha ra yasako rAmro badalA dinuhuncha |

77 juna mAnisaharUle allAhale avatarita garnubhaeko kurAna tathA uhA~le paThAunu bhaekA rasUlaharUmAthi ImAna lyAune ra tyasamA kAyama rahane upadezalAI saMsArako tuccha vastusa~ga sATAsATa garchan, tinIharUkA nimti AkhiratamA kunai puNya hunechaina | mahApralayako dina allAhale tinIharUsa~ga na ta kurA garnuhunecha, na kRpAdRSTi garnuhunecha, na tinIharUlAI pApa tathA kuphrako phoharabATa zuddhatA nai pradAna garnuhunecha, tinIharUkA lAgi du:khada yAtanA cha |

78 yahUdImadhye euTA samUhale taurAta paDhdA Aphno jibro baGgAera uccAraNa garchan, tAki timIharU tyasalAI taurAtako aMza ThAna, jabaki tyo allAhale avataraNa garnubhaeko taurAtakA zabdaharU hoinan | yo ta tinIharUle jhUTo misAeko kurA ho | tinIharU dAbI garchan– hAmI allAhadvArA avatarita taurAta paDhdaichauM yadyapi tyo allAhako tarphabATa avatarita hu~daina | tinIharU jAnIjAnI allAha tathA uhA~kA rasUlaharUko bAremA jhUTo kurA bolchan |

79 yadi allAhale kasailAI sandeSTA cunnuhuncha ra usalAI kitAba ra jJAna pradAna garnuhuncha ke tyo dUtale mAnisaharUlAI allAhako bhakti nagarera mero bhakti gara bhanna sakcha ra? usale ta mAnisaharUlAI yo bhancha– timIharU allAhako bhakti gara | uhA~le timIharUlAI kitAba pradAna garnubhaeko cha, yo kitAtako zikSAlAI AdhAra banAera saccA dharmaguru, prazikSaka tathA sudhAraka bana |
80 tyasaigarI uhA~le phariztA tathA nabIharUlAI pUjya banAU pani bhannuhunna | ke nabIle timIharUlAI AjJAkArI muslima bhaepachi kuphratarpha ahvAna garna sakchan ra?

81 he rasUla! smaraNa garnuhos jaba allAhale sandeSTAharUsita vacana linubhayo– timIharUlAI jasto sukai grantha, tatvadarzitA pradAna gare pani ra timIharUko sthAna jati ucca bhae pani yadi timIharU samakSa antima rasUla muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallamA) ko Agamana bhayo bhane timIharUle uhA~mAthi ImAna lyAunu ra sakesamma uhA~lAI sahayoga garnu | allAhale sodhnubhayo– he sandeSTAharU ho! ke timIharU Aphno mahatvapUrNa jimmevArI vahana garne malAI vacana dinchau? nabIharUle bhane– hAmIle hajurako vacanalAI svIkAra garyauM | allAhale bhannubhayo– tyaso bhae timIharU AphU ra Aphno samudAyako sAkSI basa ra ma pani timIharU tathA unIharUko sAkSI basnechu |
82 allAha tathA uhA~kA rasUlaharUlAI sAkSI banAera vAcA garepachi tyasabATa vimukha hune vyaktiharU avajJAkArI hun |

83 ke allAhako dharma; islAmabATa niskekA mAnisaharU kunai anya dharmako cAhanA garchan ta? yadyapi AkAza evaM pRthvImA rahekA sabai sRSTiharU allAhaprati samarpita chan, cAhe mominaharU jhai~ svecchAle hos vA kAphiraharU jhai~ anicchAle hos | mahApralayako dina sabai sRSTiharU hisAba kitAbako lAgi uhA~tarpha nai pharkAine chan |

84 he rasUla! bhanidinuhos– hAmI allAhamAthi ImAna lyAyauM, uhA~ nai hAmrA pUjya hunuhuncha | uhA~le dinubhaeko Adezako AjJApAlana garyauM | uhA~le avataraNa garnubhaeko vahI (prakAzanA), ibrAhIma, ismAIla, ishAka, yAkUba, yAkUbakA santAnaharU, mUsA, IsA tathA anya nabIharU (alaihimussalAma) mAthi avatarita kitAba tathA nizAnIharUmAthi ImAna lyAyauM | kasaimAthi ImAna rAkhne ra anya kasaimAthi ImAna narAkhne jasto bhedabhAva hAmI gardainauM | hAmI allAhakai AjJAkArI bhakta hauM |

85 jasale allAhale mana parAunu bhaeko dharma; islAma bAheka kunai anya dharma grahaNa garna khojcha, usako dharma kadApi svIkArya hunechaina | U AkhiratamA narkamA hAlinecha ra yasarI ghATA behorneharUmadhye hunecha |

86 allAhale tyasto samudAyalAI kasarI mArgadarzana garnuhuncha, jasale ImAna lyAisakepachi ra muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) le lyAunu bhaeko sandeza satya ho bhanne kurA pramANita bhaisakepachi kuphra (inkAra) gare | mArgadarzanako saTTA pathabhraSTatA apanAune atyAcArIharUlAI uhA~le satyamArga dekhAunu hunna |
87 asatya rojne atyAcArIharUmAthi allAha, phariztAharU evaM sampUrNa mAnavajAtiko abhizApa cha, yahI tinIharUko badalA ho | tinIharU allAhako kRpAbATa TADhA tathA vaJcita bhae |
88 tinIharU sadhaiM narkako AgomA rahanechan; tyasabATa nata nikAline chan, na tinIharUko yAtanA kama garinecha | tinIharUlAI taubA (prAyazcita) garne maukA pani diinechaina |
89 sivAya tI vyaktiharU jasale tyasa kuphra tathA atyAcArabATa prAyazcita garI Aphno sudhAra gare | allAha AphnA yastA bhaktaharUprati ati kSamAzIla evaM parama dayAvAna hunuhuncha |

90 jasale ImAna lyAepachi kuphra gare ra kuphramai kAyama rahe ani mRtyuko belAmA taubA garna khoje bhane allAhale yasto taubAlAI kadApi svIkAra garnuhunna | vAstavamA tinIharUle allAhasamma pugne sIdhA mArga birAekA chan |

91 jasale kuphra gare ani tyasai kuphrakai avasthAmA mare, tinIharUle narkabATa chuTakArA pAunako lAgi pRthvI barAbara suna die pani svIkAra garinechaina | yastA mAnisaharUkA nimti duHkhada yAtanA cha | yastA vyaktiharUlAI narkako yAtanAbATa jogAuna kohI sahayogI hunechaina |

92 he mominaharU ho! jabasamma timIharU AphnA priya vastuharU allAhako mArgamA kharca gardainau, tabasamma satkarmIharUle prApta garne puNya ra sthAna prApta garna sakdainau | timIharUle kama vA baDhI je jati kharca garchau, allAhale timIharUko manazAya tathA karmaharUlAI rAmrarI jAnnuhuncha ra tyasai anusAra pratidAna dinuhunecha |

93 taurAta avatarita hunu aghi yAkUba (alaihissalAma) le AphUmAthi harAma garekA khAne kurAharU bAheka sampUrNa rAmrA khAne kurAharU isrAIlakA santAnaharUkA lAgi halAla (vaidha) thie | vAstavamA, yI kurAharU taurAtadvArA harAma gariekA thienan; jasto ki yahUdIharUle ThAnekA chan | he nabI! bhanidinuhos– yadi timIharU Aphno dAbImA saccA chau bhane lyAU taurAta ra paDha tyasalAI | tara tinIharU Azcaryacakita bhae ra taurAta lyAera paDhenan | yahUdIharUle taurAtamA thapaghaTa ra pherabadala gareko yo ThUlo ra spaSTa pramANa ho |

94 yAkUba (alaihissalAma) le Aphno lAgi kehI khAne kurA harAma garekA thie bhanne kurA pramANita bhaepachi pani yadi kasaile allAhamAthi jhUTo Aropa lagAu~chan bhane tinIharU nai atyAcArI hun | kinabhane tinIharUle satya kurA pramANita bhaepachi tyasalAI tyAge |

95 he nabI! bhanidinuhos– allAhale yAkUba (alaihissalAma) ko bAremA juna kurAharU garnubhaeko cha ra tyasaigarI je jati vidhividhAna lAgU garnubhaeko cha, tI sabai satya hun | ataH timIharU ibrAhIma (alaihissalAma) ko dharmako anusaraNa gara | unI sampUrNa dharmaharUlAI tyAgera islAma dharmamA aDiga thie | unale kahile pani allAhasa~ga kasailAI sAjhedAra banAenan |

96 allAhako bhakti garna mAnavajAtikA nimti dhartImA nirmANa garieko pahilo ghara masjide harAma (kAbA) ho, juna makkAmA avasthita cha | yo barakatavAlA, sAMsArika tathA dhArmika dherai lAbha bokeko ra sabai mAnisaharUkA lAgi mArgadarzana ho |

97 yo ghara ati mahatvapUrNa tathA pratiSThita cha | yasamA nikai spaSTa nizAnIharU chan | yasaimA makAme ibrAhIma (DhuGgA) cha, jasamAthi ubhiera ibrAhIma (alaihissalAma) le kAbAkA parkhAla nirmANa garekA thie | yo gharamA praveza garisakepachi pUrNa zAnti ra surakSita mahasusa huncha | yahA~samma pugna sAmarthya rAkhne sampUrNa vyaktiharUmAthi allAhako lAgi yasa gharako haja garna anivArya garieko cha | yadi kasaile hajalAI inkAra garcha bhane allAhalAI kehI pharaka pardaina, kinabhane uhA~ ekadamai susampanna hunuhuncha | hunata allAhalAI yo sArA saMsAra bAsIharUko kunai khAco chaina |

98 he nabI! bhanidinuhos– he yahUdI ra IsAIharU ho! muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) saccA sandeSTA hun bhanne kurAkA taurAta tathA injIlamA rahekA pramANaharUlAI kina asvIkAra gardachau ॽ timIharUle garirAkhekA kAryaharUmAthi allAha svayam sAkSI hunuhuncha | uhA~le timIharUkA sampUrNa kriyAkalApako pratidAna dinuhunecha |

99 he nabI! bhanidinuhos– he yahUdI ra IsAIharU ho! timIharU ImAna lyAekAharUlAI allAhako dharma islAmabATa kina rokchau? ke timIharU satyabATa asatyatarpha ra mArgadarzanabATa pathabhraSTatarpha pharkAuna cAhanchau ॽ islAma nai satya dharma ho bhanne kurA timIharU rAmrarI jAndachau | timIharUko granthale pani yasako puSTi gardacha | timIharUle utpanna garirAkhekA bAdhA ra kuphralAI allAhale rAmrarI jAnnuhuncha ra tyasako sajAya dinuhunecha |

100 he AsthAvAnaharU ho! yadi timIharUle yahUdI ra IsAIharUko euTA jamAtako bhanAi ra vicArako anusaraNa garchau bhane tinIharUle timIharUlAI ImAnabATa kuphratira pharkAune chan | kinabhane unIharU timIharUsita DAhA garchan ra pathabhraSTa bhaekA chan |

101 timIharU allAhamAthi ImAna lyAisakepachi kasarI kuphra garna sakchau? jabaki ImAnamA aDiga rahane timIharUsa~ga prazasta kurAharU chan, jasamadhye sabaibhandA ThUlo kurA ke cha bhane timIharUlAI allAhakA AyataharU paDhera sunAinchan ra uhA~kA rasUla muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) le tyasako vyAkhyA garnuhuncha | allAhakA kitAba tathA rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) kA sunnatalAI dRr3hatApUrvaka samAtne vyaktilAI allAhale ekadama sIdhA mArga dekhAunu huncha |

102 he AsthAvAnaharU ho! allAhakA AdezaharUko pAlanA garera, uhA~le manAhI garnubhaekA kAryaharUlAI tyAgera tathA uhA~kA varadAnaharUprati AbhAra vyakta garera, jasarI uhA~sa~ga DarAune haka cha tyasarI nai DarAU | Aphno dharmalAI rAmrarI samAta, yahA~samma ki islAmakai avasthAmA timIharUko mRtyu hos |

103 he mominaharU ho! kurAna ra sunnatalAI baliyosa~ga samAta ra matabheda utpanna garne kArya nagara | allAhale timIharUmAthi gareko kRpAlAI smaraNa gara, jaba timIharU islAmapUrva paraspara zatru thiyau ra sa-sAnA kurAharUle gardA yuddha garthyau | uhA~le islAma dharmadvArA timIharUko mana milAi dinubhayo | tasartha timIharU paraspara dayA mAyA gardai dhArmika dAjubhAi banyau | timIharU yasa aghi Aphno kuphrako kAraNale narkamA jAna lAgekA thiyau; ani uhA~le islAma pradAna garera tyasabATa bacAunu bhayo ra ImAnatarpha mArgadarzana garnubhayo | yasako sAthai timIharUkA loka ra paraloka duvailAI rAmro banAune kurAharU batAunu bhayo | tAki timIharU aDiga bhaera satmArgamA hi~Da |

104 he mominaharU ho! timIharUmadhyebATa euTA yasto jamAta avazya hunuparcha, jasale allAhale mana parAune bhalAitarpha ahvAna garos | zarIatale batAeko tathA vivekale mana parAeko satkarmako Adeza deos | zarIatale rokeko tathA vivekale ghina mAneko duSkarmabATa rokos | yI guNaharU bhaekA mAnisaharUle nai loka ra paralokakA pUrNa saphalatA prApta garnechan |

105 he mominaharU ho! timIharU yahUdI ra IsAI jhaiM nahoU, jo spaSTa nizAnIharUkA bAvajuda vibhinna guTamA vibhAjita bhae ra dharmako mAmilAmA matabhedamA aljhirahe | ukta avaguNaharU bhaekA mAnisaharUkA lAgi allAhako tarphabATa kaThora yAtanA cha |

106 mahApralayako dina yo kaThora yAtanA tinIharUmAthi nai parnecha | tyatikhera mominaharUkA anuhAraharU khuzIle gardA ujjavala hunechan bhane kAphiraharUkA anuhAraharU cintA tathA piDAle gardA kAlA hunechan | tyasa mahAna dinamA kAlo muhAra bhaekA vyaktiharUlAI sodhinecha– ke timIharUle allAhalAI eka jAnne tathA eka mAnnechau ra uhA~sa~ga kasailAI sAjhedAra banAune chainau bhanne vAcA garepachi tyasalAI inkAra garyau? tasartha Aphno kuphrako kAraNale allAhale tayAra pArnubhaeko yAtanAko svAda cAkha |
107 ujjavala muhAra bhaekA vyaktiharU sadAsarvadA svargamA rahanechan | svargakA varadAnaharU na ta kahile kharAba hunechan na kahile samApta hunechan |

108 he nabI! allAhale garnubhaeko vAcA tathA dhamkImA AdhArita yI AyataharU hAmI tapAIMlAI paDhera sunAu~daichauM, jasamA sahI sUcanAharU tathA nisAphamA AdhArita AdezaharU chan | allAhale saMsArabAsIharUmadhye kasaimAthi kunai atyAcAra garna cAhanuhunna baru mAnisaharUle AphaiMle garekA sajAya bhognechan |

109 AkAzaharU evaM pRthvImA rahekA sampUrNa kurAharUlAI allAhale nai sRSTi garnubhayo ra yI sabaimA uhA~ kai Adeza caldacha | sabai sRSTiharUko mAmilA uhA~ kahA~ nai peza garinecha, ani uhA~le sabailAI karma anusAra pratiphala dinuhunecha |

110 he nabI (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) kA anuyAyIharU ho! timIharU ImAna ra karmamA sabai samudAyaharU bhandA utkRSTa samudAya hau | timIharUlAI allAhale mAnavajAtikA nimti paThAunu bhaeko cha | timIharU mAnavajAtikA nimti sabaibhandA baDhI phAidAjanaka hau | timIharUle zarIatale batAeko tathA vivekale rAmro mAneko satkarmako Adeza dinchau | zarIatale manAhI gareko tathA vivekale narAmro mAneko duSkarmabATa rokchau | allAhamAthi pakkA ImAna rAkhchau sAthai satkarma garchau | yahUdI ra IsAIharUle muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) mAthi ImAna lyAeko bhae tinIharUkA loka ra paraloka duvaimA rAmro hune thiyo | tinIharUmadhye thoraile muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) le lyAunu bhaekA kurAmAthi ImAna lyAe, adhikAMzale ImAna lyAenan | unIharU allAhako dharma tathA zarIatabATa TADhA nai rahe |

111 he mominaharU ho! tinIharUle jati zatrutA rAkhe pani sAmAnya kaSTa dina bAheka kehI bigArna sakdainan | jastai- dharmamA kamI-kamajorI nikAlne chan, timIharUko ThaTTA garnechan, ityAdi | tinIharUle timIharUsa~ga yuddha gare pani hArera piThyU~ pharkAu~dai bhAgne chan | tinIharUlAI timIharUviruddha kunai sahayoga prApta hunechaina |

112 yahUdIharU jahA~sukai rahe pani tinIharUko bhAgyamA sadhaiM apamAna tathA hInatA nai thupArie | allAhale zAnti pradAna nagaresamma athavA mAnisaharUle zaraNa nadiesamma tinIharUlAI sukha zAnti prApta hune chaina | tinIharU allAhako risako bhAgIdAra bhae | tinIharUmAthi hInatA tathA garibI thupArie | kinaki tinIharUle allAhakA AyataharUlAI asvIkAra gare | sandeSTAharUlAI anAhaka hatyA gare | ataH tinIharUle avajJA gardA sImA nai ullaGghana gare |

adhikAMza yahUdI ra IsAIharUko varNanapachi allAhale tinIharUmadhye satmArgamA raheko samUhako varNana gardai bhannubhaeko cha–
113 sabai yahUdI ra IsAIharU ekanAsa chainan | tinIharUmadhye euTA samUha allAhako dharmamA kAyama cha | uhA~ko Adezako pAlanA gardaicha ra uhA~le manAhI garnubhaeko kurAbATa baceko cha | rAtakA samayaharUmA namAjamA allAhakA AyataharU paDhdacha | yo samUha muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) ko nubuvvata (sandeSTA banAinu) aghi thiyo | yo samUhamadhye ja-jasale uhA~ (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) ko nubuvvata pAe islAmamA praveza gare |

114 unIharU allAha evaM Akhiratako dinamAthi pakkA ImAna rAkhdachan | satkarmako Adeza dinchan, duSkarmabATa rokchan ra bhalAikA kAryaharUmA agrasara rahanchan | AjJApAlanakA maukAharUko sadupayoga garchan | yI guNaharU bhaekA allAhakA bhaktaharU ThIka nIyatakA sAtha satkarma gardaichan |

115 yinIharU kama besa je-jati satkarma gardaichan, tyasako puNya na ta khera jAnecha ra na tyasamA kamI garinecha | allAhale AphnA AdezaharUko pAlanA garne ra varjita kAryaharUlAI tyAgne asala bhaktaharUlAI rAmrarI jAnnuhuncha | unIharUko kunai pani kArya uhA~bATa lukeko chaina ra uhA~le tyasako ucita pratidAna dinuhunecha |

116 jasale allAha tathA uhA~kA rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) lAI inkAra gare, tinIharUko dhanasampatti tathA santAnaharUle allAhabATa bacAuna sakdainan | na ta unIharUsita kunai rAmro vyavahAra garinecha, na ta yAtanAlAI TArna saknechan | baru tinIharUkA yAtanA tathA pIDAmA baDhottarI garinecha | tinIharU narkabAsI hun ra sadA tyasaimA rahanechan |

117 yI kAphiraharU puNya ThAnera je-jati kharca gardaichan ra juna badalAko pratIkSAmA chan, tyo tinIharUko kuphrale gardA milne chaina | kuphrale satkarmalAI tyasarI nai naSTa pArcha jasarI hurI-batAsale khetIlAI naSTa pArcha | kAphiraharUko kharcako udAharaNa yasto hurI-batAsa jasto cha jasamA atyantai cisopana huncha | yo hurI-batAsa pApI atyAcArIharUko khetImA calcha ra tyasa khetIlAI naSTa pArcha | jabaki tinIharU tyasa khetIbATa dherai lAbhako AzA rAkhekA hunchan | yasa viSayamA allAhale tinIharUmAthi anyAya garnubhaena baru tinIharUle svayam allAhako inkAra ra uhA~kA rasUlaharUlAI jhUTo Thahara garera AphUmAthi anyAya gare |

118 he mominaharU ho! mominaharU bAheka anya kasailAI Aphno sAthI tAthA ghaniSTa mitra nabanAU | AphnA bheda tathA vizeSa kurA tinIharUlAI nabatAU | tinIharUle timIharUlAI barbAda pArna kunai kasara bA~kI rAkhne chainan | tinIharU timIharUlAI kaSTa tathA du:kha dine kArya garne kAmanA garnechan | tinIharUko jibromAthi ghRNA tathA zatrutA spaSTa bhaisakeko cha | tinIharU timro dharmamAthi prahAra garchan | timIharUbIca phUTa paidA garchan | timIharUko bhedalAI jAhera garchan | tinIharUkA chAtIle lukAekA ghRNA tyobhandA pani bhayAnaka cha | he mominaharU ho! hAmIle timIharUkA lAgi loka ra paraloka duvaimA kAma lAgne spaSTa pramANaharU bayAna garisakekA chauM | yadi timIharU allAhale avataraNa garnubhaekA kurAharUmA soca-vicAra garchau bhane |

119 he mominaharU ho! timIharU po tinIharUlAI prema garchau ra tinIharUkA lAgi bhalAi cAhanchau tara tinIharUle timIharUlAI mana parAu~dainan ra timIharUko bhalo cAhadainan | baru timIharUsita irSyA garchan | timIharU unIharUkA kitAba sameta sabai kitAbaharUmAthi ImAna rAkhchau jabaki tinIharU timIharUkA nabI (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) mAthi avatarita kitAbamAthi ImAna rAkhdainan | tinIharU timIharUlAI bheTdA mukhale bhanchan– hAmI AsthAvAna bhayauM | tara alaga hu~dA ekezvaravAda, timIharUko ekatA tathA islAmako zAna ra arko tarpha Aphno apamAnaprati krodha tathA cintAle auMlA capAu~chan | he nabI (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! unIharUlAI bhanidinuhos– timIharU Aphno krodha tathA cintAkai avasthAmA mara | nissandeha allAhale timIharUkA hRdayamA rahekA ImAna tathA kuphra ra bhalAi tathA duSTatAlAI jAnnuhuncha |

120 he mominaharU ho! jaba timIharUlAI zatrumAthi vijaya, dhanasampatti tathA santAnamA vRddhi jastA varadAnaharU prApta hunchan, taba tinIharU cintita tathA dukhita hunchan | tara tyasako viparIta jaba timIharU parAjita hunchau, dhanasampatti tathA santAnamA kunai ghaTanA ghaTcha, taba tinIharU khusI hunchan ra timIharUlAI gAlI garchan | yadi timIharUle allAhakA AdezaharUlAI dhairya garera pAlanA garchau ra uhA~kA risabATa DarAu~chau bhane tinIharUko SaDyantra tathA kaSTale timIharUlAI kunai hAni puryAuna sakdaina | nizcaya nai allAha tinIharUle garirahekA sampUrNa SaDyantrabATa avagata hunuhuncha ra tyasalAI viphala pArnuhunecha |

121 he nabI (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! tyasa kSaNalAI smaraNa garnuhos, jaba tapAIM dinako pahilo praharamA madInAbATa niskera bahudevavAdIharUsa~ga yuddha garna uhudatarpha jAnubhaeko thiyo ra mominaharUlAI yuddha-raNamA tainAtha gardai hunuhunthyo | pratyekalAI unIharUko sthAna batAu~dai hunuhunthyo | allAha timIharUkA kurAharUlAI sunnuhuncha ra timIharUkA karmaharUlAI jAnnuhuncha |

122 he nabI! muslimaharUkA duI samUha banU salmA tathA banU hArisAbIca ghaTeko ghaTanAlAI samjhanuhos, jaba unIharU kamajora bhae ra yuddhabATa munAphikaharUsaMgai pharkane nIyata gare, tara allAhale unIharUlAI yuddhamA aDiga rAkhera tathA pharkane cAhanAbATa pherera unIharUlAI maddata garnubhayo | mominaharUle hareka avasthAmA mAtra allAhamAthi nai bharosA rAkhnupardacha |

123 allAhale bahudevavAdIharUko viruddhamA badrako yuddhamA timIharUlAI maddata garnubhayo jaba timIharU saMkhyA tathA hAta hatiyArako kamIle gardA ati kamajora thiyau | ataH allAhasa~ga DarAU, AzA cha, timIharU uhA~ko varadAnaharUprati kRtajJa hunechau |

124 he nabI! smaraNa garnuhos, bahudevavAdIharUlAI maddata Aune khabara pAepachi tapAIMle mominaharUharUlAI badrako yuddhamA aDiga pArdai bhannubhayo– allAhale tIna hajAra phariztAharUdvArA timIharUlAI sahAyatA garnuhunecha | ke yo timIharUkA lAgi paryApta chaina ॽ!

125 kina nahunu, yo timIharUkA lAgi paryApta hunecha | timIharUkA lAgi allAhako tarphabATa arko maddatako zubhasUcanA cha | yadi kAphiraharUle maddata prAptapachi timIharUmAthi AkramaNa garchan ra timIharUle yuddhamA dhairya tathA Izabhaya rAkhchau bhane timrA pAlanakartAle tyasai belA vizeSa cinha bhaekA pA~ca hajAra phariztAharU tathA ghoDAharUdvArA timIharUlAI sahAyatA garnuhunecha |

126 allAhale timIharUlAI khusI ra manalAI santuSTa pArnako lAgi phariztAharUdvArA maddata garnubhayo | vAstavamA yI vAhya sara-sAmAnaharU mAtra maddata hoinan baru asala maddata allAhako maddata ho | uhA~ ati zaktizAlI hunuhuncha | uhA~mAthi kohI vijaya prApta garna sakdaina | uhA~ Aphno hareka kAma tathA zarIata (kAnuna) nirdhAraNa garnamA tatvadarzI hunuhuncha |

127 badrako yuddhamA prApta maddatadvArA kAphiraharUko euTA samudAyalAI hatyA garera, arko samudAyalAI apamAnita ra parAjita garera risa dilAunu thiyo tAki tinIharU asaphala tathA beijjata bhaera pharkun |

128 jaba rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) le uhuda yuddhamA bahudevavAdIharUkA netAharUle gareko vyavahAraprati tinIharUko sarvanAzako lAgi zrApa dinubhayo taba allAhale uhA~ (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) lAI bhannubhayo– tapAIMlAI yasa mAmilAmA kunai adhikAra chaina | allAhako hAtamA sabai mAmilA cha | uhA~le timIharUbIca nirNaya nagaresamma dhairya garnuhos | ki ta uhA~le tinIharUlAI taubA garne tauphIka dinuhunecha ani tinIharU islAma grahaNa garnechan ki ta kuphramai jiddI garnechan ani uhA~le yAtanA dinuhunecha | vAstavamA tinIharU atyAcArI ra yAtanA diine lAyaka hun |

129 AkAzaharU tathA pRthvImA rahekA sabai kurAharU allAhale nai sRSTi garnubhayo ra uhA~le nai sabai saJcAlana garirAkhnu bhaeko cha | uhA~le AphnA bhaktaharUmadhye jasalAI cAhanuhuncha Aphno kRpAle mApha garnuhuncha ra jasalAI cAhanuhuncha Aphno nisAphale yAtanA dinuhuncha | allAha AphnA bhaktaharUmadhye taubA garneharUprati atyanta kSamAzIla evaM parama dayAlu hunuhuncha |

130 he AsthAvAnaharU ho! mUla-dhanamA baDhAI-caDhAI byAja linabATa sAvadhAna! yasto kArya islAma pUrvakA mAnisaharUle garne garthe | allAhakA AdezaharUko pAlanA garera tathA varjita kAryaharUlAI tyAgera uhA~sita DarAU tAki timIharUle mana parAeko loka ra paralokako bhalAi prApta garna saka |
131 timIharU AjJApAlana garera tathA varjita kAryaharU tyAgera kAphiraharUkA lAgi tayAra pArieko AgobATa AphUlAI jogAU |

132 allAhakA AdezaharUko pAlanA garera tathA varjita kAryaharUlAI tyAgera uhA~ko tathA uhA~kA rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) ko AjJApAlana gara tAki timIharUle loka ra paralokamA dayA prApta garna saka |

133 satkarma ra vibhinna bhaktidvArA allAhako nikaTatA prApta garna eka-arkAdekhi pratispardhA gara | tAki allAhako mahAna kSamAdAna prApta garna saka ra AkAza tathA pRthvI jasto vizAla svargamA praveza garna saka | allAhale yasalAI Izabhaya rAkhneharUkA lAgi tayAra pArnubhaeko cha |

134 jo garibI ra sampanna duvai avasthAmA allAhako mArgamA dhanasampatti kharca garchan | badalA line kSamatA rAkhdA rAkhdai risalAI dabAu~chan | AphUmAthi atyAcAra garne mAnisaharUlAI kSamA garchan | allAhale yastA guNaharU bhaekA sukarmIharUlAI mana parAunuhuncha |

135 yastA mAnisaharU kunai ThUlA vA sAnA pApa garemA allAhalAI smaraNa garchan, avajJAkArIharUkA lAgi rahekA dhamkIharU tathA Izabhaya rAkhneharUkA lAgi rahekA vacanaharUlAI yAda garchan, ani lajjita bhaera AphnA pAlanakartAsa~ga tI pApaharU chopidina ra tyasamA pakaDa nagarna prArthanA garchan | kinabhane eka allAha bAheka kasaile pApalAI kSamA garna sakdaina | unIharU jAnIjAnI AphnA kukarmamA jiddI gardainan | nissandeha allAhale sampUrNa pApaharUlAI mApha garnuhuncha |

136 yastA rAmrA guNaharU tathA ucca AcaraNa bhaekAharUkA pApaharUlAI allAhale mApha garnuhunecha | unIharUkA lAgi AkhiratamA yastA bagaiMcAharU hunechan jasakA mahalakA talatirabATa nadIharU bagirahekA hunechan | unIharU tyasamA sadAsarvadA rahanechan | satkarmIharUkA nimti yo kati rAmro pratidAna ho!

137 jaba mominaharU uhuda yuddhako dina saGkaTamA pare taba allAhale sAntvanA diMdai bhannubhayo– kAphiraharUlAI sakhApa pArne tathA mominaharUlAI parIkSApachi saphalatA dine allAhako purAno tarikA ho | tasartha dhartImA ghumaphira garI pATha sikne garI hera | allAha tathA uhA~kA rasUlaharUlAI asatya Thahara garneharUko kasto pariNAma bhayo | kasarI tinIharUko ghara ra sattA zAsana barbAda bhae!

138 yo kurAnale sabai mAnisaharUlAI satya apanAuna ra asatyalAI tyAgna ahvAna gardacha | yo Izabhaya rAkhneharUkA nimti mArgadarzana ra upadeza ho | kinabhane unIharU nai yasamA rahekA mArgadarzana ra upadezaharUbATa lAbha prApa garchan |

139 he mominaharU ho! AphulAI na kamajora ThAna, nata uhudako yuddhamA bhogekA pIDAprati nirAza hoU | yo timIharUkA lAgi ucita chaina | yadi timIharU allAha tathA uhA~kA vAcAmAthi ImAna rAkhchau bhane Aphno ImAna ra uhA~ko sahayogale timIharU nai utkRSTa hunechau | yo Izabhaya rAkhneharUsita uhA~ko vacana ho |

140 he mominaharU ho! uhudako dina yadi timIharUlAI kunai AghAta pugeko cha vA kasaiko hatyA bhaeko cha bhane tyastai AghAta ra hatyA kAphiraharUlAI pani pugeko cha | allAhale kahile mominalAI ta kahile kAphiralAI hAra jIta garAunu huncha | munAphikaharUbATa mominaharUlAI spaSTa pArnu ra Aphno mArgamA zahAdata prApta garne maukA dinu yasako rahasya ho | jihAdamA bhAga naliera AphUmAthi atyAcAra garne mAnisaharUlAI allAha mana parAunuhunna |
141 tyasaigarI mominaharUlAI pApabATa pavitra pArnu, mominaharUko bIcabATa munAphikaharUlAI bAhira nikAlera unIharUko paGktilAI zuddhIkaraNa garnu ra kAphiraharUlAI naSTa garnu yasako uddezya ho |

142 he mominaharU ho! ke timIharU binA parIkSA tathA binA dhairya svargamA praveza pAunechau bhanne ThAnekA chau ॽ parIkSA tathA dhairyale gardA nai allAhako mArgamA jihAda garne tathA saGkaTamA dhairya garneharUharU vijaya prApta garchan |

143 he mominaharU ho! timIharU tyasarI nai allAhako mArgamA kAphiraharU viruddha yuddha garera zahAdata prApta garne kAmanA gardathyau, jasarI timrA dAjubhAiharUle yasaaghi badrako yuddhamA zahAdata prApta gare | aba ta timIharUle uhudako yuddhamA kAmanA gareko kurA pratyakSa rUpamA Aphnai A~khAle dekhi sakyau |

uhudako dina jaba nabI (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) ko zahAdatako khabara phailiyo taba kehI mominaharUle yuddha garna choDekA thie | nimna AyatamA yastA mAnisaharUprati aprasannatA prakaTa gardai allAhale bhannubhayoH
144 muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) pahilA bitekA rasUlaharU jastai hunuhuncha, jasako mRtyu bhayo vA hatyA gariyo | ke nabI (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) ko mRtyu bhaemA vA uhA~ko hatyA gariemA timIharU islAma dharmabATa phirtA hunechau ra jihAdalAI tyAgnechau? jasale vyakti islAma dharmalAI tyAgnecha tyasale kadApi allAhako kehI bigArna sakdaina | allAha ati zaktizAlI tathA prabhutvazAlI hunuhuncha | islAmalAI tyAgne vyaktile AphUlAI loka ra paralokako ghATAmA hAlera AphailAI hAni puryAu~cha | allAhale AbhAra vyakta garne mAnisaharUlAI islAmamA kAyama rahekAle tathA uhA~ko mArgamA jihAda garekole rAmro pratidAna dinuhunecha |

145 allAhale bhAgyamA lekhnubhaeko samaya purA bhaepachi ra mRtyuko samaya Aepachi mAtra kunai prANI marcha | tyasako samayamA kunai thapaghaTa hu~daina | jasale saMsAramai pratidAna pAune uddezyale kArya garcha hAmI usalAI saMsAramai usako karmako nirdhArita pratidAna dinechauM | AkhiratamA usako kunai aMza hune chaina | jasale AkhiratamA pratidAna pAune uddezyale kArya garcha hAmI usako karmako pratidAna AkhiratamA dinechauM | AbhAra vyakta garneharUlAI hAmI cA~Dai ThUlo pratidAna dinechauM |

146 katipaya sandeSTAharUsa~ga lAgera unIharUkA anuyAyIharUle yuddha gare | allAhako mArgamA unIharUko hatyA garie tathA ghAite pArie tara unIharUle yuddha garnamA kunai kamajorI dekhAenan ra ghu~DA pani Tekenan, baru aDiga rahe ra dhairya gare | allAha AphnA mArgamA kaDA samaya AemA dhairya garne ra kaSTa tathA du:kha AemA tyasalAI sahana garneharUlAI mana parAunuhuncha |

147 tI dhairyavAnaharU kaSTa bhaemA yasarI prArthanA garthe– he hAmrA pAlanakartA! hAmIle garekA pApa tathA kAnunako ullaGghanalAI kSamA garnuhos | zatrusita bhIDanta bhaemA hAmrA kadamaharUlAI jamAunuhos ani kAphiraharUko viruddha laDanamA hAmIlAI maddata garnuhos |

148 ataH allAhale unIharUlAI maddata garera tathA aDiga pArera yasa saMsArako rAmro pratidAna dinubhayo ra unIharUsita khusI bhaera AkhiratamA pani rAmro pratidAna ra varadAnale bharipUrNa sadhaiM bA~kI rahane svarga pradAna garnuhunecha | allAhale rAmro tarikAle bhakti tathA mAmilA garneharUlAI mana parAunuhuncha |

149 he mominaharU ho! yadi timIharUle yahUdI, IsAI, tathA bahudevavAdI kAphiraharUko AjJApAlana garchau bhane tinIharUle timIharUlAI kAphira banAune chan | ani timIharUle loka ra paraloka duvaimA noksAna behornechau |

150 yI kAphiraharUko AjJApAlana gare pani yinIharUle timIharUlAI maddata kadApi garne chainan | baru allAhale nai timIharUlAI maddata garnu hunecha | ataH uhA~kai AjJApAlana gara | uhA~ sarvottama sahayogI hunuhuncha | uhA~ko maddatapachi kasaiko maddatako khA~co hunechaina |

151 hAmI cA~Dai nai kAphiraharUkA hRdayamA dherai Dara hAlnechauM, tAki timIharU viruddha yuddha garna nasakun | kinabhane tinIharUle Aphnai manale yastA cijaharUlAI allAhako sAjhedAra banAekA chan jasako kunai pramANa uhA~le avataraNa garnubhaeko chaina | AkhiratamA tinIharUko vAsasthAna narka ho | tyo ati narAmro vAsasthAna ho, juna atyAcArIharUkA lAgi tayAra pArieko cha |

152 uhudako dina allAhale zatruharUko viruddhamA timIharUlAI maddata garera timIharUsa~ga gareko Aphno vacana purA garnubhayo, taba timIharUle uhA~ko AjJAle tinIharUko hatyA gardai thiyau | tara jaba timIharUle sAhasa gumAyau ra rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) le dinubhaeko Adezako pAlanAmA kamajorI dekhAyau | Aphnai sthAnamA rahera yuddha garne ki sthAna choDera ganImata (yuddhabATa prApta dhanasampatti) baTorne bhanne mAmilAmA ApasamA vAdavivAda garyau | hareka avasthAmA timIharUle Aphnai sthAnamA basnuparcha bhanne rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) ko Adezako ullaGghana garyau | zatruharUmAthi vijayapachi timIharUle matabheda garyau | kinabhane timIharUmadhye kohI yo saMsArako ganImata (dhanasampatti) cAhanthyo | sAMsArika pratidAna cAhaneharUle sthAna choDe | timIharUmadhye kohI Akhiratako pratidAna cAhanthyo | Akhiratako pratidAna cAhaneharU nai rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) ko Adezako pAlanA gardai AphnA sthAnamA aDiga rahe | timIharUko parIkSAkA nimti allAhale timIharUmAthi tinIharUlAI hAvI garnubhayo | ani yo kurA spaSTa bhayo ki timIharUmadhye ko saGkaTamA dhairya garneharU hun ra ko pachi haTneharU tathA kamajorI dekhAuneharU hun | timIharUle gareko rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) ko Adezako ullaGghanalAI allAhale mApha garnubhayo | uhA~ mominaharUprati ati kRpAlu hunuhuncha | jasto ki uhA~le unIharUlAI ImAnatarpha mArgadarzana garnubhayo, unIharUkA pApaharUlAI mApha garnubhayo ra unIharUle bhogekA pIDAprati puNya pradAna garnubhayo |

153 he mominaharU ho! tyasa samayako smaraNa gara, jaba timIharU uhudako dina bhAgdai TADhA hu~dai thiyau | rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) ko Adezako ullaGghanale gardA timIharUlAI hArako sAmanA garnu pareko thiyo | timIharU eka arkAlAI herdai naherI bhAgdai thiyau | rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) pachADi tathA bahudevavAdIharUko bIcabATa yo bhandai bolAu~dai hunuhunthyo– he allAhakA bhaktaharU! matira AU, he allAhakA bhaktaharU! matira pharkera AU | ani timIharUlAI dherai pIDA bhayo ra timIharU allAhako maddata tathA ganImatabATa vaJcita bhayau | rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) ko hatyAko khabarale pani timIharUlAI dherai pIDA bhayo | timIharUle gumAeko allAhako maddata, ganImata, rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) ko hatyA tathA ghAite hune khabarale gardA pugeko duHkhaprati nirAza nahoU | rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) ko hatyA bhaeko chaina bhanne jAnakArI pAepachi timIharUko du:kha tathA pIDA kama bhayo | timIharUko manako avasthA tathA karma allAhabATa lukeko chaina |

154 allAhale tyasa duHkha tathA pIDApachi timIharUlAI zAnti tathA Atma-vizvAsa pradAna garnubhayo | allAhako vacanamAthi bharosA rAkhne samUhalAI uMghale laTTha pAryo | tara munAphika (kapaTI) harUlAI zAnti tathA uMgha prApta bhaena | kinabhane tinIharUlAI mAtra Aphno jyAnako cintA thiyo | tinIharU trAsa tathA Darako avasthAmA thie ra allAhako bAremA vibhinna kisimakA asatya, ajJAnatApUrNa anumAnaharU garna thAlekA thie | jastai- allAhale AphnA rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) ra bhaktaharUlAI maddata garnuhunechaina | islAma pUrvakA mAnisaharU jhaiM, jasale allAhalAI uhA~ko zAna ra haka anusAra ucita kadara garekA thienan | allAhako bAremA ajJAnatAko kAraNale munAphikaharUle bhane– yuddhako lAgi niskane mAmilAmA hAmro kunai sallAha chaina | hAmro adhikAramA raheko bhae hAmI niskane thienauM | he nabI! javAphamA yinIharUlAI bhani dinuhos– sampUrNa adhikAra allAhasa~ga cha | uhA~le je cAhanuhuncha nirdhAraNa tathA nirNaya garnuhuncha | timIharU yuddhako lAgi niskanechau bhanne kurA uhA~le nai nirdhArita garisaknu bhaeko thiyo | yI munAphikaharU Aphno hRdayamA yasto zaGkA tathA bhrama lukAi rAkhekA chan, jo tapAIM samakSa prakaTa gardainan | jastai yinIharU bhandachan– yadi yuddhako lAgi niskane bAremA hAmro sallAha mAnekA bhae hAmI yahA~ mArine thienauM | he nabI! yinIharUko khaNDana gardai bhannuhos– timIharU hatyA tathA mRtyu sthalabATa TADhA A-Aphno gharabhitrai bhae pani ja-jasako mRtyu nirdhArita thiyo tinIharU A-AphnA hatyA-sthalasamma pugne nai thie | allAhale timIharUko hRdayamA rahekA nIyata tathA uddezyalAI jA~ca garna ra tyasamA rahekA ImAna tathA kapaTalAI chuTyAunako lAgi yo anivArya garnubhayo | allAha AphnA bhaktaharUko manakA kurAharU rAmrarI jAnnuhuncha | uhA~bATa kunai kurA lukeko chaina |

155 he sahAbIharU ho! timIharUmadhye jo mAnisaharU uhudako dinamA parAjita bhae | vAstavamA zaitAnale tinIharUlAI yasto garna lagAyo | kinabhane unIharUle avajJA garekA thie | ukta dinamA kAphiraharUsa~ga muslimaharUko dalako Takkara bhaeko thiyo | allAhale unIharUlAI Aphno kRpA tathA dayAle gardA kSamA pradAna garnubhayo | nissandeha allAha taubA garneharUprati ati kSamAzIla hunuhuncha | uhA~ mahAna hunuhuncha, sajAya dinamA hatAra garnuhunna |

156 he AsthAvAnaharU ho! munAphikaharU jhaiM kuphra garne nabana | unIharUle rojagArako lAgi videziekA vA yuddhako lAgi niskeko avasthAmA marekA vA hatyA gariekA AphnA nAtedAraharUko bAremA bhane– yadi unIharU hAmIsa~ga rahekA bhae ra yuddhako lAgi nagaeko bhae unIharU marne thienan vA unIharUko hatyA hune thiena | tinIharUko manamA ajhai cintA tathA du:khamA vRddhi hos bhanera allAhale ukta kurA tinIharUko hRdayamA hAlnubhayo | vAstavamA, allAhale jasalAI cAhanuhuncha jIvana pradAna garnuhuncha ra jasalAI cAhanuhuncha mRtyu dinuhuncha | nata gharamA basera bhAgya vidhAtAle lekheko mRtyulAI TArna sakincha, nata yuddha gardA samaya bhandA pahilA mRtyu Auna sakcha | timIharU je garchau tyo allAhale dekhirahanu bhaeko cha | timIharUkA karmaharU uhA~bATa lukekA chainan | uhA~le tyasako pratidAna dinuhunecha |

157 he mominaharU ho! yadi timIharU allAhako mArgamA zahIda hunchau vA timro nidhana huncha bhane uhA~le timIharUlAI mahAna pratidAna dinuhunecha ra timIharUmAthi dherai kRpA garnuhunecha | zahAdatako anupAtamA yo saMsAra ra saMsAra vAsIharUle jammA garirahekA dhanasampatti kehI pani hoina |
158 timIharUko juna avasthAmA mRtyu vA hatyA bhae pani timIharU sabai janA eka allAhako darabAramA ekatrita garinechau ra uhA~le timIharUko karmako pratidAna dinuhunecha |

159 he nabI! allAhako apAra kRpAle tapAIM AphnA sAthIharUsa~ga ekadamai narama ra utkRSTa vyavahAra garnuhuncha | yadi tapAIMko kurAkAnI tathA vyavahAra krura ra hRdaya kaThora bhaeko bhae yinIharU tapAIMbATa chuTTine thie | ataH yinIharUbATa tapAIMprati kunai kamI bhaemA kSamA garnuhos; yinIharUkA lAgi kSamAyAcanA garnuhos ra yinIharUsita sarasallAha linuhos | jaba tapAIM sallAhapachi kunai kAryako dRr3ha saGkalpa garnuhuncha taba tyo kAma garnuhos ra allAhamAthi bharosA garnuhos | nissandeha allAha bharosA garneharUlAI mana parAunuhuncha, tyo kAma garne zakti dinuhuncha ra maddata garnuhuncha |

160 yadi allAhale maddata garnuhuncha bhane kasaile pani timIharUlAI harAuna sakdaina, yadyapi saMsArakA sabai mAnisaharU timro viruddhamA kina nahoun | yadi uhA~le nai maddata garnubhaena bhane kasaile pani timIharUlAI jitAuna sakdaina | asala maddata allAhako hAtamA mAtra cha | mominaharUle mAtra uhA~mAthi bharosA rAkhnu pardacha |

161 kunai pani sandeSTAle ganImatabATa harAma tarikAle dhanasampatti linuhunna | timIharUmadhye jasale pani ganImatabATa kehI liera beimAnI garcha, mahApralayako dina usalAI nAGgejhAra pArera sajAya diinecha | beimAnI gareko cIjalAI bokera sampUrNa mAnisaharU samakSa hAjira hunuparcha | pheri pratyeka vyaktilAI usale Arjana gareko puNya kamI nagarikana pradAna garinecha | kasaiko pApamA pApa thapera vA puNyamA kamI garera anyAya garine chaina |

162 ImAna tathA satkarmadvArA allAhako prasannatA prApta garne vyakti ra kuphra tathA duSkarma garera uhA~ko risako bhAgI bhaeko vyakti samAna huna sakdaina | duSkarmIko vAsasthAna narka ho | kati nikRSTa tathA narAmro sthAna ho tyo!

163 tI mAnisaharUkA lAgi duniyA~mA ra allAhakahA~ AkhiratamA beglAbeglai darjA rahekA chan | allAha tinIharUle garirahekA sabai kAryaharU herirahanu bhaeko cha | uhA~bATa kunai pani kurA lukeko chaina | uhA~le pratyekalAI usako karmako pratiphala dinuhunecha |

164 nissandeha allAhale mominaharU mAjha unIharU madhyebATa rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) paThAera unIharUmAthi ThUlo upakAra garnubhaeko cha | unIharUlAI kurAna paDhera sunAunu huncha; zirka tathA anaitikatAbATa zuddha pArnuhuncha ra unIharUlAI kurAna tathA sunnatako zikSA dinuhuncha | vAstavamA unIharU rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) bhandA pahilA spaSTa pathabhraSTamA thie |

165 he mominaharU ho! timIharUle badrako yuddhamA duIgunA zatruharUko hatyA garekA thiyau ra uhuda yuddhamA timIharUlAI kaSTa pugdA, timIharUko hatyA hu~dA yo bhanchau, hAmI momina bhae pani ra hAmrA nabI (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) hAmIbIca bhaetA pani yasto kaSTa kina pugyo ॽ he nabI! bhanidinuhos– yo timIharUko ApasI jhagaDA tathA rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) ko avajJAle gardA bhayo | nissandeha allAha hareka kAryako sAmarthya rAkhnuhuncha | uhA~ jasalAI cAhanuhuncha maddata garnuhuncha ra jasalAI cAhanuhuncha beijjata garnuhuncha |

166 uhudako dina timIharU tathA bahudevavAdIharU bIca muThabheTa hu~dA je jati hatAhata, ghAite tathA hAni-noksAnI bhayo tyo allAhakai anumati tathA bhAgyale bhayo | yasarI saccA mominaharUlAI spaSTa pArnu thiyo |

167 tyastA munAphikaharUlAI pani spaSTa pArnu thiyo jasalAI jaba allAhako mArgamA yuddha garna vA Ama muslimaharUko rakSA garna bhaniyo, taba tinIharUle bhaneH hAmIlAI yuddha hune jAnakArI bhaeko bhae hAmI timIharUsa~ga Aune thiyauM | timIharUbIca yuddha huncha bhane malAI lAgdaina | tinIharUko avasthAle thAhA huncha, tinIharU ImAnako anupAtamA kuphrasa~ga baDhI nikaTa chan | tinIharU manamA nabhaekA kurAharU mukhale gardaichan | allAha tinIharUle manamA lukAekA kurAharU rAmrarI jAnnuhuncha ra tyasako cA~Dai sajAya dinuhunecha |

168 tinIharU uhuda yuddhamA gaenan ra yuddhamA hatAhata bhaekA nAtedAraharUko bAremA bhane– yadi unIharUle hAmro kurA mAnera yuddhamA bhAga naliekA bhae mArine thienan | he nabI! bhanidinuhos– yadi timIharU Aphno dAbImA saccA chau, ki unIharU yuddhamA bhAga nalieko bhae mArine thienan ra timIharU yuddhamA bhAga nalieko kAraNale jIvita chau bhane svayaMlAI mRtyubATa bacAU |

169 he nabI! allAhako mArgamA mAriekA zahIdaharUlAI mRta naThAnnuhos, unIharU AphnA pAlanakartAkahA~ pratiSThata gharamA vizeSa jIvana bitAi rahekA chan | vibhinna prakArakA varadAnaharU pAirahekA chan, jasako pUrNa jJAna allAhalAI mAtra cha |

170 zahIdaharU allAhale pradAna garnubhaeko sukha ra zAntiprati ekadamai khuzI chan | duniyA~mA rahekA AphnA bhAiharUko pratikSAmA chan | unIharU jihAdamA zahAdata prApta garchan bhane hAmI jhaiM ThUlo varadAna pAune chan | AkhiratamA unIharUlAI kunai kisimako Dara hunechaina ra bhautika jIvanamA pAuna nasakekA kurAprati kunai cintA rahanechaina |

171 sAthai allAhabATa pAune ati dherai ra thapa puNyaprati ekadamai khusI hunechan | nizcaya nai allAhale mominaharUko puNya khera phAlnuhunechaina, baru purA purA pratidAna dinuhunecha ra ajhai thapnuhunecha |

172 yI tI vyaktiharU hun, jasale tyatikhera allAha tathA uhA~kA rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) ko Adezako pAlanA garekA thie | jaba rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) le yuddha uhudako dina lagattai “hamarAula-asada” nAmI yuddhako lAgi niskana ra bahudevavAdIharU viruddha laDnako lAgi ahvAna garnubhaeko thiyo | ghAite bhaera pani allAha evaM rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) ko ahvAnalAI svIkAra gare | unIharUmadhye satkarma garne tathA allAhakA AdezaharUko pAlanA garera tathA varjita kAryaharUlAI tyAgera Izabhaya rAkhneharUkA nimti ThUlo puNya cha, tyo ho svarga |

173 yI tI vyaktiharU hun, jasalAI kehI bahudevavAdIharUle bhane– abU suphyAnako netRtvamA kuraizako ThUlo samUha timIharU viruddha yuddha garna tathA timIharUlAI samApta pArna ekatrita bhaekA chan; Aphno jyAna jogAU ra tinaharU viruddha yuddha nagara | yo kurA tinIharUko lAgi ajhai urjA sAbita bhayo ra unIharUko manamA allAha pratiko vizvAsamA jhan vRddhi garyo | unIharU yo bhandai tinIharUko viruddhamA niske– hAmro lAgi allAha nai paryApta hunuhuncha | uhA~ kati rAmrA saMrakSaka hunuhuncha | hAmI Aphno mAmilA uhA~lAI nai sumpinchauM |

174 unIharU “hamarAula asada” yuddhabATa atyAdhika puNya, ThUlo sthAna tathA zatrubATa binA kehI hAni noksAnI surakSita pharke | allAhako AjJApAlana garera tathA uhA~ko avajJAbATa bacera uhA~ko prasannatA prApta gare | vAstavamA, allAha AphnA momina bhaktaharUprati ati kRpAvAna hunuhuncha |

175 zaitAnale AphnA sahayogI ra mitraharUdvArA timIharUlAI tarsAu~cha ra DarAu~cha | zaitAnasa~ga naDarAU, Usa~ga kunai zakti tathA sAmarthya chaina | allAhako AjJApAlana garera uhA~sa~ga mAtra DarAU yadi timIharU uhA~prati AsthAvAna hau bhane |

176 he rasUla! munAphikaharUko kuphramA sakriyatA dekhAune tathA islAmabATa murtada (pharkine) harUko kAryale cintA nagarnuhos | nissandeha tinIharUle allAhako kehI pani bigArna sakdainan | baru allAhamAthi ImAna tathA AjJApAlanabATa TADhA bhaera AphaiMlAI hAni puryAune chan | paralokamA tinIharUlAI kunai aMza nahos bhanera allAhale tinIharUlAI zakti pradAna garnubhaena | tinIharUkA lAgi AkhiratamA narkako kaThora yAtanA cha |
177 nissandeha ImAnako saTTAmA kuphra rojneharUle allAhalAI kunai pani hAni puryAuna sakdainan | tinIharUle AphaiMlAI hAni puryAune chan | tinIharUlAI AkhiratamA pIDAdAyaka yAtanA diinecha |

178 hAmIle dieko chuTa tathA lAmo umeralAI kAphiraharU tathA zarIata (islAmI kAnuna) sita zatrutA rAkhneharUle Aphno lAgi kadApi uttama naThAnun | vAstavikatA tinIharUle soce jasto chaina | tinIharUle pApamAthi pApa garun bhanera hAmIle tinIharUlAI chuTa diekA chauM | tinIharUkA lAgi apamAnajanaka yAtanA cha |

179 he mominaharU ho! timIharU munAphikaharUsita misieko avasthAmA chau ra ko munAphika ho ra ko pakkA momina ho bhanne kurA spaSTa chaina | yasai avasthAmA choDnu allAhako viveka viruddha kurA ho | uhA~ vibhinna jimmevArI tathA parIkSAdvArA pavitra mominalAI apavitra munAphikabATa chuTyAuna cAhanuhuncha | tyastai momina tathA munAphikalAI chuTyAune uddezyale timIharUlAI gaiba (adRzya) ko bAremA jAnakArI dinu pani uhA~ko viveka viruddha ho | tara allAhale AphnA rasUlaharUmadhye jasalAI cAhanuhuncha chAnnuhuncha ra unalAI gaibakA kehI kurA batAunu huncha | jastai uhA~le Aphno nabI (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) lAI munAphikaharUko bAremA batAunu bhayo | ataH timIharU allAha tathA uhA~kA rasUlaharUmAthi vAstavika rUpamA ImAna lyAU | yadi timIharUle vAstavika rUpamA ImAna lyAu~chau ra uhA~kA AdezaharUko pAlanA garera tathA varjita kArya tyAgera Izabhaya rAkhchau bhane timIharUkA lAgi allAha kahA~ atyantai ThUlo puNya cha |

180 allAhale Aphno kRpAle dinubhaeko dhanasampattimA kanjusyAi~ garnele Aphno lAgi rAmro naThAnun | yo tinIharUkA lAgi narAmro kurA ho | juna dhanasampatti tinIharUle kanjusyAi~ garera bacAu~dai chan mahApralayako dina tyasalAI tinIharUko gardhanako kaThAlo banAinecha ra yAtanA diinecha | AkAzaharU evaM dhartIkA sampUrNa sampattikA asala pAlanakartA allAha nai hunuhuncha | timIharUle gariraheko sampUrNa kurAlAI uhA~le khabara rAkhnuhuncha ra tyasako pratidAna dinuhunecha |

181 allAhale yahUdIharUko kurA sunnubhayo jasale bhane– allAha nirdhana hunuhuncha, tyasaile hAmIbATa RNa mAgnu bhaeko cha ra hAmI dhanI chauM | tinIharUle AphnA pAlanakartAko bAremA lagAeko mithyA abhiyoga ra nabIharUlAI anAhakamA gareko hatyAlAI hAmIle lekhera rAkhnechauM | hAmIle bhannechauM– la, dankiraheko Agoko yAtanA cAkha |
182 he yahUdIharU ho! yo narakIya pIDA timro Aphnai kAraNale ho | allAhale AphnA bhaktaharUmAthi anyAya garnuhunna |

183 yinIharUle mithyA abhiyoga lagAu~dai bhane– allAhale AphnA kitAbaharUmA ra AphnA sandeSTAharUko jibrobATa hAmIlAI tabasamma kunai rasUlamAthi ImAna nalyAune upadeza dinubhaeko cha, jabasamma unale yasto dAna nalyAun, jasalAI AkAzabATa Aeko Agole jalAos | vAstaviktA ke cha bhane allAhale yasto kunai upadeza dinubhaeko chaina | nabIharUle pani yasto kehI bhanekA chainan | ataH allAhale AphnA nabI muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) lAI Adeza dinubhayo, bhanidinuhos– ma bhandA pahile timIharU samakSa spaSTa pramANakA sAtha ra timIharUle varNana gare jhaiM balidAnakA sAtha nabIharU Ae jasakA balidAnalAI AkAzabATa Aeko Agole jalAyo | yadi timIharU Aphno bhanAimA saccA chau bhane unIharUlAI kina jhUTho Thahara garyau ra hatyA garyo ta?!

184 he nabI! yadi tinIharUle tapAIMlAI jhUTalAu~chan bhane cintA nalinuhos | yo kAphiraharUko bAnI ho | tapAIMbhandA aghi dherai rasUlaharU jhUTlAie | unIharU spaSTa pramANa, upadeza tathA naitika zikSAmA AdhArita kitAbaharU, AdezaharU tathA zarIata (islAmI kAnuna) mA AdhArita mArgadarzana garne kitAba liera AekA thie |

185 pratyeka prANIle mRtyuko svAda cAkhnuparcha | kasaile pani yasa saMsArabATa dhokA khAnu hu~daina | mahApralayako dina timIharUlAI timIharUkA sabai kAryaharUkA pratiphala kaTauti nagarikana pUrNa rUpamA diinecha | ani jasalAI allAhale narkabATa jogAunu bhayo ra svargamA praveza garAunu bhayo usale nizciya nai saGkaTabATa mukti pAyo | sAMsArika jIvana ta samApta hune vastu ho | dhokA khAne vyakti mAtra sAMsArika jIvanasita sambandha rAkhcha |

186 he mominaharU ho! timrA dhanasampattimA avazya nai timIharUko parIkSA hunecha | timIharUmAthi anivArya garieko kurAmA ra kahile kunai Arthika saMkaTadvArA pani, tyasaigarI timIharUko jyAnamA pani parIkSA hunecha | zarIatale dieko jimmevArI ra timIlAI hune du:kha ra bimArIdvArA | yahUdI, IsAI tathA bahudevavAdIharUle timIharUmA ra islAma dharmamA kamI-kamajorI nikAlne chan jasale gardA timIharU dukhi hunechau | yI saGkaTa, kaSTa tathA du:khamA dhairya garchau ra allAhako AjJApAlana garera tathA varjita kArya tyAgera Izabhaya rAkhyau bhane nissandeha yo ati sAhasI kArya hunecha | pratispardhA garneharUle yasamA pratispardhA garnuparcha |

187 he nabI! yAda garnuhos, jaba allAhale yahUdI ra IsAI dharma guruharUsita pakkA vacana linubhaeko thiyo– timIharUle allAhako kitAbalAI mAnisaharU mAjha spaSTa pArnechau, yasamA raheko mArdarzana tathA muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) ko nubuvvatako pramANalAI lukAune chainau | tara tinIharUle bevAstA gare ra tyasatarpha dhyAna dienan | yasarI satyalAI lukAe ra asatya prakaTa gare | pada tathA dhanasampatti jasto thorai mUlyamA allAhako vacanalAI lenadena gare | kati narAmro rahecha tyo mUlya jasako saTTAmA tinIharUle allAhako vacanako saudA gare!

188 he nabI! narAmrA kArya garera prasanna hune ra AphUle nagareko rAmro kAryako prazaMsA khojneharU allAhako yAtanAbATa bacnechan bhanne kurA tapAIM naThAnnuhos | baru tinIharU narkamA jAne chan jasamA du:khadAyI yAtanA diinecha |
189 nissandeha AkAzaharU evaM pRthvIko sRSTi, rAjya saJcAlana sabai allAhakai hun | allAha sampUrNa kAryako sAmarthya rAkhnuhuncha |

190 nissandeha AkAzaharU evaM pRthvIko binA kunai udAharaNa sRSTi, rAta evaM dinako pAlaipAlo Aune jAne krama tathA rAtadinako choTo ra lAmo hune kAryamA buddhimAnaharUkA lAgi spaSTa nizAnIharU chan | yasale pramANita huncha, yI sabaikA sRSTikartA allAha mAtra bhakti yogya hunuhuncha |

191 yI buddhimAnaharU nai ubhi~dA, basdA, sutdA hareka avasthAmA allAhalAI smaraNa garchan ra AkAzaharU evaM pRthvIko saMracanAmA cintana gardai bhanchan– he hAmrA pAlanakartA! tapAIMle yati mahAna jagata vyartha sRSTi garnubhaeko chaina | tapAIM vyartha kunai pani kArya garnuhunna | ataH hAmIlAI satkarma garne zakti diera tathA duSkarmabATa jogAera narkako yAtanAbATa bacAunuhos |
192 he hAmrA pAlanakartA! tapAIMle jasalAI narkamA hAlnuhuncha usalAI apamAnita garnuhuncha | kayAmatako dina atyAcArIharUlAI allAhako yAtanAbATa jogAune kohI sahayogI hunechaina |

193 he hAmrA pAlanakartA! hAmIle ImAna (AsthA) tarpha bolAune muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) ko kurA sunyauM | uhA~le ahvAna gardai bhannubhayo– eka mAtra satya Izvara tathA pAlanakartA allAhamAthi ImAna lyAU | tasartha hAmIle ImAna lyAyauM ra uhA~ko zarIatako anusaraNa garyauM | hAmrA pApaharUlAI lukAi diera beijjata hunabATa bacAunuhos | hAmrA duSkarmaharUlAI mApha garnuhos ra tyasamA pakaDa nagarnuhos | satkarma garne tathA duSkarmalAI tyAgne kSamatA diera sukarmIharUsa~ga mRtyu dinuhos |

194 he hAmrA pAlanakartA! tapAIMle dinubhaeko vacana anusAra hAmIlAI mArgadarzana tathA maddata pradAna garnuhos | kayAmata (mahApralaya) ko dina narkamA hAlera hAmIlAI apamAnita nagarnuhos | he hAmrA pAlanakartA! tapAIM mahAna hunuhuncha, Aphno vAcA kahilyai toDnuhunna |

195 unIharUkA pAlanakartAle javAphamA bhannubhayo– ma timIharUmadhye kasaiko karmako puNya khera phAldinaM, cAhe tyo thorai hos vA dherai hos, cAhe tyo karma garnevAlA puruSa hos vA mahilA | islAmale timIharU bIca vibheda gardaina | puruSalAI baDhI dine ra mahilAlAI kama dine calana chaina | jo mAnisaharUle mero mArgamA hijrata (palAyana) gare, kAphiraharUle unIharUlAI islAmakai kAraNale gharabATa nikAle ra yAtanA die ra unIharUle allAhako vANI ucca pArnako lAgi yuddha gare tathA yuddhamA mArie | mahApralayako dina maile unIharUkA pApaharU pUrNarUpamA mApha garnechu | unIharUlAI yastA svargaharUmA praveza garAunechu jasako talatirabATa nadIharU kalakala bagirahekA hune chan | yo puNya allAhako tarphabATa ho ra sarvottama puNya allAhasa~ga nai raheko cha jasako kunai udAharaNa chaina |
196 he nabI! kAphiraharUko dezavyApI ghumaphira, ThUlo vyApAra tathA dhanasampattile tapAIMlAI dhokAmA napAros |
197 yo saMsAra thorai dinako sarasAmAna mAtra ho, yo sadhaiM rahanechaina | mahApralayako dina yinIharUko vAsasthAna narka hunecha | ekadamai narAmro vAsasthAna ho narka!

198 tara AphnA pAlanakartAko AjJApAlana gardai tathA varjita kAryaharUlAI tyAgdai Izabhaya rAkhneharUkA lAgi svargaharU chan, jasako talatirabATa nadIharU bagirahekA hunechan | unIharU tyasamA sadAsarvadA rahanechan | yo unIharUkA lAgi allAhako tarphabATa tayAra pArieko varadAna ho | allAhale AphnA satkarmI bhaktaharUkA lAgi je jati tayAra pArnubhaeko cha tyo kAphiraharUle ramAirahekA sAMsArika mojamastIko anupAtamA ati uttama cha |

199 sabai yahUdI ra IsAI ekanAsa chainan | tinIharUmadhye euTA samUha allAhamAthi ra unIharUtarpha avatarita satya tathA mArgadarzanamAthi ImAna rAkhcha | unIharU AphUtarpha avatarita kitAbamA rahekA kurAmA ImAna rAkhchan ra rasUlaharUbIca vibheda gardainan | allAhakahA~ rahekA svargamA cAso rAkhera uhA~samakSa vinamra rahane garchan | allAhakA AyataharUlAI sAMsArika tuccha mUlyamA vikrI gardainan | yastA guNaharU bhaekA mAnisaharUkA lAgi mahAna puNya cha | nissandeha allAha cA~Dai karmaharUkA hisAba linuhunecha ra cA~Dai tyasako pratidAna dinuhunecha |

200 he AsthAvAnaharU ho! zarIatakA jimmevArI tathA sAMsArika saMkaTaprati dhairyadhAraNa gara | dhairya dhAraNamA kAphiharUlAI parAjita gara | tinIharU timIharUbhandA baDhI dhairya dhAraNa garna sakdainan | allAhako mArgamA yuddhamA kAyama raho | allAhako AjJApAlana garera tathA uhA~ko avajJAbATa bacera uhA~sa~ga DarAU | AzA cha timIharU narkabATa joginechau ani svarga prApta garI manale citAekA kurAharU prApta garnechau |

1 he mAnavaharU ho! AphnA pAlanakartAsa~ga DarAU | uhA~le nai timIharUlAI eka vyakti, timrA pitA purkhA AdamabATa sRSTi garnubhayo | uhA~le AdamabATa unako joDI tathA timIharUko AmA havvAlAI sRSTi garnubhayo | yasai dampatIbATa saMsArabhari cAraitira dherai puruSa tathA mahilAharU phailAunubhayo | tyasa allAhasa~ga DarAU, jasako nAmale timIharU ekArkAsa~ga sahayoga mAgdachau | kohI bhancha– allAhako nAmale timIlAI yo kAma garna bhanchu ityAdi | nAtAgotA toDne kAma nagara | yasale timIharU paraspara sambandhamA gA~siekA chau | nissandeha allAha timIharUkA nirIkSaka hunuhuncha | timIharUkA kunai kArya pani khera jA~daina, baru uhA~le tyasako hisAba kitAba rAkhnuhuncha ra tyasako pratidAna dinuhunecha |

2 he vasiyata gariekA mAnisaharU ho! bAliga ra hosiyAra bhaepachi anAthaharUlAI unIharUko dhanasampatti pUrNarUpamA phirtA gara | unIharUko asala dhanasampatti liera Aphno kharAba dhanasampatti nadeU | tyastai unIharUko dhanasampattilAI Aphno dhanasampatimA misAera nakhAU | nizcaya nai yo allAhako dRSTimA mahApApa ho |

3 Aphno adhInamA rahekA anAtha keTIharUsa~ga vivAha garemA mahara kama diera vA narAmro vyavahAra garera nyAya garna nasakielA ki bhanne timIharUlAI Dara cha bhane timIharU tinIharUsa~ga vivAha nagarera anya pavitra mahilAharUsa~ga vivAha gara | timIharUle Aphno cAhanA anusAra duI-duI, tIna-tIna vA cAra-cAra janAsa~ga vivAha gara | bahuvivAha gardA nyAya garna sakinna bhanne AzaGkA cha bhane euTImA mAtra sImita raha vA Aphno adhInamA rahekI kunai dAsIharUsa~ga phAidA uThAU | dAsIharUprati tyasto jimmevArI chaina jasto jimmevArI zrImatIharUprati huncha | anAtha keTI vA zrImatIharUbIca nyAya garna nasakielA bhanne Darale euTImA mAtra sImita rahane vA dAsIharUsa~ga phAidA uThAune Adeza diieko cha |
4 mahilAharUlAI unIharUko mahara (upahAra) anivAryarUpamA deU | yadi unIharUle rAjIkhusI tyasabATa kehI dinchan bhane tyo majAle khAU |

5 he abhibhAvakaharU ho! jabasamma yI anAthaharU dhanasampattilAI ucita tarikAle kharca garne, saJcAlana tathA surakSA garne kSamatA rAkhdainan tabasamma tinIharUlAI hastAntaraNa nagara | yI dhanasampattilAI allAhale AphnA bhaktaharUko phAidA tathA unIharUko Arthika AvazyakatA purA garne sAdhana banAunubhaeko cha | tara unIharUmAthi kharca gara, khuvAU tathA pahirAU | unIharUsita mITho bolI bola | unIharUsita gareko vAcA purA gara arthAta bAliga bhaepachi ra dhanasampatti kharca garne tarikA jAnepachi unIharUko dhanasampatti unIharUlAI pUrNarUpamA hastAntaraNa garideU |

6 he abhibhAvakaharU ho! jaba anAthaharU bAliga hunchan taba unIharUlAI thorai dhanasampatti diera jA~ca gara ki kasarI kharca garchan | unIharUle ThIka tarikAle kharca garchan ra hosiyAra bhaisakeko kurA spaSTa bhaepachi unIharUkA dhanasampatti pUrNarUpamA unIharUlAI sumpideU | unIharUko dhanabATa AvazyakatA paremA tyati mAtra khAU jati jAyaja cha | tI anAthaharU bAliga bhaepachi AphnA dhanasampatti phirtA linechan bhanne Darale hatAramA nakhAideU | anAthako juna abhibhAvakasa~ga paryApta dhanasampatti cha usale tyasako dhanasampatti nakhAos ra jo gariba cha usale AvazyakatA anusAra mAtra khAos | bAliga tathA hosiyAra bhaepachi unIharUko sampatti unIharUlAI sumpane belAmA kehI vyaktiharUlAI sAkSI banAU, tAki haka surakSita rahos ra kunai vivAda nahos | hunata gavAha ra karmaharUko hisAbako lAgi allAha nai paryApta hunuhuncha |

7 AmA-bAbu evaM nikaTatama nAtedAraharU jastai dAjubhAi tathA kAkA ityAdile marepachi choDekA dhanasampattimA puruSa ra mahilA duvaiko aMza huncha, cAhe thorai hos vA dherai | islAmaaghi mahilA tathA bAla bAlikAharUlAI paitrika dhanamA kunai aMza thiena | kasako haka kati ho bhanne kurA pani allAhabATa spaSTa ra anivArya garieko cha |

8 yadi aMzabaNDAko samayamA yastA nAtedAra, anAtha tathA garibaharU Au~chan jasako tyasamA aMza chaina bhane tinIharUlAI atirikta rUpamA kehI deU | kinabhane tinIharUlAI pani kehI milos bhanne cAhanA huncha | tinIharUsa~ga mITho bola |

9 mAnisaharUle AphUpachADi sasAnA bAlabAlikA choDera gaemA jasarI Aphno santAnako mAyA lAgcha ra tinIharU barbAda hunchan bhanne Dara lAgcha, tyasarI nai tinIharUle Aphno adhInamA rahekA anya anAthaharUprati pani allAhasita DarAunu pardacha ra anyAya garnuhu~daina | tAki allAhale unIharUle gareko rAmro vyavahAra jastai unIharUko santAnako lAgi rAmro abhibhAvaka pradAna garun | tyasaigarI mRtyuko samayamA mAnisale santAnaharUlAI rAmro ra satya kurA bhannuparcha | kasaiko aMzamA kamibesI garnu vA vasiyata nagarera AphUlAI bhalAibATa vaJcita garnuhu~daina |
10 jo mAnisaharUle anAthaharUko sampatti anyAyapUrvaka linchan ra kharca gardachan, tinIharU vAstavamA Aphno bhu~DImA Ago bhardachan | mahApralayako dina tinIharUlAI Agole jalAunecha ra polnecha |

11 allAhale santAnaharUmA yasarI aMzabaNDA garne Adeza dinubhaeko cha– eka janA chorAko aMza duI janA chorIharU barAbara huncha | yadi mRta vyaktile chorIharU mAtra choDeko cha, chorA choDeko chaina bhane duI vA duIbhandA baDhI chorIharUle mRtale choDeko sampattiko duI tihAI pAune chan | euTI mAtra chorI che bhane usale sampattiko AdhA aMza pAuneche | mRtakako kunai santAna cha bhane mRtakakA mAtA-pitAmadhye pratyekale mRtakale choDeko sampattiko chaiMTho bhAga pAunecha | tara, chorA-chorI kunai santAna chaina ra uttarAdhikArI kevala AmA-buvA nai hun bhane AmAko aMza eka tihAI hunecha bA~kI sabai buvAko hunecha | mRtakako duI vA duIbhandA baDhI dAjubhAi tathA didIbahinI chan cAhe euTai AmA-buvAbATa houn vA euTai buvA tathA chuTTA chuTTai AmAbATa houn, AmAko aMza anivArya rUpamA sampattiko chaiThauM bhAga hunecha ra bA~kI sabai abhibhAvaka bhaeko hunAle buvAko aMza hunecha | yasamA dAjubhAiharUko aMza hunechaina | mRtakako vasiyata (antima upadeza) lAI lAgU garepachi mAtra virAsatako yo bhAgabaNDA garnuparcha | yasa sartakA sAtha ki tyo vasiyata usale choDeko sampattiko eka tihAi bhandA baDhI nahos ra usamAthi rahekA RNa cuktA gari sakieko hos | allAhale yasarI virAsatako bhAgabaNDA garnubhaeko cha | kinabhane timIharUkA mAtA-pitA ra santAnaharUmadhye loka ra paralokamA timrAlAgi ko baDhI lAbhadAyaka hunecha bhanne kurA timIharUlAI thAhA chaina | kahile mRtakale kunai santAnalAI baDhI manaparAera sampUrNa dhanasampatti usailAI dina sakcha ra kasailAI mana naparAemA virAsatabATa vaJcita rAkhna sakcha tara vAstavikatA yasako viparIta pani huna sakcha | yI sabai kurAharUko vAstavikatA allAhabAheka kasailAI pani thAhA hu~daina | tyasaile allAhale bayAna garnubhaeko tarikA anusAra anivArya rUpamA virAsata bhAgabaNDA garnuparcha | nissandeha allAha sarvajJa hunuhuncha | bhaktaharUko phAidA ke kurAmA cha bhanne kurA uhA~bATa lukeko chaina | uhA~ kAnuna banAuna tathA saJcAlana garnamA tatvadarzI hunuhuncha |

12 he zrImAnaharU ho! timrA zrImatIharUle choDekA sampattimA timIharUlAI AdhA aMza prApta hunecha | yadi zrImatIko santAna (chorAchorI) timIharUbATa vA anya zrImAnabATa chainan bhane | unIharUko santAna bhaemA cautho bhAga prApta hunecha | yo unIharUle gareko vasiyata (antima upadeza) purA garepachi ra unIharUmAthi raheko RNa cuktA bhaepachi mAtra kAryAnanvayana hunecha | he zrImAnaharU ho! yadi timIharUkA chorAchorI kunai santAna chaina, na tI patnIbATa na anya patnIbATa, timIharUle choDekA sampattimA timrA patnIharUlAI cautho bhAga prApta hunecha | tara, santAna cha bhane zrImatIharUlAI AThauM bhAga prApta hunecha | yo timIharUle gareko vasiyata (antima upadeza) purA bhaepachi ra timIharUmAthi raheko RNa cuktA bhaepachi mAtra kAryAnvayana hunecha | yadi kunai yasto puruSa vA mahilAko mRtyu huncha jasako mAtA-pitA vA santAna jIvita chainan tara AmA paTTIko ekajanA mAtra dAjubhAi athavA ekajanA didIbahinI chan bhane yasto avasthAmA AmA paTTIko dAjubhAi vA didI-bahinIlAI anivAryarUpamA chaiThauM bhAga prApta hunecha | tara, AmA paTTIko dAjubhAi vA didIbahinIko saGkhyA ekabhandA baDhI cha bhane unIharU sabaile eka tihAImA anivArya rUpamA sAjhedAra bannechan | puruSa-mahilA duvaile barAbara aMza pAune chan | vasiyata purA garepachi ra RNa cuktA bhaepachi mAtra unIharUle AphnA aMza line chan | yasa sartakA sAtha ki paitRka dhanakA aMziyAraharUlAI hAni napugos | jastai jammA dhanako tIna tihAibhandA baDhIko vasiyata nahos | yasa AyatamA bhaeko Adeza allAhako tarphabATa vacana ho | uhA~le yasako pAlanA garna anivArya garnubhaeko cha | bhaktaharUko lAgi loka ra paraloka duvaimA kuna kurA rAmro cha bhanne kurA allAhalAI rAmrarI thAhA cha | uhA~ sahanazIla hunuhuncha, sajAya dinamA hatAra garnuhunna |

13 allAhale anAthaharU ra anya uparyukta viSayaharUmA niyamaharU batAunubhaeko cha | jasale allAhakA AdezaharUko pAlanA garera tathA varjita kAryaharUbATa bacera allAha tathA rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) ko AjJApAlana garchan allAhale unIharUlAI yastA bagaiMcAharUmA praveza garAunu hunecha jasakA bhavanaharUko talatirabATa nadIharU bagirahekA hunechan | tyasamA unIharU sadAsarvadA rahanechan, kahile marne chainan | yo mahAna pratidAna ra ThUlo saphalatA ho | yo jasto anya kunai saphalatA huna sakdaina |

14 jasale allAhale dinubhaeko Adeza anusAra karma nagarera vA tyasamA zaMkA garera allAha tathA uhA~kA rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi vasallama) ko avajJA garcha ra uhA~le banAunubhaeko kAnunako ullaGghana garcha, tyastAlAI uhA~le narkamA phyA~knu hunecha, jahA~ U sadAsarvadA apamAnajanaka yAtanA bhogirahane cha |

15 timrA mahilAharUmadhye vivAhita vA avivAhita jasale pani vyabhicAra garchan, tinIharU viruddha Aphno tarphabATa cAra janA nyAya garne puruSaharUlAI sAkSI banAU | tinIharUle sAkSI diemA tI mahilAharUlAI sajAya svarUpa gharabhitra kaida garera rAkha yahA~samma ki ta marera samApta hoUn, ki ta allAhale tinIharUkA lAgi kaida bAheka anya bATo nikAlun | pachi allAhale tinIharUkA lAgi bATo nikAlnu bhayo | avivAhita mahilAle vyabhicAra garemA eka saya korrAko sajAya diine cha ra ekavarSako lAgi ghara nikAlA garinecha | vivAhita mahilAle vyabhicAra garemA rajma garnu (DhuGgAle hAnera mArnu) parcha |

16 duIjanA puruSale ApasamA aprAkRtika maithuna garemA cAhe duvai vivAhita hos vA avivAhita duvailAI gAlI garera apamAna gardai kuTera kaSTa deU | yadi tinIharUle prAyazcita (taubA) garchan ra tyasato garna choDchan bhane tinIharUlAI choDideU | kinabhane taubAle sampUrNa pApalAI pakhAlcha, nissandeha allAhale taubA garne bhaktaharUko taubA svIkAra garnuhuncha ra unIharUmAthi dayA garnuhuncha | yo sajAya islAmako suruvAtI samayamA thiyo pachi avivAhitako lAgi eka saya korrAko sajAya diine cha ra ekavarSako lAgi ghara nikAlA garinecha | vivAhitako lAgi rajma garnu (DhuMgAle hAnera mArnu) parcha |

17 allAha tyastA mAnisaharUko mAtra taubA (prAyazcita) svIkAra garnuhuncha jasale tyasako pariNAmalAI najAneko kAraNale kukarma garekA hunchan | (jAnIjAnI tathA najAnIkana pApa garneharU duvai khAlakA pApIharU yasto garchan) pheri mRtyuaghi taubA garchan | yastA mAnisaharUko taubA allAhale svIkAra garnuhuncha ra unIharUkA pApaharUlAI mApha garnuhuncha | allAha Aphno sRSTiko sampUrNa avasthAharUlAI rAmrarI jAnnuhuncha ra unIharUko bhAgya tathA kAnunabAre tatvadarzI hunuhuncha |

18 allAhale tyastA mAnisaharUko taubA svIkAra garnuhunna jo nirantara duSkarma garirahanchan ra mRtyukA nizAnIharU dekhA parepachi mAtra taubA garchan | tyatikhera unIharUmadhye ekajanA bhancha– maile gareko pApaprati aba taubA gareM | tinIharUko pani taubA svIkAra garine chaina jo nirantara kuphra gareko avasthAmA marchan | nirantara pApa garne tathA kuphrako avasthAmA marekA yastA avajJAkArIharUkA lAgi hAmIle duHkhadAyI yAtanA tayAra pArekA chauM |

19 he mominaharU! AphnA pUrvaja ra nAtedAraharUkA zrImatIharUko vArisa tyasarI nabana jasarI dhanasampattiko vArisa banchau | timIharU Aphno cAhanA anusAra nata tinIharUsa~ga vivAha gara, na arUsa~ga vivAha garAU | tinIharU Aphno icchA anusAra vivAha garchan bhane tyasabATa naroka | AphnA zrImatIharUlAI kaSTa dinako lAgi bAdhya pArera nikAhamA narAkha tAki tinIharUle maharako kehI aMza choDun | spaSTa rUpamA vyabhicAra garemA tinIharUlAI nikAhamA rokna ra kaDAi garna milcha yahA~samma ki tinIharUle timIharUle dieko mahara phirtA garun | tinIharUsa~ga rAmro vyavahAra gara, kunai kaSTa nadeU baru upakAra gara | sAMsArika mAmilAmA tinIharUkA kunai kArya mana naparemA dhairya gara | AzA cha tinIharUkA mana napardA kurAmA dhairya garemA loka ra paraloka duvaimA dherai bhalAi prApta hunecha |

20 he zrImAnaharU ho! yadi timIharU euTI zrImatIlAI talAka diera tyasako sthAnamA arkI zrImatI lyAuna cAhanchau bhane yasamA kunai Apatti chaina | yadi timIharU maharako rUpamA prazasta dhanasampatti diekA chau bhane tyasabATa kehI pani phirtA linu jAyaja chaina | dieko vastu phirtA linu spaSTa jhUTa tathA pApa hunecha |

21 timIharUle dieko mahara kasarI phirtA lina sakchau jabaki timIharUbIca sambandha, prema tathA sambhoga bhaisakeko cha ra ekaarkAko bheda jAnisakekA chau | zrImatIharUko hAtamA raheko dhanamA lAlaca garnu nacAhi~do tathA ghRNita kArya ho | jabaki timIharUsa~ga pakkA vacana pani liisakekA chan | allAhako vANI tathA zarIata (kAnuna) dvArA eka arkAko lAgi halAla garieko kurAlAI pakkA vacana bhanieko ho |

22 tI mahilAharUsa~ga vivAha nagara josa~ga timIharUkA pitAharUle vivAha garekA thie | yo timIharUkA lAgi harAma ho | islAmaaghi je bhayo tyasamA pakaDa hunechaina | pitAharUle vivAha garekA mahilAharUsa~ga chorAharUle vivAha garnu ati ghRNita kArya ho | yasto vyaktisa~ga allAha risAunu huncha | yo ta ekadamai narAmro calana ho |
