23 allAhale timIharUkA lAgi nimnalikhita mahilAharUharUsa~ga vivAha garnu harAma garnubhaeko cha: AmA, hajuraAmA, mAmAgharako hajuraAmA vA yasa bhandA mAthi duvai paTTikA bajyaisa~ga | chorI, chorIpaTTikI nAtinI, chorApaTTikI nAtinI vA yasa bhandA tala | didIbahinI vA sautenI didIbahinI | phupU, sautenI phupU, AmA ra buvAkA phupUharU | sAnIAmA tathA AmA ra buvAkA sAnIAmAharU | bhatijI, sautenI bhatijI vA yasa bhandA tala, jastaiH nAtinI | bhAnjI, sautenI bhAnjI vA yasa bhandA tala, jastaiH nAtinI | dudhe-AmA, dudhe didI-bahinI, dudhe AmAkI chorI | sAsuAmA, cAhe zrImatIharUsa~ga sahavAsa bhaeko cha/chaina, zrImatI sAthamA cha/chaina, sAsuAmA sadAko lAgi avaidha ho | sautenI chorI, jasako janma timIbATa nabhae pani pAlanapoSaNa timro kAkhamA bhayo ani usako AmAsa~ga timIharUko sahabAsa bhaisakeko cha | tara, yadi sahavAsa bhaeko chaina bhane unIharUlAI talAka diepachi unakA chorIharUsa~ga vivAha garnamA kunai pApa chaina | buhArI, nAtinIbuhArI vA yasa bhandA tala | dhAi chorAharUkA zrImatIharUsa~ga pani bihe garnu yasai antargata parcha | tyasaigarI hADanAtA vA dUdhako nAtAkA didI-bahinIlAI ekaisAtha nikAha (vivAha bandhana) mA rAkhnu harAma ho | tara islAmaaghi je bhayo tyasalAI allAhale mApha garnubhayo | nissandeha allAha AphnA taubA garne bhaktaharUprati ati kSamAzIla hunuhuncha | unIharUprati parama dayAlu hunuhuncha | hadIsamA zrImatI tathA usanakI phupU, zrImatI tathA unakI sAnImAlAI ekasAtha vivAha bandhanamA rAkhnu pani harAma ho |

24 vivAhita mahilAharUsa~ga vivAha garnu harAma garieko cha | yuddhamA dAsI banAiekI mahilAsa~ga sahavAsa garnu jAyaja cha, tara yasako sarta ke cha bhane rajasvalA nahunjela kurnuparne huncha | yo allAhale anivArya garnubhaeko niyama ho | unIharU bAheka anya mahilAharUsa~ga bihe garnu halAla cha | Aphno dhanasampatti kharca garera vivAha gara ani halAla tarikAbATa AphUlAI pavitra rAkha | vyabhicAra nagara | bihe gardA zrImatIlAI mahara deU | allAhale mahara cuktA garnu anivArya garnubhaeko cha | mahara nizcita bhaepachi tyasamA ApasI samajhadArIbATa timIharUle je ghaTabaDha garyau tyasamA kunai pApa lAgne chaina | nissandeha allAha Aphno sRSTiko bAremA sarvajJa hunuhuncha, kunai kurA uhA~bATa lukeko chaina | uhA~ kArya saJcAlana tathA kAnuna banAunamA tatvadarzI hunuhuncha |

25he puruSaharU ho! timIharUmadhye jo dhana–mAlako kamIle gardA svatantra mahilAsa~ga vivAha garna sakdaina usako lAgi dAsI mahilAharUsa~ga vivAha garnu jAyaja cha | yadi tinIharU momina huna bhanne lAgcha bhane | allAha timIharUko ImAna tathA avasthAsita avagata hunuhuncha | timIharU tathA tI mahilAharU dharma tathA mAnavatAmA samAna chau | ataH tinIharUsa~ga vivaha garnamA lAja namAna baru unIharUko abhibhAvakaharUko anumati liera vivA gara ra unIharUko mahara purA-purA tathA samayamA cuktA gara, yadi tinIharU khullA rUpamA vyabhicAra gardainan bhane | lukI chipI vyabhicAra garnako lAgi mitratA nagA~sa | yadi vivAha garepachi vyabhicAra garchan bhane tinIharUlAI svatantra mahilAbhandA AdhA sajAya deU arthAta pacAsa korrA lagAU | svatantra mahilAle vyabhicAra garemA rajma garincha, tyo sajAya dAsIlAI diidaina | dAsIharUsa~ga vivAhako anumati yastA vyaktiharUkA lAgi mAtra cha jasalAI vyabhicAramA lipta hune Dara cha ra jo svatantra mahilAsa~ga vivAha garne sAmarthya rAkhdainan | dAsIharUsa~ga vivAha nagarnu nai besa ho | kinabhane usako kokhabATa janmeko baccA pani dAsa nai huncha | taubA garne bhaktaharUkA lAgi allAha kSamAzIla tathA dayAvAna hunuhuncha | dAsIharUsa~ga vivAhako anumati allAhako kRpAmadhye ho |

26 allAhale yI AdezaharUdvArA zarIata tathA dharmakA mahatvapUrNa kurAharU tathA loka ra paralokakA bhalAiharU timIharUlAI sikAunu bhaeko cha | halAla tathA harAmabAre aghillA sandeSTAharUko tarikA ra unIharUkA jIvanI tathA rAmrA guNaharU spaSTa pArna cAhanuhuncha tAki timIharU tyasako anusaraNa gara | allAha timIharUlAI avajJAbATa pherera AjJAkArI banAuna cAhanuhuncha | bhaktaharUko hIta kuna kurAmA cha bhanne kurA allAha jAnnuhuncha ani tyasai anusAra kAnuna banAunu huncha | uhA~ kAnuna banAuna tathA unIharUko mAmilA saJcAlanamA tatvadarzI hunuhuncha |
27 allAhale timIharUko taubA svIkAra garna ra pApa mApha garna cAhanuhuncha | tara mojamastIko pachi lAgneharU timIharUlAI satya mArgabATa TADhA pArna cAhanchan |
28 allAha timIharUmAthi zarIatakA bojha halukA garna cAhanuhuncha | timIharUkA kamIkamajorIlAI jAnnuhuncha, tyasaile sAmarthya bhandA baDhI bojha hAlna cAhanuhunna |

29 he AsthAvAnaharU ho! timIharUmadhye kasaile kasaiko dhanasampatti anAhaka tarikA; jabarjastI, corI tathA ghusa ityAdile nakhAU | tara vyApArabATa prApta bhaeko dhanasampatti khAna tathA prayoga garna jAyaja cha | na kasaile kasaiko hatyA garUn na Atma–hatyA garun | allAha timIharUprati dayAvAna hunuhuncha tyasaile timIharUmAthi eka arkAko ragata, dhanasampatti tathA ijjata harAma garnubhaeko cha |

30 jasale manAhI garieko kArya jAnIjAnI garcha, ani arkAko dhanasampatti haDapne garcha, anAhaka jAnI jAnI hatyA ga|rera jyAdatI garcha, najAnera vA birsera hoina, allAhale yasto vyaktilAI mahApralayako dina bhayAvaha narkako AgomA hAlnu hunecha, jasamA U DaDhanecha ra pIDA bhognecha | allAhako lAgi yo ekadama sajilo kArya ho | kinabhane uhA~ hareka kAryako sAmarthya rAkhnuhuncha, uhA~lAI kasaile rokna sakdaina |

31 he mominaharU ho! yadi timIharU ThUlA pApaharU jastai zirka (allAhasa~ga kasailAI sAjhedAra banAune kArya), mAtA pitAko avajJA, hatyA, hiMsA, byAja khAne kAryaharUbATa jogine chau bhane timIharUle garekA sAnA pApaharUlAI ma mApha garnechu ra sammAnita sthAna svargamA praveza garAunechu |

32 he mominaharU ho! timIharUmadhye kasaile anya kasailAI pradAna garieko kRpAko kAmanA nagara | yasale gardA timIharUbIca risa tathA DAhA utpanna hunasakcha | mahilAle puruSalAI pradAna garieko kurAko kAmanA nagarun | mahilA tathA puruSa duvailAI tinIharUkA karma anusAra badalA prApta hunecha | allAhasita uhA~ko thapa kRpA mAgne gare | allAha hareka cijakA jJAtA hunuhuncha ra jasako lAgi je ucita huncha tyahI pradAna garnuhuncha |

33 timIharUmadhye pratyekako lAgi allAhale najikako nAtedAra banAunu bhaeko cha, jo AphnA buvA AmA tathA nikaTatama nAtedAraharUle choDera gaekA dhanasampattiko vArisa banchan | timIharUle sandhi garekAharUlAI pani paitrika sampattimA unIharUkA aMza deU | nissandeha allAha hareka kurAmA sAkSI hunuhuncha | tyasaigarI timIharUko ImAna tathA vAcAmAthi gavAhI pani tI gavAhImadhye hun | sandhiko AdhAramA aMza dine calana surumA thiyo tara pachi radda gariyo |

34 puruSaharU mahilAharUko heracAha garchan ra unIharUko mAmilA tathA samasyAko samAdhAna garchan | kinabhane allAhale unIharUlAI mahilAharUmAthi prAthamikatA pradAna garnubhaeko cha | tyasaigarI mahilAharUko gA~sa, vAsa tathA kapAsako jimmevArI puruSaharUmAthi anivArya garieko cha | sukarmI mahilAharU AphnA pAlanakartA ra tyasapachi Aphno zrImAnako Adezako pAlanA garchan | allAhako kRpAle tinIharU AphnA zrImAnaharUko anupasthitimA ijjatako rakSA garchan | he zrImAnaharU ho! kunai mahilAharUko bhanAi tathA garAibATa timIharUlAI haThadharmI tathA avajJAko Dara cha bhane pahilA tinIharUlAI samjhAune prayAsa gara ra allAhako Dara dekhAU | yadi aTerI garchan bhane ochyAnamA arko tira kolTo pherera suta ra sahavAsa nagara | yatile mAndainan bhane sAmAnya kuTa piTa gara | AjJApAlana garchan bhane jyAdatI nagara | allAhasita DarAU kinabhane uhA~ Aphno astitva tathA guNamA ati ucca tathA mahAna hunuhuncha |

35 he abhibhAvakaharU ho! yadi timIharUlAI mAmilA jhana carkane ra zatrutA baDhane AzaMkA cha bhane zrImAna-zrImatI duvaiko tarphabATa eka eka janA madhyasthakartA paThAU tAki duvai ko hItamA ki ta milApa ki ta bichoDako nirNaya garun, taramilApa nai besa ho | yadi nirNAyakaharUle ThIka tarikAle nirNaya garemA allAhale zrImAna-zrImatIbIca milApa paidA garidinuhunecha ra duvaibIca raheko vibheda samApta hunecha | bhaktaharUko kunai pani cija allAhabATa lukeko chaina, baru unIharUko hRdayamA lukekA kaNa barAbara cija pani jAnnuhuncha |

36 pUrNa samarpaNa bhaera allAhako mAtra upAsanA gara ra uhA~ko sAthamA anya kasaiko upAsanA nagara | mAtA pitAko sevA tathA Adara gardai rAmro vyavahAra gara | nAtedAra, anAtha, gariba, nAtedAra chimekI, gaira nAtedAra chimekI, timro sAthamA yAtrA garne sAthI, bATo kharca siddhiekA yAtrI tathA dAsaharUsa~ga rAmro vyavahAra gara | allAhale mapAI~ tathA ghamaNDa garne ra prazaMsA cAhaneharUlAI mana parAunu hunna |

37 allAha yastA mAnisaharUlAI mana parAunu hunna jo svayama pani kharca gardainan ra arUlAI pani kharca garnabATa rokchan, allAhale pradAna garnubhaeko dhanasampatti tathA jJAna ityAdi jastA upakAralAI lukAu~chan ra mAnisaharUlAI satya spaSTa pArdainan baru lukAu~chan ra asatya kurA batAu~chan | yI kuphrakA avaguNaharU hun | hAmIle kAphiraharUkA lAgi du:khadAyI yAtanA tayAra pArekA chauM |

38 tyasaigarI hAmIle yastA mAnisaharUkA lAgi yAtanA tayAra pArekA chauM, jo mAnisaharUlAI dekhAuna tathA prazaMsA prApta garnako lAgi Aphno dhanasampatti kharca garchan | tinIharU allAha tathA mahApralayako dinamAthi ImAna rAkhdainan | hAmIle tinIharUkA lAgi apamAnajanaka yAtanA taiyAra pArekA chauM | tinIharU zaitAnako anusaraNa gareko kAraNale pathabhraSTa bhae | jasako sAthI zaitAna bhayo, usale kati duSTa sAthI pAyo |

39 tinIharUle sA~ccikai allAha tathA mahApralayako dinamAthi ImAna lyAekA bhae ra AphnA dhana allAhako mArgamA uhA~lAI mana parne tarikA anusAra evam uhA~ko prasannatAko lAgi kharca garekA bhae ke hAni hunthyo ra?! baru yasamA nai bhalAi thiyo | allAha tinIharUkA sabai kurAharU tathA avasthAharU jAnnuhuncha ra harekalAI karma anusAra badalA dinuhunecha |

40 allAha nyAya nisApha garnuhuncha ra bhaktaharUmAthi alikati pani anyAya garnuhunna | kamilA barAbara pani kasaiko satkarmalAI kamI garnuhunna ra duSkarmamA kehI pani thapnuhunna | josa~ga kaNa barAbara pani satkarma huncha tyasako puNyalAI uhA~le kaiyau~ guNA baDhAi dinuhunecha |

41 mahApralayako dina tyatikhera ke avasthA hunecha jaba hAmIle hareka samudAyakA nabIlAI unako samudAya viruddha sAkSIko rUpamA khaDA garnechauM | he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama), tapAIMlAI yasa samudAya viruddha sAkSI svarUpa khaDA garnechauM!?

42 tyasa mahAna dinamA allAhalAI inkAra garne tathA rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) ko avajJA garneharU cAhanA garnechan–unIharU mATo bhaidiemA besa hunthyo | tinIharU allAhabATa kehI pani lukAuna sakne chainan, kinabhane allAhale tinIharUko jibrolAI mohara lagAI dinuhunecha jasale gardA bolna sakne chainan ra aMgaharUlAI bolne anumati dinuhunecha ani tinIharU viruddha gavAhI dinechan |

43he AsthAvAnaharU ho! nazAmA raheko avasthAmA namAja napaDha, nazA samApta bhaepachi mAtra namAja paDha, tAki paDheko kurA thAhA hos | yo Adeza raksI pUrNarUpamA harAma nagarieko belAko ho | tyasaigarI sambhogapachi apavitratAko avasthAmA snAna (pavitratA prApta) nagarunjela namAja napaDha ra masjidamA praveza nagara | tara masjidako bATo hu~dai bAhira jAna sakincha | yadi timIharU rogale gardA pAnIle nuhAuna sakdainau, vA yAtrAmA chau, vA disA-pisAba garekAchau vA mahilAsa~ga sahavAsa garekAchau ra nuhAunako lAgi pAnI chaina bhane pavitra mATo liera tayammuma (pavitratA prApta) gara | AphnA duvai hAtalAI pavitra mATomAthi rAkha ani hAtamA lAgeko dhulo jhArera anuhAra tathA duvai hAtamA nADIsamma mala | allAha timIharUko kamI-kamajorIlAI mApha garnu hunuhuncha |

44 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! ke tapAIM tI yahUdIharUko avasthAbATa avagata hunuhunna? jasalAI taurAtako jJAna diieko thiyo tara tinIharUle mArgadarzanako saTTAmA pathabhraSTatAlAI apanAe | he AsthAvAnaharU ho! tinIharUle timIharUlAI sIdhA mArgabATa pathabhraSTa garna cAhanchan, jo rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) le dekhAunubhaeko cha?! yahUdIharU timIharUlAI Aphno bAGgo TiGgo mArgamA hiMDAuna cAhanchan |

45 he mominaharU ho! timIharUkA zatrulAI allAhale rAmrarI cinnuhuncha | saMrakSaka tathA sahayogIko rUpamA allAha paryApta hunahuncha ra tinIharUkA calakhela tathA kaSTabATa timIharUlAI surakSita rAkhnuhuncha ra maddata garnuhuncha |

46 yahUdIharUmadhye yastA mAnisaharU pani chan jo allAhakA vANImA pherabadala garchan ra tyasako narAmro artha lagAu~chan | rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) le Adeza diMdA tinIharU bhanchan– hAmIle tapAIMko kurA sunyauM tara tapAIMko Adezako avajJA garyauM | ThaTTA gardai bhanchan– hAmIle bhanekA kurA tapAIMle sunnus tara tapAIMko kurA nasuniyos | rAinA bhandA yasarI bhanchan mAnauM tinIharUko tAtparya ho– hAmIle tapAIMko sunAiko khayAla garyauM | tara vAstavamA tinIharUko tAtparya huncha– kurAlAI phernu, nabI (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) lAI sarApnu ra dharmamA kaTAkSa garnu | yadi tinIharUle pahilA je bhane, tyasako saTTAmA yo bhanekA bhae– hAmIle tapAIMkA kurA sunyauM ra tapAIMkA Adezako pAlanA garyauM, sunnuhos, parkhanuhos, hAmI tapAIMkA kurA bujhnechauM bhane tinIharUko hakamA rAmro hunthyo | yaso bhandA nisApha pani hunthyo ra nabI (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) prati Adara pani | tara allAhale tinIharUlAI dhikkArnubhayo | tinIharUko kuphrako kAraNale Aphno kRpAbATa TADhA pArnubhayo | tyasaile tinIharU ImAna lyAune chainan jasamA tinIharUko phAidA cha |

47 he kitAba pAekA yahUdI ra IsAIharU ho! muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) mAthi avataraNa garieko kitAba kurAnamAthi ImAna lyAU | yo kitAba timIharUsa~ga raheko taurAta tathA injIlako puSTi gardacha | timIharUkA anuhAramA rahekA indriya vA mahasusa garne aGgaharUlAI pherera pachADi garinu bhandA pahile ImAna lyAU | natra timIharUlAI tyastai dhikkArne chauM, jasarI hAmIle zanivArako dina mAchA mArna manAhI garieko kurA pAlanA nagarneharUlAI dhikkArekA thiyauM ra tinIharUlAI bA~dara banAekA thiyauM | allAhako Adeza tathA bhAgya purA bhaerai chADcha |

48 nissandeha allAhale zirka garneharUlAI kahilyai mApha garnuhunechaina | zirka tathA kuphra bhandA kama darjAko pApalAI jasako lAgi cAhanuhuncha Aphno kRpAle mApha garnuhunecha ra jasalAI cAhanuhuncha Aphno nisAphale usako pApa anusAra yAtanA dinuhunecha | allAhasa~ga zirka garneharUle vAstavamA ThUlo pApa garchan | zirkamA rahekai avasthAmA marneharUlAI mApha chaina |

49 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! ke tapAIMlAI tI mAnisaharUko bAremA thAhA cha, jo Aphno pavitratA tathA karmaharUko prazaMsA garchan? baru mAtra allAha AphnA bhaktaharUmadhye jasalAI cAhanuhuncha usako prazaMsA garnuhuncha ra jasalAI cAhanuhuncha pavitra pArnuhuncha | kinabhane uhA~ hRdayakA bhedaharU jAnnuhuncha | unIharUkA karmaharUbATa ratti barAbara pani kamI garinechaina |
50 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! hernuhos! tinIharU kasarI Aphno prazaMsA garera allAhamAthi jhUTo Aropa lagAu~daichan | tinIharU pathabhraSTa hun bhanne kurA charlaGga huncha |

51 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! ke yahUdIharUko avasthAbAre tapAIMlAI thAhA bhaena ra Azcarya bhaena, allAhale tinIharUlAI jJAnako kehI aMza dinubhayo tara tinIharUle uhA~ bAheka anyalAI pUjya banAe ra bahudevavAdIharUbAre bhanna thAle– yinIharU muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) kA sAthIharU bhandA baDhI sIdhA mArgamA chan |
52 yI hun tI mAnisaharU jo yastA kisimakA galata dhAraNA rAkhchan | allAhale yastA mAnisaharUlAI dhikkArnu bhaeko cha ra usako sahayogI kohI huna sakdaina |
53 yinIharUkA lAgi sattA zAsanamA kunai aMza chaina | yadi kunai aMza bhaeko bhae yinIharUle kasailAI rattIbhara pani dine thienan |

54 muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) lAI nubuvvata prApta bhaekole ra uhA~kA sAthIharU (sahAbA rajiyallAhu anhuma) lAI ImAna tathA dhartImA sattA prApta bhaekole yI yahUdIharU DAhA garchan | yinIharU kina unIharUsa~ga DAhA garchan jabaki yasaaghi hAmIle ibrAhImakA santAnaharUlAI kitAba ra sattA-zAsana pradAna garekA thiyauM?!

55 yahUdI ra IsAImadhye kehI ibrAhIma (alaihissalAma) ra unakA santAnamA AekA nabIharUmAthi avatarita bhaekA kitAbaharUmAthi ImAna rAkhchan ra kehI ImAna rAkhdainan | muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) mAthi avatarita kurAnabAre pani unIharUko yahI vicAra cha | unIharUmadhye inkAra garneharUkA lAgi narka paryApta yAtanA ho |

56 nissandeha hAmrA AyataharUlAI inkAra garneharUlAI hAmI mahApralayako dina cA~Dai nai narkamA phyA~kinuhunechauM | narkako Agole tinIharUlAI gherAmA linecha; jaba-jaba tinIharUkA chAlA DaDhne chan taba-taba hAmIle tyasako ThAu~mA arko chAlA pradAna garnechauM, tAki yAtanA nirantara jArI rahos | nissandeha allAha ekadamai mahAna ra prabhutvazAlI hunuhuncha | uhA~ Aphno kArya saJcAlana tathA nirNaya garnamA tatvadarzI hunuhuncha |

57 allAhamAthi ImAna lyAekA, uhA~kA rasUlaharUko anusaraNa garekA ra AdezaharUko pAlanA garekA mAnisaharUlAI hAmIle mahApralayako dina tyasto svargamA praveza garAunechauM jasakA bhavanaharUko talatirabATa nadIharU kalakala bagirahekA hunechan | unIharU tyasamA sadhaiM basna pAunechan | unIharUkA lAgi pavitra zrImatIharU hunechan | unIharUlAI yastA phailiekA chAyA~mA praveza garAunechauM, jasamA na garmI hunecha na jADo |

58 allAhale timIharUlAI amAnata (nAso) harU tyasakA hakadAraharUlAI hastAntaraNa garna, mAnisaharUbIca nirNaya gardA nisAphakA sAtha nirNaya garna ani jyAdatI nagarna Adeza dinuhuncha | allAha hareka avasthAmA timIharUlAI kati rAmo upadeza dinuhuncha | allAha timIharUkA kurAharU sunnuhuncha tathA timIharUkA kAryaharU dekhnuhuncha |

59 he AsthAvAnaharU ho! allAhako AjJApAlana gara | allAhakA rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) ko Adezako pAlanA garera tathA varjita gareko kurAlAI tyAgera uhA~ko AjJApAlana gara | AphnA zAsakaharUko AjJApAlana tyatIkherasamma gara jabasamma unIharUle pApako Adeza diMdainan | jaba timIharUbIca vibheda huncha taba kurAna tathA nabI (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) ko sunnatako AdhAramA phaisalA gara, yadi timIharU allAha tathA Akhiratako dinamAthi ImAna rAkhchau bhane | kurAna tathA sunnatatarpha pharkinu vibheda garnu tathA Aphno galata vicAramA aDiga rahanu bhandA besa ho | pariNAmako dRSTile yahI rAmro ho |

60 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! ke tapAIMle yahUdI munAphikaharUko virodhAbhASako bAremA vicAra garnubhayo, jasale tapAIMmAthi avatarita kitAba tathA tapAIMbhandA aghikA sandeSTAharUmAthi avatarita kitAbamAthi ImAna lyAune jhUTA dAbI garchan, tara AphnA muddA mAmilAko nirNaya mAnisale banAeko kAnuna anusAra garAuna khojchan | yadyapi yasto kAnunalAI anusaraNa nagarna Adeza diieko cha | zaitAnale tinIharUlAI pathabhraSTa garna cAhancha |

61 jaba yI munAphikaharUlAI allAhale avataraNa garnubhaeko kitAba tathA rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) ko Adeza anusAra Aphno samasyA samAdhAna garna bhanincha, taba tinIharU tapAIMbATa pUrNarUpamA piThyU~ pharkAera arUtira nirNayako lAgi pharkanchan |

62 jaba munAphikaharUlAI unakA karmale gardA saGkaTaharU Aiparchan, taba he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! tinIharU tapAIM samakSa kSamA mAgdai tathA kasama khA~dai Au~chan ra bhanchan- arU samakSa muddA mAmilA liera jAnuko uddezya duI pakSaharUbIca mela milApa garAunu mAtra thiyo! yasa mAmilAmA tinIharU jhUTo bolchan | bhaktaharUko bhalAi ta islAmI kAnuna anusAra nirNaya garAunumA nai cha |

63 tinIharUle Aphno hRdayamA lukAekA chala ra narAmro manasAyalAI allAhale rAmrarI jAnnuhuncha | he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! tinIharUlAI choDidinuhos, protsAhita gardai tathA Dara dekhAu~dai allAhako Adeza spaSTa pArnuhos ra tinIharUkA manamA asara pArne kurAharU bhannuhos |

64 mAnisaharUle allAhako Adeza anusAra rasUlaharUko AjJApAlana garun bhanera hAmIle rasUlaharU paThAyauM | he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! jaba unIharU pApa garera AphUmAthi atyAcAra garchan ra tapAIMko jIvanamA Aphno pApalAI svIkAra gardai, taubA gardai tathA allAhasita kSamA mAgdai tapAIM samakSa Au~chan ani tapAIMle unIharUkA lAgi kSamA mAgnu huncha bhane allAhale tinIharUko taubAlAI svIkAra garnuhuncha |

65 yI munAphikaharUle ThAne jasto chaina | allAhale Aphno astitvako kasama khAera bhannubhayo– unIharUle jabasamma AphnA sampUrNa mAmilAharUko nirNaya rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) ko jIvanamA uhA~sa~ga ra uhA~ko mRtyupachi uhA~le dinubhaeko kAnuna anusAra garAu~dainan ra jabasamma uhA~le garnubhaeko nirNayabATa rAjIkhusI hu~dainan, ani jabasamma hRdayamA kunai kisimako saGkoca tathA zaGkA bA~kI rAkhchan ra jabasamma vAhya tathA Antarika duvai rUpamA AphUlAI pUrNarUpamA samarpaNa gardainan, tabasamma saccA momina huna sakdainan |

66–68 yadi hAmIle tinIharUmAthi eka arkAko hatyA tathA gharabATa niskanu anivArya gareko bhae tinIharUmadhye thoraile yasa hukumako pAlanA garne thie | tasartha tinIharUle allAhako prazaMsA garnuparcha ki uhA~le yo anivArya garnubhaena | yadi tinIharUle allAhakA Adezako pAlanA gareko bhae tinIharUkA lAgi rAmro hunethiyo | yasale gardA tinIharUko ImAna baliyo hunethiyo ra hAmIle tinIharUlAI ThUlo badalA dine thiyauM | tinIharUlAI allAhasamma tathA svargasamma pugne mArga dekhAune thiyauM |

66–68 yadi hAmIle tinIharUmAthi eka arkAko hatyA tathA gharabATa niskanu anivArya gareko bhae tinIharUmadhye thoraile yasa hukumako pAlanA garne thie | tasartha tinIharUle allAhako prazaMsA garnuparcha ki uhA~le yo anivArya garnubhaena | yadi tinIharUle allAhakA Adezako pAlanA gareko bhae tinIharUkA lAgi rAmro hunethiyo | yasale gardA tinIharUko ImAna baliyo hunethiyo ra hAmIle tinIharUlAI ThUlo badalA dine thiyauM | tinIharUlAI allAhasamma tathA svargasamma pugne mArga dekhAune thiyauM |

66–68 yadi hAmIle tinIharUmAthi eka arkAko hatyA tathA gharabATa niskanu anivArya gareko bhae tinIharUmadhye thoraile yasa hukumako pAlanA garne thie | tasartha tinIharUle allAhako prazaMsA garnuparcha ki uhA~le yo anivArya garnubhaena | yadi tinIharUle allAhakA Adezako pAlanA gareko bhae tinIharUkA lAgi rAmro hunethiyo | yasale gardA tinIharUko ImAna baliyo hunethiyo ra hAmIle tinIharUlAI ThUlo badalA dine thiyauM | tinIharUlAI allAhasamma tathA svargasamma pugne mArga dekhAune thiyauM |

69 allAha tathA rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) ko AjJApAlana garneharU tI mAnisaharUsa~ga hunechan jasamAthi allAhako kRpA bhayo | unIharU nabI, satyavAdI, zahIda ra satkarmIharUsa~ga svargamA praveza garnechan | svargamA unIharUkA kati rAmrA sAthIharU hunechan |
70 yo allAhako mahAnatA ho | allAha sabai bhaktaharUko avasthAsa~ga rAmrarI avagata hunuhuncha ra tyasai anusAra sabailAI badalA dinuhunecha |

71 he AsthAvAnaharU ho! zatruharUbATa sAvadhAna! tinIharUsita yuddhako lAgi hAta hatiyAra jammA gara | ki ta tinIharU viruddha samUha samUha garera niska vA sabai ekasAtha niska | timIharU tyahI gara jasamA timIharUko phAidA ra zatruharUko hAni huncha |

72 he muslimaharU ho! timIharUmadhye kehI yastA DarapokaharU chan, jo zatruharU viruddha yuddhako lAgi niskanamA pakkai Dhilo garnechan ra arUlAI pani Dhilo garAune chan | tinIharU munAphika tathA kamajora ImAna bhaekA mAnisaharU hun | timIharUmadhye kasaiko hatAhata bhaemA vA timIharUko hAra bhaemA khusI tathA santuSTa bhaera tinIharUmadhye eka janAle bhancha– allAhako kRpAle maile tyasa yuddhamA bhAga liina, natra jo saGkaTa unIharUlAI Ayo, tyo malAI pani Aune thiyo |

73 he muslimaharU ho! timIharUlAI jIta ra ganImatako dhanasampatti prApta bhaemA yuddhabATa pachADi pareko tyo vyaktile bhancha– maile pani tyasa yuddhamA bhAga lieko bhae unIharU jastai maile pani ganImatako dhanasampatti prApta garne thie~ |

74 saccA mominaharUle allAhako mArgamA yuddha garnuparcha tAki allAhako vANI ucca hos | yastA saccA mominaharU jasale sAMsArika jIvanamA cAso naliera Akhiratako jIvanamA cAso linchan‌, ani allAhako vANI ucca pArnako lAgi jasale pani yuddha garcha, ani zahIda huncha vA zatrulAI parAsta garcha vA vijayI huncha, allAhale tyasalAI mahAna pratiphala dinuhunecha | tyo pratiphala ho svarga tathA allAhako prasannatA |

75 he mominaharU ho! allAhako vANIlAI ucca pArna tathA kamajora ra pIDita puruSa, mahilA, bAla bAlikAharUlAI atyAcArabATa mukta garnako lAgi kina yuddha gardainau, unIharU allAhasita duA garchan– he hAmrA pAlanakartA! hAmIharUlAI makkAbATa nikAlnuhos, kinabhane yahA~kA bAsIharU zirka garera AphUmAthi atyAcAra garchan ra allAhakA bhaktaharUmAthi pani atyAcAra garchan | Aphno tarphabATa tyastA mAnisaharU paThAunuhos, jasale hAmro rakSA tathA maddata garun |

76 saccA mominaharU allAhako mArgamA yuddha garchan, kAphiraharU AphnA asatya upAsyaharUko mArgamA yuddha garchan | ataH zaitAnakA mitraharUviruddha yuddha gara, vijayI hunchau kinabhane zaitAnako calakhela kamajora huncha ra tinIharU allAhamAthi bharosA garneharUlAI hAni puryAuna sakdainan |

77 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! ke tapAIM AphnA kehI sAthIharUko mAmilAbAre avagata hunuhunna, jasale jihAda anivArya garine mAga gare | unIharUlAI javApha diiyo– jihAda nagara, salAha kAyama gara, jakAta dine gara | yo Adeza jihAda anivArya hunubhandA aghiko ho | jaba unIharUle madInA hijrata gare ra islAmako mArgamA bAdhA utpanna bhayo taba jihAda anivArya gariyo ra yo kehI mAnisaharUlAI bojha mahasusa bhayo | unIharU mAnisaharUsa~ga yasarI DarAuna thAle jasarI allAhasa~ga DarAunu parne thiyo, baru tyasabhandA pani baDhI | bhanna thAle– he hAmrA pAlanakartA! hAmImAthi tapAIMle jihAda kina anivArya garnubhayo? saMsArabATa thapa moja garne ajhai maukA dinubhaeko bhae rAmro hunthyo | he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! unIharUlAI bhanidinuhos- sAMsArika dhanasampatti jati bhae pani kama huncha ra eka dina samApta huncha | allAhasa~ga DarAuneharUkA lAgi paraloka nai rAmro cha, kinabhane tyasamA rahekA kRpA sadhaiM rahanecha | timIharUkA satkarmaharUmadhye rattI barAbara pani kamI garine chaina |

78 timIharU jahA~ rahe pani mRtyuko samaya bhaepachi tyo Aerai choDcha, yadyapi timIharU killAbhitra basa jo yuddha-raNabATa TADhA huncha | munAphikaharUlAI santAna tathA jIvIkAle khusI pArchan taba tinIharU bhanchan– yo allAhako tarphabATa prApta bhayo | jaba tinIharUlAI santAna tathA jIvikAmA kamI huncha taba tinIharU nabI (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) lAI azubha ThAnchan ra bhanchan– yo kamI tapAIMko kAraNale bhayo | he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! yinIharUko khaNDana gardai bhannuhos – garibI tathA sampannatA duvai allAhako cAhanA tathA bhAgyale huncha | yinIharU kina yasto kurA bhanchan, ke yinIharU tapAIMko kurA bujhirahekA chainan?!

79 he AdamakA santAna ho! timIharUlAI je jati santAna tathA jIvikA prApta huncha jasabATa timIharU khusI hunchau, tyo allAhako tarphabATa prApta huncha | yo timIharUmAthi allAhako kRpA ho | santAna tathA jIvikAmA timIharUlAI narAmro lAgne je kamI huncha, tyo timIharUle gareko pApako kAraNale huncha | he nabI (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! hAmIle tapAIMlAI sabai mAnisaharUkA lAgi sandeSTA banAera paThAekA chauM, tAki sRSTikartAko sandeza puryAunuhos | tapAIM janamAnasamA juna jJAna ra ekezvaravAdako jyoti pramANa sahita charnuhuncha tyasamA saccA hunuhuncha | gavAhIko lAgi allAha paryApta hunuhuncha |

80 jasale rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) kA AdezaharUko pAlanA garera tathA varjita kAryaharUlAI tyAgera uhA~ko AjJApAlana garcha, usale allAhako AdezalAI purA garcha | he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! yadi kohI tapAIMko AjJApAlanabATa vimukha huncha bhane tyasabATa nirAza nahunuhos, hAmIle tapAIMlAI unIharUmAthi nirIkSaka banAera paThAekA chainauM | unIharUkA kAryaharUko gantI tathA hisAba rAkhnu hAmro jimmAmA cha |

81 munAphikaharU Aphno jibrole bhanchan– hAmI tapAIMko Adezako AjJApAlana garchauM | tapAIMbATa pharkera gaepachi tinIharUmadhye euTA samudAyale rAtamA gopyarUpamA tyasako viparIta kArya garchan | tinIharUle je jati gare tI sabaibATa allAha avagata hunuhuncha | tinIharUko yasa calakhelako sajAya allAhale cA~Dai dinuhunecha | tapAIM tinIharUko cintA nalinuhos, tinIharUle tapAIMlAI kunai hAni puryAuna sakdainan | Aphno mAmilA allAhalAI hastAntaraNa garnuhos ra uhA~mAthi bharosA garnuhos | tapAIMko lAgi allAha paryApta hunuhancha |

82 kurAnamA kunai kisimako virodhAbhASa tathA truTi chaina | kina yinIharU kurAna paDhdainan ra tyasamA vicAra gardainan? yadi yo kitAba allAha bAheka anya kasaiko tarphabATa bhaeko bhae tinIharUle yasakA AdezaharUmA dherai truTiharU pAune thie ra yasakA arthaharUmA dherai virodhAbhASa pAune thie |

83 muslimaharUko zAnti vA Dara tathA cintAko kurAlAI munAphikaharUle jatAtatai phailAi dinchan | yadi tinIharUle yo mAmilA allAhakA rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama), buddhijIvI tathA AdhikArika vyaktiharU samakSa puryAekA bhae mAmilAko tahasamma pugneharUle kuna kurA phailAunu ThIka huncha ra kuna kurA gopya rAkhnu ThIka huncha bhanne kurA jAnne thie | he mominaharU ho! yadi timIharUmAthi islAma tathA kurAna pradAna garera allAhale kRpA evaM dayA nagarnubhaeko bhae kehI mominaharU bAheka timIharUmadhye adhikAMzale zaitAnako anusaraNa garne thiyau | allAhale timIharUlAI tyasa parIkSAbATa surakSita rAkhnu bhayo jasamA munAphikaharU homie |

84 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! allAhako vANI ucca pArnako lAgi yuddha garnuhos | tapAIMlAI arUko bAremA sodhine chaina | mominaharUlAI yuddhako lAgi protsAhita garnuhos | AzA cha, allAhale timIharUko yuddhale kAphiraharUko zaktilAI parAsta garnuhunecha | allAha sarvAdhika zaktizAlI tathA ekadamai kaDA sajAya dinuhunecha |

85 jasale arUko lAgi bhalAi khojcha, tyasako puNya usale pani pAunecha | jasale arUko lAgi kubhalo khojcha, tyasako pApa usale pani pAunecha | mAnisaharU je jati garchan tyasako bAremA allAha sAkSI hunuhuncha ra tyasako badalA cA~Dai dinuhunecha | timIharUmadhye jo kohI rAmro kAma kurAko mAdhyama bancha usako lAgi pani tyasamA puNyako bhAga milnecha ra jo kohI narAmro kAryako mAdhyama bancha, usako lAgi pani tyasamA pApako bhAga milnecha |

86 kasaile timIharUlAI salAma garcha bhane timIharUle tyasabhandA ajha rAmro tarikAle vA samAna zailImA salAmako javApha deU | rAmro tarikAle javApha denu besa ho | nissandeha allAhale sampUrNa karmaharUko surakSA garirahanubhaeko cha ra tyasako badalA cA~Dai nai dinuhunecha |

87 allAha bAheka kohI upAsya chaina | uhA~le timIharU sampUrNalAI; pahilo mAnisadekhi antima mAnisasamma sabailAI mahApralayako dina ekatrita garnuhunecha, jasako AgamanamA kunai sandeha nai chaina | uhA~le timIharUlAI timIharUkA karmaharUko badalA dinuhunecha | allAha bhandA baDhI satya kurA arU kasako hunasakcha ra?

88 he mominaharU ho! timIharUlAI ke bhaeko cha, munAphikaharUsita mAmilA garnebAre timIharU duImata chau? euTA jamAta tinIharUko kuphrale gardA tinIharU viruddha yuddhako pakSamA chau bhane arko jamAta tinIharUko ImAnale gardA yuddha nagarne pakSamA chau?! timIharUle yasabAre duImata hunu rAmro kurA hoina | tinIharUko kukarmale gardA allAhale kuphra tathA pathabhraSTa garnubhaeko cha | jasalAI allAhale mArgadarzana garnubhaena, tyasalAI timIharUle satmArga dekhAuna khojchau? jasalAI allAhale pathabhraSTa pArnubhaeko cha tyasalAI kunai pani tarikAle mArgadarzana garna saki~daina |

89 munAphikaharU ke cAhanchan bhane timIharU pani tinIharU jhaiM timIharUtarpha avatarita kurAharUko inkAra gara | tAki timIharU pani kuphramA tinIharU jhaiM bana | ataH tinIharUmadhye kasailAI tabasamma zatrutA apanAeko kAraNale ghaniSTa mitra nabanAU, jabasamma tinIharU kAphirako dezabATa palAyana garera allAhako mArgamA islAmI dezamA Au~dainan | yadi tinIharU vimukha hunchan ra tyasaimA kAyama rahanchan bhane tinIharUlAI jahA~ bheTchau tyahIM samAta ra hatyA gara | tinIharUmadhye kasailAI Aphno ghaniSTa-mitra tathA sahayogI nabanAU |

90 tara juna samudAyasa~ga timIharUko yuddha nagarne sandhi bhaeko cha vA jo timIharUsAmu yuddhabATa khinna bhaera na timIharU viruddha laDna cAhanchan na Aphno samudAya viruddha nai | allAhale cAheko bhae tinIharU timIharUmAthi hAvI bhaera timIharU viruddha yuddha garne thie | yadi tinIharU yuddha gardainan ani timIharUsa~ga samjhautA garna cAhanchan bhane timIharUkA lAgi tinIharUlAI hatyA garnu vA kaidI banAunu jAyaja chaina |

91 he mominaharU ho! timIharUle kehI yastA munAphikaharU bheTTAunechau jo timIharU samakSa ImAna jAhera garchan tAki timIharUbATa surakSita rahun ra AphnA samudAya kAphiraharUmA kuphra jAhera garchan tAki tinIharUbATa pani surakSita rahun | tara jaba tinIharUlAI allAhako inkAra tathA zirkatarpha bolAincha taba tyasamA bessarI lipta hunchan | yadi yastA vyaktiharUle timIharU viruddha yuddha garna choDdainan, sandhi gardainan ra hAta rokdainan bhane jahA~ bheTchau tinIharUlAI samAta ra hatyA gara | hAmIle yastA mAnisaharUlAI samAtna tathA hatyA garna tinIharUko dhokA tathA calakhelako kAraNale timIharUlAI spaSTa pramANa diekA chauM |

92 mominale kunai mominako hatyA garnuhu~daina | yadi kasaile bhulacukamA kunai mominako hatyA garyo bhane usale jarivAnA svarUpa euTA momina dAsalAI mukta garnu pardacha | ani tyasako parivAralAI blaDa manI tirnu pardacha | tara unIharUle mApha garchan bhane tyo tirnupardaina | yadi hatAhata bhaeko vyakti timro zatru samudAya madhyeko ra momina ho bhane eka janA momina dAsalAI mukta garnu pardacha ra artha-daNDa tirnu pardaina | yadi hatAhata bhaeko vyakti sandhi bhaeko samudAya madhyeko ra gaira muslima ho bhane eka usakA nAtedAraharUlAI artha-daNDa dinuparcha ra eka janA momina dAsalAI pani mukta garnuparcha | jasale mukta garna dAsa pAu~daina vA tyasalAI mukta garna dhanasampatti chaina, usale nirantara duI mahinAko vrata rAkhnu pardacha tAki allAhale usako taubA svIkAra garun | allAha AphnA bhaktaharUkA kAryaharU tathA nIyatasita avagata hunuhuncha ra kAnuna banAuna tathA tyasalAI saJcAlana garnamA tatvadarzI hunuhuncha |

93 jasale jAnibujhIkana binA kAraNa kunai mominako hatyA garcha, tyasako sajAya narka ho tyahA~ U sadAsarvadA rahanecha | yadi usale yasto kArya halAla ThAnera garyo ra yasto garepachi taubA garena bhane usamAthi allAhako prakopa tathA dhikkAra huncha | allAhale usako ThUlo pApako sajAya dinako lAgi kaThora yAtanA tayAra pArnubhaeko cha |

94 he AsthAvAnaharU ho! timIharU allAhako mArgamA jihAdako lAgi prasthAna gardA jA~cabujha garne gara ki timIharU kasako viruddhamA yuddha garna gairahekA chau | kasaile kunai yasto kArya garcha jasabATa usako islAma jAhera huncha bhane usalAI jhaTTa yo nabhana ki timI momina hoinau ra Aphno dhanasampatti tathA jyAna jogAunako lAgi muslima hune dAbI gardaichau | yadi timIharUle yo bhanera usako hatyA garchau ra usako dhanasampattilAI hatyAu~chau bhane allAhasa~ga dherai sampatti cha jo yasa dhanasampattibhandA uttama cha | pahile timIharU pani Aphno jAtibATa ImAnalAI gopya rAkhthyau | ani allAhale timIharUlAI islAma pradAna garera kRpA garnubhayo ani timIharUko ragata surakSita garnubhayo | ataH jA~cabujha garne gara | nizcaya nai, timIharUle garne kAma allAhabATa lukeko chaina ra uhA~le tyasako badalA dinuhunecha |

95 roga, apAGgatA ityAdi kunai kAraNabinA gharamai basneharU ra allAhako mArgamA jIudhanale jihAda garne mominaharU samAna huna sakdainan | allAhale binA kAraNa basirahaneharUmAthi Aphno jIudhanakAsAtha jihAda garneharUlAI eka darjA ucca pArnubhaeko cha | jihAda garne tathA roga, apAGgatA ityAdile gardA gharamA basirahane sabailAI allAhale rAmro puNyako vacana dinubhaeko cha | jihAda garneharUlAI basirahaneharUko tulanAmA ThUlo badalA dinuhunecha |
96 allAhakahA~ unIharUkA lAgi ucca darjAharU, ThUlAThUlA darabAraharU, pApaharUko kSamA tathA dayA chan | allAha ati kSamAzIla tathA parama dayAlu hunuhuncha |

97 nissandeha, jasale kAphira dezabATa hijrata garera islAmI dezamA nagaera AphUmAthi atyAcAra garchan tinIharUko AtmAlAI samAtera phariztAharU hapkAu~dai sodhnechan– timIharU kuna avasthAmA thiyau? timIharU tathA bahudevavAdIharUmA ke pharaka thiyo? unIharUle bhannechan– hAmI dhartImA kamajora ani vivaza thiyauM | hAmImA Aphno bacAva garne zakti thiena | phariztAharUle hapkAu~dai bhannechan– ke allAhako dhartI vizAla thiena? timIharU Aphno jyAna tathA dharmako rakSA garna ra beijjatIbATa jogina kunai pani ThAu~mA hijrata (palAyana) garna sakthyau | yahI tI mAnisaharU hun jasale hijrata (palAyana) garenan ataH tinIharUko vAsasthAna narka ho ra kati narAmro vAsasthAna ho narka!

98-99 yasa yAtanAbATa vivaza puruSa, mahilA tathA baccAharU surakSita rahanechan jasamA atyacArako sAmanA garne zakti chaina ra jo yasa atyAcArabATa niskane kunai sAdhana pAirahekA chainan | AzA cha allAhale unIharUlAI Aphno kRpAbATa kSamA garnuhunecha | nissandeha allAha AphnA bhaktaharUlAI dherai mApha garne tathA taubA garneharUlAI kSamA garne hunuhuncha |

98-99 yasa yAtanAbATa vivaza puruSa, mahilA tathA baccAharU surakSita rahanechan jasamA atyacArako sAmanA garne zakti chaina ra jo yasa atyAcArabATa niskane kunai sAdhana pAirahekA chainan | AzA cha allAhale unIharUlAI Aphno kRpAbATa kSamA garnuhunecha | nissandeha allAha AphnA bhaktaharUlAI dherai mApha garne tathA taubA garneharUlAI kSamA garne hunuhuncha |

sAdhanakA bAvajuda hijrata nagarneharUlAI Dara dekhAepachi nimna AyatamA hijratako lAgi protsAhita garieko chaH
100 jo sukai pani allAhako prasannatA prApta garnako lAgi kAphira deza tyAgera islAmI dezatarpha hijrata garcha, usale tyahA~ pharAkilo ThAu~, Tikne maukA tathA rAmro jIvIkA pAunecha | jo kohI AphnA gharabAra choDera allAha evaM uhA~kA rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) tarpha hijrata garnecha ra jA~dai gardA gantavyasamma pugnuaghi usako mRtyu huncha bhane usale avazya rUpamA allAhakahA~ badalA pAunecha | allAha taubA garne bhaktaharUprati ati kSamAzIla tathA parama dayAlu hunuhuncha |

101 jaba timIharU yAtrAmA niskanchau taba cAra rakAta bhaeko namAjalAI duI rakAta (kasra garera) paDhchau bhane yasamA kunai pApa chaina, yadi timIharUlAI zatrubATa khatarA huncha bhane | kAphiraharUko zatrutA spaSTa cha | saMkaTa, yuddha tathA zAnta avasthAmA pani yAtrA gardA kasra paDhnu sunnatabATa pramANita cha |

102 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! jaba tapAIM zatruharUviruddha yuddha garna maidAnamA hunuhuncha ani yoddhAharUsa~ga namAja paDhna cAhanuhuncha bhane yoddhAharUlAI duI jamAtamA bA~Dnuhos | euTA jamAtale tapAIMsa~ga namAja paDhos, namAjako avasthAmA unIharUle hatiyAra AphUsa~ga rAkhun | dosro jamAtale rakSA garos | pahilo jamAtale imAmasa~ga eka rakAta paDhos ani arko rakAta Aphaile purA garera zatrubATa surakSAko lAgi tayAra rahos | ani dosro jamAta jo zatrubATa surakSA dina pachADi ubhieko thiyo ra namAja paDheko thiena, imAmasa~ga eka rakAta paDhos | imAmale salAma pherepachi unIharUle chuTeko namAja purA garun | unIharU zatruharUdekhi sAvadhAna rahun ra hatiyAra bokera rAkhun | nissandeha kAphiraharU ke kAmanA garchan bhane timIharU Aphno hAta-hatiyAra tathA sara-sAmAnabATa asAvadhAna hoU ani tinIharUle timIharUle namAja paDhiraheko avasthAmA AkramaNa garun ani timIharU asAvadhAna raheko avasthAmA timIharUlAI samAtun | varSAko kAraNale kaSTa bhaemA vA virAmI bhaemA yadi timIharUle hatiyAra bokdainau bhane timIharUlAI kunai pApa lAgdaina | sakesamma AphnA zatruharUdekhi sAvadhAna raho | allAhale kAphiraharUkA lAgi apamAnajanaka yAtanA taiyAra pArera rAkhnubhaeko cha |

103 he mominaharU ho! namAja purA garepachi ubhieko, baseko, Dhalkieko hareka avasthAmA allAhako prazaMsA tathA pavitratAko varNana gara tathA lAilAha illallAha bhanera uhA~lAI smaraNa garne gara | jaba Dara samApta huncha ra timIharU nizcinta hunchau taba purA namAja paDhne gara | Adeza diiekA sabai anivArya tathA aicchika stambha tathA kArya purA gardai namAja kAyama gara | nissandeha mominaharUmAthi samayako pAlanAkA sAtha namAja anivArya garieko cha | gharamA baseko avasthAmA binA majaburI DhIlA garnu jAyaja chaina tara yAtrAmA jammA pani garna milcha ra kasra pani |

104 he mominaharU ho! kAphira zatruharUlAI lakheTnamA DhIlA nagara | yadi timIharU hatAhata tathA ghAite bhaera kaSTa bhogdaichau bhane tinIharU pani timIharU jhaiM kaSTa bhogdaichan | timIharUle je jati bhogdaichau tinIharU pani tyahI bhogdaichan | timIharUko dhairya bhandA mahAna tinIharUko dhairya huna sakdaina | nissandeha timIharU allAhasita jati pratidAna, maddata tathA sahayogako AzA rAkhdachau tinIharU tyasako AzA rAkhdainan | allAha AphnA bhaktaharUko avasthAbAre avagata hunuhuncha ra kArya saJcAlana tathA kAnuna banAunamA tatvadarzI hunuhuncha |

105 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! hAmIle tapAIMmAthi satyamA AdhArita kurAna avataraNa garekA chauM | tapAIM allAhale sikAe anusAra mAnisaharUkA sabai mAmilAharUko tapasIla bayAna garnuhos, na ki Aphno manale tathA vicArale | vizvAsaghAta garneharUko pakSadhara nabannuhos |
106 allAhasita kSamAyAcanA gara, uhA~ bhaktaharUmadhye taubA garneharUprati ati kSamAzIla evaM parama dayAlu hunuhuncha |
107 nAsomA hinAminA garne ra tyasa hinAminAlAI lukAune vyaktiko pakSamA vAda vivAda nagarnuhos | nissandeha allAhale nAsomA dherai hinaminA garne tathA pApa garneharUlAI mana parAunu hunna |

108 Dara tathA lAjale gardA pApa gardA mAnisaharUbATa lukAu~chan tara allAhabATa lukAu~dainan | yadyapi uhA~ tinIharUkA sabai kurAharU jAnnuhuncha | tinIharUle allAhako icchA viparIta parAmarza gareko kurA pani uhA~bATa gopya rahadaina, jastai pApIko pakSapAta garnu tathA nirdoSamAthi Aropa lagAunu | allAhale tinIharUle ekAntamA vA jamAtamA garekA sabai kAryalAI gherAmA linubhaeko cha | uhA~bATa kehI pani lukna sakdaina ra uhA~le tinIharUkA karmaharUko badalA cA~Dai nai dinuhunecha |

109 aparAdhIharUlAI mahatva dine tathA sajAyabATa bacAuna tinIharUko pakSamA ubhine timIharU hau! suna ta, mahApralayako dina allAha samakSa tinIharUko pakSamA ubhine ra vakAlata garne ko holA! yadyapi uhA~lAI sabai kurA rAmrarI thAhA cha?! tyasa dina kohI pani yasto garna saknechaina |

110 kasaile kunai duSkarma garcha vA pApa garera svayaMmAthi atyAcAra garcha ra tyasapachi Aphno pApalAI svIkArera tathA lajjita bhaera allAhasita kSamAyAcanA garcha bhane usale allAhalAI sadhaiM pApaharUlAI mApha garnevAlA tathA dayAlu pAunecha |

111 jasale sAno vA ThUlo jasto sukai pApa garcha tyasako sajAya usaile bhognuparcha arU kasaile bhognu pardaina | allAha AphnA bhaktaharUko karmaharUbATa avagata hunuhuncha ra kArya saJcAlana tathA kAnuna banAunamA tatvadarzI hunuhuncha |
112 jasale bhUla cUkamA vA jAnIjAnI kunai galtI garcha ani tyasako doSa kunai nirdoSamAthi lagAu~cha usale nizcaya nai euTA ThUlo jhUTa tathA prasTa pApako bojha uThAu~cha |

113 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! tapAIMmAthi allAhako varadAna evaM kRpA naraheko bhae euTA pathabhraSTa samUhale tapAIMlAI pathabhraSTa garne saGkalpa garisakeko thiyo | vAstavamA tinIharUle AphaiMlAI pathabhraSTa gardaichan | kinabhane tinIharUko tapAIMlAI pathabhraSTa garne prayAsa tinIharUtarpha nai pharkiyo | allAhako surakSA tapAIMko lAgi bhaekole tinIharUle tapAIMlAI katti pani hAni puryAuna sakdainan | allAhale tapAIMmAthi kurAna tathA sunnata avataraNa garnubhaeko cha | tapAIMlAI jJAna nabhaekA kurAharU sikAunu bhaeko cha | tapAIMlAI nubuvvata tathA surakSA pradAna garera allAhale ThUlo varadAna pradAna garnubhaeko cha |

114 mAnisaharUkA adhikAMza kAnekhusimA kunai bhalAi tathA phAidA hu~daina | a~, kasaile dAna garna, kAnuna tathA vivekale bhalo mAneko kArya garna vA duI pakSabIca mela milApa garAuna kAnekhusI garcha bhane rAmro ho | jasale allAhako prasannatAko lAgi yasto garcha, hAmIle usalAI ThUlo puNya pradAna garnechauM |

115 jo sIdhA mArga ra satyatA spaSTa bhaepachi pani rasUla salallAhu alaihi va sallama viruddha zatrutA apanAu~cha ra uhA~ko virodha garcha ani mominaharU bAheka arU kunai mArgako anusaraNa garcha, hAmIle tyasatAlAI mArgadarzana gardainauM | usalAI narkako AgomA phyA~knechauM jasako sajAya usale bhognecha | kati narAmro ThegAnA ho narka!

116 nissandeha allAhale zirkalAI kadApi mApha garnuhune chaina | baru bahudevavAdIlAI sadhaiMko lAgi narkamA phyA~knu hunecha | zirkabhandA sAno pApa cha bhane Aphno kRpAle mApha garnuhunecha | jasale allAhasa~ga kasailAI sAjhedAra banAyo U ekadamai pathabhraSTa bhayo | kinabhane usale sRSTikartA tathA sRSTilAI samAna banAyo |

117 tinIharUle allAhalAI choDI lAta, ujjA jastA mahilAharUkA nAma rahekA devIharUlAI pukArdachan, jo na ta lAbha puryAuna sakchan na hAni nai | yaso garera kevala tyasa vidrohI zaitAnako upAsanA garchan, jo allAhako AjJA pAlanabATa vimukha bhayo ra jasamA kunai bhalAi chaina | kinabhane tyasale nai devIharUko upAsanAko Adeza dieko thiyo |
118 yasai kAraNale allAhale zaitAnalAI dhikkArnu bhayo | zaitAnale ta allAhalAI cunauti dieko cha– ma tapAIMkA adhikAMza bhaktaharUlAI galata bATomA DoryAune chu |

119 ma tinIharUlAI pathabhraSTa garerai choDne chu, jhUTA vacanaharU diera ra pApalAI AkarSaka banAera mohajAlamA phasAune chu | maile avazya nai tinIharUlAI janAvaraharUkA kAna cheDne, halAla garieko janAvaralAI harAma garne ra allAhako saMracanA tathA prAkRtimA pherabadala garne Adeza dine chu | suna, jasale allAhalAI choDI zaitAnalAI mitra banAu~cha ra usako AjJA pAlana garcha, U kSatigrasta bhayo |
120 zaitAnale tinIharUsa~ga jhUTo vAcA garcha ra jhUTo AzAko jAlamA aljhAu~cha, vAstavamA tyasakA sabai vAcAharU jhUTA hunchan, jasako kunai vAstaviktA chaina |
121 zaitAnakA padacinhaharUko anusaraNa garneharUko ThegAnA narka ho | tinIharUsa~ga tyasabATa bhAgera zaraNa line kunai ThAu~ hunechaina |

zaitAnakA anuyAyIharUko pariNAma varNana garepachi rasUlaharUkA anuyAyIharUko pariNAmako varNana gari~daichaH
122 jo mAnisaharUle allAhamAthi ImAna lyAe ra satkarma gare unIharUlAI tyastA bagaiMcAharUmA praveza garAunechauM jasakA bhavanaharUko talatirabATa nadIharU kalakala bagirahekA hunechan; jahA~ unIharU sadAsarvadA rahanechan | yo allAhako pakkA vacana ho | allAhale Aphno vacana kahile bhaGga garnuhunna | allAhabhandA baDhI Aphno vacanabaddhatAmA kohI satya huna sakdaina |

123 he muslimaharU ho! mukti tathA saphalatA na timIharUko icchAmA nirbhara cha na yahUdI ra IsAIko kAmanAmA nai | yo ta karmamA nirbhara cha | timIharUmadhye jasale pani duSkarma garcha tyasako sajAya mahApralayako dina avazya pAunecha | allAhako viruddhamA kunai phAidA puryAune tathA hAnibATa jogAune kohI samarthaka pAune chaina |

124 puruSa hos vA nArI jasale pani allAhamAthi pakkA ImAna lyAu~cha ra ImAnakA sAtha satkarma garcha U svargamA praveza garcha | usakA karmaharUkA puNyamA khajUrako phalako bhitra gu~ThalImA bhaeko sAno khAlTo barAbara pani kamI garine chaina |

125 tyo vyaktibhandA rAmro kohI huna sakdaina jasale Antarika tathA vAhya duvai rUpale manasAyalAI zuddha pArdai, satkarma gardai tathA islAmI kAnunako pAlanA gardai allAha samakSa AphUlAI samarpita garyo | ibrAhImale lyAeko dharmako pani anusaraNa garyo; jo muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) le lyAunubhaeko dharmako AdhAra ho | zirka tathA kuphralAI tyAgera tauhIda (ekezvaravAda) tathA ImAnalAI aMgAlyo | ibrAhImalAI allAhale sabai mAnisaharUbATa prema tathA mitratAko lAgi chAnnubhayo |
126 AkAzaharU tathA dhartImA rahekA sabai kurAharUkA pAlanakartA allAha nai hunuhuncha | sampUrNa cijalAI allAhale Aphno jJAna, zakti tathA saJcAlana antargata linubhaeko cha |

127 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! tinIharUle tapAIMsa~ga mahilAko haka adhikAra tathA jimmevArIko bAremA sodhdachan | bhanidinuhos– allAhale AphaiM timIharUle sodheko kurA batAunuhunecha, jasako kurAnamA tilAvata huncha | timIharUko saMrakSaNamA rahekA tI anAtha mahilAharU, jasalAI timIharUle nirdhArita mahara vA paitRka sampattimA haka diekA chainau, tinIharUsa~ga svayama vivAha garna pani cAhadainau ra tinIharUko dhanasampattimA lobha garera arUsa~ga pani vivAha garna didainau | allAhale tI durbala bAla bAlikAharUlAI paitrika sampattimA unIharUko kati haka adhikAra dine ra unIharUkA dhanasampattimAthi kabjA jamAera unIharUmAthi atyAcAra nagarne Adeza dinuhuncha | tI anAthaharUsa~ga nisApha gara, tinIharUko loka ra paraloka duvailAI sudhArne prayAsa gara | timIharUle anAtha ityAdisa~ga je jati bhalAi garchau tyasalAI allAhale rAmrarI jAnnuhuncha ra tyasako badalA cA~Dai dinuhunecha |

128 yadi kunai patnIlAI unako patile narAmro vyavahAra garne tathA vAstA nagarne AzaGkA cha bhane duvaile kehI haka adhikAra tyAgera paraspara samjhautA garnu rAmro ho, jastai- zrImatIle nirvAha kharca tathA rAta bitAunamA kehI haka choDnu, kinabhane talAkabhandA samjhautA nai uttama huncha | lAlaca tathA kaJjusyAIM mAnisaharUko prakRtimA rAkhieko cha, tyasaile patnIle Aphno haka choDna cAhadainan | pati patnI duvaile eka arkAlAI sahane tathA upakAra garne bAnI basAlnu parcha | hareka mAmilA rAmro DhaMgale garnuparcha | allAhakA AdezaharUko pAlanA garera tathA varjita kArya tyAgera uhA~sita DarAunu parcha | timIharU je jati garchau tyasabATa uhA~ avagata hunuhuncha | uhA~bATa kehI pani lukeko chaina | uhA~le cA~Dai nai tyasako badalA dinuhunecha |

129 he zrImAnaharU ho! timIharUle cAhera pani AphnA zrImatIharUbIca hRdayako jhukAvako mAmilAmA pUrNa nyAya garna sakdainau | yo timIharUko cAhanAbhandA mAthiko kurA ho | mana naparAekI zrImatIbATa TADhA hunu ra usalAI bevAstA garnu rAmro hoina | yadi timIharU paraspara eka arkAko haka purA garera sudhAra garchau ra yasabAremA allAhasa~ga DarAu~chau bhane nizcaya nai uhA~ timIharUprati ati kSamAzIla evaM parama dayAlu hunuhuncha |

130 yadi pati–patnI ekaarkAbATa talAka vA khulaa (sambandha viccheda) garchan bhane allAhale tI duvailAI Aphno kRpAle Atmanirbhara tulyAunuhunecha | allAha kRpAvAna ra Aphno kArya saJcAlana tathA bhAgya banAunamA tatvadarzI hunuhuncha |

131 AkAzaharU, pRthvI tathA yI duvaibIca rahekA sabai vastukA pAlanakartA allAha mAtra hunuhuncha | timIharUle hAmrA AdezaharUko pAlanA garnechau ra hAmIle manAhI garekA kAryaharUbATa bacnechau bhanera yahUdI, IsAI ra timIharUsa~ga pani hAmIle vacana liekA thiyauM | yadi timIharUle tyasa vacanalAI inkAra garchau bhane timIharU AphaiMlAI hAni puryAunechau | timIharUle allAhako AjJApAlana gara vA nagara uhA~lAI kehI pharaka pardaina, uhA~ ekadamai sampanna hunuhuncha | AkAzaharU evaM pRthvImA rahekA sampUrNa cijakA pAlanakartA allAha nai hunuhuncha | uhA~ ekadamai sampanna hunuhuncha ra uhA~ AphnA sabai guNaharU tathA kAryaharUmA prazaMsanIya hunuhuncha |

132 AkAzaharU ra pRthvImA bhaekA sabai cIjaharU allAhakai hun | uhA~ nai AjJApAlanakA hakadAra hunuhuncha | saMrakSakako haisiyatale uhA~ nai paryApta hunuhuncha; jo sabai sRSTiharUkA mAmilA saJcAlana garirahanubhaeko cha |
133 he mAnava! yadi allAhale cAhanubhaemA timIharUlAI sakhApa pArera anya jAtilAI lyAunu hunecha, jasale AjJApAlana garnecha, avajJA garnechaina | allAha yasako sAmarthya rAkhnuhuncha |

134 he mAnavaharU! timIharUmadhye jo Aphno karmabATa yasa saMsArako mAtra bhalAi cAhancha, usale yo kurA jAnnuparcha, allAhako pAsamA loka evaM paraloka duvai bhalAi chan | timIharUle allAhasa~ga duvai bhalAi mAga | allAhale timIharUkA kurA sunnuhuncha ra timIharUkA kAryaharU dekhnuhuncha | uhA~le cA~Dai nai yasako badalA dinuhunecha |

135 he mominaharU ho! hareka avasthAmA nisApha kAyama garnevAlA ra harekako sAthamA hakako gavAhI dinevAlA bana, yadyapi tyo svayam timIharU, timrA AmA­bAbu vA nAtedAraharUkai viruddhamA kina najAos | garibI vA sampannatAlAI AdhAra banAera nata gavAhI deU, na gavAhI dine kAryalAI choDa | dhani houn vA nirdhana allAha nai duvaikA lAgi adhika hitaiSI hunuhuncha ra duvaikA hItasita avagata hunuhuncha | ataH timIharU gavAhI dine mAmilAmA AphnA icchAko anusaraNa nagara | yasa mAmilAmA nisApha kAyama gara | yadi timIharUle galata tarikAle gavAhI dinchau vA gavAhI dina choDchau bhane jAni rAkha jejati timIharUle gardachau tyasabATa allAha avagata hunuhuncha |

136 he ImAnavAlAharU ho! allAhamAthi, uhA~kA rasUlamAthi, uhA~le AphnA rasUla (muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) ) mAthi avataraNa garnubhaeko kurAnamAthi ra yasabhandA pUrva AphnA rasUlaharUmAthi avataraNa garnubhaekA kitAbaharUmAthi ImAna lyAU | jasale allAha, uhA~kA phariztAharU, kitAbaharU, rasUlaharU ra mahApralayako dinalAI inkAra garyo U sIdhA mArgabATa dherai TADhA pugyo |

137 nissandeha tI mAnisaharU jasale ImAna lyAepachi paTaka-paTaka kuphra (avajJA) gare, arthAta ImAna lyAe pheri inkAra gare ani pheri kuphramai jiddI garera lAgirahe ra tyasai avasthAmA tinIharUko mRtyu bhayo, allAhale tyastA mAnisaharUkA pApaharUlAI kahilyai mApha garnuhunechaina ra tinIharUlAI AphU samakSa pugne sIdhA satmArga pani dekhAunu hunechaina |
138 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! AphUlAI momina jAhira garne ra kuphralAI dilamA rAkhne munAphikaharUlAI mahApralayako dina duHkhadAyI yAtanAko zubhasUcanA dinuhos |

139 kinabhane yI munAphikaharUle mominaharUlAI choDera kAphiraharUlAI AphnA sahayogI banAe | Azcarya cha yastA mAnisaharUmAthi jasale kAphiraharUlAI mitra banAe! ke tinIharU yasarI kAphirabATa zakti ra surakSA prApta garna cAhanchan? vAstavamA sampUrNa zakti allAhako hAtamA cha |

140 he mominaharU ho! allAhale kurAnamA timIharUkA lAgi yo Adeza avataraNa garnubhaeko cha, jaba timIharU kunai sabhAmA allAhakA AyataharUko inkAra tathA majAka gareko sunchau taba timIharUmAthi tyahA~bATa uThera bAhira jAnu anivArya cha, natra timIharU pani allAhako avajJAmA tinIharU jhaiM sahabhAgI mAnine chau | a~, jaba tI majAka garneharU arkai kurAmA vyasta hunchan bhane taba tyahA~ basna sakchau | nissandeha allAhale AphUlAI muslima jAhera garne tathA kuphralAI manamA lukAune munAphikaharUlAI mahApralayako dina kAphiraharUsa~ga narkamA ekatrita garnuhunecha |

141 timIharUlAI bhalAi prApta huncha vA kaSTa pugcha bhanne kurA herna munAphikaharU pratIkSAmA rahanchan | yadi timIharUlAI allAhako tarphabATa sahayoga tathA ganImatako dhanasampatti prApta huncha bhane tinIharU ganImatako dhanasampatti linako lAgi bhanchan– ke hAmI timIharUsa~ga thienauM ra ke jahA~ timIharU upasthita bhayau, tyahIM hAmIharU pani upasthita bhaenauM? yadi kAphiraharUlAI vijayako kunai aMza prApta huncha bhane tinIharUle tI kAphiraharUlAI bhanchan– ke hAmIle timIharUko mAmilAko heracAha garera tathA timIharUlAI maddata garera mominaharUbATa bacAekA thienauM?! allAhale mahApralayakA dina timIharU sabaibIca phaisalA garnuhunecha ra mominaharUlAI svarga pradAna garera rAmro badalA dinuhunecha ra munAphikaharUlAI narkako tallo staramA hAlera sajAya dinuhunecha | allAhale mahApralayako dina Aphno kRpAle kAphiraharUkA lAgi mominaharU viruddha kunai pramANa dinuhune chaina, baru jabasamma mominaharU zarIata anusAra kArya garnechan ra ImAnamA saccA tathA pakkA rahanechan ra islAmI kAnunaanusAra karma garnechan, tabasamma allAhale unIharUlAI saphalatA pradAna garnuhunecha |

142 munAphikaharU AphUlAI momina jAhera garera ra manamA kuphra lukAera allAhalAI dhokA dinchan tara vAstavamA allAhale Aphno zAna anusAra tinIharU svayamalAI dhokAmA rAkhnuhuncha | kinabhane tinIharU kAphira hun bhanne jAndA jAndai pani tinIharUko ragatalAI surakSita rAkhnubhaeko cha, tara AkhiratamA tinIharUkA lAgi yasabhandA kaDA yAtanA taiyAra garnubhaeko cha | tinIharU namAjako lAgi ubhi~dA alchI gardai tathA nacAhikana ubhinchan | tinIharU allAhako lAgi niSkapTa bhaera namAja paDhadainan, baru mAnisaharUlAI dekhAuna namAja paDhachan | tinIharU mominaharUlAI dekheko belAmA mAtra allAhalAI yAda garchan, tyo pani dekhAunako lAgi thorai mAtra |

143 yI munAphikaharU dvividhAmA chan | vAhya tathA Antarika rUpamA nata mominaharUsa~ga chan nata kAphiraharUsa~ga | baru jAheramA mominaharUsa~ga chan bhane Antarika rUpamA kAphiraharUsa~ga | he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! allAhale jasalAI pathabhraSTa pArnuhuncha usalAI tapAIM mArgadarzana garna saknuhunna |

144 he allAhamAthi ImAna rAkhne ra uhA~ko rasUlako anusaraNa garneharU ho! timIharUle mominaharUlAI choDI allAhalAI inkAra garne kAphiraharUlAI AphnA ghaniSTa-mitra nabanAU | ke timIharU yasto kArya garera allAhalAI AphU yAtanAko hakadAra bhaeko spaSTa pramANa dina cAhanchau?!
145 nissandeha allAhale cA~Dai nai mahApralayako dina munAphikaharUlAI narkako sababhandA tallo khaNDamA phyA~knu hunecha ra tinIharUlAI yAtanAbATa jogAune kunai sahayogI tapAIMle pAunuhune chaina |

146 tara jasale niphAka (kapaTa) bATa taubA garera allAhatarpha pharke ra pUrNa rUpamA islAmamA praveza gare ra allAhako vacanalAI dRDhatApUrvaka samAte | yI guNaharU bhaekA mAnisaharU nai loka ra paralokamA mominaharUkA sAthamA hunechan | allAhale cA~Dai nai mominaharUlAI ThUlo puNya pradAna garnuhunecha |

147 yadi timIharU allAhakA varadAnaharUprati AbhArI hunchau ra vAhya tathA Antarika duvai rUpamA ImAna lyAu~chau bhane timIharUlAI yAtanA dine allAhalAI kunai rahara chaina | allAha ati dayAvAna tathA kRpAvAna hunuhuncha | uhA~ AphnA bhaktaharUkA karmaharUsita avagata hunuhuncha ra cA~Dai nai karma anusAra badalA dinuhunecha |

148 carko zabdamA narAmro kurA garnu ra apazabda bolnu allAhalAI mana pardaina | a~, piDitale pIDakako gunAso garnu, sarApa dinu tathA badalAmA apazabda bhannu jAyaja cha | tara piDitale pani apazabda bolnu bhandA sahanazIlatA apanAunu rAmro ho | allAha timIharUkA kurA sunnuhuncha ra timIharUkA manasAya jAnnuhuncha | ataH timIharU apazabda bolnabATa baca |

149 timIharU khullam khullA vA ekAntamA satkarma garchau vA atyAcArIlAI mApha garchau bhane allAha ati kSamAzIla evaM sarvazaktimAna hunuhuncha | mApha garne timIharUko bAnI hunuparcha, tAki allAhale timIharUlAI mApha garun |

150 jasale allAha tathA uhA~kA rasUlaharUlAI inkAra gardachan | allAha tathA uhA~kA rasUlaharUbIca vibheda garna cAhanchan | allAhamAthi ImAna rAkhchan tara rasUlaharUlAI inkAra garchan, ani bhandachan– hAmI kehI rasUlamAthi ImAna rAkhdachauM ra kehIlAI inkAra gardachauM | tinIharU ImAna tathA kuphrabIca euTA nayA~ bATo nikAlna khojIrahekA chan | jasale tinIharUlAI mokSa dincha bhanne ThAndachan |

151 vAstavamA tinIharU nai pakkA kAphira hun | kinabhane rasUlaharUmadhye euTAlAI inkAra garnu pani allAhalAI inkAra garnu ho | hAmIle kAphiraharUkA lAgi mahApralayako dina apamAnajanaka yAtanA tayAra pArekA chauM | kinabhane tinIharUle ghamaNDako kAraNale allAha tathA uhA~kA rasUlaharUlAI inkAra gare |

kAphiraharUko pariNAma varNana garepachi allAhale mominaharUko pariNAma varNana gardai bhannubhayoH
152 jasale allAhamAthi ImAna lyAe, uhA~ko upAsanA gare ra uhA~sa~ga kasailAI sAjhedAra banAenan, uhA~kA sabai rasUlaharUlAI saccA mAne, unIharUbIca vibheda garenan, unIharUlAI allAhale chiTTai nai unIharUkA ImAna tathA satkarmako mahAna badalA dinuhunecha | allAha taubA garne bhaktaharUprati ati kSamAzIla tathA parama dayAlu hunuhuncha |

153 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! yadi tapAIM saccA nabI ho bhane AkAzabATa ekai coTimA euTA kitAba avataraNa garidinuhos, jasarI sandeSTA mUsA (alaihissalAma) mAthi avataraNa garieko thiyo bhanera yahUdIharU mAga gardaichan | yasa mAgalAI ThUlo tathA acamma naThAnnuhos kinabhane tinIharUkA pUrvajale yobhandA ThUlo mAga sandeSTA mUsA (alaihissalAma) sa~ga garekA thie | tinIharUle hAmIlAI pratyakSa rUpamA allAhako darzana garAunuhos bhanera mAga garekA thie, ani tinIharUko yasa atyAcArale gardA tinIharUmAthi bajrapAta bhaeko thiyo | tyasapachi allAhale tinIharUlAI jIvita pArnubhayo | allAha nai hAmrA pAlanakartA ra pUjya hunuhuncha bhanne kurAko spaSTa nizAnIharU Aepachi tinIharUle bAcchAko pUjA garna thAle | hAmIle tinIharUlAI mApha garyauM ra sandeSTA mUsA (alaihissalAma) lAI unako samudAya viruddha spaSTa pramANa pradAna garyauM |

154 hAmIle tinIharUsa~ga pakkA vacanamA raheko kurAbATa DarAunako lAgi tUra pahADalAI tinIharUmAthi uThAyauM | tyasalAI uThAepachi hAmIle tinIharUlAI baitula-makdisako DhokAbhitra sajdA gardai tathA TAuko nihurAu~dai praveza garne Adeza diyauM | tara tinIharU tyasamA basera ghisradai praveza gare | hAmIle tinIharUlAI zanivArako niyamako ullaGghana nagarne Adeza diyauM | tara tinIharUle tyasa niyamako ullaGghana garera mAchA mAre tathA AphUmAthi jyAdatI gare | hAmIle tinIharUsa~ga dRDha vacana liyauM | tara tinIharUle vacanalAI bhaGga gare |

155 hAmIle tinIharUlAI Aphno kRpAbATa TADhA pAridiyauM | kinabhane tinIharUle vacanalAI bhaGga gare, allAhakA AyataharUlAI asvIkAra gare, nabIharUlAI anAhaka hatyA gare | he nabI (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama), tinIharUle hAmro hRdaya pardA bhitra banda bhaekole tapAIMko kurA bujhdainauM bhane | tinIharUle bhane jasto mAmilA chaina | vAstavamA kuphrale gardA allAhale tinIharUkA hRdayaharUmA mohara lagAi dinubhaeko cha | jasale gardA tinIharUsamma bhalAi pugdaina ra tinIharUle AMzika rUpamA ImAna lyAunechan, yasale tinIharUlAI phAidA dinechaina |
156 tyasaigarI tinIharUle kuphra gare tathA maryamamAthi vyabhicArako jhUTo Aropa lagAekole hAmIle tinIharUlAI kRpAbATa TADhA garyauM |

157 hAmIle tinIharUlAI yasa kAraNale dhikkAryauM ki tinIharUle ghamaNDa gardai tathA jhUTo boldai bhane– hAmIle nai allAhakA rasUla maryama putra IsA masIhako hatyA garekA hauM | jabaki tinIharUle nata unako hatyA gare na zUlI nai caDhAe | baru tinIharUle yasto vyaktilAI hatyA gare tathA zUli caDhAe jasalAI allAhale IsA (alaihissalAma) jasto banAunu bhaeko thiyo ani tinIharUle IsA (alaihissalAma) lAI hatyA garekA ThAne | IsA (alaihissalAma) ko hatyA bhaeko dAbI yahUdIharUle gare ra tyasamA vizvAsa IsAIharUle gare | tara duvai Azcaryacakita tathA zaGkAmA chan, vAstavika jAnakArI kasailAI chaina | yinIharU bhramako anusaraNa gardaichan | bhramale satyalAI kunai phAidA puryAuna sakdaina | tinIharUle nata IsA masIha (alaihissalAma) lAI hatyA gare, na zUlImA caDhAe |

158 baru allAhale unalAI tinIharUko calakhelabATa jogAunubhayo ra unalAI zarIra tathA AtmAsahita Aphnotarpha uThAunubhayo | allAha zAsanamA prabhutvazAlI hunuhuncha, kohI uhA~mAthi vijayI huna sakdaina | uhA~ Aphno kArya saJcAlana tathA kAnuna banAunamA tatvadarzI hunuhuncha |

159 jaba antima yugamA IsA (alaihissalAma) pRthvImA orline chan, taba unako mRtyuaghi sabai ahale-kitAbale unImAthi ImAna lyAunechan | mahApralayako dina IsA (alaihissalAma) le tinIharUko karmaharUko gavAhI dinechan; tinIharUkA kuna karma zarIata anukUla thie ra kuna karma zarIata viparIta |

160 yahUdIharUko atyAcArapUrNa vyavahArale gardA tinIharUkA lAgi vaidha rahekA pavitra cijaharUlAI hAmIle avaidha garidiyauM | hAmIle naGa bhaekA janAvara harAma garyauM | piThyU~mA raheko boso bAheka gAI tathA bAkhrAkA bosolAI pani harAma garyauM | kinabhane tinIharU AphUsameta arU mAnisaharUlAI allAhako mArgabATa rokne garthe, yahA~samma ki satkarmabATa roknu tinIharUko bAnI nai bhaisakeko thiyo |
161 tyasaigarI tinIharUle manAhI garepachi pani byAja line garthe, ani avaidha tarikAle mAnisaharUko sampatti khAne garthe | hAmIle kAphiraharUkA lAgi duHkhadAyI yAtanA tayAra garekA chauM |

yahUdI ra IsAIko udAharaNa varNanapachi mominaharUko udAharaNa varNana gari~daicha–
162 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! yahUdIharUmadhye gahiro jJAnarAkhneharU ra mominaharUle tapAIMmAthi avatarita kurAna ra tapAIM bhandAaghi avatarita gariekA kitAbaharU; jastai- taurAta tathA injIlalAI puSTi gardachan | tinIharUle salAha kAyama garchan ra Aphno dhanako jakAta dinchan | allAha nai hAmro pUjya hunuhuncha ra uhA~ko kohI sAjhedAra chaina bhanne kurAmA tathA mahApralayako dinamAthi vizvAsa gardachan | yI guNaharU bhaekA mAnisaharUlAI hAmI chiTTai nai ThUlo pratiphala dinechauM |

163 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! hAmIle tapAIMmAthi tyasarI nai vahI (prakAzanA) garyauM, jasarI hAmIle tapAIMbhandA aghikA sandeSTAharUmAthi vahI garekA thiyauM | yasarI tapAIM naulo sandeSTA hunuhunna | hAmIle nUha (alaihissalAma) ra unI pachi Aune sandeSTAharU; jastai- ibrAhIma, unakA duvaijanA chorAharU ismAIla ra ishAka, ani ishAkakA chorA yAkUba, tathA asbAta (alaihimussalAma) tarpha vahI garyauM | asbAta bhanekA banI isrAIlakA bAhra vaTA kabIlAmA AekA sandeSTAharU hun | yI kabIlA yAkUbakA bAraha janA chorAbATa banekA thie | hAmIle IsA, ayyUba, yUnusa, hArUna ra sulaimAna alaihimussalAma tarpha pani vahI garyauM | ani, dAUda (alaihissalAma) lAI hAmIle jabUra nAmI kitAba pradAna garyauM |

164 hAmIle paThAekA katipaya rasUlaharUko varNana kurAnamA garisakekA chauM ra katipaya rasUlaharUko varNana garekai chainauM | hAmIle kehI vivekale unIharUkA varNana garenauM | sandeSTA mUsA (alaihissalAma) sa~ga unalAI sammAna dinako lAgi allAhale pratyakSa rUpamA kurA garnubhayo ra nabI banAunubhayo |

165 yI rasUlaharUlAI hAmIle ImAna lyAekAharUkA lAgi zubha-sUcaka tathA kuphra garneharUkA lAgi sacetaka banAera paThAekA chauM | tAki rasUlaharU pazcAt mAnisaharUkA lAgi allAhalAI kehI bhanne ra bahAnA garne ThAu~ na rahos | allAha zAsana garnamA prabhutvazAlI evaM kArya saJcAlanamA tatvadarzI hunuhuncha |

166 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! yadi yahUdIharUle tapAIMlAI inkAra garchan bhane allAhale tapAIMko ra tapAIMmAthi avatarita kurAnako puSTi garnuhuncha | uhA~le Aphno jJAna anusAra tI kurAharU avataraNa garnubhayo, tAki bhaktaharUle janAkArI prApta garun | tapAIMle lyAunubhaeko kurAmAthi allAhakA sAtha-sAthai phariztAharU pani sAkSI chan, yadyapi allAhakai gavAhI paryApta cha |
167 nissandeha jo mAnisaharUle tapAIMko nubuvvatalAI asvIkAra gare ra mAnisaharUlAI allAhako mArgabATa roke tinIharU satyabATa dherai TADhA niskisakekA chan |

168 nissandeha jo mAnisaharUle allAha tathA uhA~kA rasUlaharUlAI asvIkAra gare tathA AphUlAI kuphramai rAkhera AphUmAthi anyAya gare; allAhale tinIharUlAI kuphramai jiddI garekole kadApi mApha garnuhune chaina ra na tinIharUlAI yAtanAbATa bacAune sIdhA mArga nai dekhAunu hunecha |
169 sivAya narkatarpha liera jAne bATo, jasamA tinIharU sadAsarvadA rahanechan ra yo allAhakA lAgi ekadamai sarala cha, alikati pani kaThina chaina |

170 he mAnava ho! timrA pAlanakartAko tarphabATa mArgadarzana tathA satya dharmakA sAtha rasUla muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) timIharU samakSa Aisaknu bhaeko cha | ataH timIharU uhA~mAthi ImAna lyAU | yo timIharUko loka ra paralokako lAgi uttama hunecha | yadi timIharUle allAhalAI inkAra garchau bhane jAnirAkha allAhalAI timIharUkA ImAnako AvazyakatA chaina | timIharUko inkArale uhA~lAI kunai pharaka parnevAlA chaina | AkAzaharU, dhartI tathA yI duvaibIca rahekA sabai kurAharUkA pAlanakartA allAha nai hunuhuncha | ko mArgadarzana pAune hakadAra cha bhanne kurAlAI allAhale jAnnuhuncha, ani usako lAgi uhA~le satmArgalAI sajilo pArnuhuncha ra jo tyasako hakadAra chaina usalAI andho banAunuhuncha | allAha AphnA bhanAi, kArya, kAnuna tathA bhAgya banAunamA tatvadarzI hunuhuncha |

171 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! injIla bokekA IsAIharUlAI bhannuhos- dharmako mAmilAmA sImA ullaGghana nagara | allAhako bAremA IsA (alaihissalAma) ko mAmilAmA nitAnta satya bAheka kehI nabhana | maryamakA putra IsA masIha (alaihissalAma) kevala allAhakA rasUla (sandeza vAhaka) hun, jasalAI uhA~le satyakA sAtha paThAunu bhayo | unalAI allAhale Aphno vANI (Adeza) dvArA sRSTi garnubhayo | jasalAI uhA~le jibrIlako mAdhyamabATa maryamatarpha paThAunubhayo | yo vANI ho- bhaihAla, ani unI bhaihAle | unI allAhako tarphabATa euTA phu~ka thie, jo allAhako AdezaanusAra jibrIlale phu~ke | ataH allAha evaM uhA~kA sabai rasUlaharUmAthi bhedabhAva na garikana ImAna lyAU | allAha tInavaTA chan nabhana; yasa jhUTo tathA nirAdhAra kurAlAI tyAga | timIharUkA lAgi loka ra paralokamA yahI rAmro hunecha | allAha nai eka mAtra pUjya hunuhuncha | uhA~ko nata kohI sAjhedAra cha, na kohI chorA cha | uhA~ susampanna hunuhuncha | jejati AkAzaharU, dhartI tathA yI duvai bIcamA chan‌; tI sabaikA pAlanakartA uhA~ mAtra hunuhuncha | AkAzaharU tathA dhartIkA vyavasthA calAuna allAha nai paryApta hunuhuncha |

172 maryama putra IsA AphU allAhakA eka bhakta hunumA kahilyai apamAna ThAndainan na yasabATa rokchan nai | nikaTavartI phariztAharUle pani AphU allAhakA bhakta hune kurAlAI apamAna ThAndainan | allAhale unIharUlAI najika garera Aphno bhakta banAunubhayo | ani timIharUle kasarI IsA (alaihissalAma) lAI Izvara banAyau?! bahudevavAdIharUle kuna AdhAramA phariztAharUlAI pUjya banAekA chan?! jasale allAhako bhaktilAI Aphno lAgi apamAna ThAncha ra AphUlAI tyasabATa ucca ThAncha, allAhale yastA sabailAI mahApralayako dina gherera AphUsAmu bhelA pArnuhunecha ra tinIharUkA karmaanusAra badalA dinuhunecha |

sabailAI jammA garne kurA bhanepachi allAhale mominaharUko badalAlAI chuTTai varNana gardai bhannubhaeko cha–
173 allAhamAthi ImAna lyAekA, rasUlaharUko puSTi garekA ra mAtra allAhako khusIko lAgi zarIata anusAra satkarma garekAharUlAI allAhale unIharUko kunai kaTauti nagarikana purA-purA puNya dinuhunecha | baru uhA~le Aphno kRpAbATa tyasamA thapera dinuhunecha | tara jasale AphUlAI allAhako bhakta huna apamAna ThAnekA ra ghamaNDa gardai AphUlAI tyasabATa ucca ThAnekA hunechan allAhale tinIharUlAI pIDAdAyaka yAtanA dinuhunecha | tinIharUle allAha bAheka kasailAI pani AphnA saMrakSaka mitra pAune chainan jasale tinIharUlAI yasa kaSTabATa jogAuna sakos, na kunai sahAyaka pAunechan jasale tinIharUlAI maddata garos |

174 he mAnava ho! timIharU samakSa timrA pAlanakartAko tarphabATa muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) ko rUpamA spaSTa pramANa Aisakeko cha, jasale timIharUko bahAnA tathA zaMkAlAI samApta pArdacha | hAmIle timIharUtarpha kurAnako rUpamA spaSTa prakAza avatarita garisakekA chauM |

175 jasale allAhamAthi ImAna lyAe ra AphnA sandeSTAmAthi avatarita kurAnalAI dRDhatAkA sAtha samAtirAkhe, allAhale tinIharUlAI svargamA praveza garAera Aphno dayA evaM kRpAmA samAveza garnuhunecha ra unIharUko puNya tathA darjAmA baDhottarI garnuhunecha | unIharUlAI sIdhA mArgamA hi~Dne tauphIka (maukA) pradAna garnuhunecha | adana nAmI svargasamma DoryAune mArga dekhAunu hunecha jasamA kunai TeDhopana hunechaina |

176 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! yinIharU tapAIMsita kalAlA (tyasto mRtaka jasako marne belAmA na buvA huncha na kunai santAna) ko paitRka sampattimA aMzako bAremA sodhdaichan | bhanidinuhos– allAhale timIharUlAI usako bAremA yo Adeza dinuhuncha- yadi kunai vyakti pitA tathA santAna nabhaeko avasthAmA marcha ra usako ekajanA sAkhkhai didIbahinI vA buvA paTTiko didI vA bahinI mAtra chin bhane usale choDeko sampattiko AdhA aMza anivArya rUpamA pAunechin | ekajanA sAkhkhai vA buvA paTTikA dAju vA bhAi mAtra chan bhane dAjubhAi bhaeko nAtAle tyo tyasako vArisa hunecha, yadi kohI sAhebe pharja (tokieko hakadAra) chaina bhane | yadi kohI sAhebe pharja cha bhane U bA~kI sampattiko vArisa hunecha | yadi mRtakakA vArisa duIvaTI vA tyo bhandA baDhI didIbahinI chan bhane unIharU usale chADeko sampattimA duI tihAI aMzakA hakadAra anivArya rUpamA hunechan | yadi kaiyauM sAkhkhai vA buvA paTTikA dAjubhAi tathA didIbahinIharU chan bhane unIharU buvA paTTibATa bhaekole yasa niyama anusAra aMza pAunechan (ekajanA puruSako aMza duI mahilAko aMza barAbara huncha) | unIharUmadhye puruSako aMza mahilAko bhandA duI guNA hunecha | allAhale timIharUkA lAgi spaSTa rUpamA kalAlA ityAdiko aMzabaNDAbAre islAmI kAnuna ullekha garnuhuncha, tAki timIharU tyasako mAmilAmA pathabhraSTa na hoU | allAhale hareka cijako jJAna rAkhnuhuncha, kunai kurA uhA~bATa lukeko chaina |

1 he ImAnavAlAharU ho! timIharUle AphnA sRSTikartA (allAha) sita ra anya mAnisaharUsa~ga garekA vAcA ra karArako pAlanA gara | allAhale timIharUmAthi kRpA gardai timIharUkA lAgi caupAyAharU (U~Ta, gAi, bheDAbAkhrA) vaidha garnubhaeko cha | sivAya tI janAvaraharU juna harAma bhaeko Adeza timIharU samakSa paDhera sunAinecha | sAthai haja tathA umrAko samayamA eharAmako avasthAmA thalamA rahekA janAvaraharUko zikAra pani allAhale harAma garnubhayo | nissandeha allAha Aphno viveka anusAra halAla tathA harAmako juna Adeza cAhanuhuncha dinuhuncha | na kohI uhA~lAI bAdhya tulyAuna sakcha na kohI virodha garna sakcha |

2 he ImAnavAlAharU ho! allAhakA pratIkaharUko anAdara nagara, jasako Adara garne Adeza allAhale dinubhaeko cha | eharAmako avasthAmA varjita gariekA kAryaharU; jastai- silAieko lugA nalagAU | haramamA varjita garieko kArya; jastai- zikAra garnabATa baca | harAma (pratiSThita) mahinA (jula-kAdaha, jula-hijjA, muharrama ra rajaba) harUmA yuddhalAI vaidha nagara | haramamA allAhako lAgi badha garna lyAiekA kurbAnIkA janAvaraharUlAI pani japhata ityAdi garera anAdara nagara, na haramasamma pugnamA bAdhA utpanna gara | yo kurbAnIko janAvara ho bhanne cinha svarUpa paTTI ityAdi bA~dhiekA janAvaraharUlAI pani anAdara nagara | pratiSThita ghara kAbAtarpha allAhako prasannatA ra jIvikAko khojImA niskaneharUlAI pani anAdara nagara | haja vA umrahako eharAma phukAlepachi ra haramabATa niskepachi timIharUle cAhemA zikAra gara | timIharUlAI pratiSThita ghara kAbAbATa rokne samudAyako zatrutAle atyAcAra tathA nisAphalAI choDna kadApi uttejita nagaros | he mominaharU ho! timIharUlAI juna kArya garne Adeza diieko cha tyasalAI garna ra juna kAryabATa manAhI garieko cha tyasalAI choDna ApasamA eka-arkAlAI sahayoga gara | pApa karma garna tathA mAnisaharUko ragata, dhanasampatti tathA ijjatamAthi atyAcArako kAryamA paraspara sahayoga nagara | allAhako Adezako pAlanA garera tathA uhA~ko avajJAbATa bacera uhA~sa~ga DarAU | nissandeha allAhale avajJAkArIharUlAI kaThora daNDa dinuhunecha, ataH uhA~ko prakopabATa sAvadhAna hoU!

3 allAhale harAma garnubhaeko cha- jabaha na garikana marekA janAvaraharU, bagAieko ragata, suMgurako mAsu, allAha bAhekako nAmamA jabaha gariekA, ghA~TI thicera mAriekA, coTapaTakale marekA, mAthibATa laDera marekA, siGa ityAdi lAgera marekA ra siMha, cituvA, bvA~so ityAdi jastA kunai jaMgalI janAvarale khAekA janAvaraharU tara juna janAvaraharUlAI timIharUle jIvita pAera jabaha (vadha) garyau tI halAla hun | vibhinna devI devatAharUkA nAmamA jabaha gariekA janAvaraharU pani harAma garieko cha | tyasaigarI adRSya vA thAhA nabhaeko kurAharUlAI bhAgya ciTThAko rUpamA DhuGgA vA tIra hAnera zubha-azubha nikAlna vA gara vA nagara lekheko kunai cIjadvArA bhAgya nirdhAraNa garna timIharUkA lAgi harAma garnubhaeko cha | ukta kAryaharU garnu allAhako avajJA ho | Aja kAphiraharUle islAmako zaktilAI dekhera timIharU yasa dharmabATa pharkanechau bhanne kurAdekhi nirAza bhaisakekA chan | ataH timIharU tinIharUsita naDarAU, mAtra masita DarAU | Aja maile timIharUko dharma islAmalAI timIharUkA nimti pUrNa gareko chu ra timIharUprati Aphno vAhya tathA Antarika duvai varadAna purA gareko chu ra timIharUkA lAgi dharma svarUpa islAmalAI rojeko chu | islAma bAheka timIharUko anya kunai pani dharma maile svIkAra garne chaina | jasale bhokale gardA vivaza bhaera pApa garne manasAya narAkhI mRta janAvarabATa khAncha ta usalAI kunai pApa hu~daina | nissandeha allAha ati kSamAzIla evaM parama dayAlu hunuhuncha |

harAma gariekA kurAharUko varNanapachi halAla kurAharUko varNana garieko cha | allAhale bhannubhaeko cha–
4 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! tapAIMkA sahAbA (sAthIharU) le sodhchan- unIharUkA nimti allAhale kuna vastu khAna vaidha garnubhaeko cha? he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) bhanidinuhos– allAhale timIharUkA lAgi svaccha ra pavitra kurAharU halAla garnubhaeko cha | tI janAvaraharU pani allAhale halAla garnubhaeko jasalAI kukura, cituvA jastA tikho dA~ta bhaekA zikArI janAvaraharUle zikAra garchan ra jasalAI AphnA paJjAbATa samAtne zikArI carA jastai cIlale zikAra garcha | yI zikArI janAvara tathA carAlAI timIharU tyasa jJAna tathA tarikAbATa sikAu~chau jo allAhale timIharUlAI sikAera timIharUmAthi kRpA garnubhaeko cha | yahA~samma ki jaba timIharU tI janAvara tathA carAlAI kunai Adeza dinchau taba tinIharU pAlanA garchan ra jaba tinIharUlAI hapkAu~chau taba tinIharU DarAu~chan | tinIharUle zikAra garekA janAvara tathA carAharU khAU, yadyapi tI zikAra gariekA janAvaraharUko zikArI janAvaradvArA hatyA bhaeko kina nahos | tara zikArI janAvara tathA carAlAI paThAu~dA bismillAha bhanera paThAU | allAhale dinubhaekA AdezaharUko pAlanA garera tathA varjita kAryaharUlAI tyAgera uhA~sa~ga DarAU | nissandeha allAhale cA~Dai nai timIharUkA karmaharUko hisAba linuhunecha |

5 Aja allAhale timIharUkA lAgi pavitra cijaharU halAla garnubhaeko cha | allAhale yahUdI ra IsAIharUle jabaha garekA janAvarako mAsu khAna halAla garnubhaeko cha ra timIharUle jabaha garekA janAvarako mAsu tinIharUkA lAgi halAla garieko cha | niSkalaGka svatantra AsthAvAna (momina) mahilAharU tathA yahUdI ra IsAI mahilAharUsa~ga pani vivAha allAhale halAla garnubhaeko cha | yasa sartamA ki timIharUle unIharUlAI mahara deU | azlIla kAryabATa baca, tinIharUlAI mitra banAera vyabhicAra nagara | bhaktaharUkA lAgi allAhale banAunubhaeko kAnuna tathA Adezako jasale pani inkAra garcha usale garekA satkarmaharU vyartha hunechan | kinabhane satkarma svIkArya hune sarta ImAna tinIharUmA chaina | tinIharU Akhiratako dina noksAna behorneharUmadhye hunechan ra sadhaiMko lAgi narkamA jAnechan |

6 he asthAvAnaharU ho! yadi timIharU namAja paDhna cAhanchau ra timIharU vujUmA chainau bhane vujU banAU | vajU banAune tarikA ke cha bhane anuhAra tathA hAta- kuhinAsamma dhoU ra TAukomAthi masaha gara (hAtale TAuko ghasa) ra AphnA khuTTA golIgA~Tho sameta dhoU | yadi timIharU apavitra avasthAmA chau bhane nuhAera pavitra hoU | yadi timIharU birAmI chau ra roga baDhane khatarA cha, vA svastha hu~dA yAtrAmA chau, vA timIharUmadhye kasaile disApisAba gareko cha, vA apavitra cha jastai- patnIsa~ga sahavAsa gareko cha, ani pAnI pAiraheko chaina bhane usale pavitra mATole tayammum garos | arthAta mATomAthi hatkelA rAkhI AphnA anuhAra tathA hAtamA dalos | allAhale timIharUlAI kunai kisimako apThyAromA pArna cAhanuhunna | pAnIle timIharUlAI hAni puryAeko avasthAmA, birAmI bhaeko avasthAmA vA pAnI upalabdha nabhaeko avasthAmA uhA~le tyasako saTTAmA arko vikalpa diera timIharUmAthi Aphno varadAna purA garnubhayo tAki timIharU kRtajJa bana kRtaghna nabana |

7 allAhale timIharUlAI islAmako mArgadarzana garnubhaeko varadAnalAI yAda gara | tyasaigarI uhA~le timIharUsita linubhaeko pakkA vacanalAI yAda gara, jaba timIharUle nabI (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) ko hareka avasthAmA AjJApAlana garne zapatha liekA thiyau ra bhanekA thiyau– hAmIle tapAIMko kurA sunyauM ra tapAIMko Adezako AjJApAlana garyauM | allAhako Adezako tathA vAcAko pAlanA garera tathA varjita kArya tyAgera uhA~sa~ga DarAU | nissandeha allAhale hRdayakA rahasyaharU pani jAnnuhuncha, kunai pani kurA uhA~bATa lukeko chaina |

8 he AsthAvAnaharU ho! allAhakA anivArya haka adhikAralAI dRDhatAkA sAtha adA garnevAlA ra tyasabATa uhA~ko prasannatA prApta garnevAlA bana, nyAyako sAkSI dinevAlA bana na ki atyAcArako | kunai samudAyako zatrutAle timIharUlAI yati uttejita nagaros ki timIharU nyAyalAI choDideU | mitra hos vA zatru sabaisita nisApha gara | nisApha garnu bhaneko allAhako Dara ho ra atyAcAra garnu bhaneko uhA~ viruddha A~Ta garnu ho | allAhako AdezaharUko pAlanA garera tathA varjita garnubhaekA kArharUlAI tyAgera uhA~sa~ga DarAU | timIharU je gardachau allAhale tyasako khabara rAkhnuhuncha | timIharUko kunai pani kArya uhA~bATa gopya chaina | uhA~le cA~Dai nai tyasako badalA dinuhunecha |

9 allAha tathA uhA~kA rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) mAthi ImAna rAkhne tathA satkarma garneharUkA pApaharUlAI mApha garnuhunecha ra ThUlo puNya arthAta svarga pradAna garnuhunecha bhanne kurAko allAhale vAcA garnubhaeko cha | uhA~ Aphno vAcAmA satya hunuhucha |

10 jo mAnisaharUle allAhalAI inkAra gare ra uhA~kA AyataharUlAI jhUTo Thahara gare tinIharU narkabAsI hun | tinIharU Aphno kuphra gareko tathA jhUTo Thahara gareko aparAdhako sajAya bhognako lAgi narkamA jAnechan | unIharU tyasamA sadAsarvadA rahanechan |

11 he mominaharU ho! timIharU Aphno hRdaya ra jibrobATa allAhako tyasa kRpAlAI yAda gara jo uhA~le timIharUlAI zAnti pradAna garera ra timIharUkA zatruharUko hRdayamA Dara hAlera garnubhayo | jaba tinIharUle timIharUmAthi hAta hAlna khojekA thie taba allAhale timIharUmAthi tinakA hAtaharUlAI roknubhayo ra timIharUlAI jogAunu bhayo | allAhakA AdezaharUko pAlanA garera tathA varjita kAryaharUlAI tyAgera uhA~sa~ga DarAU | momiharUle AphnA dhArmika tathA sAMsArika hItako lAgi allAhamA mAtra bharosA garnuparcha |

12 allAhale banI isrAIlakA santAnasita dRDha vacana linubhayo, jasako varNana arko AyatamA cA~Dai Aunecha | uhA~le tinIharUko mAjha 12 vaTA nAyaka tainAtha garnubhayo jasale mAtahatako heracAha garnechan | allAhale banI isrAIlalAI bhannubhayo- ma Aphno maddata tathA samarthanakA sAtha timIharUsa~ga chu yadi timIharUle pUrNarUpamA namAja kAyama garchau, dhanasampattibATa jakAta dinchau, binA bhedabhAva merA sabai rasUlaharUmAthi ImAna rAkhchau, unIharUlAI sammAna garchau, eka-arkAlAI sahayoga garchau ra bhalAiko kAmamA kharca garchau | yadi timIharUle yI kAryaharU garchau bhane maile timIharUle garekA sabai pApaharU mApha garnechu ra mahApralayako dina tyastA bagaiMcAharUmA praveza garAunechu jasakA bhavanakA talatirabATa nadIharU kalakala bagirahekA hunechan | yI vacana liepachi yadi kasaile allAhalAI inkAra garyo bhane mAnauM usale jAnIjAnI sIdhA mArga gumAyo |

13 yahUdI ra IsAIsita lieko vAcAlAI tinIharUle toDekAle hAmIle tinIharUlAI Aphno kRpAbATa TADhA pAryauM | hAmIle tinIharUkA hRdayalAI kaThora tathA kaDA pAridiyauM, jasasamma na bhalAi pugcha na upadezako asara parcha | tinIharUle zabdaharUlAI tinako sthAnabATa haTAera tathA tyasakA arthalAI manacAhI anartha lagAera pherabadala garchan | juna kurAko tinIharUlAI zikSA diieko thiyo tinakA kehI bhAgaanusAra karma garna choDidie | he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! tapAIM tinIharUle allAha tathA mominaharUsita gareko vizvAsaghAtako kunai na kunai khabara sunirahanu hunecha | tinIharUmadhye thoraile liieko vAcAlAI purA gare | ataH tinIharUlAI mApha garnuhos, pakaDa nagarnuhos ra tinIharUlAI najara andAja garnuhos | yo tapAIMko tarphabATa tinIharUmAthi upakAra hunecha | nizcaya nai allAha upakAra garneharUlAI mana parAunu huncha |
