14 yahUdIharU jastai hAmIle tI mAnisaharUsa~ga pani vacana liyauM, jasale cokho bandai AphU IsA (alaihissalAma) ko anusaraNakartA batAe, tara tinIharUlAI juna kurAko upadeza diieko thiyo tyasakA kehI aMzaharUlAI birsidie | yastai tinIharUkA pUrvaja yahUdIharUle pani garekA thie | hAmIle tinIharUbIca mahApralaya sammakA lAgi zatrutA tathA dherai ghRNA utpanna garidiyauM | ani tinIharUle paraspara kATamAra, hatyA hiMsA garna thAle ra eka arkAlAI kAphira bhanna thAle | tinIharUle garne garekA kAryaharUbAre allAhale cA~Dai nai sUcita garnuhunecha ra tyasako badalA dinuhunecha |

yahUdI ra IsAIsa~ga lieko vacana ra tinIharUko vacana bhaGga garne kAryako varNana garepachi tinIharUlAI muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) mAthi ImAna lyAune ahvAna gardai allAhale bhannubhayoH
15 he taurAta taurAta ra injIlalAI mAnnevAle pUrvagrantha vAhaka (yahUdI ra IsAI) harU ho! timIharU samakSa hAmrA rasUla muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) ko Agamana bhaisakeko cha | uhA~le timIharUlAI tI dherai kurAharU spaSTa pArnuhunecha jo timIharUtarpha avatarita kitAbabATa timIharU lukAu~dai AekA chau | timIharUko pola kholne dherai kurAharU uhA~le mApha ra najara andAja garnuhunecha | nizcaya nai timIharUkA lAgi allAhako tarphabATa kurAna nAmI kitAba Aisakeko cha, jo sabaiko lAgi mArgadarzaka ra prakAzamaya jyoti ho | yasamA loka ra paralokakA sampUrNa samasyAharUko samAdhAna batAieko cha |

16 allAhale yasa kitAbadvArA ImAna ra satkarmalAI mana parAune mAnisaharUlAI zAnti mArga dekhAunu hunecha, jasale unIharUlAI svargasamma puryAunecha | allAhale unIharUlAI Aphno marjIle kuphra tathA avajJAko a~dhyArAharUbATa nikAlera ImAna tathA AjJApAlanako prakAzasamma puryAunu hunecha ra islAmako sIdhA tathA saccA mArgako anusaraNa garne tauphIka (maukA) dinuhunecha |

17 nissandeha IsAIharUmadhye tI mAnasaharUle kuphra gare jasale bhane– maryamakA putra IsA masIha nai allAha hun | he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! bhanidinuhos– yadi allAhale maryama putra IsA masIha, unakI AmA maryama tathA dhartIkA sampUrNa cijalAI vinAza garna cAhemA kasale allAhalAI yasabATa rokne sAmarthya rAkhcha ta?! yadi kohI allAhalAI yaso garnabATa rokna sakdaina bhane yo yasa kurAko pramANa ho ki allAha bAheka kohI satya pUjya paramezvara chaina | maryamakA putra IsA masIha, unakI AmA maryama lagAyata sabai cIjaharU allAha kai sRSTi hun | AkAzaharU, pRthvI tathA yI duvaibIca rahekA sabai kurAharUkA pAlanakartA allAha nai hunuhuncha | je cAhanuhuncha sRSTi garnuhuncha ra IsA (alaihissalAma) lAI jasarI cAhanubhayo sRSTi garnubhayo | unI allAhakA bhakta tathA rasUla (sandeza vAhaka) hun | allAhale sampUrNa kAryako sAmarthya rAkhnuhuncha |

18 yahUdI ra IsAI duvaile dAbI gare– hAmI allAhakA putra tathA priya pAtra hauM | he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! tinIharUko dAbIko khaNDana gardai bhannuhos– tyaso bhae allAhale timIharUlAI timIharUle gareko pApaharUko sajAya kina dinuhuncha?! timIharU allAhako priya chau bhane allAhale kina timIharUmadhye kehIlAI hatyA garera tathA kehIlAI rUpa parivartana garera duniyA~mA sajAya dinubhayo ra AkhiratamA narkako sajAya kina dinuhunecha? allAhale jasalAI mAyA garnuhuncha usalAI ta sajAya dinuhunna | baru nizcaya nai timIharU pani anya mAnisa jastai manuSya hau | timIharUmadhye jasale rAmro karma garnecha usalAI rAmro badalA dinuhunecha ra jasale pApa garnecha usalAI narkamA hAlera sajAya dinuhunecha | allAhale jasalAI cAhanuhuncha Aphno kRpAle mApha garnuhunecha ra jasalAI cAhanuhuncha nisAphakA sAtha yAtanA dinuhunecha | AkAzaharU, pRthvI tathA duvaibIca jejati chan tI sabaikA pAlanakartA mAtra allAha hunuhuncha | sabaile pharkera uhA~tarpha nai jAnuparnercha |

19 he yahUdI ra IsAIharU ho! timIharU samakSa kehI antarAlapachi ra ati Avazyaka bhaeko samayamA hAmrA rasUla muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) Aisaknu bhaeko cha | aba timIharUle yo bhanna pAune chainau ki timIharU kahA~ pratiphalako zubhasUcanA dina tathA yAtanAbATa saceta garAuna kunai rasUla Aenan | nissandeha timIharU samakSa rAmro badalAko zubhasUcanA dina tathA sajAyabATa saceta garAuna muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) Aisaknu bhaeko cha | allAhale sampUrNa kAryako sAmarthya rAkhnuhuncha | kasaile pani uhA~lAI vivaza pArna sakdaina | uhA~le muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) lAI sampUrNa sandeza vAhakaharUko samApaka banAera paThAunubhayo |

20 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! yAda garnuhos, jaba sandeSTA mUsA (alaihissalAma) le AphnA samudAya banI isrAIlalAI bhane– he merA samudAya ho! allAhako kRpAlAI hRdayabATa smaraNa gara ra mukhale bhana jaba uhA~le timIharU mAjha sandeSTAharU banAera paThAunubhayo, jasale timIharUlAI mArgadarzana garekA thie | timIharUlAI zAsaka banAunubhayo ani timIharU Aphno nirNaya AphaiM garchau, jabaki tyasaaghi timIharU kasaiko mAtahata tathA dAsa banAiekA thiyau | allAhale timIharUlAI tI varadAnaharU dinubhayo, jo timIharUko yugamA arU kasailAI dinubhaena |

21 sandeSTA mUsA (alaihissalAma) le bhaneH he merA samudAyaharU ho! tyasa pavitra dhartI (baitula-makdisa tathA tyasako varipari) mA praveza gara, jasamA praveza garera timIharUle yuddha garchau bhanne vAcA allAhale garnubhaeko cha | tyasamA rahekA zaktizAlI mAnisaharUbATa parAjita nahoU, natra loka ra paraloka duvaimA ghATA khAnechau |

22 unakA samudAyaharUle bhaneH he mUsA! tyasa pavitra sthalamA dherai zaktizAlI mAnisaharU basdachan | jabasamma tinIharU tyahA~ chan tabasamma hAmI tyahA~ jAdainauM | kinabhane hAmImA tinIharU viruddha yuddha garne zakti chaina | ho, tinIharU tyahA~bATa niskepachi hAmI avazya praveza garnechauM |

23 sandeSTA mUsA (alaihissalAma) kA duI janA sAthIharU jo allAhasita DarAu~the ra allAhale tI duvai janAmAthi Aphno kRpA garnubhaeko thiyo | unIharUle Aphno samudAyalAI sandeSTA mUsA (alaihissalAma) ko AjJApAlanako lAgi prerita gardai bhane– timIharU yI zaktizAlI mAnisaharUko mukAbilAko lAgi DhokAbATa bhitra praveza gara | allAhako Adezale timIharU nai vijayI hunechau | allAhamAthi bharosA gara | timIharUko ImAna jati baliyo huncha, timIharU tyati nai allAhamAthi bharosA garnechau |

24 mUsA (alaihissalAma) ko samudAya banI isrAIlale Aphno nabIko virodhamA jiddI gardai bhaneH he mUsA! jabasamma yI zaktizAlI mAnisaharU tyasa nagaramA chan, tabasamma hAmI tyasamA pasdainauM | he mUsA! tapAIM ra tapAIMkA pAlanakartA duvai jAnuhos ra zaktizAlI mAnisaharU viruddha yuddha garnuhos | jahA~samma hAmro kurA cha, hAmI yahI~ basirahane chauM, yuddha garna jA~dainauM |

25 sandeSTA mUsA (alaihissalAma) le AphnA pAlanakartAlAI bhane– he merA pAlanakartA! mero adhikAra mAtra mamAthi ra Aphno bhAi hArUnamAthi calcha | tasartha hAmI ra avajJAkArIharU bIca phaisalA garidinuhos |

26 allAhale bhannubhayo– nissandeha allAhale banI isrAIlako lAgi yasa pavitra sthAnamA praveza garna cAlIsa varSako lAgi harAma garnubhayo | yasa avadhimA tinIharU marubhUmimA hairAna bhaera bhauMtArI hiMDnechan, tinIharUle sIdhA mArga pAune chainan | he mUsA (alaihissalAma)! yI avajJAkArIharUko sambandhamA pachuto namAna, kinabhane tinIharU je jati sajAya pAu~daichan tI Aphnai kAlA kartuta tathA pApaharUle gardA pAu~daichan |

27 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! yI DAhA garne atyAcArI yahUdIharUlAI AdamakA duI janA chorAharUko satya kathA sunAunuhos | tI duI hun- kAbIla ra hAbIla | jaba duvai janAle allAhako nikaTatA prApta garna kurbAnI (bali) pesa gare taba allAhale hAbIlale pesa gareko kurbAnI svIkAra garnubhayo, kinabhane unI Izabhaya vAlA thie | tara allAhale kAbIlako kurbAnI svIkAra garnubhaena, kinabhane usalAI allAhako Dara thiena | kAbIlalAI Aphno balI svIkAra nabhaeko kurA narAmro lAgyo ra hAbIlako mAmilAmA DAhA gardai bhanyo– he hAbIla! ma avazya nai timIlAI hatyA garnechu | hAbIlale bhane– allAhale tyasto vyaktiko kurbAnI mAtra svIkAra garnuhuncha,jo uhA~kA AdezaharUko pAlanA garera tathA varjita kAryaharUlAI lyAgera uhA~sa~ga DarAu~cha |

28 yadi timIle mero hatyA garne manasAyale hAta uThAu~chau bhane pani badalA linako lAgi ma timIle gareko jasto kArya gardina | maile Darapoka bhaera yasto bhaneko hoina baru ma sampUrNa jagatakA pAlanakartA allAhasita DarAu~chu |

29 unale kAbIlalAI Dara dekhAu~dai bhane- ma ke cAhanchu bhane timI AphnA purAnA pApaharUkA sAtha sAtha atyAcArapUrNa tarikAle malAI hatyA garera tyo pApa pani liera jAU | yasarI timI tI mAnisaharUmadhye bhaihAla jo mahApralayako dina narkamA jAnechan | atyAcArIharUko yahI sajAya ho | ma timIlAI hatyA garera narkabAsIharUmadhye huna cAhanna |
30 kAbIlako galata AtmAle usalAI Aphno bhAiko hatyA garna sundara tulyAyo ani usale unako hatyA garidiyo | ataH U loka ra paraloka duvaimA ghATA behornevAlA banyo |

31 bhAiko mRta zarIralAI cihAnamA hAlne tarikA sikAune uddezyale allAhale tyahA~ euTA kAga paThAunu bhayo jasale arko mRta kAgalAI daphana garna usako agADi jamina khanna thAlyo | tyatikhera bhAiko hatyArAle bhanyo– dhikkAra cha AphaiMlAI! ma mRta kAgalAI daphana garne kAga jasto pani banna sakina, tAki Aphno bhAiko zavalAI chopna saku~ | ani U lajjita huneharU madhyeko bhayo |

32 kAbIlale Aphno bhAilAI hatyA garekole hAmIle banI isarAIlalAI batAyauM, jasale kisAsa (hatyAko badalA hatyA), kuphra ra vidhvaMsa bAheka binA kAraNa kasaiko hatyA garcha, samjha usale sampUrNa mAnava samudAyakai hatyA garyo | kinabhane usale nirdoSa tathA pApImA pharaka garena | arkotarpha jasale binA kAraNa hatyA garnu harAma ho bhanne vizvAsa rAkhcha ra binA kAraNa kasaiko hatyA garena ta mAnauM usale sampUrNa mAnava samudAyalAI nai jIvana diyo | kinabhane usako kAryale sabailAI zAnti milyo | hAmrA rasUlaharU tinIharU samakSa spaSTa pramANa tathA AdezaharU liera Ae tara tyasapachi pani tinIharUmadhye dheraile duSkarma garera tathA rasUlaharUko virodha garera allAhako kAnunako ullaGghana gare |

33 jo mAnisaharU allAha tathA rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) viruddha yuddha garchan, hatyA, hiMsA, luTapATa tathA DaketI garera dhartImA AtaGka maccAu~chan; tinIharUlAI ki ta binA zUlI mRtyudaNDa vA zUlImA caDhAera mRtyudaNDa dinuparcha, ki ta tinIharUkA dAhine hAta tathA debre khuTTA kATnuparcha | pheri tyahI kArya garemA debre hAta tathA dAhine khuTTA kATnuparcha, ki ta tinIharUlAI deza nikAlA garnuparcha | tinIharUko lAgi duniyA~mA apamAna janaka yAtanA cha ra paralokamA pani kaThora yAtanA cha |

34 he zAsakaharU ho! timIharUsa~ga yuddha garneharUmadhye yadi kunai vyakti timro pakaDamA AunubhandA pahile taubA (kSamAyAcanA) garcha bhane yAda rAkha, allAha taubA garneharUprati ati kSamAzIla tathA parama dayAlu hunuhuncha | tinIharUprati allAhako dayAle tinIharUko sajAya mApha garieko cha |

35 he mominaharU ho! allAhakA AdezaharUko pAlanA garera tathA varjita kAryaharUlAI tyAgera uhA~sa~ga DarAU ani uhA~sita najika hune prayAsa gara | allAhako prasannatA prApta garnako lAgi uhA~ko mArgamA kAphiraharU viruddha yuddha gara | zAyada, timIharUko manokAmanA purA hunecha ra Dara-trAsabATa joginechau |

36 allAha tathA uhA~kA rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) lAI inkAra garne (kAphira) harUsita yadi sampUrNa dhartImA bhae barAbarako dhanasampatti hos ra tyati nai thapa dhanasampatti tinIharUsa~ga ajhai hos, aba yI sampUrNa dhanasampatti diera pani tinIharUle mahApralayako dinako yAtanAbATa bacna cAhemA tinIharUko tyo harjAnA svIkAra garine chaina | tinIharUkA lAgi duHkhadAyI yAtanA raheko cha |
37 tinIharU narkako AgobATa umkana khojnechan tara tyasabATa umkana kahA~ sambhava holA ra? kahilyai pani niskana saknechainan | tinIharUkA lAgi sadAsarvadAko yAtanA hunecha |

vAhyarUpamA arUko dhanasampatti luTne DAkAko sajAya batAepachi allAhale gopya rUpamA dhanasampatti corne corako sajAya yasarI bayAna garnubhaeko chaH
38 he zAsakaharU ho! cora, puruSa hos vA nArI duvaikA dAhine hAta kATideU | yo tI duvaiko corI garne kAryako badalA ho ra allAhako tarphabATa pATha sikAune daNDa ho, sAthai tI duvaiko lAgi ra anya mAnisaharUkA lAgi pani pATha ho | allAha zaktizAlI hunuhuncha, kohI uhA~mAthi vijayI huna sakdaina, bhAgya nirdhAraNa tathA kAnuna banAunamA tatvadarzI hunuhuncha |

39 jasale corIbATa taubA garyo ra Aphno karmalAI sudhAra garyo, tyasto vyaktimAthi allAhale dayA garnuhuncha ra usako taubAlAI svIkAra gardai usakA pApaharUlAI kSamA garnuhuncha | muddA mAmilA prazAsanasamma pugepachi taubAle gardA sajAya Tardaina |

40 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! tapAIMlAI thAhai cha, AkAzaharU evaM dhartIkA pAlanakartA allAha mAtra hunuhuncha, uhA~ jasarI cAhanuhuncha rAjya zAsana calAunuhuncha | jasalAI cAhanuhuncha nisAphako AdhAramA yAtanA dinuhuncha ra jasalAI cAhanuhuncha dayA garera mApha garnuhuncha | nissandeha allAha sabai kAryako sAmarthya rAkhnuhuncha | uhA~lAI kasaile pani vivaza pArna sakdaina |

41 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! tI mAnisaharUkA vyavahArabATa tapAIM dukhI nahunuhos, jo kuphrakA kAryamA sakriya chan | munAphikaharU ImAna jAhera garera tathA kuphralAI lukAera tapAIMlAI risa uThos bhanne cAhanchan | yahUdIharUko vyavahArabATa pani tapAIM cintita nahunuhos, jasale AphnA ThUlA baDAkA jhUTo kurA sunchan ra tyasalAI svIkAra garchan | yinIharU AphnA netAharUko anusaraNa garchan, juna netAharU tapAIMbATa piThyU~ pharkAeko kAraNale tapAIM samakSa Aenan | tinIharU taurAtamA rahekA allAhakA vANIharUmA Aphno icchA anusAra pherabadala garchan | tinIharU AphnA anuyAyIharUlAI bhanchan– yadi muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) ko Adeza timIharUko icchAanusAra huncha bhane tyasako anusaraNa gara | yadi icchAanusAra hu~daina bhane tyasalAI choDi deU | he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! jasalAI allAhale nai pathabhraSTa garnubhayo usalAI tapAIM mArgadarzana garna saknuhunna | yahUdI tathA munAphikaharUmadhye yI guNaharU bhaekA mAnisaharUkA hRdayalAI allAhale kuphrabATa pavitra pArna cAhanuhunna | tinIharUkA lAgi yasa duniyA~mA apamAna tathA beijjati cha ra paralokamA kaThora yAtanA arthAta narka cha |

42 yI yahUdIharU jhUTA kurA dherai sunchan ra byAja ityAdi harAma dhanasampatti dherai khAnchan | he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! yadi yinIharU tapAIMkahA~ phaisalAko lAgi Au~chan bhane cAhe yinIharUbIca phaisalA garnuhos cAhe nagarnuhos tapAIMlAI akhtiyAra cha | yadi tapAIMle tinIharUko phaisalA garnuhunna bhane tinIharUle tapAIMko kehI bigArna sakdainan | yadi tinIharUbIca phaisalA garnuhuncha bhane nyAyakA sAtha phaisalA garnuhos, yadyapi tinIharU atyAcArI houn vA zatru houn | nizcaya nai allAha phaisalA gardA nisApha garneharUlAI mana parAunuhuncha yadyapi nirNaya garAuneharU nyAyadhIzakA zatru nai kina nahoun |

43 yahUdIharUko mAmilA pani acammako cha | tinInIharU tapAIMlAI allAhako rasUla svIkara gardainan taipani tapAIMle unIharUko cAhanA anusAra phaisalA garnuhunecha bhanne ThAnera tapAIMlAI nirNAyaka banAu~chan | jabaki tinIharUsa~ga taurAta cha, tinIharU tyasamA ImAna rAkhchan bhanne kurA ThAnekA chan | tyasamA allAhakA AdezaharU chan | jaba tapAIMle garnubhaeko phaisalA tinIharUko icchA anusAra hu~daina, taba tinIharU tapAIMko nirNayabATa vimukha hunchan | tinIharU yasarI AphnA kitAbamA rahekA kurAharUlAI inkAra garchan ra tapAIMko nirNayabATa vimukha pani hunchan | tinIharUkA kartutaharU momina jasto chaina, tyasaile tinIharU na ta tapAIMmAthi ImAna rAkhchan na tapAIMle lyAunu bhaeko kitAbamAthi |

44 nissandeha hAmIle sandeSTA mUsA (alaihissalAma) mAthi taurAta avataraNa garekA thiyauM jasamA mArgadarzana tathA bhalAiko kAryatarpha nirdezana evaM prakAzamaya jyoti thiyo | AphUlAI allAhaprati samarpita garekA banI isrAilakA sabai sandeSTAharUle tyasaianusAra phaisalA garthe, ani dharmaguruharU tathA phukahA (zAstrIharU) pani tyasaianusAra nirNaya garne garthe | kinabhane allAhale tinIharUlAI Aphno kitAbako saMrakSaka tathA amAnatadAra banAunubhaeko thiyo, jo yasa kitAbalAI pherabadalabATa surakSA garne garthe | unIharU yo kitAba satya ho bhanne kurAko sAkSI thie | mAnisaharU Aphno mAmilA yasai kitAbalAI AdhAra mAnne garthe | he yahUdIharU ho! timIharU mAnisaharUsita naDarAU kevala masita DarAU | pada, kursI, sammAna tathA dhanasampatti jastA tuccha mUlyamA allAhale avataraNa garnubhaeko Adeza tathA AyataharUlAI nabeca | jasale allAhadvArA avatarita kAnunalAI kAryAnvayana nagarna vA yasamAthi arU kasaile banAeko kAnunalAI prAthamikatA dina vA yasako barAbaramA rAkhna jAyaja cha bhanchan ra tyasaanusAra nirNaya gardainan, tinIharU nai pakkA kAphira hun |

45 hAmIle taurAtamA yahUdIharUkA lAgi anivArya garekA thiyauM, jasale kasailAI anAsatya jAnIjAnI hatyA garcha, usalAI pani hatyA garinecha, jasale kasaiko A~khA jAnIjAnI phuTAlcha, usako A~khA pani phuTAlinecha, jasale kasaiko nAka jAnIjAnI kATcha usako nAka pani kATinecha, jasale kasaiko kAna jAnIjAnI kATcha usako pani kAna kATinecha, jasale kasaiko dA~ta jAnIjAnI bhA~ccha usako dA~ta pani bhA~cinecha | hAmIle unIharUmAthi yo pani anivArya garyauM, ghAite tulyAune doSIlAI usako doSa barAbara sajAya diinecha | tara juna pIDitale tyasalAI mApha garidincha tyo tyasa pIDitako pApako prAyazcita hunecha | jasale allAhadvArA avatarita niyama ra kAnuna anusAra nirNaya gardainan tinIharU nai allAhakA sImAko ullaGghanakArI hun |

46 hAmIle tI sandeSTAharUpachi maryama putra IsA (alaihissalAma) lAI paThAyauM, unI taurAtamA ImAna rAkhdathe ra tyasaianusAra nirNaya garthe | hAmIle unalAI injIla pradAna garyauM jasamA satyatarpha mArgadarzana, zaGkAlAI nivAraNa garne pramANa tathA samasyAharUko samAdhAna garne AdezaharU thie | yasakA adhikAMza AdezaharU taurAta jastai thie, sivAya thorai AdezaharU, jasamA pherabadala gariekA thie | hAmIle injIlalAI mArgadarzana banAyauM jasabATa Izabhaya rAkhneharU sIdhA mArga prApta garthe | yo kitAba harAma kArya garnabATa saceta garnevAlA thiyo |

47 hAmIle injIlamA avataraNa garekA AdezaharUmA IsAIharUle ImAna rAkhun | muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) ko Agamana bhandA pahilA tyasamA juna ThIka AdezaharU thie tyasai anusAra tinIharUle AphnA mAmilAko phaisalA garun | jasale allAhale avataraNa gareko kAnuna anusAra nirNaya gardainan tinIharU nai allAhakA AdezalAI vAstA nagarekA, satyalAI tyAgekA tathA asatyatarpha jhukekA mAnisaharU hun |

taurAta tathA injIlako varNana tathA prazaMsApachi allAhale kurAnako varNana tathA prazaMsA gardai bhannubhaeko chaH
48 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! hAmIle tapAIMmAthi satyakAsAtha kurAna avataraNa garyauM | yo allAhako tarphabATa avatarita kitAba ho yasamA kunai zaGkA chaina | yasale pahile avatarita bhaekA kitAbaharUlAI puSTi gardacha ra yo tI kitAbaharUko saMrakSaka pani ho | tI kitAbaharUmA je jati kurAna anusAra chan tI sabai satya huna ra je jati yasa anusAra chainan tI sabai asatya hun | ataH allAhale kurAnamA avataraNa garnubhaeko niyama anusAra mAnisaharUbIca nirNaya garnuhos | tI mAnisaharUko anusaraNa nagarnuhos, jasale tapAIMmAthi avatarita AdezaharUlAI choDera AphnA icchAko anusaraNa garchan | hAmIle sampUrNa samudAyakA lAgi AdezaharUmA AdhArita euTA dharma-vidhAna evaM kAryapraNAlI taya garekA chauM | yadi allAhale cAheko bhae timIharU sabailAI euTai zarIata (islAmI kAnuna) mA jammA garnuhunthyo | tara allAhale parIkSA lina ra avajJAkArIbATa AjJAkArIlAI khulAune uddezyale hareka samudAyako lAgi chuTTA chuTTai zarIata banAunu bhayo | ataH satkarma garnamA tathA duSkarmalAI tyAgnamA eka arkA bhandA agADi baDhne prayAsa gara | antataH mahApralayako dina timIharU sabai allAhatarpha nai pharkera jAnechau ani uhA~le timIharUlAI timIharUle matabheda garne kurAharUbAre batAunuhunecha ra timIharUkA karmaharUkA badalA dinuhunecha |

49 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! yinIharUbIca tyasa kAnunaanusAra phaisalA garnuhos juna allAhale tapAIMmAthi avataraNa garnubhaeko cha | narAmro kurAko anusaraNa garneharUkA narAmrA vicAraharUko anusaraNa nagarnuhos | tinIharUbATa sAvadhAna rahanu holA! tinIharUle calakhela garera tapAIMlAI pathabhraSTa napArun | yasako lAgi tinIharUle kosisa garnamA kunai kamI garne chainan | yadi tinIharU allAhale avataraNa garnubhaeko AdezabATa vimukha hunchan bhane jAnI rAkhnus allAhale nai tinIharUlAI tinakA kehI pApaharUko sAMsArika sajAya dina cAhanuhuncha | AkhiratamA tinIharUle garekA sabai kAryaharUko pUrai sajAya dinuhunecha | nissandeha adhikAMza mAnisaharU allAhakA AjJAbATa vimukha chan |

50 ke yinIharU tapAIMko phaisalAbATa vimukha bhaera islAma pUrvakA mUrti pUjakaharUbATa phaisalA garAuna manamAnI garchan?! AsthAvAnaharUkA nimti allAha bhandA sarvotkRSTa nyAyAdhIza arU kohI chaina | unIharU allAhako tarphabATa nabI (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) mAthi avatarita kurAlAI bujhchan | murkha ra manamAnI garneharU AphnA icchA anukUla kurAlAI mAtra svIkAra garchan, cAhe tyo galata nai kina nahos |

51 he mominaharU ho! yahUdI ra IsAIharUlAI Aphno ghaniSTa tathA mitra nabanAU | kinabhane yahUdIharU yahUdIharUkA ra IsAIharU IsAIharUkA ghaniSTa-mitra hun | yI duvai timIharUko zatrutAmA ekamata chan | timIharUmadhye jasale tinIharUlAI Aphno mitra banAu~cha U tinIharUmai ganine cha | nissandeha allAhale atyAcArIharUlAI satmArga dekhAunu hunna, kinabhane tinIharUle kAphiraharUlAI ghaniSTa mitra banAe |

52 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! munAphika tathA kamajora ImAna bhaekA muslimaharUle yahUdI ra IsAIharUsita mitratA gA~sna hatAra gardai gareko tapAIM dekhnuhuncha | yinIharU hAmIharUmAthi vijaya hunchan, rAjyako bAgaDora ra sattA kabjAmA liepachi hAmIharU katai kunai saGkaTamA phasnechauM ki bhanne Dara lAgcha bhanchan | allAhale cAhanubhayo bhane AphnA rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) tathA mominaharUlAI vijaya pradAna garnuhuncha yA allAhale yahUdI tathA tinIharUsa~ga mitratA garneharUko pola kholnuhuncha ani yahUdIharUsa~ga mitratA gA~sna hatAra garne munAphikaharUle AphnA hRdayamA lukAi rAkhekA kapaTako pola khulepachi tinIharU lajjita hunechan | ataH tinIharUko sambandha jhUTo kurAmA gA~sieko pramANita huncha |

53 mominaharUle munAphikaharUko avasthAprati Azcarya prakaTa gardai bhannechan– ke yinIharU nai hun allAhako dRDha kasama khAera hAmI ImAna, maddata tathA mitratAmA timIharUsa~ga nai chauM bhanI vizvAsa dilAuneharU?! yinakA sArA karmaharU vyartha bhae ra yinIharUko uddezya asaphala bhaekole yinIharU kSatigrasta bhae | tinIharUkA lAgi yAtanA tayAra pArieko cha |

54 he mominaharU ho! timIharUmadhye jo pani islAma dharmabATa vimukha bhaera kuphratarpha pharkancha, allAhale tinIharUko sthAnamA yastA mAnisaharUlAI lyAunu hunecha jo islAma dharmamA yati aDiga rahanechan ki unIharUlAI uhA~le manaparAunu hunecha ra unIharUle allAhalAI manaparAune chan | unIharU mominaharUprati komala ra kAphiraharUprati kaThora hunechan | unIharU allAhako vANIlAI ucca pArnako lAgi AphnA jIudhanale uhA~ko mArgamA jihAda (asatyako viruddha yuddha) garnechan | unIharU allAhako prasannatAlAI mAnisaharUko prasannatAmAthi prAthamikatA dinechan ra kunai nindA garne vyaktiko nindAbATa DarAune chainan | yo allAhako varadAna ho | uhA~ AphnA bhaktaharUmadhye jasalAI cAhanuhuncha pradAna garnuhuncha | allAha ekadamai mahAna ra parama dayAlu hunuhuncha | ko uhA~ko varadAnako hakadAra cha ra ko hakadAra chaina bhanne kurA uhA~ jAnnuhuncha ani hakadAralAI varadAna pradAna garnuhuncha ra jo hakadAra chaina usalAI tyasabATa vaJcita rAkhnuhuncha |

yahUdI, IsAI tathA anya kAphiraharUsita ghaniSTa sambandha rAkhnabATa manAhI garepachi mominaharUle kosa~ga sambandha rAkhnuparcha bhanne kurA batAu~dai allAhale bhannubhaeko cha–
55 timIharUkA ghaniSTa mitra tathA sahayogI yahUdI, IsAI ra anya kAphiraharU nabhaera allAha, uhA~kA rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) tathA yastA mominaharU hun, jo pUrNarUpamA namAja kAyama garchan, AphnA dhanako jakAta dinchan tathA allAhaprati tallIna ra vinamra rahanchan |

56 jo mAnisaharU allAha, uhA~kA rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) ra mominaharUlAI sahayogI tathA ghaniSTa mitra banAu~chan tinIharU allAhakA jamAtavAlA hun ani allAhako jamAta nai vijayI hunecha, kinabhane allAha unIharUkA maddatagAra hunuhuncha |

57 he mominaharU ho! timIharU bhandA pahilA kitAba pradAna gariekA yahUdI, IsAI tathA bahudevavAdIharUmadhye yastA mAnisaharUlAI ghaniSTa mitra na banAU, jasale islAma dharmalAI khela ThaTTA banAe | allAhale jasa jasalAI ghaniSTa mitra banAuna manAhI garnubhaeko cha; unIharUlAI ghaniSTa mitra nabanAU ra allAhasa~ga Dara yadi timIharU allAha tathA uhA~le avataraNa garnubhaeko kitAbamA ImAna rAkhchau bhane |

58 tinIharU tyatikhera pani khela ThaTTA garchan jaba timIharU namAjako lAgi ajAna dinchau; jo allAhako nikaTatA prAptiko sabaibhandA ThUlo mAdhyama ho | kinabhane tinIharU allAhako bhaktiko artha tathA uhA~le banAunubhaeko zarIata (kAnuna) lAI bujhdainan |

59 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! yahUdI ra IsAImadhye ThaTTA garneharUlAI bhannuhos– he ahale–kitAba ho! ke timIharU hAmImAthi yasa kAraNale doSa lagAu~chau ki hAmIle allAha, kurAna yasabhandA pahile avatarita AkAzIya granthamAthi ImAna lyAekA chauM; jabaki timIharUmadhyekA adhikAMza vyaktiharU ImAna tathA AjJAkAritAlAI tyAgekAle allAhako AdezabATa bAhiriekA chan?! juna doSa timIharU hAmImAthi lagAu~chau tyo hAmro lAgi nindanIya kurA hoina baru prazaMsAko kurA ho |

60 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! bhanidinuhos– ke ma tapAIMlAI batAu~ yinIharUbhandA pani baDhI doSI, nindAkA lAyaka ra sajAyakA hakadAra ko chan? tinIharUkA pUrvajaharU hun jasalAI allAhale Aphno kRpAbATa TADhA garnubhayo ra tinIharUmAthi krodha prakaTa garnubhayo | tinIharUlAI kurUpa banAera bA~dara tathA su~gura banAunubhayo | tinIharUmadhye kehIlAI tAgUtako bhakta banAunubhayo | allAha bAheka jasako bhakti mAnisaharUle garchan ra bhaktibATa prasanna hunchan; tI sabai tAgUta antargata parchan | mAthi ullekhita sabaiko pariNAma ati narAmro hunecha ra tinIharU nai sabaibhandA baDhI sIdhA mArga birAekA chan |

61 he mominaharU ho! jaba munAphikaharU timIharU samakSa Au~chan taba kapaTako kAraNale AphUle ImAna lyAekA jAhera garchan | vAstaviktA ke cha bhane tinIharU ImAna lyAu~dA tathA tyasabATa niska~dA kuphrakAsAtha hunchan | yadyapi tinIharU ImAna jAhera garchan tara tinIharUle lukAekA kuphrabAre allAha avagata hunuhuncha | uhA~le cA~Dai nai yasako badalA dinuhunecha |

62 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! tapAIMle yahUdI tathA munAphikaharUmadhye dherailAI jhUTo bolne, arUmAthi atyAcAra garne tathA avaidha tarikAle arUko dhanasampatti khAne jastA pApa karmamA tachADa machADa gariraheko pAunuhunecha | kati narAmro rahecha unIharUle garne kAma!

63 tinIharUkA dharmaguru tathA santaharUle tinIharUlAI pApakA kurA garna, jhUTo gavAhI dina tathA avaidha tarikAbATa arUko dhanasampatti khAnabATa kina rokdainan? kati narAmrA chan tinIharUkA zAsaka tathA dharmagurukA kAlA kartutaharU jo AphnA anuyAyIharUlAI kukarmabATa rokdainan!

64 yahUdIharUlAI khAdya-saGkaTa hu~dA bhandachan–allAhakA hAta bA~dhiekA chan | uhA~le hAmIharUlAI jIvikA dina banda garnubhaeko cha | jAni rAkha! bhalAi tathA varadAna garnabATa tinIharUkA hAta po bA~dhiekA chan | tinIharUle allAhako bAremA yasto kurA bhanekole tinIharU uhA~ko kRpAbATa TADhA pArie | baru allAha (subhAnahu va taAlA) kA hAta bhalAi tathA varadAnakA sAtha khullA chan | uhA~ jasarI cAhanuhuncha kharca garnuhuncha | uhA~le cAhanu bhaemA baDhI dinuhuncha ra nacAhanu bhaemA kama dinuhuncha | uhA~lAI kasaile pani na rokna sakcha na bAdhya tulyAuna sakcha | he rasUla (sadallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! tapAIMmAthi avatarita kitAbale gardA yahUdIharUko vidroha tathA inkAramA ajhai vRddhi hunecha | kinabhane tinIharU DAhA garchan | hAmIle tinIharUkA vibhinna samUhaharUbIca mahApralaya sammako lAgi zatrutA evaM ghRNA utpanna garidiekA chauM | jaba jaba tinIharU yuddhako lAgi jammA hunchan ra hAta hatiyAra tayAra pArchan vA tyasalAI bhaDakAuna SaDayantra garchan taba allAhale tinIharUko zaktilAI samApta pArnuhuncha ra tyo AgolAI nibhAunuhuncha | tinIharU islAma dharmalAI meTAuna dhartImA vidhvaMsa maccAune garchan | allAha vidhvaMsakArIharUlAI manaparAunu hunna |

65 yadi yahUdI ra IsAIharUle muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) le lyAunubhaeko sandezamAthi ImAna lyAekA bhae, pApa-karmabATa jogiera Izabhaya rAkhekA bhae, hAmIle tinIharUle garekA sabai pApaharUlAI meTAune thiyauM ra mahApralayako dina anekauM varadAnale bharipUrNa jannata (svarga) mA praveza garAune thiyauM jahA~ unIharU sadAsarvadA Anandita hune thie |

66 yadi yahUdIharUle taurAta anusAra tathA IsAIharUle injIla anusAra karma garekA bhae ra tI sabaile kurAna anusAra karma garekA bhae; maile tI sabaikA lAgi varSA barsAera tathA anAja umArera jIvIkAkA mAdhyamaharUlAI sajilo pArne thie~ | yahUdI ra IsAImadhye kehI asala chan ra satyamA kAyama chan | tara tinIharUmadhye adhikAMzakA karmaharU ImAna nabhaekole khera gayo |

67 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! allAhale tapAIMmAthi avataraNa garnubhaeko sandezalAI pUrNarUpamA mAnisaharU samakSa puryAunuhos | tyasabATa kunai pani kurA nalukAunuhos | yadi tapAIMle tyasabATa kehI kurA lukAunubhayo bhane tapAIM allAhako sandezalAI puryAunu bhaena | (vAstavamA, rasUla sallallAhu alaihi va sallamale jastAko tyastai sampUrNa AdezaharU puryAi dinubhayo | uhA~le puryAunu bhaena bhanera kasaile ThAncha bhane usale allAhamAthi jhUTo Aropa lagAu~cha |) allAhale Ajadekhi kAphiraharUbATa tapAIMko rakSA garnuhunecha | tinIharUle tapAIMlAI kehI hAni puryAuna sakne chainan | tapAIMko jimmevArI bhaneko sandezalAI puryAI dine mAtra ho | nissandeha allAhale tyastA kAphiraharUlAI sIdhA mArga dekhAunu hunechaina jo sIdhA mArgadarzana cAhadainan |

68 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! bhanidinuhos– he yahUdI ra IsAIharU ho! jabasamma timIharUle taurAta, injIla tathA timIharU samakSa timrA pAlanakartAko tarphabATa avatarita kurAnamA rahekA kurAharU anusAra karma gardainau tabasamma timIharUko ImAna sahI hu~daina | allAhako tarphabATa tapAIMmAthi avatarita kurAnale yahUdI ra IsAIbhitra raheko DAhAle gardA tinIharUmadhye adhikAMzako vidrohamAthi vidroha tathA kuphramAthi kuphralAI nai thapnecha | yI kAphiraharUko bAremA socera cintita nahunuhos | tapAIMko anusaraNa garne mominaharU nai tapAIMkA lAgi paryApta chan |

69 nissandeha muslima, yahUdI, sAbiI (jo kehI nabIharUkA anuyAyI hun) tathA IsAIharUmadhye jo jo allAha tathA AkhiratamAthi ImAna rAkhchan ra satkarma garchan tinIharUkA lAgi AgAmI dinaharUmA kunai Dara hune chaina | tinIharUle sAMsArika aMzamadhye je jati gumAekA chan tyasaprati cintita pani hune chainan |

70 hAmIle isrAIlakA santAnasita AjJApAlanako dRDha vacana liyauM ra tinIharUsamma allAhako kAnuna puryAuna rasUlaharU paThAekA thiyau~, tara tinIharUle liekA vacana bhaGga gare | tinIharU AphnA rasUlaharUkA kurAharUbATa vimukha bhaera eka arkAlAI jhUTo Thahara garera tathA hatyA garera AphnA icchAharUko anusaraNa gare |

71 vacana bhaGga gare pani, jhUTo bole pani ra nabIharUko hatyA gare pani kehI pharaka parnechaina ra tinIharUlAI kunai kaSTa pugnechaina bhanne kurA tinIharUle ThAnekA thie | tara tinIharUle kalpanA pani nagareko dukhaH kaSTa tiniharUmAthi Aipugyo | ani tinIharU satyalAI dekhna nasakne garI andhA bhae tyasatarpha mArgadarzana pAenan, satyalAI svIkAra garne garI sunnabATa vaJcita bhaera bahirA banirahe | ani allAhale kRpA garera mApha garnubhayo | pheri tinIharU satyabATa andho bhae ra tyasalAI sunnabATa bahiro bhae | yasto tinIharUmadhye dheraisa~ga bhayo | tinIharUle garne sampUrNa karmaharUlAI allAhale herirahanu bhaeko cha | uhA~bATa kehI pani lukeko chaina | uhA~le cA~Dai nai tyasako badalA dinuhunecha |

72 maryama putra masIha nai allAha hun bhanne IsAIharUle kuphra gare | kinabhane tinIharUle gairullAha (sRSTi) lAI pUjya banAe | jabaki maryama putra masIhale AphaiM bhanekA thie– he isrAIlakA santAnaharU ho! mAtra tyasa allAhako upAsanA gara jo merA ra timIharUkA pani pAlanakartA hunuhuncha | hAmI sabai uhA~kai bhakta hauM | kinabhane jasale kasailAI allAhako sAjhedAra ThaharAyo usako lAgi allAhale svarga sadhaiMko lAgi harAma garnubhaeko cha ra usako nivAsa narka hunecha | yastA atyAcArIharUkA lAgi allAhako yAtanAbATa bacAune kohI sahayogI hunechaina ra yAtanAbATa bacAuna pani saknechaina |

73 allAha tInavaTA cIjaharU; pitA, putra tathA pavitra AtmAbATa milera bannubhaeko cha bhanne IsAIharUle pani kuphra (satyalAI inkAra) gare | uhA~ tinIharUko yasa bhanAIbATa pavitra ra ati ucca hunuhuncha | allAha eka mAtra hunuhuncha, aneka hunuhunna | uhA~sa~ga kohI sAjhedAra chaina | yadi tinIharUle AphnA yasa ghRNita kurAharUlAI choDenan bhane tinIharUle duHkhadAyI yAtanA bhognechan |

74 ke tinIharUle Aphno yo bhanAilAI chADera allAhako samakSa taubA (pazcAttApa) gardainan ra tinIharUle gareko zirkabATa mAphI mAgdainan?! bhaktale juna sukai pApa gareko bhaepani yadi taubA (pazcAttApa) garcha bhane allAha mApha garnuhuncha, yadyapi usale kuphra nai kina na gareko hos | allAha mominaharUprati parama dayAlu hunuhuncha |

75 maryama putra IsA masIha ta rasUlaharUmadhye ekajanA rasUla mAtra thie | jasarI arUko mRtyu bhayo unako pani mRtyu hunecha | unakI AmA maryama eka janA saccA nArI thiin ra tI duvai janA AvazyakatA anusAra bhojana garne garthe | bhojanako AvazyakatA bhaekA yI duI janA kasarI Izvara huna sakchan?! he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! vicAra garnuhos, hAmI kasarI yinIharU samakSa AphnA yastA AyataharU varNana gardaichau~; jo ekezvaravAdalAI pramANita garchan ra IsA tathA maryamalAI Izvara banAune dhAraNAko khaNDana gardachan tara yinIharU yastA AyataharUlAI inkAra gardachan! ajhai vicAra garnuhos yinIharU kasarI satyabATa vimukha hu~daichan jabaki yinIharU samakSa yastA AyataharU AisakekA chan, jasale pramANita garchan ki allAha eka mAtra hunuhuncha |

76 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! allAha bAhekalAI pujne kAryako khaNDana gardai bhanidinuhos– ke timIharU allAhalAI choDera tyasako upAsanA garchau jasale na timIharUlAI kunai phAidA puryAuna sakcha na timIharUbATa hAni TArna sakcha?! allAha bAheka kohI pani kehI garne zakti rAkhdaina baru allAha sabai kisimako kamI-kamajorIbATa pavitra hunuhuncha | allAhale mAtra timIharUkA kurA sunnuhuncha | uhA~bATa kehI kamI hu~daina | allAhale timIharUkA kAryaharUlAI jAnnuhuncha, uhA~bATa kehI pani lukna sakdaina | uhA~le tyasako sajAya timIharUlAI dinuhunecha |

77 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! IsAIharUlAI bhanidinuhos– timIharUlAI juna satyako anusaraNa garne Adeza diieko thiyo tyasako sImAko ullaGghana nagara | jasalAI sammAna garne Adeza diieko cha; jastai- sandeSTAharU, tinIharUko sammAnamA ati nagara ra Izvarako darjA nadeU | jasarI timIharUle pathabhraSTa agrajaharUko anusaraNale gardA maryamakA putra IsA (alaihissalAma) lAI Izvara banAyau | vAstavamA, tinIharUle dherailAI pathabhraSTa pAre ra svayaM pani sIdhA mArgabATa vicalita bhae |

78 allAhale banI isrAilakA kAphiraharUlAI Aphno kRpAbATa TADhA pArnubhayo | allAhale yo sUcanA dAUda (alaihissalAma) mAthi avatarita jabUra tathA maryamakA putra IsA (alaihissalAma) mAthi avatarita injIlamA dinubhayo | tinIharUko pApa tathA allAhale harAma garnubhaekA kArya garekole uhA~le Aphno kRpAbATa TADhA pArnubhayo |

79 tinIharUle kukarmabATa eka arkAlAI rokdainathe | tinIharUmA pApa garne kukarmIharUle AphnA pApalAI khullamakhullA eka-arkAlAI bhanne garthe | kinabhane tinIharUlAI manAhI garne ra rokne kohI pani thiena | pApabATa na rokera tinIharU kati narAmro gardai thie |

80 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! tapAIMle adhikAMza yahUdI kAphira (avajJA) harUlAI anya samudAyakA kAphiraharUsa~ga najiki~dai tathA mitra banAu~dai gareko, ani tapAIM ra ekezvaravAdIharUsa~ga zatrutA gardai gareko dekhnuhuncha | kAphiraharUlAI mitra banAunatira lAgnu ekadamai narAmro ho | yasai kAraNale allAha tinIharUmAthi krodha prakaTa garnubhayo | allAhale tinIharUlAI narkamA phyA~knuhunecha, jahA~ sadAsarvadA rahanechan ra kahilyai niskana sakne chainan |

81 yadi yI yahUdIharUle vAstavamA allAha tathA Aphno sandeSTAmAthi pakkA ImAna rAkhekA bhae tinIharUle mominaharUlAI choDera kAphiraharUlAI mitra banAune thienan | kinabhane kAphiraharUlAI mitra banAunabATa manAhI garieko thiyo | tara adhikAMza yahUdIharU allAhako AdezabATa vimukha bhaekA chan |

82 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! nissandeha tapAIM ra tapAIMko sandezamA ImAna rAkhneharUsita sabaibhandA baDhI zatrutA garne yahUdI tathA mUrtI pUjakaharUlAI pAunu hunecha | yahUdIharU ghRNA, DAhA ra ahaMkArale gardA zatrutA garchan bhane mUrti pUjakaharU mUrtI pUjAle gardA zatrutA garchan | tapAIM tathA tapAIMko sandezamA ImAna rAkhneharUsita sabaibhandA baDhI mAyA garneharU tinalAI pAunu hunecha jasale AphUlAI nasArA (IsAI) bhanchan | kinabhane unIharUmAjha dheraijaso dharmaguru tathA bhaktaharU chan | unIharU komala chan, ghamaNDa gardainan | ghamaNDIharUko manasamma bhalAi pugdaina |

83 jastai najjAzI tathA unakA sAthIharUko hRdaya komala chan | unIharU kurAnako pATha sunera runa thAlchan | unIharUlAI IsA (alaihissalAma) le lyAeko sandezako bAremA jAnakArI cha | unIharU bhanchan- he hAmrA pAlanakartA! tapAIMle je jati muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) mAthi avataraNa garnubhayo tI sabaimAthi hAmIle ImAna lyAyauM | ataH he hAmrA pAlanakartA! hAmro nAma muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) ko anuyAyImA sAkSI dineharUmA lekhnuhos |

84 hAmIle allAhamAthi ra muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) mAthi avatarita satyamAthi ImAna kina nalyAune?! jabaki hAmI sandeSTAharU ra allAhadekhi DarAune unIharUkA sadAcArI anuyAyIharUsa~ga svargamA praveza garne AzAvAdI chauM |

85 unIharUle ImAna lyAekole tathA satyalAI svIkAra garekAle allAhale yastA bagaiMcAharU pradAna garnuhunecha, jasakA mahala tathA rukhaharUkA talatirabATa nadIharU kalakala bagirahekA hunechan jahA~ unIharU sadAsarvadA rahanechan | binA sarta rAmro tarikAle satyako anusaraNa garne sukarmIharUko yahI badalA ho |

86 allAha tathA uhA~kA rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) lAI inkAra garne tathA uhA~mAthi avatarita Ayata (nizAnI) harUlAI jhUTlAuneharU sadhaiMko lAgi narkamA jAnechan, yAtanA bhogdai rahanechan ra tyasabATa kahilyai niskana sakne chainan |

87 he mominaharU ho! allAhale vaidha garnubhaeko khAne-piune sAmagrI, nikAha tathA pavitra vastulAI harAma na banAU | khAne-piune sAmagrI tathA nikAhalAI bhakti tathA Izabhaya viparIta kurA ThAnera harAma nagara | tyasaigarI uhA~le toknu bhaeko sImAko ullaGghana nagara | nissandeha allAhale sImA ullaGghana garneharUlAI mana parAunuhunna, baru krodha prakaTa garnuhuncha |

88 allAhale pradAna garnubhaeko pavitra tathA halAla cijaharU khAU tara arUbATa khosekA, nAjAija tarikAle Arjana garekA vA apavitra cijaharU nakhAU | allAhakA AdezaharUko pAlanA garera tathA varjita kAryaharUlAI tyAgera uhA~sa~ga DarAU | yadi timIharU sA~ccikai AsthAvAna hau bhane |

89 he mominaharU ho! timIharUle binA manasAya khAeko kasamamA allAhako pakaDa hunechaina | tara bhitrI manabATa khAeko kasamako sambandhamA uhA~ko pakaDa hunecha | timIharUle bhitrI manabATa khAeko kasamako kaphphArA (jarivAnA) nimnalikhita chan: 1) daza janA garibalAI rAmro khAnA khuvAunu, arthAta pratyeka garibalAI AdhA sAa (1 kilo 633 grAma) khAnA dinu | 2) vA tinIharUlAI pracalita lattAkapaDA dinu | 3) vA ekajanA momina dAsalAI mukta garnu | tara ukta jarivAnAharUmadhye kunai pani jarivAnA dina sakne kSamatA chaina bhane 3 dina rojA rAkhnu | he mominaharU ho! yo kasamako kaphphArA (jarivAnA) ho | allAhako jhUTo kasama khAnabATa, uhA~ko dherai kasama khAnabATa ra kasama khAepachi tyasalAI purA nagarnabATa baca | yadi timIharUle yasto kasama khAekA chau jasalAI purA nagarnamA bhalAi cha bhane tyasalAI purA nagara, kasamako prAyazcita gara | allAhale jasarI kasamako kaphphArAlAI spaSTa pArnubhaeko cha tyastai uhA~le halAla tathA harAmako bAremA AdezaharUlAI pani spaSTa pArnuhunecha | allAhale timIharUle najAneko kurAharU sikAunubhayo ataH uhA~prati AbhAra vyakta gara |

90 he mominaharU ho! hoza gumAune madirA, duvai pakSale tinarnuparne juvA, DhuGgA jasako sammAna garera bahudevavAdIharU bali dinchan vA bhaktiko lAgi tyasalAI gADchan, tIra jasalAI hAnera Aphno bhAgya pattA lagAu~ chan, yI sabai zaitAnale AkarSaka banAera dekhAekA pApa kAryaharU hun | timIharU yI kAryaharUbATa TADhA basa tAki duniyA~mA rAmro jIvana pAera tathA AkhiratamA svargakA varadAnaharU pAera saphala hoU |

91 zaitAnale timIharUkA lAgi raksI tathA juvAlAI AkarSaka banAera timIharUbIca zatrutA evaM ghRNA utpanna garna cAhancha | timIharUlAI allAhako yAda tathA namAjabATa rokna cAhancha | he mominaharU ho! ke timIharU yI narAmrA kurAharUlAI tyAgdainau ta? ho, tyAgnu nai timIharUkA lAgi rAmro huncha, tasartha yI kAryaharUlAI choDideU |

92 allAha ra uhA~ko rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) ko AjJApAlana gara | uhA~harUko avajJA garnabATa baca | yadi timIharU yasabATa vimukha hunchau bhane jAnIrAkha hAmrA rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) ko jimmevArI spaSTa rUpamA allAhako sandezalAI puryAunu mAtra ho, jasalAI uhA~ (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) le pUrNarUpamA puryAunubhayo | yadi timIharUle sIdhA mArga apanAu~chau bhane Aphnai lAgi apanAu~chau ra yadi narAmro garchau bhane tyasako hAni timIharUle nai behornu parnehuncha |

raksI harAma garieko Adeza avatarita bhaepachi kehI mominaharUle AphnA tI dAjubhAiharUko avasthA jAnne kAmanA gare jasako mRtyu ImAna lyAepachi tara raksI harAma garinuaghi nai bhayo, ani nimna Ayata (zloka) avatarita bhayoH
93 jo mAnisaharUle allAhamAthi ImAna lyAe ra uhA~ko nikaTatA prApta garnako lAgi satkarma gare, tinIharUle raksI harAma hunuaghi khAekomA kunai pApa lAgne chaina | yadi unIharU harAmabATa bace, allAhako krodhabATa Dara mAne, allAhamAthi ImAna rAkhe, satkarma garirAkhe, allAhako bhakti yasarI gare mAnauM unIharUle allAhalAI dekhirahekA chan | allAhale yastA mAnisaharUlAI mana parAunuhuncha jo yasarI bhakti garchan mAnauM allAhalAI dekhirahekA hunchan ra sadhaiM yasto mahasusa garchan ki unIharU allAhako nigarAnImA chan | yasto bhAvanAle mominalAI ajha rAmro tathA Thosa tarikAle bhakti garna lagAu~cha |

94 he mominaharU ho! eharAmako avasthAmA raheko belA allAhale thalamA rahekA zikArakA janAvaraharU najika lyAera timIharUko parIkSA avazya nai linuhunecha | sAnAlAI timIharUle hAtabATa ra ThUlAharUlAI bhAlAbATa zikAra garna saknechau | allAhalAI na dekhikana ko DarAu~cha ani Aphno sRSTikartAko Darale zikAra garna choDcha bhanne kurAlAI jA~cnako lAgi uhA~le yasto garnuhuncha | uhA~le sabai kurAharU jAnnuhucha ra uhA~bATa kehI pani lukeko chaina | ani jasale yasapachi pani sImA ullaGghana garcha ra haja vA umarahako eharAma lagAera zikAra garcha, usako lAgi mahApralayako dina duHkhadAyI yAtanA cha |

95 he mominaharU ho! timIharU haja vA umarahako eharAmako avasthAmA hu~dA thalamA rahekA janAvaraharUko zikAra nagara | timIharUmadhye kasaile jAnIjAnI kunai janAvaralAI mArcha bhane usale mAreko janAvarako badalAmA jarivAnA svarUpa mAreko janAvarasa~ga mildo juldo janAvara; U~Ta, gAI tathA bAkhrA AdibATa kSatipUrti dinuparcha | jasako nirNaya duI janA nyAyI muslimaharUle garnechan, jasalAI makkA lagera harama sImA bhitra jabha garnuparcha | vA tyasako mUlya barAbara bhojana haramakA garibaharUmA vitaraNa garnuparcha | pratyeka garibalAI AdhA sAa (1 kilo 633 grAma) khAdyAnna dinuparcha, vA tyasako barAbara rojA rAkhnuparcha, pratyeka AdhA sAa bhojanako saTTAmA eka dinako rojA rAkhnuparcha | tAki zikAra garnele janAvaralAI mAreko sajAya bhogos | jasale haramako kSetrabhitra zikAra garnu ra eharAmako avasthAmA zikAra garnu harAma garinu aghi zikAra gare tinIharUlAI allAhale mApha garnubhayo | tara yo kArya harAma gariepachi jasale pani yasalAI dohoryAune chan, allAhale tinIharUlAI sajAya diera tyasako badalA linuhunecha | allAha zaktizAlI hunuhuncha tathA badalA line sAmarthya rAkhnuhuncha | uhA~ josita cAhanuhuncha badalA linuhuncha, kohI pani badalA linabATa rokna sakdaina |

96 timIharUkA lAgi pAnImA rahekA janAvaraharU zikAra jAyaja garieko cha | tyasaigarI samudrale bAhira phAlekA jIvita vA mRta duvai kisimakA janAvaraharU sthAnIya tathA yAtru duvaikA lAgi halAla gariekA chan | tara haja vA umarahako eharAma lagAeko avasthAmA thalamA rahekA janAvaraharUko zikAra harAma garieko cha | allAhakA AdezaharUko pAlanA garera tathA varjita kAryaharUlAI tyAgera uhA~ko bhaya gara | mahApralayako dina timIharUlAI uhA~tarpha nai pharkAera laginecha ani uhA~le timIharUle gareko karmaharU anusAra badalA dinuhunecha |

97 allAhale pratiSThita ghara kAbAlAI mAnisaharUkA lAgi jIvana sthApanAko sAdhana banAunu bhayo | jahA~ unIharU namAja, haja tathA umaraha jastA AphnA dhArmika kriyAkalApa garchan ra haramamA zAntiko mAhola bhaeko tathA phalaharU Aune vyavasthAle AphnA sAMsArika hIta pani purA garchan | allAhale harAma (pratiSThita) mahinAharU (jula-kAdaha, jula-hijjA, muharrama ra rajaba) mA yuddhalAI avaidha ghoSita garera zAntiko mahinA banAunubhayo | yI mahinAharUmA timIharU hajamA kurbAnI diine janAvara tathA ghA~TImA paTTA lagAiekA janAvaralAI zAntipUrNa avasthAmA haramatarpha liera jAne garchau, kasaile bATomA hAni puryAune Dara hu~daina | allAhale yaso garera timIharUmAthi kRpA garnubhayo | tAki timIharUlAI thAhA hos, allAhale AkAzaharU evaM dhartIkA sabai cija jAnnuhuncha | allAhako kAnuna timIharUko hItako rakSA garna tathA hAnibATa bacAunako lAgi ho | uhA~ko kAnunako pAlanAmA nai sabai bhaktaharUko hIta cha |
98 he mAnava ho! jAni rAkha, avajJAkArIharUlAI allAhale kaThora yAtanA dinuhuncha ra taubA garneharUprati ati kSamAzIla evaM parama dayAlu hunuhuncha |

99 rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) ko jimmevArI sandeza puryAunu mAtra ho, mArgadarzana dine zakti uhA~ko hAtamA chaina | yo ta mAtra allAhako hAtamA cha | mArgadarzana tathA pathabhraSTatAmadhye je jati timIharU prakaTa gardachau ra je jati lukAu~chau; allAhale tI sabailAI rAmrarI jAnnuhuncha ra tyasako badalA dinuhunecha |

100 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! bhanidinuhos– apavitra vastu ra pavitra vastu samAna huna sakdainan, cAhe apavitratAko pracuratAle tapAIMlAI jati pani AkarSita garos | kunai pani kurAko bahumata tyasako satyatAko pramANa hoina | he buddhimAnaharU ho! apavitra vastulAI tyAgera tathA pavitra vastulAI aMgAlera allAhasa~ga DarAU tAki timIharU svarga prApta garera saphala hoU |

101 he mominaharU ho! AphnA rasUla (sallalalAhu alaihi va sallama) sa~ga sarokAra ra dhArmika sambandha nabhaeko kurAbAre sodhapucha nagara | kinabhane tyasamA timIharUkA lAgi apThyAro huna sakcha | rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) mAthi kurAna avataraNa bhairahekA bakhatamA yadi timIharUle manAhI garieko prazna sodhyau bhane tI kurAharU timIharUmAthi anivArya huna sakchan | yo allAhako lAgi sajilo cha | juna kurAbAre kurAna mauna cha, tyasalAI allAhale mApha garnubhayo | ataH tyasako lAgi praznaharU nagara, natra timIharUmAthi tI AdezaharUko pAlanA anivArya garinecha | bhaktaharUle taubA garemA allAhale pApaharUlAI mApha garnuhuncha ra sajAya dina hatAra garnuhunna baru sahana garnuhuncha |

102 timIharUbhandA pahileko euTA samUhale yastai kisimakA praznaharU sodheko thiyo | tara jaba tyo Adeza lAgu gariyo taba tinIharUle tyasa anusAra karma garna sakenan | ani tinIharU tinai kurAharUle gardA kAphira bhae |

103 allAhale caupAyAharUlAI halAla garnubhaeko cha | uhA~le tI caupAyAharUlAI harAma garnubhaeko chaina jasalAI bahudevavAdIharUle AphUmAthi harAma garekA chan | kAphiraharUle bahIrA (tyo U~TanI ho jasale euTA nizcita gantImA baccA janmAepachi tyasako kAna cheDincha), sAibA (tyo U~TanI ho jasalAI euTA nizcita umerasamma pugepachi mUrtIko nAmamA choDincha), vasIlA (tyo U~TanI ho jo nirantara pothI baccA janma dincha) tathA hAmI (tyo sA~Da U~Ta ho jasabATa euTA nizcita gantImA U~Ta janma lincha) yI janAvaraharUlAI mUrtiharUko lAgi harAma gare | allAhale ukta U~TaharUlAI harAma garnubhaeko cha bhanera kAphiraharUle allAhamAthi jhUTo Aropa lagAe | adhikAMza kAphiraharU satya ra asatya tathA halAla ra harAmamA pharaka jAndainan |

104 halAla janAvaralAI harAma garera allAhamAthi jhUTa gaDhneharUlAI jaba bhaninchaH AU allAhadvArA avatarita kurAna tathA rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) ko sunnata tathA niyamatarpha | tAki timIharU halAla harAmabIca pharaka jAnna saka taba tinIharU bhanchan– hAmro lAgi tyahI AsthA, vizvAsa, kurA tathA kAryaharU paryApta chan jo hAmIle AphnA pUrvajaharUbATa liekA chauM | yI kurAharU tinIharUkA lAgi kasarI paryApta huna sakchan jabaki tinIharUkA pUrvajaharU na ta jAnakAra thie na satyamA nai thie? tinIharUko anusaraNa ajJAnI tathA pathabhraSTaharUle mAtra garchan | ataH tinIharU ajJAnI tathA pathabhraSTa hun |

105 he mominaharU ho! timIharU Aphno cintA gara tathA Aphno hItamA rahekA kAryaharU mAtra gara | yadi timIharU satmArgamA chau bhane pathabhraSTaharUle timIharUlAI hAni puryAuna sakdainan | mAnisaharUlAI satya kurAtarpha ahvAna garnu tathA duSkarmabATa manAhI garnu, mArgadarzanako tAtparya ho | mahApralayako dina timIharU sabai allAhakahA~ nai pharkera jAnucha ani uhA~le timIharUle duniyA~mA garekA kAryaharUbAre batAunu hunecha ra tyasako badalA dinuhunecha |

106 he mominaharU ho! jaba timIharUmadhye kasaiko mRtyukA saMketaharU dekhA parchan, taba usale vasiyata (antima upadeza) garos tathA vasiyata gardAkheri duI janA nyAyI muslimaharUlAI sAkSI banAos | muslima phelA naparemA duI janA gaira muslimaharUlAI sAkSI banAos, yadi timIharU yAtrAko avasthAmA chau ra tyahIM mRtyuko vipatti Aipugcha | duvaiko gavAhImA kunai zaGkA bhaeko khaNDamA duvai sAkSIlAI namAjapachi roka jahA~ duvaile allAhako kasama khAera bhanun– hAmI yasako badalAmA kunai mUlya line chainauM cAhe kohI nAtedAra nai kina nahos ra na hAmI allAhako sAkSIlAI lukAune nai chauM | yadi hAmIle yasto garyauM bhane hAmro gantI pApI tathA avajJAkArIharUmA hunecha |

107 kasama khAepachi yI duvaile AphnA gavAhI tathA kasamamA jhUTa boleko tathA beimAnI gareko Thahara huncha bhane yinIharUko ThAu~mA anya duI janA (mRta vyaktikA nikaTatama) vyaktiharU khaDA houn ani yinIharUle allAhako kasama khAun- tI duIjanAko jhUTa tathA beimAnImAthi hAmI duvaiko sAkSI unIharUko sAkSIbhandA baDhI saccA cha | hAmIharUle jhUTo kasama khAekA chainau | yadi hAmIharUle jhUTo kasama khAekA chauM bhane hAmIharU atyAcArI tathA hadalAI pAra garneharUmadhye hauM |

108 pahilA duI janAko gavAhImA zaGkA utpanna bhaekole radda gariepachi arko duI janAsita namAjapachi islAmI kAnunaanusAra kasama linu sabaibhandA ucita tarikA ho | yasarI yinIharUle gavAhI dine kramamA pherabadala ra beimAnI gardainan | kinabhane tinIharU jastai yinIharUko kasamako khaNDana nahos | gavAhI dine tathA kasama khAne kAryamA jhUTa tathA beimAnIlAI tyAga tathA allAhasita DarAU ra juna kurAko Adeza diincha tyasalAI svIkAra gardai suna | allAhale avajJAkArIharUlAI satmArga dekhAunu hunna |

109 he mAnava ho! mahApralayako dinalAI yAda gara, jaba allAhale sabai rasUlaharUlAI ekatrita garnuhunecha ani sodhnuhunecha– timIharUlAI juna samudAya tarpha paThAieko thiyo unIharUle ke javApha die? unIharUle bhannechan– he allAha! hAmIlAI kehI jJAna chaina | tapAIMlAI sabai kurAko jJAna cha, kinabhane tapAIM eka mAtra sabai adRzya mAmilAkA mahAna jJAtA hunuhuncha |

110 smaraNa gara, jaba allAhale IsA (alaihissalAma) lAI sambodhana garera bhannubhayo– he maryama putra IsA! maile timImAthi gareko kRpAharUlAI yAda gara; maile timIlAI binA pitA sRSTi gareM | timro AmA maryama (alaihissalAma) mAthi gareko kRpAlAI yAda gara; maile unalAI unako yugakA mahilAharUmadhye cayana gareM | maile timIlAI jibrIla (alaihissalAma) dvArA sazakta banAe~ | timI zizu arthAta AmAko dUdha khAne umeramA pani mAnisaharUlAI allAhatarpha bolAu~dai unIharUsa~ga kurAkAnI gardathyau ra ThUlo umeramA pani | maile timIlAI lekhna tathA mUsA (alaihissalAma) mAthi avatarita taurAta ra timImAthi avatarita injIla paDhna sikAe~ | tyasaigarI timIlAI islAmI kAnunakA rahasya, phAidA tathA tatvadarzitA sikAe~ | timI mATole paMkSIko AkRti banAera tyasamA phukthyau ani tyo sA~ccikai paMkSI banthyo | tyasaigarI timI janmajAta andho evaM kuSTharogIharUlAI niko pArthyau | janmajAta andho dekhna thAlthyo ra kuSTharogIko chAlA niko hune garthyo | mRtaharUlAI jIvita pArna allAhasa~ga duA garthyau ani jIvita pArthyau | timI yI sabai kArya allAhako anumatibATa garthyau | timI spaSTa camatkAraharU liera banI isrAIla samakSa pugyau taba tinIharUle timIlAI hatyA garna khoje tara maile nai timIlAI tinIharUbATa bacAe~ | tinIharUle timro camatkAralAI inkAra gare ra bhane– yo ta spaSTa jAdU ho |

111 maile timImAthi gareko kRpAlAI yAda gara, jaba maile havArI (masIha alaihissalAmakA sAthI) harUko manamA yo kurA hAleM; timIharU mamAthi tathA IsA (alaihissalAma) mAthi ImAna lyAU taba unIharUle ImAna lyAe ra bhane– hAmIle ImAna lyAyauM ra he hAmrA pAlanakartA! tapAIM sAkSI basnuhos hAmI sabai muslima tathA AjJAkArI banyauM |

112 smaraNa gara, jaba havArIharUle bhane– he maryama putra IsA! ke timrA pAlanakartAle hAmImAthi AkAzabATa mAidA (vibhinna parikArale sajAieko thAlI) avataraNa garna saknuhuncha? ani IsA (alaihissalAma) le bhane– timIharU allAhasa~ga DarAU, yasto khAle mAga nagara, yo timIharUkA lAgi parIkSA hunsakcha | yadi timIharU momina hau bhane jIvikopArjanako bAremA allAhamAthi bharosA gara |

113 havArIharUle IsA (alaihissalAma) lAI bhane– hAmI tyasa mAidAbATa khAna cAhanchauM, hAmro hRdayalAI allAhako varadAnabATa santuSTa pArna cAhanchauM | sAthai timI allAhakA rasUla hau bhanne jAnakArI cAhanchauM | timIle allAhako tarphabATa lyAeko kurA satya ho hAmI pUrNarUpamA vizvasta hun cAhanchauM | anupasthita mAnisaharUko tarphabATa hAmI sAkSI hunechauM |

114 IsA (alaihissalAma) le unIharUko mAgalAI svIkAra gardai allAhasa~ga duA gare- he hAmrA pAlanakartA! hAmImAthi bhojanale sajAieko dastarakhAna (thAla) avataraNa garnuhos | hAmI yo dinalAI khusIko rUpamA manAune chauM ra tapAIMprati AbhAra vyakta garnechauM | yo dina tatkAla jIvita rahekA mAnisaharUkA lAgi ra pachi Aune pi~DhIkA lAgi pani khusIyAlI manAune dina hunecha | yo kArya tapAIMko ekezvaravAdako ra ma satyakA sAtha paThAieko sandeSTA hu~ bhanne kurAko cinha tathA pramANa hunecha | hAmIlAI yasto jIvIkA pradAna garnuhos jo tapAIMko bhakti garnamA sahayogI hos | he hAmrA pAlanakartA tapAIM sabaibhandA rAmrA jIvIkA pradAnakartA hunuhuncha |

115 allAhale IsA (alaihissalAma) ko duA svIkAra gardai bhannubhayo– timIle mAga gareko mAidA (bhojanale sajAieko thAla) ma avatarita garnechu, tara ja-jasale yasapachi kuphra garnechan tinIharUlAI yasto kaDA yAtanA dinechu jasto kasailAI dieko chaina | kinabhane tinIharUle spaSTa nizAnI dekhepachi gareko kuphra bhaneko khullama khullA zatrutAmA AdhArita kuphra hunecha | allAhale Aphno vAcA anusAra bhojanale sajAieko thAla avataraNa garnubhayo |

116 yAda gara, jaba mahApralayako dina allAhale maryama putra IsA (alaihissalAma) lAI sambodhana garera bhannuhunecha– he maryama putra IsA! ke timIle mAnisaharUlAI allAhalAI choDera malAI ra merI AmAlAI Izvara banAunu bhanekA thiyau? IsA (alaihissalAma) le yasa kurAko khaNDana gardai bhannuhunecha– satya kurA bAheka arU kehI bhannu mero lAgi ucita chaina | maile tyaso bhaneko bhae tapAIMlAI thAhA hune thiyo kinabhane tapAIMbATa kehI pani lukeko chaina | mero manamA bhaeko kurA tapAIMlAI thAhA cha tara tapAIMko manamA raheko kurA malAI thAhA chaina | nissandeha tapAIM mAtra dRzya, gopya tathA adRzyakA mahAna jJAtA hunuhuncha |

117 IsA (alaihissalAma) le AphnA pAlanakartAlAI bhane– maile ta mAnisaharUlAI tyahI Adeza die~ jo tapAIMle malAI dinubhaeko thiyo; mAtra eka allAhako bhakti gara | jabasamma ma tinIharUbIca jIvita rahe~ tabasamma tinIharUko kAryako nigarAnI gare~ tara jaba tapAIMle malAI jIvita AkAzatarpha uThAunubhayo ani ma tinIharUbIca rahena~ taba he merA pAlanakartA! tapAIMle tinIharUko karmaharUko rakSA garnubhayo, tapAIM sabai vastumAthi gavAha hunuhuncha, tapAIMbATa kunai pani vastu lukeko chaina, maile bhaneko kurA pani tapAIMbATa gopya chaina ra mapachi tinIharUle bhaneko kurA pani tapAIMbATa gopya chaina |

118 he pAlanakartA! yadi tapAIMle unIharUlAI daNDa dinuhuncha bhane nissandeha unIharU ta tapAIMkai bhakta hun, tapAIM je cAhanuhuncha garnuhuncha | yadi unIharUmadhye ImAna lyAekA mAnisaharUmAthi kRpA gardai mApha garnuhuncha bhane yasabATa tapAIMlAI kohI pani rokna sakdaina | tapAIM prabhutvazAlI tathA tatvadarzI hunuhuncha |

119 allAhale IsA (alaihissalAma) lAI bhannubhayo– yo tyo dina ho juna dina satyavAdI tathA satkarmIharUlAI tinIharUko satyatAle phAidA dinecha | unIharUkA lAgi yastA bagaiMcAharU hunechan jasakA mahala tathA rukhaharUkA talatirabATa nadIharU kalakala bagirahekA hunechan | unIharU tyasamA sadhaiM rahanechan, unIharUlAI kahilyai mRtyu Aunechaina | allAha unIharUsa~ga sadhaiMko lAgi khusI hunubhayo ra unIharU pani sadhaiM rahane kRpA pAera allAhasita khusI bhae | yo ho unIharUle pAekA mahAna badalA tathA allAhako prasannatA jasabhandA mahAna saphalatA hunai sakdaina |

120 AkAzaharU tathA pRthvImA rahekA sabai kurAharUko rAjya sattA allAhakai hAtamA cha | yI duvailAI ra yasamA rahekA sabai sRSTiharUlAI uhA~le nai sRSTi garnubhayo | uhA~ nai yI sabaiko kArya saJcAlana garnu hunuhuncha | uhA~ hareka kAryako sAmarthya rAkhnuhuncha | uhA~lAI kohI pani hairAna pArna sakdaina |

1 sampUrNa kisimakA pUrNatA, prazaMsA tathA guNagAnaharU premakA sAtha allAhakai lAgi hun, jasale AkAzaharU tathA pRthvIlAI binA kunai udAharaNa sRSTi garnubhayo | rAtale dinalAI ra dinale rAtalAI pachyAune garI sRSTi garnubhayo | rAtalAI andhakAra ra dinalAI prakAzamaya banAunubhayo | yasakA bAvajuda kAphiraharU arUlAI allAhako barAbara ra sAjhedAra banAu~chan |

2 he mAnava ho! allAhale timIharUlAI ra timIharUkA pUrvaja AdamalAI mATobATa sRSTi garnubhayo | timIharU duniyA~mA kati dina bA~cnechau ra mRtyu pazcAta mahApralayako dina uThAinechau tyasako arko avadhi pani nizcata garnubhayo, jasako jJAna mAtra uhA~lAI cha | yasakA bAvajuda timIharU punarjanmabAre allAhako zaktimA zaMkA garchau |

3 AkAza tathA pRthvIkA vAstavika pUjya allAha mAtra hunuhuncha | uhA~bATa kunai pani vastu lukeko chaina | timIharUle lukAune garekA tathA vyakta garne garekA nIyata tathA karmaharUlAI allAhale jAnnuhuncha ra cA~Dai nai tyasako badalA dinuhunecha |

4 bahudevavAdIharU samakSa allAhakA je jati pramANaharU Ae pani tinIharUle tyasako parvAha na garikana tyasalAI tyAge | vAstavika pUjya allAha mAtra hunuhuncha ra muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) uhA~kA saccA rasUla (sandeSTA) hunuhuncha bhannebAre spaSTa pramANa ra nizAnIharU Ae | tara tinIharU tyasabATa vimukha bhae |

5 yadi tinIharUle tyastA spaSTa pramANaharUlAI jhUTo Thahara gare bhane tinIharUle muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) le lyAnubhaekA ajhai spaSTa nizAnI kurAnalAI pani jhUTo Thahara gare | mahApralayako dina jaba tinIharUle prakopa dekhnechan, taba tinIharUle jAnnechan ki tinIharU juna kurAharUko ThaTTA gardai thie tI sabai satya thie |

6 atyAcArI samudAyaharUlAI sakhApa pArne allAhako niyama ho bhanne kurA ke yI kAphiraharUlAI thAhA chaina?! yinIharUbhandA pahile pani allAhale dherai samudAyaharUlAI sakhApa pArnubhayo josa~ga yI kAphiraharUbhandA baDhI dhanasampatti, hAta hatiyAra tathA dhartImA basobAsa garne sara sAmAna thie | allAhale tinIharUmAthi paTaka-paTaka varSA paThAunubhayo ra tinIharUkA bhavanakA talatirabATa nadIharU jArI garnubhayo | tara tinIharUle allAhako avajJA gare ani allAhale tinIharUko pApako kAraNale tinIharUlAI sakhApa pArnubhayo ra tinIharUpachi anya samudAyaharU sRSTi garnubhayo |

7 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) yadi hAmIle tapAIMmAthi pAnAharUmA lekhieko kitAba avataraNa gareko bhae pani, ani tyasalAI tinIharUle Aphnai A~khAle dekheko bhae pani ra hAtale choera rAmrarI mahasusa gareko bhae pani zatrutAko kAraNale tinIharUle ImAna lyAune thienan | baru bhanne thie- yo spaSTa jAdU ho hAmI kadApi yasamAthi ImAna lyAune chainauM |

8 yI kAphiraharUle bhane– yadi allAhale muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) sa~ga phariztA (devadUta) paThAunuhuncha jasale hAmIharUsa~ga kurA garera uhA~ rasUla hunuhuncha bhanne gavAhI dine chan bhane hAmI ImAna lyAunechauM | tinIharUle gareko mAga anusAra hAmIle phariztA paThAyauM taipani tinIharUle ImAna lyAenan bhane hAmI tinIharUko vinAza garnechauM ra tinIharUlAI taubAko maukA pani diine chaina |

9 yadi hAmIle phariztAlAI rasUla banAera paThAeko bhae tyasalAI mAnavako rUpamA paThAune thiyauM tAki tinIharU tyasako kurA sunera lAbhAnvita hun sakuna | yadi phariztA Aphno vAstavika rUpamA Aeko bhae tinIharU tyasako kurA na sunna sakthe na lAbhAnvita huna sakthe | phariztAlAI mAnavako rUpamA paThAu~dA pani tinIharUko lAgi aspaSTa hune thiyo |

10 tapAIMsa~ga phariztA avataraNa garne mAga garera yinIharUle tapAIMko majAka uDAu~dai chan; tapAIM bhandA aghikA samudAyaharUle pani AphnA rasUlaharUkA yasaigarI majAka uDAekA thie | juna prakopabATa saceta ra sAvadhAna garAu~dA tinIharUle majAka uDAe tathA inkAra gare; tyahI prakopa tinIharUmAthi Aipugyo |

11 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) yI jhUTlAune tathA ThaTTA garneharUlAI bhannuhos- dhartImA bhramaNa gara ani allAhakA rasUlaharUlAI jhUTalAuneharUko pariNAmamA vicAra gara | tinIharU zaktizAlI hu~dAhu~dai pani tinIharUmAthi allAhako prakopa avatarita bhayo |

12 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) yinIharUlAI sodhnuhos- AkAzaharU, pRthvI tathA yI duvaiko bIcamA kasko sattA cha? bhanidinuhos- yI sabaikA zAsana allAhako hAtamA mAtra cha | allAhale AphnA bhaktaharUprati dayA gardai AphUmAthi kRpAko dAyitva anivArya garnubhayo | tyasaile uhA~ AphnA bhaktaharUlAI turuntai sajAya dinuhunna | allAhale avazya nai timIharUlAI mahApralayako dina jammA garnuhunecha, jasamA kunai sandeha chaina | jasale AphulAI ghATA behorne sUcImA rAkheko cha, usale ImAna lyAune chaina |
13 rAta dinamA hune ra yasamA basobAsa garne sabaikA sattA zAsana allAha kai hAtamA cha | uhA~ sabaikA kurAharU sunnuhuncha tathA kAryaharU jAnnuhuncha ra sabailAI tyasako badalA dinuhunecha |

14 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! allAhako sAthasAthai mUrti pUjA garne bahudevavAdIharUlAI bhanidinuhos- ke allAhabAheka arUlAI guhArnu ra tinIharUsa~ga maddata mAgnu buddhimAnI ho ra?! yadyapi allAhale nai AkAza tathA pRthvIlAI vigatako kunai namunA binA nai sRSTi garnubhayo | uhA~le nai AphnA bhaktaharUlAI jIvIkA pradAna garnuhuncha, kunai bhaktale uhA~lAI jIvIkA pradAna gardaina | uhA~lAI kasaiko kunai AvazyakatA chaina baru sabai bhaktaharU uhA~mai Azrita chan | he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! bhanidinuhos- malAI yasa samudAyamadhye prathama muslima (AjJAkArI bhakta) banne ra uhA~sa~ga anya kasailAI sAjhedAra nabanAune Adeza bhaeko cha |

15 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! bhanidinuhos- yadi maile manAhI garieko kArya zirka garera vA allAhabATa Adeza bhaekA kAryaharU ImAna tathA AjJApAlanalAI tyAgera allAhako avajJA garchu bhane mahApralayako dina allAhale sajAya dinuhunecha bhanne kurAbATa bhayabhIta chu |
16 allAhale mahApralayako dina jasalAI yAtanAbATa jogAunu hunecha, usalAI uhA~ko kRpAle ThUlo saphalatA prApta bhayo | yAtanAbATa mukti mahAna saphalatA ho |

17 he AdamakA santAna ho! yadi timIharUlAI kunai saGkaTa Au~cha bhane tyasalAI allAha bAheka kohI pani TArna sakdaina | yadi timIharUlAI allAhako tarphabATa kunai bhalAi tathA kRpA prApta huncha bhane tyasalAI kohI pani rokna sakdaina | allAha hareka kAryako sAmarthya rAkhnuhuncha | kasaile uhA~lAI vivaza pArna sakdaina |

18 allAha AphnA bhaktaharUmAthi hareka dRSTile utkRSTa hunuhuncha ra mahAna hunuhuncha | kasaile uhA~lAI vivaza pArna sakdaina | sabai prANIharU uhA~ samakSa nihurekA chan | uhA~ Aphno zAna anusAra sabai bhaktaharUmAthi hunuhuncha | sRSTi, kArya saJcAnala tathA kAnunamA tatvadarzI hunuhuncha | uhA~ sabaibATa avagata hunuhuncha, kunai vastu uhA~bATa gopya chaina |

19 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! tapAIMlAI rasUla namAnne bahudevavAdIharUlAI bhanidinuhos- ma saccA rasUla hu~ bhanne kurAmAthi kasako gavAhI sabaibhandA ucca tathA bharapardo cha? bhanidinuhos- allAhako gavAhI sabaibhandA ucca tathA bharapardo cha | uhA~ ma ra timIharUbIca gavAha hunuhuncha | maile timIharU samakSa lyAeko kurAlAI pani uhA~le jAnnuhuncha ra tyasaprati timIharUko pratikRyA ke hunecha bhanne kurAlAI pani jAnnuhuncha | timIharU ani jinna ra mAnavamadhye jo josamma yo pugcha tI sabailAI DarAunako lAgi allAhale mamAthi yo kurAna avataraNa garnubhaeko cha | he bahudevavAdIharU! allAhasa~ga anya pUjyaharU pani chan bhanne kurAmAthi timIharU vizvAsa rAkhchau | he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! bhanidinuhos- timIharUko yo jhUTo vizvAsa bhaekole ma yasako gavAhI dina sakdina | allAha mAtra vAstavika pUjya hunuhuncha, uhA~sa~ga kohI sAjhedAra chaina | timIharUle je jasto zirka (sAjhedAra Thahara garne kArya) garchau tyasasa~ga mero kunai sarokAra chaina |

20 taurAta diiekA yahUdIharU tathA injIla diiekA IsAIharUle arUkA santAnaharUko bIcamA AphnA santAnaharUlAI spaSTa rUpamA cine jhaiM sandeSTA muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) lAI rAmrosa~ga cinchan | tinIharU narkabAsI bhaekole AphUlAI ghATAmA hAle | tinIharU ImAna lyAune chainan |

21 allAhasa~ga sAjhedAra Thahara garneharU vA rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va salla) mAthi avatarita Ayata (zloka) harUlAI jhUTo bhanneharU nai sabaibhandA ThUlA atyAcArI hun | yinIharUle jabasamma taubA gardainan tabasamma kadApi saphala huna sakdainan |

22 mahApralayako dinalAI yAda garnuhos, juna dina maile sabailAI jammA garnechu, eka janAlAI pani choDdina ra masa~ga arUlAI sAjhedAra Thahara garneharUlAI nindA gardai bhannechu- kahA~ chan timrA tI sAjhedAraharU, jasako timIharU upAsanA garthyau?!

23 yasa parIkSApachi tinIharUle mAphI mAgdai tathA jhUTo boldai bhannechan- tI (asatya) pUjyaharUsita hAmro kunai sambandha chaina, he hAmrA pAlanakartA! tapAIMko kasama! hAmI duniyA~mA tapAIMsa~ga kasailAI sAjhedAra gardainathyauM | baru hAmI tapAIMmAthi ImAna rAkhthyauM ra mAtra tapAIMko upAsanA garthyauM |

24 he muhammda (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! hernuhos, yinIharUle allAha tapAIMsa~ga kasailAI sAjhedAra banAenauM bhanera kasarI jhUTo boldaichan | yinIharUle duniyA~mA banAekA sAjhedAraharU kasarI harAera gae ra yinIharUlAI kasarI besahArA chADera beijjata nai gare?!

25 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! jaba tapAIM kurAnako pATha garnuhuncha taba kehI bahudevavAdIharU tyasalAI sunchan tara tyasabATa phAidA uThAu~dainan | kinabhane hAmIle tinIharUkA vimukhatA tathA zatrutAko kAraNale tinIharUkA hRdayamAthi pardA hAlekA chauM tAki tinIharUle kurAna bujhna nasakun | tinIharUkA kAnamA bujo hAlekA chauM, jasale gardA tinIharU phAidAjanaka kurA sunna sakdainan | ati spaSTa tathA Thosa pramANa dekhe pani tinIharUle tyasamAthi ImAna lyAu~dainan | jaba tinIharU tapAIM samakSa Au~chan taba tinIharU satya kurAmA jhUTo tarikAle jhagaDA garchan | tinIharU bhanchan- timIle je jati lyAekA chau; tI sabai aghillA samudAyaharUkA kitAbaharUbATa liiekA chan |

26 tinIharU mAnisaharUlAI rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) mAthi ImAna lyAunabATa rokchan ra svayam pani TADhA rahanchan | arUlAI pani phAidA uThAuna diirahekA chainan ra svayam pani phAidA uThAirahekA chainan | yaso garera tinIharUle AphaiMlAI barbAda garirahekA chan, tara yo kurA bujhekA chainan |

27 he rasUla (sallAhu alaihi va sallama)! tapAIMle tinIharUlAI ati narAmro avasthAmA dekhnuhunecha ani Azcarya garnuhunecha | jaba mahApralayako dina tinIharUlAI narkamA hAlinecha, tyatikhera tinIharU pachuto gardai bhannechan- hAmIlAI sAMsArika jIvanatarpha pharkAiyo bhane hAmI allAhakA Ayata (nizAnI) harUlAI asatya tathA jhUTo bhanne chainauM ra allAhamAthi ImAna lyAunechauM |

28 tinIharUlAI duniyA~mA pharkAiemA ImAna lyAune chan bhanne kurA nai galata ho | tinIharUle lukAeko yo kurA (allAhako kasama hAmI uhA~sa~ga kasailAI sAjhedAra banAekA thienauM) tyatikhera charlaGga hunecha jatikhera tinIharUkA indriyaharUle tinIharU viruddha gavAhI dinechan | yadi tinIharUlAI pheri duniyA~mA pharkAiyo bhane tinIharUle punaH manAhI garieko zirka tathA kuphra nai garnechan | tinIharUle ImAna lyAune chainan |
29 bahudevavAdIharUle bhane– jIvana ta mAtra yahI sAMsArika jIvana ho jasamA hAmI ramAirahekA chauM, hAmIharUlAI hisAba kitAbako lAgi punaH jIvita pArI uThAine chaina |

30 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! punarjanma ra hisAba kitAbalAI inkAra garneharUlAI tapAIM ati narAmro avasthAmA dekhnuhunecha jatikhera tinIharUlAI allAhale bhannuhunecha– ke punaH jIvita pArI uThAine dina satya hoina ra?! timIharUle inkAra garne gareko yasa dinamA ke kunai zaMkA cha ra?! tinIharUle allAhako kasama khAera bhannechan- nissandeha yo satya ho, yasamA kunai sandeha chaina | ani allAhale tinIharUlAI bhannuhunecha– yasa dinalAI jhUTho Thahara garekole yAtanAko svAda cAkha |

31 mahApralayako dina punaH jIvita pArI uThAine ra allAhako samakSa upasthita hune kurAlAI asambhava ThAnera inkAra garneharU ghATAmA pare | jaba akasmAta mahApralaya Aunecha, taba tinIharUle pachuto gardai bhannechan- hAmI ta barbAda bhayauM! allAhalAI inkAra garera tathA mahApralayako dinako tayArI nagarera hAmIle baDo lAparavAhI garyau | tinIharUle gareko pApako bhArIlAI AphnA piThyU~mAthi boknechan | vAstavamA, tinIharUle bokeko pApako bhArI ati narAmro hunecha |

32 mojamastI garneharUkA lAgi yo sAMsArika jIvana khela kuda mAtra ho jo yasamA lipta bhaera allAhalAI khusI pArne kArya gardainan | tara AsthAvAnaharUkA lAgi Akhirata (paraloka) rAmro cha | jo allAhako Adezako pAlanA garera tathA varjita garnubhaekA zirka tathA avajJAlAI tyAgera Izabhaya rAkhchan | he bahudevavAdIharU ho! ke timIharU yo kurA bujhdainau? allAhamAthi ImAna lyAU ani satkarma gara |

33 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! unIharUko vAhya inkArale gardA tapAIM cintita hunuhuncha bhanne kurA hAmIlAI thAhA cha | tara tinIharUle tapAIMlAI haina baru allAhako nizAnIlAI inkAra garirahekA chan | kinabhane tinIharU tapAIMko satyatA tathA imAndArImAthi vizvAsa garchan |

34 tinIharU tapAIMle lyAunubhaeko sandezalAI mAtra jhUTo Thahara gardaichan bhanne naThAnnuhos | tapAIM bhandA aghi AekA rasUlaharUlAI unIharUkA samudAyale jhUTo Thahara garera nAnAtharIkA kaSTa diekA thie | tara unIharUle dhairya gare ani nirantara allAhako mArgatira ahvAna gare ra uhA~ko bATomA jihAda gare | yahA~samma ki allAhako maddata Aipugyo | allAhale AphnA rasUlaharUko lAgi khAsa garnubhaeko maddata ra vAcA avazya purA huncha, tyasamA kunai pherabadala hunechaina | he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! tapAIMsamakSa tapAIM bhandA aghikA rasUlaharUkA samAcAraharU, unIharUle AphnA samudAyaharUko tarphabATa bhogekA pIDAharU ra unIharUkA zatruharUlAI nAza pArera unIharUlAI allAhale garnubhaeko maddatako varNana bhaisakeko cha |

35 he rasUla (sallalalAhu alaihi va sallama)! yadi unIharUko jhUTalAune bAnI ra vimukhatA tapAIMkA lAgi asahanIya cha bhane tapAIM pRthvImA suruGga vA AkAzamA kunai bharyAGga khojnuhos ani tinIharUsamakSa maile pradAna nagarekA pramANaharU lyAunuhos | allAhale cAhanubhayo bhane tI sabailAI tapAIMle lyAunubhaeko satmArgamA ekatrita garna saknuhuncha | tara uhA~le Aphno viveka ra tatvadarzIle yaso garnubhaena | ataH tapAIM ajJAnIharUmadhye na bannuhos | tinIharUle ImAna nalyAeko cintAmA AphUlAI kamajora napArnuhos |

36 tapAIMle lyAunubhaeko sandezako javApha tI mAnisaharUle mAtra dina sakchan jo kurA sunne tathA bujhne kSamatA rAkhchan | kAphiraharUko muTu murdA bhaisakeko cha | yinIharUko kunai kurai nagarnus | allAhale yI mRta hRdaya bhaekAharUlAI mahApralayako dina punarjIvita garI uThAunuhunecha | pheri tinIharUkA karmakA badalA dinakA lAgi allAhatarpha nai pharkAera laginecha |

37 bahudevavAdIharUle ImAnaprati DhilAsustI gardai bhane– muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) mAthi uhA~kA pAlanakartAko tarphabATa kunai adabhuta nizAnI kina avataraNa garidaina, jo uhA~le lyAunubhaeko sandezako pramANa banos? he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! bhanidinuhos- nizcaya nai allAha yinIharUle mAga gare jhaiM nizAnI avataraNa garne sakSama hunuhuncha, tara yasto kisimako mAga garneharUmadhye adhikAMza mAnisaharU jAndainan ki allAhale kunai kAraNa tathA AvazyakatA anusAra nizAnI avataraNa garnuhuncha, kasaiko cAhanAko AdhAramA nizAnI avataraNa garnuhunna | yadi allAhale nizAnI avataraNa garnuhuncha bhane tyasapachi pani ImAna na lyAuneharUlAI naSTa garnuhunecha |

38 he AdamakA santAna! bhUmimA hi~DDula garne jati prakArakA janAvaraharU chan ra AkAzamA uDne jati paMkSIharU chan tI sabai sRSTi tathA jIvikopArjanamA timIharU jastai euTA samUha hun | hAmIle surakSita kitAbamA kehI pani nachuTAera sabai kurA lekhidiekA chauM | allAhalAI yI sabaiko bAremA pUrNa jJAna cha | ani yinIharU mahApralayako dina nirNayako lAgi AphnA pAlanakartAsAmu nai ekatrita garine chan | ani allAhale tinIharUlAI tinIharUko karma anusAra badalA dinuhunecha |

39 hAmrA nizAnIharUlAI asatya Thahara garneharU bahirA jhaiM hun, jasale kurA sundainan, lATA jastai hun, jo bolna sakdainan | sAthai tinIharU andhakAramA chan, kehI dekhdainan | yasto avasthAmA rahekAharUle kasarI sIdhA mArga pAuna sakchan?! allAhale jasalAI cAhanuhuncha pathabhraSTa pArnuhuncha ra jasalAI cAhanuhuncha mArgadarzana garnuhuncha ra sIdhA mArgamA DoryAunuhuncha |

40 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) yI bahudevavAdIharUlAI bhanidinuhos– yadi timIharUmAthi allAhako prakopa AiparemA vA mahApralaya nai AemA jasako vAcA timIharUsita garieko cha ke timIharUle tyasalAI TArna allAhabAheka anya kasailAI bolAu~chau? yadi timIharU yasa dAbImA saccA chau bhane batAU, timIharUkA pUjyaharUle phAidA puryAuna sakchan vA hAni TArna sakchan?!

41 baru yasto avasthAmA timIharUle allAhalAI mAtra pukArdachau, jasale timIharUlAI sRSTi garnubhayo ani uhA~le cAhanubhaemA tyo saGkaTa TArnuhuncha | uhA~ nai pAlanakartA hunuhuncha ra tyasalAI TArne sAmarthya rAkhnuhuncha | tyatikhera timIharUle tI pUjyaharUlAI pukArdainau jasalAI timIharUle allAhasa~ga sAjhedAra banAekA chau | kinabhane timIharUlAI thAhA cha, tinIharUle na ta phAidA puryAuna sakchan na hAni nai |

42 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! hAmIle tapAIM bhandA pahile dherai samudAyaharUtarpha rasUlaharU paThAyauM tara tinIharUle unIharUlAI jhUTo Thahara gare ra vimukha bhae | ani hAmIle tinIharUlAI daridratA, kaSTaharU tathA zArIrika rogaharUbATa grasta pArera sajAya diyauM tAki tinIharU AphnA pAlanakartAprati vinamra houn |

43 hAmro prakopa Au~dA tinIharU binamra bhaemA hAmIle tinIharUmAthi kRpA garne thiyauM | tara tinIharU vinamra bhaenan, baru tinIharUko hRdaya jhan kaThora bhayo | tinIharUle pATha lienan | tinIharUle garirahekA kuphra tathA avajJA jastA narAmrA kAryaharUlAI zaitAnale AkarSaka tulyAidiyo | ani tinIharUle nirantara kuphra tathA avajJA nai garirahe |

44 jaba bhayAnaka roga ra ati garibIko kAraNa tinIharUle smaraNa garAiekA kurA birse ra allAhako Adezako pAlanA garenan, taba hAmIle tinIharUkA lAgi sabai jIvIkA tathA sampannatAkA DhokA kholera tathA niko pArera chuTa diyauM, | ani jaba tinIharU pradAna gariekA cijaharUmA khubai magna bhae taba akasmAt tinIharUmAthi hAmro prakopa Ayo ani tinIharU nirAza hun puge |

45 antataH kAphiraharUlAI sarvanAza pArie ra tinIharUko jaro nai kATiyo ani rasUlaharUlAI maddata gariyo | sampUrNa prazaMsAko pAtra mAtra allAha hunuhuncha | uhA~ nai sampUrNa jagatakA pAlanakartA hunuhuncha | jasale zatruharUlAI nAza garnubhayo ra mitraharUlAI sahayoga garnubhayo |

46 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! yI bahudevavAdIharUlAI sodhnuhos– yadi allAhale timIharUko sunne kSamatA khosera bahiro banAunuhunecha, A~khAko jyoti khosera andho banAunuhunecha ra timrA hRdayaharUmA mohara lagAidinuhanecha jasale gardA timIharU cintana manan garna sakdainau bhane allAha bAheka kuna upAsyale timIharUlAI tyo phirtA dina sakcha? he nabI (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! vicAra garnuhos, hAmI kasarI vibhinna tarikAle pramANaharU varNana garchauM taipani tinIharU bevAstA garchan |

47 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) yinIharUlAI bhanidinuhos– malAI batAU, yadi timIharUmAthi allAhako prakopa akasmAt vA spaSTa rUpamA khullama-khullA Aipugyo bhane tyasale allAhako inkAra garera tathA rasUlaharUlAI jhUTo Thahara garera atyAcAra garekAharUlAI mAtra naSTa pArnecha |

48 hAmIle rasUlaharUlAI ImAna lyAune tathA AjJApAlana garneharUlAI sadhaiM rahane varadAnako zubhasUcanA dinevAlA banAera ra kAphira tathA avajJAkArIharUlAI Aphno kaDA yAtanAbATa saceta garnevAlA banAera paThAyauM | rasUlaharUmAthi ImAna lyAune tathA satkarma garneharUkA lAgi AkhiratamA kunai Dara hune chaina | duniyA~mA unIharUle je jati sAMsArika aMza gumAe tyasaprati cintita hune chainan |
49 jasale hAmrA Ayata (nizAnI) harUlAI jhUTo Thahara gare ra hAmro avajJA gare | tinIharUmAthi prakopa AilAgnecha |

50 he rasUla (sallalalAhu alaihi va sallama)! yI bahudevavAdIharUlAI bhannuhos– masita allAhako khajAnA cha, jasalAI ma jasarI cAhanchu prayoga garchu bhanne kurAko ma timIharUsa~ga dAbI gardina | ma yo pani bhandina- malAI gaiba (parokSa) ko jJAna cha, sivAya tI vahI (prakAzanA) ko bAremA jasabATa allAhale malAI sUcita garnubhaeko cha | ma yo pani bhandina- ma phariztAharUmadhye euTA phariztA hu~ | ma mAtra allAhako rasUla hu~ | ma yasto kurAko dAbI gardina jo masa~ga chaina | tyasa prakAzanAko anusaraNa mAtra garchu juna mamAthi avatarita garincha | he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) bhanidinuhos– ke satyalAI dekhna na sakne kAphira ra satyalAI dekhne tathA tyasamA ImAnarAkhne momina samAna huna sakchan? he bahudevavAdIharU ho! ke timIharU AphnA varipari rahekA nizAnIharUmA vicAra gardainau?

51 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! tapAIM yasa kurAnadvArA tI mAnisaharUlAI DarAunuhos, jo mahApralayako dina AphnA pAlanakartA samakSa ekatrita garinebATa DarAu~chan | tinIharUkA lAgi allAha bAheka kohI saMrakSaka chaina, jasale tinIharUlAI phAidA puryAos, kohI siphArisakartA pani chaina jasale hAnibATa jogAos | zAyada, tinIharUle allAhakA AdezaharUko pAlanA garera tathA varjita kAryalAI tyAgera uhA~sa~ga DarAune chan | yastA mAnisaharU nai kurAnabATa phAidA uThAune chan |

52 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! zIrSa bahudevavAdIharUlAI AphUtarpha AkarSita garnako lAgi yI gariba muslimaharUlAI Apano sabhAbATa TADhA narAkhnuhos, jo bihAna ra sA~jha pAbandIkA sAtha allAhako upAsanA garchan | yinIharUko kunai pani hisAba na tapAIMmAthi cha, na tapAIMko kunai hisAba yinIharUmAthi cha | yinIharUko hisAba yinIharUko pAlanakartAle dinuhunecha | yadi tapAIMle yinIharUlAI Aphno sabhAbATa TADhA pArnubhayo bhane tapAIM sImA ullaGghana garneharUmadhye bannuhunecha |

53 yasarI hAmIle timIharUmadhye ekalAI dhanI ra arkolAI gariba banAera jA~cekAchauM | tAki dhani kAphiraharUle gariba muslimaharUlAI bhanun – ke hAmIharUbIca yinai garibaharU hun jasalAI allAhale mArgadarzana garera hAmIharUmAthi prAthamikatA dinubhayo? yadi ImAna rAmro vastu bhaeko bhae yinIharU bhandA pahilA hAmI aMgAlne thiyauM | ke allAha Aphno rAmro bhaktalAI jAnnuhunna? ani allAhale unIharUlAI ImAna lyAune tauphIka deun | ke allAha kAphiraharUlAI jAnnuhunna ki tinIharUlAI beijjata garun ani tinIharUle ImAna na lyAun?! kina nahunu, allAha tinIharUlAI rAmrarI jAnnuhuncha |

54 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! jaba tapAIMsamakSa hAmrA Ayata (nizAnI) harUmAthi AsthA rAkhneharU Au~chan, taba tinIharUkA sammAnako lAgi tinIharUlAI salAma bhannuhos ra allAhako mahAna kRpAko zubhasUcanA dinuhos | allAhale AphUmAthi kRpAlAI anivArya garnubhaeko cha | timIharUmadhye kasaile najAnIkana vA galtIle kukarma garyo ra tyasapachi taubA garyo ani sudhAra garyo bhane allAhale unIharUlAI mApha garnuhunecha, uhA~ ati kSamAzIla evaM parama dayAlu hunuhuncha |

55 yasarI hAmIle Ayata (nizAnI) harU asatyavAdIharUkA lAgi khulasta rUpamA varNana garchauM, aparAdhIharUkA tarikAlAI spaSTa pArchauM tAki timIharU tyasabATa sAvadhAna rahana saka ra tyasto kArya nagara |

56 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! tinIharUlAI bhannuhos- allAha bAheka timIharU jasako bhakti garchau tyasako bhaktibATa merA pAlanakartAle malAI manAhI garnubhaeko cha | he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! bhanidinuhos- allAha bAheka anya kasaiko bhaktibAre ma timIharUko icchAko anusaraNa gardina, yadi maile yasabAremA timIharUko icchAko anusaraNa gare bhane ma pathabhraSTa hunchu ra sIdhA mArga pAuna sakdina | jasale pani icchAko anusaraNa garcha, usako yahI avasthA huncha |

57 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! yI bahudevavAdIharUlAI bhannuhos- allAhale malAI spaSTa pramANa pradAna garnubhaeko cha, ma icchAko anusaraNa gardina | timIharUle yasa pramANalAI jhUTo Thahara garekA chau | timIharU juna prakopako lAgi hatAra gardaichau ra jasto khAle camatkArako mAga gardaichau tyo mero hAtamA chaina baru allAhako hAtamA cha | sabai sattA zAsana mAtra allAhako hAtamA cha | uhA~ satya bhannuhuncha ra tyahI anusAra zAsana garnuhuncha | uhA~ nai asatyavAdIbATa satyavAdIlAI chuTyAunuhuncha |

58 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! yinIharUlAI bhanidinuhos- timIharUle hatAra garirAkheko prakopa yadi mero hAtamA bhaeko bhae ma avataraNa garidine thie~ ani timIharU tathA mero bIca nirNaya bhai sakthyo | atyAcArIrUlAI kati mohalata dine ra kahile samAtne bhanne kurA uhA~ rAmrarI jAnnuhancha |

59 allAhasa~ga mAtra rgaiba (parokSa) ko khajAnA cha | uhA~ bAheka arU kasaisa~ga gaibako jJAna chaina | uhA~ thala tathA jalakA sabai janAvara, vanaspati tathA kurAharUlAI jAnnuhuncha | jahA~ pani kunai pAta jharcha, kunai jaminamA jahA~ pani kunai dAnA lukeko huncha, kA~co pAkeko juna sukai vastu chan, tI sabai euTA spaSTa kitAba arthAta lauhe mahaphUja (surakSita pATI) mA lekhieko cha |
