60 sutiraheko belA allAhale timIharUko AtmAharUlAI kehI kSaNako lAgi niyantraNamA linuhuncha | dinamA timIharUle gareko kAryalAI uhA~le rAmrarI jAnnuhuncha | nindrAmA niyantraNamA lieko AtmAlAI allAhale dinamA phirtA garnuhuncha tAki timIharUle kAma garna saka | yahA~samma ki allAhale lekhnubhaeko umeralAI purA garepachi saMsAra choDera jAnchau | mahApralayako dina uhA~le nai punaH jIvita pArnuhunecha ra uhA~sa~ga timIharU bheTnechau | timIharUle duniyA~mA garekA kAryaharUbAre uhA~le sUcita garnuhunecha ra tyasako badalA dinuhunecha |

61 allAha AphnA bhaktaharUmAthi hareka dRSTile sarvocca ra hAvI hunuhuncha | hareka vastu uhA~samakSa natamastaka chan | uhA~ Aphno mahAnatA ra zAna anusAra bhaktaharUbhandA mAthi hunuhuncha | he mAnava ho! timIharUkA karmaharUko lekhA jokhA rAkhnako lAgi uhA~le pratiSThita phariztAharUlAI paThAunuhuncha | umera purA bhaepachi timIharUko AtmAlAI mRtyukA phariztA ra usakA sahayogIharUle niyantraNamA linchan | phariztAharUle Adezako pAlanAmA kunai kamI gardainan |

62 pheri niyantraNamA liiekA AtmAharUlAI tinIharUkA karmako badalA dina vAstavika pAlanakartA allAhatarpha pharkAine cha | uhA~kai Adeza lAgu huncha | uhA~le ekadamai nyAya- nisApha garnuhuncha | uhA~le ekadamai chiTo hisAba linuhunecha |

63 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! yI bahudevavAdIharUlAI bhanidinuhos: thala tathA jalakA andhakAraharUmA AekA khatarAharUbATa kasale jogAu~cha? tyatikhera timIharU allAhalAI nai vAhya tathA gopya rUpamA ati bintIkA sAtha pukArchauH yadi hAmrA pAlanakartAle hAmIlAI yasa khatarAbATa jogAunu huncha bhane hAmI uhA~kA kRpAharUprati ati AbhArI hunechauM ra uhA~ bAheka arU kasaiko bhakti garnechainauM |

64 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) bhanidinuhas- allAhale nai timIharUlAI hareka kisimakA kaThinAi tathA samasyAbATa jogAunuhuncha | tara tyasapachi timIharU jaba khusIko avasthAmA allAhasa~ga arUlAI sAjhedAra banAuna thAlchau | yaso garera timIharU kati ThUlo aparAdha garchau?!

65 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! bhanidinuhos- allAhale timIharUtira mAthibATa; DhuDgA, caTyAGa, hAvAhurI vA munibATa bhUkampa, pahiro ityAdi jastA prakopa paThAuna sakne sAmarthya rAkhnuhuncha | vA timIharUko hRdayaharUmA matabheda utpanna garna saknuhuncha | ani timIharUmadhye sabaile A-AphnA icchAko anusaraNa garnechan ani eka arkAsa~ga yuddha garnechan | he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! vicAra garnuhos- hAmI kasarI vibhinna tarikAle vibhinna pramANaharU bayAna garchauM ra spaSTa pArchauM tAki tinIharUle yo kurA bujhun ki tapAIMle lyAunubhaeko dharma satya ho ra tinIharUle mAndai Aeko dharma galata ho |

66 tapAIMkA samudAyale yasa kurAnalAI jhUTo Thahara garyo jabaki yo kurAna allAhako tarphabATa ho bhanne kurAmA kunai zaGkA chaina | he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! bhanidinuhosa- mero jimmevArI timIharUko nigarAnI garne hoina baru timIharUmAthi Aune kaDA prakopabATa DarAune tathA saceta garne ho |
67 hareka kurAko lAgi euTA nizcita samaya tokieko cha | tyasaimadhye timIharUko pariNAma pani ho | jaba timIharU mahApralayako dina jIvita pArera uThAine chau taba cA~Dai nai jAnnechau |

68 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! jaba tapAIM bahudevavAdIharUlAI hAmrA AyataharUko bAremA ThaTTA gardai gareko dekhnuhuncha, taba tinIharUbATa TADhA bhai hAlnus yahA~samma ki khillI uDAuna choDera anya kurAharUmA vyasta hunchan | yadi tapAIMlAI zaitAnale birsAidincha ra tapAIM tinIharUsa~ga basnubhayo bhane yAda Auna bittikai tinIharUko sabhAbATa niski hAlnuhos ra tI atyAcArIharUsa~ga kahilyai na basnuhos |

69 jo mAnisaharU allAhakA AdezaharUlAI pAlanA garera tathA varjita kAryaharUlAI tyAgera uhA~sa~ga DarAu~chan, unIharUsita yI atyAcArIharUko bAremA sodhapucha hunechaina | unIharUko jimmedArI tI atyAcArIharUlAI duSkarma garnabATa manAhI ho | tAki tinIharU allAhasa~ga Darun ani uhA~kA AdezaharUko pAlanA garun ra uhA~le manAhI garnubhaekA kAryaharUlAI tyAgun |

70 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! yI bahudevavAdIharUlAI choDidinuhos, jasale AphnA dharmalAI khela ThaTTA banAekA chan | saMsArako kSaNika mojamastIle tinIharUlAI dhokAmA pAreko cha | he nabI (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! mAnisaharUlAI kurAnadvArA upadeza di~dai rahanuhos, tAki kohI pani AphUle gareko pApako kAraNale vinAzako zikAra nahos | yasto avasthAmA allAha bAheka kohI sahayogI tathA maddatagAra hunechaina jasasa~ga usale maddata mAgna sakos, ra usalAI kayAmatako yAtanAbATa bacAuna sakne kunai siphArisakartA pani hunechaina | yAtanAbATa mukti pAuna usale jati pani artha-daNDa diepani tyo svIkArya hunechaina | yinIharU nai hun jasale Aphnai pApako kAraNale AphUlAI mahApralayako dina vinAzamA hAlekA chan | tinIharUko kuphrako kAraNale tinIharUlAI ati umliraheko pAnI pilAinecha ra pIDAdAyI yAtanA diinecha |

71 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! yI bahudevavAdIharUlAI bhanidinuhos- ke hAmI allAhalAI choDera yasto mUrtiharUko pUjA garauM jasale na ta kunai phAidA puryAuna sakchan na hAni nai? ke allAhale pradAna garnubhaeko ImAnalAI tyAgera zaitAnale pathabhraSTa pArekA mAncheharU jastai banauM? jo bATo birAera yatAutA bhaTakirahekA chan, jabaki sIdhA mArgamA rahekA usakA sAthIharU satyatarpha bolAu~dai chan, tara usale javAphai diiraheko chaina | he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! tinIharUlAI bhannuhos- vAstavika mArgadarzana ta allAhako mArgadarzana ho | hAmIlAI eka allAhamAthi ImAna lyAune, uhA~prati AtmasamarpaNa garne ra uhA~ko mAtra upAsanA garne Adeza diieko cha | uhA~ sampUrNa jagatakA pAlanakartA hunuhuncha |

72 allAhale hAmIharUlAI pUrNarUpamA namAja kAyama garne ra uhA~le dinubhaekA AdezaharUko pAlanA garera tathA varjita kAryaharUlAI tyAgera uhA~sita DarAune Adeza dinubhaeko cha | mahApralayako dina bhaktaharUlAI unIharUkA karmaharUko badalA dinako lAgi allAha samakSa nai jammA garinecha |

73 allAhale nai AkAzaharU tathA pRthvIlAI satyakA sAtha sRSTi garnubhayo | tyasa dina allAhale juna sukai vastulAI bhannuhunecha bhaihAla, tyo bhaihAlne cha | mahApralayako dina jaba allAhale unIharUlAI jIvita hoU bhannuhunecha taba unIharU turuntai jIvita bhaera ubhinechan | uhA~ko kurA satya ho, jo avazya nai hunecha | mahApralayako dina tyatikhera sabai zAsana uhA~ kai hAtamA hunecha, jaba isrAphIla (alaihissalAma) le dosro paTaka zaMkha phuknechan | dekhine tathA nadekhine duvai kisimakA kurAharUkA jJAtA uhA~ nai hunuhuncha | sRSTi garna tathA kArya saJcAlanamA uhA~ tatvadarzI hunuhuncha, uhA~ susUcita hunuhuncha, kunai pani vastu uhA~bATa lukeko chaina | sabai kisimakA lukekA mAmilAharU pani uhA~le spaSTa dekhnuhuncha |

74 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! yAda garnuhos, jaba ibrAhIma (alaihissalAma) le Aphno bahudevavAdI pitA AjaralAI bhane: he merA buvA! ke tapAIM allAhalAI choDera mUrtiharUko pUjA garnuhuncha?! ma ta tapAIMlAI tathA mUrti pUjA garne tapAIMkA samudAyalAI spaSTa rUpale pathabhraSTa bhaeko ra sIdhA mArgabATa haTeko dekhdachu | jabaki allAha mAtra vAstavika pUjya hunuhuncha ra uhA~ bAheka jasako pani pUjA garincha tI sabai asatya pUjya hun |

75 jasarI hAmIle ibrAhIma (alaihissalAma) lAI unakA buvA tathA unako samudAyakA pathabhraSTatA dekhAyauM, tyasarI nai unalAI AkAzaharU tathA pRthvIkA vizAla rAjya-vyavasthA pani dekhAyauM, tAki unI svayam pani yasamA vizvAsa garun ra arU samakSa pani pramANita garun ki allAha eka mAtra hunuhuncha, uhA~ nai bhakti yogya hunuhuncha, uhA~sa~ga kohI sAjhedAra chaina ra uhA~ sabai kArya garne sAmarthya rAkhnuhuncha |

76 jaba rAtako a~dhyAro chAyo taba unale euTA tArA dekhera bhane– yo mero Izvara ho | ani jaba tyo bepattA bhayo taba unale bhane– ma bepattA hune vastulAI mana parAu~dina kinabhane vAstavika Izvara sadhaiM rahirahancha ra kahilyai bepattA hu~daina |

77 jaba unale udAu~do candramA dekhe taba bhane– yahI mero Izvara ho | ani, jaba tyo pani bepattA bhayo taba unale bhane– merA pAlanakartAle malAI mAtra eka allAhamAthi ImAna tathA uhA~ko bhakti garne mArgadarzana nagareko bhae nizcaya nai ma satya dharmabATa TADhA hune thie~ |

78 jaba unale udAu~do sUryalAI dekhe taba bhane– yo udAu~do sUrya mero raba (prabhu) ho | yo tArA tathA candramAbhandA ThUlo cha | jaba tyo pani astAyo taba unale bhane– he merA samudAyakA dAjubhAiharU ho! juna kurAharUlAI timIharU allAhasa~ga sAjhedAra banAu~chau tI sabaibATa mero kunai sarokAra chaina |

jaba unale allAhabAheka jhUTA pUjyaharUsa~ga kunai sarokAra nabhaeko ghoSaNA gare taba mAnauM unakA samudAyakA mAnisaharUle sodhe- ani kasako bhakti garne ta? unale bhane–
79 maile Aphno dharmalAI ekAgra bhaera mAtra tyasa allAhako lAgi khAsa gareM, jasale binA kunai aghillA udAharaNa AkAzaharU tathA pRthvIko sRSTi garnubhayo | ma zirka (allAhasa~ga arUlAI sAjhedAra ) garne kArya choDera tauhIda (ekezvaravAda) tarpha pharkeM | ma kadApi muzrikaharUmadhye hoina, jo allAhasa~ga arUko pUjA pani garchan |

80 unakA samudAyakA bahudevavAdI mAnisaharUle unIsa~ga eka allAhako mAtra bhaktiko bAremA vAdavivAda garna thAle ra unalAI AphnA mUrtIharUko Dara dekhAe | ani ibrAhIma (alaihissalAma) le javApha die– ke timIharU masa~ga allAha ekamAtra satya pUjya hunuhuncha ra uhA~ko bhakti mAtra garnuparcha bhanne kurAmA vAdavivAda garchau? ma uhA~ko kRpAle uhA~ko bhakti gardaichu?! ma timIharUko mUrtIharUbATa DarAu~dina kinabhane tinIharU allAhako cAhanAbinA kunai kisimako hAni vA lAbha puryAune sAmarthya rAkhdainan | allAhale je cAhanuhuncha tyahI huncha | sabai kurAharU allAhako jJAnamA cha | pRthvI tathA AkAzamA kunai pani vastu uhA~bATa lukeko chaina | he merA samudAyaharU ho! ke timIharU yasa kurAlAI bujhdainau ki timI eka allAhako inkAra gardaichau ra uhA~sa~ga sAjhedAra Thahara gardaichau? ataH timIharU mAtra eka allAhamAthi ImAna lyAU |

81 ma timIharUle pUjA garne mUrtIharUsa~ga kina ra kasarI DarAU~ jabaki timIharU allAhasa~ga tI cIjaharUlAI sAjhedAra banAuna DarAu~dainau jasalAI uhA~le nai sRSTi garnubhaeko cha ra jasako upAsanA garne kunai pramANa allAhale timIharUmAthi avataraNa garnubhaeko chaina?! ani duvai samUha ekezvaravAdIko samUha tathA bahudevavAdIharUmadhye ko baDhI amana zAntiko hakadAra ho? timIharU juna samUhalAI baDhI hakadAra ThAndachau tyasaiko anusaraNa gara | eka allAhamAthi AsthA rAkhne jamAta nai zAntikA baDhI hakadAra chan bhanne kurAmA kunai zaGkA chaina |

82 jo mAnisaharUle allAhamAthi ImAna lyAe, uhA~bATa avatarita zarIata (islAmI kAnuna) ko anusaraNa gare ra Aphno ImAnamA zirka misAenan, unIharUkA lAgi sukha ra zAnti cha | unIharU nai satyamArgI chan |

83 yo hAmro tyo tarka ra pramANa ho, jo hAmIle ibrAhIma (alaihissalAma) lAI unakA samudAyakA mAnisaharU viruddha pradAna garyauM | tyo tarka allAhako yo bhanAi hoH (kuna samUha zAntiko baDhI hakadAra ho) | yasa tarkale gardA ibrAhIma (alaihissalAma) AphnA samudAyakA mAnisaharUmAthi vijayI bhae | yasa tarkadvArA hAmIle ibrAhIma (alaihissalAma) lAI unakA samudAyasa~ga vAdavivAda garne zakti pradAna garyauM | hAmI jasalAI cAhanchauM tyasako loka ra paralokakA darjA ucca pArdachauM | he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! nissandeha tapAIMkA pAlanakartA sRSTi garna tathA kArya saJcAlanamA tatvadarzI hunuhuncha ra bhaktaharUbAre sabai thoka jJAna rAkhnuhuncha |

84 hAmIle ibrAhIma (alaihissalAma) lAI chorA ishAka tathA nAtI yAkUba pradAna garyauM | unIharU sabailAI sIdhA mArga dekhAyauM | yasaaghi hAmIle nUha (alaihissalAma) lAI pani sIdhA mArga dekhAyauM, unakA santAnaharUmadhye dAUda, unakA chorA sulaimAna, ayyUba, yUsupha, mUsA evaM hArUna (alaihimussalAma) lAI pani sIdhA mArga dekhAyauM | jasarI hAmIle yI sandeSTAharUlAI unIharUkA sukarmako badalA diyauM tyasarI nai hAmIle anya sukarmIharUlAI pani unIharUkA sukarmako badalA dinechauM |
85 hAmIle jakariyyA, yahayA, IsA tathA ilyAsa (alaihimussalAma) lAI pani satmArga dekhAyauM | yI sabai sandeSTAharU satkarmIharUmadhye thie jasalAI hAmIle sandeSTA banAuna chanoTa garekA thiyauM |

86 hAmIle ismAIla, al–yasaa, yUnusa ra lUta (alaihimussalAma) lAI pani satmArga dekhAyauM | muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) lAI sabaibhandA ucca darjA pradAna garyau | unIharU sabailAI hAmIle saMsAra bAsIharUmAthi prAthamikatA pradAna garyauM |

87 hAmIle unIharUkA kehI pUrvaja, kehI santAna tathA kehI dAjubhAiharUlAI satmArga dekhAyauM, sandeSTA banAuna cayana garyau ra sIdhA mArgamA hi~DAyauM, jo allAhalAI eka mAnne tathA uhA~ kai bhakti garne mArga ho |

88 yo allAhako mArgadarzana tathA kRpA ho | uhA~le AphnA bhaktaharUmadhye jasalAI cAhanuhuncha satmArga pradAna garnuhuncha | yadi yinIharUle pani zirka (allAhasa~ga kasailAI sAjhedAra Thahara) gareko bhae yinIharUkA sabai satkarmaharU vyartha hune thie |

89 yI ullekhita sandeSTAharU hun jasalAI hAmIle kitAba, bauddhikatA tathA dUtatva (nabUvata) pradAna garyauM | yadi tapAIMkA samudAyale ukta tInavaTA kurAharUko inkAra garchan bhane hAmIle tyasa mArgadarzanako lAgi yastA mAnisaharU cayana garnechauM jo inkAra garnevAlA hune chainan baru ImAna lyAunevAlA ra tyasalAI bala pUrvaka samAtnevAlA hunechan | unIharU nai hun muhAjira (apravAsI), ansAra (maddata garne madInA bAsIharU) tathA mahApralayasamma Aune mAnisaharUmadhye rAmro DhaMgale unIharUko anusaraNa garneharU |

90 yI ullekhita sandeSTAharU tathA unIharUkA buvAharU, chorAharU tathA dAjubhAiharU nai satmArgamA chan | unIharUko anusaraNa garnuhos ra unIharUbATa dhairya garna siknuhos | he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! bhanidinuhos: ma timIharUsamma yo kurAna puryAe bApata kunai badalA mAgdina | kurAna sabai saMsArakA sabai mAnava tathA jinnako lAgi upadeza ho tAki tinIharU tyasabATa sIdhA tathA sahI mArga pAuna sakun |

91 bahudevavAdIharUle allAhako sahI kadara garenan, jaba tinIharUle allAhakA nabI (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) lAI bhane– allAhale kunai manuSyamAthi kunai vahI (prakAzanA) avataraNa garnubhaeko chaina | he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! unIharUlAI sodhnuhos– mUsA (alaihissalAma) mAthi taurAta kasale avataraNa garnubhayo jo unakA samudAyakA lAgi prakAza, mArgadarzana tathA nirdezana thiyo? jasalAI yahUdIharUle alaga alaga pAnAharUmA rAkhekA chan, jasamadhye Aphno icchA anusAra rahekA kurAlAI vyakta garchan tara icchA viparIta kurAlAI lukAu~chan, jastai muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) ko bAremA varNana bhaekA kurAharU | he araba bAsIharU ho! timIharUlAI kurAnako yasto zikSA diieko cha jo yasaaghi na ta timIharUlAI thAhA thiyo na ta timIharUkA pUrvajaharUlAI nai | he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) bhanidinuhos- yasalAI allAhale avataraNa garnubhayo | tinIharUlAI vizvAsa nahunjela tinIharUkai ajJAnatA tathA pathabhraSTatAmA magna choDidinuhos |

92 he nabI (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! hAmIle tapAIMmAthi avatarita gareko yo barakatayukta (maGgalamaya) kitAba ho | jo yasabhandA pahilekA AkAzIya kitAbaharUko puSTi gardacha | tapAIMle yasabATa makkAbAsI tathA pUrva tathA pazcima cAraitira phailiekA sabai mAnisaharUlAI DarAunuhos, yahA~samma ki tinIharU mArgadarzana pAun | juna mAnisaharU Akhirata (paraloka) mAthi ImAna rAkhdachan unIharU yasa kurAnamAthi pani ImAna rAkhdachan, yasakA zikSA anusAra karma gardachan ra pharja (anivArya), sunnata tathA naphila (ecchika) namAjaharU samayamA ra batAieko tarikA anusAra kAyama gardachan |

93 yasto vyakti sabaibhandA ThUlo atyAcArI ho, jasale allAhamAthi jhUTo Aropa lagAu~dai bhandachaH allAhale mAnavamAthi kunai vahI avataraNa garnubhaeko chaina | vA yo jhUTo kurA bhanchaH allAhale mamAthi vahI (prakAzanA) avataraNa garnubhaeko cha, jabaki allAhale usamAthi kunai vahI avataraNa garnubhaeko chaina | vA U bhancha– jasarI allAhale kurAna avataraNa garnubhayo tyasarI ma pani kitAba avatarita garna sakchu | he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! tapAIMle tyo samaya herna pAune bhae jaba atyAcArIharU mRtyuvaraNamA hune chan ra phariztAharU hAtale tinIharUlAI yAtanA diMdai tathA hirkAu~dai kaDA zabdamA bhannechan- tyAga AphnA prANaharU, hAmIle tyasalAI niyantraNamA linechauM! Aja timIharUlAI apamAnajanaka yAtanA diinecha | kinabhane timIharUle IzadUta banne tathA allAhale vahI avatarita garne jhaiM vahI avatarita garna sakne dAbI garera allAha viruddha asatya kurA bhanyau ra ghamaNDale gardA allAhakA Ayata (nizAnI) harUle jhUTo Thahara garyau | yadi tapAIMle dekhnuhuncha bhane ati bhayAnaka dRzya dekhnuhuncha |

94 mahApralayako dina tinIharUlAI bhaninecha– Aja timIharU hAmI samakSa eklai upasthita bhaekA chau, binA dhanasampatti tathA pada, jasarI hAmIle timIharUlAI surumA binA vastra tathA khAlI khuTTA ra binA khatnA sRSTi garekA thiyauM | hAmIle timIharUlAI je pradAna garekA thiyauM tyo AphUpachi duniyA~mA choDera AekA chau | hAmIle timIharUsa~ga timrA tI pUjya iSTadekha, tathA IzvaraharUlAI pani dekhirahekA chainauM jasalAI timIharUle madhyasthakartA tathA bhaktimA allAhakA sAjhedAra ThAnekA thiyau | timIharUko sampUrNa sambandha viccheda bhayo ra tinIharU siphArisakartA tathA allAhakA sAjhedAra hun bhanne timIharUko dAbI pani samApta bhayo |

95 allAhale nai annakA dAnA phoDera bAlIharU ra geDAharUlAI phoDera khajura, aGgura ityAdikA rukha nikAlnuhuncha | uhA~le nai nirjIvabATa sajIva arthAta viryabATa mAnava tathA sabai janAvaraharU ra sajIvabATa nirjIva; mAnavabATa virya tathA kukhurIbATa phula nikAlnuhuncha | he bahudevavAdIharU ho! yI sampUrNa kAryaharU allAhale nai garnuhuncha, jasale timIharUlAI pani sRSTi garnubhayo | timIharU allAhakA yI kAryaharU dekhera pani kina satyabATa vimukha hu~daichau?!

96 allAhale nai rAtako andhakAralAI toDera bihAniko prakAza nikAlnuhuncha | uhA~le nai rAtalAI mAnisaharUkA lAgi ArAmako samaya banAunubhayo, jasamA unIharU dinako thakAi samApta pArna ArAma garchan | uhA~le nai sUrya tathA candramAlAI nirdhArita gati ra paridhimA calne Adeza dinubhayo | yI sabai allAhale banAunubhayo jo zaktizAlI hunuhuncha jasamAthi kohI vijayI huna sakdaina tathA Aphno sRSTiko bAremA sarvajJa hunuhuncha |

97 he AdamakA santAna ho! uhA~le timIharUkA lAgi AkAzamA tArAharUlAI banAunubhayo tAki timIharU thala tathA jalamA bATo birAemA mArga pattA lagAuna saka | hAmIle yastA mAnisaharUkA lAgi pramANaharU praSTasa~ga bayAna garidiekA chauM, jo tyasamA cintana manan garchan ra tyasabATa phAidA uThAu~chan |

98 allAha nai hunuhuncha, jasale timIharUlAI eka janA vyakti (Adama alaihissalAma) bATa sRSTi garnubhayo | sarvaprathama allAhale Adama (alaihissalAma) lAI mATobATa banAunubhayo ani unIbATa timIharUlAI sRSTi garnubhayo | AmAko garbhalAI timIharUkA lAgi euTA prArambhika ghara banAunubhayo | buvAkA piThyU~lAI timIharUkA lAgi aDine ThAu~ banAunubhayo | hAmIle yastA mAnisaharUkA lAgi nizAnIharU praSTasa~ga bayAna garekAchauM jo allAhakA bhanAilAI bujhdachan |

99 allAha nai hunuhuncha, jasale AkAzabATa varSA barsAunubhayo ra tyasapachi uhA~le tyasabATa hareka kisimakA banaspati umArnubhayo | ani, hAmIle tyasabATa hariyA rukha–viruvAharU umAryauM, jasabATa dAnAharU umAryau juna eka ApasamA gAbhiekA hunchan | hA~gAharUmA jhuNDiekA khajurakA jhuppAharU umAryauM, jasalAI ubhiekA ra basekA mAnisaharU sajilai Tipna sakchan | aMgurakA bagaiMcAharU banAyauM | jaitUna tathA anAra umAryauM jasakA pAtaharU mildA juldA hunchan ra jasakA phalaharU bhinna bhinna hunchan | he mAnava ho! yI sabaikA phala hera jaba tI phalchan ra jaba pAkchan | nissandeha allAhamAthi ImAnarAkhne mAnisaharUkA lAgi spaSTa pramANaharU chan | kinabhane unIharU nai yastA pramANaharUbATa phAidA uThAu~chan |

100 jinnaharUle lAbha tathA hAni puryAuna sakchan bhanne AsthA rAkhera bahudevavAdIharUle allAhako bhaktimA jinnaharUlAI sAjhedAra Thahara gare | yadyapi allAhale nai jinnaharUlAI sRSTi garnubhayo ra jinnaharUle kasailAI sRSTi garekA chainan | ataH allAha nai bhaktikA hakadAra hunuhuncha | tinIharUle allAhakA santAna chan bhanne kurA race | jastai yahUdIharUle ujaira (alaihissalAma) lAI, IsAIharUle IsA (alaihissalAma) lAI ra bahudevavAdIharUle phariztAharUlAI allAhakA santAna Thahara gare | asatyavAdIharUle gaDheko kurAbATa allAha pavitra tathA ucca hunuhuncha |

101 allAhale nai pahileko kunai namunA binA AkAzaharU evaM pRthvIlAI sRSTi garnubhayo | uhA~ko choro kasarI huna sakcha jabaki uhA~ko patnI chainin? uhA~le nai sabai cijaharU sRSTi garnubhayo | uhA~ hareka vastukA jJAtA hunuhuncha | uhA~bATa kunai pani vastu lukeko chaina |

102 he mAnavaharU ho! yI guNaharU bhaekA allAha nai timIharUkA pAlanakartA hunuhuncha | uhA~ bAheka kohI pani timIharUkA pAlanakartA tathA upAsya chaina | uhA~ sabai cijakA sRSTikartA hunuhuncha | ataH timIharU uhA~kai bhakti gara | uhA~ mAtra bhakti yogya hunuhuncha | uhA~ sabai vastukA rakSaka hunuhuncha |
103 A~khAharUle uhA~lAI dekhna sakdainan tara uhA~le A~khAharUlAI dekhnuhuncha | uhA~ AphnA satkarmI bhaktaharUlAI sUkSmarUpamA dekhnuhuncha tathA unIharUbAre khabara rAkhnuhuncha |

104 he mAnavaharU ho! nizcaya nai timIharUsamakSa timrA pAlanakartAko tarphabATa spaSTa pramANaharU AisakekA chan | ani jasale viveka prayoga garcha tyasako phAidA usailAI hunecha | tara jo andho bancha ra viveka prayoga gardaina tyasako hAni usailAI hunecha | timIharUkA karmaharUko ‌hisAba kitAba rAkhne ma kunai saMrakSaka hoina | ma ta Aphno pAlanakartAko tarphabATa rasUla mAtra hu~ | uhA~ timIharUmAthi nigarAnI rAkhnuhuncha |

105 jasarI hAmIle allAhako zaktikA vibhinna pramANaharU varNana garyauM, tyasarI nai hAmIle vibhinna tarikAle vAcA, dhamkI ra upadezabAre AphnA Ayata (nizAnI) harU varNana garnechauM | bahudevavAdIharUle cA~Dai nai bhannechan- yo vahI (prakAzanA) hoina, yo ta timIle pahilAkA yahUdI ra IsAIbATa sikekA hau | hAmI muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) kA samudAya mominaharUkA lAgi vibhinna pramANaharU tathA nizAnIharU bayAna garchauM tAki satyalAI yinIharUsamakSa spaSTa pArauM | kinabhane unIharU satyalAI svIkAra garchan ra tyasako anusaraNa garchan |

106 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! tapAIM pAlanakartAko tarphabATa avatarita vahI (prakAzanA) ko anusaraNa garnuhos | uhA~ bAheka kohI pUjya chaina | tapAIM kAphiraharU tathA tinIharUkA zatrutAko cintA nalinuhos | tinIharUkA mAmilA allAhako hAtamA cha |

107 yadi allAhale cAhanubhaeko bhae tinIharUle zirka garne thienan | he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! hAmIle tapAIMlAI tinIharUmAthi saMrakSaka tainAta garekA chainauM | tapAIMle tinIharUkA karmaharUko lekhAjokhA rAkhnu pardaina | tapAIM tinIharUkA caukIdAra hunuhunna | tapAIM ta mAtra rasUla hunuhuncha | tapAIMko jimmevArI ta tinIharUsamakSa islAmako sandeza puryAune mAtra ho |

108 he mominaharU ho! bahudevavAdIharUle pUjA garne mUrtIharUlAI gAlI nagara | yadyapi tI mUrtIharU ati tuccha chan ra gAlI garne yogya chan | tAki bahudevavAdIharUle sImA ullaGghana gardai ajJAnatAvaza allAhalAI gAlI na garun | jasarI hAmIle yasa samudAyako lAgi tinIharUkA pathabhraSTatAlAI AkarSaka banAekAchauM tyasarI nai hareka samudAyako lAgi tinako karmalAI AkarSaka banAekA thiyauM, cAhe tinIharUkA karmaharU rAmrA houn vA narAmrA | tinIharUle tI kAryaharU gare jo tinIharUlAI AkarSaka lAgyo | mahApralayako dina tinIharU tinakA pAlanakartAkahA~ nai pharkera jAnechan | taba uhA~le tinIharUlAI duniyA~mA garekA karmabAre batAunuhunecha ra tyasako badalA dinuhunecha |

109 bahudevavAdIharU allAhako pakkA kasama khAera bhanchan– yadi muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) le tinIharUko mAga anusAra kunai nizAnI liera Aunuhuncha bhane tinIharUle avazya tyasamAthi ImAna lyAune chan | he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi vasallama)! tinIharUlAI bhanidinuhos– avataraNa garnakA lAgi masa~ga nizAnIharU masa~ga chainan | nizAnIharU ta allAhasa~ga chan, uhA~ jahile cAhanuhunecha avataraNa garnuhunecha | he mominaharU ho! timIharUlAI ke thAhA, tinIharUle mAga gare anusAra jaba yI nizAnIharU Aune chan taba tinIharUle ImAna lyAune chainan | baru AphnA zatrutA tathA inkAramAthi nai kAyama rahanechan, kinabhane tinIharU mArgadarzana cAhadainan |

110 hAmIle tinIharUkA hRdaya tathA A~khAharU ra mArgadarzanabIca pardA hAlera tinIharUkA hRdaya ra A~khAharUlAI pheri dinechauM | jasarI hAmIle pahilo palTa tinIharU ra kurAnamAthi ImAna lyAunubIca tinIharUko zatrutAko kAraNale pardA hAlyauM | hAmIle tinIharUlAI tinIharUko pathabhraSTatA ra uddaNDatAmA nai barAli rahana choDidinechauM |

111 yadi hAmIle tinIharUko mAga anusAra phariztAharU paThAI dinthyauM ani tinIharUle Aphnai A~khAle dekhthe, mRtaharUle tinIharUsa~ga kurAkAnI sameta garthe, tapAIMle lyAunubhaeko sandezako puSTi garthe ra unIharUkA sampUrNa mAgaharU purA garidinthe, taipani yI bahudevavAdIharU ImAna lyAune thienan | yadi allAhale cAhanubhaeko bhae tinIharUle mArgadarzana pAune thie | tara, tinIharUmadhye adhikAMza ajJAnI chan | tinIharU mArgadarzanako lAgi allAhatarpha pharkadainan |

112 jasarI hAmIle bahudevavAdIharUko zatrutAdvArA tapAIMko parIkSA liyauM tyasarI nai hAmIle pratyeka sandeSTAko parIkSA liyauM | ani hAmIle tinIharUmadhye pratyekakA lAgi ghamaNDI manuSya tathA jinnamadhyekA zaitAnaharUlAI zatru banAekA thiyauM jasale eka arkAlAI gopya parAmarza dine garthe ra unIharUlAI dhokA dinako lAgi asatyalAI AkarSaka banAera peza garne garthe | allAhale cAhanu bhaemA tinIharUle tyasto garne thienan | tara tinIharUko parIkSAko lAgi allAhale tyo cAhanubhayo | ataH tinIharUlAI ra tinIharUle gaDhekA asatya tathA kuphralAI choDidinuhos |

113 tAki AkhiratamAthi AsthA narAkhneharUkA mana-mastiSkaharU tI kurAharUtarpha AkarSita rahun, jo eka arkAko manamA hAlchan | tAki tinIharUle tI kurAharUlAI Aphno lAgi svIkAra garun, tyasaimA khusI rahun tathA tinIharUle garne pApaharUmA yinIharU pani lipta houn |

114 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! allAhasa~ga arUko bhakti garne bahudevavAdIharUlAI bhanidinuhos- ke ma Aphno tathA timIharUbIca allAhabAheka arU kunai nirNAyaka khoju~? jabaki uhA~le nai timIharUtarpha vistRta rUpamA sabai kurAharU varNana garne kurAna avataraNa garnubhaeko cha | tapAIMmAthi avatarita kurAna satya ho bhanne kurA taurAta pAekA yahUdIharU tathA injIla pAekA IsAIharUle pani jAndachan | tinIharUle yasabAremA pramANa pani AphnA kitAbaharUmA pAekA chan | ataH hAmIle avataraNa gareko kurAmA tapAIM kadApi zaMkA garneharUmadhye na bannuhos |

115 kurAnale bhaneko kurA tathA dieko sUcanA nitAnta satya ho | yasamA rahekA vANIharU kasaile pani parivartana garna sakdainan | allAhale AphnA bhaktaharUko kurA sunnuhuncha tathA jAnnuhuncha | jasale pani uhA~kA vANIharUmA pherabadala garne prayAsa garcha, usalAI uhA~le cA~Dai nai sajAya dinuhunecha |

116 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! yadi tapAIMle adhikAMza mAnisaharUko AjJApAlana garna khojnubhayo bhane tinIharUle tapAIMlAI allAhako dharmabATa pathabhraSTa pArnechan | satyako anusaraNa garneharU sadhaiM alpa saMkhyAmA hunchan bhanne kurA allAhako tarikA nai raha~dai Aeko cha | adhikAMza mAnisaharU binA AdhAra anumAnakai bharamA anusaraNa garchan | jasto tinIharUko yo anumAna- tinIharUkA pUjyaharUle tinalAI allAhako najika pArchan | yasa bAremA tinIharU jhUTo bolchan |
117 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! tapAIMkA pAlanakartAle pathabhraSTa ra sIdhA mArgamA rahekA mAnisaharUlAI rAmrarI jAnnuhuncha | yasa bAremA kunai pani kurA uhA~bATa lukeko chaina |
118 he mAnava! bismillAha paDhera vadha gariekA janAvaraharUko mAsu khAU, yadi timIharU vAstavamai allAhakA spaSTa pramANaharUmA AsthA rAkhchau bhane |

119 he mominaharU ho! allAhako nAma liera vadha garieko janAvaraharUko mAsu timIharU kina khA~dainau? jabaki timIharUkA lAgi harAma gariekA janAvaraharUko vivaraNa allAhale spaSTa rUpamA batAisaknu bhaeko cha | ataH harAma gariekA janAvaraharU nakhAU | tara bAdhyatAmA pugyau bhane varjita kurAlAI pani AvazyakatA anusAra khAna sakincha | adhikAMza bahudevavAdIharU AphnA anuyAyIharUlAI narAmrA vicAra tathA ajJAnatAle gardA satyabATa TADhA pAridinchan | ani harAma gariekA janAvaraharUlAI tinIharUle halAla garidinchan, jastai mRta janAvara ityAdilAI | halAla gariekA janAvaraharUlAI harAma garidinchan, jastai bahIrA, vasIlA, hAmI ityAdilAI | he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! nissandeha tapAIMkA pAlanakartA sImA ullaGghana garneharUlAI rAmrarI jAnnuhuncha ra uhA~le tinIharUlAI tyasako badalA dinuhunecha |
120 he mAnavaharU! timIharUle khullama khullA vA gopya duvai kisimakA pApaharUlAI tyAga | yI duvai kisimakA pApa garne mAnisaharUle cA~Dai nai tyasako sajAya pAune chan |

121 he muslimaharU ho! gairullAhako nAmamA vadha (jabaha) gariekA janAvaraharUko mAsu nakhAU | allAhabAheka anya kasaiko nAmamA vadha garieko vA kasaiko nAma na liieko vadha garieko janAvara pani harAma ho | yadi kohI tyasalAI khAncha bhane U allAhako AjJAbATa niskera avajJAmA jAncha | nissandeha zaitAnaharUle AphnA sAthIharUko manamA sandeha utpanna garchan tAki tinIharUle timIharUsa~ga mRta janAvaraharU khAnebAremA jhagaDA garun | he muslimaharU ho! yadi timIharUle mRta janAvara halAla ho bhanne kurAko AjJApAlana garchau bhane timIharU pani tinIharU jastai bahudevavAdI (muzrika) hunechau |

122 euTA yasto vyakti juna kuphra, ajJAnatA tathA zirkamA lipta raheko murdA thiyo tara hAmIle usalAI ImAna, jJAna tathA AjJApAlana pradAna garera jIvita tulyAyauM, ani arko jo ahilesamma kuphra, ajJAnatA tathA pApaharUko daladalabATa niskana sakeko chaina | ke duvai samAna huna sakchan?! yI bahudevavAdIharUkA lAgi tinIharUle garne garekA zirka, mRta janAvaraharUko sevana, asatyamA jhagaDA garne kAmaharUlAI AkarSaka tulyAieko cha, tAki tyastA avajJAkArIharUlAI mahApralayako dina pIDAdAyI sajAya diiyos |

123 jasarI makkAkA bahudevavAdIharUle allAhako mArgamA bAdhA utpanna gare, tyasarI nai hAmIle hareka bastIkA ThUla-ThUlA netAlAI zaitAnako mArgatarpha bolAuna tathA rasUlaharU tathA unIharUkA anuyAyIharU viruddha SaDyantra garna lAgAyauM | vAstavamA tinIharU Aphnai viruddha SaDyantra garirahekA chan | tara yasalAI mahasusa garirAkhekA chainan |

124 ThUlA baDA kAphiraharUsamakSa nabI (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) mAthi avatarita nizAnI Au~dA tinIharU bhanchan– hAmI tyatikherasamma ImAna lyAu~dainauM jabasamma hAmIlAI pani tyastai IzadUtatva pradAna gariMdaina jasto allAhakA rasUlaharUlAI pradAna garieko thiyo | allAhale tyasako javApha dinubhayo- IzadUtatvako lAgi ko ThIka bhanne kurA uhA~ rAmrarI jAnnuhuncha ra unalAI nai rasUla banAunuhuncha | juna aparAdhIharU ghamaNDa tathA calakhelale gardA satya dharma islAmalAI svIkAra garenan | cA~Dai nai apamAna tathA kaDA yAtanA pAune chan |

125 jasalAI allAhale satmArga dekhAuna cAhanuhuncha, usako chAtIlAI islAmako lAgi kholnuhuncha tathA islAma svIkAra garne zakti dinuhuncha | jasalAI allAhale apamAnita garna cAhanuhuncha tathA sIdhA mArga dekhAuna cAhanuhunna usako chAtIlAI saGkucita garnuhuncha ra tyasamA satya praveza gardaina | mAnauM, ki tyo AkAzatarpha uklina khojdai cha, tara pugdaina | yasarI nai allAhale pathabhraSTaharUlAI saGkucita avasthAmA puryAunubhayo ra avizvAsIharUlAI yAtanAmA grasta garnubhayo |

126 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! yo, hAmIle tapAIMlAI pradAna gareko sIdhA mArga ho | yasamA kunai TeDhopana chaina | nizcaya nai hAmIle bujhne kSamatA bhaekA mAnisaharUkA lAgi nizAnIharU spaSTa garidiekA chauM |
127 unIharUkA lAgi unakA pAlanakartAkahA~ zAnti-gRha (svarga) raheko cha, jasamA kunai kisimako kaSTa hu~daina | unIharUle garne garekA satkarmaharUle gardA allAha unIharUkA sahayogI hunuhuncha |

128 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! tyasa dinalAI yAda garnuhos juna dina allAhale mAnava tathA jinnalAI ekatrita garnuhunecha ra bhannuhunecha– he jinnaharUko samudAya! timIharUle dherai mAnisaharUlAI pathabhraSTa pAryau ra unIharUlAI allAhako mArgabATa rokyau | tinIharUkA mAnava anuyAyIharUle allAhalAI javApha diMdai bhannechan- he hAmrA pAlanakartA! hAmIharUmadhye harekale eka arkAbATa phAidA uThAyo | ani, jinnale Aphno mAnava sAthIko AjJApAlanabATa phAidA uThAyo ra mAnavale Aphno icchA purA garera phAidA uThAyo | ani hAmIle tyasa avadhilAI purA garyauM jo tapAIMle hAmro lAgi nizcita garnubhaeko thiyo, ani yo ho mahApralayako dina | allAhale bhannuhunecha– timIharUko vAsasthAna narka ho; sadA tyasamai rahanechau, sivAya tyasa avadhi jo allAhale cAhanuhunecha, cihAnako jIvana dekhi narkamA phyA~kinesammako avadhimA timIharU narkabATa surakSita rahanechau | he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! tapAIMkA pAlanakartA bhAgya nirdhAraNa tathA kArya saJcAlanamA tatvadarzI hunuhuncha ra AphnA bhaktaharU tathA tinIharUmadhye ko-ko yAtanAkA hakadAra chan bhannebAre rAmro jAnakAra hunuhuncha |

129 jasarI hAmIle badamAsa jinnaharUlAI mAnavaharUlAI pathabhraSTa garna tinIharUmAthi thopyauM tyasarI nai hAmIle hareka atyAcArImAthi arko atyAcArIlAI thopekA chauM tAki usale duSkarma garna prerita garos tathA bhalAi garnabATa rokos |

130 mahApralayako dina hAmIle bhannechauM- he jinna tathA manuSya ho! ke timIharU samakSa timIharU madhyebATa rasUlaharU Aenan, jo allAhale avataraNa garekA AyataharUko pATha garera sunAune garthe ra timIharUlAI mahApralayako dinabATa DarAune garthe? tinIharUle bhannechan– kina nahunu, hAmI svayam Aphai~ viruddha sAkSI chauM | tapAIMkA rasUlaharUle hAmI samakSa tapAIMkA sandeza puryAe | tara hAmIle duniyA~mA tapAIMkA rasUlaharUlAI ra yasa dinako bhe~TalAI pani jhUTo Thahara garyauM | nizcaya nai tinIharUlAI saMsAra tathA sAMsArika jIvanako saundaryale dhokAmA pAreko thiyo | tinIharUle duniyA~mA allAha ra uhA~kA rasUlaharUlAI inkAra garekA thie bhanne kurAlAI svIkAra garnechan | tara tyasa dina samaya bitisakeko hunAle yasa svIkAra garne tathA ImAna lyAune kAryale tinIharUlAI kunai phAidA puryAune chaina |
131 kinabhane allAhale kunai pani bastImA jabasamma rasulaharU paThAunu hunna ra dharmabAre sampUrNa jAnakArI dinuhunna, tabasamma tyo bastImA akasmAta prakopale grasta garnuhunna |

132 sabai mAnisaharUkA lAgi tinakA karma anusAra darjAharU chan | dherai badamAsI ra thorai badamAsI barAbara huna sakdainan | anuyAyI tathA netA barAbara huna sakdainan | tyasaigarI sabai satkarmIharUko puNya barAbara huna sakdainan | tinIharUle garirahekA kAryaharUbATa timrA pAlanakartA anabhijJa hunuhunna | uhA~bATa kunai pani vastu lukeko chaina | uhA~le cA~Dai nai unIharUlAI unIharUko karmaharUko badalA dinuhunecha |

133 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! tapAIMkA pAlanakartA ekadamai sampanna ra paripUrNa hunuhuncha | uhA~lAI bhakta tathA unIharUko bhaktiko kunai Avazyakta chaina | tyasaigarI unIharUko kuphra (avajJA) le pani uhA~lAI kunai hAni puryAuna sakdaina | taipani uhA~ AphnA bhaktaharUprati dayAvAn hunuhuncha | he avajJAkArI bhaktaharU ho! uhA~le cAhemA timIharUlAI Aphno prakopabATa jaraidekhi nai sakhApa pArnuhuncha | timIharUlAI sakhApa pArepachi timIharUko sthAnamA yasto samudAyalAI lyAunuhuncha jo uhA~mAthi ImAna rAkhnechan ra uhA~ko AjJApAlana garnechan | jasarI uhA~le timIharUlAI timIharUbhandA aghikA samudAyabATa sRSTi garnubhayo |

134 he kAphiraharU ho! timIharUsita vAcA gariekA punarjanma, hisAba, kitAba tathA sajAya nizcaya nai hunechan | timIharU bhAgera allAhabATa bacna sakdainau | uhA~le timIharUlAI jhyAppa samAtnu hunecha ra yAtanA dinuhunecha |

135 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! bhanidinuhos– he merA samudAyaharU ho! timIharU Aphno tarikA, kuphra tathA pathabhraSTatAmA kAyama hoU | maile timIharUsamma allAhako sandeza puryAera timIharUmAthi satya-tathya pramANita garidieko chu | malAI timIharUkA kuphra tathA pathabhraSTatAko kunai paravAha chaina | tara ma cA~Dai nai timIharUsamakSa tyasa satyalAI siddha garnechu, jasamA ma kAyama chu | duniyA~mA kasako sahayoga hunecha, dhartIko hakadAra ko bannecha ra AkhiratamA saphalatA kasalAI prApta hunecha bhanne kurA timIharUle cA~Dai nai thAhA pAunechau | bahudevavAdIharU nata lokamA saphala hunechan na paralokamA | duniyA~mA tinIharUle kehI kurAmA Ananda uThAepani AkhiratamA tinIharU asaphala hunechan |

136 bahudevavAdIharUle allAhale sRSTi garnubhaeko khetI evaM pazubATa eka bhAga allAhakA lAgi alaga garchan ra eka bhAga AphnA anya pUjyaharUkA lAgi alaga garchan | ani AphaiMle banAeko dhAraNA anusAra bhanchans yo allAhako lAgi ho ra yo hAmrA mUrtiharU ra pUjyaharUkA lAgi ho | ani yinIharUle allAhasa~ga sAjhedAra banAekA pUjyaharUko bhAgabATa allAhale nirdhArita garnubhaekA gariba tathA asahAyasamma kehI pugdaina, tara allAhakA lAgi nirdhArita bhAga cAhi~ tinIharUle banAekA sAjhedAraharU- mUrtiharU tathA anya pUjyaharUsamma pugcha | kati narAmro phaisalA tathA bA~DaphA~Da chan jo yinIharU garchan!

137 jasarI zaitAnale bahudevavAdIharUkA lAgi yo anyAyapUrNa phaisalAlAI AkarSaka banAeko cha, tyasarI nai dherai bahudevavAdIharUkA lAgi tinIharUkA sAjhedAra zaitAnaharUle garibIko Darale santAnako hatyA garne kAryalAI AkarSaka banAeko cha | tAki tinIharUle mArna avaidha gariekA jyAnalAI mArera Aphanai vinAza garun ra tinakA nimti tinIharUko dharma sandigdha banos, yahA~samma ki tinIharUle jAyaja nAjAyajalAI najAnun | allAhale cAhanubhaemA tinIharUle tyasto garne thienan | tara allAhale kunai kAraNale tyastai cAhanubhayo | ataH he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! yI bahudevavAdIharU tathA yinIharUle racekA managaDhanta jhUTalAI choDidinuhos | yasale tapAIMlAI kunai hAni puryAune chaina, tinIharUko mAmilA allAhalAI sumpinuhos |

138 bahudevavAdIharUle bhane– yI pazuharU tathA khetako bAlInAlIko prayoga niSedha cha, tara hAmIle bhaneko mAnche; jastai- mUrtiharUkA sevaka tathA rakSaka ityAdile bhane khAna sakchan | yo jhUTo kurA ho | tinIharUsa~ga yasako kunai pramANa chaina | kehI pazuharU yastA chan, jasamAthi nata yAtrA garna milcha na sara-sAmAna DhuvAnI garna milcha | tI hun- bahIrA, sAibA, hAma | ani arko kisima unIharUle janAvaralAI badha gardA allAhako nAma uccAraNa nagarI AphnA mUrtiharUko nAmamA badha garchan | tinIharUle jhUTo kurA gardai bhane– yI sabai niyama allAhako tarphabATa ho | allAhale tinIharUle jhUTo Aropa lagAeko sajAya cA~Dai nai dinuhunecha |

139 tinIharUle yo pani bhane– sAibA tathA bahIrAharUkA garbhamA rahekA zizu jIvita janma liemA tI kevala hAmrA puruSaharUkA lAgi halAla chan ra hAmrA mahilAharUkA lAgi harAma chan ra yadi tyo mRta avasthAmA janma linchan bhane tyasamA puruSa tathA mahilA sabai zarIka hune chan | allAhale cA~Dai nai tinIharUlAI tinIharUle bhaneko kurAharUko ucita sajAya dinuhunecha | nissandeha uhA~ kAnuna banAuna tathA sRSTiko kArya saJcAlanamA tatvadarzI tathA sarvajJa hunuhuncha |

140 nissandeha yastA mAnisaharU barbAda bhae jasale ajJAnatA evaM mUrkhatAle gardA AphnA santAnaharUko hatyA gare ra allAha viruddha jhUTo Aropa lagAera uhA~le pradAna garnubhaekA pazuharUlAI harAma gare | tinIharU sIdhA mArgabATa TADhA bhae ra mArgadarzana pAenan |

141 allAhale nai dhartImA vizAla bagaiMcAharU banAunubhayo kehI laharA bhaekA tathA kehI ucca tathA lAmA laharA nabhaekA | uhA~le nai khajura evaM vibhinna AkAra tathA svAdakA phala bhaekA khetI sRSTi garnubhayo | uhA~le nai jaituna tathA anAra sRSTi garnubhayo, jasakA pAta eka arkAsa~ga mildAjuldA hunchan tara svAda bhinna hunchan | he mAnava! jaba tI phalchan taba timIharU tyasakA phala khAU ra kATne dina tyasako jakAta (anivArya dAna) dine gara | khAna tathA kharca garnamA sImA ullaGghana nagara | nissandeha allAhale khAna pIna, kharca ityAdimA sImA ullaGghana garneharUlAI mana parAunuhunna, baru krodha prakaTa garranuhuncha | jasale yI sabaiko sRSTi garnubhayo uhA~le nai yI sabailAI AphnA bhaktaharUkA lAgi halAla (vaidha) garnubhayo | bahudevavAdIharUlAI tI janAvaraharU harAma Thahara garne adhikAra chaina |

142 allAhale kehI janAvaraharUlAI savArIko lAgi sRSTi garnubhayo; jastai ThUlA U~Ta | kehI yastA janAvaraharU sRSTi garnubhayo jo savArI yogya chainan; jastai sAnA U~Ta ra bheDAbAkhrA | he mAnava! timIharU allAhale pradAna garekA halAla khAdya sAmagrIharUmadhye khAU | allAhale harAma garekA kurAharUlAI halAla garne tathA uhA~le halAla garekA kurAharUlAI harAma garne kAryamA zaitAnakA padacinhaharUko anusaraNa nagara | jasarI bahudevavAdIharU garchan | he mAnava! nizcaya nai zaitAna timIharUko khullama-khullA zatru ho | usale timIharUlAI allAhako avajJA garne kAryamA lagAuna cAhancha |

143 allAhale ATha prakArakA bhAle pothIharU sRSTi garnubhayo; duIvaTA bheDAmadhyebATa ra duIvaTA bAkhrAmadhyebATa | he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! bahudevavAdIharUlAI sodhnuhos- ke allAhale yI duvaikA bhAlelAI bhAle bhaeko kAraNale harAma garnubhayo? yadi tinIharUle bhanchan- ho! ani tinIharUlAI sodhnuhos- ani timIharUle pothIharUlAI kina harAma garyau? ke allAhale yI duvaikA pothIharUlAI pothI bhaeko kAraNale harAma garnubhayo? yadi tinIharUle bhanchan- ho! ani tinIharUlAI sodhnuhos- ani timIharUle bhAleharUlAI kina harAma garyau? ke allAhale bheDA ra bAkhrAharUkA garbhamA rahekA zizulAI garbhamA raheko kAraNale harAma garnubhayo? yadi tinIharUle bhanchan- ho! ani tinIharUlAI sodhnuhos- timIharU kina vibheda gardai kahile garbhamA raheko bhAlelAI ra kahile garbhamA raheko pothIlAI harAma garchau? he bahudevavAdIharU ho! yI janAvaraharUlAI allAhale harAma garnubhaeko ho bhanne timro kurA sahI cha bhane pramANa prastuta gara |

144 ATha kisimakA janAvaraharUmadhye hun- U~TakA bhAle pothI garI duIvaTA ra gAIkA bhAle pothI garI duIvaTA | he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! bahudevavAdIharUlAI sodhnuhos, ke allAhale duvaimadhye kasailAI bhAle bhaeko kAraNale vA duvaikA pothIlAI pothI bhaeko kAraNale harAma garnubhayo? vA duvaikA garbhamA rahekA zizu bhaeko kAraNale harAma garnubhayo? he bahudevavAdIharU ho! ke timIharU Aphno vicAramA tyasa samayamA upasthita thiyau jaba allAhale timIharUle harAma banAekA pazuharUlAI harAma ho bhanne upadeza dinubhaeko thiyo?! tyobhandA ThUlo atyAcArI tathA aparAdhI ko hunasakcha jasale binA jJAna mAnisalAI sIdhA mArgabATa pathabhraSTa garna allAhako bAremA jhUTo kuro gaDhacha ani uhA~le harAma nagarekA janavaraharUko bAremA yo allAhale harAma garnubhayo bhancha? nizcaya nai allAhamAthi jhUTo Aropa lagAera atyAcAra garneharUlAI uhA~le mArgadarzana garnuhunna |

145 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! bhanidinuhos–allAhale mamAthi juna vahI (prakAzanA) avataraNa garnubhaeko cha, tyasamA ma kunai pani yasto cija pAU~dina juna khAna harAma hos, sivAya binA vadha mRta janAvara vA bageko ragata vA suMgurako mAsu jo phohara tathA harAma ho vA allAhabAheka anya kunai mUrtIko nAma liera vadha gariekA janAvara | tara kasaile svAdako lAgi hoina baru bhokako kAraNa bAdhya bhaera ra AvazyakatAko sImA na nAghera khAyo bhane usalAI pApa lAgdaina | he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! nizcaya nai tapAIMkA pAlanakartA bAdhya bhaera khAne vyaktiprati ati kSamAzIla evaM parama dayAlu hunuhuncha |

yasa samudAyamAthi allAhale je jati harAma (avaidha) garnubhaeko cha tyasako varNanapachi yahUdIharUmAthi harAma gariekA kurAharUko varNana garnubhayoH
146 hAmIle yahUdIharUkA lAgi khura naciriekA sampUrNa janAvaraharU jastai U~Ta, asTrica harAma garekA thiyauM ra gAI tathA bAkhrAko boso pani harAma garekA thiyauM sivAya tinakA piThyU~, hADa vA AndrAmA TA~siekA boso | tinIharUko atyAcArale gardA hAmIle yo sajAya diekA thiyauM | hAmI Aphno kurAmA ekadamai satyavAdI hauM |

147 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! yadi tinIharUle tapAIMlAI jhUTA Thahara garchan ra tapAIMle lyAunubhaeko dharmalAI satya mAndainan bhane tinIharUlAI AkarSaNa gardai bhannuhos- timIharUkA pAlanakartA apAra dayAvAna hunuhuncha | timIharUlAI chuTa dinu ra Aphno prakopa paThAunamA hatAra nagarnu uhA~ko mahAnatA ho | unIharUlAI DarAu~dai bhannuhos- pApa tathA duSkarma garneharUlAI uhA~ko prakopabATa kohI pani bacAuna sakdaina |

148 bahudevavAdIharUle allAhasa~ga sAjhedArI (zirka) garne kAryalAI allAhakai cAhanA tathA zaktibATa bhaekole yo ThIka ho bhanne kurA pramANita garna yasarI bhannechan– yadi allAhale cAheko bhae nata hAmIle sAjhedArI (zirka) garne thiyauM na hAmrA purkhAle nai | tyastai nata hAmIle kunai cijalAI harAma Thahara garne thiyauM | yinIharU jhaiM yasabhandA pUrvakA mAnisaharUle rasUlaharUlAI jhUTo Thahara gardai bhanekA thie- yadi allAhale cAheko bhae hAmIle unIharUlAI jhUTo Thahara garne thienauM | tinIharUle nirantara jhUTo Thahara gare yahA~samma ki hAmIle avataraNa gareko prakopako svAda cAkhe | he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! yI bahudevavAdIharUlAI bhanidinuhos- timIharUle gareko zirka, halAlalAI harAma ra harAmalAI halAla banAeko kAryasa~ga allAha khusI hunuhuncha bhanne kurAko ke pramANa cha? timIharUle gareko kAryabATa uhA~ khusI hunuhuncha bhanne pramANita garna mildaina | yasa bAremA timIharU aDkalako mAtrai anusaraNa gardaichau ra aDkalabATa satya kurA pramANita hu~daina, timIharU jhUTo boldaichau |

149 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! bahudevavAdIharUlAI bhanidinuhos– yI bekAra tarkaharU hun | tara allAhasa~ga nirNAyaka tarkaharU chan, jasale timIharUkA zaGkAharUlAI nivAraNa garchan | he bahudevavAdIharU ho! yadi allAhale cAhemA timIharU sabailAI satmArgamA DoryAunu hunthyo |

150 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! allAhale halAla garekA cIjaharUlAI harAma garne bahudevavAdIharUlAI bhanidinuhos– allAhale yI cIjaharUlAI harAma gareko sAkSIharUlAI liera AU | yadi tinIharUle allAhale harAma garnubhayo bhanI binA jJAna sAkSI dinchan- bhane he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! tapAIMle tinIharUkA gavAhIlAI satya namAnnuhos, kinabhane tyo jhUTo gavAhI ho | tI mAnisaharUkA icchAharUko anusaraNa nagarnuhos jo Aphno icchA anusAra nirNaya garera hAmrA nizAnIharUlAI jhUTo Thahara gare ani halAla vastulAI harAma Thahara gare | yastA mAnisaharUko anusaraNa nagarnuhos jo AkhiratamA ImAna rAkhdainan ra AphnA pAlanakartAsa~ga arUlAI sAjhedAra Thahara garchan, anyalAI uhA~ko barAbara banAu~chan | arUlAI AphnA pAlanakartAko barAbara banAuneharUko anusaraNa kasarI garna sakincha?!

151 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! mAnisaharUlAI bhanidinuhos– AU, ma timIharUlAI timrA pAlanakartAle harAma (avaidha) garekA kurA paDhera sunAU~ | tI hun– uhA~sa~ga zirka (kasailAI sAjhedAra) garnu | mAtApitAko avajJA garnu, unIharUsa~ga narAmro vyavahAra garnu | garibIko Darale AphnA santAnako hatyA garnu, jasarI islAma pUrvakA mAnisaharU garne garthe | kinabhane timIharUlAI ra unIharUlAI pani hAmIle nai jIvIkA pradAna garnechauM | azlIla kurAharUko najika jAnu, cAhe tyo khullArUpamA hos vA gopya | allAhale harAma garekA jIvako hatyA garnu | tara nyAyako dRSTile jAyaja cha jastai vivAhita balAtkArIlAI vA islAmabATa phirtA hune (murtada) lAI hatyA garnu jAyaja cha | allAhale ukta kurAharUko upadeza dinuhuncha, tAki timIharU viveka prayoga gara, uhA~kA AdezaharUko pAlanA gara ra varjita kAryaharUbATa baca |

152 allAhale anAtha (yatima) harUko dhanasampattimA hastakSepa garna harAma garnubhaeko cha | anAtha (yatima) tyo ho jo vayaska hunubhandA pahile nai usakA buvAko mRtyu bhaisakeko huncha | tara anAtha phAidA puryAune uddezyale tathA usako sampattimA baDhottarI garne uddezyale hastakSepa garna milcha | bAliga tathA sujhabujha bhaepachi usako dhanasampatti usalAI sumpideU | allAhale nApataulamA pani kamI garna pani harAma garnubhaeko cha | kina-beca vA lena-dena gardA nyAya garna anivArya garieko cha | hAmI kunai pani vyaktimAthi usako sAmarthyabhandA baDhI jimmevArI didainauM | jahA~ nApataulamA kamIbesI garnabATa bacna sambhava chaina tyahA~ kunai pakaDa hu~daina | allAhale galata sUcanA dina tathA jhUTo gavAhI dinabATa pani manAhI garnubhaeko cha | allAhale vacanabhaGga garnu pani harAma garnubhaeko cha, cAhe tyo allAhasa~ga garieko vacana hos vA allAhako lAgi garieko vacana hos, vacana purA garnu anivArya cha | allAhale timIharUlAI yI kurAharUko kaDA Adeza dinubhaeko cha, AzA cha timIharUle rAmro natijAko lAgi yI AdezaharUko pAlanA garnechau |

153 allAhale bhraSTa mArgaharUmA hi~Dna manAhI garnubhaeko cha | kinabhane galata mArgaharUko anusaraNale timIharUbIca vibheda utpanna garcha ra satmArgabATa TADhA pArcha | allAhale Aphno sIdhA mArgamA hi~Dnu ra tyasaiko anusaraNa garnu anivArya garnubhaeko cha | yasamA kunai TeDhopana chaina | yasa AzAkA sAtha ki timIharUle uhA~kA AdezaharUko pAlanA garera tathA varjita kAryaharUbATa bacera uhA~bATa DarAunechau |

154 ukta kurAharUbAre sUcita garepachi aba timIharUlAI ke batAu~daichauM bhane hAmIle mUsA (alaihissalAma) lAI unale rAmro kArya gare bApata unImAthi Aphno kRpA purA garna, dharmako mAmilAmA Avazyaka kurAharU spaSTa pArna ra satya tathA dayAko kurA batAunako lAgi taurAta pradAna garyauM | tAki mAnisaharUle mahAprayako dina AphnA pAlanakartAsita bheTa hunecha bhanne kurAmA ImAna lyAun ra satkarma garera tyasako tayArI garun |

155 yo kurAna yasto kitAba ho jasalAI hAmIle nai avataraNa garekA hauM; jo barakatayukta (maGgalamaya) raheko cha | yasamA sAMsArika ra dhArmika mAmilAmA dherai phAidAharU chan | ataH yasamA rahekA kurAharUko anusaraNa gara tathA yasako virodha garnabATa baca | tAki timIharUmAthi dayA gariyos |

156 he arabakA bahudevavAdIharU ho! tAki timIharU yo nabhana– hAmIbhandA pahile yahUdI ra IsAIharUkA lAgi taurAta tathA injIla ta avatarita bhae tara hAmrA lAgi kunai kitAba avatarita bhaena | tinIharUkA kitAba hAmro bhASAmA nabhaera tinIharUko bhASAmA bhaekole hAmI tyasako pATha garna jAndainauM |

157 yo pani nabhana- yadi hAmrA lAgi pani yahUdI ra IsAI jhaiM kunai kitAba avataraNa bhaeko bhae hAmI tinIharUbhandA baDhI satmArgamA aDiga rahane thiyauM | la, aba timrA pAlanakartAko tarphabATa muhammada (sallalalAhu alaihi va sallama) mAthi timIharU kai bhASAmA kitAba avatarita bhaisakeko cha | yo sampUrNa samudAyako lAgi spaSTa pramANa, mArgadarzana evaM dayA ho | tasartha vAhiyAta tathA bekAra kisimakA bahAnA tathA tarkaharU pesa nagara | tyasabhandA ThUlo atyAcArI kohI hunai sakdaina jo allAhakA nizAnIharUlAI jhUTo Thahara garcha ra tyasabATa vimukha huncha | jo sukai pani hAmrA nizAnIharUbATa vimukha huncha tyasalAI yasa vimukhatAko kAraNa narkamA hAlera kaDA sajAya dinechauM |

158 jhUTA Thahara garneharUle malakula-mauta (mRtyukA phariztA) ra unakA sahayogIharUko pratIkSA gardaichan, tAki tinIharUko AtmA niyantraNamA liun | vA he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! AkhiratamA tapAIMkA pAlanakartA tinIharUko nirNayako lAgi Aun | vA mahApralayalAI pramANita garne kehI nizAnIharU timIharUsamakSa Aun | juna dina tapAIMkA pAlanakartAkA kehI nizAnIharU sAmunne Aune chan jastai sUrya pazcima dizAbATa udAunu, taba yo ImAna lyAune kAryale pahile ImAna nalyAeko vA ImAna lyAI satkarma nagareko vyaktilAI kunai phAidA dine chaina | he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! yI jhUTA Thahara garne bahudevavAdIharUlAI bhannuhos– timIharU yI nizAnIharUmadhye euTA nizAnIko pratIkSA gara; hAmI pani pratIkSA gardaichauM |

159 yahUdI ra IsAIharUmadhye ja-jasale Aphno dharmalAI vikhaNDita tulyAe, kehI kurA lie tathA kehI kurA tyAge ra tinIharU vibhinna sampradAyamA vibhAjita bhae, he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! tinIharUko pathabhraSTatAsa~ga tapAIMko kunai sarokAra chaina; tapAIMko jimmA mAtra tinIharUlAI DarAunu ho | tinIharUko mAmilA allAhako jimmAmA cha | ani allAhale nai mahApralayako dina tinIharUlAI tinIharUle garne kAryaharUbAre avagata garAunuhunecha ra sajAya dinuhunecha |

160 mominaharUmadhye jo allAhakahA~ euTA satkarma liera Aunecha usalAI allAhale tyasako dasa guNA puNya banAunuhunecha ra jasale euTA kukarma liera Aunecha usalAI kevala tyasa barAbarakai sajAya hunecha, tyasabhandA baDhI hune chaina | tinIharUko puNyalAI ghaTAera vA sajAyalAI baDhAera unIharUmAthi anyAya garine chaina |

161 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! yI jhUTA Thahara garne bahudevavAdIharUlAI bhannuhos– malAI merA pAlanakartAle sIdhA mArga dekhAunubhaeko cha; tyo yasto dharma ho jo loka ra paraloka duvaikA hItalAI sunizcita garcha | jo ibrAhIma (alaihissalAma) ko mArga tathA ThIka dharma ho | unI bahudevavAdIharU madhyekA thienan |

162 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! bhanidinuhos- mero namAja ra mero balidAna allAhako lAgi ho ra uhA~kai nAma liera vadha garchu | mero jIvana tathA mero maraNa sabai allAhako lAgi mAtra ho jo sampUrNa sRSTiharUkA pAlanakartAkai lAgi hunuhuncha, tyasamA anya kasaiko aMza chaina |

163 uhA~ko kohI sAjhedAra chaina, uhA~ bAheka anya kohI satya pUjya chaina | malAI merA pAlanakartAle yasai zuddha ekezvaravAdako Adeza dinubhaeko cha, ma nai sarvaprathama AjJApAlana garne allAhako AjJApAlaka (muslima) hu~ |

164 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! yI bahudevavAdIharUlAI bhannuhos– ke ma allAhabAheka kunai anya pAlanakartA khojU~ jabaki uhA~ hareka cijakA pAlanakartA hunuhuncha?! uhA~ timIharUle pUjA garne pUjyaharUko pani pAlanakartA hunuhuncha | kunai pani bhArI boknele arU kasaiko bhArI bokne chaina | ani timIharUlAI timrA pAlanakartAtarpha nai mahApralayako dina pharkanucha | ani juna juna kurAmA timIharU matabheda gardaithyau tyo uhA~le timIharUlAI batAunuhunecha |

165 allAha nai hunuhuncha jasale timIharUlAI dhartIkA uttarAdhikArI banAunubhayo tAki tyasamA bhavana banAU | timIharUmadhye kehIlAI anya kehImAthi ruparekhA tathA jIvikA ityAdimA ucca darjA pradAna garnubhayo tAki jejati uhA~le dinubhaeko cha tyasamA timIharUko parIkSA liiyos | he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! nissandeha tapAIMkA pAlanakartAle cA~Dai nai sajAya dinuhunecha | je pani AunevAlA cha tyo najika cha | bhaktaharUmadhye jo pani taubA garcha usalAI uhA~le kSamA tathA dayA garnuhunecha |
1 alipha0 lAma0 mIma0 sAda0 | yastA akSaraharUko vyAkhyA sUraha al-bakarahako ArambhamA bhaisakeko cha |

2 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! allAhale tapAIMmAthi yo kurAna avataraNa garnubhaeko ho | tasartha yasako bAremA kunai zaGkA tathA upa-zaGkA nagarnuhos | tAki tapAIM yasadvArA mAnisaharUlAI DarAunuhos, satya-tathya pramANita garnuhos tathA AsthAvAnaharUlAI upadeza dinuhos, kinabhane tinIharUle nai upadeza grahaNa garnechan |

3 he mAnava ho! timrA pAlanakartAdvArA avatarita kitAba ra AphnA nabI (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) ko tarikAko anusaraNa gara | zaitAnaharUmadhye kunai pani mitraharU tathA narAmrA dharmaguruharUko anusaraNa nagara | tara timIharUmadhye thoraile upadeza svIkAra gardachau | yadi timIharUle upadeza svIkAra gareko bhae satyamAthi anya kasailAI prAthamikatA dine thienau baru rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) le lyAunu bhaekA tathA sikAunu bhaekA kurAharUko anusaraNa garne thiyau ra yI bAhekakA kurAharU choDne thiyau |

4 hAmIle katipaya gA~u ra bastIharUlAI Aphno prakopabATa tyatikhera sarvanAza garyauM jatikhera tinIharUle kuphra tathA pathabhraSTatAmAthi jiddI gare | ani tI gA~u ra bastIharUmAthi ki ta rAtako samayamA hAmro prakopa Ayo ki ta aparAhnako samayamA, jaba tinIharU aceta avasthAmA thie | prakopalAI nata tinIharUle rokna sake na tinIharUle mAnne garekA pUjyaharUle nai rokna sake |
5 prakopapachi sabaile yasa kurAlAI svIkAra gare- vAstavamA hAmIle allAhalAI inkAra garera AphaimAthi atyAcAra garyauM |

6 juna-juna samudAyamA hAmIle sandeSTAharU paThAyauM, tI samudAyale sandeSTAharUlAI je-je javApha die ra tyasaigarI hAmIle rasUlaharUlAI hAmro sandeza puryAunebAre tathA unIharUkA samudAyale pharkAeko javAphabAre mahApralayako dina avazya nai sodhnechauM |

7 hAmIle pratyeka sRSTilAI usale duniyA~mA garekA karmaharUbAre Aphno jJAnako AdhAramA batAunechauM | hAmIsa~ga tinIharUle garekA sabai karmaharUko bAremA pUrNa jAnakArI cha | hAmIbATa kehI kurA gopya chaina | hAmI kunai pani samayamA tinIharUbATa anabhijJa thienauM |

8 mahApralayako dina karmaharUko nApataula binA ghaTabaDha pUrNa nyAya ra nisAphakA sAtha hunecha | jasa-jasakA satkarmaharUko pallA duSkarmaharUko tulanAmA bhArI hunecha unIharU nai cAhieko kurA (svarga) pAunamA saphala hunechan ra DarAieko kurA (narka) bATa mukti pAunechan |

9 ani jasa-jasakA duSkarmaharUko pallA satkarmaharUko tulanAmA bhArI hunecha unIharU nai mahApralayako dina asaphala bhaera barbAdImA parnechan | kinabhane unIharUle hAmrA nizAnIharUlAI jhUTo Thahara garne garthe |

10 he AdamakA santAna! hAmIle nai timIharUlAI dhartImA adhikArakAsAtha basAyauM ra tyasamA timIharUkA lAgi jIvana-sAmagrI banAyauM | tyasa bApata timIharU allAhaprati pUrNa AbhArI hunuparne thiyo tara timIharUle thorai AbhAra vyakta garyau |

11 he AdamakA santAna! hAmIle timro pitA AdamalAI sRSTi garyauM ra unalAI rAmro rUparekhA pradAna garyauM | ani unako sammAnako lAgi phaztiAharUlAI bhanyauM– AdamalAI sajdA gara | taba iblIsa (zaitAna) bAheka sabaile kurA mAne tathA sajdA gare | ghamaNDa tathA zatrutAle gardA iblIsale sajdA garnabATa inkAra garyo |

12 allAhale iblIsako nindA gardai bhannubhayo– AdamalAI sajdA gara bhanne mero Adezako pAlanAbATa kuna cijale timIlAI rokyo? iblIsale Aphno pAlanakartAlAI javApha diMdai bhanyo– ma AdamabhandA zreSTha hu~ bhanne kurAle malAI usalAI sajdA garnabATa rokyo | malAI tapAIMle AgobATa sRjanA garnubhayo ra usalAI mATobATa sRjanA garnubhayo ra Ago mATobhandA zreSTha huncha |

13 allAhale usalAI bhannubhayo– timI svargabATa orla | timIlAI yahA~ ghamaNDa garne kunai adhikAra chaina | yo rAmrA pavitraharUko ghara ho, timIlAI yahA~ basne anumati chaina | he iblIsa! timI nIca ra apamAnita hau, yadyapi timI AphUlAI Adama bhandA zreSTha ThAndachau |
14 iblIsale bhanyo– he merA pAlanakartA! malAI kayAmatasamma maukA dinuhos, tAki sakesamma mAnisaharUlAI pathabhraSTa garna saku~ |
15 allAhale bhannubhayo– he iblIsa! timIlAI tyasa dinasammako lAgi maukA diincha juna dina pahilo zaGkha phukinecha jasale gardA sabai sRSTiharU marnechan ra sRSTikartA mAtra jIvita rahanuhunecha |

16 iblIsale bhanyo– jasarI tapAIMle malAI pathabhraSTa pArnubhayo jasale gardA maile AdamalAI sajdA garne tapAIMko Adezako pAlanA garina, tyasarI nai ma pani AdamakA santAnaharUlAI pathabhraSTa pArna tapAIMko sIdhA mArgamA basnechu | tAki unIharUkA pitA AdamalAI sajdA nagareko kAraNa ma pathabhraSTa bhae jhai~ unIharUlAI pani pathabhraSTa garna saku~ |

17 tyasapachi tinIharUlAI Akhirata (paraloka) bATa asAvadhAna pArna, duniyA~mA lipta pArna, zaGkAmA grasta pArna ra kukarmalAI AkarSaka tulyAuna hareka dizAbATa Aunechu | he merA pAlanakartA! tapAIMle tinIharUmadhye adhikAMzalAI tapAIMprati AbhAra prakaTa garne pAunuhune chaina |

18 allAhale usalAI bhannubhayo– he iblIsa! svargabATa apamAnita tathA allAhako kRpAbATa TADhA bhaera niska! mahApralayako dina timI ra timro anusaraNa garne allAhakA sampUrNa avajJAkArIharUdvArA narkalAI bharnechu |

19 allAhale AdamalAI bhannubhayo– he Adama! timI ra timrI patnI havvA duvai svargamA basa ra pavitra kurAharU khAU tara yo (euTA vizeSa) rukhako phala nakhAnu | yadi timIharUle manAhI garepachi pani yasabATa khAnchau bhane timIharU duvai janA sImA ullaGghana garneharUmadhye Thaharinechau |

20 iblIsale duvaiko manamA zaGkAspada kurA hAlyo tAki duvaikA guptAGga eka arkAko lAgi nAGgo pAros | bhanna thAlyo– timIharUlAI timrA pAlanakartAle yasa rukhabATa phala khAna mAtra yasa kAraNale manAhI garnubhaeko cha, ki timIharU phariztA nabana vA timIharU sadhaiMko lAgi amara bhaera svargamA nabasa |
21 duvaisamakSa usale yo bhandai allAhako kasama khAyo, he Adama ra havvA! juna kurAtarpha maile timIharUlAI saMketa gareko chu tyasamA nizcaya nai ma timIharUkA saccA hitaiSI hu~ |

22 usale chalera duvailAI tala jhAryo | jaba duvaile manAhI garieko rukhako phala khAe taba duvaikA guptAGgaharU eka arkAsamakSa nAGgA bhae | duvaile AphnA zarIralAI chopnakA lAgi svargakA pAtaharU TA~sna thAle | unakA pAlanakartAle unIharUlAI bhannubhayo– ke maile timIharUlAI tyasa rukhako phala khAnabATa manAhI gareko thiina~ ra sAvadhAna gareko thiina~- nizcita rUpamA zaitAna timIharUko khullama khullA zatru ho?!

23 Adama tathA havvA duvaile bhane– he hAmrA pAlanakartA! tapAIMle manAhI gareko rukhako phala khAera hAmIle AphUmAthi atyAcAra garekA chauM | yadi tapAIMle hAmrA pApalAI mApha garnubhaena ra hAmImAthi dayA garnubhaena bhane nizcaya nai hAmI loka ra paralokako aMza gumAera ghATA khAneharUmadhye hunechauM |

24 allAhale Adama, havvA ra iblIsalAI sambodhana garera bhannubhayoH timIharU svargabATa orlera dhartImA jAU! timIharU eka-arkAkA zatru bhayau | timIharUkA lAgi dhartImA nizcita avadhisammakA lAgi vAsasthAna tathA jIvikopArjanako sAdhana hunecha |

25 allAhale Adama, havvA tathA duvaikA santAnaharUlAI sambodhana garera bhannubhayo– timIharUle dhartImai jIvana vyatIta garnechau, tyahI~ marnechau, cihAnamA purinechau ra cihAnabATa jIvita pArera nikAlinechau |

26 he AdamakA santAna ho! hAmIle guptAGgaharUlAI chopnakA lAgi kehI aparihArya posAkaharU banAekA chauM ra kehI posAka saundarya ra AkarSaNako lAgi banAekA chauM | tara 'Izabhaya' (takvA) ko posAka bhautika posAka bhandA uttama ho | ukta posAka pani allAhakA nizAnIharUmadhyeko ho | tAki timIharU allAhakA kRpAharUlAI yAda garera uhA~prati AbhAra prakaTa gara |

27 he AdamakA santAna ho! zaitAnale timIharUlAI bhautika tathA Izabhayako posAka choDna lagAera tathA pApalAI AkarSaka tulyAera dhokAmA napAros | usale nai timrA AmAbuvAlAI manAhI garieko rukhako phala khAna lagAera dhokA dieko thiyo ra pariNAma svarUpa duvailAI svargabATa niSkAsita garAeko thiyo | tinakA vastra khulekA thie | zaitAna tathA usakA santAnaharUle timIharUlAI yasto ThAu~bATa dekhchan jahA~bATa timIle tinIharUlAI dekhna sakdainau | zaitAna tathA tyasakA santAnaharUbATa sAvadhAna hoU! allAhamAthi ImAna na lyAuneharUkA mitra hAmIle zaitAna tathA usakA santAnaharUlAI banAekA chauM | satkarma garne mominaharUmAthi zaitAnako kehI caldaina |

28 bahudevavAdIharU zirka, tathA kAbAko nAGgo parikramA jastA ghRNita kArya gardA yo bhanera bahAnA garchan– hAmIle AphnA pUrvajaharUlAI yastai gardai Aeko pAekA chauM ra allAhale nai hAmIharUlAI yasto garne Adeza dinubhaeko cha | he nabI (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama! tinIharUko kurAko khaNDana gardai bhanidinuhos– allAhale kadApi pApako Adeza dinuhunna, uhA~le ta yastA kAryabATa roknuhuncha | uhA~ko bAremA yasto dAbI kuna AdhAramA garchau?! ke timIharU allAha viruddha jhUTa tathA gaDheko kurA garchau jasako timIharUlAI jJAna nai chaina?!

29 he nabI (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! yI bahudevavAdIharUlAI bhanidinuhos– nissandeha allAhale nyAya garne Adeza dinubhaeko cha, azlIla tathA pApakarmako Adeza dinubhaeko chaina | uhA~le nisvArtha bhaera uhA~ko mAtra bhakti garne Adeza dinubhaeko cha ra vizeSa rUpamA masjidaharUmA uhA~kai bhaktiko Adeza dinubhaeko cha | jasarI uhA~le timIharUlAI pahilo paTaka zunyabATa sRSTi garnubhayo tyasarI nai uhA~le dosro paTaka pani jIvita pArnuhunecha | jo pahilo paTaka sRSTi garne sAmarthya rAkhcha, usale dosro paTaka pani sRSTi garne tathA jIvita pArne sAmarthya rAkhcha |

30 allAhale mAnavalAI duivaTA samUhamA vibhAjita garnubhayo | euTA samUhalAI allAhale satmArga dekhAunubhayo, mArgadarzanakA sAdhana juTAunubhayo tathA bAdhA aDacanalAI haTAunubhayo | arko samUhamAthi pathabhraSTatA siddha bhaeko cha kinabhane tinIharUle allAhalAI choDI zaitAnaharUlAI mitra banAe, ajJAnatAle tinIharUkai anusaraNa gare, tara tinIharU svayaMlAI sIdhA mArgamA hi~DirahekA ThAndachan |

31 he AdamakA santAna ho! namAja tathA tavApha (kAbAko parikramA) ko belAmA jiulAI chopne, sundara, saphA tathA pavitra posAka lagAune gara | allAhale halAla garekA pavitra khAnekurAharU khAU ra halAlako sImA nanAgha | sImA ullaMGana garneharUlAI allAhale mana parAunuhunna |

32 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! allAhale halAla garekA posAka tathA pavitra khAne kurAharUlAI harAma garne bahudevavAdIharUlAI sodhnuhos– timIharUle saundarya prApta garne posAka ra pavitra khAnapina kasale harAma garyo? he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! bhanidinuhos– yI pavitra khAne kurAharU duniyA~mA mominaharUkA lAgi hun ra anya mAnisaharU pani tyasamA sAjhedAra chan, tara AkhiratamA mominaharUkA lAgi mAtra hunechan, kAphiraharU tyasamA sAjhedAra hune chainan | kinabhane svargamA praveza kAphiraharUkA lAgi harAma (avaidha) cha | yasarI hAmI AphnA nizAnIharU samajhadAra mAnisaharUkA lAgi tapasIlakA sAtha batAu~chauM, kinabhane tinIharU nai yasabATa phAidA uThAuna sakchan |

33 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! allAhale halAla garekA kurAharUlAI harAma garne bahudevavAdIharUlAI bhannuhos– nissandeha allAhale sampUrNa kisimakA azlIla kAryaharU, pApaharU, mAnisaharUko jiudhana tathA ijjatamA jyAdatIlAI harAma garnubhaeko cha | tyasaigarI pramANa nai nabhaeko kArya- allAha bAheka arU kasaiko pUjAAjA garnu ra allAhakA nAma, guNa, kArya tathA kAnunako bAremA jJAna nabhaeko kurA bhannu ityAdilAI pani harAma garnubhaeko cha |
34 hareka samudAya tathA pustAkA nimti euTA nizcita samaya avadhi ra sthAna toknubhaeko cha | unIharUko myAda purA bhaepachi na eka kSaNa Dhilo hunecha, na chiTo nai |

35 he AdamakA santAna ho! yadi timIharUsamakSa timIharUkai samudAyabATa rasUlaharU Aera maile avataraNa gareko kitAbabATa AyataharU sunAu~chan bhane unIharUko AjJApAlana gara ra unIharUle lyAekA kurAharUko anusaraNa gara | jasale allAhakA AdezaharUko pAlanA garera ra uhA~le manAhI garnubhaekA kArharUbATa bacera AphnA karmaharU sudhAra garchan, tinIharUlAI mahApralayako dina na kunai bhaya hunecha ra na unIharU sAMsArika bhAga gumAekAmA duHkhI nai hunechan |

36 tara hAmrA nizAnIharUlAI jhUTo Thahara garne, tyasamA ImAna nalyAune tathA rasUlaharUle lyAekA kurAharU anusAra ghamaNDale gardA karma nagarneharU narkabAsI hun, jasamA tinIharU sadAsarvadA rahanechan |

37 allAhako viruddha jhUTo bolne, allAhasa~ga anya vastulAI sAjhedAra Thahara garne, allAhako zAnamA kami garne, juna kurA allAhale bhannubhaeko chaina tyo kurA uhA~sa~ga joDne vA allAhakA sIdhA mArgamA DoryAune nizAnIharUlAI jhUTo Thahara garne vyaktibhandA ThUlo atyAcArI arU ko huna sakcha? | yastA mAnisaharUle surakSita pATImA lekhiekA AphnA rAmrA vA narAmrA bhAgya anusAra duniyA~mA mojamastI garchan | tara mRtyuko samaya jaba mRtyukA phariztA ra unakA sahayogI phariztAharU tinako prANa lina Aipugnechan taba nindA gardai sodhnechan– kahA~ chan tI pUjyaharU jasalAI timIharUle allAhalAI choDera pUjA garne garthyau?! tinIharUlAI bolAU tAki timIharUlAI phAidA puryAun | bahudevavAdIharUle phariztAharUlAI javApha dinechan– hAmIharUle pUjne garekA pUjyaharU harAera gae | kahA~ harAe tyo hAmIharUlAI thAhA chaina | tinIharU kAphira thie bhanera AphaiM svIkAra garnechan | tara tinIharUko yo svIkAra tinIharUko viruddha nai pramANa bannecha ra tinIharUlAI kunai phAidA dinechaina |

38 phariztAharUle tinIharUlAI bhannechan: he bahudevavAdIharU ho! timIharU pani AphUbhandA pahilekA kuphra tathA pathabhraSTatAmA kAyama rahekA jinna tathA mAnavakA samUhaharUsa~ga narkamA pasa | pratyeka samUha narkamA praveza gardA AphUbhandA pahilekA samUhaharUlAI dhikkArnecha, yahA~samma ki jaba sabai tyasamA ekatrita hunechan ra eka arkAsa~ga milnechan taba hareka pachillA anuyAyIko samUhale AphUbhandA aghiko aguvA samUhako viSayamA bhannechan– he hAmrA pAlanakartA! yI ThUlA baDA netAharU hun jasale hAmIlAI sIdhA mArgabATa pathabhraSTa garekA thie; tasartha yinIharUle hAmIharU samakSa pathabhraSTatAlAI AkarSaka banAera dekhAekole yinIharUlAI narkako dobbara yAtanA dinuhos | allAhale tinIharUlAI javApha diMdai bhannuhunecha– hareka samUhalAI tyasako bhAgako yAtanA kaiyauM guNA baDhAera diinecha | tara timIharU yasako bAremA ajJAnatA tathA anyolamA chau |

39 ani tI aguvA tathA netAharUle anuyIharUlAI bhannechan– he anuyAyIharU ho! timIharUlAI hAmImAthi pradhAnatA prApta chaina, jasale gardA timIharU yAtanAmA kamIko hakadAra hoU | timIharUle pani Aphno kriyAkalApako sajAya svarUpa yAtanAko svAda cAkhnai parcha, kunai bahAnA caldaina | ataH he anuyAyIharU ho! timIharUle gareko kuphra tathA pathabhraSTatAko kAraNale hAmIharUle yAtanA bhoge jhaiM timIharU pani yAtanA bhoga |

40 jasale hAmrA spaSTa nizAnIharUlAI jhUTo bhane, ani ghamaNDako kAraNa svIkAra garnuko sATo asvIkAra gare, tinIharU sabai kisimakA bhalAibATa nirAza hunechan | kuphra (inkAra) gareko kAraNa mRtyu pazcAta tinIharUkA karma ra tinIharUkA AtmAharUkA lAgi AkAzakA DhokAharU kadApi kholine chainan | siyoko ati sAno pvAlamA U~Ta na chirunjelasamma tinIharU svargamA kahile pani pasna sakne chainan | jasarI ThUlo janAvara U~Ta siyoko sAno pvAlamA pasna asambhava cha, tyasarI nai tinIharUko svargamA praveza asambhava cha | allAhale ThUlo pApa garneharUlAI yasarI nai badalA dinuhunecha |
41 allAhalAI jhUTlAune ghamaNDI mAnisaharUkA ochyAna ra mAthibATa oDhne Agokai hunecha | kuphra tathA vimukha bhaera allAhakA sImAko ullaGghana garneharUlAI hAmIle yastai sajAya dinechauM |

42 jo mAnisaharUle AphnA pAlanakartA allAhamAthi ImAna lyAe ra sakdo satkarma gare (allAhale kasaimAthi pani usako sAmarthyabhandA baDhI bojha dinuhunna) tyastA mAnisaharU svargabAsI hun, unIharU tyasamA praveza garnechan; tyahA~ tinIharU sadAsarvadA rahanechan |

43 svargakA kRpAharUmadhye yo pani ho- unIharUko manamA bhaekA dveSabhAva tathA DAhAlAI allAhale bAhira nikAlnu hunecha | unIharUko talatirabATa nadIharU bagirahekA hunechan | unIharUle allAhakA kRpAharUlAI svIkAra gardai bhannechan– sArA prazaMsA allAhakai nimti hun, jasale hAmIlAI satkarma garne maukA dinubhayo ra yo darjAsamma puryAunubhayo | allAhale hAmIlAI yo maukA na dinubhaeko bhae hAmIle yo maukA pAune thienauM | nissandeha hAmrA pAlanakartAle paThAekA rasUlaharU satya liera AekA thie, jasamA kunai zaGkA thiena | uhA~le je jati vacana dinubhayo ra juna kurAko dhamkI dinubhayo tyo satya siddha bhayo | unIharUbIca ghoSaNA garnele ghoSaNA garnecha– merA rasUlaharUle duniyA~mA juna svargako sUcanA diekA thie tyo timIharUle allAhako prasannatAko lAgi garekA satkarmako badalA svarUpa timIharUlAI pradAna gariyo |

44 svargabAsIharUle Aphno sthAnabATa narkabAsIharUlAI pukArera bhannechan– hAmIle ta hAmrA pAlanakartAle dinubhaeko vacanalAI satya pAyauM ra uhA~le hAmIlAI svargamA praveza garAunubhayo | he kAphiraharU ho! ke timIharUle allAhale dinubhaeko narkako dhamkIlAI satya pAyau? kAphiraharUle bhannechan– ho, hAmIlAI juna narkako dhamkI diieko thiyo tyasalAI satya pAyauM | ani tinIharUbIca ekajA ghoSaNA garnele allAhasita duA gardai ghoSaNA garnecha– atyAcArIharUlAI Aphno kRpAbATa TADhA pArnuhos | kinabhane duniyA~mA tinIharUkA lAgi kRpAko DhokA khullA thiyo tara tinIharUle tyasalAI vAstai garekA thienan |

45 yinai tI atyAcArIharU hun, jo AphaiM allAhako mArgabATa vimukha hune garthe ra arUlAI pani vimukha pArne garthe | sIdhA mArgalAI TeDho pArna khojthe tAki mAnisaharU tyasamA hi~Dana nasakun | tinIharU Akhiratako dinalAI inkAra garthe ra tyasako lAgi tayAra thienan |

46 svargabAsI tathA narkabAsI duvai samUhabIca euTA ArApha nAmI ucca parkhAla hunecha | tyasa ucca parkhAlamA kehI mAnisaharU hunechan, jasakA satkarma ra duSkarma barAbara hunechan | tinIharUle svargabAsIharUlAI unIharUkA ujyAlo anuhAra ra narkabAsIharUlAI unIharUkA kAlo anuhArabATa cinnechan | unIharUle svargabAsIharUlAI sammAnako lAgi bhannechan– timIharUmAthi zAnti hos! yadyapi unIharUle tyasabakhata svargamA praveza garna nasakekA bhaepani tyasako pUrNa AzAvAdI bhane rahanechan |

47 jaba tinIharUko dRSTi narkabAsIharUtarpha pharkAinecha ta tinIharUle pAiraheko kaDA yAtanA dekhera allAhalAI pukArdai bhannechan– he pAlanakartA! hAmIlAI tapAIko sAtha kuphra tathA zirka garera atyAcAra garneharUmA sAmela nagarnuhos |

48 ArApha (parkhAla) mA basekAle narkabAsI kAphiralAI tinIharUko cinha; kAlo muhAra ra pahelo A~khAbATa cinepachi bhannechan– timIharUkA dhanasampatti tathA jatthA timIharUko kunai kAma lAgena | ghamaNDa tathA ahaMkArale gardA satyabATa vimukha hune kAryale pani kunai phAidA diena |

49 allAhale kAphiraharUko nindA gardai bhannuhunecha– ke timIharUle yinIharUkai sambandhamA kasama khAne garthyau, allAhale yinIharUmAthi dayA garnuhune chaina? allAhale mominaharUlAI bhannuhunecha– he mominaharU ho! timIharU svargamA praveza gara | timIharUle bhaviSyamA je jati pAunechau tyasako bAremA kunai bhaya hunechaina ra vigatamA timIharUle je jati gumAekA chau tyasako bAremA kunai cintA pani hunechaina |

50 narkabAsIharUle svargabAsIharUsita anurodha gardai bhannechan– he svargabAsIharU ho! hAmItarpha pAnI bagAU vA allAhale pradAna garnubhaeko khAnA paThAU | svargabAsIharUle uttara dinechan– allAhale yI duvailAI kAphiraharUkA lAgi tinIharUko kuphrako kAraNale harAma (avaidha) garnubhaeko cha | allAhale timIharUkA lAgi harAma garnubhaeko vastu timIharUlAI dina sakdainauM |

51 yI tinai kAphiraharU hun, jasale Aphno dharmalAI manoraJjana evaM khela ThaTTA banAekA thie ra jasalAI sAMsArika jIvanakA sundaratAle bhramamA pAreko thiyo | ani mahApralayako dina allAhale tinIharUlAI (Aphno zAna anusAra) birsAunu bhayo, jasarI tinIharUle yasa dinako AgamanalAI birsekA thie ra yasako lAgi kunai satkarma tathA tayArI garekA thienan | kinabhane tinIharU hAmrA pramANaharUlAI satya mAndA mAndai asvIkAra garekA thie |

52 nissandeha tinIharU samakSa hAmIle yasa kurAlAI paThAekA chauM, jo muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) mAthi avataraNa garieko cha | yasalAI hAmIle Aphno jJAnako AdhAramA spaSTa pArekA chauM | yasale mominaharUlAI satmArga dekhAu~cha | yo mArgadarzana evaM dayA ho | yasamA loka ra paralokako bhalAi rahekole unIharUkA lAgi kRpA ho |

53 kAphiraharU pIDAdAyI prakopa avataraNako pratIkSAmA chan | yasa prakopako sUcanA tinIharUlAI dii sakieko cha | Akhiratako dina avazya tinIharUlAI prakopale samAtnecha | mominaharUlAI pani juna badalAko sUcanA diieko cha tyo tyasa dina avazya milnecha | duniyA~mA kurAnalAI birsine tathA tyasalAI vyavahAramA nalyAuneharUle bhannechan– nissandeha rasUlaharU satya liera AekA thie | yasamA kunai zaGkA thiena | nizcaya nai tyo satya allAhakai tarphabATa Aeko thiyo | (tara tyatikhera hAmIle ImAna lyAenauM, jasale gardA Aja narkamA jA~daichauM |) Aja hAmro lAgi kohI siphArisakartA bhaidieko bhae besa hunthyo | yastA siphArasakartAharU jasale hAmro yAtanA samApta garidina allAha samakSa siphArisa garun | vA hAmIharUlAI sAMsArika jIvanamA pharkAidieko bhae besa hune thiyo | hAmIharUlAI duniyA~mA pharkAinecha bhane aba yAtanAbATa bacna satkarma garnechauM | hAmI pahilAjhaiM kukarma gardainauM | vAstavamA yI kAphiraharUle kuphra garera AphaiMlAI barbAdImA pArekA chan | yinIharUle allAhalAI choDera juna bhagavAnaharUko pUjA garne garthe tI sabai Aja harAe ra yinIharUlAI kunai phAidA dienan |

54 he mAnavaharU! nissandeha timIharUkA pAlanakartA allAha hunuhuncha, jasale AkAzaharU tathA pRthvIlAI binA kunai aghillo udAharaNa 6 dinamA sRSTi garnubhayo | pheri Aphno arza (siMhAsana) mA Aphno zAna anusAra virAjamAna hunubhayo, jasako kaiphiyata hAmI jAnna sakdainauM | uhA~ rAtakA andhakAralAI dinako prakAzabATa ra dinako prakAzalAI rAtako andhakArabATa samApta pArnuhuncha | Dhilo nagarikana duvai eka arkAko pachADi yasarI vyavasthita DhaMgale Au~chan ki euTA jAne bittikai arko Aipugcha | allAhale nai sUrya, candramA tathA tArAharUlAI sRSTi garnubhayo | yI sabai uhA~kai niyantraNamA chan ra uhA~kai Adeza anusAra kAryarata chan | sAvadhAna! allAhale nai yI sabailAI sRSTa garnubhayo, ke allAhabAheka anya kohI sRSTikartA cha?! mAtra uhA~ kai Adeza calcha, uhA~ko bhalAi pani ThUlo cha ra upakAra pani mahAna | uhA~ sampUrNa guNaharUle paripUrNa, ati mahAna ra sampUrNa jagatakA pAlanakartA hunuhuncha |

55 he mominaharU ho! timIharU AphnA pAlanakartAsa~ga ati namratAkA sAtha, bilaunA gardai, gopya rUpamA, nisvArtha bhaera, uhA~sa~ga kasailAI sAjhedAra nabanAikana duA gara | duA gardA sImA ullaGghana garneharUlAI allAhale mana parAunuhunna | bahudevavAdIharU jastai allAhabAheka anya kasaisa~ga mAgnu bhaneko sabaibhandA ThUlo sImA ullaGghana ho |

56 allAhale AphnA rasUlaharU paThAera dhartImA sudhAra garepachi tathA yasalAI Aphno AjJApAlanabATa pUrNa garepachi timIharU pApa garera vidhvaMsa na maccAU | allAhako yatanAko Dara tathA uhA~ko tarphabATa badalAko AzA rAkhdai uhA~sa~ga duA gara | nissandeha allAhako dayA sukarmIharUko najika raheko cha, ataH unIharUmadhye bana |

57 allAhale nai hAvAlAI varSAaghi zubhasUcanA svarUpa paThAunuhuncha | jaba hAvAdvArA bAklA bAdalaharUmA pAnI bharincha taba hAmI tyasa pAnI bharieko bAdalalAI sukkhA dhartItira hA~kera laijAnchauM, ani tyasa sukkA dhartImA pAnI barsAu~chauM | ani pAnIbATa hareka prakArakA phalaphUla utpanna garchauM | jasarI hAmIle phalaphUla umAryauM tyasarI nai hAmIle mRtakaharUlAI cihAnabATa jIvita pArera nikAlnechauM | he mAnava! tAki timIharUle allAhako zakti tathA vibhinna sRSTimA cintana manan garnechau ra allAha mRtaharUlAI jIvita pArne sAmarthya rAkhnuhuncha bhanne kurAmA AsthA rAkhnechau |

58 uttama bhUmile allAhako anumatile rAmro tathA pUrNa biruvA utpanna garcha | momina pani tyastai ho, usale upadeza suncha ra tyasabATa phAidA uThAu~cha ani pariNAma svarUpa satkarma garcha | kharAba tathA nunilo (amlIya) bhUmile kAma nalAgne biruvA mAtra utpanna garcha | kAphira (avajJAkArI) pani tyastai ho, usale upadezaharUbATa phAidA uThAu~daina | satyalAI pramANita garnako lAgi hAmIle vibhinna prakArakA pramANa tathA tarkaharU varNana garchauM, yastA mAnisaharUkA lAgi jo allAhakA kRpAharUprati AbhAra vyakta garchan, tyasalAI inkAra gardainan ra AphnA pAlanakartAko AjJApAlana garchan |

59 nissandeha hAmIle nUha (alaihissalAma) lAI unako samudAyatarpha rasUla banAera paThAyauM | tAki unIharUlAI ekezvaravAdatarpha AhvAna garun ra bahudevavAdabATa rokun | ani unale Aphno samudAyalAI bhaneH he merA samudAya! allAhako mAtra bhakti gara | uhA~ bAheka timIharUko anya kohI vAstavika upAsya chaina | yadi timIharU kuphramai jiddI garchau bhane ma timIharUmAthi Aune bhayAnaka dinako yAtanAbATa sAvadhAna garna cAhanchu |
60 tinIharUko samudAyakA ThUlA aguvAharUle bhane– he nUha! hAmI ta timIlAI spaSTa satyabATa TADhA gaeko dekhchauM |

61 nUha (alaihissalAma) le Aphno samudAyakA aguvAharUlAI bhane– timIharUle ThAne jhaiM ma pathabhraSTa chaina | ma Aphno pAlanakartA allAhako tarphabATa satya mArgamA chu | ani ma timIharUko lAgi allAhako tarphabATa paThAieko rasUla hu~, jo allAha mero, timIharUko ra sampUrNa jagatakA mAnisaharUko pAlanakartA hunuhuncha |

62 ma Aphno pAlanakartAko sandeza timaharUsamakSa puryAu~chu | allAhakA Adezako pAlanA tathA tyasako badalAko lAgi prerita garera tathA duSkarmaharU tathA tyasale gardA hune yAtanAbATa manAhI garera timIharUkA lAgi bhalAi cAhanchu | allAhako tarphabATa malAI tyo kurAko jJAna cha jo jJAna timIharUlAI chaina, yo jJAna allAhale malAI vahI (prakAzanA) pradAna garnubhaeko cha |

63 ke timIharU yasa kurAle cakita bhayau ki timIharUsamakSa timIharUko cinajAnakai eka janA vyaktiko mukhabATa timrA pAlanakartAko tarphabATa vahI (IzavANI) tathA upadeza Ayo?! tyo vyakti timIharUbIca nai hurkiyo jo nata jhUTA ho na pathabhraSTa na arko sRSTi | ani timIharU allAhakA AdezaharUko pAlanA garera tathA varjita kAryaharUlAI tyAgera Izabhaya grahaNa gara | yadi timIharUle nUha (alaihissalAma) mAthi ImAna lyAu~chau bhane timIharUmAthi dayA garinecha bhanne kurAko AzA rAkha |

64 tara unako samudAyale unalAI vizvAsa garenan ra unImAthi ImAna lyAenan, baru jiddI garera kuphramai DaTirahe | antataH unale unIharUlAI sarvanAza garne duA gare | hAmIle unI ra unakA sAthamA rahekA mominaharUlAI euTA DuMgAmA rAkhera DubnabATa surakSita rAkhyauM ra bA~kI sabailAI bADhIbATa DubAera sarvanAza garyauM, jasale hAmrA nizAnIharUlAI jhUTA Thahara gare tathA yaso garna arUlAI protsAhita gare, hAmIle tinIharUlAI DubAidiyauM | nissandeha tinIharUkA hRdayaharU satyabATa andhA thie |

65 hAmIle Ada samudAyatarpha unIharU madhyebATa hUda (alaihissalAma) lAI rasUla banAera paThAyauM | unale bhane– he merA samudAyaharU ho! allAhako mAtra upAsanA gara, uhA~ bAheka timIharUko kohI vAstavika upAsya chaina | ke timIharU uhA~kA AdezaharUko pAlanA garera tathA varjita kAryaharU tyAgera uhA~sa~ga DarAu~dainau, tAki uhA~ko prakopabATa surakSita rahana saka?

66 allAhalAI inkAra garekA tathA uhA~kA rasUlalAI jhUTA Thahara garekA kAphira aguvAharUle bhane– he hUda! hAmIlAI thAhA cha timIsa~ga buddhi kama cha ra rIsa baDhI cha, tyasaile timIle eka allAhako mAtra bhaktitarpha hAmIharUlAI ahvAna garchau ra mUrtIharUko pUjAlAI choDna bhanchau | timI rasUla hune dAbI gareko kurAmA pakkA jhUTAharUmadhye ho bhanne hAmro vizvAsa cha |
67 hUda (alaihissalAma) le samudAyalAI bhane– he mero samudAya ho! mero buddhimA kamI chaina baru ma sampUrNa saMsArakA pAlanakartAkA rasUla hu~ |
68 allAhale dinubhaeko Adeza anusAra ma ekezvaravAda tathA zarIatatarpha imAndArIpUrvaka kunai kamI besI nagarIkana ahvAna gardachu |

69 ke timIharU yasa kurAle cakita bhayau ki timIharUsamakSa phariztA vA jinnamadhye hoina baru timI mAnavamadhye eka janA vyaktiko mukhabATa timIharUkA pAlanakartAko tarphabATa upadeza Aisakeko cha, tAki unale timIharUlAI DarAun?! allAhaprati AbhAra prakaTa gara, uhA~le timIharUlAI dhartImA sthApita garnubhayo | nUha (alaihissalAma) ko samudAyako uttarAdhikArI banAunubhayo jasalAI uhA~le tinIharUko kuphrako kAraNale sarvanAza garnubhayo | timIharUlAI ThUlo jIu tathA zakti pradAna garnubhayo | timIharUmAthi bhaeko allAhakA mahAna upakAraharUlAI smaraNa gara yasa AzAkA sAtha ki timIharUle cAhanA gareko vastu pAunechau ra DarabATa mukta hunechau |

70 unako samudAyale uttara die– he hUda! ke timI hAmIharUlAI mAtra eka allAhako bhaktitarpha AhvAna garna ra hAmrA pUrvajaharUle pUjdai AekA mUrtiharUlAI upAsanA nagara bhanna AekA hau?! suna, timI juna prakopako dhamkI diMdaichau yadi timI saccA chau bhane hAmI samakSa prastuta gara |
