71 hUda (alaihissalAma) le javAphamA bhane– timIharUmAthi timrA pAlanakartAko tarphabATa prakopa tathA krodha nizcita bhaisakeko cha, tyo avazya nai Aunecha | ke timIharU masa~ga yastA mUrtiharUko bAremA vAdavivAda garchau jasalAI timI ra timrA pUrvajaharUle pUjya banAekA chau, jasako kunai vAstaviktA chaina?! allAhale kunai pramANa avataraNa garnubhaeko chaina jasabATa timIharUle dAbI garekA pUjyaharUlAI satya-tathya pramANita garna saka | juna prakopako lAgi timIharU hatAra gardaichau tyasako pratIkSA gara ra ma pani timIharUsa~ga pratIkSA garchu, tyo avazya Aunecha |

72 antataH hAmIle hUda (alaihissalAma) tathA unakA momina sAthIharUlAI Aphno kRpAle jogAyauM | tara jasale hAmrA nizAnIharUlAI jhUTA Thahara gare tinakA jarAsameta naSTa pAridiyauM | tinIharU momina thienan baru jhUTA Thahara garneharU thie tyasaile prakopako bhAgIdAra bane |

73 samUdakA samudAyatarpha hAmIle unakA bhAi sAleha (alaihissalAma) lAI paThAyauM, tAki unale tinIharUlAI eka allAhamAthi ImAna rAkhne tathA uhA~kai bhakti garnatarpha bolAun | sAleha (alaihissalAma) le tinIharUlAI bhane– he merA samudAyaharU ho! mAtra eka allAhako bhakti gara, uhA~ bAheka timrA kohI upAsya chaina jo bhaktiko hakadAra hos | maile timIharU samakSa lyAeko sandeza satya ho bhanne pramANita garnako lAgi timrA pAlanakartAko tarphabATa spaSTa nizAnI Aisakeko cha | tyo timIharU samakSa euTA U~TanIko rUpamA euTA caTTAnabATa niskanecha | usako pAnI khAne samaya chuTTai hunecha ra timIharUko pAnI khAne samaya chuTTai hunecha | tyasalAI allAhako dhartImA carna choDideU | tyasalAI hAni puryAune manasAyale hAta nalagAU natra bhane timIharUmAthi duHkhada prakopa Aiparnecha |

74 allAhakA kRpAharUlAI yAda gara jaba uhA~le timIharUlAI Ada samudAyako uttarAdhikArI banAunubhayo | dhartImA basobAsa garne maukA pradAna garnubhayo, jasabATa timIharU phAidA uThAu~chau ra Aphno icchA purA garchau | yI sabai Adako vinAzapachi bhayo jaba usale ghamaNDa gardai kuphra tathA jhUTlAune kAma garyo | timIharU tyasako samatala maidAnamA mahala nirmANa garchau ra pahADalAI khopera ghara banAu~chau | allAhakA upakAraharUlAI smaraNa gara ra uhA~prati AbhAra prakaTa gara | allAhako avajJA tathA pApa garera dhartImA vidhvaMsa maccAune kriyAkalApa nagara |

75 unako samudAyakA ThUlA baDA ghamaNDI aguvAharUle kamajora pAriekA mominaharUlAI bhane– he mominaharU ho! ke sAleha vAstavamai allAhakA rasUla hun? kamajora pAriekA mominaharUle javApha die– juna sandezakA sAtha unalAI paThAieko cha tyasamAlAI hAmI saccA mAnchauM, tyasako AjJApAlana garchauM ra unale lyAeko zarIata anusAra kArya garchauM |

76 unakA samudAyakA ahaMkArIharUle bhane– he mominaharU ho! juna kurAmAthi timIharUle ImAna lyAekA chau tyasako hAmIharU inkAra gardachauM | hAmI kadApi tyasamAthi ImAna lyAune chainauM ra tyasa anusAra kArya garne chainauM |

77 antataH tinIharUle allAhako Adezako avahelanA garera tyasa U~TanIlAI gardhana kATera mAridie, jasalAI kaSTa dina manAhI garieko thiyo | ani, ThaTTA gardai tathA sAleha (alaihissalAma) le dieko prakopako dhamkIlAI TADhA ThAndai bhane– he sAleha! yadi timI allAhakA saccA rasUlaharUmadhye hau bhane juna prakopako dhamkI timIle diekA thiyau tyo hAmI samakSa liera AU |
78 ani kAphiraharU juna prakopako lAgi hatAra gardai thie tyo Aipugyo, bhayAvaha bhUkampale tinIharUlAI samAtyo | tinIharU jaminamA ghopTo parera mare ra sabai sarvanAza bhae kohI pani bacena |

79 jaba tinIharUle sAleha (alaihissalAma) ko ahvAna svIkAra garenan taba unI tinIharUbATa mukha pharkAera bhane– he merA samudAyaharU ho! malAI merA pAlanakartAle juna sandeza puryAune Adeza dinubhaeko thiyo tyo maile puryAidie~ ra timIharUlAI protsAhana garera tathA DarAera timIharUko bhalo cAheM, tara timIharUle bhane hitaiSI tathA yastA mAnisaharUlAI mana parAu~dainau jo timIharUlAI bhalAitarpha bolAuna tathA duSkAryabATa TADhA pArna lAlAyita rahanchan |

80 lUta (alaihissalAma) lAI yAda garnuhosa, jaba unale Aphno samudAyako duSkarmaprati ghRNA gardai bhane– ke timIharU Aphno kAmavAsanA puruSasa~ga purA garera ati ghRNita tathA azlIla kArya garchau?! yasa duSkarmako suruvAta timIharUle garyau, timIharU bhandA aghi duniyA~mA kasaile yasto gareko thiena?

81 timIharU puruSaharUsita kAmavAsanA purA garchau ra mahilAharUsita gardainau, jasalAI tyasako lAgi sRSTi garieko cha | timIharU yo kArya gardA na buddhiko prayoga garchau na upadezako ra na prAkRtika niyamako? vAstavamA timIharU mAnavIya madhya mArga choDera tathA ThIka buddhibATa vicalita bhaera tathA pratiSThita prakRtilAI tyAgera allAhale nirdhArita garnubhaeko sImAko ullaGghana garchau |

82 tara, azlIla kAryamA lipta bhaekA unako samudAyako uttara yasabAheka kehI thiena– lUta tathA unImAthi ImAna lyAekA mAnisaharUlAI Aphno gAu~bATa bAhira nikAla | yinIharU hAmIharUko kAmabATa bacera khuba pavitra banna khojchan | hAmIbIca unIharU basun, yo hAmIharUlAI sohAu~daina |

83 ani hAmIle lUta tathA unImAthi ImAna lyAekA mAnisaharUlAI surakSita rAkhyauM ra lUtakI patnI bAheka sabailAI prakopa Aune bastIbATa rAtA-rAta niskane Adeza diyauM | jo prakopamA grasta huneharUmadhyekI thiI, Akhira prakopamA parihAlI |

84 hAmIle tinIharUmAthi bhISaNa varSA garyauM, yahA~samma ki DhuMgAle prahAra garyauM | tinIharUko gAu~lAI palTAera ulTo pAridiyauM | he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! vicAra garnuhos, ke bhayo lUta (alaihissalAma) ko aparAdhI samudAyako duSpariNAma? tinIharUko pariNAma apamAna janaka tarikAle sadhai~ko nimti sarvanAza bhayo |

85 madayana samudAyatarpha hAmIle tinakA bhAi zuaiba (alaihissalAma) lAI paThAyauM | unale tinIharUlAI bhaneH he merA samudAyaharU ho! mAtra allAhako upAsanA gara | uhA~ bAheka timIharUko kohI upAsya chaina, jo upAsanAko hakadAra hos | allAhako tarphabATa timIharU samakSa maile lyAeko sandezako spaSTa pramANa tathA tarka Aipugeko cha | timIharU nApataula purA purA garera mAnisaharUko haka purA gara | unIharUkA sara sAmAnamA kamI nagara vA tinIharUlAI dhokA nadeU | allAhale dhartImA sandeSTAharU paThAera sudhAra garisakepachi timIharU kuphra tathA pApa garera vidhvaMsa namaccAU | yadi timIharU momina hau bhane, ukta kurAharUko pAlanA mai timIharUko bhalAi tathA hIta cha | kinabhane yasamA allAhadvArA manAhI gariekA kurAharUbATa dUrI ra allAhako AjJApAlanadvArA uhA~ko nikaTatA prApta garne mAdhyama cha |

86 mAnisaharUlAI dhamkAuna, tinIharUkA dhanasampatti khosna, sIdhA mArga khojneharUlAI tyasa mArgabATa rokna ra allAhako mArgalAI TeDho pArna timIharU bATomA nabasa | allAhakA kRpAlAI smaraNa gara tAki timIharU uhA~prati AbhAra prakaTa gara | timIharU alpasaMkhyaka thiyau ani allAhale timIharUko saMkhyAlAI baDhAunubhayo | vicAra gara, timIharUaghi vidhvaMsakArIharUko pariNAma kasto bhayo! unIharUko pariNAma bhayo sarvanAza tathA barbAdI |

87 maile lyAeko sandezamAthi timIharUmadhyeko eka samUhale ImAna lyAeko cha ani arko samUhale ImAna lyAeko chaina | he jhUTA Thahara garneharU ho! allAhale timIharUbIca nirNaya garuJjela pratIkSA gara | uhA~ sarvottama nirNAyaka hunuhuncha |

88 zuaiba (alaihissalAma) ko samudAyakA ghamaNDI aguvAharUle unalAI bhane– he zuaiba! timI ra timIsa~ga ImAna lyAuneharU hAmro dharmamA phirtA Aunai parcha natra hAmIle timIharUlAI Aphno samudAyabATa nikAlera nai choDanechauM | zuaiba (alaihissalAma) le Azcarya cakita hu~dai bhane– timIharUko dharma asatya bhaekole hAmI tyasalAI mana parAu~dainauM, ani kasarI timIharUko dharmamA phirtA Auna sakchauM?!

89 yadi hAmI timIharUko dharmamA phirtA bhayauM bhane hAmI pani allAhamAthi jhUTo Aropa lagAunevAlAmadhye hunechauM | kinaki timIharU kuphra tathA zirkamA chau jasabATa allAhale hAmIlAI jogAunubhaeko cha | timIharUko dharmamA phirtA hunu ekadamai ThIka chaina; hAmro pAlanakartA allAhale nai cAhanubhayo bhane beglai kurA ho, kinabhane hAmI sabai allAhako cAhanAko pAbanda chauM | hAmrA pAlanakartAle hareka kurAlAI rAmrarI jAnnuhuncha, uhA~bATa kunai pani cIja lukna sakdaina | allAhale hAmIlAI sIdhA mArgamA rAkhnuhuncha ra narkatarpha liera jAne mArgabATa bacAunuhuncha bhanne kurAmA uhA~mAthi hAmro bharosA cha | he hAmrA pAlanakartA! hAmI ra kAphira samudAyabIca nyAyakA sAtha nirNaya garidinuhos ani pIDitalAI atyAcArI zatrubATa bacna maddata garnuhos | he hAmrA pAlanakartA! tapAIM sarvottama nirNAyaka hunuhuncha |

90 ekezvaravAdako ahvAnalAI nakArne unakA samudAyakA kAphira netAharUle AphnA bastIkA mAnisaharUlAI DarAu~dai bhane– yadi timIharUle zuaibako dharmamA praveza garyau ra AphnA pUrvajaharUko dharmalAI choDyau bhane timIharU avazya nai barbAda hunechau |
91 antataH bhayAnaka bhUkampa gayo ani tinIharU AphnA gharamai ghopTo parera mare ani sabaiko sarvanAza bhayo |

92 zuaiba (alaihissalAma) lAI jhUTo Thahara garne sabai yasarI barbAda bhae mAnauM tinIharU tyahA~ kahilyai basekai thienan ra tyahA~ kunai kisimako phAidA uThAekai thienan | zuaiba (alaihissalAma) lAI jhUTlAuneharU ghATAmA rahe, kehI hAta pArenan | mominaharU ghATAmA parenan jasto ki yI jhUTlAune kAphiraharUle bhanne garthe |

93 zuaiba (alaihissalAma) le Aphno samudAyaharUlAI sambodhana gardai bhaneH he merA samudAyaharU ho! merA pAlanakartAle juna sandeza puryAune Adeza dinubhaeko thiyo tyo timIharUsamakSa puryAisakeM ra timIharUko hita nai cAheM tara timIharUle mero upadeza svIkAra garenau ra mero nirdezanako pAlanA garenau | allAhalAI inkAra garne tathA tyasamA jiddI garne samudAyamAthi kina pachutAunu?!

94 samudAyaharUmadhye juna samudAyamA pani hAmIle nabI paThAyauM ani tyahA~kA bAsindAle inkAra gare tathA tyasalAI jhUTo Thahara gare hAmIle tinIharUlAI daridratA, kaThinAI tathA rogamA grasta pAryauM, yasa AzAkA sAtha ki tinIharUle allAhaprati vinamratA apanAun ra AphUle apanAeko kuphra tathA ghamaNDalAI tyAgun | yo cetAvanI kuraiza ra sabai kAphira tathA jhUTlAuneharUkA lAgi ho | jhUTlAuneharUko pariNAma yastai huncha |

95 tinIharUko daridratA, kaThinAI tathA rogalAI hAmIle bhalAi, sampannatA tathA zAntimA pariNata garyauM yahA~samma ki tinIharUko saMkhyA tathA dhanasampattimA dherai vRddhi bhayo | tinIharUle bhane– hAmIharUlAI je jati duHkha-sukha pugekA chan tyastai duHkha-sukha yasa aghi hAmrA pUrvajaharUmAthi pani AekA thie | vAstavamA, tinIharUkA pUrvajalAI pATha sikAunako lAgi hAmIle chuTa diekA thiyauM | hAmIle tinIharUlAI akasmAt samAtyauM ra tinIharUlAI tyasa prakopako thAhA bhaena |

96 hAmIle juna samudAyaharUmA nabIharU paThAekA chauM tyahA~kA bAsIharUle unIharUkA sandezalAI svIkAra garekA bhae, kuphra tathA pApaharUlAI tyAgera tathA allAhakA AdezaharUko pAlanA garera Izabhaya rAkhekA bhae hAmI tinIharUkA lAgi cAraitirabATa bhalAikA DhokAharU kholne thiyauM, tara tinIharUle nata svIkAra gare na Izabhaya nai apanAe baru rasUlaharUkA sandezalAI jhUTo Thahara gare | ani tinIharUkA pApa tathA kukarmako kAraNale hAmIle tinIharUlAI akasmAta samAtyauM |
97 ke yasa samudAyakA bAsIharU masta sutiraheko avasthAmA hAmro prakopa Aipugne cha bhanne kurAbATa nizcinta chan?
98 vA ke yasa samudAyakA bAsIharU dinako pahilo praharamA khela kuda tathA sAMsArika mAmilAmA masta raheko avasthAmA hAmro prakopa Aipugne cha bhanne kurAbATa nizcinta chan?

99 allAhale tinIharUlAI dherai zakti ra rAmro jIvIkA pradAna garera chuTa dinubhayo | ke yasa samudAyakA yI jhUTlAuneharU allAhako jukti tathA gopya yojanAbATa nizcinta chan? allAhako juktibATa sarvanAza huneharU mAtra nizcinta rahane garchan | tara mArgadarzana pAekA mAnisaharU allAhakA juktiprati saceta rahane garchan, uhA~le pradAna garnubhaeko kRpAbATa dhokA khA~dainan baru tyasalAI uhA~ko paropakAra ThAnera tyasaprati AbhAra prakaTa garchan |

100 ke yI uttarAdhikArIharUle vigatamA AphnA pApaharUle gardA sarvanAza gariekA mAnisaharUbATa kehI pATha sikenan? baru tinIharUle purvajaharU jastai galata kArya gare | ke yinIharUlAI thAhA chaina- allAhale cAhanu bhaemA yinIharUko pApale gardA yinIharUlAI pani naSTa garnuhuncha ra tinIharUkA hRdayamAthi sila (mohara) lagAunuhuncha | tyasapachi nata tinIharUle kunai upadeza lina sakchan na upadezale tinIharUlAI asara garcha |

101 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! yI vigatakA (nUha, hUda, sAleha, lUta tathA zuaiba (alaihimussalAma) kA samudAyaharUkA) bastIharU hun | jasakA kehI sUcanAharU, tinIharUle jhUTo Thahara garekA kurAharU ani tinIharUmAthi AekA prakopaharU tapAIMlAI batAu~daichauM, tAki yasabATa pATha siknale pATha sikun ra upadeza grahaNa garnele upadeza grahaNa garun | yI bastIkA bAsindAharUsamakSa tinIharUkA rasUlaharU spaSTa pramANaharU liera Ae | vigatakA sandeSTAharUmAthi unIharUkA samudAyakA mAnisaharUle ImAna lyAenan baru jhUTo Thahara gare, kinabhane allAhale Aphno agrima jJAnale vAstavikatA jAnnu huncha tyasaile tinIharUkA hRdayaharUmAthi sila lagAunubhayo | tyastai muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) lAI nakArneharUkA hRdayaharUmAthi pani sila lagAunubhaeko cha, tyasaile yinIharUle ImAna lyAune chainan |

102 hAmIle sandeSTAharU paThAiekA samudAyaharUmadhye adhikAMzalAI pratijJAko kunai pAlanA nagarne, allAhako upadeza grahaNa nagarne tathA uhA~kA AdezaharUko pAlanA nagarne pAyauM | baru tinIharUmadhye adhikAMzalAI allAhakA AjJAbhandA bAhira pAyauM |

103 yI rasUlaharUpachi hAmIle mUsA (alaihissalAma) lAI AphnA spaSTa pramANa tathA nizAnIharU diera phirauna evaM usako samudAyatarpha paThAyauM ani tinIharUmadhye sabaile tI nizAnIharUlAI inkAra gare | ani he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! vicAra garnuhos! allAhale kasarI tinIharUlAI DubAera naSTa pArnubhayo? uhA~le tinIharUlAI loka ra paraloka duvaimA dhikkArnubhayo |

104 jaba allAhale mUsA (alaihissalAma) lAI phiraaunatarpha paThAunubhayo, taba unI U samakSa gaera bhane: he phirauna! ma sampUrNa saMsArakA sRSTikartA, pAlanakartA tathA prabandhakako tarphabATa paThAieko rasUla hu~ |

105 mUsA (alaihissalAma) le bhane– ma allAhakA rasUla bhaekole ma mAtra satya kurA garchu | ma timIharUko lAgi hAmro pAlanakartAko tarphabATa paThAieko satya rasUla hu~ ra uhA~le svayam spaSTa pramANa pani dinubhaeko cha | ataH banI isrAIlamAthi bhairaheko atyAcAralAI banda gara ra unIharUlAI mukta pArera masa~ga jAna deU |
106 phiraunale mUsA (alaihissalAma) lAI bhanyo– yadi timI kunai camatkAra liera AekAchau bhane tyasalAI prastuta gara, yadi timI Aphno dAbImA satya chau bhane |
107 ani mUsA (alaihissalAma) le Aphno lauro phyA~ke ra tyo darzakaharUkA lAgi spaSTa tathA ThUlo ajiGgara banyo |

108 ani, unale Aphno hAta chAtI najika raheko kamijako khullA bhAgabATa vA kAkhIbATa bAhira nikAle ra tyo tyatikhera nai darzakaharUkA sAmu ati seto bhaera Talkina thAlyo, tara tyo seto dubI roga thiena |
109 ani phiraunakA aguvAharUle ukta duIvaTA camatkAraharUlAI dekhera bhane– nizcaya nai, yo atyanta jAnakAra tathA dakSa jAdugara ho |
110 yasale timIharUlAI timro deza (misra) bATa nikAlna cAhancha | phiraunale AphnA vizeSa aguvAharUsita salAha mAgdai bhanyo– mUsA (alaihissalAma) ko bAremA timIharUle ke rAya-sallAha dinchau?

111 tinIharUle phiraunalAI parAmarza die– mUsA (alaihissalAma) ra unakA bhAi hArUna (alaihissalAma) lAI maukA dinuhos ra sabai jAdUgaraharUlAI jammA garna misrakA sabai zaharaharUmA sUcanAkAraharUlAI paThAunuhos |
112 tapAIMkA sUcanAkAraharUle sabai zaharaharUbATa sabai jAnakAra tathA dakSa jAdUgaraharUlAI jammA garera lyAunechan |

113 jAdugaraharUlAI jammA garna phiraunale sUcanAkAraharUlAI paThAyo | jaba jAdUgaraharU jammA bhae taba tinIharUle phiraunalAI sodhe– yadi hAmI mUsA (alaihissalAma) mAthi vijayI bhayauM bhane ke hAmIlAI pArizramika milcha?
114 phiraunale javAphamA bhanyo– a~, nissandeha timIharUlAI pArizramika milnecha ra rAjadarabArako ucca pada pani pAera mero najika hunechau |

115 jAdugaraharUle mUsA (alaihissalAma) mAthi vijaya avazya prApta hunecha bhanne kurAmA bharosA rAkhdai tathA ghamaNDa gardai bhane– mUsA! yA ta timI je phyA~kna cAhanchau tyo phyA~kera pahilA suru gara vA hAmI phyA~kera pahilA suru garchauM |

116 mUsA (alaihissalAma) le Aphno pAlanakartAko sahayogamA bharosA gardai ra jAdUgaraharUko paravAha nagarI bhane– timIharU Aphno lauro (laThThI) tathA DorIharU phyA~ka | ani, jaba tinIharUle phyA~ke taba mAnisaharUkA A~khAharUmA jAdU garidie, A~khAharU sahI tarikAle dekhnabATa pherie, tinIharU DarAie ra yasarI tinIharUle mAnisaharUkA A~khAmA bhayAnaka DaralAgdo jAdU prastuta gare |

117 allAhale Aphno nabI mUsA (alaihissalAma) tarpha vahI (sandeza) paThAunubhayo– he mUsA! phyA~ka Aphno lauro | jaba unale Aphno lauro phyA~ke ta tyo lauro ajiGgara jasto sarpa banera tinIharUkA jAdUrupI nakkalI DorI ra lauroharUlAI nilna thAlyo, jasalAI tinIharUle vAstavika kurAlAI ra mAnisaharUlAI bhramamA pArnako lAgi prayoga garekA thie ki yI sarpaharU hun |
118 nitAnta satyako vijaya bhayo | mUsA (alaihissalAma) satyamA mArgamA chan bhanne kurA charlaGga bhayo ra jAdUgaraharUle dekhAekA jAdU jhUTo ho bhanne kurA pani pramANita bhayo |
119 tinIharU sabai tyasa maidAnamA parAjita bhae ra mUsA (alaihissalAma) vijayI bhae | jAdUgaraharU khubai apamAnita bhaera pharkie |
120 sabai jAdugaraharU allAhakA mahAn zakti tathA spaSTa nizAnIharU dekhera allAhaprati natamastaka bhae |
121 jAdUgaraharUle bhane– hAmIle sabai sRSTiharUkA pAlanakartAmAthi ImAna lyAyauM |
122 mUsA (alaihissalAma) tathA hArUna (alaihissalAma) kA pAlanakartAmAthi | uhA~ mAtra upAsanA yogya hunuhuncha, uhA~ bAheka kohI pani upAsanA yogya chainan |

123 jaba jAdUgaraharUle eka allAhamAthi ImAna lyAe taba unIharUlAI dhamkI diMdai phiraunale bhanyo– maile anumati dinubhandA pahile nai timIharUle mUsA (alaihissalAma) mAthi ImAna lyAyau? nizcaya nai mUsA (alaihissalAma) tathA unale lyAeko sandezamAthi timIharUko ImAna lyAunu dhokA tathA SaDayantra ho | jasalAI timIharU tathA mUsA (alaihissalAma) le yasa samudAyakA bAsindAharUlAI yahA~bATa niSkAsana garnakA lAgi garekA chau | he jAdUgaraharU ho! timIharUko ke pariNAma hunecha ra kasto sajAya diinecha bhanne kurA timIharUle cA~Dai nai thAhA pAunechau |

124 ma nizcaya nai timIharU pratyekako dAhine hAta tathA debre khuTTA vA debre hAta tathA dAhine khuTTA kATidinechu ani timIharUlAI sajAya dina tathA sabai darzakaharUlAI saceta garnako lAgi timIharU sabailAI khajurakA rukhamA zUlI dinechu |
125 jAdUgaraharUle phiraunako dhamkIko javAphamA bhane– timIlAI je sajAya dina mAna cha deU | hAmIharU AphnA pAlanakartAtarpha pharkera nai jAnechauM | timro dhamkIko kunai paravAha chaina |

126 he phirauna! allAhako nizAnImAthi AsthAvAna hunu galata ho bhane yo nai hAmro pApa ho | pheri tinIharU vinamra bhaera yo duA gardai allAhatarpha pharke- he hAmrA pAlanakartA! hAmIharUlAI satyamA kAyama rahane zakti ra dhairya pradAna garnuhos | hAmIharUlAI muslima (AjJApAlaka) bhaera, tapAIMko Adezako pAlanA gardai tathA tapAIMkA rasUla (alaihissalAma) ko anusaraNa gardai gareko avasthAmA mRtyuvaraNa garAunuhos |

127 phiraaunako samudAyakA ThUlA baDA aguvAharUle phiraunalAI mUsA (alaihissalAma) tathA unakA momina sAthIharUviruddha bhaDakAu~dai bhane– he phirauna! ke tapAIMle mUsA (alaihissalAma) ra unako samudAyalAI tyasai dhartImA vidhvaMsa maccAu~dai choDidinu huncha jabaki unIharUle tapAIM ani tapAIMkA pUjyaharUlAI choDi sakekA chan ra mAtra eka allAhako upAsanAko ahvAna gardaichan? phiraaunale uttara diyo– hAmI banI isrAIlakA putraharUko vadha garnechauM ra unIharUkA mahilAlAI sevAko lAgi jIvita chADnechauM | ani hAmro sattA, prabhutva tathA Dara unIharUmAthi kAyama nai cha |

128 mUsA (alaihissalAma) le Aphno samudAyalAI upadeza diMdai bhane– he merA samudAya ho! kaSTa nivAraNa garna tathA phAidA prApta garna allAhasita mAtra sahAyatA mAga ra kaSTamA dhairya dhAraNa gara | nissandeha dhartI allAhakai ho, phirauna vA anya kasaiko lAgi hoina ki tinIharUle rAja garun | allAhale Aphno cAhanA anusAra pAlai pAlo jasalAI cAhanuhuncha sattA pradAna garnuhuncha | tara dhartImA antimamA saphalatA mominaharUko lAgi ho jo allAhakA AdezaharUko pAlanA garchan ra uhA~le manAhI garekA kAryaharUbATa bacchan | je jati saGkaTaharU Ae pani yo dhartI unIharUkai lAgi ho |

129 mUsA (alaihissalAma) ko samudAyale bhane– he mUsA! tapAIMko AgamanabhandA aghi pani phiraunale hAmrA putraharUlAI vadha garera tathA hAmrA mahilAlAI choDera satAune garthyo ra tapAIMko Agamana pazcAt pani hAmIlAI satAu~daicha | mUsA (alaihissalAma) le unIharUlAI upadeza diMdai tathA rAmro dina Aune zubhasUcanA diMdai bhane– AzA cha timIharUkA pAlanakartAle timro zatru phirauna tathA usakA samudAyalAI naSTa pArnuhunecha ra tinIharUpachi timIharUlAI dhartIko sattA pradAna garnuhunecha, ani tyasapachi timIharUle uhA~prati AbhAra vyakta garnechau vA kRtaghna bannechau bhanne kurA uhA~le hernuhunecha |

130 hAmIle phiraunakA samudAyalAI sukhkhA tathA phalaphUla ra khAdyapadArthako kamImA grasta garyauM | yo samasyA tinIharUko kuphrale gardA bhaeko ho tinIharUle upadeza grahaNa garun ani taubA garun |

131 jaba phiraunaharUlAI sukha, hariyAlI, phalaphUla dherai hanthyo ra tyo sasto hunthyo taba tinIharU bhantheH hAmI yasakA hakadAra hauM tyasaile vizeSarUpamA yo hAmIlAI pradAna garieko cha | jaba tinIharUlAI sukhkhA, bhokamarI tathA duHkha parthyo taba mUsA (alaihissalAma) tathA unakA sAthI banI isrAIlalAI doSa di~dai AphnA lAgi azubha ra yo duHkha unIharUle gardA Aeko ho bhanthe | vAstavikatA ke cha bhane tinIharUlAI je jati kaSTa pugcha tyo allAhale bhAgyamA nirdhArita garnubhaeko cha, tyasamA tinIharU tathA mUsA (alaihissalAma) ko kunai dakhala chaina | sivAya yasako ki mUsA (alaihissalAma) le tinIharU viruddha duA gare | tara tinIharUmadhye adhikAMsalAI thAhA chaina ani tinIharU allAha bAheka anya kasaile gareko bhancha |

132 phiraunakA samudAyale satyalAI asvIkAra gardai mUsA (alaihissalAma) lAI bhaneH timIle hAmIharU samakSa junasukai camatkAra tathA nizAnI liera Ae pani ra hAmro dharmalAI radda gardai tyasabATa phernako lAgi juna sukai pramANa lyAe pani hAmIharU timImAthi ImAna lyAune chainauM |

133 hAmIle tinIharUko zatrutA ra badamAsIle gardA sajAya svarUpa ThUlo bADhI paThAyauM, jasale gardA tinIharUkA khetIpAtI tathA phalaphUla Dubna puge | hAmIle tinIharUtarpha salaha paThAyauM jasale tinIharUkA khetIpAtIlAI khAidiyo | hAmIle ghuna tathA uDusa paThAyauM, jasale tinIharUkA anAja tathA jiulAI hAni puryAe | hAmIle tinIharUtarpha bhyAguto paThAyauM jo tinIharUkA bhA~DAmA pare ra tinIharUko khAnAlAI bigAre tathA tinIharUko ochyAnalAI phohara gare | hAmIle tinItarpha ragata paThAyauM jasale gardA tinIharUkA inAra tathA nadIkA pAnI ragatamA pariNata bhayo | yI sabailAI hAmIle khullA nizAnIharU banAera ekapachi arkAlAI paThAyauM tara jahile pani saGkaTa Au~dA tinIharUle ghamaNDa gardai mUsA (alaihissalAma) le lyAeko sandezamAthi ImAna lyAuna inkAra gare | tinIharU duSkarmI thie, asatyalAI choDera satyalAI svIkAra gardainathe |

134 jaba tinIharUmAthi prakopa Ayo, taba tinIharUle mUsA (alaihissalAma) lAI bhane– he mUsA! timIlAI AphnA pAlanakartAko tarphabATa juna nubUvata (IzadUtatva) prApta cha ra timIle taubA garemA uhA~le prakopa haTAune juna vAcA garnubhaeko cha tyasako AdhAramA hAmIharUbATa prakopa haTAuna prArthanA gara | yadi timIle hAmIharUbATa prakopa haTAu~chau bhane hAmIharU timImAthi ImAna lyAunechauM, banI isrAIlalAI mukta garera timIsa~ga paThAidinechauM |

135 jaba hAmIle pAnImA DubAune prakopa eka avadhikA lAgi haTAyauM taba tinIharUle ImAna lyAune tathA banI isrAIlalAI mukta garne vacana bhaGga gare | tinIharU kuphramai kAyama rahe ra banI isrAIlalAI mUsA (alaihissalAma) sa~ga paThAuna inkAra gare |

136 tinIharUlAI naSTa pArne nirdhArita samaya Aepachi hAmIle samudramA curlumma DubAune prakopa paThAyauM, kinabhane tinIharUle hAmrA spaSTa nizAnIharUlAI jhUTo Thahara gare tathA satyabATa vimukha bhae |

137 hAmIle banI isrAIlalAI pUrvadekhi pazcimasammakA uttarAdhikArI banAyauM jasalAI phirauna tathA usako samudAyale Aphno kabjAmA rAkhekA thie | yI bhUbhAgalAI zAmakA zaharaharU; sIriyA, urduna, phalastIna ityAdi bhanincha | allAhale yasamA khetI bADI tathA phalaphUla umArera barkatayukta banAunubhaeko cha | he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! tapAIMkA pAlanakartAko rAmro vANI yasa nizAnImA pUrNa bhayo- hAmI dhartImA kamajora pAriekA mAnisaharUmAthi Aphno paropakAra pUrNa garna cAhanchauM, unIharUlAI aguvA tathA dhartIkA vArisa banAuna cAhanchauM | (sUraha al-kasasH 5) ani allAhale tinIharUlAI dhartImA sthApita pArnubhayo kinabhane unIharUle phirauna tathA usakA samudAyale diekA pIDAprati dhairya gare | hAmIle phiraunakA khetI bADI tathA ucca bhavanaharUlAI naSTa garidiyauM |

138 jaba mUsA (alaihissalAma) le laurole samudramA hirkAe taba tyasale bATo diyo, yasarI hAmIle banI isrAIlalAI samudra pAra garAyauM, ani tyahA~bATa hi~Depachi tinIharU yasto samudAyakahA~ Ae jo allAhalAI choDera AphnA kehI mUrtiharUko pUjA gardai thie | ani banI isrAIlale mUsA (alaihissalAma) lAI bhane– he mUsA! yinIharUle pUjA garirAkhekA mUrtiharUjhaiM hAmrA lAgi pani euTA mUrti banAidinuhos tAki hAmIharU tyasako pUjA garauM | mUsA (alaihissalAma) le tinIharUlAI bhane– he merA samudAya ho! allAhako mahAnatA nabujhekAle timIharU ekezvAravAdalAI tyAgera zirkako daladalamA phasna khojirahekA chau |
139 mUrtI pUjA gairullAhako bhakti bhaekole tyo avazya nai naSTa hunecha | tinIharUle allAhako bhaktimA jasalAI sAjhedAra batAu~dai chan tI sabai asatya hun |

140 mUsA (alaihissalAma) le Aphno samudAyalAI bhane– he mero samudAya ho! ma allAhabAheka timIharUkA lAgi kunai arko pUjya kuna AdhAramA khojU~, jabaki timIharUle uhA~kA mahAn nizAnIharU dekhisakyau, sAthai uhA~le timIharUlAI Aphno yugakA dherai mAnisaharUmAthi zreSThatA pradAna garnubhayo | timrA zatrulAI naSTa pArera timIharUlAI dhartIkA uttarAdhikArI banAera tathA sthApita garera timIharUmAthi kRpA garnubhayo?!

141 he banI isrAIla! yAda gara, jaba hAmIle timIharUlAI phirauna tathA usakA samudAyale garirAkhekA apamAnabATa mukta pAryauM | tinIharU timrA putraharUlAI badha garthe ra timrA mahilAlAI sevAko lAgi jIvita choDera timIharUlAI kaSTa puryAune garthe | timIharUlAI phirauna tathA usako samudAyabATa mukti pradAna garne kAryamA timIharUkA lAgi timrA pAlanakartAko tarphabATa kaDA parIkSA ho | timIharUle uhA~prati AbhAra vyakta garnuparcha |

142 allAhale mUsA (alaihissalAma) sa~ga kurAkAnI garna tIsa rAtako avadhi nirdhArita garnubhayo ani tyasamA arU 10 rAta thapera cAlIsa rAta purA garnubhayo | jaba mUsA (alaihissalAma) le allAhasa~ga kurAkAnI garna yAtrA garne nIyata gare taba Aphno bhAi hArUna (alaihissalAma) lAI bhane– he hArUna! mero anupasthitimA mero samudAyamA uttarAdhikArIko kAryabhAra samhAla ani rAmro vyavahAra tathA namratAkA sAtha tinIharUko mAmilA sudhAra gara | duSkarma garera vidhvaMsakArIharUko mArgamA nahi~Da ra avajJAkArIharUko sahayogI nabana |

143 jaba mUsA (alaihissalAma) AphnA pAlanakartasa~ga kurAkAnI garna nirdhArita avadhi cAlIsa rAtako lAgi Ae ra uhA~kA AdezaharU tathA varjita kAryaharUbAre kurAkAnI gare taba unako manamA pAlanakartAlAI dekhne icchA bhayo, ani unale Aphno pAlanakartAsa~ga dekhne icchA prakaTa gare | allAhale bhannubhayo– timImA yasa sAMsArika jIvanamA malAI dekhnasakne kSamatA nabhaekole malAI kadApi dekhna sakdainau | tara, timI parvatatarpha hera ma prakaTa hu~dA yadi tyo Aphno sthAnamA sthira rahayo tathA prabhAvita bhaena bhane timIle malAI dekhna saknechau | yadi tyo dhartIko barAbara huncha bhane timI malAI duniyA~mA dekhna sakdainau | jaba allAhale parvatamAthi tajallI (Aphno prakAza) avataraNa garnubhayo taba tyo parvata TukrA-TukrA bhaera barAbara jamina bhayo ra mUsA (alaihissalAma) behoza bhaera laDe | jaba unI hozamA Ae taba bhane– he pAlanakartA! ma tapAIMko pavitratAko guNagAna garchu, tapAIM tI sabai kurAbATa pavitra hunuhuncha jo tapAIMko yogya chaina | tapAIMle AphUlAI duniyA~mA malAI dekhAunuhos bhanne juna mAga maile gareko thie~ tyasaprati kSamAyAcanA garchu ra ma Aphno samudAyamA ImAna lyAuneharUmadhye sarvaprathama hu~ |

144 allAhale mUsA (alaihissalAma) lAI bhannubhayo– he mUsA! maile timIlAI mAnavajAtiko lAgi sandeSTA banAera ra timIsa~ga pratyakSa kurA garera sampUrNa mAnavamAthi zreSThatA pradAna gareko chu | maile pradAna gareko sammAnalAI grahaNa gara ra maprati AbhAra prakaTa garneharUmadhye bana |

145 hAmIle mUsA (alaihissalAma) ko lAgi kAThakA pATI vA anya pATIharUmA banI isrAIlalAI Avazyaka bhaekA dhArmika tathA sAMsArika mAmilAharUsita sambandhita upadeza, AdezaharU tathA vidhividhAna lekhera diyauM | tAki upadeza grahaNa garnele yasabATa upadeza grahaNa garos | he mUsA! yasa taurAtalAI dRDhatApUrvaka samhAla ra Aphno samudAya banI isrAIlalAI tyasamA rahekA upadezaharUlAI rAmro tarikAle upadezako pAlanA garne jastai- Adeza diiekA kAryalAI pUrNarUpamA garnu, dhairya garnu, mApha garnu ityAdi Adeza deU | mero Adezako ullaGghana garne tathA mero AjJApAlana nagarneharUko narAmro pariNAma tathA vinAza ma cA~Dai nai timIlAI dekhAunechu |

146 allAhakA asala bhaktaharUmAthi ghamaNDa garne tathA islAmabATa binA pramANa vimukha huneharUlAI ma AkAzamA, mAnavabhitra tathA mero kitAbamA rahekA nizAnIharUbATa zikSA grahaNa garnabATa TADhA nai rAkhnechu | tinIharUle yI sabai nizAnIharU dekhe pani ImAna lyAu~dainan kinabhane tinIharUlAI yasaprati kheda cha ra yasabATa tinIharU vimukha chan, sAthai tinIharU allAha tathA uhA~kA rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) sita zatrutA rAkhchan | allAhako prasannatA prApta garne sIdhA mArga pAe pani tinIharU tyasamA hi~Ddainan na tyasamA cAso linchan | tara, tinIharUle allAhako krodhalAI nimtyAune kumArga bheTTAemA tyasamA hi~Dchan | kinaki tinIharUle rasUlaharUle lyAeko sandeza ra allAhakA mahAn nizAnIharUlAI jhUTo Thahara gare ra tyasamA socavicAra garnamA lAparavAhI gare |

147 yastA mAnisaharUkA satkarma vyartha hunechan, jasale hAmrA rasUlaharUko nizAnIharU ra mahApralayamA allAhasa~ga bheTa hune kurAlAI inkAra gare | tinIharUlAI tI karmaharUko puNya prApta hunechaina kinabhane tinIharUle ImAna lyAenan, jabaki kunai pani karma svIkArya hune sarta ImAna nai ho | mahApralayako dina pani tinIharUlAI tinIharUle gareko kuphra tathA zirkako kAraNale sadhaiMko lAgi narka nai milnecha |

148 mUsA (alaihissalAma) AphnA pAlanakartAsita prArthanAko lAgi gaepachi unako samudAyale gara-gahanAharUbATa pUjya svarUpa bAchAko euTA mUrti banAe, tyasamA AtmA ta thiena tara AvAja thiyo | ke tinIharUle jAnenan- yo bAchAle tinIharUsa~ga kurAkAnI garna sakdaina, nirjIva tathA sajIva kunai kisimako bhalAitarpha nirdezana dina sakdaina, na phAidA puryAuna sakcha na khatarAlAI TArna sakcha?! tinIharUle tyasto pUjya banAera vAstavamA AphUmAthi atyAcAra gare |

149 bAchA banAera tathA allAhasa~ga tyasalAI pUjya banAera pathabhraSTa bhaekA chan bhanne kurA jaba tinIharUle bujhe ra lajjita bhae taba allAha samakSa bintI gardai bhanna thAle: yadi hAmrA pAlanakartAle hAmIharUlAI Aphno AjJApAlanako maukA diera tathA hAmrA pApalAI mApha garera dayA nagareko bhae hAmI nizcaya nai loka ra paraloka duvaimA ghATA khAneharUmadhye hunethiyauM |

150 jaba mUsA (alaihissalAma) AphnA pAlanakartAsa~ga bhalAkusArI garera pharke taba Aphno samudAyalAI bAchAko pUjAmA lipta pAera ati krodhita evaM dukhita bhaera bhane– he merA samudAya ho! mero anupasthitimA timIharUle kati narAmro avasthA sRjanA garyau jasako pariNAma vinAza tathA abhAgI hunu ho | ke timIharU mero pratIkSA gardA gardai dikka bhayau ra bAchAko pUjAmA lipta bhayau?! mUsA (alaihissalAma) le krodha tathA duHkhale pATIharUlAI ekatarpha phyA~ke ra AphnA bhAi hArUna (alaihissalAma) ko kapAla tathA dAhrI samAtI unalAI AphUtira tAnna thAle, kinabhane unI tinIharUsa~ga nai baseko avasthAmA tinIharUle bAchAko pUjA garekA thie ra pani unale sudhAra garena | hArUna (alaihissalAma) le Aphno vivazatA prakaTa gardai tathA dayA garne anurodha gardai bhane– he merA AmApaTTikA dAi! mAnisaharUle malAI durbala ThAne, mero apamAna gare ra hatyA garne prayAsa gare | ataH malAI sajAya diera zatruharUlAI mero hA~so uDAune maukA nadinuhos ra tinIharUle allAhabAheka arUko bhakti gare bhanera mero gaNanA tI atyAcArIharUmA nagarnuhos |

151 mUsA (alaihissalAma) le allAhasita duA gare– he merA pAlanakartA! malAI ra mero bhAi hArUna (alaihissalAma) lAI kSamA pradAna garnuhos | hAmIlAI hareka dRSTile Aphno kRpAmA samAveza garnuhos | he hAmrA pAlanakartA! tapAIM sabai dayAluharUbhandA mahAna dayAvAn hunuhuncha |

152 juna vyaktiharUle bAchAlAI pUjya banAera tyasako bhakti garna thAle tinIharU avazya AphnA pAlanakartAko prakopamA grasta hunechan ra sAMsArika jIvanamA apamAnita hunechan kinabhane tinIharUle AphnA pAlanakartAlAI krodha dilAe tathA apamAna garna khoje | allAhamAthi jhUTo gar3hneharUlAI hAmIle yastai daNDa dine garchauM |

153 jo mAnisaharUle zirka tathA avajJA jastA duSkarma gare ra tyasapachi allAha samakSa taubA garera ImAna lyAe tathA vigatamA garirAkhekA pApaharUlAI tyAge | he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! nizcaya nai tapAIMkA pAlanakartA taubA pachi zirkalAI chADera ImAna pharkane ra duSkarmalAI tyAgera satkarmatira lAgneharUmAthi ati kSamAzIla evaM dayAvAn hunuhuncha | uhA~le tinIharUko pApalAI DhAknuhunecha ra mApha garnuhunecha |

154 jaba mUsA (alaihissalAma) ko krodha zAnta bhayo taba unale pATIharU uThAe, jasalAI unale risale gardA phAlekA thie | jasamA AphnA pAlanakartAsita DarAuneharU tathA uhA~ko sajAyabATa tarsineharUkA lAgi mArgadarzana tathA kRpAko varNana thiyo |

155 mUsA (alaihissalAma) le AphnA samudAyakA sattara janA puruSaharUlAI cayana gare tAki tinIharUkA bevakUphaharUle bAchAlAI pUjya banAeko mahApApako lAgi AphnA pAlanakartAsita mAphI mAgun | allAhale tinIharUko upasthitiko lAgi nizcita samaya dinubhaeko thiyo | jaba tinIharU tyahA~ puge taba A~Ta garera mUsA (alaihissalAma) sita bhane hAmI AphnA A~khAle allAhalAI dekhne cAhanchauM | yo bhandA bittikai tyahA~ bhUkampa Ayo ra tinIharU Darale gardA laDe tathA marna puge | taba mUsA (alaihissalAma) le bintI garera bhane– he merA pAlanakartA! yadi tapAIMle cAhanubhaeko bhae tinIharUlAI ra malAI pani yahA~ Aunu aghi nai naSTa garna saknu hunuhunthyo | ke tapAIMle hAmIharUmadhye kehI mUrkhaharUle garekA aparAdhale gardA hAmI sabailAI naSTa garnuhuncha? mero samudAyale je jasto bAchAko pUjA gare tyo euTA parIkSA thiyo, jasadvArA tapAIMle jasalAI cAhanuhuncha pathabhraSTa garnuhuncha ra jasalAI cAhanuhuncha mArgadarzana garnuhuncha | tapAIM hAmrA mitra hunuhuncha | ataH hAmIharUkA pApaharUlAI mApha garnuhos ra hAmIharUmAthi AphnA vizAla kRpAbATa dayA garnuhos, tapAIM kSamA garnuhuncha tathA hAmrA pApalAI mApha garnuhuncha |

156 hAmIharUlAI tI mAnisaharUmadhye banAunuhos jasalAI tapAIMle yasa jIvanamA vibhinna kRpAharU, sukha zAnti tathA satkarma garne maukA pradAna garnubhayo, jasalAI AkhiratamA satkarmIharUmadhye banAunubhayo ra jasako lAgi svarga tayAra pArnubhayo | hAmIharUle tapAIM samakSa taubA (pazcAttApa) garyauM ra Aphno kamI-kamajorIlAI svIkAra garera tapAIMtarpha pharkera AyauM | allAhale bhannubhayoH yo yo mero yAtanA ho, galata kArya garneharUmadhye jasalAI cAhanchu yAtanA dinchu, tara mero dayA cAhi~ saMsArakA hareka vastumAthi chAeko cha | kunai pani yasto prANI chaina josamma allAhako dayA napugeko hos ra uhA~ko kRpA tathA paropakArale usalAI naDhAkeko hos | AkhiratamA maile Aphno kRpA tI mAnisaharUkA lAgi avazya nai lekhnechu jo allAhako AdezaharUko pAlanA garera tathA varjita kAryaharUlAI tyAgera uhA~sita DarAu~chan, hakadAraharUlAI Aphno dhanasampattibATa jakAta dine garchan ra hAmrA nizAnIharUmAthi ImAna rAkhchan |

157 muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) ummI hunuhuncha arthAta svayam lekhna ra paDhna jAnnuhunna | baru uha~kA pAlanakartAle vahI (prakAzanA) paThAunuhuncha | uhA~ko nAma, guNa tathA nubUvata (IzadUtatva) bAre mUsA (alaihissalAma) mAthi avatarita taurAta tathA IsA (alaihissalAma) mAthi avatarita injIlamA lekhieko pAu~chan | muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) le tinIharUlAI rAmrA tathA ThIka kAryaharUko Adeza dinuhuncha ra sahI viveka tathA prAkRti viparIta rahekA narAmrA kAryaharUbATa manAhI garnuhuncha | hAni noksAnI nagarne phAidAjanaka ra pavitra kurAharUlAI jAyaja Thahara garnuhuncha, jastai khAna pina tathA vivAha garnu | hAnikAraka tathA apavitra kurAharUlAI harAma garnuhuncha | kaThina jimmevArI tathA bojhabATa mukti pradAna garnuhuncha, jastai hatyArAko hatyAlAI anivArya garnu, cAhe jAnIjAnI hatyA gareko hos vA anjAnamA | ataH jasale uhA~ (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) ko anusaraNa gare, banI isrAIla ra anya samudAyamadhye jasale uhA~ (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) mAthi ImAna lyAe, uhA~ko sammAna gare, kAphiraharU viruddha uhA~ko maddata gare tathA uhA~mAthi avataraNa bhaeko kurAna (prakAza) ko anusaraNa gare, unIharU nai saphala mAnisaharU hun jasale AphUle cAheko kurAharU pAunechan ra DarAirahekA kurAharUbATa surakSita rAkhinechan |

158 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! bhanidinuhos: he mAnava ho! ma timIharU sabai arabI tathA gaira arabItarpha tyasa allAhadvArA paThAieko rasUla hu~ jasakA lAgi AkAzaharU tathA dhartImA zAsana raheko cha | uhA~ bAheka kohI vAstavika pUjya chaina | uhA~ mRtalAI jIvana pradAna garnuhuncha ra jIvitalAI mRtyu dinuhuncha | ataH he mAnava! allAhamAthi ImAna lyAU, uhA~kA nabI (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) mAthi ImAna lyAU jo ummI hunuhuncha (svayama na paDhna jAnnuhuncha na lekhna jAnnuhuncha) | uhA~kA pAlanakartAle je vahI pradAna garnubhayo tyahI liera Aunubhayo | uhA~ allAha, uhA~mAthi avataraNa tathA uhA~bhandA aghi bitekA nabIharUmAthi avataraNa vANIharUmAthi binA bhedabhAva ImAna rAkhnuhuncha | uhA~le je jati AphnA pAlanakartAko tarphabATa liera Aunubhaeko cha tyasako anusaraNa gara, tAki timIharUle loka ra paralokakA hitatarpha mArgadarzana pAuna saka |

jaba allAhale banI isrAIlakA yastA mAnisaharUko carcA garnubhayo jasale bAccholAI Aphno pUjya banAekA thie, ta sAthasAthai arko tyasto samUhako pani carcA garnubhaeko cha, jasale bAcchoko pUjA garneharUko virodha garekA thie | tyasaile bhannubhaeko chaH
159 mUsA (alaihissalAma) ko samudAya banI isrAIlamadhye euTA jamAta ThIka dharmamA kAyama cha | arU mAnisaharUlAI tyasatarpha bolAu~cha | nisAphakA sAtha nirNaya garcha ra atyAcAra gardaina |

160 hAmIle banI isrAIlalAI alaga alaga 12 vaTA kabilA (khAnadAna) mA vibhAjita garyauM | unako samudAyale unIsita pAnIko lAgi allAhasita duA garne mAga gardA hAmIle mUsA (alaihissalAma) lAI vahI (prakAzanA) garyauM– he mUsA! timI Aphno lauro DhuGgAmA hAna | unale DhuGgAmA hAndA tyasabATa banI isrAIlakA 12 vaTA kabilA (khAnadAna) lAgi 12 vaTA muhAna phuTe ra pratyeka kabilAle A-Aphno pAnIko ghATa cinyo jasamA arko kabilA sAjhedAra thiena | hAmIle tinIharUmAthi bAdalako chAyA~ pAryauM jo tinIharUsa~ga hi~Dane garthyo ra jahA~ tinIharU ubhinthe tyahIM bAdala pani rokinthyo | hAmIle tinIharUkA lAgi maha jasto svAdilo peya ra baTTAI (titrA raMgako bha~gero) jasto dekhine sAno carAko svAdilo mAsu avatarita garyauM ra bhanyauM- hAmIle pradAna gareko yI pavitra khAnAharU khAU | unIharUle gareko atyAcAra, kRtaghnatA tathA garnuparne kadara nagarnule hAmro kunai kamI garena baru tinIharUle allAhako Adezako ullaGghana tathA uhA~kA kRpAharUlAI nakArera Aphnai vinAzalAI nimtiyAe ani AphaiMmAthi atyAcAra gare |

161 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! smaraNa garnuhos, jaba allAhale banI isrAIlalAI bhannubhayo– timIharU baitula- makdisamA praveza gara, yahA~kA sampUrNa phalaphUlaharU nirdhakka bhaera khAU ra bhana- he hAmrA pAlanakartA! hAmrA pApaharUlAI mApha garnuhos ra DhokAbhitra nihurera tathA AphnA pAlanakartAsa~ga bintI gardai pasa | yadi timIharUle yaso garnechau bhane hAmI timIharUko pApalAI kSamA garidinechauM ani sukarmIharUlAI loka ra paralokakA bhalAi ajha baDhAera dinechauM |

162 tara atyAcArIharUle Adeza diieko kurAlAI parivartana garera arkai kurA bhane | tinIharU allAhasa~ga mAphI mAgnuko saTTA jauko dAnA bhanna thAle | tinIharUle allAhako Adezako kAryamA pani parivartana gare | allAhako lAgi bintIkA sAtha zira nihurAera praveza garnuko saTTA ghisriera praveza garna thAle | ani hAmIle tinIharUko atyAcArako kAraNale AkAzabATa prakopa paThAyauM |

163 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! yahUdIharUlAI smaraNa garAu~dai nadIko kinAramA raheko samudAyabAre sodhnuhos | tinIharUle zanibArako dina simA ullaGghana garna thAle | kinabhane zanibArako dinamA nai mAchAharU tinIharUko najika pAnIko satahamA Aune garthe ra zanivArabAheka anya dinaharUmA Au~dainathe | tinIharU AjJApAlanabATa niskekole tathA avajJA garna thAlekole tinIharUko parIkSA liyauM | tinIharU kasarI zikAra garthe bhane tinIharU jAla gADne ra khADala khanne garthe, tyasamA zanivArako dina mAchA khasne garthe ani aitavArako dina tyasabATa mAchA liera jAne ani khAne garthe |

164 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) yAda garnuhos, jaba euTA jamAtale satkarma garna ra kukarma nagarna AhvAna garthyo tyatibelA tinIharUlAI arko samUhale bhana: timIharU yastA mAnisaharUlAI kina upadeza dinchau jasalAI tinIharUko avajJAle gardA allAhale duniyA~mA vinAza garnuhunecha tathA AkhiratamA kaThora yAtanA dinuhunecha?! upadeza dine samUhale javApha diyo: rAmro kAmako Adeza dina ra narAmro kAmabATa rokna ani allAha samakSa doSa mukta huna ra uhA~ko pakaDabATa bacnako lAgi hAmIle upadeza dinchauM | AzA cha tinIharUle upadezabATa phAidA uThAunechan ani avajJAlAI tyAgnechan |

165 jaba avajJAkArIharUko samUhale upadeza grahaNa garenan ra nirantara avajJAmA lipta rahe | taba hAmIle pahilo samUhalAI bacAyauM ra zanivArako dina mAchAko zikAra garne avajJAkArI samUhalAI kaDA prakopamA samAtyauM | kinabhane tinIharU allAhako AjJApAlana garenan ra avajJAmA jiddI gare |

166 jaba tinIharUle ghamaNDa, avajJA tathA zatrutAmA sImA ullaGghana gare ra upadeza grahaNa garenan taba hAmIle Adeza diyauM– he avajJAkArIharU ho! timIharU apamAnita bA~dara hoU | ani tinIharU hAmro Adeza anukUla bA~dara bane | jaba hAmI kunai kArya garna cAhanchauM taba bhanchauM- bhaI hAla, ani tyo hunapugcha |

167 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! yAda garnuhos, jaba allAhale spaSTa ghoSaNA garnubhayo– uhA~le mahApralayako dinasamma yahUdIharUmAthi yastA mAnisaharUlAI thopI rahanuhunecha jasale tinIharUlAI duniyA~mA apamAnita garirahane chan | he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! nissandeha tapAIMkA pAlanakartA avajJAkArIharUlAI chiTo daNDa dinuhuncha yahA~samma ki duniyA~mA pani tinIharUlAI sajAya dinuhuncha | nissandeha uhA~ taubA garne bhaktaharUkA pApaharUlAI mApha garnuhuncha tathA dayA garnuhuncha |

168 hAmIle tinIharUlAI dhartImA vibhinna samUha tathA guTamA vibhAjita garidiyauM jabaki tinIharU pahilA eka thie | tinIharUmadhye euTA samUha sajjana thiyo ra allAhakA ra uhA~kA bhaktaharUkA adhikAra purA garthyo bhane dosro samUha madhyamArgI thiyo ra tesro samUha avajJA garera AphUmAthi jyAdatI garnevAlA thiyo | hAmIle tinIharUko parIkSA sukha tathA duHkhabATa gardai garyauM tAki tinIharUle garirAkheko kukarmalAI tyAgun |

169 tinIharUpazcAt duSkarmIharUle tinIharUko sthAna lie | Aphno pUrvajabATa taurAta pAe, tyasalAI paDhne garthe tara tyasalAI kAryAnvayana gardainathe | tinIharU allAhako kitAba (grantha) mA pherabadala garna tathA uhA~le avataraNa nagareko Adeza anusAra nirNaya garna ghUsa line garthe | ani allAhale cA~Dai tinIharUlAI mApha garnuhunecha bhanne socthe | yadi sAMsArika dhanasampatti paTaka-paTaka Ae bhane tinIharUle linechan | ke tinIharUsa~ga allAhale yo vacana linubhaeko thiena- tinIharUle allAhabAre binA heraphera satya bAheka arU kehI bhanne chainan? tinIharUle kitAba anusAra karma garna ajJAnatAle gardA choDenan baru jAnIjAnI choDe, tinIharUle tyasalAI paDhe pani ra jAne pani yasarI tinIharUle ThUlo pApa gare | Akhiratako ghara tathA tyasamA rahekA varadAnaharU sadhaiM rahanechan ra saMsArakA samApta hune varadAnabhandA uttama chan tI mAnisaharUkA lAgi jo allAhakA AdezaharUko pAlanA garera tathA varjita kAryaharUlAI choDera uhA~sa~ga DarAu~chan | ke yastA mAnisaharU buddhi rAkhdainan jo saMsArakA kSaNika tathA samApta hune dhanasampattilAI AkhiratakA sadhaiM rahane kRpAharUbhandA uttama tathA baDhI TikAu ThAnchan, jasalAI allAhale Izabhaya rAkhneharUkA lAgi tayAra pArnubhaeko cha?!

170 jo mAnisaharU allAhakA kitAbalAI dRDhatApUrvaka samAtchan, tyasamA rahekA AdezaharUko pAlanA garchan ra samayako pAbandI, sarta, anivArya tathA sunnata kAryaharUko pAlanAkA sAtha namAja kAyama garchan, allAhale tinIharUlAI cA~Dai nai tyasako badalA dinuhunecha | allAhale satkarmIharUko puNyalAI vyartha garnuhunna |

171 he nabI (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! yAda garnuhos, jaba banI isrAIlale taurAtamA lekhieko kurAlAI mAnna inkAra gare taba hAmIle pahADalAI uThAera tinIharUmAthi ubhyAyauM ani pahADalAI bAdala jhaiM ziraharUmAthi chAyA~ garyauM, tyo tinIharUmAthi khascha bhanne tinIharUlAI bhayo | tinIharUlAI bhaniyo- timIharUlAI je jati hAmIle pradAna garekAchauM tyasalAI dRDhatApUrvaka samAta ra tyasamA je jati AdezaharU diiekA chan, tinalAI nabirsikana yAda rAkha | AzA cha yaso garera timIharU allAhasa~ga DarAunechau |

172 he nabI (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! yAda garnuhos, jaba tapAIMkA pAlanakartAle Adama (alaihissalAma) kA santAnaharUkA piThyU~harUbATa tinakA santAnaharUlAI sRSTi garnubhayo ra uhA~ nai tinIharUkA pAlanakartA hunuhuncha bhanne kurAko vAcA lidai sodhanubhayo– ke ma timIharUko pAlanakartA hoina? tinIharU sabaile bhane– kina nahunu? hAmI sAkSI chauM, tapAIM hAmrA pAlanakartA hunuhuncha | tinIharUko prAkRtimA rAkhiekole unIharUle yasto javApha die | allAhale bhannubhayo– yo timIharUko parIkSAko lAgi garekAchauM ra timIharUbATa vacana liekA chauM tAki timIharUle mahApralayako dina inkAra garna nasaka ra yo timIharUko inkArako viruddha pramANa banos | timI yo bhanna nasaka ki hAmIlAI yasako jJAna thiena |

173 vA yo pramANita garna nasaka ki hAmrA pUrvajale vacana bhaGga garekA thie, ani allAha~ga zirka garekA thie | hAmI ta tinIharUpachikA santAna paryauM, tinIharUlAI juna zirkamA pAyauM tyasailAI anusaraNa garyauM | ani yo pani nabhana- he hAmrA pAlanakartA! ke tapAIMle hAmIlAI tyasa duSkarmako sajAya dinuhuncha jo hAmrA pUrvajale gare?! tinIharUle allAsa~ga sAjhedAra banAera AphnA karmaharUlAI barbAda pAre, hAmro kunai doSa chaina, hAmIle je garyauM tyo ajJAnatA tathA AphnA pUrvajako anusaraNamA garyauM |

174 jasarI hAmIle jhUTo Thahara garne samudAyaharUko bAremA nizAnIharU spaSTa pAryauM, tyasarI nai yinIharUko lAgi pani spaSTa pArnechauM tAki yinIharU allAhasa~ga gariraheko zirkalAI tyAgera eka mAtra allAhamAthi ImAna lyAun ra uhA~ko bhaktitarpha pharkun |

175 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! banI isrAIlalAI tinIharUkai tyasa vyaktiko bAremA sUcita garnuhos jasalAI hAmIle AphnA nizAnIharU pradAna garyauM | usale tyasamA raheko satyalAI bujhyo tara tyasa anusAra karma garena | baru tyasako pAlanAbATa panchera bhAgyo ra zaitAna usako sAthI banyo | ani U mArgadarzana tathA mukti pAepachi pathabhraSTaharUmadhye banna pugyo |

176 yadi hAmIle cAheko bhae ukta nizAnIharUdvArA phAidA puryAune thiyauM | tyasa anusAra karma garne maukA diera loka ra paraloka duvaimA ucca sthAna ra saphalatA pradAna garne thiyauM | tara usale sAMsArika mojamastImA lipta bhaera apamAnako bATo rojyo | sAMsArika jIvanalAI Akhiratako jIvanabhandA prAthamikatA diera kukarma garyo | saMsAraprati usako lAlacako udAharaNa kukura jasto cha, jo hareka avasthAmA jibro bAhira nikAlI nirantara svA~-svA~ garcha | dhapAu~dA pani svA~-svA~ nadhapAu~dA pani svA~-svA~ garcha | hAmrA nizAnIharUlAI jhUTo Thahara garne pathabhraSTaharUko yo udAharaNa ho | he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! tapAIM yo kathA tinIharUlAI sunAunuhos | hunasakcha tinIharU juna satyatAlAI jhUTalAune tathA pathabhraStAmA lipta chan tyasabATa bAhira Aune bAremA socavicAra garun |
177 hAmrA pramANaharUlAI asatya Thahara garne ra ImAna nalyAune mAnisaharU ekadamai narAmrA chan | tinIharUle AphailAI vinAzamA hAlera AphaiMmAthi atyAcAra garirahekA chan |

178 allAhale jasalAI Aphno sIdhA mArga dekhAunuhuncha usale nai vAstavamA sIdhA mArga pAu~cha ra jasalAI sIdhA mArgabATa TADhA pArnuhuncha, tinIharU nai Aphno aMzamA kamI garchan | tinIharUle AphUlAI tathA AphnA parivArakA sadasyaharUlAI mahApralayako dina ghATAmA pAre | sAvadhAna! vAstavika ghATA bhaneko yahI ho |

179 dheraijaso jinna tathA manuSyaharUle narkabAsIle gare jasto kAma garnechan bhanne pUrva jJAna bhaekole hAmIle tinIharUlAI narkako lAgi sRSTi garekAchauM | tinIharUko hRdaya cha tara Aphno hita tathA hAnIko kurA bujhdainan; A~khA chan tara tyasabATa jagata tathA mAnavabhitra rahekA allAhakA nizAnIharUlAI dekhdainan, kAna chan tara tyasabATa allAhakA nizAnIharUmA cintana manan garne garI sundainan | yastA mAnisaharU buddhiko prayoga nagarne kurAmA pazu jastai chan baru tyasabhandA pani baDhI bATo gumAekA chan | tinIharU allAha ra AkhiratamAthi ImAna lyAune sambandhamA asAvadhAna chan |

180 allAhakA utkRSTa nAmaharU chan, jo uhA~ko pUrNatA tathA zAnalAI spaSTa pArchan | timIharU duA gardA tathA allAhako nikaTatA prApta gardA yI utkRSTa nAmaharUlAI mAdhyama banAU ra uhA~ko suhAune prazaMsA tathA guNagAna gara | tI vyaktiharUlAI choDideU jasale uhA~kA nAmaharUlAI anya kasaiko lAgi banAera vA tyasako inkAra garera vA tyasako arthamA heraphera garera vA tyasako upamA arUsa~ga diera satyabATa yatAutA bahakinchan | hAmIle satyabATa yatAutA bahakineharUlAI cA~Dai nai pIDAdAyI yAtanA dinechauM |

181 hAmrA sRSTimadhye yastA jamAta pani chan, jo AphaiM satmArgamA hiMDne garchan ra anya mAnisaharUlAI pani satmArgatarpha bolAu~chan | unIharU nyAya-nisAphakA sAtha phaisalA garchan ra atyAcAra gardainan |

182 jo mAnisaharUle hAmrA nizAnIharUlAI jhUTo Thahara gare ra ImAna lyAenan, tinIharUkA lAgi hAmIle rAmro jIvikAko DhokA kholnechauM | yo tinIharUko sammAnako lAgi hoina baru kramazaH vinAzatarpha liera jAnako lAgi ho | tAki tinIharU pathabhraSTatAmA ajhai agADi baDhun ra yasai dhokAmA rahadai hAmro yAtanAmA grasta houn |

183 ma tinIharUbATa prakopalAI DhIlo pArdaichu tAki tinIharUle prakopa Au~daina bhanera ThAnun, ani nirantara jhUTo Thahara garne tathA kuphra garne kArya garirahun, yahA~samma ki tinIharUkA prakopalAI kaiyauM guNA baDhAiyos | nissandeha mero yojanA ati dRDha cha | bAhirI rUpamA tinIharUprati paropakAra garchu tara vAstavamA tinIharUlAI apamAnita garna cAhanchu |

184 ke allAhakA nizAnIharU tathA rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) lAI jhUTo Thahara garneharUle vicAra garenan, buddhi prayoga gardA spaSTa hunthyo- unIharUkA sAthI muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) kunai baulAhA hunuhunna | uhA~ ta allAhakA rasUla hunuhuncha, allAhale uhA~lAI mAnisaharUlAI praSTarUpamA saceta garnako lAgi paThAunubhayo |

185 ke tinIharUle AkAzaharU tathA dhartIko prabandhamA ra allAhale sRSTi garekA janAvara tathA rukha viruvA ityAdimA zikSA linegarI vicAra garenan? ke tinIharUko mRtyuko samaya najika pugeko cha bhanne kurAmA vicAra garenan, tAki tinIharUle samaya bitnu aghi nai taubA garun? yadi tinIharUle kurAna jasto kitAba, tyasamA rahekA vAcA ra Dara dekhAieko kurAharUmA ImAna lyAu~dainan bhane tyasabAheka kuna kitAbamA ImAna lyAunechan ta?!

186 jo mAnisaharUlAI allAhale satyabATa TADhA pArnubhayo ra sIdhA mArgabATa pathabhraSTa garnubhayo usalAI kunai mArgadarzakale sIdhA mArga dekhAuna sakdaina | allAhale tinIharUlAI tinako pathabhraSTatA tathA kuphramA nai hairAna bhaI ghumna choDnubhaeko cha | tinIharUle sIdhA mArga pAunai sakdainan |

187 tapAIMlAI jAnIjAnI jhUTo Thahara garneharUle sodhchan- mahApralaya (kayAmata) kahile Aunecha ra tyasako jJAna kasarI huncha? he nabI (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! bhanidinuhos– tyasako jJAna nata masa~ga cha na arUsa~ga; tyasako jJAna ta mAtra allAhasa~ga cha | tyasalAI tyasako nirdhArita samayamA mAtra allAhale prakaTa garnuhunecha | mahApralaya hune mAmilA AkAza ra dhartIbAsIharUbATa gopya rAkhieko cha | tyo timIharUsamakSa akasmAta Aunecha | tinIharUle mahApralayako bAremA yasarI sodhchan mAnauM tapAIM yasako khojImA lAgnubhaeko cha | he nabI (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! bhanidinuhos– yasako jJAna mAtra allAhalAI cha, tara adhikAMza mAnisaharU yasako bAremA jAndainan |

188 he nabI (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! bhanidinuhos– allAhale nacAhikana nata ma svayaMko lAgi lAbha prApta garna sakchu na AphUbATa hAnilAI haTAuna sakchu, kinabhane yo allAha kai tarphabATa huncha | malAI tyati jJAna mAtra cha jati allAhale malAI sikAunubhaeko cha | tyasaile masa~ga adRzya (gaiba) vAstavikatAko jJAna chaina | masa~ga gaibako jJAna bhaeko bhae maile hitakArI kArya garne thie~ ra hAnikAraka kArya tyAgne thie~ | ma allAhako tarphabATa rasUla mAtra hu~ | ma je jati liera Aeko chu tyo satya ho bhanne kurAmA ImAna rAkhneharUlAI allAhako pIDAdAyI yAtanAbATa DarAu~chu ra uhA~ko rAmro badalAko zubhasUcanA dinchu |

189 he puruSa tathA mahilA ho! allAhale nai timIharUlAI eka vyakti Adama (alaihissalAma) bATa sRSTi garnubhayo ra Adama (alaihissalAma) ko karaGabATa unakI zrImatI havvA (alaihassalAma) lAI sRSTi garnubhayo | tAki unale unalAI mAyA garun ani santuSTi prApta garun | jaba patile patnIsa~ga sahavAsa garcha taba patnIle garbha dhAraNa garchin | suruko avasthAmA haluko rahekole unale mahasusa gardainin | garbha bojhilo nabhaekole unale tyasalAI liera hi~DaDula garirahanchin ra Aphno AvazyakatA purA garirahanchina | peTa ThUlo bhaepachi unalAI bojhilo huncha taba duvai dampati AphnA pAlanakartA allAhasita yo bhandai prArthanA garchan– he hAmrA pAlanakartA! yadi tapAIMle hAmIlAI rAmro ra asala zizu pradAna garnuhuncha bhane hAmI avazya nai tapAIMko kRpAprati AbhArI hunechauM |

190 jaba allAha duvaikA duA svIkAra garnuhuncha ra asala zizu pradAna garnuhuncha, taba duvaile allAhako sRSTimA uhA~sa~ga zirka garna thAlcha, zizulAI allAhabAheka arUko bhakta banAu~cha tathA usako nAma abdula hArisa (hArisako bhakta) rAkhcha | tara allAha tinIharUko zirkabhandA ati ucca tathA pavitra hunuhuncha, uhA~ mAtra pAlanakartA tathA pUjya hunuhuncha |

191 ke tinIharUle mUrti ityAdilAI allAhako upAsanAmA sAjhedAra banAu~chan? jabaki tinIharUlAI thAhA cha yI mUrtiharUle kunai pani vastu sRSTi gardainan, jasako kAraNa bhaktiko hakadAra banun, baru tinIharU svayam sRSTi gariekA hun | ani tinIharU kuna AdhAramA yI mUrtiharUlAI allAhako sAjhedAra banAu~chan?
192 yI pUjyako rUpamA rAkhiekA mUrtiharUle nata AphnA bhaktaharUlAI maddata garne kSamatA rAkhdachan na svayaMlAI nai bacAuna sakchan, ani kuna AdhAramA tinIharU yinako bhakti garchan?!

193 he bahudevavAdIharU ho! allAhalAI choDera juna mUrtiharUlAI pUjya banAekA chau, yadi timIharUle tinIharUlAI sIdhA mArgatarpha bolAu~chau bhane tinIharUle timIharUko kurAko na javApha dinechan na anusaraNa garnechan | ataH timIharUle tinIharUlAI bolAU vA na bolAU duvai samAna cha, kinabhane tinIharU nirjIva vastu mAtra hun, na bujhna sakchan, na sunna sakchan ra na bolna sakchan |

194 he bahudevavAdIharU ho! timIharU allAhabAheka jasako pani bhakti garchau tinIharU pani timIharU jastai allAhakA sRSTi ra dAsa hun | baru timIharU unIharU bhandA rAmro avasthAmA chau, kinabhane timIharU jIvita chau, bolna sakchau, hi~Dna sakchau, sunna sakchau ra dekhna sakchau | jabaki mUrtiharU yasto garna sakdainan | yadi timIharU Aphno dAbImA saccA chau bhane timIharUle guhArekomA tinIharUle javApha dinuparne ho |

195 ke yI mUrtiharUkA khuTTA chan jasadvArA hi~DaDula garchan ra timIharUkA AvazyakatA purA garna prayAsa garchan? vA tinIharUkA hAtaharU chan jasadvArA zaktikA sAtha timIharUko bacAu garchan? vA tinIharUkA A~khAharU chan jasadvArA tinIharUle adRzya kurAharUlAI dekhchan? vA ke tinIharUkA kAnaharU chan jasadvArA tinIharUle gopya kurAharU sunera timIharUlAI batAu~chan? yadi tinIharUsa~ga yI cIjaharUmadhye kehI pani chaina bhane timIharUlAI kasarI phAidA puryAune chan ra hAnibATa bacAune chan? yasto AzA bokera kina tinIharUko pUjA garchau?! he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! yI bahudevavAdIharUlAI bhanidinuhos– bolAU tI mUrtiharUlAI jasalAI timIharUle allAhako barAbara banAekA chau ani malAI hAni puryAune upAya gara ra malAI maukA nadeU |

196 nissandeha mero maddata garnevAlA allAha hunuhuncha, uhA~le nai mero rakSA garnuhuncha | uhA~ bAheka arU kasaisita AzA rAkhdina | timIharUkA mUrtiharUdekhi malAI Dara lAgdaina | allAhale nai mamAthi kurAna avataraNa garnubhayo jo sampUrNa mAnavajAtiko lAgi mArgadarzana ho | uhA~le satkarmI bhaktaharUko saMrakSaNa, surakSA tathA sahayoga garnuhuncha |

197 he bahudevavAdIharU ho! allAhabAheka juna mUrtiharUko timIharU bhakti garne garchau tinIharUle na ta timIharUlAI maddata garna sakdachan na svayaMlAI nai sahAyatA garna sakchan | tinIharU asahAya chan, ani kina allAhalAI choDera tinIharUko bhakti garchau ta?!

198 he bahudevavAdIharU ho! yadi timIharUle pUjA gardai AekA yI pUjyaharUlAI satmArgatarpha bolAu~chau bhane tinIharUle sunne chainan | tinIharUkA banAvaTI A~khAle timIharUlAI dekhchan bhanne ThAnchau? tI nirjIva vastu bhaekAle dekhna sakdainan | tinIharU mAnava tathA janAvaraharUko rUpamA mUrti banAune garthe, jasakA hAta, khuTTA tathA A~khA hune garthe, tara thie nirjIva vastu nai, tyasamA jyAna chaina | U hiMDaDula garna sakdaina |

199 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! mAnisaharUle mAgeko mAphIlAI ra unIharUlAI sajilo hune karma tathA nItilAI svIkAra garnuhas, tinIharUkA lAgi apThyAro hune kAmako bojha nahAlnuhos, tAki tinIharUmA ghRNA utpanna nahos | tinIharUlAI miTho vacana bolne tathA rAmro kArya garne Adeza dinuhos ra ajJAnIharUlAI najara andAja garnuhos | tinIharUko ajJAnatAle gardA tinIharUsa~ga bhe~Ta nagarnuhos | kasaile kaSTa diemA tapAIM kaSTa nadinuhos ra kasaile kunai vastu nadie pani tapAIM dinuhos |

200 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! yadi zaitAnale tapAIMlAI duSkarmako lAgi prerita garcha vA satkarmabATa rokne prayAsa garcha bhane tapAIM allAhako zaraNa mAgnuhos | uhA~ tapAIMle mAgeko kurA sunnuhuncha ra pradAna garnuhuncha | uha~le tapAIMlAI zaitAnabATa jogAunu hunecha |

201 allAhasita DarAune mAnisaharU yadi zaitAnako bahakAule gardA pApa garchan bhane allAhako mahAnatA yAda Aune bittikai taubA garchan | yastA mAnisaharU allAhakA AdezaharUko pAlanA garchan ra uhA~le manAhI garekA kAryaharUbATa bacchan | avajJAkArIharUkA lAgi sajAya tathA AjJAkArIharUkA lAgi puNya cha bhanne kurAlAI jAndachan, satyamA kAyama rahanchan, galtIlAI sudhAra garchan ra galtIlAI tyAgchan |

202 tara zaitAnaharUle AphnA bhAi bandhu avajJAkArI tathA pApIharUbATa ekapachi arko pApa garAera tinIharUko pathabhraSTatAmA nai baDhottarI garAu~chan | nata zaitAnaharU pathabhraSTa garne kArya banda garchan, na pApI mAnisaharU duSkarma garne kArya tyAgchan |

203 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! jaba tapAIM tinIharUsamakSa kunai nizAnI prastuta garnuhuncha, taba tinIharUle vAstA gardainan | tara jaba tapAIM tinIharUsamakSa nizAnI prastuta garnuhunna taba tinIharU bhanchan- timIle kunai nizAnI racanA garera kina lyAenau? he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! bhanidinuhos– ma Aphno tarphabATa nizAnI racanA garera lyAu~dina | allAhale vahI (prakAzanA) garnubhaeko Adezako anusaraNa garchu | yo kurAna jasako pATha ma timIharUsamakSa gardaichu, allAhako tarphabATa pramANa ho jo timIharUkA sRSTikartA tathA prabandhaka hunuhuncha | yo kurAna mominaharUkA lAgi nirdezana tathA dayA ho | kAphiraharU ta pathabhraSTa tathA abhAgI hun |
204 jaba kurAnako pATha garincha taba tyasalAI dhyAnapUrvaka sunne gara | nata kurAkAnI gara, na anya kunai kAma gara, yasa AzAkA sAtha ki allAhale timIharUmAthi dayA garnuhunecha |

205 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! AphnA pAlanakartA allAhalAI bihAna belukA manamanai bilaunA gardai tathA bhayakA sAtha yAda garnuhos sAthai Aphno duAlAI ThUlo svara tathA sAno svarako madhyamA rAkhnuhos | allAhako yAdabATa anabhijJa tathA aceta mAnisaharUmadhye nabannuhos |

206 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! tapAIMkA pAlanakartA najika rahekA phariztAharU allAhako bhakti garna kahilyai pani choDdainan | baru uhA~kai AjJApAlana garchan, rAta-dina allAhako zAna anusAra uhA~ko mahimAgAna garchan ra uhA~samakSa nai sajdA garne garchan |

1 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! tapAIMkA sAthIharU yuddhabATa prApta dhanako bA~DaphA~Da ra hakadArako bAremA sodhdachan? he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! unIharUlAI bhanidinuhos– yuddhabATa prApta dhanasampatti ta allAha ra rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) ko lAgi ho | yasalAI kahA~ kharca garnuparcha ra kasarI vitaraNa garnuparcha bhanne kurAko nirNaya allAha tathA uhA~kA rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) ko Adeza anusAra garinecha | timIharUle ta mAtra yasako pAlanA tathA anusaraNa garnuparcha | he mominaharU ho! allAhakA AdezaharUko pAlanA garera tathA uhA~le manAhI garekA kAryaharUlAI tyAgera uhA~ko bhaya gara | prema, mAyA, rAmro AcaraNa tathA eka arkAlAI mApha garera ApasI sambandhalAI ThIka rAkha | yadi timIharU vAstavika momina hau bhane anivAryarUpamA allAha tathA uhA~kA rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) ko AjJA pAlana gara, kinabhane ImAnale AjJApAlana tathA avajJAbATa TADhA rahane kAryako lAgi prerita garcha | unIharUle yo prazna badrako yuddhapachi garekA thie |

2 vAstavika mominaharU tI hun, jasakA hRdaya allAhalAI samjhane bittikai DarAu~chan | hRdaya tathA indriyale allAhako AjJApAlana garna thAlchan ra kurAna paDhera sunAu~dA ani tyasamA cintana manan gardA unIharUko ImAna jhan baDhna thAlcha ra unIharU hitakA kurAharU prApta garnako lAgi tathA hAnikAraka kurAharUlAI TADhA garnako lAgi AphnA pAlanakartAmAthi mAtra bharosA rAkhchan |
3 jasale namAjalAI tyasako samayamA sahI tarikAle sunnatako sAtha adA garchan ra hAmIle unIharUlAI pradAna gareko dhanasampattibATa anivArya tathA atirikta duvai prakArakA dAna dinchan |

4 yastA mAnisaharU nai saccA mominaharU hun, kinabhane unIharUbhitra Antarika ImAna tathA vAhirI islAma duvai guNaharU chan | unIharUkA lAgi unakA pAlanakartAkahA~ ucca darjAharU, pApaharUkA kSamA tathA pavitra jIvikA chan | allAhale unIharUkA lAgi yI cIjaharU varadAnako rUpamA tayAra pArnubhaeko cha |

5 jasarI timIharUbIca yuddhabATa prApta dhanako bhAgabaNDAmA matabheda tathA jhagaDA bhaepachi allAhale yasalAI Aphno hAtamA rAkhnubhayo ra rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) ko hAtamA dinubhayo, tyastai he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) tapAIMkA pAlanakartAle tapAIMlAI bahudevavAdIharUsita muThabheDako lAgi vahI (prakAzanA) dvArA madInAbATa niskane Adeza dinubhayo | yadyapi mominaharUko euTA samUhalAI mana pareko thiena |

6 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! mominaharUmadhye euTA samUha bahudevavAdIharUsa~ga yuddhabAre tapAIMsa~ga jhagaDA garchan, jabaki yo yuddha avazya hunecha bhanne kurA spaSTa bhaisakeko cha | yuddhako lAgi niskanu tinIharUlAI yati apriya lAgiraheko thiyo, mAnauM tinIharU mRtyutarpha hA~kera lagidai chan ra mRtyulAI Aphno A~khAsAmu dekhirahekA chan |

7 he vAdavivAda garne mominaharU ho! yAda gara jaba allAhale timIharUsa~ga bahudevavAdIharUkA duI samUhamadhye euTA samUhamAthi timIharUle vijaya prApta garnechau bhanera vacana dinubhaeko thiyo | euTA samUha khAdya sAmagrI bokeko U~Tako nirbala samUha thiyo jasabATa timIharU yuddhabATa prApta dhanasampatti prApta garne thiyau ra arko samUha yoddhAharUko samUha thiyo josa~ga timIharUle yuddha garnuparne thiyo ra timIharUlAI sahayoga garine thiyo | timIharU cAhi~ khAdya sAmagrI bokeko U~Tako samUhamAthi vijaya prApta garna cAhanthyau kinabhane tyasamAthi binA yuddha sajilosa~ga vijaya garna sakinthyo | tara allAhako cAhanA thiyo timIharUlAI yuddhako Adeza diera satyalAI asatyamAthi vijaya garAunu | tAki timIharUle bahudevavAdIharUkA netAharUlAI hatyA gara tathA tinIharUmadhye dherailAI kaidI banAU yahA~samma ki islAmako prabhutva kAyama hos |

8 allAhale islAma tathA muslimaharUlAI vijaya pradAna garera satyalAI satya ra asatyalAI asatya siddha garnu thiyo | islAma nai satya dharma ho ra anya sabai dharmaharU asatya hun bhanne kurA vibhinna pramANa tathA tarkaharUbATa pramANita cha | bahudevavAdIharUlAI jatisukai apriya lAge pani allAhale islAmalAI vijaya pradAna garnuhunecha |

9 badrako dinalAI yAda gara; jaba timIharU zatru viruddha allAhasa~ga prArthanA gardai thiyau | he mominaharU ho! allAhale ekapachi arko Aune garI eka hajAra phariztAdvArA timIharUlAI maddata garnuhunecha bhanera timIharUko prArthanA svIkAra garnubhayo |

10 he mominaharU ho! allAhale zatruharUviruddha phariztAharUdvArA timIharUko maddata zubhasUcanA svarUpa garnubhayo | uhA~ nai zatruharUviruddha timIharUko sahayogI hunuhuncha | tAki maddatako AzvAsanale timIharUko mana santuSTa hos | dherai saMkhyA tathA dherai hAtahatiyArale vijaya prApta hu~daina, baru asala vijaya allAhako vizeSa kRpAle huncha | nissandeha allAha sattA zasana calAunamA atyanta prabhutvazAlI hunuhuncha kohI pani uhA~mAthi vijaya prApta garna sakdaina | kAnuna banAuna tathA bhAgya nirdhAraNa garnamA pani uhA~ tatvadarzI hunuhuncha |

11 he mominaharU ho! smaraNa gara jaba timIharUbhitra zatruko Dara utpanna bhaepachi, manamA zAnti pradAna garnako lAgi allAhale timIharUlAI nindrAle chopi dinubhayo | allAhale AkAzabATa pAnI barsAunubhayo timIharUlAI apavitratAbATa pavitra pArna, zaitAnakA bahakAu samApta pArna, timIharUkA manamastiSkalAI baliyo banAuna ra pAnIle bAluvA yukta jaminalAI kaDA banAuna; tAki tyasamA timIharUkA khuTTA nadhasos |

12 he nabI (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! smaraNa garnuhos, jaba tapAIMkA pAlanakartAle badrako yuddhamA mominaharUko maddatako lAgi paThAunu bhaekA phariztAharUlAI vahI garnubhayo– he phariztAharU ho! ma timIharUko sAthamA chu | mominaharUkA hausalA baDhAU | ma cA~Dai nai kAphiraharUkA hRdayamA Dara evam trAsa utpanna garnechu | he mominaharU ho! kAphiraharUko ghA~TI tathA jornIharUmA prahAra gara tAki tinIharU timIharUviruddha yuddha garna nasakun |

13 kAphiraharUko hatyA tathA tinIharUkA jornIharUmAthi prahArako Adeza yasa kAraNale diieko cha, kinabhane tinIharUle allAha evam uhA~ko rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) ko virodha gare | juna kArya garne Adeza diieko thiyo tyasako pAlanA garenan ra juna kAryaharUbATa manAhI garieko thiyo tyasalAI tyAgenan | yasa mAmilAmA jasale pani allAha tathA uhA~kA rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) ko virodha garchan nissandeha allAhale tinIharUlAI duniyA~mA hatyA garera tathA kaidI banAera sajAya dinuhunecha ra AkhiratamA narkamA hAlera yAtanA dinuhunecha |

14 he allAha ra uhA~kA rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) kA virodhIharU ho! ukta yAtanA timIharUkA lAgi ho, yasalAI duniyA~mA cA~Dai nai cAkha ra kuphra tathA islAmasa~gako zatrutAmai marchau bhane paralokamA pani narkako yAtanA cAkhnechau |

15 he mominaharU ho! jaba timIharUko bhiDanta yuddhako maidAnamA bahudevavAdIharUsita huncha bhane timIharU bhAgera tinIharUlAI piThyu~ nadekhAU | baru aDiga bhaera tinIharUko mukAbilA gara | allAha Aphno sahayogakA sAtha timIharUsa~ga hunuhuncha |

16 jo yuddhasthalabATa Darale piThyU~ pharkAera bhAgcha, U allAhako krodhako bhAgIdAra huncha | AkhiratamA tyasako vAsasthAna narka hunecha ra tyo ati narAmro sthAna ho | tara jasale yuddhako raNanIti svarupa pharkera AkramaNa garne vA Aphno muslima sainyalAI bolAune uddezyale yasto garcha bhane kehI Apatti chaina |

17 he mominaharU ho! badrako dina bahudevavAdIharUlAI timIharUle Aphno zaktibATa hatyA garenau baru allAhale yasamA timIharUlAI maddata garnubhayo | he nabI (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! jaba tapAIMle tIra phyA~knubhayo tyo tapAIMle phyA~knubhaena baru allAhale phyA~knubhayo | saMkhyA tathA hAtahatiyAramA kamI bhaepani mominaharUlAI allAhale vijaya pradAna garera unIharUko parIkSA linu thiyo | uhA~prati AbhAra prakaTa gara | nissandeha allAha timIharUkA duA tathA kurAharU sunnuhuncha ra timIharUkA satkarma ra timro lAgi phAidA puryAune kurAharU jAnnuhuncha |
18 bahudevavAdIharUko parAjaya tathA mominaharUlAI vijaya pradAna garera unIharUmAthi allAhale nai kRpA garnubhayo | uhA~le islAma viruddha kAphiraharUko calakhelalAI kamajora pArnuhuncha |

19 he bahudevavAdIharU ho! atyAcArIharUmAthi allAhale prakopa paThAun bhanI timIharUko mAga thiyo bhane uhA~le timIharUko mAga anusAra Aphno prakopa timIharUmAthi avataraNa garnubhayo | yasamA timIharUkA lAgi sajAya cha bhane Izabhaya rAkhneharUkA lAgi pATha cha | yadi timIharU yasto mAga garnabATa rokinchau bhane yahI timIharUkA lAgi rAmro hunecha | sambhavataH uhA~le maukA dinuhunecha ra timIharUbATa badalA linuhune chaina | yadi pheri tyahI mAga dohoryAu~chau ra mominaharU viruddha yuddha garchau bhane hAmI pheri timIharUlAI yAtanA dinechauM ra mominaharUlAI maddata garnechauM | timIharUko ThUlo jatthA, bhArI hAta hatiyAra tathA mominaharUko sAno saMkhyAle timIharUlAI kunai phAidA dine chaina | allAhako maddata mominaharUkA sAthamA cha ra jasako sAthamA allAhako maddata huncha usalAI kasaile parAjita garna sakdaina |

20 he mominaharU ho! allAhako Adezako pAlanA garera tathA varjita kAryalAI tyAgera allAha evam uhA~kA rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) ko AjJApAlana gara | uhA~ko Adezako ullaGghana garera tathA varjita kArya garera uhA~bATa vimukha nahoU, jabaki timIharU kurAnako pATha sunirahekA chau |

21 he mominaharU ho! timI bahudevavAdI tathA munAphikaharU jasto nabana, jo kurAnamA allAhakA AyataharUko pATha sunepachi bhanchan: hAmIle pATha gariekA kurAharU Aphno kAnale sunyauM, jabaki tinIharUle tyasamA cintana manan garne ra tyasabATa upadeza grahaNa garne uddezyale sundainan, ki tyasabATa phAidA uThAuna sakun |

22 nissandeha allAhako dRSTimA dhartImA hi~DaDula garne sRSTiharUmadhye sabaibhandA nikRSTa vyakti tI bahirAharU hun jo satya dharma islAmalAI svIkAra garne garI sundainan ra tI lATAharU hun jo satya boldainan | yinIharU nai hun jo allAhakA AdezaharU tathA varjita garnubhaekA kurAharU jAndainan |

23 yadi allAhale yI jhUTlAune bahudevavAdIharUmA kunai bhalAi jAnnu bhaemA avazya nai tinIharUlAI sunna yogya banAunu hunthyo jasale gardA tinIharU phAidA uThAune thie ra pramANaharUlAI bujhne thie | tinIharUbhitra kunai bhalAi chaina bhanne kurA allAhalAI thAhA cha | mAnauM yadi allAhale tinIharUlAI sunne zakti pradAna garnuhuncha bhane tinIharU zatrutAle gardA ImAnabATa vimukha huna pugchan |

24 he AsthAvAnaharU ho! allAhakA AdezaharUko pAlanA garera tathA manAhI kAryaharUlAI tyAgera allAha tathA uhA~kA rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) samakSa AtmAsamarpaNa gardai uhA~harUkA AdezaharUlAI svIkAra gara | rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) timIharUlAI yasto kAryakA lAgi bolAunuhuncha jasamA timIharUko vAstavika jIvana cha | vizvAsa rAkha allAha hareka kAryako sAmarthya rAkhnuhuncha | yadi timIharU satyalAI asvIkAra garepachi tyasalAI svIkAra garna khojchau bhane tyasabIca pani uhA~ pardA hAlne sAmarthya rAkhnuhuncha | ataH uhA~tarpha pharka ra yasa kurAmA vizvAsa gara ki mahApralayako dina timIharU mAtra uhA~samakSa bhelA garAinechau | ani uhA~le timIharUlAI timIharUle duniyA~mA gareko karmako badalA dinuhunecha |

25 sAvadhAna he mominaharU ho! allAhako prakopa timIharUmadhye avajJAkArIharUlAI mAtra hoina baru arUlAI pani diinecha | yo tyatikhera huncha jaba atyAcAra hAvI huncha ra yasamA parivartana Au~daina | vizvAsa gara allAha avajJAkArIharUkA lAgi kaThora daNDadAtA hunuhuncha | avajJAbATa sAvadhAna!

26 he mominaharU ho! yAda gara tyasa samayalAI jaba timIharU makkAkA samudAyamA alpasaGkhyaka thiyau; tyahA~kA bAsIharUle timIharUlAI kamajora banAera rAkhekA thie, timIharUmAthi atyAcAra garthe, zatruharUle timIharUlAI samAtnechan bhanI DarAu~thyau ani allAhale timIharUlAI madInAmA zaraNa pradAna garnubhayo, badra ityAdi yuddhamA uhA~le timIharUlAI zatruharU viruddha sahayoga garera timIharUlAI sazakta banAunubhayo | uhA~le pavitra kurAharU pradAna garnubhayo tImadhye yuddhamA prApta bhaeko dhanasampatti pani ho, jo timIharUle zatruharUbATa prApta garyo tAki timIharUle allAhaprati uhA~le pradAna garnubhaekA kRpAharU bApata AbhAra prakaTa gara ani uhA~le timIharUlAI ajhai pradAna garnuhunecha | uhA~prati kRtaghnatA prakaTa nagara natra uhA~le Aphno kRpAlAI phirtA linuhunecha ra timIharUlAI yAtanA dinuhunecha |

27 he mominaharU ho! allAhakA AdezaharUko ullaGghana garera tathA varjita kAryaharU garera allAha evam rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) sa~ga vizvAsaghAta nagara ra Aphno nAsoharU jastai- RNa ityAdimA hinAminA pani nagara | yadi timIharU hinaminA garchau bhane timIharUko gaNanA pani vizvAsaghAtIharUmA hunecha bhanne kurA timIharUlAI thAhai cha |

dhanasampatti tathA santAnako moha mAyAle mAnisalAI hinaminA garna prerita garcha, tyasaile yI parIkSAkA sAmagrIharU hun bhanne kurAsita allAhale sUcita gardai bhannubhaeko chaH
28 he mominaharU ho! jAnirAkha timIharUkA dhanasampatti tathA santAnaharU allAhako tarphabATa parIkSAkA sAmagrIharU hun | yinale timIlAI satkarma garnabATa rokna sakchan ra hinAminA (khayAnata) garna prerita garna sakchan | jAnirAkha! allAhakahA~ ThUlo puNya cha | ataH AphnA dhanasampatti tathA santAnamA baDhI lipta bhaera Aphno puNyalAI barbAda napAra |

29 he mominaharU ho! yadi timIharU allAhakA AdezaharUko pAlanA garera tathA varjita kAryaharUlAI choDara uhA~sa~ga DarAu~chau bhane uhA~le timIharUbhitra satya ra asatyabIca pharaka chuTyAune kSamatA pradAna garnuhunecha, duSkarmaharUlAI meTAunuhunecha ra pApaharUlAI mApha garnuhunecha | allAha mahAn varadAnavAlA hunuhuncha, jasamadhye svarga pani ho, jasalAI uhA~le AphnA Izabhaya rAkhne (parahejagAra) bhaktaharUkA lAgi tayAra pArnubhaeko cha |

30 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! tyasa samayalAI yAda garnuhos, jaba bahudevavAdIharUle tapAIMlAI bandI banAune vA hatyA garne vA deza-nikAlA garne tapAIMviruddha SaDyantra racekA thie | tinIharU Aphno calakhela gardaithie ra allAhale pani Aphno yojanA banAudai hunuhunthyo, allAha nai sarvottama yojanAvid hunuhuncha |

31 jaba tinIharUsamakSa kurAnako pATha garincha taba tinIharU zatrutAle gardA bhanchan– a~, hAmIle yasa prakArakA nizAnIharU pahilA pani sunisakekA chauM | kurAnamA rahekA vANI jastai hAmI pani banAuna sakchauM | hAmIle suneko kurAnamA ta vigatakA jhUTA kathAharU mAtra chan, tyasaile hAmI yasamA kadApi ImAna lyAune chainauM | tinIharU inkAramA ati kaThora bhaekole yo kurA bhane |

32 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va salla)! yAda garnuhos, jaba bahudevavAdIharUle bhane– he allAha! yadi muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) le lyAeko yo kurAna tapAIMko tarphabATa nitAnta satya ho bhane hAmIlAI sakhApa pArnako lAgi AkAzabATa DhuGgA barsAunuhos vA kunai duHkhadAyI yAtanA paThAunuhos |

33 tara he nabI (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! tapAIM tinIharUbIca rahunjela vA unIharUle kSamAyAcanA garirahunjela allAhale tapAIMko samudAyalAI sakhApa pArne garI yAtanA dinuhune chaina, cAhe ImAna lyAeko samUha hos vA ImAna nalyAeko samUha hos | tapAIMko upasthiti tinIharUkA lAgi surakSA cha |

34 tinIharUlAI aba kasale sajAyabATa bacAunecha jabaki tinIharUle mAnisaharUlAI masjide harAmamA tavApha (parikramA) garna ra namAjabATa rokera yAtanAlAI nimtyAekA chan? bahudevavAdIharU allAhakA mitra hoinan baru Izabhaya rAkhneharU allAhakA mitra hun, jo uhA~kA AdezaharUko pAlanA garera tathA varjita kAryaharUlAI tyAgera uhA~sa~ga DarAe, tara tinIharUmadhye adhikAMzalAI thAhA nai chaina |

35 masjide harAma najika bahudevavAdIharUko namAja tathA upAsanA siTI bajAune ra tAlI bajAunebAheka arU kehI thiena | he bahudevavAdIharU! aba allAhako inkAra gareko tathA rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) lAI jhUTo Thahara gareko kAraNale badrako dina hatyA ra kaidako yAtanA cAkha |

36 allAhako mArga tathA satya dharmabATa mAnisaharUlAI roknako lAgi kAphiraharUle Aphno dhanasampatti kharca garchan | tinIharUle ajha kharca garnechan tara tinIharUle khojeko yojanAmA saphala huna sakdainan | antataH tyo prayAsa tinIharUkA lAgi pazcAttApako kAraNa bannecha, kinabhane tinIharUle gareko kharca ra yojanA tyattikai khera jAnechan | pheri tinIharU mominaharUbATa parAjita hunechan | kAphiraharU mahApralayako dina narkatarpha hA~kiera ekatrita garine chan ani sadhaiMko lAgi narkamA phyA~kine chan |

37 allAhako mArgabATa roknako lAgi kharca garne kAphiraharU narkako Agotarpha hA~kiera lagine chan | allAhale apavitra kAphiraharU tathA pavitra mominaharUbIca pharaka bhaeko nirNaya garnuhunecha ra apavitra vyakti, karma ra dhanasampatti eka arkAmAthi rAkhera jammA garnuhunecha ani tyasa thuprolAI narkamA phyA~kanu hunecha | yastA mAnisaharU nai ghATA khAneharU hun kinabhane tinIharUle mahApralayako dina AphUlAI ra Aphno parivAralAI ghATAmA pAre |

38 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! kAphiraharUlAI bhanidinuhos– yadi tinIharUle allAha ra uhA~ko rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) ko sAtha kuphra garnabATa rokinchan ani mominaharUlAI allAhako mArgabATa rokna choDa chADidinchan bhane, allAhale tinIharUkA pahilekA sabai pApaharU mApha garnuhunecha, kinabhane islAmale pahilekA sabai pApaharUlAI meTAidincha | yadi islAma lyAepachi pheri kuphratarpha pharkanchau bhane allAhale pahilekA samudAyaharUlAI ke garnubhayo bhanne kurA spaSTai cha, uhA~le cA~Dai nai Aphno kAnuna anusAra prakopa paThAunuhunecha |

39 he mominaharU ho! timIharU kAphira zatruharUviruddha yuddha gara yahA~samma ki zirka tathA dharmako mAmilAmA muslimaharUko bAdhA samApta hoos, tathA dharma tathA AjJApAlana pUrNarUpamA mAtra allAhakai lAgi bhaihAlos jasako kohI sAjhedAra chaina | yadi tinIharUle zirka tathA muslimaharUlAI allAhako mArgabATa rokna choDcha bhane tinIharU viruddha yuddha nagara | allAhale tinIharUko kAryalAI dekhirahanubhaeko cha, uhA~bATa kehI lukeko chaina |

40 yadi tinIharUle kuphra garna ra muslimaharUlAI sIdhA mArgabATa rokne kArya garna choDdainan bhane he mominaharU ho! timIharU vizvAsa gara allAha tinIharUviddha timIharUkA sahayogI hunuhuncha | uhA~ sabaibhandA uttama mitra evaM sahAyaka hunuhuncha! uhA~ jasalAI saMrakSaNa dinuhuncha ra maddata garnuhuncha U saphala tathA vijayI huncha |

41 he mominaharU ho! jAnirAkha! allAhako mArgamA jihAda gardA kAphiraharUbATa prApta garekA dhanasampattilAI pA~ca bhAgamA bA~Da | jasamadhye cAra bhAga mujAhidaharUbIca bA~Da ra zeSa eka bhAgalAI pA~ca bhAgamA bA~Da | ekabhAga allAha ra uhA~kA rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) ko lAgi, jasalAI muslima janahitako kAryamA kharca garinecha | eka bhAga nabI (sallAhu alaihi va sallama) kA nAtedAra banU hAzima tathA banU muttalibamA, eka bhAga anAthaharUmA, eka bhAga nirdhanaharUmA ra eka bhAga alapatra parekA yAtruharUmA bA~Dinecha | yadi timIharUle allAhamAthi ra muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) mAthi badrako dina avatarita sahayogamAthi ImAna rAkhchau bhane yI AdezaharUko pAlanA gara | allAhale badrako yuddhamA zatruharUviruddha timIharUlAI maddata garera satya evam asatyabIca pharaka chuTyAunu bhayo | yasto maddata garne allAha sampUrNa kArya garnasakne sAmarthya rAkhnuhuncha |

42 yAda gara, jaba timIharU madInA najika upatyakAko cheumA thiyau, bahudevavAdIharU makkA najika TADhAko cheumA thie ra sara-sAmAna lAdiekA U~Tako samUha lAlasAgara najika timIharUbhandA talatira thiyo | timIharU ra bahudevavAdIharUle badrako maidAnamA paraspara milne samaya pahiledekhi nirdhArita gare pani timIharU tyahA~ milna sakdaina thiyau | tara timIharU duvaile milne samaya nirdhArita nagare pani allAhale badrako maidAnamA jammA garAunubhayo | tAki euTA hunai parne kAma arthAta mominaharUko maddata, kAphiharUko apamAna, dharmalAI baliyo pArne tathA zirkalAI apamAnita pArne kAma purA hos | phalasvarUpa jasale barbAda hunucha tyo spaSTa pramANasAtha barbAda hos | spaSTa pramANa ke jAhera bhayo bhane allAhale mominaharUlAI maddata garnubhayo jaba ki unIharUko saMkhyA pani kama thiyo ra unIharUsa~ga sarasAmAna pani kama thie | jasale jIvita rahanucha tyo spaSTa pramANasAtha jIvita rahos | jasto ki allAhale spaSTa pramANa jAhera garnu bhayo tAki kasaisa~ga allAha viruddha pramANa narahos | nizcaya nai allAha sabaikA kurAharU sunnuhuncha, sabaile gareko kAma jAnnuhuncha ra tyasako badalA cA~Dai nai dinuhunecha |

43 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! tapAIM tathA mominaharUmAthi bhaeko kRpAharUlAI yAda garnuhos, jaba allAhale tapAIMlAI sapanAmA bahudevavAdIharUko saMkhyA kama garera dekhAunubhayo | tapAIMle yo kurA mominaharUlAI batAunubhayo ani unIharU khusI bhae, jasale gardA zatruharU viruddhako lAgi unIharUko manobala baDhyo | yadi allAhale tinIharUko saMkhyA baDhI dekhAunu hunthyo bhane avazya nai tapAIMkA sAthIharUkA sAhasa gumne thiyo, yasa viSayamA jhagaDA garne thiyau ra unIharU yuddha garnabATa DarAune thie | tara allAhale timIharUlAI tyasabATa surakSita rAkhnako lAgi tinIharUko saMkhyA rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) lAI kama dekhAunubhayo | mAncheko hRdayamA kuna kurA lukeko cha, allAha tyasalAI rAmrarI jAnnuhuncha |

44 he mominaharU ho! yAda gara jaba timIharUko bahudevavAdIharUsa~ga muThabheTa bhayo taba allAhale tinIharUlAI timIharUko dRSTimA kama saMkhyAmA dekhAunubhayo ra yasarI tinIharU viruddha AkramaNa garne sAhasa pradAna garnubhayo | timIharUlAI tinIharUko dRSTimA kama saMkhyAmA dekhAunubhayo tAki tinIharUle AkramaNa garun ra pharkanebAre nasocun | sAthai bahudevavAdIharUlAI hatyA garI vA kaidI banAi badalA liera tathA mominaharUmAthi kRpA garI tathA zatruharU viruddha maddata garI hunai parne kAma allAhadvArA purA gariyos | sampUrNa mAmilAharU allAhatarpha nai pharkAine chan, jasabATa allAhale duSkarmIharUlAI duSkarmako sajAya dinuhunecha ra sukarmIharUlAI sukarmako badalA dinuhunecha |

45 he mominaharU ho! kAphiraharUko samUhasa~ga muThabheTa hu~dA aDiga rahane gara, allAhalAI dherai yAda garne gara tathA uhA~sa~ga duA (prArthanA) garne gara, AzA cha uhA~le timIharUle cAheko kurA dinuhunecha ra nacAhine kurAbATa mukti dinuhunecha |
