46 Aphno bhanAi, garAi tathA hareka avasthAmA allAha evaM uhA~kA rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) ko AjJApAlana gara ra eka-ApasamA matabheda nagara | ApasI matabhedale timIharUlAI kamajora pArnecha | zatruharUsa~ga muThabheTa hu~dA aDiga rahane gara | nizcaya nai allAhako maddata ra samarthana dhairyavAnaharUko sAthamA cha | jasako sAthamA allAhako maddata huncha U pakkai vijayI huncha |

47 timIharU bahudevavAdIharU jasto nabana jo makkAbATa ghamaNDa gardai tathA mAnisaharUlAI dekhAu~dai niske | tinIharU mAnisaharUlAI allAhako dharmamA praveza garnamA bAdhA garchan | tinIharUkA karmaharU allAhabATa gopya chainan | uhA~le cA~Dai nai tinIharUkA karmako badalA dinuhunecha |

48 he mominaharU ho! allAhako kRpAlAI yAda gara jaba zaitAnale bahudevavAdIharUlAI tinIharUkA kriyAkalApa AkarSaka banAera dekhAyo | muslimaharU viruddha yuddha garna prerita garyo ra bhanyo– Aja kohI pani timIharUmAthi vijayI huna sakdaina ra ma timIharUko sahayogI chu | tara jaba mominaharUko dala josa~ga phariztAharU thie ra bahudevavAdIharUko dala josa~ga zaitAna thiyo, bIca muThabheTa bhayo taba zaitAna piThyU~ pharkAera bhAgdai bhanyo– timIharUsa~ga mero kunai sarokAra chaina | ma mominaharUko maddatako lAgi AekA phariztAharUlAI dekhdaichu | malAI allAhale naSTa pArnuhuncha bhanne Dara lAgiraheko cha, allAhale kaThora yAtanA dinuhunecha, uhA~ko yAtanAlAI kohI sahana garna sakdaina |

49 yAda gara jaba munAphikaharU tathA hRdaya-rogI mAnisaharUle bhane– yI muslimaharUlAI yinIharUko dharmale dhokAmA pAreko cha | yinIharUsa~ga allAhale maddata garne vAcA garnubhaeko cha, yadyapi yinIharU kama saMkhyAmA chan, hAta hatiyAra pani kama cha, zatruharUko saMkhyA pani dherai cha ra hAtahatiyAra pani dherai cha | mAtra allAha ra uhA~ko maddatamAthi bharosA garneharUlAI allAhale maddata garnuhunecha bhanne kurA yI munAphikaharUlAI thAhA chaina | uhA~ prabhutvazAlI hunuhuncha, kohI uhA~mAthi vijayI huna sakdaina | uhA~ bhAgya nirdhArita garna tathA kAnuna banAunamA tatvadarzI hunuhuncha |

50 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! jaba phariztAharUle allAha ra uhA~ko rasUlalAI inkAra garne kAphiraharUko anuhAra ra DhADamA hirkAu~dai prANa khi~cera nikAldai thie ra bhandai thie– kAphiraharU ho! cAkha Agoko yAtanA! yadi tapAIMle tyo avasthA dekhnu bhaeko bhae tapAIMlAI ati nai acamma ra bhayAnaka avasthA lAgne thiyo |

51 he kAphiraharU ho! yo du:khadAyI yAtanA timIharUko prANa nikAldA kherI diinecha ra cihAna tathA AkhiratamA Agole polne yAtanA diinecha | yo timIharUko karmako pratiphala ho | nissandeha allAhale AphnA bhaktaharUmAthi atyAcAra garnuhunna, uhA~ nisAphakA sAtha nirNaya garnuhuncha kinabhane uhA~ nyAyapremI hunuhuncha |

52 yasto yAtanA yI kAphiraharUlAI mAtra hoina, allAhako kAnuna anusAra heraka yuga tathA hareka sthAnakA kAphiraharUlAI diieko thiyo | phiraunako samudAya tathA tinIharUbhandA aghikA samudAyaharUle pani jaba allAhakA nizAnIharUlAI asvIkAra garekA thie taba uhA~le tinIharUkA pApaharUko kAraNale bessarI samAtnubhaeko thiyo ra kaDA yAtanA dinubhaeko thiyo | nissandeha allAha zaktizAlI hunuhuncha, kohI uhA~mAthi vijayI huna sakdaina, sAthai uhA~ avajJAkArIharUkA lAgi kaThora daNDadAtA hunuhuncha |

53 yo kaDA yAtanA tyatikhera diincha jaba kunai samudAya allAhale pradAna garnubhaeko ImAna, satkarma tathA kRpAprati AbhAra vyakta gardaina baru kuphra, avajJA tathA kRtaghnatA garcha | nissandeha allAha AphnA bhaktaharUkA kurAharUlAI sunnuhuncha, unIharUkA karmaharUlAI jAnnuhuncha ra uhA~bATa kunai pani vastu lukeko chaina |

54 tinIharUko avasthA phirauna tathA tinIharUbhandA aghikA samudAya jasto cha | tinIharUle AphnA pAlanakartAkA nizAnIharUlAI jhUTo Thahara gare, ataH allAhale tinIharUlAI avajJAko kAraNale naSTa pArnubhayo | allAhale phiraunako samudAyalAI samudramA curlummai DubAera naSTa pArnubhayo | tinIharU sabaile zirka tathA kuphra garekAle atyAcArI bhae tyasaile tinIharU allAhako prakopako zikAra bhae |

55 nissandeha allAhako dRSTimA saMsArakA sampUrNa sRSTiharUmA sabaibhandA nIca vyakti kAphira (avajJAkArI) harU hun, tinIharUsamakSa jasto sukai nizAnI Ae pani tinIharUle ImAna lyAu~dainan | kuphramA jiddI gareko kAraNale tinIharUkA buddhi, A~khA ra kAnale kAma garirahekA chainan |
56 banU kuraijA ityAdi josa~ga tapAIMle sandhi garnubhayo tara hareka paTaka tinIharUle sandhi bhaGga gare, allAhasita alikati pani DarAu~dainan ra sandhiko pAlanA gardainan |

57 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! yadi yuddhamA tinIharU bheTinchan bhane tapAIM yati kaDA sajAya dinuhos ki tinIharUko khabara pachi rahekA vyaktiharUmA phailiyos tAki tinIharUle zikSA grahaNa garun ani tapAIMkA zatruharUmA Dara utpanna hos |

58 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! kunai sandhi garieko samudAyako tarphabATa yadi tapAIMlAI vizvAsaghAtako AzaGkA cha bhane tinIharUsa~gako sandhi tinIharUle bhaGga gare jhaiM bhaGga garidinuhos | nizcaya nai allAha vizvAsaghAtIharUlAI mana parAunuhunna, baru ghRNA garnuhuncha, ataH vizvAsaghAtabATa sAvadhAna!
59 kAphiraharU allAhako prakopabATa bacisakekA chan bhanne kurA kadApi naThAnun | tinIharU allAhako prakopabATa bacekA chainan | prakopale avazya nai tinIharUlAI samAtnecha |

60 he mominaharU ho! zatruharUviruddha baDhIbhandA baDhI sainya zakti tathA hAta hatiyAra tayAra pAra, jastai tIra ra ghoDA ityAdi | tAki tyasabATa allAhakA zatru ra timIharUko barbAdIko pratIkSAmA rahekA zatruharUlAI DarAU | tyasaigarI timIharUviruddha SaDayantra garne zatruharUlAI pani DarAU, jasakA zatrutAlAI timIharU jAndainau, mAtra allAhalAI thAhA cha | timIharUle allAhako mArgamA je pani kamIbesI kharca garnechau, tyasalAI uhA~le duniyA~mA dinuhunecha ra kamI nagarikana purA purA badalA AkhiratamA pani dinuhunecha | ataH allAhako mArgamA kharca garna pratispardhA gara |

61 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! yadi tinIharU yuddha choDera sandhi garna cAhanchan bhane tapAIM pani tyasakA lAgi tayAra hunuhos, tinIharUsa~ga sandhi garnuhos ra allAmAthi bharosA garnuhos | uhA~le tapAIMlAI kadApi apamAnita garnuhune chaina | nizcaya nai allAhale tinIharUkA kurA sunnahuncha ra tinIharUkA manazAya tathA kArya pani jAnnuhuncha |

62 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! yadi tinIharUle sandhiko nAmamA tapAIMlAI dhokA dina khojchan bhane tapAIMkA lAgi allAha nai paryApta hunuhuncha | uhA~le nai tapAIMlAI Aphno maddata garera tathA muhAjira evam ansAra mominaharUdvArA zakti pradAna garnubhayo |

63 allAhale nai mominaharUkA hRdayalAI joDera tapAIMlAI zakti pradAna garnubhayo, yadyapi pahilA unIharUbIca matabheda thiyo | yadi tapAIMle dhartIkA sampUrNa sampatti kharca garnubhayo bhane pani unIharUkA hRdaya joDna saknu hunnathyo, tara allAhale eklai tinIharUbIca prema utpanna garnubhayo | nissandeha sattA-zAsana calAunamA uhA~ prabhutvazAlI hunuhuncha, kohI uhA~mAthi prabhutva jamAuna sakdaina | uhA~ bhAgya nirdhAraNa, kArya saJcAlana tathA kAnu banAunamA tatvadarzI hunuhuncha |

64 he nabI (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! tapAIMlAI zatruharUko duSTatAbATa jogAunako lAgi allAha paryApta hunuhuncha ra tapAIMsa~ga rahekA mominaharU lAgi pani uhA~ paryApta hunuhuncha | ataH allAhamAthi bharosA garnuhos |

65 he nabI (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! mominaharUlAI yuddhakA lAgi prerita garnuhos ra hausalA baDhAunuhos | he mominaharU ho! timIharU madhyekA bIsa janA dhairyavAna duI saya janA kAphiraharU viruddha yuddha garera vijayI hunechan ra timIharUkA saya janA dhairyavAna eka hajAra kAphiraharU viruddha yuddha garera vijayI hunechan | kinabhane kAphiraharU yastA samudAya hun jo allAhako mominaharUlAI maddata garne ra kAphiraharUlAI prAsta garne kAnunalAI jAndainan | tinIharU yuddhako uddezya pani jAndainan, mAtra sAMsArika sattAko lAgi yuddha garchan |

66 he mominaharU ho! aba allAhale timIharUbhitra Aeko kamajorIle gardA kRpA gardai timIharUmAthiko jimmevArI kama garnubhaeko cha | ataH aba timIharUmadhye eka janAle dasa janAsamakSa hoina mAtra dUI janA samakSa aDiga rahanuparcha | timIharUkA saya janA dhairyavAna duI saya janA kAphiraharU viruddha ra timIharUkA eka hajAra dhairyavAna duI hajAra kAphiraharU viruddha yuddhamA allAhako Adezale vijayI hunechan | allAhako maddata dhairyavAna mominaharUkA sAthamA cha |

67 yuddha garne kAphiraharUlAI hatyA nagarera tinIharUlAI bandI banAunu nabI (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) ko lAgi ucita chaina, tAki tinIharU bhitra Dara utpanna hos ra tinIharU pheri yuddhako lAgi naAun | he mominaharU ho! timIharU badrakA bandIharUbATa jarimAnA liera sAMsArika lAbha cAhanchau yadyapi allAha Akhiratako bhalAi cAhanuhuncha jo dharmako maddata garera tathA tyasalAI baliyo banAera prApta huncha | allAha Aphno astitva, guNa tathA zAsanamA prabhutvazAlI hunuhuncha, uhA~mAthi kasaile prabhutva jamAuna sakdaina | uhA~ bhAgya nirdhAraNa garna tathA kAnuna banAunamA tatvadarzI hunuhuncha |

68 yuddhamA prApta dhanasampatti tathA kaidIharUbATa liine artha-daNDa linu halAla ho bhanne kurA pahile nai nalekhieko bhae timIharUle yuddhamA prApta juna dhanasampatti tathA kaidIharUbATa artha-daNDa liyau tyasale gardA kaThora yAtanA diine thiyo | kinabhane timIharUle vahI (prakAzanA) avataraNa hunuaghi nai yasto garyau |

69 he mominaharU ho! timIharUle kAphiraharUbATa yuddhamA prApta bhaeko juna dhanasampatti liekA chau tyo timIharUkA lAgi halAla cha, tyasalAI khAU | allAhakA AdezaharUko pAlanA garera tathA uhA~le manAhI garekA kAryaharUlAI tyAgera uhA~sa~ga DarAU | nissandeha allAha AphnA momimana bhaktaharUlAI mApha garnuhuncha ra dayA garnuhuncha |

70 he nabI (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! badrako dina tapAIMko kabjAmA AekA bahudevavAdI bandIharUlAI bhanidinuhos– yadi allAhale timIharUko hRdayamA kunai rAmro bhAvanA dekhnuhuncha bhane juna dhanasampatti timIharUbATa liieko cha tyo bhandA uttama pradAna garnuhunecha | timIharUbATa je pani liieko cha tyasaprati cintA nagara | allAha timIharUkA pApaharUlAI mApha garnuhunecha kinabhane uhA~ AphnA bhaktaharUlAI mApha garnuhunecha ra dayA garnuhunecha | allAhako yo vAcA nabI (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) ko kAkA abbAsa (rajiyallAhu anhu) ko islAmale purA bhayo |

71 he nabI (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! yadi tinIharUle tapAIMsa~ga vizvAsaghAta garna khojchan, jasto ki tinIharUko kurAbATa spaSTa huncha bhane yasaaghi tinIharUle allAhasa~ga pani vizvAsaghAta garisakekA chan | allAhale tinIharU viruddha tapAIMlAI maddata garisaknubhaeko cha | tinIharUmadhye kehI hatAhata bhae ra kehI bandI banAie | yadi pheri tyastai kArya garchan bhane tinIharUle tyastai pariNAmako pratIkSA garnuparcha | allAha Aphno sRSTi tathA tyasako lAgi ke ThIka cha bhanne kurAlAI jAnnuhuncha ra vivekapUrNa tarikAle kArya saJcAlana garnuhuncha |

72 allAha tathA uhA~kA rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) mAthi ImAna lyAera tathA AphnA dhanasampatti tathA jyAnale allAhako mArgamA yuddha garekA muhAjiraharU tathA unIharUlAI gharabAra tathA Azraya diekA ansAra vAstavamA eka-ApasamA mitra hun | tara yastA vyaktiharU jasale ImAna ta lyAe tara gharabAra tyAgI islAmI rAjyamA Aenan unIharU jabasamma gharabAra tyAgera Au~dainan, he mominaharU ho! tabasamma unIharUko saMrakSaNako kunai jimmevArI timIharUmAthi chaina | tara yadi kAphiraharUle unIharUmAthi atyAcAra garchan ra unIharU timIharUsa~ga maddata mAgchan bhane unIharUlA2 sahayoga gara | tara yadi timIharUbIca ra unIharUkA zatruharUbIca samjhautA kAyama cha bhane unIharUlAI maddata nagara | allAhale timrA sampUrNa kAryaharU herirahanubhaeko cha | timIharUko kunai pani kArya uhA~bATa gopya chaina ra uhA~le cA~Dai nai tyasako badalA dinuhunecha |

73 kAphiraharU eka arkAkA sahayogI-mitra hun | mominaharUle tinIharUsa~ga mitratA gA~snu hu~daina | yadi timIharUle mominasa~ga mitratA ra kAphiraharUsa~ga zatrutA rAkhdainau bhane kasale mominalAI sahayoga garne cha | tinIharUle allAhako mArgamA bAdhA utpanna garAera pRthvImA AtaGka maccAune chan |

74 allAhamAthi ImAna lyAera uhA~ko mArgamA palAyana garekA muhAjiraharU tathA unIharUlAI Azraya diera sahayoga garekA ansAra nai saccA momina hun | allAhale unIharUkA pApaharUlAI mApha garnuhunecha ra utkRSTa jIvikA tathA svarga pradAna garnuhunecha |

75 he mominaharU ho! muhAjira tathA ansArapachi ImAna lyAera gharabAra tyAgekA, allAhako vANIlAI ucca pArne tathA kuphralAI tala pArna timIharUsa~ga milera yuddha garekA mominaharU timIharUmadhyekai hun | unIharUko lAgi tyahI haka-adhikAra cha jo timIharUko cha ra unIharUko jimmevArI pani tyahI cha jo timIharUko cha | nAtedAraharU allAhako AdezAnusAra eka arkAko baDhI hakadAra hunchan | nizcaya nai allAha hareka kurAkA jJAtA hunuhuncha | uhA~bATa kehI pani lukeko chaina | uhA~le bhaktaharUkA lAgi tyahI kAnuna banAunubhaeko cha jo unIharUko hItamA cha |

1 he muslimaharU ho! yo allAha tathA uhA~kA rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) ko tarphabATa tI bahudevavAdIharUsa~ga sambandha viccheda tathA sandhi bhaGga garieko ghoSaNA ho, josa~ga timIharUle araba TApUmA sandhi garekA thiyau |

2 he bahudevavAdIharU ho! timIharU ajha cAra mahinAsamma dhartImA zAntipUrvaka ghumaphira gara, yasa avadhipachi timIharUsa~gako sandhi samApta huncha ra timIharU zAnta rahana sakdainau | vizvAsa gara yadi timIharUle kuphramA jiddI tathA aTerI garchau bhane allAhako yAtanA tathA sajAyabATa bacna sakdainau | allAhale kAphira (avajJAkArI) harUlAI duniyA~mA hatyA garera tathA kaidI banAera ra mahApralayako dina narkamA hAlera apamAnita garnuhunecha | yo sajAya tI mAnisaharUlAI pani diinecha jasale sandhilAI bhaGga gare ra tI mAnisaharUlAI pani jasako sandhiko samaya tokieko chaina | jo mAnisaharUsa~ga samaya tokiera sandhi garieko cha tinIharUsa~ga tyasa nirdhArita samayasamma sandhiko pAlanA garinecha, yadyapi tyo cAra mahinAbhandA baDhIko hos |

3 hajamA dazauM jil-hijjAko dina allAha ra uhA~kA rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) le bahudevavAdIharUsita kunai sambandha naraheko sArvajanika ghoSaNA garnubhayo | he bahudevavAdIharU ho! yadi timIharU zirkabATa taubA (pazcAttApa) garchau bhane yo timIharUkai lAgi rAmro hunecha | yadi timIharU taubA gardainau bhane vizvAsa gara timIharU allAha tathA uhA~ko sajAyabATa bacna sakdainau | he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! kAphiraharUlAI kaThora yAtanAko zubhasUcanA dinuhos |

4 juna bahudevavAdIharUsa~ga timIharUko sandhi kAyama cha ra jasako pAlanA tinIharU gardai AekA chan, tyasa sandhiko myAda purA gara | allAhakA AdezaharUko pAlanA garera tathA manAhI gariekA kAryaharUlAI tyAgera uhA~ko Dara ra sandhiko pAlanA gara | nissandeha allAha DarAuneharUlAI mana parAunuhuncha |

5 harAma (pratiSThita) mahinAharU samApta bhaepachi bahudevavAdIharUlAI jahA~ pAu~chau tyahI~ hatyA gara, tinIharUlAI bandI banAU, gherAu gara ra bATomA tinIharUko tAkamA basa | tara yadi tinIharUle zirkabATa taubA garchan, namAja kAyama garchan ra jakAta dinchan bhane tinIharU timIharUkA dAjubhAi bhae, tinIharU viruddha yuddha garna choDideU | nizcaya nai allAhale taubA garne bhaktaharUlAI mApha garnuhuncha ra dayA garnuhuncha |

6 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! yadi tapAIMkahA~ kunai nirdoSa bahudevavAdI Aera zaraNa mAgcha bhane tyasalAI zaraNa dinuhos, yahA~samma ki U kurAna sunos | pheri usalAI usako surakSita gantavyamA puryAi dinuhos kinabhane kAphiraharU yasa dharmako vAstavikatAlAI jAndainan | hunasakcha kurAnako pATha sunepachi sIdhA mArgamA Au~chan |

7 he muslimaharU ho! allAha, uhA~kA rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) ra bahudevavAdIharUbIca aba kunai sandhi huna sakdaina | tI bahudevavAdIharUbAheka josa~ga timIharUle masjide harAma najika hudaibiyAmA sandhi garyau | yadi tinIharU Aphno sandhimA kAyama rahanchan bhane timIharU pani Aphno sandhimA kAyama raho ra tyasalAI bhaGga nagara | nissandeha allAha AdezaharUko pAlanA garera tathA varjita kAryaharUlAI tyAgera Izabhaya rAkhne bhaktarUlAI mana parAunuhuncha |

8 bahudevavAdIharUsa~ga sandhi tathA zAnti kasarI bA~kI rahana sakcha, yadyapi tinIharU timIharUkA zatru hun | tinIharUle timIharUmAthi vijaya pAemA nata allAha, na nAtA-gotA ra na sandhiko mAna maryAdA rAkhnechan, baru timIharUlAI pIDAdAyI yAtanA dinechan?! tinIharUle AphnA rAmrA kurAle ta timIharUlAI rAjI garne prayAsa garchan tara tinIharUkA hRdayale tyasalAI sAtha diMdainan | sandhi bhaGga garekole tinIharUmadhye adhikAMsa allAhako AjJAbATa bAhira niskekA chan |

9 tinIharUle AphnA galata cAhanAharU purA garna allAhakA AyataharU ra sandhilAI tuccha mUlyamA bece | AphUlAI pani ra anya mAnisaharUlAI pani allAhako mArgabATa roke | vAstavamA tinIharUle garne garekA kArya ekadamai nIca hun |
10 mominaharUsita zatrutAle gardA unIharUle mAmilAmA allAha, nAtedArI tathA samjhautAko mAna maryAdA rAkhdainan | atyAcAra gareko kAraNale tinIharU sImA ullaGghanakArI hun |

11 yadi tinIharU taubA (kSamAyAcanA) garchan, ImAna lyAu~chn, namAja kAyama garchan ra jakAta dinchan bhane tinIharU muslima bhae | aba timIharUkA dhArmika bhAi-bandhu hun | timIharU tathA unIharUko haka hIta evam jimmevArI samAna chan ra tinIharU viruddha yuddha jAyaja chaina | tinIharUko islAma grahaNale tinIharUkA ragata, dhanasampatti tathA sammAnalAI surakSita pAreko cha | hAmI jJAnIharUkA lAgi nizAnIharU spaSTa pArekA chauM | unIharU nai yasabATa phAidA uThAune chan ra unIharUbATa anya mAnisaharUle pani phAidA uThAune chan |

12 yadi yI bahudevavAdIharUle nizcita avadhiko lAgi yuddha virAmako sandhi garera tyasako ullaGghana garchan, timIharUko dharmamA doSa lagAu~chan ra sandhilAI bhaGga garchan bhane tinIharU viruddha yuddha gara | kinabhane tinIharU kuphrakA aguvAharU hun, tinIharUsa~ga aba kunai sandhi bA~kI rahena | tinIharU viruddha yuddha gara, tAki tinIharUle kuphra, sandhiko ullaGghana tathA islAma dharmako nindA garna choDun |

13 he mominaharU ho! timIharU tyastA mAnisaharUsa~ga kina yuddha gardainau jasale AphnA sandhilAI bhaGga gare; dArunnadavaha (sabhAhala) mA rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) lAI makkAbATa niSkAsana garne nirNaya gare | yinIharUle nai banU khujAAko mukAbilAmA banU bakralAI maddata garera yuddhako lAgi pahala gare | banU bakra kuraizako sahayogI thiyo ra banU khujAA rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) ko sahayogI thiyo | ke timIharU yastA mAnisaharU viruddha yuddha garna DarAu~chau?! yadi timIharU pakkA momina hau bhane allAha yasakA adhika hakadAra hunuhuncha ki timIharU uhA~sita DarAU |

14 he mominaharU ho! yI bahudevavAdIharU viruddha yuddha gara | timIharUle yuddha garemA allAhale tinIharUlAI timIharUkA hAtabATa yAtanA dinuhunecha | tinIharUlAI parAjita garera tathA bandI banAera apamAnita garnuhunecha | timIharUlAI vijaya pradAna garera tinIharU viruddha sahayoga puryAunu hunecha | zatruharUko parAjaya, hatyA, bandI tathA mominaharUko vijayabATa tI mominaharUkA hRdaya zItala hunechan, jo yuddhamA sahabhAgI huna sakenan |

15 allAhale mominaharUlAI maddata garera tathA vijaya pradAna garera unIharUkA hRdayamA raheko krodhalAI samApta pArnuhunecha | yI virodhIharUmadhye jasale taubA garnechan, allAhale unIharUkA taubAlAI svIkAra garnuhunecha | uhA~le makkAko vijayako dina pani kehI makkAbAsIharUlAI mApha garnubhayo | sA~ccikai taubA garneharUlAI allAha jAnnuhuncha | uhA~ bhAgya nirdhAraNa, kArya saJcAlana tathA kAnuna banAunamA tatvadarzI hununahuncha |

16 he mominaharU ho! ke allAhale timIharUlAI parIkSAbinA nai choDidinuhunecha bhanne ThAnekA chau?! jabaki parIkSA linu allAhakA niyamaharU madhyeko eka niyama ho | uhA~le timIharUko parIkSA li~dai rahanuhunecha, tAki allAhalAI jihAda garne bhaktaharUko bAremA jAnakArI hos anya uhA~kA bhaktaharUlAI pani spaSTa hos | jasale allAha, uhA~kA rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) tathA mominaharUlAI choDera kAphiraharUlAI ghaniSTa mitra tathA gopya bhedI banAenan | timIharUle garirahekA sabai kAryaharUsita allAha avagata hunuhuncha | uhA~bATa kehI pani gopya chaina | uhA~le timIharUkA kAryaharUko badalA dinuhunecha |

17 kuphramai rahekA bahudevavAdIharUle bhaktibhAva garera allAhako masjidalAI AvAda garnu ucita chaina | satkarma svIkArya hune mukhya sarta ImAna nabhaekole tinIharUkA satkarmaharU vyartha bhae | mahApralayako dina tinIharU narkamA jAnechan jahA~ sadAsarvadA rahanechan | mRtyuaghi zirkabATa taubA garchan bhane yo beglai kurA ho |

18 allAhakA gharalAI AbAda garne hakadAra tI vyaktiharU hun, jo allAhamAthi ImAna rAkhchan, uhA~sa~ga kasailAI sAjhedAra Thahara gardainan, mahApralayako dinamAthi ImAna rAkhdachan, namAja kAyama garchan, jakAta dinchan ra allAhabAheka anya kasaisita DarAu~dainan | AzA cha, yinIharUle satmArga pAunechan | jabaki bahudevavAdIharU sIdhA mArgabATa TADhA chan |

19 he bahudevavAdIharU ho! ke timIharUle hAjIharUlAI pAnI khuvAune ra masjide harAmalAI AbAda garne vyaktiharUlAI tI vyaktiharU jasto ThAnchau jo allAhamAthi ImAna rAkhchan, uhA~sa~ga arU kasailAI sAjhedAra gardainan, mahApralayako dinamAthi ImAna rAkhdachan ra allAhako vANIlAI ucca pArnako lAgi tana, mana, dhanakA sAtha yuddha garchan | ke yI duvai kisimakA mAnisaharU allAhakahA~ samAna huna sakchan?! allAhako dRSTimA barAbara hunai sakdainan | allAhale zirka garera atyAcAra garneharUlAI mArga dekhAunu hunna, yadyapi tinIharUle hAjIharUlAI pAnI khuvAune jastA bhalAikA kAma garun |

20 jo mAnisaharUle ImAna lyAe, kAphirako dezabATa islAmI dezatarpha hijrata gare, tana, mana, dhanabATa jihAda gare, allAhako mArgamA ghara tyAge; allAhakahA~ unIharUkA lAgi ucca darjA raheko cha | yastA mAnisaharU nai svarga pAera vijayI hunechan |

21 unIharUkA pAlanakartAle Aphno tarphabATa tinIharUlAI prasanna pArne kurAko zubhasUcanA dinuhuncha | unIharUsita kahile krodha prakaTa garnuhune chaina | unIharUlAI tyastA svargako zubhasUcanA dinuhuncha, jahA~ kahilyai samApta nahune varadAnaharU hunechan |

22 unIharU tI svargaharUmA sadAsarvadA rahanechan, kinabhane unIharUle duniyA~mA satkarmaharU garekA thie | jo mAnisaharU nisvArtha bhaera allAhakA AdezaharUlAI pAlanA garchan tathA varjita kAryaharUbATa bacchan, unIharUkA lAgi allAhakahA~ mahAn puNya cha |

23 he mominaharU ho! yadi timIharUkA pitA, dAjubhAi tathA anya najika nAtedAraharU eka allAhamAthi ImAna nalyAera kuphralAI mana parAu~chan bhane tinIharUlAI mitra banAera mominaharUko gopya kurA nabatAU | jasale tinIharUlAI mitra banAucha usale allAhako avajJA garcha ra AphUlAI barbAdamA pArera AphaiMmAthi atyAcAra garcha |

24 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! bhanidinuhos– he mominaharU ho! yadi timIharUkA bAu-bAjeharU, santAnaharU, dAjubhAiharU, patnIharU, nAtedAraharU, timIharUle Arjana garekA sampatti, tyo vyApAra jasamA vRddhi bhaeko mana parAu~chau ra mandI hunabATa DarAu~chau ani timIharUle mana parAekA gharaharU ityAda; allAha, uhA~kA rasUla ra uhA~ko mArgamA yuddha garnu bhandA baDhI mana parchan bhane allAhale Aphno prakopa tathA sajAya paThAuJjela parkha | allAhale avajJAkArI mAnisaharUlAI yasto kArya garne maukA dinuhunna, jasalAI uhA~le mana parAunuhuncha |

25 he mominaharU ho! jaba timIharUle allAhamAthi bharosA garyau ani tyasapachi jukti lagAyau ra Aphno saGkhyAmA ghamanDa garenau ta timIharUko kama saMkhyA ra kama hAta hatiyAra bhaepani allAhale dherai yuddhaharUmA timIharUlAI sahayoga garnubhayo ani zatruharUmAthi timIharUlAI vijayI garAunubhayo | timIharUko ThUlo saMkhyA timIharUko vijayako kAraNa thiena | hunainako yuddhamA pani timIharUko vijayako kAraNa timIharUko ThUlo saMkhyA thiena, tyahA~ pani allAhale timIharUlAI maddata garnubhaeko thiyo | tyasabelA timIharUko ThUlo saMkhyAle timIharUlAI ahaGkArI banAyo ra timIharUle bhanyau- Aja hAmIharU ThUlo saMkhyAmA bhaekole vijayI hunechauM, tara timIharUkA zatru timIharUmAthi hAvI bhae | pRthvI pharAkilo hu~dAhu~dai pani timIharUkA nimti sAMghuro bhayo, ani timIharU piThyU~ pharkAera bhAgirahekA thiyau |

26 timIharU bhAgepachi allAhale Aphno rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) tathA mominaharUlAI sAntvanA ra himmata dinubhayo ani unIharUle DaTera yuddha gare | sAthamA maddatako lAgi phariztAharU paThAunubhayo | ani uhA~le kAphiraharUlAI hatyA garAera, kaida garAera, dhanasampatti khosera tathA unakA santAnaharUlAI bandI banAera yAtanA dinubhayo | rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) lAI jhUTo Thahara garne tathA uhA~ko sandezabATa vimukha hune kAphira badalA yasarI nai huncha |

27 pheri yasa yAtanApachi jasale kuphra tathA pathabhraSTatAbATa taubA (kSamAyAcanA) garcha, allAhale usako taubA svIkAra garnuhunecha | allAha AphnA taubA garne bhaktaharUprati kSamAzIla tathA dayAvAn hunuhuncha, kinabhane uhA~le kuphra tathA avajJAkA bAvajuda bhaktako taubA svIkAra garnuhuncha |

28 he mominaharU ho! bahudevavAdIharUbhitra kuphra (avajJAkArItA), anyAya ra narAmrA AcaraNa ra karmaharU bhaekAle tinIharU apavitra hun | tasartha tinIharU yasa varSa 9 hijrIpachi makkAko harama simAnA (jasa antargata masjide harAma pani parcha) jAna pAu~dainan, yadyapi tinIharU haja vA umrA kai nIyatale jAna cAhe pani | he mominaharU ho! tinIharUmAthi pratibandhale gardA vibhinna khAnekurA ra vyApAra banda hunAle garibIko bhaya cha bhane allAhale cAhanubhayo bhane Aphno varadAnale timIharUlAI sampanna tulyAunu hunecha | nissandeha allAha timIharUko avasthAbATa avagata hunuhuncha | timIharUko lAgi garirahanu bhaeko kAryamA tatvadarzI hunuhuncha |

29 he mominaharU ho! yahUdI ra IsAIharUmadhye jasale allAha evam mahApralayako dinamAthi ImAna lyAu~dainan; allAha tathA uhA~kA rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) le harAma garnubhaekA mRta janAvara, suGgura, raksI, tathA byAja ityAdilAI harAma ThAndainan ra satya dharma islAmaprati samarpita gardainan tinIharUsa~ga yuddha gara | yahA~samma ki tinIharUle apamAnita bhaera jijyA (surakSA-kara) tirun |

30 yahUdI ra IsAI duvai bahudevavAdI hun, kinabhane yahUdIharUle ujaira (alaihissalAma) lAI ra IsAIharUle IsA masIha (alaihissalAma) lAI allAhakA putra banAera zirka gare | yo kurA tinIharUle binA pramANa AphnA mukhabATa bhanekA chan | tinIharUle AphUbhandA pahilekA bahudevavAdIharU jhaiM yo kurA bhanekA chan jo bhanne garthe phariztAharU allAhakA chorIharU hun | yastA kurAharUbATa allAha pavitra hunuhuncha | allAhale tinIharUlAI barbAda pArun, tinIharU kasarI spaSTa satyabATa asatyatarpha jA~dai chan?!

31 yahUdIle AphnA dharmagurUharUlAI tathA IsAIharUle pUjArI ra tapasvIharUlAI allAha bAheka chuTTai pUjya banAekA chan | tinIharUle allAhale harAma garnubhaekA kurAharUlAI halAla ra halAla garnubhaekA kurAharUlAI harAma banAu~chan | IsAIharUle maryama putra IsA (alaihissalAma) lAI allAhasa~ga pUjya banAe | yadyapi ujaira (alaihissalAma) le yahUdIharUlAI ra IsA (alaihissalAma) le IsAIharUlAI ekamAtra satya Izvara allAhako bhaktiko Adeza diekA thie ra uhA~sa~ga kasailAI sAjhedAra banAuna manAhI garekA thie | uhA~ bAheka kohI upAsya chaina | bahudevavAdIharUle garne garekA zirkabATa uhA~ pavitra hunuhuncha |

32 yI sabai kAphiraharU milera jhUThA kurAharU racera islAma dharmalAI samApta pArna cAhanchan | allAha eka mAtra hunuhuncha bhanne kurAko kurAnamA rahekA spaSTa pramANaharUlAI yinIharU radda garna cAhanchan | jabaki muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) le lyAunubhaeko dharma satya ho | yasa dharmalAI allAhale pUrNa tathA vijayI garerai choDnuhunecha yadyapi kAphiraharUle katti pani mana na parAun | jaba allAha kunai kArya garne cAhanA garnuhuncha taba tyasa viparIta anya sabai cAhanAharU samApta huna pugchan |

33 allAhale nai AphnA rasUla muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) lAI sampUrNa mAnavajAtiko lAgi mArgadarzana kurAna ra satya-dharma islAma diera paThAunu bhayo | tAki yasalAI pramANako AdhAramA anya sabai dharmaharUmAthi vijayI garun | cAhe bahudevavAdIharUlAI apriya kina nahos |

34 he mominaharU ho! vAstavamA dherai jaso yahUdI dharmaguru tathA IsAI pUjArIharU mAnisaharUkA dhanasampatti ghUsa ityAdi anucita tarikAle khAnchan | allAhako dharma islAmamA praveza garnabATa mAnisaharUlAI rokchan | he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! jo mAnisaharU suna tathA cA~dI thupArera rAkhchan ra tyasako jakAta tirdainan, tinIharUlAI mahApralayako dinako duHkhadAyI yAtanAbAre sUcita garidinuhos |

35 mahApralayako dina tinIharUle thupArera rAkhekA ra jakAta natirekA suna-cA~dIlAI narkako AgomA tatAinecha ani tyasabATa tinIharUkA nidhAra, kAkhI evaM piThyU~harUlAI DAminecha ra nindA gardai bhaninecha yI hun timIharUle thupArera rAkhekA ani jakAta nadiekA dhanasampatti, lau aba bhoga tyasako sajAya!

36 mahinAharUko gaNanA allAhako ra kAnunamA 12 raheko cha, yo kAnuna uhA~ko surakSita kitAbamA tyasai dinadekhi lekhieko cha juna dina uhA~le AkAzaharU ra pRthvIko sRSTi garnubhayo | yI 12 mahinAharUmadhye 4 mahinAharU AdarakA hun, jasamA yuddha harAma garieko cha | 3 mahinA lagAtAra; jula-kAdA, jula-hijjA, muharrama ra cautho rajaba hun | yahI sidhA dharma tathA satya kurA ho, ani yI AdarakA mahinAharUmA yuddha garera svayam mAthi atyAcAra nagara | timIharU sabai milera bahudevavAdIharU viruddha yuddha gara jasarI tinIharU sabai milera timIharU viruddha yuddha garchan | jAnirAkha allAhako maddata tI mAnisaharUsa~ga cha jo uhA~kA AdezaharUko pAlanA garera tathA varjita kAryaharUlAI tyAgera uhA~sa~ga DarAu~chan | josa~ga allAha hunuhuncha, usamAthi kohI pani vijayI huna sakdaina |

37 nissandeha harAma (pratiSThata) mahinAlAI sArera gaira harAma (apratiSThata) mahinAko sthAnamA rAkhne kArya juna islAma pUrva hunthyo yo kuphramA vRddhi garnu ho | euTA kuphra bhayo harAma (pratiSThata) mahinAko bAremA allAhako Adezako inkAra, dosro kuphra bhayo zaitAnako bahakAumA Aera narAmro tarikAko prArambha | eka varSa ta tinIharU harAma (pratiSThata) mahinAlAI halAla garthe ra arko varSa tyasailAI harAma garthe tAki tinIharUle allAhale harAma garnubhaekA mahinAharUko saMkhyAsa~ga ekarUpatA dekhAun | tinIharUle halAla gareko mahinAko sthAnamA arko harAma mahinAlAI halAla garthe ra allAhako Adezako ullaGghana garthe | zaitAnale tinIharUkA kukarmaharUlAI tinIharUkA dRSTimA AkarSaka banAera dekhAyo ani tinIharUle tyastai mahinAlAI aghi pachi sArne kAma garnathAle | allAhale kAphiraharUlAI satmArga dekhAunuhunna |

38 he mominaharU ho! yo timIharUko ke cAlA ho, jaba allAhako mArgamA zatruharUviruddha yuddhako lAgi niska bhanI bolAincha taba timIharU DhIlA sustI garchau ra gharamA basirahanchau?! ke timIharU Akhiratako sadAsarvadA rahane varadAnaharUlAI choDera kSaNika sAMsArika jIvanasa~ga nai prasanna bhaekA chau?! allAhale AkhiratakA varadAnaharU mujAhidaharUko lAgi taiyAra pArnubhaeko cha | sAMsArika jIvanako mojamastI ta Akhiratako tulanAmA dherai tuccha cha | ani kasarI eka janA buddhimAna sadhaiM bA~kI rahane mahAn AkhiratalAI choDera kSaNika tathA tuccha saMsAralAI rojna sakcha?!

39 he mominaharU ho! yadi timIharU zatruharUviruddha allAhako mArgamA jihAdako lAgi niskenau bhane allAhale timIharUlAI duHkhadAyI tathA apamAnajanaka sajAya dinuhunecha ra timIharUko sthAnamA yastA AjJAkArI mAnisaharUlAI lyAunuhunecha jo jihAdako lAgi niskane chan | timIharUle allAhako Adezako ullaGghana garera uhA~lAI kunai kSati puryAuna sakne chainau | allAha susampanna hunuhuncha ra timIharU gariba chau | uhA~ hareka kAryako ra Aphno dharma tathA nabI (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) ko maddata garne sAmarthya rAkhnuhuncha |

40 he mominaharU ho! yadi timIharU allAhakA rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) lAI sahayoga gardainau ra allAhako mArgamA jihAda gardainau bhane jAni rAkha allAhale uhA~ (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) lAI sahayoga timIharU binA nai tyatikhera garnubhayo jaba uhA~ (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) tathA abU bakra (rajiyallAhu anhu) lAI bahudevavAdIharUle niSkAsita garekA thie | ani tesro vyakti binA duvai janA saura nAmI guphAmA kAphiraharUbATa lukekA thie | jaba duvai janAlAI kAphiraharU khojdai thie taba rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) le Aphno sAthI abU bakra (rajiyallAhu anhu) lAI bhannubhaeko thiyo– cintA nalinus, allAhako maddata hAmIharUko sAthamA cha | ani allAhale rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) lAI zAnti pradAna garnubhayo ra yastA phariztAharUdvArA sahayoga garnubhayo jasalAI timIharUle dekhdainathyau | phariztAharUle uhA~ (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) lAI sazakta pAre | allAhale kAphiraharUko vANIlAI tala ra Aphno vANIlAI ucca pArnubhayo | allAha Aphno astitva tathA zAsana-sattAmA prabhutvazAlI hunuhuncha | uhA~ Aphno kArya saJcAlana, bhAgya tathA kAnuna banAunamA tatvadarzI hunuhuncha |

41 he mominaharU ho! timIharU garibIko avasthAmA chau vA sampanna chau, yuvA-vasthAmA chau vA buDhesakAlamA, allAhako mArgamA Aphno jana-dhanakAsAtha jihAdako lAgi niska | jana-dhanale jihAda garnu loka ra paraloka duvaiko jIvanako lAgi gharamA basirahanubhandA uttama cha | yadi timIharUlAI yasa kurAko jJAna cha bhane yo kAma gara |

42 he nabI (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! yadi sahajatApUrvaka prApta hune dhanasampatti ra choTo yAtrA bhaeko bhae yI munAphikaharU avazya nai tapAIMsa~ga jAna tayAra hune thie, tara kaThina tathA lAmo yAtrAle gardA tinIharU yasa jihAdamA bhAga nalina tapAIMsa~ga anumati mAgdaichan | jaba tapAIM jihAdabATa pharkera Aunuhuncha taba yI anumati mAgneharU yo bhandai allAhako kasama khAera bhannechan– yadi hAmIharUmA zakti bhaeko bhae tapAIMsa~ga avazya niskane thiyauM | yasto bahAnA garera tathA jhUTo kasama khAera tinIharUle AphaiMlAI allAhako prakopako hakadAra banAu~daichan | nizcaya nai tinIharU Aphno dAbI tathA kasamamA jhUTo hun bhanne kurA allAhalAI thAhA cha |

43 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! tapAIMle Aphno socAi anusAra tinIharUlAI pachADi rahane juna anumati dinubhayo tyasa kAryalAI allAhale mApha garun | sA~co bolne vA jhUTalAunelAI rAmrarI na ThamyAIkana tapAIMle tinIharUlAI kina anumati dinubhayo? tapAIMle saccA mAnisalAI mAtra anumati dinuparne thiyo |

44 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! allAha evam mahApralayako dinamAthi sA~ccikai AsthA rAkhne mominaharUkA lAgi allAhako mArgamA jihAdamA bhAga nalina tapAIMsa~ga anumati mAgnu ucita chaina | unIharUkA lAgi ke ucita cha bhane tapAIMle jahile pani yuddhako lAgi paThAu~dA khurukka jAun ra allAhako mArgamA jana-dhanale jihAda garun | allAhale tI saccA Izabhaya rAkhne bhaktaharUlAI jAnnuhuncha, jo vAstavika bAdhyatAmA mAtra jihAdamA bhAga nalina anumati mAgchan |

45 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) jihAdamA bhAga nalina tapAIMsa~ga anumati mAgne vyaktiharU munAphika hun, jo allAha evaM mahApralayako dinamAthi ImAna rAkhdainan | islAma dharmako bAremA tinIharUko manamA zaGkA cha | tinIharU Aphno sandehamai hairAna bhaera duvidhAmA chan ra satmArga bheTAirahekA chainan |

46 yadi tinIharU tapAIMsa~ga jihAdako lAgi sA~ccikai niskana cAhanthe bhanne dAbImA saccA bhaekA bhae tinIharUle hAta hatiyAra tayAra garne thie | tara tinIharU tapAIMsa~ga niskun bhanne kurAlAI allAhale mana parAunu bhaena | tinIharUkA lAgi niskane kAryalAI bhArI banAunubhayo yahA~samma ki tinIharUle gharamai basne kAryalAI prAthamikatA die |

yuddhabATa pachADi rahane yinIharUko kAryale mominaharUlAI cintita pArcha ki bhanera allAhale unIharUlAI yo bhandai zAntvanA dinubhayo- tinIharUle jihAdamA bhAga liekA bhae jhana hAnikAraka hunthyo, ani bhannubhayoH
47 yI munAphikaharU timIharUsa~ga jihAdako lAgi naniskanumA nai bhalAi thiyo | yadi tinIharU timIharUsa~ga niskekA bhae timIharUbIca zaGkA utpanna garera upadrava maccAune thie ra eka arkAmA cuklI garera timIharUbIca phUTa paidA garne thie | he mominaharU ho! timIharUbIca yastA mAnisaharU chan jo jhUTa phailAera vibheda utpanna gardaichan | mominaharUbIca zaGkA upazaGkA utpanna garne atyAcArI munAphikaharUlAI allAhale rAmrarI cinnuhuncha |

48 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! tabUka yuddhaaghi yI munAphikaharUle mominaharUbIca vibheda sRjanA garera ekatAlAI bhaGga garna duSprayAsa garekA thie | tapAIMkA jihAda garne aThoTalAI khalbalyAune prayAsa gare | yahA~samma ki tapAIMkA lAgi allAhako maddata Ayo | allAhale Aphno dharmalAI baliyo ra zatruharUlAI parAsta pArnubhayo | yadyapi tinIharUlAI yo apriya thiyo | kinabhane tinIharU satyamAthi asatyako jIta cAhanthe |

49 munAphikaharUmadhye kehI vyaktiharUle jihAdamA najAna nAnAtharIkA bahAnA gardai bhane– he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! malAI jihAdamA bhAga naline anumati dinuhos ra AphUsa~ga niskana bAdhya natulyAunuhos | kinabhane romI zatruharUkA mahilAharUko saundarya dekhepachi hAmI pApamA lipta huna sakchauM | jAni rAkha! tinIharU yasa bhandA ThUlo saGkaTamA parisakekA chan, tyo ho chala kapaTako upadrava ra jihAdabATa pachADi rahane upadrava | nissandeha mahApralayako dina narkale kAphiraharUlAI cAraitirabATa gherAmA linecha, tyasabATa na kohI bacna saknecha ra na bhAgna saknecha |

50 he rasUla (sallAhu alaihi va sallama)! jaba tapAIM allAhako maddata pAera ra yuddhamA dhanasampatti prApta garera khuzI hunuhuncha, taba yo kurA munAphikaharUlAI apriya lAgcha ra tinIharU cintita hunchan | tara jaba tapAIMmAthi kunai saGkaTa Au~cha ra zatrulAI vijaya prApta huncha taba tinIharU bhanchan– yuddhako lAgi naniskera buddhimAniko kAma garekAchauM | yadyapi mominaharU yuddhako lAgi niske ani tinIharUmadhye kehI hatAhata bhae ra kehI bandi banAie | tara munAphikaharU Aphno parivAratarpha sakuzala khusI khusI pharke |

51 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! yI munAphikaharUlAI bhanidinuhos– hAmImAthi allAhale lekhnubhaeko bAheka arU kunai saGkaTa Aune chaina | uhA~ hAmrA pAlanakartA hunuhuncha | hAmI uhA~kai zaraNa cAhanchauM ra sabai mAmilAmA uhA~mAthi nai bharosA garchauM | mominaharU AphnA mAmilA uhA~lAI nai hastAntaraNa garchan ra uhA~ unIharUkA lAgi paryApta hunuhuncha | uhA~ kati rAmrA sahayogI hunuhuncha |

52 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! yinIharUlAI bhanidinuhos– ke timIharU hAmIharUkA lAgi yasa pratIkSAmA chau ki hAmIharUlAI ki ta vijaya prApta hos ki ta zahAdata? yadyapi hAmI yasa pratIkSAmA chauM ki allAhale timIharUlAI yAtanA diera sakhApa pArun | ani timIharUviruddha yuddhako anumati diera hAmIharUkA hAtabATa hatyA garera tathA bandI banAera daNDa diun | timIharU hAmIharUko pariNAmako pratIkSA gara ra hAmIharU timIharUko sajAyako pratIkSA garchauM |

53 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! yinIharUlAI bhanidinuhos– timIharU icchApUrvaka dhanasampatti kharca gara vA anicchApUrvaka kharca gara, timIharUko kuphra tathA avajJAko kAraNale tyo svIkAra garine chaina |

54 tIna vaTA kAraNaharUle tinIharUko dAna svIkAra gariena, allAha tathA uhA~kA rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) ko sAtha kuphra, namAjamA DhilA sustI ra anicchApUrvaka kharca garnu, kinabhane tinIharU Aphno namAja tathA dAnabATa puNyako AzA rAkhdainan |

55 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! munAphikaharUkA dhanasampatti tathA santAnaharUle tapAIMlAI Azcaryacakita napArun | kinabhane yinIharUkA dhanasampatti tathA santAnaharUko pariNAma narAmro hunecha | allAhale tinIharUlAI duniyA~mA bijogamA pArera yAtanA dinuhunecha, yinIharUko AtmA kuphrako avasthAmA nikAlnuhunecha ra paralokamA sadhaiMko lAgi narkako sabaibhandA tallo zreNImA phyA~kidinu hunecha |

56 he mominaharU ho! munAphikaharU jhUTo kasama khAera bhanchan- hAmI timIharUmadhyekai hauM | tara vAstavamA bhitradekhi tinIharU timIharU madhyekA hoinan | bahudevavAdIharU jastai tinIharUlAI hatyA garera tathA bandI banAera yAtanA diinecha bhanne kurAbATa DarAu~chan, jasabATa bacnako lAgi AphUlAI muslima bhanchan |
57 yI munAphikaharU killA vA guphA pAemA nizcaya nai tyasamA bhAgera luknechan vA tinIharUle chirne euTA suruGa mAtra pAemA suTukka tyasamA pasera zaraNa linechan |
58 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! kehI munAphikaharUle dAna vitaraNamA tapAIMmAthi Aropa lagAu~chan | tinIharUle cAhe jati pAemA khusI hunchan na pAemA risAu~chan |

59 tapAIMmAthi dAnako vitaraNamA doSa lagAune munAphikaharU yadi allAha ra uhA~kA rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) le pradAna garnubhaekA dhanabATa santuSTa tathA rAjIkhusIkA sAtha yo bhanekA bhae- allAha hAmrA lAgi paryApta hunuhuncha, allAhale Aphno kRpAbATa tathA uhA~kA rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) le Aphno tarphabATa ajhai dinuhunecha, bhane tinIharUkA lAgi rAmro hunethiyo |

dAnako vitaraNako bAremA rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) mAthi lagAieko doSako varNanapachi allAhale tyasakA hakadArako varNana garera uhA~ (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) mAthi Aropa lagAune ThAu~ naraheko pramANita garnubhaeko cha |
60 jakAta (anivArya dAna) nimnalikhita vyaktiharUmA anivAryarUpamA vitaraNa garnuparcha: | 1) gariba vyakti; josa~ga sAno vyavasAya vA kamAiko sAdhana huncha tara tyasabATa unIharUko AvazyakatA purA hu~daina sAthai tinIharUko avasthAbAre anya mAnisaharU bekhabara hunchan | 2) dIna-du:khIharU; josa~ga kehI pani hu~daina, unIharUko avasthAko dRzyale sabai kurA charlaGga huncha | 3) jakAta asulna ra vitaraNa garna niyukta vyaktiharU | 4) nayA~ muslimaharUko sAntvanA vA gaira-muslimako islAmamA Aune AzA bhaeko vA kAphiraharU duSTAtAbATa joginako lAgi | 5) dAsako svatantratAko lAgi | 6) RRNale Dubeko ra cuktA garna asamartha RRNIko lAgi | 7) allAhako bATomA yuddha garne (mujAhida) harUko lAgi | 8) alapatra pareko yAtrIharUko lAgi | yinIharU nai jakAtakA hakadAraharU hun | allAha AphnA bhaktaharUko hItabAre jJAna rAkhnuhuncha ra kArya saJcAlana tathA kAnuna banAunamA tatvadarzI hunuhuncha |

61 kehI munAphikaharU rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) lAI Aphno kurAbATa dukhita tulyAu~chan ra uhA~kA sahiSNutAlAI dekhera bhanchan– uhA~ ta sabaikA kurA sunnuhuncha ra vizvAsa garnuhuncha, satya asatyamA pharaka chuTyAunu hunna | he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! bhanidinuhos– ma bhalAikA kurAharU sunchu, allAha ra saccA mominaharUko kurAko puSTi garchu ra unIharUmAthi dayA garchu | mero Agamana mominaharUkA lAgi dayA ho | rasUlalAI kaSTa dineharUkA lAgi du:khadAyI yAtanA cha |

62 he mominaharU ho! munAphikaharU timIharUlAI prasanna pArna allAhako kasama khAera ke bhanchan bhane tinIharUle nabI (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) lAI kaSTa puryAune kunai kurA bhanekai chainan | yadi yinIharU vAstavika momina hun bhane tinIharUle ImAna lyAera tathA satkarma garera allAha tathA uhA~kA rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) ko prasannatA prApta garnuparne thiyo |

63 ke yI munAphikaharUlAI thAhA chaina ki yinIharU AphnA vyavahArabATa allAha ra uhA~kA rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) ko virodha gardaichan, yadyapi virodha garneharU mahApralayako dina narkamA jAnechan jasamA sadhaiM rahanechan, jo ati apamAnako kurA ho |

64 munAphikaharUlAI ke Dara lAgiraheko cha bhane allAhale rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) mAthi tinIharUle manamA lukAeko kuphrako bAremA kunai sUraha avatarita garera muslimaharUlAI batAunuhunecha | he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) bhanidinuhos– he munAphikaharU ho! timIharU ajhai ThaTTA garirAkha ra islAma dharmamAthi doSa lagAu~dai gara, allAhale avazya nai sUraha avatarita garera timIharUbAre tyasa kurAbATa sUcita garnuhunecha juna kurAko timIharUlAI Dara cha |

65 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! yadi tapAIMle tinIharUlAI sodhnuhuncha- timIharU dharmamA ke doSa lagAu~dai thiyau ra mominaharUlAI ke kasto gAlI gardai thiyau? tinIharUle spaSTa rUpamA bhannechan– hAmI tyastai gaphasapha ra khyAla ThaTTA gardai thiyauM | he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallA)! bhanidinuhos– ke timIharU allAha, uhA~kA AyataharU ra uhA~kA rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) ko ThaTTA gardai thiyau?!

66 jhUTho bahAnA nagara, timIharUle ThaTTA garera lukAeko kuphra spaSTa bhaisakeko cha | timIharUmadhye kapaTa chADera taubA garne samUhalAI kSamA garidie pani arko kapaTa nachADne ra taubA nagarne samUhalAI avazya daNDa dinechauM |

67 sabai munAphika puruSa tathA mahilAharU chala kapaTamA samAna chan | tinIharU kukarmako Adeza dinchan, puNya-karmabATa rokchan ra allAhako mArgamA dhanasampatti kharca gardainan | tinIharUle allAhako AjJApAlanalAI birse tasartha allAhale pani tinIharUlAI sIdhA mArga dekhAunu bhaena | nissandeha munAphikaharU avajJAkArI tathA pathabhraSTa hun |

68 allAhale taubA nagarekA munAphika tathA kAphira puruSa tathA mahilAharUsa~ga narkako Agoko vAcA garnubhaeko cha jasamA tinIharU sadA rahanechan | tyo tinIharUkA lAgi paryApta hunecha | allAhale tinIharUlAI Aphno kRpAbATa TADhA pArnubhayo, tinIharUkA lAgi nirantara yAtanA cha |

69 he munAphikaharU ho! kuphra garne ra dharmako khillI uDAune kurAmA timIharU vigatakA samudAyaharU jastai chau | tinIharU timIharUbhandA baDhI zaktizAlI ra dhanavAna thie | tinIharUle AphnA bhAgyako mojamastI garisake ra timIharUle pani tinIharU jhaiM mojamastI garyau | jasarI tinIharUle satya dharma tathA rasUlaharUlAI jhUTo Thahara gare timIharUle pani islAma dharma tathA rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) lAI jhUTo Thahara garyau | yI avaguNaharU bhaekA mAnisaharUkA karmaharU tinIharUkA kuphrale gardA vyartha bhae | tinIharUle AphUlAI barbAdImA pArera ghATA khAneharUmadhye bane |

70 ke yI munAphikaharUle vigatakA jhUTo samudAyaharUkA pariNAmabATa nasihata hAsila garenan; nUha, hUda, sAleha, ibrAhIma, zueba tathA lUta (alaihimussalAma) kA samudAyaharUbATa?! tinIharUsamakSa tinIharUkA rasUlaharU spaSTa pramANa tathA tarkaharU liera Ae tara tinIharUle mAnenan | tinIharUlAI naSTa pArera allAhale tinIharUmAthi atyAcAra garnubhaena | baru tinIharUle allAha tathA uhA~kA rasUlaharUlAI jhUTo Thahara garera AphaiMmAthi atyAcAra gare |

71 momina puruSa tathA mahilAharU eka arkAkA mitra tathA maddata garnevAlA hun | unIharUlAI ImAnale joDeko cha | unIharU allAhale manaparAune ekezvaravAda, namAja jastA satkarmako Adeza dinchan ra allAhale mana naparAune kuphra, avajJA jastA kukarmabATa rokchan, pAbandIkA sAtha namAja kAyama garchan; jakAta dinchan ra allAha tathA uhA~kA rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) ko AjJApAlana garchan | yinIharUlAI allAhale Aphno kRpAko pAtra banAunuhunecha | nissandeha allAha prabhutvazAlI hunuhuncha | kohI uhA~mAthi vijayI huna sakdaina | uhA~ Aphno kArya saJcAlana tathA kAnuna banAunamA tatvadarzI hunuhuncha |

72 allAhale AphUmAthi ImAna lyAune puruSa tathA mahilAharUsita mahApralayako dina yastA bagaiMcAharUmA praveza garAune vAcA garnubhaeko cha, jasakA mahalaharUkA talatirabATa nadIharU kalakala bagirahekA hunechan | unIharU tyasamA sadAsarvadA rahanechan | unIharUlAI kahilye mRtyu Aunechaina | sadAbahAra varadAnaharU pAirAkhekA hunechan | allAhale unIharUlAI ati sundara bagaiMcAharUmA basobAsako lAgi praveza garAune vAcA garnubhaeko cha | tyo bhandA pani uttama allAhako prasannatA prApta hunecha ra yahI mahAn saphalatA ho, yo bhandA ThUlo saphalatA kehI huna sakdaina |

73 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! kAphiraharU viruddha taravArale ra munAphikaharU viruddha vacana tathA tarkale jihAda garnuhos tathA duvai samudAyalAI dabAera rAkhnuhos | tinIharU yasai yogya chan | mahApralayako dina tinIharUko vAsasthAna narka hunecha ra yo ati nIca vAsasthAna ho |

74 munAphikaharU allAhako jhUTo kasama khAera bhanchan– dharmamA doSa lagAune tathA tapAIMlAI gAlI garne kurA hAmIharUle bhanekA thienauM, jasto ki tapAIMsamma kurA pugyo | baru tinIharUle ImAna lyAepachi kuphra garne kurA bhanekA thie | tinIharUle nabI (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) lAI dhokA dine prayAsa gare tara saphala huna sakenan | tinIharUle nakArnai nahune kurAlAI nakAre ra allAhale nabI (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) lAI yuddhamA pradAna garnubhaeko dhanako bAremA nakArAtmaka kurA gare | yadi tinIharUle allAhako darabAramA Aphno chalakapaTabATa taubA garchan bhane tinIharUkA lAgi uttama hunecha | yadi tinIharU vimukha hunchan bhane allAhale tinIharUlAI lokamA hatyA garera tathA bandI banAera du:khadAyI yAtanA dinuhunecha ra paralokamA narkako duHkhadAyI yAtanA dinuhunecha | kohI mitra tathA sahayogIle tinIharUlAI yAtanAbATa jogAuna sakdaina |

75 kehI munAphikaharUle allAhasita yo bhanera vAcA gare- yadi allAhale Aphno kRpAbATa dhanasampatti pradAna garnuhuncha bhane hAmI avazya nai asahAyaharUlAI dAna dinechauM ra satkarmIharUmadhye bannechauM |

76 tara jaba allAhale Aphno kRpAbATa dhanasampatti sampanna tulyAunubhayo taba tinIharUle AphUle gareko vacana purA garenan, baru Aphno dhanasampattilAI rokera rAkhe, kehI pani dAna garenan ra tinIharU ImAnabATa vimukha bhae |
77 ataH allAhasa~ga gareko vAcAlAI bhaGga ra jhUTo bolekole mahApralayako dinasammakA lAgi tinIharUko hRdayamA chala kapaTalAI bA~kI rAkhiyo |

78 ke munAphikaharUlAI thAhA chaina- allAha tinIharUkA calakhela tathA sabhAmA garne gupta sara-salAhalAI jAnnuhuncha ra adRzyakA jJAna rAkhnuhuncha? allAhabATa tinIharUkA kukarmaharU gopya chainan ra uhA~le tyasako daNDa dinuhunecha |

79 yI munAphikaharU gariba mominaharUmAthi doSa lagAu~chan, jo mehanata majadurI garera thorai dAna dinchan ra yo bhandai unIharUko majAka garchan- timIharUsa~ga dAna dinako lAgi ke cha?! jasarI tinIharUle mominaharUko khillI uDAe tyasarI allAhale pani tinIharUko majAka Aphno zAna anusAra garnubhayo | tinIharUkA lAgi duHkhadAyI yAtanA cha |

80 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! tapAIM munAphikaharUkA lAgi kSamAko duA (prArthanA) garnus vA nagarnus samAna cha | tapAIMle tinIharUkA lAgi sattarI paTakasamma kSamAko duA (prArthanA) gare pani allAhale tinIharUlAI kSamA garnuhune chaina, kinabhane tinIharUle allAha ra uhA~kA rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) lAI inkAra gare | allAhalAI inkAra garne mAnisaharUlAI uhA~le sIdhA mArga dekhAunuhunna |

81 tabUka yuddhamA pachADi rahane munAphikaharU allAhako mArgamA jihAda choDera basna pAekomA prasanna bhae | mominaharU jasto unIharU Aphno dhanasampatti ra jyAnale jihAda garna rucAenan ani AphnA munAphika sAthIharUlAI bhane– garmImA yuddhako lAgi bAhira naniska | tabUkako yuddha garmI mahinAmA bhaeko thiyo | he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! tinIharUlAI bhanidinuhos– narkako Ago ta yasa garmIbhandA pani adhika tAto cha, yadi timIharU bujhna sakekA bhae |

82 jihAdabATa pachi rahane yI munAphikaharU nAzavAna yasa duniyA~mA kehI dinakA lAgi hA~sun, tara sadhaiM rahane Akhiratako jIvanamA dherai runu parnecha | yo unIharUle garekA kuphra, avajJA tathA pApale gardA yasto hunecha |

83 he nabI (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! yadi allAhale tapAIMlAI yinIharUkA kunai samUhabIca phirtA lyAunuhuncha bhane yinIharU arko yuddhamA pani tyastai anumati mAgnechan | bhanidinuhos– he munAphikaharU ho! timIharU masa~ga kahilyai pani jihAdako lAgi niskana sakne chainau | jasarI timIharUle pahilo paTaka pachADi rahaneharUsa~ga basna rucAyau tyastai aba mahilA, rogI tathA zizuharUsa~ga basa | yo timIharUko karmako badalA ho |

84 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! munAphikaharUmadhye kasaiko mRtyU bhaemA kahilyai usako janAjA (antima saMskAra) ko namAja napaDhnuhos ra kahilyai usako cihAnanira usako kSamAdAnako lAgi duA (prArthanA) garna naubhinuhos kinabhane tinIharUle allAha tathA uhA~kA rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) lAI inkAra gare ra avajJAkArI bhaeko avasthAmA nai mare | yasto avasthAmA marekA mAnisako na namAja paDhincha na usako lAgi duA garincha |

85 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! yI munAphikaharUkA dhanasampatti tathA santAnabATa tapAIMlAI bhrama nahos | allAhale yinIharUlAI yI kurAharUdvArA sAMsArika jIvanamA daNDa dina cAhanuhuncha ani tyasakai lAgi tinIharU hairAna bhairahekA chan | tinIharUko prANa kuphrakai avasthAmA jAos bhanne allAha cAhanuhuncha |

86 jaba allAhale AphnA rasUla muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) mAthi kunai yasto sUraha avatarita garnuhuncha jasamA allAhamAthi ImAna lyAune tathA uhA~ko mArgamA jihAda garne Adeza huncha, taba tinIharU madhyekA dhanI vyaktiharU tapAIMsa~ga jihAdamA bhAga nalina anumati mAgdachan ra bhandachan– hAmIlAI kamajora tathA rogIharUsa~ga gharamai basna dinuhos |

87 yI munAphikaharUle lAcAra mAnisaharUsa~gai pachADi basera apamAnalAI nai roje | tinIharUkA kuphra tathA chala-kapaTako kAraNale allAhale tinIharUko mana-mastiSkamA silabandI (mohara) lagAunubhayo, tyasaile tinIharU hItakA kurAharU jAndainan |

88 rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) tathA mominaharU allAhako mArgamA jihAdabATa pachADi rahenan baru jana-dhanale jihAda gare | lokamA unIharUko badalA vijaya tathA yuddhamA prApta bhaekA phAidAharU hun bhane AkhiratamA unIharUko lAgi phAidAharU- svargamA praveza, jindagIko uddezyamA saphalatA ra narkabATa mukti ho |
89 allAhale unIharUkA lAgi tyastA bagaiMcAharU tayAra pArnubhaeko cha, jasakA mahalaharUko talatirabATa nadIharU bagirahekA hunechan | unIharU tyasamA sadA rahanechan ra yo mahAn saphalatA ho |

90 madInA varipari basne kehI gAu~leharU bahAnA banAera rasula (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) kahA~ Aera jihAdamA naniskana anumati mAge | jabaki kehI anya mAnisaharU pani jihAdamA gaenan, jasale jihAdamA najAne kunai bahAna pani pesa garekA thienan | kinabhane tinIharUle allAhakA vAcAharU ra nabI sallallAhu alehi vasallamalAI saccA mAndainathe | yastA mAnisaharU Aphno kuphrako kAraNale cA~Dai nai duHkhadAyI yAtanA pAunechan |

91 mahilA, bAlabAlikA, rogI, apAGga tathA jihAdako kharca juTAuna nasakne vyaktiharUsa~ga bAdhyatA rahekole unIharU jihAdamA nagae pani unIharUmAthi kunai doSa chaina | yasa sartamA ki unIharU allAha tathA uhA~kA rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) prati pUrNa hitaiSI rahun tathA islAmI kAnunako pAlanA garun | yastA sukarmIharUlAI sajAya dine kunai kAraNa chaina | allAha sukarmIharUlAI mApha garnuhuncha ra dayA garnuhuncha |

92 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) jihAdabATa pachi rahane yastA vyaktiharUmAthi kunai doSa chaina; jo malAi jihAdamA jAnako lAgi kunai savArI dinuhos bhandai Au~chan, ani tapAIM javApha dinuhuncha- masa~ga timro lAgi kunai savArI chaina, ani yo sunera unIharU AphUsita kharca garna kehI naraheko ra tapAIMsa~ga pani kehI naraheko pirale A~khAbATa dhardharI A~su bagAu~dai pharkanchan |

93 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) sajAyako bhAgIdAra tI vyaktiharU hun- jo dhanI hu~dAhu~dai pani tapAIMsita jihAdamA bhAga nalina anumati mAgna Au~chan | tinIharUle pachADi rahera apamAnalAI nai mana parAe | allAhale tinIharUkA mana-mastiSkamA silabandI lagAunubhayo, tyasaile tinIharUmAthi upadezako kunai prabhAva pariraheko chaina | kuna kurAmA tinIharUko hIta cha ra kuna kurAmA hAni cha bhanne kurA jAnirahekA chainan |

94 jaba muslimaharU jihAdabATa pharke taba jihAdamA bhAga naliekA munAphikaharUle vibhinna kisimakA jhUTA bahAnA banAuna thAle | tyasako javAphamA allAhale AphnA nabI (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) ra mominaharUlAI yo javApha dina lagAunubhayo– jhUTA bahAnA nabanAU, hAmI timIharUko kunai kurAmA vizvAsa garne chainauM | allAhale hAmIlAI timIharUkA sampUrNa avasthA tathA manakA kurAharUbAre sUcita garAi saknubhaeko cha | timIharU taubA garchau vA Aphno chala kapaTamA nai rahanchau bhanne kurAlAI allAha tathA uhA~kA rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) le hernuhunecha | pheri timIharU allAhatarpha nai pharkAine chau, jo hareka cIjakA jJAtA hunuhuncha | uhA~le timIharUlAI timIharUle garekA kAryaharUbAre avagata garAunuhunecha ra tyasako badalA dinuhunecha | ataH cA~Dai taubA garera satkarma gara |

95 he mominaharU ho! jaba timIharU pharkinechau taba yI jihAdamA bhAga nalineharUle AphnA jhUTA bahAnAharUlAI satya siddha garna allAhako kasama khAne chan, tAki timIharU tinIharUko nindA nagara | ataH tinIharUlAI tinIharUkai avasthAmA choDideU | tinIharU phoharI hun | tinIharUko chala kapaTa tathA pApako kAraNale tinako bAsa-sthAna narka ho |

96 he mominaharU ho! yI jihAdamA bhAga naliekA munAphikaharU timIharUlAI prasanna pArna kasama khAne chan tAki timIharU prasanna hoU | timIharU tinIharUsa~ga prasanna hunchau bhane allAhako Adezako avajJA garchau, kinabhane allAha kuphra ra chala kapaTa garera avajJA garneharUlAI mana parAunuhunna | he muslimaharU ho! yasa bAremA sAvadhAna!

97 kuphra tathA chala kapaTamA zahariyAharUbhandA gAu~leharU agADi chan | allAhale AphnA rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) mAthi avataraNa garnubhaekA pharja (anivArya), sunnata (atirikta), kAnuna tathA AdezaharUbATa anabhijJa bhaeko kAraNa tinIharU yasaikA yogya chan | kinabhane tinIharUmA kaThoratA cha ra mAnisaharUsa~ga melajolako kamI cha | allAha tinIharUkA avasthAbATa avagata hunuhuncha | tinIharUkA kunai kurA uhA~bATa lukeko chaina | uhA~ kArya saJcAlana tathA kAnuna banAunamA tatvadarzI hunuhuncha |

98 kehI gAu~le munAphikaharU allAhako mArgamA kharca garnu ghATA tathA harjAnA ThAndachan kinabhane tinIharUko vicAramA tyasalAI kharca garemA puNya mildaina ra kharca nagaremA sajAya hu~daina | yasakA bAvajuda tinIharU kahilekAhI~ dekhAvaTIko lAgi ra timIharUko Darale kharca garchan | tinIharU ke kAmanA garchan bhane mominaharUmAthi kunai prakopa avatarita hos, tAki unIharUbATa mukti milos | mominaharUmAthi prakopa avatarita hos bhanne tinIharUko kAmanAlAI allAhale tI munAphikaharUmAthi nai avataraNa garnubhayo | allAha tinIharUle bhanekA kurAharU sunnuhuncha ra tinIharUle lukAekA kurAharU jAnnuhuncha |

99 kehI gAu~leharU allAha tathA mahApralayako dinamAthi ImAna rAkhchan, allAhako nikaTatA prApta garne ra rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) ko duA tathA kSamAyAcanA prAptiko mAdhyama ThAnera allAhako mArgamA kharca garchan | jAni rAkha! tyo nizcaya nai unIharUkA lAgi nikaTatA prApta garne ra rasUla sallallAhu alaihi vasallamako duAko sAdhana ho | allAhale unIharUlAI avazya nai Aphno kRpAdvArA kSamA garera svarga pradAna garnuhunecha | nissandeha allAhale taubA garne bhaktaharUlAI mApha garnuhuncha ra dayA garnuhuncha |

100 gharabAra tyAgera surumA ImAna lyAekA muhAjiraharU, nabI (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) lAI maddata garekA ansAraharU tathA yI duvailAI rAmro tarikAle anusaraNa garekA tAbiIna (sahAbA rajiyallAhu anhuma pachiko pustA) sa~ga allAha rAjI khusI hunubhayo ra unIharUkA satkarmalAI svIkAra garnubhayo | unIharU pani allAhale pradAna garnubhaeko puNyabATa prasanna bhae | uhA~le unIharUkA lAgi yastA bagaiMcAharU tayAra pArnubhaeko cha, jasakA mahalakA munibATa nadIharU bagirahekA hunechan | unIharU tyasamA sadAsarvadA rahanechan | yahI mahAn saphalatA ho |

101 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! madInA varipari basne gAu~le ra madInAmA basne munAphikaharU chala kapaTamA pakkA chan | tapAIMlAI tinIharUko bAremA thAhA chaina baru allAhalAI thAhA cha | uhA~le cA~Dai nai tinIharUlAI duI paTaka yAtanA dinuhunecha | eka paTaka duniyA~mA tinIharUko chala kapaTako pola khulepachi hatyA tathA bandI banAera ra dosro paTaka AkhiratamA kabra (cihAna) mA yAtanA diera; tyasapachi tinIharU kayAmatako dina narkako sabaibhandA tallo tahamA kaDA yAtanAtira paThAinechan |

102 kehI madInA bAsIharUle jihAdamA sahabhAgI nabhaeko Aphno doSalAI svIkAra gare | unIharUsa~ga kunai bAdhyatA thiena bhanne kurAlAI svIkAra gare | tara unIharUle kunai jhUTA bahAnA banAenan | unIharU pahilA AjJApAlana, islAmI kAnuko pAbandI, jihAdamA sahabhAgI jastA satkarma pani gare ra kehI duSkarma pani gare | tara allAhale yasa duSkarmalAI mApha garnuhunecha bhanne AzA pani rAkhe | nissandeha allAha taubA garne bhaktaharUlAI mApha garnuhunecha ra dayA pani garnuhunecha |

103 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! unIharUko dhanabATa jakAta linuhos | jakAtale unIharUlAI pApabATa zuddha pArnecha ra unIharUle garekA satkarmamA vRddhi garnecha | jakAta liera unIharUkA lAgi prArthanA garnuhos | nissandeha tapAIMko prArthanA unIharUkA lAgi kRpA tathA zAnti hunecha | allAhale tapAIMko prArthanA sunnuhuncha ra unIharUkA karma tathA nIyatalAI jAnnuhuncha |

104 tAki yI jihAdamA bhAga naliekA tara allAha samakSa taubA garekA mAnisaharUlAI thAhA hos ki allAhale nai AphnA bhaktaharUko taubA svIkAra garnuhuncha ra jakAta svIkAra garnuhuncha | uhA~le jakAta dinelAI aDiga rAkhnuhuncha | nizcaya nai allAha bhaktaharUko taubA svIkAra garnevAlA ra dayAvAn hunuhuncha |

105 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! jihAdabATa pachADi rahane tara taubA garneharUlAI bhanidinuhos– Aphno kamIkamajorIlAI satkarmale purA gara | allAhako lAgi nisvArtha bhaera uhA~ko prasannatA prApta garnako lAgi satkarma gara | allAha, uhA~kA rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) ra mominaharUle timIharUle garekA karmaharUlAI hernuhunecha | mahApralayako dina timIharU AphnA pAlanakartAtarpha pharkAinechau, jasalAI timIharUkA Antarika tathA vAhya sabai kurAharUko jJAna cha | uhA~le timIharUlAI timIharUle duniyA~mA garirahekA kAryaharUbAre avagata garAunuhunecha ra tyasako badalA pani cA~Dai nai dinuhunecha |

106 tabUka yuddhamA bhAga nalineharUmadhye yastA pani chan josa~ga kunai bAdhyatA thiena | yinIharUko mAmilAko nirNaya allAhako Adeza AuJjela sthagita garieko cha | uhA~le yinIharUko bAremA je cAhanuhuncha nirNaya garnuhuncha | yinIharUle taubA nagaremA sajAya dinuhunecha ra mAphI mAgemA uhA~le mApha garnuhunecha | ko sajAyako hakadAra cha ra ko mAphIko hakadAra cha bhanne kurA allAha jAnnuhuncha | uhA~ kAnuna banAuna tathA kArya saJcAlanamA tatvadarzI hunuhuncha | jihAdabATa binA kAraNa pachADi rahane tara jhUTo nabolne ra taubA garneharU thie- murArA bina rabI, kAaba bina malika ra hilAla bina umaiyyA |

107 kehI munAphikaharUle allAhako avajJA gardai muslimaharUlAI kaSTa puryAunako lAgi masjidako nirmANa gare | tinIharUko uddezya munAphikaharUlAI bala puryAera kuphralAI vijayI pArnu ra mominaharUharUbIca matabheda utpanna garnu ho | yasa masjidako nirmANako arko uddezya yasaaghi allAha ra uhA~kA rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) viruddha yuddha garisakekA mAnisaharUkA lAgi dharApa-sthala upalabdha garAunu pani ho | tara yI munAphikaharUle avazya nai kasama khAera bhannechan- hAmro uddezya muslimaharUsa~ga namratAko vyavahAra garnu ho | vAstavamA yinIharU Aphno yasa dAbImA pakkA jhUTA hun bhanne kurAko allAhale sAkSI dinuhuncha |

108 he nabI (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! munAphikaharUle tyasa masjidamA namAja paDhna bolAu~dA tyasamA kahilyai najAnuhos, baru kubA masjidamA namAja kAyama garnu ucita cha | kubA masjidako nirmANa pahile dinadekhi nai Izabhaya (takvA) ko AdhAramA bhaeko cha | yasabhitra yastA mAnisaharU chan jo saphA sughghara rahera zArIrikarUpamA ra kSamA yAcanA garera adhyAtmikarUpamA pavitra rahana mana parAu~chan | allAhale apavitratA, phohora ra pApaharUbATa pavitra rahaneharUlAI mana parAunuhuncha |

109 ke allAhakA AdezaharUko pAlanA garera ra uhA~le manAhI garekA kAryaharUbATa bacera Izabhaya (takvA) tathA uhA~ko prasannatAko AdhAramA masjida nirmANa garne vyakti uttama huncha vA tyo vyakti uttama huncha jasale muslimaharUlAI kaSTa puryAuna, kuphralAI baliyo pArna tathA mominaharUbIca vibheda utpanna garnako lAgi masjidako nirmANa gareko cha?! yI duvai kahilyai samAna huna sakdainan | pahilo vyaktiko udAharaNa yasto bhavana jasto cha jasako jaga baliyo huncha ra bhatkane Dara hu~daina, jabaki dosro kisimako vyaktiko udAharaNa yasto bhavana jasto cha jo nadIko kinArAmA huncha ra jahile pani bhatkane Dara huncha | jahile pani tyasako jaga bhatkera narkamA khasna sakcha | allAhale kuphra tathA chala kapaTa garera atyAcAra garneharUlAI sIdhA mArga dekhAunuhunna |

110 muslimaharUlAI kaSTa puryAunako lAgi nirmANa garieko masjida sadhaiM tinIharUkA hRdayamA sandeha tathA chala kapaTako jaro banirahanecha yahA~samma ki tinIharUkA hRdaya mRtyu vA taravArabATa hatyAle chiyA-chiyA huna pugun | allAha AphnA bhaktaharUko karmaharUsita avagata hunuhuncha ra unIharUkA rAmrA ra narAmrA karmaharUko badalA dinamA tatvadarzI hunuhuncha |

jihAdamA bhAga naline munAphikaharUkA avaguNaharUko varNanapachi satmArgamA jihAda garneharUkA puNyako varNana gardai allAhale bhannubhaeko cha–
111 nissandeha allAhale mominaharUko jyAna tathA dhanasampatti svargako saTTAmA kinnubhaeko cha | unIharU allAhako vANIlAI ucca pArnako lAgi kAphiraharU viruddha yuddha garchan ani kAphiraharUko hatyA garchan ra kAphiraharU unIharUko hatyA garchan | allAhale yasako vAcA taurAta, injIla tathA kurAnamA garnubhaeko cha | taurAta mUsA (alaihissalAma), injIla IsA (alaihissalAma) ra kurAna muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) mAthi avatarita granthaharU hun | allAhabhandA baDhI vAcA purA garne arU ko hunasakcha? he mominaharU ho! khusI manAU tyasa saudAprati juna timIharUle allAhasita garekA chau | yasamA dherai phAidA cha ra yo mahAna saphalatA ho |

112 saphalatA prApta garneharU tI hun- jo taubA garchan, allAhale mana naparAune kAryaharUlAI tyagchan ra mana parAune kArya garchan ani vinamra bhaera uhA~ko AjJApAlana garchan | hareka avasthAmA uha~ko guNagAna garchan, vrata baschan, namAja kAyama garchan | allAha ra uhA~kA rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) ko Adeza anusAra satkarma garne ra duSkarma nagarne ahvAna garchan | satkarmako anusaraNa garera tathA duSkarmabATa bacera allAhakA AdezaharUko rakSA garchan | he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! yastA mominaharUlAI loka ra paraloka duvaimA khuzIko khabara sunAunuhos |

113 bahudevavAdIharUkA lAgi kSamAko prArthanA garnu nabI (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) ra mominaharUko lAgi ucita chaina, cAhe tinIharU unIharUkA nAtedAra nai kina nahoun | bahudevavAdIharUko mRtyu zirkamA bhaekale tinIharU narkabAsI hun |

114 ibrAhIma (alaihissalAma) le Aphno pitAko nimti gareko kSamAko prArthanA kevala euTA vAcAko kAraNale thiyo, jo unale AphnA pitAsita garisakekA thie | tara, unako pitA allAhakA zatru hun, upadeza grahaNa garirahekA chainan ra unako mRtyu kuphra kai avasthAmA hunecha bhanne kurA jaba spaSTa bhayo taba unI Aphno pitAdekhi alaga bhae | ibrAhIma (alaihissAma) le pitAko lAgi kSamA yAcanA Aphno vicArale garekA thie, allAhako Adezako ullaGghana garekA thiena | nissandeha ibrAhIma (alaihissalAma) ati bintI garthe ra Aphno samudAyalAI dherai mApha garthe |

115 allAhale kunai samudAyalAI mArgadarzana pradAna garisakepachi tabasamma pathabhraSTa bhaeko phaisalA garnuhunna tathA pakaDa garnuhunna, jabasamma usako lAgi bacnu parne harAma kAryaharU batAunuhunna | bacnuparne harAma kAryaharU batAisakepachi pani tinIharU tyastA kAryaharUbATa bacdainan bhane allAhale tinIharUmAthi pathabhraSTa bhaeko phaisalA garnuhuncha | nissandeha allAha hareka kurAkA jJAtA hunuhuncha | kunai kurA uhA~bATa lukeko chaina | uhA~le timIharUlAI timIharUle najAnekA kurAharU sikAunubhayo |

116 nissandeha AkAzaharU tathA pRthvImA allAhakai zAsana raheko cha | yI duvaimA uhA~ko kohI sAjhedAra chaina ra kunai pani vastu uhA~bATa gopya chaina | uhA~ jasalAI cAhanuhuncha jIvita garnuhuncha ra jasalAI cAhanuhuncha mArnuhuncha | he mAnava! allAhabAheka na timIharUko kohI mitra raheko cha na kohI sahayogI nai |

117 allAhale sandeSTA muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) lAI mApha garnubhayo jaba uhA~le munAphikaharUlAI tabUka yuddhamA bhAga naline anumati dinubhayo | uhA~le yuddhamA bhAga liekA muhAjira tathA ansAralAI pani mApha garnubhayo | unIharUle kaDA garmI, sara-sAmAna ra hAta hatiyArako kamI ra zatrukA zaktikA bAvajuda uhA~ (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) ko anusaraNa gare | yadyapi nAjuka avasthAle gardA unIharUmadhye euTA samUhako hRdayamA yuddha choDne vicAra Aeko thiyo | ani allAhale unIharUlAI aDiga pArera yuddhako lAgi prasthAna garne maukA dinubhayo ra mApha garnubhayo | nizcaya nai uhA~ unIharUprati karuNAmaya evam parama dayAlu hunuhuncha |

118 allAhale tIna janAko taubA svIkAra garnubhayo, unIharU hunH kaaba bina mAlika, murArA bina rabI ra hilAla bina umaiyyA | yinIharUle rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) sa~ga tabUka yuddhamA bhAga liekA thienan | kehI dinapachi yinIharUko taubA svIkAra garieko thiyo | rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) le tinIharUlAI bahiSkAra garne Adeza dinubhaeko thiyo | jasale gardA unIharU yati cintita bhaekA thie ki unIharUkA nimti vizAla pRthvI pani saGkIrNa bhaeko thiyo | unIharUko Aphno jyAna pani unIharUkA lAgi bojha huna pugeko thiyo | allAhabAheka anya kahIM zaraNa prApta hu~daina bhanne kurA unIharUle bujhekA thie | ani allAhale unIharUlAI taubA garne maukA diera kRpA garnubhayo | pheri unIharUko taubA svIkAra garnubhayo | uhA~ bhaktaharUko taubA svIkAra garnevAlA ra dayAvAn hunuhuncha |

119 he mominaharU ho! allAhakA AdezaharUko pAlanA garera tathA varjita kAryaharUlAI tyAgera uhA~sita DarAU | Aphno ImAna, karma tathA bhanAimA satyaniSTha mAnisaharUmadhye bana | saccAimA nai timIharUko mukti cha |

120 jaba allAhakA rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) AphaiM jihAdako lAgi niskirahanu bhaeko cha bhane madInAbAsI tathA tyasakA varipari basobAsa garne gAu~leharUkA nimti gharamA basirahanu ra uhA~ko jyAnabhandA Aphno jyAnalAI priya ThAnnu ucita chaina | baru tinIharUle Aphno jyAna tyasamA lagAunu parcha ra uhA~ (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) ko rakSA garnuparcha | kinabhane tinIharUlAI allAhako mArgamA juna tirkhA, thakAi tathA bhoka lAgcha, tinIharUle jati kAphiraharUko krodha sahana garchan, zatruharUko tarphabATa junasukai hatyA vA kaida vA yuddhamA prApta dhanasampatti vA parAjayako sAmanA garchan; tyasa satkarmako puNya allAhale lekhnuhuncha | allAhale sukarmIharUko badalAlAI barbAda pArnuhunna | baru tyasalAI svIkAra garera tyasako purA-purA badalA mAtra hoina baru thapera dinuhuncha |

121 unIharUle juna sAno vA ThUlo dhanarAzi kharca garchan vA juna upatyakA pAra garchan, yI sabai lekhine garincha tAki allAhadvArA tinIharUlAI tinIharUle garekA kAryaharUko uttama puNya pradAna gariyos | allAhale unIharUlAI AkhiratamA ati uttama badalA dinuhunecha |

122 sabai mominaharUle yuddhako lAgi niskanu ucita chaina, tAki zatruharU vijayI bhaemA sabailAI sakhApa napArun | euTA jamAta jihAdako lAgi niskos ra arko jamAta cAhi~ rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) sa~ga basera kurAna, islAmI zariata ra zikSA grahaNa garos | pheri Aphno samudAyatarpha pharkepachi unIharUlAI sAvadhAna garos | AzA cha tinIharU allAhako yAtanAbATa DarAune chan, ani uhA~kA AdezaharUko pAlanA garnechan ra varjita kAryaharUlAI choDnechan | yo Ayata tI sainyadalaharUko bAremA ho jasalAI allAhako rasUla sallallAhu alaihi vasallamale madInA variparikA kSetraharUmA paThAunuhunthyo ra tyasako lAgi sahAbAko eka samUhalAI cayana garnuhunthyo |

123 allAhale mominaharUlAI variparikA kAphiraharU viruddha yuddha garne Adeza dinubhaeko cha, kinabhane tinIharU najika bhaekole baDhI ghAtaka huna sakchan | kAphiraharUmAthi dhAka jamAuna ra tinIharUbATa surakSita rahanako lAgi Aphno zakti pradarzanako Adeza pani allAhale mominaharUlAI dinubhaeko cha | allAhako maddata Izabhaya rAkhne mominaharUkA sAthamA cha |

124 jaba allAhale Aphno rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) mAthi kunai sUraha avataraNa garnuhuncha taba kehI munAphikaharU ThaTTA gardai sodhchan– yasa sUrahale timIharUmadhye kasako ImAnalAI baDhAeko cha? jabaki juna vyaktiharU allAha tathA rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) mAthi ImAna rAkhchan, tyasa sUrahale unIharUko ImAnamA vRddhi garcha | avatarita garieko sUrahamA loka ra paralokako bhalAi rahekole tyasabATa mominaharU prasanna chan |

125 kurAnamA Adeza tathA satya kathAharU bhaekAle yasako avataraNale munAphikaharUko roga tathA phoharamai vRddhi garcha | jati kurAna avatarita huncha tyati nai tinIharUkA hRdayako roga baDhcha | kinabhane jati kurAna avatarita bhayo tyati tinIharUko zaGkA baDhyo ra tinIharU kAphira bhaekai (avizvAsakai) avasthAmA mare |

126 ke munAphikaharUle yasa kurAbATa pATha lienan- hareka varSa eka-duI paTaka tinIharUkA chala kapaTalAI spaSTa pArera allAhale parIkSA linuhuncha?! tinIharU yo jAndA jAndai ki allAha nai tinIharUsa~ga yasto garirahanubhaeko cha, Aphno kuphra tathA chala kapaTabATa taubA gardainan ra kunai zikSA grahaNa gardainan |

127 jaba allAha kunai yasto sUraha rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) mAthi avataraNa garnuhuncha jasamA munAphikaharUko vAstaviktAko varNana huncha, taba tinIharU A~khai A~khAmA eka arkAsa~ga kurA garchan- kahIM timIlAI kasaile heriraheko ta chaina? yadi kasaile heriraheko chaina bhane tinIharU suTukka sabhAbATa hi~Dchan | yAda rAkha! allAhale tinIharUkA hRdayaharUlAI nai mArgadarzana tathA bhalAibATa phernubhaeko cha | uhA~le tinIharUlAI apamAnita garnubhaeko cha kinabhane tinIharU buddhile kAma li~dainan |

128 he araba samudAya ho! timIharUkai samudAyabATa rasUlako Agamana bhaeko cha, jasalAI timIharUmAthi AilAgne saGkaTale dukhita tulyAu~cha | uhA~le timIharUko mArgadarzana cAhanuhuncha | uhA~ mominaharUprati atyantai mamatAmaya tathA dayAvAn hunuhuncha |
129 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! yadi tinIharU tapAIMbATa vimukha hunchan ra ImAna lyAu~dainan bhane bhanidinuhos- mero lAgi allAha paryApta hunuhuncha |
1 (alipha0 lAma0 rA0) yastA akSaraharUko vyAkhyA sUraha al-bakarahako ArambhamA bhaisakeko cha | yasa sUrahamA rahekA allAhakA AdezaharU ekadamai praSTa ra vivekapUrNa chan |

2 ke mAnisaharUkA nimti yo Azcaryako viSaya baneko cha, hAmIle tinIharUmadhyekai ekajanA puruSamAthi vahI (prakAzanA) avatarita garera mAnisaharUlAI sAvadhAna garne Adeza diyauM?! he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! allAhamAthi ImAna lyAune mAnisaharUlAI zubhasUcanA dinuhos | unIharUle garekA satkarmako badalAsvarUpa unIharUkA pAlanakartAkahA~ ucca darjA cha bhanI zubhasandeza dinuhos | kAphiraharUle bhane– yo mAnche jasale yI AyAta (nizAnIharU) lyAeko cha, yo pakkA jAdugara ho |

3 he Azcaryacakita huneharU ho! timIharUkA pAlanakartA allAhale nai 6 dinamA vizAla AkAzaharU tathA pharAkilo pRthvI sRjanA garnubhayo | pheri uhA~ arza (siMhAsana) mAthi virAjamAna hunubhayo | uhA~le timIharUmadhye eka janA rasUla paThAunubhaekomA kina Azcarya gardaichau?! uhA~ mAtra yasa vizAla sattA-zAsanako nirNaya garnuhuncha ra bhAgya nirdhAraNa garnuhuncha | uhA~ko anumatibinA kohI pani uhA~najika siphArisa garna sakdaina | yI guNaharUle paripUrNa timIharUkA pAlanakartA allAha nai bhaekole niSThApUrvaka uhA~ko mAtrai upAsanA gara | ke yati pramANaharUle allAha eka mAtra hunuhuncha bhanne kurAlAI pramANita gardainan? ani timIharU kina upadeza grahaNa garera ImAna lyAu~dainau?

4 mahApralayako dina timIharU uhA~tarpha nai pharkera jAnechau, tAki uhA~dvArA karmaharUko badalA diiyos | mAnisaharUsa~ga allAhako yo saccA vAcA ho, uhA~le vAcA kahilyai toDanuhunna | uhA~ yasako sAmarthya rAkhnuhuncha | vigatakA kunai udAharaNa binA uhA~le sRSTiharUlAI pahilo paTaka sRjanA garnubhayo | mRtyupachi pheri uhA~le nai sRSTi garnuhunecha | tAki uhA~le ImAna lyAera satkarma garneharUlAI nyAyakAsAtha badalA deun | kAphiraharUlAI tinIharUle garekA kuphrale gardA ati umliraheko pAnI khuvAinecha ra ati duHkhada yAtanA diinecha |

5 uhA~ nai hunuhuncha jasale sUryalAI prajvalita dIpa ra candramAlAI camkilo banAunubhayo ra tyasakA lAgi 28 vaTA gantavyaharU nirdhAraNa garnubhayo | gantavya bhaneko candramAle 24 ghaNTAmA pAra gareko dUrI ho | he mAnava! tAki timIharU sUryabATa dinako gantI ra candramAbATa mahinA ra varSako gantI garna saka | allAhale AkAzaharU, pRthvI ra yI duvaibIca je jati sRSTi garnubhaeko cha, sabailAI satyakA sAtha sRSTi garnubhaeko cha | tAki mAnisaharUkA lAgi uhA~kA AphnA zakti tathA mahAnatA spaSTa hoUn | uhA~ eka mAtra pUjya hunuhuncha bhanne kurA spaSTa pArnako lAgi pani jJAnI mAnisaharUsamakSa pramANaharU prastuta garnuhuncha |

6 rAtale dinalAI ra dinale rAtalAI pachyAunu ra tyasale gardA hune andhakAra ra prakAza tathA dina rAta lAmo ra choTo hunumA AkAzaharU ra dhartImA rahekA sRSTiharUmA allAhako zaktilAI spaSTa pArne nizAnIharU chan | allAhakA AdezaharUko pAlanA garera tathA varjita kAryaharUlAI tyAgera uhA~sita DarAune mAnisaharU yasabATa phAidA uThAu~chan |

7 nissandeha allAhasita bheTne AzA narAkhne kAphiraharUle sadhai~ bA~kI rahane Akhiratako jIvanako saTTAmA nAzavAn sAMsArika jIvanalAI rojekA chan, tyasaimA santuSTa chan ra allAhakA nizAnI evaM pramANaharUsita vimukha tathA asAvadhAna chan |
8 tyastA vyaktiharUko bAsa narka hunecha, kinabhane tinIharUle kuphra gare ra mahApralaya (kayAmata) ko dinalAI jhUTo Thahara gare |

9 tara, satkarmI mominaharUlAI unIharUko ImAnale gardA allAhale sIdhA mArga dekhAunuhunecha | uhA~le unIharUlAI yasto satkarma garne maukA pradAna garnuhunecha, jasalAI uhA~le mana parAunuhuncha | pheri mahApralayako dina allAhale unIharUlAI sadAsarvadA rahane svargamA praveza garAunuhunecha, jasako talatirabATa nadIharU bagirahekA hunechan |

10 svargamA unIharUle allAhako pavitratAko guNagAna garera prArthanA garnechan | unIharUko lAgi allAhako ani phariztAharUko abhivAdana hunecha ra unIharU eka-ApasamA pani salAma garera abhivAdana garnechan | sabai prazaMsAharU sampUrNa sRSTikA pAlanakartA allAhakA nimti hun bhanne bhanAiko sAtha unIharUkA duA tathA prArthanAko samApti hunecha |

11 mAnisaharUle Aphno bhalAiko lAgi gareko prArthanAlAI jasarI allAhale turuntai svIkAra garnuhuncha tyasarI nai unIharUle risamA AphU, AphnA santAnaharU ra dhanasampatti viruddha gareko zrApalAI svIkAra garnubhaeko bhae tinIharU naSTa hunethie | tara allAhale tinIharUlAI maukA dinuhuncha | tyasaigarI uha~sita bheTne AzA narAkhneharUlAI hairAna tathA zaGkAmA choDnuhuncha |

12 jaba AphUmAthi jyAdatI gareko vyakti roga vA saGkaTamA grasta huncha taba usale kolTo parera, basera tathA ubhiera pani bintI gardai hAmIlAI pukArcha; tara jaba hAmI usako prArthanA svIkAra garera usako saGkaTa nivAraNa garchauM taba yasarI hi~Dcha mAnauM usale AphUmAthi pareko saGkaTa TArnako lAgi kahilyai hAmIlAI pukArekai thiena | yasto garne mAnisaharUkA lAgi jiddI garera pathabhraSTatAmA aDiga rahane kAryalAI AkarSaka banAieko cha | tyastai sImA ullaGghana garneharUkA lAgi pani tinIharUle garne kuphra tathA avajJAlAI AkarSaka tulyAieko cha | tinIharUle tyasalAI choDne chainan |

13 he bahudevavAdIharU ho! hAmIle timIharUbhandA pahilekA kaiyauM samudAyaharUlAI tinIharUko avajJA ra rasUlaharUlAI jhUTo Thahara gareko kAraNa naSTa garyauM | tinIharUsamakSa rasUlaharU spaSTa nisAnIharU liera AekA thie tara tinIharU ImAna lyAune khAlakA thienan | tyasaile allAhale tinIharUlAI apamAnita garnubhayo ra sIdhA mArga dekhAunu bhaena | vigatakA aparAdhI samudAyaharUlAI dieko yAtanA jastai hAmI hareka yugamA tathA hareka sthAnamA tyastA khAlakA samudAyaharUlAI sajAya dine garchauM |

14 he mAnava! vigatamA naSTa pAriekA samudAyaharUko sthAnamA aba timIharUlAI lyAekA chauM, tAki timIharU satkarma garera puNya prApta garchau ki duSkarma garera sajAyako bhAgI bannechau bhanne kurA herauM |

15 jaba tinIharUsamakSa allAha eka mAtra hunuhuncha bhanne kurAlAI spaSTa pArne kurAnakA AyataharUko pATha garincha taba mRtyupazcAta punarjivIta garine kurAlAI inkAra garne, badalA pAune AzA narAkhne tathA sajAyasita na DarAuneharU bhanchan: he nabI (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! mUrti pUjAlAI apamAna garne yasa kurAnako saTTAmA arko kurAna pherabadala garI liera AU, jo hAmro cAhanA anukUla hos | he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) bhanidinuhos: nata yasa kurAnalAI badalna sakchu, na yasabAheka arko kurAna lyAuna sakSama chu | baru allAhale cAhanubhaemA parivartana garna saknuhuncha | ma ta tyasai Adezako anusaraNa garchu jo allAhale mamAthi vahI (prakAzanA) garnubhaeko cha | yadi maile timIharUko mAga svIkAra garera AphnA pAlanakartAko avajJA gareM bhane malAI mahApralayako dinako yAtanAbATa Dara lAgcha |

16 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! bhanidinuhos– yadi allAhale cAhanubhaeko bhae ma timIharUsamakSa kurAnako pATha garne thiena ra timIharUlAI kurAnabATa avagata garAune thiena | maile Aphno jIvanako 40 varSa timIharUmAjha bitAe | malAI paDhna ra lekhna Audaina bhanne kurA timIharUlAI rAmrarI thAhA cha | maile yasa garimAmaya padako lAgi kahile prayAsa pani garina~ | maile bayAna gareko yI sampUrNa kurAharU allAhako tarphabATa ho ra yasamA mero kunai kamAla chaina | ke timIharU yati pani bujhdainau?!

17 tyo vyaktibhandA baDhI atyAcArI kohI huna sakdaina jasale allAha viruddha jhUTo Aropa lagAu~cha | ma kasarI jhUTo kurA racanA garera kurAnamA pherabadala garna sakchu? nissandeha allAhako viruddha jhUTo kurA racanA garera sImA ullaGghana garneharU Aphno uddezyamA saphala huna sakdainan |

18 bahudevavAdIharU allAhalAI choDera mana gaDhante pUjyaharUko pUjA upAsanA garchan, jo na lAbha puryAuna sakchan na hAni nai | jabaki vAstavika pUjyale jahile pani cAhemA lAbha tathA hAni puryAuna sakchan | tinIharU yI mUrtiharUlAI AphU ra allAhako bIca madhyasthakartA hun bhanchan, jasale tinIharUko pakSamA siphArisa garnechan ra allAhale tinIharUlAI pApako sajAya dinuhune chaina | he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama! tinIharUlAI bhannuhos: ke timIharU allAhako kohI sAjhedAra cha bhanne kurA uhA~lAI batAu~chau jabaki uhA~le nata AkAzaharUmA na pRthvImA nai kunai sAjhedAralAI jAnnuhuncha | bahudevavAdIharUle bhaneko yasa asatya tathA jhUTo kurAbATa allAha ati pavitra tathA ucca hunuhuncha |

19 vAstavamA sampUrNa mAnava euTai samudAya thiyo, tara tinIharUle vibheda gare, ani tinIharUmadhye kehI momina (AsthAvAn) rahe ra kehI kAphira (anAsthAvAn) bhae | yadi allAhale tinIharUbIcako vibhedako nirNaya AkhiratamA garnuhunecha bhanne kurA pahilA nai nalekheko bhae uhA~le saMsAramai tyasako nirNaya garidinu hunthyo ra mArgadarzana pAuneharU pathabhraSTaharUbATa spaSTa hunethie |

20 bahudevavAdIharU bhanchan– muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) lAI saccA rasUla pramANita garna uhA~ko pAlanakartale kunai camatkAra kina avatarita garnuhunna? he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! tinIharUlAI bhanidinuhos– camatkAraharUko avataraNa adRzya vAstavikatAko jJAnamadhye ho, jo allAhalAI mAtra cha | timIharU camatkArako avataraNako pratIkSA gara jasako mAga timIharU gardaichau | ma pani timIharUsa~gai pratIkSA gardachu |
