21 jaba hAmIle bahudevavAdIharUlAI tinIharUle bhogeko sukhkhA ra bhokamarIpachi varSA tathA hariyAlI varadAnasvarUpa pradAna garchauM taba tinIharU hAmrA nizAnIharUkA khillI uDAuna ra jhUTalAuna thAlchan | he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) bhanidinuhos– allAhale yojanA banAuna ra sajAya dinamA alikati pani Dhilo garnuhunna | vAstavamA timIharU je calakhela garchau tyasalAI phariztAharUle kamI nagarikana lekhirahekA chan | unIharUbATa lekhnamA kunai kurA chuTdaina | unakA sRSTikartA (allAha) dvArA kasarI chuTna sakcha?! allAhale timIharUko calakhelako sajAya cA~Dai nai dinuhunecha |

22 he mAnava! allAha nai timIharUlAI thalamA paidala tathA savArImA ra jalamA DuGgAmA hi~DAunuhuncha | yahA~samma ki jaba timIharU samudramA DuGgAharU calAudai hunchau ra DuGgAharU anukUla vAyukA sAtha mAnisaharUlAI liera gairahekA hunchan ra tinIharU prasanna hunchan, tyattikaimA akasmAt pratikUla hurI calna thAlcha; hareka dizAbATa laharaharU uThna thAlchan ra tinIharUlAI lAgna thAlcha aba yasaimA barbAda bhaincha, taba tinIharU Aphno bhaktilAI allAhakai nimti zuddha pArdai uhA~lAI mAtrai pukArdachan tathA guhArchan | uhA~sa~ga kasailAI sAjhedAra banAu~dainan | tinIharU bhanchan– yadi tapAIMle yasa saGkaTabATa hAmIlAI bacAunubhayo bhane hAmIharU nizcaya nai AbhArI hunechauM |

23 jaba allAhale tinIharUko duA (prArthanA) svIkAra garera tinIharUlAI saGkaTabATa nikAlnu huncha taba tinIharU pRthvImA kuphra, avajJA tathA pApa garera vidhvaMza maccAuna thAlchan | he mAnava! timIharUko yasa vidrohako duSpariNAma timIharUviruddha nai gai raheko cha | yasale allAhalAI kunai hAni puryAune chaina | yasabATa kSaNika sAMsArika jIvanamA kehI dina mojamastI gara | pheri mahApralayako dina timIharUle hAmItarpha nai pharkera Aunuparcha ani timIharUle gareko avajJAbATa hAmI avagata garAunechauM ra tyasako badalA dinechauM |

24 timIharUle mojamastI gariraheko sAMsArika jIvanako udAharaNa varSA jasto cha jo dhartIko boTa biruvAmA misincha, jasakA phala tathA dAnA mAnisale khAncha ra jasako bAlIlAI janAvarale khAncha | jaba dhartI vibhinna kisimakA bAlI nAlIbATa manamohaka bancha ra tyasakA kisAnaharUle tyasalAI kATera lAbha uThAune ThAnchan, taba akasmAta tyasalAI sakhApa pArne hAmro Adeza Au~cha | pheri hAmIle tyasalAI yasarI sakhApa pAridinchauM mAnauM hijosamma tyasamA kunai biruvA tathA rukha thiena | jasarI hAmIle saMsArako avasthA ra cA~Dai samApta hune kurAko varNana garyauM tyasarI hAmIle cintana manan garne mAnisaharUkA lAgi AphnA nisAnIharU vistRta rUpamA bayAna garchauM |

25 allAhale sabai mAnisaharUlAI zAntiko ghara svargatarpha bolAunu huncha | jasamA unIharU sabai cintA, du:kha tathA mRtyubATa surakSita rahanechan | allAhale AphnA bhaktaharUmadhye jasalAI cAhanuhuncha islAma svIkAra garne maukA pradAna garnuhuncha, jo tyasa zAntiko gharatira laijAncha |

26 allAhale anivArya garnubhaekA AdezaharUko pAlanA garera ra harAma garnubhaekA kAryaharUlAI tyAgera satkarma garneharUkA lAgi ati rAmro badalA cha, tyo ho svarga | ajha thapa prApta hunecha, tyo ho allAhako divya anuhArako darzana | svargabAsIharUkA anuhAramA dhulo, mATo ra apamAna kehI pani hunechaina | bhalAikA guNaharU bhaekA yinai mAnisaharU svargabAsI hun, tyahA~ unIharU sadAsarvadA basnechan |

27 jo mAnisaharUle kuphra tathA avajJA garera narAmro kArya gare, tinIharUko lAgi tyasako badalAmA tyasakai samAna AkhiratamA sajAya hunecha | tinIharUkA anuhAramA apamAna ra nirAzA chAeko hunecha | tinIharUlAI allAhako yAtanAbATa bacAune kohI hunechaina | tinIharUkA anuhAraharU narkako Ago tathA dhuvA~le gardA andhakAra rAti jasto ekadama kAlo hunechan | yastA mAnisaharU nai hun narkabAsI, jahA~ sadAsarvadA rahanechan |

28 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! mahApralayako dinalAI yAda garnuhos, jaba hAmIle sabai sRSTilAI ekatrita garnechauM | ani bahudevavAdIharUsita sodhnechauM– he bahudevavAdIharU ho! timIharU tathA timrA sAjhedAraharU A-AphnA sthAnamai ubhirAkha | ani hAmIle tinIharUle banAekA bhagavAnaharU tathA bhaktaharUlAI alaga alaga chuTyAunechauM | ani tI bhagavAnaharUle bhaktaharUsa~ga kunai sarokAra naraheko kurA gardai bhannechan– timIharUle duniyA~mA hAmro bhakti garenau |

29 bhagavAnaharUle bhaktaharUsa~ga kunai sarokAra naraheko kurA gardai bhannechan- sAkSIko lAgi allAha paryApta hunuhuncha- hAmI timIharUko bhaktibATa khusI thienauM | hAmIle yasako Adeza pani diekA thienauM ra yasalAI mahasusa pani garenauM |

30 tyasa mahAn ghaDImA hareka vyaktile duniyA~mA garekA karmaharUko bAremA jAnakArI pAunecha | bahudevavAdIharUlAI vAstavika pAlanakartA allAhatarpha hisAba kitAbako lAgi pharkAinecha ra tinIharUle mAnekA jhUTA bhagavAnaharU harAune chan |

31 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! yI bahudevavAdIharUlAI bhannuhos– timIharUlAI AkAzabATa varSA barsAera tathA dhartIbATa boTa biruvA ityAdi umArera kasale jIvikA pradAna garcha? kasale nirjIvabATa sajIva nikAlcha? jastai- vIryabATa mAnava ra aNDAbATa carA | kasale sajIvabATa nirjIva nikAlcha? jastai- janAvarabATa vIrya ra carAbATa aNDA | kasale AkAzaharU, dhartI ra yI duvaimA rahekA sRSTiharUkA kArya saJcAlana garcha? tinIharUle turuntai javApha dinechan– yI sabai allAhale garnuhuncha | ani tinIharUlAI sodhnus– tyaso bhae timIharU kina jJAna prApta gardainau ra kina allAhakA AdezaharUko pAlanA garera tathA varjita kAryaharUlAI tyAgera uhA~sa~ga DarAu~dainau?!

32 he mAnisaharU! yI sabai kAryaharU garne allAha nai hunuhuncha, jo timIharUkA vAstavika sRSTikartA tathA mAmilAharUkA saJcAlanakartA hunuhuncha | satyalAI jAnepachi kina tyasabATa TADhA hu~daichau? yati spaSTa satyalAI pani timIharU kina bujhirahekA chainau?

33 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) allAha nai sabaikA sRSTikartA tathA pAlanakartA hunuhuncha bhanne kurA jasarI satya pramANita bhaisakeko cha, tyasarI nai allAhale bhAgyamA lekhnubhaeko phaisalA pani pramANita bhaisakeko cha | jo mAnisaharU satya dharma islAmabATa zatrutAle gardA niske tinIharU ImAna lyAune chainan |

34 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) yI bahudevavAdIharUlAI sodhnuhos- ke timIharUle allAhabAheka bhakti gardai AekA pUjyaharUmadhye kohI yasto cha jasale vigatakA kunai udAharaNa tathA namunA binA sRSTiko Arambha gareko hos? pheri tyasako mRtyupachi punaH sRSTi garna sakos? bhanidinuhos– allAhale nai vigatakA kunai udAharaNa tathA namunA binA sRSTiko Arambha garnubhayo ra tyasako mRtyupachi punaH sRSTi garnuhunecha | he bahudevavAdIharU ho! timIharU satyalAI choDera asatyatarpha kina jA~daichau?!

35 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! yinIharUlAI sodhnuhos– ke timIharUle banAekA sAjhedAraharUmadhye kohI yasto pani cha jasale satyatAtarpha mArgadarzana garna sakcha? bhanidinuhos– allAhale mAtra satyatAtarpha mArgadarzana garnuhuncha | ke satya batAune allAha baDhI anusaraNa yogya hunuhuncha vA timIharUle racanA garekA pUjyaharU jasalAI mArga nadekhAesamma svayamale mArga prApta garna sakdainan?! Akhira timIharU kuna AdhAramA allAhasa~ga arUlAI sAjhedAra banAera galata nirNaya garchau?! timIharUle sAjhedAra banAeko kurAbATa allAha ati ucca hunuhuncha |

36 adhikAMsa bahudevavAdIharU binA jJAna, mAtra anumAna tathA aDakalabAjIko bharamA anusaraNa garchan | yadyapi aDakalabAjIle jJAnako sthAna lina sakdaina ra yasale alikati pani lAbha puryAu~daina | nissandeha tinIharUle garirahekA kAryaharUsa~ga allAha pUrNa rUpamA avagata hunuhuncha ra uhA~le cA~Dai nai tinIharUlAI tyasako badalA dinuhunecha |

37 yo kurAna allAhabAheka arU kasaile prastuta garna sakdainan | kinabhane kurAna jasto kitAba racanA garnabATa sabai asamartha nai rahe | baru yasale aghikA kitAbaharUko puSTi gardacha ra tI kitAbaharUmA rahekA saMkSipta AdezaharUlAI vistAramA vyAkhyA garcha | yo kitAba sampUrNa sRSTikA pAlanakartAko tarphabATa avatarita kurAmA kunai sandeha chaina |

38 ke bahudevavAdIharU bhanchan- yasa kurAnalAI muhammada (sallallahu alaihi va sallama) le racanA garera allAhatarpha joDnubhaeko cha? he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! yinIharUle bhaneko kurAko khaNDana gardai bhannnuhos– yadi maile Aphno tarphabATa racanA garera lyAeko hu~ bhane; ani ma pani timIharU jastai mAnava nai hu~; ta timIharU yo jastai kunai euTA sUraha racera prastuta gara | timIharU Aphno dAbIlAI pramANita garnako lAgi allAhabAheka ja-jasalAI bolAuna cAhanchau bolAU | timIharU arabI bhASAkA vijJa tathA kavi bhae pani kurAnamA bhaeko jasto euTA sUraha pani lyAuna sakdainau | yo cunautI nai kurAnako satyatAko ThUlo pramANa ho |

39 tinIharUle kurAnale dieko cunautIko javApha dina sakenan | baru kurAnalAI nabujhera, tyasamA cintana manan nagarera ra juna yAtanAbATa DarAieko thiyo tyasalAI manan nagarera hatAramA yasalAI jhUTo Thahara gare | jabaki juna yAtanAbATa DarAieko cha tyo najika Ai pugeko cha | jasarI yI bahudevavAdIharUle jhUTo Thahara gardaichan tyasarI nai vigatakA samudAyaharUle pani jhUTo Thahara garekA thie, ani tinIharUmAthi prakopa Aeko thiyo | he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) vicAra garnuhos, allAhale kasarI jhUTA samudAyaharUlAI naSTa pArnubhayo |

40 bahudevavAdIharUmadhye kehI vyaktiharU mRtyuaghi cA~Dai nai kurAnamAthi ImAna lyAune chan | tara kehI zatrutA tathA ghamaNDale gardA marne belAsamma pani ImAna lyAune chainan | he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! tapAIMkA pAlanakartAle jiddI garera kuphramA aDiga rahaneharUlAI rAmrarI jAnnuhuncha ra cA~Dai nai tinIharUko kuphrako sajAya dinuhunecha |

41 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! yadi tapAIMlAI tinIharUlele jhUTho Thahara garchan bhane, bhanidinuhos– maile gareko karmako badalA malAI milnecha ra ma tyasako javAphadehI hunechu | timIharUle gareko kAryako badalA timIharUlAI milnecha | maile garekA kAryako javAphadehI timIharUle dinuparne chaina ra timIharUle gareko kAryako sajAya malAI milne chaina |

42 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! jaba tapAIM kurAnako pATha garnuhuncha taba kehI bahudevavAdIharU tyasalAI svIkAra nagarne manasAyale tapAIMtira kAna lagAera sunchan | ke tapAIM yasto vyaktilAI sunAuna saknuhuncha jasako sunne kSamatA khosieko cha?! tyastai tapAIM yastA vyaktiharUlAI mArgadarzana garna saknuhunna jo na sunna sakchan na bujhna sakchan?!

43 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) bahudevavAdIharUmadhye kehI tapAIMtarpha bAhirI dRSTile herchan tara Atmika dRSTile herdainan | ke tapAIM yastA mAnisaharUlAI mArga dekhAuna saknuhuncha jasakA dRSTiharU khosiekA chan?! tapAIM yasto garna saknuhunna ra andhAlAI sIdhA mArga dekhAuna saknuhunna |

44 nissandeha allAha mAnisaharUmAthi atyAcAra garnabATa pavitra hunuhuncha | uhA~ kasaimAthi kaNa barAbara pani atyAcAra garnuhunna | tara mAnisaharU zatrutA ra ghamaNDale gardA AphaiMlAI vinAzamA hAlera AphaimAthi atyAcAra garchan |

45 mahApralayako dina allAhale mAnisaharUlAI hisAbako lAgi ekatrita garnuhunecha | tyasabelA tinIharUle mahasusa garnechan- saMsAra ra kabrako jIvanamA eka dinako kehI palabhandA baDhI basekai thienan | tinIharU eka arkAlAI cinnechan, tara mahApralayako bhayAvaha ghaTanAle gardA eka arkAlAI birsane chan | mahApralayako dina allAhasita bheTa garne AzA narAkhneharUle ghATA behore | ho, mRtyu pazcAt punaH jIvita garine kurAmA ImAna narAkhekAle tinIharU ghATAbATa bacna sakenan |

46 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! hAmI tinIharUlAI juna prakopako cetAvanI diirahekA chauM tyasakA kehI aMza ki ta tapAIMlAI tapAIMko mRtyuaghi dekhAunechauM ki ta tyasa aghi nai tapAIMlAI mRtyu dinechauM | duvai avasthAmA tinIharU mahApralayako dina hAmIkahA~ nai pharkera Aunucha | pheri allAhale tinIharUlAI tinIharUle garekA kAryaharUbAre avagata garAunuhunecha | uhA~bATa kehI pani lukeko chaina | uhA~le tinIharUlAI tinIharUle garekA kAryaharUko badalA cA~Dai nai dinuhunecha |

47 vigatamA hareka samudAyatarpha rasUlaharU paThAyauM | sabai rasUlaharUle AphnA samudAyamA Adezabamojima allAhakA sandeza puryAe, tara mAnisaharUle unIharUlAI jhUTo Thahara gare ani allAhale unIharUbIca nisAphakA sAtha nirNaya garnubhayo | rasUlaharUlAI Aphno kRpAle jogAunubhayo ra jhUTlAuneharUlAI nisAphako AdhAramA naSTa pArnubhayo | tinIharUmAthi kunai atyAcAra gariena |
48 yI kAphiraharU zatrutAmA cunauti diMdai bhanchan– yadi timIharU Aphno prakopa paThAune vAcAmA saccA chau bhane batAU tyo kahile purA hunecha?!

49 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) tinIharUlAI bhanidinuhos– ma svayam Aphno hAni tathA lAbhako adhikAra rAkhdina bhane arUlAI kasarI hAni vA lAbha puryAuna sakchu? allAhale nai cAhanubhayo bhane beglai kurA ho | malAI kasarI adRzyako jJAna huna sakcha? hareka samudAyako vinAzako lAgi euTA nirdhArita samaya cha, tyasako jJAna allAhalAI mAtra cha | jaba tyo samaya Aipugcha taba tyasamA alikati pani agADi pachADi hunechaina |

50 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! prakopako lAgi hatAra garneharUlAI bhanidinuhos– malAI batAU, yadi allAhako prakopa timIharUmAthi rAta vA dinako kunai samayamA Au~cha bhane tyasamA kuna yasto cija cha jasako lAgi timIharU hatAra gardaichau?!

51 ke jaba timIharUsita vAcA garieko prakopa Aipugnecha taba ImAna lyAunechau? jabaki prakopa Aepachi lyAeko ImAnale kunai phAidA dine chaina | ke timIharU aba ImAna lyAu~dai chau? jabaki timIharU ta yasalAI jhUTalAune uddezyale yasako lAgi hatAra gardai thiyau |

52 prakopamA grasta gariepachi ra yasabATa nikAline mAga garepachi tinIharUlAI bhaninecha– timIharU Akhiratako sadhaiM rahane yAtanA bhoga | timIharUlAI timIharUle gareko kuphra tathA avajJAko badalA nai mileko cha!

53 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! bahudevavAdIharU tapAIMsita sodhchan– ke hAmIsita garieko yAtanAko vAcA satya ho? bhanidinuhos– ho, allAhako kasama tyo satya ho, timIharU yasabATa bacna sakdainau |

54 yadi pratyeka bahudevavAdIlAI pRthvIkA sampUrNa dhanasampatti pani prApta hunchan bhane usale allAhako yAtanAbATa bacnako lAgi tI sabai artha-daNDako rUpamA dina tayAra hunecha | jaba bahudevavAdIharUle mahApralayako dina yAtanAlAI dekhnechan, taba AphnA kuphraprati lAgeko lAjalAI lukAune chan | allAhale tinIharUbIca nyAyakAsAtha nirNaya garnuhunecha | tinIharUsa~ga anyAya garine chaina | tinIharUlAI ta tinIharUle garekA kAryaharUko badalA diinecha |

55 jAni rAkha! AkAzaharU tathA pRthvImA allAhakai sattA zAsana calcha | jAni rAkha, allAhako tarphabATa kAphiraharUlAI dine yAtanAko vacana satya ho | yasamA kunai sandeha chaina | tara adhikAMsa mAnisaharUlAI thAhA nai chaina, tyasaile yasako bAremA zaGkAmA chan |

56 allAhale nai mRtaharUlAI jIvita pArnuhuncha ra jIvitaharUlAI mRtyu dinuhuncha | mahApralayako dina uhA~tarpha nai timIharUlAI pharkAera laginecha, ani uhA~le timIharUko karmako badalA dinuhunecha |
57 he mAnava ho! timIharUsamakSa timrA pAlanakartAko tarphabATa kurAna Aisakeko cha | yasamA upadeza, hRdaya-rogako upacAra ra mArgadarzana cha | yasamA mominaharUkA lAgi dayA cha |

58 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! mAnisaharUlAI bhanidinuhos– ma timIharUsamakSa juna kurAna liera Aeko chu tyo timIharUkA lAgi allAhako varadAna tathA dayA ho | tasartha timIharU allAhako yasa varadAna tathA dayAbATa prasanna hoU | muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) le lyAunubhaeko kurAna tinIharUle jammA garirAkhekA nAzavAn dhanasampatti bhandA uttama cha |

59 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! yI bahudevavAdIharUlAI bhannuhos– malAI batAU allAhale timIharUlAI pradAna garnubhaeko khAdya padArthamadhye Aphaile kehIlAI harAma ra kehIlAI halAla kina garekA chau? sodhnuhos– ke allAhale halAla tathA harAma garne anumati dinubhaeko thiyo vA timIharU uhA~mAthi jhUTo Aropa lagAu~chau?!

60 allAhamAthi jhUTo Aropa lagAuneharU juna yAtanAbAre socdaichan tyo mahApralayako dina tinIharUmAthi avazya Aunecha?! ke allAhale tinIharUlAI mApha garnuhunecha? hoina, baru allAha tinIharUlAI kehI maukA diera tathA hatAra nagarera kRpA garnuhuncha | tara adhikAMsa mAnisaharU allAhakA kRpAlAI nakArchan | tyasaprati AbhAra prakaTa gardainan |

61 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! tapAIMle junasukai kArya garnuhuncha ra kurAnabATa je pani pATha garnuhuncha; ani he mominaharU! timIharUle juna pani kArya garchau; tI sabaibATa hAmIle dekhirahekA chau ra timIharUkA hareka kurA sunchauM | kaNa barAbara pani kunai cIja timIharUkA pAlanakartAbATa lukeko chaina, cAhe tyo AkAzamA bhaeko hos vA jamInamA; na kaNabhandA sAno ra na tyobhandA ThUlo | baru sabai euTA surakSita kitAbamA spaSTarUpamA lekhiekA chan |
62 jAni rAkha! nissandeha, allAhakA mitraharUlAI nata bhaviSyamA Aune mahApralayako khataranAka avasthAko Dara hunecha, na duniyA~mA gumAekA AphnA bhAgaharUprati pachutAune chan |

63 allAhakA yastA mitraharUle nai uhA~ ra uhA~kA rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) mAthi ImAna rAkhchan ani allAhakA AdezaharUko pAlanA garera tathA varjita kAryaharUbATa bacera uhA~bATa DarAu~chan |

64 unIharUkA lAgi sAMsArika jIvanamA pani zubhasUcanA cha; jastai- rAmro sapanA, mAnisaharUko prazaMsA, prANa nikAldAkheri, mRtyUpachi tathA hazrako maidAnamA pani zUbhasUcanA sunAune chan | allAhale unIharUsa~ga gareko vAcAmA kunai pherabadala hunechaina | yo badalA mahAn saphalatA ho, kinabhane unIharUle cAheko kurA pAune chan ra DarAieko kurAbATa surakSita rAkhine chan |

65 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! tinIharUle islAma dharmamA juna doSa lagAu~chan tyasaprati cintA nalinuhos | nissandeha sampUrNa cIjaharUmA allAhakai prabhutva tathA adhipatya cha | uhA~lAI kunai kurAle vivaza pArna sakdaina | uhA~ unIharUkA kurAharU sunnuhuncha, kriyAkalApaharUlAI jAnnuhuncha ra tyahI anusAra badalA dinuhunecha |

66 jAni rAkha! AkAzaharU evaM pRthvIkA sabai sRSTimAthi allAhakai sattA-zAsana cha | allAhalAI choDera arUlAI pukArneharU kuna cijako anusaraNa gardaichan?! tinIharU ta mAtra zaGkAko anusaraNa gardaichan ra sAjhedAraharUlAI allAhasa~ga joDera jhUTa boldaichan | allAha tinIharUle bhaneko kurAbATa ati pavitra hunuhuncha |

67 he mAnava! allAhale nai timIharUkA lAgi rAta banAunubhayo tAki tyasamA ArAma gara | uhA~le dinalAI ujyAlo banAunubhayo tAki tyasamA jIvikAko lAgi bhAga dauDa gara | nissandeha yastA vyaktiharUkA lAgi tyasamA nisAnIharU chan, jo dhyAnapUrvaka pATha linako lAgi sunchan |

68 bahudevavAdIharUko euTA samudAyale bhanyoH allAhale phariztAharUlAI Aphno chorI banAunubhaeko cha | allAha tinIharUle bhanekA kurA tathA yasto AropabATa pavitra hunuhuncha | uhA~ sabai sRSTibhandA susampanna hunuhuncha | AkAzaharU evam pRthvImA je jati chan sabaimAthi uhA~kai sattA-zAsana cha | he bahudevavAdIharU ho! timIharUsa~ga yasako kunai pramANa chaina | allAhako lAgi putra Thahara garera timIharU Apattijanaka kurA gardaichau, jasako nata kunai vAstavikatA cha na kunai pramANa?! timIharU allAha viruddha tyo kurA kina garchau jasabAre timIharUlAI kunai jJAna nai chaina?

69 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! tinIharUlAI bhanidinuhos– juna vyaktiharU allAhako lAgi putra Thahara garera uhA~mAthi jhUTo Aropa lagAu~chan tinIharUle nata cAheko saphalatA pAuna sakchan na DarAiekA yAtanAbATa bacna sakchan | tinIharU kadApi saphala hune chainan |

70 saMsArako mojamastIbATa tinIharUle dhokA khAnuhunna | yo kSaNika tathA samApta hune ho, pheri mahApralayako dina tinIharU hAmItarpha nai pharkanu parnecha | ani allAha tathA rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) lAI asvIkAra garekole gardA hAmI kaThora daNDa dinechauM |

71 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! yI bahudevavAdIharUlAI nUha (alaihissalAma) ko satya kathA sunAunuhos | jaba unale AphnA samUdAyalAI bhane– he merA samudAya! timIharUlAI mero basAI, allAhakA AyataharUdvArA upadeza dinu kaSTapUrNa lAgiraheko cha ra timIharU mero hatyA garna cAhanchau bhane ma allAhamAthi mAtra bharosA garchu | timIharU AphnA nirNaya gara, malAI mArne prayAsa gara ra AphnA maddatako lAgi sAjhedAraharUlAI pani bolAU | timIharUko yojanA gopya tathA anyolamA narahos | pheri malAI mArne prayAsa gara ra tyasamA ali pani DhIlo nagara |

72 yadi timIharU mero ahvAnabATa vimukha hunchau bhane timIharUlAI thAhA cha– maile AphUle gareko ahvAnako badalA mAgdina | mero puNya ta mAtra allAhakahA~ raheko cha | cAhe timIharU mamAthi ImAna lyAU vA nalyAU | allAhale malAI AjJAkArI banne tathA satkarma garne Adeza dinubhaeko cha |

73 tara unako samudAyale unalAI jhUTo Thahara garyo ra unImAthi ImAna lyAena | hAmIle nUha (alaihissalAma) ra DuGgAmA rahekA mominaharUlAI jogAyauM ra unIharUlAI vigatakA samudAyako uttarAdhikArI banAyauM | hAmIle tyastA sabai mAnisaharUlAI bADhImA DubAidiyauM, jasale nUhale lyAekA nizAnI tathA pramANaharUlAI asatya Thahara gare | he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! hernuhos, kasto pariNAma bhayo tI vyaktiharUko jasalAI nUha (alaihissalAma) le saceta garekA thie tara tinIharUle ImAna lyAekA thienan |

74 nUha (alaihissalAma) biteko eka antarAlapachi hAmIle anya rasUlaharUlAI tinIharUkA samudAyaharUtarpha paThAyauM | unIharU spaSTa nisAnIharUkA sAtha tinIharUsamakSa puge, tara tinIharUle rasUlaharUlAI jhUTlAune purAnai jiddIko kAraNale ImAna lyAenan | ani allAhale tinIharUkA mana-mastiSkamAthi sila lagAunubhayo | hAmI hareka yugakA sImA ullaGghana garneharUkA mana-mastiSkamAthi yasarI nai silabandI lagAune garchauM |

75 unIharU pazcAt hAmIle mUsA ra hArUna (alaihimassalAma) lAI AphnA satyatA darsAune nisAnIharUkA sAtha misrakA rAjA phirauna evam unakA ahaMkAra samarthakaharU mukhiyAharUkahA~ paThAyauM, tara tinIharUle ghamaNDako kAraNa unIharUle lyAekA satya kurAharUlAI inkAra gare | vAstavamA tinIharU allAhamAthi ImAna nalyAeko ra rasUlalAI asatya ThaharAeko kAraNa aparAdhI samudAya thie |

76 jaba phirauna ra usakA samarthaka mukhiyAharUsamakSa mUsA ra hArUna (alaihimassalAma) le allAhako dharma tathA satyatA darsAune spaSTa nisAnIharU pesa gare taba tinIharUle bhane– nizcaya nai yo euTA spaSTa jAdU ho |

77 mUsA (alaihissalAma) le khaNDana gardai bhane– ke timIharU AphUsamakSa Aeko satyalAI jAdU bhanchau?! hoina, kadApi yo jAdU hoina | nizcita rUpale malAI thAhA cha jAdUgara kahilyai saphala huna sakdaina, ta yo thAhA hu~dAhu~dai ma kasarI jAdU prastuta garna sakchu?!

78 phiraunako samudAyale javAphamA bhanyo– ke timIharU hAmIharUlAI hAmrA pUrvajaharUko dharmabATa haTAuna cAhanchau | tAki timIharU duvaiko sattA kAyama hos? he mUsA ra hArUna! hAmI timIharU duvailAI kahilyai allAhakA rasUla mAnne chainauM |
79 phiraunale Aphno samUdAyalAI bhanyo–jAnakAra tathA nipuNa jAdUgaraharUlAI mero agADi upasthita garAU |
80 jaba jAdUgaraharU Ae taba mUsA (alaihissalAma) le AphU nai vijaya hune kurAmA vizvasta hu~dai tinIharUlAI bhane– he jAdUgaraharU ho! timIharUle je dekhAuna cAhanchau dekhAU |

81 jaba tinIharUle jAdU-sAmagrI phyA~ke taba mUsA (alaihissalAma) le bhane– timIharUle phyA~kekA sAmagrI jAdU ho | nizcaya nai allAhale tyasalAI vyartha tulyAunuhunecha ra tyasako prabhAvalAI samApta pArnuhunecha | timIharU Aphno jAdUbATa vidhvaMsa utpanna garna cAhanchau | allAhale vidhvaMsakArIko kAryalAI saphala pArnuhunna |
82 allAhale AphnA baliyA zabdaharU, zaraI tarkaharU ra satya pramANaharUkA sAtha satyatAlAI sthApita garnuhuncha | cAhe phirauna ra unakA samarthaka kAphiraharUlAI mana paros vA naparos |

83 mUsA (alaihissalAma) le ati spaSTa nisAnI tathA pramANaharU prastuta gare pani phiraunako samudAya vimukha bhayo ra unalAI jhUTo Thahara garyo | mUsA (alaihissalAma) mAthi banI isrAIlakA kehI yuvAharUbAheka anya kasaile phiraunako ra unakA samarthakaharUko Darale ImAna lyAenan | kinabhane unIharUle thAhA pAune bittikai yAtanA diera ImAnabATa phernechan | nissandeha phirauna ghamaNDI thiyo ra misramAthi prabhutva kAyama gareko thiyo | usale kuphra garnamA, banI isrAIlalAI hatyA garnamA ra yAtanA dinamA sImA nai ullaGghana gareko thiyo |

84 mUsA (alaihissalAma) le Aphno samudAyalAI bhane– yadi timIharU allAhamAthi pakkA ImAna rAkhchau bhane ra timIharU muslima hau bhane uhA~mAthi nai bharosA rAkha | allAhamAthi bharosAle timIharUlAI duSTatAbATa bacAunecha ra bhalAi pradAna garnecha |

85 unIharUle javApha die– hAmIharUle allAhamAthi mAtra bharosA garyauM | he hAmrA pAlanakartA! hAmIharUmAthi atyAcArIharUlAI nathopnuhos | tinIharUle hAmIharUlAI yAtanA diera ra hatyA garera hAmro dharmabATa phernechan |

86 he hAmrA pAlanakartA! hAmIharUlAI Aphno kRpAdvArA kAphira phiraunakA samudAyabATa mukti pradAna garnuhos, kinabhane tinIharUle hAmIharUlAI dAsa banAekA chan, yAtanA diera tathA hatyA garera satAirahekA chan |

87 hAmIle mUsA tathA unakA bhAi hArUna (alaihimassalAma) mAthi vahI (prakAzanA) avataraNa garyauM- timIharU misramA AphnA samudAyakA nimti eka mAtra allAhako bhaktiko lAgi gharaharU banAU ra tI gharaharUko dizA baitul-makdisatarpha gara | pUrNarUpamA namAja kAyama gara | he mUsA! mominaharUlAI zubhasUcanA deU jasabATa tinIharU khusI hunechan- timIharUlAI allAhako maddata prApta hunecha | uhA~le zatruharUlAI naSTa garnuhunecha ra timIharUlAI dhartIko uttarAdhikArI banAunuhunecha |

88 mUsA (alaihissalAma) le prArthanA gare– he hAmrA pAlanakartA! tapAIMle phirauna ra usakA samarthakaharUlAI sAMsArika jIvanamA saundarya tathA dhanasampatti pradAna garnubhaeko cha | tara tinIharUle mAnisaharUlAI tapAIMko mArgabATa vicalita gardaichan | he hAmrA pAlanakartA! tinIharUkA dhanasampatti naSTa garidinuhos, tinIharUkA hRdayalAI kaThora pAridinuhos tAki duHkhadAyI yAtanA dekhuJjelasamma ImAna nalyAun, jabaki tyatikherako ImAnale tinIharUlAI phAidA puryAune chaina |

89 allAhale bhannubhayo– he mUsA ra hArUna! phirauna ra usakA samarthakaharU viruddha timI duvaile gareko duA (prArthanA) lAI maile svIkAra gareM | timI duvaijanA Aphno dharmamA aDiga rahanu ra ajJAnIharUko mArgako anusaraNa nagarnu |

90 hAmIle samudralAI cirera banI isrAIlako lAgi samudra pAra garna sahaja bATo banAera surakSita pAra garAyauM | phiraauna ra usakA sainikaharU atyAcAra tathA anyAya garne manasAyale tinIharUko pachi lAge | jaba tinIharU samudramA puge hAmIle pAnIlAI milAidiyauM | jaba phiraauna Dubna thAlyo ra bacne AzA rahena taba bhanyo– banI isrAIlale ImAna lyAeko satya upAsya allAhamAthi maile pani ImAna lyAe~ | uhA~ bAheka kohI upAsya chainan ra ma allAhako AjJAkArI hu~ |

mRtyu hu~dAkheriko taubA svIkArya hu~daina bhanne kurAlAI spaSTa pArdai allAhale bhannubhayoH
91 ke timIharU jIvanabATa nirAza bhaepachi yatikhera ImAna lyAu~daichau?! jabaki he phirauna! yasa prakopaaghi timIle allAhako inkAra garyau | timI svayam pathabhraSTa bhaera arUlAI pani pathabhraSTa pArera vidhvaMsakArIharUmadhye banyau?

92 he phirauna! Aja hAmIle timro zavalAI samudrabATa nikAlera surakSi rAkhnechauM, tAki timI timIbhandA pachi AuneharUkA lAgi pATha bana | nizcaya nai dherai mAnisaharU hAmrA nisAnI tathA pramANaharUbATa vimukha chan, tyasamA vicAra gardainan |

93 hAmIle banI isrAIlalAI siriyA ra tyasakA varaparakA zaharaharUmA dherai rAmro vAsasthAna tathA pavitra khAdya padArtha pradAna garyauM, tara jaba tinIharUsamakSa kurAna Ayo jasale taurAtamA varNana bhaeko muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) ko guNako puSTi garyo taba tinIharUle dharmako mAmilAmA matabheda gare | jaba tinIharUle tyasako inkAra gare taba tinIharUbATa tinIharUko deza khosiyo | he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! nissandeha tapAIMkA pAlanakartAle mahApralayako dina tinIharUle matabheda garirahekA kurAbAre nirNaya garnuhunecha ra satyavAdI tathA asatyavAdI duvailAI tinIharUkA karma anusAra badalA dinuhunecha |

94 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! yadi hAmIle avataraNa gareko kurAnabAre tapAIMlAI zaGkA cha bhane taurAta paDhne yahUdIharU ra injIla paDhne IsAIharUmadhye islAma grahaNa garekA mAnisaharUlAI sodhnuhos | vAstavamA tapAIMmAthi avatarita kurAna satya ho bhanne kurA tinIharUle batAunechan | tapAIM samakSa tapAIMkA pAlanakartAko tarphabATa satya Aipugeko cha jasamA kunai sandeha chaina | tapAIM kadApi sandeha garneharUmadhye nabannuhos |

95 tapAIM tI vyaktiharUmadhye nabannuhos jasale allAhakA nisAnI ra pramANaharUlAI asatya Thahara gare | natra tapAIM ghATAmA parneharUmadhye bannuhunecha | jasale pani kuphra gare tinale AphUlAI barbAdImA pArera ghATAmA parneharUmadhye bane | nabI (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) bATa yasto narAmro hune sambhAvanA thiena | yasto zaGkA garnu pani ghRNita kArya ho | kuphrako khatarAlAI darzAuna mAtra yahA~ ullekha garieko cha |
96 allAhale juna mAnisaharUko bhAgyamA kuphramA aDiga raheko kAraNale tyasai avasthAmA marnechan bhanne kurA lekhi saknubhaeko cha, nissandeha yastA mAnisaharUle kahilyai ImAna lyAune chainan |

97 tinIharUsamakSa sabai prakArakA nisAnI tathA pramANaharU Ae pani tinIharUle ImAna lyAune chainan | duHkhadAyI yAtanA Aepachi mAtra ImAna lyAunechan | tyasabelA lyAeko ImAnale tinIharUlAI kunai phAidA dinechaina |

98 allAhako prakopa dekhepachi ImAna lyAunule kunai pani samudAyalAI phAidA puryAeko chaina, tara yUnusa (alaihissalAma) ko samudAyale allAhako prakopa dekhepachi jaba saccA ImAna lyAe, taba allAhale sAMsArika jIvanamA tinIharUbATa apamAnajanaka yAtanA haTAidinu bhayo ra jIvita rahesamma sAMsArika lAbha uThAune maukA pradAna garnubhayo |

99 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! yadi allAhale cAhanubhaeko bhae pRthvImA basne sabai mAnisaharUle ImAna lyAune thie | tara uhA~le tyasto garnubhaena | uhA~le jasalAI cAhanuhuncha Aphno nisAphale pathabhraSTa garnuhuncha ra jasalAI cAhanuhuncha Aphno kRpAle mArgadarzana garnuhuncha | tapAIM mAnisaharUlAI ImAna lyAuna bAdhya pArna saknuhunna | kinabhane unIharUlAI ImAna tathA mArgadarzana pradAna garnu allAhako adhikAramA cha |

100 allAhako anumati binA kasaile pani ImAna lyAuna sakdaina | allAhako anumatile mAtra ImAna lyAune saubhAgya prApta huncha | tapAIM tinIharUko bAremA cintA nalinuhos | jo vyaktiharU allAhakA pramANaharUlAI bujhdainan, uhA~kA AdezaharUko pAlanA gardainan ra varjita kAryaharUbATa bacdainan; tinIharUlAI allAhale prakopa tathA apamAna dinuhuncha |

101 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! nisAnIharU mAgne bahudevavAdIharUlAI bhanidinuhos–timIharU AkAzaharU tathA pRthvImA phailiekA nisAnIharUmA cintana manan gara | yI nisAnIharUle allAha eka mAtra hunuhuncha bhanne kurAlAI pramANita garchan | ImAna nalyAune samudAyalAI nisAnI, cetAvanI tathA rasUlako Agamanale pani phAidA puryAu~dainan, kinabhane tinIharU aTerI garera kuphramai aDiga rahanchan |

102 ke yI jhUTalAuneharUle tyastai prakopako pratIkSA garirahekA chan, jasto prakopa allAhale vigatakA samudAyamAthi avataraNa garnubhayo?! he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! bhanidinuhos– timIharU allAhako prakopako pratIkSA gara, ma pani timIharUsa~gai Aphno pAlanakartAko vacanako pratIkSA gardaichu |

103 pheri hAmIle tinIharUmAthi prakopa paThAu~chauM ra AphnA rasUlaharU tathA mominaharUlAI jogAu~chauM | jasarI hAmIle vigatakA rasUlaharUlAI jogAyauM tyasarI nai rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) ra mominaharUlAI pUrNarUpamA jogAunechauM | yo hAmro vAcA ho |

104 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! bhanidinuhos– he mAnava! ma timIharUlAI ekezvaravAdamA AdhArita juna islAma dharmatarpha bolAu~dai chu, tyo satya dharma ho | yasamA zaGkA nagara | timIharUko dharma galata dharma ho bhanne kurAmA ma vizvasta chu | ma tyasako anusaraNa gardina | allAhabAheka jasako upAsanA timIharU garchau ma cAhi~ tyasako upAsanA gardina | ma tyasa allAhako upAsanA garchu, jasale timIharUlAI mRtyu dinuhuncha | malAI nisvArtha momina (AsthAvAn) banera rahane Adeza bhaeko cha |
105 malAI satya dharma islAmamA aDiga rahane Adeza cha | anya sabai dharmaharUlAI choDera mAtra islAma dharmamAthi aDiga rahane chu | malAI kadApi bahudevavAdIharUmadhye nabannu bhanne Adeza cha |

106 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! tapAIM allAhalAI choDI anya devI devatA ra mUrti-phoTolAI napukArnuhos, jasale nata kunai phAidA puryAuna sakchan na hAni nai | yadi tapAIMle tinIharUko upAsana garnuhuncha bhane nizcaya nai atyAcArIharUmadhye bannuhuncha |

107 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! yadi allAhale tapAIMlAI kunai kaSTa dinuhuncha ra tapAIMle tyasako nivAraNa cAhanuhuncha bhane tyasako nivAraNa allAhale mAtra garna saknuhuncha | yadi uhA~le tapAIMlAI kunai bhalAi pradAna garna cAhanuhuncha bhane tyasalAI kasaile rokna sakdaina | allAhale AphnA bhaktaharUmadhye jasalAI cAhanuhuncha kRpAko pAtra banAunuhuncha | uhA~lAI kasaile kunai kAmako lAgi bAdhya pArna sakdaina | uhA~ taubA garne bhaktaharUlAI mApha garnuhuncha ra unIharUmAthi dayA garnuhuncha |

108 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! bhanidinuhos– he mAnava ho! timIharUsamakSa timrA pAlanakartAko tarphabATa kurAna Aipugeko cha | jasale tyasamAthi ImAna lyAu~cha tyasako phAidA usailAI huncha | kinabhane allAhalAI kunai bhaktako khA~co chaina | jasale pathabhraSTatA apanAu~cha usale Aphai hAni behorcha | bhaktaharUko avajJAle allAhako kehI bigArdaina | ma timIharUko karmaharUko anugamana ra mulyAGkana garne paharedAra hoina |

109 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! allAhale vahI (prakAzanA) dvArA tapAIMlAI je Adeza dinuhuncha, tyasalAI kAryAnvayana garnuhos | allAhako Adeza anusAra uhA~ko sandezalAI puryAune kAma jArI rAkhnuhos | Aphno virodhI samudAyabATa pAeko kaSTaprati dhairya garnuhos | yahA~samma ki allAhako phaisalA Aos ra kAphiraharUmAthi tapAIMko vijaya hos | yadi tinIharUko mRtyu kuphrakai avasthAmA huncha bhane tinIharU AkhiratamA yAtanAko bhAgIdAra hunechan |

1 (alipha0 lAma0 rA0) | yastA akSaraharUko vyAkhyA sUraha al-bakarahako ArambhamA bhaisakeko cha | kurAna yasto kitAba ho jasakA AyataharU hareka dRSTile dRDha pAriekA chan | tapAIMle tyasamA kanai kamI-kamajorI pAuna saknuhunna | sAthai yasamA allAhale halAla, harAma, Adeza, niSedha, vAcA, dhamkI, satya kathAharU ityAdi kurAharU spaSTa pArnubhaeko cha | allAha kArya saJcAlana tathA kAnuna banAunamA tatvadarzI hunuhuncha ra bhaktaharUkA avasthAbAre avagata hunuhuncha |

2 muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) mAthi avatarita bhaekA yI AyataharUmA bhaktaharUlAI gairullAhako bhaktibATa manAhI garieko cha | he mAnava! yadi timIharU allAhako inkAra tathA avajJA garchau bhane ma timIharUlAI allAhako yAtanAbATa saceta gardachu | yadi timIharU allAhamAthi ImAna rAkhchau ra uhA~ko anusaraNa garchau bhane ma timIharUlAI puNyako zubhasUcanA dinchu |

3 he mAnava! timIharUle garekA pApaharUbAre AphnA pAlanakartAsita kSamAyAcanA gara ra AphUmAthi gareko atyAcAraprati taubA (pazcAttApa) gara | uhA~le timIharUlAI euTA vizeSa avadhisamma duniyA~mA rAmro jIvana pradAna garnuhunecha | timIharUle gareko AjJApAlana ra satkarmako purA-purA badalA dinuhunecha | maile lyAeko dharmaprati ImAna lyAu~dainau bhane mahApralayako dinako bhayAvaha yAtanAbATa DarAu~chu |

4 he mAnava! mahApralayako dina timIharU allAhatarpha nai pharkera jAnucha | uhA~ hareka kAryako sAmarthya rAkhnuhuncha | uhA~lAI kasaile pani vivaza pArna sakdaina | timIharUko mRtyupachi punarjIvita garAunu ra hisAba kitAba linu uhA~ko lAgi sajilo cha | yasale uhA~lAI hairAna pArna sakdaina |

5 jAni rAkha! yI bahudevavAdIharU AphnA chAtIharUlAI arkotira moDchan, tAki tyasabhitra allAhaprati rahekA zaGkA lukAuna sakun | yo zaGkA tinIharUko manamA ajJAnatAko kAraNale ho | jAni rAkha, jaba tinIharU AphUlAI vastrabhitra DhAkchan tyatikhera pani allAha tinIharUle lukAekA vA prakaTa garekA kurAharUlAI jAnnuhuncha | nissandeha uhA~ hRdaya bhitra rahekA bhedaharUlAI pani rAmrarI jAnnuhuncha |

6 dhartImA hiMDaDula garne pratyeka jIvalAI allAhale jIvikA pradAna garnuhuncha | uhA~le sabaikA bAsa-sthAna ra mRtyu-sthAnalAI rAmrarI jAnnuhuncha | ataH sampUrNa jIvaharUkA jindagI, bAsa-sthAna ra mRtyu-sthAna euTA surakSita ra spaSTa kitAbamA lekhieko cha |

7 allAhale nai vizAla AkAzaharU, pharAkilo pRthvI tathA tI duvaimA rahekA vastuharUlAI 6 dinamA sRSTi garnubhayo | yI duvaiko sRSTiaghi allAhako arza (siMhAsana) pAnImAthi thiyo | he mAnava ho! allAhako uddezya timIharUko parIkSA linu ho | timIharUmadhye kasale allAhalAI prasanna pArne ra kasale aprasanna pArne kArya garcha | uhA~le sabailAI karmaanusAra badalA dinuhunecha | he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallamA)! jaba tapAIM bhannuhuncha, he mAnava ho! hisAba kitAbako lAgi timIharUlAI mRtyupazcAt avazya jIvita pArinecha, taba kAphiraharU bhanchan– jo kurAna tapAIMle hAmIlAI paDhera sunAunuhuncha tyo jAdU bAheka kehI hoina, tasartha yo spaSTa jhUTa ho |

8 jaba hAmIle nizcita avadhiko lAgi duniyA~mA bahudevavAdIharUmAthi Aune prakopalAI sthagita garchauM taba tinIharUle hatAra gardai ra ThaTTA gardai bhanchan– hAmIbATa prakopalAI kasale rokeko cha? jAnirAkha– tinIharUmAthi Aune prakopako lAgi allAhakahA~ euTA nizcita samaya cha | jaba tyo samaya Aipugcha taba tinIharUlAI kasaile bacAuna sakdaina | tinIharUle ThaTTA gardai hatAra gareko prakopale tinIharUlAI avazya nai samAtnecha |

9 jaba hAmI mAnavalAI svAsthya, dhanasampatti ityAdi varadAna pradAna garchauM ani kahile tyasa varadAnabATa usalAI vancita garchauM ta U allAhako kRpAbATa nirAza huncha, uhA~ko varadAnaprati kRtaghna hunajAncha ra allAhakA sabai varadAnaharUlAI birsancha |

10 jaba hAmI mAnavalAI garibI tathA rogapachi sampannatA tathA susvAsthya pradAna garchauM taba U bhancha– merA sabai duHkha samApta bhae ra ati prasanna huncha | tara U allAhaprati AbhAra vyakta gardaina ra mAnisaharUbIca ghamaNDa garcha |

11 tara saGkaTamA dhairyadhAraNa garne, AjJApAlanamA aDiga rahane, avajJAbATa bacne ra satkarma garne mAnisaharU nirAzA hu~dainan tathA kRtaghna pani hu~dainan | unIharU mAnisaharUbIca ghamaNDa gardainan | yastA mAnisaharUkA lAgi AkhiratamA kSamAyAcanA ra ThUlo puNya cha |

12 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! tinIharUko kuphra, zatrutA ra camatkAraharU avataraNa garne mAgako kAraNale tapAIMle vahI (prakAzanA) dvArA paThAiekA kehI yastA kurA puryAune kAma sambhavataH choDnuhuncha, jasako pAlanA tinIharUkA lAgi kaThina huncha | kAphiraharUle yo nabhanun- tapAIMmAthi kunai khajAnA kina avatarita gariena vA tapAIMsa~ga kunai phariztA kina Aena bhanne kurA socera tapAIMko hRdaya cintita nahos | tara tapAIM tinIharUko yasa bhanAIle islAma dharmako pracAra prasArako kAma nachoDnuhos | tapAIM ta sacetakartA mAtra hunuhuncha | tiniharUle mAga gare anusAra camatkAra lyAune jimmevArI tapAIMmAthi chaina | allAha sabai cijaharUkA nirikSaka hunuhuncha |

13 bahudevavAdIharU bhanchan- yo kurAna muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) ko racanA ho | yo allAhako tarphabATa vahI (prakAzanA) hoina | he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) tinIharUlAI cunautI diMdai bhannuhos– yadi yo kurAna mero racanA ho bhanchau bhane timIharU pani kurAnamA bhaekA jastai dasa vaTA sUrahaharU racanA garera lyAU | yadi timIharU Aphno dAbImA saccA chau bhane allAhabAheka jasalAI sahAyatAko lAgi bolAuna sakchau bolAU |

14 he mominaharU ho! yadi tinIharUle ukta cunautIlAI svIkAra gardainan bhane vizvasta hoU, allAhale kurAnalAI jJAnakA sAtha AphnA rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) mAthi avataraNa garnubhaeko cha | kurAnalAI anya kasaile racanA gareko hoina | jAnirAkha, allAhabAheka kohI vAstavika upAsya chaina | ke aba timIharU spaSTa pramANa pAisakepachi allAhako AjJAkArI bhakta banchau?

15 jo mAnisaharU sAMsArika jIvana tathA tyasako kSaNika mojamastIko lAgi mAtra kArya garchan ra Akhiratako lAgi kArya gardaina, tinIharUlAI tinIharUkA karmaharUko purA-purA badalA yasai duniyA~mA rAmro svAsthya, zAnti tathA sampannatAko rUpamA dine garchauM |

16 yastA tuccha uddezya rAkhekA mAnisaharU mahApralayako dina narkamA phyA~kinechan | tinIharUkA sabai satkarmaharU vyartha hunechan | kinabhane tinIharUle duniyA~mA ImAna lyAenan, ThIka uddezya rAkhenan, allAhako prasannatA ra Akhiratako lAgi kAma garenan |

17 sandeSTA muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) tathA uhA~sa~ga ImAna lyAekA mAnisaharU ra kAphiraharU ekasamAna huna sakdainan | kinabhane uhA~ (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) sa~ga allAhako tarphabATa pramANa (vahI) cha, jasalAI jibrIla (alaihissalAma) le tilAvata garchan ra jasako sandeSTA hune gavAhI mUsA (alaihissalAma) mAthi avatarita taurAta diMdaicha | mominaharU kurAna ra muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) mAthi ImAna rAkhchan | jabaki kAphiraharU pathabhraSTatAmA bhau~tArirahekA chan | tinIharU mahApralayako dina narkamA jAnechan | he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! tapAIM kurAna ra tyasako vacanamA zaGkA nagarnuhos | nizcaya nai yo satya ho | yasamA kunai zaGkA chaina | tara yasamA ati spaSTa pramANa ra tarkaharU hu~dAhu~dai pani adhikAMsA mAnisaharU ImAna lyAu~dainan |

18 allAhako sAjhedAra ra putra banAera uhA~mAthi jhUTA Aropa lagAuneharU bhandA ThUlA atyAcArI kohI chainan | yastA vyaktiharUlAI mahApralayako dina allAha samakSa pesa garinecha | allAhale tinIharUsa~ga tinIharUko karmaharUko hisAba linuhunecha | phariztA ra rasUlaharUmadhye gavAhaharUle bhannechan– yinIharU nai hun allAhako lAgi sAjhedAra ra putra banAera jhUTA kurA racneharU | jAnirAkha, tinIharUko jhUTo ra atyAcArako kAraNale allAhale tinIharUlAI Aphno kRpAbATa TADhA pArnubhayo |

19 yinIharU mAnisaharUlAI allAhako sIdhA mArgabATa rokchan ra tyasalAI baGgyAuna khojchan, tAki mAnisaharU yasamA hi~Dana nasakun | yinIharUle mRtyupachi punarjIvita garine kurAlAI pani inkAra garchan |

20 yastA vyaktiharU dhartImA allAhako prakopabATa bhAgna sakdainan | yasa prakopabATa bacAune allAhabAheka kohI mitra pani hune chaina | mahApralayako dina tinIharUkA yAtanAlAI baDhAinecha | kinabhane tinIharU allAhako mArgamA svayam pani hi~Denan ra arUlAI pani tyasabATa roke | tinIharUle duniyA~mA islAma dharma tathA satya mArgadarzanalAI svIkAra garenan | satyabATa ati nai vimukha bhaeko kAraNale tinIharUle duniyA~mA phailiekA allAhakA nisAnIharUlAI pani herenan |
21 yastA mAnisaharUle allAhasa~ga arUlAI sAjhedAra banAera AphailAI ghATAmA pAre | tinIharUle banAekA sAjhedAra ra siphArisakartAharU tinIharUlAI choDera gae |
22 mahApralayako dina tinIharU ghATA khAneharUmadhye hunechan | kinabhane tinIharUle ImAnako saTTAmA kuphralAI, Akhiratako saTTAmA saMsAralAI ra kRpAko saTTAmA prakopalAI roje |
23 nissandeha juna vyaktiharUle allAha ra uhA~kA rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) mAthi ImAna lyAe, satkarma gare ra allAhasita DarAe unIharU nai svargamA jAneharU hun, jahA~ sadA rahanechan |

24 kAphiraharU ra mominaharU duvai samUhako udAharaNa yasto cha, kAphiraharU A~khA nadekhne andhA ra kAna nasunne bahirA jastai hun | kAphiraharUle satyalAI svIkAra garne irAdAle nata sunchan na herchan | jabaki mominaharU herna sakchan ra sunna sakchan | ke yI duvaiko avasthA barAbara huna sakcha?! yI duvai barAbara huna sakdainan | ke timIharU yI duvaiko barAbara nahune avasthAbATa zikSA prApta gardainau?!

bahudevavAdIharUle ImAna lyAune chainan bhanne kurA jaba spaSTa bhayo taba allAhale vigatakA sandeSTAharUkA satya kathAharU varNana garera nabI (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) lAI sAntvanA dinubhayo | yinIharUle mAtra tapAIMlAI jhUTo Thahara garekA chainan, baru tapAIMbhandA aghikA sandeSTAharUlAI pani unakA samudAyale jhUTA Thahara gare bhanne kurA spaSTa pArdai bhannubhaeko chaH
25 hAmIle nUha (alaihissalAma) lAI unako samudAyatarpha paThAyauM | unale bhane– he merA samudAya! ma timIharUlAI allAhako prakopabATa saceta garchu ra timIharUko lAgi jo sandeza diera malAI paThAieko cha tyasalAI spaSTa pArchu |
26 timIharUlAI eka mAtra allAhako bhaktiko AhvAna garchu | uhA~ bAheka anya kasaiko bhakti nagara | ma timIharUlAI hune kaSTakara yAtanAdekhi DarAu~chu |

27 unako samudAyakA kAphira aguvAharUle bhane– hAmI timro ahvAnalAI mAndainauM, kinabhane timImA hAmIharUmA bhaeko bhandA alaga kunai vizeSatA chaina | timI hAmI jastai mAnava hau | timro anusaraNa pani tallo starakA mAnisaharUle garne garekA chan | timI sammAna, dhanasampatti ra pada kunai pani dRSTile anusaraNa yogya chainau | baru timIlAI hAmI timro AhvAna tathA dAbImA jhUTo ThAnchauM |

28 nUha (alaihissalAma) le samudAyalAI bhane– malAI batAU, yadi ma Aphno pAlanakartAko tarphabATa spaSTa pramANamA kAyama chu, jasale ma sA~co nabI bhaeko gavAhI pani dincha ra mamAthi sA~co ImAna lyAunu timIharUko lAgi anivArya cha | uhA~le malAI Aphno IzdUtatva (nubUvata) jasto kRpA pani pradAna garnubhaeko cha, tara tyo timIharUko ajJAnatAko kAraNale timIharUle dekhna sakekA chainau bhane ke hAmIle timIharUlAI yasamAthi ImAna lyAuna bAdhya pArna sakchauM ra jabarajastI timIharUko hRdayamA yasalAI hAlna sakchauM?! hAmImA yasako zakti chaina | ImAna lyAune kSamatA ta allAhale mAtra pradAna garna saknuhuncha |

29 he merA samudAya! ma juna kurAko ahvAna gardaichu tyasako badalAmA kunai dhanasampatti timIharUsita mAgdina | mero badalA allAhako jimmAmA mAtra cha | timIharUle gareko mAgako AdhAramA ma Aphno sabhAbATa gariba mominaharUlAI niSkAsana gardina | unIharU mahApralayako dina AphnA pAlanakartAsita bheTnechan | uhA~le unIharUlAI ImAnako badalA dinuhunecha | tara timIharU hAmro ahvAnako vAstaviktAlAI bujhirahekA chainau |

30 he merA samudAya! yadi maile yI mominaharUlAI binA kAraNa niSkAsana gareM bhane malAI allAhako prakopabATa kasale bacAu~cha? ke timIharU upadeza grahaNa gardainau ra juna kurA timIharUko lAgi rAmro cha tyasako lAgi prayAsa gardainau?!

31 he merA samudAya! ma yo bhandina- masa~ga allAhakA khajAnAharU chan, jasalAI timIharUle ImAna lyAemA ma timIharUmAthi kharca garchu | ma adRzya vAstavikatAbAre jJAna rAkhchu bhanne dAbI pani gardina | ma phariztA pani hoina | ma ta timIharU jastai mAnava hu~ | timIharUle tuccha ThAnekA mominaharUbAre ma yo bhandina ki- allAhale kahilyai unIharUlAI mArgadarzana dinuhune chaina | unIharUkA manasAya ra karmaharUlAI allAhale rAmrarI jAnnuhuncha | yadi maile yasto dAbI gare bhane ma avazya nai atyAcArI ra prakopako bhAgI bannechu |
32 tinIharUle ghamaNDa gardai bhane– he nUha! timIle hAmIharUsa~ga dherai tarkavitarka garyau | yadi timI Aphno dAbImA saccA chau bhane tyo prakopa lyAera dekhAU jasako timIle dhamkI diMdaichau |

33 nUha (alaihissalAma) le bhane– prakopa lyAunu mero kAma hoina | allAhale cAhanu bhayo bhane lyAunuhunecha | yadi allAhale timIharUlAI sajAya dina cAhanubhayo bhane timIharU tyasabATa kadApi bacna sakdainau |

34 yadi allAhale timIharUlAI pathabhraSTa garna cAhemA mero sahAnubhUti tathA upadezale kunai phAidA puryAune chaina | uhA~ nai timIharUkA pAlanakartA hunuhuncha | uhA~ kai hAtamA timIharUko mAmilA cha | uhA~le cAhanu bhaemA timIharUlAI pathabhraSTa garnuhunecha | mahApralayako dina uhA~tarpha nai pharkera jAnechau | uhA~le timIharUkA karmaharUko badalA dinuhunecha |

35 nUha (alaihissalAma) ko samudAyako pathabhraSTatAko kAraNa tinIharUko yo bhrama thiyo ki nUha (alaihissalAma) le Aphno managaDhanta kurAlAI allAhale bhannubhaeko ho bhanera AphaiM yo dharma banAekA chan | he rasUla (alaihissalAma)! bhanidinuhos– yadi maile Aphaile gaDheko kurAlAI allAhako kurA ho bhaneko chu bhane mero pApa mamAthi cha | timIharUle jhUTo Thahara gareko kurAko bojha mamAthi Au~daina ra tyasasa~ga mero kunai sarokAra pani chaina |

36 allAhale nUha (alaihissAma) tarpha vahI (prakAzanA) garnubhayo | he nUha! yasaaghi jati mAnisaharUle timImAthi ImAna lyAe unIharU bAheka arU kasaile ImAna lyAune chainan | he nUha! tinIharUle euTA lAmo avadhisamma jhUTo Thahara garekAle ra khillI uDAekAle timI nirAza nahoU |

37 hAmro nirIkSaNamA vahI anusAra euTA DuGgA nirmANa gara | atyAcArI kAphiraharUlAI maukA dinu bhanera malAI sambodhana nagara, kinabhane tinIharU avajJA ra kuphramA DaTera lAgirahekAle sajAyasvarUpa avazya bADhImA DubAinechan |

38 nUha (alaihissalAma) le allAhako Adezako pAlanA gardai DuGgA banAuna suru gare | unakA samudAyakA aguvAharU unako najikabATa ohora dohora gardA unako khillI uDAuna thAle, kinabhane nata tyahA~ pAnI thiyo na nadI | paTaka-paTaka khillI uDAeko dekhdA nUha (alaihissalAma) le bhane– yadi timIharU yo DuGgA banAu~dA hAmro ThaTTA garchau bhane timIharU bADhImA Dubiraha~dA hAmI timIharUko ThaTTA garnechauM |
39 timIharUlAI cA~Dai thAhA hunecha, kasamAthi duniyA~mA prakopa Aunecha ra tyasa prakopale usalAI apamAnita garnecha ani kasalAI mahApralayako dina sadhaiM rahane yAtanA diinecha |

40 nUha (alaihissalAma) le DuGgA banAune kAma purA gare | yahA~samma ki tinIharUlAI sarvanAza pArne hAmro Adeza Aipugyo | roTI banAune ‘tannUra’ phuTyo | yo bADhI suru hune sUcanA thiyo | hAmIle nUha (alaihissalAma) lAI bhanyauM– pRthvImA rahekA sabai prakArakA janAvarakA eka-eka joDI bhAle pothI DuGgAmA rAkha | Aphno parivAra ra samudAyakA ImAna lyAekA mAnisaharUlAI DuGgAmA savAra garAU | parivArakA juna sadasyaharUle ImAna lyAekA chainan tinIharUlAI DuGgAmA savAra nagarAU | kinabhane tinIharUlAI DubAine nirNaya pahilA nai bhaisakeko cha | unale lAmo avadhisamma eka allAhamAthi ImAna lyAune ahvAna gare pani unImAthi unakA samudAyakA kehI vyaktiharUle mAtra ImAna lyAekA thie |

41 nUha (alaihissalAma) le mominaharUlAI bhane– timIharU DuGgAmA savAra hoU | allAhakai nAmale yo DuGgA calnecha ra rokinecha | nissandeha merA pAlanakartA taubA garne bhaktaharUprati ati kSamAzIla ra parama dayAlu hunuhuncha | uhA~le Aphno kRpAle nai mominaharUlAI vinAzabATa jogAunu huncha |

42 DuGgA tinIharUlAI bokera pahADajastA aglA laharaharUbIca calna thAlyo | nUha (alaihissalAma) le buvA bhaeko nAtAle AphU ra samudAyabATa alaga bhaera baseko Aphno avajJAkArI putralAI bhane- he bAbu! AphUlAI jogAunako lAgi hAmIsa~ga DuGgAmA savAra hoU | kAphiraharUko jamAtamA sAmela nahoU, natra tinIharU jastai timI pani Dubera marchau |

43 usale javApha diyo– ma yasto aglo pahADamAthi caDhnechu jahA~samma pAnI nai pugne chaina ra yasale malAI pAnIbATa surakSita rAkhnecha | nUha (alaihissalAma) le bhane– Aja allAhako yasa bADhIko prakopabATa kasaile jogAuna sakdaina | allAhale Aphno kRpAbATa jasalAI cAhanuhuncha usalAI bacAunuhuncha | yattikaimA nUha (alaihissalAma) ra unako kAphira putrako bIcabATa lahara uThyo ani U Aphno avajJAko kAraNale bADhImA Dubyo |

44 tuphAnapachi allAhale dharatIlAI bhannubhayo– he dharatI Aphno pAnIlAI nila | uhA~le AkAzalAI bhannubhayo– he AkAza! rokihAla ra thapa pAnI nabarsA | ani pAnI sukyo ra pRthvI pahilA jhaiM bhayo | allAhale kAphiraharUlAI sarvanAza pArnubhayo | DuGgA jUdI pahADamA rokiyo ra bhaniyo– dhikkAra cha kuphra garera sImAullaGghana garneharUmAthi |

45 nUha (alaihissalAma) le maddata mAgdai allAhalAI pukAre– he merA pAlanakartA! mero putra nizcaya nai mero parivAra madhyeko ho, usalAI tapAIMko tarphabATa jogAune vAcA cha | tapAIMko vacana satya cha, jasako ullaGghana gari~daina | tapAIM sabaibhandA saTika nirNAyaka ra sarvajJAnI hunuhuncha |

46 allAhale nUha (alaihissalAma) lAI bhannubhayo– he nUha! nissandeha timIle Aphno juna putralAI bacAunako lAgi duA garyau U kAphira bhaekole timro tyasa parivAraantargatako pardaina jasalAI bacAune vAcA maile gareko thie~ | timro yo duA timro tarphabATa anucita kArya ho | yo timIlAI zobhA diMdaina | jJAna nabhaeko kurAko lAgi timI ma sa~ga duA nagara ra ajJAnIharU jhaiM nabana |

47 nUha (alaihissalAma) le bhane– he merA pAlanakartA! jJAna nabhaeko kurAbAre duA garnabATa bacna ma tapAIMko zaraNa cAhanchu | yadi malAI mApha garnubhaena ra mamathi dayA garnubhaena bhane ma AkhiratamA ghATA khAneharUmadhye hunechu |

48 allAhale nUha (alaihissalAma) lAI bhannubhayo– he nUha! DuGgAbATa sakuzala orla | timI, timrA santAna, DuGgAmA savAra momina ra pachi Aune mominaharUkA lAgi zAnti, barakata tathA varadAnaharU chan | tinIharUmadhye kehI samUhaharU kAphira hunechan, jasalAI hAmIle sAMsArika phAidAbATa lAbhAnvita garnechauM tara pheri AkhiratamA du:khadAyI yAtanA dinechauM |

49 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama! nUha (alaihissalAma) ko satya kathA parokSa (adRSyakA) kA khabaraharU hun, jasako jJAna yasa vahI (prakAzanA) aghi na tapAIMlAI thiyo na tapAIMko samudAyalAI | jasarI nUha (alaihissalAma) le dhairya gare, tapAIM pani Aphno samudAyale diiraheko kaSTaprati dhairya dhAraNa garnuhos | allAhakA AdezaharUko pAlanA garne tathA varjita kAryaharUbATa bacneharUlAI nai allAhako maddata tathA vijaya prApta huncha |

50 hAmIle Adatarpha unakA bhAi hUda (alaihissalAma) lAI paThAyauM | unale bhane– he merA samudAya! mAtra allAhako upAsanA gara | uhA~sa~ga anya kasailAI sAjhedAra nabanAU | uhA~ bAheka timIharUko kohI vAstavika pUjya chaina | uhA~sa~ga sAjhedAra hune dAbI timIharU madhyekA jhUTAharU mAtra garchan |

51 he merA samudAya! ma yasa ahvAna ra upadezako saTTAmA kunai badalA timIharUsita mAgdina | mero badalA mero sRSTikartA allAhako jimmAmA mAtra cha | ke timIharU yo kurA bujhdainau ra mero ahvAnalAI svIkAra gardainau?!

52 he merA samudAya! timIharU allAhasita kSamAyAcanA gara | uhA~bATa Aphno pApa vizeSarUpamA zirkako lAgi taubA gara | uhA~le timIharUmAthi AkAzabATa avirala varSA barsAunuhunecha | timIharUlAI dherai dhanasampatti tathA santAna pradAna garera ajha zaktizAlI banAunuhunecha | mero ahvAna garabATa vimukha nahoU | yadi mero ahvAnabATa vimukha hunchau, allAhako inkAra garchau ra mero sandezalAI jhUTo Thahara garchau bhane timIharU aparAdhIharUmadhye bannechau |

53 unako samudAyale bhanyo– he hUda! timIle hAmI samakSa kunai spaSTa pramANa prastuta garenau, jasalAI dekhera hAmI timImAthi ImAna lyAU~ | timIle bhandaimA hAmI AphnA upAsyaharUko upAsanA choDne chainauM | timIle rasUla hu~ bhanne dAbI gareko kurAmA hAmI vizvAsa gardainauM |

54–55 hAmro vicAramA timIlAI hAmro kunai devatAle baulAhA banAeko cha | kinabhane timI hAmIharUlAI mUrti pUjAbATa rokchau | hUda (alaihissalAma) le bhaneH ma allAhalAI sAkSI banAu~chu ra timIharU pani sAkSI basa, allAha bAheka timIharU jasako pUjA garchau tinIharUsa~ga mero kunai sarokAra chaina | ataH timIharU timrA bhagavAnaharU sabai milera mero viruddha yojanA banAU ra malAI alikati pani maukA nadeU |

54–55 hAmro vicAramA timIlAI hAmro kunai devatAle baulAhA banAeko cha | kinabhane timI hAmIharUlAI mUrti pUjAbATa rokchau | hUda (alaihissalAma) le bhaneH ma allAhalAI sAkSI banAu~chu ra timIharU pani sAkSI basa, allAha bAheka timIharU jasako pUjA garchau tinIharUsa~ga mero kunai sarokAra chaina | ataH timIharU timrA bhagavAnaharU sabai milera mero viruddha yojanA banAU ra malAI alikati pani maukA nadeU |

56 maile Aphno mAmilAmA allAhamAthi nai pUrNa bharosA gareM | uhA~ mero pani pAlanakartA hunuhuncha ra timIharUko pani | dhartImA kunai sRSTi chaina jo vinamra bhaera allAhako sattA-zAsana antargata baseko nahos | allAha jasarI cAhanuhuncha tyasarI tyasalAI calAunuhuncha | nissandeha merA pAlanakartA satya tathA nisAphamA hunuhuncha | ma satyamA ra timIharU asatyamA bhaekole allAhale timIharUlAI mamAthi kahilyai prabhutva pradAna garnuhune chaina |

57 maile lyAeko sandezabATa timIharU vimukha hunchau bhane hoU | malAI timIharUsamakSa tyasalAI puryAune jimmevArI mAtra cha | allAhale pradAna garnubhaeko sandeza maile timIharUlAI puryAi sakeko chu | timIharUmAthi satya-tathya pramANita bhaisakeko cha | merA pAlanakartAle timIharUlAI sarvanAza garnuhunecha ra timIharUko sthAnamA anya samudAyalAI lyAunuhunecha | vimukha bhaera ra jhUTo Thahara garera timIharUle allAhako kehI bigArna sakdainau | kinabhane uhA~ Atmanirbhara tathA nirapekSa hunuhuncha | uhA~ AphnA bhaktaharUmadhye kasaimA Azrita hunuhunna | nissandeha merA pAlanakartA sampUrNa cijakA saMrakSaka hunuhuncha | timIharUle puryAeko kaSTabATa uhA~le nai malAI surakSita rAkhnuhuncha |
58 jaba tinIharUlAI vinAza garne hAmro Adeza Aipugyo taba hAmIle Aphno kRpAle hUda (alaihissalAma) ra mominaharUlAI prakopabATa bacAyauM |
59 yo ho Ada samudAya, jasale AphnA pAlanakartAkA nisAnIharUlAI inkAra garyo, AphnA rasUla hUda (alaihissalAma) ko avajJA garyo ra pratyeka atyAcArI ra vidrohIko anusaraNa garyo |

60 tinIharU yasa duniyA~mA apamAnita bhae ra allAhako kRpAbATa TADhA garAie | mahApralayako dina pani tinIharUlAI kuphrako kAraNale allAhako kRpAbATa TADhA rAkhinechan | jAnirAkha, allAhale tinIharUlAI hareka bhalAibATa TADhA rAkhnubhayo ra hareka duSTatAbATa najika pArnubhayo |

61 hAmIle samUdatarpha unakA bhAi sAleha (alaihissalAma) lAI paThAyauM | unale bhane– he merA samudAya! allAhako mAtra upAsanA gara | uhA~ bAheka timIharUko kohI upAsya chaina | unale nai timIharUkA purkhA Adama (alaihissalAma) lAI mATobATa sRSTi garera timIharUlAI pani sRSTi garnubhayo ra dhartIlAI AbAda garnubhayo | ataH uhA~sita kSamAyAcanA gara | uhA~kA AjJApAlana garera tathA pApaharUlAI tyAgera uhA~tarpha pharka | nisvArtha bhaera uhA~ko bhakti gara ra uhA~sita mAga, uhA~le duA (prArthanA) lAI svIkAra garnuhuncha |

62 sandeSTA sAleha (alaihissalAma) ko samudAyale unalAI bhane– he sAleha! yasa ahvAnaaghi timI hAmImAjha ucca sthAnamA thiyau | timIle buddhile kAma linechau ra hAmIharUlAI rAmro upadeza tathA salAha dinechau bhanne AzA hAmIharUle timIsa~ga garekA thiyauM | he sAleha! ke timI hAmIharUlAI tI mUrtiharUko pUjAbATa rokchau jasako pUjA hAmrA pUrvajaharUle gardai AekA chan? juna eka allAhako bhaktiko ahvAna timI garchau tyasako bAremA hAmI zaGkAmA chauM | yasale hAmIharUlAI allAhamAthi jhUTo Aropa lagAuna prerita garcha |

63 sAleha (alaihissalAma) le khaNDana gardai bhane– he merA samudAya! malAI bhana ta, yadi maile allAhako ahvAna garne kArya tyAge bhane uhA~ko prakopabATa kasale jogAu~cha? uhA~le malAI spaSTa pramANa ra vizeSa kRpA IzadUtatva pani pradAna garnubhaeko cha | yasakA bAvajuda timIharU malAI ajha pathabhraSTatA tathA allAhako prasannatAbATa TADhA pArdaichau |

64 he merA samudAya! yo allAhako U~TanI, mero satyatAko nizAnI ho | yasalAI allAhako dhartImA svatantra bhaera carna deU ra kunai kisimako kaSTa nadeU anyathA timIharUlAI cA~Dai nai prakopale samAtnecha |

65 tara, tinIharUle unalAI jhUTo Thahara gardai U~TanIlAI mAridie | ani sAleha (alaihissalAma) le bhane– timIharU ajha tIna dina dhartImA sAMsArika jIvanako bhoga gara | tyasapachi timIharUmAthi allAhako prakopa Aunecha | yo kunai asatya vacana hoina | yo avazya nai hunecha |

66 jaba tinIharUlAI naSTa pArne hAmro Adeza Ayo taba hAmIle Aphno vizeSa kRpAdvArA sAleha (alaihissalAma) ra mominaharUlAI naSTa hunabATa bacAyauM | unIharUlAI tyasa dinako apamAnabATa pani bacAyauM | he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! nissandeha tapAIMkA pAlanakartA sarva-zaktimAn tathA prabhutvazAlI hunuhuncha | kohI pani uhA~mAthi prabhutva jamAuna sakdaina | tyasaile uhA~le jhUTA samudAyaharUlAI naSTa pArnubhayo |
67 bhayAnaka tathA ThUlo garjanale tinIharUlAI samAtyo | ThUlo AvAjale gardA tinIharU mare | tinIharU ghopaTo parera dhartImA laDe |
68 mAnauM tinIharU tyahA~ mojamastImA basekai thienan | jAnirAkha, samUdale AphnA pAlanakartA allAhako avajJA garyo | tinIharU nirantara allAhako kRpAbATa TADhA pArie |

69 phariztAharU mAnavako rUpa dhAraNa garera ibrAhIma (alaihissalAma) ra unakI patnIlAI putra ishAka ra tyasapachi yAkUbako zubhasUcanA dina Ae | phariztAharUle ibrAhIma (alaihissalAma) lAI salAma gare | ibrAhIma (alaihissalAma) le salAma pharkAe | unale cA~Dai nai bAchAko mAsu bhuTera lyAe | unIharU mAnava hun ra yasalAI khAnechan bhanera pesa gare |

70 jaba ibrAhIma (alaihissalAma) le unIharUkA hAta khAnAtarpha baDheko dekhenan, unIharUlAI aparicita ThAnI unale manamA Dara mahasusa gare | phariztAharUle ibrAhIma (alaihissalAma) lAI DarAiraheko dekhera bhane– naDarAU, hAmIharUlAI allAhale lUta (alaihissalAma) ko samudAyamAthi prakopa paThAunako lAgi paThAunubhaeko cha |

71 ibrAhIma (alaihissalAma) kI patnI sArA najikai ubhirahekI thiin | unalAI hAmIle khusIko khabara sunAyauM | unale ishAkalAI janma dinechin ra ishAkako yAkUba nAmako chorA hunecha | yo sunepachi unI khusI bhain |

72 sArAle yo zubhasUcanA sunera Azcarya prakaTa gardai phariztAharUlAI bhanin– ma kasarI AmA banna sakchu jabaki ma buDhesakAlamA pugekI chu | merA pati pani bUDhA bhaisakekA chan | yo umeramA santAlAI janma dinu ekadamai Azcaryako kurA ho |

73 phariztAharUle sArAlAI bhane– ke timI allAhako nirNaya ra Aphno bhAgyaprati Azcarya mAnchyau? he ibrAhImakA parivAra! allAha yasako sAmarthya rAkhnuhuncha | timIharUmAthi allAhako kRpA ra varadAnaharU chan | nissandeha allAha AphnA guNa ra kAryaharUmA ati prazaMsanIya ra ati gauravazAlI hunuhuncha |

74 jaba ibrAhIma (alaihissalAma) le yI khAnA nakhAne atithiharU phariztA hun bhanne thAhA pAe ani manabATa Dara haTyo ra putra lAbhako zubha sandeza pani pAe; tyasapachi phariztAharUsa~ga lUta (alaihissalAma) ko samudAyako bAremA tarka vitarka garna thAle | lUta (alaihissalAma) ko samudAyalAI prakopabATa bacAuna sakincha ki bhanne AzAle |

75 nissandeha ibrAhIma (alaihissalAma) ati sahanazIla thie, tyasaile lUta (alaihissalAma) ko samudAyamAthi prakopa naAos bhanne cAhanthe | unI allAha samakSa ati bintI garthe ra dherai duA tathA taubA garthe |

76 phariztAharUle bhane– he ibrAhIma! timI lUta (alaihissalAma) ko samudAyabAre kurA nagara | allAhabATa yasa samudAyalAI naSTa pArne Adeza bhaisakeko cha | timro tarka vitarka ra duAle TArine chaina |

77 jaba phariztAharU lUta (alaihissalAma) kahA~ puruSako rUpamA puge taba unI ati cintita bhae ra tinIharUko sambandhamA AphUlAI asamartha pAe; kinabhane unako samudAyakA mAnisaharU mahilAlAI choDera puruSatarpha AkarSita thie | lUta (alaihissalAma) le bhane– Ajako dina ati kaThina cha, kinabhane samudAyakA mAnisaharUle pAhunAharUko apamAna garcha ki bhanne Dara cha |

78 lUta (alaihissalAma) kA samaliGgI samudAya hatAra-hatAra aprAkRtika maithuna garne manasAyale pAhunAharUkahA~ Ae | unIharUko pahiledekhi nai nArIharUlAI choDera puruSaharUsa~ga kAmavAsanA purA garne bAnI baseko thiyo | lUta (alaihissalAma) le pahunAharUsamakSa samudAyalAI bhane– he merA samudAya! yI hAmrA celIbeTIharUsa~ga bihe gara | puruSaharUsa~ga azlIla kArya garnu bhandA yinIharUsa~ga bihe garera Aphno kAmecchA purA garnu rAmro ho | allAhasita Dara | merA pAhunAharUko agADi malAI apamAnita nagara | he merA samudAya! ke timIharUmadhye yI ghRNita kArya garneharUlAI samjhAune kohI sajjana tathA buddhimAna chaina?!
79 tinIharUle lUta (alaihissalAma) lAI bhane– he lUta! timIlAI thAhA cha~daicha, hAmIlAI timrA celIbeTI ra nArIharUmA cAso chaina | hAmI puruSaharUsa~ga kAmecchA purA garna cAhanchauM |
80 lUta (alaihissalAma) le bhane– apasoca, yadi mamA timIharUsita mukAbilA garne zakti vA mero kohI zaktizAlI Aphanta bhaidieko bhae merA pAhunAharUlAI timIharUbATa jogAune thie~ |

81 phariztAharUle bhane– he lUta! hAmI allAhakA dUtaharU hauM | hAmIharUlAI allAhale paThAunubhaeko cha | tinIharUle kadApi timIlAI kaSTa puryAuna sakdainan | timI AphnA parivArakAsAtha rAtako andhakAramA yasa samudAyabATa niskera jAU | timIharUmadhye kasaile pani pachADi pharkera naheros | tara timrI patnIle kurA namAnera pachADi pharkera herneche | tyasamAthi pani tyahI prakopa Aunecha juna tinIharUmAthi Aunecha | tinIharUko vinAzako samaya bihAna raheko cha, jo ati nikaTa cha |

82 jaba lUta (alaihissalAma) ko samudAyalAI naSTa pArne hAmro Adeza bhayo, taba hAmIle tyasa gAu~ko mAthillo bhAgalAI tala pArdai ghopTAi diyauM ra tinIharUmAthi lagAtAra DhuGgAmuDhAko varSA garAyauM |

83 tI sabai DhuGgAharUmA allAhako tarphabATa vizeSa cinhaharU aGkita thie | kuraizakA atyAcArIharUbATa pani tyasto DhuGgAko prakopa TADhA chaina | allAhale jahile cAhanuhuncha tinIharUmAthi pani barsAunuhanecha |

84 madayanatarpha hAmIle unakA bhAi zuaiba (alaihissalAma) lAI paThAyauM | unale bhaneH he merA samudAya! allAhako mAtra upAsanA gara | uhA~ bAheka timIharUko anya kohI upAsya chaina | nApataulamA kamI nagara | ma timIharUlAI susampanna dekhdaichu | allAhale pradAna gareko kRpAko badalAmA avajJA nagara | ma timIharUlAI tyasa dinako prakopabATa DarAu~chu jasale sabailAI ghernecha | na ta kasaile bhAgne bATo pAunecha na zaraNa line ThAu~ nai |

85 he merA samudAya! mAnisaharUlAI nApera vA taulera di~dA nyAyakAsAtha ThIka-ThIka nApataula garera deU | nApataulamA kamI garera, vA dhokA diera vA chalera mAnisaharUkA haka-adhikAra hanan nagara | hatyA-hiMsA ra pApale dhartImA vidhvaMsa namaccAU |

86 mAnisaharUkA haka-adhikAra nisAphakA sAtha purA gardai prApta bhaekA vaidha nAphA timIharUkA lAgi tyasa dhanabhandA uttama cha juna nApataulamA kamI ra dhartImA vidhvaMsa maccAera prApta huncha | yadi timIharU pakkA momina (AsthAvAn) hau bhane tyasa vaidha phAidAmA santoSa gara | ma timIharUmAthi nirikSaka hoina ki timIharUkA karmaharUko gantI rAkhu~ ra mulyAGkana garu~ | saMrakSaka ta allAha hunuhuncha jo gopya kurA ra kAnekhusIlAI pani jAnnuhuncha |

87 zuaiba (alaihissalAma) ko samudAyale bhane– he zuaiba! ke timIle allAhako lAgi paDhne gareko namAjale timIlAI yahI Adeza dincha- pUrvajale pujdai AekA mUrtiharUko pUjA hAmI tyAgauM ra AphnA dhanako lenadena ra tyasamA baDhottarI pani icchA anusAra nagarauM?! timI nai eka sahanazIla evam satyaniSTha vyakti hau | yasa ahvAnaaghi hAmIharU timIlAI buddhimAna tathA tatvadarzI ThAnekA thiyauM, aba timIlAI ke bhaeko cha?!

88 zuaiba (alaihissalAma) le bhane– he merA samudAyakA mAnisaharU! timIharUko ke vicAra cha, yadi ma AphnA pAlanakartAko tarphabATa spaSTa pramANamA kAyama chu ra uhA~le malAI uttama jIvikA ra IzdUtatva pradAna garnubhaeko cha | mero manasAya timIharUko virodha garne ani svayam tyahI kArya garne hoina | ma eka allAhako bhakti ra AjJApAlanako ahvAnadvArA timIharUko sudhAra cAhanchu | yI sabai kArya allAhako kRpAle garna sakiraheko chu | ma sabai mAmilAmA uhA~mAthi nai bharosA garchu ra uhA~tarpha nai pharkera jAnechu |

89 he merA samudAyakA mAnisaharU! masa~gako zatrutAle gardA timIharU allAhako sandezalAI jhUTo Thahara nagara | yasto garemA timIharUmAthi pani tyahI prakopa Aunecha, jo nUha, hUda ra sAleha (alaihimussalAma) kA samudAyaharUmAthi Aeko thiyo | lUta (alaihissalAma) ko samudAyalAI sarvanAza garieko kurA ta timIharUlAI thAhai cha | samaya tathA dUrI duvai hisAbale dherai TADhA chaina | ataH tinIharUbATa pATha sika |
90 AphnA pAlanakartAsita kSamAyAcanA gara ra pApaharUprati pazcAttApa gara | nissandeha merA pAlanakartAle pazcAttApa tathA taubA garneharUlAI dherai dayA ra mAyA garnuhuncha |

91 zuaiba (alaihissalAma) ko samudAyale bhane– he zuaiba! hAmI timIle bhanekA prAyaHjaso kurAharU bujhdainauM | hAmIharU timIlAI timrA A~khAharU kamajora tathA andhA bhaekAle durbala vyakti ThAndachauM | yadi timrA nAtedAraharU hAmrai dharmamA kAyama narahekA bhae nizcaya nai hAmIle timIlAI DhuGgAle hAnera mArne thiyauM | hAmIbhandA timI zaktizAlI pani chainau | timrA nAtedAraharUko sammAna gardai hAmIharUle timro hatyA garekA chainauM |

92 zuaiba (alaihissalAma) le bhane– he merA samudAya! ke merA nAtedAraharU timIharUkA lAgi allAha bhandA pani zaktizAlI chan?! timIharU allAha ra uhA~ko nabIdekhi vimukha hunchau | nissandeha merA pAlanakartAle timIharUlAI gherAmA linubhaeko cha | uhA~bATa timIharUkA kAryaharU lukekA chainan | lokamA tyasako badalA sarvanAza pArera dinuhunecha ra paralokamA yAtanA diera dinuhunecha |

93 he merA samudAya! timIharU Aphno tarikA anusAra karma gara | ma pani Aphno tarikA anusAra karma garchu | apamAnita garne prakopa kasamAthi Au~cha ra ko Aphno dAbImA jhUTo cha bhanne kurA timIharUle cA~Dai nai thAhA pAunechau | timIharU allAhako cAhanAko pratIkSA gara | ma pani timIharUsa~gai pratIkSA gardaichu |

94 jaba zuaiba (alaihissalAma) ko samudAyalAI vinAza garne Adeza Ayo taba hAmIle unalAI ra mominaharUlAI Aphno kRpAle surakSita rAkhyauM | unako samudAyakA atyAcArIharUlAI bhayaGkara garjanale samAtyo | ani tinIharU mare ra dhartImA ghopTo parera laDe |
95 mAnauM tinIharU yasaaghi tyahA~ basekai thienan | jAnirAkha, madayana allAhako kRpAbATa TADhA pArie | tinIharUmAthi tyastai prakopa Ayo jasto samUdamAthi Aeko thiyo |
96 hAmIle mUsA (alaihissalAma) lAI spaSTa pramANasahita paThAyauM | unale lyAeko sandeza satya ho bhanne nizAnIharU pani diera paThAyauM |

97 hAmIle unalAI phirauna ra usakA samarthakaharUsamakSa ekezvaravAdako ahvAna garna paThAyauM | tara phiraunakA samarthakaharUle usaiko Adezako pAlanA gare jabaki usako Adeza allAhako inkAramA AdhArita thiyo | vAstavamA, usako Adeza nata satyamA AdhArita thiyo ra na anusaraNa yogya thiyo |
98 mahApralayako dina phiraunale Aphno samudAyako aguvAi garnecha ra tinIharUlAI narkamA liera jAnecha | tyo katti narAmro sthAna hunecha jasamA tinIharUlAI hAlinecha!

99 allAhale tinIharUlAI jasarI yasa duniyA~mA dhikkArnubhayo ra samudramA DubAera Aphno kRpAbATa TADhA pArnubhayo | tyasaigarI mahApralayako dina pani dhikkArnuhunecha ra Aphno kRpAbATa TADhA pArnuhunecha | tinIharUle loka ra paralokamA pAekA dhikkAra tathA prakopa kati narAmrA chan!

100 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) yI kehI samudAharUkA satya kathAharU hun; juna hAmI tapAIMsamakSa bayAna gardaichauM | tinIharUmadhye kehIkA nizAnIharU ahilesamma kAyama chan bhane kehIkA nizAnIharU meTisakekA chan |

101 hAmIle tinIharUlAI sarvanAza garera tinIharUmAthi kunai atyAcAra garenauM | baru tinIharUle nai allAhako inkAra garera AphaiMlAI barbAdImA pAre ani AphaiMmAthi atyAcAra gare | he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! jaba tapAIMkA pAlanakartAko tarphabATa prakopako Adeza Aipugyo taba tinIharUkA pUjyaharUle tinIharUlAI bacAuna sakenan | baru tinIharUle tinIharUko vinAzamai vRddhi gare |
102 tapAIMkA pAlanakartAle hareka ThAu~ ra hareka yugamA jhUTA samudAyalAI yasarI nai prakopamA grasta garnuhuncha | nissandeha allAhako prakopa ati kaDA ra dukhadAyI hunegarcha |

103 nissandeha allAhako prakopamA mahApralayako yAtanAbATa DarAune vyaktiharUkA lAgi zikSA cha | yo tyasto dina hunecha jasamA allAhale sabai mAnisaharUlAI hisAba kitAbako lAgi jammA garnuhunecha | yahI ho allAha samakSa hAjira garine dina, jahA~ mAnisaharU gavAhI dinechan |
104 hAmI hisAba kitAbako dinalAI eka nizcita avadhikA lAgi mAtra DhIlo gardaichauM |

105 tyasa dina kohI pani allAhako anumatibinA na pramANa prastuta garna saknecha, na kasaiko siphArisa garna saknecha | tyasa dina mAnisaharUlAI duI samUhamA vibhAjita garinecha | abhAgIharUko samUha jo narkamA jAnechan ra bhAgyazAlIharUko samUha jo svargamA jAnechan |
106 abhAgIharU Aphno kuphra ra duSkarmaharUle gardA narkamA jAnechan, tyahA~ kaSTale gardA ThUlo svaramA rune karAunechan |

107 tinIharU sadA sarvadA tyasaimA rahanechan | jabasamma AkAzaharU tathA dhartI kAyama rahanechan tabasamma tyasabATa niskane chainan | eka allAhamAthi ImAna rAkhekA avajJAkArIharUmadhye jasalAI cAhanuhuncha uhA~le narkabATa nikAlnuhunecha | he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! tapAIMkA pAlanakartAle je cAhanuhuncha garerai choDnuhuncha, uhA~lAI kasaile bAdhya pArna sakdaina |

108 bhAgyazAlI vyaktiharU svargamA praveza garnechan | unIharUkA ImAna ra satkarmaharUle gardA allAhale bhAgyazAlI banAunuhunecha | jabasamma AkAzaharU tathA dhartI kAyama rahanechan tabasamma sadA sarvadAko lAgi unIharU svargamA basobAsa garnechan | allAhale avajJAkArI tathA galtI garekA mominaharUlAI svargamA praveza garAunuaghi narkamA hAlnuhunecha | nissandeha svargabAsIharUkA lAgi allAhako varadAna nirantara rahirahanecha |

109 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! bahudevavAdIharU mUrti pUjA garera galata garirahekA chan | yasa kurAbAre kadApi zaGkAmA naparnuhos | tinIharUsa~ga yasako lAgi na kunai tarka cha na kunai pramANa | mAtra AphnA pUrvajaharUko anusaraNamA yasto gardaichan | hAmIle tinIharUlAI purA-purA yAtanA dinechauM, tyasamA kunai kamI garne chainauM |

110 hAmIle mUsA (alaihissalAma) lAI taurAta pradAna garyauM | tara mAnisaharUle tyasamA matabheda gare | kehI mAnisaharUle tyasamA ImAna lyAe ra kehIle kuphra gare | allAhale tinIharUmAthi Aune prakopalAI mahApralayasammako lAgi sthagita garne nirNaya pahilA nai garisaknu bhaeko thiyo | pahilA nai yasako nirNaya nabhaeko bhae allAhale saMsAramai tinIharUmAthi prakopa paThAunuhunthyo | nissandeha yahUdI tathA bahudevavAdIharU kurAnako bAremA sandehamA chan |

111 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! tapAIMkA pAlanakartAle tI sabai vibhedakArIharUlAI purA-purA badalA dinuhunecha | satkarmIharUlAI rAmro badalA ra duSkarmIharUlAI sajAya | nissandeha allAha tinIharUle garne garekA sabai kAryaharUsita rAmrarI avagata hunuhuncha | tinIharUkA kunai pani karma uhA~bATa lukeko chaina |

112 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! tapAIM ra tapAIMkA anuyAyIharU satmArgamA nirantara kAyama rahanuhos | allAhakA AdezaharUko pAlanA garnuhos ra varjita kAryaharUlAI tyAgnuhos | mominaharU ho! timIharU allAhako avajJA garera sImAharUko ullaGghana nagara | nissandeha uhA~le sampUrNa kAryaharUlAI dekhirahanu bhaeko cha | uhA~le timIharUko karmaharUko badalA dinuhunecha |

113 timIharU atyAcArI kAphiraharUtarpha cApalusI ra premakA sAtha najhuka | yasarI jhukemA narkako Agole chunecha | allAhabAheka kasaile pani tyasabATa bacAuna sakdaina | timIharUle kunai mitra ra sahayogI pAune chainau |

114 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) tapAIM dinako duvai kinArA arthAta bihAna tathA belukI ra rAtakA praharaharUmA rAmro tarikAle namAja kAyama garnuhos | nissandeha satkarmaharUle sAnA pApaharUlAI meTAunechan | yasamA upadeza grahaNa garne ra pATha sikneharUkA lAgi upadeza ra pATha cha |

115 dhairya, aDigatA ra nirantaratAkAsAtha allAhakA AdezaharUko pAlanA garnuhos ra varjita kAryaharUbATa bacnuhos | nizcaya nai allAhale satkarmIharUkA pratidAnalAI naSTa pArnuhunna, baru svIkAra garnuhuncha | uhA~le satkarmaharUko rAmro badalA dinuhuncha |

116 prakopamA grasta bhaekA vigata samudAyaharUmA kuphra, avajJA ra AtaGka maccAunabATa manAhI garne mAnisaharU thorai thie | tI atyAcArI samudAyaharUko vinAza gardA hAmIle tyastA mAnisaharUlAI surakSita rAkhyauM | tI samudAyakA atyAcArIharU vilAsItAtira lAge | tinIharUle yasto garera atyAcArI bane |

117 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! tapAIMkA pAlanakartAle samAja sudhArakaharUlAI naSTa pArnuhunna | allAhale kuphra tathA atyAcAra garera dhartImA AtaGka maccAuneharUlAI naSTa pArnuhuncha |

118 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) tapAIMkA pAlanakartAle cAhanubhaeko bhae sampUrNa mAnavalAI satyamA jammA garera euTai samudAya banAunuhune thiyo | tara uhA~le yasto cAhanubhaena | tinIharUle AphnA icchA ra atyAcArako anusaraNa garekAle satyako viSayamA paraspara matabheda garirahanechan |

119 tara jasalAI allAhale sIdhA mArga dekhAera kRpA garnubhayo unIharU ekezvaravAdamA matabheda gardainan | matabhedadvArA parIkSA linako lAgi allAhale tinIharUko sRSTi garnubhayo | tinIharUmA kehI abhAgI chan bhane kehI bhAgyazAlI | he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! Adi kAlamA allAhale garnubhaeko vANI purA bhayo | tyo vANI thiyo- maile narkalAI zaitAnako anusaraNa garne jinna ra mAnavale bharnechu |

120 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! vigatakA rasUlaharUkA satya kathAharU hAmIle varNana garekA chauM, tyasako uddezya tapAIMkA hRdayalAI satyamAthi dRDha pArnu ho | yasa sUrahamA pani yasto satya Aeko cha jasamA kunai sandeha chaina | yasamA kAphiraharUkA lAgi pATha cha ra upadezabATa phAidA uThAune mominaharUkA lAgi pani upadeza cha |

121 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! allAhamAthi ImAna nalyAune ra uhA~lAI eka namAnneharUlAI bhanidinuhos– timIharU AphnA tarikA anusAra satyabATa vimukha hune ra yasamA bAdhA hAlne kAma garirAkha | hAmI pani satyalAI sthApita pArne, yasako ahvAna garne ra yasamA dhairya rahane kAma garirAkhchauM |
122 allAhako prakopale timIharUlAI ghernecha yA hAmIlAI ghernecha tyasako pratIkSA garau~ |

123 AkAzaharU tathA dhartIkA adRzya vAstavikatAharUko jJAna kevala allAhalAI mAtra cha | uhA~bATa kehI pani lukeko chaina | mahApralayako dina sabai mAmilAharU uhA~tarpha nai pharkAinechan | he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! tapAIM allAhakai upAsanA garnuhos ra sabai mAmilAmA uhA~mAthi nai bharosA garnuhos | tapAIMharUle garne garekA kAryaharUbATa allAha anabhijJa hunuhunna | baru uhA~ sabai kurAharUbATa avagata hunuhuncha ra tyasako badalA dinuhunecha |
1 (alipha0 lAma0 rA0) yastA akSaraharUko bAremA sUraha al-bakarahako ArambhamA varNana bhaisakeko cha | yasa sUrahakA AyataharU kurAnakA spaSTa AyataharU hun |
2 he arabIharU ho! hAmIle kurAnalAI arabI bhASAmA avataraNa garyauM | tAki timIharU yasako artha bujhna saka |

3 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! hAmI tapAIMlAI yasa kurAnamA satya ra utkRSTa kathAharU sunAu~dai chauM | juna satyatA, zabdako chanauTa ra bhASAko zuddhatA ityAdile utkRSTa cha | yasa kurAnako avataraNaaghi tapAIMlAI yasa kathAko bAremA thAhA thiena |

4 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! hAmI tapAIMlAI sUcita garAu~dai chauM, tyasa samayako bAremA jaba yUsupha (alaihissalAma) le AphnA pitA yAkUba (alaihissalAma) lAI bhane– he merA pitA! maile 11 vaTA tArA, sUrya ra candramAle malAI sajdA gardai gareko sapanA dekhe | yo yUsupha (alaihissalAma) ko lAgi cA~Dai purA hune sapanAko zubhasUcanA thiyo |

5 yAkUba (alaihissalAma) le Aphno chorA yUsupha (alaihissalAma) lAI bhane– he mero chorA! timI yo sapanA AphnA dAjubhAiharUlAI nasunAunu, tinIharUle yo kurA sunepachi timIsa~ga DAhA garnechan ani timIviruddha SaDayantra garnechan | kinabhane zaitAna mAnavako khullA zatru ho |

6 he yUsupha! yasa sapanAko artha ke cha bhane allAhale timIlAI cayana garera sapanAko arthako jJAna dinuhunecha ra timIlAI IzadUtatva pradAna garera Aphno varadAna pUrNa garnuhunecha | jasarI allAhale yasa aghi hAmro pUrvaja ibrAhIma ra ishAka (alaihimassalAma) lAI pani varadAna dinubhaeko thiyo | nissandeha allAha sRSTiharUko jJAna rAkhnuhuncha ra vivekapUrNa tarikAle kArya saJcAlana garnuhuncha |
7 yasa kathAmA yUsupha (alaihissalAma) ra unakA dAjubhAiharUko bAremA jAnna cAhaneharUkA lAgi dherai pATha ra upadezaharU chan |

8 jaba yUsupha (alaihissalAma) kA sautelA dAjubhAiharUle ApasamA bhane– yUsupha ra unakA sAkhkhai bhAi hAmrA pitAkA lAgi hAmIbhandA ati priya chan, jabaki hAmIharUko jamAta ThUlo cha | hAmrA pitAle unIharUlAI hAmIharUmAthi kina prAthamikatA dinuhuncha | binA kAraNa unIharUlAI hAmImAthi prAthamikatA diera hAmrA pitAle galata garnubhaeko cha |

9 yUsupha (alaihissalAma) lAI mAridiU vA usalAI kunai TADhAko ThAu~mA puryAera bepattA banAidiU | yaso garemA hAmro pitAko dhyAna pUrNarUpale hAmIharUtarpha mAtrai kendrita hunecha ra uhA~le hAmIharUlAI mAyA garna thAlnuhunecha | yUsupha (alaihissalAma) lAI mArepachi vA bepattA banAepachi yasa pApabATa taubA (pazcAttApa) garera satkarmI banauMlA |

10 unakA dAjubhAiharUmadhye ekajanAle bhanyo– usako hatyA nagara baru usalAI kunai gahiro inArako piMdhamA phyA~kideU jahA~bATa hi~Diraheko kunai baTuvAle nikAlera laijAncha | yo usalAI mArnu bhandA kama hAnikAraka cha, yadi timIharUle usako bAremA bhaneko kurA garna nai cAhanchau bhane |

11 yUsupha (alaihissalAma) lAI TADhA pArne kurAmA ekamata bhaepachi unakA dAjubhAiharUle yAkUba (alaihissalAma) lAI bhane– he hAmrA pitA! Akhira yUsuphako sambandhamA tapAIM hAmImAthi bharosA kina garnuhunna? jabaki hAmIle usalAI mAyA garchauM, usako rekhadekha garchauM ra usako vAstavika zubhacintaka hauM? tapAIM kina usalAI hAmIsa~ga jAna dinuhunna | hAmI usalAI surakSita tapAIMsamakSa phirtA lyAidinechauM |
12 bholi usalAI hAmIsa~gai khelakuda ra khAnapina garne anumati dinuhos | hAmI pUrNarUpamA unako rakSA garnechauM ra kunai kisimako kaSTa huna dine chainauM |

13 yAkUba (alaihissalAma) le putraharUlAI bhane– timIharUle usalAI lagyau bhane malAI usako bAremA cintA lAgirahanecha | U binA ma rahana sakdina | timIharU khelakudamA vyasta hu~dA usalAI bvA~sole khAlA ki bhanne malAI Dara cha |

14 tinIharUle pitAlAI bhane– hAmI euTA samUha hu~dAhu~dai pani yadi bvA~sole yUsuphalAI khAncha bhane hAmro ke kAma | usalAI hAmIharUle bvA~sobATa bacAenauM bhane hAmI ghATA khAneharUmadhye hunechauM |

15 yAkUba (alaihissalAma) le yUsupha (alaihissalAma) lAI tinIharUsa~ga paThAe | jaba tinIharU unalAI liera TADhA lagera InArako pi~dhamA hAlne nizcaya gare taba allAhale yUsupha (alaihissalAma) tarpha vahI (prakAzanA) paThAunu bhayo, timIle tinIharUlAI yasa kartutabAre avagata garAunechau ra tinIharU tyasabAre anabhijJa hunechan |
16 yUsupha (alaihissalAma) kA dAjubhAiharU rAti ghara pharkiMdA banAvaTI rUpamA ru~dai karAu~dai AphnA pitAsamakSa Ae |

17 tinIharU bhanna thAle– pitA jyU! hAmI dauDako pratispardhA ani tirabAjImA vyasta thiyauM ra yUsuphalAI lugA tathA sAmAnaharUko surakSAko lAgi choDekA thiyauM | tyattikaimA bvA~so Aera usalAI khAidiyo | hAmIle jatisukai satya bole pani tapAIMle hAmro kurA patyAunu hunna |

18 tinIharUle Aphno dAbIko puSTiko lAgi yUsupha (alaihissalAma) ko kamijamA kataibATa ragata pani lagAera lyAekA thie | yAkUba (alaihissalAma) le kamija nacyAtieko dekhepachi bujhihAle ki yinIharU jhUTo boldaichan | unale bhane– timIharUle bhaneko kurA galata ho | baru yo timIharUko SaDayantra ho | ma dhairya garchu ra yUsupha (alaihissalAma) ko bAremA allAhakai sahayoga khojnechu |

19 tyasatarpha euTA yAtrudala Ayo ra unIharUle pAnI bharna Aphno euTA mAnche paThAe | jaba usale InAramA Aphno bAlTina khasAlyo taba yUsupha (alaihissalAma) le DorIlAI samAte | pAnI bharne vyaktile yUsupha (alaihissalAma) lAI dekhepachi khusI hu~dai bhanyo- oho kati khusIko kurA! yahA~ euTA keTA po rahecha | usale ra usakA sAthIharUle unalAI euTA bikrIko vastu ThAnera lukAe | tinIharUle gariraheko kAryalAI allAha rAmrarI jAnnuhunthyo | kunai pani kArya uhA~bATa lukeko thiena |

20 yAtrudalale unalAI dherai kama mUlyamA bikrI gare | tI gantIkA kehI dirhama (paisA) thie | tinIharU unIbATa cA~Dai chuTakArA pAuna cAhanthe, tyasaile kunai cAso dekhAena | kinabhane yUsupha (alaihissalAma) tinIharUko bikrIko vastu hoinan bhanne kurA tinIharUlAI thAhA thiyo | kasaile yo hAmro sampatti ho bhanne dAbI garcha ki bhanne kurAbATa tinIharU DarAekA thie | yI sabai allAhako kRpAle hu~dai thiyo tAki yUsupha (alaihissalAma) tinIharUsa~ga lAmo samayasamma narahun |
