21 unalAI kharIda garne misrako vyaktile AphnI patnIlAI bhane– usako rAmro heracAha gara | AzA cha yo hAmro lAgi lAbhadAyaka hunecha vA yasalAI hAmI dharma-putra nai banAu~chauM | yasarI hAmIle yUsupha (alaihissalAma) lAI hatyA hunabATa jogAyauM, InArabATa nikAlyauM ra misrako ajIja (artha mantrI) ko hRdayamA unako lAgi mAyA utpanna garyauM | yasarI unalAI misrako bhUmimA sthApita garyauM | tAki unalAI sapanAko artha bujhna sikAauM | allAha Aphno kArya garnasakne purA sAmarthya rAkhnuhuncha | uhA~ko Adeza avazya nai lAgu huncha | uhA~lAI kasaile bAdhya pArna sakdaina | tara adhikAMsa mAnisaharU vizeSarUpamA kAphiraharUlAI thAhA chaina |
22 jaba yUsupha (alaihissalAma) yuvAvasthAmA puge ra hRSTapuSTa bhae taba hAmIle unalAI buddhi ra jJAna pradAna garyauM | yasarI nai hAmI satkarmIharUlAI pratidAna dine garchauM |

23 ajIjako patnIle unIsa~ga azlIla kArya garnako lAgi unalAI jabarjastI garna thAlin | unIsa~ga ekAntamA hunako lAgi unale DhokAharU banda garin ani bhanin– mero najika AU | yUsupha (alaihissalAma) le bhane– timI juna kAryako lAgi bolAu~daichyau tyasabATa bacna ma allAhako zaraNa cAhanchu | mero mAlika (ajIja) le malAI kati rAmro tarikAle rAkhekA chan | unIsa~ga ma kadApi vizvAsaghAta gardina | unIsa~ga vizvAsaghAta garemA ma atyAcArI hunchu | atyAcArIharU kahilyai saphala huna sakdainan |

24 ajIjakI patnIle azlIla kAryako cAhanA garina | yUsupha (alaihissalAma) ko manamA pani narAmro vicAra Auna sakne khatarA thiyo yadi unale allAhako nizAnI nadekhekA bhae; ani unI yasabATa bacna pani sakne thienan | hAmIle unalAI azlIla kArya, vizvAsaghAta tathA vyabhicArabATa jogAunako lAgi nizAnI dekhAyauM | nissandeha yUsupha (alaihissalAma) IzadUtatva (nubUvata) ko lAgi chAniekA hAmrA asala bhaktaharUmadhye thie |

25 duvaijanA DhokAtarpha huttie | yUsupha (alaihissalAma) AphUlAI bacAunako lAgi ra mahilAle unalAI bAhira jAnabATa roknako lAgi DhokAtarpha bhAge | mahilAle unalAI niskanabATa roknako lAgi unako kamija samAtin, jasale gardA kamija pachADibATa cyAtiyo | DhokAmai tI duvaiko ajIjasa~ga jamkAbheTa bhayo | unale calAkha banera turunta bhanin– he ajIja! tapAIMko patnIsa~ga vyabhicAra garna khojnelAI ki ta jela cAlAna garnuparcha ki ta pIDAdAyI yAtanA dinuparcha |

26 yUsupha (alaihissalAma) le bhane– unale nai masa~ga azlIla kArya garna khojekI hun, maile garna khojeko hoina | mahilAko Aphnai parivArakA eka janA sAkSIle gavAhI diyo– yadi yUsuphako kamija agADipaTTi cyAtieko cha bhane yo mahilA sA~co boldaiche bhanne kurAko saGketa ho | usale AphUlAI jogAune kramamA cyAteko huna sakcha ra yUsupha jhUTo ho |

27 yadi unako kamija pachADipaTTi cyAtieko cha bhane yUsupha sA~co boldaicha bhanne kurAko saGketa ho | mahilAle unalAI jabarjastI garna khojeko ra unale AphUlAI jogAunako lAgi bhAgne kramamA cyAteko hunasakcha ra mahilA jhUTI ho |

28 ajIjale kamija pachADipaTTi cyAtieko dekhe | yUsupha (alaihissalAma) saccA hun bhanne vizvAsa bhayo | unale bhane– juna kurAko Aropa timIle yUsuphamAthi lagAu~dai chyau, tyo mahilAharUko SaDyantrako khela ho | timI mahilAharUko SaDyantra ati nai khataranAka hunegarcha |

29 unale yUsupha (alaihissalAma) lAI bhane– yo galtIlAI mApha garideU | yasalAI gopya rAkha ra kasailAI nabhana | he mahilA! timI Aphno pApako lAgi prAyazcita gara | vAstavamA timIle yUsupha (alaihissalAma) lAI jabarjastI garna khojekole timrai doSa ho |

30 zaharamA yo khabara phailiyo | mahilAharUko euTA samUhale bhanyo- ajIjakI patnIle Aphno yuvA dAsalAI Aphno kAmavAsanA purA garna jabarjastI garna khojekI chin ra usako premamA baulAhA banekI chin | hAmro vicAramA ta unI ThUlo galtI gardaichin |

31 jaba ajIjakI patnIle AphU badanAma bhaeko kurA sunin taba unale zaharakA mahilAharUlAI bolAuna paThAin | tAki tinIharUle yUsupha (alaihissalAma) lAI dekhun ra badanAma gareko kAryaprati mAphI mAgun | unale tinIharUkA lAgi vizeSa baiThakako vyavasthA garin jasamA rAmro khAlako ochyAna ra sirAnIharU rAkhie | tinIharUmadhye pratyekalAI phala kATna eka eka vaTA churI diin | tyasapachi yUsupha (alaihissalAma) lAI tinIharUsamakSa Aune Adeza diin | tI mahilAharU unalAI dekhepachi unIharU hereko herai bhae | unako sundaratAmA yasarI laTTha pare ki tinIharUle AphnA hAta kATeko pattai pAenan | tinIharUle bhane– allAha pavitra hunuhuncha! yo vyakti mAnava hoina | mAnavamA yasto sundaratA hu~daina | yo ta mahAn phariztAharU madhyeko kunai euTA phariztA ho!

32 ajIjakI patnIle yo avasthA dekhepachi bhanin– yahI ho tyo vyakti jasako bAremA timIharU mero badanAma gardai thiyau | sA~ccikai maile usalAI phakAune prayAsa garekI thie~ tara U mero phandAmA Aena | yadi usale mero kurA mAnena bhane nizcaya nai usalAI kaida garinecha ra dherai apamAnita hunecha |

33 yUsupha (alaihissalAma) le duA (prArthanA) gare– he mero pAlanakartA! juna azlIla kAryatarpha yo mahilAle malAI bolAu~daichin tyasabhandA baDhI priya ta kArAgAra nai cha jasako dhamkI diMdaichin | yadi tapAIMle tinakA SaDyantrabATa malAI jogAunubhaena bhane ma tinIharUko jAlamA phasnechu ra ajJAnIharUmadhye hunechu |

34 allAhale unako duA (prArthanA) lAI svIkAra garnubhayo | ajIjakI patnI ra zaharakA mahilAharUko SaDayantrabATa jogAunubhayo | nissandeha allAhale yUsupha (alaihissalAma) lagAyata sabai duA garneharUko duA sunnuhuncha ra unIsameta sabaiko avasthAbATa avagata hunuhuncha |
35 ajIja ra zaharakA aguvAharUle yUsupha (alaihissalAma) ko pavitratAkA pramANa dekhepachi badanAmIbATa bacnako lAgi yUsupha (alaihissalAma) lAI anizcita kAlakA lAgi kArAgAramA hAlne nirNaya gare |

36 tinIharUle yUsupha (alaihissalAma) lAI kArAgAramA hAlidie | unIsa~gai anya duI janA vyaktiharU pani kArAgAramA praveza gare | tI duImadhye ekajanAle bhanyo– maile sapanAmA ke dekheko chu bhane aGgurabATa madirA banAu~daichu | arkole bhanyo– maile sapanAmA ke dekheko chu bhane ma Aphno TAukomAthi roTI bokeko chu jasabATa paMkSIharU khA~daichan | he yUsupha! hAmIlAI sapanAko abhiprAya batAidinuhos | hAmro dRSTimA tapAIM sukarmI hunuhuncha |

37 yUsupha (alaihissalAma) le bhane– timIharUlAI diine sarakArI bhojana timIharUsamakSa AunubhandA aghi nai ma timIharUlAI sapanAko artha batAidine chu | malAI mero pAlanakartAle sapanAko artha batAune jJAna sikAunubhaeko cha | yo kunai jyotiSIko aDkalabAjI hoina | maile tI mAnisaharUko dharma choDisakeko chu jo allAha ra Akhiratako dinamAthi ImAna rAkhdainan |

38 ma AphnA pUrvaja ibrAhIma, ishAka ra yAkUba (alaihimussalAma) ko dharmako anusaraNa gardaichu | tyo allAhalAI eka mAnne dharma ho | allAhasa~ga kunai cijalAI sAjhedAra banAunu hAmro lAgi ThIka chaina | uhA~ eka mAtra hunuhuncha | allAhako vizeSa kRpAle ma ra merA pUrvajaharU ekezvaravAdI ra momina (AsthAvAn) hauM | sabai mAnisaharUtarpha sandeSTAharU paThAunu pani allAhako kRpA ho | tara adhikAMsa mAnisaharU yastA varadAnaharUkA lAgi allAhaprati AbhAra vyakta gardainan baru kRtaghna chan |

39 pheri yUsupha (alaihissalAma) le kArAgAramA rahekA duI janA vyaktiharUlAI sambodhana garera bhane– ke aneka IzvaraharUko pUjA rAmrA ho vA mAtra eka allAhako bhakti josa~ga kohI sAjhedAra chaina ra jasalAI sabaimAthi prabhutva prApta cha?

40 allAhabAheka timIharU ja-jasako pUjA garchau tinIharU kevala nAma mAtra hun, juna timIharU tathA timrA purvajaharUle racekA hun | bhaktimA tinIharUko kunai sAjhedArI chaina | timIharUle rAkheko nAma ThIka ho bhannebAre allAhale kunai pramANa avataraNa garnubhaekai chaina | sabai sRSTimAthi allAhakai zAsana-sattA calcha | timI ra timrA pUrvajaharUle rAkhekA nAmaharUko sattA-zAsana caldaina | allAhako Adeza cha– mAtra uhA~kai upAsanA gara | AphUsa~ga kasailAI sAjhedAra banAunabATa uhA~le manAhI garnubhaeko cha | yahI sIdhA dharma ho, jo alikati pani bAGgo TiGgo chaina | tara adhikAMsa mAnisaharU yo kurA jAndainan | tyasaile tinIharU zirka garchan ra kehI sRSTiko pUjA garchan |

41 he merA kArAgArakA duvai sAthIharU! timIharU duvaimadhye pahilo vyakti jasale aGgUrabATa madirA banAune sapanA dekheko cha U kArAgArabATa rihA gariepachi Aphno kAmamA pharkanecha ra Aphno mAlikalAI madirA pilAunecha | Aphno TAukomAthi roTI cha jasalAI paMkSIharU khA~daichana bhanne sapanA dekheko dosro vyaktilAI zUlI caDhAinecha ra hatyA garinecha | marepachi usako TAukokA mAsulAI paMkSIharUle luchera khAnechan | timIharUle sodhekA praznaharUko javApha purA bhayo | nissandeha yastai hunecha |

42 yUsupha (alaihissalAma) le tI duvaimadhye rihA bhaera rAjAlAI madirApAna garAune vyaktilAI bhane– rAjAsamakSa mero muddA-mAmilAko carcA garnu | AzA cha unale malAI kArAgArabATa rihA garnechan | tara zaitAnale usalAI rAjAsamakSa carcA garna bhulAidiyo, jasale gardA unI kehI varSasamma kArAgAramai rahe |

43 rAjAle bhane– maile sapanAmA sAtavaTA moTA gAIharUlAI anya sAtavaTA dublA gAIharUle khA~dai gareko dekhe | sAtavaTA annakA hariyA bAlA thie ra anya sAtavaTA sukekA bAlA thie | he samarthakaharU ho! yadi timIharU sapanAko artha batAune jJAna cha bhane mero sapanAko artha batAU |
44 tinIharUle bhane– yI arthahIna sapanAharU hun | yastA sapanAharUko kunai artha hu~daina | hAmIlAI yastA arthahIna sapanAko artha thAhA chaina |

45 kArAgArabATa rihA bhaeko madirApAna garAune vyaktilAI dherai samayapachi yUsupha (alaihissalAma) ra sapanAko artha batAune kurA yAda Ayo | usale bhanyo– rAjAle dekheko sapanAko artha ekajanA jAnakAralAI sodhera ma batAunechu | he mahArAja! malAI yUsupha (alaihissalAma) kahA~ jAne anumati dinuhos, tAki unale tapAIMko sapanAko artha batAun |

46 tyo vyakti yUsupha (alaihissalAma) kahA~ pugera bhanyo, he saccA yUsupha! hAmIlAI euTA sapanAko artha batAU– sAtavaTA moTA tAjA gAIlAI anya sAtavaTA dublA kamajora gAIle khA~daichan | sAtavaTA annakA hariyA bAlA chan ra anya sAtavaTA sukekA bAlA chan | tAki ma rAjA ra unakA samarthakaharUsamakSa pharkera sapanAko artha batAu~ | unIharUle sapanAko artha jAnepachi timro mahatva ra sthAnalAI jAnnechan |

47 yUsupha (alaihissalAma) le sapanAko artha batAu~dai bhane– timIharU sAta varSa lagAtAra mehanatakA sAtha khetI gara | annalAI tyasako bAlAmai rahana deU tAki tyasamA kirA nalAgos | AvazyakatA anusAra mAtra bAlAbATa nikAla |

48 tyasapachi bhokamarIkA kaThina sAta varSaharU Aunechan | tyasa avadhimA tI sabai annaharU grahaNa garinechan juna timIharUle jammA garera rAkhekA hunechau | timIharUle jogAera rAkheko annabATa biu mAtra bA~kI rahanecha |
49 tyasapachi euTA yasto varSa Aunecha jasamA dherai varSA hunecha | tyasa varSa khuba dherai khetI hunecha | mAnisaharUle aGgura, jaitUna tathA u~khubATa AvazyakatA anusAra madirA banAunechan |

50 jaba yUsupha (alaihissalAma) le batAeko sapanAko artha pugyo taba rAjAko Adeza bhayo– yUsupha (alaihissalAma) lAI kArAgArabATa nikAlera hAjira gara | jaba rAjAko dUta yUsupha (alaihissalAma) lAI bolAunako lAgi Ayo taba yUsupha (alaihissalAma) le bhane– timI rAjAkahA~ jAU ra juna mahilAharUle AphnA hAta ghAite pArekA thie tinIharUko vAstavika mAmilA ke ho bhanI sodha | tAki kArAgArabATa niskanuaghi ma nirdoSa bhaeko kurA charlaGga hos | mahilAharUle masa~ga jabarjastI garnako lAgi gareko prayAsabAre merA pAlanakartAlAI rAmrosa~ga thAhA cha | uhA~bATa kunai pani kurA lukeko chaina |

51 rAjAle mahilAharUlAI sodhe– tyasa samaya ke bhaeko thiyo jaba timIharUle yUsupha (alaihissalAma) sa~ga azlIla kArya garne prayAsa garekA thiyau? tinIharUle rAjAlAI bhane– hAmI allAhako zaraNa cAhanchauM! yUsupha (alaihissalAma) mAthi kunai pani Aropa lagAunu ThIka hoina | hAmIharUle unamA kunai kisimako truTi pAenau | ajIjakI patnIle je jati calakhela garekI thiin tyasalAI svIkAra gardai bhanin– aba satya kurA spaSTa bhaisakyo | maile nai unalAI phakAune prayAsa garekI thie~ | unale malAI phakAune prayAsa garekA thienan | unImAthi lagAieko Aropasa~ga unako kunai sarokAra chaina |

52 ajIjakI patnIle bhanin– yUsupha (alaihissalAma) lAI thAhA hos ki maile nai unalAI phakAune prayAsa garekI thie~ | ma yasa kurAlAI svIkAra garchu | unI saccA chan | ma unako anupasthitimA unImAthi Aropa lagAu~dina | allAhale jhUTo bolne tathA SaDayantra garnelAI maddata garnuhunna bhanne kurA charlaGga bhayo |

53 ajIjakI patnIle kurA thapin– kAmavAsanA purA garne prayAsabATa ma cokho chu bhanne dAbI gardina | nissandeha mAnavalAI manale duSkarma garna prerita garcha | yasabATa tyastA mAnisaharU mAtra bacna sakchan jasamAthi allAhako vizeSa kRpA huncha ani duSkarmabATa bacAunuhuncha | nissandeha mero pAlanakartA allAhale taubA garne bhaktaharUlAI mApha garnuhuncha ra unIharUmAthi dayA garnuhuncha |

54 yUsupha (alaihissalAma) nirdoSa raheko tathya khulepachi rAjAle AphnA sahayogIharUlAI bhane– yUsuphalAI mero pAsamA hAjira gara | ma unalAI Aphno nikaTtama banAunechu | tinIharUle yUsupha (alaihissalAma) lAI rAjAko pAsamA hAjira gare | unIsa~ga kurA garepachi unako jJAna tathA buddhibATa rAjA dherai prabhAvita bhae | unale bhane– he yUsupha! timI Ajadekhi hAmIkahA~ ucca padastha, sammAnita ra vizvAsIlo bhayau |
55 yUsupha (alaihissalAma) le rAjAlAI bhane– malAI misrako dhana ra khAdyapadArtha rakSA garne jimmevArI dinuhos | ma vizvAsIlo koSAdhyakSa banna sakchu | yasabAremA malAI rAmro jJAna cha |

56 hAmIle yasarI yUsupha (alaihissalAma) lAI kArAgArabATa mukta garera ra misramA sattA pradAna garera upakAra garyauM | unI jahA~ cAhanthe jAne garthe ra basobAsa garne garthe | hAmI juna bhaktalAI cAhanchauM duniyA~mA kRpA garchauM | hAmI satkarmIharUko puNya barbAda pArdainauM | kamI nagarikana purA-purA dine garchauM |
57 allAhakA AdezaharUko pAlanA garera ra varjita kAryaharUlAI tyAgera uhA~sita DarAune mominaharUkA lAgi Akhiratako badalA saMsArako badalAbhandA dherai uttama cha |

58 yUsupha (alaihissalAma) kA dAjubhAiharU AphnA sAmAna liera misramA praveza gare | yUsuphako najikai Aepachi yI merA dAjubhAiharU hun bhanI unale cinihAle | tara tinIharUle yUsupha (alaihissalAma) hAmro bhAi ho bhanera cinna sakenan | kinabhane tinIharUle unalAI InAramA phyA~kdA sAno bAlaka thie ra yati lAmo avadhi bitepachi unako raGga rUpa badali sakeko thiyo |

59 yUsupha (alaihissalAma) le tinIharUlAI tinIharUko mAga anusAra anAja die | tinIharUko eka janA sautelo bhAi pani cha bhanne kurA tinIharUle bhanepachi yUsupha (alaihissalAma) le bhane– aba Au~dA sautelo bhAilAI pani liera Aunu | ma thapa eka U~Ta anAja dinechu | tapAIMharUle dekhnu bhaena, maile tapAIMharUlAI kama garera sAmAna diena baru rAmrarI thapera dieko chu ra rAmrosa~ga satkAra gareko chu |

60 yadi tapAIMharUle bhAilAI liera Aunuhunna bhane tapAIMharUko sautelo bhAi pani cha bhanne dAbImA tapAIMharU jhUTo Thahara hunuhuncha | unalAI liera Aunuhunna bhane tapAIMharUlAI anAja mildaina, ma kahA~ naAunu holA |
61 dAjubhAiharUle bhane– hAmI buvAsa~ga mAga garchauM | tapAIMko Adeza anusAra unalAI liera Aune sakabhara prayAsa garchauM |

62 yUsupha (alaihissalAma) le karmacArIharUlAI bhane– tinIharUkA mUladhana phirtA garideU tAki tinIharU ghara pharkepachi hAmIle tinIharUbATa mUlya lienauM bhanne kurA jAnnechan ani bhAilAI liera pharkana bAdhya hunechan | tAki tinIharU Aphno satyatAlAI yUsupha (alaihissalAma) samakSa pramANita garnechan ra unale mUla dhanalAI svIkAra garnechan |

63 jaba tinIharU AphnA pitAsamakSa puge taba tinIharUle yUsupha (alaihissalAma) le gareko pAhunA satkArabAre batAe | tinIharUle bhane– buvA! yadi hAmI Aphno bhAilAI liera gaenauM bhane hAmIlAI anna mildaina | hAmIsa~ga hAmro bhAilAI pani jAne anumati dinuhos, tAki anna liera Auna sakauM | hAmI usako rakSA garne vAcA garchauM | tapAIMsamakSa usalAI surakSita liera AunechauM |

64 yAkUba (alaihissalAma) le bhane– ke ma usako bAremA timIharUmAthi tyasarI nai bharosA garU~ jasarI yasabhandA pahile usako sAkhkhai dAju yUsupha (alaihissalAma) ko bAremA gareko thie~?! timIharUmAthi maile yUsupha (alaihissalAma) ko bAremA bharosA gareM, tara timIharUle vizvAsaghAta garyau | timIharUko vAcAmAthi malAI bharosA rahena | ma allAhamAthi mAtra bharosA garchu | uhA~ uttama rakSaka ra sarvazreSTha dayAlu hunuhuncha |

65 jaba tinIharUle Aphno sAmAna khole taba AphnA mUladhana pani pharkAieko pAe | tinIharUle bhane– buvA! hAmIlAI ke cAhiyo? hernus, hAmIle dieko mUladhana (dAma) pani phirtA garieko cha | aba hAmIlAI tyasa ajIjabATa kasto satkAra cAhiyo | aba tyasa ajIjale kRpA gardai phirtA gareko mUladhanabATa AphnA parivArakA lAgi thapa khAdyAnna lyAunechauM ra Aphno bhAiko rakSA pani garnechauM | bhAiko kAraNale euTA U~Tale bokna sakne jati khAdyAnna thapa prApta garnechauM | yati khAdyAnna ta sajilai prApta hunecha |

66 yAkUba (alaihissalAma) le bhane: jabasamma timIharU allAhalAI sAkSI rAkhera usalAI ma samakSa phirtA liera Aunechau bhanera vAcA gardainau tabasamma ma usalAI timIharUsa~ga paThAudina | timIharU sabai saGkaTamA parchau vA gherinechau, jasle gardA sabai mArinechau vA phirtA Auna sakdainau bhane yo beglai kurA ho | jaba tinIharUle allAhalAI sAkSI rAkhera vAcA gare, taba yAkUba (alaihissalAma) le bhane: hAmIle bhaneko kurAmA allAha sAkSI hunuhuncha | uhA~ko sAkSI hAmro lAgi paryApta cha |

67 unIharUkA buvAle upadeza diMdai bhane– he merA chorAharU! timIharU euTai DhokAbATa ekasAtha misramA praveza nagarnu baru alaga-alaga DhokAharUbATa praveza garnu | tAki kasaile kaSTa puryAuna khojemA sabailAI kaSTa puryAuna nasakos | ma timIharUlAI allAhako cAhanA viparIta na kaSTa nivAraNa garna sakchu na phAidA puryAuna sakchu | Adeza ta mAtra allAhakai calcha | mero pUrNa bharosA uhA~mAthi cha | sabai bharosA garneharUle Aphno mAmilAmA uhA~mAthi nai bharosA garnuparcha |

68 tinIharU yUsupha (alaihissalAma) kA sAkhkhai bhAilAI liera hi~De | AphnA buvAko Adeza anusAra tinIharU alaga-alaga DhokAharUbATa praveza gare | tara tinIharUko yo upAya allAhako nirNayalAI rokna sakdaina | yo ta kevala yAkUba (alaihissalAma) ko putra-moha thiyo jo unale vyakta garekA thie ra putraharUlAI upadeza diekA thie | je huncha tyo allAhako nirNaya anusAra nai huncha bhanne kurA unalAI thAhA thiyo | hAmIle sikAeko jJAnale gardA unalAI bhAgyamAthi ImAna ra zrota tathA sAdhanako prayoga garne jJAna thiyo | tara, adhikAMsa vyaktiharUlAI thAhA nai chaina |

69 jaba tinIharU yUsupha (alaihissalAma) kA bhAilAI liera unI samakSa puge taba yUsupha (alaihissalAma) le Aphno bhAilAI aMgAlo mAre ra kAnamA sAno svaramA bhane– ma timro sAkhkhai dAju yUsupha hu~ | aba yinIharUle hAmIharUsa~ga jati DAhA ra ghRNA gare pani kunai kaSTa puryAuna sakdainan | yinIharUle nai malAI inAramA phAlekA thie | aba timIle kunai cintA linupardaina |

70 yUsupha (alaihissalAma) le tinIharUko U~TaharUmAthi khAdyAnna rAkhdA AphnA karmacArIharUlAI Aphno bhAiko sAmAnamA unIharUle thAhA napAune garI gallA nApna prayoga garine rAjAko kacaurA (bhA~Do) rAkhidine Adeza die, tAki bhAilAI AphUsa~ga rAkhna sakiyos | jaba tinIharU pharkana thAle taba ekajanAle ghoSaNA garyo– he yAtru-dala! timIharU nizcaya nai cora hau |
71 yUsupha (alaihissalAma) kA dAjubhAiharU tinIharUtarpha pharkera bhane– timIharUko kuna cija harAeko cha? jasako kAraNa hAmIharUmAthi corIko Aropa lagAu~dai chau |

72 karmacArIharUle bhane– rAjAko gallA nApne kacaurA (bhA~Do) harAeko cha, jasale nApera diinthyo | jasale talAzI linuaghi tyo khojera lyAunecha usalAI euTA U~Tale bokna sakne barAbara anna prApta hunecha, jasako jimmA ma liMdaichu |

73 yUsupha (alaihissalAma) kA dAjubhAiharUle bhane– allAhako kasama! nizcaya pani tapAIMle hAmIharUkA vyavahArabATa hAmro imAnadArI ra nirdoSatAko bAremA thAhA pAisaknu bhaeko cha | corIsa~ga hAmro kunai sambandha chaina | hAmI yasa dezamA phasAda maccAuna AekA hoinauM | hAmIle jIvanamA kahile corI garekA chainauM |
74 pukArne vyakti ra anya karmacArIharUle bhaneH yadi timIharU Aphno dAbImA jhUTA pramANita bhayau bhane timIharUkA lAgi ke sajAya hunuparcha?

75 yUsupha (alaihissalAma) kA dAjubhAiharUle bhane– hAmrotira corI garneko lAgi daNDa yo cha ki, jasako sAmAnamA corIko tyo vastu bheTincha tyasalAI nai daNDasvarUpa sAmAna corI bhaeko vyaktiko dAsako rUpamA havAlA garincha | hAmI coraharUlAI yastai sajAya dine garchauM |

76 khoja talAsako lAgi tinIharUlAI yUsupha (alaihissalAma) samma puryAiyo | gopya yojanA anusAra unale bhAiko sAmAnabhandA pahile dAjubhAiharUkA sAmAnako khoja talAsa suru gare | pheri bhAiko sAmAnako khoja talAsa gare ani usako sAmAnabATa harAeko rAjAko kacaurA bAhira nikAle | yasarI hAmIle yUsupha (alaihissalAma) ko lAgi unIharUko dezako kAnuna anusAra bhAilAI sAthamA rAkhna saphala banAyauM | kinabhane misrako kAnuna anusAra unI Aphno bhAilAI tyasarI rokna sakdainathe | misrako kAnuna anusAra unale coralAI sajAya ra daNDa mAtra dina sakthe | tara allAhale cAhemA unako lAgi arko upAya garna saknuhunthyo, kinabhane allAha yasako sAmarthya rAkhnuhuncha | hAmI AphnA bhaktaharUmadhye jasalAI cAhanchauM padonnati garchauM | jasarI hAmIle yUsupha (alaihissalAma) ko padonnati garyauM | pratyeka jJAnI bhandA kohI na kohI ThUlo jJAnI huncha | sabai jJAnIharUbhandA mahAna jJAnI allAha hunuhuncha | uhA~ hareka kurAko jJAna rAkhnuhuncha |

77 yUsupha (alaihissalAma) kA dAjubhAiharUle bhane– he ajIja! yadi yasale coreko ho bhane yo kunai Azcaryako kurA hoina, yasaaghi yasako dAju yUsuphale pani corI gareko thiyo! yUsupha (alaihissalAma) le yasa kurAlAI Aphno manamai lukAirAkhe | tinIharUsamakSa vyakta garenan | unale manamanai bhane– timIharUle pahilA pani ati DAhA garera nikRSTa kArya garyau | allAhale yasa jhUTo kurAlAI rAmrarI jAnnuhuncha |

78 yUsupha (alaihissalAma) kA dAjubhAiharUle unalAI bhane– he ajIja! yasako buvA ati vRddha chan ra unale yasalAI dherai mAyA garchan | tapAIM yasako badalAmA hAmIharUmadhye kasailAI rAkhnus | hAmro dRSTimA tapAIM ati paropakArI hunuhuncha | ataH hAmIharUsa~ga rAmro vyavahAra garnuhos |

79 yUsupha (alaihissalAma) le bhane– nirdoSamAthi atyAcAra garnu ra josa~ga hAmIle rAjAko kacaurA pAekA chauM tyasalAI choDI anya kasailAI samAtnu anyAya ho | hAmI yaso garnabATa allAhako zaraNa cAhanchauM |

80 jaba tinIharU yUsupha (alaihissalAma) ko javAphabATa nirAza bhae taba ekAntamA parAmarza garna thAle | tinIharUkA jeTho dAjule bhane– ma timIharUlAI smaraNa garAu~chu, buvAle timIharUsa~ga allAhako kasama khuvAera dRDha vacana linubhaeko thiyo ki uhA~ko kAncho chorAlAI avazya phirtA liera Aunechau | kahIM bAdhya pAriera gheriyo bhane yo beglai kurA ho | yasaaghi pani timIharUle yUsuphako mAmilAmA galtI garisakekA chau | ataH ma misrabATa pharkera jAnna | mero buvAle misrabATa pharkane anumati dinuhuncha vA allAhale nai mero lAgi bhAilAI liera jAne kunai bATo nikAlnuhuncha bhane mAtra pharkanechu | uhA~ sarvazreSTha nirNAyaka hunuhuncha ra nisApha tathA satyakA sAtha nirNaya garnuhuncha |

81 jeTho dAjule bhane– timIharU sabai buvAkahA~ pharkera jAU ani bhana– buvA! tapAIMko chorole corI garyo tyasaile misrako ajIjale usalAI dAsa banAyo | hAmI ta tyahI bhanna sakchauM jo hAmIle dekhekA chauM | usako sAmAnabATa rAjAko kacaurA (bhA~Do) niskeko hAmIle dekhyauM | usale corI garcha bhanne kurA hAmIlAI thAhA bhaeko bhae hAmIle tapAIMlAI kasama khAera vacana dine thienauM |

82 tapAIM misrakA bAsindAharUlAI sodhnuhos jasako bIcamA hAmI thiyauM | tyasa yAtrudalalAI pani sodhnuhos josa~ga hAmI AyauM | tinIharU sabaile tapAIMlAI yahI kurA batAunechan | hAmI usako corIko bAremA je sUcanA diMdaichauM tyasamA hAmIharU saccA chauM |

83 unIharUkA buvAle bhane– usale corI gareko cha bhanne kurA galata ho | baru timIharUle usako bAremA pani tyastai SaDyantra garekA chau jasto usako dAju yUsupha (alaihissalAma) ko bAremA garekA thiyau | tara ma rAmrarI dhairya garnechu, ani allAhasita nai gunAso garnechu | allAhale yUsupha, usako bhAi ra duvailAI phirtA garAunu hunecha bhanne malAI AzA cha | nissandeha uhA~ mero avasthAbAre avagata hunuhuncha ra mero samasyAko samAdhAnamA tatvadarzI hunuhuncha |

84 yAkUba (alaihissalAma) tinIharUbATa munTo pharkAera TADhA bhae ani bhane– e yUsupha! pIra ra cintAle ru~dA ru~dai unakA A~khAharU setA bhaekA thie | unI ati zokamagna bhaekA thie taipani mAnisaharUbATa zoka ra dukhalAI lukAu~the |

85 yUsupha (alaihissalAma) kA dAjubhAiharUle bhane– he buvA! allAhako kasama! tapAIM sadhaiM yUsuphalAI nai yAda garirahanu huncha | yahA~samma ki yA ta tapAIM jhana birAmI parnuhuncha yA Aphno jyAna nai gumAunuhuncha |

86 yAkUba (alaihissalAma) le bhane– ma Aphno zoka ra vedanA allAha samakSa mAtra prakaTa garchu | malAI juna kurAko jJAna cha, tyo timIharUlAI chaina | allAha kRpAvAn hunuhuncha, zokAkulako duA (prArthanA) sunnuhuncha ra pIDitalAI badalA dinevAlA hunuhuncha |

87 unIharUkA buvAle bhane– he merA chorAharU! timIharU jAU ani yUsupha ra unakA bhAiko bAremA pattA lagAU | allAhale AphnA bhaktaharUkA samasyAharUmA rAhata dinuhuncha ra dayA garnuhuncha bhanne kurAbATa nirAza nahoU | uhA~ko dayAbATa ta avajJAkArIharU mAtra nirAza hune garchan | kinabhane tinIharU allAhako mahAnatA ra kRpAko bAremA anabhijJa chan |

88 tinIharUle buvAko Adezako pAlanA gardai yUsupha (alaihissalAma) kahA~ pugera bhane– hAmI ra hAmrA parivAralAI saGkaTa ra garibIle ghereko cha | hAmIle ati thorai dhana lyAekA chauM | ataH hAmIlAI bharapura anna pradAna garnuhos ra dAna pani garnuhos | allAhale dAna garnelAI nizcaya nai uttama pratidAna pradAna garnuhuncha |

89 jaba yUsupha (alaihissalAma) le tinIharUkA kurA sune taba tinIharUmAthi dayA Ayo | unale Aphno pahicAna kholdai sodhe– yUsupha ra unako bhAisa~ga gareko vyavahAra tapAIMharUlAI yAda cha ki chaina?!

90 tinIharUle Azcarya prakaTa gardai bhane– ke tapAIM nai yUsupha hunuhuncha ra?! unale bhane– ho, ma yUsupha hu~ ra yo mero sAkhkhai bhAi ho | nissandeha allAhale hAmIprati upakAra garnubhayo | narAmro avasthAbATa mukti pradAna garnubhayo ra hAmro sthAnalAI ucca pArnubhayo | satya yo ho ki juna vyaktiharU allAhakA AdezaharUko pAlanA garera, varjita kAryaharUlAI tyAgera uhA~sa~ga DarAu~chan ra saGkaTamA dhairyadhAraNa garchan, allAhale tyastA sukarmIharUko pratiphalalAI kadApi naSTa garnuhunna | baru tyasako rakSA garnuhuncha |
91 dAjubhAiharUle mAphi mAgdai bhane– allAhako kasama! uhA~le tapAIMlAI hAmIharUmAthi zreSThatA pradAna garnubhayo | vAstavamA hAmI nai doSI ra atyAcArI thiyauM |

92 yUsupha (alaihissalAma) le tinIharUko mAphI svIkAra gardai bhane–tapAIMharUmAthi Aja kunai doSako kAraNa dhikkAra ra nindA chaina | allAhale tapAIMharUlAI kSamA garun bhanI duA (prArthanA) garchu | uhA~ ati dayAvAn hunuhuncha |

93 buvAle ru~dA-ru~dA A~khAko jyoti gumAeko khabara sunepachi unale Aphno kamija diMdai bhane– mero yo kamija liera jAnuhos ra merA buvAko anuhAramA rAkhnuhos | uhA~ko A~khAko jyoti pharkinecha ani AphnA sampUrNa parivAraharUlAI liera makahA~ Aunuhos |

94 jaba yAtru-dala misrabATa niskiyo, taba yAkUba (alaihissalAma) le AphnA chorAharU variparI rahekA mAnisaharUlAI bhane– timIharUle malAI yo bUDho ta khuskecha kyAre, abujha ra ke bole bhanne pani thAhA napAune bhaecha nabhanne ho bhane malAI ta yUsuphako sugandha Airaheko cha |
95 unako sAthamA bhaeko chorA ra anya mAnisaharUle bhane– allAhako kasama! tapAIM yUsuphako sthiti ra unalAI bheTane sambhAvanAko bAremA ahilesamma purAnai bhramamA hunuhuncha |

96 zubhasUcanA liera jAne vyaktile yUsupha (alaihissalAma) ko kamija yAkUba (alaihissalAma) ko anuhAramAthi rAkhyo, jasale gardA unako A~khAko jyoti pharkera Ayo | unale santAnaharUlAI bhane– ma allAhakA tI kRpA tathA upakArako bAremA jAndachu juna timIharU jAndainau bhanera ke maile timIharUlAI bhaneko thiena ra?

97 yAkUba (alaihissalAma) kA santAnaharUle yUsupha (alaihissalAma) ra unakA bhAisa~ga gareko durvyavahAraprati mAphI magdai bhane– he buvA! hAmIharUle yUsupha ra unakA bhAiko bAremA garekA pApaharUkA lAgi allAhasita kSamA yAcanA garidinuhos | nissandeha hAmIharUle yUsupha ra unakA bhAisa~ga durvyavAhara garekA thiyauM |
98 buvAle santAnaharUlAI bhane– ma timIharUkA lAgi AphnA pAlanakartAsa~ga kSamAyAcanA garnechu | nizcaya nai uhA~le taubA garne bhaktaharUlAI mApha ra dayA garnuhuncha |

99 yAkUba (alaihissalAma) Aphno parivArakA sAtha yUsupha (alaihissalAma) lAI bheTna misratarpha prasthAna gare | jaba unIharU yUsupha (alaihissalAma) kahA~ puge taba unale buvA AmA duvailAI aGgAlo mAre | unale dAjubhAiharU ra unIharUkA parivAraharUlAI bhane– misramA tapAIMharUlAI svAgata cha! tapAIMharU yahA~ zAntipUrvaka basobAsa garnuhos | yahA~ tapAIMharUlAI kunai pani kaSTa hunechaina |

100 unale AphnA AmA-buvAlAI AphU basne siMhAsanamA basAe | AmA-buvA ra 11 janA dAjubhAile unI samakSa sajdA gare | yo sajdA unako sammAnako lAgi thiyo, bhaktiko lAgi thiena | yo tyasa Adezako pAlanA thiyo jo allAhale yUsupha (alaihissalAma) lAI sapanAmA dekhAunubhaeko thiyo | yUsupha (alaihissalAma) le bhane– buvA! yo ho tyasa sapanAko artha jo maile dekhepachi tapAIMlAI batAeko thie~ | yasalAI mero pAlanakartAle satya siddha garnubhayo | allAhale kRpA garera malAI kArAgArabATa nikAlnubhayo | ma ra merA dAjubhAiharUbIca zaitAnadvArA sirjita phUTako sthiti pazcAt tapAIharUlAI gAu~bATa yahA~ puryAunubhayo | vAstavamA merA pAlanakartAle cAhanu bhaekA kAryaharU ekadamai sUkSma tarikAle purA garnuhuncha | nissandeha uhA~ AphnA bhaktaharUkA avasthAsita avagata hunuhuncha ra Aphno yojanAmA tatvadarzI hunuhuncha |

101 pheri yUsupha (alaihissalAma) le allAhasita duA gare– he mero pAlanakartA! tapAIMle nai malAI misramA sattA pradAna garnubhayo | tapAIMle nai malAI sapanAko arthako jJAna sikAunubhayo | he AkAzaharU tathA dhartIkA sRSTikartA! tapAIM nai loka ra paralokamA merA sabai mAmilAkA saMrakSaka hunuhuncha | malAI muslima (AjJApAlaka) bhaeko avasthAmA mRtyu dinuhos | malAI merA satkarmI pUrvajaharU ra sandeSTAharUkA sAtha svargako ucca sthAna phirdausamA praveza garAunuhos |

102 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! yUsupha (alaihissalAma) ra unakA dAjubhAiharUko yo kathA parokSa (tapAIMle nadekhekA) samAcAraharUmadhye ho, jasako vahI (prakAzanA) hAmI tapAIMmAthi gardaichauM | hAmIle nabatAemA tapAIMlAI thAhA hune thiena | kinabhane tapAIM yUsupha (alaihissalAma) ra unakA dAjubhAiharUle gareko SaDyantrako samayamA upasthita hunuhunthena |
103 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! tapAIMle jati saGgharSa gare pani adhikAMsa mAnisaharUle ImAna lyAune chainan | ataH tinIharUko cintAmA Aphno jyAnalAI jokhimamA nahAlnuhos |

104 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! yadi tinIharUle rAmrosa~ga socavicAra garera kAma gareko bhae tapAIMmAthi ImAna lyAune thie | kinabhane tapAIM kurAna ra ahvAnako saTTAmA kunai badalA mAgnuhunna | kurAna ta sampUrNa mAnavajAtikA lAgi euTA zikSA ra upadeza ho |
105 allAha eka mAtra hunuhuncha bhanne kurAko dherai nizAnIharU AkAzaharU ra dhartImA phailiekA chan | tI nizAnIharU bhaekA bhUmibATa tinIharU hiDne gardachan tara tyasamA cintana manana gardainan |

106 allAha nai sRSTikartA, pAlanakartA, jIvana ra mRtyu dAtA hunuhuncha bhanne kurAmAthi yinIharUmadhye adhikAMsa mAnisaharU ImAna rAkhchan tara uhA~ko bhaktikA sAtha sAthai mUrti ra anya pUjyaharUko pani pUjA garchan | tinIharUle allAhako santAna cha bhanne kurAko pani dAbI garchan | jabaki allAha yI kurAharUbATa pavitra hunuhuncha |

107 ke yI bahudevavAdIharU allAhako prakopa vA akasmAta hune mahApralayabATa nizcinta chan jasalAI tinIharU na mahasusa garna sakne chan na tyasako tayArI garna sakne chan | tyasaile tinIharU ImAna lyAirahekA chainan?!

108 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! bhanidinuhos– yo mero tarikA ho | ma spaSTa pramANakA sAtha mAnavalAI allAhatarpha ahvAna gardachu ra merA anuyAyIharU pani mero pada cinhako anusaraNa gardai ahvAna gardachan | allAha tI kurAharUbATa pavitra hunuhuncha juna kurA tinIharUle uhA~sa~ga joDchan | tyastA kurAharU uhA~ko zAna ra pUrNatAsa~ga mela khA~dainan | ma allAhasa~ga kasailAI sAjhedAra banAu~daina | ma ta kevala ekezvaravAdIharU madhyeko hu~ |

109 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! hAmIle tapAIMbhandA pahile pani mAnavamadhye puruSalAI nai rasUla banAera paThAyauM phariztAlAI paThAenauM | jasarI tapAIMmAthi vahI (prakAzanA) garyauM tyasarI unIharUmAthi pani vahI garyauM | sabai sandeSTAharU zaharabATa thie gAu~bATa thienan | tinIharUkA samudAyaharUle tinIharUlAI jhUTo Thahara gare | ani hAmIle tinIharUlAI naSTa pAryauM | ke tapAIMlAI jhUTlAuneharUle dhartImA ghumaphira garenan, dekhenan ra nasihata hAsila garenan ki tinIharUbhandA aghikA jhUTlAuneharUko pariNAma ke kasto bhayo?! Izabhaya rAkhneharUkA lAgi AkhiratamA rahekA varadAnaharU nai uttama rahekA chan | ke timIharU yo kurA bujhdainau ra allAhakA AdezaharUko pAlanA garera ani varjita kurAharUbATa bacera uhA~sa~ga DarAu~dainau? allAhakA AdezaharUmadhye sabaibhandA utkRSTa satkarma ImAna ho ra varjita kurAharUmadhye sabaibhandA nikRSTa kurA zirka ho |

110 rasUlaharUkA zatruharUlAI hAmIle maukA diyauM ra cA~Dai samAtenauM | yahA~samma ki jaba rasUlaharU nirAza bhae ra unIharUle dieko prakopako dhamkIlAI mAnisaharUle jhUTA ThAne taba akasmAta hAmro sahayoga unIharUkahA~ pugyo | jhUTA Thahara garne aparAdhIharUlAI hAmro prakopale gheryo | hAmIle rasUlaharU ra mominaharUlAI tyasabATa surakSita rAkhyauM |

111 nissandeha rasUlaharU, unIharUkA samudAyaharU, yUsupha (alaihissalAma) ra unakA dAjubhAiharUko satya kathAmA buddhi ra vivekale kAma lineharUkA lAgi ThUlo upadeza cha | kurAnamA ullekhita kurAharU satya hun, kAlpanika hoinan | yasale aghillA AkAzIya kitAbaharUko puSTi gardacha | yasamA sabai Avazyaka Adeza, kAnuna ra bhalAikA nirdezanaharU chan | yo mominaharUkA lAgi dayA ho | yasabATa unIharU nai phAidA uThAune garchan |

1 (alipha0 lAma0 mIma0 rA0) yastA akSaraharUko vyAkhyA sUraha al-bakarahako ArambhamA bhaisakeko cha | he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! yasa sUrahakA utkRSTa AyataharU ra tapAIMmAthi avatarita kurAna nitAnta satya hun, yasamA kunai zaGkA chaina | ho, yo allAhako tarphabATa avatarita grantha ho bhanne kurAmA kunai zaGkA chaina | tara, adhikAMsa mAnisaharU ghamaNDa ra zatrutAko kAraNale ImAna lyAu~dainan |

2 allAhale nai binA kunai khambA AkAzaharUlAI mAthi uThAunubhayo | pheri uhA~ Aphno arza (siMhAsana) mAthi Aphno zAna anusAra virAjamAna hunubhayo | uhA~le nai sUrya ra candramAlAI sRSTiko sevAmA niyamita khaTAunubhayo | sUrya ra candramA duvai euTA nirdhArita samayako lAgi kAryarata chan | allAhale Aphno cAhanA anusAra AkAzaharU ra pRthvImA sampUrNa kArya saJcAlana garirahanu bhaeko cha | uhA~le Aphno zakti spaSTa pArne nizAnIharU batAunuhuncha | AzA cha, timIharUle mahApralayako dina AphnA pAlanakartAsa~ga bheTa garne kurAmA vizvAsa garnechau ra yasako lAgi satkarma garera tayArI garnechau |

3 allAhale nai pRthvIlAI pharAkilo pArnubhayo | uhA~le tyasamA sthira pahADa banAunubhayo tAki tyo mAnisaharUlAI liera nahalliyos | uhA~le tyasamA nadI nAlAharU banAunubhayo tAki tyasabATa mAnava, janAvara ra boTa biruvAlAI pAnI milos | uhA~le phalaphulaharU ra janAvaraharUmA bhAle pothI banAunubhayo | uhA~le nai dinalAI rAtabATa chopnuhuncha jasale gardA tyo andhakAra hunapugcha | nissandeha yo pRthvIko sRSTimA cintana manana garneharUkA lAgi prazasta pramANaharU chan | unIharU nai tI pramANaharUbATa phAidA uThAu~chan |

4 pRthvImA eka arkAsita milekA vibhinna prakArakA bhUbhAgaharU chan | pRthvImA aGgurakA bagaiMcA, khetIpAtI ra khajurakA rUkhaharU chan | kunai phalamA vibhinna hA~gAharU chan bhane kunaimA euTai cha | yI sabai bagaiMcA ra khetIharU ekai kisimako pAnIbATa siMcAi garinchan | tara hAmI kehI phalalAI dherai svAdiSTa ra baDhI lAbhadAyaka banAidinchauM ra kehIlAI kama svAdiSTa ra kama lAbhadAyaka | nissandeha yasamA vivekale kAma line vyaktiharUkA lAgi pramANaharU chan | kinabhane yastA vyaktiharU nai upadeza grahaNa garchan |

5 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! yadi tapAIM Azcarya mAnnuhuncha bhane punarjIvita hune kurAlAI jhUTalAuneharUdekhi Azcarya mAnnuhos | tinIharU bhanchan– jaba hAmI marepachi saDera mATo banisakekA hunechauM taba ke hAmI punaH jIvita pArinechauM?! yinIharU nai hun jasale AphnA pAlanakartAlAI inkAra gare | yinIharUkA gardhanamA mahApralayako dina Agoko janjira hAlinecha | yinIharU nai narkabAsI hun jahA~ sadAsarvadA rahanechan | yinIharU nata kahile marnechan, na yinIharUko yAtanAmA kamI garinecha |

6 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! yI bahudevavAdIharU prakopako lAgi hatAra gardaichan | allAhakA kRpAharU pUrNa hunuaghi nai prakopa Aos bhanne kAmanA gardaichan | jaba ki yasa aghi kaiyauM samudAharUlAI prakopale samAtisakeko cha | tara tinIharU yasabATa upadeza liirahekA chainan | he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! tapAIMkA pAlanakartAle mAnisaharUlAI tinakA atyAcArakA bAvajuda pani mApha garnuhuncha, tatkAlai prakopa napaThAera tinIharUlAI taubA garne maukA dinuhuncha | uhA~le kuphramA jiddI garera aDiga rahaneharU ra taubA nagarneharUlAI kaThora daNDa dinuhuncha |

7 kAphiraharU zatrutAmA bhandachan– muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) mAthi uhA~kA pAlanakartAko tarphabATa kunai nizAnI kina avataraNa gariena jasarI mUsA ra IsA (alaihimassalAma) mAthi avataraNa gariyo? he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)– tapAIM mAtra sacetaka hunuhuncha | mAnisaharUlAI allAhako prakobATa DarAunuhuncha | tapAIMsa~ga tI camatkAraharU mAtra chan jo allAhale tapAIMlAI dinubhaeko cha | pratyeka samudAyako lAgi ekajanA sandeSTA chan jo tinIharUlAI satyako nirdezana dinchan |

8 pratyeka garbhavatIko garbhamA ke cha, tyasamA ke ghaTabaDha huncha, svasthya cha ki rogI cha bhanne kurAko jJAna allAhalAI cha | uhA~le hareka cijako nizcita mApa ra samaya toknubhaeko cha | tyasamA ghaTabaDha hu~daina |

9 allAha mAnisaharUle mahasusa garirahekA ra mahasusa nagarekA vastuharUlAI pani rAmrarI jAnnuhuncha | uhA~ AphnA guNa ra nAmamA mahAn hunuhuncha | uhA~ Aphno astitva ra guNamA sabai sRSTiharUbhandA mAthi hunuhuncha |

10 he mAnava! allAha gopya kurAharU pani jAnnuhuncha | timIharUmadhye kasaile sAno svaramA kurA garos vA ThUlo svaramA, kohI rAtako andhakAramA mAnisaharUko A~khAbATa lukera kehI gareko hos vA dinako ujyAlomA hos, allAhalAI sabai kurAharUko jAnakArI cha |

11 pratyeka vyaktiko agADi ra pachADi uhA~le phariztAharU khaTAunubhaeko cha, jo allAhako Adezale pAlai pAlo usako rekhadekha garchan | kasaiko pAlo rAtamA huncha bhane kasaiko dinamA | unIharU mAnavakA satkarma ra duSkarmaharUlAI lekhchan | allAhale kunai samudAyako rAmro avasthAlAI narAmro avasthAmA tabasamma parivartana garnuhunna jabasamma usale Aphno avasthAlAI svayam kRtaghnatA tathA avajJAdvArA badaldaina | jaba allAhale kunai samudAyamAthi prakopa lyAera sakhApa pArne nirNaya garnuhuncha taba tyasalAI kasaile bacAuna sakdaina | he mAnava! timIharUkA saGkaTaharU nivAraNa garne allAhabAheka kohI chaina | ataH allAhakai zaraNa khoja |

12 he mAnavaharU! allAha nai timIharUlAI bijulIko camaka dekhAunuhuncha, ani tyasadvArA timIharUbhitra caTyAGko Dara ra varSAko AzA pani jagAunuhuncha | uhA~le nai musaladhAre varSAle bhariekA bAklA bAdalaharU sRjanA garnuhuncha |

13 bijulIko garjanale allAhako mahimA varNana garcha ra phariztAharUle pani allAhakai Darale AdarapUrvaka uhA~ko prazaMsAkA sAtha pavitratAko guNagAna garchan | uhA~ nai jasalAI cAhanuhuncha caTyAGgabATa barbAda pArnuhuncha | kAphiraharU ekezvaravAdamA vAda-vivAda garchan | allAha avajJAkArIharUkA nimti sarvazaktimAn hunuhuncha | uhA~le je cAhanuhuncha garerai chADnuhuncha |

14 mAtra eka allAhalAI nai pukArnu satya ho | uhA~ko kohI sAjhedAra chaina | uhA~ bAheka bahudevavAdIharU juna devI devatAharUlAI pukArchan tinIharUle kunai javApha dina sakdainan | mUrtiharUlAI pukArnu yastai ho jastai kunai tirkhAlu pAnItarpha Aphno hAta phailAu~cha tAki usako mukhamA pAnI pugos | jabaki pAnItarpha hAta phailAu~daimA pAnI mukhamA pugdaina | kAphiraharUle mUrtiharUlAI pukArnu khera nai jAncha | kinabhane tinIharUle nata lAbha puryAuna sakchan na hAnilAI TArna sakchan |

15 AkAzaharU ra dhartImA rahekA sabai allAha samakSa nai natamastaka chan, momina ra kAphira pani allAha samakSa natamastaka hunchan | mominale icchApUrvaka allAha samakSa sajdA garcha bhane kAphira nacAhera pani vivaza bhaera allAha samakSa natamastaka huncha | kinabhane usako prakRtile nai usalAI jhukna Adeza dincha | tyasaigarI sampUrNa sRSTiharUkA chAyA~harU pani bihAna ra belukA uhA~ samakSa nai jhukchan |

16 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! bahudevavAdIharUlAI sodhnuhos– AkAzaharU tathA dhartIkA sRSTikartA ra yI duvaikA prabandhaka ko hun? bhanidinuhos– allAha mAtra yI duvaikA sRSTikartA ra prabandhaka hunuhuncha ra timIharU yasa kurAlAI svIkAra gardachau | he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! tinIharUlAI bhanidinuhos– ke timIharUle allAhalAI choDera yastA cijaharUlAI Aphno mitra tathA sahayogI banAekA chau jasalAI svayam Aphno lAbha ra hAniko pani sAmarthya chaina? yadi tinIharU svayamalAI lAbha ra hAni puryAuna sakdainan bhane arUlAI kasarI puryAuna sakchan? he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) tinIharUlAI sodhnuhos– ke dRSTivihIna kAphira ra dRSTivAna momina eka samAna huna sakchan? ke andhakAra arthAta kuphra ra prakAza arthAta ImAna eka samAna huna sakchan? ke tinIharUle allAhako sAjhedAra Thahara garekA chan? ke jasarI allAhale sRSTi garnubhaeko cha tyastai tI sAjhedAraharUle pani kehI sRSTi garekA chan ani tinIharUlAI allAhale sRSTi garnubhaekA ra sAjhedAraharUle sRSTi garnubhaekA vastuharU pharaka chuTyAuna gAhro bhairaheko cha? he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! tinIharUlAI bhanidinuhos– allAha mAtra yI sabaikA sRSTikartA hunuhuncha | uhA~ko sRSTimA kohI sAjhedAra chaina | uhA~ mAtra bhakti yogya hunuhuncha | uhA~ hareka vastumAthi prabhutva rAkhnuhuncha |

17 allAhale samApta hune asatya ra bA~kI rahane satyako udAharaNa varSAbATa dinubhaeko cha | jaba AkAzabATa varSA huncha taba sabai sAnA ThUlA nadI nAlAharUbATa pAnI bADhI banera bagcha ra pAnIle jameko phohara mailAlAI bagAidincha | allAhale yasako dosro udAharaNa dinubhaeko cha– jaba mAnisaharU hAta-hatiyAra ra gara-gahanA banAunako lAgi phalAma vA dhAtulAI AgomA tatAu~chan taba tyasabATa phohora phi~ja ra khiyA niskanchan | yasarI allAhale satya ra asatyako udAharaNa prastuta garnuhuncha | phohara ra phi~ja jastai asatya chiTai samApta huncha ra mAnisa, janAvara ra boTabiruvAharUkA lAgi lAbhadAyaka pAnI bA~kI rahe jastai satya bA~kI rahancha | tyasaigarI phi~ja bagepachi asala dhAtu bA~kI rahe jastai satya bA~kI rahancha | yasarI allAhale udAharaNaharU dinuhuncha tAki satya ra asatya spaSTa hos |

18 allAhako ekatva (tauhIda) ko AhvAnalAI svIkAra garera uhA~ko AjJApAlana garne mominaharUkA lAgi ati uttama vAsasthAna svarga cha | uhA~ko ekatva (tauhIda) ko AhvAnalAI asvIkAra garne ra AjJApAlana nagarne kAphiraharUkA lAgi narkako atyantai narAmro vAsasthAna cha | kAphiraharUle pRthvImA bhaekA sampUrNa cijako dobbara dhana-sampatti narkabATa bacna jarimAnAsvarupa die pani tinIharU tyasabATa bacna saknechainan | allAhako AhvAna tathA nimantraNalAI svIkAra nagarne mAnisaharUkA sabai pApa karmaharUko hisAba-kitAba garine cha, ani unIharUko vAsasthAna narka hunecha | kati narAmro vAsasthAna ho narka!

19 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! momina ra kAphira eka samAna huna sakdainan | tapAIMmAthi avatarita kurAna satya ho ra tyasamA kunai sandeha chaina bhanne kurAlAI jAnne ra tyasako pAlanA garne momina ani kurAnalAI namAnne ra allAhakA AdezaharUko pAlanA nagarne andho kAphira barAbara huna sakdaina | vAstavamA buddhimAnaharU mAtra upadeza grahaNa garchan |
20 allAhako AjJApAlana garne mominaharU allAhasa~ga gareko vAcA ra anya mAnisaharUsa~ga gareko vAcA purA garchan | unIharU kahilyai pani kunai vAcA bhaGga gardainan |

21 unIharU tyasa sambandhalAI joDera rAkhchan jasalAI allAhale joDera rAkhne Adeza dinubhaeko cha | AphnA pAlanakartAsita DarAera uhA~kA AdezaharUko pAlanA garchan ra varjita kAryaharUlAI tyAgchan | unIharU allAhale pratyeka pApaharUkA hisAba kitAba linuhunecha bhanera DarAu~chan | kinabhane jasakA pratyeka karmaharUkA hisAba liiyo U barbAda bhayo |

22 mominaharU allAhako prasannatA prApta garnako lAgi uhA~ko AjJApAlanamA aDiga rahanchan | uhA~le nirdhArita garnubhaeko rAmro narAmro bhAgyamAthi dhairya garchan | uhA~ko avajJAbATa bacchan ra pUrNa tarikAle namAja kAyama garchan | hAmIle pradAna garekA sampattiko anivArya haka adA garchan ani tyasabATa suTukkai ra khullama khullA kharca garchan | kasaile unIharUsa~ga narAmro vyavahAra gare pani tyasako badalA upakArale dinchan | yastA vizeSatA bhaekA mominaharUle mahApralayako dina rAmro badalA pAunechan |

23 yo rAmro badalA svarga ho | unIharU tyasamA mojamastIkA sAtha sadhaiM rahanechan | unIharUsa~ga unIharUkA satkarmI pUrvaja, AmAbuvA, pati-patnI ra santAnaharU pani praveza garnechan | yasarI unIharUko ApasI bheTaghATadvArA khuzI ra varadAna purA garinechan | phariztAharU unIharUlAI abhinandana gardai unakA gharakA pratyeka DhokAharUbATa praveza garnechan |

24 phariztAharUle unIharUko abhinandana gardai bhannechan- salAmun alaikuma arthAta timIharUmAthi zAnti hos | aDiga bhaera allAhako AjJApAlana garekAle, uhA~ko kaSTadAyaka phaisalAmA dhairya garekAle ra uhA~ko avajJAbATa bacekAle timIharU sabai kisimakA saGkaTaharUbATa surakSita bhayau | kati utkRSTa cha tinIharUle AkhiratamA pAeko svarga!

allAhale mominaharUkA guNaharU varNana garepachi kAphiraharUkA avaguNaharU batAu~dai bhannubhaeko cha–
25 kAphiraharU allAhasa~ga gareko dRDha vAcAlAI bhaGga garchan | allAhale kAyama rAkhne Adeza dinubhaeko nAtAlAI toDne garchan | uhA~ko avajJA gardai dhartImA AtaGaka maccAune garchan | tyastA abhAgIharU allAhakA kRpAbATa TADhA pArie | tinIharUkA lAgi narAmro badalA cha, tyo ho narka |

26 allAhale AphnA bhaktaharUmadhye jasalAI cAhanuhuncha dherai jIvikA pradAna garnuhuncha ra jasalAI cAhanuhuncha thorai jIvikA pradAna garnuhuncha | dherai ra thorai jIvikA bhAgyamAnI vA abhAgI hune pramANa hoinan | kAphiraharU sAMsArika jIvanamA nai prasanna ra santuSTa chan | jabaki sAMsArika jIvana paralokako jIvanako tulanAmA kSaNika mojamastI mAtra ho |

27 kAphiraharU bhanchan– muhammadamAthi allAhako tarphabATa spaSTa tathA sAkSAta camatkAra kina avataraNa gariena? tyasale uhA~ko satyatAko puSTi garthyo ani hAmI pani ImAna lyAune thiyauM | he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! bhanidinuhos– allAha jasalAI cAhanuhuncha nisAphako AdhAramA pathabhraSTa garnuhuncha ra jasalAI cAhanuhuncha unIharUko taubAlAI svIkAra gardai Aphno kRpAle sIdhA mArga dekhAunuhuncha | mArgadarzana unIharUko hAtamA chaina |

28 mArgadarzana pAekA mAnisaharU mominaharU hun | unIharUkA hRdayale allAhako jikra, pavitratAko guNagAna, prazaMsA, kurAnako pATha ra vibhinna prakArakA anya jikraharUdvArA santuSTi prApta garchan | jAnirAkha, allAhako smaraNabATa nai hRdayaharU santuSTa hune garchan |
29 jo mAnisaharUle allAhamAthi ImAna lyAe ani allAhasa~ga najika garne satkarma gare tinakA lAgi AkhiratamA ati sukhamaya jIvana ra svarga jasto utkRSTa bAsa sthAna hunecha |

30 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! jasarI hAmIle vigatakA rasUlaharUlAI unIharUkA samudAyaharUtarpha paThAyauM, tyasarI nai tapAIMlAI tapAIMko samudAyatarpha paThAyauM | tAki tapAIM tinIharUlAI kurAna paDhera sunAunuhos | yo kurAna hAmIle tapAIMtarpha avataraNa garekA chauM | tapAIM saccA rasUla hunuhuncha bhanne kurA pramANita garnako lAgi yo kitAba paryApta cha | tara tapAIMko samudAyale yasa nizAnIlAI inkAra garcha | kinabhane tinIharU karuNAmaya allAhalAI inkAra garchan ra arUlAI uhA~ko sAthamA sAjhedAra banAu~chan | he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! bhanidinuhos, timIharU juna karuNAmaya allAhasa~ga arUlAI sAjhedAra Thahara garchau uhA~ allAha nai merA pAlanakartA hunuhuncha | vAstavamA, uhA~ bAheka kohI satya pUjya chaina | ma sabai mAmilAmA uhA~mAthi nai bharosA gardachu ra uhA~tarpha nai pharkinechu |

31 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! yadi IzvarIya granthaharUmadhye kunai granthamA pahADaharUlAI hiMDna lagAune, dhartIlAI phuTAera tyasabATa nadI ra mUla nikAlne ani murdAharUsamakSa paDhadA tinIharU jIvita hune vizeSatA hunthyo bhane tyo avazya pani tapAIMmAthi avataraNa bhaeko kurAna nai hunthyo | kinabhane tapAIMmAthi avataraNa bhaeko yo kurAna ati spaSTa ra prabhAvakArI cha, yadi tinIharUkA hRdayamA Izabhaya cha bhane | tara tinIharU inkAra garneharU hun | baru camatkAraharU avataraNa garne sampUrNa adhikAra allAhakai hAtamA cha | ke yasa kurAbATa mominaharUlAI yasa kurAko jAnakArI chaina ki yadi allAhale cAhanubhaeko bhae binAcamatkAra sabailAI mArgadarzana garnuhunthyo? tara allAhale yasto cAhanu bhaena | kAphiraharUmAthi ra tinIharUkA ghara cheuchAumA tinIharUko kuphra ra avajJAle gardA kunai na kunai prakopa nirantara avataraNa bhairahanecha | yahA~samma ki allAhako tarphabATa nirantara Aune yAtanAko vAcA purA hunecha | nirdhArita samaya Aepachi allAhale avazya nai Aphno vAcA anusAra prakopa avataraNa garnuhunecha |

32 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! Aphnai samudAyabATa majAka uDAieko ra jhUTo Thahara garieko tapAIM pahilo rasUla hunuhunna | baru tapAIMbhandA aghi pani rasUlaharUko majAka gariyo ra unIharUlAI jhUTo Thahara gariyo | maile rasUlaharUlAI jhUTA Thahara garneharUlAI maukA pradAna gareM | tinIharUmAthi prakopa avataraNa hunechaina bhanne kurA tinIharUle ThAne | ani tinIharUlAI maukA diepachi maile tinIharUmAthi vibhinna khAlakA prakopaharU paThAe~ | ani, kastA thie merA prakopaharU? nissandeha ati kaDA prakopaharU thie |

33 sampUrNa sRSTikA prANIharUkA annadAtA, jIvikAkA sarakSaka, sabai prANIharUkA karmakA rekhadekhakartA ani tyasako badalA dine eklo allAha upAsanAko adhika hakadAra hunuhuncha vA kehIpani garna nasakne asakSama tI mUrtiharU? kAphiraharUle jabarajastI banAvaTI mUrtiharUlAI allAhasa~ga sAjhedAra banAekA chan | he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! tinIharUlAI bhanidinuhos: yadi timIharU Aphno dAbImA saccA chau bhane tI sAjhedAraharUko nAma batAU jasako bhakti allAhasa~ga garchau, | ke timIharU allAhalAI yastA sAjhedAraharUbAre sUcanA dinchau jasako dhartImA kunai astitva ra vAstavikatA nai chaina? baru kAphiraharUkA lAgi zaitAnale tinIharUkA karmaharU AkarSaka banAeko cha | ani tinIharUle allAhako inkAra gare ra zaitAnale tinIharUlAI satmArgabATa rokyo | jasalAI allAhale pathabhraSTa garnuhuncha usalAI kasaile mArgadarzana garna sakdaina |

34 yastA vyaktiharUlAI sAMsArika jIvanamA mominaharUkA hAtabATa hatyA ra kaidI banAiera yAtanA diinecha | saMsArakA yAtanAbhandA kaThora yAtanA AkhiratamA diinecha, jasale tinIharUlAI parkhiraheko cha | kinabhane tyasa yAtAnamA kaThoratA ra nirantaratA hunecha, tinIharUlAI kayAmatako dina allAhako yAtanAbATa kasaile pani bacAuna sakdaina |

35 allAhakA AdezaharUko pAlanA garera ra varjita kAryaharUlAI tyAgera uha~sita Dara rAkhneharUkA lAgi svargamA yastA mahalaharU hunechan, jasako talabATa nadIharU bagirahekA hunechan | tyasamA kahilyai samApta vA kama nahune phala ra chahArI hunechan | jabaki kAphiraharUko pariNAma narka hunecha, jasamA tinIharU sadhaiM yAtanA bhognechan |

36 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! taurAta pAekA yahUdI ra injIla pAekA IsAIharU tapAIMmAthi avataraNa bhaekA yastA kurAharUsita khusI hunchan jo tinIharUko pustakasa~ga sahamati janAu~chan | tara kehI yahUdI ra IsAIharU yastA kurAharUlAI mana parAu~dainan jo tinIharUko icchA viparIta hunchan vA tinIharUle gareko pherabadala ra vikRtilAI spaSTa pArchan | he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! yinIharUlAI bhanidinuhos– malAI allAhale ke Adeza dinubhaeko cha bhane ma uhA~ko mAtra upAsanA garu~, uhA~sa~ga anya kasailAI pani sAjhedAra Thahara nagaru~, uhA~kai bhaktitarpha mAnisaharUlAI ahvAna garu~ ra arU kasaiko bhaktitarpha ahvAna nagaru~ | uhA~tarpha nai malAI pharkera jAnucha | taurAta ra injIlamA pani yahI kurAharU ullekha chan |

37 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! jasarI hAmIle vigatakA rasUlaharUmAthi unIharUkA bhASAmA kitAba avataraNa garyauM tyasarI nai tapAIMmAthi arabI bhASAmA spaSTa kurAna avataraNa garyauM | he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! yadi tapAIMle yo satya jJAna Aepachi tinIharUkA cAhanAharUko anusaraNa garnuhuncha bhane tapAIMlAI allAhabATa jogAune kohI sahayogI hunechaina | tyasaigarI allAhako prakopabATa bacAune rakSaka pani kohI hunechaina |

38 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! hAmIle tapAIMbhandA pahile mAnavamadhye nai rasUlaharU paThAyauM | tapAIM naulo rasUla hunuhunna | hAmIle unIharUlAI patnI ra santAnaharU pani pradAna garekA thiyauM | phariztAharUmadhye hAmIle rasUla paThAenauM | tapAIM pani tI rasUlaharU jastai mAnava hunuhuncha | ani bahudevavAdIharU tapAIMmAthi Azcarya kina garchan? kunai rasUlalAI allAhako anumati binA kunai pani camatkAra lyAune adhikAra chaina | allAhakA sabai nirNayaharU euTA kitAbamA spaSTa lekhiekA chan | hareka mAmilAko samaya nizcita cha, jasabATa alikati pani agADi pachADi hu~daina |

39 allAhale bhalAi vA nikRSTatA ra zubha vA azubhalAI jati cAhanuhuncha samApta pArnuhuncha ra jati cAhanuhuncha bA~kI rAkhnuhuncha | sabai kurAharU surakSita pATImA lekhisakieko cha, jo uhA~sa~gai cha |

40 he nabI (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! hAmIle bahudevavAdIharUmAthi kehI prakopaharU tapAIMko jIvanamA paThAyauM ra kehI tapAIMko mRtyupachi Aunecha | tapAIMko jimmevArI kevala sandeza puryAunu ho, hisAba line hoina | hisAba linu hAmro jimmAmA ho |

41 ke yI kAphiraharUle dekhenan, hAmI islAmalAI phailAera ra muslimaharUlAI vijaya pradAna garera tinIharU basne bhU-bhAgako sImAlAI cAraitirabATa saGkucita pArdaichauM | allAha AphnA bhaktaharUbIca jasarI cAhanuhuncha nirNaya garnuhuncha | allAhako AdezamA kamI vA pherabadala garera kohI pani uhA~ko nirNayalAI TArna sakdaina | allAha cA~Dai nai hisAba linuhunecha | uhA~le pahilo mAnavadekhi antima mAnavasammakA hisAba kitAbaharU ekai dinamA linuhunecha |

42 vigatakA samudAyaharUle AphnA rasUlaharUviruddha calakhela gare ra unIharUle lyAeko sandezalAI jhUTA Thahara gare | ke tinIharUle AphnA calakhelabATa unIharUko kehI bigArna sake? kehI bigArna sakenan | kinabhane kAma lAgne yojanA mAtra allAhako yojanA huncha | allAha sabai sRSTiharUkA karmaharUlAI jAnnuhuncha | uhA~bATa kehI pani lukeko chaina | yI jhUTA Thahara garneharUle allAhamAthi ImAna nalyAera kati bhayaGkara galtI garekA chan ra mominaharUle ThIka garekA chan bhanne kurA mahApralayako dina thAhA pAunechan | ani mominaharU paralokamA rAmro pariNAmasvarUpa svarga pAunechan |

43 kAphiraharU bhanchan– he muhammada! timI rasUla hoinau | bhanidinuhos– ma allAhako tarphabATa paThAieko rasUla hu~ bhanne kurAmA ma ra timIharUbIca allAhako sAkSI paryApta cha, tyasaigarI yahUdI tathA IsAIharUko granthamA diiekA mero zubhasUcanA pani paryApta cha | jasako sAkSI allAha hunuhuncha usalAI jhUTlAuneharUle je bhane pani pharaka pardaina |

1 (alipha0 lAma0 rA0) yastA akSaraharUko bAremA sUraha al-bakarahako ArambhamA varNana bhaisakeko cha | he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! hAmIle yo kitAba kurAna tapAIMmAthi yasakAraNa avataraNa garekAchauM, tAki tapAIM mAnisaharUlAI unIharUkA pAlanakartAko Adeza tathA sahayogale kuphra, ajJAnatA ra pathabhraSTatAbATa nikAlera ImAna, jJAna, mArgadarzana ra islAmamA lyAunuhos | islAma dharma nai prabhutvazAlI evam prazaMsA yogya allAhako mArga ho |

2 AkAzaharU ra pRthvImA rahekA sabai vastuharUkA sRSTikartA allAha nai hunuhuncha | tyasaile uhA~ mAtra bhakti yogya hunuhuncha | uhA~ko sRSTimadhye kunai pani vastu uhA~ko sAjhedAra chaina | kAphiraharUle cA~Dai nai ati kaThora yAtanA pAunechan |

3 kAphiraharU sAMsArika jIvana ra yasamA rahekA kSaNika mojamastIlAI paralokamA sadhaiM rahirahane varadAnamAthi prAthamikatA dinchan | mAnisaharUlAI allAhako mArgabATa rokne garchan | allAhako mArgalAI satyabATa baGgyAuna khojchan tAki kohI tyasamA hi~Dna nasakos | yastA avaguNa bhaekA kAphiraharU pathabhraSTatAmA curlumma DubisakekA chan |

4 hAmIle pratyeka rasUlalAI unIharUko samudAyale bolne bhASAmA paThAyauM | tAki mAnisaharUlAI IzvarIya AdezaharU bujhna sajilo hos | rasUlale tinIharUlAI allAhamAthi ImAna lyAuna bAdhya pArun bhanne uddezyale hAmI unalAI paThAenauM | allAhale jasalAI cAhanuhuncha Aphno nisAphale pathabhraSTa pArnuhuncha ra jasalAI cAhanuhuncha Aphno kRpAle satmArga dekhAunuhuncha | uhA~ prabhutvazAlI hunuhuncha, kasaile pani uhA~lAI parAjita garna sakdaina | uhA~ sRSTi garna ra kArya saJcAlana garnamA tatvadarzI hunuhuncha |

5 hAmIle mUsA (alaihissalAma) lAI tyastA camatkAraharU diera paThAyauM jasale unako satyatAlAI spaSTa pArdathyo ra unI allAhako rasUla hun bhanne kurAlAI pramANita gardathyo | Aphno samudAyalAI kuphra ra ajJAnatAbATa nikAlera ImAna ra jJAnamA lyAune Adeza hAmIle unalAI diyauM | unIharUlAI vizeSa dinaharU yAda dilAune Adeza pani hAmIle diyauM | nissandeha tI dinaharUmA ekezvaravAdakA spaSTa pramANaharU ra mominaharUmAthi uhA~kA mahAna upakAra ra varadAnaharU thie | yasabATa dhairyavAna ra kRtajJaharU mAtra phAidA uThAune garchan |

6 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) tyasa samayalAI yAda garnuhos jaba mUsA (alaihissalAma) le allAhako Adezako pAlanA gardai Aphno samudAya banI isarAIlalAI bhane– he merA samudAya! allAhale timIharUprati garnubhaekA varadAnalAI yAda gara | uhA~le timIharUlAI phiraauna ra usakA samarthakaharUko anyAya ra atyAcArabATa mukta garnubhayo | phiraauna ra usakA samarthakaharU timrA chorAharUlAI vadha garthe tAki unako sattA-zAsanalAI kabjA garne kohI bA~kI narahos | timrA chorIharUlAI jIvita choDne garthe tAki tinIharUlAI apamAnita garun | yasarI tinIharU timIharUlAI pIDA dine garthe jasamA timIharUko dhairyako ThUlo parIkSA thiyo | allAhale timIharUko dhairyako kAraNale phiraauna ra usakA samarthakaharUkA pIDAbATa mukti dinubhayo |

7 mUsA (alaihissalAma) le bhane– smaraNa gara jaba allAhale timIharUlAI khabaradAra garnubhayoH yadi timIharU allAhakA varadAnaharUprati AbhAra prakaTa garchau bhane uhA~le thapa varadAna pradAna garnuhunecha | yadi timIharU uhA~kA varadAnaharUprati kRtaghna hunchau ra AbhAra prakaTa gardainau bhane uhA~le kaDA sajAya dinuhunecha |

8 mUsA (alaihissalAma) le bhane– he merA samudAya! yadi timIharU ra timIharUsa~ga saMsArakA sabai mAnisaharUle kuphra gare pani allAhalAI kunai pharaka parne chaina | tyasale gardA timIharUlAI nai hAni pugnecha | allAha AphaiMmA sampanna ra prazaMsanIya hunuhuncha | mominaharUko ImAnale uhA~lAI kunai lAbha puryAu~daina ra kAphiraharUko kuphrale pani uhA~lAI kunai hAni puryA~udaina |

9 he kAphiraharU ho! ke timIharUlAI timIharUbhandA pahile bitekA samudAyaharUko satya kathAharU pugenan? jaba tinIharUle rasUlaharUlAI jhUTA Thahara gare taba allAhale tinIharUlAI sarvanAza pArnubhayo | tI samudAyaharUmadhye thie- nUha (alaihissalAma) ko samudAya, hUda (alaihissalAma) ko samudAya Ada, sAleha (alaihissalAma) ko samudAya samUda ra tinIharU pachikA dherai samudAyaharU jasako saMkhyA allAhalAI mAtra thAhA cha, arU kasailAI thAhA chaina | tinIharUsamakSa tinIharUkA rasUlaharU spaSTa camatkAra liera Ae | tara tinIharUle risale gardA AphnA hAta mukhamAthi rAkhe ra auMlAharUlAI Toke | tinIharUle rasUlaharUlAI bhane– hAmI timIharUle lyAekA sandezalAI mAndainauM baru tyasako bAremA zaGkAmA chauM |

10 rasUlaharUle tinIharUlAI javApha diMdai bhane– ke timIharUlAI allAhako ekezvaravAda ra uhA~ko mAtra upAsanA garnuparcha bhanne kurAmA sandeha cha? jabaki uhA~le binA kunai aghillo udAharaNa AkAzaharU tathA pRthvI sRSTi garnubhayo | uhA~le timrA pApaharUlAI kSamA garna ra sAMsArika jIvanamA timIharUko mRtyusamma maukA pradAna garna timIharUlAI ImAnatarpha bolAunuhuncha | unakA samudAyale uttara die– timIharU ta hAmI jastai mAnava hau | timIharUlAI hAmIharUmAthi kunai zreSThatA prApta chaina | hAmIharUlAI hAmrA pUrvajaharUle pUjA gardai AekA pUjyaharUko pUjAbATa timIharU rokna cAhanchau | yadi timIharU allAhakA saccA rasUlaharU hau bhane spaSTa pramANa prastuta gara |

11 tinIharUkA rasUlaharUle bhane– ho, hAmI vAstavamA timIharU jastai mAnava hauM, yasa kura|mA hAmIharU ra timIharUbIca samAnatA cha | tara hareka cijamA yo samAnatA chaina | allAha AphnA bhaktaharUmadhye jasalAI cAhanuhuncha vizeSa varadAna pradAna garnuhuncha ra sandeSTA banAunuhuncha | timIharUle mAga gare anusAra allAhako cAhanAbinA hAmIharU camatkAra prastuta garna sakdainauM | yo hAmro vazamA chaina | allAhale mAtra yasako sAmarthya rAkhnuhuncha | momiharUle AphnA sabai mAmilAmA mAtra allAhahamAthi bharosA garnuparcha |

12 allAhamAthi mAtra bharosA kina nagarne jabaki uhA~le hAmIharUlAI satmArgamA DoryAunubhaeko cha? hAmIlAI jhUTo Thahara garera ra hAmro khillI uDAera timIharUle dine gareko kaSTaharUmA avazya dhairya garnerchauM | mominaharUle AphnA sabai mAmilAmA allAhamAthi mAtra bharosA rAkhnuparcha |

13 kAphiraharUle A-AphnA rasUlaharUsa~ga vAdavivAda gardAgardai hAra khAepachi bhane– ki ta hAmIle timIharUlAI Aphno samudAyabATa niSkAsita garidinchauM ki ta timIharUle hAmrai dharmamA pharkanuparcha | tyasapachi allAhale rasUlaharUlAI sAntvanA di~dai vahI (prakAzanA) avataraNa garnubhayo- allAha ra rasUlaharUkA inkAra garne atyAcArIharUlAI hAmI avazya nai sarvanAza garnechauM |

14 he rasUlaharU ra unIharUkA anuyAyIharU ho! yI atyAcArI samudAyaharUlAI vinAza garepachi timIharUlAI tyasa bhUmimA punarvAsa garAunechauM | timIharUmadhye punarvAsa tI vyaktiharUlAI garAunechauM jo mero mahAnatA tathA nirikSaNalAI yAda rAkhchan ra maile dieko prakopako cetAvanIbATa DarAu~chan |
15 rasUlaharUle zatruharUviruddha allAhasita maddata mAge | yastA sabai zoSaka ra bhraSTa zatruharU ghATAmA pare jasale spaSTa satyako anusaraNa garenan |

16 mahApralayako dina ghamaNDIko pariNAma narka hunecha | narkale tinIharUlAI parkhiraheko cha | narkamA tinIharUkA ghAubATa niskekA ragata ra pipa tinIharUlAI pilAinecha, jasale gardA tinIharUko tirkhA meTine chaina | yasarI tinIharUlAI tirkhA ra tyasa jastA vibhinna pIDAharUbATa nirantara yAtanA diinecha |

17 ghAukA ragata ra pipa ati tIto, tAto ra ghina lAgdo hune bhaekole narkabAsIharUle tyasalAI piune prayAsa gare pani nilna sakne chainan | ati kaDA yAtanAle gardA tinIharU cArai tirabATa mRtyu Ai raheko ra marna A~TekA mahasusa garnechan tara marne chainan | baru nirantara yAtanA bhogi rAkhekA hunechan | ekapachi arko kaThora daNDa tinIharUkA lAgi tayAra hunecha |

18 mahApralayako dina kAphiraharUle garekA satkarma jastai dAna, kamajoramAthi upakAra ra dayA ThIka tyastai barbAda hunechan jasarI kharAnIlAI kunai A~dhI ra hurIle yasarI uDAera laijAncha ki tyasako kunai nAmonisAna nai bA~kI raha~daina | tinIharUkA karmamA kuphrako A~dhI calisakeko cha | tinIharUle garekA satkarmaharUle kayAmatako dina tinIharUlAI kunai lAbha puryAune chainan | ImAna binAko satkarma satmArgabATa dUrI tathA pathabhraSTatA ho |

19 he mAnava! ke timIharU jAndainau, allAhale satyakAsAtha AkAzaharU ra dhartI sRSTi garnubhayo, binA uddezya garnubhaena | uhA~le cAhanubhaemA timIharUlAI naSTa pArera timIharUko sthAnamA nayA~ prANIko sRSTi garnuhunecha jasale uhA~ko AjJApAlana ra bhakti garnecha | uhA~ko lAgi yo ati sajilo kArya ho |
20 timIharUlAI naSTa pArera anya prANIharUlAI lyAunu allAhako lAgi alikati pani kaThina chaina | uhA~ hareka kAryako sAmarthya rAkhnuhuncha |

21 mahApralayako dina sabai prANIharU allAhakahA~ upasthita hunechan | andhabhaktaharUle aguvAharUlAI bhannechan– duniyA~mA hAmI ta timIharUkA anuyAyI thiyauM | ke timIharU Aja hAmIharUlAI allAhako yAtanAbATa bacAuna sakchau ta? tinIharUle javApha dinechan– yadi allAhale hAmIharUlAI sIdhA mArga dekhAunu bhaeko bhae avazya timIharUlAI tyo mArga dekhAune thiyauM ra hAmIharU sabai uhA~ko yAtanAbATa bacne thiyauM | tara hAmIharU svayam pani pathabhraSTa bhayauM ra timIharUlAI pani pathabhraSTa pAryauM | aba hAmI ra timIharU durbalatA dekhAauM vA dhairya garauM barAbara cha | hAmro lAgi yAtanAbATa bA~cne kunai upAya chaina |

22 svargabAsIharU svargamA ra narkabAsIharU narkamA gaepachi iblIsale bhannecha– allAhale timIharUlAI satya vacana dinubhaeko thiyo jasalAI uhA~le purA garnubhayo | tara, maile timIharUlAI jhUTo vacana dieko thie~, jasalAI maile purA garena | duniyA~mA maile timIharUlAI kuphra ra pathabhraSTatAko lAgi jabarjastI gareko thiena | maile ta timIharUlAI kuphratarpha bolAe~ ra avajJAlAI AkarSaka banAe~ ani timIharUle turuntai mero kurA mAnyau | tasartha timIharU Aphno pathabhraSTatAko lAgi malAI doSI nabanAU, baru svayam Aphnai nindA gara | yAtanAbATa jogAi dina ma timIharUlAI guhAra gardaina | timIharU pani malAI naguhAra | nissandeha zirka garera atyAcAra garneharUkA lAgi mahApralayako dina du:khadAyI yAtanA parkhiraheko cha |

kAphiraharUkA lAgi tayAra pArieko vAsasthAna narkako varNanapachi allAhale mominaharUkA vAsasthAna svargako varNana gardai bhannubhaeko cha-
23 satkarmI mominaharUlAI yastA bagaiMcAharUmA praveza garAinecha jasako mahalamA tala nadIharU bagirahekA hunechan | unIharU allAhako AjJAle tyasamA sadAsarvadA rahanechan | unIharUle ApasamA eka arkAlAI salAmadvArA abhivAdana garnechan ani phariztAharU ra allAhale pani unIharUlAI assAlu alaikuma (timIharUmAthi zAnti hos) bhanera abhivAdana garnechan |

24 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! ke tapAIMlAI thAhA cha, allAhale lA ilAha illallAha (allAhabAheka kohI pUjya chaina) ko udAharaNa kasarI bayAna garnubhaeko cha? tyo euTA khajurako asala rUkha jastai ho jasakA jarAharU jaminamA gADiekA hunchan, ani jarAharUbATa usale pAnI prApta garcha ra tyasakA hA~gAharU AkAzatira baDhekA hunchan, jasadvArA zIta ra tAjA hAvA grahaNa gariraheko huncha |
25 yasa asala rUkhale AphnA pAlanakartAko AjJAle nirantara rAmro phala dine garcha | mAnisaharUle upadeza grahaNa garun bhanera allAhale upamA bayAna garnuhuncha |

26 zirkako upamA yasto kharAba rUkha jasto cha, jasakA jarA jaminamA pasekA hu~dainan, tyasalAI jaminako mAthillo bhAgabATai sajilai ukhelna sakincha | tyo AkAzatarpha aglo pani hu~daina | teja hAvAle sajilai ukhelincha ani sukcha | vAstavamA, kuphrako pariNAma vinAza nai ho | kuphra garne vyaktikA satkarma allAhasamma pugdaina |

27 allAhale mominaharUlAI tauhIda (ekezvaravAda) kA kalimA (zabda) dvArA lokamA dRDhatA pradAna garnuhuncha yahA~samma ki unIharUko mRtyu ImAnako avasthAmA huncha | cihAnako (barjakhI) jIvanamA pani allAhale mominaharUlAI dRDhatA pradAna garnuhuncha yahA~samma ki unIharU phariztAle gareko praznako javApha ThIka-ThIka dinechan | mahApralayako dina pani allAhale unIharUlAI dRDhatA pradAna garnuhunecha | tara allAhale atyAcArIharUlAI tinIharUko zirka ra kuphrako kAraNale pathabhraSTa garnuhuncha | allAha Aphno nisAphale pathabhraSTatA cAhanelAI pathabhraSTa garnuhuncha | uhA~le Aphno kRpAle mArgadarzana cAhaneharUlAI mArgadarzana pradAna garnuhuncha | uhA~lAI kasaile vivaza pArna sakdaina |

28 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! tapAIMle kuraizakA kAphiraharUko avasthA dekhnubhayo | tinIharUle haramamA zAnti pradAna garieko ra muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) lAI nabI banAera paThAieko jastA allAhakA varadAnaharUprati AbhAra prakaTa garenan | baru uhA~ (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) le lyAunubhaeko sandezalAI jhUTo Thahara gare | yasarI tinIharU ImAna lyAunuko saTTA varadAnaharUprati kRtaghnatA dekhAera AphnA kAphira anuyAyIharUlAI vinAzako mukhamA puryAe |
29 vinAzako ghara ho narka, jasamA tinIharU DaDhnechan | ati nikRSTa vAsasthAna ho narka |

30 bahudevavAdIharUle AphnA anuyAyIharUlAI pathabhraSTa pArnako lAgi allAhakA sAjhedAra Thahara gare | he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! bhanidinuhos– kehI dinasamma yasa duniyA~mA azlIlatA ra bhrama phailAera mojamastI garirAkha | antataH mahApralayako dina timIharUko vAsasthAna narka nai ho |

31 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! bhanidinuhos: he mominaharU ho! timIharU pUrNarUpamA namAja kAyama gara | allAhale pradAna garnubhaeko dhanasampattibATa anivArya ra atirikta dAna gara | timIharU lukAera pani dAna gara tAki dekhAvaTI nahos ra dekhAera pani kharca gara tAki arUle pani timro anusaraNa garun | timIharU tyasa dinako AgamanabhandA aghi nai kharca gara juna dina na kinabeca hunecha, na jarimAnA tirera yAtanAbATa bacna sakinecha ra na kunai mitrale siphArisa garna saknecha |

32 he mAnava! allAhale nai AkAzaharU ra pRthvIlAI pahileko kunai namunA binA nai sRSTi garnubhayo | uhA~le nai AkAzabATa varSA barsAera timIharUko jIvikAko lAgi vibhinna prakArakA phalaharU utpanna garnubhayo | uhA~le nai DuGgAharUlAI timIharUko adhInamA garnubhayo jo pAnImAthi uhA~le nirdhAraNa gareko anumAna anusAra calchan | uhA~le nai nadIharUlAI pani timIharUko adhInamA garnubhayo tAki timIharUle pani tyasakA pAnI khAU ra AphnA janAvara tathA khetIlAI pani pAnI deU |

33 uhA~le nai nirantara gatizIla rahane sUrya, candramA ra ekapachi arko Aune rAta ra dinalAI timIharUko sevAmA khaTAunubhayo | rAtalAI timIharUko nindrA tathA ArAmako lAgi ra dinalAI timIharUko kAma tathA saGgharSako lAgi banAunubhayo |

34 allAhale nai timIharUlAI timIharUle mAgekA ra namAgekA sampUrNa vastuharU pradAna garnubhayo | yadi timIharUle allAhakA varadAnaharUko gaNanA garna cAhe pani garna sakne chainau | kinabhane uhA~kA varadAnaharU anagintI chan | nissandeha mAnava AphUmAthi anyAya garchan ra uhA~kA varadAnaharUlAI inkAra garchan |

35 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) smaraNa garnuhos jaba ibrAhIma (alaihissalAma) le Aphno chorA ismAIla ra unakI AmA hAjirAlAI makkA upatyakAmA choDepachi prArthanA gare– he pAlanakartA! maile Aphno parivAralAI basAeko makkAlAI zAntipUrNa nagara banAunuhos, jahA~ raktapAta nahos ra kasaile atyAcAra nagaros | malAI ra merA santAnalAI mUrti pUjAbATa bacAunuhos |

36 he mero pAlanakartA! yI mUrtiharUle dherai mAnisaharUlAI pathabhraSTa pArekA chan | mUrtipUjakaharUle yI mUrtiharUle hAmro siphArisa garnechan bhanne ThAnekA chan | yasai bhramamA parera tinIharUle mUrti pUjA garna thAle | tasartha jasale allAhako ekezvaravAda ra AjJApAlanamA mero anusaraNa garnecha U mero anuyAyI hunecha ra jasale mero anusaraNa garne chaina U avajJAkArIharUmadhye hunecha | he mero pAlanakartA! avajJAkArIharUmadhye jasalAI tapAIMle cAhemA mApha garnuhos ra dayA garnuhos |

37 he pAlanakartA! maile ismAIla ra usako santAnalAI makkAmA tapAIMkA pratiSThita gharako cheumA lyAera basAeko chu | jahA~ pAnI pani chaina ra bAlInAlI pani umra~daina | he pAlanakartA! unIharUle tyahA~ namAja kAyama garun bhanne uddezyale maile yasa gharako cheumA basAeko chu | he pAlanakartA! mAnisaharUkA hRdayalAI merA parivAra ra yasa nagaratarpha AkarSita garidinuhos | unIharUlAI phalaphUlaharUdvArA jIvikA pradAna garnuhos tAki unIharU yI varadAnaharUprati tapAIMko AbhAra prakaTa garun |

38 he pAlanakartA! hAmIle manamA lukAekA vA vyakta garekA sabai kurAhamarUbATa tapAIM avagata hunuhuncha | pRthvI ra AkAzamA kunai cija tapAIMbATa lukeko chaina | tapAIM hAmrA AvazyakatA ra kamajorIlAI pani jAnnuhuncha |

39 sampUrNa prazaMsA allAhakai lAgi hun, jasale mero duA (prArthanA) lAI svIkAra garera malAI buDhesakAlamA hAjirAbATa ismAIla ra sArAbATa ishAka pradAna garnubhayo | nissandeha merA pAlanakartAle duA garneharUkA duA sunnuhuncha |
40 he merA pAlanakartA! malAI ra merA santAnaharUlAI pUrNarUpamA namAja kAyama garnevAlA banAunuhos | he pAlanakartA! mero duA svIkAra garnuhos |

41 he pAlanakartA! merA pApaharUlAI mApha garnuhos | merA buvA-AmAlAI pani mApha garnuhos | (unale yo duA tyatikhera gare jatikhera unako buvA allAhako zatru ho bhanne kurA unalAI thAhA thiena | jaba yo kurA spaSTa bhayo taba unale Usa~ga kunai sambandha nabhaeko kurAko ghoSaNA gare) | tyasaigarI sampUrNa mominaharUlAI pani hisAba kitAbako dina kSamA pradAna garnuhos |

42 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! jaba allAhale atyAcArIharUmAthi prakopa avatarita garna Dhilo garnuhuncha taba allAhalAI asAvadhAna naThAnnuhos | baru uhA~ jhUTlAune ra uhA~kA mArgabATa rokne atyAcArIharUlAI rAmrosa~ga jAnnuhuncha | allAhale tinIharUko prakopalAI mahApralayasamma sthagita garnubhaeko cha, juna dina DaralAgdo dRzya dekhera A~khAharU ekohoro herirahanechan |

43 jaba mAnisaharU cihAnabATa TAuko uThAera teja gatimA bhAgirahekA hunechan, taba Aphno A~khA najhukAikana trAsale gardA AkAzatarpha TvAlla parera herirahekA hunechan | tinIharUkA hRdayaharU uDisakekA hunechan ra tinIharUko buddhi harAunecha |

44 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! tapAIM Aphno samudAyalAI mahApralayako dinabATa sAvadhAna garAunuhos | ani kuphra ra zirka garera AphUmAthi atyAcAra garekAharUle bhannechan– he hAmrA pAlanakartA! hAmIharUlAI ekacoTi maukA dinuhos ra prakopalAI sthagita garnuhos | hAmIharUlAI kehI dinako lAgi duniyA~mA paThAunuhos, hAmI tapAIMmAthi ImAna lyAunechauM ra tapAIMkA rasUlaharUko anusaraNa garnechauM | tinIharUko nindA gardai uttara diinecha– ke timIharUle punaH jIvita garera uThAine kurAlAI inkAra garekA thienau? ke timIharU kasama khAera bhanekA thienau– hAmIharU sAMsArika jIvanabATa sarera Akhiratako jIvanamA Aune chainauM?!

45 timIharUle hUda ra sAleha (alaihimassalAma) kA samudAyaharU jastA atyAcArIharUkA vAsasthAnaharU dekhisakekA chau | tinIharUlAI hAmIle kina naSTa garyauM bhanne kurA pani bujhisakekA chau | timIharUle upadeza grahaNa gara bhanera allAhale tinIharUko udAharaNa dinubhaeko cha tara timIharUle upadeza grahaNa garenau |

46 vigatakA atyAcArI samudAyaharUko pariNAma dekhisakekA makkAkA yI kAphiraharUle muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) lAI hatyA garna ra uhA~ko AhvAnako mizanalAI samApta pArna sakdo calakhela gare | allAha tinIharUko calakhelasita avagata hunuhuncha, uhA~bATa kehi pani lukeko chaina | tinIharUkA calakhela yati durbala cha ki pahADa ra anya kunai pani vastu A-Aphno sthAnaharUbATa hallidainan | jabaki allAhako yojanA ati zaktizAlI cha |

47 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) allAhale AphnA rasUlaharUko maddata ra islAma dharmalAI sabai dharmaharUmAthi vijaya pradAna garne vAcAlAI kadApi bhaGga garnuhune chaina baru avazya purA garnuhunecha | nissandeha allAha prabhutvazAlI hunuhuncha, kohI uhA~mAthi vijayI huna sakdaina | uhA~le avazya AphnA mitraharUlAI ijjata pradAna garnuhunecha ra AphnA tathA AphnA rasUlaharUkA zatruharUsa~ga badalA linuhunecha |

48 yo badalA mahApralayako dina kAphiraharUsita liinecha, juna dina yasa pRthvIlAI arkai pRthvImA ra AkAzaharUlAI arkai AkAzaharUmA pariNata garinecha | sabai mAnisaharU A-AphnA cihAnaharUbATa AphnA zarIra ra karmaharUkA sAtha niskanechan ra eka mAtra mahAna sarvazaktimAn, mahimAvAn, prabhutvazAlI ra aparAjita allAha samakSa upasthita hunechan |

49-50 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) mahApralayako dina tapAIMle kAphira ra bahudevavAdIharUlAI bandI banAiekA dekhnuhunecha | tinIharUkA hAta, khuTTA ra gardhanaharUlAI jaJjIrale bA~dhinecha | tinIharUkA vastra alakatrAko hunecha | tinIharUkA anuhAraharU Agole DaDhekAle kAlA hunechan |

49-50 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) mahApralayako dina tapAIMle kAphira ra bahudevavAdIharUlAI bandI banAiekA dekhnuhunecha | tinIharUkA hAta, khuTTA ra gardhanaharUlAI jaJjIrale bA~dhinecha | tinIharUkA vastra alakatrAko hunecha | tinIharUkA anuhAraharU Agole DaDhekAle kAlA hunechan |
51 tAki pratyeka vyaktilAI usale gareko satkarma ra duSkarma anusAra badalA diiyos | nissandeha allAhale karmaharUko hisAba kitAba cA~Dai nai linuhunecha |

52 muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) mAthi avatarita kurAna mAnisaharUkA lAgi allAhako sandeza ho | yasamA rahekA cetAvanI ra dhamkIsita tinIharU DarAunuparcha | allAha eka mAtra upAsya hunuhuncha bhanne kurA pani tinIharUle jAnnuparcha | tinIharUle uhA~ko mAtra bhakti garun ra uhA~sa~ga kasailAI sAjhedAra nabanAun | buddhimAnaharUle yasabATa upadeza grahaNa garun | kinabhane tinIharUle nai upadezaharUbATa phAidA uThAune garchan |

1 (alipha0 lAma0 rA0) yastA akSaraharUko bAremA sUraha ala-bakarahako ArambhamA varNana bhaisakeko cha | yI akSaraharU kurAnakA utkRSTa AyataharU hun | kurAna allAhako tarphabATa avatarita grantha ho bhanne kurA charlaGga huncha | kurAnakA yI AyataharUle taihIda ra islAmI vidhividhAnalAI spaSTa pArchan |

2 mahApralayako dina jaba kAphiraharUlAI islAma satya raheko ra AphUle mAndai Aeko dharma asatya raheko kurA spaSTa hunecha taba tinIharU AphU pani muslima bhaeko bhae kati rAmro hunthyo bhanne kurAko kAmanA garnechan |

3 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! tinIharUlAI janAvara jhaiM khA~dai-piu~dai ra mojamastI gardai choDidinuhos | ThUlAThUlA sapanA ra AzAharUle tinIharUlAI ImAna ra satkarmabATa bhulAi rAkhun | tinIharU AphU ghATAmA pareko kurA mahApralayako dina thAhA pAunechan |
4 hAmIle jati pani atyAcArI samudAyaharUlAI naSTa pArekAchauM, tyasako sarvanAzako lAgi euTA nizcita samaya hAmro jJAnamA cha | tyasa bhandA tyo sarvanAza na pahilA Au~cha na pachi |
5 kunai pani samudAyako sarvanAza nata samaya bhandA pahilA huncha na DhIlo nai | allAhale nirdhAraNa garnubhaeko yasa samayabATa atyAcArIharUle dhokA nakhAun |

6 makkAkA kAphiraharUle rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) ko khillI uDAu~dai bhane– allAhale timImAthi upadeza (kurAna) avataraNa garnubhaeko ho bhanne dAbI garne timI baulAhA hau ra baulAhA jasto vyavahAra garchau |

7 yadi timI saccA rasUla hau bhane hAmI samakSa phariztAharU kina lyAu~dainau jasale yasa kurAko gavAhI deuna ki timI allAhako tarphabATa paThAiekA rasUla hau vA hAmro kuphrale gardA prakopa kina A~udaina?

8 allAhale tinIharUko khaNDana gardai bhannubhayo– jaba kunai samudAyako vinAza najika huncha taba hAmIle Aphno viveka (hikmata) anusAra mAtra phariztAharU paThAune garchauM | phariztAharUko Agamanapachi ImAna lyAeko chaina bhane tinIharUlAI alikati pani maukA diine chaina, baru turuntai vinAza garinecha |

9 nissandeha hAmIle nai mAnisaharUlAI upadeza dinako lAgi muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) ko hRdayamA kurAna avataraNa garyauM | hAmI nai pherabadala ra thapaghaTa hunabATa kurAnako surakSA garnechauM |

10 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! hAmIle tapAIMbhandA pahilekA kAphira samudAyaharUmA pani rasUlaharU paThAyauM | tara tinIharUle rasUlalAI jhUTo Thahara gare | jhUTo Thahara garine tapAIM naulo rasUla hunuhunna |
11 vigatakA kAphira samudAyaharUmA jati rasUlaharU Ae, unIharUle tinalAI jhUTo Thahara gare ra khillI uDAe |

12 jasarI hAmIle vigatakA samudAyaharUkA hRdayaharUmA jhUTalAune pravRttiko thAlanI garyauM tyasarI nai hAmI makkAkA bahudevavAdIharUko vimukha bhaeko ra jiddI garekole tinIharUko hRdayaharUmA jhUTalAune prAvRtti utpanna garnechauM |

13 tinIharU muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) mAthi avatarita kurAnamAthi ImAna lyAune chainan |jhUTalAune samudAyaharUlAI barbAda garne allAhako purAno tarikA ho | ataH tapAIMlAI jhUTalAuneharUle vigatakA samudAyaharUkA pariNAmabATa pATha sikun |

14 yinIharU zatrutAmA yati agADi baDhisakekA chan ki satya-tathya pramANita bhaisake pani mAnne chainan | yadi tinIharUko lAgi AkAzako DhokA khole pani tinIharU tyasamA caDhna thAlnechan tara ImAna lyAune chainan |
15 yI pramANaharU dekhepachi tinIharUle bhannechan– hAmrA A~khAharUlAI dhokA diieko cha | baru hAmImAthi jAdU garieko cha |

16 hAmIle AkAzamA ThUlAThUlA tArAharU sRSTi garyauM | yI tArAharUko prakAzabATa jalathalakA yAtruharU andhakAramA mArga pattA lagAune garchan | yI tArAharUlAI hAmIle dekhneharUkA lAgi AkarSaka banAyauM tAki unIharUle allAhakA zaktilAI pahicAna garna sakun |
17 hAmIle AkAzalAI allAhako kRpAbATa dhikkArieko pratyeka zaitAnabATa surakSita pArekA chauM |
18 yadi kasaile lukIchipI AkAzamA pharizatAharUko jamAtabATa sunne prayAsa garcha bhane euTA Agoko jvAlAyukta ulkAle tyasalAI hAnincha ra jalAi dincha |

19 hAmIle pRthvIlAI phailAyauM tAki mAnisaharU tyasamA basna sakun | hAmIle pRthvImA aglA ra vizAla pahADaharU gADyauM tAki mAnisaharU sameta naDagamagAos | hAmIle tyasamA aneka prakArakA banaspatiharU umAryauM jo AvazyaktA anusAra nizcita mAtrAmA cha |

20 he mAnava! timIharU jabasamma yasa sAMsArika jIvanamA rahanechau tabasamma hAmIle jIvikA pradAna garnechauM | hAmI timIharUbAheka anya mAnava ra prANIharUlAI pani jIvikA pradAna gardaichauM | tinIharUlAI timIharU jIvikA pradAna garirahekA chainau |
21 sabai mAnava ra prANIharUlAI lAbha ra jIvikA pradAna garne sAdhana ra kSamatA hAmIsa~ga mAtra cha | hAmI hareka kurA AvazyaktA anusAra nizcita mAtrAmA sRSTi garchauM |

22 hAmI nai bAdalalAI uDAune hAvA paThAu~chauM | ani tI bAdalaharUbATa pAnI barsAu~chauM | ani hAmI varSAko pAnIbATa timIharUlAI khuvAu~chauM | he mAnava! timImA tyo pAnIlAI dhartIkA mUla ra InArako rUpamA jammA garera rAkhne sAmarthya chaina | allAhale nai tI pAnIlAI jammA garera rAkhnuhuncha |

23 hAmI nai mRtakaharUlAI jIvita pArera sRSTi garchauM | hAmI nai jIvita sRSTiharUlAI tinIharUko umera purA bhaepachi mRtyu dinchauM | hAmI nai bA~kI rahanechauM ra dhartI tathA yasamA rahekA sRSTiharUkA uttarAdhikArI hauM |
24 timIharUmadhye pahilA bitisakekA ra pachi bitne mAnisaharUlAI pani hAmI jAndachauM | kunai pani vastu hAmIbATa lukeko chaina |

25 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! tapAIMkA pAlanakartAle mahApralayako dina sabai mAnisaharUlAI ekatrita garnuhunecha ani satkarmIlAI rAmro badalA ra duSkarmIlAI sajAya dinuhunecha | uhA~ AphnA kArya saJcAlanamA tatvadarzI hunuhuncha | uhA~ sarvajJa hunuhuncha, uhA~bATa kehI pani lukeko chaina |
26 hAmIle Adama (mAnisa) lAI tyasto sukeko mATobATa sRSTi garekA hauM, jasalAI hAndA AvAja Au~cha | tyo mATo kAlo thiyo ra dherai dina bitekole tyasa mATomA bAsanA utpanna bhaeko thiyo |
27 hAmIle jinnalAI Adama (alaihissalAma) bhandA pahile nai ekadamai tAteko AgobATa sRSTi garekA thiyauM |
28 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! smaraNa garnuhos jaba allAhale phariztAharU ra unIharUsa~ga baseko iblIsalAI bhannubhayo– ma sukeko mATobATa ekajanA mAnava sRSTi gardaichu |

29 jaba maile pUrNarUpale tyasako rUpa rekhA banAera tyasabhitra AtmA hAlchu taba timIharU sabaile usalAI sajdA gara | yo sajdA mero Adezako pAlanA gardai ra Adama (alaihissalAma) lAI salAmI dinako lAgi gara |
