30 sabai phariztAharUle allAhako Adezako pUrNa pAlanA gardai sajdA gare |
31 phariztAharUsa~ga baseko iblIsale Adama (alaihissalAma) ko sajdA garna inkAra garyo | U unIharU madhyeko thiena |
32 Adama (alaihissalAma) lAI sajdA garna inkAra garepachi allAhale iblIsalAI sodhnubhayo– sabai phariztAharUle Adama (alaihissalAma) lAI sajdA gare timIle kina garenau?
33 iblIsale ghamaNDa gardai bhanyo– mero lAgi tyasa mAnavasAmu sajdA garnu ThIka chaina jasalAI tapAIMle kuhiera sukeko Dallo ra kAlo mATobATa sRSTi garnubhayo |
34 allAhale iblIsalAI Adeza dinubhayo– svargabATa niska | dhikkAra cha timIlAI |
35 nissandeha mahApralayako dinasamma dhikkAra cha timIlAI ra mero dayAbATa pani TADhA rahanechau |
36 iblIsale bhanyo– he mero pAlanakartA! mahApralayako dinasamma malAI mohalata pradAna garnuhos ra mRtyu nadinuhos |
37 allAhale bhannubhayo– timIlAI maukA diincha | timIlaI mRtyule samAtne chaina |
38 pahilo zaGkha (sUra) phukine belAsamma timIlAI maukA diinecha |

39 iblIsale bhanyo– he pAlanakartA! jasarI tapAIMle malAI pathabhraSTa garnubhayo ma avazya nai dhartImA mAnisaharUkA lAgi pApaharUlAI AkarSaka banAera dekhAunechu ra tI sabailAI sIdhA mArgabATa pathabhraSTa pArnechu |
40 tapAIMle Aphno bhaktiko lAgi chAnnu bhaekA kehI mAnisaharUbAheka sabailAI pathabhraSTa pArnechu |
41 allAhale bhannubhayo– ma samma pugne yahI sidhA mArga ho |
42 merA niSThAvAn bhaktaharUlAI timI pathabhraSTa garna sakne chainau | timI tI vyaktiharUlAI mAtra pathabhraSTa garna saknechau jasale timro anusaraNa garnechan |
43 nissandeha narka nai iblIsa ra usakA sabai pathabhraSTa anuyAyIharUko vAsasthAna ho |
44 narkakA sAtavaTA DhokAharU chan | pratyeka DhokAbATa iblIsakA anuyAyIharU allAhale toknubhaeko saGkhyAmA praveza garnechan |
45 allAhakA AdezaharUko pAlanA garera ra varjita gariekA kAryaharUlAI tyAgera uhA~sa~ga DarAune mAnisaharU nissandeha svargakA bagaiMcA ra pAnIkA mUlaharUko pAsamA rahanechan |
46 unIharUlAI svargamA praveza gardA bhaninecha– sabai kisimakA saGkaTa ra DaraharUbATa surakSita bhaera zAntipUrvaka yasamA praveza gara |
47 hAmIle unIharUkA hRdayamA rahekA sabai DAhA ra zatrutAlAI samApta pArnechauM | unIharU paraspara premakA sAtha dAjubhAi banera eka arkAlAI herAhera gardai palaGamAthi ArAma garnechan |
48 unIharUlAI tyahA~ kunai thakAi lAgnechaina | unIharUlAI tyahA~bATa kahilyai nikAline chaina, baru sadAsarvadA rahanechan |
49 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! merA bhaktaharUlAI sUcita garidinuhos– ma taubA garneharUlAI mApha garchu ra dayA garchu |
50 unIharUlAI sUcita garidinuhos- mero yAtanA pani ati duHkhadAyI cha | ataH mero kSamA pAuna ra yAtanAbATa surakSita rahana tinIharUle taubA (pazcAttApa) garun |

51 unIharUlAI ibrAhIma (alaihissalAma) kahA~ AekA pAhunAharUko bAremA batAunuhos | unIharU phariztA thie | unalAI putrako zubhasUcanA dina ra lUta (alaihissalAma) ko samudAyalAI naSTa garna AekA thie |

52 phariztAharUle ibrAhIma (alaihissalAma) lAI salAma gare ani unale jhana rAmro tarikAle javApha die | unale unIharUlAI mAnava ThAnera siGgo bAchA khAnako lAgi bhuTera pesa gare | jaba tinIharUle khAnA khAenan taba unale bhane– malAI tapAIMharUbATa Dara mahasusa hu~daicha |
53 phariztAharUle bhane– naDarAunus! hAmI tapAIMko lAgi zubhasUcanA lyAera AekA chauM, tapAIMko euTA jJAnI putra janmanecha |
54 ibrAhIma (alaihissalAma) le Azcarya prakaTa gardai bhane– ke timIharUle malAI yasa buDhesakAlamA putrako zubhasUcanA diirahekA chau? yo zubhasUcanA timIharU kuna AdhAramA diirahekA chau ta?
55 unIharUle bhane– hAmIharUle tapAIlAI juna kurAko zubhasUcanA diirahekA chauM tyo satya ho | yasamA kunai sandeha chaina | ataH tapAI yasa zubhasUcanAprati nirAza nahunus |
56 ibrAhIma (alaihissalAma) le bhane– allAhako sIdhA mArgabATa bicalita bhaekA pathabhraSTaharU mAtra Aphno pAlanakartAko kRpAbATa nirAza hunchan |
57 unale thapa sodhe– he allAhakA phariztAharU! tapAIMharU kuna uddezyale Aunubhaeko cha?
58 unIharUle javApha die– hAmIharUlAI euTA ThUlo AtaGkI ra aparAdhI samudAya; lUta (alaihissalAma) ko samudAyatarpha paThAieko cha |
59 lUta (alaihissalAma) ra unakA momina anuyAyIharUlAI hAmIle vinAzabATa surakSita rAkhnechauM |
60 lUta (alaihissalAma) kI patnI vinAza huneharUmadhye parneche bhanne nirNaya bhaisakeko cha |
61 paThAiekA phariztAharU puruSako rUpamA lUta (alaihissalAma) ko ghara puge |
62 lUta (alaihissalAma) le bhane– timIharU aparicita samudAyakA mAnisaharU jhai~ lAgchau |
63 phariztAharUle bhane– he lUta! naDarAunu, hAmI tinIharUkA lAgi tyasto vinAzakArI prakopa liera AekA chauM, jasako bAremA unIharUle zaGkA garthe |
64 hAmIle tapAIMsamakSa vAstavika kurA liera AekA chauM, ThaTTA garirahekA chainauM | jo kurA hAmI batAu~daichauM tyasamA hAmI satya chauM |

65 ataH tapAIM AphnA parivArasahita rAta Dhalepachi yahA~bATa prasthAna garnuhos | tapAIM svayam unIharUko pachi-pachi hiMDnuhos | tinIharUsa~ga ke hu~daicha bhanne kurA tapAIMharUmadhye kasaile pani pachADi pharkera naheros | tapAIMharUlAI jahA~ jAne Adeza bhaeko cha tyahIM jAnuhos |
66 hAmIle lUta (alaihissalAma) lAI vahI (prakAzanA) dvArA nirNaya gareko kurAbAre sUcita garyauM- bihAnasamma tinIharUko antima vyaktisameta sabailAI naSTa garera jaraidekhi samApta pArnechauM |
67 sadUma bAsIharU lUta (alaihissalAma) kA pAhunAharUsa~ga aprAkRtika maithuna garne manasAyale harSollAsakA sAtha Ae |
68 lUta (alaihissalAma) le bhane– yinIharU merA pAhunAharU hun, timIharU juna irAdAle AekA chau, tyo garera mero beijjata nagara |
69 allAhasa~ga DarAera yasto azlila kArya choDideU ra ghRNita kArya garera malAI beijjata nagara |
70 unako samudAyale bhanyo– ke hAmIle timIlAI kasailAI pani pAhunA nabanAunu bhanera bhanekA thienauM?

71 lUta (alaihissalAma) le AphnA pAhunAko sAmu samasyAko samAdhAna batAu~dai Aphno samudAyakA mAnisaharUlAI bhane– yadi timIharU AphnA kAmavAsanA pUrA garnai cAhanchau bhane merA chorIharU jastA yI mahilAharUsa~ga bihe gara |
72 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! tapAIMko umerako kasama! lUta (alaihissalAma) ko samudAyakA mAnisaharU kAmavAsanAko nazAmA cUra bhairahekA thie |
73 antataH sUryodaya hunAsAtha euTA ThUlo vinAzakArI dhamAkAle tinIharUlAI samAtyo |
74 hAmIle tinIharUkA gAu~harUlAI ghopTo pAridiyauM ra tinIharUmAthi mATo misieko DhuGgAko varSA garidiyauM |
75 nissandeha lUta (alaihissalAma) ko samudAyako yasa vinAzamA soca-vicAra garne vyaktiharUkA lAgi dherai nizAnIharU chan |
76 lUta (alaihissalAma) ko gAu~ mUlabATomA cha | tyahA~bATa hi~Dne yAtruharUle vinAzakA nizAnaharU sajilai dekhna sakchan |
77 nissandeha upadeza grahaNa garne mominaharUkA lAgi yasa prakopamA pATha cha |

78 nissandeha ThUlA rUkhaharU bhaeko gAu~kA bAsindA zueba (alaihissalAma) ko samudAya pani atyAcArI thie | tinIharUle allAhalAI inkAra garera ra zueba (alaihissalAma) lAI jhUTo Thahara garera atyAcAra gare |
79 hAmIle prakopale gherera tinIharUsita badalA liyauM | lUta (alaihissalAma) ra zueba (alaihissalAma) duvai samudAyakA gAu~harU khullA mArgamA chan |

80 samUda samudAya athavA hijravAle (hijra hijAja ra zAmako bicamA parne ThAu~ko nAma ho |) mAnisaharUle pani AphnA rasUla sAleha (alaihissalAma) lAI jhUTo bhanera sabai rasUlaharUlAI jhUTA Thahara gare |

81 hAmIle tinIharUlAI nizAnI ra pramANaharU pradAna garyauM | tI nizAnIharUmadhye sAleha (alaihissalAma) lAI pradAna garieko U~TanI pani thiyo | tara tinIharUle tyasalAI bevAstA gardai nasihata lienan |
82 tinIharUle pahADaharUlAI khopera tyasamA zAntipUrvaka basna gharaharU banAune garthe |
83 bihAna hu~dAhu~dai tinIharUlAI bhayaGkara AvAjako prakopale gheryo |
84 tinIharUle Arjana garekA dhana-sampatti ra khopera banAekA gharale allAhako prakopabATa jogAuna sakenan |

85 hAmIle AkAzaharU, pRthvI ra yI duvai bIcamA rahekA vastuharU binA uddezya sRSTi garekA chainauM | baru hAmIle yI sabailAI uddezyakA sAtha sRSTi garekAchauM | mahApralaya avazya nai Aunecha | ataH he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! tapAIM jhUTA Thahara garneharUlAI najaraandAja garnuhos ra tinIharUlAI mApha garnuhos |
86 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! nissandeha tapAIMkA pAlanakartA nai hareka vastukA mahAn sRSTikartA ra sarvajJa hunuhuncha |
87 nissandeha hAmIle tapAIMlAI paTaka-paTaka dohoryAera paDhine sAtavaTA AyataharUmA AdhArita sUraha ala-phAtihA ra yo mahAn kurAna pradAna garekAchauM |

88 hAmIle kAphiraharUlAI pradAna garekA vibhinna prakArakA dhana-sampatti ra sara-sAmAnatarpha nahernuhos | tinIharUle jhUTo Thahara garekomA cintA nagarnuhos ra mominaharUsa~ga namratAko vyavahAra garnuhos |
89 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! bhanidinuhos– ma spaSTa rUpamA saceta garne sacetaka hu~ | allAhako prakopabATa timIharUlAI saceta garchu |
90 sAvadhAna! IzvarIya kitAbakA kehI bhAgamAthi ImAna lyAune ra kehI bhAgalAI inkAra garneharUlAI jasto kisimako prakopale gheryo timIharUlAI pani tyastai prakopale nagheros |
91 yinIharUle kurAnalAI vibhinna bhAgamA bA~De ra bhane yo jAdU vA kavitA ho |
92 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! tapAIMkA pAlanakartAko kasama! kurAnalAI vibhinna bhAgamA bA~DneharUsita hAmIle mahApralayako dina avazya sodhapucha garnechauM |
93 tinIharUle saMsAramA garne garekA kuphra ra avajJAbAre hAmIle sodhapUcha garnechauM |
94 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! allAhale Adeza dinubhaeko sandezalAI khullama khullA puryAunuhos | bahudevavAdIharUko bhanAi ra garAitarpha dhyAna nadinuhos |
95 tinIharUsita naDarAunuhos | khillI uDAune kuraizakA aguvAharUkA calakhelalAI viphala pArna hAmI paryApta chauM |
96 tinIharUle nai allAhako sAthasAthai arko pUjya banAune gardachan | ataH cA~Dai nai tinIharUle ghRNita zirkako pariNAma jAnnechan |
97 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! tinIharUko jhUTo Thahara garne garekAle ra ThaTTA garekAle tapAIMko hRdaya dukhita huncha bhanne kurA hAmIlAI rAmrarI thAhA cha |

98 ataH tapAIM allAhako zAna anusAra uhA~ko pavitratA ra prazaMsA garera uhA~tarpha pharkanuhos | uhA~kai bhakti garnuhos ra uhA~ko lAgi namAja kAyama garnuhos | yasaimA tapAIMko hRdayako pIDAko upacAra cha |
99 jIvita rahunjela nirantara allAhakai upAsanA garnuhos | yahA~samma ki allAhako bhakti gardA gardai tapAIMko mRtyu hos |

1 he kAphiraharU ho! timIharUkA lAgi allAhale nirNaya garnubhaeko prakopa najika Aisakeko cha | timIharU tyasako lAgi ajhai hatAra nagara | bahudevavAdIharUle allAhasa~ga Thahara garekA sAjhedAraharUbATa uhA~ pavitra hunuhuncha |

2 allAha phariztAharUdvArA Aphno vahI (prakAzanA) juna rasUlaharUmAthi cAhanuhuncha paThAunuhuncha | allAhale Adeza dinubhayo– he rasUlaharU ho! mAnisaharUlAI zirka garnabATa sAvadhAna gara | mabAheka arU kohI satya pUjya chaina | merA AdezaharUko pAlanA garera ra varjita kAryaharUlAI tyAgera masa~ga mAtra DarAU |

3 allAhale kunai pahileko namunA nai AkAzaharU ra pRthvIlAI sRSTi garnubhayo | uhA~le yI duvailAI binA uddezya sRSTi garnubhaeko chaina | yI duvaiko sRSTile uhA~ko mahAnatA ra uhA~ko kohI sAjhedAra chaina bhanne kurAlAI darsAucha |
4 allAhale mAnavalAI vIryadvArA sRSTi garnubhayo | mAnava vibhinna caraNamA paripakva bhaepachi satyalAI dabAunako lAgi khullama khullA asatyako pakSamA jhagaDA garna thAlcha |

5 he mAnava ho! allAhale timIharUko phAidAko lAgi U~Ta, gAI ra bheDAbAkhrA jastA janAvaraharU sRSTi garnubhayo | tI janAvaraharUkA phAidAharUmadhye rauMbATa Una ra nyAno vastra ityAdi hun | tyasaigarI dUdha, chAlA, mAsu ra savArIsAdhanako rUpamA prayoga garnu ho |
6 bihAna carAunako lAgi liera jA~dA ra sA~jha parepachi janAvaraharUlAI liera Au~dA timIharUko vyaktitva charlaGga dekhincha |

7 allAhale sRSTi garnubhaekA yI caupAyAharU timIharUkA bhArI bokera eka ThAu~bATa arko ThAu~samma puryAu~chan jahA~ timIharU sajilai puryAuna sakdaina thiyau | he mAnava! nissandeha timIharUkA pAlanakartA parama dayAlu hunuhuncha, tyasaile uhA~le yI caupAyAharUlAI timIharUko adhInamA dinubhayo |

8 allAhale nai ghoDA, khaccaDa ra gadhAharU sRSTi garnubhayo | tAki timIharU tyasamA savAra hoU, Aphno sAmAnako osArapasAra gara ra mAnisaharUbIca timIharUkA lAgi yI zobhA banun | uhA~le timIharUlAI thAhA nabhaekA anya kaiyauM cIjaharU sRSTi garnuhuncha |

9 allAhale nai AphUle manaparAeko satya dharma; islAmako mArgadarzana garnuhuncha | islAmabAheka sampUrNa dharmaharU satyabATa haTekA zaitAnI mArgaharU hun | allAhale cAhanubhaemA timIharU sabailAI ImAna lyAune maukA dinuhunthyo |

10 allAhale nai timIharUkA lAgi bAdalabATa pAnI barsAunubhayo | tyasa pAnIlAI timIharU piune garchau ra AphnA caupAyAharUlAI pilAune garchau | tyasai pAnIle gardA umrekA ghAsa ra banaspatibATa AphnA caupAyAharU carAune garchau |

11 tyasai pAnIdvArA timIharUkA lAgi khetIpAtI, jaitUna, khajUra, aMgUra ra sabai prakArakA phalaharU sRSTi garnuhuncha | jasabATa timIharU jIvikopArjana garchau | nissandeha yasa pAnImA soca-vicAra garne vyaktiharUkA lAgi allAhakA sAmarthyakA pramANaharU chan |

12 allAhale nai timIharUlAI rAta pradAna garnubhayo jasamA ArAma garchau ra dina pradAna garnubhayo jasamA jIvikA Arjanako lAgi saMgharSa garchau | uhA~le nai sUryalAI timIharUko sevAmA khaTAunubhayo ra tyasalAI prajvalita dIpa banAunubhayo | uhA~le nai candramAlAI timIharUko sevAmA khaTAunubhayo ra tyasalAI camkilo jyoti banAunubhayo | uhA~kai Adezale tArAharU timIharUko sevAmA khaTiekA chan, jasabATa jalathalamA yAtrA gardA mArga pAu~chau ra samaya pani pattA lagAu~chau | nissandeha yasamA vivekazIlaharUkA lAgi allAhako sAmarthyakA pramANaharU chan |

13 allAhale nai jamInamA nAnA tharikA khanija padArtha, janAvara, boTa biruvA ra anAja sRSTi garnubhayo ra timIharUko adhinamA garidinubhayo | nissandeha tyasamA pani zikSA grahaNa garne, bujhna harUkA lAgi allAhako sAmarthya ra upakArakA pramANaharU chan |

14 allAhale nai samudralAI timIharUko sevAmA khaTAunubhayo | timIharUkA lAgi tyasamA yAtrA garna ra zikAra sambhava banAunubhayo | timIharU tyasabATa tAjA mAchA khAnchau ra motI jastA gahanA nikAlchau | samudrabATa nikAleko gahanA timIharU pani lagAu~chau ra timIharUkA mahilAharU pani lagAu~chan | timIharU DuGgAharUlAI pAnI cirdai guDirahakA dekhchau | allAhakA varadAna khojna ra vyApAra garna timIharU yI DuGgAharUmA yAtrA garchau | AzA cha timIharUle allAhaprati AbhAra prakaTa garnechau ra mAtra uhA~ kai bhakti garnechau |

15 allAhale nai pRthvImA pahADaharU khaDA garnubhayo tAki pRthvI santulita rahos ra timIharUlAI liera nahalliyos vA naDhalkiyos | uhA~le pRthvImA nadIharU nikAlnubhayo tAki tyasabATa timIharU pani pAnI khAU, caupAyAlAI khuvAU ra khetIko pani si~cAi gara | uhA~le tyasamA mArgaharU banAunubhayo tAki timIharU tyasamA hi~Dera gantavyasamma pugna saka |

16 allAhale pRthvImA timIharUkA lAgi thapa nizAnIharU banAunubhayo jasale gardA dinamA yAtrA gardA sajilai gantavyasamma pugchau | uhA~le AkAzamA tArAharU banAunubhayo, jasale gardA timIharU rAtamA mArga pattA lagAu~chau |

17 ke yo pRthvI ra anya vastuharUkA sRSTikartA ra jasale kehI pani sRSTi gareko chaina barAbara hunasakcha?! ke timIharU allAhako mahAnatAlAI smaraNa gardainau jasale sabai vastuharUlAI sRSTi garnubhayo? ho, mAtra eka allAhako bhakti gara ra uhA~sa~ga anya kasailAI sAjhedAra nabanAU |

18 he mAnava! timIharUle allAhakA varadAnaharUlAI gaNanA garna cAhe pani garna sakdainau | kinabhane tI varadAnaharU dherai chan ra vibhinna khAlakA chan | nissandeha allAha ati kSamAzIla hunuhuncha | timIharUle AbhAra prakaTa garna birse pani uhA~le mApha garnuhuncha | uhA~ parama dayAlu hunuhuncha | timIharUkA avajJA ra pApale gardA uhA~ko dayA banda hu~daina |
19 he bhaktaharU ho! timIharUle lukichipI ra khullama khullA garekA sabai kAryaharUlAI allAhale jAnnuhuncha | uhA~bATa kehI pani lukeko chaina | uhA~le tyasako badalA dinuhunecha |

20 bahudevavAdIharUle allAhalAI choDI juna pUjyaharUko upAsanA garchan tinIharUle kehI pani sRSTi garna sakdainan | bahudevavAdIharU AphaiMle tinIharUlAI banAune garchan | ani kasarI tinIharU Aphnai hAtale banAekA mUrtiharUko pUjA garchan?!

21 tinIharUlAI bahudevavAdIharUle Aphnai hAtale banAekA hun, ani tinIharU nirjIva vastu hun | tinIharUmA nata jyAna cha, na jJAna | tinIharUlAI ta mahApralayako dina AphnA bhaktaharUsa~ga kahile jIvita pArera uThAinechan bhanne kurA pani thAhA chaina | tinIharU pani unakA bhaktaharUsa~gai narkamA phyA~kinechan |

22 timIharUkA pUjya eka mAtra allAha hunuhuncha | uhA~sa~ga kohI sAjhedAra chaina | paralokamA ImAna narAkhneharUkA hRdayaharU eka allAhako inkAra garchan | tinIharUkA hRdayamA Dara hu~daina ani hisAba ra sajAyamA ImAna rAkhdainan | tinIharU ghamaNDI bhaekAle satyalAI svIkAra gardainan |

23 nizcaya nai tinIharUle lukAune ra prakaTa garne kAryaharUlAI allAhale jAnnuhuncha | uhA~bATa kehI pani lukeko chaina | uhA~le cA~Dai nai tinIharUkA karmaharUko badalA dinuhunecha | vAstavamA allAhale ahaGkArIharUlAI manaparAunu hunna baru ghRNA garnuhuncha |

24 allAha ra paralokako inkAra garneharUlAI jaba sodhincha- allAhale muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) mAthi ke avataraNa garnubhayo? tiniharUle bhane– uhA~mAthi kehI pani avataraNa gariena | uhA~le Aphai~ vigatakA kathAharU racanA garera lyAunubhaeko cha |

25 mahApralayako dina tinIharUle AphnA pApaharUko bhArasa~gai tI vyaktiharUkA pApaharUko bhAra pani uThAunu parnecha, jasalAI tinIharUle binA jJAna pathabhraSTa gare ra anuyAyI banAe | tinIharUle uThAune AphnA pApaharUko bhAra ra AphnA anuyAyIharUkA pApaharUko bhAra uThAunu kati narAmro kAma ho |

26 tinIharUbhandA aghikA kAphiraharUle pani AphnA rasUlaharUsa~ga yastai calakhela garekA thie tara allAhale tinIharUkA gharaharUlAI jagasameta ukhelera phyA~knubhayo | tinIharUmAthi gharakA chAnAharU bhatkera khase | tinIharUle kalpanAsameta nagarekA dizAharUbATa allAhako prakopale gheryo | tinIharUkA gharaharUle tinIharUlAI bacAunechan bhanne kurA ThAnekA thie, tara tinai gharaharUdvArA allAhale tinIharUlAI naSTa pArnubhayo |

27 pheri allAhale mahApralayako dina tinIharUlAI yAtanA diera apamAnita garnuhunecha | uhA~le sodhnuhunecha– kahA~ chan timIharUle pujne garekA bhagavAnaharU, jasale gardA timIharU hAmrA rasUlaharU ra mominaharUsita zatrutA rAkhekA thiyau? asala dharmaguruharU bhannechan– avazya nai Aja ta kAphiraharUlAI yAtanA ra apamAnamA grasta garinecha |

28 yI kAphiraharUle kuphra garera svayamamAthi atyAcAra gariraheko avasthAmA mRtyukA phariztA (malakula-mauta) ra unakA sahayogIharUle tinIharUko prANa linechan | tyasa samaya tinIharUle Atma-samarpaNa garnechan ra AphUle gareko kuphra ra avajJAbATa inkAra garnechan | tinIharUle yo ThAnera inkAra garnechan ki yasa inkArale tinIharUlAI yAtanAbATa bacAunechan | tinIharUlAI javApha diinechan– timIharU jhUTa boldaichau, timIharU kAphira thiyau ra avajJA gardai thiyo | timIharUle saMsAramA garirAkhekA kAryaharUlAI allAhale rAmrarI jAnnuhuncha | uhA~bATa kunai pani kurA lukeko chaina | uhA~le timIharUlAI tyasako badalA dinuhunecha |

29 tinIharUlAI bhaninecha– timIharU Aphno kukarmaharU anusAra narkakA vibhinna DhokAharUbATa pasa | timIharU tyasamA sadA sarvadA basnu parcha | kati nikRSTa cha ghamaNDI mAnisaharUko vAsasthAna! yahI ghamaNDale tinIharUlAI allAhamAthi ImAna lyAuna ra uhA~ko bhakti garnabATa rokeko thiyo |

30 allAhakA AdezaharUko pAlanA garera ra varjita kAryaharUbATa bacera uhA~sa~ga DarneharUlAI sodhinecha– allAhale timIharUkA nabI muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) mAthi ke avataraNa garnubhayo? unIharUle javApha dinechan– allAhale uhA~mAthi dherai bhalAi avataraNa garnubhayo | saMsAramA rAmro tarikAle allAhako bhakti garne ra mAnisaharUsa~ga rAmro vyavahAra garneharUlAI loka ra paraloka duvaimA rAmro badalA diinecha | lokako bhalAi allAhako maddata ra jIvikAmA baDhottarIko rUpamA milnecha | paralokamA milne badalA lokako kSaNika sAMsArika badalAbhandA uttama hunecha | allAhakA AdezaharUko pAlanA garera ra varjita kAryaharUlAI tyagAgera Izabhaya rAkhneharUkA lAgi AkhiratamA kati rAmro ghara hunecha |

31 unIharU sadA sarvadA rahane bagaiMcAharUmA praveza garnechan jasako talabATa nadIharU bagirahekA hunechan | unIharUkA lAgi tyasamA manale cAhe anusArakA khAdya padArtha tathA peya padArtha ityAdi hunechan | allAhale muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) ko samudAya ra vigatakA sabai sandeSTAharUkA samudAyaharUlAI yastai badalA dinuhunecha |

32 mominaharUkA hRdaya kuphrabATa pavitra bhaeko avasthAmA mRtyukA phariztA (malakula-mauta) ra unakA sahayogIharUle prANa niyantraNamA linechan | phariztAharUle bhannechan– timIharUmAthi zAnti hos | timIharU sabai kisimakA saGkaTaharUbATa surakSita bhayau | saMsAramA timIharUle ThIka AsthA rAkhekole ra satkarma garekole svargamA praveza gara |

33 ke yI jhUTA Thahara garne bahudevavAdIharU yasa pratIkSAmA chan– mRtyukA phariztA ra unakA sahayogIharU Aun ra tinIharUkA anuhAra ra piThyU~mAthi prahAra gardai tinIharUkA prANa niyantraNamA leun? vA tinIharUlAI saMsAramA pUrNarUpamA vinAza garne prakopako Adeza allAhako tarphabATa Aos? makkAkA bahudevavAdIharU jhaiM vigatakA bahudevavAdIharUle kuphra garekA thie ani allAhale tinIharUko sarvanAza garnubhaeko thiyo | allAhale tinIharUlAI sarvanAza garera tinIharUmAthi atyAcAra garnubhaeko thiena baru tinIharUle kuphra garera svayamamAthi atyAcAra garekA thie |
34 ataH tinIharUle garekA kukarmaharUle gardA tinIharUmAthi prakopa avataraNa bhayo | tinIharU juna prakopako ThaTTA gardai thie tyahI prakopale tinIharUlAI gherAmA liyo |

35 bahudevavAdIharUle bhane– yadi allAhale cAhanubhaeko bhae hAmIharU ra hAmrA pUrvajaharUle na uhA~ko bhaktimA kasailAI sAjhedAra banAune thiyauM na kunai vastu harAma garne thiyauM | yastai kisimakA galata tarkaharU vigatakA kAphiraharUle pani diekA thie | rasUlaharUko jimmebArI allAhako Adeza anusAra uhA~ko sandeza spaSTarUpamA puryAunu mAtra ho | rasUlaharUle allAhako sandeza spaSTarUpamA puryAera AphnA jimmebArI pUrA gare | kAphiraharUle bhAgyalAI dvoSa dina mildaina | kinabhane allAhale tinIharUlAI vivaza pArnubhaena baru adhikAra dinubhayo ra rasUlaharU paThAunubhayo |

36 hAmIle pratyeka samudAyamA rasUla paThAyauM | rasUlale AphnA samudAyalAI bhaneH mAtra allAhako upAsanA gara, ani mUrti ra zaitAnaharU ityAdiko upAsanA nagara | tinIharUmadhye jasalAI allAhale sIdhA mArga dekhAunubhayo tinaile ImAna lyAe ra rasUlale lyAeko sandezako anusaraNa gare | tinIharUmadhye jasale allAhako inkAra gare ra rasUlako avajJA gare tinIharUlAI allAhale sIdhA mArga dekhAunubhaena, ani tinIharU pathabhraSTa bhae | timIharU dharatImA ghumaphira gara ani hera ta jhUTA Thahara garneharUko ke kasto pariNAma bhayo |

37 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! tapAIMle tinIharUlAI jati satmArgatira AhvAna garepani, tinIharUko mArgadarzanako lAgi jati lAlAyita bhae pani ra saMgharSa gare pani jasalAI allAhale mArgavicalita garnuhuncha usalAI mArgadarzana garnuhunna | tinIharUmAthi Aeko prakopabATa bacAuna allAhabAheka kohI sahayogI hunechaina |

38 punarjIvita hune kurAlAI jhUTo Thahara garneharUle kasama khAera bhanchan– mRta vyaktiharUlAI allAhale punaH jIvita pArnuhunechaina | tinIharU yo kurA binA pramANa bhanchan | allAhale avazya nai sabai mRtakaharUlAI punaH jIvita pArnuhunecha | yo uhA~ko satya vAcA ho | tara adhikAMsa mAnisaharU yo kurA jAndainan ra yasako inkAra garchan |

39 allAhale mahApralayako dina sabai mAnisaharUlAI punaH jIvita pArnuhunecha tAki unIharUle tauhIda, punarjanma ra nubuvvata (IzdUtatva) mA gareko vibhedabAre spaSTa pAriyos | sAthai kAphiraharUle jAnun- ki allAhasa~ga arUpani sAjhedAra chan bhanne dAbImA ra punaH jIvita pArnuhunna bhanI inkAra garne kAryamA pani tinIharU jhUTA thie |
40 jaba hAmI mRtakaharUlAI jIvita pArne nirNaya garchauM taba hAmIlAI kasaile pani rokna sakdaina | hAmIle bhaihAla bhanchauM ani tyo avazya nai bhaihAlcha |

41 kAphiraharUko atyAcArako zikAra bhaepachi allAhako prasannatA prApta garnako lAgi AphnA ghara, parivAra ra dhana-sampatti tyAgera hijrata (sthAnAntara) garneharUlAI hAmIle avazya yasa lokamA pani sammAnita vAsasthAna pradAna garnechauM ra paralokako pratidAna svarga bhaekole tyo jhana mahAn hunecha | hijrata garneharUle kati puNya prApta gare bhanne kurA hijrata nagarneharUle jAnekA bhae tinIharU pani avazya hijrata garne thie |

42 allAhako mArgamA hijrata garekA yI muhAjiraharUle nai dhairya dhAraNa gare | unIharUle AphnA samudAyale diekA kaSTamA dhairya gare, ghara parivAra ra Aphno dezalAI tyAgera dhairya gare, allAhako AjJApAlanamA aDiga rahera dhairya gare | yastA mAnisaharU sabai mAmilAmA allAhamAthi mAtra bharosA garchan | tyasaile uhA~le unIharUlAI yo mahAn badalA dinubhaeko cha |

43 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! hAmIle tapAIMbhandA pahile puruSaharUlAI mAtra rasUla banAera paThAyauM | unIharUmAthi hAmIle vahI (prakAzanA) avataraNa garyauM | hAmIle phariztAharUlAI rasUla banAera paThAenauM | yahI hAmro sadhai~ko sunnata (tarikA) ho | yadi timIharU yasa kurAko inkAra garchau bhane yahUdI ra IsAIharUlAI sodha | rasUlaharU mAnava thie, phariztA thienan bhanne kurA tinIharUle batAunechan |

44 hAmIle tI rasUlaharUlAI spaSTa pramANa ra kitAbaharUkA sAtha paThAyauM | he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! hAmIle tapAIMmAthi kurAna avataraNa garekAchauM | tAki tapAIMle mAnisaharUkA nimti AvazyaktA anusAra yasalAI spaSTa pArnuhos | AzA cha mAnisaharUle yasamA rahekA vicAra ra upadeza grahaNa garnechan |

45 ke allAhako mArgabATa rokna SaDyantra garneharUlAI yasa kurAko Dara lAgdaina ki allAhale tinIharUlAI dhartImA kArUnalAI dhasAe jhai~ dhasAuna saknuhuncha vA tinIharUmAthi akasmAta prakopa Aunasakcha |
46 vA tinIharU yAtrA ra jIvikA Arjanako lAgi bhAgadauDa gariraheko avasthAmA allAhako prakopale tinIharUlAI samAtna pani sakcha | yaso garnabATa allAhalAI kasaile rokna sakdainan |

47 vA tinIharU DarAiraheko avasthAmA pani allAhako prakopale tinIharUlAI samatna sakcha | allAha hareka avasthAmA yAtanA dine sAmarthya rAkhnuhuncha | nissandeha timIharUkA pAlanakartA karuNAmaya ra parama dayAlu hunuhuncha | uhA~le prakopa paThAunamA hatAra garnuhunna, yasa AzAkA sAtha ki tinIharUle taubA garun |

48 ke yI jhUTA Thahara garneharUle allAhakA sRSTiharUmA vicAra garenan? unIharUkA chAyA~ dinamA sUryako cAlaanusAra ra rAtamA candramAko cAlaanusAra dAyA~bAyA~ pharkaMdai ra vinamratAkA sAtha allAha samakSa sajdA garne tathA natamastaka hune garchan?
49 AkAzaharU ra dhartImA rahekA sabai sRSTi, janAvara ra phariztAharU allAhako mAtra sajdA garchan | unIharU allAhako bhakti ra AjJApAlanabATa alikati pani ghamaNDa gardainan |
50 unIharU sadhaiM allAhako bhakti ra AjJAkArI gardai astitva evam zaktikA sAtha AphUmAthi pUrNa prabhutva rAkhne pAlanakartAsita DarAu~chan | unIharU allAhako AdezaharUko pUrNa pAlanA garchan |
51 allAhale sabai bhaktaharUlAI bhannubhayo– duIvaTA upAsya na banAU | vAstavamA ma eka mAtra upAsya chu | masa~ga kohI sAjhedAra chaina | timIharU masa~ga mAtra DarAU, anya kasaisa~ga naDarAU |

52 AkAzaharU ra pRthvImA rahekA sabai vastuharUlAI allAhale nai sRSTi garnubhayo, yI sabaikA pravandhaka tathA mAlika pani uhA~ nai hunuhuncha | sabaimAthi uhA~kai Adeza caldaicha | yI sabai vastuharU allAhakai AjJApAlana gardaichan | ani ke timIharU allAhabAheka arUsita DarAu~chau?! hoina, baru timIharU allAhasita mAtra DarAU |

53 he mAnava! timIharUlAI prApta dhArmika ra sAMsArika sabai varadAnaharU allAhale nai pradAna garnubhaeko cha, anya kasaile pradAna gareko chaina | jahile pani timIharUlAI kunai duHkha, roga ra garibI Au~cha uhA~sa~ga nai duA (prArthanA) garchau tAki timIharUko duHkha nivAraNa hos | tyasaile varadAnaharU pradAna garne ra duHkhalAI haraNa garne allAha kai bhakti garnu anivArya cha |
54 jaba allAhale timIharUkA duHkha nivAraNa garnuhuncha taba timIharU madhyeko euTA giroha uhA~ bAheka arUko bhakti garera uhA~sa~ga sAjhedAra banAuna thAlcha | yo kasto viDambanA ho?!

55 allAhasa~ga sAjhedAra banAune kAryale tinIharUlAI kRtaghna banAyo | tinIharUmAthi allAhakA dherai varadAnaharU chan jasamadhye kaSTako nivAraNa pani ho, tara tinIharUle tyasako lAgi allAhaprati AbhAra prakaTa garenan | ani tinIharUlAI bhaniyo– cA~Dai vA Dhilo Aune allAhako prakopaaghi timIharU mojamastI gara |

56 bahudevavAdIharU hAmIle pradAna gareko dhana-sampattikA kehI aMza mUrtiharUko nikaTtA prApta garna chuTyAu~chan, tara yI mUrtiharU nirjIva bhaekAle kehI pani jAndainan, na lAbha puryAuna sakchan na hAni nai | he bahudevavAdIharU ho! allAhako kasama! timIharUle Izvara ThAnekA mUrtiharU ra tinIharUkA lAgi dhanamA aMza nikAlnebAre allAhale avazya sodha pUcha garnuhunecha |

57 bahudevavAdIharUle allAhakA lAgi chorIharU Thahara garchan | phariztAharU allAhakA chorIharU hun bhanne kurA tinIharU vizvAsa garchan | tinIharU allAhako lAgi chorI Thahara garchan tara Aphno lAgi chorI mana parAu~dainan, baru chorA mana parAu~chan | tinIharUko mithyA AropabATa allAha pavitra hunuhuncha | yo kati ThUlo aparAdha ho?!

58 jaba yI bahudevavAdIharUmadhye kasailAI chorI janmieko khabara diincha taba ati ghRNA ra duHkhale gardA tinIharUko anuhAra kAlo huna pugcha | ani tinIharU allAhako lAgi tyo kurA Thahara garchan‌, jo Aphno lAgi mana parAu~dainan!

59 chorIko janmako zubhasUcanAlAI azubha ThAnera U mAnisaharUsita lukera hi~Dcha | manamA bhanchaH apamAna sahera yasalAI jIvita rAkhu~ ki mATomA purideu~? apasoca cha! bahudevavAdIharUprati, kati narAmro nirNaya garchan | allAhako lAgi tyo kurA Thahara garchan jo Aphno lAgi mana parAu~dainan |

60 paralokamA ImAna narAkhne kAphiraharUkA avaguNaharU ati narAmrA chan, jastai- chorAko AvazyaktA, ajJAnatA, kuphra | allAhakA guNaharU ati ucca chan, jastai- mahAnatA, pUrNatA, sampannatA, jJAna | uhA~ prabhutvazAlI hunuhuncha jasamAthi kohI vijayI huna sakdaina | uhA~ sRSTi, kArya saJcAlana ra kAnuna banAunamA tatvadarzI hunuhuncha |

61 yadi allAhale mAnisaharUlAI tinIharUko atyAcArako kAraNa turuntai samAtnu bhaeko bhae uhA~le dhartIkA kunai mAnisa ra prANIlAI choDnuhune thienan | tara euTA nirdhArita myAdasamma uhA~le tinIharUlAI maukA pradAna garnuhuncha | ani jaba tyo nirdhArita myAda Aipugcha taba tinIharU na eka ghaDI pachi haTna saknechan na aghi nai baDhna saknechan |

62 tinIharU allAhakA nimti chorI Thahara garchan juna tinIharU svayam mana parAu~dainan | tinIharUkA jibrAharU jhUTo mAtra bolne garchan | mahApralayako dina tinIharUkA lAgi rAmro badalA raheko cha bhanne kurA tinIharU ThAnekA chan | hoina, vAstavamA tinIharUko vAsasthAnarka ho | tinIharU tyasamA phyA~kinechan ra kahile pani nikAline chainan |

63 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! allAhako kasama, nizcaya nai hAmIle tapAIMbhandA aghikA samUdAyaharUko pAsamA pani AphnA rasUlaharU paThAyauM | tara zaitAnale tinIharUkA zirka, kuphra ra avajJA jastA kukarmaharUlAI tinIharUko dRSTimA AkarSaka tulyAera dekhAyo, mAnauM tyasale mahApralayako dina tinIharUko sahayoga garnecha ra tinIharUle tyasasita maddata mAgnuparcha | vAstaviktA ke cha bhane tinIharU sabaikA lAgi duHkhadAyI yAtanA cha |

64 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! hAmIle tapAIMmAthi kurAna yasa uddezyale avataraNa garekAchauM ki tapAIMle tinIharUsamakSa ekezvaravAda, punarjIvana ra islAmI kAnuna spaSTa pArnuhos, jasako viSayamA tinIharU matabheda garchan | yo kitAba ra yasamA rahekA sandeza mominaharUkA lAgi mArgadarzana ra dayA ho bhanne kurA pani batAunuhos kinabhane unIharU nai satyabATa phAidA uThAu~chan |

65 allAhale nai AkAzabATa pAnI barsAunubhayo | varSAko pAnIbATa bA~jho ra sukeko bhUmilAI jIvita pArnubhayo ra tyasamA bAlI nAlI umArnubhayo | nissandeha AkAzabATa varSA barsAune ra bAlI nAlI umArne kAryamA allAhako zaktiko spaSTa pramANa cha | yI pramANaharUbATa allAhakA vANI sunne ra tyasamA cintana-manana garne mAnisaharU lAbha uThAune garchan |

67 hAmIle pradAna garekA khajura ra aGgurakA phalaharUmA pani timIharUkA lAgi upadeza cha | timIharU tyasabATa nazAlu padArtha pani banAune garchau, jasale gardA buddhi harAu~cha | yo narAmro kArya ho | yasabATa pavitra ra lAbhadAyaka khAnekurA pani prApta garchau, jastai- khajura, kisamisa, jusa ityAdi | nissandeha yasamA buddhimAnaharUkA lAgi allAhako sAmarthyakA pramANaharU chan | yastA mAnisaharU nai yasabATa zikSA grahaNa garchan |
68 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! tapAIMkA pAlanakartAle mAhurIlAI nirdezana dinubhayo- timIharU pahADa, rUkha tathA mAnisaharUle banAekA chAnAharUmA AphnA ghara banAU |

69 tyasapachi timIharUle mana parAekA hareka prakArakA phalaphUlaharU khAU ra pAlanakartAle batAeko sahaja mArgamA hiDne gara | tI mAhurIkA peTabATa seto ra pahelo ityAdi vibhinna raGgakA maha niskanchan | tyasamA mAnisaharUkA lAgi upacAra cha | mAnisaharUle tyasabATa vibhinna rogaharUko upacAra garne garchan | nissandeha mAhurI ra maha duvaimA cintana-manana garne mAnisaharUkA lAgi allAhakA sAmarthya ra sattA-zAsanakA pramANaharU chan |

70 allAhale nai timIharUlAI binA kunai namunA tathA udAharaNa sRSTi garnubhayo | timIharUko umera pUrA bhaepachi uhA~le nai timIharUlAI mRtyu dinuhuncha | timIharUmadhye kehI vyaktiharU ekadamai vRddha avasthAmA pugepachi marchan | yahA~samma ki tinIharUle jAnekA kurAharU pani birsanchan | nissandeha allAha bhaktakA sabai kAryaharU jAnnuhuncha | uhA~bATa kehI pani lukeko chaina | uhA~ sAmarthyavAn hunuhuncha, kohI pani uhA~lAI vivaza pArna sakdaina |

71 allAhale timIharUmadhye kehI vyaktiharUlAI anya kehI vyaktiharUko tulanAmA utkRSTa jIvikA pradAna garnubhayo | kasailAI dhani banAunubhayo ra kasailAI gariba | kasailAI padAdhikArI banAunubhayo ra kasailAI sevAgrAhI banAunubhayo | dhanI ra padAdhikArI mAnisaharU AphnA mAtahatakA sevakaharUlAI Aphno dhana ra pada yati mAtrAmA dine gardainan ki tinIharU barAbara hoUn | jaba dhanI tathA ucca padAdhikArIharU AphnA sevaka ra mAtahatalAI Aphno barAbara banAuna cAhadaina bhane allAhale kasarI AphnA bhaktaharUlAI Aphno barAbara sAjhedAra banAuna saknuhuncha | allAhasa~ga kasailAI sAjhedAra banAunu kati ThUlo atyAcAra ho ra uhA~ko varadAnako kati ThUlo inkAra ho?!

72 he mAnava! allAhale timIharUkA lAgi timIharU madhyebATa joDIharU banAunubhayo, josa~ga timIharU mAyA sATAsATa garchau | uhA~le nai timIharUkA patnIharUbATa santAna ra santAnabATa nAtinAtinAharU pradAna garnubhayo | uhA~le nai timIharUlAI mAsu, anAja ra phalaharU jastA pavitra khAnekurA pradAna garnubhayo | ke yasakA bAvajuda pani mAnisaharU mUrti ra anya asatya devI devatAharUmAthi ImAna rAkhdachan? ke yinIharU allAhakA yati dherai varadAnalAI asvIkAra gardachan? ke yinIharU eka allAhamAthi ImAna lyAera yI varadAnaharUprati AbhAra prakaTa gardainan |

73 yI bahudevavAdIharU allAhalAI choDera mUrtiharUko pUjA garchan, jo tinIharUlAI nata AkAzaharUbATa jIvikA dina sakchan na pRthvIbATa | nirjIva vastu bhaekAle tinIharUle bhaktakA lAgi kehI pani garne kSamatA rAkhdainan | tinIharUmA nata jyAna cha na jJAna |

74 he bahudevavAdIharU ho! yI kamajora mUrtiharUlAI allAhako samAna naThaharAU | kinabhane yI mUrtiharUle na lAbha puryAuna sakchan na hAni nai | allAha jasto kehI pani chaina | allAha AphnA zakti ra utkRSTa guNaharUlAI rAmrarI jAnnuhuncha | timIharUlAI jJAna nabhaekole timIharU zirka garna thAlchau ra mUrtiharUlAI allAha jasto banAuna thAlchau |

75 allAha bahudevavAdIharUko khaNDanako lAgi euTA udAharaNa dinuhuncha; ekajanA dAsa cha jo svayam kunai adhikAra rAkhdaina | Usa~ga kharca garnako lAgi dhana pani chaina | ke yasto dAsa tyasa svatantra vyakti jasto huna sakcha jasalAI hAmIle halAla jIvikA pradAna garekAchauM jasabATa U gopyara rUpamA pani ra dekhAera pani jasarI ra jahile cAhancha kharca gardacha | yI duvai kisimakA vyaktiharU eka samAna huna sakdainan | ani timIharU mahAn sRSTikartA allAha ra zaktivihIna mUrtiharUlAI kuna AdhAramA eka samAna ThAndachau?! sampUrNa prazaMsA allAhakai lAgi hun tara adhikAMsa bahudevavAdIharU allAha mAtra satya Izvara hunuhuncha ra uhA~ mAtra bhakti yogya hunuhuncha bhanne kurAlAI jAndainan |

77 AkAzaharU ra pRthvImA lukekA adRzya vAstavikatAharUko jJAna allAhalAI mAtra cha, arU kasailAI chaina | mahApralaya yati najika cha mAnauM tyo palabharamA vA tyobhandA pani chiTo hunecha | nissandeha allAha pratyeka kAryako sAmarthya rAkhnuhuncha, uhA~lAI kasaile vivaza pArna sakdaina | jaba uhA~ kunai kArya garne nIyata garnuhuncha taba bhannuhuncha bhaihAla, ani tyo huna pugcha |

78 he mAnava! AmAko garbhamA pUrNarUpamA zizu banepachi allAhale timIharUlAI timrA AmAharUkA kokhabATa nikAlnuhuncha | tyatikhera timIharU kehI pani jAndainau | uhA~le timIharUkA lAgi kAna banAunubhayo tAki sunna saka | uhA~le timIharUkA lAgi A~khA banAunubhayo tAki herna saka | uhA~le timIharUkA lAgi mana-mastiSka banAunubhayo tAki timIharU buddhi-vivekale kAma leU | AzA cha timIharUle yI varadAnaharUko lAgi allAhaprati AbhAra prakaTa garnechau |

79 ke bahudevavAdIharUle carAharUlAI AkAzamA uDirahekA dekhenan? allAhale tinIharUlAI pakheTA pradAna garera ra hAvAlAI anukUla banAera uDna sambhava banAunubhayo | allAhale nai carAharUlAI pakheTAharUlAI phailAuna ra khumcyAuna sikAunubhayo tAki tinIharU najharun | nissandeha carAharUko uDne ra khasnabATa bacne yasa kAryamA mominaharUkA lAgi pramANaharU chan | unIharU nai nizAnI ra upadezaharUbATa phAidA uThAune garchan |

80 allAhale nai timIharUkA gharaharU zAntimaya banAunubhayo | uhA~le timIharUkA lAgi U~Ta, gAI, bheDAbAkhrAkA chAlAharUbATa tambu (khemA) banAunubhayo | timIharU yAtrA gardA halukA anubhava gardai yasalAI liera hi~Dchau | katai jhardA khemA lagAunamA pani sajilo huncha | allAhale nai timIharUkA lAgi bheDAkA Una, U~Ta ra bAkhrAkA rauMharUlAI gharakA upabhogya vastuharU banAunubhayo | yI vastuharUbATa timIharU sara-sAmAna, lugA, chAnA ityAdi banAera euTA nizcita avadhisamma lAbha uThAu~chau |

81 allAhale nai rUkha ra gharaharUbATa timIharUlAI chAyA~ pradAna garnubhayo | pahADaharUmA timIharUkA lAgi guphAharU banAunubhayo, jasamA timIharU jADo, garmI ra zatrubATa bacchau | uhA~le nai timIharUkA lAgi kapAsabATa vastraharU banAunubhayo, jasale timIharUlAI garmI ra jADobATa bacAu~chan | uhA~le yastA vastraharU pani banAunubhayo jasale timIharUlAI yuddhamA hatiyArako prahArabATa surakSita rAkhchan | allAhale timIharUlAI yI varadAnaharU pradAna garnubhayo, AzA cha timIharUle allAhako mAtra AjJApAlana garnechau ra uhA~sa~ga kasailAI sAjhedAra banAune chainau |

82 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) yadi tinIharUle tapAIle lyAunubhaeko sandezamAthi ImAna lyAu~dainan bhane tapAIMko jimmevArI puryAune mAtra ho | mArgadarzanamA lyAune jimmebArI tapAIMmAthi chaina |

83 allAhale pradAna garnubhaekA varadAnaharUlAI bahudevavAdIharU jAndachan | tI varadAnaharUmadhye tinIharUmAjha muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) ko Agamana pani ho | taipani allAhaprati AbhAra prakaTa nagarera ra muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) lAI jhUTo Thahara garera tI varadAnaharUko inkAra garchan | tinIharUmadhye adhikAMsa allAhakA varadAnaharUlAI inkAra garneharU nai chan |

84 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) smaraNa garnuhos tyasa dinalAI jaba allAhale sabai samudAyabATa tyasakA rasUlalAI upasthita garnuhunecha, jasale mominako ImAna ra kAphirako kuphrako sAkSI dinechan | tyasapachi kAphiraharUlAI kuphramA raheko kurAprati mAphI mAgne anumati diinechaina | allAhalAI khusI pArna satkarma garnako lAgi tinIharUlAI punaH saMsAramA pharkAine pani chaina | kinabhane Akhirata hisAbako dina ho na ki karmako dina |

86 jaba saMsAramA pUjdai garekA bhagavAnaharUlAI bahudevavAdIharUle AkhiratamA dekhnechan taba bhannechan– he allAha! yinIharU hun tI sAjhedAraharU jasako pUjA hAmIharU tapAIMlAI choDera garne garthyauM | tinIharUle yo kurA Aphno bojha jhArera tI bhagavAnaharUmAthi hAlnako lAgi garnechan | allAhale tI bhagavAnaharUlAI bolna lagAepachi tinIharUle javApha dinechan– he bahudevavAdIharU ho! allAhako bhaktimA sAjhedAra banAune kurAmA timIharU jhUTA hau | allAhasa~ga kohI sAjhedAra chaina |
87 tyasa dina bahudevavAdIharU allAha samakSa Atma-samarpaNa garnechan | mUrtiharUle allAha samakSa tinIharUko siphArasa garnechan bhanne tinIharUko jhUTo dAbI harAunecha |

88 juna vyaktiharU allAhalAI inkAra garchan ra arUlAI allAhako mArgabATa rokchan; tinIharUlAI kuphra ra arUlAI pathabhraSTa pArera AtaGka maccAekole diine yAtanAmAthi hAmI ajha baDhI yAtanA thapnechauM |

89 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! tyasa dinalAI smaraNa garnuhos jaba hAmI pratyeka samudAyakA rasUlalAI sAkSI banAera upasthita garnechauM | ani tinIharU kuphramA thie vA ImAnamA bhanne kurAko gavAhI rasUlale dinechan | tI rasUlaharU unIharUkA samudAyakai hunechan ra unIharUle bolne bhASA nai bolnechan | he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! hAmIle tapAIMlAI sabai samudAyaharUkA lAgi sAkSIko rUpamA khaDA garnechauM | hAmIle tapAIMmAthi kurAna avataraNa garyauM | yasa kurAnale tinIharUsamakSa halAla, harAma, satkarma ra duSkarma ityAdi sabai kurAharUlAI spaSTa pArdacha | yasa kurAnale mAnavalAI satmArgatarpha mArgadarzana garcha | yo momina ra satkarmIharUkA lAgi dayA ho | mominaharUlAI yasa kurAnale sadhaiM rahane svargako zubhasUcanA dincha jasako pratIkSA unIharU gardaichan |

90 nissandeha allAhale bhaktaharUlAI nyAya garne Adeza dinuhuncha | bhaktale allAha ra anya bhaktaharUko haka pUrA garnuparcha | bhaktale AdezamA ekalAI arkAmAthi prAthamikatA dinu hu~daina, sivAya tyasa hakako mAmilAmA jasamA prAthamikatA dinu jarurI cha | allAhale paropakAra garne Adeza dinuhuncha | bhaktale usamAthi anivArya nabhaepani paropakAra svarUpa garnuparcha, jastai- dAna dinu, atyAcArIlAI mApha garnu, nAtedAraharUmAthi kharca garnu, duSkarma, azlIla kurA ra azlIla kArya jastai vyabhicAra, pApa, atyAcAra ra ghamaNDabATa manAhI garnu | allAha timIharUlAI Adezako pAlanA garne ra varjita kAryaharUbATa bacne Adeza dinuhuncha | AzA cha timIharUle upadeza grahaNa garnechau |

91 timIharUle allAha ra mAnisaharUsita garekA vAcAharU pUrA gara | allAhako nAma liera khAeko kasamalAI natoDa | timIharUle khAeko kasama pUrA garna allAhalAI gavAha banAekA chau | nissandeha allAha timIharUle garne garekA karmaharUbATa avagata hunuhuncha | uhA~bATa kehI pani lukeko chaina | uhA~le cA~Dai nai badalA dinuhunecha |

92 timIharU vacana bhaGga garera murkha ra buddhihIna jasto nabana | tyasa mahilA jasto nabana, jasale pahilA ta khuba mihineta garera dhAgo tayAra pArin ani pachi Aphai~le tyasalAI TukrA-TukrA pArin | dhAgo tayAra garera ani TukrA pArera hairAna mAtra bhain, kehI prApta bhaena | timIharU AphnA kasamalAI eka arkAlAI dhokA dine sAdhana banAu~chau | tAki timIharUko samudAyako saGkhyA ra zakti timrA zatruko samudAyabhandA baDhI hos | allAhale timIharUko parIkSA linuhuncha, kasale vAcA pUrA garcha ra kasale bhaGga garcha? tI saMsAramA vibheda garne kurAlAI allAhale mahApralayako dina avazya nai spaSTa pArnuhunecha | ani uhA~le satyavAdIlAI jhUTAharUbATa alaga chuTyAunuhunecha |

95 allAhasita garekA vAcAlAI tuccha mUlyamA nabeca | vAcAlAI natoDa, baru tyasalAI pUrA gara | yasa saMsAramA allAhale jo vijaya ra yuddhamA prApta dhana (ganimata) pradAna garnuhuncha tyo, ani AkhiratamA sadhaiM rahane juna varadAna pradAna garnahunecha tI kurAharU tyasa tuccha lAbha bhandA uttama cha jo timIharU vAcA bhaGga garera prApta garchau | yadi timIharUle yasa kurAlAI bujhchau bhane |

96 he mAnava! timIharUsa~ga bhaeko dhana-sampatti ra mojamastIkA sara-sAmAna jati dherai bhae pani samApta hunechan | allAhasa~ga bhaeko badalA bA~kI rahanecha | ani timIharU kuna AdhAramA samApta hune dhana-sampattilAI sadhaiM bA~kI rahane badalAmAthi prAthamikatA dinchau | nissandeha vAcAmA kAyama rahane ra tyasalAI bhaGga nagarneharUlAI hAmIle unIharUle garekA satkarmaharUbhandA rAmrA badalA dinechauM | unIharUle gareko euTA satkarmako badalA dasa guNAdekhi sAtasaya guNAsamma baru tyasabhandA pani baDhI dinechauM |

97 puruSa hos vA mahilA jasale pani allAhamAthi ImAna lyAera islAmI kAnuna anusAra satkarma garcha, usalAI hAmIle avazya nai saMsAramA sukhamaya jIvana pradAna garnechauM | usale sAMsArika jIvana allAhadvArA lekhieko bhAgyasa~ga rAjIkhusI, dhairya ra AjJApAlana gardai bitAunecha | AkhiratamA yasto vyaktilAI usale saMsAramA garekA satkarmabhandA uttama badalA hAmIle dinechauM |
99 allAhamAthi ImAna lyAune ra sabai mAmilAharUmA uhA~mAthi mAtra bharosA garne mAnisaharUmAthi zaitAnako kunai cAla caldaina |
100 zaitAnako cAla tathA prabhutva ta mAtra yastA vyaktiharUmAthi calcha jo usalAI mitra banAu~chan, usako anusaraNa garchan ra usalAI allAhako bhaktimA sAjhedAra Thahara garchan |

101 jaba hAmI kunai Ayatako AdezalAI arko Ayatako AdezabATa radda garchauM taba kAphiraharU bhanchan– he muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! timI jhUTo chau | timI allAhamAthi jhUTo Aropa lagAu~daichau | tinIharUmadhye adhikAMsa mAnisaharU yo kurA jAndainan ki allAhale kunai khAsa kAraNale kunai Ayatako AdezalAI radda garnuhuncha |

102 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! tinIharUlAI bhanidinuhos– yasa kurAnalAI jibrIla (alaihissalAma) le allAhako tarphabATa satyakA sAtha lyAera AekA hun | yasamA kunai truTi, kunai pherabadala ra kunai thapaghaTa garieko chaina | tAki allAhale nayA~-nayA~ AdezaharU avataraNa garera ra kehI AdezaharUlAI radda garera mominaharUlAI dRDhatA pradAna garUn | sAthai muslimaharUko lAgi mArgadarzana hos, unIharUle yasabATa puNya prApta garun ra yo unIharUkA lAgi zubhasUcanA hos |

103 hAmIlAI rAmrarI thAhA cha ki bahudevavAdIharUle bhanchan: nissandeha muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va salla) lAI ekajanA vyaktile kurAna sikAu~cha | tara tinIharU Aphno dAbImA jhUTA chan | tinIharUko saGketa juna vyaktitarpha cha usako bhASA ta gaira-arabI ho | jabaki yo kurAna vizuddha zailIvAlA, ucca starIya spaSTa arabImA bhASAmA cha | ani tinIharUle kuna AdhAramA yo ThAnekA chan ki uhA~ (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) kunai gaira-arabI vyaktibATa kurAna siknubhayo?!

104 vAstavamA juna vyaktiharU allAhale avataraNa garnubhaekA AyataharUmAthi ImAna lyAu~dainan allAhale pani tinIharUlAI mArgadarzana garnuhunna | tinIharUkA lAgi duHkhadAyI yAtanA cha kinabhane tinIharUle allAhalAI inkAra gare ra uhA~kA AyataharUlAI jhUTA Thahara gare |

105 muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) jhUTA hunuhunna | allAhakA AyataharUko puSTi nagarneharU vAstavamA jhUTo chan | kinabhane tinIharU prakopabATa DarAu~dainan ra puNyako AzA rAkhdainan | nissandeha kAphiraharU nai jhUTA hun | kinabhane tinIharUlAI jhUTako bAnI baseko cha |

106 yastA vyaktiharU islAmabATa phirekA chan, jo ImAna lyAepachi allAhalAI inkAra garchan, spaSTarUpamA ImAnako tulanAmA kuphralAI mana parAu~chan ra kuphrako AjJApAlana garchan | tinIharUmAthi allAhako krodha avataraNa huncha ra tinIharUkA lAgi ThUlo yAtanA cha | tyastA mAnisaharU yAtanAbATa surakSita rahanechan jo bAdhya bhaera kuphrakA zabda bhanchan tara unIharUkA hRdaya ImAnamAthi santuSTa rahancha |
107 sAMsArika jIvanalAI paralokamAthi prAthamikatA dieko kAraNale tinIharU islAmabATa phire | nissandeha allAha kAphiraharUlAI ImAna lyAune maukA dinuhunna baru apamAnita garnuhuncha |

108 ImAnabATa phirekA kAphiraharUkA hRdayaharUmAthi allAhale mohara lagAunubhaeko cha, jasale gardA tinIharU upadezaharUlAI bujhdainan | tinIharUkA kAnamAthi pani uhA~le mohara lagAunubhaeko cha, jasale gardA tinIharU phAidA uThAune garI sundainan | tinIharUkA A~khAharUmAthi pani uhA~le mohara lagAunubhaeko cha, jasale gardA tinIharU ImAnalAI pramANita garne pramANaharUlAI dekhdainan | tinIharU saubhAgya ra durbhAgyakA mAdhyamaharU ra allAhale tayAra pArnubhaeko yAtanAbATa asAvadhAna chan |
109 nissandeha tinIharUle mahApralayako dina ghATA behorne chan | tinIharUle ImAna lyAepachi kuphra garekAle AphUlAI ghATAmA pAre | tinIharU ImAnamA kAyama rahekA bhae svargamA praveza garne thie |

110 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! nissande tapAIMkA pAlanakartA kamajora pAriekA mominaharUmAthi dayAvAn ra kSamAzIla hunuhuncha | unIharU nai huna jasamAthi makkAkA bahudevavAdIharUle atyAcAra gare, jasale gardA unIharUmadhye kehI nacAha~dA nacAha~dai pani AphnA mukhabATa kuphrakA zabda bhanna bAdhya bhae jaba ki unIharUkA hRdaya ImAnamAthi santuSTa thie | ani unIharU makkAbATa madInA hijrata (sthAnAntara) gare | pheri unIharUle allAhako vANI ucca pArna ra kuphralAI tala pArna jihAda gare | AphUmAthi AiparekA kaSTaharUmA dhairya gare | unIharUle kaSTabATa bacnako lAgi kuphrakA zabda bolepani allAha ati kSamAzIla ra parama dayAlu hunuhuncha | kinabhane unIharUle bAdhya bhaera kuphrakA zabda bolekA thie |

111 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! tyasa dinalAI smaraNa garnuhos jaba pratyeka vyakti Aphnai bacAu gardai hAjira hunecha | bhayAvaha avasthAle gardA kasaile arUko bacAu garne chaina | pratyeka vyaktilAI usako satkarma ra duSkarmako pUrA-pUrA badalA pradAna garinecha | kasaikA satkarmaharUmA kunai kamI garera vA duSkarmaharU thapera tinIharUmAthi atyAcAra garine chaina |

112 allAhale makkA nagarako udAharaNa prastuta garnuhuncha, jo zAnta thiyo ra tyahA~kA bAsindAharUlAI kunai Dara thiena | cAraitirabATa khAdya-sAmagrI prazasta mAtrAmA sajilai tyahA~ Airaheko thiyo | tara tyahA~kA bAsindAharUle allAhako varadAnaharUprati kRtaghnatA dekhAe | tinIharUle allAhaprati AbhAra prakaTa gareranan | ataH allAhale tinIharUlAI tinIharUko kukarmale gardA bhayAnaka bhokamarI ra trAsako svAda cakhAunubhayo, jasako asara kamajorIko rUpamA tinIharUkA zarIramA spaSTa dekhinthyo | tinIharUle kuphra garekAle ra satyalAI jhUTalAeko kAraNale lugAharU zarIrasa~ga sadhai~ TA~siera rahe jhai~ bhoka ra trAsa pani tinIharUsa~ga rahirahayo |

113 makkA bAsIharUsamakSa tinIharU madhyebATa ekajanA saccA ra imAnadAra vyakti rasUlako Agamana bhayo | uhA~ muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) hunuhuncha | tara tinIharUle uhA~mAthi avataraNa bhaeko satya kurAlAI asatya Thahara gare | ani tinIharUmAthi bhoka ra trAsako rUpamA allAhako prakopa avataraNa bhayo | tinIharUle allAhasa~ga arUlAI sAjhedAra banAera ra rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) lAI jhUTA Thahara garera AphUlAI barbAdImA hAle | yasarI AphaiMmAthi atyAcAra gare |

114 he bhaktaharU ho! allAhale jejati vaidha ra pavitra jIvikA timIharUlAI pradAna garnubhaeko cha, tyasabATa khAU | yadi timIharU allAhakai upAsanA garchau ra uhA~sa~ga anya kasailAI sAjhedAra banAu~dainau bhane uha~kA varadAnaharUlAI svIkAra garera ra tyasalAI allAhako icchA anusAra kharca garera uhA~prati AbhAra prakaTa gara |

115 allAhale timIharUkA lAgi jabaha (vadha) nagarikana marekA janAvara, bageko ragata, su~gurako mAsu ra tyasako zarIrako sabai bhAga, allAha bAheka anya kasaiko nAmamA caDhAeko balI, ityAdi harAma garnubhaeko cha | tara kohI bAdhya bhayo, usale anicchApUrvaka ra sImA ullaGghana nagarIkana khAyo bhane allAha nissandeha ati kSamAzIla hunuhuncha | uhA~le bAdhya bhaera khAekA mAnisaharUlAI mApha garnubhayo | uhA~ parama dayAlu hunuhuncha, tyasaile harAma gariekA vastuharUlAI pani AvazyaktA pareko khaNDamA halAla garnubhayo |

116 he bahudevavAdIharU ho! timIharU allAhako bAremA jhUTo boldai yo vastu halAla ho ra yo vastu harAma ho nabhana | allAhale harAma nagareko vastulAI harAma ra uhA~le halAla nagareko vastulAI halAla nabhana | nissandeha allAha viruddha mithyA Aropa lagAuneharU Aphno uddezyamA saphala huna sakdainan ra yAtanAbATa bacna sakdainan |
117 Aphno icchAko anusaraNa garekoharUlAI sAMsAramA thorai sukha mAtra milnecha | mahApralayako dina tinIharUkA lAgi duHkhadAyI yAtanA cha |

allAhale yasa samudAyako lAgi harAma gariekA vastuharUko varNanapachi yahUdIharUmAthi harAma gariekA vastuharUko varNana garnubhaeko chaH
118 yahUdIharUkA lAgi vizeSarUpamA juna vastuharU hAmIle harAma garyauM tyasako varNana yasaaghi (sUraha anAma 146 mA) garisakekA chauM | hAmIle tinIharUkA lAgi tI vastuharU harAma garera tinIharUmAthi atyAcAra garenauM | tinIharU svayam prakopalAI nimtyAune kArya garera AphaiMmAthi atyAcAra garne garthe | hAmIle tinIharUlAI tinIharUle garekA atyAcArako sajAya diyauM | hAmIle sajAya svarUpa tinIharUkA lAgi tI vastuharU harAma garyauM |

119 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! allAhale tyastA mAnisaharUlAI mApha garnuhuncha ra dayA garnuhuncha, jasale anjAnamA duSkarma garchan ani prAyazcita garera Aphno karmako sudhAra garchan |

bahudevavAdIharU ibrAhIma (alaihissalAma) ko dharmamA chan bhanne ThAnekA thie | allAhale tinIharUko khaNDana gardai bhannubhayoH
120 ibrAhIma (alaihissalAma) euTA ummata (samudAya) mA hunuparne sabai rAmrA guNaharUdvArA susajjita ummata saraha vyakti thie | sadhaiM allAhako AjJApAlana garne ra sabai dharmaharUlAI choDera islAma dharmamA samarpita thie | unI kadApi bahudevavAdIharUmadhye thienan |
121 unI allAhakA varadAnaharUprati kRtajJa thie | allAhale unalAI rasUla banAunako lAgi rojnubhaeko thiyo | allAhale unalAI sIdhA ra satya dharma islAmako mArgadarzana garnubhayo |

122 hAmIle unalAI yasa lokamA sandeSTA banAyauM, rAmro khyAti ra sadAcArI tathA dhArmika santAna pradAna garyauM | unI paralokamA pani tyastA vyaktiharU madhyeko hunechan jasako lAgi allAhale svargamA ucca sthAna tayAra garnubhaeko cha |

123 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! pheri hAmIle tapAIMtarpha vahI (prakAzanA) garyauM- eka allAhako bhakti gara | bahudevavAdIharUdekhi TADhA bAsa | allAhatarpha ahvAnara allAhako kAnunako pAlanAmA ibrAhIma (alaihissalAma) ko dharmako pAlanA gara | sabai dharmaharUlAI tyAgera mAtra islAma dharmalAI aMgAla | ibrAhIma (alaihissalAma) bahudevavAdIle ThAnejasto thienan, baru unI pakkA ekezvAravAdI thie |

124 zanivAralAI Adara garna yahUdIharUmAthi anivArya garieko thiyo, tAki tyasa dinalAI upAsanAko lAgi khAsa garun | tara tinIharUle tyasamA vibheda gare | yasaaghi tinIharUkA lAgi zukravArako dina khAsa garieko thiyo tara tyasabAre tinIharU pathabhraSTa bhae | he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! mahApralayako dina allAhale matabheda garneharU bicakA vivAdita muddAharUbAre nirNaya garnuhunecha | uhA~le tinIharUlAI tinIharUkA karma anusAra badalA dinuhunecha |

125 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! tapAIM ra tapAIMkA anuyAyI mominaharUle pani mAnisaharUlAI allAhako mArgatarpha mAnisaharUko avasthA ra buddhi anusAra hitaiSI banera AhvAna garnuhos | tinIharUlAI prerita garera, DarAera ra sarvottama tarikAle tarka vitarka garera AhvAna garnuhos | tapAIMko jimmebArI mAnisaharUlAI sIdhA mArgamA lyAunu hoina, baru islAmako sandeza puryAunu mAtra ho | allAhale rAmrarI jAnnuhuncha kuna-kuna mAnisaharU islAma dharmabATa bhraSTa bhaekA chan ra kuna-kuna mAnisaharU islAma dharmamA kAyama chan | tapAIMle tinIharUbAre cintA linupardaina |

126 yadi timIharU AphnA zatruharUsita badalA lina cAhanchau bhane tyahI hadasamma leU jati timIharUmAthi atyAcAra garieko cha | yadi timIharU zaktizAlI bhaera pani dhairya gardai badalA li~dainau bhane yo dhairyavAnaharUkA lAgi jhan rAmro hunecha |

127 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! tinIharUko tarphabATa pugeko kaSTamAthi dhairya garnuhos | tapAIMbhitra allAhakai kRpAle dhairya Aunecha | kAphiraharU vimukha bhaekomA cintita nahunuhos | tinIharUkA calakhelaprati mana sAno napArnuhos |
128 nissandeha allAha tyastA vyaktiharUkA sAtha hunuhuncha, jo pApalAI choDera allAhasa~ga Darchan ra uhA~kA AdezaharUko pAlanA garchan | allAhako maddata yastai mAnisaharUko sAthamA cha |

1 allAha pavitra ra mahAna hunuhuncha, kinabhane uhA~sa~ga yasto zakti tathA sAmarthya cha jo uha~bAheka arU kasaisa~ga chaina | uhA~le nai Aphno bhakta muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) ko AtmA ra zarIralAI pUrNa hosa havAsako avasthAmA rAtako eka praharamA pratiSThita masjida (kaabA) dekhi baitula makdisako bhramaNa garAunubhayo | allAhale nai yasalAI yasako varipari phalaphUla, khetIharUdvArA ra sandeSTAharU paThAera barkatamaya tathA vibhUSita tulyAunubhayo | tAki tinIharUle allAhako sAmarthyalAI darsAune kehI nizAnIharUkA dekhun | nissandeha allAha sarvazrotA hunuhuncha, kunai pani sunine vastu uhA~bATa lukeko chaina | uhA~ sarvadraSTA hunuhuncha, kunai pani dekhine vastu uhA~bATa lukeko chaina |

2 hAmIle mUsA (alaihissalAma) lAI taurAta pradAna garyauM ra tyasalAI banI isrAIlakA lAgi mArgadarzaka banAyauM | hAmIle banI isrAIlalAI bhanyauM– mabAheka arU kasailAI Aphno sahayogI nabanAU | Aphno mAmilA anya kasailAI hastAntraNa nagara, mAtra mamAthi bharosA gara |

3 timIharU tI mAnisaharUkA santAna hau jasalAI hAmIle nUha (alaihissalAma) sa~ga bADhImA DubnabATa jogAekA thiyauM | timIharU yasa kRpAlAI yAda rAkha ra allAhako mAtra bhakti ra AjJApAlana garera uhA~prati AbhAra vyakta gara | yasa bAremA nUha (alaihissalAma) ko anusaraNa gara | unI allAhaprati dherai AbhAra vyakta garthe |
4 hAmIle banI isrAIlalAI taurAtamA khabaradAra garyauM- timIharUle dhartImA avazya nai avajJA garera duI paTaka AtaGka maccAunechau ra ati ghamaNDa tathA atyAcAra garera sImA ullaGghana garnechau |

5 jaba tinIharUle pahilo paTaka AtaGka maccAe taba hAmIle tinIharUmAthi zaktizAlI bhaktaharUlAI tainAta garyauM, jasale tinIharUko hatyA gare, tinIharUkA gharaharUbhitra ghusera AtaGka maccAe ra gharabATa bAhira nikAle | yasarI allAhako vacana nizcita rUpamA pUrA bhayo |

6 he banI isrAIla! jaba timIharUle taubA garyau taba hAmIle timIharUlAI timIharUle gumAekA deza, sattA, dhana-sampatti ra bandI banAiekA santAna phirtA diyauM, ani timIharUko saMkhyA zatruharUbhandA baDhI garyauM |

7 he banI isrAIla! timIharUle satkarma garchau bhane tyasako phAidA timIharUlAI nai pugnecha | allAhalAI timIharUkA satkarmako AvazyaktA chaina | timIharUle kukarma garchau bhane tyasako sajAya timIharUle nai bhognuparcha | tyasale gardA allAhalAI kunai hAni pugdaina | jaba timIharUle dosro paTaka AtaGka maccAyau taba hAmIle zaktizAlI bhaktaharUlAI pheri timIharUmAthi tainAtha garyauM | tAki tinIharUle timIharUlAI apamAnita garun ra vibhinna tarikAle kaSTa puryAera timIharUko anuhAraharUlAI bigArun | jasarI tinIharUle pahilo paTaka baitul-makdisamA pasera toDa phoDa garekA thie tyasarI nai dosro paTaka pani tyasamA pasera toDa phoDa garun ra pUrA dezalAI nai tahasa nahasa pArun |

8 he banI isrAIla! yadi timIharU yasa kaDA sajAyapachi taubA garchau ra satkarma garchau bhane AzA cha allAhale timIharUmAthi dayA garnuhunecha | yadi timIharU tesro paTaka vA tyo bhandA baDhI AtaGka maccAu~chau bhane hAmI pheri timIharUbATa badalA linechauM | kAphiraharUkA lAgi hAmIle narkalAI bAsa-sthAna banAekAchauM |

9 vAstavamA muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) mAthi avatarita kurAnale utkRSTa mArgadarzana gardacha; tyo mArgadarzana ho- islAma | yasale satkarmI mominaharUlAI allAhako tarphabATa mahAn badalAko zubha-sUcanA dincha |
10 mahApralayamAthi ImAna na lyAuneharUlAI yasale unIharUlAI mana naparne kurAko sUcanA dincha | tyo ho- hAmIle unIharUkA lAgi kayAmatako dina duHkhadAyI yAtanA tayAra garekAchauM |

11 mAnava risAeko belA ajJAnatAmA Aphno ra Aphno santAna ra dhana-samapattiko kubhaloko lAgi yasarI prArthanA garcha jasarI Aphno lAgi bhalAiko prArthanA garne garthyo | yadi hAmIle usako kubhaloko lAgi gareko prArthanA svIkAra gareko bhae U barbAda hune thiyo ra usakA santAna tathA dhana-sampatti pani barbAda hune thie | vAstavamA mAnavako svabhAvamA nai hatAra garne bAni baseko cha | tyasaile U kahile yasto kAryako lAgi hatAra garcha jasamA usako hAni huncha |

12 hAmIle rAta ra dinalAI duIvaTA nizAnIko rUpamA banAekAchauM jasale allAha eka mAtra hunuhuncha ra uhA~ prabhutvazAlI hunuhuncha bhanne kurAlAI pramANita garcha | kinabhane rAta ra dina kahile lAmo hunchan bhane kahile choTo, kahile tAto hunchan bhane kahile ciso | hAmIle rAtalAI a~dhyAro banAyauM tAki tyasamA timIharU ArAma gara ra suta | hAmIle dinalAI prakAzamaya banAyauM tAki timIharUle Aphno jIvikA khoja | tyasaigarI dina ra rAtako pAlaipAlo AvatajAvatale timIharU varSaharUko saGkhyA, mahinA, dina ra ghaNTAko hisAba jAnna saka | hAmIle pratyeka vastulAI vistRtarUpamA varNana garekAchauM, tAki satya asatyabATa spaSTa hos |

13 hAmIle pratyeka manuSyale garne rAmrA-narAmrA karmaharUlAI mAlA jastai usako gardhanamA jhuNDAi dinechauM | usale garekA sabai kAryako hisAba anivAryarUpamA dinai parnehuncha | mahApralayako dina usako lAgi hAmIle euTA bahI (khAtA) nikAlnechauM jasamA usale AphUle garekA sabai rAmrA-narAmrA karmaharUlAI spaSTa ra khullA lekhieko pAunecha |
14 hAmIle tyasalAI bhannechauM– he mAnava! Aphno karma-patra paDha | AphUle garekA kAryaharUko hisAbako jimmevArI AphaiMmAthi leU | mahApralayako dina timI Aphno hisAba AphaiM garna paryApta chau |

15 jasale ImAnako mArga grahaNa garcha, usako mArgadarzanako puNya usailAI prApta huncha | jo pathabhraSTa huncha, pathabhraSTatAko sajAya usaile bhognuparcha | kasaile pani anya kasaiko pApako bhArI bokne chaina | jabasamma hAmI kunai samudAyatarpha rasUlaharU paThAera satya-tathya pramANita gardainauM tabasamma tyasalAI yAtanA diMdainauM |

16 jaba hAmI kunai atyAcArI bastIlAI naSTa garne cAhanA garchauM taba tyahA~kA sampanna mAnisaharUlAI AjJApAlana garne Adeza dinchauM tara tinIharU AjJApAlana gardainan baru avajJA garchan | ani tinIharUlAI jarAdekhi samApta pArne prakopako Adeza tinIharUmAthi lAgu huncha | antataH hAmI tinIharUlAI pUrNa rUpamA naSTa garidinchauM |

17 nUha (alaihissalAma) pachi hAmIle Ada ra samUda jastA katipaya jhUTA Thahara garne samudAyaharUlAI naSTa pAridiyauM | he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) tapAIMkA pAlanakartA AphnA bhaktaharUko pApaharUsa~ga pUrNa rUpamA avagata hunuhuncha ra tyasalAI herirahanu bhaeko cha | uhA~bATa kehI pani lukeko chaina ra uhA~le tyasako badalA dinuhunecha |

18 juna mAnisaharU satkarma garera tyasabATa sAMsArika lAbha cAhanchan ra AkhiratamAthi ImAna rAkhdainan tathA tyasasa~ga vAstA pani rAkhdainan; hAmIle cA~Dai nai AphUle cAheko cIja pradAna garchau, tinIharUle cAheko varadAna hoina | tyo pani tyasalAI pradAna garchauM jasalAI hAmIle cAhanchauM | tara usako bhAgyamA narka lekhidinchauM jasamA tinIharU mahApralayako dina phyA~kinechan ra tyasako Agoko svAda cAkhnechan | yo sajAya hAmIle yasa kAraNale dinechauM ki tinIharUle sAMsArika jIvanalAI roje ra AkhiratalAI inkAra gare | yasarI tinIharU allAhako kRpAbATa TADhA pArie |

19 juna mAnisaharU paralokako lAgi satkarma garchan | dekhAvaTI ra nAma kamAune manasAya narAkhera tyasako lAgi sakdo prayatna garchan, sAthai juna kurAharUmAthi ImAna rAkhna anivArya cha tI kurAharUmAthi ImAna rAkhchan; tyastA sabai mAnisaharUko prayantalAI allAhale svIkAra garnuhunecha ra tyasako badalA dinuhunecha |

20 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) hAmIle duSkarmI ra satkarmI duvai samUhalAI Aphno varadAna nirantara pradAna garnechauM | yo saMsAramA satkarmI ra duSkarmI kasailAI pani allAhako varadAnabATa vaJcita garine chaina |

21 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! vicAra garnuhos, kasarI hAmIle ekalAI arkAmAthi jIvikA ra sthAnamA prAthamikatA pradAna garekAchauM | varadAna diine mAmilAmA lokabhandA baDhI antara paralokamA hunecha | mominale paralokako lAgi kriyAzIla hunuparcha |

22 he bhakta! allAhasa~ga anya kasailAI pUjya nabanAU | yaso garchau bhane timI allAhako najaramA tiraskRta hunechau ra satkarmI bhaktaharUko najaramA pani | kasaile timro prazaMsA gardaina, baru apamAnita hunechau | kohI sahayogI pani hune chaina |

23 he bhakta! timrA pAlanakartAle Adeza dinubhaeko cha- allAhabAheka kasaiko bhakti nagara, AmA buvAsa~ga rAmro vyavahAra gara, vizeSarUpamA jaba unIharU buDhesakAlamA pugchan | yadi tI duvaimadhye eka vA duvai timro upasthitimA buDhesakAlamA pugchan bhane unIharUlAI uph! sameta nabhana, na unIharUlAI hapkAU, na unIharUsa~ga kaThora zailImA kurA gara | baru unIharUsita AdarapUrvaka ra namratApUrvaka kurA gara |

24 AmA buvAsa~ga namratAkA sAtha utkRSTa vyavahAra gara ra yasarI prArthanA gara– he merA pAlanakartA! unIharUmAthi dayA garnuhos | kinabhane unIharUle bAlyakAlamA mero pAlanapoSaNa ra dayA garekA thie |

25 he mAnava! timIharUko manamA bhaekA allAhako bhakti bhAva, satkarma ra AmA buvAsa~ga rAmro vyavahAra jastA kurAharUsita allAha rAmrarI avagata hunuhuncha | yadi timIharUko manasAya rAmro cha bhane allAhako AjJApAlana ra AmA buvAko sevAmA bhaekA aghillA galtIharUko bAremA taubA (kSamAyAcanA) garneharUlAI allAhale mApha garnuhuncha |
26 he momina! nAtedAra, dIna-duHkhI ra yAtrAmA alapatra parekAharUlAI unIharUkA haka-adhikAra pradAna gara | Aphno dhana-sampatti pApamAkA kAryaharUmA kharca nagara, na anAvazyaka kharca gara |

27 pApamA kharca garne ra anAvazyaka kharca garneharU zaitAnakA bhAibandhu hun | tinIharU anAvazyaka garnamA zaitAnakA AjJApAlana garchan | zaitAnale Aphno pAlanakartAko avajJA garcha ra uhA~lAI krodhita pArne kAma garcha |

28 yadi timIsa~ga nAtedAra, gariba, yAtru ityAdimAthi kharca garna kehI chaina bhane unIharUsa~ga namratAkA sAtha kurA gara | udAharaNasvarUpa unIharUlAI sampanna jIvikA prApta hos bhanne duA gara | allAhale malAI dhana dinuhuncha bhane timIharUlAI avazya dinechu bhanera bhana |
29 kharca garnamA na ta kanjusyAi~ gara, na anAvazyaka kharca gara | timIharUle kanjusyAi~ garemA mAnisaharUle nindA garnechan bhane anAvazyaka kharca garemA kharca garna kehI pAu~dainau |

30 nissandeha allAhale jasalAI cAhanuhuncha dherai jIvikA pradAna garnuhuncha ra jasalAI cAhanuhuncha vizeSa kAraNale vipanna jIvikA pradAna garnuhuncha | nissandeha uhA~ AphnA bhaktaharUsita rAmrarI avagata hunuhuncha ra unIharUlAI dekhirahanu bhaeko cha | uhA~bATa kehI pani lukeko chaina | uhA~ jasarI cAhanuhuncha unIharUmAthi Adeza calAunuhuncha |

31 timIharUle bhaviSyamA hune garibIko AzaGkAle AphnA santAnako hatyA nagara | hAmI nai unIharUlAI pani jIvikA pradAna garnechauM ra timIharUlAI pani jIvikA pradAna garchauM | nissandeha unIharUko hatyA mahApApa ho | kinabhane santAnaharUko na kunai doSa cha na hatyA garine kunai kAraNa cha |

32 vyabhicAra garnabATa baca ra vyabhicArako lAgi prerita garne kAryabATa pani TADhA basa | kinabhane yo ati ghRNita kArya ho | yasale gardA vaMzamA misAvaTa huncha ra yasale allAhako prakopalAI nimtyAu~cha |

33 allAhale manAhI garnubhaeko mAnisako hatyA nagara, jastaiH ImAna lyAeko vyakti vA kasaile Azraya dieko vyakti | a~, yastA mAnisaharUko hatyA mAtra vaidha cha jo islAmabATa phircha vA vivAhita hu~dA hu~dai pani vyabhicAra garcha vA kasaiko hatyA gareko kAraNale usamAthi kisAsa lAgu huncha | yadi kasaile atyAcArapUrNa tarikAle kasaiko hatyA garcha bhane hatAhata bhaeko vyaktiko abhibhAvakale kisAsa svarUpa hatyarAko hatyA garne mAga garna sakcha | abhibhAvakale rakta-mUlya (jarimAnA) naliera pani hatyArAlAI mApha garna sakcha ra rakta-mUlya liera pani mApha garna sakcha | abhibhAvakalAI jyAdatI garne adhikAra chaina, jastai- hatyArAlAI hatyA garera TukrA-TukrA pArne vA hatyArAle juna tarikAle hatyA gareko cha tyo bhandA pharaka tarikAle hatyA garne vA hatyArAlAI hatyA nagarera anya kasaiko hatyA garne | yadi kasaile yasto garcha bhane pIDitako maddata garinecha |

34 TuhurAko dhana-sampattilAI anucita tarikAle nakhAU | tyasa bAlakako vikAsa ra surakSAko lAgi kharca gara | yahA~samma ki usako jiu ra buddhi paripakva huna pugos | tI vAcAharUlAI pUrA gara jo timIharU tathA allAhabIca chan ra jo timIharU tathA bhaktaharUbIca chan | na vacana bhaGga gara na tyasamA kamI gara | nissandeha allAhale mahApralayako dina vAcA garneharUlAI sodhapUcha garnuhunecha | vAcA pUrA garneharUlAI badalA dinuhunecha ra vAcA pUrA nagarneharUlAI sajAya dinuhunecha |

35 arUlAI nApataula garera diMdA pUrA nApataula garera dine gara ra tyasamA kamI nagara | sahI tarAjule jokhne gara | pUrA-pUrA nApataula garnu nai loka ra paraloka duvaiko lAgi ra pariNAmasvarUpa uttama ho |

36 he AdamakA santAna! jJAna nabhaeko kurAko pachi nalAga jasale gardA timI anumAnako anusaraNa garna thAlne chau | kinabhane kAna, A~khA ra hRdayakA prayogako bAremA sodhapUcha garinecha ki bhalAiko kAmamA prayoga gariyo ki duSkarmamA | bhalAiko kAmamA prayoga garemA rAmro badalA milnecha bhane duSkarmamA prayoga garemA sajAya milnecha |

37 dhartImA ghamaNDa gardai ra mapAI~ bhandai nahi~Da | ghamaNDa gardai hi~DemA timIle dhartIlAI cirna sakdainau ra u~cAimA pahADa barAbara pani huna sakdainau | ani timI kuna AdhAramA ghamaNDa garchau?!
38 he mAnava! uparyukta sabai kukarmaharUlAI timrA pAlanakartAle manAhI garnubhaeko cha | yI kArya garneharUlAI allAhale mana parAunu hunna baru ghRNA garnuhuncha |

39 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! allAhale tapAIMmAthi avataraNa garnubhaeko Adeza, manAhi gariekA kurA ra sandezaharUmA rahasyamaya kurAharU lukekA chan | he mAnava! allAhasita anya kasailAI pUjya nabanAU, anyathA timI mahApralayako dina narkamA hominechau | timImAthi timro AtmAle pani dhikkArnecha ra mAnisaharUle pani dhikkArnechan | timI sabai kisimakA bhalAibATa TADhA pArinechau |

40 phariztAharUlAI allAhako chorI Thahara garne bahudevavAdIharU ho! ke allAhale timIharUlAI chorA pradAna garnako lAgi chAnnubhaeko cha ra AphnA lAgi phariztAharUlAI chorI grahaNa garnubhaeko cha? timIharUle bhaneko kurAbATa allAha ati mahAna hunuhuncha | timIharU allAhako inkAra garne manasAyale uhA~ko lAgi chorI Thahara garchau |

41 nissandeha hAmIle yasa kurAnamA vibhinna Adeza, upadeza ra udAharaNaharU varNana garekAchauM tAki juna kurAmA mAnisaharUkA lAgi phAidA cha tyasalAI grahaNa garun ra juna kurAmA hAni cha tyasalAI tyAgun | tara tinIharUmadhye jasako svabhAva nai bigreko cha, U satyabATa TADhA bhAgcha ra tyasaprati ghRNA garcha |

42 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va salla) yI bahudevavAdIharUlAI bhanidinuhos– timIharUle bhane jhai~ yadi allAhako sAthasAthai arUpani pUjya bhaekA bhae tinIharUle avazya siMhAsanako mAlika allAhamAthi vijaya prApta garna ra uhA~sa~ga jhagaDA garnako lAgi uhA~samma pugna kunai na kunai mArga khojera nikAlne thie |
43 bahudevavAdIharUle Aropa lagAeko kurAharUbATa allAha pavitra ra mahAn hunuhuncha |

44 AkAza, pRthvI ra tinIharUbIca rahekA sampUrNa sRSTiharU allAhako pavitratAko guNagAna ra prazaMsA gardaichan | tara tinIharU kasarI allAhako pavitratAko guNagAna gardaichan bhanne kurAlAI timIharU bujhdainau | jasale timIharUko bhASAmA allAhako pavitratAko guNagAna garchan, timIharU tyasalAI mAtra bujhchau | nissandeha allAha sahanazIla hunuhuncha, turuntai sajAya dinuhunna | allAha taubA garneharUprati kSamAzIla hunuhuncha |

45 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) jaba tapAIM kurAnako pATha garnuhuncha ra yI bahudevavAdIharUle tyasamA rahekA upadeza ra cetAvanI sunchan, taba hAmIle tapAIM ra mahApralayako dinamAthi ImAna narAkhne bahudevavAdIharUbIca euTA pardA kAyama garidinchauM, jasale tinIharUlAI kurAna bujhnabATa rokcha | tinIharU vimukha bhaekAle sajAya svarUpa hAmI yasto garchauM |

46 hAmIle tinIharUkA hRdayalAI pardAle DhAkidinchauM tAki tinIharU kurAna bujhnai nasakun ra tinIharUkA kAna bahirA pAridinchauM tAki tinIharU tyasabATa phAidA uThAune garI sunna nasakun | jaba tapAIMle kurAnamA eka mAtra allAhako carcA garnuhuncha ra tinIharUkA tathAkathita pUjyaharUko carcA garnuhunna taba tinIharU eka allAhalAI mAnnabATa piThyU~ pharkAera TADhA bhAgchan |

47 tinIharUkA aguvAharUle kasarI kurAna sunchan bhanne kurAlAI hAmI rAmrarI jAndachauM | tinIharU mArgadarzana cA~hadainan | tapAIMle kurAnako pATha gardA tinIharUle tyasalAI halkA linchan ra tyasamA bAdhA utpanna garne prayAsa garchan | tinIharU tyasalAI jhUTo Thahara garne ra tyasamA bAdhA utpanna garnebAre je jati kAnekhusI garchan tyasalAI hAmI rAmrarI jAndachauM | tyatikhera yI atyAcArIharU kuphra gardai bhanchan– he mAnava! timIharU ta kevala ekajanA jAdU garieko ra buddhihIna vyaktiko anusaraNa garchau |

48 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! tinIharUle tapAIMko bAremA yastA narAmrA kurAharU bhandaichan jasamA tapAIMle vicAra gardA tapAIMlAI Azcarya hunecha | tyasaile tinIharU pathabhraSTa bhae ra satmArga pAuna sakenan |
49 bahudevavAdIharUle punarjIvita hune kurAlAI inkAra gardai bhane– ke jaba hAmI marera saDera karaGga ra haDDI mAtra hunechauM taba hAmIlAI punaH jIvita pArine cha ta? yo asambhava kurA ho |

50 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) bahudevavAdIharUlAI bhanidinuhos– timIharU kaThoratAmA DhuGgA banna sakchau bhane bana vA zaktimA phalAma banna sakchau bhane bana | timIharU kadApi DhuGgA vA phalAma banna sakdainau |

51 vA timIharU yI duvai vastuharUbhandA pani zaktizAlI sRSTi banna sakchau bhane bana | timIharU je bane pani allAhale timIharUlAI jasarI pahilopaTaka sRSTi garnubhaeko thiyo tyasarI nai punaH jIvita pArnuhunecha | yI zatruharUle javAphamA bhannechan– mRtyupachi hAmIharUlAI kasale jIvita pArnecha ta? he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! bhanidinuhos– jasale timIharUlAI pahilo paTaka binA kunai namunA zunyabATa sRSTi garnubhayo uhA~le nai dosro paTaka pani sRSTi garnuhunecha | tapAIMko javAphako ThaTTA gardai, TAuko hallAu~dai ra yasalAI asambhava ThAndai sodhnechan– yo kahile hunecha?! bhanidinuhos– yo cA~Dai nai hunecha! kinabhane AunevAlA samaya ekadamai najika cha |

52 allAhale timIharUlAI tyasa dina punarjIvita garnuhunecha juna dina timIharUlAI hazra (bhelA garine maidAna) mA bolAunuhunecha | ani timIharUle uhA~ko AjJApAlana gardai ra prazaMsA gardai hAjira hunechau | tyasa dina timIharUle saMsAramA thorai dina bitAekA chauM bhanne anumAna garnechau |

53 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! merA momina bhaktaharUlAI bhanidinuhos– unIharUle vArtAlApa gardA rAmro kurA mAtra garne garun ra ghRNita tathA narAmrA kurA nagarun | vAstavamA zaitAnale tyasako anucita phAidA uThAera mAnavaharUbIca jhagaDA utpanna garera unIharUkA loka ra paraloka duvailAI barbAda pArna cAhancha | nizcaya nai zaitAna mAnavako khullama khullA zatru ho | mAnavale tyasabATa sAvadhAna rahanuparcha |

54 he mAnava! allAha timIharUko bAremA sabai kurA jAnnuhuncha | uhA~bATa timIharUko kunai pani kurA lukeko chaina | uhA~le cAhanubhaemA timIharUmAthi dayA gardai ImAna lyAune ra satkarma garne avasara dinuhunecha | uhA~le cAhanubhaemA timIharUlAI ImAna lyAune avasara nadiera ra kuphramAthi mRtyu garAera yAtanAko bhAgidAra banAunuhunecha | he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! hAmIle tapAIMlAI mAnisaharUkA rakSaka (jimmedAra) banAera paThAekA chainau ki tapAIMle unIharUlAI ImAna lyAuna bAdhya pArnuhos, kuphrabATa roknuhos ra tinIharUkA karmaharUko gantI garnuhos | tapAIMko jimmevArI tinIharUsamma allAhako Adeza anusAra uhA~ko sandeza puryAunu mAtra ho |

55 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! AkAzaharU ra pRthvImA rahekA sabai vastuharUsa~ga allAha rAmrarI avagata hunuhuncha | uhA~le tinIharUkA avasthAlAI jAnnuhuncha | tinIharU kuna kurAko hakadAra chan bhanne kurAlAI pani uhA~ jAnnuhuncha | hAmIle kehI sandeSTAharUlAI baDhI saMkhyAmA anuyAyI pradAna garera ra kitAba pradAna garera anya kehI sandeSTAharUmAthi zreSThatA pradAna garekAchauM | hAmIle nai dAUda (alaihissalAma) lAI jabUra nAmaka kitAba pradAna garekAchauM |

56 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! bhanidinuhos– he bahudevavAdIharU ho! timIharUko vicAramA allAhabAheka anya kohI pUjyaharU chan bhane kaSTako samayamA tinIharUlAI pukArera hera | tinIharUmA kehI pani garne kSamatA chaina | tinIharUle nata timIharUkA kaSTa nivAraNa garna sakchan na tyasalAI timIbATa haTAera anya kasaisamma puryAuna sakchan | kehI pani garna sakne kSamatA narAkhne Izvara huna sakdaina |

57 tinIharUle juna phariztAharU vA anya kasailAI pukArchan, unIharU svayam AphnA pAlanakartAko nikaTatA prApta garnakA lAgi satkarma jastA mAdhyama khojdaichan ra AjJApAlana gardai yasako lAgi pratispardhA gardaichan | unIharU allAhako dayAko AzA rAkhchan ra uhA~ko yAtanAbATa DarAu~chan | he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! vAstavamA tapAIMkA pAlanakartAko yAtanA ekadamai DaralAgdo cha |

58 kAphiraharU basobAsa gareko junasukai gAU~ vA zahara cha, tyasalAI hAmIle sAMsArika jIvanamA tinIharUko kuphrako kAraNale prakopa paThAera dhvasta pAryauM vA hatyA garera yAtanA diyauM | yo allAhale nizcita garnubhaeko bhAgya ho jo lauhe mahaphUja (surakSita pATI) mA lipIbaddha bhaisakeko cha |

59 bahudevavAdIharUle gareko mAga anusAra rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) lAI hAmIle bhautika camatkAraharU jastai- mRtalAI jIvita pArnu ityAdi pradAna garenauM | kinabhane hAmIle vigatakA samudAyaharUtarpha bhautika camatkAraharU avataraNa garekA thiyauM tara tinIharUle jhUTo Thahara garekA thie | hAmIle samUda samudAyalAI ThUlo ra spaSTa nizAnIko rUpamA U~TanI pradAna garekA thiyauM, tara tinIharUle jhUTo Thahara gare | ani hAmIle turuntai prakopa paThAera tinIharUlAI samAtyauM | hAmIle rasUlaharUko hAtabATa junasukai camatkAraharU paThAu~chauM tyo unIharUkA samudAyalAI DarAunako lAgi paThAu~chauM tAki tinIharUle islAma grahaNa garun |

60 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) smaraNa garnuhos, jaba hAmIle bhanyauM– nissandeha tapAIMkA pAlanakartAle mAnisaharUlAI Aphno zaktile gherAmA linubhaeko cha ra tinIharU uhA~ko niyantraNamA chan | allAhale tapAIMlAI tinIharUbATa surakSita rAkhnuhunecha | tapAIMlAI juna sandeza puryAune Adeza bhaeko cha tyasako pracAra prasAra garnuhos | isrA (makkAdekhi baitul-makdisasammako rAtiko yAtrA) mA hAmIle tapAIMlAI je jati dekhAyauM tyo mAnisaharUkA lAgi parIkSA thiyo ki unIharU tyasako puSTi garchan vA jhUTo Thahara garchan? kurAnamA varNana garieko jakkUma nAmI tiraskAra garieko rUkhalAI mAnisaharUkA lAgi parIkSA banAyauM | yo vRkSa narkako phedabATa umranecha | yadi tinIharUle yI duIvaTA nizAnIharUmA ImAna lyAu~dainan bhane tinIharUle anya nizAnIharUmA pani ImAna lyAune chainan | hAmI AphnA nizAnIharU avataraNa garera tinIharUlAI DarAu~daichauM tara cetAvanIle tinIharUko kuphra ra pathabhraSTatAmA nai vRddhi gardacha |

61 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! smaraNa garnuhos tyasa avasaralAI jaba hAmIle phariztAharUlAI bhanyauM– Adama (alaihissalAma) lAI salAmI dinako lAgi sajdA gara, unako bhaktiko lAgi hoina | taba Adezako pAlanA gardai sabaile sajdA gare | tara iblIsale ghamaNDa gardai sajdA garna inkAra garyo ra bhanyo– ke ma yasto vyaktilAI sajdA garu~ jasalAI tapAIMle mATobATa sRSTi garnubhayo ra jabaki malAI AgobATa sRSTi garnueko ho?! ma U bhandA zreSTha chu |

62 iblIsale allAhalAI bhanyo– ke yahI tyo prANI ho, jasako sAmu malAI sajdA garne Adeza diera usalAI mamAthi zreSThatA pradAna garnubhayo? yadi tapAIMle malAI yasa lokako antasamma jIvita rAkhnuhuncha bhane usakA sampUrNa santAnalAI tapAIMko sIdhA mArgabATa bahakAunechu | mero bahakAvAbATa tapAIMkA thorai asala bhaktaharU surakSita rahanechan jasalAI tapAIMle jogAunuhunecha |
63 allAhale bhannubhayo– timI jAU | tinIharUmadhye timro anusaraNa garneharUko ra timro ThegAnA narka nai ho, jo timIharUkA kAryako bharapura badalA ho |

64 tinIharUmadhye ja-jasalAI timI bahakAuna sakchau Aphno AvAjale bahakAU ra avajJA garne ahvAna gara | tinIharUmAthi AphnA ghoDasavAra ra paidala hiMDne duvaidvArA tinIharUlAI Aphno AjJApAlanako ahvAna gara | islAmI kAnuna viparIta tinIharUkA dhana-sampattilAI AkarSaka tulyAU ra sAjhedAra bana | jhUTo vacana diera, vyabhicAra garAera ra kehI kAma suru gardA allAhabAheka anya kasaiko nAma liera tinIharUkA santAnamA pani sAjhedAra bana | jhUTo vacana ra cAhanAlAI AkarSaka tulyAU | zaitAnale tinIharUlAI dieko vacana jhUTo mAtra ho jasale gardA tinIharU dhokA khAnchan |

65 he iblIsa! mero AjJApAlana garne momina bhaktaharUmAthi timro kehI calne chaina | kinabhane allAhale unIharUlAI timro duSTatAbATa jogAunuhunecha | sahayogIko rUpamA allAha tI mAnisaharUkA lAgi paryApta hunuhuncha jasale AphnA mAmilAharUmA uhA~mAthi bharosA garchan |

66 he mAnava! timIharUkA pAlanakartA allAha nai hunuhuncha jasale samudramA DuGgA calna lagAunuhuncha tAki timIharUle vyApAra ityAdidvArA jIvikA khoja | nissandeha uhA~ timIharUprati parama dayAlu hunuhuncha tyasaile yI sAdhanaharU pradAna garnubhayo |

67 he bahudevavAdIharU ho! jaba samudramA timIharUmAthi saGkaTa AilAgcha ra timIharUko jyAna nai jAne khatarA huncha taba timIharUle pUjA garne garekA sabai devI devatAharUlAI birsera allAhalAI mAtrai pukArchau ra uhA~sa~ga mAtrai maddata khojdachau | jaba uhA~le surakSita DhaGgale timIharUlAI jaminamA puryAi dinuhuncha taba timIharU uhA~bATa vimukha hunchau ani uhA~lAI mAtra napukArera anya devI devatAharUlAI pukArna thAlchau | vAstavamai mAnava allAhakA varadAnaharUko inkAra garnegarcha |

68 he bahudevavAdIharU ho! jaba allAhale timIharUlAI jalabATa jogAera thalamA lyAunubhayo, ke timIharU yasa kurAbATa nizcinta chau ki uhA~le timIharUlAI dhartImA dha~sAunuhunecha vA timIharUmAthi DhuGgA barsAunuhunecha, jasarI lUta (alaihissalAma) ko samudAyamAthi barsAunubhayo? uhA~le yasto garemA timIharU AphUlAI yasabATa jogAune kunai sahayogI pAune chainau |

69 ke timIharU yasa kurAbATa pani nizcinta chau ki allAhale timIharUlAI pheri samudramA phirtA liera jAnuhunecha ra timIharUmAthi kRtaghnatAle gardA bhayAnaka A~dhI paThAera DubAunuhunecha? tyasa bakhata timIharUko samarthanamA hAmIsita sodhapUcha garnevAlA kohI hune chaina |

70 hAmIle Adama (alaihissalAma) kA santAnalAI buddhi pradAna garera tathA unIharUkA pUrvajalAI phariztAharUdvArA sajdA garAera sammAnita tulyAekA chauM | tinIharUlAI hAmIle thalamA janAvara ra gADI jastA savArI pradAna garyauM ra jalamA DuGgA jastA savArI pradAna garyauM | hAmIle tinIharUlAI bhojana, peyapadArtha ra vivAha jastA pavitra jIvikA pradAna garyauM | hAmIle sRSTi garekA dherai sRSTiharUmAthi tinIharUlAI zreSThatA pradAna garyauM | tinIharUle yI varadAnaharUkA lAgi allAhaprati AbhAra vyakta garnuparcha |

71 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! tyasa dinako kalpanA garnuhos, jaba hAmIle pratyeka samUhalAI unakA aguvAsahita bolAunechauM | jasalAI usako karma-patra dAhine hAtamA diinecha tI vyaktiharUle ullAsakA sAtha Aphno karma-patra paDhnechan | unIharUkA puNyamA kaNa barAbara pani kamI garine chaina |
