72 jo vyakti yasa lokamA satyalAI svIkAra garna ra tyasako pAlanA garnabATa andho banera basnecha tyo mahApralayako dina jhana andho bannecha ra svarga jAne mArga pAune chaina baru mArga vihIna bhaera rahanecha | karma anusAra nai badalA milne garcha |

73 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! hAmIle tapAIMmAthi avataraNa gareko kurAnako vahI (prakAzanA) bATa yI bahudevavAdIharUle tapAIMlAI pathabhraSTa garne A~Ta garekA thie tAki tapAIMle hAmro nAmamA Aphno tarphabATa anya kunai kurA racera peza garnuhos; jo tinIharUko cAhanA anusAra hos | tapAIMle yasto gareko bhae tinIharUle pakkai tapAIMlAI mitra banAune thie |

74 yadi hAmIle tapAIMlAI satyamAthi aDiga napAreko bhae tapAIM tinIharUtarpha kehI hadasamma jhuknuhunthyo ra tinIharUko calakhelale gardA tathA yasa kurAko cAhanAmA tinIharUko kurAko puSTi garnuhunthyo ki tinIharUle ImAna lyAun | tara hAmIle yasabATa tapAIMlAI jogAyauM |

75 yadi tapAIM tinIharUtarpha jhuknuhunthyo bhane hAmIle tapAIMlAI yasa lokamA pani duI guNA yAtanAko svAda cakhAune thiyauM ra paralokamA pani | tyatikhera mero yAtanAbATa jogAune kunai sahayogI pAunuhune thiena |

76 kAphiraharU zatrutAle gardA tapAIMlAI makkAbATa niSkAsita garna bAdhya pArdai thie | tara allAhale unIharUlAI roknubhayo | yahA~samma ki tapAIMle allAhako Adeza anusAra makkAbATa hijrata (basAi~-sarAI) garnubhayo | yadi tinIharUle tapAIMlAI tyahA~bATa niSkAsita garekA bhae tapAIMko niSkAsanapachi tinIharU kehI dina mAtra basna sakne thie |

77 tapAIMlAI niSkAsita garepachi tinIharU kehI dinasamma mAtra tyahA~ basne thie bhanne kurA hAmro sunnata (kAnuna) ho; jasalAI hAmIle tapAIMbhandA pahile paThAekA AphnA rasUlaharUmAthi lAgu gardai AekAchauM | jaba-jaba kunai samudAyale Aphno rasUlalAI niSkAsita garyo taba-taba allAhale tyasamAthi Aphno prakopa avataraNa garnubhayo | he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! tapAIMle hAmro sunnatamA kunai parivartana pAunuhunna |

78 samayako pAlanAkA sAtha pUrNarUpamA namAja kAyama gara | sUrya Dhalkepachi namAja kAyama gara, yasamA juhara ra asrako namAja pardachan | rAta pUrai a~dhyAro huJjelasamma namAja kAyama gara | yasamA magriba ra izAko namAja pardachan | phajrako namAja kAyama gara ra tyasamA kurAnako lAmo pATha gara | nissandeha phajrako namAjamA rAta ra dina duvaikA phariztAharU hAjira hunchan |

79 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama!) rAtako kehI bhAgamA tahajjuda paDhne garnuhos | yo atirikta (naphila) namAjale tapAIMko sthAnalAI ucca pArnecha | tapAIMkA pAlanakartAle mahApralayako dina tapAIMlAI siphArisakartA banAunuhunecha | tapAIMle mahApralayako bhayAvaha ghaDImA mAnisaharUko siphArisa garnuhunecha | tapAIMko lAgi siphArisako ucca sthAna hunecha, jasako prazaMsA surudekhi liera antasammakA mAnisaharUle garnechan |

80 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! prArthanA garnuhos– he merA pAlanakartA! malAI jahA~ pani liera jAnuhos ra jahA~bATa pani nikAlnuhos Aphno AjJApAlanako sAtha ra khusIkA anusAra nikAlnuhos | Aphno tarphabATa malAI yasto pramANa pradAna garnuhos jasale gardA zatruviruddha sahayoga pugos |

81 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! yI bahudevavAdIharUlAI bhannuhos– islAma dharmako vijaya bhayo | allAhako maddata Aipugyo | zirka ra kuphra nirmUla bhayo | satyako agADi asatya nirmUla nai huncha |

82 hAmI yasto kurAna avataraNa garirahekA chauM jo hRdayaharUmA rahekA ajJAnatA, kuphra ra zaGkAko upacAra ho | zarIramAthi paDhera phu~kdA tyasako pani upacAra garcha | kurAna tI mominaharUkA lAgi dayA ho jo tyasa anusAra karma garchan | yasale kAphiraharUko barbAdImA mAtra abhivRddhi garcha | kinabhane jaba tinIharU kurAnalAI sunchan taba tinIharUko risa, jhUTo Thahara garne ra vimukha hune kAryamA nai abhivRddhi huncha |

83 jaba hAmI mAnavalAI svAsthya ra dhana jastA varadAnaharU pradAna garchauM taba U hAmIprati AbhAra ra AjJApAlana garnabATa vimukha huncha ra ghamaNDa gardai TADhA bhAgcha | tara jaba usalAI roga ra garibI jasto kunai kaSTa pugcha taba U allAhako kRpAbATa ati nai nirAza huncha |

84 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! bhanidinuhos– pratyeka vyakti tyasai prakAra kArya garcha jati U mArgadarzanamA huncha vA pathabhraSTatAmA huncha | kuna vyakti sidhA mArgamA cha bhanne kurA allAhale nai rAmrarI jAnnuhuncha |

85 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! yahUdI ra IsAImadhye kAphiraharU tapAIMsita rUha (AtmA) ko vAstavikatA bAre sodhchan | bhanidinuhos– rUhako vAstavikatA allAhalAI mAtra thAhA cha | timIharU ra sabai sRSTilAI allAhako tarphabATa ekadamai kama jJAna diieko cha |

86 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama!) tapAIMtarpha avataraNa garekA vahI (prakAzanA) lAI chAtI ra kitAbabATa hAmIle samApta pArna cAhemA samApta pArna sakchauM | ani tapAIMle Aphno lAgi kunai sahayogI pAunuhunna, jasale yasalAI phirtA lyAera deos |

87 tara allAhale Aphno kRpAle tapAIMbATa vahI (prakAzanA) khosnu bhaena baru yasalAI surakSita pArnubhayo | vAstavamA allAhale tapAIMmAthi ThUlo kRpA garnubhaeko cha | uhA~le tapAIMlAI vizvavyApI rasUla banAunubhayo, tapAIMlAI antima rasUla banAera IzdUtatva samApta pArnubhayo ra tapAIMmAthi kurAna avataraNa garnubhayo |

jaba bahudevavAdIharUle kurAnalAI mAnavako vANI ThAnera yasamA pherabadala garne prastAva rAkhe taba allAhale kurAna jasto vANI lyAuna cunauti dinubhayoH
88 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! bhanidinuhos– yadi manuSya ra jinna sabai milera yasa kurAna jasto zuddha, laya mileko ra sAhityika kitAba lyAune prayAsa gare pani kadApi lyAuna sakne chainan cAhe tinIharUle ApasamA eka arkAko sahayoga nai kina nagarun |

89 hAmIle yasa kurAnamA mAnavalAI prazikSaNa dinakA lAgi hareka prakArakA upadeza, pATha, Adeza, manAhI ra satya kathA prastuta garekAchauM | yasa AzAkA sAtha ki mAnavale ImAna lyAun | tara adhikAMsa mAnisaharUle inkAra gare | tinIharUle kurAnalAI jhUTo Thahara gare |

jaba tinIharUle kurAna jasto vANI lyAuna sakenan taba tinIharUle nimna khAlakA prastAvaharU prastuta garna thAleH
90 bahudevavAdIharUle bhane– jabasamma tapAIMle makkAko bhUmibATa hAmro lAgi sadhaiM bagirahane mUla phuTAunu hunna tabasamma hAmI tapAIMmAthi ImAna lyAu~dainauM |
91 vA tapAIMsa~ga khajura ra aMgurako yasto bagaiMcA hunuparcha jasako bIcamA naharaharU kalakala bagirahekA houn |

92 vA tapAIMle gareko dAbI anusAra AkAzalAI phuTAera prakopa lyAunuhos | vA allAha ra phariztAharUlAI lyAera hAmrA sAmunne sAkSAtarUpamA khaDA garnuhos jasale tapAIMle gareko dAvI ThIka ho bhanera gavAhI deun |

93 vA tapAIMko sunako mahala hos | vA tapAIM AkAzamAthi caDhnuhos | hAmI tapAIMle caDheko kurAlAI pani vizvAsa gardainauM jabasamma tapAIMle tyahA~bATa kunai kitAba avataraNa garnuhunna jasamA yo kurA lekheko hos ki tapAIM allAhako rasUla hunuhuncha, jasalAI hAmI svayam paDhauM | he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! bhanidinuhos– merA pAlanakartA pavitra hunuhuncha | ma ta anya rasUlaharU jastai mAnava ra rasUla hu~ | ma kehI pani lyAune sAmarthya rAkhdina | ani timIharUle prastAva gareko vastu kasarI lyAuna sakchu ta?!

94 kAphiraharUle allAha ra uhA~kA rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) mAthi ImAna lyAuna ra uhA~ (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) le lyAunubhaeko sandeza anusAra karma garna yasa kAraNale inkAra gare ki uhA~ (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) mAnava hunuhunthyo | tinIharUle bhane– ke allAhale ekajanA mAnavalAI hAmItarpha rasUla banAera paThAunubhayo ta?!

95 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! tinIharUkA kurAko khaNDana gardai bhanidinuhos– yadi dhartImA phariztAharU nizcinta bhaI hiMDDula garekA bhae ra basobAsa garekA bhae hAmIle tinIharUsamakSa AkAzabATa kunai phariztAlAI nai rasUla banAera paThAune thiyauM | kinabhane unIharUle nai allAhako sandezalAI bujhAuna sakthe |

96 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! bhanidinuhos– mero ra timIharUko bica allAha nai sAkSIko rUpamA paryApta hunuhuncha | ma uhA~ko rasUla hu~ ra maile uhA~ko sandeza timIharUsamakSa puryAi sakeko chu | uhA~ AphnA bhaktaharUkA avasthAharUbAre pUrNa jJAtA hunuhuncha | uhA~bATa kehI pani lukeko chaina | uhA~le unIharUkA manamA lukekA kurAharU pani dekhirahanu bhaeko cha |

97 jasalAI allAhale mArgadarzana garnuhuncha, tyo vyaktile mAtra mArgadarzana pAu~cha | jasalAI allAhale apamAnita ra pathabhraSTa garnuhuncha he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! usako lAgi tapAIMle satmArga dekhAune, hAnilAI TArne ra phAidA puryAune mitra pAunuhunna | hAmIle tinIharUlAI mahApralayako dina ghopTo pArera ekatrita garnechauM, na tinIharU dekhna saknechan, na bolna saknechan ra na sunna saknechan | tinIharUko vAsasthAna narka hunecha | jaba-jaba narkako Ago nibhna thAlnecha taba taba hAmI tyasako jvAlAlAI salkAunechauM |

98 yo hunecha tinIharUko sajAya | kinabhane tinIharUle hAmrA rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) mAthi avatarita nizAnIharUko inkAra gare | sAthai punarjIvita garine kurA asambhava ThAndai bhane– ke jaba hAmI saDera hADakA TukrA TAkrI huna pugnechauM, taba ke hAmI euTA nayA~ sRSTiko rUpamA punarjIvita hunechauM?

tinIharUko inkArako varNanapachi tyasalAI khaNDana gardai allAhale bhannubhayoH
99 ke punarjIvanako inkAra garneharUle jAnenan– juna allAhale yati mahAn AkAzaharU ra pRthvIko sRjanA garnubhayo uhA~ tyastai ra tyasabhandA sAno vastulAI sRjanA garne avazya nai sAmarthya rAkhnuhuncha? uhA~le unIharUkA lAgi saMsAramA euTA samaya nirdhArita garnubhaeko cha, jo eka dina samApta huncha | unIharUlAI punarjIvita pArnakA lAgi uhA~le euTA samaya nirdhArita garnubhaeko cha jasamA kunai sandeha chaina | tara bahudevavAdIharUle punarjIvita pArine spaSTa nizAnIharUkA bAvajuda tyasalAI inkAra gare |

100 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! yI bahudevavAdIharUlAI bhanidinuhos– yadi kahilyai samApta nahune merA pAlanakartAko dayAko khajAnA pani timIharUsa~ga bhaeko bhae timIharUle tyasalAI samApta hune Darale rokera rAkhne thiyau ra kharca garne thienau | tAki timIharU gariba nahoU | kanjusyAi~ garnu mAnavako svabhAva ho | mominaharUko kurA beglai cha | unIharU puNya pAune AzAle kharca garnegarchan |

jaba nabI (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) lAI bahudevavAdIharUle jhUTo Thahara garera duHkha die taba allAhale uhA~ (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) ko sAntvanAko lAgi mUsA (alaihissalAma) ko satya kathA avataraNa garnubhayo ra bhannubhayoH
101 hAmIle mUsA (alaihissalAma) lAI nauvaTA spaSTa pramANaharU pradAna garyauM | tI pramANaharU thieH lauro, hAta, sukhkhA, phalako kamI, bADhI, phaTyAGgrA, uDusa, bhyAguto ra ragata | he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! yahUdIlAI sodhnuhos– jaba mUsA (alaihissalAma) tinIharUkA pUrvajasamakSa tI pramANaharU liera Ae taba phiraunale unalAI bhanyo– he mUsA! ma timIlAI jAdUpIDita ThAndachu | kinabhane timI yI acammakA kurAharU liera AekA chau |

102 mUsA (alaihissalAma) le usako khaNDana gardai bhane– timIlAI thAhA cha ki yI spaSTa nizAnIharU AkAzaharU ra pRthvIkA pAlanakartAle Aphno sAmarthyako pramANasvarUpa ra Aphno rasUlako puSTiko lAgi avataraNa garnubhaeko cha | tara timI yasako inkAra garchau | he phirauna! malAI thAhA cha timI vinAza hune vyakti hau |
103 phiraunale mUsA (alaihissalAma) ra banI isrAIlalAI misrako bhUmibATa niSkAsita garera sajAya dine vicAra garyo tara hAmIle Usameta Usa~ga rahekA sabai sainikaharUlAI DubAI diyauM |

104 phirauna ra Usa~ga rahekA sainikaharUlAI vinAza garepachi hAmIle banI isrAIlalAI bhanyauM– sIriyAko bhUbhAgamA basobAsa gara | ani jaba mahApralayako vAcA Aipugcha hAmI timIharU sabailAI hisAbako lAgi hazrako maidAnamA jammA garera lyAunechauM |

105 hAmIle yasa kurAnalAI muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) mAthi satyakA sAtha avataraNa garyauM ra tyo satyakai sAtha binA kunai pherabadala avataraNa bhaeko cha | he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! hAmIle tapAIMlAI Izabhaya rAkhneharUlAI svargako zubha-sUcanA dina, kAphira ra avajJAkArIharUlAI narkabATa saceta garna paThAekAchauM |

106 yasa kurAnalAI hAmIle thorai-thorai garI spaSTarUpamA avataraNa garekAchauM | mAnisaharUlAI bujhna ra kurAnamA cintana-manan garna sajilo hos bhanera tapAIM samayako antarAlamA paDhera sunAunuhos | hAmIle yasalAI avasthA ra ghaTanA anusAra vistArai-vistArai avataraNa garekAchauM |

107 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! bhanidinuhos: timIharU yasamAthi ImAna lyAe pani timIharUko ImAnale tyasamA kunai vRddhi hu~daina | timIharUle ImAna nalyAe pani timIharUko kuphrale tyasamA kunai kamI hu~daina | vAstavamA juna mAnisaharUle vigatakA AkAzIya kitAbaharU paDhekA chan ra vahI (prakAzanA) tathA IzadUtatvabATa avagata chan, jaba unIharU samakSa yasako pATha garincha taba allAhaprati AbhAra vyakta garnako lAgi sajdAmA jAnchan |

108 unIharU sajdAmA bhanchan– hAmrA pAlanakartA vacana bhaGga garnabATa pavitra hunuhuncha | uhA~le muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) ko Agamanako bAremA juna vAcA garnubhaeko cha tyasalAI avazya pUrA garnuhunecha |
109 unIharU allAhako Darale ru~dai sajdA garchan | kurAna sundA ra yasako arthamA vicAra gardA unIharUko vinamratAmA jhan vRddhi huncha |

110 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! he allAha, he rahamAna bhanera duA gardA rokneharUlAI bhanidinuhos– allAha ra rahamAna duvai allAhakA nAmaharU hun | timIharUle allAhalAI uhA~kA yI duIvaTA nAma vA anya nAmaharUbATa pani pukArna sakchau | allAhakA dherai sundara nAmaharU chan | Aphno namAjamA ati ucca svaramA kurAnako pATha nagarnuhos ki bahudevavAdIharUle sunun ra ati nimna svaramA pani pATha nagarnuhos ki mominaharUle sunna nasakun | baru yI duvaikA bicako mArga apanAunuhos |

111 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! bhanidinuhos– sampUrNa prazaMsAharU allAhakai lAgi hun | uhA~ hareka kisimakA prazaMsAkA hakadAra hunuhuncha | uhA~ putra banAune kArya ra sAjhedArIbATa pavitra hunuhuncha | uhA~ko sattA-zAsanamA kohI sAjhedAra chaina | uhA~lAI kasaile kahilyai pani apamAnita garna sakdaina | uhA~lAI nata sahayogIko AvazyaktA cha na samarthana puryAune vyaktiko | allAhako khubai mahimAgAna gara | uhA~ko lAgi kasailAI putra, sAjhedAra ra sahayogI nabanAU |

1 sampUrNa kisimakA prazaMsA tathA guNagAnaharU allAhakai lagi hun | jasale AphnA bhakta tathA sandeSTA muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi vasallama) mAthi kurAna avataraNa garnubhayo | yasa kurAnamA alikati pani TeDhopana chaina |

2 allAhale yasa kurAnalAI virodhAbhASa ra matabhedabATa mukta rAkhI sIdhA ra utkRSTa mArgadarzana banAunu bhaeko cha | yasale kAphira (allAhalAI namAnne) harUlAI kaThora yAtanAbATa DarAu~cha ra momina (AsthAvAna) harUlAI sadAsarvadA rahane utkRSTa pratidAnako zubhasUcanA dincha |
3 mominaharU sadA sarvadA svargamA rahanechan | yo pratiphala kahilyai samApta hunechaina |
4 allAhako santAna cha bhanne yahUdI, IsAI ra bahudevavAdIharUlAI yasa kurAnamArphata cetAvanI diieko cha |

5 allAhako santAna cha bhanera abhiyoga lagAuneharUsa~ga ra yasa viSayamA unIharUle anusaraNa garne garekA pUrvajaharUsa~ga na kehI jJAna cha na kunai pramANa nai | unIharUko mukhabATa binA viveka niskeko yo kurA ati ghRNita cha | unIharUle bhaneko kurA jhUTo, AdhArahIna ra tathyahIna raheko cha |

6 sambhavataH he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) – tinIharUle yasa kurAnamAthi AsthA rAkhenan bhanI cintita bhaera tapAIMle Aphno jyAna nai gumAunu hunecha | yaso na garnuhos | yinIharUko mArgadarzana tapAIMko jimmAmA chaina | baru tapAIMko dAyitva sandeza puryAunu mAtra ho |

7 hAmIle yasa saMsAramA rahekA sampUrNa sRSTilAI yasa pRthvIko lAgi zobhA banAyauM | tAki kasale allAhako prasannatAko lAgi satkarma garnecha ra kasale uhA~ko avajJA gardai kukarma garnecha bhani parikSA garauM | hAmI sampUrNalAI unIharUko karma anusAra nai badalA dinechauM |
8 hAmI yasa saMsAramA rahekA sampUrNa sRSTilAI yasa jIvanako samApti pazcAta boTabiruvA rahitako mATo banAunechauM | ataH unIharUle yasabATa zikSA grahaNa garun |

9 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! yo kadApi naThAnnuholA ki guphAvAlAharU ra unIharUko nAma lekhieko zilAlekhako kathA hAmrA nizAnIharU madhyekA ati Azcaryajanaka nizAnIharU hun baru tyasa bAhekakA nizAnIharU baDhI Azcaryajanaka chan jastai- AkAzaharU ra dhartIko sRSTi |

10 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! smaraNa garnuhos, jaba tI AsthAvAn navayuvakaharU Aphno AsthAlAI jogAuna bhAgera guphAmA Azraya lina puge | ani AphnA pAlanakartAsita duA gareH he hAmrA pAlanakartA! hAmIlAI Aphno vizeSa kRpAko pAtra banAunuhos | hAmrA pApaharU kSamA garnuhos, hAmIlAI hAmrA zatruharUbATa bacAunuhos, adharmIharUbATa bacera bhAgnu ra AsthAko surakSA garnulAI hAmro lAgi satyatAko bATomA hi~Dne ra bhalAIko sAdhana banAidinuhos |
11 guphAmA Azraya lie pazcAta hAmIle unIharUko kAnamA pardA lagAyauM, tAki kunai AvAja nasunun ra dherai varSasamma unIharUlAI sutAyauM |
12 lAmo samayako nidrA pazcAta hAmIle unIharUlAI byU~jhAyauM | guphAmA bitAeko avadhiko viSayamA vivAdAspada dubai samUhamadhye kasale rAmrarI jAndachan bhani herauM hAmro uddezya thiyo |

13 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! hAmI tapAIMlAI tinIharUko vAstavika kathA sunAu~daichauM ra yasamA kunai zaGkA chaina | tinIharU navayuvaka thie, jasale AphnA pAlanakartAmA AsthA rAkhekA thie ra uhA~ko anusaraNa garthe | tasartha hAmIle unIharUlAI ajhai mArgadarzana pradAna garyauM ra islAmamAthi kAyama rahana aDiga tulyAyauM |

14 hAmIle unIharUko hRdayamA AsthAlAI sudRDha tulyAyauM | mAtRbhUmI chADera palAyana hunakA nimti dhairya dhAraNa garne zakti pradAna garyauM | unIharUle adharmI rAjA samakSa satya Izvara allAhamAthi Aphno AsthAko pradarzana gardai bhaneH hAmrA pAlanakartA nai AkAzaharU tathA yasa dhartIkA pAlanakartA hunuhuncha | uhA~mAthi hAmIle AsthA rAkhyauM ra uhA~kai upAsanA garyauM | hAmI uhA~ bAheka arU kasaiko upAsanA garne chainauM | yadi uhA~ bAheka arU kasaiko upAsanA garyauM bhane hAmIle nitAnta satyabATa TADhieko kAma garyauM |

15 tyasapachi tinIharUle eka arkAlAI sambodhana gardai bhane yI mAnisaharUle allAhabAheka arUlAI upAsya banAekA chan | vAstavamA unIharUsa~ga tinIharU upAsanAko lAyaka bhaeko spaSTa pramANa chaina | allAhako sAjhedAra Thahara garera allAhamAthi mithyA abhiyoga lagAune vyaktibhandA baDhI atyAcAra kohI chaina |

16 jaba timIharUle Aphno samudAya ra unIharUle allAhabAheka pUjne garekA sampUrNalAI choDyau ra kevala allAhako upAsanA garne saGkalpa garyau ta Aphno AsthAko surakSAko lAgi guphAmA zaraNa liU | timrA pAlanakartAle timIharUmAthi dayA garnuhunecha ra timIharUlAI zatrubATa bacAunu hunecha | timIharUlAI Aphnai samudAyamA jIvana vyatIta garna sahaja hunecha |

17 unIharUle Adezako pAlanA gare | allAhale unIharUlAI nidrA pradAna garnubhayo ra yasarI unIharUlAI zatrubATa bacAunubhayo | sUrya pUrvabATa udAune samayamA unIharUko guphAko dAyA~tira Dhalkadai udAu~thyo ra astAune samayamA uttaratira Dhalkadai astAu~thyo tara sidhA guphAmA pardainathyo | unIharU sadA chAyA~mA nai hune gardathe | unIharU guphA khullA ThAu~mA bhaekole cAhine jati hAvA Au~thyo | unIharUle guphAmA zaraNa linu, tyahA~ nidAunu, ghAmabATa joginu, unIharUko ThAu~ pharAkilo hunu ra unIharUko samudAyabATa joginu allAha prabhutvazAlI hunuhuncha bhanne pramANa ho | jasalAI allAhale mArga dekhAunu huncha usale sA~ccikai satmArga prApta garnecha ra jasalAI uhA~le pathabhraSTa garnu huncha usale mArgadarzana garne kohI sahayogI pAu~ne chaina kinaki allAhale mAtra mArgadarzana garnuhuncha |

18 unIharUko A~khA khuleko dekhera lAgthyo ki unIharU byU~jhekA chan | tara vAstavamA unIharU sutirahekA thie | dhartIle unIharUko zarIralAI nakhAos bhanI hAmI nidrAmA kahile dAhinetira ra kahile debretira unIharUko kolTo pherthyauM | unIharUko kukura unIharUko sAthamA thiyo jasale AphnA duIvaTA khuTTA guphAko dvAramA pasArera basiraheko thiyo | yadi timIle unIharUlAI dekheko bhae bhayabhIta bhaera bhAgne thiyau ra timro manamA unIharUko Dara basne thiyo |

19 jasarI hAmIle Aphno prabhutvako acammakA kAryaharU garyauM, tyasarI nai unIharUlAI lAmo samayako antarAla pazcAta byU~jhAyauM, tAki tinIharUle sutera bitAeko avadhiko viSayamA ekaApasamA prazna tarun | kehI vyaktiharUle javApha die- eka dina vA eka dina bhandA pani kama ra kehIle bhaneH timIharUle suteko avadhibAre timrA pAlanakartA nai rAmrarI jAnnuhuncha | tasartha AphUmadhye ekajanAlAI Aphno yo cA~dIko mudrA diera zaharatarpha paThAU | usale sAvadhAnIkAsAtha zaharabATa rAmrA ra pavitra khAnA liera Aos | kasaile pani timIharUko yasa ThAu~ko viSayamA cAla napAos natra ThUlo hAni hunecha |

20 yadi timro samudAyale timIharU ra timIharUko yasa ThAu~ko viSayamA cAla pAe bhane unIharUle timIharUlAI DhuGgAle hirkAera mArnechan vA unIharUle Aphno galata AsthAmA pharkAera lAnechan‌ juna AsthA timIharUko pani thiyo | yadi timIharU tyasa asatya AsthAtira pharkera gayau bhane yasa sAMsArika jIvana ra pAralaukika jIvana dubaimA asaphala hunechau ra ThUlo ghATA behornechau |

21 hAmIle Aphno zaktilAI pramANita garna unIharUlAI dherai varSasamma sutAyauM | tyasapazcAta unIharUlAI byU~jhAyauM ra unIharUkA zaharabAsIharUlAI unIharUko sthitibAre sUcita garyauM | AsthAvAnaharUko sahayoga, mRtyupazcAtako jIvanako astitva ra mahApralaya Aune sambandhamA kunai sandeha chaina bhanI unIharUlAI avagata garAyauM | jaba guphAvAlAharUko sthiti spaSTa bhayo ani tyasapazcAta unIharUko mRtyu bhayo tyahA~ upasthitaharUmA yinIharUko ke garne bhanne viSayamA matabheda bhayo | kehI vyaktiharUle bhaneH unIharUko lAzalAI chopna ra surakSita rAkhna unIharUko guphAko DhokAmAthi euTA bhavanako nirmANa gara | unIharUko pAlanakartA unIharUko sthAnalAI rAmrarI jAnnuhuncha | allAhako najaramA unIharUko mahatvapUrNa sthAna raheko cha | ajJAnI vyaktiharUle bhaneH unIharUko sammAnamA ra yasa ThAu~ko smaraNamA hAmI yasa ThAu~lAI upAsanAkA lAgi masjida banAunechauM |

22 unIharUko viSayamA carcA garneharUmadhye kehIle unIharUko saMkhyAko viSayamA bhaneH unIharU tIna janA thie ra cautho unIharUko kukura thiyo | kehIle bhaneH unIharU pA~ca janA thie ra chaiThauM unIharUko kukura thiyo | dubai samUhale Aphno anumAnako bharamA binA pramANa kurA gare | kehIle bhaneH unIharU sAta janA thie ra AThau~ unIharUko kukura thiyo | he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! yinIharUlAI bhanidinuhos, unIharUko saMkhyAko bAremA mero pAlanakartAlAI rAmrarI thAhA cha | allAhale thorailAI mAtra unIharUko vAstavika saMkhyAko jJAna dinubhaeko cha | unIharUko saMkhyA ra avasthAko viSayamA yahUdI-IsAI vA anya kasaisa~ga vAdavivAda nagarnuhos baru spaSTa tarka prastuta garnuhos | unIharUko viSayamA jati tapAIMlAI vahI mArphata avagata garAieko cha tyatimA nai santuSTa hunuhos | unIharUmadhye kasailAI pani unIharUko viSayamA nasodhnuhos kinaki unIharUlAI yasako jJAna chaina |

23 he nabI (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! tapAIMle bholI garne soMca banAunubhaeko kAmalAI ma yo kAma bholI garnechu bhanI nabhannuhos kinaki tapAIMlAI thAhA chaina ki tapAIMle tyo kAma garnuhunecha vA garna asaphala hunuhunecha | yo nirdezana pratyeka muslimako lAgi ho |

24 baru Aphno soMcalAI allAhako icchAko adhinamA rAkhI bhannuhos– yadi allAhale cAhanubhayo bhane ma bholI yo kAma garnechu | yasarI allAhako smaraNa garnuhos tara yadi tapAIMle yo bhanna virsanubhayo bhane, bhannuhos– AzA cha, merA pAlanakartAle malAI yasa mAmilAmA sIdhA mArga dekhAunuhunecha |
25 guphAvAlAharU tIna saya nauM varSa guphAmai rahe |

26 he sandeSTA! bhanidinuhos: unIharU guphAmA kati varSa rahe bhanne kurA allAhalAI rAmrarI thAhA cha | hAmIharUko lAgi yasamA unIharUko basAIko avadhi ullekha garieko cha | allAhako bhanAi pazcAta arU kasaiko kurAko mahatva raha~daina | AkAzaharU tathA dhartIkA sampUrNa adRzya kurAharUko jJAna kevala allAhalAI cha | allAhako dRSTi kati asAdhAraNa cha! uhA~le sabai dekhnuhuncha | uhA~ko sunnezakti kati asAdhAraNa cha! uhA~le sabai sunnuhuncha | uhA~ bAheka unIharUko saMrakSaNakA lAgi kohI saMrakSaka chaina | uhA~ Aphno zAsanamA kasailAI sAjhedAra banAunu hunna | uhA~ mAtra eklo zAsaka hunuhuncha |

jaba allAha taAlAle zAsanako mAlika uhA~ mAtra hunuhuncha bhanne kurA ullekha garnubhayo taba uhA~le AphnA sandeSTAlAI uhA~mAthi avatarita kurAnako pATha garne ra tyasako anusaraNa garne Adeza didai bhannubhayoH
27 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! allAhale avataraNa garnubhaeko kurAnako pATha garnuhos ra tyasako anusaraNa garnuhos | uhA~kA kurAharUlAI kasaile parivartana garna sakdaina, kinaki tI pUrNatayA satya ra nisAphamA AdhArita rahekA chan | tapAIMle uhA~ bAheka arko Azraya kadApi pAunuhune chaina |

28 bihAna ra belukA ekAgratAkA sAtha AphnA pAlanakartAsa~ga duA garneharUsa~ga AphUlAI joDera rAkhnuhos | Aphno samAjakA dhanI tathA pratiSThita vyaktisa~ga basne avasara prApta garnako lAgi Aphno dRSTi yinIharUbATa naphernuhos | hAmro samjhanAbATa Aphno manalAI vaJjita rAkheko kAraNale jasako hRdayamAthi hAmIle sila lagAi diekAchauM usako kurA nasunnuhos | usale tapAIMlAI Aphno sabhAmA garibaharUlAI narAkhna bhanyo ra AphnA pAlanakartAko anusaraNa garna choDera Aphnai manamAnI garyo | tasartha unIharUkA kriyAkalApaharU naSTa bhae |

29 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! allAhako samjhanAbATa Aphno manalAI vaJcita rAkhneharUlAI bhannuhos– ma timIharU samakSa juna (kurAna) liera Aeko chu tyo nitAnta satya ho ra tyo allAhako tarphabATa ho, mero tarphabATa hoina | malAI timIharUle AsthAvAnaharUlAI choDa bhaneko kurAlAI ma mAndina | yasa satyalAI svIkAra gardai timIharUmadhye kohI AsthA apanAuna cAhancha bhane U apanAos | yasako pratiphala dekhera U prasanna hunecha | jo yasalAI asvIkAra garna cAhancha U asvIkAra garos | usako parkhAImA baseko prakopalAI dekhera U dukhIta hunecha | AsthAlAI asvIkAra garera AphaimAthi atyAcAra garneharUkA lAgi hAmIle vizAla Ago tayAra pArekA chauM jasalAI cAraitirabATa parkhAlale ghereko cha | tyasabATa unIharU umkana sakne chainan | tirkhA lAgera jaba unIharU pAnI mAgnechan unIharUlAI tirkhA meTAunakA lAgi pagleko tA~bA jasto umliraheko pAnI diinecha jasale unIharUko anuhAraharUlAI jalAune | yo ati nai narAmro peya ho juna unIharUlAI piunakA nimti diinecha | yasale unIharUko tirkhAlAI jhan baDhAidinecha | unIharUko chAlA polne Ago kahilyai nibhne chaina | narka ati nai narAmro vAsasthAna ho |

allAhale kurAnamA atyacArIko lAgi yAtanA tayAra pArera rAkhieko kurA varNana garepachi AsthAvAnaharUkA lAgi tayAra pArera rAkhieko utkRSTa pratidAnako pani varNana garnubhaeko cha | uhA~le bhannubhaeko chaH
30 allAhamAthi AsthA rAkhne ra satkarma garneharUko lAgi ThUlo pratiphala raheko cha | satkarma garneharUkA pratiphalalAI hAmI vyartha jAna diMdainauM | baru hAmI unIharUlAI pUrA-pUrA badalA dinechauM rattibhara ni kamI garine chaina |

31 satkarma garneharUkA lAgi vAsasthAna svarUpa bagaiMcAharU rahekA chan jasamA unIharU sadA rahanechan | unIharUkA gharaharUkA talatirabATa miTho pAnIkA nadiharU bagirahekA hunechan | tyahA~ unIharUlAI sunakA bAlAharU lagAera sajAinecha | ani unIharUlAI rezamako bAklo ra pAtalo kapaDA lagAinecha | pyArA-pyArA pardAharUle sajiekA palaGamA aDesa lAgera basnechan | kati rAmro unIharUko pratidAna ra kati rAmro vAsasthAna ho svarga |

atyAcArIharUle pAune yAtanA ra AsthAvAnaharUle pAune uttama pratiphalako varNana pazcAta unIharUko udAharaNa dinubhaeko cha | uhA~le bhannubhayo–
32 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! duIjanA vyakti arthAta kAphira ra mominako udAharaNa dinuhos | hAmIle tI duImadhye kAphiralAI duITA aGgurakA bagaiMcA diyauM, jasalAI hAmIle khajurakA rUkhaharUdvArA gherekA thiyauM ra tI dubai bagaiMcAharUbica annabAlI pani ubjAekA thiyauM |
33 dubai bagaiMcAle khajura, aGgUra ra annaharU utpAdana gare | utpAdanamA kunai kamI garieko thiena baru prazasta thiyo | hAmIle tI duvailAI sicAI garnakA nimti bicamA euTA nahara jArI garidiyauM |
34 tI dubai bagaiMcAko mAlikasa~ga arU pani dhana-sampattI ra phalaphUla thie | usale Aphno momina sAthIlAI bhanyo, ma timIbhandA dhanI ra pratiSThita chu ra mero khAnadAna dherai zaktizAlI cha |

35 Aphno bagaiMcA dekhAunakA nimti kAphira mominalAI liera bhitra gayo | usale kuphra ra ghamaNDale gardA AphUmAthi atyAcAra gareko thiyo | kAphirale bhanyoH maile yasa bagaiMcAko lAgi gareko kaDA parizrama ra vyavasthAle yo bagaiMcA kahile sakhApa hunechaina |

36 mahApralaya Au~cha bhanne malAI lAgdaina | yo jIvana nai asala jIvana ho | yadi mahApralaya Ayo ra malAI mero pAlanakartAtira pharkAera lagiyo bhane pani maile merA yI bagaiMcAbhandA uttama bagaiMcAharU tyahA~ pAunechu ra yahA~bhandA dhanI hunechu |

37 usako momina sAthIle javApha diMdai bhanyoH jasale timro purkhA Adama (alaihissalAma) ko sRSTi mATobATa ra timro sRSTi viryako thopAbATa garnubhayo ke timI tyasa astitvalAI nakArchau | ani timIlAI euTA mAnava banAunubhayo ra timrA aGgaharU banAera timIlAI pUrNa rUpa dinubhayo | yI kAryaharUmAthi sAmarthya rAkhne allAhale timIharUlAI mRtyupazcAta puna jIvita pArnuhunecha |
38 ma timro bhanAisa~ga sahamata chaina | baru ma bhanchuH merA pAlanakartA pavitra evaM kRpAvAn hunuhuncha | ma uhA~ bAheka arU kasaiko upAsanA gardina |

39 yadi timIle malAI dhana ra santAnamA AphUbhandA kamajora ThAnekA chau bhane timI bagaiMcAmA praveza gardA yI sabai allAhako cAhanAle bhaeko ho ra kevala allAhalAI yasako sAmarthya cha kina bhanenauM? uhA~ je cAhanuhuncha garnuhuncha, uhA~ zaktizAlI hunuhuncha |
40 allAhale malAI yasa bagaiMcAbhandA rAmro dinuhuncha ra timro bagaiMcAmAthi AkAzabATa prakopa paThAunuhuncha bhanne malAI vizvAsa cha | jasale gardA tyo bA~jho bhUmimA pariNata hunecha |
41 vA kunai pani sAdhanako sahayogale tAnna nasakne gahirAisamma pAnI pugnecha | pAnI sukepachi bagaiMcAko astitva nai bA~kI raha~daina |

42 mominale bhaneko kurA purA bhayo | kAphirako bagaiMcAkA phalaphUlaharU sakhApa bhae | surakSA vyavasthAko lAgata naSTa bhaeko dekhera usalAI pazcatApa huna thAlyo | aGgurakA hA~gAharU phailiekA khambAharU bagaiMcAko jaminamA DhalekA thie | usale bhanna thAlyoH yadi maile kevala allAhamAthi AsthA rAkheko bhae ra uhA~kai upAsanA gareko bhae yo dina dekhne thiena holA!
43 kAphirako tyo bagaiMcAlAI bacAuna kohI pani usako sahayogI thiena, jabaki AphnA sahayogIharUko viSayamA ghamaNDa garne garthyau | ani usale svayam pani Aphno bagaiMcAlAI bacAuna sakena |

44 maddata kevala allAhako hAtamA cha | momina bhaktaharUkA lAgi utkRSTa sahayogI uhA~ nai hunuhuncha | uhA~le unIharUko puNyalAI dobbara garera dinuhunecha | unIharUko pariNAma ekadamai rAmro hunecha |

45 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! saMsAramai ramAekAharUlAI yasa saMsArako vinAzako udAharaNa dinuhos | jasarI AkAzabATa pareko pAnIle annabAlI phasTAu~cha ani pachi sukhera jAncha | tyasalAI havAle uDAera antai laijAncha ra dhartI Aphno purAnai avasthAmA pharkancha | tyasarI nai saMsArako vinAza hunecha | allAha hareka kAryako sAmarthya rAkhnuhuncha ra uhA~lAI kohI pani asamartha tulyAuna sakdaina | tasartha uhA~ je cAhanuhuncha jIvita pArnuhuncha ra je cAhanuhuncha naSTa garnuhuncha |

46 dhana-sampatti ra santAnaharU yasa saMsArakA zobhA hun | yadi dhana-sampattilAI allAhako prasannatA prAptikA lAgi kharca gariena bhane paralokamA yasako kunai mahatva raha~daina | sAMsArika jIvanako zobhA ra mAnisaharUko cAhanA bhandA satkarmako pratidAna uttama raheko cha kinaki sAMsArika jIvanako zobhA naSTa hunecha tara satkarmako pratidAna sadA bA~kI rahanecha |

47 tyasa dinalAI yAda garnuhos, jaba pahADaharU Aphno ThAu~bATa haTAinechan | pahADa, rUkha ra bhavanaharU naSTa pArieko kAraNale tapAIMle dhartIlAI khullA maidAna dekhnuhunecha ani hAmI sampUrNa sRSTilAI bhelA pArnechauM |

48 mAnisaharUlAI unakA pAlanakartA samakSa paMktibaddha lyAinecha ra unIharUko hisAba liinecha | unIharUlAI bhaninechaH timIharU janmane belAmA jastai eklai, khAlI khuTTA, binA kapaDA ra khatanA hAmro pAsamA AekA chau, jabaki timIharUle ta hisAba-kitAbako lAgi punarjIvita garera bhelA hunechainauM bhanne ThAnekA thiyau |

49 ani tinIharUsamakSa karma-patra rAkhinecha | kasaile dAhine hAtamA linechan bhane kasaile debre hAtamA | he mAnava! kAphiraharUle garekA avajJAlAI tyahA~ aGkita dekhera unIharU DarAirahekA timIle dekhnechau | unIharUle bhannechan– hAya hAmro durbhAgya! kasto karma-patra ho yo! yasale ta hAmrA sAnA ThUlA sabai kAryaharU lekhera surakSita gareko cha | unIharUle garne garekA sampUrNa pApa ra avajJAharUlAI tyasamA surakSita rAkheko dekhnechan | he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! tapAIMkA pAlanakartAle kasaimAthi atyAcAra garnuhunechaina ra pApIharUlAI mAtra daNDa dinuhunecha | ani satkarmIharUko pratidAnamA rattibhara pani kamI garnuhunechaina |

50 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! smaraNa garnuhos, jaba hAmIle phariztAharUlAI Adama (alaihissalAma) lAI sammAna garnako lAgi sajdA garne Adeza diyauM | iblIsa bAheka sabaile sajdA gare | U jinnaharU madhyeko thiyo, phariztA thiena | usale asvIkAra garyo ra ghamaNDale gardA sajdA garena | pariNAma svarUpa U Aphno pAlanakartAko avajJAkArI huna pugyo | he mAnisaharU! ke timIharU malAI choDI usalAI ra usakA santAnaharUlAI AphnA mitra banAu~chau, jabaki unIharU timIharUkA zatru hun | timIharU AphnA zatruharUlAI kasarI mitra banAuna sakchau?! allAhako mitratAlAI choDera zaitAnalAI mitra banAune atyAcArIharU ati ghRNita chan |

51 timIharUle allAhalAI choDI jasalAI mitra banAekA chau unIharU pani timIharU jastai bhakta hun | AkAza ra dhartIko sRSTiko samayamA unIharU upasthita nai thienan | unIharU eka arkAko sRSTiko samayamA pani upasthita thienan | maile eklaile sRSTi gareko ho | maile pathabhraSTa manuSya ra jinnako sahayoga lieko thiina | baru malAI kasaiko sahayogako AvazyakatA nai chaina |

52 he rasUla (sallAhu alaihi va sallama)! unIharUlAI kiyAmatako dinako smaraNa garAunuhos, jaba saMsAramA zirka garneharUlAI allAhale bhannuhunechaH Aphno sahayogako lAgi timIharUle banAekA sAjhedAraharUlAI bolAU | na unIharU Aunechan na sahayoga nai garnechan | hAmI mithyA upAsya ra upAsakaharUkA lAgi narkalAI sAjhA sthAna banAunechauM |
53 muzrikaharUle narka dekhepachi unIharU tyasaimA jAnechan bhanI bujhnechan ra unIharUle tyasabATa bacera zaraNa line kunai ThAu~ nai pAune chainan |

54 hAmIle muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) mAthi avatarita yasa kurAnamA mAnavalAI samjhAunakA nimti thuprai udAharaNaharU prastuta garyauM, tara mAnava vizeSagarI kAphira pramANa binA nai jhagaDA garna thAlyo |

55 kAphiraharUlAI muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) le liera Aunubhaeko kurAnamA AsthA rAkhnabATa kuna kurAle rokiraheko cha | unIharU kina allAhasa~ga AphnA pApaharUko kSamA yAcanA garirahekA chainan? unIharUkA lAgi kurAnamA udAharaNaharU diiekA chan ra unIharUle spaSTa pramANa dekhisakekA chan | vAstavamA pahilekA samudAyaharUmAthi Aeko prakopa unIharUmAthi pani Aos ra juna prakopabATa unIharUlAI DarAieko cha tyo prakopa dekhAiyos bhanI gareko haThadharmile unIharUlAI rokeko cha |

56 hAmIle mominaharUlAI zubhasUcanA dina ra kAphiraharUlAI saceta garna AphnA rasUlaharU paThAekA hauM | unIharU mAnisaharUkA hRdaya parivartana garera mAgadarzana garne sAmarthya rAkhdainan | allAhalAI inkAra garneharU satya-tathya pramANita bhaisakepachi pani rasUlaharUsa~ga jhagaDA tathA bahasa garchan; tAki muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) mAthi avatarita satyatAlAI asatyako sahayogale parAjita garna sakiyos | ani unIharUle kurAnalAI ra unIharUlAI DarAieko kurAko upahAsa garna thAle |

57 jasalAI usakA pAlanakartAkA nizAnIharU dekhAepachi pani usale tyasamA ullekha prakopako cetAvanIlAI bevAstA garyo tyobhandA ThUlo atyAcArI ko hunasakcha ra? baru usale yasa saMsAramA gareko kuphra ra pApaharU birsyo ra kahilyai pazcAttApa garena | hAmIle yastA vyaktiharUko hRdayalAI pardAle DhAkidiekA chauM ra kAna bahiro banAidiekA chauM jasale gardA unIharU na kurAna sunna sakchan na bujhna nai | yadi yastA vyaktiharUlAI tapAIM ImAna lyAuna AhvAna garnuhuncha bhane unIharUko hRdaya pardAle DhAkiekAle ra unIharU bahirA bhaekAle kahilyai pani tapAIMko AhvAnalAI svIkArna saknechainan |

58 nabI (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) AphUlAI jhUTo Thahara garne samudAyalAI prakopa Au~dA uhA~ herera basna saknuhune chaina | allAhale uhA~lAI bhannubhayoH he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! tapAIMko pAlanakartA taubA garne bhaktaharUlAI kSamA garnuhuncha | uhA~le sabaimAthi dayA garnuhuncha | avajJAkArIharUlAI pazcAttApa garna avasara pradAna garnu allAhako dayA ho | yadi allAhale unIharUlAI sajAya nai dine ho bhane yasa saMsAramA nai dinuhunthyo tara allAha sahanazIla ra dayAvAn hunuhuncha | unIharUlAI pazcAttApako avasara pradAna garnakA nimti sajAya dina Dhilo garnubhayo | AphnA avajJAlAI tyAgnakA nimti unIharUsa~ga nizcita samayAvadhi raheko cha | yadi yasa samAyAvadhimA unIharU pazcAttApa gardainan bhane unIharUle allAhako sajAyabATa bacne kunai Azraya pAune chainan |
59 timIharUkA najika rahekA hUda, sAleha ra zuaibakA bastIharUlAI hAmIle unIharUko kuphrale gardA naSTa pAryauM | hAmIle unIharUko vinAzako euTA nizcita samaya nirdhArita garekA thiyauM |

60 he rasUla ( sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! smaraNa garnuhos, jaba mUsA (alaihissalAma) le Aphno sevaka yUzaa bina nUnalAI bhaneH ma duI samudrako saMgamasthalasamma napuguJjela vA asala bhaktalAI nabheTunjelasamma hi~Dirahanechu ani unIbATa kehI jJAna siknechu |
61 jaba unIharU duI samudrako saMgamasthalasamma puge AphUsa~gai lyAeko mAchAlAI birsie | ani allAhale mAchAlAI jIvita pArnubhayo ra tyasale samudramA suruGa jhaiM bATo banAyo |
62 jaba tinIharU tyasa ThAu~bATa agADi baDhe musA (alaihissalAma) le AphnA sevakalAI bhane– aba hAmro khAnA lyAU, yasa yAtrAbATa hAmI ekadamai thAkisakekA chauM |

63 sevakale bhanyoH tapAIMlAI thAhA cha? jaba hAmI caTTAnamA aDesa lAgera ArAma garirahekA thiyauM, ma tapAIMlAI mAchAko viSayamA bhanna birseM ra zaitAnale nai malAI tyasabAre tapAIMlAI batAuna birsAyo | mAchA jiu~do bhayo ra samudramA acamma tarikAle bATo banAera gayo |

64 mUsA (alaihissalAma) le bhane– yahI ho hAmIle khojeko | yo asala bhaktako ThegAnA ho | bATo birAune Darale dubai janA Aphnai pada cinha pachyAu~dai gae | unIharU caTTAna bhaeko ThAu~mA puge ra tyahA~bATa mAchA gaeko ThAu~samma |

65 jaba unIharU mAchA harAeko ThAu~samma puge, unIharUle tyahA~ hAmrA bhaktaharUmadhye eka janA asala bhaktalAI bheTe (unI khijra alaihissalAma hun) | hAmIle unImAthi vizeSa kRpA garekA thiyauM ra unalAI vizeSa jJAna pradAna garekA thiyauM | yasto jJAna hAmIle arUharUlAI diekA thienauM ra yasa kathAko AdhAra nai yahI ho |
66 mUsA (alaihissalAma) le unalAI namratApurvaka sodhe- allAhale tapAIMlAI sikAunu bhaeko satya jJAna siknakA nimti ke ma tapAIMko anusaraNa garna sakchu?
67 khijra (alaihissalAma) le bhane– masa~ga raheko jJAna sikna tapAIMle dhairya dhAraNako kSamatA rAkhna saknuhunna kinaki mero jJAna tapAIMko jJAnasa~ga kunai mela rAkhdaina |
68 juna kurAko jJAna tapAIMlAI chaina tyo dekhera tapAIM kasarI dhairya garna saknuhuncha?! kinaki tyasako mulyAGkana ta tapAIMle Aphno jJAnako AdhAramA garnuhunecha |
69 mUsA (alaihissalAma) le bhane– allAhale cAhanubhayo bhane tapAIMle malAI sahanazIla tathA dhairyadhAraNa garnasakne pAunuhunecha | tapAIMko kunai pani Adezako ullaGghana garne chaina |

70 khijra (alaihissalAma) le mUsA (alaihissalAma) lAI bhane– tapAIMle mero anusaraNa garne kramamA maile garekA kAmaharUko viSayamA kunai prazna nagarnuholA | ma Aphai tyasakA kAraNaharU khulAune chu |

71 jaba dubai janA yasa kurAmA sahamata bhae | unIharU samudrI taTatira gae ra tyahA~ euTA DuGgA caDhe | khijra (alaihissalAma) ko sammAnamA DuGgAvAlAle bhADA liena tara khijra (alaihissalAma) le tyasa DuGgAkA kAThakA euTA TukrA jhikera phAlidie bhayo | ani mUsA (alaihissalAma) le bhane– ke tapAIMle yasakA savAraharUlAI DubAuna khojnubhaeko ho jasale hAmIsa~ga bhADA pani liekA chainan?! tapAIMle svIkArna nasakine kArya garnubhayo |
72 khijra (alaihissalAma) le mUsA (alaihissalAma) lAI bhane– merA kAryaharU dekhera tapAIMle dhairya dhAraNako kSamatA rAkhna saknuhunna bhanI maile bhanekai thie~ |
73 mUsA (alaihissalAma) le khijra (alaihissalAma) lAI bhane– maile birsera bacana toDeko khaNDamA malAI daNDa nadinuhos ra maprati nirdayI nabannuhos |

74 DuGgAbATa tala jharepachi tinIharU kinAramA hiMDna thAle ra tinIharUle euTA nAbAlaka keTA bheTe | U arU keTAharUsa~ga kheliraheko thiyo | khijra (alaihissalAma) le usako hatyA gare | mUsA (alaihissalAma) le unalAI bhane– kina tapAIMle euTA nirdoSa nAbAlakako hatyA garnubhayo?! tapAIMle ati ghRNita kArya garnubhayo |
75 khijra (alaihissalAma) le mUsA (alaihissalAma) lAI bhane– he musA (alaihissalAma)! tapAIMle dhairya dhAraNako kSamatA rAkhna saknuhunna bhanI maile pahile nai bhaneko thie~ |

76 mUsA (alaihissalAma) le bhane– yadi yasapachi pani maile tapAIMlAI kehI sodheM bhane malAI Aphno sAthamA narAkhnuholA | kinabhane ma mApha garine sImA nAghi sakeko chu ra duI paTaka Adezako avahelanA garisakeko chu |

77 dubaijanA tyahA~bATa hi~De ani euTA gAu~mA puge | gA~ubAsIharUsa~ga unIharUle khAnA mAge, tara kasaile pani khAnA khuvAuna ra atithi satkAra garna mAnenan | | taipani yattikaimA gAu~mA euTA Dhalnai lAgeko parkhAla bheTiyo ta khijra (alaihissalAma) le tyo Dhalna lAgeko parkhAlalAI sIdhA pAridinubhayo | tyasapachi mUsA (alaihissalAma) le khijra (alaihissalAma) lAI bhane– yadi tapAIM cAhanuhuncha bhane yasa kAmako jyAlA lina saknuhuncha kinaki yinIharUle satkAra nagareko hunAle hAmIlAI yasako AvazyakatA pani cha |

78 khijra (alaihissalAma) le mUsA (alaihissalAma) lAI bhane– maile yo parkhAlalAI sidhA pAreko khaNDamA jyAlA naliekomA tapAIMle garnubhaeko yo praznale tapAIM ra mabIca chuTTine samaya lyAidieko cha | maile garekA kAmaharUko ma vistRta jAnakArI dinechu jasalAI dekhera tapAIMle dhairya dhAraNa garna saknubhaena |

79 maile DuGgAlAI kSati puryAekomA tapAIMle Apatti janAunubhaeko thiyo | tyo DuGgA samudramA kAma garne garibaharUko thiyo, tinIharUle tyasabATa jIvanayApana gardathe | AgADi euTA rAjA cha, usale rAmrA DuGgAharU tyasakA mAlikaharUbATa khosne garcha ra bigrekAlAI choDidincha | tyasa rAjAdvArA khosinabATa bacAunakA nimti maile tyasalAI bigArI die~ |

80 juna bAlakako hatyAmA Apatti janAunu bhaeko thiyo usakA mAtApitA momina thie tara allAhako jJAna anusAra U kAphira (avajJAkArI) thiyo | ThUlo bhaepachi usale AphnA mAtApitAlAI kuphra ra atyAcArakA sAtha vyavahAra garnecha bhanne Dara thiyo, kinaki usakA mAtApitA usalAI dherai nai mAyA gardathe |
81 tasartha tI dubailAI unakA pAlanakartAle yasto santAna pradAna garnuhunecha jo UbhandA AsthAvAn, asala ra dhArmika mAmilAmA pavitra hunecha, ani AphnA mAtApitAmAthi atyantai dayA garnecha |

82 maile parkhAlalAI sidhA pArne viSayamA pani tapAIMle Apatti janAunubhaeko thiyo | tyo tyasa saharakA duI janA bAlakaharUko thiyo jahA~bATa hAmI AyauM | unIharUkA mAtApitAko dehAnta bhaisakeko thiyo ra tyasa parkhAlamunI unI dubaikA lAgi khajAnA gADieko thiyo | yI dubaikA pitA asala vyakti thie | tasartha, he mUsA (alaihissalAma) yI dubai ThUlo bhaisakepachi tyahA~bATa tyo khajAnA nikAlnechan bhanne soMca tapAIMkA pAlanakartAko thiyo | yadi tyo parkhAla ahile Dhaleko bhae sabaijanAle tyasa khajAnAko viSayamA thAhA pAune thie ra tyo vyartha jAne thiyo | yo maile Aphno vivekale gareko hoina baru yo tapAIMkA pAlanakartAko tI dubaimAthi dayA ho | yahI ho vAstavikatA jasalAI dekhera tapAIMle dhairya garna saknubhaena |

allAhale khijra (alaihissalAma) ko kathApachi jul-karnainako kathA ullekha garnubhaeko cha, kinaki dubai kathAmA kamajorako sahayogako samarthana garieko cha | uhA~le bhannubhaeko chaH
83 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! yI yahUdI ra bahudevavAdIharU tapAIMlAI jul-karnainako viSayamA sodhchan | tapAIM bhannuhos­- ma timIharUlAI unako viSayamA kehI sunAune chu | timIharU bicAra gara ra tyasalAI yAda gara |
84 hAmIle unalAI yasa dhartImA sakSama banAyauM ra gantavyasamma pugnakA lAgi Avazyaka parne sampUrNa sAmagrIharU diyauM |
85 hAmIle pradAna garekA sAdhana ra vidhiharU unale apanAe ani pazcimatira gae |

87 jul-karnainale bhane– hAmIle eka mAtra allAhako upAsanA garnetira ahvAna garisakepachi pani yadi kohI zirkamA aDiga rahancha bhane yasa saMsAramA hAmI usalAI sajAya dinechauM ra kiyAmatako dina Aphno pAlanakartA samakSa gaepachi uhA~le usalAI DaralAgdo yAtanA dinuhunecha |

88 tara, tinIharUmadhye jasale AsthA rAkhyo ra satkarma garyo, usako pratiphala svarga raheko cha | yo usako pAlanakartAko tarphabATa usako ImAna ra satkarmako pratiphala ho | ani hAmIle Aphno kAmaharUmA sahajatA ra saralatAko Adeza dinechauM |
89 tyasapachi unale sUryodayako dizAtarpha pharkera arkotirako yAtrA suru gare |
90 unI hi~Dadai gae, jaba A~khAko dRSTimA sUryodaya bhaeko dekhine ThAu~mA puge ta unale pAe tI mAnisaharUmAthi sUrya ta udAu~thyo tara ghAma cheknakA nimti ghara ra rUkhaharU thienan |
91 yo unako kathA ho | unIsa~ga bhaeko kSamatA ra zaktikA bAremA hAmI rAmrarI jAndachauM |
92 tyasapachi unI pUrva ra pazcimatirako bATo choDera arko bATotira lAge |
93 unI hi~Ddai gae ta duIvaTA pahADako bicamA puge ra tyasako arkopaTTi unale yasto samudAyalAI pAe jasale Aphno bhASAbAheka arUko bhASA bujhdainathe |

94 tinIharUle bhaneH he jul-karnaina! yAjUja ra mAjUja (Adama alaihissalAmakA santAna madhyekA duI ThUlA samudAya) le yasa bhUbhAgamA hatyA hinsA garirahekA chan | ke unIharU ra hAmIbIca parkhAla khaDA garnakA lAgi tapAIMlAI dhanako sahayoga garauM?

95 jul-karnainale bhane– yasa sambandhamA merA pAlanakartAle malAI yasabhandA uttama cijaharU diera sakSama banAunubhaeko cha | tapAIMharU Avazyaka sAmAna ra sahayogI hAtaharUko vyavasthA garnuhos, ma baliyo parkhAla khaDA garidinechu |

96 tapAIMharU malAI phalAmakA TukrAharU lyAera dinuhos | unIharUle lyAera die ra unale parkhAlalAI dubai pahADaharU barAbara banAe | unale sahayogIharUlAI bhane– Ago dankAU | phalAma Agole tAtera rAto bhaepachi unale bhane– tyasamAthi khanyAunakA lAgi tA~bA lyAU |
97 parkhAlako ucAIle gardA yAjUja ra mAjUja tyasabATa uklana sakenan ra tyasako kaDApanale gardA munitira pvAla pArna sakenan |

98 jul-karnainale bhane– yo parkhAla merA pAlanakartAko kRpA ho | yasako mAdhyamale yAjUja ra mAjUjale maccAune vidhvaMsalAI niSkRya garnubhaeko cha | tara kiyAmatako dinabhandA pahile tapAIMko pAlanakartAle unIharUko bAhira Aune nirdhArita garnubhaeko samaya nikaTa bhaepachi tyasa parkhAlalAI naSTa pArera tyasa ThAu~lAI samatala banAunuhunecha | yo allAhako bAcA ho, jasamA kunai zaMkA chaina |
99 antima samayamA hAmI kehI sRSTiharUlAI anya sRSTiharUsa~ga judhna dinechauM ani tyasapachi sUra phukinecha ra sampUrNa sRSTilAI hisAba kitAbakA lAgi bhelA pArnechauM |
100 hAmIle kAphiraharUkA lAgi narkalAI spaSTarUpamA prakaTa garidinechauM, tAki unIharUle svayam Aphnai A~khAle tyasalAI dekhun |

101 sAMsArika jIvanamA allAhako yAdabATa anabhijJa rahekA kAphiraharUlAI hAmIle narka dekhAunechauM, kinaki unIharUko A~khAmA allAhako smaraNalAI rokne pardA lAgeko thiyo ra unIharUle allAhakA nizAnIharUlAI svIkArna sakne garI sunna sakdainathe |
102 ke yI kAphiraharUle malAI chADi merA bhaktaharU madhyebATa phariztAharU, rasUlaharU ra zaitAnaharUlAI upAsya banAune socekA chan?! nissande hAmIle unIharUkA lAgi vAsasthAna narka banAekAchauM |
103 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! bhanidinuhos– he mAnisaharU ho! narAmrA kAma garnAle sabaibhandA dherai ghATA behorne ko ho bhanI bhanauM?

104 jasale yasa sAMsArika jIvanamA garekA satkarma ra mehanatalAI kiyAmatakA dina barbAda bhaeko dekhnechan | unIharUko soMcAi anusAra unIharUle rAmrA kAryaharU garekA chan ra unIharUle AphnA kAryaharUbATa phAidA uThAunechan | tara vAstavikatA yasako viparIta raheko cha |

105 yI tinai vyaktiharU hun jasale AphnA pAlanakartAkA tauhIda (ekatva) lAI pramANita garne nizAnIharU ra uhA~sa~ga bheTne kurAlAI mAnenan | vAstavamA unIharUle namAnnAle nai unIharUkA kAryaharU vyartha bhae ra kiyAmatakA dina allAhako najaramA unIharUko kunai mahatva hune chaina |
108 unIharU tyahA~ sadA rahanechan ra tyahA~bATa anyatra sarna khojne chainan kinaki yasa pratiphala saraha arU kunai pratiphala hunechaina |

109 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi vasallama)! bhannuhos– yadi allAhakA vANIharUlAI lekhna hAmI samudralAI masI banAu~chauM bhane, yI kurAharU lekhisakinu aghi nai samudraharU suknechan | yadyapI hAmI tyatinai arU samudraharU pani lyAu~chauM bhane pani kurAharU samApta hunu aghi nai sampUrNa samudraharU suknechan |

110 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! bhanidinuhos– ma timIharU saraha euTA manuSya mAtra hu~ | timIharUkA upAsya ekamAtra allAha hunuhuncha ra uhA~ko kohI sAjhedAra chaina bhanI malAI vahI mArphata bhanieko cha | yadi kohI AphnA palanakartAsa~ga bheTa hune dinako bhaya rAkhcha bhane usale uhA~kA zarIata anusAra ekAgra bhaera AphnA pAlanakartAkA lAgi asala karma garos ra kevala uhA~ko mAtra upAsanA garos |
1 kApha0 hA0 yA0 aina0 sAda0! yastA akSaraharUko vyAkhyA sUraha al-bakarahako ArambhamA bhaisakeko cha |
2 yo tapAIMko pAlanakartAle AphnA bhakta jakariyA (alaihissalAma) mAthi garnubhaeko dayAko bayAna ho | tapAIMle kehI siknuhuncha bhanI hAmI yasa viSayamA bhanna gairahekAchauM |

5 mero mRtyupazcAta merA AphantaharU yasa saMsArako mojamastImA lAgera dharmalAI kAyama nagarlAna bhanI malAI Dara lAgeko cha | merI patnI bA~jhI chin, tasartha tapAIM Aphno tarphabATa mero sahayogakA lAgi euTA santAna dinuhos |
6 U mero nubUvvata (dUtatva) ko uttarAdhikArI ra yAkUba (alaihissalAma) kA santAnako vArisa banos | he merA pAlanakartA! usalAI asala dhArmIka, naitikavAn ra jJAnI banAunuhos |

7 allAhale unako duAlAI svIkAra garnubhayo ra uhA~lAI sambodhana gardai bhannubhayoH he jakariyA (alaihissalAma)! hAmI timIlAI zubhasUcanA diMdaichauM | hAmIle timro duAlAI svIkAryauM ra timIlAI yahayA nAma gareko euTA chorA diyauM | unIbhandA pahile hAmIle yo nAma arU kasaiko rAkhekA thienauM |

8 allAhako zakti dekhera acammita hu~dai jakariyA (alaihissalAma) le bhaneH merI patnI ta bA~jhI chin, unIbATa santAna nai hu~daina ani ma pani atyantai bUDho bhaisakeko chu ra merA haDDIharU kamajora bhaisakekA chan | mero kasarI chorA hunasakcha ra?

9 phariztAle bhaneH tapAIM bhannuhuncha- merI patnI bA~jhI chin, ma atyantai bUDho bhaisakeko chu ra merA haDDIharU kamajora bhaisakekA chan, tara tapAIMkA pAlanakartA bhannuhunchaH yahayAlAI bA~jhI AmA ra atyanatai bUDho pitAbATa janmAunu mero lAgi ekadamai sahaja cha | he jakariyA (alaihissalAma)! vAstavamA timro kunai astitva nai naraheko belA pani hAmIle tapAIMlAI sRSTi garekA thiyauM |

10 jakariyA (alaihissalAma) le bhane– he merA pAlanakartA! tapAIMko phariztAle dieko zubhasUcanAlAI pramANita garnakA nimti malAI euTA nizAnI dinuhos | uhA~le bhannubhayoH timI tIna dinasamma kurAkAnI garna sakne chainauM ra timI svastha nai hunechau |
11 tyasapachi jakariyA (alaihissalAma) upAsanA gareko ThAu~bATa uThera Aphno samudAyako pAsamA gae ani sabailAI bihAna ra belukA allAhako upAsanA garne isArAmA upadeza die |

12 tyasapachi unako chorA yahayA (alaihissalAma) ko janma bhayo | jaba unI Adeza bujhne umeramA puge hAmIle bhanyauM: he yahayA (alaihissalAma)! gambhIratA ra laganazIlatAkA sAtha taurAtako adhyayana gara | unalAI hAmIle sAnai umeramA buddhi, jJAna, laganazIlatA ra ImAnadArItA pradAna garyauM |
13 hAmIle unalAI vizeSa dayAko pAtra banAyauM ra unalAI pApabATa mukta garyauM | unI allAhakA AdezaharUko pAlanA garthe ra varjita kAryaharUbATa bacne garthe |
14 unI AmAbAbukA AjJAkArI ra unIharUprati ekadamai dayAlu thie | unale AphnA pAlanakartA ra AmAbAbuko avajJA garenan |

15 unako janmako dina ra mRtyuko dina allAhale unalAI zAnti ra surakSA pradAna garnubhayo | tyasarI nai kiyAmatako dina uThAine samayamA pani pradAna garinecha | yI tIna avasthAharU nikai nai bhayAvaha avasthAharU hun | yadi yI avasthAharUmA mAnisa surakSita rahayo bhane usalAI arU avasthAharUko cintAle satAune chaina |
16 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! kurAnamA ullekhita maryama (alaihassalAma) ko kathA yAda garnuhos | unI AphnA parivArabATa TADhiera pUrvatira euTA ThAu~mA gain |

17 unI AphnA samudAyabATa pardA garera AphnA pAlanakartAko upAsanA garna thAlin | ani hAmIle jibrIla (alaihissalAma) lAI mAnavako rUpamA unako pAsamA paThAyauM | puruSalAI dekhepachi galata irAdAle Aeka hun ki bhanera unI DarAin |

18 maryama (alaihissalAma) le mAnava rUpamA jibrIla (alaihissalAma) lAI AphUtira Aeko dekhera bhanin- ma tapAIMbATa karUNAmaya allAhako zaraNa cAhanchu | yadi tapAIM allAhasa~ga DarAunuhuncha bhane malAI kehI pani nagarnuhos |
19 jibrIla (alaihissalAma) le javApha dieH ma mAnava hoina, baru ma ta tapAIMko pAlanakartAko sandezabAhaka hu~ | uhA~le malAI tapAIMlAI pavitra putrako zubhasUcanA dinakA lAgi paThAunubhaeko cha |
20 maryama (alaihassalAma) le Azcaryacakita hu~dai sodhin- ma putra kasarI janmAuna sakchu, vAstavamA mero logne pani chaina ra ma vyabhicArI pani hoina |

21 jibrIla (alaihissalAma) le unalAI bhaneH tapAIMle bhannubhaeko kurA ThIka ho tara tapAIMkA pAlanakartAle bhannubhaeko chaH pitAbinA putrako sRSTi garnu mero nimti sahaja raheko cha | tapAIMlAI diine putra tapAIMko pAlanakartAko mahAnatA ra sAmarthyako nizAnI hunecha | tapAIM ra tyasamAthi AsthA rAkhneharUkA lAgi hAmro dayA hunecha | tapAIMko putrako janma allAhako dRDha aThoTa ho juna surakSita pATI (lauhe mahaphUja) mA lekhieko cha |
22 phariztAle phukepachi unale garbha dhAraNa garin ra tyasa garbhalAI liera unI mAnisaharUbATa TADhA gain |

23 tyasapachi sutkerI vyathAle unalAI khajurako boTako hA~gAmuni puryAyo | maryama (alaihassalAma) le bhanin– hAya! ma yasaaghi nai mareko bhae malAI mAncheharUle birsisakekA hunthe ani mero bAremA galata socne pani thienan |

24 IsA (alaihissalAma) le unakA khuTTAko talatirabATa pukArera bhaneH tapAIM duHkhita nahunuhos | tapAIMko pAlanakartAle tapAIMko talatira pAnIko mUla banAunu bhaeko cha, tasartha tapAIM pAnI piunuhos |
25 khajurako rUkhalAI rAmrarI samAtera hallAunuhos | tapAIMmAthi tAjA ra rasIlA khajuraharU khasnechan ra tyasalAI Tipnuhos |

26 tAjA khajuraharU khAU, pAnI piU, Aphno baccAprati santuSTa hoU ra cintita nahoU | yadi timIle kasailAI dekhyau ra usale timro baccAko bAremA sodhyo bhane bhanaH maile merA pAlanakartAkA lAgi mauna vrata (rojA) basekI chu | tasartha maile Aja kasaisa~ga gardina |

27 maryama (alaihassalAma) Aphno chorAlAI liera Aphno samudAyamA Ain ta unako samudAyakA mAnisaharUle bhane: he maryama! timIle sAhrai ghinalAgdo kAma garyau | timIle bubAbinA nai baccA janmAekI chau?!

28 timI bhaktimA hArUna jastI chau (unI eka dhArmika vyakti thie), nata timro bubA vyabhicArI thie, na timrI AmA vyabhicAriNI thiin | timI ijjatadAra gharakI chorI hau | ani timIle kasarI bubAbinA baccA janmAuna sakchyau?!
29 unale Aphno kAkhamA bhaeko navajAta zizu IsA (alaihissalAma) tira isArA garin | unako samudAyale Azcaryacakita bhaera bhanyoH hAmI kasarI navajAta zizusa~ga kurA garna sakchauM?
30 IsA (alaihissalAma) le bhaneH ma allAhako bhakta hu~ | uhA~le malAI injIla dinubhaeko cha ra nabI banAunubhaeko cha |
31 ma jahA~ bhae pani uhA~le malAI mAnisaharUkA lAgi lAbhadAyaka banAunubhaeko cha | uhA~le malAI jIvanabhari namAja paDhne ra jakAta dine Adeza dinubhaeko cha |
32 uhA~le malAI merI AmAkA lAgi dayAlu banAunubhaeko cha, ghamaNDI ra avajJAkArI banAunubhaeko chaina |

33 juna dina ma janmieko thie~, ani juna dina ma marnechu ra juna dina malAI kayAmatako dina punarjIvita garera uThAinecha uhA~le malAI zaitAna ra usakA sahayogIharUbATa surakSA pradAna garnuhunecha | yI tIna DaralAgdA paristhitiharUmA zaitAnale malAI kaSTa dina sakne chaina |
34 yI guNaharUkA pAtra maryama-putra IsA hun | yo nai satya kurA ho | unako viSayamA zaGkAmA rahane ra binA pramANa bahasa garneharUko kurA satya hoinan |

35 allAhalAI santAnako AvazyakatA cha bhannu upayukta chaina | uhA~ hareka kisimako kamI-kamajorIbATa pavitra hunuhuncha | jaba uhA~ kehI garna cAhanuhuncha, uhA~lAI hoU bhannubhayo bhane pugihAlcha, tyasapachi tyo pakkai huncha | jo yati mahAn hunuhuncha uhA~lAI santAnako ke AvazyakatA? |
36 allAha nai merA ra timIharUkA pAlanakartA hunuhuncha, tasartha timIharU uhA~ko mAtra upAsanA gara | maile timIharUlAI dekhAeko bATo nai allAhalAI prasanna pArne bATo ho |

37 IsA (alaihissalAma) ko viSayamA unako samudAya vibhinna samUhamA vibhAjita bhae | kehIle unalAI rasUla svIkAre bhane kehIle yahUdI saraha unalAI mAnna inkAra gare | kehIle jhanai kharAba kurA gare ra unalAI allAha (paramezvara) bhane | kehIle unalAI allAhako chorAko saMjJA die | allAha yasabATa pavitra hunuhuncha | dhikkAra cha yastA mAnisaharUmAthi! jo unako viSayamA ra kiyAmatako dina upasthita hune, hisAba kitAba ra sajAya jastA ghaTanAharUko viSayamA vivAda garchan |

38 tyasa dina tinIharUle praSTa sunne ra dekhnechan | tara tinIharUlAI tyasa dina suneko ra dekhekole kehI phAidA dine chaina | baru yI atyAcArIharU ta sAMsArika jIvanamA sIdhA mArgabATa haTekA thie | unIharUle Akhiratako tayArImA nalAgI Aphnai manamAnI tathA AphaimAthi atyAcAra gareko belAmA tyo AilAgne cha |

39 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! tinIharUlAI tyasa dinako cetAvanI dinuhos; juna dina pApIle AphnA pApaprati ra satkarmIle ajhai dherai satkarma nagarekoprati pazcAttApa garnechan | hisAba kitAba sakiera karma-patra banda garepachi harekale AphUle gareko kAryako badalA pAunecha | vAstavamA unIharU AphnA sAMsArika jIvanamA dhokAmA thie | unIharUle AkhiratalAI bevAstA gare ra kiyAmatamAthi AsthA rAkhenan |

40 sampUrNa sRSTiko vinAzapachi hAmI mAtra bA~kI rahanechauM | yo saMsAra ra yasamA rahekA sampUrNa cijaharUmA kevala hAmro adhikAra rahanecha, kinaki hAmI mAtra amara chauM ra hAmI je cAhanchauM garnechauM | unIharU kiyAmatako dina hisAba kitAba ra badalAko lAgi kevala hAmItira pharkera Aunechan |

41 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! yasa kurAnamA ullekhita ibrAhIma (alaihissalAma) ko kathA samjhanuhos | unI ati nai imAnadAra tathA satyavAdI thie, allAhakA nizAnIharUmA AsthA rAkhthe ra allAhako nabI thie |

42 unale AphnA bubA AjaralAI bhaneH he mero bubA! allAhalAI choDI tapAIM yastA mUrtiko upAsanA kina garnuhuncha? jasale tapAIMle mAgnu bhaeko duA sunna sakdaina, tapAIMle garnubhaeko upAsanA dekhna sakdaina, tapAIMkA samasyAharUko samAdhAna garna sakdaina ra tapAIMlAI kunai phAidA dina pani sakdaina?!
43 he merA bubA! tapAIMlAI thAhA nabhaeko jJAna allAhale malAI vahI (IzavANI) mArphata dinubhaeko cha | tyasaile mero anusaraNa garnuhos | ma tapAIMlAI sIdhA mArga dekhAunechu |

44 he merA bubA! zaitAnako anusaraNa nagarnuhos‌, kinaki jaba allAhale zaitAnalAI Adama (alaihissalAma) lAI sajdA garne Adeza dinubhaeko thiyo tyasabelA zaitAnale allAhako Adezako avajJA gareko thiyo |

45 he merA bubA! kuphrako avasthAmA tapAIMko mRtyu bhayo bhane tapAIMmAthi allAhako prakopa avatarita holA bhanne Dara lAgeko cha | zaitAnasa~ga mitratA gareko tathA usako jasto kArya garekole tapAIM pani Usa~gai yAtanA bhognu parnecha |

46 Ajarale AphnA chorA ibrAhIma (alaihissalAma) lAI bhaneH he ibrAhIma! maile upAsanA garne garekA mUrtiharUbATa timI vimukha huna khojeko ho? yadi timIle merA mUrtiharUlAI narAmro bhanna choDenau bhane ma DhuGgAle hirkAera timro hatyA garnechu | timI mabATa sadhaiMkAlAgi TADhA basa | na masa~ga kurA gara, na masa~ga basa |

47 ibrAhIma (alaihissalAma) le AphnA bubAlAI bhaneH tapAIMmAthi zAnti hos | tapAIMlAI mabATa kaSTa pugne chaina | ma merA pAlanakartAsa~ga tapAIMkA lAgi kSamA ra sIdhA mArga mAgnechu | vAstavamA uhA~ maprati ati dayAlu hunuhuncha |

48 ma tapAIMlAI ra tapAIMharUle allAhalAI choDI pUjne garekA sampUrNa upAsyaharUlAI choDdaichu | ma kevala allAhasa~ga duA garnechu ra kasailAI uhA~ko sAjhedAra banAune chaina | malAI AzA cha maile gareko duAlAI uhA~le radda garnuhune chaina ra ma uhA~sa~ga duA garera uhA~ko kRpAbATa hunechaina |
49 jaba unale Aphno samudAya ra allAha bAheka upAsanA garine unIharUkA mithyA upAsyaharUlAI choDe | taba hAmIle tyasako badalAmA unalAI chorA ishAka ra nAti yAkUba diyauM ra harekalAI nabI banAyauM |
50 hAmIle unIharUlAI nabI banAunukA sAthai dherai bhalAi tathA dayA pradAna garyauM | ani hAmIle unIharUko prazaMsAlAI sadhaiMkA lAgi kAyama rAkhyauM |
51 he rasUla (sallallAhU alaihi va sallama)! tapAIMmAthi avatarita kurAnamA mUsA (alaihissalAma) ko kathA carcA garnuhos | unI rojiekA, sammAnita rasUla ra nabI thie |
52 hAmIle mUsA (alaihissalAma) lAI dAyA~tira pahADamA bolAyauM | Aphno gopya kurA sunAunakA lAgi hAmIle unalAI ajhai najika garyauM |
53 hAmIle mUsA (alaihissalAma) ko duA svIkAra gardai, unako mAga anusAra Aphno dayA ra kRpAle unako dAI hArUna (alaihissalAma) lAI nabI banAyauM |
54 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! yasa kurAnamA ullekhita ismAIla (alaihissalAma) ko kathA carcA garnuhos | unI pratijJA pUrA garthe ra unI rasUla ra nabI thie |
55 unI AphnA parivAralAI salAha paDhne ra jakAta dine Adeza dinthe | unI Aphno pAlanakartAko nikaTa maryAdita evam priya thie |

56 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! yasa kurAnamA ullekhita idrIsa (alaihissalAma) ko kathA samjhanuhos | unI aphnA pAlanakartAkA nizAnIharUlAI atyAdhika vizvAsa garne satyavAdI ra allAhakA nabI thie |
57 hAmIle unalAI nabI banAera unako carcAlAI ucca pAryau, ani unale ucca pada prApta garna saphala bhae |

58 yasa sUrahamA allAhale jakariyA dekhi idrIsa (alaihimussalAma) samma ko kathA ullekha garnubhaeko cha | allAhale Adama (alaihissalAma) kA santAnaharU, nUha (alaihissalAma) sa~ga DuGgAmA savAra bhaekAharU, ibrAhIma ra yAkUbakA santAnaharU ra mArgadarzana prApta garekAharU madhyebATa yinIharUlAI nabI banAunubhayo | hAmIle yinIharUlAI cunyauM ra nabI banAyauM | jaba yinIharU allAhakA nizAnIharUko pATha sunthe taba allAhako Darale rU~dai allAha samakSa sajdA garne garthe |

59 yI cuniekA nabIharU pazcAta duSTa ra pathabhraSTaharUko samaya Ayo | unIharUle namAjalAI bevAstA gare ra vyabhicAra jastA kukarma garna thAle | unIharUle cA~Dai nai narkamA Aphno karmako pratiphala pAunechan |

60 tara jasale Aphno kamIkamajorI ra lAparavAhIbATa pazcatApa gare, allAhamAthi AsthA rAkhe ra satkarma gare; unIharU nai svarga jAnechan ra unIharUlAI diine pratiphalamA rattibhara kama garine chaina |

61 sadA rahane svargaharUmA praveza garAune vAcA allAhale AphnA asala bhaktaharUsa~ga apratyakSamA garnubhaeko thiyo | unIharUle tyasalAI dekhekA chainan tApani tyasamAthi vizvAsa garchan | allAhako vAcA pUrA hune nai cha |

62 unIharUle tyahA~ narAmrA kurAharU ra apazabda sunne chainan, baru ekale arkAlAI ra phariztAharUle unIharUlAI salAma bhaneko sunne chan | bihAna ra belukA unIharUle cAheko khAnekurA khAna pAunechan |
63 yastA suvidhAharU bhaeko svargako hakadAra hAmI AphnA tyastA bhaktaharUlAI banAunechauM, jo hAmrA AdezaharUko pAlanA garchan ra avaidha gariekA kurAharUbATa bacera rahanchan |

jaba allAhale takvAvAlA (Izabhaya rAkhneharU) ko pratiphala ullekha garnubhayo ta yasako sAthasAthai uhA~le takvAko artha pani batAunubhayo | takvA bhaneko allAhako AdezamA aDiga rahanu ho |
64 he jibrIla! muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) lAI bhanaH phariztAharU Aphno marjIle tala Aune gardainan baru unIharU allAhako Adezale mAtra Aune garchan | AkhiratakA mAmilAharU, yasa saMsArakA mAmilAharU ra yI dubaikA bIcakA mAmilAharU kevala allAha kai adhinamA chan | he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) tapAIMkA pAlanakartAle kehI pani birsanuhunna |

65 AkAzaharU, dhartI ra yI dubaiko bicamA rahekA sampUrNa vastuharUkA sRSTikartA, mAlika ra vyavasthApaka eka mAtra (allAha) hunuhuncha | uhA~kai upAsanA gara | uhA~ bAheka kohI upAsanA yogya chaina | uhA~ko upAsanAmA aDiga rahane gara | uhA~ jasto arU kohI chaina |
66 mRtyupachi punarjIvita garine kurAmA vizvAsa nagarne kAphira ThaTTA gardai bhanchaH ma marepachi ke malAI cihAnabATa pheri jIvita pArera dosro jIvanako lAgi uThAinecha?! yo asambhava kurA ho!

67 punarjIvita garine kurAmA vizvAsa nagarnelAI hAmIle usako astitva nai nabhaeko belA sRSTi gareko kurA thAhA chaina?! jaba allAhale mAnisalAI zunyabATa sRSTi garna saknuhuncha bhane dosro paTaka sRSTi garnu ke ko gArho? vAstavamA dosro sRSTi ati sajilo cha |

68 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! tapAIMko pAlanakartAko kasama, hAmI avazya unIharUlAI cihAnabATa uThAunechauM ra unIharUlAI pathabhraSTa pArne zaitAnaharUsa~ga bhelA pArnechauM | tyasapachi unIharUlAI narkakA DhokAharUtira apamAnita gardai ra ghu~DA TekAera liera jAnechauM |
69 ani pathabhraSTaharUko hareka samUhabATa hAmIle unIharUkA sabaibhandA ThUlA avajJAkArI tathA aguvAharUlAI kaDAikA sAtha chA~Tera nikAlnechauM |
70 tyasapachi kasalAI narkamA hAlinecha ra tyasako pIDA sahanu parnecha bhanne kurAlAI hAmI rAmrarI jAndachauM |
71 he mAnisaharU ho! timIharUmadhye sabaile narkamAthi raheko pula (sirAta) pAra garnu parnecha | yo allAhako phaisalA ho ra kohI pani allAhako phaisalAlAI rokna sakdaina |

72 tyo pula pAra garepachi hAmIle Aphno pAlanakartAsa~ga Darera uhA~ko AjJApAlana garne ra manAhI garekA kAmaharUbATa bacne garekAharUlAI surakSita rAkhnechauM ra atyAcArIharUlAI ghu~DA Tekekai avasthAmA choDnechauM | unIharU tyasabATa bacna pAune chainan |

73 jaba rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) mAthi avatarita spaSTa AyataharU mAnisaharUlAI paDhera sunAinchan taba kAphiraharUle mominaharUlAI bhanchan- yI duI samUhaharUmadhye kasako darjA ucca ra kasako sabhA utkRSTa cha, hAmro vA timIharUko?
74 yI kAphiraharUbhandA pahile hAmIle kati yastA samudAyaharUlAI naSTa garisakekA chauM jo yinIharU bhandA dhana-sampatti, posAka ra bhautika sAmagrImA utkRSTa thie |

75 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! bhannuhos– jo pathabhraSTa bhaera mAtteko cha, usalAI allAhale jhan pathabhraSTa huna chuTa dinuhunecha | jaba usale sAMsArika vA pAralaukika jIvanamA diine yAtanAlAI Aphnai A~khAle dekhnecha, taba balla usale tallo darjAko ra asahAya momina ho vA kAphira bhanne kurAko cAla pAunecha |

76 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! allAhale unIharUko pathabhraSTatAmA vRddhi garnuhuncha tara yasako viparIta ImAna lyAune, uhA~ko AjJApAlana garne ra satkarma garneharUlAI sadAko khusI pradAna garnuhuncha | pratiphala ra pariNAmako dRSTikoNale yo baDhI lAbhadAyaka tathA uttama cha |

77 he nabI (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! ke tapAIMle tyasa vyaktilAI dekhnubhayo jasale hAmrA nizAnI ra cetAvanIlAI inkAra gardai bhanyoH mero mRtyupazcAta yadi malAI pherI jIvita pAriyo bhane malAI ajhai dherai dhana-sampatti ra santAna diinecha |

78 ke usasa~ga adRzya (parokSa) ko jJAna cha tyasaile yasto bhaneko vA Usita yasako kunai pramANa cha? ke usale Aphno pAlanakartAsa~ga kunai vacana lieko cha jasale gardA uhA~le usalAI svargamA praveza garAunu hunecha ra thuprai dhana ra santAna dinuhunecha?!
79 usale dAbI gareko jasto pakkai hoina | usale boleko ra gareko hAmIle lekhnechauM | usale gareko asatya dAbIle gardA hAmI usako yAtanAmAthi thapa yAtanA thapnechauM |

80 usalAI naSTa garepachi usale choDekA dhana ra santAnako hakadAra hAmI hunechauM | U kiyAmatako dina hAmIkahA~ eklai Aunecha ra usale upabhoga gareko dhana-sampattI ra prazaMsAbATa baJcita hunecha |
81 muzrikaharUle allAhalAI choDI mUrtiharUko upAsanA gare | tAki yI nirmita mUrtiharUle unIharUlAI sahayoga ra samarthana garun |

82 tinIharUle dAbI gareko jasto pakkai hoina | yI muzrikaharU jasako upAsanA garne garchan, kiyAmatako dina unIharUle yinIharUle gareko upAsanAlAI nakArnechan | unIharU yinIharUbhandA nikai TADhA hunechan ra yinIharUkA zatru hunechan |

83 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! hAmIle zaitAnaharUlAI muzrikaharUmAthi adhikAra diera paThAeko tapAIMle dekhnubhaena?! nizcita rUpamA unIharUlAI pApa garne pralobhanamA pArna ra allAhako mArgamA bAdhA puryAunakA nimti zaitAnaharUlAI adhikAra diekA hauM |

84 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) allAhasa~ga unIharUko vinAzako lAgi duA mAgna hatAra nagarnuhos | vAstavamA hAmI unIharUko umerako hisAba rAkhdaichauM | jaba unIharUlAI chuTa dine avadhi samApta hunecha, taba hAmIle unIharUlAI karma anusAra kaDA daNDa dinechauM |

85 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! kiyAmatako dinalAI samjhanuhos | hAmI Izabhaya rAkhneharUlAI sammAnita samUhako rUpamA bhelA pArnechauM kinaki unIharU Adezako pAlanA gardathe ra varjita kurAharUbATa bacdathe |
86 hAmIle kAphiraharUlAI tirkhAeko avasthAmA narkatira laijAnechauM |
87 yI kAphiraharUle eka arkAko lAgi siphArisa garne adhikAra pAune chainan | tara allAhamAthi AsthA rakhne ra rasUlako anusaraNa garnele mAtra yo adhikAra pAu~necha |
88 yahUdI, IsAI ra kehI bahudevavAdIharUle bhaneH rahamAna (allAha) ko chorA cha |
89 he yasto kurA bhanne mAnisaharU ho! nissandeha timIharUle yasto bhanera ThUlo galtI garyau |
90 yasa duSTa vacanale gardA AkAza Tukrine thiyo, dhartI phATine thiyo ra pahADaharU TukrA TukrA hune thie |
91 kinabhane tinIharUle allAhako chorA chan‌ bhanera jhUTo Aropa lagAe | allAha yasto AropabATa pavitra ra mahAn hunuhuncha |
92 kasailAI chorA banAunu allAhako pratiSThA anukUla chaina |
93 AkAzaharU tathA pRthvImA rahekA phariztAharU, mAnisa ra jinaharU mahApralayako dina allAha samakSa pUrNa samarpita avasthAmA upasthita hunechan |
94 allAhale sabailAI Aphno jJAnako paridhImA rAkhnubhaeko cha, sabaiko pUrNa gaNanA garnubhaeko cha ra uhA~bATa kehI pani lukeko chaina |
95 mahApralayako dina tinIharUmadhye pratyeka allAha samakSa eklai Aunechan | unako na sahayogI hunecha ra na sAthamA dhana nai hunecha |

96 vAstavamA allAhamAthi AsthA rAkhneharU ra uhA~lAI khusI pArnakA nimti satkarma garneharUko manalAI allAhale premale bharidinuhunecha | allAha unIharUsa~ga prema garnuhuncha ra AphnA bhaktaharUko manamA unIharUkA lAgi prema utpanna garnuhunecha |

97 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! hAmrA AdezaharUko pAlanA garne ra avaidha garekA kurAharUbATa bacera Izabhaya rAkhneharUlAI zubhasUcanA dina ani satyatAlAI svIkAra nagarI ahaMkAra garneharUlAI cetAvanI dina hAmIle yasa kurAnalAI tapAIMko bhASAmA avatarita garI sahaja banAekAchauM |

98 tapAIMko samudAyabhandA pahile hAmIle kaiyauM samudAyaharUlAI naSTa pArisakekAchauM | ke Aja tapAIM unIharUlAI mahasusa garna saknuhuncha? ke unIharUko sAno svara pani sunnuhuncha? unIharUko je pariNAma bhayo tyahI pariNAma allAhako Adezale arUko pani hunasakcha |
1 tA0 hA0! yastA akSaraharUko vyAkhyA sUraha al-bakarahako ArambhamA bhaisakeko cha |

2 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! tapAIMko samudAyale tapAIMmAthi ImAna nalyAemA tapAIMko cintAko kAraNa banos ra AphUlAI barbAda pArnuhos bhanera hAmIle tapAIMmAthi kurAna avataraNa garekA hoinauM |
3 baru hAmIle yasalAI allAhako bhaya rAkhneharUko lAgi upadeza banAera paThAekAchauM |
4 ucca AkAzaharU ra vizAla dhartIko sRSTikartA allAhale nai yo kurAna avataraNa garnubhaeko ho | mahAn hastIle avataraNa garnubhaeko hunAle yo kurAna mahAn ho |
5 ar-rahmAna (allAha) arza (siMhAsana) mA Aphno zAna ra mahimA anusAra virAjamAna hunubhayo |
6 AkAzaharU, dhartI ra mATomuni rahekA sampUrNa sRSTiharUko sRSTi, adhikAra ra vyavasthApana garne kAma kevala allAhakai hAtamA cha |

7 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! tapAIM ThUlo svaramA kurA garnuhos vA sAno svaramA allAha sabai jAnnuhuncha | uhA~ ta manamA khelirahekA kurAlAI sameta jAnnuhuncha | kunai pani kurA uhA~bATa lukeko chaina |
8 allAhabAheka kohI satya upAsya chaina ra uhA~kA utkRSTa evam sundara nAmaharU chan |

nabI (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) Aphno samudAyako vyavahArabATa nirAza bhaepachi mUsA (alaihissalAma) ko kathA varNana garera sAntvanA diMdai allAhale bhannubhayoH
9 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) tapAIM samakSa imrAna putra mUsAko kathA prastuta bhaisakeko cha |

10 unale yAtrAmA Ago dekhepachi AphnA parivAralAI bhaneH timIharU yahI~ basdai gara | maile tyahA~ para Ago dekheM | zAyada ma tyahA~bATa Agoko kehI jhilko liera Auna sakchu vA tyahA~ kohI bATo dekhAune bheTAuna sakchu |
11 jaba unI Agoko najika Ae, allAhale unalAI ‘he musA’ bhanera bolAunubhayo |
12 ma nai timro pAlanakartA hu~ | masa~ga kurAkAnI garnakA nimti timI AphnA dubai juttA phukAla | timI pavitra sthAna (tuvA) mA chau |
13 he mUsA (alaihissalAma)! maile timIlAI sandezavAhakako rUpamA cuneko chu | tasartha mero vahI (vANI) lAI dhyAnapUrvaka suna |
14 vAstavamA ma nai allAha hu~, ma bAheka arU kohI satya upAsya chaina | mero mAtra upAsanA gara ra malAI samjhanako lAgi pUrNatAkA sAtha namAja kAyama gara |

15 mahApralaya Aune nai cha | tara kahile Aunecha kasailAI pani tyasako jJAna chaina kinaki maile tyasalAI gopya rAkheko chu | tara nabI (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) le avagata garAunu bhaekole unIharUlAI tyasakA nizAnIharUko jJAna cha | harekale gareko rAmro ra narAmro kAmako badalA dine uddezyale yasalAI gopya rAkhieko ho |

16 mahApralayako AgamanalAI namAnne kAphiraharUle tapAIMlAI yasamAthi vizvAsa garna ra satkarmadvArA yasako tayArI garnabATa narokun | unIharUle manamAnI gare ra pApamA lipta bhae | ke yasa kAraNale tapAIM barabAda hunuhunecha?
17 (allAhale bhannubhayoH) he mUsA! tyo timro dAhine hAtamA ke cha?

18 mUsA (alaihissalAma) le bhaneH yo mero lauro ho | ma yasalAI samAI Tekera hi~Dchu | ma Aphno bheDAlAI khuvAunakA lAgi yasale rUkhabATa pAta jhArchu | yasabAheka anya kAmakA lAgi pani yasalAI prayogamA lyAu~chu |
19 allAhale bhannubhayoH he mUsA! tyasalAI timI bhui~mA rAkha |
20 mUsA (alaihissalAma) le tyasalAI bhui~mA rAkhe | tyo jiu~do sarpamA pariNata bhayo ra salbalAuna thAlyo |
21 he mUsA (alaihissalAma)! Aphno laurolAI samAta | tyasalAI sarpako rUpamA dekhera naAttiU | timIle samAtepachi hAmI tyasalAI purAnai rUpa dinechauM |
22 Aphno hAtalAI kAkhimunI cyApa | tyo hAta nikAldA seto hunecha binA kunai roga | yo timro dosro nizAnI ho |
23 he mUsA (alaihissalAma)! hAmIle timIlAI hAmro zaktikA ThUlaThUlA nizAnIharU dekhAunakA nimti yI duIvaTA nizAnIharU dekhAyauM | yo hAmro zakti ra timI allAhako rasUla pramANa ho |
24 he mUsA (alaihissalAma)! timI phiraunakahA~ jAU | usale kuphramA ra allAhako viruddha vidrohamA ati garisakyo |
25 mUsA (alaihissalAma) le bhaneH he mero pAlanakartA! mero chAtIlAI kaSTa sahana sakne pharAkilo banAunuhos |
26 mero kArya sahaja banAunuhos |
27 malAI praSTa bolna sakne kSamatA pradAna garnuhos |
28 tAki tapAIMko sandeza puryAudA unIharU mero kurA praSTa bujhna sakun |
29 mero khAnadAnabATa merA kAmaharUmA sahAyatA garnako lAgi malAI euTA sahayogI pradAna garnuhos |
30 mero dAI hArUna bina imrAnalAI |
31 unalAI pradAna garera mero samarthana garnuhos |
32 unalAI pani masa~ga rasUla banAunuhos |
33 tAki hAmI milera tapAIMko dherai bhandA dherai pavitratA bayAna garna sakauM |
34 tapAIMlAI dherai yAda garna sakauM |
35 tapAIMle hAmIlAI rAmrosa~ga dekhirahanu bhaeko cha, hAmro kunai kAma tapAIMbATa adRSya tathA lukeko chaina |
36 allAhale bhannubhayoH he mUsA! timIle mAgeko hAmIle diyauM |
37 hAmIle pherI timImAthi upakAra garyauM |
38 jaba hAmIle phiraunako kapaTapUrNa yojanAbATa jogAune kurA timro AmAko manamA hAlyauM |

39 hAmIle timrI AmAlAI Adeza diyauH mUsAlAI janmAepachi euTA bAkasamA rAkhnu ra bAkasalAI samudramA choDidinu | tyasapachi mero Adezale samudrale usalAI kinArasamma puryAidinecha | tyasapachi hAmro ra usako zatru phiraunale usalAI linecha | maile timIprati sabaiko manamA prema hAlidie~ | ataH mAnisaharUle timIlAI prema garna thAle | tAki timro pAlanapoSana mero rekhadekha ra mero heracAhamA hos |

40 timrI didIle tyasa bAkasalAI pachyAu~dai gain | tyasapachi unale bAkasalAI uThAuneharUlAI bhanin– ke ma tapAIMharUlAI tyasa mahilAbAre jAnakArI diU~ jasale usako rakSA garnechin, stanapAna garAune chin ra pAlanapoSaNa garnechin? yasarI hAmIle timImAthi upakAra garyauM ra timrI AmAlAI khusI pArnakA lAgi punaH unako pAsamA timIlAI pharkAidiyauM | tAki unI timro viSayamA cintita nahoun | tyasapachi timIle mukkAle hAnera kibtI (phiraunako samarthaka) lAI hatyA garyau | tyasabelA pani timIlAI daNDabATa bacAera timImAthi upakAra garyauM | eka pachi arko saGakaTamA phasephachi timIlAI hareka paTaka hAmIle mukta garyauM | tyasapachi timI tyasa ThAu~lAI choDera kehI varSako lAgi madayanabAsIharUkA sAthamA basyau | ani he mUsA (alaihissalAma)! timro lAgi nirdhArita gareko samayamA hAmIsa~ga kurA garnakA lAgi timI pharkera Ayau |
41 maile mAnavaharUsamma Aphno sandeza puryAunakA nimti timIlAI rasUlako rUpamA cuneko chu |

42 he mUsA (alaihissalAma) timI Aphno dAI hArUnakA sAtha allAhako zaktikA nizAnIharU ra uhA~ko ekezvaravAda (tauhIda) kA pramANaharU liera jAU | allAhatarpha ahvAna garna ra malAI smaraNa garna timI dubaijanA sustI nagarnu |
43 timI dubaijanA phiraunakahA~ jAU | usale kuphra ra allAhako viruddha vidrohamA ati garisakyo |
44 ani Usa~ga namratAkA sAtha kurA garnu | AzA cha, usale bujhne cha ra allAhasa~ga DarAera pazcatApa garnecha |

45 mUsA ra hArUna (alaihimassalAma) le bhaneH usale hAmro AhvAna sunnuaghi nai hAmIlAI sajAya dina hatAra garnecha vA sImA ullaGghana garI hAmIlAI hatyA garnecha vA arU kehI atyacAra garnecha bhanne Dara hAmIlAI cha |
46 allAhale bhannubhayoH timIharU naDarAU, mero sahayoga ra samarthana timIharUsa~gai cha | timIharUbIca je hunecha ma sunirahane ra herirahane chu |

47 timIharU Usako pAsamA jAU ra bhana- he phirauna! hAmI timrA pAlanakartAkA rasUla hauM | isrAIlakA santAnaharUlAI hAmIsa~ga jAna deU | unIharUkA chorAharUko hatyA garera ra unIharUkA chorIharUlAI jiu~dai rAkhera unIharUlAI pIDA nadeU | hAmI saccA hauM bhanI timro pAlanakartAko tarphabATa pramANa liera AekAchauM ra allAhamAthi AsthA rAkhneharUkA lAgi ra uhA~ko mArgadarzanako anurasaNa garneharUkA lAgi surakSAko vAcA liera AekAchauM |

48 allAhakA nizAnIharUlAI mithyA Thahara garneharU ra uhA~kA rasUlaharUko sandezako viparIta garneharUkA lAgi yasa saMsAramA ra AkhiratamA yAtanA raheko cha bhanI allAhale hAmIlAI vahI (vANI) mArphata bhannubhaeko cha |
49 unI dubaile lyAeko sandezalAI nakArdai phiraunale bhanyoH he mUsA! timIharUlAI mero pAsamA paThAune timIharUko pAlanakartA ko hun?
50 hAmrA pAlanakartA uhA~ hunuhuncha, jasale hareka vastulAI suhAu~do rUpa ra AkAra dinubhayo | tyasapachi hareka sRSTilAI juna uddezyale sRSTi garieko ho tyahI kurAko mArgadarzana garnubhayo |
51 phiraunale bhanyoH aghi nai mRtyu bhaisakekA kAphira (avajJAkArI) harUko ke dazA hunecha?

52 mUsA (alaihissalAma) le phiraunalAI bhaneH tinIharUko avasthAko jJAna kevala allAhasa~ga cha, jo lauhe mahaphUja (surakSita peTikA) mA surakSita rAkhieko cha | merA pAlanakartA tyasa jJAnako viSayamA na galtI garnuhuncha na uhA~ birsanuhuncha |

53 jasale yasa dhartIlAI timIharUko basobAsakA lAgi suvidhAjanaka banAunubhaeko cha ra tyasamA hi~DaDula garne mArgaharU banAunubhaeko cha | AkAzabATa pAnI pArnubhayo ani uhA~le tyasa pAnIbATa vibhinna prakArakA boTabirUvAharU umArnubhayo |

54 he mAnisaharU! hAmIle timIharUkA lAgi utpAdana garekA pavitra khAnekurAharU khAU ra AphnA gharapAluvA janAvaraharUlAI khuvAU | vAstavamA mAthi ullekhita kurAharUmA bujhneharUkA lAgi allAhako zakti ra uhA~ko ekezvaravAda (tauhIda) pramANaharU chan |
55 hAmIle mATobATai timIharUko purkhA AdamalAI sRSTi garyauM | mRtyupachi timIharUlAI purera tyahI~ mATomai pharkAinecha ra kiyAmatako dina tyahI~bATa pherI uThAunechauM |
56 hAmIle phiraunalAI AphnA nau vaTai nizAnIharU dekhAyauM | usale dekhe tApani mAnna inkAra garyo ra allAhamAthi AsthA rAkhna mAnena |
57 phiraunale bhanyoH he mUsA! timIle lyAeko jAdUdvArA hAmIharUlAI misrabATa nikAlna AekA hau, tAki yahA~ko rAjya timro hos?

58 he mUsA! tyaso bhae hAmI pani tyastai jAdU liera AunechauM | hAmI duvaijanA eka nizcita samaya ra sthAnamA bheTne samjhautA garau~ jasako ullaGghana na hAmIle garnechauM na timIle gara | tyo sthAna duI samUha bIcako AdhA bATomA hunupardacha |
59 mUsA (alaihissalAma) le phiraunalAI bhaneH parvako dina hAmro bheTne samaya nizcita bhayo | tyasadina sUryodayapazcAta mAnisaharU utsava manAunakA lAgi bhelA hunchan |
60 phirauna pharkera gayo ra SaDyantra garyo | ani tokieko samaya ra sthAnamA pratispardhA garna hAjira bhayo |

61 phiraunakA jAdUgaraharUlAI upadeza diMdai mUsA (alaihissalAma) le bhaneH sAvadhAna! Aphno jAdUko mAdhyamale mAnisaharUlAI dhokA diera allAhamAthi jhUTo Aropa nalagAU | uhA~le timIharUlAI naSTa pArnuhunecha | allAhamAthi jhUTo Aropa lagAuneharU asaphala hunechan |
62 mUsA (alaihissalAma) ko kurA sunepachi jAdUgaraharUle ApasamA matabheda gare ra gopya rUpamA sallAha garna thAle |

63 kehI jAdUgaraharUle gopya rUpamA bhanna thAleH vAstavamA mUsA ra hArUna (alaihimassalAma) jAdUgara hun | unIharUle timIharUlAI misrabATa Aphno jAdUdvArA nikAlna khojekA chan | unIharU timIharUko vyaktitva ra timIharUle mAniraheko uttama tarikAlAI naSTa pArna cAhanchan |
64 Aphno kAmamA kuzalatA apanAU ra matabheda nagara | paGktibaddha bhaera agADI baDha ra AphUle jAneko jAdU ekaipaTaka dekhAU | Aja jasale Aphno vipakSIlAI harAunecha U nai saphala hunecha |
65 jAdUgaraharUle mUsA (alaihissalAma) lAI bhaneH he mUsA! duIvaTA kurAmadhye euTA roja, pahile timI jAdU dekhAu~chau vA hAmI dekhAauM?

66 mUsA (alaihissalAma) le bhaneH pahile timIharU nai dekhAU | tyasapachi unIharUle AphUsa~ga bhaeko jAdU dekhAe | unIharUle phyAkekA DorIharU ra lauroharUlAI sarpaharU jastai salbalAeko mUsA (alaihissalAma) le dekhe |
67 unIharUle gareko jAdUle mUsA (alaihissalAma) ko manamA Dara utpanna bhayo |
68 mUsA (alaihissalAma) lAI AzvAsana diMdai allAhale bhannubhayoH he mUsA! tyo dekhera Attinu pardaina | unIharUlAI pachArera timI nai vijaya hunechau |
69 timro dAhine hAtamA bhaeko lauro bhui~mA phyAka | tyo sarpamA pariNata bhaera unIharUko jAdUlAI nilnecha | unIharUle jAdU mAtra garekA hun ra jAdUgaraharUle je gare pani saphala hunechainan |
