70 ani mUsA (alaihissalAma) le lauro phyA~ke juna sarpamA pariNata bhayo ra unIharUkA jAdUdvArA banekA sarpaharUlAI nilyo | mUsA (alaihissalAma) jAdUgara hoinan bhanI thAhA pAepachi jAdUgaraharUle allAhalAI sajdA gare | ani bhaneH yo ta allAhako tarphabATa ho | hAmIle mUsA, hArUna (alaihimassalAma) ra sampUrNa sRSTiko pAlanakartAmAthi AsthA (ImAna) rAkhyauM |

71 jAdUgaraharUko AsthA (ImAna) ko nindA gardai ra unIharUlAI dhamkAu~dai phiraule bhanyoH ke timIharUle mero anumati binA nai AsthA rAkhyau? he jAdUgaraharU! vAstavamA mUsA timIharUko aguvA ho ra usaile timIharUlAI jAdU sikAeko ho | aba ma timIharUkA hAtakhuTTAharU viparIta dizAbATa kATnechu ra mRtyuhuJjela timIharUlAI khajUrako hA~gAmA jhunDyAunechu | ani timIharU arUharUkA lAgi pATha hunechau, tyasapachi ma ra mUsAko pAlanakartAmadhye kasako yAtanA ati kaThora ra sadhaiM bA~kI rahane cha bhanI timIharUle thAhA pAunechau?!

72 jAdUgaraharUle phiraunalAI bhaneH he phirauna! hAmIlAI spaSTa AyataharU prApta bhaepachi tyasako anusaraNa choDera hAmI timro anusaraNa gardainauM | hAmI sRSTikartAlAI choDera timIlAI rojdainauM | timIlAI je garna mana cha gara | eka dina timro khela khatama hunecha kinaki timro zakti yasa samApta hune jIvanamA mAtra kAma lAgnecha |

73 hAmIle pahile garekA kuphra ra arU pApaharUlAI hAmrA pAlanakartAle mApha garnuhunecha bhanI AzA raheko hunAle hAmIle uhA~mAthi AsthA rAkhekA hauM | yasarI nai timIle hAmIharUlAI jAdU sikna, abhyAsa garna ra mUsA (alaihissalAma) lAI harAuna bAdhya pAreko pApalAI pani uhA~le mApha garnuhunecha | timIle hAmIharUlAI gareko vAcAbhandA allAhako pratiphala uttama raheko cha ra timIle Dara dekhAeko yAtanAbhandA uhA~kai yAtanA sthAyI raheko cha |
74 phalasvarUpa jo kohI kiyAmatakA dina AphnA pAlanakartAsamakSa kAphira bhaera Au~cha U sadAkA lAgi narkamA basnecha | jahA~ na ta usalAI mRtyu Aunecha ra na sukhale bA~cne cha |

75 jo kiyAmatako dina Aphno pAlanakartA samakSa AsthA rAkhera athavA momina bhaera Aunechan ra unIharUle satkarmaharU pani garekA thie bhane unIharUko lAgi pratiSThita sthAnaharU ra ucca padaharU rahekA chan |

76 padaharUko tAtparya tyasto svargamA rahanu ho jasakA mahalaharUkA talatirabATa nadIharU bagirahekA hunechan ra tyahA~ unIharU sadA rahanechan | kuphra ra pApaharUbATa jogineharUko lAgi yo pratiphala raheko cha |

77 hAmIle mUsAlAri vahI (IzavANI) mArphata bhanyauM– kasaile thAhA napAune garI timI merA bhaktaharUlAI liera rAtArAta misrabATa niska | ani Aphno laurole hAnera samudramA sukhkhA bATo banAera laijAU | cintA nagara kinaki na timIharUlAI phirauna ra usakA mantrIharUle samAtna saknechan na timIharU samudramA Dubnechau |

78 ani phirauna AphnA senAharUkA sAtha unIharUko pachi lAgyo, tara samudrale usalAI ra usakA senAlAI yasarI chopyo jasako vAstavikatA kevala allAhalAI thAhA cha | unIharU sabai Dubera mare ra mUsA (alaihissalAma) ra unakA sAthIharU yasabATa mukta bhae |
79 phiraunale AphnA samudAya samakSa kuphralAI AkarSaka banAera prastuta garI unIharUlAI pathabhraSTa garyo | asatyako sahayogale unIharUlAI dhokhA diyo ra unIharUlAI kahilyai sIdhA bATo dekhAena |

80 phirauna ra usako senAbATa bacAepachi hAmIle isrAIlakA santAnaharUlAI bhanyauM– he isrAIlakA santAnaharU! hAmIle timIharUlAI zatrubATa bacAyauM ra tUra pahADako dAhinetira avasthita ghATImA mUsA (alaihissalAma) sa~ga kurA garne vAcA garyauM | timIharU bhauMtAriraheko avasthAmA hAmIle timIharUmAthi mahajasto svAdilo peya ra baTTAI (titrA) jasto dekhine sAno carAko svAdilo mAsu avatarita garyauM |

81 hAmIle pradAna garekA svAdilA halAla khAnekurAharU khAU | hAmIle anumati diekA kurAharUbATa agADI baDhera anumati nadiekA kurAharUmA nalAga natra mero prakopa timIharUmAthi avatarita hunecha | jasamAthi mero prakopa avatarita hunecha U yasa saMsAramA ra AkhiratamA naSTa hunecha |
82 prAyazcita garne, mamAthi AsthA rAkhne, satkarma garne ani satyatAmA aDiga rahane vyaktiko lAgi ma ati kSamAzIla raheko chu |
83 he mUsA (alaihissalAma)! tapAIMlAI Aphno samudAyalAI pachADi choDera kuna kurAle cA~Dai Auna bAdhya banAyo?
84 mUsA (alaihissalAma) le bhaneH unIharU mero pachADi chan ra makahA~ Aipugne chan | ma unIharUbhandA cA~Dai Aeko dekhera tapAIM khusI hunuhuncha bhanI maile hatAra gareM |

85 allAhale bhannubhayoH timIle pachADi choDekAharUko parIkSA hAmIle liyauM, unIharU ta bAchAko upAsanAmA lAge | vAstavamA sAmarIle unIharUlAI yasako lAgi ahvAna garyo ra yasarI unIharUlAI pathabhraSTa garyo |

86 Aphno samudAyale suru gareko bAchAko upAsanAprati mUsA (alaihissalAma) risAu~dai ra cintita hu~dai pharkie | musA (alaihissalAma) le bhaneH he mero samudAya! ke allAhale timIharUko lAgi taurAta avatarita garne ra timIharUlAI svargamA praveza garAune jastA rAmrA vAcA garnubhaeko thiena? ke yo antarAla lAmo bhayo ra timIharUle yasalAI birsyau? vA timIharUko yasa kAmako kAraNale timIharUmAthi timIharUko pAlanakartAko prakopa vA yAtanA avatarita hos bhanI cAhanchau? tyasaile timIharUle ma pharkera Aune belAsamma parkhenauM ra mero vAcA viparIta garyo ani anusaraNamA aDiga rahenauM!

87 musA (alaihissalAma) ko samudAyakA mAnisaharUle javApha dieH hAmIle Aphno khusIle vAcA viparIta garekA hoina baru bAdhyatAle ho | hAmIle phiraunako samudAyakA gara-gahanAko DaGgura liera AekA thiyauM | tyasabATa chuTkArA pAunakA lAgi hAmIle tyasalAI khAlTomA phyAkyauM | jaba hAmIle tyasalAI khAlTomA phyAkyauM taba sAmarIle pani Usa~ga raheko jibrIla (alaihissalAma) ko ghoDAko pAilAko mATolAI phyAkyo |

88 ani banI isrAIlale jammA pArekA gahanAharUbATa sAmarIle prANa nabhaeko bAchAko mUrti banAyo, tara tyasako AvAja gAIko jasto thiyo | tyasabelA sAmarIbATa prabhAvita bhaekAharUle bhaneH yo timIharUko ra mUsA (alaihissalAma) ko upAsya ho tara mUsAle birsanubhayo ra yahA~ choDnubhayo |

89 jasako parIkSA bAchAdvArA liiyo ra unIharU tyasako upAsanA garna thAle, ke unIharUlAI thAhA chaina bAchAmA unIharUsa~ga kurA garnasakne ra unIharUkA duA sunnasakne kSamatA chaina, unIharUlAI ra arUlAI hAnibATa bacAuna pani sakdaina, ani na svayaMlAI phAIdA puryAuna sakcha ra na arUlAI nai?!

90 mUsA (alaihissalAma) pharkera Aunu aghi nai hArUna (alaihissalAma) le unIharUlAI bhaneH sunabATa bAchA banAunu ra tyasako AvAja timIharUko lAgi parIkSA mAtra ho | yasarI momina ra kAphirako pahicAna garna sakincha | he mAnisaharU! vAstavamA timIharUkA pAlanakartA dayAvAn hunuhuncha | jasale na timIharUlAI hAnI puryAuna sakcha na timIharUlAI phAIdA nai dina sakcha, usale timIharUmAthi dayA garna pani sakdaina | kevala uhA~ko upAsanA garne mAmilAmA mero anusaraNa gara ra arUko upAsanA choDne mAmilAmA mero kurA mAna |
91 bAchAko upAsanAdvArA parIkSA liiekAharUle bhaneH mUsA (alaihissalAma) pharkera naAuJjela hAmI yasako upAsanA garirahane chauM |
92 mUsA (alaihissalAma) le Aphno dAI hArUna (alaihissalAma) lAI bhaneH allAhalAI choDera bAchAko upAsanA garera unIharU pathabhraSTa bhaeko dekhdA tapAIMle kina roknubhaena?
93 ke tapAIM malAI choDera unIharUsa~ga milnubhaeko ho? jaba maile tapAIMlAI mero uttarAdhikArI banAe~ pheri pani tapAIMle jAnAjAnI mero Adeza namAnnubhaeko ho?

94 jaba mUsA (alaihissalAma) le Aphno dAI hArUna (alaihissalAma) ko kAmako nindA gardai unalAI unako dAhrI ra TAuko samAtera AphUtira tAne | unIsita dayAko AzA rAkhdai hArUna (alaihissalAma) le bhaneH mero dAhrI ra mero TAukoko kapAla nasamAta | unIharUsa~gai cupacApa lAgera basnuko kAraNa cha masa~ga | yadi maile unIharUlAI unIharUkai avasthAmA choDera gaeko bhae unIharU vibhAjita hune Dara thiyo | ani maile unIharUlAI vibhAjita gareko ra timro upadezalAI birseko bhanI timIle bhannethyau |
95 mUsA (alaihissalAma) le sAmarIlAI bhaneH he sAmarI! timIle yo ke gareko? timIlAI kuna kurAle yaso garna prerita garyo?

96 sAmarIle mUsA (alaihissalAma) lAI bhanyoH unIharUle dekhna nasakeko kurA maile dekheM | maile jibrIla (alaihissalAma) lAI ghoDAmAthi dekheM ani maile unako ghoDAko pAilAko mATolAI lie~ ra tyasa mATolAI pagAleko sunako bAchAko AkAra die~ | tyasabATa bAchAko rUpa ra zarIra banyo ani tyasabATa bAchAko svara niskana thAlyo | maile gareko kAmalAI mero mana mastiSkale rAmro Thahara garyo |

97 mUsA (alaihissalAma) le sAmarIlAI bhaneH aba timI yahA~bATa niskera gaihAla | timro sajAya yo ho ki timIle bA~cunjelasamma bhannechau- malAI kasaile nachoU ra ma pani kasailAI chu~daina | yasarI timI achUta bhaera eklai bA~cnechau | timro hisAba kitAba kiyAmatako dina hunecha | allAha Aphno phaisalA viparIta garnuhunna | allAhalAI chADi timIle juna bAchAko upAsanAlAI rojekA chau tyasatira hera | hAmI tyasalAI Ago bAlera pagAlnechauM ani tyasalAI TukrA-TukrA pArera samudramA phyA~kera tyasako astitva nai samApta pArnechauM |

98 he mAnisaharU! timIharUkA vAstavika upAsya allAha nai hunuhuncha | uhA~ bAheka arU kohI upAsya chaina | uhA~le sampUrNa kurAharUlAI Aphno jJAnale sameTnubhaeko cha | uhA~bATa kehI kurA chuTeko chaina |

99 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) jasarI hAmIle tapAIMlAI mUsA (alaihissalAma), phirauna ra dubaikA samudAyako kathA sunAyauM tyasarI nai hAmI tapAIMlAI tapAIMbhandA pahilekA nabIharU ra mAnisaharUko kathA sunAunechauM jasako uddezya tapAIMlAI sAntvanA dinu ho | hAmIle tapAIMlAI upadeza grahaNa garneharUkA lAgi upadeza svarUpa kurAna diekAchauM |

100 jo tapAIMmAthi avatarita yasa kurAnabATa vimukha bhayo, yasamAthi AsthA (ImAna) rAkhena ra yasako anusaraNa garena, U kiyAmatako dina ThUlo pApako bhAra bokera Aunecha jo pIDAdAyI yAtanAko pAtra bannecha |
101 yastA mAnisaharUle tyasa yAtanAlAI sadhaiMkA lAgi bhognechan | unIharUle kiyAmatako dina bokne bhAra ati nai ghRNita cha |

102 jaba mRtyupazcAta punaH jIvita pArine dina phariztAle dosro sUra phuknechan, tyasa dina hAmIle kAphiraharUlAI yasto avasthAmA ekatrita garnechauM ki Akhiratako DaralAgdo dRzyalAI dekhera Darale unIharUko zarIra ra A~khAko raGga nilo bhaeko hunecha |
103 mRtyupazcAta timIharU cihAnamA dasa rAta mAtra basyau bhandai unIharU eka arkAsa~ga kAnekhusI garnechan |

104 tinIharUko kAnekhusIlAI hAmI rAmrarI jAndachauM | kehI pani hAmIbATa lukeko chaina | tyasabelA sabaibhandA calAkha vyaktile bhannechaH timIharU cihAnamA jammA eka dina basyau, tyobhandA dherai basenau |

105 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! kiyAmatako dina pahADaharUko avasthA ke hune ho bhanI unIharU tapAIMlAI sodhchan | tapAIM unIharUlAI bhannuhos– merA pAlanakartAle pahADalAI jarAbATai ukhelnuhunecha ra tyasalAI dhUlo banAI uDAunuhunecha |
106 ani uhA~le dhartIlAI yasto samathara banAunuhunecha jahA~ kunai pani bhavana ra birUvAharUlAI bA~kI rAkhnuhunechaina |
107 tyo dhartI yasto samathala hunecha ki tapAIMle tyasa dhartImA kunai prakArako moDa, ukAlo ra orAlo dekhnuhunechaina |

108 tyasadina mAnisaharU bhelA hune ThAu~ (hazrako maidAna) tira bolAune AvAjalAI pachyAuna bAdhya hunechan | allAhako Darale sabai AvAjaharU mauna hunechan | tapAIMle kevala kAnekhusI mAtra sunnuhunecha |
109 tyasa mahatvapUrNa dina allAhako anumatikA sAtha uhA~le rojnubhaeko vyaktiko siphArisa bAheka arU kasaiko siphArisa kAma lAgnechaina |

110 kiyAmatako dina mAnisaharUle sahana garnu parne ra unIharUle saMsAramA garekA sampUrNa kriyAkalApaharUlAI allAhale jAnnuhuncha | tara kasaile pani uhA~ko mahAnatA ra guNaharUbAre pUrNa rUpale thAhA pAuna sakdaina |

111 ani mAnisaharU tyasadina apamAnita hunechan ra sadA jIvita rahane, kahilyai mRtyu naAune mahAn allAhako adhinamA hunechan | uhA~le AphnA bhaktaharUko mAmilAharUko vyavasthApana garnuhunecha | pApako bhAra bokera AphailAI naSTa garna khojne vyakti ghATAmA hunecha |

112 allAha ra uhA~kA rasUlaharUmAthi AsthA rAkhI satkarma garne vyaktile pUrA-pUrA badalA pAunecha | usalAI atyAcArako kunai Dara hunechaina kinaki usale nagareko pApako sajAya usale bhognuparne chaina ra na usako satkarmamA kunai kamI garinecha |

113 jasarI hAmIle pahilekA mAnisaharUko kathA bayAna garyauM tyasarI nai hAmIle yasa kurAnalAI praSTa arabI bhASAmA avataraNa garyauM ra hAmIle yasamA vibhinna cetAvanI ra dhamkI ullekha garekA chauM | AzA cha, unIharU allAhako bhaya rAkhnechan vA yo kurAna unIharUkA lAgi upadeza ra smaraNako sAdhana hunecha |

114 allAha mahAna evaM pavitra hunuhuncha | uhA~ rAjA hunuhuncha jasako adhInamA sampUrNa kurAharU rahekA chan | uhA~ ra uhA~kA vANI nitAnta satya raheko cha | muzrikaharUle lagAeko AropabATa uhA~ pavitra hunuhuncha | he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! tapAIMsamma kurAnako bhAga pUrNa rUpale puryAi saknubhandA pahile nai jibrIla (alaihissalAma) sa~ga kurAna pAThamA hatAra nagarnuhos | ani bhannuhos– he merA pAlanakartA! jo jJAna tapAIMle malAI pradAna garnubhaeko cha, tyasako sAthasAthai adhika jJAna pradAna garnuhos |

allAhale mUsA (alaihissalAma) ko kathA ani tyasamA phiraunako inkAra ra isrAIlakA santAnaharUko ajJAnatAko varNana garepachi Adama (alaihissalAma) ko kathA varNana garnubhaeko cha, jasamA bATo birAeko vyaktilAI allAhako bATo apanAunako lAgi protsAhita garieko cha | uhA~le bhannubhaeko chaH
115 hAmIle Adama (alaihissalAma) lAI manAhi garieko rUkhako phala nakhAna bhanekA thiyau~ | hAmIle manAhI garyauM ra tyasako pariNAma pani varNana garyauM | unale allAhako kurA birse ra tyasa rUkhako phala khAe | hAmIle unamA hAmro AdezamA aDiga rahana sakne kSamatA dekhenauM |

116 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! yAda garnuhos, jaba hAmIle phariztAharUlAI Adama (alaihissalAma) ko abhivAdanako lAgi sajdA garne Adeza dieka thiyauM | iblIsa bAheka sabaile sajdA gare | tyo unIharUsa~gai thiyo tara unIharU madhyeko thiena | ghamaNDako kAraNa usale sajdA garena |

117 ani hAmIle bhanyauH he Adama! iblIsa timro ra timrI patnIko zatru ho | usako kurAmA lAgera usale timI ra timrI patnIlAI svargabATa nanikAlos, yasto bhayo bhane timIle kaSTa ra durbhAgya sahanuparne huncha |
118 vAstavamA svargamA allAhale tapAIMko bhoka meTnakA lAgi khuvAunu hunecha ra tapAIMko nAGgo zarIralAI chopna lugA lagAidinu hunecha |
119 tapAIMko tirkhA meTnakA lAgi pAnI pilAunu hunecha ra sUryako garmI chekna chA~yA pradAna garnuhunecha |

120 zaitAnale AdamalAI bahakAyo ra bhanyoH ke ma timIlAI euTA yasto rUkhako viSayamA bhanauM jasako phala khAne mAnche amara hunecha, kahilyai marnechaina ra kahilyai samApta nahune rAjyako mAlika hunecha?!

121 antataH niSedha garieko rUkhako phala Adama ra havvA (alaihimassalAma) le khAe | unIharUkA gopya aGgaharU dekhie ra unIharUle svargako rUkhakA pAtaharU Tipera AphUlAI chopna thAle | khAna nahune rUkhako phala khAera Adama (alaihissalAma) le AphnA pAlanakartAko Adeza viparIta gare | unale manAhI garieko kAma gare |
122 tara allAhale unalAI rojnubhayo, unako pazcAttApa svIkAra garnubhayo ra unalAI sahI mArgadarzana garnubhayo |

123 allAhale Adama ra havvA (alaihimassalAma) lAI bhannubhayoH timI dubaijanA svargabATa orla | iblIsa timI dubaiko zatru ho ra timIharU iblIsako zatru hau | aba timIharU samakSa mero mArgadarzana Aunecha | yAda rAkha, jasale mero mArgadarzanako anusaraNa garnecha ra tyasabATa vimukha hunechaina, U kahile pani satyatAbATa haTne chaina ra AkhiratamA yAtanA bhognuparne chaina, baru allAhale usalAI svargamA praveza garAunuhunecha |

124 tara jo mero yAdabATa vimukha hunecha, mArgadarzanalAI svIkArne chaina ra tyasako anusaraNa garnechaina usako sAMsArika ra cihAnako jIvana dayanIya hunecha | kiyAmatako dina bhelA hune ThAu~samma unIharUlAI hAmI andho ra tarka vitarka garna nasakne avasthAmA lyAunechauM |
125 allAhako yAdabATa vimukha hunele bhannechaH he pAlanakartA! maile ta saMsAramA sabai kurA dekhthe, tara Aja malAI kina andho avasthAmA uThAunu bhaeko?

126 allAhale yasako javAphamA bhannubhayoH timI samakSa hAmrA nizAnIharU Ae tara timIle tyasalAI asvIkAra garyau | timIle saMsAramA hAmrA AyataharUsa~ga yasto vyavahAra garyau | Aja timIlAI pani yAtanA bhogna eklai choDinecha |

127 manamAnI garneharUlAI ra AphnA pAlanakartAprati ImAna (AsthA) lyAune spaSTa pramANa dekhdA dekhdai pani svIkAra nagarneharUlAI pani hAmIle yastai yAtanA dinechauM | allAhale AkhiratamA dinuhune yAtanA sAMsArika ra cihAnako dayanIya jIvanabhandA dherai DaralAgdo, kaSTakara ra sadhaiM bA~kI rahane cha |

128 hAmIle unIharUbhandA pahile ThUlo saGkhyAmA mAnisaharUlAI naSTa pArisakekA chauM bhanne kurA muzrikaharUlAI spaSTa jAnakArI chaina ra?! unIharU naSTa pAriekA tI mAnisaharUle basobAsa garne ThAu~bATa gujrane garchan ra unIharUle tyahA~ avatarita yAtanAko avalokana garekA chan | vAstavamA mAnisaharUko vinAzamA buddhimAnaharUko lAgi pATha raheko cha |

129 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! yadi tapAIMkA pAlanakartAko tarphabATa spaSTa pramANa dekhAepachi mAtra yAtanA dine kurA nagarieko bhae ra unIharUko yAtanAko lAgi nizcita myAda natokieko bhae uhA~le yAtanA dina hatAra garnuhune thiyo kinaki unIharUko lAgi yahI upayukta raheko cha |

130 tasartha, he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! tapAIMmAthi lagAiekA AropaharUprati dhairya garnuhos ra Aphno pAlanakartAko prazaMsAkA sAtha sUryodaya aghi phajrako namAjamA uhA~ko guNagAnako sAtha pavitratA bayAna garnuhos, ani sUryAstabhandA pahile asrako namAjamA ra rAtakA praharaharUmA magriba ra IzAko namAjamA pani ani madhyAnnapachi joharako salAhamA ra sUryAstapachi magribako namAjamA pani uhA~ko guNagAnako sAtha pavitratA bayAna garnuhos | AzA cha, tapAIMkA pAlanakartAle tapAIMlAI khusI pArne pratiphala dinuhunecha |

131 hAmIle yastA jhUTAharUko parIkSA linakA nimti yinIharUlAI dieko sAMsArika jIvanako sukhatira nahernuhos | yo samApta hune sukha ho | vAstavamA tapAIMlAI dine vAcA garieko pratiphala yinIharUle bhogeko sAMsArika sukhabhandA dherai uttama cha ra sadA rahirahane cha, kinaki tyo kahilyai samApta hunechaina |

132 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! Aphno parivAralAI namAja paDhne Adeza dinuhos ra svayam pani namAja paDhna aDiga rahanuhos | hAmI svayam tapAIMkA lAgi ra arUkA lAgi tapAIMbATa jIvikA cAha~dainauM, baru jIvikA hAmro jimmAmA raheko cha | allAhako Dara rAkhne, uhA~kA AdezaharUko pAlanA garne ra uhA~le manAhI garnubhaekA kurAharUbATa bacera Izabhaya rAkhneharUkA lAgi yasa saMsAramA ra AkhiratamA prazaMsanIya pariNAma raheko cha |

133 nabI (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) lAI inkAra garne jhUTAharU bhanchan- muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) Aphno nabI bhaeko kurAlAI satya Thahara garnakA nimti Aphno pAlanakartAko tarphabATa pramANa kina lyAunu hunna? uhA~bhandA pahilekA kitAbaharUlAI satya Thahara garna yI jhUTAharU samakSa kurAna Aena ra?

134 nabI (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) lAI inkAra garneharUlAI unIharUko kuphra ra kaThoratAkA kAraNa rasUla paThAunubhandA pahile ra kitAba avatarita garnuaghi nai mAthibATa prakopa avatarita garera naSTa gareko bhae unIharUle Aphno kuphrako lAgi tarka prastuta gardai bhanne thieH he merA pAlanakartA! tapAIMle hAmI saMsAramA bhaeko belA rasUla paThAunubhaeko bhae tapAIMko yAtanAko kAraNale apamAnita hunubhandA pahile nai hAmIle uhA~mAthi AsthA rAkhne thiyauM ra uhA~le lyAunubhaekA AyataharUko anusaraNa garne thiyauM |

135 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! yI jhUTA Thahara garneharUlAI bhannuhos– allAhale ke garnuhuncha bhanI hAmImadhye hareka vyakti pratIkSAmA chauM | tasartha timIharU pani pratIkSA gara | hAmI ra timIharUmadhye ko sidhA bATomA cha ra kasale mArgadarzana prApta gareko cha bhanI timIharUle cA~Dai nai thAhA pAune chau |
1 kiyAmatako dina hune hisAbako samaya nikaTa Aisakeko cha | tara mAnisaharU AkhiratalAI bevAstA garI saMsAramA nai vyasta chan |

2 unIharUko pAlanakartAko tarphabATa kurAnako nayA~ bhAga avataraNa hu~dA unIharU phAidA prApta garne niyatale gambhIra bhaera sundainan, baru tyasamA ke cha bhanne kurAko paravAha nagarI hA~so ThaTTA gardai sunchan |

3 unIharU kurAna sunera bevAstA garchan ani atyAcArIharU gopya SaDyantra garchan ra bhanchan- rasUla hune dAbI garne timIharU jastai euTA mAnche hoina ra? U timIharUbhandA vizeSa pani hoina | usalAI jAdU garna Au~cha | U timIharU jastai mAnche bhaeko ra usale jAdU jAneko kurA thAhA hu~dA hu~dai pani ke timIharU usako anusaraNa garchau?

4 rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi vasallama) le bhannubhayoH mero pAlanakartAle timIharUko SaDyantralAI rAmrarI jAnnuhuncha | vAstavamA AkAzaharU ra pRthvImA boliekA hareka kurAharU uhA~ jAnnuhuncha, kinaki uhA~ AphnA sampUrNa bhaktaharUkA kurAharU sunnuhuncha, unIharUle garekA sampUrNa kAryaharUko jJAna cha ra tyasakai AdhAramA unIharUlAI badalA dinuhunecha |

5 tara unIharU muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi vasallama) le lyAunubhaeko kurAnako viSayamA zaGkAmA chan | kahile bhanchan- yI arthahIna sapanA hun | kahile bhanchan- hoina, yo usako AdhArahIna managaDhante kurA ho | kahile bhanchan- U kavi ho | yadi vAstavamA usako dAbI saccA cha bhane pahilekA rasUlaharU jastai mUsA (alaihissalAma) ko lauro ra sAleha (alaihissalAma) ko u~TanIko camatkAra jhai~ usale pani camatkAra dekhAos |

6 yinIharUbhandA pahile pani kaiyauM samudayaharUle nizAnI dekhAune prastAva rAkhe ra hAmIle nizAnI dekhAyauM tara tinIharUle nizAnI dekhepachi pani AsthA (ImAna) rAkhenan ra yasa kAraNa hAmIle unIharUlAI naSTa pAryauM | ke yinIharUle AsthA (ImAna) rAkhnechan ta?!

7 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! hAmIle tapAIMbhandA pahile mAnisaharUmadhye kevala purUSaharUlAI nabI banAera paThAyauM ra unIharUlAI vahI garyauM | hAmIle phariztAharUlAI rasUla banAera paThAekA chainauM | yadi timIharUlAI yasako jJAna chaina bhane timIharUbhandA pahilekA ahle kitAbaharUlAI sodha |
8 hAmIle paThAekA tyasatA zarIravAlA banAekA thienauM jo khAnA nai khA~dainn; baru tI rasUlaharUko zarIra thiyo ra unIharU anya mAnisaharU jhaiM khAnapina garthe ra unIharU amara pani hoinan |
9 hAmIle hAmrA rasUlaharUlAI bacAera unIharUsa~ga gareko vAcAlAI pUrA garyau ra mominaharUmadhye jasalAI cAhyauM bacAyauM | ani atyAcArIharUlAI kuphra ra avajJAkA kAraNa naSTa pAryauM |

10 hAmIle timIharUkA lAgi kurAna avataraNa garyauM | yadi timIharU kurAnamA vizvAsa garchau ra tyasako anusaraNa garchau bhane tyasamai timIharUko sammAna ra garva raheko cha | yadi timIharUle yasa kurAlAI bujheko bhae timIharU tyasamA AsthA rAkhna ra tyasako zikSAko anusaraNa garna hatAra garne thiyau |
11 hAmIle katipaya samudAyaharUlAI tinIharUko kuphra ra atyAcArale gardA naSTa pAryauM | ani unIharU pazcAta hAmIle anya mAnisaharUko sRSTi garyauM |
12 jaba tinIharUle jaraidekhi ukhelne hAmro vinAzakArI prakopa dekhe, taba tinIharU vinAza hunabATa bacna bastibATa hatAra hatAra bhAgna thAle |
13 unIharUlAI tiraskAra gardai bolAiyo: timIharU nabhAga baru Aphno atyanta ArAmadAyI jIvana ra gharaharUtarpha pharkera jAU | tAki timIharUko sAMsArika kAryaharUbAre sodhapucha hos |
14 atyAcArIharUle bhane– kasto hAmro durbhAgya! vAstavamA hAmI allAhalAI nakArera atyAcArI bhaechauM |
15 unIharUle Aphno pApalAI svIkAra gardai ra Aphno mRtyuko mAga gardai gareko avasthAmA hAmI unIharUlAI kATieko phasala saraha mRta ra acala banAunechauM |
16 hAmIle AkAza, pRthvI ra yI dubaibIca rahekA kurAharUlAI vyartha sRSTi garekA hoinauM | hAmIle Aphno zaktiko pradarzanako lAgi tinIharUko sRSTi garekA hauM |
17 yadi hAmIle patnI vA chorA-chorI rAkhna cAheko bhae hAmIsa~gai bhaekA madhyebATa rAkhnethyauM | tara hAmIle tyaso garenauM kinaki hAmIlAI yasako AvazyakatA nai chaina |

18 baru hAmIle rasUlatira vahI gareko nitAnta satyalAI kAphiraharUko asatyamAthi prahAra garchauM, ani asatya samApta huncha | allAhako patnI ra chorA cha bhanneharU ho! timIharUle allAhako lAgi upayukta naraheko Aropa lagAeko kAraNa timIharUlAI sarvanAza garinecha |

vAstavamA patnI ra santAna rAkhnuko tAtparya apUrNa tathA jaruratamanda hunu ho, tasartha yasa brahmANDako mAlika uhA~ nai bhaeko kurA uhA~le varNana gardai bhannubhayoH
19 uhA~ eklai AkAzaharU ra dhartIkA mAlika hunuhuncha ra uhA~sa~gai rahekA phariztAharU uhA~ko upAsanAbATa vimukha hu~dainan ra unIharU thakita pani hu~dainan |
20 unIharU sadhaiM allAhako mahimAgAna garchan tara unIharUlAI kahilyai dikka lAgdaina |
21 tara muzrikaharUle allAhalAI chADi asamarthaharUko upAsamA garchan, jo mRtalAI jIvita pArna sakdainan | ta unIharU yastA asamarthako upAsanA kasarI garna sakchan?!

22 yadi AkAzaharU ra pRthvImA allAha bAheka arU dherai upAsyaharU bhaekA bhae tI jhUTA upAsyaharUmA adhikArako lAgi jhagaDAle vidhvaMsa maccine thiyo, tara yathArtha yasako viparIta raheko cha | allAhasa~ga kohI sAjhedAra chain, yasa viSayamA muzrikaharUle lagAeko AropabATa siMhAsanakA mAlika allAha pavitra hunuhuncha |

23 kevala allAhale mAtra Aphno zAsana ra phaisalAko adhikAra rAkhnuhuncha | uhA~le bhAgyamA ke lekhnubhayo ra ke phaisalA linubhayo bhanera kasaile pani sodhne adhikAra rAkhdaina | baru uhA~le AphnA bhaktaharUsa~ga unIharUle gareko kriyAkalApako viSayamA sodhnuhunecha ra tyasai anusAra unIharUlAI badalA dinuhunecha |

24 unIharUle allAhalAI choDera arU upAsyaharU banAe | he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi vasallama)! yI muzrikaharUlAI bhannuhos– unIharU upAsanAko adhikAra rAkhchan bhanne pramANa lyAU | yo mamAthi avatarita kitAba ra arU rasUlaharUmAthi avatarita kitAbaharUmA timIharUko lAgi kunai pramANa chaina | adhikatama muzrikaharUko AdhAra bhaneko ajJAnatA ra dekhAsikI ho | tasartha unIharU nitAnta satyalAI svIkAra gardainan |

25 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! hAmIle tapAIMbhandA pahile paThAiekA hareka rasUlalAI vahI garyauH ma nai timIharUko vAstAvika upAsya hu~ tasartha mero mAtra upAsanA gara ra kasailAI pani mero sAjhedAra nabanAU |

26 muzrikaharUle bhaneH allAhale phariztAharUlAI chorI banAunubhaeko cha | uhA~ yinIharUko managaDhante kurAharUbATa pavitra hunuhuncha | baru phariztAharU allAhadvArA sammAna pAekA nikaTatama bhaktaharU hun |
27 unIharU AphnA pAlanakartAbhandA pahile kahilyai boldainan | baru uhA~le Adeza nadiesamma unIharU boldainan | unIharU uhA~kA hareka Adezako pAlanA garchan ra kahile pani avajJA gardainan |

28 uhA~le tinIharUkA bhUta ra bhaviSyakA sampUrNa kriyAkalApaharU jAnnuhuncha | unIharU kevala tyasakA lAgi siphArisa garnechan jasako lAgi uhA~le anumati dinuhunecha | uhA~ko Darale unIharU satarka rahanchan ra uhA~ko avajJA gardainan |

29 mAnauM, phariztAharUmadhye kasaile mero bhakti gara bhancha bhane kiyAmatako dina hAmI usalAI sadAkA lAgi narkamA hAlnechauM | kuphra ra allAhako sAjhedAra Thahara garne atyAcArIharUko yo nai badalA ho |

30 ke kAphiraharUlAI thAhA chaina pRthvI ra AkAzaharU alaga-alaga nabhaI euTai piNDa thie bhanera | AkAzaharU ra pRthvIko bIcamA khAlI ThAu~ nai thiena | hAmIle tinIharUlAI alaga-alaga pAridiyauM ra AkAzabATa pRthvImA pareko pAnIdvArA hAmIle janAvaraharU ra vanaspatiharUko sRSTi garyauM | ke unIharU yasa kurAmA vizvAsa garera kevala allAhamAthi AsthA rAkhdainan?!

31 ani hAmIle pRthvImA aglA-aglA ra vizAla pahADaharU banAyauM tAki pRthvI mAnisaharU sahita yatAutA nahalliyos | hAmIle unIharUko lAgi mArgaharU ra pharAkilA bATAharU banAyauM | tAki unIharUle Aphno gantavyasamma pugnakA lAgi mArga prApta garna sakun |

32 hAmIle AkAzalAI stambha binA surakSita chAnA banAekAchauM juna kahile pani khasdaina ra kasaile pani gopya rUpamA tyahA~kA kurA sunna sakdaina | tara yI muzrikaharU AkAzamA rahekA candramA ra sUrya jastA nizAnIharUbATa vimukha hunchan ra vizvAsa gardainan |

33 allAhale nai rAtalAI ArAmako nimti ra dinalAI jIvikopArjanako nimti sRSTi garnubhayo | sUryalAI dinako nizAnIko rUpamA ra candramAlAI rAtako nizAnIko rUpamA sRSTi garnubhayo | sUrya ra candramA lagAyata sampUrNa grahaharU A-Aphno kakSamA parikramA garchan | na vicalita hunchan na Aphno kakSabATa dA~yA-bA~yA lAgchan |

34 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! hAmIle tapAIMbhandA pahile kasailAI pani yasa saMsAramA amara banAenauM | yadi tapaIMko samaya samApta bhaI tapAIMko mRtyu huncha bhane ke yinIharU jIvita rahanechan ta? kadApi hoinan |

35 yasa saMsAramA momina ra kAphira harekale mRtyuko svAda cAkhnu parnecha | he mAnisaharU! hAmI yasa saMsAramA jimmevArI, kRpA ra durbhAgyako mAdhyamale timIharUko parIkSA linechauM | ani mRtyupazcAta timIharU hAmItarpha nai pharkera Aunechau ra hAmI timIharUlAI timIharUkA karmakA badalA dinechauM |

36 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! yI muzrikaharUle tapAIMko khillI uDAu~dai ra AphnA anuyAyIharUlAI bahakAudai bhanchan- timIharUle upAsanA garne upAsyaharUlAI gAlI garne yahI nai ho, hoina ra?! unIharU kurAna ra varadAnalAI nakArchan | vAstavamA, unIharU kukarmamA lipta hunAle nai nindA yogya chan |

37 hatAra garnu mAnavako pravRtti ho | kunai pani kurA hunu aghi nai tyasako lAgi hatAra gardacha | yastai prakArako hatAra muzrikaharU prakopako lAgi gardaichan | mero prakopa herna hatAra garneharU, timIharUlAI ma prakopa dekhAunechu | tasartha tyo cA~Dai Aos bhanne cAhanA narAkha |
38 mRtyu pazcAta punaH jIvita hune kurAlAI inkAra garne ra hatAra garne kAphiraharUle bhanchan- he muslimaharU! yadi timIharU saccA hau bhane timIharUle bAcA gareko punarjIvana kahile hunecha?

39 punaH jIvita hune kurAlAI nakArne yI kAphiraharUle AphnA anuhAra ra DhADalAI narkako AgobATa bacAuna saknechainan ra tyasa yAtanAbATa mukta huna kunai sahayogI pani pAune chainan bhanne kurA thAhA pAekA bhae unIharUle yAtanAko lAgi hatAra garne thienan |

40 juna AgodvArA unIharUlAI yAtanA diinecha tyo unIharU saceta bhaeko avasthAmA Au~daina baru ekkAsI AI lAgnecha | unIharU tyasabATa bacna sakne chainan ra na tyasalAI pachi sArna saknechan | tara yadi unIharU pazcAttApa garchan bhane dayAko bhAgedAra hunechan |

jaba allAhakA rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) Aphno samudAyako khillI ra unIharUko inkArabATa dukhita hunuhunthyo, taba allAhale uhA~ko manobala baDhAu~dai bhannubhayoH
41 yadi tapAIMko samudAyale tapAIMko khillI uDAekA chan bhane yasto vyavahAra tapAIMsa~ga mAtra garieko hoina | he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! tapAIMbhandA pahile jati pani rasUlaharU Ae sabaiko khillI uDAiyo | khillI uDAekole unIharUlAI allAhako prakopale gheryo |

42 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! prakopa herna hatAra garneharUlAI bhannuhos– rAta ra dinako samayamA rahmAna (allAha) le AkAzabATa prakopa paThAera timIharUlAI naSTa pArne soca banAepachi kasale bacAuna sakcha ra? tara pani unIharU AphnA pAlanakartAkA upadeza ra nizAnIharUbATa vimukha hunchan | unIharU ajJAnatA ra murkhatAko kAraNale kehI pani socdainan |

43 ke unIharUle Thahara garekA upAsyaharUle unIharUlAI hAmro prakopabATa bacAunechan? unIharU ta AphUlAI ghATAbATa bacAera ra Aphno phAidA garera Aphnai sahayoga garna sakdainan bhane arUko sahayoga kasarI garna sakchan?! unIharUle hAmrA prakopalAI chalna pani sakdainan |

44 baru hAmIle yI kAphiraharUlAI ra yinakA purkhAharUlAI chuTa diera kRpAharUbATa phAidA uThAuna diyauM | yasai avasthAmA lAmo samaya bityo ani unIharU kuphramai aDiga rahera dhokhA khAe | hAmIle dhartIlAI vijaya ra prakopadvArA vibhinna dizAbATa ghaTAu~dai lageko kurA yinIharUle dekhdainan? tasartha unIharUle tyasabATa pATha sikun ra je arUsa~ga bhaeko thiyo unIharUsa~ga nahos | unIharU jitna sakdainan baru unIharU parAjita hunechan |

45 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! bhannuhos– he mAnisaharU ho! merA pAlanakartAle vahI mArphata malAI sUcita garnubhaeko prakopabATa ma timIharUlAI sAvadhAna gariraheko chu | tara allAhako prakopabATa sAvadhAna garAe tApani bahirAharU satyatAlAI svIkAra garne niyatale sundainan |

46 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! prakopako lAgi hatAra garneharUlAI yadi tapAIMko pAlanakartAko prakopale thorai mAtrai choyo bhane unIharUle bhannechan– hAmro kasto durbhAgya! allAhasa~ga arUlAI sAjhedAra Thahara garera ra muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) le lyAunubhaeko kurAnalAI nakArera hAmIle Aphai~mAthi atyAcAra garekAchauM |

47 kiyAmatako dina mAnisaharUkA karmalAI nyAyakAsAtha jokhnako lAgi tarAju rAkhnechu | tyasa dina kasaimAthi atyAcAra garinechaina | nata usako satkarmalAI kama garera atyAcAra garinecha, nata duSkarmalAI baDhAera | yadi rAyoko dAnA barAbara bhaepani hAmI tyasalAI jokhnechauM | bhaktaharUko hisAba rAkhnako lAgi hAmI nai paryAptachauM |

48 hAmIle mUsA ra hArUna (alaihimassalAma) lAI taurAta pradAna garyauM | yo satya ra asatya evam vaidha ra avaidha bIca pharaka garne sAdhana, ani yasamAthi AsthA rAkhneharUkA lAgi mArgadarzana ra AphnA pAlanakartAko bhaya rAkhneharUkA lAgi upadeza ho |
49 yinIharU nai hun jo Aphno pAlanakartAmAthi AsthA rAkhdachan, yadyapi unIharUle uhA~lAI dekhekA chainan | uhA~ko prakopa ra kiyAmatadekhi DarAu~chan |

50 muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) mAthi avatarita yo kurAna upadeza grahaNa garna cAhaneharUko lAgi upadeza ho | yasamA atyAdhika phAidA ra bhalAI cha | yasakA bAvajuda timIharU vimukha hunchau? yasakA zikSAharUlAI svIkAra gardainauM ra tinalAI vyavahAramA lAgu gardainauM?
51 hAmIle ibrAhIma (alaihissalAma) lAI sAnai cha~dA unako samudAya virUddha Avazyaka raheko Thosa tarka pradAna garyauM ra hAmI unalAI rAmrarI jAndathyauM |
52 jaba unale AphnA pitA Ajara ra samudAyalAI sodhe: yI kastA mUrtiharU hun jasalAI timIharU Aphnai hAtale banAekA chau ra usaiko upAsanAmA tallIna chau?
53 unako samudAyakA mAnisaharUle bhaneH hAmIle AphnA pUrvajaharUlAI yinako upAsanA gardai Aeko pAyauM | unIharUlAI pachyAu~dai hAmIle pani yI mUrtiharUko upAsanA garna thAlyauM |
54 ibrAhIma (alaihissalAma) le unIharUlAI bhaneH he pUrvajaharUkA samarthakaharU! timIharU ra timrA pUrvajaharUle spaSTa satyatAlAI choDera pathabhraSTatAlAI apanAekA chau |
55 unako samudAyakA mAnisaharUle unalAI bhaneH timIle bhaneko kurA satya ho vA timI ThaTTA gardaichau?

56 ibrAhIma (alaihissalAma) le bhaneH maile satya bhaneko ho, ThaTTA gareko hoina | timIharUko pAlanakartA uhA~ nai hunuhuncha jasale AkAzaharU ra pRthvIlAI binA kunai namunA sRSTi garnubhaeko ho | ani yasa kurAko ma sAkSI chu ra timIharUle upAsanA garekA mUrtiharUko yasamA kunai sahabhAgitA chaina |

57 ibrAhIma (alaihissalAma) le Aphno samudAyale nasunne garI bhaneH allAhako kasama! timIharU cADa manAuna gaepachi ma timIharUkA mUrtiharUko virUddha yasto mAmilA garnechu, jasalAI timIharUle mana parAune chainauM |
58 ibrAhIma (alaihissalAma) le mUrtiharUlAI TukrA-TukrA pAridie | kasale mUrtiharUlAI TukrA-TukrA pAreko ho bhanI unIharUle sodhnakA nimti sabaibhandA ThUlolAI yathAvata rAkhidie |

59 unIharU pharkera Aepachi AphnA mUrtiharUlAI kasaile TukrA-TukrA pAreko dekhera eka ApasamA sodhna thAleH kasale hAmrA upAsyaharUlAI TukrA-TukrA pAreko holA? jasale pani TukrA-TukrA pAreko ho U atyAcArI ho | kinabhane usale yI pavitra tathA sammAna yogya upAsyaharUlAI tiraskAra garyo |
60 kehIle bhaneH ibrAhIma nAma gareko euTA yuvakale yinIharUko viSayamA apazabda bhancha ra yinIharUko apamAna garcha bhanne kurA hAmIle sunekAchauM | usaile yo gareko hunasakcha |
61 tinIharUkA aguvAharUle bhaneH usalAI sabai mAnisaharU samakSa liera AU | usale galtI svIkAreko dRzyalAI sabaile dekhun ra yo svayam usako virUddha timIharUko lAgi pramANa hos |
62 unIharUle ibrAhIma (alaihissalAma) lAI tyahA~ upasthita garAera sodheH he ibrAhIma! timIle hAmrA mUrtiharUlAI toDaphoDa gareko ho?

63 ibrAhIma (alaihissalAma) le unIharUkA mUrtiharUko lAcArI mAnisaharU sAmu jAhera gardai bhaneH yo maile gareko hoina | baru mUrtiharUmadhye ThUlole gareko ho | yadi kurA garna sakSama chan bhane AphnA mUrtiharUlAI sodha |

64 unIharUle soca vicAra gare ra unIharUkA mUrtiharUle nata phAIdA puryAuna sakchan na hAnI nai bhanne niSkarSamA unIharU puge | tasartha allAhalAI choDera yinIharUko upAsanA garera unIharUle atyAcAra gare |

65 ani unIharUle DhipI ra ajJAnatAmA pharkaMdai bhaneH he ibrAhIma! timIlAI thAhA cha, yI mUrtiharU kurA gardainan bhanera | ani kasarI timIle hAmIlAI yI mUrtiharUlAI sodha bhaneko? yaso bhanera unIharUle Aphno pakSamA pramANa prastuta garna cAhekA thie tara yo unIharUko virUddhako pramANa huna pugyo |

66 unIharUko kurA nakArdai ibrAhIma (alaihissalAma) le bhaneH ke allAhalAI choDera timIharU yI mUrtiharUko pUjA garna cAhanchau? jasale timIharUko lAbha vA hAniko kSamatA rAkhdaina | yinIharU ta AphailAI pani hAnibATa jogAune vA Aphnai lAbhako pani kSamatA rAkhdainan |

67 kasto durbhAgya timIharUko ra yI mUrtiharUko jasako upAsanA timIharU allAhalAI choDera garchau |! yinIharU na lAbhako kSamatA rAkhchan na hAniko nai | ke timIharU yo kurA bujhera yinIharUko upAsanA choDna sakdainau?

68 jaba unIharUle ibrAhImako sAmanA tarkadvArA garna sakenan taba unIharU zArIrika zaktiko sahArA lina puge ra bhaneH timIharU Aphno bhagavAnaharUko sahayoga garna cAhanchau bhane ibrAhImalAI jalAideU | hAmrA mUrtiharUlAI naSTa pArneharUko yahI sajAya ho |
69 tyasapachi unIharUle Ago bAle ra unalAI tyasamA phyA~kidie, ani hAmIle AgolAI Adeza diyauM: timI ibrAhImako lAgi zItala ra saMrakSaka bana | tyasatai bhayo ra unalAI kehI hAni noksAnI bhaena |
70 ibrAhIma (alaihissalAma) ko samudAyale unalAI jalAune SaDyantra race tara hAmIle unIharUko SaDyantralAI viphala banAyauM ra unIharUlAI naSTa pAryauM ani parAjita garAyauM |
71 hAmIle unalAI ra lUta (alaihissalAma) lAI bacAyauM, ani dubailAI hAmIle zAmatira lagyauM, juna ThAu~lAI hAmIle nabIharU paThAera ra tyahA~ sRSTiharUko lAgi suvidhA sampanna banAyauM |

72 unale chorAkA nimti AphnA pAlanakartAsa~ga duA garepazcAta hAmIle unalAI ishAka (alaihissalAma) diyauM ra (nAti) yAkUba (alaihissalAma) pani pradAna garyauM | hAmIle ibrAhIma ra unakA chorA ishAka ra nAti yAkUbalAI satkarmI ra allAhako AjJAkArI banAyauM |

73 hAmIle unIharUlAI aguvA banAyauM ra mAnisaharU bhalAimA unIharUko anusaraNa gardathe | allAhako Adezale unIharUle mAnisaharUlAI allAhako mAtra upAsanA garna AhvAna gardathe ra hAmIle unIharUlAI satkarma garna, sahI tarikAle namAja paDhna ra jakAta dina vahI garyauM | ani unIharU hAmrA AjJAkArI bhakta thie |

74 hAmIle lUta (alaihissalAma) lAI nyAya garna sakne kSamatA ra jJAna pradAna garyauM | unako samudAya (sadUma) lAI dieko prakopabATa hAmIle unalAI bacAyauM | unIharU aprAkRtika kAryamA lipta thie | vAstavamA unIharU Aphno pAlanakartAko AjJApAlanabATa vimukha bhaera bhraSTa bhaekA thie |
75 prakopabATa bacAepachi hAmIle unalAI dayAko pAtra banAyauM, kinaki unI satkarmI thie, allAhakA AdezaharUko pAlanA gardathe ra pratibandhita kAryaharUbATa bacdathe |

76 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! ibrAhIma ra lUta (alaihimassalAma) bhandA pahile nUha (alaihissalAma) ko kathAlAI samjhanuhos | jaba unale allAhasa~ga duA gare | hAmIle unako duA svIkAra garyauM ra unale mAgeko puryAyauM | ani hAmIle unalAI ra unakA momina parivAralAI ThUlo dukhabATa jogAyauM |

77 hAmIle unalAI tyastA mAnisaharUko SaDyantrabATa jogAyauM, jasale unako sadAcAritAlAI pramANita garnakA nimti prastuta gariekA nizAnIharUlAI jhUTo Thahara gare | vAstavamA unIharU bhraSTa ra duSTa mAnisaharU thie | hAmIle unIharU sampUrNalAI DubAera naSTa pAryauM |

78 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! dAUda ra unakA chorA sulaimAna (alaihimassalAma) ko kathAlAI samjhanuhos | jaba unIharU duI jhagaDA garne vyaktiharUko sambandhamA unIharU samakSa lyAieko muddAko bAremA phaisalA sunAirahekA thie | tI duImadhye ekako bheDAle rAtamA arkoko kheta caryo ra tyasalAI naSTa pAryo | hAmI dAUda ra sulaimAna (alaihimassalAma) le gareko phaisalAlAI herirahekA thiyauM ra unIharUko phaisalAko kunai pani kurA hAmIbATa lukeko chaina |

79 hAmIle dAUda (alaihissalAma) lAI nabhaI sulaimAna (alaihissalAma) lAI yasa mAmilAbAre spaSTa pAryauM | tara hAmIle dubailAI IzadUtatva ra zarIatako jJAna pradAna garyauM | sulaimAna (alaihissalAma) lAI mAtra pradAna garenauM | hAmIle pahADaharUlAI dAUdako adhInamA garyauM, jo unIsa~gai allAhako guNagANa gardathe | tyasarI nai hAmIle carAharUlAI unako adhInamA garyauM | hAmIle nai phaisalA garne kSamatA, jJAna ra vastuharU adhInamA diyauM |

80 hAmIle sulaimAna (alaihissalAma) lAI nabhaI dAUda (alaihissalAma) lAI hAtahatiyArako coTabATa timIharUko zarIralAI bacAuna kavaca banAune kalA sikAyauM | he mAnisaharU! ke allAhale timIharUlAI dinubhaeko yasa kRpAkA kAraNa timIharU uhA~lAI dhanyavAda dinchau?

81 hAmIle tibra gatimA calne hAvAlAI sulaimAna (alaihissalAma) ko adhInamA garyauM | unako Adezale tyo hAvA zAma jAnthyo, juna ThAu~lAI hAmIle nabIharU paThAera ani dherai bhalAikA cijaharU phailAera barakatayukta banAekA thiyauM | hAmIlAI hareka cijaharUko bAremA jAnakArI cha, kunai pani cija hAmro jAnakArIbATa lukeko chaina |

82 hAmIle kehI zaitAnaharUlAI unako adhInamA diyauM jo samudramA DubulkI mArera unakA lAgi motI ra anya kurAharU nikAlera lyAu~the | ani nirmANa kArya jastA anya kAryaharU pani garthe | hAmI unIharUko saGkhyA ra kAryaharU herirahekA thiyauM | hAmIbATa kehI pani lukeko chaina |

83 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! ayyUba (alaihissalAma) ko kathA samjhanuhos | jaba unale rogabATa grasta bhaepachi AphnA pAlanakartAsa~ga duA gardai bhaneH he merA pAlanakartA! malAI roga lAgeko cha ra maile parivAra gumAeko chu | tapAIM atinai dayAvAn hunuhuncha | mero du:kha ra pIDAlAI nivAraNa garnuhos |

84 hAmIle unako duA svIkAra garyauM, ani unalAI jo roga lAgeko thiyo tyasa kaSTabATa mukta garyauM, jo parivAra ra santAnaharU unale gumAekA thie tyo unalAI punaH pradAna garyauM ra tyati arU thapera diyauM | yo sabai hAmIle hAmro dayAko rUpamA ra dhairya dhAraNa garneharUkA lAgi pATha hos bhanI garyauM |
85 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! ismAIla, idrIsa ra jul-kiphla (alaihimussalAma) lAI samjhanuhos | yinIharU kaSTako belA dhairya gardathe ra allAhako AdezalAI purA garthe |

86 hAmIle unIharUlAI dayAko pAtra banAyauM | unIharUlAI nabI banAyauM ra sabailAI svargamA praveza garAyauM | kinaki unIharU allAhakA asala bhakta ra AjJAkArI thie | unIharU vAhya tathA Antarika sabai kurAharUmA pAradarzI ra pavitra thie |

87 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! mAchAvAlA yUnusa (alaihissalAma) ko kathA samjhanuhos | jaba unI Aphno samudAyalAI unIharUko avajJAkArIle gardA Aphno pAlanakartAko anumati binA nai choDera gae | unI gaeko kAraNale hAmI unalAI sajAya dinnauM bhanI unalAI lAgeko thiyo | tara mAchAle unalAI nilepachi unI ThUlo kaSTa ra kaidamA pare | yo unako parIkSA thiyo | ani unale mAchAko peTa bhitrako, samudrako ra rAtako andhakAramA Aphno galtIlAI svIkArdai ra allAha samakSa pazcAttApa gardai uhA~sa~ga duA gare | unale bhaneH tapAIM bAheka kohI satya upAsya chaina | tapAIM pavitra ra utkRSTa hunuhuncha ra ma atyAcArIharU madhyeko hu~ |

88 hAmIle unako duA svIkAra garyauM ra unalAI andhakAraharUbATa ra mAchAko peTabATa bAhira nikAlera kaThora pIDAbATa mukta garyauM | yasarI nai hAmI mominaharUlAI duA garepazcAta pIDAbATa mukta garchauM |

89 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! jakariyA (alaihissalAma) lAI samjhanuhos | unale AphnA pAlanakartAsa~ga bintI gardai bhaneH he merA pAlanakartA! malAI nisantAna banAera eklo nachoDnuhos | tapAIM sabaibhandA uttama bA~kI rahanevAlA hunuhuncha ra malAI euTA choro dinuhos, jo mero uttarAdhikArIko rUpamA bA~kI rahos |

90 ani hAmIle unako duA svIkAra garyauM, unalAI yahyA nAmaka choro diyauM ra unakI bA~jhI patnIlAI santAna janmAune yogya banAyauM | vAstavamA jakariyA, unakI patnI ra unako chorA sadhaiM satkarma garna tatpara rahane garthe | puNya prAptiko cAhanAle ra hAmro prakopako Darale pukArne gardathe ra hAmIsa~ga bintI garne gardathe |

91 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! maryama (alaihissalAma) ko kathA samjhanuhos | unale svayaMlAI vyabhicArabATa jogAera rAkhin | ani allAhale unItarpha jibrIla (alaihissalAma) lAI paThAunubhayo ra unale unIbhitra phuke | unale IsA (alaihissalAma) lAI garbhamA dhAraNa garin | vAstavamA unI ra unako chorA IsA (alaihissalAma) dubaijanA sampUrNa mAnavajAtikA lAgi allAhakA nizAnI hun | unalAI pitA binA janmAu~dA kunai kurAle pani allAhalAI bAdhya pArna sakena |
92 he mAnisaharU ho! vAstavamA, timIharU ekezvaravAda (islAma) mA AdhArita euTai samUha hau ra ma timIharUkA pAlanakartA hu~ | tasartha ekAgra bhaera kevala mero upAsanA gara |

93 tara mAnisaharU kohI ekezvaravAdI, kohI muzrika, kohI kAphira ra kohI momina bhaera thuprai samUhamA vibhAjita bhae | tara yinIharU Akhiratako dina hAmItarpha nai pharkera Au~nechan ra hAmI unIharUlAI unIharUkA karma anusAra badalA dinechauM |

94 tasartha tinIharUmadhye jasale allAha, rasUlaharU ra Akhiratako dinamA AsthAvAn bhaera satkarma garyo usako satkarmalAI asvIkAra garine chaina | baru allAhale usako satkarmalAI sammAna gardai usalAI dobbara pratidAna dinuhunecha | AkhiratamA usale tyasalAI Aphno karma-patramA lekhieko dekhnecha ra U khusI hunecha |
95 kuphrale gardA hAmIle naSTa pArekA samudAyaharU punaH yasa saMsAramA pharkinechan, ani taubA (pazcAttApa) garnechan ra unIharUko taubA svIkAra garinecha bhannu asaMbhava kurA ho |
96 unIharU kahilyai pharkane chainan | yahA~samma ki yAjUja ra mAjUjako DhokA kholine samaya Aune cha | yAjUja ra mAjUjaharU saMsArako sabai aglA sthAnaharUbATa dauDera Aunechan |

97 unIharUko Agamanasa~gai kiyAmata najikine cha | tyasako bhaya ra saGkaTaharU prakaTa hunechan | tyasako bhayale kAphiraharUkA A~khAharU khulirahekA hunechan | unIharU bhannechan– kasto hAmro darbhAgya! hAmI saMsAramA vyasta thiyauM ra yasa mahatvapUrNa dinako tayArI garenauM | baru hAmIle kuphra garera ra pApa garera atyAcAra garyauM |

98 he muzrikaharU! vAstavamA, timIharU, timIharUle upAsanA garne garekA mUrtiharU, timIharUko upAsanAbATa prasanna bhaekA mAnisaharU ra jinnaharU narkako Indhana banne chan | timIharU ra timrA jhUTA upAsyaharU tyasai narkamA praveza garnechau |

99 yadi unakA yI upAsyaharU satya bhaeko bhae upAsanA garneharUsa~ga unIharU pani narkamA jAne thienan holA | upAsanA garneharU ra upAsyaharU sabai narkamA jAnechan | unIharU tyahA~ sadA rahanechan ra tyahA~bATa niskana sakne chainan |
100 unIharUle bhogeko narkako kaThora pIDAko kAraNa cicyAirahekA hunechan | tara narkako bhayAnaka Darako kAraNale kehI pani sunne chainan |

101 jaba muzrikaharUle bhaneH (tyaso bhae, nizcaya pani IsA ra phariztAharU jasako upAsanA garinthyo unIharU pani narkamA jAnechan) allAhale javApha dinubhayoH vAstavamA allAhako jJAnamA pahile nai utkRSTa rahekA vyaktiharU, jastai- IsA (alaihissalAma) narkabATa mukta rahanechan |
102 narkako AvAja unIharUsamma pugnechaina | unIharU AphUle cAheko kRpA ra AnandamA rahanechan | unIharUko Ananda sadAko lAgi hunecha |

103 narkabAsIharUlAI diieko kaThora yAtanAko dRzyale unIharU DarAune chainan | ani phariztAharU abhinandana gardai bhannechan– saMsAramA timIharUsita vAcA garieko dina yahI ho | ani unIharUle pAune anugrahaharUko unIharUlAI zubhasUcanA diinecha |

104 tyasa dina hAmI AkAzalAI kAgajakA pannAharU paTyAe jhaiM paTyAunechauM ra sRSTiharUlAI pahilo paTaka sRSTi garieko rUpamA nai bhelA pArnechauM | hAmro yo vAcA kahilyai asaphala hunechaina | vAstavamA hAmI Aphno vAcA pUrA garchauM |

105 lauhe mahaphUja (susakSita peTikA) mA lekhisakepachi hAmIle rasUlaharUmAthi avataraNa garekA kitAbaharUmA lekhyauH vAstavamA yasa dhartIkA uttarAdhikArI hAmrA asala ra AjJAkArI bhaktaharU nai hunechan, jo muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) kA ummata (anuyAyI) kA mAnisaharU hunechan |
106 hAmIle paThAeko upadezamA asala bhaktaharUkA lAgi paryApta mAtrAmA phAidAharU chan ra unIharU nai yasabATa phAidA uThAu~chan |

107 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! hAmIle tapAIMlAI sampUrNa sRSTikA lAgi dayAko rUpamA rasUla banAera paThAekA chauM, kinaki tapAIM mAnisaharUlAI sIdhA mArga dekhAuna ra allAhako yAtanAbATa jogAuna utsuka evam prayatnarata hunuhuncha |

108 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! bhannuhos – vAstavamA timIharU sabaikA satya Izvara eka mAtra allAha hunuhuncha ra uhA~ko kohI sAjhedAra chaina bhanI matarpha vahI (IzavANI) garieko cha | tasartha timIharU uhA~prati samarpita hoU uhA~ko AjJAkArI bana |

109 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! yadi yinIharU vimukha hunchan bhane bhannuhos– maile timIharUlAI khabaradArI garisakeM | allAhale vAcA garnubhaeko prakopale timIharUlAI kahile gherne cha bhanne kurA malAI thAhA chaina |
110 vAstavamA timIharUle jAhera garekA ra lukAekA sabai kurAharU uhA~ jAnnuhuncha | uhA~bATa kehI lukeko chaina ra tyasakai AdhAramA timIharUlAI badalA dinuhunecha |

111 malAI thAhA chaina, prakopalAI Dhilo garnu timIharUko lAgi parIkSA ho vA timIharUlAI nirdhArita samayasamma ajhai kehI sAMsArika lAbha uThAuna ra kuphra ani pathabhraSTatAmA jiddI garna diieko ho |

112 allAhakA rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) le Aphno pAlanakartAsa~ga duA gardai bhannubhayoH he mero pAlanakartA! hAmro ra hAmrA kuphramA aDiga rahane samudAyabIca nyAyakA sAtha phaisalA garnuhos | unIharUle boleko kuphra ra jhUTako virUddhamA hAmI hAmrA dayAvAn pAlanakartAko sahayoga cAhanchauM |

1 he mAnisaharU ho! AphnA pAlanakartAkA AdezaharUko pAlanA garI ra uhA~le manAhI garnubhaekA kurAharUbATa bacdai uhA~ko bhaya rAkha | vAstavamA, kiyAmatako belA hune bhUkampa ra anya Dara lAgdA ghaTanAharU ekadamai khataranAka hunechan | tasartha allAhalAI prasanna pArne kAmaharU garera tyasako tayArI gara |

2 tyasadinako Darale gardA hareka stanapAna garAune AmAle Aphno zizulAI birseko ra hareka garbhavatIle garbhapatana gareko timIharUle dekhnechau | ghaTanAko gambhIratAko kAraNa tapAIMle mAnisaharUlAI mAttekAharU saraha buddhivihIna dekhnuhunecha | raksIle mAttera hoina baru allAhako kaThora yAtanAto kAraNale unIharUle Aphno mastiSkako niyantraNa gumAunechan |

kiyAmatako dina hune Dara lAgdA ghaTanAharUko ullekha garera kiyAmata dina ra mRtyu pazcAta punaH jIvita hune kurAlAI nakArneharUko nindA gardai allAhale bhannubhaeko chaH
3 marepachi allAhale punaH jIvita pArne kSamatA rAkhnuhuncha bhanne viSayalAI liera vAdavivAda garne mAnisaharUsa~ga yasako kunai Thosa pramANa chaina | baru unIharU yasa dhAraNA ra bhanAimA Aphno pAlanakartAko bidroha garne hareka zaitAna ra pathabhraSTaharUkA aguvAharUko anusaraNa gardachan |

4 mAnava ra jinnamadhye zaitAnako anusaraNa garne ra tyasamAthi vizvAsa garnelAI usale pathabhraSTa pArnecha ra usalAI kuphra ra pApako bATomA hi~DAieko hunAle narkako yAtanAtira DoryAera lAnecha bhanne kurA usamAthi anivArya garieko cha |

5 he mAnavaharU ho! yadi timIharUlAI mRtyupazcAta punaH jIvita pArna sakne hAmro kSamatAmAthi zaGkA cha bhane svayam Aphno sRSTimA dhyAna diera soca | hAmIle timIharUkA purkhA AdamalAI mATodvArA sRSTi garyauM ani usako santAnalAI purUSale mahilAko garbhamA hAleko vIryadvArA sRSTi garyauM | tyasapachi vIrya Dhikko ragatamA pariNata huncha ra tyasapachi tyo Dhikko ragata capAeko mAsu saraha mAsuko euTA TukrAmA pariNata huncha | tyasapachi tyo mAsuko TukrA yA ta pUrNa prANImA rUpAntaraNa huncha juna garbhamA nai rahancha ra pachi jIvita janma lincha yA tyo pUrNa prANImA rUpAntaraNa hu~daina ra garbhapatana huna pugcha | yo timIharUlAI vibhinna caraNamA sRjanA garna sakne hAmro kSamatAko pradarzana ho | ani hAmI jasalAI cAhanchauM janmane belAsamma garbhamA nirdhArita nau mahinA rAkhchauM | tyasapazcAta hAmI timIharUlAI baccAko rUpamA timIharUko AmAko kokhabATa nikAlchauM | ani timIharUko pUrNa zArIrika ra mAnasika vikAsa huncha | timIharUmadhye kohI tyasabhandA pahile nai marcha bhane kohI buDhesakAlasamma bA~ccha junabelA zArIrika ra mAnasika zakti ghaTcha ra zizubhandA pani kamajora avasthAmA pugcha ani jAnirAkhekA kurAharU pani birsancha | tyasaigarI timIle dhartIlAI nirjIva ra boTa biruvA rahita pani dekhchau | tara jaba hAmI pAnI varSAu~chauM tyahA~ boTa biruvAharU umrera harAbharA hunchan, boTa viruvAharUko kAraNa tyo mAthi uThcha, ani vibhinna prakArakA sundara boTa biruvAharU pani umArcha |

6 timIharUko sRSTiko Arambha, tyasakA caraNaharU ra timIharUmadhye janma lineharUko avasthAko varNana garnuko kAraNa timIharUko vAstavika sRSTikartA timIharUle pUjne garekA mUrtiharU hoinan baru allAha nai hunuhuncha bhanne kurAko ThUlo pramANa ho | uhA~ nai mRtakalAI jIvita pArnuhuncha, uhA~ sampUrNa kAmako sAmarthya rAkhnuhuncha ra uhA~lAI kasaile pani asamartha tulyAuna sakdaina |
7 kiyAmata Aune kurAmA kunai zaGkA chaina | allAhale nai mRtakaharUlAI cihAnabATa jIvita pArera uThAunuhunecha ra unIharUko karmako badalA dinuhunecha |

tesro AyatamA anukaraNako kAraNa pathabhraSTa hune avasthAko ullekha garepachi allAhale yasa AyatamA kuphrakA aguvAharUko pathabhraSTatAko ullekha garnubhaeko chaH
8 kehI kAphiraharU allAhako ekezvaravAdako viSayamA jJAnabinA jabarjastI vivAda garchan | na unIharU mArgadarzanako anusaraNa garchan, na unIharUko mArgadarzanako lAgi allAhako tarphabATa avatarita kunai prakAzamaya kitAba nai cha |

9 unIharUle ghamaNDa garchan ra mAnisaharUlAI allAhako dharma; islAmalAI AtmasAta garnabATa rokchan | tyasaile unIharU saMsAramA apamAnita chan ra AkhiratamA hAmI usalAI Agoko yAtanAko svAda cakhAunechauM |
10 usalAI bhaninechaH timIle gareko kuphra ra pApako kAraNale timIlAI yAtanA diieko ho | allAha AphnA sRSTiharUmadhye kasailAI pani pApa nagareko tyattikai yAtanA dinuhunna |

11 mAnisaharUmadhye kohI yastA pani chan, jo alamalamA chan ra zaGkAmA rahera allAhako upAsanA garchan | yadi unIharUlAI svAstha ra dhanamA lAbha huncha bhane unIharU Aphno dharmamA ra allAhako upAsanAmA aDiga rahanchan | yadi roga ra nirdhanatA diera unIharUko parIkSA liincha bhane unIharU Aphno dharmabATa nirAza hunchan ra dharmalAI tyAgchan | pariNAma svarUpa usako saMsAra barbAda huncha, kinabhane usale kuphra gardaimA usako bhAgyamA lekhieko bhandA baDhI kunai pani sAMsArika cija mildaina ra usale Aphno paraloka pani barbAda garcha kinabhane usale allAhako yAtanA bhognecha | vAstavamA yahI spaSTa ghATA ho |

12 U allAhalAI choDI juna mUrtiharUko upAsanA garcha yadi usale nirmita mUrtiharUko virodha garyo bhane nata usalAI hAni puryAuna sakchan ra unIharUko anusaraNa garyo bhane nata usalAI phAidA dina sakchan | yo vAstavika pathabhraSTatA ho juna satyatAbATa nikai TADhA cha |

13 tyasa avajJAkArIle jo mUrtiharUko pUjA garcha unIharUsa~ga duA garcha vAstavamA, usako nizcita hAni anupasthita phAidA bhandA nikaTa raheko cha | kati narAmro upAsya ho yo jasako hAni usako phAidAbhandA najika raheko cha | Usa~ga sahayoga cAhane vyaktiko lAgi U dherai narAmro sahayogI ho ra usalAI sAthI banAuneko lAgi U dherai narAmro sAthI ho |

14 vAstavamA, allAhale uhA~mAthi AsthA (ImAna) rAkhne ra satkarma garneharUlAI yastA svargaharUmA praveza garAunuhunecha jasakA mahalaharUkA talatirabATa nadIharU bagirahekA hunechan | allAha je cAhanuhuncha garnuhuncha | jasalAI cAhanuhuncha dayA garnuhuncha ra jasalAI cAhanuhuncha daNDita garnuhuncha | uhA~lAI rokne kohI chaina |

15 allAhale yasa saMsAramA ra AkhiratamA Aphno nabI (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) lAI sahayoga garnuhunechaina bhanI kasaile soMccha bhane usale Aphno gharako kausI vA chatamA euTA rassI bA~dhos ani tyasalAI Aphno ghA~TI pAso lagAera khuTTAle bhUi~mA nachune garI tyasamA jhunDiyos | usako yasa upAyale U bhitrako krodhabATa usalAI bacAuna sakyo ki bhanI usale heros | allAhale avazya nai Aphno nabIlAI sahayoga garnuhunecha yadyapi virodhIharUle cahun vA nacAhun |

16 jasarI hAmIle timIharUko lAgi dosro jIvanako spaSTa pramANaharU prastuta garekAchauM tyasarI nai hAmIle muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) mAthi kurAnakA praSTa AyataharU avataraNa garekAchauM | allAha Aphno kRpAle jasalAI cAhanuhuncha mArgadarzana garnuhuncha ra satya dharmako bATo dekhAunuhuncha |

17 vAstavamA, allAhale yasa ummatakA AsthAvAnaharU, yahUdI, sAbiI (kehI nabIharUkA anuyAyIharU), IsAI, Ago ra mUrtikA upAsakaharUbIca kiyAmatakA dina phaisalA garnuhunecha | AsthAvAnaharUlAI allAhale svargamA praveza garAunuhunecha ra tyasabAheka sampUrNalAI narkamA hAlnuhunecha | vAstavamA, allAha AphnA bhaktaharUkA sampUrNa kurA ra kriyAkalApaharUkA gavAha hunuhuncha | uhA~bATa kehI pani lukeko chaina ra uhA~ tyasai anusAra badalA dinuhunecha |

18 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! ke tapAIMlAI thAhA chaina, AkAzaharUmA basne phariztAharU, pRthvImA basne momina munaSya ra jinnaharUle allAhako AjJApAlana garera uhA~lAI sajdA garchan bhannekurA? sUrya, candramA, AkAzakA tArAharU ra pRthvIkA pahADaharU, rUkhaharU ra caupAyAharU uhA~ko adhimA tathA niyamamA rahera sajdA garchan | kaiyau~ mAnisaharUle AjJAkArI banera uhA~ko sajdA garchan ra kaiyau~le gardainan | tasartha unIharUko yasa kuphrako kAraNale unIharUmAthi allAhako yAtanA anivArya bhaeko cha | jasako kuphrako kAraNale usamAthi allAhale apamAnalAI lekhidinubhaeko cha usalAI kasaile pani sammAnita garna sakdaina | vAstavamA, allAha je cAhanuhuncha garnuhuncha ra uhA~lAI kasaile pani rokna sakdaina |

jaba allAhale uhA~ko anusaraNa garne ra nagarneharUko ullekha garnabhayo tyasapachi yI dubaiko pariNAmako pani ullekha gardai bhannubhayoH
19 yI duI samUhaharU hun jo AphnA pAlanakartAko viSayamA unIharUmadhye ko satyatAmA cha bhanI matabhedamA parekA chan | euTA samUha mominako ra dosro samUha kAphirako | ani kAphiraharUko samUhalAI Agole yasarI ghereko cha jasarI lugAle lagAune mAnchelAI ghereko huncha ra unIharUko TAukobATa atyantai tAto pAnI khanyAinecha |
20 tAto pAnIle gardA unIharUko peTa bhitrakA aGgaharU paglanechan ra unIharUko chAlAsamma pugera tyasalAI pagAlnecha |
21 narkamA unIharUko lAgi phalAmakA ghanaharU hunechan, jasadvArA phariztAharUle unIharUkA TAukAmA hirkAunechan |
22 narkako pIDA sahana nasakera jaba unIharU tyahA~bATa niskana khojnechan unIharUlAI tyahA~ pharkAinecha ra bhaninechaH narkako yAtanAko svAda cAkha |

23 mominaharUko samUha tyo samUha ho, jo allAhamAthi AsthA rAkhdachan ra satkarma garchan | allAhale unIharUlAI yastA svargaharUmA praveza garAunuhunecha jasakA mahalaharU ra rUkhaharUkA talatirabATa nadIharU bagirahekA hunechan | allAhale unIharUlAI sunakA bAlAharU ra motIharUle sajAunuhunecha ra unIharUkA lugA rezamakA hunecha |
24 allAhale unIharUlAI sAMsArika jIvanamA utkRSTa vANIharU jastaiH ‘lA ilAha illallAha, allAhu akabara, alhamdu lillAha’ paDhne zakti pradAna garnuhunecha ra islAmako mArgadarzana garnuhunecha |

25 vAstavamA, allAhalAI inkAraharU, arUlAI islAmamA praveza hunabATa rokneharU ra sulaha hudaibiyAko sAlamA muzrikaharUle gare saraha masjide harAmabATa TADhA rAkhneharUlAI cA~Dai nai hAmI pIDAdAyI yAtanA dinechauM | hAmIle yasa masjidalAI mAnisaharUkA lAgi namAja paDhdA kiblA ani haja ra umrahakA rItiharUmadhye euTA rItiko sthAna banAekAchauM | yasa rItimA makkAbAsIharU ra gaira makkAbAsIharU samAna chan | jo kohI yasa ThAu~mA jAnAjAnI pApa ra anyAya garcha, hAmIle usalAI pIDAdAyI yAtanA dinechauM |

26 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! smaraNa garnuhos, jaba hAmIle ibrAhIma (alaihissalAma) lAI baitullAhako ThAu~ ra tyasakA ajJAta sImAharU dekhAyauM | ani hAmIle unalAI mero upAsanAmA kasailAI pani sAmela (zirka) nagarna, baru mero mAtra upAsanA garna ra mero gharalAI tyahA~ namAja paDhne ra tavApha garneharUkA lAgi dekhine ra nadekhine apavitratAbATa pavitra rAkhna vahI garyauM |

27 hAmIle timIlAI nirmANa garna Adeza dieko yasa gharako haja garna Auna mAnisaharUmA ghoSaNA gara | unIharU timIkahA~ hi~Dera vA lAmo yAtrAkA kAraNa thakita u~TaharUmA durgama kSetra ra TADhAkA ThAu~bATa Aunechan |

28 mAnisaharU pApako kSamAyAcanA, puNya prApti, ekajuTa hunu ra yasa bAheka anya phAidAharUmA sAmela houn | nirdhArita dinaharU; dasauM jil-hijjA ra tyasapachikA tIna dinaharUmA allAhako nAma liera janAvaraharUko kurbAnI gara | uhA~le u~Ta, gAI ra bheDAharUko kurbAnI garne zakti ra avasara dinubhaekomA uhA~lAI dhanyabAda vyakta gara ra yI janAvaraharUbATa khAU ra gariba-gurUvAharUlAI pani khuvAU |

29 ani unIharU hajakA bacekA rItiharUlAI pUrA garUn ani unIharU AphnA kapAla khaurera eharAmako avasthAbATa bAhira Aun ra AphnA naGa kATun ani unIharUkA zarIramA eharAmako avasthAko kAraNale jammA bhaeko mailAlAI saphA pArUn | unIharUle AphUmAthi anivArya garekA haja, umraha vA kurbAnIkA rItiharU pUrA garUn ra purAno ghara (baitullAha) ko tavAphe iphAdA garUn |

30 timIharUlAI juna kurAko Adeza diieko cha; jastai- kapAla khaurera eharAmako avasthAbATa bAhira Aunu, naGa kATnu, phohora mailA saphA garnu, pratijJA pUrA garnu ra baitullAhako tavApha garnu timIharUmAthi anivArya garieko cha | timIharUmAthi anivArya gariekA kurAko mAna rAkha | eharAmako avasthAmA allAhale bacna bhannubhaeko ra uhA~le pratibandha lagAunubhaekA kurAharU nagara | uhA~ko sImAko ullaGghana nahos bhanI tyasako mAna rAkhdai kohI baccha bhane yo usako lAgi yasa saMsAramA ra AkhiratamA pani rAmro hunecha | he mAnisaharU ho! timIharUkA lAgi u~Ta, gAI ra bheDAlAI halAla (vaidha) garieko cha | tinamA timIharUkA lAgi hAmI, bahIrA ra vasIlA jastA janAvaraharU pani harAma chainan | kurAnamA ullekha bhaekAharU mAtrai pratibandhita garnubhaeko cha; jastai- mRta janAvara, ragata Adi | tasartha timIharU mUrti jasto apavitratAbATa baca ra allAhamAthi vA uhA~kA sRSTimAthi jhUTA abhiyoga lagAuna ra hareka prakArakA asatya kurA garnabATa TADhA basa |

31 uhA~lAI khuzI pArne dharmabAheka anya sampUrNa dharmaharUbATa TADhA basa ra uhA~ko upAsanAmA kasailAI pani sAjhedAra nabanAU | jasale allAhako sAjhedAra banAu~cha mAnauM U AkAzabATa khasyo | yA ta carAle usako mAsu ra haDDI nocera laijAne chan yA hAvAle uDAura usalAI TADhA lagera khasAlnecha |

32 allAhale uhA~ko mAtra upAsanA garne, uhA~prati ekAgra rahane, mUrti pUjA tyAgne ra jhUTA kurAharUbATa bacne Adeza dinubhaeko cha | jasale dharmakA cinhaharUko sammAna garcha jasamA kurbAnIkA janAvaraharU ra hajakA rItiharU samAveza chan | tI cinhaharUko sammAna bhaneko hRdayamA tinIharUkA pAlanakartAko bhaya hunuko pramANa ho |

33 timIharUle makkAmA garne kurbAnIko janAvaraharUmA kurbAnI garna kAbAmA laijAne belAsamma nizcita avadhikA lAgi kehI phAidAharU chan; jastai savArI garnu, Una kAtnu, naslako vRddhi garnu ra dUdha prApta garnu ityAdi | yasalAI allAhale damana garne zAsakaharUko kabjAbATa mukta garnubhaeko cha |

34 aghillA hareka samUdAyamA hAmIle allAhako lAgi bhanera kurbAnIko euTA tarikA nirdhArita garyauM, tAki kurbAnIlAI jabaha garnebelA allAhaprati kRtajJatA vyakta gardai uhA~ko nAma uccAraNa garun | allAhale u~Ta, gAI ra bheDA pradAna garnubhaekomA uhA~lAI dhanyabAda garun | he mAnisaharU ho! timIharUko vAstavika upAsya eka mAtra hunuhuncha ra uhA~ko kohI sAjhedAra chaina | tasartha AjJAkArI bhaI namratAkA sAtha kevala uhA~prati samarpita hoU | he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! namra ra samarpitaharUlAI prasanna pArne khabara sunAunuhos |

35 allAhako samjhanA garAu~dA unIharU uhA~ko yAtanAdekhi DarAu~chan, uhA~ko Adeza viparIta kAma garnabATa bacchan, kunai Apata vipata paremA dhairya garchan, pUrNa tarikAle namAja paDhchan ra allAhale pradAna garnubhaeko jIvikAbATa puNyako lAgi kharca garchan |

36 kurbAnIko lAgi baitullAha lagine u~Ta ra gAIvastulAI hAmIle dharmako rIti, pratIka ra nizAnI banAekA chauM | yasamA timIharUkA saMsArakA ra AkhiratakA phAidAharU rahekA chan | tasartha unIharUlAI khuTTA sIdhA pArera bhAgna nadina AgADIko khuTTA bA~dhera ubhyAepachi jabaha garnuaghi (bismillAha) bhana | he kurbAnI garneharU! jabaha garisakepachi jaba unIharU eka tarpha laDchan, tyasapachi unIharUko mAsu khAU | ani mAgne ra namAgne dubai tharikA garibaharUlAI tyasabATa bhAga deU | jasarI hAmIle yI janAvaraharUlAI yAtAyAtakA uddezyakA lAgi prayoga garna ra savArI garna timIharUko adhInamA garekAchauM tyasarI nai hAmIle tinIharUlAI adhInamA garekAchauM jaba timIharU allAhako nikaTa huna tinIharUlAI jabaha garchau | tAki timIharU tI janAvaraharUlAI allAhale timIharUko adhInamA garnubhaekomA uhA~prati dhanyavAda jJApana gara |

37 timIharUle gareko kurbAnIko mAsu ra ragata kadApi allAhasamma pugdaina ra na svayam tyasalAI mAthi uThAincha, baru allAha samakSa ta yasa kurbAnIlAI garnebelA timIharUle apanAune Izabhaya (takvA) mAtra pugcha kinaki timIharU uhA~ko najika hunakA nimti ekAgratAkA sAtha uhA~ko AjJApAlana garchau | tyasaigarI uhA~le janAvaraharUlAI timIharUko adhInamA garnubhayo ra timIharUlAI satyatAko nirdezana dinubhaekomA pariNAma svarUpa timIharU uhA~ko guNagANa garna saka ra uhA~lAI dhanyavAda dina saka | he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! uttama tarikAle Aphno pAlanakartAko upAsanA garneharU ra uhA~kA sRSTiharUsa~ga uttama vyavahAra apanAuneharUlAI prasanna pArne khabara sunAidinuhos |

38 vAstavamA, allAhale uhA~mAthi AsthA rAkhne mominaharUlAI unakA zatrubATa bacAunuhuncha | vAstavamA, allAha kunaipani vizvAsaghAtI ra kRtaghna vyaktilAI mana parAunuhunna | usale allAhalAI dhanyavAda bhandaina baru yaso bhanna mana parAu~daina |

jaba allAhale uhA~ nai mominaharUko rakSA garnuhuncha bhanne kurA spaSTa pArera unIharUko mana santuSTa tulyAunubhayo, tyasapachi unIharUlAI kAphiraharUsa~ga yuddha garne anumati dinubhayo ra bhannubhayoH
39 allAhale mominaharUlAI muzrikaharUsa~ga yuddha garne anumati pradAna garnubhayo kinaki unIharUkA zatrule unIharUmAthi atyAcAra gare | vAstavamA, allAhale yuddha binA nai mominaharUlAI sahayoga garna sakSama hunuhuncha, tara allAhale Aphno tatvadarzitAle kAphiraharUsa~ga yuddha garera mominaharUko parIkSA linubhayo |

40 mominaharUle aparAdha nagare tApani unIharUmAthi atyAcAra gardai kAphiraharUle unIharUlAI AphnA gharaharUbATa bAhira nikAle | unIharUle kevala yati mAtra bhanekA thieH hAmrA pAlanakartA kevala allAha mAtrai hunuhuncha, uhA~ bAheka arU kohI pAlanakartA chaina | yadi allAhale nabIharU ra mominaharUlAI zatrusa~ga yuddha garna anivArya nagarnubhaeko bhae unIharUle upAsanAkA sthAnaharUmA AkramaNa garthe ani sanyAsIharUkA AzramaharU, IsAIharUkA girjAgharaharU, yahUdIharUkA upAsanA gRhaharU ra muslimaharUle namAja paDhne masjidaharU jahA~ muslimaharU adhika mAtrAmA allAhako guNagANa garchan, yI sabailAI pUrNarUpale bhatkAune thie | allAhako dIna (dharma) ra uhA~ko nabIlAI sahayoga garneharUlAI allAhale sahayoga garnuhuncha, kinaki uhA~ko dharmalAI sahayoga garneharUlAI sahayoga garna allAha zaktizAlI hunuhuncha ra kohI pani allAhamAthi vijaya prApta garna sakdaina |

41 jasalAI sahayogako vAcA garieko cha, tI mAnisaharUkA zatruharU viruddha sahayoga garera hAmIle sattA pradAna garyauM bhane unIharUle rAmrosa~ga namAja paDhnechan, jakAta dinechan, zariatale juna kurAko Adeza dieko cha tyasako upadeza dinechan ra juna kAmabATa manAhI gareko cha tyasabATa roknechan | ani puNya prApta garne ra yAtanAsa~ga sambandhita sampUrNa mAmilAharUmA kevala allAhatira pharkera Aunechan |

42 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! yadi tapAIMko samudAyale tapAIMlAI jhUTo Thahara garchan bhane dhairya garnuhos, kinaki rasUlaharUmA tapAIMlAI mAtra jhUTo Thahara garieko chaina; baru tapAIMko samudAyabhandA pahile nai nUhako samudAyale nUhalAI, Ada samudAyale hUdalAI ra samUda samudAyale sAlehalAI jhUTo Thahara garisakekA chan |
43 ibrAhImako samudAyale ibrAhImalAI ra lUtako samudAyale lUtalAI pani jhUTo Thahara garekA thie |

44 madayanabAsIharUle zuaibalAI ra phirauna ra usako samudAyale mUsAlAI jhUTo Thahara garekA thie | unIharUkA samudAyalAI thapa avasara pradAna garnakA lAgi maile unIharUbATa yAtanAlAI sthagita gareM | pherI maile unIharUlAI yAtanA dieM | hernuhos, kasto thiyo unIharUprati hAmro tiraskAra | unIharUko kuphrako kAraNa maile unIharUlAI naSTa pAreM |

45 hAmIle atyAcArI bastIharUlAI yAtanA diera sarvanAza pAryauM | tyahA~kA gharaharU bhatkera ghopTo parekA chan ra mAnisaharUbATa khAlI chan | pAnI piuneharU nabhaekAle inAraharU bekAra chan | aglA ra sajAiekA mahalaharUle tyahA~ basneharUlAI yAtanAbATa jogAuna sakenan |

46 rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) le lyAunubhaeko kurAlAI jhUTo Thahara garneharU dhartImA ghumera herdainan?! unIharUle tI naSTa pAriekA gharaharUkA cinhako avalokana garna saknechan | yasarI unIharU Aphno dimAgako prayogale socna sakchan ra upadeza line uddezyale unIharUko kathAlAI sunna sakchan bhane; kinaki vAstavika andho dekhna nasaknu hoina baru cetanAko andho hunu vinAzakArI andhopana ho | yasto andho vyaktile pATha ra cetanA prApta garna sakdaina |

47 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! tapAIMko samudAyakA kAphiraharU tapAIMsita yasa saMsAramA ra AkhiratamA chiTo prakopa Aos bhanne mAga garchan, jasako cetAvanI unIharUlAI diieko thiyo | allAhale Aphno vAcA pUrA garna pachi haTnuhunechaina | ani unIharUle hatAra garekA sajAyako kehI aMza badrako yuddhamA unIharUmAthi AI pugyo | vAstavamA, AkhiratamA diine eka dinako yAtanA tyasako kaThoratAko kAraNa yasa saMsArakA hajAra varSa barArako hunecha |

48 katipaya yastA atyAcArI nagaraharU chan jasako prakopalAI maile sthagita gareko chu | unIharUlAI yAtanA dina maile hatAra garina | ani tyasapachi maile jaraidekhi sakhApa pArne yAtanA paThAera unIharUlAI sarvanAza gareM | unIharU kiyAmatako dina matira nai pharkera Aunechan ra ma unIharUlAI unIharUko kuphrale gardA sadAko lAgi yAtanA dinechu |
49 bhannuhos– he mAnisaharU! ma ta timIharUko lAgi sacetaka hu~ | malAI je diera paThAieko cha tyasalAI timIharU samakSa puryAu~chu ra mero cetAvanI spaSTa cha |
50 ani allAhamAthi AsthA rAkhne ra satkarma garneharUko pApalAI unIharUko pAlanakartAle kSamA garnuhunecha ra unIharUlAI svargamA kahilyai samApta nahune uttama jIvikA pradAna garnuhunecha |

51 jo hAmrA nizAnIharUlAI jhUTo Thahara garna mehanata garchan ra unIharU allAhalAI zaktihIna garera uhA~ko yAtanAlAI chalna sakSama hunechan bhanI ThAndachan | unIharU narkamA jAnechan ra jasarI duIjanA sAthI sAthamA rahanchan tyasarI nai unIharU narkasa~ga rahanechan |

52 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! tapAIMbhandA pahile hAmIle jati rasUla evam nabI paThAyauM ra jaba unale allAhako kitAbako vAcana garna thAle zaitAnale unako vAcanamA avarodha utpanna garyo ra mAnisaharUle tyo vahI ho bhanera ThAne | tara allAhale zaitAnale avarodha gareko kurAlAI haTAidinuhuncha ra AphnA AyataharUlAI surakSita rAkhnuhuncha | allAhalAI sabai kurAko jJAna cha, uhA~bATa kehI pani lukeko chaina ra uhA~ Aphno sRSTi, yojanA ra prazAsanamA tatvadarzI hunuhuncha |

53 zaitAna nabI (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) ko vAcanamA avarodha utpanna garcha tara allAha tyasa avarodhalAI munAphikaharU ra kaThora hRdaya bhaekA muzrikaharUko lAgi parIkSA banAunuhuncha | vAstavamA, munAphika ra muzrikaharUmadhye atyAcArIharU allAha ra uhA~kA rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) kA zatru hun ra satyatA evam sIdhA mArgabATa dherai TADhA chan |

54 allAhale jasalAI jJAna dinubhaeko cha unIharUle yasa kurAmA vizvAsa garun ki muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) mAthi avatarita kurAna nitAnta satya cha ra allAhale yasalAI rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) mAthi vahI (IzavANI) garnubhaeko cha | yasale gardA allAhamAthi unIharUko vizvAsa baDhcha, unIharUko hRdayaharU uhA~prati samarpita rahanchan ra uhA~sa~ga DarAu~cha | vAstavamA, allAhale AphUmAthi AsthA rAkhneharUlAI nai satya ra sIdhA bAToko mArgadarzana garnuhuncha jasamA kunai TeDhopana hu~daina | yo uhA~ko lAgi unIharUle dekhAeko samarpaNako badalA ho |

55 allAhasa~ga kuphra garne ra rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) lAI jhUTo Thahara garneharU tapAIMmAthi avatarita kurAnabAre zaGkAmA nai rahanechan ra ekkAsI unIharU samakSa kiyAmata Aunecha vA unIharUmAthi yasto prakopa Aunecha jasamA na dayA garinecha na bhalAi hunecha | tyo dina unIharUko lAgi kiyAmata hunecha |

56 kiyAmatako dina zAsana kevala allAhakai hAtamA hunecha | juna dina yinIharU samakSa vAcA garieko yAtanA Aipugnecha, uhA~prati Apatti janAune kohI hunechaina | uhA~le mominaharU ra kAphiraharUbIca phaisalA garnuhunecha | nyAyapUrNa tarikAle pratyekalAI phaisalA garnuhunecha | tasartha jo allAhamAthi AsthA rAkhdachan ra satkarma gardachan unIharUko lAgi mahAn pratidAna arthAta sadAkA lAgi kRpAkA svargaharU rahekA chan |
57 ani allAhasa~ga kuphra garneharU ra uhA~kA rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) mAthi avatarita AyataharUlAI jhUTo Thahara garneharUkA lAgi narkamA apamAnajanaka yAtanA raheko cha |

58 jasale allAhako prasannatA prAptiko lAgi ra uhA~ko dharmako samarthanako lAgi AphnA gharabAra ra mAtRbhUmi tyAge ani yuddhamA mArie vA unIharUko prAkRtika mRtyu bhayo; allAhale unIharUlAI svargamA uttama ra sadA rahane jIvikA pradAna garnuhunecha | vAstavamA, allAha nai pavitra hunuhuncha ra uhA~ sarvazreSTha jIvikA pradAna garnuhuncha |

59 allAhale unIharUlAI yasto ThAu~mA praveza garAunuhunecha jasabATa unIharU santuSTa hunechan ra tyo svarga ho | vAstavamA, allAha unIharUkA karma ra niyatabATa avagata hunuhuncha ra uhA~ kSamAzIla hunuhuncha, kinaki uhA~le unIharUkA galtIko kAraNale yAtanA dina hatAra garnubhaeko chaina |

60 allAhako mArgamA hijrata (basAi~-sarAI) garneharUlAI svargamA praveza garAinecha ra unIharUlAI jati satAieko thiyo tyati mAtrAmA nai unIharUlAI badalA line anumati cha ra yasamA unIharUlAI pApa nalAgne kurA ullekha bhaisakeko cha | yadi satAunele Aphno yAtanA dohoryAu~cha bhane allAha satAiekAharUlAI sahayoga garnuhunecha | vAstavamA, allAhale mominaharUkA pApalAI avazya kSamA garnuhunecha |

61 satAiekAharUkA lAgi yo allAhako maddata ho, kinaki allAha je cAhanuhuncha tyo garna sakSama hunuhuncha | rAtalAI dinamA ra dinalAI rAtamA, ekalAI lAmo ra dosrolAI choTo banAI praveza garAunu uhA~ko zaktiko udAharaNa ho | vAstavamA, allAhale AphnA bhaktaharUkA kurAharU sunnuhuncha ra unIharUkA karmaharUlAI jAnnuhuncha | uhA~bATa kehI pani lukeko chaina ra tyasai anusAra unIharUlAI badalA dinuhunecha |

62 allAhale rAtalAI dinamA ra dinalAI rAtamA praveza garAunuhuncha bhanne kurAko ullekha bhaisakeko cha | vAstavamA, allAha satya hunuhuncha, uhA~ko dharma satya ho, uhA~ko vAdA ra mominaharUko lAgi uhA~ko sahayoga pani nitAnta satya ho | ani muzrikaharU allAhalAI choDI juna pUjyaharUko upAsanA garchan, tyo nitAnta asatya evam nirAdhAra ho | allAha Aphno vyaktitva, zakti ra prabhutvamA uhA~kA sRSTibhandA atyantai mahAn hunuhuncha | sabai kisimakA mahAnatA, varcasva ra prabhutva uhA~kai lAgi yogya chan |

63 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! allAhale AkAzabATa varSA garAunuhuncha ra yasa kAraNale virUvAharU palAera bhUmi hariyo bhaeko tapAIMle dekhnubhaena | nissandeha, allAha AphnA bhaktaharUkA lAgi komala hunuhuncha kinaki uhA~le unIharUko lAgi varSA garAunu bhayo ra tyasako mAdhyamale dhartImA virUvA palAyo | uhA~lAI sabaiko lAbhako jJAna cha ra uhA~bATa kehI pani lukeko chaina |

64 AkAzaharU ra pRthvIkA bhaekA sampUrNa cIjaharUko mAlika allAha nai hunuhuncha | vAstavamA, allAha nispRha hunuhuncha ra uhA~lAI AphnA sRSTiharUmadhye kasaiko AvazyakatA chaina | tasartha uhA~ hareka avasthAmA prazaMsanIya hunuhuncha |

65 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! ke tapAIMle dekhnuhunna- allAhale tapAIM ra mAnisaharUkA phAidA ra AvazyakatA pUrA garnakA lAgi yasa dhartImA janAvaraharU ra nirjiva vastuharUlAI adhInamA garnubhaeko cha | ani timIharUko lAgi DuGgAlAI adhInamA garnubhaeko cha, juna uhA~kai AdezabATa samudramA calcha ra timIharUlAI eka ThAu~bATa arko ThAu~ jAnako nimti sahaja banAunubhaeko cha | uhA~le AkAzalAI khasnabATa thAmera rAkhnubhaeko cha | yadi uhA~le AkAzalAI khasne Adeza dinubhayo bhane mAtra khasnecha | vAstavamA, allAha mAnisaharUprati snehI ra dayAlu hunuhuncha kinaki unIharU atyAcArI hu~dA hu~dai pani uhA~le yI kurAharUlAI adhInamA garnubhaeko cha |

66 timIharUko astitva nai nabhaeko belA allAhale timIharUlAI sRSTi garera jIvana pradAna garnubhayo | ani timIharUko avadhi samApta bhaepachi timIharUlAI mRtyu dinuhunecha | timIharUko mRtyupazcAta pherI timIharUko karmako hisAba linakA nimti timIharUlAI punaH jIvita pArnuhunecha ra karma anusAra nai timIharUlAI badalA dinuhunecha | vAstavamA, allAhakA anugrahaharU spaSTa hu~dA hu~dai pani mAnisaharU arUko upAsanA garI allAhakA anugrahaharUprati kRtaghna chan |

67 hAmIle hareka samudAyakA lAgi zarIata (vidhAna) nirdhAraNa garekAchauM ra unIharUle Aphno zarIata anusAra nai karma garchan | he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! muzrikaharU ra anya dharmakA mAnneharU tapAIMsita tapAIMko zarIatako viSayamA vivAda nagarUn | vAstavamA, tapAIM satyavAn hunuhuncha | mAnisaharUlAI allAhako tauhIda (ekatva) tira AhvAna garnuhos | vAstavamA, tapAIM ekadamai sIdhA mArgamA hunuhuncha, jasamA kunai kisimako TeDhopana chainan |

68 pramANa dekhAisakepachi pani yadi yinIharU tapAIMsita vivAda garna cAhanchan bhane yinIharUko mAmilAlAI allAhako hAtamA choDnuhos ra cetAvanI diMdai bhannuhos– allAha timIharUkA kriyAkalApalAI rAmrarI jAnnuhuncha | timIharUkA kriyAkalApako sAno aMza pani allAhabATa lukeko chaina ra tyasa anusAra nai timIharUlAI badalA dinuhunecha |
69 allAhale AphnA momina ra kAphira bhaktaharUbIca kiyAmatako dina unIharUle dharmako bAremA garne garekA matabhedalAI nirNaya garnuhunecha |

70 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! ke AkAzamA ra pRthvImA rahekA sampUrNa kurAharUko jJAna allAhalAI cha bhanne kurA tapAIMlAI thAhA chaina | allAhabATa tyahA~kA kunai pani kurA lukeko chaina | vAstavamA, yo jJAna lauhe mahaphUja (surakSita pATI) mA ullekha cha ra yI sampUrNa jJAna allAhako nimti sahaja raheko cha |

71 muzrikaharU allAhalAI choDera juna mUrtiharUkA upAsanA garchan, tinIharUko upAsanAko pramANa allAhale Aphno kitAbaharUmA ullekha garnubhaeko chaina ra unIharUsa~ga yasa viSayamA kunai pramANa pani chaina | unIharUko pramANa bhaneko purkhAharUko Andho anusaraNa ho | yI atyAcArIharUlAI allAhako yAtanAbATa bacAune kohI pani sahayogI hunechaina |

72 jaba yinIharUlAI hAmro kurAnakA AyataharU spaSTa rUpamA paDhera sunAincha, taba kAphira (anAsthAvAn) harUko anuhAramA tyo vAcana sunna nacAheko cinha spaSTarUpamA tapAIM dekhnuhuncha | mAnauM hAmrA AyataharU sunAuneharUmAthi yinIharUle krodhale AkramaNa garnechan | he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! bhannuhos– timIharUko krodha ra anuhAra bigArnubhandA narAmro kurA ke ho bhanI ma sUcanA diu~? tyo narkako Ago ho jasamA praveza garAune vAcA allAhale kAphiraharUsa~ga garnubhaeko cha | kati narAmro ThAu~ ho tyo, jahA~ yinIharU pugnechan |

74 allAhasa~gai uhA~kA kehI sRSTiharUko upAsanA garI unIharUle allAhalAI garine vAstAvika sammAna garenan | vAstavamA, allAha dherai zaktizAlI hunuhuncha | uhA~ko zaktiko pratIka bhaneko uhA~le AkAzaharU tathA pRthvI ra yI duIbIca rahekA sampUrNa cIjaharUko sRSTi garnu ho | allAha prabhutvazAlI hunuhuncha ra uhA~lAI kasaile pani parAjita garna sakdaina | muzrikaharUkA mUrtiharU saraha hoina, kinaki unIharU kamajora evam zaktihIna chan ra unIharUle kehI pani sRSTi garekA chainan |

75 allAhale phariztAharU madhyebATa rasUlaharU cayana garnubhaeko cha ra tyasarI nai mAnisaharU madhyebATa pani | uhA~ kehI phariztAharUlAI nabIharUtira paThAunuhuncha jastai jibrIla (alaihissalAma) lAI mAnavaharU madhyekA rasUlaharUtira paThAunuhuncha | ani mAnava rasUlaharUlAI mAnisaharUtira paThAunuhuncha | vAstavamA, muzrikaharUle rasUlaharUko viSayamA bhanne kurAharU allAha sunnuhuncha ra uhA~ rAmrarI herera Aphno rasUla cunnuhuncha |

76 allAha AphnA mAnava ra phariztA rasUlaharUlAI sRSTi garnubhandA agADiko avasthA ra mRtyu pazcAtako avasthAko sarvajJAtA hunuhuncha | kiyAmatako dina sampUrNa mAmilAharU uhA~tarphai pharkera jAnechan | tyasadina uhA~le AphnA bhaktaharUkA kriyAkalApako badalA dina unIharUlAI pherI jIvita pArnuhunecha |

77 he AsthAvAnaharU ho! mAtra allAhako lAgi Aphno namAjamA rUkU ra sajdA gara | ani dAna dinu ra nAtA joDnu jastA bhalAikA kAmaharU gara | tAki timIharUle cAhekA kurAharU pAuna saka ra Dara dekhAiekA kurAharUbATa bacna saka |

78 kevala allAhako prasannatA prAptiko lAgi uhA~ko mArgamA jihAda gara | uhA~le timIharUlAI cayana garnubhaeko cha, timIharUko dharmalAI zAntipUrNa banAunubhaeko cha ani kaSTa ra ativAdabATa mukta rAkhnubhaeko cha | yahI zAntipUrNa samudAya tapAIMko purkhA ibrAhIma (alaihissalAma) ko samudAya ho | allAhale aghillA kitAbaharU ra kurAnamA timIharUko nAma muslima rAkhnubhaeko cha | pariNAma svarUpa rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) le timIharU samakSa sandeza puryAunubhaeko cha bhanI timIharUko sAkSI banun | ani aghillA samudAya samakSa unIharUkA rasUlaharUle sandeza puryAunubhaeko cha bhanI timIharU sAkSI bana | uttama tarIkAle namAja paDhera, Aphno sampattibATa jakAta diera, allAhako zaraNa liera ra AphnA mAmilAharUmA uhA~kai sahArA liera uhA~lAI dhanyavAda deU | uhA~sa~ga surakSAko AzA rAkhne mominaharUlAI uhA~le uttama surakSA pradAna garnuhuncha ra uhA~sa~ga sahayoga mAgneharUkA lAgi uhA~ uttama sahayogI hunuhuncha | uhA~mAthi vizvAsa gara, uhA~le surakSA pradAna garnuhunecha ra uhA~sa~ga sahayoga mAga, uhA~le sahayoga garnuhunecha |
1 allAhamAthi AsthA rAkhne (momina) ra zarIata (vidhAna) ko anusaraNa garneharUle cAheko kurA pAuna ra DarAeko kurAbATa bacna saphala bhaekA chan |
2 yinIharU AphnA namAjamA vinamratA apanAu~chan | yinIharU yatAutA harkata gardainan ra yinIharUkA hRdaya hareka prakArakA cintAbATa mukta hunchan |
3 yinIharU asatya ra galata kurAharUbATa svayaMlAI TADhA rAkhdachan |
4 yinIharUle AphnA sampattibATa jakAta diera ra AphUlAI durAcArabATa bacAera pavitra rAkhdachan |
5 yinIharUle AphnA guptAGgalAI vyabhicAra, samaliGagI ra anya anaitikatAbATa surakSita rAkhchan | yinIharU caritravAna ra pavitra chan |
6 yinIharUkA AphnA patnI ra Aphno adhInamA harekA dAsI bAheka anya kasaisa~ga anaitika sambandha rAkhdainan, kinaki unIharUsa~ga sambandha rAkhdA yinIharU nindanIya hu~dainan |

7 jasale AphnA patnIharU ra Aphno adhInamA rahekA dAsIharUbAheka anyasa~ga sambandha rAkhne AkAMkSA rAkhcha usale allAhale nirdhAraNa garnubhaeko sImA ullaGghana gardacha | kinabhane usale allAhale vaidha gareko kAryabATa haTera avaidhako cAhanA gardacha |
8 yinIharU allAhale pradAna garnubhaeko nAso, uhA~kA bhaktaharUko nAso ra AphnA vAcAharUko pAlanA garchan, dhokA didainan |
9 yinIharUle nirdhArita samayamA namAjalAI tyasakA arkAna (AdhAraharU), vAjibAta (anivAryatAharU) ra mustahabAta (jAyaja) kAryaharUsameta nirantara rUpamA paDhchan ra yasalAIko surakSA garchan |
10 yI guNaharU bhaekAharU nai uttarAdhikArI hun |
