11 yinIharU svargako ucca sthAna (phirdausa) kA uttarAdhikArI hun, jo tyahA~ sadAkA lAgi rahanechan ra tyahA~kA anugrahaharU kahilyai samApta hunechaina |
12 hAmIle pahilo manuSya; sampUrNa mAnava jAtikA pitA AdamalAI mATodvArA sRSTi garyauM | tyo pRthvIko mATo sahita tyasamA misieko pAnIko sArabATa liieko thiyo |
13 ani hAmIle usako pi~DhIko sRSTi vIryabATa garyauM, juna janma nahuJjela usako AmAko garbhamA rahancha |

14 ani vIrya garbhamA basisakepachi tyasalAI euTA ragatako Dhikko banAyauM | ani tyasa ragatako DhikkolAI capAieko vastu saraha mAsuko Dallo banAyauM | ani tyasa mAsuko DallolAI kaDA haDDI banAyauM | ani tyasa haDDImA hAmIle mAsu caDhAyauM | ani tyasamA AtmA (prANa) hAlera tyasalAI euTA chuTTai sRSTi banAyauM ra tyasalAI jIvita pAryauM | tasartha pavitra allAha sarvottama sRSTikartA hunuhuncha |
15 he mAnisaharU! yI caraNaharU pAra garera timiharUko avadhi samApta huncha ani timIharUle marnuparnecha |
16 mRtyupazcAta kiyAmatako dina timIharUko hisAba linakA nimti timIharUlAI cihAnabATa uThAinecha |
17 he mAnisaharU! hAmIle timIharUmAthi sAtavaTA AkAzaharU ekamAthi arko garI banAyauM | nata hAmI hAmrA sRSTiharUlAI bevAstA garekAchauM nata birsekAchauM |

18 AvazyakatA anusAra hAmI AkAzabATa varSA garAu~chauM | na kSati hunegarI dherai varSA garAu~chauM na aparyApata hunegarI thorai varSA garAu~chauM | mAnisaharU ra janAvaraharU tyasabATa phAidA uThAun bhanI hAmIle tyasalAI dhartImA rokera rAkhyauM | tara kasaile pani phAidA uThAuna nasakne garI tyasalAI samApta pArne hAmI kSamatA rAkhchauM |

19 ani hAmIle tyasa pAnIle khajUra ra aGgurakA bagaiMcAharU umAryauM | tyasamA timIharUkA lAgi vibhinna prakAra ra raGgakA phalaphUlaharU rahekA chan; jastai- anjIra, anAra ra syAu | timIharU yI phalaphUlaharU khAne garchau |
20 ani tyasa pAnIbATa hAmIle sainA parvatIya kSetramA umrane jaitunako rUkha umAryauM | jaitUnabATa tela nikAlincha juna zarIramA dalna ra khAnAko lAgi prayoga garna sakincha |

21 he mAnisaharU! caupAyA (u~Ta, gAI ra bAkhrA) harUmA allAhako zaktiko pramANa ra timIharUprati uhA~ko udAratAko nizAnI cha | yI caupAyAharUkA peTamA raheko zuddha dUdha timIharUlAI piuna dinchauM | yo dUdha piuneharUkA lAgi svAdiSTa huncha | tI caupAyAharUmA timIharUkA lAgi anekauM suvidhAharU rahekA chan jasabATa timIharU phAidA uThAu~chau; jastai- yAtAyAta, Una, chAlA ra rauM Adi | ani timIharU tinakA mAsu pani khAnchau |
22 timIharU thalako yAtrA caupAyAharUmadhye u~Ta caDhI ra jalako yAtrA jahAja caDhI garne garchau |

23 hAmIle nUha (alaihissalAma) lAI unako samudAyatira unIharUlAI allAhatarpha AhvAna garna paThAyauM | nUhale unIharUlAI bhaneH he mero samudAya! kevala allAhako upAsanA gara | uhA~ bAheka timIharUko kohI vAstavika upAsya chaina | ke allAhakA AdezaharUlAI mAnera ra uhA~le manAhI garnubhaekA kurAharUbATa bacera timIharU allAhasa~ga DarAu~dainau?

24 allAhalAI inkAra garekA unako samudAyakA aguvAharUle AphnA anuyAyIharU ra Ama janatAlAI bhaneH jasalAI timIharUle rasUla ThAnekA chau tyo timIharU saraha nai euTA mAnava ho | U zaktizAlI, timIharUko netA ra aguvA banna cAhancha | yadi allAhale hAmItira rasUla paThAuna cAhanubhaeko bhae phariztAharU madhyebATa paThAunu hunethiyo, mAnava hoina | usale dAbI gare jasto kurA hAmIle pahilekA pUrvajaharUbATa sunekA chainauM |
25 yo pAgala vyakti ho | usale bhanekA kurAharUko bAremA U svayaMlAI thAhA chaina | usako avasthA sabai samakSa spaSTa nabhaesamma usako bAremA pratIkSA gara |
26 nUha (alaihissalAma) le bhaneH he merA pAlanakartA! malAI inkAra gare jhUTo bhaneko kAraNa unIharUsa~ga badalA liI unIharUko virUddha mero sahAyatA garnuhos |

27 hAmIle nUha (alaihissalAma) lAI hAmro nirdezana ra nigarAnImA euTA DuGgA banAuna vahI garyauM | unIharUlAI naSTa garne hAmro Adeza Aepachi ra roTI pakAune ThAu~bATa pUrai zaktikA sAtha pAnI bAhira Aepachi sabai prANIharUbATa bhAle pothI (eka-eka joDI) lAI tyasamA rAkha tAki tinIharUkA vaMzaja calirahos | ani Aphno parivAralAI pani tyasamA rAkha tara unIharUlAI hoina jasalAI timro pAlanakartAle naSTa pArne phaisalA garnubhaeko cha; jastai- timrI patnI ra timro chorA | kuphra garne atyAcArIharUlAI choDne ra unIharUlAI naSTa nagarne anurodha nagara | unIharU ta yasa bADhImA Dubera marne nai chan |
28 timI ra timIsa~ga rahekA surakSita mominaharUlAI DhuGgAmA caDhAepachi bhanaH sampUrNa prazaMsA allAhako lAgi jasale hAmIharUlAI kAphiraharUbATa jogAunubhayo ra unIharUlAI naSTa pArnubhayo |
29 ani bhanaH he merA pAlanakartA! malAI dhartIko pavitra sthAnamA orAlnuhos, kinaki tapAIM utkRSTa orAlne hunuhuncha |

30 vAstavamA, nUha (alaihissalAma) ra unakA sAthamA rahekA mominaharUko uddhAra garnu ra kAphiraharUko vinAza garnumA rasUlaharUlAI hAmro sahayoga ra jhUTo Thahara garneharUlAI vinAza garne hAmro zaktiko praSTa pramANa ho | hAmIle nUha (alaihissalAma) lAI unako samudAyatira paThAunu unIharUko parIkSA thiyo, jasale gardA kAphira ra momina bIca ani AjJAkArI ra avajJAkArI bIca pharaka spaSTa hos |
31 nUha (alaihissalAma) ko samudAyako vinAza pazcAta hAmIle arko samudAya sRSTi garyauM |

32 hAmIle unIharUmadhyebATa euTA rasUla paThAyauM jasale unIharUlAI allAhatira AhvAna garthe | unale unIharUlAI bhaneH kevala allAhako upAsanA gara, vAstavamA, uhA~ bAheka kohI timIharUko vAstavika upAsya chaina | ke allAhale manAhI garnubhaekA kurAharUbATa bacera ra uhA~kA AdezaharUlAI mAnera timIharU allAhasa~ga DarAu~dainau?!

33 unako samudAyakA sammAnita vyaktiharU ra aguvAharU jasale allAhalAI nakAre, Akhirata ra tyasakA puNya ra pApakA kurAharUlAI jhUTo Thahara gare ani sAMsArika jIvanamA hAmIle diekA apAra anugrahaharUbATa atyAcArI bhaisakekAharUle AphnA anuyAyIharU ra Ama janatAlAI bhaneH yo timIharU saraha euTA manuSya mAtra ho | yasale pani tyahI khAncha ra piu~cha je timIharU khAnchau ra piu~chau | U timIharUbhandA zreSTha hoina ki timIharUtira rasUla bhaera Aun |

34 yadi timIharU Aphno jastai mAncheko anusaraNa garchau bhane avazya nai ghATA behornechau kinaki timIharUle usako upAsanAbATa kunai phAidA prApta garna sakne chainau ra AphUbhandA kama vizeSatA bhaeko mAncheko anusaraNa garna pugnechau |
35 ke timIharU marera mATo ra saDe-galeko haDDI bhaepachi timIharUlAI cihAnabATa pherI jIvita pArera uThAinecha bhanI AphUlAI rasUla bhannele Dara dekhAu~cha? ke yo kurA vizvasanIya cha?!
36 timIharUko mRtyupazcAta timIharU mATo ra saDe-galeko hADa bhaepachi timIharUlAI pherI jIvita pArera uThAine kurA asambhava raheko cha |

37 yasa saMsArako jIvana bAheka arU kunai jIvana chaina, paralokako jIvana ta cha~dai chaina | hAmImadhyekA jIvitaharU marepachi pherI jIvita hu~dainan | arU mAnisaharU janma linchan ra jIvana vyatita garchan ra hAmI kiyAmatako dina hisAba kitAbako lAgi uThAine chainauM |
38 AphUlAI timIharUko rasUla bhanne ta kevala euTA sAdhAraNa mAnche mAtra ho | yaso bhanera usale allAhamAthi abhiyoga lagAeko cha | tara hAmIle UmAthi vizvAsa garne chainauM |
39 rasUla (alaihissalAma) le bhaneH he merA pAlanakartA! unIharUle malAI jhUTo Thahara gareko kAraNale unIharUsa~ga badalA liera mero samarthana garnuhos |
40 allAhale unalAI javApha dinubhayoH kehI samayapachi timIle lyAeko sandezalAI jhUTo Thahara garneharU jhUTo Thahara gareko kAraNale pachutAune chan |
41 unIharUlAI euTA vinAzakArI garjanale samAtyo kinaki unIharU haThadharmI bhaeko kAraNale yAtanA pAuna yogya thie | jasale unIharUlAI bhagnAvazeSamA pariNata garyo | atyAcArIharUko vinAza hos!
42 ani unIharUko vinAzapazcAta hAmIle anya samudAyaharUko sRjanA garyauM, jastai- lUta, zuaiba ra yUnusa (alaihimussalAma) kA samudAya |
43 jhUTo Thahara garne samudAyaharUmadhye kunai pani samudAyale junasukai sAdhanako prayoga garepani unIharUko lAgi nirdhArita garieko vinAzako samayalAI nata agADi sArna saknechan na pachADi nai |

44 ani hAmIle eka pachi arko garI rasUlaharU paThAyauM | jaba yI samudAyaharUmadhye kunai samudAyamA rasUla Ae tinIharUle unalAI jhUTo Thahara gare | yasakAraNa hAmIle tinIharUlAI eka pachi arko garI naSTa garyauM | mAnisaharUle unIharUko bAremA bhanne kathA bAheka astitva nai bA~kI rahena | tasartha jasale pAlanakartAko tarphabATa paThAiekA rasUlaharUkA sandezalAI jhUTo Thahara garchan, unIharU naSTa houn |

45 ani hAmIle mUsA ra unakA dAI hArUna (alaihimassalAma) lAI hAmrA nauMvaTA nizAnIharUH (lauro, camkine hAta, phaTyAGgrA, jumrA, bhyAgutA, ragata, bADhI, bhokamarI, phalako abhAva) ra spaSTa pramANa sahita paThAyauM |

46 yI dubai janAlAI hAmIle phirauna ra usako samudAyaharUtira paThAyauM, tara unIharUle ghamaNDa gare ra dubai janAmAthi AsthA rAkhenan | ani mAnisaharUmAthi Aphno prabhutva ra anyAyakA kAraNa unIharU ahaGkArI bhae |
47 ani unIharUle bhaneH ke hAmI yI duI janA mAnisaharUmAthi AsthA rAkhauM | yadyapi unIharU hAmI bhandA zreSTha chainan ra unIharUko samudAya (banI isrAIla) hAmIprati AjJAkArI chan?!
48 ta unIharUle yI dubai janAle allAhako tarphabATa lyAekA sandezalAI jhUTo Thahara gare | tasartha unIharU jhUTo Thahara gareko kAraNale Dubera naSTa huna puge |
49 hAmIle mUsA (alaihissalAma) lAI taurAta pradAna garyauM | tAki unako samudAyale mArgadarzana prApta garUn ra tyasai anusAra karma garun |

50 hAmIle maryamakA putra IsA ra unakI AmA maryama (alaihimassalAma) lAI hAmro zaktiko cinha banAyauM | IsA buvA binA nai maryamako garbhamA base | hAmIle dubailAI dhartImA aglo ThAu~mA zaraNa diyauM | hAmIle dubai janAlAI eka svaccha, saphA ra AvAsIya sthAnamA euTA nadIko sAthamA rAkhyauM |

51 he rasUlaharU ho! maile vaidha garekA pavitra khAne kurAharU khAU | zarIata (vidhAna) anusAra satkarma gara | vAstavamA, ma timIharUkA hareka kAryako jJAna rAkhdachu | timIharUkA kunaipani kriyAkalApa mabATa lukeko chaina |

52 he rasUlaharU ho! timIharU sabaiko dharma euTai ho, tyo dharma ho islAma | ma timIharUkA pAlanakartA hu~ ra ma bAheka timIharUko kohI vAstavika pAlanakartA chaina | tasartha merA AdezaharUko anusaraNa garera ra maile avaidha garekA kurAharUbATa bacera mabATa DarAU |

53 ani unIharUpachi dharmako mAmilAmA unakA anuyAyIharU chuTTA chuTTai guTamA vibhAjita bhae | hareka guTa Aphnai AsthAbATa prasanna thiyo, unIharUlAI lAgthyo allAhalAI mana parne pani dharma yahI ho ra unIharUle arUsa~ga ke cha bhanne kurAlAI vAstA gardainathe |
54 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! unIharUmAthi yAtanA avataraNa huJjela unIharUlAI AjJAnatA ra AzcaryatAmA nai Dubirahana dinuhos |

55 56 AphUsa~ga je cha tyasabATai prasanna rahane yI samUhaharUle ke yo socekA chan ki hAmIle saMsAramA pradAna garekA santAna ra sampattiharUlAI unIharUle Aphno rAmro kAmako turUntai pAunu parne badalA ho?! unIharUle so~ceko jasto kadApi hoina | vAstavamA, yo unIharUkA lAgi avasara ra pralobhana ho jasako unIharUlAI AbhASa nai chaina |

55 56 AphUsa~ga je cha tyasabATai prasanna rahane yI samUhaharUle ke yo socekA chan ki hAmIle saMsAramA pradAna garekA santAna ra sampattiharUlAI unIharUle Aphno rAmro kAmako turUntai pAunu parne badalA ho?! unIharUle so~ceko jasto kadApi hoina | vAstavamA, yo unIharUkA lAgi avasara ra pralobhana ho jasako unIharUlAI AbhASa nai chaina |
57 nissanadeha, jo mAnisaharU ImAna ra satkarmakA bAvajuda allAhasa~ga DarAu~chan |
58 ani Aphno pAlanakartAkA kitAbakA AyataharUmA AsthA rAkhdachan |
59 ani Aphno pAlanakartAlAI ekamAtra pUjya mAnchan ra uhA~sa~ga kasailAI pani sAjhedAra banAu~dainan |
60 ani jo satkarma garna saGgharSa garchan, satkarmadvArA allAhako nikaTa hune prayAsa garchan ra kiyAmatako dina katai allAhale hAmrA dAna ra satkarma svIkAra garnuhunna ki bhanI DarAu~chan |
61 yastA mahAn guNaharU bhaekAharU satkarma garna samarpita ra agADi rahanchan | yasakA lAgi unIharU arUbhandA baDhI agrasara rahanchan |

62 hAmI kasailAI pani usale garna nasakne kAmako bhAra didainauM ra hAmIsa~ga euTA yasto kitAba cha jasamA hAmIle sabaikA kriyAkalApaharUlAI surakSita garekAchauM | tyasale binA zaGkA satya kurA garcha | unIharUko satkarmalAI ghaTAera ra pApalAI baDhAera unIharUmAthi atyAcAra garine chaina |

63 baru kAphiraharUkA hRdayaharU satya bolne kitAba (karmapatra) ra unIharUmAthi avatarita kitAbabAre bephikra chan | unIharUle gardai gareko kuphra sa~ga-sa~gai unIharU anya kAmaharUmA pani saGlagna chan |
64 jaba hAmI unIharUmadhye saMsAramA sampanna rahekA vyaktiharUlAI kiyAmatako dina yAtanA dinechauM taba unIharU sahayogako lAgi cicyAunechan |
65 tasartha unIharUlAI allAhako dayAbATa nirAza garnakA nimti bhaninechaH Aja na cicyAU ra sahayoga namAga kinaki timIharUlAI allAhako yAtanAbATa bacAune kohI sahayogI chaina |
66 saMsAramA allAhakA nizAnIharU timIharUlAI paDhera sunAinthyo | tara timIharUle tyasalAI sunepachi tyasalAI mana naparAera AphnA piThyU~ pharkAuthyau |

67 yasto timIharUle AphUlAI pavitra gharako sevaka ThAnI svayaMlAI mAnisaharUbhandA ucca samjhera garyau | vAstavamA, timIharU pavitra gharako sevaka hoinau kinaki yasa gharako sevaka allAhasa~ga DarAuneharU hun | timIharU ta rAtI yasako variparI apazabda prayoga garchau ra yasa gharako sammAna gardainau |

68 allAhale kurAnamA avataraNa garnubhaeko kurAmA AsthA rAkhna ra tyasako anusaraNa garne kurAmA ke yI muzrikaharU dhyAna didainan vA unIharUle tyo kurA prApta gare juna tinIharUkA purkhAle prApta garekA thienan, jasa kAraNale unIharU tyasako viparIta chan ra tyasalAI jhUTo Thahara gare |

69 ke yinIharU muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) lAI cindainan, uhA~lAI allAhale unIharUtarpha rasUla banAera paThAunubhayo, tyasaile uhA~lAI inkAra garchan? vAstavamA, unIharU uhA~lAI rAmrarI cinchan ra uhA~kA satyatA ra imAndArIlAI jAndachan |

70 baru unIharU bhanchan- U ta pAgala ho, nissandeha unIharUle jhUTo boldaichan | jabaki unIharU samakSa uhA~le juna satyatA liera Aunubhaeko cha tyo allAhako tarphabATa ho bhanne kurAmA kunai zaGakA chaina | unIharUmadhye dherai janA satyalAI ghRNA garchan | unIharUle Aphno manamA raheko IrSyAko kAraNa tyasalAI mana parAu~dainan ra Aphnai adharmaprati kaTTara chan |

71 yadi allAhale yinIharUko cAhanA anusAra kArya sampAdana garnubhaeko bhae AkAzaharU ra pRthvI naSTa hune thie ra yinIharU mAmilAharUko pariNAmako viSayamA anabhijJa bhaeko kAraNale tyahA~ basneharU pani naSTa hune thie | baru hAmIle unIharUlAI kurAna pradAna garyauM, jasamA sammAna pani cha ra mahAnatA pani | tara unIharU tyasabATa vimukha bhaekA chan |

72 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! ke tapAIMle allAhatarpha AhvAna garekomA kehI pArizramika mAgnubhaeko cha jasale unIharUlAI AhvAnalAI svIkAra garna rokyo? tapAIMle yaso garnubhaena | tapAIMko pAlanakartAko anugraha ra pratidAna yinIharU ra arUharUle dina sakne pArizramika bhandA ati uttama cha | uhA~ sarvottama pradAnakartA hunuhuncha |
73 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! tapAIM yinIharUlAI ra arUlAI sIdhA bATotarpha AhvAna garnuhuncha, jasamA kunai TeDhopana chaina ra tyo islAmako bATo ho |

74 vAstavamA jo mAnisaharUle paraloka, tyasadina hune hisAba kitAba, sajAya ra pratiphalamA AsthA rAkhdainan | tinIharU islAmako bATobATa TeDho bATotira lAgekA chan ra tyasa TeDho bATole unIharUlAI narkasamma puryAunecha |
75 yadi hAmIle unIharUprati dayA dekhAyauM ra unIharUlAI anikAla ra bhokamarIbATa mukta garyauM bhane pani unIharU satyatAlAI chADI Aphnai pathabhraSTatAmA almaliera tyasaimA lAgirahane chan |

76 ani hAmIle tinIharUlAI sabai kisimakA vipattiharUdvArA jA~cyauM, tara tinIharU AphnA pAlanakartAko lAgi namra ra samarpita bhaenan | ani tinIharUle vipattiharU AIpardA tyasabATa bacnako lAgi AphnA pAlanakartAsa~ga namra bhaI duA pani garenan |
77 tyasapachi jaba hAmIle kaThora yAtanAko DhokA kholyauM unIharU bacne ra bhalAiko bATobATa nirAza huna puge |

kAna, A~khA ra dimAgabATa lAbha uThAunele prAyaH kiyAmatako inkAra gadaina | allAhale unIharUkA lAgi tayAra pArnubhaeko varadAnaharUko ullekha gardai bhannubhayoH
78 he kiyAmatalAI namAnneharU! timIharU sunna saka bhanI allAhale timIharUko lAgi kAna banAunu bhaeko cha, hernako lAgi A~khA banAunu bhaeko cha ra so~cnako lAgi dila ra dimAga banAunu bhaeko cha; taipani yI sabai anugrahakA lAgi timIharU kamai kRtajJatA vyakta garchau |
79 he mAnisaharU! uhA~le nai timIharUlAI pRthvImA sRSTi garnubhaeko ho | tasartha kiyAmatako dina timIharUlAI hisAba kitAba garna ra badalA dinako lAgi uhA~tira nai pharkAera laginecha |

80 uhA~ bAheka arU kohI pani jIvana pradAna garna sakdaina | ani uhA~ bAheka arU kohI mRtyu dina sakdaina | rAta ra dinako parivartana, andhakAra ra prakAzako prabandha ani lAmo ra choTo avadhiko anumAna lagAune kAma uhA~kai hAtamA cha | ke timIharU sRSTi ra prazAsanamA uhA~ko mAtra zakti cha bhanI mahasusa gardainau?!
81 tara jasto kuphrako kurA unIharUkA purkhAharUle garekA thie, unIharUle pani tyasatai kurA gare |
82 tinIharUle satyalAI inkAra ra bevAstA gardai bhaneH hAmI marera mATo ra galeko haDDI bhaepachi ke hAmIlAI hisAba kitAbako lAgi pherI jIvita pArinecha ra?!

83 mRtyupazcAta jIvita hune vAcA hAmIsa~ga ra hAmIbhandA pahile hAmrA purkhAharUsa~ga pani garieko thiyo tara hAmIle tyo vAcA pUrA bhaeko dekhekA chainauM | yo ta pahilekA mAnisaharUkA kiMbadantI ra jhUTA kathAharU bAheka kehI hoina |
84 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! kiyAmatalAI nakArne yI kAphiraharUlAI bhannuhos– yadi timIharUsa~ga jJAna cha bhane bhana yo pRthvI ra yasamA bhaekA sabai cIjaharUkA mAlika ko ho?

85 unIharUle bhannechan– yo pRthvI ra yasamA bhaekA sabai cIjaharUkA mAlika allAha hunuhuncha | tasartha unIharUlAI bhannuhos– yasa pRthvI ra yasamA bhaekA sabai cIjaharUkA mAlikale timIharUlAI mRtyupazcAta punaH jIvita pArna sakSama hunuhuncha bhanne kurAlAI timIharU kina bujhdainau?
86 unIharUlAI bhannuhos– sAtavaTA AkAzakA pAlanakartA ko hun ta? ani sabaibhandA mahAn sRSTi siMhAsanako mAlika ko ho?

87 unIharUle bhannechan– sAtavaTA AkAzaharU ra mahAn siMhAsanako mAlika allAha hunuhuncha | tasartha unIharUlAI bhannuhos– allAhako yAtanAbATa bacnako lAgi uhA~kA AdezaharUko anusaraNa garera ra uhA~le manAhI garnubhaekA kurAharUbATa bacera timIharU uhA~ko bhaya rAkhdainau?

88 unIharUlAI bhannuhos– hareka kurAharUko akhtiyAra kasako hAtamA cha? kohI pani uhA~ko akhtiyArabATa umkana sakdaina | uhA~ AphnA bhaktaharUmadhye jasalAI cAhanuhuncha sahayoga garnuhuncha | allAhale kasailAI yAtanA dina cAhanuhuncha bhane kohI tyasa phaisalAlAI parivartana garna sakdaina ra uhA~ko yAtanAbATa bacAuna sakdaina, yadi timIharUlAI yasako jJAna cha bhane?

89 unIharUle bhannechan– hareka kurAharUko akhtiyAra allAhako hAtamA cha | tasartha unIharUlAI bhannuhos– yo svIkAra garepachi pani kina timIharUko buddhi bhraSTa bhayo ra uhA~ bAheka arUko upAsanA garirahekA chau?

90 vAstavikatA unIharUle dAbI gareko jasto hoina | baru hAmI unIharU samakSa satyalAI liera AekAchauM jasamA kunai zaGkA chaina | allAhasa~ga kohI sAjhedAra cha ra uhA~ko chorA cha bhannu ekadamai jhUTo kurA ho | unIharUko dAbIbhandA allAha dherai ucca hunuhuncha |

91 kAphiraharUle soMce jhai~ allAhakA kunai santAna chainan ra uhA~ bAheka arU kohI satya upAsya tathA sAjhedAra pani chaina | yadi uhA~ko sAjhedAra bhaeko bhae hareka upAsyale Aphaile banAeko sRSTilAI Aphaile niyantraNa garne thiyo ra eka-arkAmAthi prabhutva prApta garne thie | ani brahmANDako vyavasthApana dhvasta hunethiyo | tara vAstavamA, yasto kehI bhaeko chaina | tyasa kAraNa kevala allAha satya upAsya hunuhuncha bhanne kurA pramANita huncha | muzrikaharUle lagAeko abhiyogabATa allAha pavitra hunuhuncha |

92 sRSTiharUko lAgi adRzya rahekA sampUrNa kurAko jJAna uhA~lAI cha ani juna kurAharU unIharU dekhchan ra AphnA indriyaharUle jAndachan tyasako jJAna pani uhA~lAI cha | yImadhye kunai pani kurA uhA~bATa lukeko chaina | tasartha uhA~ko kohI sAjhedAra hunai sakdaina |
93 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! bhannuhos– he merA pAlanakartA, yadi yI muzrikaharUlAI diieko yAtanAko dhamkI mero upasthitimA Au~cha bhane |
94 he merA pAlanakartA! yadi mero upasthitimA tapAIMle unIharUlAI yAtanA dinubhayo bhane malAI unIharUmA sAmela nagarnuhos | anyathA unIharUle bhognuparne sajAya maile pani bhognu parne holA |
95 vAstavamA, hAmI tapAIMlAI unIharUkA yAtanAko sAkSI banAune kSamatA rAkhdachauM | hAmIlAI kunai pani kAma garnamA kasaile bAdhya banAuna sakdaina |

96 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! tapAIMsa~ga narAmro garnelAI rAmro tarikAle javApha dinuhos | jastai- unIharUlAI mApha garnuhos ra unIharUko apamAnalAI sahana garnuhos | unIharUle garne zirka, unIharUko jhUTa, tapAIMko viSayamA anucita TikATippaNI, jastai- jAdugara ra pAgala bhaneko pani hAmI rAmrarI jAndachauM |
97 bhannuhos– he mero pAlanakartA! ma zaitAnaharUkA pralobhana ra bahakAubATa tapAIMko zaraNa cAhanchu |
98 he mero pAlanakartA! zaitAnaharU merA kehI mAmilAharUmA mero nikaTa AulAn bhanI tapAIMko zaraNa cAhanchu |

99 jaba yI muzrikaharUmadhye kasaiko mRtyuko samaya Au~cha ra usale AphUlAI marna lAgeko mahasusa garcha taba usale gumAeko umeraprati ra allAhako hakamA gareko galtIprati apasoca gardai bhannechaH he merA pAlanakartA! malAI sAMsArika jIvanamA punaH pharkAi dinuhos |

100 AzA cha, ma pharkepachi satkarma garnechu | kadApi hoina, yo ta usako mukhabATa niskeko kurA mAtra ho | yadi usalAI saMsAramA paThAiyo bhane usale vAcA gareko pUrA garne chaina | yI mRtakaharU kiyAmatako dinasamma saMsAra ra Akhiratako bIca cihAnamA rahanechan | unIharUle gumAeko kurA pAuna ra bigAreko banAunakA lAgi kahile pani saMsAramA pharkane chainan |

101 jaba sUra (narasiGgA) phukna niyukta garieko phariztAle dosro paTaka sUra phukera kiyAmatako ghoSaNA garnechan, taba Akhiratako bhayAvaha avasthAle gardA tinIharUle vaMzako nAmamA ghamaNDa garnechainan | ani Aphnai samasyAmA phaseko hunAle kasaile kasailAI prazna garnechainan |

102 tyasa samaya jasakA puNyako pallA pApako pallAbhandA bhArI hunechan, unIharU nai saphala hunechan kinaki unIharUle cAheko pAunechan ra juna kurAko Darale satAiraheko hunecha tyasabATa bacAinechan |

103 ani jasakA pApako pallAbhandA puNyako pallA halukA hunechan unIharUle nai svayaMlAI hAnI puryAune kAma garera ra ImAna ra satyakarma jastA phAidA puryAune kAmaharUlAI choDera AphUlAI barbAda pAre | yinIharU narkamA sadAkA lAgi rahanechn ra tyahA~bATa umkana saknechainan |
104 Agole unIharUko anuhAra polnecha ra kaThora pIDAko kAraNa unIharUko mAthiko ra talako oTha khumciera dA~ta dekhinechan |
105 unIharUko nindA gardai bhaninechaH ke saMsAramA timIharU samakSa kurAnakA AyataharU pATha garera sunAidainathyo?! tara timIharUle tyasalAI jhUTo Thahara garthyau |
106 unIharUle bhannechan: he hAmrA pAlanakartA! tapAIMlAI thAhA cha, hAmro durbhAgya hAmImAthi chAeko thiyo ra vAstavamA, hAmI satyabATa pathabhraSTa thiyauM |

107 he hAmrA pAlanakartA! hAmIlAI narkabATa mukta garnuhos | yadi hAmIle pherI kuphra ra pathabhraSTatAko bATo apanAyauM bhane hAmIle Aphnai prANamAthi atyAcAra garnechauM ra tyasapachi hAmIsa~ga arU kunai bahAnA bA~kI rahanechaina |
108 allAhale bhannuhunechaH apamAnita bhaera narkamA nai basa ra masa~ga kurA nagara |

109 merA momina bhaktaharUle bhanne garthe– he hAmrA pAlanakartA! hAmIle tapAIMmAthi AsthA rAkhyauM tasartha hAmIharUko pApalAI kSamA garidinuhos ra hAmImAthi dayA garnuhos kinaki tapAIM sarvazreSTha dayAvAn hunuhuncha |

110 tara timIharUle AphnA pAlanakartAsa~ga duA garne tI momina bhaktaharUko majAka uDAyau | unIharUko majAka uDAunamA vyasta bhaekAle timIharUle allAhalAI birsiyau | timIharU unIharUlAI hA~soko pAtra banAune garthyau |
111 allAhako anusaraNa garne ra timIharUbATa bhogeko duHkhako kramamA unIharUle gareko dhairyako badalAmA kiyAmatako dina hAmI unIharUlAI pratidAna svarUpa svarga pradAna garyauM |

jaba unIharUle punaH saMsAramA pharkera jAne ani satkarma garne anurodha garnechan taba uhA~le unIharU lAmo samayasamma tyahA~ baseko kurA ra unIharUle cAheko bhae tyahA~ pazcAttApa garna sakSama thie bhanne kurA yAda garAunu hunecha |
112 uhA~le bhannuhunechaH timIharU dhartImA kati varSa basyau? ani timIharUle tyahA~ kati samaya khera phAlyau?
113 unIharUle bhannechan: hAmI eka dina vA dinako kehI bhAga tyahA~ rahekA thiyauM | dina ra mahinAko gaNanA garneharUsita sodhnuhos |

114 uhA~le bhannuhunechaH timIharU saMsAramA kehI kSaNa mAtra rahekA hau | yadi timIharUlAI tyahA~ko basAiko avadhi thAhA bhaeko bhae allAhako anusaraNamA dhairya garna timIharUlAI sahaja hune thiyo |

115 he mAnisaharU! hAmIle timIharUlAI kunai uddezya binA ramAiloko lAgi sRSTi garekA hauM? janAvaraharU saraha timIharUko hisAba kitAba hunechaina? ke timIharU kiyAmatako dina hisAba kitAba ra badalAko lAgi hAmItarpha pharkera Aune chainau jasto timIharUlAI lAgeko thiyo?!

116 allAha pavitra hunuhuncha, jo mAlika hunuhuncha ra Aphno sRSTimAthi jasarI cAhanuhuncha zAsana garnuhuncha | uhA~ satya upAsya hunuhuncha, uhA~ko vAcA satya cha, uhA~ko kurA satya cha ra uhA~ bAheka kohI upAsanAko adhikAra rAkhdaina | uhA~ siMhAsanako pAlanakartA hunuhuncha, juna sRSTiharUmadhye sabaibhandA mahAn sRSTi ho | jo sabaibhandA mahAn sRSTiko pAlanakartA hunuhuncha uhA~ sampUrNa sRSTiko pani pAlanakartA hunuhuncha |

117 jasale allAha bAheka arUko upAsanA garcha usa~ga kunaipani pramANa chaina (yahI mAmilA allAha bAheka sampUrNa asatya upAsyaharUko ho) | tasartha usakA narAmrA karmaharUko badalA usako pAlanakartAsa~gai cha | uhA~le nai usalAI yAtanA dinuhunecha | kAphiraharUle khojeko pAuna sakdainan ra unIharUle DarAeko kurAbATa mukta huna sakdainan |

118 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! bhannuhos– he merA pAlanakartA, merA pApaharU kSamA garidinuhos ra mamAthi dayA garnuhos | tapAIM pApImAthi dayA garneharUmadhye sabaibhandA zreSTha hunuhuncha ra pApIko pazcAttApa svIkAra garnuhuncha |

1 hAmIle yasa sUrahalAI avataraNa garyauM ra yasamA ullekhita Adeza anusAra hi~Dna anivArya garyauM | yasamA hAmIle praSTa AyataharU avataraNa garekAchauM | tAki timIharU yasakA AdezaharUlAI samjha ra tyasako anusaraNa gara |

2 avivAhitA vyabhicAriNI mahilA ra avivAhita vyabhicArI puruSa, pratyekalAI saya korrA lagAU | yadi timIharU allAha ra Akhiratako dinamAthi AsthA rAkhchau bhane sajAya diMdA dubai pratiko dayAle sajAya dinamA bAdhA napuryAos | jasako kAraNale nata unIharUko sajAya mApha gara na unIharUko sajAyalAI kama gara | sajAya dieko ghaTanA hernakA lAgi mominaharUko euTA samUhako upasthiti hos, tyasa kAryalAI thapa nirUtsAhita garna |

3 vyabhicArako anaitikatAlAI ujAgara gardai allAhale bhannubhaeko chaH jasalAI yasako bAnI baseko cha usale AphUjastai vyabhicAriNI, vyabhicArabATa nabacne vA muzrika mahilAsita mAtra vivAha garna mana parAu~cha | yadyapi muzrika mahilAsa~ga vivAha garne anumati chaina | ani juna mahilAlAI yasako bAnI baseko cha usale AphUjastai vyabhicArI, vyabhicArabATa nabacne puruSa vA muzrika purUSasa~ga vivAha garna mana parAu~che | yadyapi Usa~ga vivAha garna anumati chaina | vyabhicAriNI ra vyabhicArIsa~ga vivAha garna ra garAuna mominaharUko lAgi jAyaja chaina |

4 jasale pavitra AcaraNa bhaekI mahilAharUmAthi (ra unIharU jastai pavitra purUSaharUmAthi) abhiyoga lagAu~chan tara abhiyogalAI siddha garnako lAgi cArajanA sAkSI peza garna sakdainan, he zAsakaharU! tinIharUlAI assI korrA lagAU ra tinIharUko gavAhI kahilyai svIkAra nagara | jasale pavitra mAnisaharUmAthi abhiyoga lagAu~chan tinIharUle nai allAhako anusaraNa tyAgekA chan |

5 tara jasale abhiyoga lagAepachi allAhasa~ga mAphI mAge ra AphnA kriyAkalApaharUlAI sudhAre allAhale unIharUko mAphI ra sAkSI svIkAra garnuhunecha | vAstavamA, allAha AphnA mAphI mAgne bhaktaharUkA lAgi kSamAzIla ra parama dayAlu hunuhuncha |

6 ani AphnA patnIharUmAthi abhiyoga lagAune purUSaharU; jasako abhiyoga satya cha bhanI sAkSI dine svayam unIharU bAheka kohI chaina bhane unIharUle cAra paTaka allAhako kasama khaera AphnA patnIharUmAthi lagAeko vyabhicArIko abhiyoga satya bhaeko kurA siddha garUn |
7 ani pA~cau paTaka kasama khAera usale abhiyoga lagAeko jhUTo bhaeko khaNDamA AphUmAthi dhikkAra hos bhanera abhizApa deos |
8 tyasapachi U vyabhicAriNI bhaeko abhiyogamA sajAya pAune yogya che | tara yadi usale lagAeko abhiyoga jhUTo ho bhanI usale cAra paTaka allAhako kasama khAnche bhane tyasa sajAyabATa jogina sakche |
9 ani pA~cau paTaka kasama khAera usale lagAeko abhiyoga satya bhaeko khaNDamA U allAhako prakopako bhAgedAra hune ullekha garI AphUlAI zApa deos |

10 he mAnisaharU! yadi timIharUmAthi allAhako kRpA ra dayA nabhaeko bhae ani AphnA pazcAtApa garne bhaktaharUkA pazcAtApa svIkAra nagarne bhae timIharUlAI pApa garekole yAtanA dinuhunthyo | uhA~ AphnA kSamA mAgne bhaktaharUko lAgi kSamAzIla ra Aphno prazAsana ra kAnunamA buddhimAna hunuhuncha |

11 he mominaharU! vAstavamA, (AIzA rajiyallAhu anhAmAthi vyabhicArako) abhiyoga lagAuneharU timIharUko euTA samUha ho | unIharUle lagAeko abhiyoga timIharUko lAgi narAmro ho bhanI naThAna | baru yo phAidAjanaka kurA ho ra yasamA mominaharUko lAgi pratidAna ra zuddhIkaraNa ho ra yasamA mominaharUko AmA AIzA (rajiyallAhu anhA) lAI doSamukta garnu ho | unalAI abhiyoga lagAuneharUmA sahabhAgIharUmadhye harekale jhUTo abhiyogako sajAya bhognecha | ani yo abhiyoga lagAuna surU garnelAI sabaibhandA kaThora sajAya raheko cha ra tyo kapaTIharUko aguvA abdullAha bina ubai bina salUka ho |
12 momina purUSa ra mahilAharUle yasto gambhIra abhiyoga sunepachi unIharUkale abhiyoga lagAiekA AphnA momina bhAiharU nirdoSa chan ra yo Aropa spaSTa jhUTo kurA ho bhanI kina bhanenan |

13 abhiyoga lagAuneharUle mominaharUko AmA AIzA (rajiyallAhu anhA) mAthi lagAeko gambhIra abhiyoga satya bhaeko kurA pramANita garnako lAgi cArajanA sAkSIharU kina prastuta garenan? yadi unIharUle Aphno abhiyogalAI satya pramANita garna cArajanA sAkSI prastuta garna sakenan bhane unIharU allAhako Adeza anusAra jhUTA hun | unIharU yo kahilyai pramANita garna sakne chainan |

14 he mAnisaharU! yadi timIharUmAthi allAhako kRpA ra uhA~ko dayA nabhaeko bhae ani uhA~le timIharUlAI yAtanA dina hatAra nagarera timIharUmadhye pazcAttApa garneharUkA lAgi kSamAzIla nahunubhaeko bhae mominaharUko AmAko virUddha jhUTo abhiyogako samAcAra phailAeko kAraNa timIharUmAthi ThUlo prakopa AI parnethyo |

15 jaba timIharUmadhye kehIle arUlAI yo abhiyoga sunAyau ra tyo asatya hu~dA hu~dai pani tyasalAI Aphnai mukhale phailAyau ra timIharUlAI tyasako jJAna nai thiena ani timIharUle tyasalAI gambhIra ThAnenau | vAstavamA, tyo allAhako najaramA dherai gambhIra kurA ho kinaki tyo nirdoSamAthi lagAieko ThUlo abhiyoga ho |

16 timIharUle yo abhiyoga sunepachi yasa apriya kurAko carcA garnu hAmro lAgi ucita chaina, he hAmrA pAlanakartA! tapAIM pavitra hunuhuncha, mominaharUko AmAlAI lagAieko yo abhiyoga gambhIra jhUTa ho bhanI kina bhanenau |
17 yadi timIharU allAhamAthi AsthA rAkhchau bhane nirdoSalAI yasto abhiyoga pherI nalagAuna allAhale timIharUlAI samjhAunu bhaeko cha ra cetAvanI dinubhaeko cha |

18 allAhale timIharUkA lAgi AphnA AdezaharU ra upadezaharU bhaekA AyataharU praSTa pArnuhuncha | allAhale timIharUkA kriyAkalApaharUlAI rAmrarI jAnnuhuncha ra uhA~bATa kehI pani lukeko chaina | tyasa anusAra nai timIharUlAI badalA diinecha | uhA~ Aphno prabandha ra zariyatamA buddhimAna hunuhuncha |

19 vyabhicArako abhiyoga jastA narAmrA kurAharU mominaharU mAjha phiMjAuna khojneharUlAI saMsAramA abhiyogako pIDAdAyaka yAtanA rahekocha ra AkhiratamA unIharUlAI Agoko yAtanA diinecha | allAhalAI unIharUko jhUTa, AphnA bhaktaharUko pariNAma ra unIharUko phAidAko jJAna cha tara timIharUlAI yasako jJAna chaina |

20 he abhiyoga lagAunamA sahabhAgIharU! yadi timIharUmAthi allAhako kRpA, uhA~ko dayA nabhaeko bhae ani timIharUko lAgi uhA~ kSamAzIla evaM dayAvAn nahunubhaeko bhae timIharUlAI yAtanA dina hatAra garnuhune thiyo |

21 he allAhamAthi AsthA rAkhneharU ra uhA~ko dharmako anusaraNa garneharU! asatyalAI sajAunakA nimti zaitAnakA mArgaharUko anusaraNa nagara | jo usakA mArgaharUko anusaraNa gardacha vAstavamA, usale asabhya kAma evaM kurAharU ra dharmamA narAmrA mAnine kurAharUko Adeza dincha | he mominaharU! yadi allAhako kRpA timIharUmAthi nabhaeko bhae pazcAttApa garepani timIharU kahile pani pavitra hune thienau | tara allAha jasalAI cAhanuhuncha usako pazcAttApa svIkAra garI pavitra pArnuhuncha | vAstavamA, allAhale timIharUko kurAharU sunnuhuncha ra kriyAkalApaharUko jJAna rAkhnuhuncha | uhA~bATa kehI pani lukeko chaina ra tyasa anusAra nai timIharUlAI badalA dinuhunecha |

22 dhArmika ra bhautika rUpamA sampanna vyaktiharU AphnA abhAvagrasta nAtedAraharUlAI unIharUle garekA pApako kAraNale unIharUlAI Arthika sahAyatA nadine kasama nakhAun‌, kinaki unIharU gariba chan ra allAhako mArgamA ghara tyAgekAharU hun | baru unIharUlAI mApha garUn | timIharUle mApha gareko kAraNale allAhale timIharUlAI mApha garUn bhanne kurA timIharU cAha~dainauM?! allAha AphnA pazcAttApa garne bhaktaharUlAI kSamA garnuhuncha ra unIharUmAthi dayA garnuhuncha | tasartha uhA~kA bhaktaharUle pani yasalAI AdhAra banAun | yo Ayata abU bakra (rajiyallAhu alaihi) ko viSayamA avataraNa bhaeko ho | mistaha nAmaka sahAbI abhiyoga lagAuneharUmA sahabhAgI bhaekole abU bakra (rajiyallAhu anhu) le unImAthi kharca nagarne kasama khAekA thie |

23 vAstavamA, nirdoSa AsthAvAna mahilAharU jasalAI anaitikatAko viSayamA thAhA chaina ra yo unIharUko dimAgamA kahile pani Au~daina unIharUmAthi abhiyoga lagAuneharU saMsAramA ra AkhiratamA allAhako dayAbATa vancita rahanechan ra unIharUko lAgi AkhiratamA kaThora yAtanA raheko cha |

24 tyo yAtanA unIharUle kiyAmatako dina pAunechan, juna dina unIharUko jibrole unIharUko virUddha unIharUle boleko jhUTako sAkSI dinecha ra unIharUkA hAta khuTTAle unIharUko virUddha unIharUle garekA kAmakA sAkSI dinechan |

25 tyasadina allAhale unIharUlAI nyAyakA sAtha badalA dinuhunecha ra allAha satya hunuhuncha bhanI unIharU jAndachan tasartha uhA~ko tarphabATa prApta sUcanA, pratijJA vA cetAvanI spaSTa satya ho jasamA kunai zaGkA chaina |

26 caritrahIna purUSaharU tathA mahilAharU, duSTa kurAharU ra kAryaharU kevala caritrahInaharUlAI mAtra zobhA dincha | ani pavitratA pavitraharUlAI nai zobhA dincha | yastA pavitra purUSaharU ra mahilAharU caritrahIna purUSaharU ra mahilAharUle lagAekA abhiyogabATa mukta chan | allAha unIharUkA pApalAI kSamA garnuhunecha ra unIharUko lAgi svargako rUpamA rAmro pratidAna raheko cha |

parastrIlAI herdA kAma icchA jAgcha, jo vyabhicArako kAraNa bancha | yasto kAryabATa yasa sUrahako surumA manAhI garieko cha | aba gharamA praveza gardA anumati line Adeza diieko cha tAki parastrImAthi najara naparos | tasartha allAhale bhannubhaeko chaH
27 he allAhamAthi AsthA rAkhneharU ra uhA~ko zarIatakA anuyAyIharU! anya gharaharUmA praveza garnu aghi anumati mAga ani salAma gara | salAma garna ra anumati mAgna yI zabdaharU prayoga garaH assalAmu alaikuma; ke ma Auna sakchu? ekkAsI kasaiko gharamA praveza garnubhandA timIharUlAI anumati line diieko Adeza nai timIharUko lAgi uttama cha | AzA cha, timIlAI Adeza diieko kurAlAI manan garnechau ra tyasako anusaraNa garnechau |

28 yadi tyasa gharamA kohI chaina bhane anumati prApta nahunjela tyahA~ praveza nagara | yadi tyahA~kA mAlikaharU pharkera jAna bhanchan bhane timIharU pharkera jAU ra tyahA~ praveza nagara | allAhako najaramA timIharUko lAgi yahI pavitra raheko cha | timIharUko kriyAkalApalAI allAhale rAmrosa~ga jAnnuhuncha ra uhA~bATa kehI pani lukeko chaina | ani tyasa anusAra nai timIharUlAI badalA diinecha |

29 sArvajanika prayogako lAgi tayAra pAriekA sAjhA gharaharUmA anumati binA praveza garnu nindanIya kArya hoina; jastai- pustakAlayaharU ra bajArakA pasalaharU | timIharUle jAhera garne ra lukAune kriyAkalApaharU ra avasthAharUbATa allAha avagata hunuhuncha ra uhA~bATa kehI pani lukeko chaina | ani uhA~le tyasa anusAra nai timIharUlAI badalA dinuhunecha |

vAstavamA, herAile nai vyabhicAratira DoryAune garcha, tasartha tyasabATa bacnako lAgi allAhale herAilAI niyantrita rAkhne Adeza dinubhaeko cha | uhA~le bhannubhaeko chaH
30 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! momina puruSaharUlAI bhannuhos- unIharUle herna vaidha nabhaekA cIjaharU naherun; jastai- parastrIharU ra guptAGgaharU | ani AphnA guptAGgaharUlAI avaidha tarikAle prayoga nagarna ra prakaTa nagarna bhannuhos | allAhale avaidha garnubhaekolAI nahernu ra guptAGgaharUko rakSA garnu allAhako najaramA unIharUko lAgi baDhI pavitra raheko cha | allAha unIharUko kriyAkalApaharUbATa avagata hunuhuncha ra uhA~bATa kehI pani lukeko chaina | ani tyasa anusAra nai unIharUlAI badalA dinuhunecha |

31 ani momina mahilAharUlAI bhannuhos: herna avaidha gariekA guptAGgaharUtira nahera, vyabhicArabATa TADhA basa ra pardA garera Aphno guptAGgako rakSA gara | parapuruSako agADi Aphai jAhera hune tathA lukAuna namilne lugAharU ra zrRMgAra bAheka anya zrRMgAra pradarzana nagara, AphnA lagAiekA lugAbhandA mAthiko bhAga; jastai- kapAla, anuhAra ra ghA~TI pardA garnako lAgi kunai cyAdara vA oDhanI oDha | ani AphnA bhitrI zrRMgAra kevala AphnA pati, bubA, sasurA, chorAharU, patikA chorAharU, dAjubhAIharU, bhatijAharU, bhAnjAharU, AphnA muslima vA kAphira vizvasanIya mahilAharU, dAsa-dAsIharU, mAtahatamA rahekA kAmecchA nabhaekA purUSaharU vA tyasatA baccAharUko agADi pradarzana gara jo sAno bhaekA kAraNale mahilAharUkA guptAGgaharUbAre anabhijJa chan | pAuju jastA gahanAharU lagAera AphnA khuTTA bajArdai lukekA zrRMgAra pradarzana hune garI nahi~Da | he mominaharU! avaidha herAi ra anya avaidha kArya bhaemA sabaijanA allAha samakSa pazcAttApa gara | AzA cha, timIharUle cAheko saphalatA prApta garna saknechau ra juna kurAko Dara cha tyasabATa bacna saknechau |

avivAhita rahanu vyabhicAra phailinuko kAraNa bhaekole allAhale avivAhitaharUko vivAhamA sahayoga garne Adeza dinubhaeko cha | uhA~le bhannubhaeko chaH
32 he mominaharU! avivAhita tathA ekala puruSaharU ra avivAhita tathA ekala mahilAharUko vivAha garAU | ani momina dAsa-dAsIharUko pani vivAha garAU | yadi unIharU gariba chan bhane allAhale Aphno apAra kRpAbATa unIharUlAI dhanI banAunuhunecha | allAha apAra jIvikAko mAlika hunuhuncha ra kasailAI dhanI banAunAle uhA~mA kehI kamI hu~daina | uhA~ AphnA bhaktaharUko avasthAbAre rAmrosa~ga avagata hunuhuncha |

jaba allAhale mominaharUlAI avivAhita tathA pati patnI nabhaekAharUko vivAha garAune Adeza dinubhayo ta yasako sAthasAthai vivAha garne sAmarthya nabhaeko khaNDamA avivAhitalAI rAmro AcaraNa apanAune Adeza dinubhayo | uhA~le bhannubhaeko chaH
33 gariba bhaeko kAraNale yadi kehI vyaktiharU vivAha garne sAmarthya rAkhdainan bhane allAhale unIharUlAI Aphno apAra kRpAle sampanna nabanAesamma unIharU vyabhicArabATa bacera basun | yadi kehI dAsaharUle AphnA mAlikaharUlAI dhana diera mukta hunako nimti likhita samjhautA garne prastAva peza garchan bhane unIharUkA mAlikaharUle yadi unIharUmA dhana cuktA garne kSamatA ra unIharU dharmako anusaraNa garne dekhchan bhane unIharUkA prastAvalAI svIkAra garUn | ani allAhale dinubhaeko dhanabATa svatantra huna tirne dhanako mAtrAmA kharca garun | dhana prApta garne cAhanAmA AphnI dAsIharUlAI vyabhicArako lAgi bAdhya nabanAU | jasarI abdullAha bina ubaile AphnA duIjanA dAsIharUsa~ga gareko thiyo jaba unIharUle pavitra rahana ra vyabhicArabATa TADhA rahana cAhekA thie | timIharUmadhye kasaile unIharUlAI yasako lAgi bAdhya pArcha bhane unIharUlAI bAdhya pArera garAekA pApaharUlAI allAhale kSamA garnuhunecha, unIharUmAthi dayA garnuhunecha, kinabhane unIharU bAdhya pArie | tara tyasako pApa bAdhya garneharUlAI lAgnecha |

34 he mAnisaharU! hAmIle timIharUkA lAgi spaSTa AyataharU avataraNa garyauM, jasale satya ra asatyamA pharaka chuTyAu~cha | ani timIharUbhandA pahilekA mominaharU ra kAphiraharUko udAharaNa prastuta garyauM | ani timIharUmAthi upadeza avataraNa garyauM, jasabATa Izabhaya rAkhneharU uhA~kA AdezaharUko anusaraNa garera ra pratibandhita kurAharUbATa bacera upadeza linchan |

35 allAha nU AkAzaharU ra pRthvIko prakAza ra mArgadarzana hunuhuncha | mominako hRdayamA uhA~ko prakAzako udAharaNa yasto cha- jhyAla nabhaeko bhittAmA raheko pvAlamA euTA diyo cha ra tyo diyo camkilo pAnasabhitra cha juna pAnasa mAnauM motIsaraha camkilo tArA jastai prajvalita cha | yo diyo jaitUnako tyasato pavitra rUkhabATa balcha jasamA bihAna ra sA~jha kasaile pani ghAma parnabATa chekna sakdaina | jaitunako tela Agole nachoe pani tyo zuddhatAko kAraNale prajvalita dekhincha | Agole choyo bhane kaso holA?! diyoko prakAzamAthi pAnasako prakAza cha | yastai avasthA mominako hRdayako huncha jaba tyasamA mArgadarzanako prakAza prajvalita huncha | allAha AphnA bhaktaharUmadhye jasalAI cAhanuhuncha kurAnako anusaraNalAI sahaja banAunuhuncha | allAha mildo juldo kurAharUko udAharaNa diI bujhAunuhuncha | allAha hareka kurAko jJAna rAkhnuhuncha ra uhA~bATa kehI pani lukeko chaina |

36 tyo diyo AllAhako masjidaharUmA balcha jasalAI ucca ra sammAnita pArne Adeza allAhale dinubhaeko cha | tyahA~ ajAna, kurAnako pATha ra namAjakA sAtha allAhalAI yAda garincha | bihAna ra belukI allAhako prasannatA prAptiko lAgi namAja paDhincha |

37 tyasatA purUSaharU; jasalAI allAhako smaraNabATa, ekAgratAkA sAtha namAja paDhnabATa, jakAta lina yogya bhaekAharUlAI jakAta dinabATa, na kinabecale nata vyApArale bhulAu~cha | unIharU kiyAmatako dinasa~ga DarAu~chan | tyo yasto dina ho juna dina hRdayaharU yAtanAbATa bacne cAhanA ra tyasako DarabIca dodhAramA hunechan ra A~khAharU katA jAne ho bhanI etAutA TalapalAirahekA hunechan |

38 allAhale unIharUkA karmako rAmro pratiphala dinuhunecha bhanI unIharUle yaso gare ra allAhale Aphno kRpAle unIharUko badalAlAI baDhAunuhunecha | allAha jasalAI cAhanuhuncha unIharUko karmako AdhAramA anagintI jIvikA pradAna garnuhunecha, baru uhA~le unIharUle karma gareko bhandA dherai guNA garera dinuhunecha |

39 allAhamAthi AsthA narAkhneharUle AphnA karmaharUko inAma pAune chainan | unIharUkA kAryaharU dhartImA dekhine mRgatRSNA (pAnIko bhrama) jastai hun | tirkhAeko mAnchele tyasalAI dekhepachi tyo pAnI nai ho bhanne ThAncha | U tyasatira hiMDcha tara tyahA~ pugepachi usale pAnI phelA pArdaina | yasarI nai kAphirako so~cAI anusAra usakA karmaharUle usalAI phAidA puryAunechan bhanne ThAncha tara jaba usako mRtyu huncha ra usalAI pherI jIvita pArera uThAincha taba usale kunai inAma pAunechaina, baru usale usako agADi Aphno pAlanakartAlAI dekhnecha | ani uhA~le usako kAryako pUrA badalA dinuhunecha | allAha cA~Dai hisAba linuhuncha |

40 athavA unIharUkA kAryaharUko udAharaNa gahiro samudrako andhakAra jhaiM cha jasalAI chAlale DhAkeko cha, ani tyasa chAlalAI arko chAlale DhAkeko cha | tyasamAthi bATo pattA lagAune tArAharU DhAkine garI bAdala chAeko cha, andhakAramAthi andhakAra chAeko cha | tyasato andhakAramA phaseko mAnche jaba Aphno hAta bAhira nikAlcha usale andhakArako kAraNale Aphno hAta pani dekhna sakdaina | yahI avasthA kAphirako cha | usalAI ajJAnatA, zaGkA ra anyolale DhAkeko cha ra usako hRdayamA mohara lAgeko cha | allAhale jasalAI pathabhraSTatAbATa bacAera mArgadarzana ra Aphno kitAbako jJAna pradAna garnuhunna kasaile pani usalAI mArgadarzana dina saknechaina ra kunai pani kitAbabATa usale jJAna prApta garna saknechaina |

41 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! AkAzaharU ra pRthvImA rahekA sRSTiharUle allAhako prazaMsA garchan ra carAharU hAvAmA pakheTA laharAera uhA~ko prazaMsA gardachan bhanne kurA tapAIMlAI thAhA chaina? sampUrNa sRSTiharUmadhye mAnchele athavA carAle gareko ‘tasbIha’ (allAhako prazaMsA) lAI allAhale rAmrarI jAnnuhuncha | allAha unIharUkA kriyAkalApaharUbATa avagata hunuhuncha ra uhA~bATa kehI pani lukeko chaina |
42 allAha AkAzaharU ra pRthvIkA eka mAtra mAlika hunuhuncha | ani kiyAmatako dina hisAba kitAba ra badalA pAunakA lAgi uhA~tira nai pharkera jAnuparnecha |

43 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! allAhale bAdalaharUlAI calAunuhuncha, tinIharUlAI ApasamA joDnuhuncha ani tinIharUlAI tahamAthi taha banAera rAkhnuhuncha bhanne kurA tapAIMlAI thAhA chaina? tyasapachi tapAIM tyasako bIcabATa pAnI pareko dekhnuhuncha | uhA~ AkAzamA raheko pahADaharU jastai ThUlo dekhine bAklo bAdalabATa DhuGgA jastai kaDA jameko pAnIkA TukrAharU (asinA) barsAunuhuncha | allAhale AphnA bhaktaharUmadhye jasamAthi cAhanuhuncha tyasalAI barsAunu huncha ra jasalAI cAhanuhuncha tyasabATa surakSita rAkhnuhuncha | bAdalako bijulIko camaka yati teja huncha ki dekhne zakti nai laijAlA jasto huncha |

44 allAhale rAta ra dinalAI vaikalpika DhaGgale lAmo ra choTo tathA Aune ra jAne banAunu bhaeko cha | buddhijIviharUkA lAgi yI nizAnIharUmA allAhako zakti ra uhA~ eka hunuhuncha bhanne kurAko pahicAna cha |

45 allAhale dhartImA hi~Dne sampUrNa prANIharUlAI viryadvArA sRSTi garnubhayo | tinIharUmadhye kehI Aphno peTale ghisrinchan; jastai- sarpa | tinIharUmadhye kehI duI khuTTAle hi~Dchan; jastai- mAnche ra carA | tinIharUmadhye kehI cAra khuTTAle hi~Dchan; jastai- gAIvastu | ullekha garekA ra nagarekAharUmadhye allAha je cAhanuhuncha sRSTi garnuhuncha | allAha hareka kurAko sAmarthya rAkhnuhuncha ra uhA~lAI kasaile pani vivaza garna sakdaina |

46 hAmIle muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) mAthi spaSTa ra satmArga dekhAune AyataharU avataraNa garyauM | allAha jasalAI cAhanuhuncha sIdhA mArgako lAgi bATo sahaja banAunuhuncha jasamA kunai TeDhopana chaina | ani tyo bATo usalAI svarga liera jAnecha |

47 kapaTI (munAphika) harU bhanchan- hAmIle allAhamAthi ra rasUlamAthi AsthA rAkhyauM ra hAmIle allAha ra uhA~kA rasUlako anusaraNa garyauM | tara unIharUmadhye euTA samUhale asvIkAra garyo | allAha ra uhA~kA rasUlamAthi AsthA rAkhne ra unIharUko AjJAkArI hune dAbI gare pazcAta allAhako mArgamA ra anya kAraNa yuddha garne viSayamA unIharU allAha ra uhA~ko rasUlako anusaraNa gardainan | allAha ra uhA~ko rasUlako AjJApAlana garna asvIkAra garneharUle dAbI garepani unIharU momina hoinan |

48 jaba yI kapaTIharUlAI unIharUbIca unIharUko vivAdamA rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) le nirNaya garnuhuncha bhanI allAha ra uhA~ko rasUlatarpha bolAincha taba unIharU Aphno kapaTako kAraNa vimukha hunchan |
49 yadi satya unIharUko pakSamA cha ra nirNaya unIharUko Aphnai hitamA cha bhanne unIharUlAI thAhA bhayo bhane unIharU uhA~tarpha AjJAkArI bhaera Aunechan |

50 ke unIharUko hRdayamA roga cha? ke uhA~ rasUla bhaekomA unIharUlAI zaGkA cha? vA allAha ra uhA~kA rasUlale unIharUmAthi atyAcAra garnuhuncha bhanI DarAu~chan? unIharUle bhaneko jasto kadApi hoina | yasako viparIta, yo unIharUko Aphnai roga ho kinaki unIharU uhA~ko nirNayabATa vimukha hunchan ra uhA~prati aTerI chan |

allAha ra uhA~kA rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) ko nirNaya namAnne kapaTIharUko varNanapachi uhA~bATa prasanna mominaharUko avasthA ullekha gardai uhA~le bhannubhaeko chaH
51 jaba mominaharUlAI allAha ra uhA~kA rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) tarpha unIharUbIca nirNaya garnako lAgi bolAincha, taba unIharU bhanchan- hAmIle uhA~ko kurA sunyauM ra uhA~ko Adeza mAnyauM | yastA guNaharU bhaekAharU nai yasa saMsAra ra AkhiratamA saphala hunechan |

52 jasale allAha ra uhA~kA rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) ko anusaraNa garchan, uhA~kA AdezalAI svIkAra garchan, pApako pariNAmabATa DarAu~chan, allAhako Adezako anusaraNa garera ra uhA~le manAhI garnubhaeko kurAbATa bacera uhA~ko yAtanAbATa bacchan, unIharU mAtra saMsAra ra Akhiratako bhalAi prApta garna saphala hunechan |

53 kapaTIharUle Aphno sampUrNa zaktikA sAtha allAhako kasama khAera bhane– yadi tapAIMle jihAdamA jAna AjJA dinubhayo bhane unIharU jihAdamA jAnechan | he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! unIharUlAI bhannuhos: kasama nakhAU | timIharUko jhUTa ra dekhAvaTI anusaraNa pani spaSTa cha | timIharUko kriyAkalApabATa allAha avagata hunuhuncha | timIharUle lukAepani timIharUko kunai pani kriyA uhA~bATa lukeko chaina |

54 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! yI kapaTIharUlAI bhannuhos– bAhirI ra bhitrI rUpamA allAha ra uhA~ko rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) ko anusaraNa gara | yadi timIharU uhA~harUkA AjJApAlanako AdezabATa vimukha hunchau bhane jAnirAkha, rasUlamAthi kevala uhA~lAI sumpieko AhvAnako jimmevArI ho ra timIharUlAI sumpieko AjJApAlana ra uhA~le lyAunubhaeko kurAko anusaraNa garne jimmevArI ho | uhA~le timIharUlAI garne Adeza dinubhaeko kurAlAI garchau ra nagarne Adeza dinubhaeko kurAbATa bacchau bhane timIharU satya mArgadarzana prApta garnechau | rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) lAI praSTa rUpale sandeza puryAune jimmevArI mAtra diieko cha | uhA~mAthi timIharUlAI mArgadarzana dine ra timIharUlAI tyasako lAgi vivaza pArne jimmevArI chaina |

55 timIharUmadhye allAhamAthi AsthA rAkhneharU ra satkarma garneharUsa~ga allAhale zatru virUddha sahayoga garne ra jasarI unIharUbhandA pahilekA mominaharUlAI uttarAdhikArI banAunubhaeko thiyo tyasarI nai unIharUlAI pani uttarAdhikArI banAune bAcA garnubhaeko cha | ani unIharUko lAgi rojnubhaeko islAma dharmalAI prabhAvazAlI ra zreSTha banAune, unIharUko bhayalAI zAntimA parivartana garne vAcA garnubhaeko cha | unIharU kevala mero upAsanA garchan ra kasailAI mero sAjhedAra banAudainan | yI kRpAharU pazcAta jasale kuphra garchan unIharU nai allAhako anusaraNabATa bAhiriekA chan |

56 ekAgratAkA sAtha namAja paDha, Aphno sampattibATa jakAta deU ra rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) le dinubhaeko Adeza mAnera ra uhA~le manAhI garnubhaeko kurAbATa bacera uhA~ko anusaraNa gara | AzA cha, timIharU allAhako dayAko pAtra bannechau |

57 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! allAhalAI inkAra garneharUlAI maile yAtanA dine soMcepachi unIharU umkina sakchan bhanI nasoMcnuhos | kiyAmatako dina unIharUko vAsasthAna narka hunecha | narka kati nikRSTa vAsasthAna cha |

allAhale yasabhandA pahile vayaska svatantra purUSale anumati linuparne prAvadhAna ullekha garnubhaeko thiyo | yahA~ allAhale gaira vayaska dAsa ra svatantra tathA baccAharUle anumati linuparne ullekha gardai bhannubhaeko chaH
58 he allAhamAthi AsthA rAkhneharU ra uhA~ko AdezalAI mAnneharU! timIharUkA dAsa ra dAsI tathA gaira vayaska baccAharU timIharUsita tIna avasthAmA anumati mAgun- phajrako namAjaaghi jaba timIharU sutne posAkalAI parivartana garchauM, juharako namAjako samayamA jaba timIharU kailUlA (ArAma) garnako lAgi lugA pherchau ra IzAkA namAjako samayapachi kinaki yo samaya timIharUko sutne pozAka lagAune ra sAmAnya lugAphATA parivartana garera sutne samaya ho | yI tIna avasthAharU timIharUkA lAgi pardAkA samaya hun | unIharU yI samayamA timIharUko anumati naliesamma timIharUko pAsamA naAun | yasa bAhekakA samayamA unIharUle timIharUko anumati binA timIharUko koThAmA praveza garnu timIharUko lAgi kunai Apattiko kurA chaina ra unIharUko lAgi pani | timIharU sabai ApasamA ekaarkAkA najika Airahanchau | unIharUlAI hareka samaya anumati binA praveza garnabATa rokna sakidaina | jasarI allAhale timIharUlAI anumati line AdezalAI praSTa pArnubhayo tyasarI nai uhA~le timIharUlAI dinubhaeko AdezalAI pramANita garne AyataharUlAI praSTa pArnuhuncha | allAha AphnA bhaktaharUko hitalAI rAmrarI jAnnuhuncha ra tatvadarzItAko AdhAramA Adeza dinuhuncha |

59 jaba baccAharU vayaska hunchan unIharUle hareka samaya gharamA praveza gardA anumati linuparnecha | yasako ullekha vayaskaharUko viSayamA bhaisakeko cha | jasarI allAhale anumati line Adeza spaSTa garnubhaeko cha tyasarI nai allAha timIharUko lAgi AyataharUlAI spaSTa pArnuhuncha | allAha AphnA bhaktaharUko hitalAI rAmrarI jAnnuhuncha ra unIharUlAI Adeza dinamA tatvadarzI hunuhuncha |

60 ani vRddha avasthAko kAraNale mahinAvArI nahune ra garbha dhAraNa garna ayogya mahilAharU jasamA vivAhako AzA marisakeko cha unIharUle chopna anivArya garieko bhitrako zriGgAra jAhera nagarI oDhne ra burkA jastA kehI vastraharU phukAlera rAkhemA kunai Apatti chaina | tara yadi unIharU vastra phukAldainan bhane yo unIharUko lAgi uttama hunecha ra unIharU pavitra hunechin | allAhale timIharUkA kurA sunnuhuncha ra timIharUkA kAryaharU hernehuncha | ani tyasa anusAra nai timIharUlAI badalA dinuhunecha |

61 yadi andhA, apAGga vA birAmIharUle AphnA dAyitvaharUmadhye kehIlAI asakSama bhaekA kAraNale pUrA garenan bhane unIharU pApako bhagedAra hunechainan; jastai- allAhako mArgamA jihAda garnu | he mominaharU ho! yadi timIharU Aphnai gharamA khAnchau jasamA AphnA santAnakA ghara pani parcha bhane yasamA pApa lAgdaina | tyasarI nai AphnA bAbu-bAjeharUkA gharamA, AmA-bajyaiharUkA gharamA, dAjUbhAIharUkA gharamA, didI bahinIharUkA gharamA, kAkAharUkA gharamA, phUpuharUkA gharamA, mAmAharUkA gharamA, sAnImAharUkA gharamA vA mAlI jastA kAmakA lAgi timIharUlAI rekhadekhako nimti sumpiekA gharaharUmA khAnA khAnAle pApa lAgdaina | tyasarI nai sAthIharUlAI khusI tulyAunakA nimti timIharU unIharUko gharamA khAnchau bhane yasamA pApa lAgdaina | tyasarI nai yadi timIharU sa~gai vA eklA eklA khAnchau bhane pani yasamA kunai pApa chaina | yadi timIharU mAthi ullekha gariekA gharaharU vA arU gharaharUmA praveza garchau bhane tyahA~ basneharUlAI assalAmu alaikum bhanI salAma gara | yadi gharamA kohI chainan bhane assalAmu alainA va alA IbAdillAhissAlihIna (hAmImAthi salAmatI hos ra allAhakA asala bhaktaharUmAthi pani) bhanI svayaMlAI salAma gara | yo allAhako tarphabATa nirdhAraNa garieko bhalAi tathA phAidAjanaka abhivAdana ho, kinaki yasale timIharUmAjha prema ra sneha phailAu~cha ra yo pavitratA ho kinaki yasale sunne mAncheko manalAI pavitra banAu~cha | yasto khAlako kurAlAI allAhale yasa sUrahamA spaSTa pArnubhaeko cha | timIharU allAhako AyataharUbATa pATha sikanechau ra tyasako anusaraNa garnechau bhanne AzAle uhA~ tyasalAI spaSTa pArnuhuncha |

jaba allAhale praveza garne belA anumati linuparne ullekha garnubhayo ta tyasapachi uhA~le bAhira jAne belA pani anumati linuparne ullekha gardai bhannubhaeko chaH
62 vAstavamA, AphnA AsthAprati imAndAra tI AsthAvAnaharU hun jo allAhamAthi ra uhA~kA rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) mAthi AsthA rAkhe | jaba unIharU nabI (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) sa~ga muslimaharUko hitako lAgi ekajuTa hunchan, uhA~sa~ga anumati naliesamma unIharU tyahA~bATa jA~dainan | he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! jo tapAIMsita jAnako lAgi anumati mAgchan; vAstavamA, unIharU allAha ra uhA~kA rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) mAthi pUrNa AsthA rAkhchan | tasartha jaba unIharU AphnA kehI vizeSa AvazyakatAko lAgi tapAIMsita anumati linchan, unIharUmadhye jasalAI cAhanuhuncha anumati dinuhos ra unIharUko pApako lAgi kSamA mAgnuhos | vAstavamA, allAhale AphnA bhaktaharUmadhye pazcAttApa garneharUlAI kSamA dinuhuncha ra unIharUmAthi dayA garnuhuncha |

63 he mominaharU ho! rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) ko sammAna gara ra uhA~ (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) lAI bolAu~dA uhA~ko nAma liera nabolAU; jastai- he muhammada vA uhA~ko bubAko nAmale; jastai- he abdullAhako chorA bhanera nabolAU | jasarI timIharU eka arkAlAI bolAuchau | baru uhA~lAI he allAhakA rasUla vA he allAhakA nabI bhanera bolAU | yadi uhA~ timIharUlAI sArvajanika kurAharUko lAgi bolAunu huncha bhane uhA~le bolAunulAI timIharUle eka arkAlAI sAmAnya kurAharUko lAgi bolAeko jasto naThAna, baru uhA~le bolAu~dA turuntai uttara deU | timIharUmadhye anumati naliI lukera jAneharUlAI allAhale jAnnuhuncha | tasartha allAhakA rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) ko Adezako ullaGghana garneharUle sAvadhAnI apanAun anyathA allAhale unIharUlAI saGkaTa vA parikSAdvArA kaSTa dinuhunecha vA unIharUle sahana nasakne pIDAdAyI yAtanA dinuhunecha |

64 sAvadhAna! vAstavamA, AkAzaharU ra pRthvIkA sampUrNa kurAharUko sRSTi, zAsana ra prazAsana kevala allAhakai hun | he mAnava! timIharUko avasthAko jJAna allAhalAI cha ra uhA~bATa kehI lukeko chaina | mRtyu pazcAta jaba kiyAmatako dina unIharU uhA~tarpha pharkanechan, unIharUle saMsAramA garekA kAmaharUko bAremA uhA~le jAnakArI garAunuhunecha ra allAha hareka kurAko jJAna rAkhnuhuncha | AkAzaharU ra pRthvImA uhA~bATa kehI pani lukeko chaina |

1 uhA~ ucca hunuhuncha ra uhA~ko apAra udAratA cha jasale Aphno bhakta ra rasUla muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) mAthi kurAnalAI satya ra asatya bIca pharaka garne banAera avataraNa garnubhayo | uhA~ manuSya ra jinnAtakA lAgi rasUla hunuhuncha ra unIharUlAI allAhako yAtanAbATa saceta garAunuhuncha |

2 uhA~ nai AkAzaharU ra pRthvIko sRSTikartA hunuhuncha | uhA~le kasailAI putra banAunubhaeko chaina | uhA~ko rAjyasattAmA kohI sAjhedAra chaina | uhA~le sampUrNa cijaharUko sRSTi garnubhayo | ani uhA~le Aphno jJAna ra tatvadarzitAko AdhAramA tinIharUlAI nirdhArita garnubhayo |

3 muzrikaharUle allAhalAI chADI tyastA upAsyaharU banAekA chan jasale sAno vA ThUlo kunai pani vastulAI sRSTi garekA chainan baru svayam unIharU pani sRSTi gariekA hun | allAhale unIharUlAI zUnyabATa sRSTi garnubhayo | unIharU AphUmAthi Aeko saGkaTalAI TArna sakdainan, Aphno kunai phAidA garna sakdainan, jIvitalAI mRtyu dina ra mRtakalAI jIvita pArna pani sakdainan ani mRtaharUlAI cihAnabATa jIvita pArera uThAuna sakdainan |

jaba unIharUle allAhasita sAjhedAra Thahara gareko kurA allAhale smaraNa garAunubhayo tyasako sAthasAthai uhA~ko kitAba ra rasUlako viSayamA unIharUko jhukAu smaraNa garAu~dai bhannubhaeko chaH
4 allAha ra uhA~kA rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) lAI namAnneharUle bhaneH yo kurAna jhUTa ho juna muhammadale racekA hun ra yasalAI allAhaprati sambodhita garekA hun | ani yasalAI racnamA anya vyaktiharUle pani sahayoga garekA chan | hoina, yI kAphiraharUle jhUTo abhiyoga lagAekA hun | vAstavamA, yo kurAna allAhako vANI ho | kunai pani mAnisa ra jinnale kurAna jasto vANI prastuta garna sakdainan |

5 kurAnalAI jhUTo Thahara garneharUle bhaneH kurAna pahilekA mAniharUko kathA ho ra unIharUle lekhekA jhUTaharU hun jasalAI muhammadale nakkala garera utArekA hun | jasako bAcana garera dinako surumA ra antamA unalAI sunAinthyo |

6 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! yI jhUTAharUlAI bhannuhos– allAhale kurAnako avataraNa garnubhaeko ho jo AkAzaharU ra pRthvIkA sampUrNa kurAharUkA jJAtA hunuhuncha ra timIharUle soMce jasto yasalAI racieko hoina | ani uhA~le pazcAttApa garna protsihita gardai bhannubhayoH allAha pazcAttApa garne bhaktaharUlAI kSamA garnuhuncha ra unIharUmAthi dayA garnuhuncha |

7 nabI (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) lAI jhUTo Thahara garne muzrikaharUle bhaneH svayaMlAI allAhako rasUla ThAnnele kina arU mAnisaharU jastai khAnA khAnchan ta? jIvikAko khojimA bajAraharUmA ghumchan | allAhale unIsita kunai phariztA kina paThAunubhaena? jasale unako imAnadArIko puSTi garos ra unalAI sahayoga garos |

8 unako lAgi AkAzabATa khajAnA kina paThAiena vA unako bagaiMcA kina chaina jasabATa unale phalaphUlaharU khAnthe | jasale gardA bajAramA hi~Dne ra jIvikA khojne AvazyakatAbATa U mukta hunethie | atyAcArIharUle bhaneH he mominaharU! timIharUle rasUlako anusaraNa garekA chainauM, vAstavamA, timIharUle euTA pAgalako anusaraNa garekA chau |

9 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! hernus ta, yinIharUle kastA asatya guNaharU tapAIMko lAgi prayoga garchan! unIharUle bhaneH unI jAdugara ho | ani bhaneH unI jAdudvArA grasita chan | ani bhaneH unI pAgala hun | tasartha yasa kAraNale unIharU satyako bATobATa pathabhraSTa bhae |unIharU mArgadarzanako anusaraNa garna sakdainan ra tapAIMko imAnadArItA ra vizvasanIyatAlAI jhUTo Thahara garna saknechainan |

10 allAha atyantai pavitra hunuhuncha, yadi uhA~le cAhanubhayo bhane unIharUle prastAva garekA kurAharUbhandA uttama kurAharU tapAIMlAI dinu hunethiyo | uhA~le saMsAramA tapAIMlAI bagaiMcAharU dinu hunethiyo jasakA mahalaharUkA talatirabATa nadIharU bagiraheko hunethie ra tyasakA rUkhaharUkA phalaphUlaharU tapAIMle khAnu hunthyo ra tapAIMle basobAsa apanAI Ananda prApta garnako nimti mahalaharU banAunu hunethiyo |
11 tara unIharUle satyalAI bujhna ra pramANa khojnako lAgi kurA garenan | baru unIharUle kiyAmatako dinalAI nakAre ra kiyAmatalAI nakArneharUkA lAgi hAmIle Agoko vizAla jvAlA tayAra pArekAchauM |
12 jaba narkale kAphiraharUlAI TADhA dekhi nai narkatira hA~kdai lageko dekhnecha, taba unIharU narkako risale bharieko bhayaGkara umlAi ra vicalita pArne AvAja nikAleko sunnechan |

13 jaba yI kAphiraharUlAI hAtaharU ra ghA~TI sameta janjirale bA~dhera narkako euTA sA~ghuro ThAu~mA phyA~kinecha, taba unIharUle yasa avasthAbATa mukta hune AzAle Aphno vinAzako lAgi prArthanA garnechan |

14 he kAphiraharU! Aja euTA mAtra vinAzako lAgi prArthanA nagara baru dherai vinAzako lAgi prArthanA gara tara timIharUko prArthanA sunine chaina | baru timIharU sadAkA lAgi yasa pIDAdAyaka yAtanAmA rahanechau |

15 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! unIharUlAI bhannuhos– ke timIharUlAI dine bhaneko yAtanA uttama cha vA sadAkA lAgi rahane svarga uttama cha? jasamA kahilyai samApta nahune varadAnaharU chan | kiyAmatako dina AphnA momina bhaktaharUlAI puNya svarUpa svarga pradAna garne ra uhA~ tarpha pharkine vAcA allAhale garnubhaeko cha |

16 yasa svargamA unIharUle cAhekA hareka kurA varadAna svarUpa pAunechan | yo allAhako vAcA ho | uhA~sa~ga DarAune bhaktaharUle yasako cAhanA garchan ra allAhale tyo pradAna garnuhunecha | uhA~le Aphno vAcA kahile pani birsanu hunna |

17 tyo dina jaba allAhale muzrikaharU ra unIharUle upAsanA garne garekA asatya upAsyaharUlAI bhelA pArnuhunecha | tyasapachi allAhale tI asatya upAsyaharUsa~ga unakA bhaktaharUko nindA gardai bhannuhunechaH ke merA bhaktaharUlAI timIharUle Aphno upAsanAko Adeza diera pathabhraSTa pArekA hau vA unIharU Aphai pathabhraSTa bhaekA hun?

18 tI asatya upAsyaharUle bhannechan– he hAmrA pAlanakartA! tapAIM pavitra hunuhuncha, tapAIMko kohI sAjhedAra chaina | hAmI tapAIM bAheka arUlAI sahayogI banAekA thienauM | tasartha hAmI kasarI tapAIMlAI chADI hAmro upAsanA garna AhvAna garna sakchauM?! baru tapAIMle yI muzrikaharUlAI sAMsArika jIvanamA ramAuna dinubhayo ra tapAIMle yinIharUkA pUrvajaharUlAI pani avasara pradAna garnako lAgi sampannatA dinubhayo tara unIharUle tapAIMko samjhanAlAI birse, tapAIMsa~gai arUko upAsanA gare ra unIharU Aphnai durbhAgyale vinAza huna puge |

19 allAhalAI chADI jasako upAsanA timIharU garne garthyau unIharUle timIharUlAI jhUTo Thahara garisakekA chan | timIharUle AphUlAI nata yAtanAbATa jogAuna saknechau nata AphUlAI sahayoga pradAna garna saknechau | he mominaharU! timIharUmadhye jasale allAhako sAjhedAra Thahara garera atyAcAra garnechan | hAmI tinIharUlAI kaThora yAtanAko svAda cakhAunechauM jasto yAtanA aghillo samudAyalAI diekA thiyauM |

jaba muzrikaharUle rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) le khAnA khAnubhaekomA ra bajAramA ghumnubhaekomA Apatti janAe, tyasako khaNDana gardai allAhale bhannubhayoH
20 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! hAmIle tapAIMbhandA pahile paThAekA rasUlaharU pani manuSya thie | unIharU khAnA khAne garthe ra bajAraharUmA ghumne garthe | tapAIM kunai naulo rasUla hunuhunna | he mAnisaharU! hAmIle timIharUlAI dhana-sampatti, nirdhanatA, svAsthya ra birAmI Adi jastA vibhinna avasthAmA rAkhera timIharUlAI eka arkAko lAgi parIkSA banAekAchauM | ke timIharU hAmIle lieko parIkSAmA dhairya dhAraNa garnechau jasale gardA allAhale timIharUlAI timIharUko dhairyako badalAmA puNya pradAna garnuhunecha?! dhairya garne ra nagarnelAI evaM anusaraNa garne ra avajJA garnelAI tapAIMko pAlanakartA jAnnuhuncha |

21 mRtyu pazcAta punaH jIvita hune kurAmA vizvAsa narAkhne ra hAmro prakopabATa naDarAuneharUle bhane− hAmIharUtarpha phariztAharU kina avataraNa gariena jasale muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) saccA hunuhuncha bhanne kurA batAun vA hAmIharUle allAhalAI AphnA A~khAle dekhauM ra uhA~le pani yasa bAremA sUcita garun? tinIharUko ThUlo ghamaNDale tinIharUlAI ImAna lyAunabATa rokeko cha | tinIharUle kuphra ra jyAdatImA sImA nAghekA chan |

22 kAphiraharUle phariztAharUlAI AphnA A~khAle Aphno mRtyuko samayamA, cihAna (cihAnako jIvana) mA, punaH jIvita garine samayamA, hisAba kitAbako lAgi hA~kera laijA~dA ra narkamA hAline samayamA spaSTa dekhnechan | ukta samayaharUmA tinIharUkA lAgi zubha-sUcanA hu~daina | mominaharUlAI zubha-sUcanA diMdai phariztAharUle bhannechan− timIharUkA lAgi narka harAma (avaidha) garieko cha ra allAhako tarphabATa zubha-sUcanA cha |

23 kAphiraharUkA satkarmaharUtarpha tinIharUkA kuphrako kAraNale tI sabailAI radda pArera uDiraheko dhulo jhai~ kAmai nalAgne banAi dinechauM, tyasto dhulo juna jhyAlabATa chiriraheko ghAmamA dekhna sakincha |

24 svargabAsI mominaharU tyasa dina kAphiraharUko tulanAmA ucca sthAna ra uttama avasthAmA hunechan | unIharU ImAna lyAera satkarma gareko kAraNale saMsAramA diu~soko khAnApachi vizrAma gariraheko avasthAmA jhai~ hunechan |

25 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! smaraNa garnuhos tyasa dinalAI jaba AkAza phuTera pAtalo seto bAdala jhai~ bannecha ra bhelA hune sthAna (mahazara) mA phariztAharU dherai saMkhyAmA avataraNa hunechan |
26 tyasa dina pUrNa ra vAstavika sattA-zAsana karuNAmaya allAhakai lAgi hunecha | tyo dina kAphiraharUkA lAgi kaDA hunecha, jabaki mominaharUkA lAgi sahaja hunecha |

27 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! smaraNa garnuhos, tyasa dinalAI jaba atyAcArI tapAIMko anusaraNa nagareko pazcAttApamA Aphnai hAtalAI Toknecha | usale bhannechan– muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) le lyAunubhaeko sandezako anusaraNa gareko bhae ra mukti-mArga avalambana gareko bhae kati jAti hunthyo |
28 usale pazcAttApa gardai bhannecha– ma ta barbAda bhae~ | phalAno kAphiralAI sAthI nabanAeko bhae kati jAti hunthyo!

29 yasa kAphira (avajJAkArI) sAthIle ta malAI tyasa kurAnabATa pathabhraSTa pAryo jo ma samakSa rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) dvArA pugeko thiyo | zaitAnale mAnavalAI dherai dhokA di~do rahecha | jaba sAthImAthi saGkaTa Au~cha taba zaitAna Usa~ga kunai vAstA nagarI suTukka bhAgcha |
30 mahApralayako dina rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) le Aphno samudAyaprati gunAso gardai bhannuhunecha− he allAha! mero samudAyale kurAnalAI tyAgeko thiyo |

31 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! jasarI tapAIMle Aphno samudAyako tarphabATa kaSTa pAunubhayo ra jasarI tinIharUle tapAIMko bATomA bAdhA utpanna gare ThIka tyastai tapAIMbhandA aghikA sandeSTAharUkA lAgi pani hAmIle zatru banAyauM | tI zatruharU unIharUkA samudAyakA aparAdhIharU thie | allAha mArgadarzana ra sahayoga garna paryApta hunuhuncha | uhA~ satyatarpha mArgadarzana garnuhuncha ra zatru viruddha tapAIMko maddata garnuhuncha |

32 kAphiraharU bhanchan− rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) mAthi yo kurAna ekai coTi kina avataraNa gariena? kina thorai thorai avataraNa gariyo? he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! hAmIle tapAIMko hRdayalAI bala puryAuna ra yasalAI kaNTha garna tathA bujhna sajilo hos bhanera yasalAI thorai-thorai garera samayako antarAlakA sAtha avataraNa garekAchauM |
33 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! bahudevavAdIharUle tapAIM samakSa junasukai udAharaNa lyAe pani hAmIle tyasako udAharaNa bhandA sahI javApha ra uttama vyAkhyA batAunechauM |

34 mahApralayako dina anuhArako bala ghisAri~dai narkamA phyA~kineharU nai sabai bhandA nikRSTa sthAnamA rahanechan | kinabhane tinIharUko sthAna narka hunecha | tinIharUle kuphra ra pathabhraSTatAko mArga apanAekole tinIharUko mArga satyabATa ati TADhA cha |
35 hAmIle musA (alaihissalAma) lAI taurAta pradAna garyauM ra hArUna (alaihissalAma) lAI sandeSTA banAera unako sahayogI banAyauM |

36 hAmIle tI duvai janAlAI Adeza diyauM− phirauna ra usako samudAyako pAsamA jAU, tinIharUle hAmro nizAnIlAI jhUTo Thahara garekA chan | duvai janA Adezako pAlanA gardai tinIharUkahA~ puge ra eka allAhamAthi ImAna lyAuna AhvAna gare | tara tinIharU ImAna lyAenan | ani hAmIle tinIharUlAI sarvanAza garyauM |

37 jaba nUha (alaihissalAma) ko samudAyale sabai sandeSTAharUlAI jhUTo Thahara garyo taba hAmIle tinIharUlAI samudramA DubAera naSTa pAryauM | hAmIle tinIharUlAI naSTa pArne kAryalAI yasa kurAko pramANa banAyauM ki hAmI atyAcArIharUlAI pUrNarUpamA naSTa pArne sAmarthya rAkhchauM | mahApralayako dina hAmIle atyAcArIharUkA lAgi kaSTakara yAtanA tayAra pArekAchauM |
38 hAmIle hUda (alaihissalAma) ko samudAya Ada, sAleha (alaihissalAma) ko samudaya samUda, inAra vAlAharU ra yI tInavaTai samudAyako avadhibIca rahekA anya dherai samudAyaharUlAI naSTa pAryauM |

39 vigatamA naSTa pAriekA samudAyaharUko varNana makkAkA kAphiraharUle pATha leun bhanera hAmIle bayAna garekAchauM | tinIharUko kuphra ra zatrutAko kAraNale hAmIle tinIharUlAI pUrNarUpamA naSTa pAryauM |

40 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! tapAIMlAI jhUTo Thahara garneharU vyApArako lAgi sIriyA jA~dA lUta (alaihissalAma) ko samudAyalAI naSTa garieko ThAu~bATa hi~Dne garchan | tara tyasabATa nasihata hAsila gardainan | tinIharUle azlIla kArya gardathe jasale gardA tinIharUlAI DhuGgA barsAera naSTa pAriyo | ke tinIharUle A~khA cimliekA chan ra unIharUko pariNAmalAI dekhdainan? vAstanamA tinIharU mRtyu pazcAta punaH jIvita hune kurAmA vizvAsa rAkhdainan jasamA hisAba kitAba liinecha |

41 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! jaba yI jhUTA Thahara garneharU tapAIMlAI bheTchan taba ThaTTA ra inkAra gardai bhanchan− ke allAhale yahI mAnchelAI hAmIharUtarpha rasUla banAera paThAunubhaeko cha ra?!

42 yadi hAmIharU AphnA devatAharUko pUjAmA aDiga rahenauM bhane yasa vyaktile AphnA pramANa ra tarkaharUdvArA cA~Dai nai tyasabATa vimukha pArnecha | yinIharUle cihAna ra mahApralayako dina yAtanA bhogepachi cA~Dai nai jAnnechan– ko bATo birAera pathabhraSTa bhaeko cha? tinIharU vA muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)?

43 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! tapAIMko vicAramA jasale Aphno icchAlAI upAsya banAu~cha ra tyasako anusaraNa garcha, ke tapAIMle tyasako saMrakSaka banera usalAI ImAnatarpha pherna saknuhuncha ra kuphrabATa rokna saknuhuncha ta?!

44 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! tapAIMko vicAramA tapAIMle jati mAnisaharUlAI eka allAhako bhaktitarpha bolAunu huncha ke adhikAMsale tyasalAI svIkAra garne garI sunchan ra pramANa tathA tarkaharUlAI bujhchan ta?! hoina, baru tinIharU sunne, manan garne ra bujhne mAmilAmA janAvara jastai chan, baru janAvaraharUbhandA pani baDhI bATo birAekA chan |

45 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! ke tapAIMle allAhakA spaSTa sRSTiharUmA vicAra garnubhaena, jastai- jaba uhA~ pRthvImA chAyA~ phailAunuhuncha | uhA~le cAhemA chAyA~lAI rokera rAkhna saknuhunthyo | hAmIle sUryalAI tyasamAthi pramANa banAekAchauM jasale gardA chAyA~ lAmo ra sAno hune garcha |
46 tyasapachi jaba sUrya ucca hu~dai jAncha ta hAmI chAyA~lAI vistArai- vistArai sAno pArdai jAnchauM |

47 allAhale nai rAtalAI timIharUkA lAgi vastra jasto banAunubhayo, jasale timIharU ra vastuharUlAI chopcha | uhA~le nai nindrAlAI timIharUkA lAgi ArAma garne mAdhyama banAunubhayo jasale gardA timIharU parizrama garepachi thakAi mArchau | uhA~le nai dinako samaya banAunubhayo jasamA timIharU kAma kAjako lAgi hi~Dchau |

48 allAhale nai varSAaghi tyasako zubha-sUcanA dinako lAgi hAvA calAunubhayo | varSA bhaktaharUkA lAgi allAhako kRpA ho | hAmIle AkAzabATa pavitra pAnI barsAyauM jasabATa timIharU pavitratA prApta garchau |
49 hAmIle bA~jho bhUmimA bAlinAlI umArna ra hariyAlI banAunako lAgi pAnI barsAyauM | hAmIle sRSTi garekA dherai janAvara ra mAnisaharUlAI khuvAunako lAgi pani pAnI barsAyauM |

50 hAmIle kurAnamA vibhinna khAlakA pramANa ra tarkaharU varNana garekAchauM, tAki mAnisaharUle tyasabATa zikSA grahaNa garun | tara tinIharUmadhye adhikAMsale satyalAI asvIkAra garekole inkAra gare |

51 hAmIle cAhemA hareka gAu~mA tyahA~kA bAsindAharUlAI allAhako prakopabATa DarAunako lAgi rasUla paThAune thiyauM | tara hAmIle yasto cAhenauM | hAmIle muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) lAI sabai saMsAra bAsIharUkA lAgi rasUla banAera paThAyauM |

52 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! kAphiraharUsa~ga namra vyavahAra garne tinIharUko mAga ra tinIharUle peza garekA prastAvabAre tinIharUkA kurA namAnnus | allAhatarpha garne AhvAnako kramamA tinIharUle puryAeko kaSTaprati dhairya garera tathA duHkhalAI sahana garera kurAnadvArA tinIharU viruddha khubai saGgharSa (jihAda) garnuhos |
53 allAhale nai samudramA miTho ra nunilo dubai kisimakA pAnI ekasAtha pravAhita garnubhayo tara duvai kisimakA pAnI eka arkAmA na misiyosa bhanera duvaibIca pardA hAlnubhayo |

54 allAhale nai puruSa ra mahilAko viryako mizraNabATa mAnavako sRSTi garnubhayo ra mAnavabIca ragata (vaMzaja) ra sasurAlIko nAtA banAunubhayo | he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! tapAIMkA pAlanakartA sabai kAryako sAmarthya rAkhnuhuncha | kasaile uhA~lAI vivaza pArna sakdaina | allAhakA sAmarthyaharUmadhye puruSa ra mahilAko viryabATa mAnavako sRSTi garnu ho |

55 kAphiraharU allAhalAI choDera mUrtiharUko pUjA garchan | jabaki tinIharUle mUrtiharUko AjJApAlanale kunai phAidA puryAu~daina ra tinIharUko avajJAle kunai hAni puryAu~daina | kAphiraharU allAhalAI krodhita pArera zaitAnako anusaraNa garchan |

56 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! hAmIle tapAIMlAI ImAna ra satkarma garera AjJApAlana garneharUkA lAgi zubha-sUcaka banAera tathA kuphra ra inkAra garera avajJA garneharUkA lAgi DarAunevAlA banAera paThAekAchauM |

57 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! bhanidinuhos− sandeza puryAune kAmako bApata ma timIharUsita kunai pArizramika mAgdina | kasaile Aphno icchAle allAhako prasannatA prApta garnako lAgi dAna garcha bhane garos |

58 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! sabai mAmilAmA sadhaiM jIvita rahane allAhamAthi bharosA garnuhos | allAhako prazaMsA gardai uhA~ko pavitratAko varNana garnuhos | uhA~ AphnA bhaktaharUkA pApabATa avagata hunuhuncha, uhA~bATa kehI pani lukeko chaina | uhA~le sabailAI karmako badalA dinuhunecha |

59 allAhale 6 dinamA AkAzaharU, pRthvI ra yI duvaibIca rahekA sampUrNa vastuharUko sRSTi garnubhayo | tyasapachi siMhAsanamA Aphno zAna anusAra virAjamAna hunubhayo | uhA~ karuNAmaya hunuhuncha | he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! je mAgnu cha uhA~sa~ga mAgnuhos kinabhane uhA~ sabai kurAsita avagata hunuhuncha | uhA~bATa kehI pani lukeko chaina |

60 jaba kAphiraharUlAI bhanincha− arrahamAna (karuNAmaya allAha) ko lAgi sajdA gara, taba tinIharU bhanchan− arrahamAna bhaneko ke ho bhanne kurA hAmIharUlAI thAhA chaina | tyasaile uhA~ko lAgi sajdA gardina | ke timIharUle Adeza di~daimA hAmIharUle cindai nacineko arrahamAnako sajdA garauM?! sajdAko yasa Adezale tinIharUlAI allAhamAthi ImAnabATa jhana TADhA pAryo |

61 allAha barkatavAlA (kalyANakArI) hunuhuncha, jasale AkAzamA graha ra hiMDirahane tArAharUkA gantavyaharU banAunubhayo | uhA~le AkAzamA prakAzamaya sUrya banAunubhayo | uhA~le nai AkAzamA candramA banAunubhayo jo sUryako prakAzabATa pRthvIlAI prakAzamaya banAu~cha |

62 allAhale nai dina ra rAtalAI ekapachi arko pAlaipAlo AvatajAvata garne banAunubhayo | tAki upadeza garna cAhanele allAhakA yI nizAnIharUbATa upadeza hAsila garera sIdhA mArga pAos vA uhA~kA varadAnaharUprati AbhAra vyakta garos |

jaba allAhale yasa sUrahamA uhA~mAthi ImAna nalyAune ra uhA~ko AjJA namAnne kAphiraharUko varNana garnubhayo tyasapachi uhA~ko AjJA mAnne mominaharUkA guNaharUko varNana gardai bhannubhaeko chaH
63 arrahamAna (karuNAmaya allAha) kA momina bhaktaharU tI hun- jo dhartImA namra cAla calchan | murkhale apazabda boldA ustai javApha didainan | baru salAma bhanera rAmro tarIkAle javApha dinchan |
64 unIharU rAtalAI Aphno pAlanakartAko lAgi sajdA garera ra ubhiera namAja paDhadai bitAu~chan |
65 unIharU allAhasa~ga duA gardai bhanchan− he hAmrA pAlanakartA! hAmIbATa narkako yAtanAlAI TADhA pArnuhos kinabhane kuphrako avasthAmA marneharUlAI sadhaiMko lAgi yasa yAtanAle samAtnecha |
66 nissandeha narkabAsIharUkA lAgi yo ati pIDAdAyI ra narAmro sthAna ho |
67 momina bhaktaharU Aphno dhana kharca gardA nata anAvazyaka garchan, na Avazyaka pareko ThAu~mA kharca garna kanjusyAi~ nai garchan, baru madhyamArgI rahera kharca garchan |

68 momina bhaktaharUle allAha bAheka anya kunai pUjyalAI pukArdainan ani anAhaka kasaiko ko hatyA gardainan | allAhale jasako hatyAko anumati dinubhaeko cha, tyasako hatyA mAtra garchan | jastai hatyArA, murtada ra vivAhita vyAbhicArI | momina bhaktaharU vyabhicAra gardainan | yastA mahA pApa garneharU mahApralayako dina sajAyako bhAgIdAra bannechan |
69 mahApralayako dina tinIharUko yAtanA kaiyauM guNA baDhAinecha | tinIharU apamAnita bhaera sadhaiMko lAgi narkamA rahanechan |

70 tara jasale saccA taubA (pazcAttApa) garnechan, ImAna lyAunechan ra satkarma garnechan allAhale unIharUle garekA duSkarmaharUlAI satkarmamA pariNata garnu hunecha | allAha taubA garne bhaktaharUprati kSamAzIla ra dayAvAna hunuhuncha |
71 jasale saccA taubA (pazcAttApa) garcha ra AjJApAlana garera tathA avajJAbATa bacera taubAmA kAyama rahancha usako taubA svIkArya huncha |
72 unIharU duSkarma, avajJA ra harAma gariekA kAryaharU gardainan | phAltu kurA ra kAryaharU bhairahekA sthAnaharUbATa hi~Dnai paremA tyasamA saMlagna nabhaera suTukka hi~Di hAlchan |
73 allAhakA sunine ra dekhine nizAnIharUdvArA upadeza diMdA sunine Ayata tathA nizAnIharUbATa bahiro bandainan ra dekhine nizAnIharUbATa andho bandainan |

74 unIharU allAhasita duA gardA bhanchan: he hAmrA pAlanakartA! hAmIlAI Izabhaya rAkhne ra dharmamA kAyama rahane tyastA patnI ra santAnaharU pradAna garnuhos jasale hAmrA A~khAlAI zitala pArun | hAmIlAI Izabhaya rAkhneharUkA aguvA banAunuhos |

75 yI guNaharU bhaekA mominaharUle svargako mahAn sthAna phirdausakA ucca bhavanaharU pAunechan | kinabhane unIharUle allAhako AjJApAlanamA dhairya gare | unIharUlAI phariztAharUle salAma garnechan ra tyahA~ hareka kisimakA saGkaTaharUbATa surakSita rahanechan |
76 unIharU svarmamA sadhaiM rahanechan | kati rAmro vAsasthAna ho svarga |

77 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! kuphramA DaTera rahane kAphiraharUlAI bhanidinuhos− timIharUle AjJApAlana garemA tyasako lAbha allAhalAI pugdaina | bhaktisvarUpa duA garne vA kehI mAgnako lAgi duA garne bhaktaharU nabhae pani allAhalAI kunai pharaka pardaina | timIharUle rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) le lyAunu bhaeko IzvarIya sandezalAI jhUTo Thahara garyau, jasako sajAya timIharUle avazya bhognuparcha |
1 tA0 sIna0 mIma0 | yastA akSaraharUko bAremA sUraha al-bakarahako ArambhamA varNana bhaisakeko cha |
2 yI tyasa kurAnakA AyataharU hun, jasale asatyabATa satyalAI spaSTa pArchan |
3 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! zAyada tapAIMle kAphiraharUko mArgadarzanako cAhanA ra cintAmA Aphno jyAna nai gumAunuhunecha |

4 hAmIle cAhemA AkAzabATa yasto nizAnI avataraNa garna sakchauM jasale tinIharUkA gardhanaharU tyasaprati jhukekA hunechan | tara tinIharUko parIkSA linako lAgi hAmIle yasto garna cAhenauM | tinIharUle adRzyakA kurAharUmA vizvAsa garchan ki gardainan bhanne hAmro uddezya ho |

5 allAha mAtra vAstavika upAsanAko yogya hunuhuncha ra muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) saccA rasUla hunuhuncha bhanera jahile pani yI bahudevavAdIharU samakSa allAhako upadeza Au~cha taba tinIharU vimukha nai hunchan |

6 tinIharUle rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) le lyAunubhaeko sandezalAI jhUTo Thahara gare | tinIharUle ThaTTA garekA khabaraharU avazya nai pUrA hunechan ra tinIharUmAthi avazya nai prakopa avataraNa hunecha |

7 ke kuphramA aDiga rahera jiddI garneharUle yasa kurAmA vicAra garenan− hAmIle kasarI dhartImA nAnA prakArakA bAlInAlI umArekAchauM jo hernamA pani manamohaka chan ra tinamA phAidA pani dherai chan?!

8 nissandeha nAnA prakArakA bAlInAlI umArnu yasa kurAlAI pramANita gardacha- juna allAhale bAlInAlI umArne sAmarthya rAkhnuhuncha uhA~le mRtakaharUlAI punaH jIvita pArne sAmarthya pani rAkhnuhuncha | tara adhikAMsa mAnisaharU ImAna lyAekA chainan |
9 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! tapAIMkA pAlanakartA vijayI hunuhuncha, uhA~mAthi kohI vijayI huna sakdaina | uhA~ AphnA bhaktaharUprati dayAvAn hunuhuncha |

10 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! smaraNa garnuhos, jaba allAhale mUsA (alaihissalAma) lAI pukArera Adeza dinubhayo− allAhako inkAra garera atyAcAra garekA ra banI isrAIlalAI dAsa banAeko samudAyatarpha jAU |
11 tyo phiraunako samudAya ho | tyahA~ pugera tinIharUlAI namratAkA sAtha upadeza deU− tinIharUle allAhakA AdezaharUko pAlanA garera ra uhA~le manAhI garekA kAryaharUbATa bacera Izabhaya apanAun |
12 mUsA (alaihissalAma) le bhane− tinIharUle hAmro sandezalAI jhUTo Thahara garnechan bhanne malAI AzaGkA cha |

13 tinIharUle malAI jhUTo Thahara garne AzaGkAle mero chAtI saJkucita hu~daicha ra mero jibro kurA garnabATa rokincha | tyasaile dAI hArUnalAI sandeSTA banAuna jibrIla (alaihissalAma) lAI paThAunuhos, tAki hArUna (alaihissalAma) mero sahayogI banun |
14 maile ekajanA kibtIko hatyA gareko kurAlAI AdhAra banAera tinIharUle mero hatyA garchan bhanne AzaGkA cha |

15 allAhale bhannubhayo− kadApi hoina, tinIharUle timro hatyA gardainan | ataH timI ra timro dAI hArUna hAmrA camatkAraharU liera tinIharUkahA~ jAU, hAmro maddata ra samarthana timro sAthamA cha | hAmI timI ra phiraunIharUbIca hune vArtalApalAI sunnechauM |
16 timIharU duvai janA phiraunakahA~ jAU ra bhana− hAmIharU allAhakA rasUla hauM | hAmIharUlAI sampUrNa sRSTikA pAlanakartA allAhale timItarpha sandeza diera paThAunubhaeko cha |
17 banI isrAIla (isrAIlakA santAna) lAI mukta garera hAmIsa~ga jAna deU |
18 phiraunale bhanyo− ke timI sAno hu~dA hAmIle timro pAlana-poSaNa garenauM ra timIle hAmIbIca varSauM jIvana bitAenauM, ani kuna AdhAramA sandeSTA hune dAbI gardaichau ta?
19 timIle Aphno samudAyako ekajanA vyaktiko sahayogako lAgi ekajanA kibtIko hatyA garera ThUlo pApa garekA chau | yasarI hAmIle gareko upakAraharUlAI timIle birsidiyau |
20 mUsA (alaihissalAma) le Aphno galtI svIkAra gardai phiraunalAI bhane− maile tyatikhera tyasa vyaktiko hatyA gareko thie~ jaba masamma vahI (prakAzanA) Aeko thiena ra mamA tyati jJAna thiena |
