21 tyasapachi timIharUle mero hatyA garchau bhanne Darale ma bhAgera madayanako euTA gAu~mA gai hAleM | tyahA~ allAhale malAI jJAna pradAna garnubhayo ra rasUlaharUmadhye banAunubhayo jasalAI uhA~ mAnisaharUtarpha paThAunuhuncha |
22 malAI dAsa nabanAikana mero pAlana-poSaNa garera timIle mamAthi kRpA garyau | jabaki timIle banI isrAIlalAI dAsa banAyau | yo Thika kurA ho tara yo kurAle malAI AhvAna garnabATa rokdaina |
23 phiraunale mUsA (alaihissalAma) lAI sodhyo− sabai prANIharUkA pAlanakartA ko hun, jasako rasUla hune dAbI timI gardaichau?!

24 mUsA (alaihissalAma) le javAphamA bhane− sabai prANIharUkA pAlanakartA allAha hunuhuncha; jasale AkAza, pRthvI ra yI duvaibIca rahekA sabai vastuharU sRSTi garnubhayo | yadi timI allAha nai yI sabaikA pAlanakartA hunuhuncha bhanne kurAmA vizvAsa garne vyakti hau bhane uhA~ko mAtra bhakti gara |
25 phiraunale Aphno varipari rahekA samarthakaharUlAI bhanyo− ke timIharU mUsA (alaihissalAma) ko jhUTo kurAmA AdhArita javApha sunirahekA chainau?!
26 mUsA (alaihissalAma) le bhane− allAha nai timIharU ra timIharUkA purkhAharUkA pAlanakartA hunuhuncha |
27 phiraunale bhanyo− AphUlAI timIharUtarpha paThAieko rasUla ThAnne yo vyakti baulAeko cha | kuna kurA garnu ucita cha ra kasarI kurA garnuparcha bhanne kurA pani yasalAI thAhA chaina |

28 mUsA (alaihissalAma) le bhane− ma timIharUlAI allAha kai bhaktitarpha bolAu~chu | uhA~ nai pUrva, pazcima ra yI duvaibIca rahekA vastuharUko sRSTikartA hunuhuncha, yadi timIharU buddhimAna chau bhane kurA bujha |
29 mUsA (alaihissalAma) sa~ga vArtAlApamA asaphala bhaepachi phiraunale bhanyo− yadi timIle ma bAheka anya kasaiko bhakti garchau bhane ma timIlAI kArAgAramA hAlidinchu |

30 mUsA (alaihissalAma) le bhane− ma allAhako tarphabATa camatkAra prastuta gare pani timIle malAI kAragAramA hAlchau? jabaki yI camatkAraharUle ma saccA sandeSTA hu~ bhanne kurA pramANita garnechan |
31 yadi timI Aphno dAbImA saccA chau bhane AphnA tI camatkAraharU prastuta gara jasale timIlAI saccA pramANita garcha |
32 mUsA (alaihissalAma) le lauro bhui~mA hAle, ani tyo ekkAsI spaSTa dekhine sarpamA pariNata bhayo |

33 ani unale Aphno hAta gojI (kAkhI munI) hAle; hAta gojImA hAldA seto thiena, tara jaba nikAle ta seto ra camkilo thiyo, jabaki tyo kuSTharoga athavA dubI thiena | tyasalAI dekhneharUlAI yastai lAgthyo |
34 phiraunale Aphno varipari rahekA AphnA samarthakaharUlAI bhanyo− yo vyakti ta jAdUgara po rahecha |
35 Aphno jAdUbATa timIharUlAI timIharUko bhUmibATa nikAlna cAhancha | timIharUko vicAramA yasako lAgi ke upAya garnuparcha?
36 tinIharUle bhane− usalAI ra usako bhAilAI avasara dinuhos | unIharUlAI sajAya dinamA hatAra nagarnuhos | zaharaharUmA halakArAharU paThAunuhos, jasale jAdUgaraharUlAI bhelA garera lyAun |
37 jasale nipurNa jAdUgaraharUlAI liera Aun |
38 mUsA (alaihissalAma) ko mukAbilAko lAgi phiraunale jAdUgaraharUlAI euTA nizcita samaya ra sthAnamA bhelA garyo |
39 sarvasAdhAraNamA ghoSaNA gariyo− mUsA (alaihissalAma) ra jAdUgaraharUmadhye ko vijaya huncha yo hernako lAgi timIharU sabaile bhelA hunuparcha hai |
40 AzA cha, jAdUgaraharUle mUsA (alaihissalAma) lAI parAjita garebhane hAmIharU tinIharUko dharmako pAlanA garnechauM |
41 jaba mUsA (alaihissalAma) viruddha mukAbilAko lAgi jAdUgaraharU hAjira bhae taba tinIharUle phiraunalAI sodhe− hAmIharU vijaya bhayauM bhane ke kastA bhautika ra naitika puraskAra milnecha?
42 phiraunale bhanyo− ho, timIharUlAI bhautika puraskAra pani milnecha ra ucca sarakArI pada pani | yasarI timIharU mero nikaTatama bannechau |
43 mUsA (alaihissalAma) le allAhako maddatamAthi bharosA gardai spaSTa rUpamA bhane− masa~ga kunai jAdU chaina | timIharU je jati DorI ra lauroharU bhui~mA rAkhna cAhanchau rAkha |
44 tinIharUle DorI ra lauro bhui~mA rAkhdai bhane− phiraunako sammAnako kasama! Aja hAmIharU vijayI hunechauM ra mUsA parAjita hunecha |
45 mUsA (alaihissalAma) le Aphno lauro bhui~mA rAkhe, ani tyo ajiGgaramA pariNata bhaera jAdUgaraharUkA jAdUdvArA sarpa jhai~ dekhA parekA DorI ra lauroharUlAI nilna thAlyo |
46 jaba jAdUgaraharUle mUsA (alaihissalAma) ko laurolAI AphnA jAdU-sAmagrI niliraheko dekhe taba unIharUle sajdA (daNDavat) gare |
47 unIharUle bhane− sampUrNa prANIharUkA pAlanakartAmAthi hAmIle ImAna lyAyauM |
48 mUsA ra hArUna (alaihimassalAma) kA pAlanakartAmAthi |

49 tinIharUle ImAna lyAeko kurAmA kheda prakaTa gardai phiraunale bhanyo− timIharUle mero anumati binA mUsAmAthi kina ImAna lyAyau?! vAstavamA mUsA timIharUko guru ho jasale timIharUlAI jAdU sikAyo | timIharU sabai milera misrabAsIharUlAI nikAlne SaDayantra garekA chau | timIharUlAI kati kaThora sajAya milnecha bhanne kurA timIharUle cA~Dai jAnnechau | hAmIle timIharUkA dAhine khuTTA ra debre hAta vA debre khuTTA ra dAhine hAta avazya nai kATidinechauM ra timIharU sabailAI khajurako rUkhamA zUlI dinechauM, ekajanAlAI pani choDnechainauM |

50 jAdUgaraharUle phiraunalAI javApha die− saMsAramA timIle hatyA garera vA zUlImA caDhAera je sajAya pani dine dhamakI dirahekAchau tyasale gardA hAmIlAI kehI hAni pugdaina | timro sajAya kSaNika hunecha | hAmIharU AphnA pAlanakartAkahA~ pharkera jAnechauM ra uhA~le sadhai~ rahirahane kRpAmA hAmIharUlAI praveza garAunuhunecha |
51 hAmIharUlAI AzA cha, mUsA (alaihissalAma) mAthi sarvaprathama ImAna lyAeko kAraNale uhA~le hAmrA vigatakA pApaharUlAI mApha garnuhunecha |
52 hAmIle mUsA (alaihissalAma) lAI Adeza diyauM− banI isrAIlalAI rAtA-rAta yahA~bATa liera jAU | phirauna ra usako sainikale timIharUlAI phirtA lyAuna timIharUko pachi lAgnechan |
53 phiraunale sainikaharUlAI jammA garna kehI halakArAharUlAI zaharaharUmA paThAyo tAki tinIharUle banI isrAIlalAI phirtA lyAun |
54 phiraunale banI isrAIlako mahatva kama gardai bhanyo− yo euTA sAno samUha ho |
55 unIharUle hAmIlAI risa uThAune kAma garekA chan |
56 hAmI tinIharU viruddha saceta bhaera tayArachauM |
57 allAhale phirauna ra usako samudAyalAI bahumUlya bagaiMcA ra bagirahekA pAnIkA mUlaharUbATa nikAlnubhayo |
58 dhana mAlakA khajAnA ra sundara bhavanaharUbATa nikAlnubhayo |
59 phirauna ra usako samudAyalAI yastA varadAnaharUbATa nikAlnubhayo ra banI isrAIlalAI tyastai varadAnaharU sIriyAmA pradAna garnubhayo |
60 phirauna ra usako samudAyale sUryodayako samayamA banI isrAIlalAI pachyAuna suru gare |

61 jaba phirauna tathA usako samudAya ra mUsA (alaihissalAma) tathA unako samudAya eka arkAlAI dekhine garI najika bhae taba mUsA (alaihissalAma) kA sAthIharUle bhane− aba ta phirauna ra usako samudAyale hAmIharUlAI samAtnechan ra hAmIharU tinIharUko mukAbilA garna sakdainauM |
62 mUsA (alaihissalAma) le Aphno samudAyalAI bhane− timIharUle ThAnejasto hu~daina | allAhako sAtha, sahayoga ra samarthana hAmIharUko sAthamA cha | uhA~le saphalatAko mArga dekhAunuhunecha |

63 hAmIle mUsA (alaihissalAma) lAI Adeza diyauM− samudramA laurole hirkAU | unale laurole hirkAu~dA samudra phuTyo ra tyasamA banI isrAIlakA bAhravaTA gotraanusAra bAhravaTA mArgaharU bane | samudrako phuTeko pratyeka TukrA pahADa jasto mahAna banyo ra tyasabATa pAnI bagna rokiyo |
64 hAmIle phirauna ra usako samudAyalAI samudrako najika puryAyauM, tinIharU yo ThAnera samudramA pase ki tyasamA banekA mArgaharUmA hi~Dna sakincha |
65 hAmIle mUsA (alaihissalAma) ra unako samudAya banI isrAIlalAI jogAyauM, unIharUmadhye eka janA pani hatAhata bhaena |
66 tara hAmIle phirauna ra usako samudAyalAI samudramA DubAera sarvanAza garyauM |

67 nissandeha mUsA (alaihissalAma) ko lAgi samudra phuTnu, unako tathA unako samudAya surakSita rahanu ra phirauna tathA usako samudAyako sarvanAzamA yasa kurAko pramANa cha ki mUsA (alaihissalAma) saccA sandeSTA thie, tara phiraunasa~ga rahekA adhikAMsa mAnisaharUle ImAna lyAenan |
68 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! nissandeha tapAIMkA pAlanakartAle zatruharUsa~ga badalA line sAmarthya rAkhnuhuncha ra tinIharUmadhye taubA garne bhaktaharUmAthi dayA garnuhuncha |
69 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! tinIharUlAI ibrAhIma (alaihissalAma) ko satya kathA sunAunuhos |
70 jaba ibrAhIma (alaihissalAma) le Aphno buvA Ajara ra Aphno samudAyalAI bhane− timIharUle allAhAlAI choDera kuna vastuko pUjA garchau?
71 uhA~ko samudAyaharUle bhane− hAmIharU mUrti pUjA garchauM ra tyasaimA samarpita rahanchauM |
72 ibrAhIma (alaihissalAma) le sodhe− ke mUrtiharU sunchan jaba timIharU tinIharUlAI pukArchau?
73 ke timIharUle AjJApAlana gardA tinIharUle kehI lAbha puryAu~chan vA avajJA gardA tinIharUle kehI hAni puryAu~chan?

74 tinIharUle bhane− hAmIharUle pukArdA tinIharUle sundainan, AjJApAlana gardA kunai lAbha puryAu~dainan ra avajJA gardA kunai hAni puryAu~dainan | tara hAmIharUle AphnA pUrvajaharUlAI mUrti pUjA gardai gareko pAyauM, tyasaile tinIharUko dekhA sikhI hAmIharU pani gardaichauM |
75 ibrAhIma (alaihissalAma) le bhane− ke timIharUle allAhalAI chADera upAsanA garirahekA tI mUrtiharUko bAremA soca vicAra garyau ra dekhyau?
76 ani timrA pUrvajaharUle pUjne garekA pUjyaharUko bAremA pani |
77 sabai mUrtiharU merA zatru hun, kinabhane tinIharU asatya hun | vAstavika pUjya mAtra allAha hunuhuncha jo sabai sRSTiharUkA pAlanakartA hun |
78 kinabhane uhA~le nai malAI sRSTi garnubhayo | uhA~le malAI loka ra paralokako bhalAitarpha mArgadarzana garnuhunecha |
79 bhoka lAgdA uhA~le nai malAI khuvAunu huncha ra tirkhA lAgdA pani uhA~le nai malAI pilAunu huncha |
80 ma birAmI hu~dA uhA~le nai malAI niko pArnuhuncha | uhA~ bAheka arU kasaile niko pArdaina |
81 mRtyuko samaya AemA uhA~le nai malAI mRtyu dinuhunecha ra tyasapachi pani uhA~le nai arko jIvana pradAna garnuhunecha |
82 mahApralayako dina uhA~le mAtra merA pApalAI mApha garnuhunecha bhanne AzA rAkhchu |

83 ibrAhIma (alaihissalAma) le prarthanA gardai bhane− he merA pAlanakartA! malAI dharmako jJAna pradAna garnuhos | mRtyupachi svargamA praveza garAera ma bhandA pahile bitisakekA sandeSTAharUsa~ga milAunuhos |
84 mapachi Aune yugakA mAnisaharUmA mero rAmro carcA ra prazaMsA jArI garidinuhos |
85 malAI svargako hakadAra banAi dinuhos ra tyasamA bAsa pradAna garnuhos | jasamA tapAIMkA momina bhaktaharU praveza garnechan |

86 mero buvAlAI kSamA pradAna garnuhos | nissandeha uhA~ zirka gareko kAraNale pathabhraSTa hunubhaeko cha | ibrAhIma (alaihissalAma) le Aphno buvAko lAgi yo duA tyatikhera garekA thie jaba unalAI yo thAhA thiena ki unakA buvA narkabAsI madhyekA hun | jaba unalAI yo kurA thAhA bhayo taba unale unIsa~ga kunai sarokAra rAkhenan ra unako lAgi duA garenan |
87 malAI tyasa dina yAtanA diera apamAna nagarnu holA juna dina mAnisaharUlAI hisAba kitAbako lAgi uThAinecha |
88 tyasa dina nata dhana-sampatti kAma lAgnecha jo usale saMsAramA jammA gareko thiyo, na santAna nai kAma Aunechan jasabATa usale sahayoga linthyo |

89 a~ juna mAnisa zirka, kuphra ra chalakapaTa nagarikana ThIka dila liera hAjira hunecha, usalAI tI dhana-sampatti kAma lAgnechan jo usale allAhako mArgamA kharca garekA hunecha ra usakA santAnale garekA duA pani kAma lAgnecha |
90 allAhako Adezako pAlanA garekA ra uhA~le manAhI garekA kAryaharUbATa bacekA mAnisaharUko lAgi svargalAI najika pArinecha |
91 satya dharmabATa pathabhraSTa bhaekA mAnisaharUkA lAgi mahApralayako dina narkalAI dikhAinecha |
92 tinIharUlAI nindA gardai sodhinecha− kahA~ chan timIharUle pUjdai AekA mUrtiharU?
93 allAhalAI choDera jasalAI timIharUle pUjA garne garthyau? ke tinIharUle allAhako prakopalAI rokera timIharUlAI maddata garna sakchan? vA ke tinIharUle svayam Aphno bacAu garna sakchan?
94 tinIharUlAI ekArkAmAthi narkamA phyA~kinecha ani tinIharUlAI pathabhraSTa garnelAI pani |
95 zaitAnaharUmadhye iblIsakA sabai sahayogIharUlAI narkamA phyA~kinecha | kasailAI pani choDine chaina |

96 tyasa dina allAhalAI choDera arUko upAsanA garne ra allAhako sAthasAthai arUko pani upAsanA garne bahudevavAdIharU AphnA tI bhagavAnaharUsa~ga jhagaDA garnechan jasako unIharUle upAsanA garne garthe |
97 allAhako kasama! hAmIharU sA~ccikai satya mArga birAera spaSTa pathabhraSTatAmA thiyauM,
98 jaba hAmIle timIharUlAI sabai prANIharUkA pAlanakartA allAhako barAbara Thahara garyauM ra allAhako garnuparne bhakti jastai timIharUko bhakti garyauM |
99 aparAdhIharUle hAmIharUlAI allAhalAI choDera yinIharUko bhaktitarpha bolAera pathabhraSTa pAre |
100 aba nata allAhako samakSa hAmro siphArisa garne kohI cha na yAtanAbATa jogAuna kohI cha |
101 malAI jogAune ra merolAgi siphArisa garne kunai ghaniSTa mitra chaina |
102 yadi hAmIlAI punaH saMsAramA pharkAinecha bhane hAmI avazya allAhamAthi ImAna lyAunechauM |
103 nissandeha ibrAhIma (alaihissalAma) ko satya kathA ra jhUTA Thahara garneharUko pariNAmamA pATha lineharUkA lAgi upadeza cha | tara adhikAMsa mAnisaharU ImAna lyAirahekA chainan |
104 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! nissandeha tapAIMkA pAlanakartA zatruharUbATa badalA lina sAmarthyavAna ra taubA garneharUprati dayAvAn hunuhuncha |
105 nUha (alaihissalAma) ko samudAyale nUha (alaihissalAma) lAI jhUTo Thahara garera sabai sandeSTAharUlAI jhUTo Thahara gare |
106 jaba nUha (alaihissalAma) le AphnA jAtikA dAju bhAIharUlAI bhane− ke timIharU allAhasita DarAera ra uhA~ bAheka arUko bhakti choDera takvA (allAhako bhaya, AzA tathA mAyA) grahaNa gardainau?
107 ma timIharUkA lAgi allAhako tarphabATa paThAieko rasUla hu~ | ma amAnatadAra hu~, allAhale garnubhaeko vahI (prakAzanA) mA kunai thapa ghaTa gardina |

108 allAhakA AdezaharUko pAlanA garera ra uhA~le manAhI garnubhaekA kAryaharUlAI tyAgera uhA~sita Dara | maile dieko AdezaharUko pAlanA garera tathA manAhI garekA kAryaharUlAI tyAgera mero AjJApAlana gara |
109 ma allAhako tarphabATa je jati puryAu~daichu tyasako lAgi kunai pratiphala mAgdina | mero pratiphala ta allAhako jimmAmA nai cha jo sabai prANIharUkA pAlanakartA hunuhuncha |

110 allAhakA AdezaharUko pAlanA garera ra uhA~le manAhI garnubhaekA kAryaharUlAI tyAgera uhA~sita Dara | maile dieko AdezaharUko pAlanA garera tathA manAhI garekA kAryaharUlAI tyAgera mero AjJApAlana gara |
111 unako samudAyale bhanyo− he nUha! timImAthi AsthA rAkhneharU tallostarakA mAnisaharU hun | unIharUmadhye kunai ThUlA baDA chainan?! ani hAmI kasarI timImAthi ImAna lyAune?
112 nUha (alaihissalAma) le bhane− mominaharU ke gardaichan bhanne kurA malAI thAhA chaina | ma unIharUko nirikSaka (caukIdAra) hoina ra unIharUle gareko karmako gantI rAkhdina |
113 unIharUko hisAba allAhamAthi cha jo unIharUkA vAhya tathA Antarika kurAharU pani jAnnuhuncha | timIharUle bhaneko kurA timIharUle mahasusa gareko bhae timIharUle bhanne thienau |
114 timI ThUlAbaDAharU ImAna lyAunechauM bhanera ma tI garibaharUlAI Aphno sabhAbATa bhagAu~dina |
115 ma spaSTa rUpamA DarAunevAlA sacetaka hu~ | timIharUlAI allAhako prakopabATa saceta garAu~daichu |
116 nUha (alaihissalAma) ko samudAyale bhane− yadi timIle yasa kAryalAI choDenau bhane timIle gAlI khAnechau ra DhuGgAle mArinechau |

118 tinIhaharUko vinAzako nirNaya garidinuhos, kinabhane tinIharU jiddI garera asatyamA aDiga chan | malAI ra mamAthi ImAna lyAekA mAnisaharUlAI tyasa prakopabATa jogAunus |

125 ma timIharUkA lAgi allAhako tarphabATa paThAieko rasUla hu~ | ma amAnatadAra hu~, allAhale garnubhaeko vahI (prakAzanA) mA kunai thapa ghaTa gardina |

126 allAhakA AdezaharUko pAlanA garera ra uhA~le manAhI garnubhaekA kAryaharUlAI tyAgera uhA~sita Dara | maile dieko AdezaharUko pAlanA garera tathA manAhI garekA kAryaharUlAI tyAgera mero AjJApAlana gara |

127 ma allAhako tarphabATa je jati sandeza puryAu~daichu tyasako lAgi timIharUbATa kunai pratiphala mAgdina | mero pratiphala ta mAtra allAhako jimmAmA cha jo sabai prANIharUkA pAlanakartA hunuhuncha |
128 ke timIharU hareka ucca sthAnamA ThUlAThUlA bhavana nirmANa garchau jo nizAnI banos?! jabaki yo bekArako kAma ho ra yasako kunai phAidA loka ra paralokamA mildaina |
129 ani timIharUle yati mahAn killA ra bhavana banAu~chau mAnauM timIharU sadhai~ yasai saMsAramA rahanechau, yahA~bATa kahile marera jA~dainau?!

155 sAleha (alaihissalAma) le bhane− allAhale malAI euTA nizAnI pradAna garnubhaeko cha, tyo ho U~TanI; jasalAI allAhale caTTAnabATa nikAlnu bhayo | yasalAI dekhna pani sakincha ra chuna pani sakincha | U~TanIko lAgi ra timIharUko lAgi pAnI piune dina nirdhAraNa garieko cha | juna dina timIharUko pAlo huncha tyasa dina tyasale pAnI piunechaine ra juna dina tyasako pAlo huncha tyasa dina timIharU pAnI piunechainau |

156 yasalAI coTa puryAune tathA hatyA garne ra hirkAune garI niyatale nachunu | yasto garyau bhane timIharUlAI allAhako yAtanA svarUpa bhayAvaha dinako prakopale samAtnecha, juna dina timIharU saGkaTa grasta hunechau |

157 tara tinIharU yasalAI kATera mArne kurAmA sahamata bhae | tinIharU madhyekA sabaibhandA abhAgIle tyasalAI kATera hatyA garyo | jaba tinIharUle yo kurA thAhA pAe- yasale gardA avazya nai tinIharUmAthi prakopa avataraNa huncha taba tinIharU lajjita bhae | tara prakopalAI A~khAle dekhepachi lajjita hunu kehI phAidA puryAu~daina |

994 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! unale tapAIMkA hRdayamA yasalAI avataraNa gare, tAki tapAIM rasUlaharUmadhye hunuhos | rasUlaharUko kAma mAnisaharUlAI saceta garnu ra allAhako prakopabATa DarAunu ho |

198 yadi hAmIle yo kurAna arabI bhASA nabolne kunai gaira arabImAthi avataraNa gareko bhae,

199 jibrIla (alaihissalAma) le unIharU samakSa paDhe pani unIharU ImAna lyAune thienan | unIharUle jhaTTa bhanne thie− hAmI yasalAI bujhdainauM | makkAkA yI kAphiraharUle yasa kurAmA allAhaprati AbhAra vyakta garnuparcha ki uhA~le yasalAI unIharUko arabI bhASAmA avataraNa garnubhayo |
200 yasarI hAmIle aparAdhIharUkA hRdayaharUmA jhUTo Thahara garne bAnI ra kuphra praveza garidiyauM |
201 yinIharUle bhayAvaha prakopa nadekhunjela parivartana bhaera ImAna lyAune chainan |
202 yinIharUmAthi allAhako prakopa akasmAta Aera samAtnecha, yinIharUlAI thAhai hune chaina |
203 akasmAta prakopa avataraNa bhaepachi yinIharUle pachuto gardai bhannechan− ke hAmIharUlAI avasara milnecha tAki hAmIharU allAha samakSa taubA garauM?!
204 ke yI kAphiraharU yo bhanera hAmro prakopako lAgi hatAra gardaichan− hAmIharU tyatikherasamma ImAna lyAune chainauM jatikhera timIle hAmro mAga anusAra AkAzako TukrA khasAldainau?!
205 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! khabaradAra garidinuhos− tapAIMle lyAunubhaeko sandezamAthi ImAna nalyAune kAphiraharUlAI varSauMsamma varadAna pradAna garyauM |
206 pheri varadAnaharU pAepachi yasto samaya Ayo jasamA tyo prakopa avataraNa bhayo, jasako vAcA tInIharUsa~ga garieko thiyo |
207 tinIharUsa~ga rahekA sAMsArika varadAnaharUle tinIharUlAI ke phAidA puryAe ta?! tI sabai varadAnaharU samApta bhae, kehI pani bacenan |
208 hAmIle junasukai samudAyalAI naSTa pAryauM tyasatarpha rasUla ra kitAba (grantha) paThAepachi mAtra naSTa pAryauM |

209 tinIharUko pATha ra upadezako lAgi hAmIle sandeSTA ra kitAba paThAyauM | yasarI rasUla paThAera ra kitAba avataraNa garera unIharUko bahAnA banAune bATo banda garepachi unIharUlAI yAtanA diera hAmIle anyAya garenauM |
210 zaitAnaharUle yasa kurAnalAI rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) ko hRdayamAthi avataraNa garekA hoinan |
211 zaitAnaharUle yasalAI uhA~ (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) ko hRdayamAthi avataraNa garnu ThIka pani chaina ra garne sAmarthya pani rAkhdainan |
212 tinIharU yasa kAraNale avataraNa garna sakdainan ki tinIharUko sthAna AkAzabATa alaga thalaga cha | ani tinIharU kasarI AkAzamA caDhana sakchan ra kehI liera jharna sakchan?!
213 allAhasa~ga anya kunai pUjyako pUjA upAsanA garera uhA~ko sAthamA zirka nagara, natra timI pani yAtanAko bhAgidAra bannechau |

214 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! tapAIM AphnA samudAyakA sabaibhandA baDhI nikaTatama ani tyasapachikA nikaTatama mAnisaharUlAI DarAunuhos, tAki tinIharU zirkamA lipta rahera prakopako bhAgI nabanun |
215 tapAIM AphnA anuyAyIharUsa~ga ati namratAkA sAtha kurA garnuhos ra dayA bhAvakA sAtha vyavahAra garnuhos |

216 yadi tinIharU tapAIMko avajJA garchan ra tapAIMko Adeza anusAra eka allAhako bhakti tathA AjJApAlana gardainan bhane bhanidinuhos− timIharUle gareko zirka ra duSkarmasita mero kunai sarokAra chaina |
217 tapAIM AphnA sabai mAmilAmA sarvazaktimAn allAhamAthi bharosA garnuhos, jo AphnA zatruharUsa~ga badalA linuhuncha | juna mAnisaharU allAhatarpha pharkanchan unIharUprati uhA~ dayAvAn hunuhuncha |
218 allAhale tapAIMlAI dekhnuhuncha jaba tapAIM namAjako lAgi ubhinu huncha |
219 namAja paDhirahekA mAnisaharUbIca tapAIMko avasthAharUlAI allAha dekhnuhuncha | tapAIMle ra anya mAnisaharUle garirahekA kAryaharU uhA~bATa lukeko chaina |

221 timIharUko vicAramA zaitAnaharU kurAna avataraNa garchan, yo galata kurA ho, ke ma sUcita garu~ kasamAthi zaitAnaharU avataraNa hunchan?
222 zaitAnaharU sadhai~ jhUTa bolne, dherai pApa garne pApI ra jyotiSIharUmAthi avataraNa hunchan |

223 allAhako nikaTa rahekA pharizatAharUko sabhAbATa corera kehI kurA sunchan ra AphnA jyotiSI sAthIharUlAI batAu~chan | adhikAMsa jyotiSIharU jhUTA hunchan | euTA kurA sA~co bolchan bhane sayavaTA kurAharU jhUTo bolchan |
224 timIharUko vicAramA muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) kaviharUmadhye hunuhuncha, yo galata kurA ho | kaviharU ta galata bAToko anusaraNa garchan | arUbATa uddhRta garera kavitA bhanchan |

225 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) ke tapAIMle hernubhaena, tinIharUko kumArga apanAune kAryaharUmadhye ke ho bhane tinIharU sabai upatyakAmA paschan, kahile khuba prazaMsA garchan ra kahile khuba bhartsanA garchan ra kahile yI duvai bAheka anya kurAharUtira lAgchan |
226 tinIharUle jhUTa bolchan | hAmIle yasto ra tyasto garekAchauM bhanchan tara tyasto garekA hu~dainan |

227 kaviharUmadhye tI mAnisaharU tyasto gardainan jo ImAna lyAe, satkarma gare ra allAhalAI khubai smaraNa gare | allAhakA zatruharUle atyAcAra garemA unIharU badalA linchan | jastai- hassAna bina sAbita (rajiyallAhu anhu) | allAhako bhaktimA sAjhedAra Thahara garera ani bhaktaharUmAthi jyAdatI garera atyAcAra garekA mAnisaharUle cA~Dai thAhA pAunechan− tinIharU kahA~ pharkera jAnechan | tinIharU mahatvapUrNa sthAna ra gahana hisAbamA pharkera jAnechan |

1 (tA0 sIn0) yastA akSaraharUko bAremA sUraha al-bakarahako ArambhamA varNana bhaisakeko cha | tapAIMmAthi avatarita yI AyataharU kurAnakA zlokaharU hun | kurAna ati spaSTa kitAba ho, yasamA kunai zaGkA chaina | jasale yasamA cintana manan garcha usale avazya nai thAhA pAu~cha ki yo allAhako tarphabATa avataraNa bhaeko ho |
2 yI AyataharU satya dharmatarpha mArgadarzana garchan ani mominaharUlAI allAha ra rasUlaharU (alaihimussalAma) kA zubha-sUcanAharU sunAu~chan |
3 yastA mominaharU; jasale pUrNarUpamA namAja kAyama garchan, AphnA dhana-sampattibATa jakAta nikAlera hakadAraharUlAI dinchan | ani unIharU Akhiratako pratiphala ra sajAyamAthi vizvAsa rAkhchan |

4 nissandeha juna kAphiraharU Akhiratako pratidAna ra sajAyamA vizvAsa rAkhdainan hAmIle tinIharUkA duSkarmaharUlAI tinIharUko najaramA sundara banAidiekAchauM | tinIharU hairAna bhaera duSkarmamA nai lipta rahanchan ra sIdhA tathA satya mArga pAu~dainan |

5 yastA mAnisaharU saMsAramA pani hatyA ra kaida bhogera yAtanAmA rahanchan ra AkhiratamA ThUlo ghATA sahanuparnecha | tinIharU mahApralayako dina svayam pani ra tinIharUkA parivArakA sadasyaharU pani sadhaiMko lAgi narkamA jAnechan ra yasarI ThUlo ghATA khAnechan |

6 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) tapAIM yo kurAna tatvadarzI ra sarvajJa allAhako tarphabATa prApta garirahanu bhaeko cha | uhA~ sRSTi garne, kArya saJcAlana garne ra kAnuna banAune kAryamA tatvadarzI hunuhuncha | uhA~ sarvajJa hunuhuncha, bhaktaharUkA hitaharUbAre kunai pani kurA uhA~bATa gopya chaina |

7 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) tapAIM tyasa samayalAI smaraNa garnuhos, jaba mUsA (alaihissalAma) le Aphno parivAralAI bhane− ma tyahA~ Ago dekhdaichu, ma tyahA~ pugera bATobAre jAnakArI liera Au~daichu vA Ago liera Au~daichu, AzA cha tyasabATa timIharUle AphUlAI nyAno pArnechau |

8 jaba unI Ago dekheko ThAu~mA puge taba allAhale pukArera bhannubhayo−AgomA raheko hastI pavitra hunuhuncha ra tyasako varipari rahekA phariztAharU pani pavitra chan | tinIharU allAhako zAna anusAra uhA~ko sammAna gardachan | unIharU yo pani bhandachan− allAha tI avaguNaharUbATa pavitra hunuhuncha jo pathabhraSTaharU uhA~ko bAremA bhanchan |
9 allAhale bhannubhayo− he mUsA (alaihissalAma)! ma prabhutvazAlI allAha hu~, ma mAthi kohI pani vijayI huna sakdaina | sRSTi garna, bhAgya nirdhAraNa garna ra kAnuna banAunamA ma tatvadarzI chu |

10 Aphno lauro bhui~mA rAkha | mUsA (alaihissalAma) le lauro bhui~mA rAkhe | jaba unale laurolAI sarpa jasto hi~Deko dekhe taba DarAe ani piThyU~ pharkAera bhAge ra pharkenan | allAhale unalAI bhannubhayo− yasabATa naDarAU, ma samakSa sandeSTAharU sarpa ra anya kunai pani vastubATa DarAu~dainan |
11 tara jasale pApa garera AphUmAthi atyAcAra garcha ra pheri taubA garcha usalAI ma mApha garchu ra usamAthi dayA garchu |

12 Aphno hAtalAI Aphno ghA~TInajika raheko kamisako khullA bhAgamA liera jAU, jaba hAtalAI tyasabATa nikAlchau taba tyo kuSTha rogabinA hiu~ jasto seto camkilo bhaera niskanecha | timI saccA sandeSTA ho bhanne kurAlAI nauvaTA nizAnIharUle puSTi gardachan | tImadhye hun− camkilo hAta, laurokA camatkAra, phirauna ra usako samudAyamAthi sukhkhA, phalako kamI, hurI batAsa, phaTyAGgrA, uDusa, bhyAguto ra ragatakA prakopaharU | yinIharU kuphrako kAraNale allAhako AjJApAlana gardainathe |
13 mUsA (alaihissalAma) lAI spaSTarUpamA puSTi garne yI nizAnIharU Aepachi tinIharUle bhane− mUsA (alaihissalAma) le lyAekA nizAnIharU spaSTa jAdU mAtra hun |

14 tinIharUle yI spaSTa nizAnIharUlAI inkAra gare | yI nizAnIharU allAhako tarphabATa hun bhanne vizvAsa hu~dA hu~dai pani tinIharUle svIkAra garenan | kAraNa tinIharUko atyAcAra ra satyako mukAbilAmA ghamaNDa thiyo | he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! vicAra garnuhos, kuphra ra pApa garera dhartImA AtaGka maccAuneharUko pariNAma kasto huncha | hAmIle tI sabailAI tahasa nahasa garera sarvanAza garidiyauM |

15 hAmIle dAUda ra unako putra sulaimAna (alaihimassalAma) lAI jJAna pradAna garyauM | tI jJAnaharUmadhye thiyo carAko kurA bujhne jJAna | yI duvai janA sandeSTAharUle allAhaprati AbhAra vyakta gardai bhane− sabai prazaMsAharU allAhakA lAgi hun, jasale hAmIharUlAI jJAna ra IzadUtatva (nubuvvata) pradAna garera dherai momina bhaktaharUmAthi prAthamikatA pradAna garnubhayo |

16 Aphno buvA dAUda (alaihissalAma) pachi sulaimAna (alaihissalAma) nabI, vidvAna ra rAjA bane | unale AphUmAthi ra AphnA buvAmAthi bhaeko allAhako varadAnalAI varNana gardai bhane− he mAnava! allAhale hAmIlAI carAko AvAja bujhne jJAna dinubhayo | uhA~le hAmIlAI tI sabai thoka dinubhayo jo uhA~le anya sandeSTAharU ra rAjAharUlAI dinubhaeko thiyo | allAhale hAmIlAI je jati pradAna garnubhaeko cha tI sabai uhA~kA spaSTa varadAnaharU hun |
17 sulaimAna (alaihissalAma) ko lAgi mAnava, jinna ra carAmadhye sainikaharU bhelA garie ra unIharUlAI vyavasthita tarikAle hi~Dna lagAie |

18 unIharUlAI nirantara hi~DAiyo yahA~samma ki unIharU (sirIyAmA avasthita) kamilAko upatyakAsamma puge | ta euTA kamilAle bhanyo− he kamilAharU ho! A-AphnA dulomA pasa, natra sulaimAna (alaihissalAma) ra unakA sainikaharUle timIharUlAI anjAnamA kulcana sakchan | unIharUle jAnI jAnI ta kulcadainan |

19 sulaimAna (alaihasissalAma) le usako kurA sunera musumusu hA~se | unale allAhasita duA gardai bhane− tapAIMle mamAthi ra merA mAtA pitAmAthi garekA varadAnaharUprati AbhAra vyakta garne avasara pradAna garnuhos | malAI yastA satkarma garne avasara pradAna garnuhos jasabATa tapAIM prasanna hunuhuncha | malAI AphnA satkarmI bhaktaharUko samUhamA praveza garAunuhos |
20 sulaimAna (alaihissalAma) le carAharUko anugamana gardA hudhudlAI pAenan | unale bhane− hudhud kina upasthita chaina? katai lukera baseko cha ki anupasthita cha?

21 hudhud anupasthita bhaeko kurA thAhA pAu~dA sulaimAna (alaihissalAma) le bhane− anupasthita bhaekole ma usalAI kaDA sajAya dinchu vA badha nai garidinchu | anupasthita hunuko ucita kAraNa dekhAu~cha bhane arkai kurA ho |

22 ekachina pachi jaba hudhud upasthita bhayo taba usale sulaimAna (alaihissalAma) lAI bhanyo− maile yasto kurA thAhA pAeko chu jasako bAremA hujuralAI thAhA chaina | ma sabAbATa satya khabara liera Aeko chu jasamA kunai zaGkA chaina |

23 maile ekajanA mahilAlAI dezako sattA-zAsana calAi rAkheko pAe~ | unIsa~ga sabai kisimakA zaktikA zrota sAdhana ra sainikaharU chan | unIsa~ga ThUlo siMhAsana cha, jasamAthi basera rAja kAja calAu~chin |

24 maile tI mahilA ra unako samudAyalAI pavitra pUjya allAhako bhakti nagarera sUryalAI Dhogdai tathA upAsanA gareko pAe~ | zaitAnale tinIharUkA zirka ra avajJAkA kAryaharUlAI tinIharUkA lAgi sundara banAeko cha | tinIharUlAI satkarmabATa phereko cha | tyasaile tinIharU sIdhA mArgamA chainan |

25 tinIharUkA zirka ra avajJAko kAryalAI zaitAnale yasa kAraNale sundara tulyAeko cha tAki tinIharUle eka allAhako bhakti nagarun, jo AkAzabATa pAnI barsAunuhuncha ra dhartImA lukekA boTa biruvA umArnuhuncha | timIharUle lukichipI garne ra khullama khullA garne sabai kAryaharUlAI jAnnuhuncha | uhA~bATa kehI pani lukeko chaina |
26 allAha bAheka kohI pani vAstavika pUjya chaina | uhA~ mahAn siMhAsanakA mAlika hunuhuncha |
27 sulaimAna (alaihissalAma) le hudhudasa~ga bhane− ma chAnabina garchu, timIle gareko dAbI satya ho ki asatya |
28 sulaimAna (alaihissalAma) le patra taiyAra garera hudhudlAI die ra bhane− mero yo patra liera jAU ra sabA bAsIharUsamma puryAu | ani tinIharUbATa ali para haTera tinIharUko pratikRyA suna |
29 rAnIle patra pAepachi bhanin− he merA sahayogIharU ho! malAI euTA mahatvapUrNa patra prApta bhaekocha |
30 sulaimAna (alaihissalAma) ko tarphabATa paThAieko yo patrako viSaya allAhako nAmabATa suru garieko cha, jo ati dayAvAn ra parama kRpAvAn hunuhunchaH
31 timIharU ghamaNDa nagara | Atma samarpaNa garera ra maile gareko eka allAhako bhaktiko AhvAnalAI svIkAra garera tathA sUrya pUjA jasto zirkalAI tyAgera mero pAsamA AU |
32 rAnIle sodhin− he merA sahayogIharU ho! yasa mAmilAmA ke garnu ucita huncha malAI batAU | timIharU upasthita bhaera A-Aphno vicAra narAkhesamma ma kunai nirNaya lina sakdina |
33 unako samudAyakA aguvAharUle bhane− hAmIharU zaktizAlI chauM ra yuddha garne kSamatA pani rAkhchauM | yasamA hajurako je nirNaya ra Adeza huncha hAmIharU tyasako pAlanA garna tayAra chauM |

34 rAnIle bhanin− rAjAharU jaba kunai dezamAthi AkramaNa garchan taba tyahA~ hatyA, hiMsA ra lUTapATako sAthasAthai AtaGka maccAu~chan | dezakA sammAnita aguvAharUlAI apamAnita garchan | junasukai rAjAharU dezamAthi vijayI bhaepachi tyahA~ Aphno dhAka jamAuna tyastai garchan |
35 ma yasa rAjA ra unako samudAyako lAgi upahAra paThAu~chu ani unako pratikRyA dekhchu |

36 jaba rAnIkA dUta ra unakA sahayogIharU upahAraharU liera sulaimAna (alaihissalAma) kahA~ puge taba unale upahAra paThAine kAryalAI mana parAenan | unale bhane− ke timIharU malAI Arthika sahayoga garera mabATa bacna cAhanchau? allAhale malAI pradAna garnubhaekA IzadUtatva, sattA-zAsana ra dhana-sampatti timIharUsa~ga rahekA dhana-sampattibhandA uttama chan | baru timIharU nai sAMsArika dhana-sampattimA ramAU |

37 sulaimAna (alaihissalAma) le tyasa dUtalAI bhane− timIle lyAeko upahAra phirtA liera jAU | hAmI timro rAnI ra usako samudAya viruddha yasto zaktizAlI sainya dala liera AunechauM josa~ga bhIDanta garne zakti tinIharUmA chaina | yadi tinIharU Atma-samarpaNa garera Au~dainan bhane hAmIle tinIharUlAI sabAbATa apamAnita garera nikAlnechauM |
38 sulaimAna (alaihissalAma) le sambodhana garera bhane− he merA sahayogIharU ho! rAnI Atma-samarpaNa garera yahA~ Aipugnu bhandA pahile nai timIharUmadhye kasale unako siMhAsana liera Auna sakcha?

39 jinnaharU madhyeko euTA ThUlo jinnale bhanyo− hajura yasa sabhAbATa uThnuaghi nai ma unako siMhAsanalAI liera Auna sakchu | ma tyasalAI bokera lyAune zakti pani rAkhchu ra amAnatadAra pani chu, tyasamA kunai kamI gardina |

40 sulaimAna (alaihissalAma) najika ekajanA satkarmI ra jJAnI vyakti thie josa~ga kitAba ra allAhako mahAn nAmako jJAna thiyo jasabATa pukArdA allAhale pUrA garnuhuncha | tI vyaktile bhane− hajurako A~khA jhamkinu aghi nai tyasa siMhAsanalAI lyAuna sakchu | ma duA garchu ani allAhale hAjira garAidinuhuncha | unale duA gare ra allAhale kabula garera siMhAsana hAjira garAidinu bhayo | sulaimAna (alaihissalAma) le Aphno najika siMhAsanalAI dekhera bhane− mero pavitra pAlanakartAko vizeSa kRpAle yasto bhayo; uhA~le yasa viSayamA mero parIkSA li~dai hunuhuncha, ma uhA~ko kRpAprati kRtajJa hunchu vA kRtaghna? jasale allAhaprati AbhAra vyakta garcha tyasako lAbha usailAI milcha ra jo allAhakA varadAnaharUprati kRtaghna huncha ra AbhAra vyakta gardaina usako hAni usailAI huncha | nissandeha merA pAlanakartA susampanna hunuhuncha, uhA~lAI kasaiko AbhArako AvazyaktA chaina | kasaile uhA~prati AbhAra vyakta nagare pani uhA~le jIvikA pradAna garnu uhA~ko uhA~ko mahAnatAko pramANa ho |
41 sulaimAna (alaihissalAma) le bhane− rAnIko siMhAsanako rUpa rekhAmA ali pherabadala garideU, herauM, unale yo unakai siMhAsana ho bhanne kurA cinna sakchin vA Aphno sAmAna pani cinna sakdainin?

42 jaba rAnI sulaimAna (alaihissalAma) kahA~ pugin taba rAnIko parIkSA linako lAgi sodhiyo− ke yo timro siMhAsana jastai ho? rAnIle jhaTTa javApha diin− mAnauM yo merai siMhAsana ho | sulaimAna (alaihissalAma) le bhane− malAI allAhale yastA kAryaharUmAthi Aphno sAmarthyabAre pahilA nai jJAna pradAna garisaknu bhaeko cha | hAmI uhA~ko Adezaprati samarpita chauM |
43 rAnIlAI eka allAhako bhaktibATa tyasa pUjAle rokeko thiyo jo unI AphnA samudAyako dekhA siki gardai thiin | unako sambandha allAhalAI inkAra garne kAphira (inkArI) samudAyasa~ga thiyo |

44 unalAI bhaniyo− mahalamA praveza gara | mahala bhUi~ tallAmA thiyo | jaba unI mahalamA praveza garin taba tyasalAI pAnI ThAnera AphnA lugAlAI bhijnabATa jogAuna AphnA pi~DulAbATa lugA mAthi pArin | sulaimAna (alaihissalAma) le bhane− yo zizAle baneko mahala ho | sulaimAna (alaihissalAma) le unalAI islAma grahaNa garne AhvAna gare | rAnIle bhanin− he allAha! maile tapAIMsa~ga anya vastuko pUjA garera AphUmAthi atyAcAra gareM | ani rAnIle sulaimAna (alaihissalAma) sa~ga sabai prANIharUkA pAlanakartA allAha samakSa Atma-samarpaNa garin |

45 hAmIle samUda samudAyatarpha usakA ragatako nAtAle bhAi parne sAleha (alaihissalAma) lAI paThAyauM | yasa kurAko AhvAnako lAgi ki mAtra eka allAhako bhakti gara | unako AhvAnapachi unIharU dUI samUhamA vibhAjita bhae ra yasa kurAmA jhagaDA garna thAle− kuna samUha satyamA cha | euTA momina samUha ra arko kAphira samUha |

46 sAleha (alaihissalAma) le unIharUlAI bhane− timIharU allAhako kRpAbhandA pahile kina prakopako mAga garchau? allAhale mApha garnuhunecha bhanne AzAko sAtha uhA~sita AphnA pApaharUko kSamA kina mAgdainau?

47 tinIharUle bhane− timI ra timIsa~ga rahekA mominaharUlAI hAmIharU azubha mAnchauM | sAleha (alaihissalAma) le tinIharUlAI bhane− timIharU azubha mAneko hAni timIharUlAI nai pugnecha | allAhalAI yasako jJAna cha | uhA~bATa kunai pani kurA lukeko chaina | baru timIharUle pAiraheko bhalAI ra kaSTabATa timIharUko parIkSaNa gari~daicha |
48 hijra zaharamA 9 janA mAncheharU kuphra ra pApa garera AtaGka maccAune garthe | tinIharU ImAna lyAera ra satkarma garera sudhAra gardainathe |

49 tinIharUle paraspara sallAha gardai bhaneH hAmIharU kasama khAnchauM− hAmIharU ekasAtha rAtamA sAlehako ghara jAnechauM ra unako ra unakA parivArakA sadasyaharUko hatyA garnechauM | ani unako rakta-mUlyako dAbI garne abhibhAvakalAI bhannechauM: hAmIharUle sAleha ra unako parivArakA sadasyaharUko hatyA garekA hoinauM | hAmIharU satya boldaichauM |

50 tinIharUle sAleha (alaihissalAma) ra unakA momina anuyAyIharUlAI hatyA garne SaDyantra race ra hAmIle unIharUko maddata garne, jyAna jogAune ra kAphiraharUlAI sarvanAza garne yojanA banAyauM, yasa kurAko jAnakArI tinIharUle pAenan |
51 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) vicAra garnuhos− tinIharUko SaDyantrako ke kasto pariNAma bhayo? hAmIle tinIharUmAthi prakopa paThAera sarvanAza ra nirmUla pAridiyauM |

52 yI hun tinIharUkA gharaharU, jasakA parkhAlaharU tyasakA chAnAharUmAthi khasekA chan | tyasamA basneharU atyAcAra gareko kAraNale sakhApa bhaisakekA chan | tinIharUmAthi Aeko prakopamA mominaharUko lAgi pATha cha | unIharU nai nizAnIharUbATa pATha line garchan |
53 sAleha (alaihissalAma) ko samudAyakA mominaharUlAI hAmIle jogAyauM | unIharU allAhakA AdezaharUko pAlanA garera ra uhA~le manAhI garnubhaekA kAryaharUlAI tyAgera Izabhaya avalambana garekA thie |

54 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) lUta (alaihissalAma) lAI smaraNa garnuhos, jaba unale Aphno samudAyakA mAnisaharUlAI sambodhana gardai ra tinIharUko nindA ra ghRNA prakaTa gardai bhane− ke timIharU khullArUpamA eka arkAlAI herdai AphnA klabaharUmA puruSa-puruSabIca laiGgika sambandha kAyama garchau?!

55 ke timIharU mahilAsa~ga sahavAsa nagarera puruSasa~ga sahavAsa garchau?! timIharU na pavitratA cAhanchau na santAna; timIharU ta mAtra janAvara jastai kAma icchA pUrA garna cAhanchau | baru timIharUle pAlanA garnuparne ImAna, pavitratA ra duSkarma tyAgnu parne kAryaharUbAre kunai jJAna rAkhdainau |

56 unako samudAyako javApha mAtra yo thiyo− lUtakA anuyAyIharUlAI yasa gAu~bATa nikAla | yinIharU phoharaharUbATa baDo cokho banchan | tinIharUle yo kurA lUta (alaihissalAma) kA anuyAyIharUko ThaTTA gardai bhane | kinabhane unIharU tinIharUle garirAkhekA duSkarmamA bhAga li~daina thie baru ghRNA gardathe |

57 hAmIle lUta (alaihissalAma) ra unakA anuyAyIharUlAI tyasa prakopabATa surakSita rAkhyauM jo hAmIle unako samudAyamAthi paThAekA thiyauM | lUta (alaihissalAma) ko patnIlAI hAmIle tyasa prakopabATa bacAenauM baru tyasa prakopamA barbAda huna choDidiyauM |
58 hAmIle tinIharUmAthi AkAzabATa DhuGgA barsAyauM | prakopabATa DarAie pani na sudhriekA mAnisaraharUkA lAgi yo ati nai narAmro ra vinAzakArI varSA thiyo |

59 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! bhanidinuhos, sabai prazaMsA allAko lAgi jasale varadAna dinubhayo ra merA sAthIharUlAI tyasa kisimako prakopabATa surakSita rAkhnubhayo jasamA lUta ra sAleha (alaihimassalAma) kA samudAyaharU grasta bhae | ke vastavika pUjya ra samrATa allAha zreSTha hunuhuncha vA bahudevavAdIharUle pUjne garekA pUjyaharU, jo na ta kehI phAidA puryAuna sakchan na hAni nai?!

60 he mAnava ho! ke yasto allAhasa~ga anya kunai Izvara sAjhedAra hunasakcha jasale binA kunai pUrva namunA AkAzaharU ra pRthvI banAunubhayo, timIharUkA lAgi AkAzabATa pAnI barsAunubhayo ra tyasa varSAko pAnIbATa sundara bagai~cAharU umArnu bhayo | timIharU tI bagai~cAharUkA rUkhaharU umArne sAmarthya rAkhdainau?! yasto allAhasa~ga kohI sAjhedAra huna sakdaina | baru tinIharU satyabATa phirekA mAnisaharU hun jo atyAcAra gardai sRSTikartA ra sRSTiharUlAI ekasamAna banAu~daichan |

61 allAhale nai pRthvIlAI sthira banAunubhayo jasale gardA tyasamAthi rahekA vastuharU hallidainan | uhA~le nai tyasamA kalakala bagirahekA nadIharU ra sthira rahekA pahADaharU banAunubhayo ani samudrako nunilo tathA mITho bhAgabIca pardA banAunubhayo jasale gardA duvai kisimakA pAnI eka arkAmA misidainan, tAki mITho pAnI na bigros baru piune yogya rahos | ke yasto allAhasa~ga yI sabai banAune anya kohI sAjhedAra hunasakcha?! kadApi huna sakdaina, tara adhikAMsa mAnisaharU jAndainan | tinIharUle jAneko bhae sRSTiharUmadhye kasailAI allAhasa~ga sAjhedAra Thahara gardaina thie |

62 allAhale nai duHkhI mAnisaharUkA duHkhalAI samApta pArnuhuncha, rogI ra gariba mAnisaharUko saGkaTa samApta pArnuhuncha, dhartImA timIharUko eka pi~DhIlAI arko pi~DhIko vArisa banAunuhuncha | ke yasto allAhasa~ga yI sabai garne anya kohI sAjhedAra hunasakcha?! kadApi huna sakdaina | timIharUmadhye thoraile mAtra upadeza grahaNa garchau |

63 allAhale nai timIharUlAI thala tathA jalakA andhakAraharUmA vibhinna cinhaharU ra tArAharUbATa mArga dekhAunuhuncha | uhA~le nai varSAaghi varSAko zubha-sUcanA dine hAvA calAunuhuncha | allAhale yasa varSAdvArA bhaktaharUmAthi kRpA garnuhuncha | ke yasto allAhasa~ga yI sabai banAune anya kohI Izvara hunasakcha?! yinIharUle Thahara garekA sabai sAjhedAraharUbATa allAha pavitra hunuhuncha |

64 allAhale nai AmAko garbhamA vibhinna caraNaharUmA mAnavako sRSTi suru garnuhuncha, mRtyupachi uhA~le nai jIvita pArnuhunecha | uhA~ nai AkAzabATa varSA barsAera ra dhartIbATa bAlInAlI umArera jIvikA pradAna garnuhuncha | ke arU pani kohI pUjya Izvara cha jasale allAhasa~ga yI sabai garcha?! he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! yI bahudevavAdIharUlAI bhanidinuhos: timIharUle garirAkheko zirkako puSTiko lAgi pramANaharU peza gara yadi timIharU Aphno dAbImA saccA chau bhane |

65 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! bhanidinuhos− AkAzaharUmA rahekA phariztAharU ra dhartImA rahekA mAnava parokSako bAremA kehI jAndainan, allAhale mAtra parokSako bAremA mAtra jAnnuhuncha | hisAba kitAbako lAgi kahile punaH jIvita garinecha bhanne kurA mAtra allAhalAI thAhA cha | AkAzaharU ra pRthvImA raheko anya kohI pani jAndaina |
66 ke tinIharUsa~ga Akhiratako bAremA jJAna cha ki tyasamA tinIharU vizvAsa garun? chaina, baru tinIharU Akhiratako bAremA zaGkAmA hairAna chan | baru tinIharUko A~khA yasa bAremA andhA chan |
67 kAphiraharUle inkAra gardai bhane− ke tyatikhera hAmIharUlAI jIvita pArera uThAuna sambhava cha ra jaba hAmIharU marera mATo bhaihAlchauM?!

68 hAmIharU sabaiko punaH jIvita garinecha bhanne kurAko vAcA hAmIharUsa~ga pani gariyo ra hAmrA pUrvajaharUsa~ga pani gariyo, tara khoi ta, hAmro punaH janmako vAcA ta pUrA bhaena | yI jhUTA vAcAharU hun jasalAI vigatakA mAnisaharUle racera kitAbamA lekhekA chan |

69 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! punaH jIvita garine kurAlAI inkAra garneharUlAI bhannuhos− pRthvIko kunai pani bhAgamA hi~DaDula gara ani hera ta inkAra garne aparAdhIharUko pariNAma ke bhayo? inkAra gareko kAraNale hAmIle tinIharUko sarvanAza garyauM |
70 tapAIMko AhvAnabATa bahudevavAdIharU vimukha bhaemA cintA nagarnuhos | tinIharUko calakhelaprati tapAIMko chAtI saJkucita nahos | tinIharU viruddha allAhale tapAIMlAI maddata garnuhunecha |
71 punaH jIvita pArine kurAlAI inkAra garne kAphiraharU bhanchan: yadi tapAIM Aphno dAbImA saccA hunuhuncha bhane tapAIM ra momiminaharUle gareko prakopako vAcA kahile pUrA huncha?
72 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! bhanidinuhos, juna prakopako lAgi timIharU hatAra gardaichau, AzA cha tyasako kehI aMza cA~Dai nai Aunecha |

73 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! nissandeha tapAIMkA pAlanakartA mAnisaharUmAthi kRpA garnuhuncha ra tinIharUko kuphra ra avajJAkA bAvajuda sajAya dinamA hatAra garnuhunna | tara adhikAMsa mAnisaharU allAhakA varadAnaharUprati AbhAra vyakta gardainan |
74 nissandeha allAha bhaktaharUle manamA lukAekA ra prakaTa garekA kurAharU jAnnuhuncha, uhA~bATa kehI pani lukeko chaina | uhA~le cA~Dai nai yasako badalA dinuhunecha |
75 mAnisaharUbATa AkAza vA pRthvImA ojhela rahekA sampUrNa vastuharU euTA spaSTa kitAba lauhe mahaphUja (surakSita pATI) mA surakSita cha |
76 muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) mAthi avataraNa garieko kurAna tI adhikAMsa kurAharUlAI spaSTa pArcha jasako bAremA banI isrAIla vibheda garchan |
77 nissandeha kurAna ImAna lyAera satkarma garneharUkA lAgi mArgadarzana ra kRpA ho |

78 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! nissandeha tapAIMkA pAlanakartAle mahApralayako dina momina ra kAphirabIca nisAphakA sAtha nirNaya garnuhunecha | ani mominamAthi kRpA garnuhunecha ra kAphiralAI sajAya dinuhunecha | allAha prabhutvazAlI hunuhuncha, kohI pani uhA~mAthi vijayI huna sakdaina | uhA~ sarvajJa hunuhuncha, satyavAdI ra asatyavAdIbIca pharaka garnamA zaGkAmA parnuhunna |
79 ataH allAhamAthi bharosA garnuhos, AphnA sabai mAmilAharUmA uhA~mAthi bharosA garnuhos | nissandeha tapAIM spaSTa satyamA hunuhuncha |

80 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! tapAIM yastA mAnisaharUlAI sunAuna saknuhunna jasakA hRdaya allAhako inkArako kAraNale marisakekA chan | tapAIMle vimukha bhaekA mAnisaharUlAI pani Aphno AhvAna sunAuna saknuhunna jasako sunne kSamatAlAI allAhale bahirA banAunubhayo |

81 tapAIMle yastA mAnisaharUlAI sIdhA mArga dekhAuna saknuhunna jo nitAnta satya dekhnabATa andho bhaekA chan | yastA mAnisaharUko cintA nalinuhos ra AphUlAI thakita napArnuhos | tapAIMle yastA mAnisaharUlAI mAtra satya bujhAuna saknuhuncha jo hAmrA nizAnIharUmA vizvAsa garchan ra allAhakA AdezaharUprati samarpita chan |

82 mahApralaya najika Au~dA jaba duSTa mAnisaharU mAtra bacnechan jasalAI tinIharUko kuphra ra avajJAko kAraNale allAhako prakopale anivAryarUpamA samAtnecha taba hAmIle mahApralayako cinhasvarUpa yasto janAvaralAI nikAlnechauM jasale mAnisaharUsa~ga kurA garnecha ra mAnisaharUle usako kurAlAI bujhnechan | nissandeha kAphira mAnisaharU hAmrA nabI (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) mAthi avatarita nizAnIharUko puSTi garirahekA thienan |

83 he nabI (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! mahApralayako dinalAI smaraNa garnuhos, jaba hAmIle sabai samudAyaharUbATa hAmrA nizAnIharUko inkAra garekA ThUlA baDAharUko jamAtalAI bhelA garnechauM | tinIharUkA surukA mAnisaharUlAI antatarpha pharkAinecha ra sabailAI hisAba kitAbako lAgi laginecha |

84 tinIharUlAI nirantara hA~kera laginecha, jaba tinIharUko hisAbako sthAna Aunecha taba allAhale nindA gardai bhannuhunecha− ke timIharUle merA tI AyaharUko inkAra garyau, jasamA eka allAhako bhaktiko AhvAna thiyo ra jo mero kAnunamA AdhArita thie | yo asatya ho bhanne kurAko jJAna pani timIharUsa~ga thiena | tAki timIharU yasalAI jhUTo Thahara garna saka | timIharU yI nizAnIharUko puSTi gardai thiyau vA jhUTo Thahara gardaithiyau?

85 tinIharUle allAha ra uhA~kA nizAnIharUlAI jhUTo Thahara garera atyAcAra gareko kAraNale tinIharUmAthi prakopa avataraNa bhayo | tinIharUkA pramANaharU galata siddha bhaeko kAraNale Aphno bacAvako lAgi kehI bhanne avasthAmA hune chainan |

jaba tinIharUle punaH jIvita hune kurAlAI inkAra gare taba allAhale timIharUlAI punaH jIvita pArinecha bhanne kurAlAI tinIharUko sutne ra jAgne kAryabATa siddha garnubhayo | sutnu mRtyu ho ra jAgnu punaH jIvita hunu ho | allAhale bhannubhayo−
86 punaH jIvita garine kurAlAI inkAra garneharUle yasa kurAmA vicAra garenan, nissandeha hAmIle rAtalAI banAyauM tAki tinIharU tyasamA sutera ArAma garun | hAmIle dinalAI prakAzamaya banAyauM tAki tinIharU tyasamA herna sakun ra kAma kAjako lAgi bhAga dauDa garna sakun | nissandeha yasa paTaka paTakako mRtyu (nidrA) ra punaH jIvita hunu (jAgnu) mA ImAna lyAuneharUkA lAgi spaSTa nizAnIharU chan |

87 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! smaraNa garnuhos tyasa dinalAI juna dina sUra phukne phariztAle dosro paTaka zaGkhamA phuknecha | ani AkAzaharU ra pRthvImA bhaekA sRSTikA sabai cIjaharU DarAunechan, sivAya tI vastuharU jasalAI allAhale Aphno vizeSa kRpAbATa jogAunuhunecha | tyasa dina allAhakA sabai prANIharU AjJAkArI ra vivaza bhaera allAhakahA~ Aunechan |

88 tyasa dina tapAIMle sthira raheko pahADalAI bAdala jastai teja gatimA hi~Diraheko dekhnuhunecha, yasalAI allAhale banAunu bhaeko ho | allahale nai yasalAI hallAunuhuncha | timIharUle garirAkhekA kAryaharUsita uhA~ avagata hunuhuncha | timIharUko kunai pani kArya uhA~bATa lukeko chaina | uhA~le cA~Dai nai tyasako badalA dinuhunecha |
89 mahApralayako dina ImAna ra satkarma liera AuneharUkA lAgi svarga hunecha | unIharUlAI allAhale mahApralayako DarabATa surakSita rAkhnuhunecha |

90 kuphra ra pApa liera AuneharUlAI tyasa dina anuhArako balale ghisAri~dai narkamA phyAkinecha | tinIharUko nindA gardai ra tinIharUlAI apamAnita gardai bhaninecha− timIharUle saMsAramA garirAkhekA kuphra ra avajJAko sajAya mAtra timIharUlAI diinecha |

91 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! tinIharUlAI bhanidinuhos− hAmIlAI makkAkA pAlanakartAko mAtra bhaktiko Adeza mileko cha, jasalAI uhA~le pratiSThata banAunubhaeko cha | tyasamA ragata bagAidaina, tyasamA kasaimAthi atyAcAra garidaina, kunai zikAralAI mAridaina, tyahA~kA rUkhaharUlAI kATidaina, hareka vastumAthi uhA~kai sattA-zAsana cha | malAI yo Adeza pani mileko cha ki ekAgra bhaera mAtra allAhakai Adezako pAlanA garu~ |

92 ani malAI kurAnako paDhera mAnisaharUlAI sunAune Adeza bhaeko cha | ani jasale tyasakA zikSAbATa mArgadarzana prApta garcha ra tyasa anusAra karma garcha tyasako phAidA usailAI pugcha | pathabhraSTaharU kurAnako zikSAlAI mana parAu~dainan ra tyasa anusAra karma gardainan | tinIharUlAI ke bhannuhos bhane− ma saceta garneharU madhyeko hu~, timIharUlAI allAhako prakopabATa DarAu~dai tathA saceta gardaichu | timIharUko mArgadarzana mero hAtamA chaina |

93 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! bhanidinuhos, allAhakA anagintI varadAnaharUko kAraNa sabai prazaMsAharU uhA~kai lAgi hun | allAhale cA~Dai nai AphnA nizAnIharU timIharU bhitra pani dekhAunuhunecha ra AkAza, pRthvI tathA jIvikAmA pani dekhAunuhanecha | ani timIharUle tyasalAI jAnnechau ra tyasale gardA satmArga pAunechau | timIharUle garirAkhekA kAryaharUlAI allAha rAmrarI jAnnuhuncha | uhA~bATa kehI pani lukeko chaina | uhA~le tyasako badalA dinuhunecha |
1 (tA. sIna. mIma.) yastA akSaraharUko bAremA sUraha al-bakarahako ArambhamA varNana bhaisakeko cha |
2 yI spaSTa kurAnakA AyataharU hun |

3 hAmI tapAIM samakSa mUsA (alaihissalAma) ra phiraunakA satya kathA varNana gardaichauM | yasamA kunai zaGkA chaina | yo kathA ImAna lyAuneharUkA lAgi varNana gardaichauM, kinabhane yasabATa unIharU nai phAidA uThAunechan |

4 nissandeha phiraunale misrako bhUbhAgamA ghamaNDa garyo ra tyasamAthi kabjA jamAyo | tyahA~kA bAsindAharUlAI vibhinna guTamA vibhAjita garyo | tI guTaharUmadhye euTA guTa banI isrAIlalAI kamajora pAryo | phiraunale unIharUkA chorAharUlAI hatyA garthyo ra unIharUlAI apamAnita garna unakA chorIharUlAI sevAko lAgi jIvita choDne garthyo | nissandeha, U atyAcAra garne, ghamaNDI ra dhartImA AtaGka maccAuneharU madhyeko thiyo |

5 hAmIle banI isrAIlalAI misrako bhUbhAgamA unIharUkA zatruharUlAI sarvanAza pArera tathA unIharUkA kamajorIlAI samApta pArera prAthamiktA dine nIyata garyauM, jasalAI phiraunale kamajora pAreko thiyo | hAmIle unIharUlAI aguvA banAune nIyata garyauM, tAki unIharUle satyatarpha mArgadarzana garun | phiraunako vinAzapachi hAmIle tinIharUlAI sIriyAko bhUbhAgako vArisa banAune nIyata garyauM | jasarI allAhale bhannubhayo− hAmIle yastA mAnisaharUlAI barkata vAlA bhUbhAgakA vArisa banAyauM jo dhartIkA pUrva ra pazcimamA kamajora banAiekA thie |

6 hAmIle banI isrAIlalAI zAsaka banAera dhartImA sthApita garne nIyata garyauM | hAmIle phirauna ra usakA ThUlA sahayogI hAmAna ra tI duvaikA sainikaharUko sattA-zAsana banI isrAIlamA nayA~ janma lieko zizuko hAtabATa samApta pArne nIyata garyauM, jasako tinIharUlAI Dara thiyo |

allAhale phiraunako patana ra banI isrAIlako udayako bhaviSyavANIpachi mUsA (alaihissalAma) ko pAlana poSaNa dekhi uhA~lAI sandeSTA banAine ghaTanA kramako varNana gardai bhannubhaeko chaH
7 hAmIle mUsA (alaihissalAma) ko AmAko hRdayamA prakAzanA garyauM− unalAI stana pAna garAU | jaba phirauna ra usako samudAyale unalAI hatyA garnechan bhanne kurAko AzaGkA timIlAI huncha taba unalAI bAkasamA banda garera nIla nadImA hAli deU | unI nadImA Dubnechan vA phiraunale unako hatyA garnecha bhanne kurAko cintA naleU | vichoDako cintA pani nagara | hAmIle jIvita unalAI timro pAsamA nai pharkAunechauM | hAmIle unalAI rasUla banAera mAnisaharUtarpha paThAunechauM |

8 unakI AmAle hAmro Adezako pAlanA gardai unalAI bAkasamA rAkhera nIla nadImA hAlidiin | jaba phiraunakA mAnisaharUle unalAI phelA pAre taba unalAI uThAera lage | tAki allAhako yojanA pUrA hos | mUsA (alaihissalAma) tinIharUko zatru banera tinIharUko sattA-zAsanalAI samApta pArun ra tinIharUko cintAko viSaya banun | nissandeha phirauna, usako mantrI hAmAna ra usakA sahayogIharU kuphra, atyAcAra ra dhartImA AtaGka maccAera pApa gardai thie |

9 jaba phiraunale unako hatyA garne nIyata garyo taba usakI zrImatIle bhanin− yo zizule mero ra tapAIMko manalAI khuzI pArnecha, yasalAI namArnus, ki ta yasale hAmro sevA garera hAmIlAI phAidA puryAunecha ki ta hAmIle yasalAI dharmaputra banAunechauM | yahI zizu tinIharUko sattA-zAsanako patanako kAraNa bannecha bhanne kurA tinIharUlAI thAhA thiena |

10 mUsA (alaihissalAma) ko AmAko hRdaya sabai sAMsArika kurAharUbATa khAlI bhayo ra mAtra zizuko cintA lAgyo | dhairya garna gAhro bhayo | hAmIle unako hRdayalAI baliyo na banAidieko bhae unale zizuko kurA jAhera garne thiin | hAmIle dhairya pradAna gareko le unI allAhamAthi ImAna lyAune ra bharosA garnevAlA bhain |

11 mUsA (alaihissalAma) lAI nadImA hAlepachi unakI AmAle unako (musAko) didIlAI bhanin− unako pachi-pachi jAU ra hera unIsa~ga ke kasto huncha | unale ali TADhA rahera unako avalokana garin tAki zatruharUlAI thAhA nahos | unI mUsAkI didI hun ra unako bAremA pattA lagAu~daichin bhanera phirauna ra usako samudAyale thAhA pAenan |

12 allAhako yojanAle gardA mUsA (alaihissalAma) le Aphno AmA bAheka anya kunai pani mahilAko stana-pAna garenan | unalAI stana-pAna garAune unIharUko cAhanA dekhera unakI didIle bhanin− ke ma yasto parivArako bAremA nabatAU~ jasale unako stana-pAna ra rekhadekha rAmro tarikAle garnechan ra jo unako hitaiSI hos?

13 ani hAmIle mUsA (alaihissalAma) lAI unakI AmAtarpha pharkAyauM, tAki unalAI najikabATa dekhera unako A~khA zitala hos | unako bichoDako pIDA sahana garna naparos | unalAI vizvAsa hos ki unalAI unIsamma pharkAune allAhako vAcA satya ho, yasamA kunai zaGkA chaina | tara tinIharUmadhye adhikAMsalAI yasa vAcAbAre thAhA thiena | yI mahilA unakai AmA hun bhanne kurA unIharUmadhye kasailAI thAhA thiena |

allAhale mUsA (alaihissalAma) ko bAlyakAlako varNanapachi unako yauvana avasthAko varNana gardai bhannubhaeko chaH
14 jaba mUsA (alaihissalAma) yuvA avasthAmA puge ra unI zArIrika rUpamA paripakva bhae taba hAmIle unalAI nubuvvata pradAna garnuaghi buddhi ra banI isrAIlako dharmako jJAna pradAna garyauM | jasarI hAmIle mUsA (alaihissalAma) lAI unako AjJApAlanako badalA diyauM tyasarI nai hAmI hareka yuga ra sthAnamA sukarmIharUlAI badalA dine garchauM |

15 mUsA (alaihissalAma) yasto samayamA zahara praveza gare jaba mAnisaharU gharamA ArAma gardai thie | unale duI janAlAI ApasamA jhagaDA gardai ra eka arkAlAI kuTapiTa garirAkhekA pAe | ekajanA unako Aphnai samudAya banI isrAIlako thiyo bhane arko unako zatru kibtI phiraunako samudAyako thiyo | unako samudAyako vyaktile zatru viruddha maddata garna guhAre | mUsA (alaihissalAma) le zatrulAI eka mukkA hAne, jasale gardA zatru maryo | mUsA (alaihissalAma) le bhane− yo zaitAnako bahakAvAle bhayo | nissandeha zaitAna spaSTa zatru ho, jo AphnA anuyAyIharUlAI pathabhraSTa pArcha | maile je jati gareM zaitAnakai bahakAvAle gareM |

16 mUsA (alaihissalAma) le Aphno galtI svIkAra gardai prArthanA gare− he merA pAlanakartA! maile kibtIko hatyA garera AphUmAthi atyAcAra gareko chu, mero pApalAI mApha garnuhos, ani allAhale mUsA (alaihissalAma) lAI mApha garnubhayo | nissandeha uhA~ taubA garne bhaktaharUlAI mApha garnuhuncha ra unIharUmAthi dayA garnuhuncha |

17 mUsA (alaihissalAma) le thapa duA gare− he pAlanakartA! tapAIMle malAI zakti, viveka ra jJAna pradAna garera juna kRpA garnubhayo tyasale gardA ma kadApi aparAdhIharUko aparAdhamA sahayogI banne chaina |

18 kibtIko hatyA bhaepachi mUsA (alaihissalAma) zaharamA Darale saceta bhaera hi~Dna thAle, yo hernako lAgi ki aba ke huncha | hijo juna vyaktile maddata mAgeko thiyo usale Aja arko kibtIko viruddha maddatako lAgi guhAra garyo | mUsA (alaihissalAma) le bhane− nissandeha timI pathabhraSTa ra jhagaDAlu vyakti hau |

19 jaba mUsA (alaihissalAma) le kibtIlAI hirkAune nIyata gare taba isrAIlI vyaktile ke ThAnyo bhane unI malAI hirkAuna khojdaichan, kinabhane unale malAI pathabhraSTa bhanekA chan | ani usale bhanyo− ke Aja tapAIM malAI mArna cAhanuhuncha, jasarI tapAIMle hijo ekajanAlAI mArnubhayo | tapAIM mAnisaharUlAI mArera tathA unIharUmAthi atyAcAra garera yasa dhartImA prabhutva jamAuna cAhanuhuncha | tapAIM duI janA jhagaDA garneharUbIca samjhautA garAuna cAhanuhunna |

20 jaba yo samAcAra dezamA phailiyo taba ekajanA hitaiSI dagurdai mUsA (alaihissalAma) najika Ae ra unalAI sUcita gare− he mUsA! sattAdhArIharU tapAIMlAI mArna sallAha gardaichan, tapAIM yahA~bATa bhAgera arko deza palAyana garnuhos | tinIharUle tapAIMlAI pAemA hatyA garnechan |

21 mUsA (alaihissalAma) le hitaiSI vyaktiko kurAko pAlanA gardai saceta bhaera tyahA~bATa bhAge | unale allAhasita prArthanA gardai bhane− he merA pAlanakartA! malAI atyAcArI mAnisaharUbATa jogAunuhos | tinIharUle malAI kunai hAni napuryAun |
22 mUsA (alaihissalAma) madayanatarpha jA~dai bhane− AzA cha mero pAlanakartAle malAI bhalAiko mArga dekhAunuhunecha, ma tyasa bATobATa pathabhraSTa hune chaina |

23 jaba mUsA (alaihissalAma) madayanako InArasamma puge taba euTA samUhale AphnA janAvaraharUlAI pAnI khuvAu~dai gareko pAe ra duI janA mahilAharUle AphnA bheDAbAkhrAharUlAI pAnI khAnabATa rokdai gareko pAe | mUsA (alaihissalAma) le unIharUlAI sodhe− timIharU kina arU mAnisaharUsa~ga janAvaraharUlAI pAnI khuvAi rahekA chainau? duvai mahilAle bhane− hAmI sadhaiM yastai garchauM, mAnisaharU AphnA janAvaraharUlAI pAnI khuvAepachi mAtra hAmI pAnI khuvAu~chauM | para puruSaharUsa~ga TADhA rahana hAmI yasto garchauM | hAmrA buvA buDho hunuhuncha, bheDAbAkhrAharUlAI pAnI khuvAune avasthAmA hanuhunna, tyasaile bAdhya bhaera hAmIharU nai pAnI khuvAu~chauM |

24 mUsA (alaihissalAma) le unIharUmAthi dayA gardai unIharUkA bheDAbAkhrAharUlAI pAnI khuvAidie | pheri rUkhamuni chAyA~tarpha gaera ArAma gare ra Aphno AvazyaktA allAha samakSa rAkhdai duA gare− he merA pAlanakartA! juna sukai bhalAi tapAIMle malAI pradAna garnuhunecha ma tyasako AvazyaktAmA chu |

25 ghara pharkepachi duvai janA mahilAle mUsA (alaihissalAma) ko bAremA buvAlAI sUcita gare, ani buvAle euTI chorIlAI unalAI bolAuna paThAe | mahilA lajAu~dai unI samakSa Aina ra bhanin− mero buvA tapAIMlAI bolAu~dai hunuhuncha tAki tapAIMle hAmrA bheDAbAkhrAharUlAI pAnI khuvAe bApata pArizramika pradAna garun | unIharUkA buvAkahA~ pugepachi mUsA (alaihissalAma) le AphnA sabai kurAharU bhane | unale mUsA (alaihissalAma) lAI sAntvanA diMdai bhane− aba naDarAU, timI phiraunako atyAcArI samudAyabATa mukti pAisakekAchau | madayanamA tinIharUko rAja caldaina, tyasaile tinIharU timIlAI kunai hAni puryAuna sakdainan |

26 unako euTI chorIle bhanin− he buvA! unalAI bheDAbAkhrAko rekhadekhako lAgi pArizramika diera rAkhihAlnus | unI balavAna pani chan ra imAnadAra pani | unale Aphno balale Aphno jimmAko kAma garnechan ra Aphno imAnadArIle nAsoko surakSA garnechan |

27 unIharUkA buvAle mUsA (alaihissalAma) lAI bhane− ma timro bihe AphnI duI vaTI chorIharUmadhye euTIsa~ga garAuna cAhanchu | yasako mahara ke huncha bhane timI ATha varSasamma merA bheDAharUko heracAha gara | yadi timIle dasa varSasamma bheDAko heracAha garchau bhane yo timrotarphabATa thapa sevA hunecha, timImAthi yo anivArya chaina | kinabhane hAmIharUbIca samjhautA ATha varSako cha | yasa bAheka timIle jati sevA garchau tyo ecchika hunecha | ma baDhI jimmevArI diera timIlAI apThyAromA pArna cAhanna | inzA allAha timIle malAI satkarmI, vacanako pAlanA garneharUmadhye pAunechau |

28 mUsA (alaihissalAma) le bhane− yo mero ra tapAIMko bIca samjhautA bhayo | yI duvai avadhiharUmadhye juna sukai avadhi bitAunechu, ATha varSa vA dasa varSa, maile Aphno jimmevArI pUrA garnechu | yasabhandA baDhIko mAga nagarnu holA | hAmIbIca bhaeko samjhautAko sAkSI tathA nirikSaka allAha hunuhuncha |

29 jaba mUsA (alaihissalAma) le dasa varSako avadhi pUrA gare taba Aphno parivAralAI madayanabATa liera misratarpha prasthAna gare | bATomA tUra pahADatarpha AgolAI dekhepachi parivAralAI bhane− timIharU yahI~ parkha, maile Ago dekheko chu, AzA cha ma tyahA~bATa kunai samAcAra liera Au~chu vA Agoko agulTo liera Au~chu, jasalAI tApera timIharUko jADo bhAgnecha |

30 jaba mUsA (alaihissalAma) tyasa Ago najika Ae taba unalAI allAhale tyasako dAhinetarphako barkata yukta upatyakAmA raheko rUkhabATa pukArnubhayo− he mUsA! ma sabai sRSTiharUkA pAlanakartA allAha hu~ |

31 timI Aphno laurolAI phyA~ka | mUsA (alaihissalAma) le allAhako Adezako pAlanA gardai lauro phyA~ke | jaba unale laurolAI sarpa jastai ghisriraheko dekhe taba DarAera bhAge ra pharkera herenan | allAhale pukArera bhannubhayo− he mUsA! pharka ra yasabATa naDarAU | timI yasabATa pani ra anya kurAharUbATa pani surakSita rahanechau |

32 Aphno dAhine hAta chAtImA (gojI) hAlera nikAla, tyo seto camkilo bhaera niskanecha tara tyo kuSTharoga hoina | mUsA (alaihissalAma) le hAta hAlera nikAlepachi tyo hiu~ jasto seto bhaera niskiyo | Aphno hAta AphUsa~ga milAU, timro Dara bhAgnecha | mUsA (alaihissalAma) le bAhulA AphUtarpha milAu~dA unako Dara harAyo | lauro ra hAta yI duvai allAhako tarphabATa camatkAra hun, jasalAI liera phirauna ra usakA sahayogIharUtarpha jAU, tinIharU kuphra ra avajJA garera allAhako AjJApAlanabATa haTekA chan |

33 mUsA (alaihissalAma) le allAhalAI bhane− maile tinIharUmadhye eka janAko hatyA gareko thie~ | yadi ma yo sandeza liera tinIharUkahA~ jAnchu bhane tinIharUle mero hatyA garnechan bhanne malAI Dara cha |

34 mero dAju hArUna mabhandA baDhI spaSTa bolchan, unalAI mero sahayogI banAera paThAunus | tAki phirauna ra usako samudAyale jhUTo Thahara garemA unale mero kurAko puSTi garun | tinIharUle malAI jhUTo Thahara garnechan bhanne malAI Dara cha, jasto ki vigatakA samudAyaharUle mabhandA aghikA rasUlaharUlAI jhUTo Thahara gardai AekA chan |

35 allAhale mUsA (alaihissalAma) ko duAlAI svIkAra gardai bhannubhayoH ma timro dAju hArUna (alaihissalAma) lAI rasUla banAera paThAunechu | unalAI timro lAgi pramANa ra sahayogI banAunechu | hAmIle timIlAI camatkAra pradAna garekole tinIharUle timIharU duvai janA ra timrA momina anuyAyIharUlAI kunai hAni puryAuna sakne chainan |
36 jaba mUsA (alaihissalAma) spaSTa camatkAraharU liera tinIharUkahA~ puge taba tinIharUle bhaneH yo unale AphaiM raceko kurA ho | hAmIle aghillA pUrvajaharUmA yo kurA pAenauM |

37 mUsA (alaihissalAma) le phiraunalAI sambodhana garera bhane− mArgadarzana liera Aeko satyavAdIlAI ra AkhiratamA saphala hunelAI mero pAlanakartA allAhale rAmrosa~ga jAnnuhuncha | atyAcArIharU Aphno yojanAmA saphala huna sakdainan ra yAtanAbATa bacna sakdainan |

38 phiraunale AphnA sahayogIharUlAI sambodhana garera bhanyoH he merA sahayogIharU ho! ma bAheka anya kohI pUjya Izvara chan bhanne kurA ma jAndina | he hAmAna! mATolAI tatAera IMTA banAU, ani tyasabATa ucca bhavana banAU, tAki ma mUsA (alaihissalAma) ko pUjya IzvaralAI dekhna saku~ ra cinna saku~ | malAI vizvAsa cha unI Aphno yasa dAbImA jhUTA chan ki unI allAhako tarphabATa ma ra mero samudAyatarpha rasUla banAiera paThAiekA hun |

39 phirauna ra usakA sainikaharUko ghamaNDamA jhana vRddhi bhayo ra tinIharUle binA adhikAra misrako bhUbhAgamA Aphno niyantraNa jhana baDhAe | tinIharUle mRtyu pazcAt punaH jIvita hune kurAlAI inkAra gare | tinIharU mahApralayako dina hisAba kitAbako lAgi hAmItarpha pharkera Aune chainan bhanne ThAne |

40 ani hAmIle phirauna ra usakA sainikaharUlAI samAtyauM ra samudramA hAlera curlumma DubAidiyauM, ani tI sabai sarvanAza bhae | he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! vicAra garnuhos kasto bhayo atyAcArIharUko pariNAma |

41 hAmIle kuphra ra pathabhraSTatA phailAera narkatarpha bolAunelAI atyAcArI ra pathabhraSTaharUko lAgi aguvA banAidiyauM | mahApralayako dina tinIharUle eka arkAlAI narkabATa jogAera maddata garne chainan baru tinIharUle narAmro tarikA phailAekAle tinIharUko yAtanAmA vRddhi garinecha | tinIharUle pathabhraSTatAtarpha AhvAna garekAle tinIharU Aphno pApako bojha pani uThAunechan ra AphnA anuyAyIharUko bojha pani uThAunechan | kinabhane tinIharUle tinIharUko dekhAsikI garekA hunechan |
42 hAmIle lokamA pani tinIharUko apamAna garera tinIharUko sajAyamA vRddhi garyauM ra mahApralayako dina pani tinIharU nindA garineharUmadhye ra allAhako kRpAbATa TADhA pArineharUmadhye hunechan |

43 hAmIle mUsA (alaihissalAma) lAI taurAta pradAna garyauM | hAmIle vigatamA vibhinna rasUlaharUlAI vibhinna samudAyaharU samakSa paThAyauM, tara tinIharUle jhUTo Thahara gare | tinIharUle jhUTo Thahara garekAle hAmIle tinIharUlAI sarvanAza pAryauM | yasakA rAmrA pakSaharUlAI jAnera mAnisaharU phAidA uThAu~chan ra narAmrA pakSaharUkA hAni puryAune kurAharUlAI tyagchan | yasamA bhalAitarpha mArgadarzana cha, loka ra paralokakA bhalAimA AdhArita kRpA chan tAki tinIharUle varadAnaharUlAI yAda garun, tyasako lAgi allAhaprati AbhAra vyakta garun ra allAhamAthi ImAna lyAun |

44 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! tyatikhera pahADako pazcimatarpha tapAIMko upasthitI thiena jaba hAmIle mUsA (alaihissalAma) lAI phirauna ra usakA sahayogIharUtarpha jAne Adeza diekA thiyauM | tapAIMko upasthitI tyahA~ nabhaekole tyasako bAremA mAnisaharUlAI AphaiM batAuna asambhava thiyo | tapAIM je jati batAu~dai hunuhuncha tyo allAhako tarphabATa prApta vahI (prakAzanA) ko AdhAramA batAu~dai hunuhuncha |

45 hAmIle mUsA (alaihissalAma) pachi dherai samudAya ra prANIharU sRSTi garyau | lAmo samaya bitekole allAhasa~ga garekA vAcAharUlAI tinIharUle birse | tapAIM madayana bAsIharUbIca pani basnu bhaena, tara tinIharUko bAremA tapAIM batAu~dai hunuhuncha | kinabhane tapAIMlAI hAmIle rasUla banAyauM ra vahI (IzavANI) garera mUsA (alaihissalAma) ko bAremA batAyauM ki unI madayanamA basobAsa gare | tapAIMle mAnisaharUlAI junasukai kurAharU batAunubhayo allAhako tarphabATa avatarita vahIko AdhAramA batAunubhayo |

46 tapAIMko upasthitI tUra pahADako cheumA pani thiena jaba hAmIle mUsA (alaihissalAma) lAI pukAryauM ra unItarpha vahI paThAyauM− tapAIM mAnisaharUlAI sUcita garnuhos | hAmIle nai tapAIMlAI kRpA garera rasUla banAyauM ra yI kurAharU vahI garyauM, tAki tapAIMle tI mAnisaharUlAI khabaradAra garnuhos jo samakSa tapAIMaghi kunai rasUla Aena | tapAIM tinIharUlAI DarAunuhos, tAki tinIharUle pATha sikun ra tapAIMle allAhako tarphabATa lyAeko kurAmAthi ImAna lyAun |

47 tinIharUkA kuphra ra avajJAko kAraNale tinIharUmAthi allAhako prakopa Aeko bhae tinIharUle hAmIharU samakSa rasUla Aenan bhanne kurA garera tarka dine thie ra bhanne thie− he hAmrA pAlanakartA! hAmIharUtarpha kina rasUla paThAunubhaena tAki hAmIharUle tapAIMkA nizAnIharUko anusaraNa garne thiyauM ra tyasa anusAra karma garne thiyauM | tinIharUle yo tarka peza nagareko bhae hAmIle cA~Dai nai prakopa paThAune thiyauM | tara hAmIle cA~Dai prakopa paThAenauM | baru pahilA rasUla paThAyauM tAki tinIharUsa~ga kunai bahAnA narahos |

48 jaba muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) rasUla banAiepachi kuraiza samakSa Aunubhayo taba yahUdIharUle bhaneko kurAlAI tinIharUle pramANa banAu~dai sodhe− muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) lAI ‘hAta’ ra ‘lauro’ jastA camatkAraharU kina pradAna gariena juna camatkAraharU mUsA (alaihissalAma) lAI pradAna garieko thiyo | he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! tinIharUko khaNDana gardai bhaniduhos− ke yahUdIharUle mUsA (alaihissalAma) lAI pradAna gariekA camatkAraharUko inkAra garenan ra taurAta ra kurAnako bAremA bhanenan− yI duvai jAdU hun jo eka arkAko puSTi gardacha ra hAmIharU taurAta ra kurAna duvaiko inkAra gardachauM?!

49 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! yinIharUlAI bhanidinuhos− yadi timIharU Aphno yasa dAbImA saccA chau ki yI duvai jAdU hun, timIharU allAhako tarphabATa kunai kitAba lyAera dekhAU, jo kurAna ra taurAtabhandA baDhI mArgadarzana hos, ma tyasako anusaraNa garnechu |

50 yadi kuraiza kurAna ra taurAtabhandA baDhI mArgadarzana garne kitAba lyAuna sakdainan bhane jAnirAkha tinIharU binA pramANa kurAna ra taurAtalAI jhUTA Thahara gardaichan | mAtra icchAko anusaraNamA jhUTo Thahara gardaichan | allAhako mArgadarzanalAI choDera icchAko anusaraNa garneharUbhandA baDhI arU kohI pathabhraSTa huna sakdainan | allAhalAI inkAra garera AphUmAthi atyAcAra garneharUlAI allAhale sIdhA mArga dekhAunuhunna |

51 hAmIle bahudevavAdI ra yahUdIharUlAI vigatakA samudAyaharUkA satya kathAharU batAyauM | tinIharUle rasUlaharUlAI jhUTA Thahara gare pani hAmIle prakopa paThAenauM, yasa AzAkA sAtha ki tinIharUle pATha sikera ImAna lyAunechan |

52 kurAnako avataraNaaghi juna ahale kitAbaharU taurAtamAthi ImAna lyAe tinIharUle kurAnako avataraNapachi yasamAthi pani ImAna lyAe | kinabhane unIharUle AphnA kitAbaharUmA kurAnako bAremA sUcanA ra yasako prazaMsA pAekA thie |

53 jaba tinIharU samakSa kurAnako pATha gariyo taba tinIharUle bhane− hAmIle yasamA ImAna lyAyauM | yo satya ho ra yasamA kunai sandeha chaina | yo hAmrA pAlanakartAko tarphabATa avataraNa garieko ho | hAmIharU yasa kurAnako avataraNaaghi pani rasUlaharUle lyAekA sandezamAthi ImAna rAkheko kAraNale muslima thiyauM |

54 yastA ahale kitAbaharUlAI hAmIle duI guNA pratidAna dinechauM, kinabhane unIharUle Aphno kitAbamAthi pani ImAna rAkhe ra muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) ko Agamanapachi uhA~mAthi pani ImAna lyAe | unIharU satkarmaharU garera AphnA pApaharUlAI meTAu~chan | hAmIle pradAna garekA jIvikA bhalAiko kAryamA kharca garchan |

55 yI mominaharU ahale kitAbabATa kunai narAmro kurA sunepachi tyasalAI najara andAja garchan | AphnA sAthIharUlAI sambodhana garera bhanchan− hAmrA lAgi hAmrA karmaharUko pratidAna ra timIharUkA lAgi timIharUkA karmaharUko pratidAna cha | hAmro tarphabATa timIharUle kunai gAlI ra kaSTa pAune chainau | hAmI ajJAnIharUsa~ga hela mela cAhannauM, kinabhane tinIharU sAMsArika ra dhArmika mAmilAmA kaSTa dinchan |

56 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! tapAIMle jasalAI cAhanuhuncha usalAI mArgadarzana garna saknuhunna, jastai abU tAliba ityAdi | allAhale jasalAI cAhanuhuncha usalAI mAtra mArgadarzana garnuhuncha | kasale sIdhA mArga pAunecha bhanne kurA allAhale Aphno pUrva jJAnako AdhAramA jAnnuhuncha |

57 makkAkA bahudevavAdIharUle bahAnA gardai bhane− yadi hAmIharU islAma dharmalAI svIkAra garchauM bhane zatruharUle cA~Dai nai hAmIharUbATa hAmro bhUmilAI khosne chan | ke hAmIle yI bahudevavAdIharUlAI haramamA sthApita garenauM jahA~ raktapAta ra atyAcAra harAma garieko cha | jahA~ tinIharU AkramaNabATa surakSita chan ra hAmro tarphabATa sabai kisimakA phalaphUlaharU jIvikAko rUpamA pAu~daichan | tara tinIharUmadhye adhikAMsa allAhakA varadAnalAI jAndainan ra tyasako lAgi allAhaprati AbhAra vyakta gardainan |

58 adhikAMsa bastIharU jasale allAhakA varadAnako inkAra gare ra khubai pApa gare, hAmIle prakopa paThAera tI sabailAI sarvanAza pAryauM | yI tinIharUkA sakhApa pAriekA gharaharU hun jasako cheubATa mAnisaharU hi~Dne garchan | tyahA~ kehI AvatajAvata garneharU bAheka kasaile basobAsa garekA chainan | hAmI nai AkAzaharU, pRthvI ra yI duvaimA rahekA sabai vastuharUkA vArisa hauM |

59 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! jabasamma hAmIle bastIharU madhyeko pramukha bastImA rasUla paThAera satya tathya pramANita gardainauM tabasamma tI bastIlAI sarvanAza gardainauM | jasarI hAmIle tapAIMlAI makkAmA paThAyauM jo sampUrNa gAu~ ra bastIharUko kendra ho | jabasamma gAu~ bAsIharU satyamA kAyama rahanchan tabasamma hAmI tyasalAI sarvanAza gardainauM | jaba tinIharU kuphra ra avajJA garera atyAcAra garchan taba hAmI tinIharUlAI sarvanAza garchauM |

jaba bahUdevavAdIharUle bahAnA gare− yadI hAmIharU satyako anusaraNa garchauM bhane hAmIharUlAI yuddhako sAmanA garnuparcha ra vyApArabATa vaJcita garinechauM taba allAhale javAphamA bhannubhayo−
60 sAMsArika jIvanamA allAhale je jati dhana-sampatti pradAna garnubhaeko cha jasabATa tImIharU lAbha uThAu~daichau ra banAva siGgAra gardaichau tI sabai eka dina samApta hunecha | AkhiratamA allAhakahA~ raheko mahAn pratidAna sAMsArika dhana-sampatti ra saundarya bhandA uttama pani cha sadA sarvadA rahane pani cha | ke timIharU buddhi ra vivekabATa kAma li~dainau jasale gardA kSaNikalAI sadhai~ rahanemAthi prAthamikatA dinchau?!

61 jasalAI hAmIle AkhiratamA svarga ra tyasakA varadAnako vAcA garekAchauM, jahA~ U avazya praveza garne cha | ke tyo mAnisa saraha hunasakcha jasalAI hAmIle sAMsArika dhana-sampatti pradAna garekAchauM tara U mahApralayako dina narkamA hAlineharU madhyeko hunecha?!
62 tyasa dina allAhale pukArera sodhnuhunecha− kahA~ chan malAI choDera timIle pUjne garekA tI pUjyaharU ani unIharU merA sAjhedAra hun bhanera dAbI garthyau?

63 kuphratarpha AhvAna garneharU jasamAthi mero yAtanA anivArya bhayo, unIharUle bhannechan− he hAmrA pAlanakartA! yI hun jasalAI hAmIle pathabhraSTa pAryauM ra hAmIharU pani pathabhraSTa bhayauM | tapAIM samakSa hAmIle yinIharUsa~ga kunai sarokAra nabhaeko ghoSaNA garchauM vAstavamA, yinIharUle hAmro pUjA gardainathe baru zaitAnako pUjA garne garthe |

64 tinIharUlAI bhaninecha− timIharU juna apamAnamA chau tyasabATa jogAunako lAgi tI pUjyaharUlAI bolAU, jasalAI timIharU allAhasa~ga sAjhedAra Thahara garekA thiyau | tinIharUle tI pUjyaharUlAI pukArnechan tara tinIharUle kunai javApha dine chainan | tinIharUle Aphno lAgi tayAra yAtanAlAI dekhnechan | tinIharUle saMsAramA satya mArga avalambana garekA bhae kati uttama hunethiyo bhanne kurAko kAmanA garnechan |
65 tyasa dina allAhale tinIharUlAI pukArera bhannuhunecha− maile timIharUtarpha paThAekA rasUlaharUlAI timIharUle ke javApha diyau?
66 tinIharU sabai tarkaharU birsinechan, kunai javApha dina saknechainan | tinIharU yAtanAmA parnechan bhanne kurAko tinIharUlAI yakIna bhaekole tinIharU eka arkAlAI sodhne pani chainan |

67 yI bahudevavAdIharUmadhye jasale Aphno kuphrabATa taubA (pazcAttApa) gare, allAha tathA uhA~kA rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) mAthi ImAna lyAe ra satkarma gare; AzA cha unIharUle cAhanA garekA kurAharU pAunechan ra mana naparAekA kurAharUbATa bacnechan |

68 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! allAha je cAhanuhuncha sRSTi garnuhuncha ra jasalAI cAhanuhuncha Aphno AjJApAlana ra IzadUtatvako lAgi cayana garnuhuncha | bahudevavAdIharUlAI allAhamAthi TikA-TippaNi garne kunai adhikAra chaina | tinIharU allAhasa~ga juna pUjyaharUlAI sAjhedAra Thahara garera pUjA garchan tyasabATa uhA~ ati ucca ra pavitra hunuhuncha |
69 tinIharUle AphnA manamA lukAekA ra vyakta garekA kurAharUbATa allAha avagata hunuhuncha | uhA~bATa kehI pani lukeko chaina | uhA~le tyasako badalA dinuhunecha |

70 allAha pavitra hunuhuncha, uhA~ bAheka kohI pani vAstavika pUjya huna sakdaina | uhA~ kai lAgi lokamA pani prazaMsA cha ra paralokamA pani | uhA~ko nIti avazya nai lAgU hunecha, kohI pani tyasalAI rokna sakdaina | mahApralayako dina timIharU uhA~tarpha nai hisAba-kitAba ra badalAko lAgi pharkAera laginechau |

71 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! yI bahudevavAdIharUlAI bhanidinuhos− malAI batAU, yadi allAhale mahApralayasamma sadhaiMko lAgi rAta banAeko bhae, kohI cha allAha bAheka timIharUko pUjya jasale ujyAlo dina lyAuna sakos?! ke timIharU yI pramANaharU sundainau ra yo kurA jAndainau ki allAha bAheka kohI pani ujyAlo dina lyAuna sakdaina?!

72 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! yI bahudevavAdIharUlAI bhanidinuhos− malAI batAU, yadi allAhale mahApralayasamma sadhaiMko lAgi dina banAunuhuncha bhane cha kohI allAha bAheka timIharUko pUjya jasale rAta lyAuna sakos jasamA timIharU ArAma garchau?! ke timIharU yI nizAnIharU dekhdainau ra yo kurA jAndainau ki allAha bAheka kohI pani ujyAlo dina lyAuna sakdaina?!

73 he mAnava! allAhakA kRpAharUmadhye ho ki uhA~le timIharUkA lAgi andhyAro rAta banAunubhayo tAki tyasamA timIharU dinako thakAi mArna ArAma gara | uhA~le timIharUkA lAgi ujyAlo dina banAunubhayo tAki timIharU tyasamA jIvikAko khojiko lAgi bhAga dauDa garna saka | tAki timIharU allAhakA varadAnaharUkA lAgi uhA~prati AbhAra vyakta gara ra baigunI nabana |
62 tyasa dina allAhale pukArera sodhnuhunecha− kahA~ chan malAI choDera timIle pUjne garekA tI pUjyaharU ani unIharU merA sAjhedAra hun bhanera dAbI garthyau?

75 hAmIle tyasa dina pratyeka samudAyabATa usakA rasUlalAI hAjira garnechauM jasale Aphno samudAya viruddha gavAhI dinechan ki kasarI tinIharUle inkAra gare ra jhUTo Thahara gare | hAmIle tI samudAyaharUkA jhUTA Thahara garneharUlAI bhannechauM− timIharUle gareko kuphra ra jhUTo Thahara gareko pramANa prastuta gara | tinIharU pramANa prastuta garna asaphala hunechan ra tinIharU vizvAsa garnechan− satya allAhakai lAgi cha | tinIharUle allAhako lAgi racekA sAjhedAraharU harAune chan |

allAhale sattAko kAraNale phiraunako ghamaNDako varNana garepachi dhana-sampattiko kAraNale kArUnamA Aeko ghamaNDako varNana gardai bhannubhaeko chaH
76 nissandeha kArUna mUsA (alaihissalAma) ko samudAyamadhye thiyo tara usale tinIharUmAthi ghamaNDa garyo | hAmIle usalAI yati sampatti diekA thiyauM jasako sA~cAharU euTA baliyo jamAtale uThAune garthyau | jaba yasako samudAyaharUle bhane− ghamaNDa nagara | allAha ghamaNDa garneharUlAI mana parAunuhunna, baru kodhrita hunuhuncha ra yAtanA dinuhuncha |

77 allAhale pradAna garnubhaeko dhana-sampattilAI allAhako mArgamA kharca garera Akhiratako lAgi puNya prApta gara | sAMsArika khAna, pina, lugA phATA ityAdimA kharca garna pani nabirsa | tyasamA anAvazyaka pani nagara ra kanjusyAi~ pani nagara | allAha ra uhA~kA bhaktaharUsa~ga rAmro vyavahAra gara, kinabhane allAhale timImAthi kRpA garnubhayo | allAhako avajJA garera ra uhA~ko AjJApAlanalAI tyAgera dhartImA AtaGka namaccAU | allAhale dhartImA AtaGka maccAuneharUlAI mana parAunuhunna, baru krodha prakaTa garnuhuncha |

78 kArUnale javApha diyo− yI dhana-sampatti malAI mero jJAna ra sAmarthyale gardA prApta bhaeko cha | ma yasako hakadAra chu | ke kArUnalAI thAhA chaina nissandeha allAhale yasaaghi vibhinna samudAyaharUlAI sarvanAza pArnubhayo jo UbhandA baDhI zaktizAlI thie ra baDhI dhana-sampatti jammA garekA thie?! tara tinIharUlAI tinIharUkA zakti ra dhana-sampattile kunai phAidA puryAena | kayAmatako dina aparAdhIharUlAI tinIharUko aparAdhako bAremA sodhine chaina kinabhane tinakA aparAdhako bAremA allAhalAI rAmrarI jAnakArI cha | tasartha tinIharUlAI hapkAuna ra nindA garnako lAgi sodhinecha |

79 eka dina kArUna ThA~TabA~TakA sAtha niskyo | kArUnakA sAthIharUmadhye sAMsArika dhana-sampatti mana parAuneharUle bhane− kArUna jastai hAmIharUlAI pani dhana-sampatti prApta bhaeko bhae kati rAmro hunthyo | nissandeha kArUna ati bhAgyazAlI cha |

80 tara jJAnI mAnisaharUle jaba kArUnalAI ThA~TabA~TakA sAtha niskadai gareko dekhera usakA sAthIharUle gareko kAmanAlAI sune taba bhane− timIharUko barabAdI hos! AkhiratamA milne allAhako varadAna ra uhA~le ImAna lyAera satkarma garne vyaktikA lAgi tayAra pArnubhaeko varadAna tI sAMsArika dhana-sampattibhandA uttama chan, jo kArUnalAI diieko cha | yo kurA bhanne ra satkarma garne avasara tI dhairya dhAraNa garneharUlAI mAtra prApta huncha jo allAhakahA~ raheko puNyalAI kSaNika sAMsArika dhana-sampattibhandA baDhI mahattva dinchan |

81 hAmIle kArUnalAI usako ghara, tyasamA rahekA sabai mAnisa ra sampattisameta usako atyAcArako sajAyasvarUpa dhartImA dhasAidiyauM | nata mAnisaharUko samUhale usalAI maddata garyo na usale svayam Aphno maddata garna sakyo |

82 juna mAnisaharUle dhana-sampatti ra ThA~TabA~TakAko kAmanA garekA thie, kArUnalAI dhartImA dhasAiepachi pachuto gardai ra pATha sikdai bhanna thAle− hAmIharUlAI thAhA thiena− allAhale AphnA bhaktaharUmadhye jasalAI cAhanuhuncha anagintI jIvikA pradAna garnuhuncha ra jasalAI cAhanuhuncha thorai jIvikA pradAna garnuhuncha?! yadi allAhako kRpA nabhaeko bhae uhA~le hAmIharUle bhaneko kurAle gardA kArUna jastai hAmIharUlAI pani dhartImA dhasAunu hunthyo | kAphiraharU nata lokamA saphala hunchan na paralokamA, baru duvaimA asaphala hunchan |

83 Akhiratako ghara; hAmIle tI mAnisaharUkA lAgi varadAna ra sammAnako ghara banAunechauM jo dhartimA ghamaNDa gardainan | baru satya kurAmA ImAna lyAu~chan ra tyasako anusaraNa garchan | dhartImA AtaGka maccAuna khojdainan | yinIharUkA lAgi rAmro pariNAma cha, tyo ho svargakA varadAnaharU | unIharUle allAhakA AdezaharUko pAlanA garera ra uhA~le manAhI garekA kAryaharUbATa bacera uhA~ko prasannatA prApta garchan | Izabhaya rAkhneharUlAI allAhako prasannatA prApta huncha |

84 mahApralayako dina juna mAnisaharU namAja, jakAta, rojA ityAdi jastA satkarmaharU liera hAjira hunechan unIharUlAI tyasabhandA uttama badalA pradAna garinecha | unIharUkA satkarmaharUlAI dasa guNA baDhAinecha | mahApralayako dina juna mAnisaharU kuphra, byAja, vyabhicAra ityAdi jastA duSkarmaharU liera hAjira hunechan, tinIharUlAI tinIharUle garekA duSkarma barAbara sajAya diinecha, sajAya thapera diinechaina |

85 nissandeha juna allAhale tapAIMmAthi kurAna avataraNa garnubhayo, yasako pracAra prasAra ra yasako pAlanA anivArya garnubhayo uhA~le nai tapAIMlAI vijayI banAera makkA pharkAunuhunecha | he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! bahudevavAdIharUlAI bhanidinuhos− ko satya liera Aeko cha ra ko spaSTa pathabhraSTatAmA cha bhanne kurAlAI merA pAlanakartA rAmrarI jAnnuhuncha |

86 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! tapAIMmAthi kurAna avataraNa garinecha bhanne kurAlAI rasUla banAinuaghi tapAIMle socnu bhaeko thiena | allAhako vizeSa kRpAle tapAIMmAthi kurAna avataraNa gariyo | ataH tapAIM kAphiraharUko pathabhraSTatAmA sahAyaka nabannuhos |
