87 kurAnako avataraNapachi yI bahudevavAdIharUle tapAIMlAI allAhakA AyataharUko pATha garna ra AhvAna garnabATa rokna nasakun | mAnisaharUlAI eka allAhako bhakti ra uhA~ko nItiko pAlanAtarpha AhvAna garirAkhnuhos | bahudevavAdIharUmadhye nabannuhos jo allAhakA sAtha anya pUjyaharUko pUjA garchan, baru ekezvaravAdIharU madhyeko bannuhos, jo allAhako mAtra bhakti garchan |

88 allAhako sAthamA anya kunai pUjyako pUjA upAsanA nagarnuhos, kinabhe allAha bAheka kunai satya pUjya Izvara chaina | allAha bAheka sabai marnechan | uhA~ko zAsana mAtra caldacha, uhA~le je cAhanuhuncha tyasako Adeza dinuhuncha | mahApralayako dina hisAba ra badalAko lAgi uhA~tarpha nai pharkAera laginechau |
1 (alipha. lAma. mIma.) yasa jastA akSaraharUko vyAkhyA sUraha al-bakarahako ArambhamA bhaisakeko cha |

2 ke mAnisaharUle ThAnekA chan− unIharUle allAhamAthi ImAna lyaeko dAbI gardaimA choDinechan ra unIharU Aphno dAbImA saccA chan bhanne kurAko parIkSA liine chaina?! tinIharUle ThAne jasto kahA~ huncha ra |
3 hAmIle unIharUbhandA pahilekA mAnisaharUko pani parIkSA liyauM | allAhale avazya nai tI mominaharUko ImAnako vAstavikatA ra jhUTAharUko jhUTalAI spaSTarUpamA jAnna cAhanuhuncha |

4 avajJA, zirka ityAdi duSkarma garneharUle hAmIlAI vivaza pArnechan ra yAtanAbATa joginechan bhanne kurA ThAnekA chan? tinIharUle galata ra narAmro ThAnekA chan | yadi tinIharU kuphramA marchan bhane nata allAhalAI vivaza pArna sakchan na uhA~ko yAtanAbATa bacna sakchan |

5 juna mAnisaharU mahApralayako dina rAmro badalA pAune AzA rAkhchan unIharUle yo kurA jAnnuparcha ki mahApralaya najika cha | allAha AphnA bhaktaharUko kurA sunnuhuncha ra unIharUkA karmaharUlAI jAnnuhuncha | uhA~bATa kunai kurA chuTna sakdaina ra cA~Dai nai uhA~le tyasako badalA dinuhunecha |

6 juna mAnisaharUle AjJapAlana garne tathA avajJAbATa bacne prayAsa garchan ra allAhako mArgamA jihAda garchan unIharU Aphnai hitako lAgi prayAsa garchan, kinabhane tyasako phAidA unIharUlAI nai hunecha | allAha ekadamai sampanna hunuhuncha ra sRSTiharUko AvazyakatAbATa mahAn hunuhuncha | tinIharUko AjJApAlana ra avajJAle uhA~lAI kunai pharaka pardaina |

7 juna mAnisaharUle ImAna lyAe, hAmro parIkSAmA aTala rahe ra satkarma gare, hAmIle avazya nai unIharUkA pApaharUlAI unIharUkA satkarmaharUkA kAraNale meTAunechauM ra saMsAramA garekA satkarmako AkhiratamA rAmro badalA dinechauM |

8 hAmIle mAnavalAI mAtA pitAsa~ga rAmro vyavahAra garne upadeza diyauM | he mAnava! yadi mAtA pitAle timIharUlAI allAhasa~ga kasailAI sAjhedAra Thahara garne Adeza dinchan, jasako timIharUlAI jJAna chaina bhane timIharU unIharUko AjJApAlana nagara | kinabhane sRSTikartAko avajJAmA sRSTiharUko AjJApAlana garna mildaina | saada bina vakAsa (rajiyallAhu anhu) lAI unakI AmAle zirka garne Adeza diekI thiin, tara unale yasako pAlanA garekA thienan | mahApralayako dina timIharUle meraitarpha pharkera Aunuparcha ani maile timIharUlAI timIharUle saMsAramA garirAkhekA kAryaharUbAre batAunechu ra tyasako badalA dinechu |
9 allAhamAthi ImAna lyAera puNya karma garneharUlAI hAmIle mahApralayako dina satkarmIharUmA sAmela garnechauM | unIharUsa~ga bhelA garnechauM ra unIharU jastai pratidAna dinechauM |

10 kehI mAnisaharU allAhamAthi ImAna lyAune dAbI garchan, tara jaba kAphiraharUle tinIharUlAI yAtanA dinchan taba tinIharUle dieko yAtanAlAI allAhako yAtanA jhaiM ThAnera ImAnabATa phirera kAphiraharU jastai banihAlchan | he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! jaba tapAIMlAI allAhako maddata pugcha taba tinIharUle avazya bhannechan: he mominaharU ho! hAmI timIharUko sAthamA ImAnamA chauM | mAnisaharUkA manamA lukekA kurAharU ke allAhalAI thAhA chaina ra?! tinIharUkA manamA lukekA kuphra ra ImAna allAhabATa lukeko chaina | tinIharU kuna AdhAramA allAhalAI manakA kurAharU batAu~chan, jabaki allAhalAI tyasako bAremA tinIharUbhandA baDhI jJAna cha?!
11 allAhale pakkA ImAna lyAuneharU ra ImAna jAhera garne ani kuphra lukAune monAphikaharUlAI avazya nai jAnnuhunecha |

12 mAtra eka allAhamAthi ImAna rAkhneharUlAI kAphiraharUle bhane− timIharU hAmro dharmako pAlanA gara, timIharUkA sabai pApaharU hAmI AphUmAthi boknechauM ra timIharUlAI rAmro badalA dinechauM | vAstavikatA ke cha bhane tinIharU unIharUkA alikati pani pApalAI AphUmAthi bokna sakdainan | tinIharU yasabAremA jhUTo boldaichan |

kAphiraharU arUkA pApaharU AphUmAthi lina sakchan bhanne kurAko khaNDanabATa ke spaSTa huncha bhane pathabhraSTatAtarpha bolAune kAphiraharUle arUko pApako bhAra pani uThAuna bAdhya hunechan | yasa kurAlAI allAhale yasarI spaSTa pArnubhaeko chaH
13 asatyatarpha AhvAna garne yI bahudevavAdIharUle AphnA pApaharUko bhAra pani uThAunechan ra tinIharUko AhvAnako kAraNale tinIharUkA anuyAyIharUkA pApaharUko bhAra pani uThAunechan | sAthai anuyAyIharUkA pApaharUmA pani kunai kamI garine chaina | tinIharUle saMsAramA racekA asatyaharUbAre mahApralayako dina avazya nai tinIharUsa~ga sodhapUcha hunecha |

14 hAmIle nUha (alaihissalAma) lAI rasUla banAera unako samudAyatarpha paThAyauM | unI Aphno samudAyabIca 950 varSa basera tinIharUlAI eka allAhako bhaktitarpha AhvAna gare | tara tinIharUle kuphra gare ra tyasaimA aDiga rahe | tinIharUle ekamAtra satya upAsya allAhalAI inkAra gareko ra AphnA rasUlaharUlAI jhUTo Thahara garekole bhiSaNa bADhIko capeTAmA pare ra tinIharU Dubera sarvanAza bhae |
15 hAmIle DuGgAmA rahekA nUha (alaihissalAma) ra unakA momina anuyAyIharUlAI DubnabATa bacAyauM | hAmIle DuGgAlAI mAnisaharUkA lAgi pATha banAyauM |

16 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! ibrAhIma (alaihissalAma) ko satya kathAlAI yAda garnuhos, jaba unale Aphno samudAyakA mAnisaharUlAI bhane− mAtra eka allAhako bhakti gara | uhA~kA AdezaharUko pAlanA gara ra uhA~le manAhI garekA kAryaharUlAI tyAgera uhA~sita Dara | yadi timIharU jAndachau bhane yI AdezaharU timIharUkA lAgi rAmrA chan |

17 he bahudevavAdIharU ho! timIharUle pUjdai garekA mUrtiharUle nata phAidA puryAuna sakchan na hAni nai | tI mUrtiharU pUjanIya chan bhanne kurA siddha garnako lAgi timIharU jhUTA kurAharU garchau | allAha bAheka timIharU jasa-jasako pUjA garchau tinIharUle timIharUlAI jIvikA pradAna gardainan | allAhasita jIvikA pradAna garne prArthanA gara, uhA~ nai anna-dAtA hunuhuncha | mAtra uhA~ kai bhakti gara | uhA~le je jati jIvikA pradAna garnubhayo tyasako lAgi uhA~prati AbhAra vyakta gara | mahApralayako dina timIharU hisAba ra badalAko lAgi uhA~tarpha nai pharkera jAnechau, mUrtiharUtarpha pharkera jAnechainau |

18 he bahudevavAdIharU ho! yadi timIharU muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) le lyAunubhaeko sandezalAI jhUTo Thahara garchau bhane timIharUbhandA pahilekA samudAyaharU jastai nUha (alaihissalAma) ko samudAya, Ada ra samUdale pani jhUTo Thahara garisakekA chan | rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) ko jimmevArI yasa sandezalAI spaSTarUpamA puryAune mAtra ho, jo uhA~le pUrA garidinubhayo |

19 ke yI jhUTA Thahara garneharUle yasa kurAmA vicAra garenan, allAhale kasarI pahilo paTaka sRSTi garnubhayo ra yI sabai vinAza bhaepachi uhA~le pheri sRSTi garnuhunecha?! yo allAhako lAgi sahaja kArya ho | uhA~ yasako sAmarthya rAkhnuhuncha, kasaile uhA~lAI vivaza pArna sakdaina |

20 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! mRtyu pazcAta punaH jIvita hune kurAlAI jhUTo Thahara garneharUlAI bhanidinuhos− dhartImA hi~DaDula gara ani vicAra gara pahilo paTaka allAhale kasarI sRSTi garnubhayo, tinIharUko mRtyupachi uhA~le pheri dosro paTaka hisAbako lAgi jIvita pArnuhunecha | nissandeha allAha sabai kAryako sAmarthya rAkhnuhuncha | jasarI pahilo paTaka sRSTi garnabATa kasaile rokna sakena tyasarI nai dosro paTaka sRSTi garne kAryabATa pani uhA~lAI kasaile rokna sakdaina |

21 allAhale AphnA sRSTiharUmadhye jasalAI cAhanuhunecha Aphno nisAphale yAtanA dinuhunecha ra jasalAI cAhanuhunecha Aphno kRpAle dayA garnuhunecha | mahApralayako dina jaba uhA~le timIharUlAI timIharUko cihAnaharUbATa jIvita pArera uThAunuhunecha taba hisAbako lAgi timIharU uhA~tarpha nai pharkera jAnechau |

22 timIharU allAhalAI vivaza pArna sakdainau | dhartI ra AkAzamA uhA~ko prakopabATa bhAgna sakdainau | allAha bAheka timIharUko kohI saMrakSaka chaina | allAha bAheka timIharUko kohI sahayogI chaina, jasale timIharUbATa allAhako prakopalAI TArna sakos |

23 juna mAnisaharUle allAhakA nizAnIharU ra mahApralayako dina uhA~sa~ga bheTahune kurAlAI jhUTo Thahara gare tinIharU mero kRpAbATa nirAza bhae | tinIharU Aphno kuphrako kAraNale kahilyai svargamA praveza garna sakdainan | AkhiratamA tinIharUkA lAgi pIDAdAyI yAtanAle parkhiraheko cha |

24 jaba ibrAhIma (alaihissalAma) le eka allAhako bhakti ra mUrti pUjA tyAgne Adeza die taba unako samudAyale bhanyo− AphnA mUrtiharUko badalA linako lAgi yasako hatyA gara ra AgomA hAlideU, tara allAhale unalAI AgobATa surakSita rAkhnubhayo | tinIharUle unalAI AgomA hAlepachi tyasabATa surakSita rahane kAryamA AsthAvAnaharUkA lAgi pATha cha | AsthAvAnaharU mAtra upadezabATa lAbha uThAune garchan |

25 ibrAhIma (alaihissalAma) le Aphno samudAyalAI bhane− timIharU yasa saMsAramA juna premale gardA mUrti pUjA gardaichau, mahApralayako dina tyo prema sambandha chinna bhinna hunecha | yAtanA hu~dA timIharUle eka arkAsa~ga kunai sarokAra rAkhne chainau | baru eka arkAko nindA garnechau | timIharUko vAsasthAna narka hunecha | allAhako yAtanAbATa jogAune kohI pani hune chaina | allAhalAI choDera juna mUrtiharUko pUjA gardaichau tinIharUle pani ra anya kasaile pani timIharUko sahayoga garna sakne chainan |

26 ani lUta (alaihissalAma) le ImAna lyAe | ibrAhIma (alaihissalAma) le bhane ma allAhako Adeza anusAra pavitra bhUmi siriyAtarpha prasthAna garna cAhanchu | uhA~ prabhutvazAlI hunuhuncha, kohI pani uhA~mAthi vijayI huna sakdaina | uhA~tarpha hijrata (pravAsa) garne apamAnita hune chaina | uhA~ bhAgya nirdhAraNa garna ra kArya saJcAlana garnamA tatvadarzI hunuhuncha |

27 hAmIle ibrAhIma (alaihissalAma) lAI ishAka pradAna garyauM ra ishAka (alaihissalAma) lAI yAkUba pradAna garyauM | hAmIle ibrAhIma (alaihissalAma) ko santAnamA nubuvata (IzdUtatva) jArI garyauM ra kitAbaharU avatarita garyauM | hAmIle unalAI dhairyako badalAmA saMsAramA rAmrA santAnaharU ra khyAti pradAna garyauM | hAmIle AkhiratamA unalAI satkarmIharUmA sAmela garera pratidAna dinechauM | unalAI lokamA prApta bhaeko pratidAnale gardA paralokako utkRSTa pratidAnamA kamI garine chaina |

28 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! lUta (alaihissalAma) lAI smaraNa garnuhos, jaba unale Aphno samudAyalAI bhane− timIharU yasto ghRNita karma garchau, jasto duSkarma timIharUbhandA pahile saMsAramA kasaile pani gareko thiena | timIharUle yasto duSkarmako suruvAta garekA chau jo prAkRti viruddha ho |

29 ke timIharU puruSako maladvAramA sahavAsa garchau ra bATomA yAtruharUko sAmAna DaketI garchau? ke timIharU azlIla kArya gardA Dara mAndainau? ke timIharU sabhAmA nagna ra hi~Da rahekA mAnisaharUlAI Aphno jibro ra kAryale kaSTa diera duSkarma garchau? yI duSkarmaharUbATa manAhI gardA unako samudAyaharUle javApha die− yadi timI Aphno dAbImA saccA chau bhane timIle dhamkI diiraheko prakopa lyAera dekhAU |

30 samudAyale inkAra ra prakopako mAga garepachi lUta (alaihissalAma) le allAhasita duA gare− he merA pAlanakartA! kuphra ra azlIla karma garera dhartImA AtaGka maccAune yasa samudAya viruddha malAI maddata garnuhos |

31 jaba ibrAhIma (alaihissalAma) samakSa tI phariztAharU Ae jasalAI hAmIle unalAI isahAka ra unIpachi unako santAna yAkUbako zubhasUcanA dinako lAgi paThAekA thiyauM, taba unIharUle unalAI bhaneH hAmIharUle lUta (alaihissalAma) ko samudAya sadUma bAsIharUlAI sarvanAza garnechauM, kinabhane tinIharU azlIla kArya garera atyAcAra garekA chan |

32 ibrAhIma (alaihissalAma) le unIharUlAI bhane− timIharU juna gAu~lAI sarvanAza garna cAhanchau tyasamA lUta (alaihissalAma) pani chan jo atyAcArIharUmadhye hoinan | phariztAharUle bhane− hAmIharU tyasamA rahekA sabailAI rAmrarI jAndachauM | hAmIharUle unalAI ra unako parivAralAI vinAzabATa jogAunechauM | tara unako patnIlAI jogAu~dainauM baru vinAza garnechauM |

33 phariztAharU puruSako rUpamA lUta (alaihissalAma) kahA~ pugdA unako samudAyaharUle unIharUsa~ga pani azlIla kArya garnechan bhanne kurA ThAnera unI cintita bhae | kinabhane tinIharU puruSaharUsa~ga azlIla kArya garthe | phariztAharUle bhane− tapAIM cintA nalinuhos | tinIharUle tapAIMlAI kunai kaSTa puryAuna sakne chainan | tinIharUlAI hAmIharUle sarvanAza garnechauM bhanne kurAko pani cintA nalinus | hAmIharUle tapAIM ra tapAIMkA parivArakA sabailAI jogAunechauM | tapAIMko patnI sarvanAza huneharUmadhye hunechin |

34 hAmIharU yasa gAu~kA atyAcArI bAsindAharUmAthi AkAzabATa prakopa avataraNa gardaichauM | tinIharUmAthi cinha bhaekA DhuGgA sajAya dinako lAgi barsAunechauM | kinabhane tinIharU mahilAharUlAI choDera puruSaharUsa~ga azlIla kAryamA lipta chan ra yasarI allAhako AjJApAlanabATa niskekA chan |
35 hAmIle yasa sarvanAza pArieko gAu~mA buddhimAna mAnisaharUkA lAgi spaSTa nizAnI choDyauM, kinabhane unIharUle nai nizAnIharUbATa pATha line garchan |

36 hAmIle madayana bAsIharUsamma tinIharUkA nAtAmA parne bhAi zuebalAI paThAyauM | unale bhane− he mero samudAyakA mAnisaharU ho! mAtra eka allAhako bhakti gara ra Aphno bhaktiko badalAko Asa mAtra AkhiratamA rAkha | avajJA garera ra tyasalAI phailAera dhartImA AtaGka namaccAU |

37 unako samudAyaharUle unalAI jhUTho Thahara gare jasale gardA tinIharUlAI bhUkampale samAtyo, phalasvarUpa tinIharU AphnA gharamA ghopTo parera laDe | tinIharUkA anuhAra mATomA TA~siera halacala garna nasakne bhae |

38 hAmIle hUda (alaihissalAma) ko samudAya AdalAI ra sAleha (alaihissalAma) ko samudAya samUdalAI pani sarvanAza pAryauM | he makkA bAsIharU ho! timIharU samakSa hajaramautako hijra ra zihra nAmI gAu~sthita tinIharUkA gharaharUbATa tinIharU sarvanAza pArieko kurA spaSTa bhaisakeko cha | tinIharUkA bhatkekA gharaharU yasako gavAhI dinchan | tinIharUkA kuphra ra avajJAlAI zaitAnale tinIharUkA lAgi sundara tulyAekA thie ra tinIharUlAI sIdhA mArgabATa rokekA thie | tinIharUkA rasUlaharUle avagata garAekAle tinIharU samakSa satya tathA asatya ra sIdhA mArga tathA pathabhraSTatA spaSTa thiyo | tara tinIharUle mArgadarzanako anusaraNa cayana nagarera icchAko anusaraNalAI cayana gare |

39 hAmIle tyatikhera kArUnalAI usako gharasameta dhartImA dhasAera vinAza garyauM jaba usale mUsA (alaihissalAma) ko samudAyamAthi jyAdatI garyau | hAmIle phirauna ra usako mantrI hAmAnalAI samudramA DubAera vinAza garyauM | mUsA (alaihissalAma) tinIharU samakSa spaSTa camatkAraharU liera Ae jo unako saccAilAI pramANita gardathe | tara tinIharUle misrako dhartImA ghamaNDale gardA ImAna lyAenan | tinIharU hAmro prakopabATa bacna sakdainathe |

40 hAmIle uparyukta sabailAI Aphno prakopadvArA samAtyauM | tinIharUmadhye lUta (alaihissalAma) ko samudAya thiyo jasamAthi hAmIle cinha bhaekA DhuGgAko prakopa paThAyauM | tinIharUmadhye sAleha (alaihissalAma) ra zueba (alaihissalAma) kA samudAya thie jasalAI ThUlo svarale samAtyo | tinIharUmadhye kArUna thiyo jasalAI usako gharasameta hAmIle dhartImA dhasAyauM | tinIharUmadhye nUha (alaihissalAma) ko samudAya, phirauna ra hAmAnalAI hAmIle bADhImA DubAyauM | allAhale tinIharUlAI binA kasUra sarvanAza pArnubhaena baru tinIharU avajJA garera AphUmAthi atyAcAra garne garthe, tyasaile prakopakA bhAgidAra bane |

41 allAhalAI choDera mUrti pUjA garne ra tyasabATa phAidA ra siphArisako AzA rAkhneharUko udAharaNa mAkurA jasto cha jo AkramaNabATa joginako lAgi ghara banAu~cha | jabaki sabaibhandA kamajora ghara mAkurAko ghara huncha | yasa gharale zatrulAI rokna sakdaina | mUrtiharUle na phAidA puryAuna sakchan, na hAni ra na siphArisa garna sakchan | yadi bahudevavAdIharUle yo kurA jAnekA bhae tinIharUle allAhalAI choDera mUrtiharUko pUjA garne thienan |

42 tinIharUle allAhalAI choDera juna vastuharUko pUjA garchan, ninsandeha allAhalAI tyasako jAnakArI cha | uhA~bATa kunai vastu lukeko chaina | uhA~ prabhutvazAlI hunuhuncha, kohI pani uhA~mAthi vijayI huna sakdaina | uhA~ sRSTi garna, bhAgya nirdhAraNa garna ra kArya saJcAlana garnamA tatvadarzI hunuhuncha |

43 hAmIle yI udAharaNaharU mAnisaharUlAI jagAuna ra saceta garnakA lAgi varNana garchauM, tAki tinIharUle satyalAI apanAun | allAhako kAnuna ra hikmata (buddhi) kA jAnakAraharUle mAtra yasalAI rAmrarI bujhdachan |

44 allAhale AkAzaharU ra pRthvIlAI satyakA sAtha sRSTi garnubhayo, asatyakA sAtha ra binA uddezya sRSTi garnubhaena | yasa sRSTimA mominaharUkA lAgi allAhako sAmarthyako spaSTa pramANa cha | kinabhane tinIharU nai sRSTibATa sRSTikartAko pahicAna garchan | saMsAra ra svayam mAnavabhitra rahekA nizAnIharUlAI kAphiharUle dekhchan tara tyasabATa sRSTikartAko mahAnatA ra sAmarthyalAI bujhdainan |

45 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! allAhale je jati kurAna vahI garnubhayo tyasalAI mAnisaharU samakSa pATha garnuhos | salAha (namAja) pUrNarUpamA kAyama garnuhos | rAmro tarikAle kAyama gareko namAjale namAja kAyama garnelAI pApa ra duSkarmamA parnabATa rokdacha | kinabhane yasale hRdayamA prakAza utpanna garcha, pApa karma garnabATa rokcha ra satkarma garna prerita garcha | allAhako smaraNa sabai vastuharUbhandA mahAn cha | timIharUle garekA kAryalAI allAhale rAmrosa~ga jAnnuhuncha | timIharUkA kunai pani karma uhA~bATa lukeko chaina | uhA~le timIharUkA karmako badalA dinuhunecha | yadi rAmro karma garchau bhane rAmro pratidAna ra yadi duSkarma garchau bhane sajAya allAhale dinuhunecha |

46 he mominaharU ho! yahUdI ra IsAIharUsa~ga vAdavivAda gardA rAmro tarikAle gara | bhanAiko tAtparya tinIharUlAI rAmro upadeza ra spaSTa pramANakA sAtha AhvAna garnu ho | zatrutA ra ghamaNDale atyAcAra garekAharUsa~ga vAdavivAda nagara | baru tinIharU viruddha yuddhako ghoSaNA gara | tinIharU viruddha yuddha gara yahA~samma ki tinIharU ki ta ImAna lyAun ki ta apamAnita bhaera rakSAkara tirun | yahUdI ra IsAIharUlAI bhana− allAhale hAmIharUtarpha avataraNa garnubhaeko kurAnamAthi hAmIle ImAna lyAyauM ra timIharUmAthi avataraNa garieko taurAta tathA injIlamAthi pani ImAna lyAyauM | hAmIharU ra timIharUkA pUjya paramezvara (allAha) euTai hunuhuncha | nissandeha, uhA~ko ulUhiyyata (upAsanA) mA, rubUviyyata (prabhutva) mA ra pUrNatAmA kohI sAjhedAra chaina | hAmIharUle AphUlAI uhA~ samakSa vinamra bhaera samarpita garisakekA chauM |

47 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! jasarI hAmIle tapAIMbhandA pahilekA rasUlaharUmAthi kitAbaharU avataraNa garyauM, tyasarI tapAIMmAthi pani kurAna avataraNa garyauM | taurAta paDhneharUmadhye abdullAha bina salAma jastA kehIle kurAnamAthi pani ImAna lyAe | unIharUle AphnA kitAbaharUmA kurAnako bAremA paDhekA thie | yI bahudevavAdIharUmadhye pani kehIle ImAna lyAe | kAphira (avajJAkArI) harUle mAtra yasalAI inkAra gare | tinIharU satya spaSTa hu~dA hu~dai pani tyasalAI inkAra garne garchan |

48 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! tapAIM kurAna paDhnubhandA pahile kunai kitAba paDhnu hunnathyo ra Aphno hAtale kunai kurA lekhnu hunnathyo | kinabhane tapAIM lekhapaDha garna siknubhaeko thiena | yadi tapAIM paDhna ra lekhna jAnnu hunthyo bhane ajJAnIharUle tapAIMko nubuvvata (IzdUtatva) mA zaGkA garthe | tapAIMle aghillA kitAbaharUbATa nakkala garnubhaeko jhUTA kurA tinIharU phailAune thie |

49 tara tapAIMmAthi avatarita kurAna spaSTa cha ra yasakA AyataharU jJAnI mominaharUkA hRdayamA spaSTa surakSita chan | allAhalAI inkAra garne ra uhA~sa~ga zirka garera AphUmAthi atyAcAra garneharUle mAtra hAmrA AyataharUlAI inkAra garchan |

50 bahudevavAdIharUle bhane− muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) mAthi tyastA camatkAraharU kina avataraNa gariena jasto arU sandeSTAharUmAthi avataraNa garie?! he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! yasto kurA garneharUlAI bhanidinuhos− camatkAraharU avataraNa garne kAma allAhako hAtamA cha | uhA~ jahile cAhanuhuncha avataraNa garnuhuncha | yo avataraNa garnu mero hAtamA chaina | ma ta mAtra allAhako prakopabATa spaSTarUpamA sAvadhAna gardaichu |

51 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! camatkAraharUbAre sallAha dineharUkA lAgi ke yo paryApta chaina ki hAmIle tapAIMmAthi kurAna avataraNa garekAchauM, jasako pATha tinIharU samakSa garincha | nissandeha kurAnamA mominaharUkA lAgi kRpA ra upadeza chan | unIharU nai yasabATa lAbha uThAu~chan | tinIharUkA lAgi avatarita kurAna vigatakA rasUlaharUlAI pradAna gariekA camatkAraharUbhandA uttama cha, jasako sujhAva tinIharU diMdaichan |

52 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! bhanidinuhos− maile lyAeko sandeza satya ho | timIharU yasalAI jhUTo Thahara gardaichau bhanne kurAko gavAhako rUpamA allAha paryApta hunuhuncha | uhA~ AkAzaharU ra pRthvImA rahekA vastuharUlAI jAnnuhuncha | uhA~bATa kehI pani gopya chaina | juna mAnisaharUle allAha bAheka anya vastuharUko pUjA garera tathA vAstavika pUjya allAhalAI inkAra garera asatyamAthi vizvAsa gare tinIharU nai ghATA khAneharU hun | kinabhane tinIharUle ImAnako saTTAmA kuphralAI roje |

53 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! bahudevavAdIharU tyasa prakopako lAgi hatAra gardaichan jasabATa tapAIMle sAvadhAna garnubhayo | allAhale prakopako lAgi nirdhAraNa garnubhaeko samayabhandA na pahilA prakopa Auna sakcha na pachi nai | samaya nirdhArita nabhaeko bhae tinIharUle mAga gareko prakopa tinIharUle nasoce jasto akasmAta Aune thiyo |

54 tapAIMle tinIharUsa~ga vAcA garnubhaeko prakopako lAgi tinIharU hatAra gardaichan | kAphiraharUlAI tyasa narkale gherAmA lieko cha jasako vAcA allAhale garnubhayo | tyasako yAtanAbATa tinIharU bhAgna sakdainan |
55 tyasa dina yAtanAle tinIharUlAI mAthibATa pani chopnecha ra munibATa pani bichyaunA bannecha | allAhale tinIharUlAI dhikkArdai bhannuhunecha− timIharUle gareko zirka ra avajJAko svAda cAkha |

56 he merA AsthAvAna bhaktaharU ho, mero dhartI pharAkilo cha | yasto sthAnabATa hijrata (basAi~-sarAI) gara jahA~ mero bhakti garnu sambhava chaina! tasartha mAtra mero bhakti gara ra masa~ga anya kasailAI sAjhedAra nabanAU |

57 mRtyuko bhayale timIharUlAI hijrata garnabATa narokos | kinabhane pratyeka jIvale mRtyuko svAda cAkhnai parcha | mahApralayako dina timIharUle hisAba ra badalAko lAgi mAtra hAmraitarpha pharkera Aunuparcha |

58 juna mAnisaharUle allAhamAthi ImAna lyAe ra uhA~ko nikaTatA prApta garna satkarmaharU gare hAmIle unIharUlAI svargakA ucca bhavanaharUmA basobAsa garAunechauM, jasakA talatirabATa naharaharU bagirahekA hunechan | unIharU tyasamA sadhaiM basobAsa garnechan | unIharU tyasamA kahilyai marne chainan | allAhako AjJApAlanako yo kati rAmro badalA ho |
59 yastA satkarmIharUle kati rAmro badalA pAunechan jo allAhako AjJApAlana garchan, tyasamA aDiga rahanchan, avajJAbATa bacdachan ra sabai mAmilAharUmA allAhamA mAtra bharosA garchan |

60 katipaya prANIharU yastA chan jo nata Aphno jIvikA jammA garna sakchan, na bokna sakchan, allAhale nai tinIharUlAI ra timIharUlAI pani jIvikA pradAna garnuhuncha | tasartha bhokako Darale timIharU hijrata nagarne bahAnA nagara | uhA~ timIharUkA kurA sunnuhuncha ra timIharUko nIyata ra karmaharU jAnnuhuncha | uhA~bATa kehI pani lukeko chaina | uhA~le cA~Dai nai tyasako badalA dinuhunecha |

61 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! yadi tapAIMle yI bahudevavAdIharUlAI sodhnuhuncha AkAzaharU ra pRthvIlAI kasale sRSTi garyo? eka arkApachi Aune sUrya ra candramA kasako niyantraNamA cha? tinIharUle javApha dinechan− yI sabailAI allAhale sRSTi garnubhayo | ani tinIharU kuna AdhAramA eka allAhamAthi ImAna lyAirahekA chainan ra kunai phAidA ra hAni puryAuna nasakne devI devatAharUko pUjAmA lipta chan?

62 AphnA bhaktaharUmadhye allAha jasalAI cAhanuhuncha khubai jIvikA pradAna garnuhuncha ra jasalAI cAhanuhuncha kama dinuhuncha | yasamA lukeko rahasyalAI allAhale nai jAnnuhuncha | allAha hareka vastukA jJAtA hunuhuncha | uhA~bATa kehI pani lukeko chaina | bhaktaharUko hItamA kuna kArya ThIka cha bhanne kurA pani uhA~ jAnnuhuncha |

63 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! yadi tapAIMle bahudevavAdIharUlAI sodhnuhuncha−pAnI kasale barsAu~cha, jasale gardA mRta dhartIle bAlInAlI umArcha? tinIharUle avazya javApha dinechan− AkAzabATa pAnI barsAune ra tyasabATa dhartImA bAlInAlI umArne allAha mAtra hunuhuncha | he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! tinIharUlAI bhannuhos− sabai prazaMsA allAhako lAgi chan, jasale pramANalAI timIharUmAthi spaSTa pArnubhayo | vAstAvikatA ke cha bhane tinIharUmadhye adhikAMsa mAnisaharU bujhdainan | tinIharUmA buddhi bhaeko bhae tinIharUle allAhako sAthamA mUrtiharUlAI sAjhedAra banAune thienan, jo na phAidA dina sakchan na hAni puryAuna sakchan |

64 sAMsArika jIvana, mojamastI ra khela tamAsA mAtra ho | yo cA~Dai samApta hune cija ho | Akhiratako jIvana asala ra sadhaiM rahane jIvana ho | tinIharUle jAnekA bhae kSaNika jIvanalAI sadhaiM bA~kI rahane jIvanako tulanAmA baDhI prAthamiktA dine thienan |

bahudevavAdIharU allAhalAI pAlanakartA mAnne tara uhA~lAI mAtra pUjya namAnne virodhAbhASako varNanapachi tinIharUmA pAine arko virodhAbhASa- Darako avasthAmA allAhalAI mAtra pukArne tara zAntiko avasthAmA uhA~sa~ga anyalAI sAjhedAra Thahara garne kurAko varNana allAhale yasarI garnubhaeko chaH
65 jaba bahudevavAdIharU samudramA DuGgAmA yAtrA garchan taba ekAgratAkA sAtha saphala yAtrAko lAgi allAhasa~ga mAtra prArthanA garchan | tara jaba allAhale tinIharUlAI DubnabATa bacAunuhuncha taba uhA~sa~ga arUlAI sAjhedAra Thahara garna thAlchan |
66 bahudevavAdIharU hAmrA varadAnaharUprati kRtaghnatA prakaTa gare ra sAMsArika sampattibATa mojamastI garna thAle | tinIharUle mRtyupachi turuntai yasako duSpariNAma jAnnechan |

67 ke allAhakA varadAnaharUlAI inkAra garneharUle yasa kurAmA vicAra garenan, uhA~le nai tinIharUlAI samudramA DubnabATa jogAunubhayo, dosro varadAna, uhA~le nai harama (kAbA) banAunubhayo jasale gardA tinIharUko ragata ra dhana-sampatti surakSita rahanchan | jabaki haramako simAnA bAhira rahekA mAnisaharUmAthi rAtamA AkramaNa huncha, tinIharUko hatyA garincha, tinIharUlAI bandI banAincha, tinIharUkA mahilA tathA santAnaharU kaidI banAinchan ra tinIharUkA dhana-sampatti japhata garinchan | ke (yati hu~dAhu~dai pani) tinIharU asatya tathA managaDhanta pUjyaharUko pUjA garchan, allAhako varadAnaprati kRtaghna hunchan ra uhA~prati AbhAra vyakta gardainan?!

68 allAhako sAthamA arUlAI sAjhedAra ThaharAune, uhA~ko sambandhamA jhUTo kurA racne ra allAhakA rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) le lyAunubhaeko satyalAI jhUTo Thahara garne mAnisaharUbhandA ThUlo atyAcArI kohI huna sakdaina | kAphiraharU ra tinIharU jastA mAnisaharUkA vAsasthAna narka ho |
69 juna mAnisaharUle hAmro prasannatA prApta garna saMgharSa gare, hAmIle tinIharUlAI sIdhA mArga dekhAu~chauM | nissandeha sukarmIharUle allAhako maddata ra mArgadarzana pAu~chan |
1 alipha. lAma. mIma. | yastA akSaraharUko bAremA sUraha al-bakarahako ArambhamA varNana bhaisakeko cha |
2 phArasa (IrAna) le romamAthi vijaya prApta garyo |
3 IrAnale Aphno najika raheko siriyAko bhUbhAgamA yo vijaya prApta garyo | romale IrAnasa~ga hArepani cA~Dai nai IrAnamAthi vijaya prApta garnecha |

4 romale 3 dekhi 10 varSabhitra yo vijaya prApta garnecha | romako parAjayabhandA aghi tathA pachi je bhayo allAha kai Adezale bhayo | juna dina romale vijaya prApta garcha tyasa dina mominaharU khuzI hunechan |

5 romalAI allAhako maddataprati mominaharU yasa kAraNale khuzI hunechan ki tinIharU ahale kitAba hun | allAha jasalAI jasamAthi cAhanuhuncha maddata garnuhuncha | uhA~ sAmarthyavAna hunuhuncha, kohI pani uhA~mAthi vijaya prApta garna sakdaina | uhA~ AphnA momina bhaktaharUprati dayAvAna hunuhuncha |

6 yo maddata allAhako vAcA ho | allAhale Aphno vAcA bhaGga garnuhunna | allAhako maddatako vAcA pUrA bhaepachi mominaharUko ImAnamA vRddhi huncha | tara adhikAMsa mAnisaharU Aphno kuphrale gardA yasa kurAlAI bujhdainan |

7 tinIharUle ImAna ra islAmI kAnunalAI jAndainan, tinIharU sAMsArika jIvanakA bAhirI pakSalAI jAnchan, jo dhana-sampatti Arjana garne ra bhautika sabhyatA nirmANasa~ga sambandhita chan | tinIharU Akhiratako vAstavika jIvanabATa vimukha chan tyasatarpha dhyAna diMdainan |

8 ke jhUTo Thahara garne yI bahudevavAdIharUle AphUbhitra vicAra garenan− allAhale kasarI tinIharUkA AtmAlAI sRSTi garnubhayo ra tyasalAI ThIka pArnubhayo? allAhale AkAzaharU, pRthvI ra yI bhitra rahekA sabai vastuharUlAI satya uddezyakA sAtha sRSTi garnubhayo, binA uddezya sRSTi garnubhaena | uhA~le saMsAramA yI duvaikA samaya nirdhArita garnubhayo | tara dherai mAnisaharU mahApralayako dina uhA~sa~ga bheTa garne kurAlAI inkAra garchan | tinIharU uhA~lAI khusI pArne satkarma garera Akhiratako tayArI garirahekA chainan |

9 ke tinIharUle dhartImA ghumaphira garera aghillA samudAyaharUkA pariNAmamA vicAra garenan, inkAra garneharUko pariNAma kasto bhayo | tI samudAyaharU yinIharUbhandA baDhI zaktizAlI thie | tinIharUle khetIpAtI ra nirmANako dhartIlAI kati ulaTa-pulaTa garera AbAda garekA thie | tinIharUle dhartIlAI yinIharUbhandA baDhI AbAda tathA vikAza garekA thie | allAha mAtra vAstika pUjya hunuhuncha bhanne kurAko spaSTa pramANaharU liera tinIharUkA pAsamA rasUlaharU Ae tara tinIharUle jhUTho Thahara gare | allAhale tinIharUlAI sarvanAza garera tinIharUmAthi atyAcAra garnubhaena baru tinIharUle kuphra garera AphailAI vinAzamA pArI AphaiMmAthi atyAcAra gare |
10 antataH zirka ra duSkarma garneharUko pariNAma narAmro bhayo | kinabhane tinIharUle allAhakA nizAnIharUlAI jhUTo Thahara gare ra tinako bAremA ThaTTA gare |

11 allAhale sRSTiko Arambha binA kunai aghillo udAharaNa garnubhayo, pheri sabailAI mArnuhunecha ra pheri jIvita pArnuhunecha | mahApralayako dina timIharU sabai uhA~tarpha nai hisAba ra badalAko lAgi jAnechau |

12 mahApralayako dina aparAdhIharU allAhako kRpAbATa nirAza hunechan | allAhako kRpAko bAremA tinIharUko AzA samApta bhaisakeko hunecha, kinabhane allAhalAI inkAra gareko kAraNa tinIharUsa~ga kunai tarka bA~kI rahanechaina |

13 tinIharUle yasa saMsAramA pUjne gareko kunai pani pUjyale tinIharUlAI yAtanAbATa nikAlna siphArisa garne chaina | baru tinIharUle sAjhedAra Thahara garneharUsa~ga kunai sarokAra naraheko dAbI garnechan | tinIharUle tyatikhera sAjhedAra Thahara garneharUlAI apamAnita garnechan jatikhera tinIharUlAI allAhasa~ga sAjhedAra garAiekA pUjyaharUko khA~co hunecha | tinIharU sabai samAnarUpamA sarvanAza garinechan |

14 mahApralayako dina sabai mAnisaharU saMsAramA garekA karma anusAra badalA pAuna vibhAjita hunechan | unIharUmadhye kehI sabaibhandA ucca darjAmA hunechan bhane kehI sabaibhandA tallo darjAmA hunechan |
15 juna mAnisaharUle allAhamAthi ImAna lyAe ra uhA~lAI khusI pArne kArya gare unIharU svargamA ramAunechan kinabhane unIharUle kahile samApta nahune varadAnaharU pAunechan |

16 allAhalAI inkAra garne ra hAmrA rasUlaharUmAthi avatarita camatkAraharU, mRtyu pazcAta punaH jIvita pArine kurA ra hisAba kitAbalAI jhUTo Thahara garneharU yAtanAko lAgi hAjira garine chan ra sadhaiM yAtanAmai rahanechan |
17 timIharU sA~jha parepachi allAhako mahimAgAna gara | yo magriba ra izAko namAja (salAha) ko samaya ho | bihAna bhaepachi pani timIharU allAhako mahimAgAna gara | yo phajrako namAjako samaya ho |

18 AkAzaharUmA allAhako mahimAgAna phariztAharUle garchan ra pRthvImA uhA~ko mahimAgAna anya sRSTiharUle garchan | timIharU belukA pani allAhako mahimAgAna gara | yo asra namAjako samaya ho | diu~so juharako samayamA pani uhA~ko mahimAgAna gara |

19 allAhale nai mRtabATa jIvitalAI nikAlnuhuncha; jastai- viryabATa mAnava ra aNDAbATa callA | uhA~le jIvitabATa mRtalAI nikAlnuhuncha; jastai- mAnavabATa virya ra kukhurAbATa aNDA | uhA~le nai varSA barsAera mRta bhUmilAI jIvita pArnuhuncha ra tyasamA bAlInAlI umArnuhuncha | jasarI uhA~le mRta bhUmilAI jIvita pArera tyasamA bAlInAlI umArnubhayo tyasarI nai timIharUlAI mRtyupachi jIvita pArera cihAnabATa hisAba ra badalA dinako lAgi nikAlnuhunecha |

20 he mAnava! allAha sAmarthyavAna ra eka mAtra pUjya hunuhuncha bhanne kurAko ThUlA nizAnIharUmadhye yo pani ho ki uhA~le timIharUkA buvA AdamalAI mATobATa sRSTi garnubhayo, ani timIharU prajananadvArA vRddhi hu~dai dhartIko pUrva ra pazcimamA phailidaichau |

21 he puruSaharU ho! allAha sAmarthyavAna ra eka mAtra pUjya hunuhuncha bhanne kurAko ThUlA nizAnIharUmadhye yo pani ho ki uhA~le timIharUkai jatibATa timIharUko joDI banAunubhayo tAki timIharU sahavAsa garera santuSTa hoU | uhA~le pati patnIbIca prema tathA dayA sRjanA garnubhayo | yI kurAharUmA cintana manan garne mAnisaharUkA lAgi spaSTa pramANaharU chan, kinabhane tinIharU nai Aphno buddhi prayoga garera tyasabATa phAidA uThAu~chan |

22 AkAzaharU ra pRthvIko sRSTi, timIharUko pharaka-pharaka bhASAharU ra pharaka-pharaka raGgaharU pani yasa kurAkA ThUlA nizAnIharU hun ki allAha sAmarthyavAna ra eka mAtra pUjya hunuhuncha | yI kurAharUmA jJAnI ra vivekazIla mAnisaharUkA lAgi pramANaharU chan |

23 timIharU thakAi mArnako lAgi rAtamA sutnu ra jIvikA Arjana garna dinamA bhAga dauDa garnumA pani yasa kurAkA ThUlA nizAnIharU hun ki allAha sAmarthyavAna ra eka mAtra pUjya hunuhuncha | yI kurAharUmA cintana manan garna ra satya svIkAra garnako lAgi sunne mAnisaharUkA lAgi pramANaharU chan |

24 allAha sAmarthyavAna ra eka mAtra pUjya hunuhuncha bhanne kurAkA ThUlA nizAnIharUmadhye yo pani ho ki uhA~le nai AkAzamA bijulI camkAunuhuncha, yasarI caTyAGgadvArA DarAunuhuncha ra varSAdvArA AzA dilAunuhuncha | AkAzabATa varSA barsAunuhuncha ani tyasabATa sukeko mRta bhUmilAI jIvita pArnuhuncha ra tyasamA bAlInAlI umArnuhuncha | yI kurAharUmA vivekazIla mAnisaharUkA lAgi pramANaharU chan | yasabATa unIharU ke pramANita garchan bhane mRtyupachi allAhale hisAba ra badalAko lAgi pheri jIvita pArnuhunecha |

25 allAha sAmarthyavAna ra eka mAtra pUjya hunuhuncha bhanne kurAko ThUlA nizAnIharUmadhye yo pani ho ki uhA~ko Adezale AkAza nakhasera ra dhartI dhvasta nabhai vyavasthita rUpale sathApita chan | jaba allAhale phariztAlAI sUramA phukne Adeza diera timIharUlAI bolAunuhunecha taba timIharU hisAba ra badalAko lAgi A-AphnA cihAnabATa niskanechau |

26 AkAzaharU ra pRthvImA je jati chan tI sabaikA mAlika, sRSTikartA ra bhAgya vidhAtA allAha mAtra hunuhuncha | AkAzaharU ra pRthvImA rahekA sabai sRSTiharU allAhakA AjJAkArI chan ra uhA~ko Adezako pAlanA gardaichan |

27 allAhale nai binA kunai aghillo udAharaNa pahilo paTaka sRSTi garnubhayo ra uhA~le nai tI sabai sarvanAza bhaepachi dosro paTaka pani sRSTi garnuhunecha | dosro paTaka sRSTi garnu pahilo paTaka sRSTi garnubhandA sajilo cha | hunata allAhako lAgi duvai sajilA chan | kinabhane jaba uhA~ kunai vastuko sRSTi garne nIyata garnuhuncha taba bhannuhuncha bhaihAla, ani tyo huna pugcha | uhA~ AphnA hareka zAna ra guNaharUmA mahAn hunuhuncha | uhA~ prabhutvazAlI hunuhuncha, kohI uhA~mAthi vijaya prApta garna sakdaina | uhA~ sRSTi garna ra tyasalAI saJcAlanamA tatvadarzI hunuhuncha |

28 he bahudevavAdIharU ho! allAhale timIharUkA lAgi timIharUkai euTA udAharaNa dinuhuncha | ke timIharUkA nokaracAkara timIharUkA dhana-sampattimA barAbarako sAjhedAra chan? ke jasarI timIharU mukta nAtedAraharUsita DarAu~chau ki tinIharUle sampattimA aMzako dAbI garnechan ke tyasarI nokara ra dAsaharUsita DarAu~chau? kunai dAsale yasto garchan bhanne kurA ke timIharUle mana parAu~chau? nissandeha timIharUle yo mana parAu~dainau | allAha yasa kurAko baDhI hakadAra hunuhuncha ki uhA~kA sRSTiharUmadhye kohI pani uhA~ko sattA zAsanamA sAjhedAra nahos | hAmI buddhimAnaharUkA lAgi yasarI udAharaNa diera vibhinna pramANa ra tarka dinchauM | kanabhane tinIharU nai tyasabATa lAbha uThAu~chan |

29 pramANa ra tyasako vyAkhyAharUko kamIle gardA tinIharU pathabhraSTa bhairahekA chainan, baru tinIharUko icchA ra pUrvajaharUko andho anusaraNale gardA pathabhraSTa hu~daichan | tinIharU AphUmAthi rahekA allAhako haka adhikArabATa anabhijJa chan | jasalAI allAha pathabhraSTa garnuhuncha usalAI kasaile sIdhAmArga dekhAuna sakdaina | allAhako yAtanAbATa jogAune kohI sahayogI hune chaina |

30 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! tapAIM ra tapAIMkA sAthIharU sabai dharmaharUlAI choDera islAma dharmatarpha nai pharkanuhos | juna dharmamA allAhale tapAIMlAI sRSTi garnubhaeko cha | yo allAhako tarphabATa prAkRtika dharma ho | uhA~le mAnavako sRSTi prAkRtika rUpamA nai garnubhaeko cha | allAhako sRSTimA kunai pherabadala hu~daina | yo sIdhA ra Thosa dharma ho, yasamA katai TeDhopana chaina | yahI ThIka dharma ho bhanne kurAlAI adhikAMsa mAnisaharU jAndainan |

31 AphnA pApaharUbATa taubA garera allAhatarpha pharka | uhA~ko AdezaharUko pAlanA garera ra uhA~le mAnahI garekA kAryaharUlAI tyAgera uhA~sita DarAU | salAha (namAja) lAI rAmro tarikAle pUrA gara | bahudevavAdIharUmadhye nabana jo prAkRtika niyamalAI bhaGga garchan ra allAhako bhaktimA arUlAI sAjhedAra banAu~chan |

32 timIharU yastA bahudevavAdIharUmadhye nabana jasale Aphno dharmalAI badalera TukrA TukrA pAre, kehImA ImAna lyAe ra kehIko inkAra gare | ani tinIharU vibhinna guTa ra samUhamA vibhAjita bhae | pratyeka samUha AphUsa~ga raheko asatyaprati prasanna bhae | mAtra tyasako samUha satyamA cha ra arU samUhaharU asatyamA chan bhanne kurA tInIharUle ThAne |

33 bahudevavAdIharU ati birAmI hu~dA, vA dhana-sampattiko khA~co hu~dA, vA bhokamarI hu~dA bintI gardai allAhatarpha pharkane garthe ra tyasa saGkaTalAI nivAraNa garidine prArthanA garthe | tara jaba allAhale tinIharUmAthi dayA garera tinIharUko saGkaTa nivAraNa garnuhunthyo taba tinIharUmadhye euTA samUha uhA~sa~ga arUlAI pukArera zirka garthyo |

34 tinIharUle allAhadvArA garieko saGkaTa nivAraNa sameta uhA~kA anya varadAnaharUprati kRtaghnatA tathA kuphra garekAle ra yasa saMsAramA mojamastI garekAle mahApralayako dina AphU spaSTa pathabhraSTatAmA thie bhanne kurAlAI AphnA A~khAle dekhnechan |

35 tinIharUle kuna AdhAramA zirka garna thAle jabaki tinIharUsa~ga yasako kunai pramANa chaina?! allAhasa~ga anya kasailAI sAjhedAra Thahara garne kunai pani pramANa hAmIle kitAbamA avataraNa garekA chainauM | tinIharUsa~ga yasto kunai kitAba pani chaina jasale tinIharUko zirka ra kuphrako puSTi garos |

36 jaba hAmIle mAnisaharUlAI svAsthya ra dhana jastA varadAnaharU pradAna garchauM taba tinIharU khusIle ghamaNDa garna thAlchan | tinIharUle garekA avajJAharUle gardA jaba tinIharUlAI roga ra garibI jasto kunai saGkaTa pugcha taba tinIharU cintita hunchan ra tyo saGkaTa samApta hu~daina bhanne kurA ThAnera nirAza hunchan |

37 ke tinIharUle yasa kurAmA vicAra gareranan− allAhale kasarI AphnA bhaktaharUmadhye kehIko jIvikA parIkSAko lAgi pharAkilo pArnuhuncha, yasa kurAko parIkSAko lAgi ki tinIharU allAhaprati kRtajJa hunchan vA kRtaghna?! allAhale AphnA bhaktaharUmadhye kehIko jIvikA parIkSAko lAgi saGkucita pArnuhuncha, yasa kurAko parIkSAko lAgi ki tinIharU dhairya garchan vA risAu~chan?! kasaiko lAgi jIvikA pharAkilo pArne ra kasaiko lAgi saGkucita pArne kAryamA mominaharUkA lAgi yasa kurAko pramANaharU chan ki allAha karuNAmaya ra dayAvAna hunuhuncha |

38 he muslima! nAtedArasa~ga puNya ra dayA garera usako haka deU, abhAvagrastako AvazyaktA pUrA gara | alapatra parekA yAtrulAI Arthika sahayoga gara tAki gharasamma pugna sakun | juna mAnisaharU yI sabai kArya allAhako mAtra prasannatA prApta garnako lAgi garchan, tinIharUkA lAgi yo rAmro hunecha | yI kArya garneharU nai svarga pAera ani narkabATa jogera saphala hunechan |

allAhako nikaTatA prApta garne karmako varNanapachi yasto karmako varNana garieko cha jasabATa allAhako nikaTatA prApta garne uddezya hu~daina, mAtra sasto sAMsArika phAidA ra lokapriyatA prApta garnako lAgi garincha | allAhale bhannubhaeko chaH
39 timIharU junasukai dhana-sampatti yasa uddezyakA sAtha kasailAI hastAntaraNa garchau ki usale tyasabhandA baDhI phirtA garnecha tyasako puNya allAhakahA~ pAu~dainau | yadi timIharU allAhako prasannatA prApta garne uddezyale kasailAI usako AvazyaktA pUrA garnako lAgi dhana-sampatti dinchau ra tyasabATa mAnisaharUsita pada vA badalA khojdainau bhane allAkahA~ kaiyauM guNA badalA pAunechau |

40 allAhale nai timIharUlAI sRSTi garnubhayo, jIvikA pradAna garnubhayo, pheri timIharUlAI mRtyu dinuhunecha, ani punaH jIvita pArnuhunecha | ke timIharUle pUjne garekA mUrtiharUle yI madhye kunai pani kAma garna sakchan?! bahudevavAdIharUle bhanekA ra vizvAsa rAkhekA kurAharUbATa allAha pavitra hunuhuncha |

41 mAnisaharUko avajJA tathA galtIle gardA thala ra jalamA phasAda maccieko cha, jastai- sukhkhA, varSAko kamI, dherai roga ra mahAmArI | tinIharUlAI tinIharUko duSkarmako kehI sajAya saMsAramai dinako lAgi phasAda maccieko cha, AzA cha tinIharUle taubA garera allAhatarpha pharkanechan |

42 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! yI bahudevavAdIharUlAI bhanidinuhos− dhartImA ghumaphira gara ani vicAra gara kasto pariNAma bhayo timIharUbhandA pahile jhUTo Thahara garne samudAyaharUko? tinIharUko ati narAmro pariNAma bhayo | tinIharUmadhye adhikAMsa muzrika thie | allAhasa~ga arUlAI sAjhedAra garekole tinIharU sarvanAza garie |

43 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! naTarine mahApralaya Aunuaghi tapAIM islAma dharmamA aDiga rahanuhos | yahI sIdhA mArga ho | yasamA kahiM katai pani TeDhopana chaina | mahApralayako dina mAnisaharU duI samUhamA bA~Dinechan | euTA samUha svargako varadAnamA ramAunecha bhane arko samUha narkako yAtanA bhognecha |

44 jasale allAhalAI inkAra garcha tyasako duSpariNAma sadhaiMko lAgi narka usaile bhognuparcha | jasale allAhako prasannatA prApta garnako lAgi satkarma garcha usale Aphnai lAgi svarga ra tyasamA rahekA varadAna tayAra garcha | yastA mAnisaharU tyasamA sadhaiM rahanechan |

45 tAki allAhale AphUmAthi ImAna lyAune ra uhA~lAI mana parAune satkarmIharUlAI Aphno kRpA ra upakArabamaTa badalA deun | uhA~le kAphiraharUlAI mana parAunuhunna, baru ati ghRNA garnuhuncha | yastA mAnisaharUlAI uhA~le mahApralayako dina cA~Dai nai kaDA yAtanA dinuhunecha |

46 allAha sAmarthyavAna ra eka mAtra pUjya hunuhuncha bhanne kurAkA ThUlA nizAnIharUmadhye yo pani ho ki uhA~ nai varSA barsAunuaghi AphnA bhaktaharUlAI tyasako zubhasUcanA dinako lAgi hAvA calAunuhuncha | he mAnava! tAki timIharUlAI varSApachi hariyAlI ra khuziyAlI pradAna garun | tAki uhA~ko AjJAle DuGgAharU samudramA guDun, tAki timIharU samudramA vyApAradvArA jIvikA khoja | tAki timIharU allAhako varadAnako lAgi uhA~prati AbhAra vyakta gara tAki uhA~ko tarphabATa timIharUlAI ajhai pradAna gariyos |

47 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! hAmIle tapAIMbhandA pahile pani dherai rasUlaharUlAI unIharUkA samudAyaharUtarpha paThAyauM | unIharU tinIharU samakSa vibhinna pramANaharU liera gae tara tinIharUle rasUlaharUkA sandezalAI jhUTo Thahara gare | ani hAmIle kharAba kAma garneharUbATa badalA liyauM ra tinIharUlAI Aphno prakopabATa sarvanAza garyauM | hAmIle rasUlaharU ra mominaharUlAI sarvanAza hunabATa jogAyauM | mominaharUlAI jogAunu ra unIharUlAI maddata garnu hAmIle AphUmAthi anivArya garekAchauM |

48 allAhale nai hAvA paThAera bAdalalAI hA~kera lyAunuhuncha, ani tyasalAI AkAzamA kama vA dherai phailAunuhuncha | kahile tyasalAI TukrA-TukrA pArnuhuncha | he darzaka! timI tyasa bAdalabATa pAnI jhariraheko dekhchau | juna bhaktaharUmAthi tyo pAnI parcha unIharU allAhako yasa kRpAbATa khuzI hunchan | tyasapachi tyasa varSAle gardA bhUmimA yastA bAlInAlI umranchan jasako AvazyaktA unIharUlAI pani huncha ra unIharUkA caupAyAharUlAI pani huncha |
49 jabaki allAhale unIharUmAthi tyasa varSA varSAunubhandA aghi unIharU nirAza thie |

50 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! bhaktaharUmAthi dayAsvarUpa allAhale barsAunubhaeko varSAkA prabhAvaharUmA vicAra garnuhos | allAhale kasarI sukeko bhUmilAI varSAdvArA jIvita pArnuhuncha ra tyasamA bAlInAlI umArnuhuncha | nissandeha jo allAle sukeko mRta dhartIlAI punarjIvita pArna saknuhuncha uhA~le nai mRtaharUlAI punaH jIvita pArnuhunecha | uhA~ hareka kArya garna sakSama hunuhuncha | kohI pani uhA~lAI vivaza pArna sakdaina |

51 yadi hAmIle tinIharUkA khetImA ra boTaviruvAharUmA kunai hAvA paThAu~chauM ani tyasale khetIlAI barbAda pArcha, ani tinIharUle Aphno harAbharA khetIlAI pahe~lo dekhchan bhane yasto dekhepachi allAhakA pahilekA neamataharU pAekA bhaepani kRtaghna banna pugchan |

52 jasarI tapAIMle marekAharUlAI sunAuna saknuhunna ra bahirAharUlAI sunAuna saknuhunna; kinabhane tinIharU AvAja sunnabATa vaJcita bhaekA chan ra tinIharUle sunnechainan bhanne nizcita cha, tyasarI nai tapAIMle vimukha bhaekA ra phAIdA uThAuna nacAhekA mAnisaharUlAI sIdhA mArga dekhAuna saknuhunna |

53 tapAIM sIdhA mArgabATa pathabhraSTa bhaekA mAnisaharUlAI mArgadarzana garna saknuhunna | yastA mAnisaharUlAI tinIharUle phAidA puryAune garI sunAuna pani saknuhunna | tapAIM hAmrA nizAnIharUmAthi ImAna lyAuneharUlAI mAtra sunAuna saknuhuncha, kinabhane tinIharU nai upadezabATa phAidA uThAu~chan | unIharU hAmro Adezako pAlanA garchan ra tyasaprati samarpita rahanchan |

54 he mAnava! allAhale nai timIharUlAI mahatvahIna pAnIbATa sRSTi garnubhayo | tyasapachi uhA~le timIharUlAI kamajora bAlya kAlabATa baliyo yuvA avasthAmA puryAunubhayo | tyasapachi uhA~le nai timIharUlAI baliyo yuvA avasthApachi kamajora buDhesakAlabATa puryAunubhayo | kamajorI ra baliyopanamadhye allAha je cAhanuhuncha sRSTi garnuhuncha | uhA~ sabai vastulAI jAnnuhuncha | uhA~bATa kehI pani lukeko chaina | uhA~ zaktizAlI hunuhuncha | uhA~lAI kasaile pani vivaza pArna sakdaina |

55 mahApralayako dina aparAdhIharU kasama khAera bhannechan: hAmIharU Aphno cihAnamA eka ghaNTAbhandA baDhI basenauM | jasarI tinIharUlAI cihAnamA baseko avadhiko jJAnabATa pheriyo tyasarI nai tinIharUlAI saMsAramA satyabATa pani pherieko thiyo |

56 jJAnI sandeSTA ra phariztAharUle bhannechan: allAhale Aphno pUrva jJAnako AdhAramA lekhnu bhaeko bhAgya anusAra timIharU Aphno janmadekhi liera punaH jIvita pArine yasa dinasamma basyau, jasalAI timIharUle asatya ThAnekA thiyau | yo tyahI dina ho jaba mAnisaharU AphnA cihAnaharUbATa jIvita pArera nikAlinechan | tara punaH jIvita pArinecha bhanne kurAlAI satya ho bhanne najAnekAle timIharUle yasalAI inkAra garekA thiyau |

57 tyasa dina allAhale prANIharUlAI hisAba ra badalAko lAgi jIvita pArnuhunecha | tyasa dina atyAcArIharUle racekA bahAnAharU tinIharUko kAma lAgne chaina | tyasa dina pazcAttApa garera ra mAphI mAgera allAhalAI khusI pArne maukA pani diine chaina | tyasako maukA saMsAramA thiyo jo bitisakyo |

58 hAmIle mAnisaharUmAthi dayA garera tinIharUkA lAgi yasa kurAnamA vibhinna udAharaNaharU varNana garekAchauM | tAki tinIharU samakSa satya ra asatya bIcako pharaka spaSTa hos | he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! yadi tapAIM kAphiraharU samakSa Aphno saccAiko pramANa liera Ae pani tinIharUle avazya bhanne thie− timIharUle lyAeko sandeza jhUTo ho |
59 allAhale tinIharUko hRdayaharUmAthi yasarI sila mohara lagAunubhayo ki tapAIMle nizAnI lyAe pani tinIharUle ImAna lyAune chainan |

60 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! tapAIMko samudAyale jhUTo Thahara garekomA dhairya garnuhos | tapAIMlAI maddata garne ra aDiga rAkhne allAhako vAcA yathAvata kAyama cha, yasamA kunai zaGkA chaina | punaH jIvita pArine kurAmA ImAna narAkhneharUko kAraNale tapAIM hatAra nagarnuhos ra dhairya nagumAunuhos |
1 (alipha. lAma. mIma.) yastA akSaraharUko bAremA sUraha al-bakarahako ArambhamA varNana bhaisakeko cha |
2 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! tapAIMmAthi avatarita yI AyataharU yasto kitAkA AyataharU hun jo vivekako kurA garchan |
3 yo kitAba yastA mAnisaharUkA lAgi mArgadarzana ra dayA ho; jo allAha ra bhaktaharUkA sabai haka pUrA garera sukarma garchan |
4 jo rAmro tarikAle salAha (namAja) kAyama garchan, AphnA dhana-sampattiko jakAta dinchan ra AkhiratakA punarjanma, hisAba, puNya ra sajAyamAthi ImAna rAkhchan |
5 yI guNaharU bhaekA mAnisaharU allAhako mArgadarzanamA chan | yinIharUle khojeko svarga pAera ra DarAieko narkabATa TADhA pAriera saphalatA prApta garnechan |

allAhale sukarmIharUkA guNaharU varNana garepachi duSkarmIharUkA avaguNaharU varNana gardai bhannubhaeko chaH
6 mAnisaharUmadhye kehI najara bina hArisa jastA mAnisaharU chan, jo mAnisaharUlAI islAma dharmabATa phernako lAgi binA jJAna nAca gAnamA AdhArita kurAharU liera Au~chan | yinIharU allAhakA AyataharUlAI khela ThaTTA banAera upahAsa garchan | yastA pApIharUlAI AkhiratamA apamAna janaka yAtanAharU diinecha |

7 jaba tinIharU samakSa hAmrA AyataharUko pATha garincha taba yasarI piThyU~ pharkAera bhAgchan mAnauM tinIharUle kehI sunekai chainan | mAnauM tinIharUko kAnamA buco cha, jasale gardA tinIharU kehI sundainan | he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! tinIharUlAI pIDAdAyI yAtanAko zubhasUcanA dinuhos jasako tinIharU pratIkSAmA chan |
8 nissandeha allAhamAthi ImAna lyAera satkarma garneharU svargamA ramAunechan | allAhale unIharU kai lAgi yasalAI tayAra pArnubhaeko cha |

9 unIharU tyasamA sadhaiM rahanechan | unIharUsa~ga yo allAhako satya vacana ho | yasamA kunai sandeha chaina | allAha prabhutvazAlI hunuhuncha | kasaile uhA~lAI vivaza pArna sakdaina | allAha sRSTi, bhAgya nirdhAraNa garna ra kAnuna banAunamA tatvadarzI hunuhuncha |

10 allAhale nai binA stambha ucca AkAzaharU banAunubhayo | uhA~le pRthvImA baliyA tathA sthira pahADaharU gADnubhayo tAki timIharUlAI liera nahalliyos | uhA~le dhartImA vibhinna prakArakA janAvaraharU phailAunubhayo | uhA~le AkAzabATa varSA barsAunubhayo ra tyasabATa dhartImA nAnA tharikA sundara boTabiruvA umArnubhayo |

11 yI sabailAI allAhale nai sRSTi garnubhayo | he bahudevavAdIharU ho! allAha bAheka jasako upAsanA timIharUle garchau, tinIharUle ke sRSTi garekA chan dekhAU?! baru atyAcArIharU satyabATa TADhA ra spaSTa pathabhraSTatAmA chan | kinabhane tinIharU yastA pUjyaharUko pUjA upAsanA garchan jasale kehI pani sRSTi garekA chainan baru tinIharU svayam sRSTi gariekA hun |

12 nissandeha hAmIle lukmAnalAI dharmako sujhabujha ra mAmilAlAI bujhne kSamatA pradAna garyauM | hAmIle unalAI bhanyauM: he lukmAna! timIharUmAthi gareko varadAna bApata Aphno pAlanakartAprati AbhAra vyakta gara | uhA~le timIlAI AjJApAlana garne avasara diera kRpA garnubhayo | jasale allAhaprati AbhAra vyakta garcha tyasako phAidA usailAI hunecha | allAhalAI tyasako AvazyaktA chaina | jasale allAhako varadAnaprati kRtaghnatA vyakta garcha usale allAhako inkAra garcha | tinIharUko kRtaghnatAko hAni usailAI huncha | allAhalAI tyasako kunai hAni hu~daina | uhA~ sRSTibATa ucca hunuhuncha ra hareka avasthAmA prazaMsanIya hunuhuncha |

13 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! smaraNa garnuhos, jaba lukmAnale Aphno putralAI bhalAiko kAryako lAgi prerita gardai ra narAmro kAryabATa sAvadhAna garAu~dai bhaneH he mero putra! allAhako sAthamA anya kasaiko bhakti nagara | allAhako sAthamA anya kasaiko bhakti garnu Aphai~mAthi mahAna atyAcAra ho | yo mahA pApale gardA sadhaiM narkamA rahanuparcha |

14 hAmIle mAnavalAI yasto kAryamA mAtA pitAko AjJApAlana garne upadeza diyauM jasamA allAhako avajJA nahos | kinabhane usakI mAtAle garbhavatI avasthAmA duHkha mAthi duHkha uThAin | stanapAna garAune avadhi 2 varSa ho | hAmIle usalAI bhanyauM− allAhale pradAna garnubhaekA varadAnaharU bApata uhA~prati AbhAra vyakta gara | tyasapachi timIharUko pAlana poSaNa gare bApata mAtA pitAprati AbhAra vyakta gara kinabhane unIharUle timro hera cAha gare | mAtra meraitarpha timIharUle pharkera Aunucha ani maile nai nisAphakA sAtha sabailAI badalA dinechu |

15 yadi timIharUkA mAtA pitAle allAhasa~ga arU kasailAI sAjhedAra banAuna dabAva dinchan bhane yasa kurAmA unIharUko AjJApAlana nagara | kinabhane jahA~ sRSTikartAko avajJA huncha tyahA~ sRSTiko AjJApAlana garnuhu~daina | saMsAramA unIharUsa~ga rAmro ra paropakArako vyavahAra gara | eka allAhako bhakti ra AjJApAlana garera merotarpha pharkane vyaktiko anusaraNa gara | timIharU sabaile mahApralayako dina meraitarpha pharkera Aunuparnecha, ani maile nai timIharUlAI tI kAryaharUbAre avagata garAunechu, jo timIharU saMsAramA gardai thiyau ra tyasako badalA dinechu |

16 he mero putra! rAyoko dAnA barAbara pani puNya vA pApa cAhe tyo caTTAnamuni hos vA AkAzamA vA pRthvIko kunai sthAnamA hos, mahApralayako dina allAhale tyasalAI hAjira garAunu hunecha ra bhaktalAI tyasako badalA dinuhunecha | allAha sukSmadarzI hunuhuncha | nissandeha allAha sukSmadarzI hunuhuncha, sAno bhandA sAno vastu pani uhA~bATa lukeko chaina | uhA~ sabai vastuko vAstavikatA ra sthAnabAre pUrNa jAnakAra hunuhuncha |

17 he mero putra! rAmro ra pUrNa tarikAle salAha (namAja) kAyama gara | satya karma garne Adeza deU, duSkarma garnabATa manAhI gara | kunai pani duHkha-kaSTa AiparemA dhairya gara | timIlAI juna Adeza diieko cha tyo timIle garnuparcha, yahI allAhako icchA ho | yasamA timIle manamAnI garna mildaina |

18 ghamaNDale gardA mAnisaharUbATa vimukha nahoU, AphUlAI ThUlo samjhera dhartImA ghamanDa gardai nahi~Da | allAhale ThUlo banera ghamaNDa gardai hi~Dne, uhA~dvArA pAeko varadAnamA ghamaNDa garne ra allAhaprati AbhArI nahuneharUlAI mana parAunuhunna |

19 madhyama gatimA sammAnita tarikAle hi~Da, na dherai teja gatimA ra na ati Dhilo gatimA | madhyama svaramA kurA gara, na ati carko svaramA jasale gardA kasailAI kaSTa pugos | carko svara bhaeko hunAle gadhAko svara ati narAmro svara mAnincha |

20 he mAnava! ke timIharUle dekhenau, allAhale timIharUkA lAgi AkAzamA rahekA sUrya, candramA ra tArAharUbATa phAidA uThAuna sajilo banAunubhaeko cha ra dhartImA rahekA caupAyA, rUkha ra biruvAbATa phAidA uThAuna pani sajilo banAunubhaeko cha | uhA~le timIharUlAI A~khAle dekhine varadAnaharU; jastai- sundaratA ra nadekhine varadAnaharU; jastai- buddhi ra jJAna pUrA-pUrA dinubhaeko cha | allAhakA yI varadAnaharUkA bAvajuda kehI mAnisaharU binA AkAzIya jJAna, binA viveka ra binA spaSTa kitAba allAhako tauhIda (ekezvaravAda) mA vAda vivAda gardachan |

21 ekezvaravAdamA vAda vivAda garneharUlAI jaba bhanincha, allAhale Aphno rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) mAthi avataraNa garnubhaeko vahI (IzavANI) ko anusaraNa gara taba tinIharU bhanchan− hAmIle tyasako anusaraNa gardainau, hAmIle AphnA pUrvajabATa pAeko mUrti pUjAko anusaraNa garchauM | ke tinIharUle AphnA pUrvajaharUkai anusaraNa garnechan jabaki zaitAnale tinIharUlAI mUrti pUjAtarpha AhvAna garera pathabhraSTa gardaicha, jasale gardA tinIharU mahApralayako dina narkako AgomA hAlinechan?!

22 jo vyakti niSkapaTa bhaI zuddha rUpale allAha kai lAgi upAsanA garcha ra sukarma garera uhA~tarpha pharkancha, usale sabaibhandA bharapardo sahArA samAtcha | tyo yasto sahArA ho jasabATa saphalatA prApta hune AzA huncha ra jo TuTcha bhanne Dara pani hu~daina | sabai mAmilAharU allAhatarpha nai pharkera jAnechan | uhA~le sabailAI tyasto badalA dinuhunecha jasako unIharU hakadAra hunechan |

23 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! allAhalAI inkAra garneharUko inkArale tapAIMlAI cintita napAros | mahApralayako dina tinIharU hAmraitarpha pharkera Aunechan ani hAmIle tinIharUle saMsAramA garekA duSkarmabATa tinIharUlAI avagata garAunechauM ra tyasako sajAya dinechauM | nissandeha allAhale manamA lukekA kurAharU pani jAnnuhuncha | uhA~bATa kehI pani gopya chaina |
24 hAmIle tinIharUlAI kehI dinako lAgi sAMsArika mojamastIkA sAmAna dinechauM ani mahApralayako dina ati kaDA yAtanA narkatarpha pharkAunechauM |

25 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! yadi tapAIMle yI bahudevavAdIharUlAI sodhnuhunchaH kasale AkAzaharU ra pRthvIlaI sRSTi gareko ho? tinIharUle avazya nai bhannechan: sabailAI allAhale nai sRSTi garnubhaeko ho | tinIharUlAI bhanidinuhos− sabai prazaMsA allAhako lAgi chan jasale pramANalAI timIharUkA lAgi spaSTa pArnubhayo | tara prazaMsAko hakadAra ko hun bhanne kurAlAI tinIharUmadhye adhikAMsa mAnisaharUle jAndainan |

26 AkAzaharU ra pRthvImA rahekA sabai vastuharUkA sRSTikartA, mAlika ra saJcAlaka allAha mAtra hunuhuncha | uhA~lAI jagatakA kunai prANIko AvazyaktA chaina | uhA~ loka ra paraloka duvaimA prazaMsanIya hunuhuncha |

27 yadi dhartImA rahekA sabai rUkhaharUlAI kATera kalama banAincha ra samudrako pAnIlAI masI banAincha ani tyastai arU sAtavaTA samudrakA pAnIlAI masI banAera lekhepani allAhakA zabda tathA prazaMsAharU saki~dainan | kinabhane uhA~kA kalimAta tathA zabdaharU asImita | nissandeha allAha prabhutvazAlI hunuhuncha, kohI pani uhA~lAI vivaza pArna sakdaina | uhA~ sRSTi garna ra kArya saJcAlanamA tatvadarzI hunuhuncha |

28 he mAnava! timIharU sabaiko sRSTi ra mahApralayako dina jIvita pArera uThAinu allAhako lAgi eka janAko sRSTi garnu ra jIvita pArera uThAinu jastai sajilo cha | allAha sarvazrotA hunuhuncha | sabaikA kurAlAI eka sAtha sunna sakSama hunuhuncha | uhA~ sarvadraSTA hunuhuncha | sabailAI ekasAtha dekhna sakSama hunuhuncha | tyastai uhA~ sabailAI eka sAtha sRSTi garna ra punaH jIvita pArna pUrNa rUpama sakSama hunuhuncha |

29 ke timIharUle yasa kurAmA vicAra garenau− allAha kasarI rAtalAI choTo pArera dinalAI lAmo pArnuhuncha ra dinalAI choTo pArera rAtalAI lAmo pArnuhuncha | uhA~le nai sUrya ra candramAko hi~Dne sthAna nirdhArita garnubhayo jasamA yI duvai nirdhArita samayamA hi~Dchan | allAhale timIharUkA karmalAI hernuhuncha | timIharUkA kunai pani kArya uhA~bATa lukeko chaina ra uhA~le tyasako badalA dinuhunecha |

30 allAhako yo kArya saJcAlana ra bhAgya nirdhAraNa yasa kurAko gavAhI dinchan− allAha mAtra vAstavika pUjya hunuhuncha | allAha Aphno astitva, guNa ra kAryamA satya hunuhuncha ra bahudevavAdIharU uhA~ bAheka jasako pani pUjA garchan tI sabai asatya ra nirAdhAra hun | allAha astitva, prabhutva ra bhAgya nirdhAraNamA sabai prANIharUbhandA ucca hunuhuncha | uhA~bhandA ucca kohI pani chaina | uhA~ sabai vastuharUbhandA mahAn hunuhuncha |

31 he mAnisaharU ho! ke timIharUle yasa kurAmA vicAra garenau− DuGgAharU samudramA uhA~kai dayA ra adhinamA guDchan | tAki timIharUle uhA~ko Aphno prabhutva ra kRpAlAI pramANita garne nizAnIharU dekhna saka | kaSTaharUmA dhairya garne ra varadAnaharUprati AbhAra vyakta garneharUkA lAgi yasamA yasa kurAko pramANaharU chan ki uhA~ prabhutvazAlI hunuhuncha |

32 jaba tinIharU cAraitirabATa samudrakA pahADa jastA lahara ra bAdalaharUko capeTamA parchan taba allAhakai lAgi prArthanA ra bhaktilAI niSkapaTa pArera uhA~lAI mAtra pukArchan, tara jaba allAhale tinIharUlAI DubnabATa jogAera sakuzala thalamA puryAunuhuncha taba tinIharUmadhye kehI madhya mArgIharU eka hadasamma allAhaprati AbhArI hunchan tara pUrNarUpamA AbhArI hundainan | tinIharUmadhye kehI allAhakA varadAnaharUko lAgi uhA~prati AbhArI hu~dainan | tinIharU dhokebAja hun kinabhane tinIrUle vAcA garekA thie− yadi uhA~le jogAunubhayo bhane hAmIharU uhA~prati AbhArI hunechauM tara khatarA Tarepachi tinIharU uhA~prati AbhAra vyakta garenan | baru uhA~ko varadAnaharUprati kRtaghna bhae |

33 he mAnava! allAhakA AdezaharUko pAlanA garera ra uhA~le manAhI garekA kAryaharUlAI tyAgera uhA~sita Dara | timIharU tyasa dinako yAtanAbATa Dara juna dina na pitAle putralAI na putrale pitAlAI kunai phAidA puryAuna sakcha | mahApralayako dina allAhale avazya nai Aphno vAcA pUrA garera badalA dinuhunecha | sAMsArika jIvana ra tyasakA mojamastIle timIharUlAI dhokAmA napAros | allAhako tarphabATa sahanazIlatA ra prakopa paThAunamA DhIlole gardA zaitAnale timIharUlAI dhokAmA napAros |

34 kayAmata (mahApralaya) ko bAremA allAhalAI mAtra pUrNa jAnakArI cha, mahApralayako ghaTanA kahile ghaTcha bhanne uhA~lAI mAtra thAhA cha, uhA~le jahile cAhanuhuncha varSA varSAunuhuncha, AmAko garbhamA chorA cha ki chorI, tyo bhAgyavAna cha ki abhAgi, bholI kosa~ga ke huncha, rAmro ki narAmro? yI kurAharUko jJAna kasailAI chaina, baru mAtra allAhalAI cha | nissandeha allAha sampUrNa kurAharUkA jAnakAra hunuhuncha uhA~bATa kehI pani lukeko chaina |
1 (alipha. lAma. mIma.) yastA akSaraharUko bAremA sUraha al-bakarahako ArambhamA varNana bhaisakeko cha |
2 muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) le lyAunubhaeko yo kurAna sampUrNa jagatakA pAlanakartAko tarphabATa uhA~mAthi avataraNa bhaeko kurAmA kunai sandeha chaina |

3 yI kAphiraharU bhanchan− yasa kurAnalAI muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) le AphaiM racera yo allAhako tarphabATa Aeko bhanchan | tinIharUle bhaneko kurA ThIka chaina | baru yo allAhako tarphabATa avataraNa bhaeko kurAmA kunai sandeha chaina | he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! tapAIMko jimmevArI yasto samudAyalAI allAhako prakopabATa DarAunu ho jo samakSa kunai rasUla Aenan | AzA cha tinIharU satya mArga pAunechan, tyasako anusaraNa garnechan ra tyasa anusAra karma garnechan |

4 allAha nai hunuhuncha jasale AkAzaharU, pRthvI ra yI duvaibIcakA vastuharUlAI 6 dinamA sRSTi garnubhayo | jabaki uhA~le tyo bhandA kama samaya athavA A~khA jhimkyAu~dA bittikai pani sRSTi garna saknuhunthyo | tyasapachi uhA~ Aphno zAna anusAra siMhAsana (arza) mA virAjamAna hunubhayo | he mAnava! uhA~ bAheka timIharUko kohI saMrakSaka tathA sahayogI chaina jasale timIharUko mAmilAko heracAha garos | uhA~ bAheka timIharUko kohI siphArisakartA hune chaina jasale allAha samakSa timIharUko siphArisa garos | ke timIharU cintana manan gardainau ki timIharUle eka mAtra sRSTikartA allAhako bhakti garnuparcha ra uhAsa~ga anya kasaiko bhakti garnuhunna?!
5 AkAzaharU ra pRthvImA rahekA sabai prANIharUko kArya saJcAlana garne allAha mAtra hunuhuncha | he mAnava! pheri tyo mAmilA allAhakahA~ timIharUle gantI gareko 1000 varSamA uhA~samma pugcha |

6 uhA~le nai yI sabai mAmilAko saJcAlana garnuhuncha | uhA~ upasthita ra anupasthitakA jJAtA hunuhuncha | uhA~bATa kehI pani lukeko chaina | uhA~ prabhutvazAlI hunuhuncha ra AphnA zatruharUsa~ga badalA linuhuncha | uhA~lAI kohI pani vivaza pArna sakdaina | uhA~ AphnA momina bhaktaharUprati dayAvAna hunuhuncha |
7 jasale sabai vastuharU rAmro tarikAle sRSTi garnubhayo ra binA kunai aghillo udAharaNa Adama (alaihissalAma) ko sRSTi mATobATa garnubhayo |
8 tyasapachi unako nasala (vaMzaja) mahatvahIna pAnI (virya) bATa jArI garnubhayo |

9 pheri mAnavako sRSTi pUrNarUpamA garnubhayo ra zarIramA AtmA hAlne phariztAle allAhako Adezale AtmA hAle | he mAnava! allAhale timIharUlAI sunnako lAgi kAna dinubhayo, hernako lAgi A~khA dinubhayo, vicAra garnako lAgi dila dinubhayo | allAhale pradAna garnubhaekA yI varadAnaharUkA lAgi timIharU uhA~prati kamai AbhAra vyakta garchau |

10 mRtyu pazcAta punaH jIvita pArera uThAine kurAlAI inkAra garne bahudevavAdIharUle bhane− ke jaba hAmIharU marera mATomA misinchauM ra hAmrA zarIra mATo bhaihAlchan taba hAmIharUlAI punaH sRSTi garinecha?! yo kurA ta samajhamA Au~daina | vAstavamA tinIharUle punaH jIvita hune kurAlAI inkAra garchan, tyasamA ImAna rAkhdainan |

11 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! punaH jIvita hune kurAlAI inkAra garne yI bahudevavAdIharUlAI bhanidinuhos− prANa nikAlnakA lAgi niyukta gariekA mRtyukA phariztAle timIharUko prANa nikAlnechan, tyasapachi mahApralayako dina timIharU hisAba ra badalAko lAgi hAmItarpha pharkera Aunechau |

12 mahApralayako dina aparAdhIharU cA~Dai nai apamAnita bhaera prakaTa hunechan | punaH jIvica hune kurA inkAra garekAle tinIharU TAuko nihurAekA hunechan | tinIharUle bhannechan− he hAmrA pAlanakartA! hAmIlAI dekhAunuhos | hAmIle punaH jIvita hune kurAlAI inkAra gardainathyauM | tapAIMko tarphabATa AekA rasUlaharUle pani tyastai kurA bhandai garekA sunekA thiyauM | hAmIlAI punaH sAMsArika jIvanamA pharkAunuhos, hAmIle tapAIMko icchA anusAra satkarma garnechauM | aba hAmIle punaH jIvita hune kurAmA ImAna rAkhnechauM ra rasUlaharUle lyAekA sandezalAI saccA mAnnechauM | tapAIMle aparAdhIharUlAI tyasa avasthAmA dekhepachi ThUlo ghaTanAlAI dekhnuhunecha |

13 yadi hAmIle sabailAI mArgadarzana dina cAhemA dinasakthyauM tara viveka ra nisAphako AdhAramA hAmro yo nirNaya anivArya bhayo− maile avazya nai mahApralayako dina narkalAI kAphira mAnisaharU ra jinnaharUbATa bharnechu | kinabhane tinIharUle ImAna lyAune ra tyasamA aDiga rahane kAryalAI chADera kuphra ra pathabhraSTatAko mArgalAI roje |

14 tinIharUlAI mahApralayako dina nindA gardai bhaninecha− timIharU sAMsArika jIvanamA mahApralayako dina allAhasa~ga bheTa hunecha bhanne kurAmA lAparavAha thiyau, tyasaile yAtanA bhoga | hAmIle timIharUko parvAha nagarikana timIharUle soce jastai yAtanAmA choDidiyauM | narkako sadhaiM rahane yAtanAlAI cAkha | timIharUle saMsAramA gareko avajJAko kAraNale yo kahile samApta hune chaina |

aparAdhIharUko avasthAko varNanapachi allAhale mominaharUko avasthAko varNana gardai bhannubhaeko chaH
15 hAmIle AphnA rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) mAthi avataraNa garekA AyatamAthi tI mAnisaharU ImAna lyAu~chan jo upadeza sunepachi allAhako prazaMsA ra mahimAgAna gardai sajdA garchan | unIharU allAhako bhakti ra uhA~ko sajdAbATa kunai pani hAlatamA ghamaNDa gardainan |

16 unIharUkA zarIra unIharUkA bichyaunAbATa alaga rahanchan ra tyasalAI choDera allAhatarpha pharkanchan | unIharU allAhako yAtanAbATa DarAu~dai ra uhA~ko kRpAprati cAhanA gardai namAjamA ra tyasa bAheka arU avasthAmA pani allAhasita duA garchan | hAmIle pradAna garekA dhana-sampattilAI unIharU hAmrai mArgamA kharca garchan |

17 allAhale A~khA zitalatA pradAna garne kasto badalA tayAra pArnubhaeko cha bhanne kurA kasailAI thAhA chaina | yo badalA allAhale unIharUkA tI satkarmaharUko badalA svarUpa tayAra pArnubhaeko cha jo tinIharUle sAMsArika jIvanamA garekA thie | yasa badalAko mahAnatAlAI allAhale mAtra jAnnu huncha |

18 eka allAhamAthi ImAna rAkhne, uhA~kA AdezaharUko pAlanA garne ra uhA~le manAhI garnubhaekA kAryaharUlAI tyAgne mAnisaharU avajJAkArI mAnisaharU saraha huna sakdainan | yI duvai jamAtaharUko badalA allAhakahA~ ekasamAna huna sakdaina |

19 eka allAhamAthi ImAna rAkhne ra satkarma garneharUko badalA allAhako pAsamA svargako rUpamA tayAra cha | unIharU tyasamA sadhaiM rahechan ra allAhako tarphabATa sammAna pAunechan | yo ho unIharUle saMsAramA garekA satkarmaharUko badalA |

20 kuphra ra avajJA garera allAhako AjJApAlanabATa bAhira haTekA mAnisaharUkA lAgi allAhale mahApralayako dina narka tayAra garnubhaeko cha | tinIharU tyasamA sadhaiM rahanechan | jaba-jaba tyasabATa niskane prayAsa garnechan tyasamA phirtA paThAinechan | tinIharUko nindA gardai bhaninecha− narkako yAtanA cAkha | jaba saMsAramA timIharUkA rasUlaharU yasabATa DarAune garthe taba timIharU yasalAI jhUTo Thahara gardathyau |

21 yI jhUTA Thahara garne avajJAkArI mAnisaharUharUlAI hAmIle avazya nai saMsAramA saGkaTagrasta garnechauM | yadi tinIharU taubA gardainan bhane AkhiratamA tinIharUkA lAgi ThUlo yAtanA tayAra nai cha | AzA cha tinIharU allAhako AjJApAlanatarpha pharkanechan |

22 yastA mAnisaharU sabaibhandA ThUlA atyAcArI hun jasalAI allAhakA AyataharU sunAera upadeza diMdA tyasalAI grahaNa gardainan, baru tyasako parvAha nagarikana tyasabATa vimukha hunchan | kuphra ra avajJA garera aparAdha garne ra AyataharUbATa vimukha huneharUsita hAmIle avazya nai badalA linechauM |

23 hAmIle mUsA (alaihissalAma) lAI taurAta pradAna garyauM | he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! isrA ra merAjako rAta mUsA (alaihissalAma) sa~ga tapAIMko bheTamA zaGkA nagarnuhos | hAmIle mUsA (alaihissalAma) mAthi avatarita taurAtalAI banI isrAIlako lAgi mArgadarzana banAyauM |

24 hAmIle isrAIlakA santAnaharUmadhye kehIlAI aguvA banAyauM | mAnisaharU satya kurAmA unIharUko anusaraNa garne garthe | hAmro anumati ra preraNAle gardA unIharU mAnisaharUlAI satmArga dekhAune garthe | hAmIle unIharUlAI tyatikhera aguvA banAyauM jaba unIharUle aDiga bhaera hAmrA AdezaharUko pAlanA gare, manAhI gariekA kAryaharUbATa bace ra AhvAna gardA pugekA kaSTaharUlAI sahana gare | unIharU AphnA rasUlamAthi avatarita AyataharUko pUrNarUpamA puSTi gardathe |

25 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! mahApralayako dina tapAIMkA pAlanakartAle avazya tI mAmilAharUko nirNaya garnuhunecha jasamA tinIharU saMsAramA vibheda garne garthe | uhA~le satyavAdI ra asatyavAdIharUlAI chuTyAunu hunecha ra tinIharUlAI tinIharUkA karma anusAra badalA dinuhunecha |

26 ke tinIharU andhA bhaisakekA chan ra yo kurA tinIharU samakSa spaSTa bhaeko chaina ki vigatakA katipaya samudAyaharUlAI hAmIle sarvanAza pAryauM?! tinIharU ta vigatakA samudAyaharUkA sarvanAza pAriekA gharaharU najikabATa hi~DaDula garirAkhchan | ke tinIharUko avasthAbATa pATha li~dainan | kuphra ra avajJAko kAraNale sarvanAza pAriekA samudAyaharUmA pATha cha ra yasa kurAko pramANa cha ki allAhako tarphabATa AekA tinIharUkA rasUlaharU saccA thie | ke yI jhUTA Thahara garneharU allAhakA AyataharUlAI svIkAra garne ra pATha line garI sundainan?!

27 mRtyu pazcAta punaH jIvita garine kurA inkAra garneharUle yasa kurAmA vicAra garenan− hAmIle sukeko bhUmitarpha varSAko pAnI paThAu~chauM, ani tyasamA rUkha ra ghA~sa umranchan jasamA tinIharUkA U~Ta, gAI ra bheDA carne garchan ra tinIharU svayam pani tyasabATa khAne garchan?! ke tinIharUle dekhenan ra bujhenan− juna allAhale yI murdA bhUmilAI jIvita pArne zakti rAkhnuhuncha uhA~le mRtaharUlAI punaH jIvita pArne zakti pani rAkhnuhuncha?!

28 punaH jIvita garine kurAlAI jhUTo Thahara garneharUle prakopako lAgi hatAra gardai bhanchan− timIharUle ThAneko Adeza kahile Aunecha jasale mahApralayako dina hAmIbIca nirNaya garnecha, ani hAmro vAsasthAna narka hunecha ra timIharUko vAsasthAna svarga hunecha?!

29 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! yinIharUlAI bhanidinuhos, yo vacana mahApralayako dina pUrA hunecha jo vAstavamA bhaktaharUbIca nirNayako dina hunecha | mahApralayalAI dekhepachi saMsAramA allAhako inkAra garneharUlAI tyasako puSTile kunai phAidA dine chaina ra tinIharUlAI taubA garne avasara pani diine chaina |

30 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! yinIharU pathabhraSTatAmA lAgirahanchan yinIharUlAI bevAstA garnuhos ra yinIharUmAthi Aune prakopako lAgi parkhanuhos | tapAIMle vacana dinubhaeko prakopako lAgi yinIharU parkhi rAkhekA chan |

1 he nabI (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! allAhako AdezaharUko pAlanA garera ra uhA~le manAhI garnubhaekA kAryaharUlAI tyAgera takvA (Izabhaya) mA kAyama rahanuhos | uhA~sita mAtra DarAunuhos | kAphira (avajJAkArI) ra munAphika (kapaTI) harUko icchAko anusaraNa nagarnuhos | allAhale kAphira ra munAphikaharUko calakhelabATa avagata hunuhuncha | uhA~ sRSTi garna ra kArya saJcAlana garnamA tatvadarzI hunuhuncha |

2 tapAIMmAthi allAhale je jati vahI (IzavANI) avataraNa garnuhuncha tyasako anusaraNa garnuhos | nissandeha allAha tapAIM lagAyata sabaile garekA kAryaharUsita pUrNarUpamA avagata hunuhuncha | uhA~le tapAIharUkA kAryaharUko badalA dinuhunecha |
3 AphnA sabai mAmilAharUmA allAhamAthi mAtra bharosA garnuhos | jo bhakta pani uhA~mAthi bharosA garcha uhA~ usako rakSAko lAgi paryApta hunuhuncha |

4 jasarI allAhale eka janA vyaktiko chAtimA duIvaTA hRdayaharU banAunu bhaena tyasarI uhA~le sammAnako dRSTile zrImatIharUlAI AmAharUko darjAmA rAkhnu bhaena | ThIka tyastai uhA~le dattaka putralAI sAkhkhai putrako darjAmA rAkhnu bhaena | jihAra (puruSale AphnI zrImatIlAI AmA ra bahinI jastai AphUmAthi avaidha garnu) ra dattaka putra (dharma putra) banAunu pani islAma pUrvako tarikA thiyo; jasalAI islAmale radda garyo | jihAra ra dattaka putra banAunu timIharUle mukhale boleko kurA mAtra ho, yasako kunai vAstavikatA chaina | zrImatI AmA huna sakdaina ra kasaile dAbI gardaimA dattaka putra sAkhkhai putra huna sakdaina | allAhale satya kurA bhannuhuncha tAki bhaktaharUle tyasa anusAra karma garun | ani uhA~le satya mArgatira mArgadarzana pani garnuhuncha |

5 dattaka putraharUlAI unIharUkA vAstavika buvAharUtarpha joDera bolAU | yo nai allAha najika nisApha ho | yadi unIharUkA buvAharUko bAremA thAhA chaina bhane unIharU timIharUkA dharmika bhAi hun | dAsatvabATa mukta gariekA svatantra vyakti hun | ataH unIharUlAI− he mero bhAi vA he mero bhatija bhanera bolAU | yadi kasaile pahilA dattaka putralAI usako dattaka buvAtarpha joDyo bhane U pApI bhaena tara aba jAnI jAnI yadi kasaile yasto garcha bhane U pApI huncha | taubA garne bhaktaharUlAI allAha mApha garnuhuncha | uhA~ dayAvAna hunuhuncha tyasaile galatImA pakaDa garnuhunna |

6 nabI (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) mominaharUkA lAgi unIharUkA prANabhandA pyAro hunuhuncha | unIharUkA hRdayako jhukAva arUtarpha hos tara unIharUle uhA~ (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) ko AhvAnalAI prAthamikatA dinuparcha | uhA~ (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) kI patnIharU sabai mominaharUkA lAgi AmA saraha hun | uhA~ (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) ko mRtyupachi uhA~kA kunai pani patnIsa~ga bihe garnu sabai mominaharUko lAgi harAma cha | kehI nAtedAraharUle anya nAtedAraharUko tulanAmA paitRka sampattimA baDhI aMza pAunechan | kohI pani ImAna ra hijratako AdhAramA paitRka sampattimA aMziyAra bandaina | surumA unIharU ImAna ra hijratako AdhAramA pani aMziyAra banne garthe tara pachi yasa kAnunalAI radda gariyo | he mominaharU ho! AphnA mitraharUlAI antima upadeza diera kehI aMza dina sakchau, tyo pani niyama anusAra ra paropakAra garera | yo Adeza surakSita pATI (lauhe mahaphUja) mA lekhieko cha, ataH yasalAI vyavahAramA lyAunu anivArya cha |

7 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! tyasa samayalAI yAda garnuhos, jaba hAmIle sandeSTAharUsita pakkA vacana liyauM ki unIharUle eka mAtra allAhako bhakti garnechan | uhA~sa~ga anya kasailAI sAjhedAra Thahara garne chainan | unIharUtarpha avataraNa garieko vahI (IzavANI) lAI arUsamma puryAunechan | yo vacana hAmIle vizeSarUpamA tapAIMsa~ga ra nUha, ibrahIma, mUsA tathA maryama putra IsA (alaihimussalAma) sa~ga liyauM | unIharUle allAhako sandezalAI puryAune jimmevArIlAI pUrNarUpamA nirvAha garnechan bhanne pakkA vacana hAmIle liyauM |

8 sandeSTAharUsa~ga yo vacana allAhale yasa kAraNale pani linubhayo ki mahApralayako dina uhA~le kAphiraharUko nindAko lAgi sandeSTAharUsa~ga sodhnuhunecha- timIharUle yasa satya dharmalAI puryAekA thiyau ki thienau? allAhale kAphiraharUkA lAgi narkako pIDAdAyI yAtanA tayAra pArnubhaeko cha |

9 he AsthAvAnaharU ho! allAhale timIharUmAthi garnubhaeko varadAnalAI yAda gara, jaba kAphiraharU jatthA banAera timIharU viruddha yuddha garna madInA puge | munAphika ra yahUdIharUle kAphiraharUlAI maddata gare | tyatikhera nabI (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) ko maddatako lAgi hAmIle hAvAhurI paThAyauM | hAmIle phariztAharUko sainya dala pani paThAyauM jasalAI timIharUle dekhenau | ani kAphiraharU piThyU~ pharkAera bhAge ra kehI pani garna sakenan | timIharUle garirahekA kAryaharUlAI allAha dekhirahanu huncha | uhA~bATa kehI pani lukeko chaina | uhA~le timIharUlAI timIharUle garirahekA kAryaharUko badalA dinuhunecha |

10 yo tyatikhera bhayo jaba kAphiraharU upatyakAko pazcima ra pUrva duvaitirakA ukAlo ra orAlobATa Ae | tyatikhera timIharU sabaiko dRSTi zatrumAthi thiyo | timIharUkA muTuharU Darale yati kA~pekA thie ki ghA~TIsamma puge jhai~ bhaekA thie | timIharUle allAhaprati vibhinna prakArakA anumAna garna thAlekA thiyau, kahile maddatako AzA ta kahile nirAzA |

11 khandaka (khADala) ko yuddhamA tyatikhera mominaharUko khubai parIkSA bhayo | zatruharUko tarphabATa unIharUle kaSTa bhoge ra Darale gardA khubai byAkula bhae | yasa parIkSAle gardA ko momina ho ra ko munAphika ho bhanne kurA charlaGga bhayo |

12 tyasa dina munAphika ra manamA zaGkA rAkhekA kamajora ImAnakA mAnisaharUle bhaneH allAha ra uhA~kA rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) le zatruharU viruddha hAmro maddata garne ra dhartImA sthApita garne juna vAcA garnubhaeko cha tyo jhUTo ra nirAdhAra vAcA ho |

13 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! tyasa samayalAI yAda garnuhos, jaba munAphikaharUko euTA jatthAle madInA bAsIharUlAI bhanyo− he yasriba bAsIharU ho! (islAma pUrva madInAko yahI nAma thiyo) yasa khADala (khandaka) najika timIharUko lAgi kunai sthAna chaina, yahA~bATa AphnA ghara pharkera jAU | tinIharUmadhye euTA samUha AphnA ghara pharkanako lAgi nabI (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) sita anumati mAgna thAlyo | tinIharUle ke bahAnA banAe bhane hAmro ghara zatruharUko gharako cheumA khullA ra asurakSita cha | tara tinIharUle ThAne jasto khullA thiena | zatrubATa bhAgnako lAgi tinIharU jhUTA bahAnA banAu~dai thie |

14 yadi madInAmA cAraitirabATa zatruharU praveza garchan ra tinIharUlAI islAma dharma tyAgera kuphra ra zirkatarpha pharkana bhanchan bhane tinIharU pharkanechan | tinIharUmadhye kuphratarpha napharkane kamai mAnisaharU hunechan |

15 yI munAphikaharU uhudako dina yuddhabATa pharAra bhaepachi vAcA garekA thie ki AindA yuddha bhaemA unIharU yuddha garnechan ra zatrusa~ga DarAera pharAra hune chainan | tara tinIharUle vacana bhaGga gare jabaki allAhasa~ga gareko vAcAbAre sodhapUcha hunecha | ataH tinIharUsita cA~Dai nai sodhapUcha hunecha |

16 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! yinIharUlAI bhanidinuhos− mRtyu vA hatyA garine Darale yuddhako maidAnabATa bhAgne kAryale timIharUlAI kunai phAidA hune chaina | kinabhane mRtyuko samaya nizcita cha | yadi timIharU pharAra hunchau ra mRtyuko samaya naAe pani timIharU kehI dina mAtra jIvita rahanechau |

17 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! yinIharUlAI bhanidinuhos− yadi allAhale timIharUlAI mana naparne cIja mRtyu dina vA hatyA garna cAhanuhuncha bhane tyasabATa kasale timIharUlAI jogAuna sakcha? yadi allAhale timIharUlAI surakSita ra sakuzala rAkhnuhuncha jasako AzA timIharU rAkhchau bhane kasale timIharUlAI yasabATa vaJcita rAkhnuhuncha? yI munAphikaharUle allAha bAheka kunai heracAha garne saMrakSaka ra prakopabATa jogAune sahayogI pAune chaina |

18 rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) ko sAthamA milera yuddha garnabATa pachADi rahane mAnisaharUko bAremA allAhalAI thAhA cha | tinIharUle AphnA bhAiharUlAI bhanchan− hAmItarpha AU ra uhA~ (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) ko sAthamA yuddhamA bhAga naleU tAki timIharU hatAhata nahoU | timIharUko hatyA huncha bhanne kurAbATa hAmIlAI Dara lAgcha | yI apamAnita garneharU yuddhamA kamai bhAga linchan | yuddhamA abhiyogabATa bacnako lAgi mAtra sahabhAgI hunchan | allAha ra rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) ko maddatako lAgi yuddhamA bhAga li~dainan |

19 he mominaharU ho! yinIharU kanjusa hun, timIharUlAI Arthika sahayoga gardainan | Aphno jyAnako mAmilAmA pani kAyara tathA kanjusa chan tyasaile timIharUko sAthamA yuddha gardainan | mitratAmA pani kanjusa chan tyasaile timIharUsa~ga mitratA rAkhdainan | he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! jaba zatruharUsa~ga muThabheDa huncha taba Darale gardA tinIharUko A~khA yasarI ghumna thAlchan jasarI mRtyuko pIDAle A~khA ghumna thAlchan | Darako avasthA samApta bhaepachi ra nizcinta bhaepachi tinIharU tikho vacanale tapAIMlAI kaSTa dina thAlchan | tinIharU ganimatako mAla (yuddhamA prApta dhanamAla) ko baDo lobhI hunchan, sadhai~ tyasaiko khojimA hunchan | yastA avaguNaharU bhaekA mAnisaharU vAstavamA momina hoinan | allAhale tinIharUkA karmakA puNyaharUlAI radda garnubhayo | karmaharUkA puNya radda garnu allAhako lAgi sajilo kArya ho |

20 yI kAyaraharUle ke ThAnekA chan bhane rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) ra mominaharU viruddha yuddha garna AekA jatthAharUle yinIharUlAI jaraidekhi nai sakhApa pArnechan | yadi arko paTaka yI jatthAharUle madInAmAthi AkramaNa garchan bhane yI munAphikaharU ke kAmanA garchan bhane yinIharU madInA bAhira gAu~leharUsa~ga basera timIharUko hAla khabara sodhirahun ki yuddhako ke kasto pariNAma bhayo? he mominaharU ho! yadi tinIharU timIharUsa~ga bhaekA bhae yuddhamA kamai bhAga line thie | timIharU yinIharUko parvAha nagara na yinIharUko cintA gara |

21 rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) ko bhanAi ra garAimA timIharUkA lAgi utkRSTa namunA cha | jaba uhA~ (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) AphaiM upasthita hunubhayo ra yuddhamA bhAga linubhayo bhane timIharU kina Aphno jyAna corAi rahekA chau? rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) prati dayAbhAva yastA mAnisaharU rAkhchan jo allAhako tarphabATa puNya tathA dayAko AzA rAkhchan, Akhiratako dinako AzA rAkhchan, tyasako lAgi kArya garchan ra allAhalAI khubai smaraNa garchan | Akhiratako dinako AzA narAkhne ra allAhalAI smaraNa nagarneharU rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) prati dayAbhAva rAkhdainan |

22 jaba mominaharUle AphnA A~khAle tI jatthAharUlAI dekhe; jo unIharU viruddha yuddha garna bhelA bhaekA thie taba bhaneH yahI tyo parIkSA, saGgharSa ra maddata ho jasako vAcA allAha ra uhA~ko rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) le garnubhaeko thiyo | allAha ra uhA~ko rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) le yasako bAremA satya bhannubhaeko thiyo, jo pUrA bhayo | jatthAharUlAI AphnA A~khAle dekhepachi allAhaprati unIharUko ImAna ra AjJApAlanamA nai vRddhi bhayo |

23 mominaharUmadhye kehI yastA mAnisaharU chan jasale DaTera, dhairya garera ra allAhako mArgamA yuddha garera uhAsa~ga gareko vAcAlAI pUrA gare | unIharUmadhye kehI mare, kehI allAhako mArgamA zahIda bhae ra unIharUmadhye kehI allAhako mArgamA zahAdata prApta garne Aphno pAlo kurirahekA chan | munAphikaharU jastai yinIharUle Aphno vacana bhaGga garekA chainan |

24 tAki allAhale Aphno vAcA pUrA garekA satyavAdIharUlAI rAmro badalA dinuhunecha ra vacana bhaGga garekA munAphikaharUlAI uhA~le cAhemA yAtanA dinuhunecha | ki ta kuphrabATa taubA garnubhandA pahile nai tinIharUko jyAna linuhunecha ki ta tinIharUlAI taubA garne avasara pradAna garera mApha garnuhunecha | nissande allAha taubA garneharUkA pApaharUlAI mApha garnuhuncha ra unIharUmAthi dayA garnuhuncha |
