25 mominaharUlAI jaraidekhi sakhApa pArne kuraiza, gataphAna ra tinIharUkA sahayogIharUko sapanA sAkAra nabhaepachi tinIharU byAkula bhae | jasako javAphamA allAhale bhannubhayoH mominaharUko tarphabATa yuddha garnako lAgi allAha paryApta hunuhuncha | tyasaile uhA~le hAvAhurI paThAunubhayo ra phariztAharUlAI avataraNa garnubhayo | allAha sarvazaktimAna ra prabhutvazAlI hunuhuncha | kohI pani uhA~mAthi vijayI huna sakdaina baru uhA~ sabaimAthi vijayI hunuhuncha ra apamAnita garnuhuncha |

26 tinIharUlAI sahayoga garne yahUdIharUlAI allAhale tinIharUkA killAbATa bAhira nikAlnu bhayo jasamA tinIharU zatrubATa surakSita rahana basne garthe | uhA~le tinIharUko manamA Dara hAlnubhayo | he mominaharU ho! timIharU tinIharUko euTA jatthA viruddha yuddha gardai thiyau bhane arko jatthAlAI bandI banAu~dai thiyau |

27 allAhale tinIharUlAI sarvanAza garepachi tinIharUkA anAja tathA khajurakA khetIharU, gharaharU ra anya dhana-sampattiharU timIharUlAI pradAna garnubhayo | uhA~le khaibarako bhUbhAga pani timIharUlAI pradAna garnuhunecha jahA~ timIharU pasekA chainau tara cA~Dai nai pasnechau | yo allAhako tarphabATa mominaharUko lAgi vacana ra zubhasUcanA ho | allAha hareka kAryako sAmarthya rAkhnuhuncha | uhA~lAI kasaile pani vivaza pArna sakdaina |

28 he nabI (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! tapAIMkA patnIharUle baDhI khAnA kharcako mAga garchan ra tapAIMsa~ga baDhI kharca chaina bhane unIharUlAI bhanidinuhos: yadi timIharU sAMsArika jIvana ra tyasako taDaka bhaDaka cAhanchau bhane AU timIharUlAI pArapAcuke ra patnIharUle pAune garekA sampatti barAbara sampatti dinchu ra kunai pani hAni ra kaSTa nadiikana timIharUsa~ga raheko sambandha viccheda garchu |

29 yadi timIharU allAha tathA uhA~kA rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) ko prasannatA ra AkhiratamA svarga cAhanchau bhane timIharU juna avasthAmA chau tyasaimA dhairya gara | dhairya garera sukarma garne ra rAmro tarikAle basneharUkA lAgi allAhale mahAn pratidAna tayAra pArnubhaeko cha |

30 he nabI (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) kA patnIharU ho! timIharUmadhye jasale khullA rUpamA avajJA garcha usako ucca darjA ra nabI (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) ko kAraNale usako yAtanAlAI mahApralayako dina duI guNA baDhAinecha | yAtanAlAI duI guNA garnu allAhako lAgi sajilo cha |

31 timIharUmadhye jo allAha ra uhA~ko rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) ko AjJApAlanamA kAyama rahanechan ra allAhalAI khuzI pArna satkarma garnechan, unIharUlAI hAmIle anya mahilAharUbhandA duI guNA puNya pradAna garnechauM | hAmIle unIharUkA lAgi AkhiratamA svargako rAmro pratidAna tayAra pArekAchauM |

32 he muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) kI patnIharU ho! yadi timIharUle allAhakA AdezaharUko pAlanA garnechau ra uhA~le manAhI garnubhaekA kAryaharUbATa TADhA rahanechau bhane timIharUko sammAna ra darjA anya mahilAharUbhandA ucca rahanecha | timIharU gaira maharama puruSaharU (yastA puruSaharU josa~ga bihe garna jAyaja cha) sa~ga kurA gardA lacilo pArAmA kurA nagara, baru ThADho pArAmA kurA gara tAki unIharUmadhye kapaTI ra mana pApI mAnisaharUle timIharUprati galata nasocun | tinIharUsa~ga sIdhA, ThADho ra cAhine kurA mAtra gara |

33 timIharU gharamA Tikera basa | binA AvazyaktA gharabATa naniska | puruSaharUlAI AkarSita garne khAlakA banAva siGgAra nagara jasarI timIharU islAma pUrva garne garthyau | namAja (salAha) pUrNarUpamA kAyama gara, Aphno dhana-sampattikA jakAta deU, allAha ra uhA~kA rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) ko AjJApAlana gara | he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) kI patnIharU ra ahale baita (gharavAlA) ho! allAhale timIharUbATa kaSTa ra kharAbI samApta pArna cAhanuhuncha ra timIharUko AtmAlAI zuddha pArna cAhanuhuncha | timIharUbhitra rAmro AcaraNa utpanna garera ra narAmro bAnI samApta pArera timIharUlAI pUrNarUpamA pavitra pArna cAhanuhuncha, tAki tyasapachi kunai phohara bA~kI narahos |

34 rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) mAthi avatarita AyataharU ra uhA~ (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) kA sunnatalAI smaraNa gara jasako pATha timIharUko gharamA garincha | allAha sukSmadarzI hunuhuncha tyasaile uhA~le timIharUlAI nabI (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) ko gharamA puryAunubhayo | allAha susUcita hunuhuncha tyasaile uhA~le timIharUlAI uhA~ (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) kA patnIharU ra mominaharUko AmA banAunubhayo |

35 allAhale yastA momina puruSa ra mahilAharUkA lAgi mahApralayako dina kSamAdAna, puNya ra svargako rUpamA ThUlo pratidAna tayAra pArnubhaeko cha jo allAhako AjJApAlana garera uhA~ samakSa Atma samarpaNa garchan, allAhamAthi AsthA rAkhchan, uhA~ko AjJApAlana garchan, ImAnamA ra bhanAimA satyavAdI chan, aDiga bhaera nirantara allAhakA AdezaharUko AjJApAlana garchan, uhA~le manAhI garnubhaekA kAryalAI tyAgchan ra saGkaTamA dhairya garchan, anivArya ra atirikta dAna garchan, anivArya ra atirikta siyAma (rojA) rAkhchan, jo samakSa guptAGga kholna vaidha chaina tinIharU samakSa guptAGga kholdainan, vyabhicAra ra tyasasamma puryAune azlIla kAryaharU gardainan | unIharU hRdayale gopya rUpamA ra vacanaharUbATa spaSTa rUpamA allAhalAI dherai yAda garchan |

36 kunai pani mAmilAmA allAha ra uhA~ko rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) ko nirNaya Aepachi momina puruSa ra mahilAko lAgi tyasalAI svIkAra garne vA nagarne adhikAra bA~kI rahadaina | juna mAnisaharU allAha ra uhA~kA rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) ko avajJA garchan, tinIharU spaSTa rUpamA sIdhA mArgabATa pathabhraSTa hunchan |

37 jaida bina hArisA (rajiyallAhu anhu) lAI allAhale islAma dharma avalambana garne avasara diera upakAra garnu bhayo ra rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) le unalAI mukta garera upakAra garnubhayo | he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! tyasa samayalAI yAda garnuhos, jaba jaida bina hArisA (rajiyallAhu anhu) tapAIM samakSa AphnI patnI jainaba binta jahaza (rajiyallAhu anhA) lAI pArapAcuke dinebAre sallAha garna AekA thie | tyatikhera tapAIMle bhannubhayo− timI AphnI patnIlAI sAthamA rAkha, unalAI pArapAcuke nadeU | allAhakA AdezaharUko pAlanA garera ra uhA~le manAhI garnubhaekA kAryaharUlAI tyAgera uhA~sita Dara | he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! tapAIMle mAnisaharUko Darale jainaba (rajiyallAhu anhA) sa~ga bihe garne icchAlAI lukAunu bhaeko thiyo | tara allAhale vahI (prakAzanA) garera tapAIMlAI batAunubhayo | jaida (rajiyallAhu anhu) le jainaba (rajiyallAhu anhA) lAI pArapAcuke dine ra tapAIMsa~ga unako bihe hune kurAlAI allAhale cA~Dai nai spaSTa pArnuhunecha | yasa bAremA tapAIM allAhasita Darnuparcha | jaida (rajiyallAhu anhu) ko avasthA ThIka bhaepachi unale jainaba (rajiyallAhu anhA) lAI pArapAcuke die, ani hAmIle tapAIMsa~ga unako bihe garidiyauM | tAki dattaka putraharUkA patnIharUsa~ga pArapAcuke bhaera ra vizeSa avadhi bitAepachi bihe garne mominaharUlAI pApa nalAgos | allAhako nirNaya avazya pUrA huncha | yasalAI kohI pani rokna sakdaina |

38 allAhale zaraI rUpamA vaidha garisakepachi dattaka putra (dharmaputra) dvArA pArapAcuke pAekI mahilAsa~ga nabI muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) le gareko bihemA kunai Apatti ra pApako kurA chaina | yasabAremA uhA~ (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) le vigatakA sandeSTAharUko anusaraNa garnubhayo | rasUlaharUmadhye uhA~ (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) le kunai naulo kAma garnubhaena | yo bihe ra dattaka putrabAre galata calanako samApti allAhako pakkA niNaryale bhayo | yasamA uhA~ (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) ko kunai sallAha ra adhikArako dakhala thiena |

39 AphnA samudAyaharUsamma allAhakA sandeza puryAune yI sandeSTAharU allAhasita mAtra DarAu~chan | allAhale halAla garnubhaeko kArya gardA kasaile kehI bhanemA tyasako vAstA gardainan | bhaktaharUkA kAryaharUko rekarDa rAkhnako lAgi allAha paryApta hunuhuncha, tAki tyasako hisAba liera rAmro karmako rAmro ra narAmro karmako narAmro badalA deun |

40 muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) timIharUmadhye kunai puruSako pitA hunuhunna | uhA~ jaida (rajiyallAhu anhu) ko pitA pani hunuhunna ki uhA~mAthi unakI pArapAcuke pAekI patnIsa~ga bihe harAma hos | uhA~ (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) mAnisaharUtarpha paThAiekA rasUla hunuhuncha | uhA~ (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) antima sandeSTA hunuhuncha | uhA~ (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) pachi anya kunai pani nabI Aune chaina | allAha hareka vastukA jJAtA hunuhuncha | bhaktaharUko kunai pani mAmilA uhA~bATa lukeko chaina |
41 he mominaharU ho! Aphno hRdaya, vacana ra zarIrakA anya aGgaharUbATa allAhalAI dherai yAda gara |
42 bihAna ra belukA allAhako mahimAgAna gara | yI duvai samaya ati mahatvapUrNa chan |

43 allAha nai timIharUmAthi dayA garnuhuncha, timIharUko prazaMsA garnuhuncha ra uhA~kA phariztAharUle timIharUlAI kuphrako andhakArabATa nikAlera ImAnako prakAzamA lyAuna allAhasa~ga prArthanA garchan | allAha momimanaharUprati dayAvAna hunuhuncha | jaba bhaktaharU allAhakA AdezaharUko pAlanA garera ra uhA~le manAhI garekA kAryaharU choDera AjJApAlana garchan, taba uhA~ unIharUlAI yAtanA dinuhunna |

44 mahApralayako dina allAhasa~ga bheTa hu~dA mominaharUko svAgata salAmadvArA garinecha | unIharU sabai kisimakA kaSTabATa surakSita rahanechan | allAhale unIharUkA lAgi rAmro badalA svarga tayAra pArnubhaeko cha, kinabhane unIharUle allAhako AjJApAlana gare ra avajJAbATa bace |

45 he nabI (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! hAmIle tapAIMlAI mAnisaharUkA lAgi gavAha banAera paThAekAchauM, tapAIMlAI juna sandeza diera paThAieko thiyo tyo tapAIMle unIharUsamma puryAunubhayo | hAmIle tapAIMlAI mominaharUlAI svargako zubhasUcanA dina ra kAphiraharUlAI yAtanAbATa sAvadhAna garAuna paThAyauM |
46 hAmIle tapAIMlAI eka mAtra allAhako bhakti ra uhA~ko AjJApAlanatarpha AhvAna garna ujjavala dIpa banAera paThAyauM tAki mArgadarzana cAhaneharUle prakAza pAun |

47 mominaharUlAI sUcita garnuhos− allAhale unIharUkA lAgi mahAna kRpA tayAra pArnubhaeko cha, jasale gardA unIharU khusI hunechan | tyo ho lokamA maddata ra paralokamA svargamA praveza garera saphalatA prApta garnu |

48 kAphira ra munAphikaharUle allAhako dharmamA bAdhA utpanna garnako lAgi AhvAna garemA tinIharUko AjJApAlana nagarnuhos | tinIharUlAI bevAstA garnuhos | zAyada unIharUle ImAna lyAuchan ki | sabai mAmilAmA allAhamAthi bharosA garnuhos, jastai- zatruharU viruddha maddatabAre | bharosA garnako lAgi allAha paryApta hunuhuncha | loka ra paraloka duvaimA bhaktaharU AphnA sabai mAmilAmA uhA~mAthi nai bharosA garchan |

49 he mominaharU ho! yadi timIharU momina mahilAharUsa~ga bihe garepachi sahavAsa nagarikana pArapAcuke dinchau bhane unIharUle tIna mahinA vA tIna mahinavArIsamma iddata bitAunu pardaina | kinabhane yasto avasthAmA garbha dhAraNako sambhAvanA rahadaina | timIharU Aphno sAmarthya anusAra unIharUlAI dhana-sampatti deU tAki pArapAcukele gardA TuTekA manalAI sAntvanA milos | tinIharUko bATomA bAdhA napuryAU ra kaSTa nadeU |

50 he nabI (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! tapAIMle mahara tirera bihe garekA patnIharU ra dAsIharUlAI hAmIle tapAIMko lAgi vaidha (halAla) garyauM | yI dAsIharU tapAIMlAI hAmIle yuddhamA pradAna garyauM | hAmIle tapAIMkA lAgi tapAIMsa~ga makkAdekhi madInAsamma hijrata garekI mahilAharUsa~ga bihe garna vaidha garyauM | kAkAkI chorIharU, phUpukI chorIharU, mAmAkI chorIharU, sAnImAkI chorIharUsa~ga pani bihe garna halAla garyauM | hAmIle tapAIMko lAgi yastA momina mahilAharUsa~ga bihe garna pani halAla garekAchauM jo binA mahara tapAIM samakSa samarpita garchin | yo vizeSa rUpamA tapAIMko lAgi mAtra halAla cha, anya mominaharUko lAgi halAla chaina | mominaharUle 4 bhandA baDhI patnI ekasAtha rAkhna pAu~dainan, baru dAsIharU baDhI pani rAkhna sakchan | uparyukta kehI mahilAharUsa~ga bihe vizeSa rUpamA tapAIMko lAgi halAla garekAchauM, anya kasaiko lAgi garekA chainauM tAki tapAIMlAI kunai apThyAro nahos | allAha taubA garne bhaktaharUprati ati kSamAzIla ra parama dayAlu hunuhuncha |

51 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! tapAIMle juna patnIsa~ga rAta bitAuna cAhanuhunna unako pAlolAI sthagita garna milcha ra juna patnIsa~ga rAta bitAuna cAhanuhuncha, unIsa~ga rAta bitAuna milcha | patnIharUko pAlomA agADi pachADi garemA tapAIMlAI kunai pApa lAgdaina | patnIharUko pAlomA udAra nIti apanAu~dA unIharUkA A~khAlAI zItalatA prApta hunecha ra unIharU khusI hunechan | tapAIMle unIharUprati raheko jimmevArI ra haka pUrA garnuhunecha bhanne unIharUlAI thAhA cha | he puruSaharU ho! timIharUko hRdaya mahilAharUmadhye kehI mahilAtarpha baDhI AkarSita hune kurAlAI allAha jAnnuhuncha | allAha sarvajJa hunuhuncha, bhaktaharUkA karmaharUlAI jAnnuhuncha | uhA~ sahanazIla hunuhuncha, bhaktaharUmAthi prakopa paThAunamA hatAra garnuhunna ki zAyada tinIharUle taubA garun |

52 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! tapAIMko saMrakSaNamA rahekA patnIharU bAheka anya mahilAharUsa~ga bihe garnu tapAIMko lAgi jAyaja chaina | unIharUlAI sabailAI vA unIharUmadhye kehIlAI pArapAcuke diera anya kunai mahilAsa~ga bihe garnu pani jAyaja chaina, cAhe anya mahilA baDhI sundara kina nahoun | tara dAsIharUlAI Aphno adhInamA lina saknuhuncha, yasamA saMkhyAko hadabandI chaina | allAhale hareka vastuko rakSA garnuhuncha | yasa Adezale mominaharUkI AmAharUko mahatva spaSTa huncha | tyasaile unIharUlAI pArapAcuke dina ra anya mahilAharUsa~ga bihe garna manAhI garieko cha |

53 he mominaharU ho! jabasamma timIharUlAI bhojanako lAgi nabI (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) ko ghara Aune anumati mildaina tabasamma uhA~ (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) ko gharamA praveza nagara | bhojana pAkne pratIkSAmA lAmo samayasamma uhA~ (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) ko gharamA nabasa | baru jatikhera timIharUlAI bolAincha tyatikhera uhA~ (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) ko gharamA praveza gara ani bhojana garepachi niskihAla | eka arkAko kurA sundai thapakka tyahI~ nabasa | timIharU thapakka basirahanAle nabI (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) lAI kaSTa huncha tara uhA~ (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) timIharUlAI yahA~bATa gaihAla bhanna lajAunuhuncha tara allAha satya kurA bhanna lajAunuhunna | ataH timIharUlAI lAmo samaya nabasne Adeza diincha tAki timIharU uhA~ (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) lAI kaSTa nadeU | uhA~ (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) kI patnIharUsa~ga kunai sAmAna vA bhA~DA ityAdi mAgdA pardA pachADibATa mAga | unIharUko surakSAko lAgi ra uhA~ (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) ko ucca sthAnako kadara gardai unIharUtarpha pharkera pratyakSa rUpamA kehI namAga tAki timIharUko A~khAle unIharUlAI naherun | yasale timIharU ra unIharUkA manalAI baDhI zuddha rAkhnecha | tAki zaitAnale timIharU ra unIharUkA hRdayaharUmA bhrama utpanna nagaros ra duSkarmalAI sundara banAera nadekhAos | he mominaharU ho! rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) ko gharamA thapakka lAmo samayasamma basera uhA~ (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) lAI kaSTa nadeU | rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) ko dehAntapachi uhA~ (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) kI patnIharUsa~ga bihe nagara, kinabhane unIharU mominaharUkI AmAharU hun | AmAsa~ga bihe garnu kasaiko lAgi jAyaja chaina | rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) lAI yasto kaSTa dinu harAma ho ra allAhako najika ThUlo pApa ho |

54 timIharU AphnA karmaharU khullA rUpamA gara vA lukera gara allAhabATa gopya rahana sakdaina | allAha hareka vastukA jJAtA hunuhuncha | uhA~bATa kehI pani lukera rahana sakdaina | uhA~le timIharUkA karmaharUko badalA dinuhunecha | rAmro karmako rAmro badalA ra narAmro karmako narAmro badalA |

55 yI mahilAharUle nimna puruSaharUbATa pardA nagarera kurA garemA kunai pApa lAgdainaH unakA buvA, unakA chorA, sAkhkhai vA dUdhe dAju bhAi, bhatijA ra bhadai | unIharUlAI kunai pApa lAgdaina yadi unIharUsa~ga momina mahilA ra dAsale binA pardA kurA garchan bhane | he momina mahilAharU ho! allAhako AdezamA ra uhA~le manAhI garnubhaeko kurAmA uhA~sa~ga DarAU | timIharUkA hareka kriyAkalApalAI uhA~le dekhirahanu bhaeko cha |

56 allAhale phariztAharUko sAmu rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) ko prazaMsA garnuhuncha ra phariztAharUle uhA~ (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) ko lAgi prArthanA garchan | he allAhamAthi ImAna rAkhne ra uhA~dvArA nirdhArita zarIyata anusAra karma garne mominaharU ho! timIharU pani rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) ko lAgi darudo salAma (dayA ra zAntiko prArthanA) gara |

jaba allAhale rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) ko sammAnako Adeza dinubhayo taba uhA~ (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) lAI kaSTa puryAunabATa manAhI gardai allAhale bhannubhaeko chaH
57 nissandeha juna mAnisaharU allAha ra rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) lAI Aphno kurA vA kAryabATa kaSTa puryAu~chan allAhale yastA mAnisaharUlAI loka ra paraloka duvaimA Aphno kRpAbATa vaJcita rAkhnuhunecha ra paralokamA yastA mAnisaharUkA lAgi apamAnajanaka yAtanA tayAra pArnubhaeko cha |

58 juna mAnisaharUle momina puruSa ra mahilAharUlAI galtI binA nai Aphno kurA vA kAryabATa kaSTa puryAu~chan; tinIharUle jhUTa ra pApako bojha bokchan | a~ yadi unIharUle yasto pApa garchan jasale gardA anivArya rUpamA kaSTa dinuparcha bhane yo beglai kurA ho |

59 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! AphnA patnIharU, chorIharU ra mominaharUkI mahilAlAI bhanidinuhos− unIharUle AphnA pachyaurIle AphnA anuhAra chopera bAhira niskun tAki kunai pani aGga para-puruSa samakSa dekhA naparos | yasale gardA unIharU svatantra mahilA hun bhanne pahicAna huncha ra kasaile bATomA du:kha diMdaina, jasarI dAsIharUsa~ga garincha | taubA garne bhaktaharUko pApa allAhale mApha garnuhuncha ra unIharUmAthi dayA garnuhuncha |

60 bhitra kuphra pAlera bAhira islAma jAhira garne, kAma icchA sambandhI azlIla kArya garne ra madInAmA jhUTo khabara phailAera mominaharUbIca phUTa utpanna garne munAphikaharUle yadi chala kapaTa tyAgenan bhane; he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! hAmIle tinIharUlAI sajAya dine Adeza tapAIMlAI dinechauM ra tapAIMlAI tinIharUmAthi tainAtha garidenechauM ani dhartImA AtaGka phailAekole tinIharU ki ta mArinechan ki ta dhapAinechan ra yasarI kehI dina mAtra madInAmA basna saknechan |
61 allAhako kRpAbATa TADhA pArinechan | kapaTa ra dhartImA AtaGka maccAekole tinIharU jahA~ bheTinechan tyahIM samAtinechan ra mArinechan |
62 munAphikaharUle spaSTa chala kapaTa garemA tinIharUko bAremA yahI allAhako nIti rahadai Aeko cha | allAhako nItimA kahile pani kunai pherabadala hu~daina |

63 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! bahudevavAdIharU ra yahUdIharU inkAra garne ra jhUTlAune manasAyale prazna garchan: mahApralaya kahile Au~cha? yinIharUlAI bhanidinuhos: yasako samaya allAhalAI mAtra thAhA cha | malAI yasa bAremA kehI thAhA chaina | he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! tapAIMlAI ke thAhA, mahApralaya ati najika cha ki?
64 nissandeha allAhale kAphiraharUlAI Aphno kRpAbATa TADhA pArnubhayo | uhA~le mahApralayako dina tinIharUkA lAgi dankiraheko Ago tayAra pArnubhaeko cha, jo tinIharUko pratIkSAmA cha |
65 tinIharU tyasa AgomA sadhaiMko lAgi rahanechan | tinIharUle phAidA puryAune mitra ra tyasa yAtanAbATa bacAune kohI sahayogI pAune chainan |

66 mahApralayako dina tinIharUlAI anuhArako bala narkamA phyA~kinecha | tinIharUle ati cintA gardai bhannechan: hAmIharUle sAMsArika jIvanamA allAhakA AdezaharUko pAlanA garera ra uhA~le manAhI garnubhaekA kAryaharUlAI tyAgera allAha ra rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) ko AjJApAlana gareko bhae kati jAti hunthyo |
67 tinIharUle jhUTA pramANa prastuta gardai bhannechan: he hAmrA pAlanakartA! hAmIharUle AphnA aguvAharUko anusaraNa garyauM ani tinIharUle hAmIharUlAI sIdhA mArgabATa vicalita gare |

68 he hAmrA pAlanakartA! hAmIharUlAI pathabhraSTa pArne yI aguvAharUlAI duI guNA yAtanA dinuhos | euTA tinIharUko pathabhraSTatAko ra arko hAmIharUlAI pathabhraSTa pAreko | tinIharUlAI Aphno kRpAbATa dherai TADhA pArnuhos |

69 he mominaharU ho! timIharU tI mAnisaharU jastai AphnA rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) lAI kaSTa napuryAU juna mAnisaharUle AphnA rasUla mUsA (alaihissalAma) lAI kaSTa puryAe | tinIharUle unako zarIramA khoTa bhaeko AkSepa lagAe | tinIharUle lagAeko AkSepabATa allAhale unalAI mukta garnubhayo | mUsA (alaihissalAma) allAhako najika pratiSThita thie |
70 he mominaharU ho! allAhakA AdezaharUko pAlanA gara ra uhA~le manAhI garnubhaekA kAryaharUlAI tyAgera uhA~sita Dara ani sIdhA ra saccA kurA bhana |

71 yadi timIharU allAhasita DarAu~chau ra satya kurA garchau bhane allAhale timIharUkA karmaharUlAI ThIka pArnuhunecha, tinalAI svIkAra garnuhunecha ra timIharUkA pApaharUlAI mApha garnuhunecha | tyasale gardA uhA~le pakaDa garnuhune chaina | allAha ra uhA~kA rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) ko AjJAkArIharUle nai ThUlo saphalatA prApta garnechan | tyo saphalatA ho allAhako prasannatA prApta garnu ra svargamA praveza garnu |

72 hAmIle islAmI kAnuna ra dhana-sampatti jogAune kAnunako pAbandIko prastAva AkAzaharU, pRthvI ra pahADa samakSa prastuta garyauM tara tinIharUle yasa prastAvalAI svIkAra garenan ra yasako pariNAmabATa DarAe | tara mAnavale yasalAI svIkAra garyo | mAnavale yasalAI svIkAra garera AphUmAthi atyAcAra garyo kinabhane usalAI yasako pariNAmabAre jJAna chaina |

73 bhAgyamA lekhiekole mAnavale svIkAra garyo | jasabATa allAhale munAphika ra bahudevavAdI puruSa evam mahilAlAI tinIharUkA chala kapaTa ra zirkako kAraNa yAtanA dinuhunecha | momina puruSa tathA mahilAle yasa kAnunako pAlanA garekAle unIharUkA taubA svIkAra garnuhunecha | allAhale taubA garne bhaktaharUkA pApaharU mApha garnuhuncha ra unIharUmAthi dayA garnuhuncha |

1 sabai prazaMsAharU tyasa allAhako lAgi chan; jo AkAzaharU ra pRthvImA rahekA sabai vastuharUkA sRSTikartA, mAlika ra saJcAlanakartA hunuhuncha | AkhiratamA pani uhA~ kai lAgi prazaMsA cha | uhA~ sRSTi garna ra kArya saJcAlana garnamA tatvadarzI hunuhuncha | uhA~ bhaktaharUko avasthAbAre avagata hunuhuncha, uhA~bATa kehI pani lukeko chaina |

2 allAha dhartIbhitra pasne pAnI ra biruvAko bAremA pani avagata hunuhuncha ra tyasabATa bAhira niskane boTabiruvA ityAdibAre pani avagata hunuhuncha | uhA~ AkAzabATa jharne pAnI, phariztAharU ra jIvikAko bAremA pani avagata hunuhuncha ra AkAzatarpha caDhane phariztAharU, bhaktaharUkA karmaharU ra unIharUkA AtmAbAre pani avagata hunuhuncha | uhA~le momina bhaktaharUmAthi dayA garnuhuncha ra taubA garneharUlAI mApha garnuhuncha |

3 kAphiraharUle bhane− mahApralaya kahile pani AunevAlA chaina | he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! yinIharUlAI bhanidinuhos: kina naAunu, mahApralaya avazya nai Aunecha | tara yasako jJAna allAhalAI mAtra cha | mahApralayasameta parokSakA sabai kurAharUko jJAna allAhalAI mAtra cha | AkAzaharU ra pRthvImA kamilA barAbara lukeko vastu pani allAhabATa lukeko chaina | kamilAbhandA sAnA ra ThUlA sabai vastuharU ra mahApralayasamma hune kAryaharU lauhe mahaphUja (surakSita pATI) mA lekhiekA chan |

4 allAhale lauhe mahaphUjamA je jati lekhnubhaeko cha tyo yasa kAraNale lekhnubhaeko cha ki uhA~dvArA momina ra satkarmIharUlAI rAmro badalA pradAna gariyos | yastA mAnisaharUkA lAgi allAhako tarphabATa kSamAdAna cha | uhA~le yastA mAnisaharUko pakaDa garnuhune chaina | unIharUkA lAgi mahApralayako dina utkRSTa jIvikA hunecha, tyo ho svarga |

5 juna mAnisaharUle hAmrA AyataharUlAI asatya ThaharAune prayAsa gare, tyasalAI jAdU batAe, hAmrA rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) lAI jyotiSI, jAdUgara ra kavi bhane, tyastA mAnisaharUlAI mahApralayako dina kaDA yAtanA diinecha |

6 jJAnI sahAbA (rajiyallAhu anhum) ra ahale kitAbamadhye momina jJAnIharUle yasa kurAko gavAhI dinchan ki nabI (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) mAthi avataraNa bhaeko vahI (prakAzanA) satya ho, yasamA kunai sandeha chaina | yo vahIle tyasa allAhako mArgalAI batAu~cha jo ati prabhutvazAlI hunuhuncha uhA~mAthi kohI vijaya prApta garna sakdaina | allAha loka ra paraloka duvaimA prazaMsanIya hunuhuncha |

7 rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) le lyAunu bhaeko sandezamA Azcarya prakaTa gardai kAphiraharUle eka arkAlAI bhaneH ke timIharUlAI ekajanA yasto vyaktiko bAremA batAauM; jasale bhanchaH jaba timIharU marera TukrA-TukrA huna pugchau taba punaH jIvita pArera uThAinechau?!

8 tinIharUle bhaneH ke yo vyaktile allAhako sambandhamA jhUTo kurA raceko cha, tyasaile mRtyupachi punaH jIvita pArine kurA garcha vA pAgala bhaeko cha jasale gardA yasto nirAdhAra kurA garcha? kurA tyasto chaina jasto tinIharUle ThAnekA chan, baru kuro yo ho ki, juna mAnisaharU AkhiratamA ImAna rAkhdainan; nissandeha tinIharU mahApralayako dina kaDA yAtanAmA hunechan ani saMsAramA satyabATa ati TADhA bhaera pathabhraSTa chan |

9 ke yI punaH jIvita garine kurAlAI jhUTo Thahara garneharUle Aphno agADI raheko dhartI ra pachADi raheko AkAzalAI dekhenan? hAmIle cAhemA dhartIlAI dhasAuna sakchauM ra AkAzako TukrAlAI tinIharUmAthi khasAlna sakchauM | allAhako AjJApAlana garne bhaktaharUkA lAgi yasamA spaSTa nizAnI cha | tI bhaktaharUle yasabATa allAhako sAmarthya pramANita garchan | yI kAryaharU garne sAmarthya rAkhne allAhale timIharUlAI mRtyupachi ra zarIra kaNa-kaNa bhaepachi pani punaH jIvita garAuna saknuhuncha |

10 nissandeha hAmIle dAUda (alaihissalAma) lAI Aphno tarphabATa nubuvvata (IzdUtatva) ra sattA-zAsana pradAna garyauM | hAmIle pahADa ra carAlAI Adeza diyauM− he pahADa ra carA! dAUda (alaihissalAma) sa~ga timIharU pani allAhako mahimAgAnalAI dohoryAU | hAmIle unako lAgi phalAmalAI narama pAryauM tAki unale tyasabATa juna sAmAna banAuna cAhanchan banAun |

11 he dAUda! tyasabATa ThUlA kavacaharU banAU jasale timrA sainikaharUlAI yuddhamA zatrukA AkramaNabATa surakSita rAkhun | kavacakA gherAharU anusAra cukulaharU banAU | na ta ati pAtalo ki tyasakA gherAmA na Thaharos na ati moTo ki tyasa gherAmA napasos | timIharU satkarma gara, ma timIharUko karmaharUlAI dekhiraheko chu | mabATa timIharUko kunai pani karma lukeko chaina | ma tyasako badalA dinechu |

12 hAmIle hAvAlAI dAUdakA chorA sulaimAna (alaihimassalAma) ko niyantraNamA diyauM | tyasa hAvAko pravAha bihAna eka mahinAko yAtrA barAbara thiyo ra belukIko yAtrA pani eka mahinAko dUrI barAbara thiyo | hAmIle unako lAgi paglieko tAmbAko mUla phuTAyauM tAki unale tyasabATa je cAhun banAun | jinnAtalAI hAmIle unako adhinamA garekA thiyauM jo allAhako Adezale unako lAgi kAma gardathe | hAmro Adezako ullaGghana garne jinnaharUlAI hAmIle dankado Agoko yAtanAko svAda cakhAunechauM |

13 yI jinnaharUle sulaimAna (alaihissalAma) ko lAgi kAma gardathe | unIharUle sulemAnale jo cAhanthe tyahI banAu~the; jastaiH salAha (namAja) ko lAgi masjida, bhavana, citra, pAnIkA ThUlA kuNDaharU, nahalline khAlakA gADiekA ThUlA bhA~DAharU, ityAdi | hAmIle unIharUlAI bhanyauM− he dAUdakA parivAra ho! allAhakA varadAnaharUko lAgi uhA~prati AbhAra vyakta gara | merA varadAnaharUkA lAgi maprati AbhAra vyakta garne bhaktaharU kamai chan |

14 jaba hAmIle sulaimAna (alaihissalAma) ko mRtyuko nirNaya garyauM ta tyasako khabara jinnaharUlAI tyatikhera bhayo jaba unI aDesa lAgeko laurolAI dhamirole khAidiyo | dhamirole khAepachi unI dhartimA laDe | tyatikhera jinnaharUlAI jJAna bhayo− tinIharUlAI parokSako jJAna chaina | tinIharUlAI parokSako jJAna bhaeko bhae yAtanA sahera kaThina kAmamA lAgirahane thienan | sulaimAna (alaihissalAma) jIvita chan ra hAmro rekhadekha gardaichan bhanne kurA ThAnera jinnaharU kAmamA juTirahe |

dAUda (alaihissalAma) ra unakA putra sulaimAna (alaihissalAma) mAthi allAhako varadAnako varNanapachi sabA bAsIharUmAthi bhaeko allAhako varadAnako varNana garidaicha | duvaimA ke pharaka cha bhane dAUda ra sulaimAna (alaihimassalAma) le ta allAhaprati AbhAra vyakta gare tara sabA bAsIharUle AbhAra vyakta garenan | yasai sambandhamA allAhale bhannubhaeko chaH
15 sabA samudAyako lAgi tinIharUko basobAsa sthalamA allAhakA sAmarthya ra varadAnaharUkA spaSTa nizAnIharU thie | tinIharUkA dAhine ra debre duvai tira duIvaTA bagai~cAharU thie | hAmIle bhanekA thiyauH timrA pAlanakartAle pradAna garekA jIvikAharUbATa khAU ra uhA~prati AbhAra vyakta gara | yo pavitra nagarI ho ra uhA~ timro pAlanakartA allAha ati kSamAzIla hunuhuncha, uhA~le taubA garneharUlAI mApha garnuhuncha |

16 tinIharU allAhako prazaMsA garna ra rasUlamAthi ImAna lyAunabATa vimukha bhae | ani hAmIle tinIharUlAI diekA varadAnaharUlAI tinIharUkA lAgi saGkaTa banAera sajAya diyauM | hAmIle tinIharUtarpha ThUlo bADhI paThAyauM jasale tinIharUkA bA~dhalAI bhatkAi diyo ra khetIlAI DubAi diyo | hAmIle tinIharUkA duI vaTai bagai~cAharUlAI titA ra pIrA phala dine rukhaharU ra bayarakA rukhaharU rahekA bagai~cAmA pariNata garidiyauM |

17 hAmrA varadAnaharU pAepachi tyasako lAgi tinIharUle hAmIprati Abhara prakaTa garnu parne thiyo tara tyasako saTTA tinIharUle kRtaghnatA prakaTa gare ra vimukha bhae | ani hAmIle tinIharUlAI yo kaDA sajAya diyauM |

18 hAmIle yamanako sabA ra barakatayukta siriyAbIca kehI anya najika najika gAu~harU pani banAyauM ra tinIharUbIca yAtrAkA gantabyaharU nirdhArita garyauM jasale gardA tinIharU sajilai eka gAu~dekhi arko gAu~ pugne garthe ra antataH siriyA pugthe | hAmIle tinIharUlAI bhanekA thiyauH timIharU jatikhera cAhanchau, rAta vA dina, zatru, bhoka ra tirkhAbATa nizcinta bhaera yAtrA gara |

19 allAhako tarphabATa yAtrAko dUrI kama hune varadAnaprati tinIharUle ghamaNDa gare ra bhaneH he hAmrA pAlanakartA! yI gAu~harUlAI samApta pArera hAmro yAtrAko dUrIlAI ajhai baDhAi dinuhos tAki hAmIharU yAtrAko thakAiko svAda cAkhauM ra hAmrA savArIharUko kSamatA spaSTa hos | jaba tinIharUle allAhako varadAnaprati ghamaNDa garera, uhA~prati AbhAra vyakta garnabATa vimukha bhaera ra garibaharUsita DAhA garera AphUmAthi atyAcAra gare taba hAmIle tinIharUlAI kathA jasto banAidiyauM jo pachikA mAnisaharU sunAune garchan | hAmIle tinIharUlAI vibhinna dezaharUmA yasarI alaga-alaga pAridiyauM ki tinIharU eka arkAsa~ga samparkavihIna bhae | uparyukta kathAmA sabai dhairyavAnaharUkA lAgi pATha cha jo aDiga bhaera allAhako AjJApAlana garchan, avajJAbATa bacchan, saGkaTalAI sahana garchan ra allAhakA varadAnaharUko lAgi uhA~prati AbhAra vyakta garchan |

20 iblIsale mAnavalAI satyabATa pathabhraSTa pArna sakcha bhanne Aphno vizvAsa pUrA garyo | mominaharUko sAno jamAta bAheka sabaile iblIsako anusaraNa gare | mominaharUlAI pani tinIharUle pathabhraSTa pArna sakchan bhanne tinIharUko AzA nirAzAmA pariNata bhayo |

21 mominaharUlAI vivaza pArera pathabhraSTa pArna sakne sAmarthya iblIsamA thiena | baru U duSkarmalAI sundara banAune ra bahakAune kAma mAtra gardathyo | tara hAmIle usalAI mAnisaharUlAI bahakAune anumati diekA thiyauM tAki yo spaSTa hos ki kasale Akhirata ra tyahA~ko badalAmAthi ImAna rAkhcha ra ko yasa bAremA dvividhAmA rahancha | he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! tapAIMkA pAlanakartAle sabai vastuharU surakSita rAkhnuhuncha | uhA~ AphnA bhaktaharUkA kAryaharUko lekhAjokhA ra rekarDa rAkhera tyasako badalA dinuhunecha |

22 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! yI bahudevavAdIharUlAI bhanidinuhos: allAha bAheka timIharU ja-jasalAI pUjya ThAndathyau tinIharU sabailAI bolAU, tAki tinIharUle timIharUlAI lAbha puryAuna sakun ra timrA kaSTa nivAraNa garna sakun | tinIharU AkAzaharU ra pRthvIko kaNa barAbara vastumA pani kunai adhikAra rAkhdainan | yI vastuharUmA allAhasa~ga tinIharUko kunai sAjhedArI chaina | allAhako kohI pani sahayogI chaina | uhA~lAI sAjhedAra ra sahayogIharUko kunai AvazyaktA nai chaina |

23 allAhale jasalAI siphArisa garne anumati dinuhunecha usako siphArisa mAtra uhA~ najika phAidA puryAunecha | allAhale yastA mAnisaharUlAI mAtra siphArisa garne anumati dinuhunecha jasalAI uhA~le mana parAunuhunecha | allAhako mahAnatAmadhye yo pani ho ki jaba uhA~ AkAzamA bolnuhuncha taba phariztAharU AjJApAlana gardai AphnA pakheTAharU bhui~mA mArchan | jaba unIharUkA hRdayaharUbATa Dara bhAgcha taba unIharU jibrIla (alaihissalAma) lAI sodhchan: allAhale ke bhannubhayo? jibrIla (alaihissalAma) bhanchan: allAhale satya kurA bhannubhayo | uhA~ Aphno astitva ra prabhutvamA mahAna hunuhuncha | uhA~ bAhekakA sabai vastuharU sAnA tathA hIna chan |

24 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! yI bahudevavAdIharUlAI sodhnuhos− timIharUlAI kasale AkAzabATa pAnI barsAera ra bhUmibATa bAlInAlI ra phalaphUla ityAdi umArera jIvikA pradAna garnuhuncha? bhanidinuhos: allAhale nai jIvikA pradAna garnuhuncha | he bahudevavAdIharU ho! ki ta hAmIharU spaSTa mArgadarzanamA chauM ki ta timIharU spaSTa mArgadarzanamA chauM ki ta spaSTa pathabhraSTatAmA | yasamA kunai sandeha chaina ki spaSTa mArgadarzanamA mominaharU chan ra spaSTa pathabhraSTatAmA bahudevavAdIharU chan |

25 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! yinIharUlAI bhanidinuhos: mahApralayako dina hAmIle gareko pApako bAremA timIharUlAI sodhine chaina ra timIharUle gareko pApako bAremA hAmIharUlAI sodhine chaina |

26 yinIharUlAI bhanidinuhos− allAhale mahApralayako dina hAmIharUlAI ra timIharUlAI jammA garnuhunecha ani nisAphakA sAtha nirNaya garnuhunecha | allAhale satyavAdIlAI asatyavAdIbATa alaga chuTyAunuhunecha | allAhale nisAphakA sAtha nirNaya garnuhuncha | uhA~ nirNaya garna rAmrarI jAnnuhuncha |

27 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! yinIharUlAI bhannuhos: malAI tI sAjhedAraharU dekhAU jasalAI timIharU allAhako bhaktimA sAjhedAra Thahara gardachau | kadApi hoina, uhA~ko kunai sAjhedAra chaina, jasto ki timIharUle ThAnekA chau | baru allAha prabhutvazAlI hunuhuncha, uhA~mAthi kohI vijaya prApta garna sakdaina | sRSTi garna, bhAgya nirdhAraNa garna ra kArya saJcAlana garnamA uhA~ tatvadarzI hunuhuncha |

28 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! hAmIle tapAIMlAI sabai mAnisaharUkA lAgi paThAekAchauM, Izabhaya (takvA) rAkhneharUlAI svargako zubha-sUcanA dina ra kAphira tathA pApIharUlAI narkabATa DarAunako lAgi | tara adhikAMsa mAnisaharU yasa kurAlAI jAndainan | yadi tinIharUle jAnekA bhae tapAIMlAI jhUTo Thahara garne thienan |
29 bahudevavAdIharU tyasa prakopako lAgi hatAra gardai sodhchan jasabATa tinIharUlAI DarAieko cha | tinIharUle bhanchan: yadi timIharU Aphno dAbImA satya chau bhane tyo kahile pUrA hunecha?

30 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! prakopako lAgi hatAra garneharUlAI bhanidinuhos− prakopako dina nizcita cha, jasabATa eka ghaNTA pani aghi vA pachi hune chaina | tyo mahApralayako dina ho |

31 kAphiraharUle bhaneH muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) le allAhako tarphabATa avataraNa bhaeko ho bhanI dAbI gareko yasa kitAbamAthi hAmIharU ImAna lyAune chainauM | hAmI vigatakA AkAzIya kitAbaharUmAthi pani ImAna lyAune chainauM | he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! tapAIMle tyasa samayalAI dekhemA kati jAti hunthyo jaba yI atyAcArIharUlAI hisAbako lAgi thunera rAkhinecha ani tinIharU paraspara vAda vivAda garnechan | pratyekale arko vyaktilAI doSI ThaharAiraheko hunecha ra arUko nindA garnecha | kamajora pAriera rAkhiekA anuyAyIharUle AphnA aguvAharUlAI bhannechan: yadi timIharUle saMsAramA hAmIharUlAI pathabhraSTa napArekA bhae hAmIharU allAha ra uhA~kA rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) mAthi ImAna lyAune thiyauM |

32 satyabATa ghamaNDa garekA aguvAharUle javApha dinechan− muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) le lyAunubhaeko mArgadarzanako anusaraNa garnabATa ke hAmIharUle manAhI garekA thiyauM?! baru timIharU atyAcArI, bhraSTa ra phasAdI thiyau |

33 kamajora pAriera rAkhiekA anuyAyIharUle AphnA ghamaNDI aguvAharUlAI bhannechan: timIharUko rAta dinako calakhelale hAmIharUlAI mArgadarzanabATa rokyo, jaba timIharUle hAmIharUlAI allAhalAI inkAra garne ra uhA~lAI choDera sRSTiharUko bhakti garne Adeza dine garthyau | tinIharUle sAMsArika jIvanamA kuphra garekAle yAtanAlAI dekhepachi manamA lAgeko pachutolAI lukAunechan | tinIharUlAI yAtanA diinecha bhanne kurAlAI tinIharUle jAnnechan | hAmIle kAphiraharUko gardhanamA janjira hAlnechauM | tinIharUle saMsAramA allAha bAheka arUko bhakti ra pApakarma garekAle hAmIle yo sajAya dinechauM |

jaba rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) lAI uhA~ko samudAyale jhUTo Thahara garyo, taba allAhale uhA~ (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) ko sAntvanAko lAgi vigatakA samudAyaharUko yastai rIti thiyo bhanne kurA smaraNa garAunubhayo | allAhale bhannubhaeko chaH
34 bastIharUmadhye juna bastImA pani hAmIle kunai rasUla paThAyauM, unale tinIharUlAI hAmro yAtanAbATa DarAe taba tyahA~kA dhanI ra sattAdhArIharUle bhaneH he rasUlaharU ho! timIharUlAI juna kurAko sAtha paThAieko cha, tyasalAI hAmI inkAra gardaichauM |

35 sattAdhArIharUle ghamaNDa gardai bhaneH hAmIharU baDhI dhana ra santAna vAlA chauM | hAmIharUlAI yAtanA diine kurA jhUTa ho | timIharUle ThAne jasto hAmIharUlAI nata yasa lokamA yAtanA diinecha na paralokamA |

36 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! varadAna pAepachi ghamaNDa garneharUlAI bhanidinuhos: mero pAlanakartAle jasalAI cAhanuhuncha dherai jIvikA pradAna garnuhuncha, yo jA~ca garnako lAgi ki usale AbhAra vyakta garcha ki kRtaghna garcha? uhA~le jasalAI cAhanuhuncha jIvikAmA kamI garnuhuncha, yasa kurAko jA~cako lAgi ki U dhairya garcha ki Attincha? tara allAha tatvadarzI hunuhuncha bhanne kurA adhikAMsa mAnisaharUlAI thAhA chaina | uhA~le nirdhArita garnubhaeko hareka kAmamA kunai na kunai rahasya lukeko huncha | jJAnIharUlAI yasako bAremA thAhA cha ra ajJAnIharUlAI yasako bAremA thAhA chaina |

37 timIharU juna dhana-sampatti ra santAnamAthi garva garchau, tyasale gardA timIharUlAI allAhako prasannatA prApta hu~daina baru ImAna ra satkarmale gardA timIharUlAI kaiyauM guNA puNya prApta huncha | dhana-sampattilAI allAhako mArgamA kharca gardA ra santAnale duA gardA allAhako prasannatA prApta huncha | yastA satkarmI mominaharUkA lAgi kaiyauM guNA puNya cha, tyo ho svargakA ucca darjAharU | tyahA~ unIharU sabai kisimakA yAtanA, mRtyu ra varadAnako samAptibATa surakSita rahanechan |
38 mAnisaharUlAI allAhakA nizAnIharUbATa rokne ra tyasako lAgi athaka prayAsa garne kAphiraharU yasa lokamA pani asaphala hunechan ra paralokamA pani yAtanAko bhAgIdAra hunechan |

39 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! bhanidinuhos: nissandeha, mero pAlanakartAle AphnA bhaktaharUmadhye jasalAI cAhanuhuncha dherai jIvikA pradAna garnuhuncha ra jasalAI cAhanuhuncha kama jIvikA pradAna garnuhuncha | timIharU allAhako mArgamA je pani kharca garchau allAhale yasa lokamA tyasabhandA rAmro badalA dinuhunecha ra paralokamA tyasabhandA dherai puNya pradAna garnuhunecha | allAha rAmro jIvikA pradAnakartA hunuhuncha | jasale pani jIvikA cAhancha usale allAhatarpha pharkanuparcha |

40 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! tyasa dinalAI yAda garnuhos, jaba allAhale tinIharU sabailAI jammA garnuhunecha | pheri bahudevavAdIharUko nindAko lAgi phariztAharUlAI bhannuhunechaH ke yinIharU sAMsArika jIvanamA allAhalAI choDera timIharUko bhakti gardathe?

41 phariztAharUle javApha dinechan: tapAIM pavitra hunuhuncha! tapAIM nai hAmrA mAlika hunuhuncha | hAmIharU ra tinIharUbIca kunai mitratA chaina | baru yI bahudevavAdIharUle zaitAnaharUko pUjA garthe | zaitAnaharUle AphUlAI tinIharU samakSa phariztA batAune garthe ani tinIharU tapAIMlAI choDera tinIharUko pUjAmA lipta thie | tinIharUmadhye adhikAMsa zaitAnaharUmAthi vizvAsa rAkhthe |

42 bahudevavAdIharUle allAha bAheka jasako pUjA garne garchan tinIharUle mahApralaya ra hisAbako dina na ta kunai phAidA puryAune sAmarthya rAkhnechan na hAni puryAune sAmarthya nai | kuphra ra avajJA garera AphUmAthi atyAcAra garekAharUlAI hAmIle bhannechauH tyasa narkako yAtanA cAkha jasako inkAra timIharU saMsAramA gardai thiyau |

43 hAmrA rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) mAthi avatarita spaSTa AyataharUko pATha yI jhUTA bahudevavAdIharU samakSa gardA tinIharUle bhanchan: yI AyataharU lyAune vyaktile timIharUlAI timIharUkA pUrvajaharUko dharmabATa pherna cAhancha ra yo kurAna jhUTo ho, yasalAI allAhako nAmamA racieko ho | jaba kAphiraharU samakSa yo kurAna Ayo ta unIharUle bhaneH yo spaSTa jAdU ho | kinabhane yasale zrImAna zrImatIbIca ra buvA chorAbIca vibhAjana utpanna garcha |

44 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! hAmIle tinIharUlAI kurAnabhandA pahile kunai kitAba diekA chainauM jasalAI tinIharUle paDhun ani tapAIMbhandA pahile kunai rasUla pani tinIharUtarpha paThAekA chainauM jasale tinIharUlAI allAhako prakopabATa sAvadhAna garun |

45 vigatakA samudAyaharU jastai Ada, samUda, lUta (alaihissalAma) kA sudAyale pani A-AphnA rasUlalAI jhUTo Thahara gare | makkAkA bahudevavAdIharUlAI tinIharUsa~ga rahekA zakti ra dhana sampattikA dasa bhAgako eka bhAga pani prApta chaina | jaba tinIharUlAI mero prakopale samAtyo taba tinIharUlAI tinIharUkA dhana-sampatti, zakti ra saGkhyAle kunai phAidA puryAena | he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! vicAra garnuhos ke pariNAma bhayo tinIharUko inkArako ra kasto thiyo tinIharUmAthi mero prakopa |

46 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! yI bahudevavAdIharUlAI bhannuhos: ma timIharUlAI euTA kAma garne upadeza dinchu, timIharU mAtra allAhako lAgi icchAbATa alaga bhaera duI-duI janA garera vA eklA-eklai ubhiera Aphno sAthI (muhammada) ko bAremA soca vicAra gara | unako buddhi, satyatA ra ImAnadArIko bAremA timIharUlAI je jati jAnakArI cha tyasamA vicAra gara | vicAra garepachi timIharUlAI thAhA hunecha unI pAgala hoinan | unale ta timIharUlAI tyasa kaDA prakopako bAremA sAvadhAna garne garchan, jo timIharUko sAmunne cha yadi timIharU zirkabATa taubA gardainau bhane |

47 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! yI jhUTA Thahara garne bahudevavAdIharUlAI bhanidinuhos: ma je jati mArgadarzana ra bhalAi liera Aeko chu tyasako saTTAmA kunai pratidAna mAgdina | mero pratidAna ta allAhale mAtra dinuhunecha | uhA~ hareka vastumAthi gavAha hunuhuncha | maile uhA~ko sandeza puryAi diekochu bhanne kurAmAthi pani uhA~ gavAha hunuhuncha | uhA~ timIharUle garne garekA karmaharUmAthi pani gavAha hunuhuncha | uhA~le tI sabai kAryaharUko badalA dinuhunecha |

allAhale kAphira ra bahudevavAdIharUmAthi Aphno pramANaharU siddha garepachi Aphno kAnunako varNana garnubhayoH
48 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! bhanidinuhos: allAhan] satyalAI asatyamAthi vijaya pArera asatyalAI samApta pArnuhuncha | uhA~ parokSakA jJAtA hunuhuncha, AkAzaharU tathA pRthvIko kunai pani vastu ra bhaktaharUko kunai kArya uhA~bATa lukeko chaina |

49 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! yI jhUTA Thahara garne bahudevavAdIharUlAI bhannuhos: satya dharma islAma Aisakyo ra asatya samApta bhayo | asatyako kunai prabhAva tathA zakti bA~kI chaina ra tyo phirtA pani Aune chaina |

50 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! yI jhUTA Thahara garne bahudevavAdIharUlAI bhannuhos: yadi ma pathabhraSTa hunchu bhane tyasako hAni masamma sImita rahanecha | tyasako hAni timIharUlAI pugne chaina | yadi ma sIdhA mArga pAu~chu bhane tyo mAtra allAhale matarpha avataraNa garnubhaeko vahI (prakAzanA) ko kAraNale hunecha | allAha bhaktaharUkA kurAharU sunnuhuncha | uhA~ yati najika hunuhuncha ki uhA~lAI sunnamA kunai apThyAro hu~daina |

51 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! tapAIMle yI jhUTA Thahara garneharUlAI mahApralayako dina yAtanA dekhepachi DarAeko dekhnuhunecha | tinIharU yAtanAbATa bhAgna sakne chainan | tinIharUkA lAgi kunai Azraya sthala hune chaina | tinIharU najikako sthAnabATa sajilaisa~ga samAtinechan | tyo dRzya dekhdA tapAIMlAI acamma lAgnecha |

52 kAphiraharUle mahApralayako dina Aphno vAsasthAna dekhepachi bhannechan: hAmIle mahApralayako dinamAthi ImAna lyAekAchauM | tara aba tinIharU ImAna kasarI grahaNa garna sakchan? ImAna lyAune ra karma garne sthAna ta saMsAra thiyo jasabATa yinIharU niskera AkhiratamA AisakekA chan, jo pratidAna pAune sthala ho karma garne sthala hoina?!

53 aba tinIharUle ImAna lyAunu kasarI sahI hunasakcha ra tinIharUko ImAna kasarI svIkAra garna sakincha, jabaki tinIharUle sAMsArika jIvanamA kuphra gare ra satya kurAbAre aDakala gare; udAharaNa svarUpa tinIharUle rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) lAI jAdUgara, jyotiSI ra kavi bhane?!

54 yI jhUTA Thahara garneharU mahApralayako dina mojamastI, kuphrabATa taubA, narkabATa mukti ra sAMsArika jIvanatarpha pharkanabATa vaJcita garinechan | vigatakA jhUTA Thahara garne samudAyaharU pani yI vastuharUbATa vaJcita gariekA thie | rasUlaharUle lyAeko eka allAhako bhakti ra mutyu pazcAta punaH jIvita garine AsthAbAre tinIharU zaGkAmA thie, yo yasto zaGkA ho jo kuphrako kAraNa banyo |

1 sabai prazaMsAharU tyasa allAhako lAgi chan jasale binA kunai aghillo udAharaNa AkAzaharU ra pRthvIlAI sRSTi garnubhayo | uhA~le phariztAharUlAI sandezavAhaka banAera paThAunubhayo jo allAhale nirdhArita garnubhaekA AdezaharU lAgu garchan | unIharUmadhye kohIle rasUlaharUsamma allAhako vahI puryAu~chan ra unIharUlAI unIharUko jimmevArI nirvAha garnamA sazakta pArchan | tI phariztAharUmadhye kasaikA duIvaTA, kasaikA tInavaTA, kasaikA cAravaTA pakheTAharU chan | unIharU allAhakA AdezaharU lAgu garna tyasabATa uDne garchan | uhA~ Aphno sRSTimA je cAhanuhuncha vRddhi garnuhuncha | jastai sRSTiharUkA aGga, sundaratA vA AvAja | allAha hareka kAryako sAmarthya rAkhnuhuncha | uhA~lAI kasaile hairAna pArna sakdaina |

2 sabai vastuharUkA sA~cAharU allAhako hAtamA chan | uhA~le mAnisaharUlAI je jati jIvikA, mArgadarzana, bhAgyazAlI ityAdi varadAna pradAna garnuhuncha tyasalAI kohI pani rokna sakdaina | allAhale yI varadAnaharUmadhye jasalAI roknuhuncha tyasalAI kohI pani dina sakdaina | uhA~ prabhutvazAlI hunuhuncha kohI pani uhA~mAthi vijayI huna sakdaina | uhA~ sRSTi garna, bhAgya nirdhAraNa garna ra kArya saJcAlana garnamA tatvadarzI hunuhuncha |

3 he mAnava! timIharU hRdaya, jibro ra aGgaharUbATa karma garera allAhakA varadAnalAI smaraNa gara | ke allAha bAheka timIharUkA anya kohI sRSTikartA cha, jasale timIharUlAI AkAzabATa pAnI barsAera jIvikA pradAna garcha vA bhUmibATa phalaphUla ra bAlInAlI ityAdi umArera jIvikA pradAna garcha? allAha bAheka kohI pani vAstavika pUjya chaina | ani timIharU kasarI satyabATa bahaki~daichau, allAha viruddha jhUTo racchau, allAhakA sAjhedAra chan bhanne kurA ThAnchau jabaki uhA~le nai timIharUlAI sRSTi garnubhayo ra jIvikA pradAna garnubhayo?!

4 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! yadi tapAIMko samudAyale tapAIMlAI jhUTo Thahara gareko cha bhane dhairya garnuhos, kinabhane tapAIM jhUTA Thahara garine pahilo rasUla hunuhunna baru tapAIMaghi vigatakA samudAyaharUle pani A-AphnA rasUlaharUlAI jhUTo Thahara garekA thie | jastai Ada, samUda ra lUta (alaihissalAma) ko samudAya | sabai mAmilAharU allAhatarpha nai pharkAera laginechan | ani uhA~le jhUTA Thahara garneharUlAI sarvanAza garnuhunecha ra rasUlaharU ra mominaharUlAI sahayoga garnuhunecha |

5 he mAnava ho! mahApralayako dina punaH jIvita garne ra badalA dine juna vAcA allAhale garnubhaeko cha tyo satya ho, tyasamA kunai zaGkA chaina | ataH satkarma garera tyasa dinako tayArI gara | sAMsArika jIvanako mojamastI, zaitAna ra sAMsArika jIvanatarphako jhukAvale timIharUlAI yasabATa narokos |

6 he mAnava ho! zaitAna timIharUko zatru ho | ataH Usa~ga nirantara laDne pratibaddhatAko sAtha usalAI zatru samjha | zaitAna AphnA anuyAyIharUlAI allAhako inkAra garna lagAu~cha, tAki tinIharU mahApralayako dina dankado AgomA jAun |

7 zaitAnako anusaraNa gardai jasale allAhalAI inkAra gare, tinIharUlAI kaDA yAtanA diinecha | juna mAnisaharUle allAhamAthi ImAna lyAe ra satkarma gare allAhale unIharUkA pApaharU mApha garnuhunecha ra svarga jasto mahAna badalA dinuhunecha |

8 zaitAnale duSkarmalAI sundara banAera dekhAu~dA tyasalAI sundara mAnne mAnisaharU tI mAnisaharU jastA huna sakdainan jasalAI allAhale satyalAI sundara banAera dekhAunuhuncha ani unIharUle satyalAI satya mAnchan | nissandeha allAhale jasalAI cAhanuhuncha pathabhraSTa pArnuhuncha ra jasalAI cAhanuhuncha sIdhA mArga dekhAunuhuncha | uhA~lAI kasaile vivaza pArna sakdaina | he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! tapAIM pathabhraSTa huneharUlAI pathabhraSTatAbATa nikAlne cintAmA Aphno jyAna nagumAunuhos | allAha tinIharUle garne garekA kAryaharUlAI jAnnuhuncha | tinIharUkA karmaharUmadhye kehI pani uhA~bATa lukeko chaina |

9 allAhale nai hAvA paThAunuhuncha jasale bAdalalAI hA~kcha, pheri uhA~le nai bAdalalAI hA~kera boTabiruvA nabhaeko bhUmimA puryAunuhuncha | uhA~le nai tyasako pAnIbATa sukeko bhUmilAI jIvita pArnuhuncha ra boTabiruvA umArnuhuncha | jasarI uhA~le mRta bhUmilAI jIvita pArnuhuncha tyasarI nai mahApralayako dina marekA mAnisaharUlAI pani punaH jIvita garnuhunecha |

10 juna mAnisaharU loka vA paralokamA sammAna cAhanchan unIharUle yo sammAna allAhasa~ga mAtra mAgnuparcha | kinabhane yasa loka ra paraloka duvaimA sammAna allAhakai lAgi cha | uhA~ko lAgi gariekA smaraNa ra satkarma uhA~tarpha nai mAthi jAnchan | juna mAnisaharU muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) lAI hatyA garne khAlakA SaDyantraharU garchan tinIharUkA lAgi kaDA yAtanA cha | yastA kAphiraharUko SaDyantralAI allAhale viphala pArnuhunecha, tinIharU Aphno uddezyamA saphala hune chainan |

11 allAhale nai timIharUkA purkhA Adama (alaihissalAma) lAI mATobATa sRSTi garnubhayo | pheri timIharUko sRSTi viryabATa garnubhayo, ani timIharUmadhye puruSa ra mahilA banAunubhayo, jo paraspara bihe garchan | juna sukai strIliGgale garbha dhAraNa garcha ra zizulAI janma dincha tI sabaiko jJAna allAhalAI cha | uhA~bATa kunai pani kurA lukeko chaina | sRSTiharUmadhye jasako pani umeramA kunai thapa ghaTa huncha tyo lauhe mahaphUja (surakSita pATI) mA lekhieko cha | ukta varNana gariekA sabai kAryaharU allAhako lAgi sajilo cha |

12 duI kisimakA samudraharU ekasamAna huna sakdainan, euTA dherai miTho cha miTho bhaekole piunamA sajilo cha; dosro nunilo cha, nunilo bhaekole piuna asambhava chaina | yI duvaibATa timIharU tAjA mAchA khAnchau, bahumUlya hIrA-motI nikAlchau, jasalAI sundaratAko lAgi lAu~chau | he darzaka! timIle DuGgAharUlAI Aune jAne kramamA samudrako pAnIlAI cirdai daguriraheko dekhchau, tAki vyApAra garera allAhako varadAnako khoji gara ra uhA~le dinubhaekA dherai varadAnaharUkA lAgi uhA~prati AbhAra vyakta gara |

13 allAhale rAtalAI dinamA praveza garAunuhuncha jasale gardA dina lAmo huna pugcha ra dinalAI rAtamA praveza garAunuhuncha jasalegardA rAta lAmo huna pugcha | allAhale sUrya ra candramAlAI Aphno niyantraNamA linubhaeko cha | duvai nirdhArita samayakA lAgi mahApralayasamma gatizIla chan jasako jJAna allAhalAI mAtra cha | tI sabaikA saJcAlanakartA timIharUkA pAlanakartA allAha mAtra hunuhuncha | sabaikA mAlika uhA~ nai hunuhuncha | uhA~lAI choDera timIharU juna mUrtIharUko pUjA garchau tI sabai khajurako biumAthi raheko jhillI barAbara vastuko pani mAlika hoinan | ani timIharU kuna AdhAramA malAI choDera tI mUrtIharUko pUjA garchau?!

14 timIharUle mUrtiharUlAI pukArdA tinIharUle javApha dine chainan, kinabhane tinIharUmA jyAna chaina | mAnauM tinIharUle sune pani javApha dine chainan | tinIharUle mahApralayako dina timIharUko zirka ra bhaktisita kunai sarokAra naraheko ghoSaNA garnechan | he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! allAhale jati saccA pakkA kurA bhannuhuncha tyati arU kohI pani bhanna sakdaina |

15 he mAnava! timIharU AphnA sabai mAmilA ra avasthAmA allAhako AzrayamA chau | allAha mAtra kasaiko AzrayamA hunuhunna | uhA~le loka ra paralokamA AphnA bhaktaharUko bhAgyamA je jati lekhnuhuncha tyasamA uhA~ prazaMsanIya hunuhuncha |
16 allAhale cAhanubhaemA timIharU sabailAI vinAza pArera nayA~ sRSTi lyAunuhunecha jasale uhA~ko bhakti garnechan ra uhA~sa~ga kasailAI sAjhedAra Thahara garne chainan |
17 timIharU sabailAI vinAza pArera nayA~ sRSTi lyAunabATa kasaile pani uhA~lAI rokna sakdaina |

18 kunai pani pApI vyaktile arkAko pApako bhAra uThAune chaina | baru sabaile Aphnai pApako bhAra uThAunu parnecha | yadi kohI pApIle Aphno pApako alikati pani bhAra uThAuna arUlAI pukArcha bhane kasaile pani usako bhAra uThAune chaina yadyapi pukArine vyakti usako najikako nai kina nahos | he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! tapAIMle yastA mAnisaharUlAI mAtra allAhako yAtanAbATa DarAuna saknuhuncha jo nadekhikana pani allAhasita DarAu~chan ra pUrNarUpamA salAha (namAja) kAyama garchan | yastA mAnisaharUle mAtra tapAIMko sAvadhAna garAine kAryabATa phAidA uThAuna sakchan | zirkasameta anya pApaharUbATa AphUlAI pavitra rAkhne mAnisaharUlAI nai tyasako phAidA hunecha | allAhalAI kasaiko AjJApAlanako AvazyakatA chaina, uhA~ nirapekSa hunuhuncha | mahApralayako dina hisAba ra badalAko lAgi sabaijanA uhA~tarpha nai pharkera jAnuparcha |
19 jasarI andho ra dekhne vyakti ekasamAna huna sakdainan, tyasarI nai kAphira (avajJAkArI) ra momina (AjJAkArI) ko darjA ekasamAna huna sakdaina |
20 jasarI andhakAra ra prakAza ekasamAna huna sakdainan, tyasarI nai kuphra ra ImAna ekasamAna huna sakdainan |
21 jasarI chAyA~ ra tAto hAvA ekasamAna huna sakdainan tyasarI nai svarga ra narka ekasamAna huna sakdainan |

22 jasarI jIvita ra mRtaharU ekasamAna huna sakdainan tyasarI nai mominaharU ra kAphiraharU ekasamAna huna sakdainan | allAhale jasalAI cAhanuhuncha mArgadarzana garnuhuncha | he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! jasarI tapAIM cihAnamA rahekA murdAharUlAI sunAuna saknuhunna tyasarI nai kAphiraharUlAI sunAuna saknuhunna |
23 tapAIM ta mAtra tinIharUlAI allAhako yAtanAbATa saceta gardai hunuhuncha |

24 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! nissandeha hAmIle tapAIMlAI satyakA sAtha paThAyauM | tapAIMle mominaharUlAI tyasa rAmro pratidAnako zubhasUcanA dinuhuncha jasalAI allAhale unIharUkA lAgi tayAra pArnubhaeko cha | tapAIM kAphiraharUlAI tyasa pIDAdAyI yAtanAbATa sAvadhAna garnuhuncha jasalAI allAhale tinIharUkA lAgi tayAra pArnubhaeko cha | vigatamA bitekA pratyeka samudAyatarpha allAhale sAvadhAna garna rasUla paThAunu bhayo |

25 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! yadi tapAIMko samudAyale tapAIMlAI jhUTo Thahara gardaichan bhane dhairya garnuhos | tapAIM pahilo rasUla hunuhunna jasalAI unako samudAyale jhUTo Thahara garyo, baru vigatakA Ada, samUda ra lUta (alaihissalAma) kA samudAyaharU lagAyata anya samudAyaharUle pani A-AphnA rasUlaharUlAI jhUTA Thahara garekA thie | tinIharU samakSa tinIharUkA rasUlaharU spaSTa pramANaharU, sAnA kitAbaharU ra prakAzamaya kitAba liera AekA thie |

26 yasakA bAvajuda tI samudAyaharUle allAha ra uhA~kA rasUlaharU (alaihimussalAma) lAI inkAra gare | unIharUle lyAeko sandezako puSTi tinIharUle garenan | ani hAmIle tI kAphiraharUlAI sarvanAza garyauM | he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! vicAra garnuhos, kasto bhayo tinIharUko inkArako pariNAma |

27 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! ke tapAIMle vicAra garnubhaena, allAhale AkAzabATa pAnI barsAunubhayo ra tyasa pAnIlAI rukhaharUsamma puryAera tyasabATa rAto, hariyo, pahelo ityAdi vibhinna raGgakA phalaphUlaharU sRSTi garnubhayo; ani uhA~le pahADaharUmA setA, rAtA ra kAlA mArgaharU banAunubhayo |

28 allAhale vibhinna raGgakA mAnava, caupAyA, janAvara (U~Ta, gAI, bheDA) sRSTi garnubhayo | uparyukta vastuharUle allAhako sammAna garchan ra vidvAnAharU allAhasita DarAu~chan | kinabhane unIharU allAhakA guNaharU, kAnuna ra zaktikA pramANaharUlAI jAndachan | nissandeha allAha prabhutvazAlI hunuhuncha, kohI uhA~mAthi vijaya prApta garna sakdaina | uhA~le taubA garne bhaktaharUlAI mApha garnuhuncha |

29 nissandeha juna mAnisaharU rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) mAthi avatarita kitAbalAI paDhchan, tyasamA rahekA AdezaharUko pAlanA garchan, rAmrarI salAha (namAja) kAyama garchan, hAmIle pradAna gareko dhana-sampattibATa khullArUpamA jakAta nikAlchan ra gopyarUpamA dAna garchan ra yI karmaharUdvArA allAhasa~ga yasto vyApArako AzA rAkhchan jasamA ghATako AzaGkA hu~daina |

30 jasako kAraNa yastA mAnisaharUlAI allAhale unIharUkA karmaharUko pUrA-pUrA badalA dinuhunecha | baru Aphno varadAnabATa thapa dinuhunecha | allAha yasako sAmarthya rAkhnuhuncha | uhA~ yastA guNaharU rAkhekA mAnisaharUlAI mApha garnuhuncha | unIharUkA satkarmaharUko kadara garnuhuncha |

31 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! hAmIle juna kitAba tapAIMtarpha avataraNa garekAchauM tyo satya ho, tyasamA kunai sandeha chaina | yasale vigatakA kitAbaharUko puSTi gardacha | nissandeha allAha AphnA bhaktaharUsita avagata hunuhuncha ra tinIharUlAI dekhirahanu huncha | uhA~le hareka samudAyako rasUlatarpha tyasa yugako AvazyaktA anusAra sandeza avataraNa garnuhuncha |

32 pheri hAmIle muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) ko samudAyalAI anya samudAyaharUmadhye cayana garyauM ani kurAna pradAna garyauM | unIharUmadhye kehI harAma gariekA kAryaharU garera ra anivArya gariekA kAryaharU nagarera Aphai~mAthi atyAcAra garnevAlA chan | unIharUmadhye kehI madhya mArgI chan, jasale anivArya gariekA kAryaharU garchan, harAma gariekA kAryaharU tyAgchan, atirikta puNya-karmaharU garchan ra makrUha (mana naparAiekA kAryaharU) garchan | uharUmadhye kehI allAhako anumatile bhalAiko kAryamA agrasaratA dekhAuneharU chan, jasale anivArya tathA atirikta puNya-karmaharU garchan ra harAma tathA makrUha (mana naparAiekA kAryaharU) bATa bacchan | yasa samudAyako cayana ra kurAna pradAna garinu allAhakA yastA mahAna varadAna hun, yo jasto kohI varadAna huna sakdaina |
33 yI cayana gariekA mAnisaharU svargaharUmA praveza garnechan | tyahA~ motI ra sunakA kaDAharU ani rezamakA lugAharU lAunechan |

34 unIharU svargamA praveza garepachi bhannechan: sabai prazaMsAharU allAhako lAgi chan, jasale narkamA jAne hAmro cintAlAI samApta pArnubhayo | nissandeha hAmrA pAlanakartA taubA garne bhaktaharUlAI mApha garnuhuncha ra satkarmalAI svIkAra garnuhuncha |
35 allAhale nai hAmIharUlAI sadhaiM rahane svargamA praveza garAunubhayo, jahA~bATa na katai sarnu parcha, na haTnuparcha, na tyahA~ thakAi lAgcha ra na kaSTa nai pugcha |

cayana gariekA bhaktaharUko varNanapachi apamAnita kAphiraharUko varNana gardai allAhale bhannubhaeko chaH
36 kAphiraharUlAI narkako AgomA phyA~kinecha, jahA~ tinIharUle sadhaiM basnuparnecha | tinIharU tyahA~ nata marnechan na yAtanAbATa mukti pAunechan | narkako yAtanAmA kamI pani garinechaina | allAhale mahApralayako dina yasto yAtanA tI sabailAI dinuhunecha jasale uhA~ko varadAnaprati AbhAra vyakta garenan |

37 tinIharU narkamA ThUlo svaramA karAera yo bhandai maddata mAgirahekA hunechan- hAmIlAI narkabATa nikAlera saMsAramA puryAidinuhos, aba hAmIle pahilA jasto gardainauM, aba tapAIMko khusI prApta garna ra narkako yAtanAbATa bacnako lAgi satkarma garnechauM | javAphamA allAhale bhannuhunechaH ke hAmIle saMsAramA yati lAmo umera dienauM jasamA eka janA upadeza grahaNa garnele upadeza grahaNa garna sakos ra taubA garera satkarma garna sakos, jabaki timIharU samakSa rasUla pani Ae ra allAhako yAtanAbATa sAvadhAna pani garAe?! yasapachi aba timIharUsa~ga na kunai tarka cha na kunai bahAnA | tasartha allAhako yAtanAlAI bhoga | kuphra ra avajJA garera AphUmAthi atyAcAra garekAharUkA lAgi na kohI sahayogI cha jasale tinIharUlAI allAhako yAtanAbATa nikAlna sakos vA yAtanAlAI kama garna sakos |

38 nissandeha allAha AkAzaharU ra pRthvIkA sabai adRSya kurA (parokSa) kA jJAtA hunuhuncha | uhA~bATa kehI pani chuTeko chaina ra uhA~ bhaktaharUkA manamA lukekA rAmrA ra narAmrA kurAharU pani jAnnuhuncha |

39 he mAnava! allAhale nai timIharUlAI dhartImA eka pachi arko Aune pratinidhi banAunubhayo, tAki timIharU kasto karma garchau bhanne kurAko parIkSA liiyos | jasale allAha ra rasUlaharUle lyAeko sandezalAI inkAra gare tyasako kuphra (inkAra) ko pApa ra pariNAma usaitarpha pharkanecha | tinIharUko kuphrale allAhalAI kunai hAni pugdaina | kAphiraharUko kuphrale tinIharUko zatrutA ra ghATAmai baDhottarI garnecha | allAhale ImAna lyAuneharUkA lAgi tayAra pArnubhaeko svargabATa vaJcita bhaera tinIharU ghATA vyahorne chan |

40 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! yI bahudevavAdIharUlAI sodhnuhos: malAI batAU- allAhalAI chADera timIharUle pUjA gardai AekA pUjyaharUle pRthvIko kuna cIja sRSTi garekA chan? ke tinIharUle pahADa vA nadIharU vA caupAyAharU sRSTi garekA chan? ke tinIharU AkAzako sRSTimA allAhakA sAjhedAra chan? ke tinIharUlAI hAmIle kunai kitAba diekAchauM jasamA yasa kurAko pramANa cha ki allAha bAheka arUko bhakti garnu ThIka ho? yI madhye kunai pani kurA ThIka chaina | baru kuphra ra avajJA garera AphUmAthi atyAcAra garekAharU eka arkAsita dhokAmA AdhArita vAcA gardaichan |

41 nissandeha allAhale AkAzaharU ra pRthvIlAI thAmnubhaeko cha ra avayavasthita tathA TuTaphuTa hunabATa roknubhaeko cha | mAnauM yadi yI duvai avyavasthita bhae bhane allAha bAheka kasaile pani rokna sakdaina | nissandeha allAha sahanazIla hunuhuncha, sajAya dinamA hatAra garnuhunna | uhA~ taubA garne bhaktaharUko pApa mApha garnuhuncha |

42 yI jhUTA Thahara garne bahudevavAdIharUle pakkA kasama khAekA thie ki, yadi allAhako tarphabATa uhA~ko prakopabATa sAvadhAna garAunako lAgi kunai rasUla Au~chan bhane hAmIharUle yahUdI, IsAI ra anya samudAyabhandA baDhI aDiga bhaera satyako anusaraNa garnechauM | tara jaba tinIharU samakSa muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) ko Agamana bhayo ra uhA~ (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) le allAhako prakopabATa DarAunubhayo taba tinIharU satyabATa ajhai TADhA bhae ra asatyasa~ga ajhai nikaTa bhae | tinIharUle khAeko kasama pUrA garenan |

43 tinIharUle ThIka niyatale kasama khAekA thienan, baru dhartImA ghamaNDa garna ra mAnisaharUlAI dhokA dinako lAgi khAekA thie | calakhela garneharUlAI tinIharUko calakhelale nai Aphno gherAmA line garcha | ke yI ghamaNDI calakhela garneharU allAhako aTala kAnunako pratIkSA gardaichan; sarvanAza garine pratIkSA, jasarI tinIharU jastA vigatakA anya samudAyaharU sarvanAza garie?! ghamaNDIharUko sarvanAzabAre allAhako nItimA tapAIMle kunai parivartana pAunuhunna, yo avazya nai avataraNa hunecha | tyasamA kunai pherabadala pAunuhunna ki tinIharUmAthi avataraNa nabhaera arUmAthi avataraNa hos, kinabhane yo allAhako aTala kAnuna ho |

44 ke kuraizakA jhUTA Thahara garneharU dhartImA ghumaphira garenan tAki tinIharUle dekhun kasto bhayo vigatakA jhUTA Thahara garneharUko pariNAma? ke tinIharUko pariNAma narAmro bhaena? tinIharU kuraizabhandA zaktizAlI thie tara allAhale tinIharUlAI sarvanAza garnubhayo?! AkAzaharU ra pRthvImA raheko kunai pani vastu allAhabATa lukeko chaina, uhA~le yinIharUkA kAryaharUlAI hernuhuncha | uhA~ jahile pani cAhanuhuncha yinIharUlAI sarvanAza garnuhuncha |

45 mAnisaharUle gareko avajJA ra pApako lAgi yadi allAhale tatkAlai pakaDa garera sajAya dinuhunthyo bhane sabai dhartI bAsI, tinIharUkA caupAyA ra dhana-sampattilAI sarvanAza pArnuhunthyo | tara allAhale euTA nizcita avadhi mahApralayasamma avasara dinuhuncha jasako jJAna uhA~lAI mAtra cha | ani jaba mahApralaya Aunecha taba allAhale sabai bhaktaharUlAI rAmrosa~ga hernuhunecha | uhA~bATa kehI pani lukeko chaina | uhA~le tinIharUkA karmaharUko badalA dinuhunecha, rAmro karmako rAmro badalA ra narAmro karmako narAmro badalA |
