3 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! allAhale bhaktaharU samakSa paThAunubhaekA rasUlaharUmadhye tapAIM pani hunuhuncha | tAki unIharUle mAnisaharUlAI eka allAhako bhaktiko AhvAna garun |

4-5 unIharUle mAnisaharUlAI eka allAhako bhaktiko AhvAna allAhako tarphabATa pakkA tarikA ra sIdhA kAnuna anusAra gare | allAha prabhutvazAlI hunuhuncha, jasamAthi kohI vijayI huna sakdaina ra uhA~ momina bhaktaharUmAthi dayAvAna hunuhuncha |

4-5 unIharUle mAnisaharUlAI eka allAhako bhaktiko AhvAna allAhako tarphabATa pakkA tarikA ra sIdhA kAnuna anusAra gare | allAha prabhutvazAlI hunuhuncha, jasamAthi kohI vijayI huna sakdaina ra uhA~ momina bhaktaharUmAthi dayAvAna hunuhuncha |

6 hAmIle tapAIMmAthi kurAna avataraNa garyauM tAki tapAIMle araba bAsIharUlAI sAvadhAna garAunuhos jasalAI sAvadhAna garAuna pahilA rasUla Aenan, jasale gardA tinIharU ImAna ra eka allAhako bhaktibATa TADhA chan | yasarI nai sAvadhAna nagarAiekA samudAyaharUlAI rasUlako AvazyaktA huncha |

7 yinIharUmadhye adhikAMsamAthi allAhako prakopa anivArya bhaisakeko cha, kinabhane rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) le allAhako sandeza puryAisake pani tinIharUle ImAna lyAenan baru kuphramai aDiga gare | tinIharUle allAha ra uhA~ko rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) mAthi ImAna lyAune chainan ra tinIharU samakSa pugeko satyako pAlanA garne chainan |

8 yasa sambandhamA tinIharUko udAharaNa yastA mAnisaharU jasto cha jasako ghA~TImA nela (janjIra) bA~dhieko huncha ra jasakA duvai hAta gardhanasa~ga yasarI bA~dhiekA hunchan ki tinIharU AkAzatarpha herna bAdhya hunchan ra talatira herna sakdainan | tinIharU allAhamAthi ImAna lyAunabATa bA~dhiekA chan, tinIharUkA sira allAha samakSa nihuridaina |

9 hAmIle tinIharUkA agADi, pachADi pardA rAkhidiekA chauM ra tinIharUkA A~khAlAI chopidiekA chauM jasale gardA tinIharU satyabATa phAidA uThAune garI tyasalAI herna sakdainan | yo tyatikhera bhayo jaba tinIharUko zatrutA ra kuphramA aDiga rahane kurA spaSTa bhayo |
10 he muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! tapAIMle tinIharUlAI DarAunuhos vA naDarAunuhos tinIharUle tapAIMle lyAunubhaeko sandezamAthi ImAna lyAune chainan |

11 tapAIMko upadezabATa yastA mAnisaharUle mAtra lAbha uThAunechan jasale yasa kurAnako puSTi gare, yasamA raheko sandezako anusaraNa gare, ekAntamA allAhasita DarAe | yastA mAnisaharUlAI batAunuhos: allAhale tinIharUkA pApaharUlAI mApha garnuhunecha ra mahAna\ pratidAna svarga pradAna garnuhunecha |

12 hAmIle nai mahApralayako dina hisAbako lAgi mRtaharUlAI jIvita pArnechauM, tinIharUle sAMsArika jIvanamA garekA rAmrA ra narAmrA kAryaharUlAI lekhdaichauM | hAmIle tinIharUle garekA satkarmakA asaraharU jastai sadakae jAriyA (nirantara jArI rahane dAna) pani lekhdaichauM ra duSkarmakA asaraharU jastai kuphralAI pani lekhdaichauM | hAmI sabai kurAharUlAI lauhe mahaphUja (surakSita pATI) mA lekhdaichauM |

13 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! yI jhUTA Thahara garne zatruharUko lAgi udAharaNa varNana garnuhos, tAki tinIharUle tyasabATa pATha leun | tyo euTA gAu~ bAsIko satya kathA ho | jaba tinIharUkahA~ rasUlaharU Ae |

14 surumA hAmIle tinIharUkahA~ duI janA rasUlaharU paThAyauM, jasale tinIharUlAI eka allAhako bhaktiko lAgi AhvAna gare | tinIharUle duvai rasUlaharUlAI jhUTA Thahara gare | ani hAmIle tesro rasUla paThAera unIharUlAI baliyo pAryauM | tInai janA rasUlaharUle gAu~ bAsIharUlAI bhaneH hAmI tInai janA allAhakA rasUla hauM ra timIharUlAI eka allAhako bhakti ra uhA~ko nItiko pAlanAtarpha AhvAna garnako lAgi AekAchauM |

15 gAu~ bAsIharUle rasUlaharUlAI bhane− timIharU hAmIharU jastai mAnava hau | hAmIharUko tulanAmA timIharUmA kunai vizeSa zreSThatA chaina | timIharUmAthi karuNAmaya allAhale kunai vahI (prakAzanA) avataraNa garnubhaeko chaina | yasabAremA timIharU jhUTo mAtrai boldaichau |
16 tInai janA rasUlaharUle bhaneH he gAu~ bAsIharU ho! allAhalAI thAhA cha hAmIharU uhA~ko tarphabATa paThAiekA rasUla hauM | yo pramANa hAmro lAgi paryApta cha |
17 hAmIharUko jimmevArI timIharUtarpha allAhako sandezalAI spaSTarUpamA puryAunu mAtra ho | mArgadarzana dine zakti hAmIharUmA chaina |

18 gAu~ bAsIharUle bhaneH hAmIharUle timIharUlAI azubha mAnyauM | yadi timIharUle eka allAhako bhaktitarpha AhvAna garna banda garenau bhane hAmIharUle timIharUlAI DhuGgA-muDA barsAera mAridinechauM ra timIharUlAI avazya nai khubai kaSTa pugnecha |

19 rasUlaharUle javAphamA bhaneH timIharUle allAhalAI inkAra gareko ra rasUlaharUko anusaraNa nagarekole timIharU nai azubha hau | ke hAmIharUle timIharUlAI allAhako smaraNa garAu~dA hAmIharUlAI azubha ThAndachau? baru timIharU kuphra ra avajJA garera sImoullaGghana garne mAnisaharU hau |

20 gAu~kA mAnisaharUle rasUlaharUlAI jhUTA Thahara garnechan ra unIharUlAI hatyA garne ra kaSTa puryAune dhamakI dinechan bhanne AzaGkAle gAu~ko TADhA sthAnabATa ekajanA dagurdai Ae ra bhaneH he merA samudAya! timIharU yI rasUlaharUle bhanekA kurAharUko anusaraNa gara |

21 he merA samudAya! timIharU yastA rasUlaharUko anusaraNa gara jo allAhako sandeza puryAe bApata timIharUsita kunai pratidAna mAgdainan | unIharU allAhako juna sandeza puryAu~daichan tyasamA sIdhA mArgamA chan | yastA rasUlaharU anusaraNa garine yogya chan |
22 yasa hitaiSI vyaktile thapa bhaneH sRSTikartA allAhako bhaktibATa malAI ra timIharUlAI kasale rokna sakcha, jabaki badalAko lAgi punaH jIvita bhaera uhA~tarpha nai pharkera jAnucha?!

23 ke ma sRSTikartA allAhalAI choDera binA pramANa arUko bhakti garu~?! yadi karuNAmaya allAhale malAI kunai kaSTa puryAuna cAhemA yI jhUTA pUjyaharUko siphArisale kunai phAidA puryAune chaina | yinIharU mero phAidA ra hAniko zakti rAkhdainan | kuphramA mero mRtyubhaemA ra allAhale kaSTa dina khojemA yinIharUle malAI bacAuna sakdainan |

24 maile allAhalAI choDera yinIharUlAI pUjya banAemA ThUlo galtI garnechu | yasto garemA ma yastA jhUTAharUko bhakti garnechu jo bhaktiko hakadAra chainan | yaso garemA ma bhaktiko asala hakadAra allAhako bhaktilAI choDnechu |

25 he merA samudAya! suna, maile Aphno ra timIharUko pAlanakartAmAthi ImAna lyAeko chu | timIharUle malAI hatyAko juna dhamakI diirahekA chau, tyasako malAI kunai parvAha chaina | unakA samudAyale unako hatyA gare ani allAhale unalAI svargamA praveza garAunubhayo |

26-27 unako zahAdatapachi unako sammAna gari~dai bhaniyoH svargamA praveza gara | svargamA praveza garepachi ra tyahA~ rahekA varadAnaharU dekhepachi unale kAmanA gardai bhaneH malAI jhUTo Thahara garera mero hatyA gareko samudAyale malAI prApta bhaeko kSamAdAna ra sammAnabAre jAneko bhae tinIharUle pani ma jastai ImAna lyAune thie ra maile pAeko pratidAna jastai pratidAna pAune thie |

26-27 unako zahAdatapachi unako sammAna gari~dai bhaniyoH svargamA praveza gara | svargamA praveza garepachi ra tyahA~ rahekA varadAnaharU dekhepachi unale kAmanA gardai bhaneH malAI jhUTo Thahara garera mero hatyA gareko samudAyale malAI prApta bhaeko kSamAdAna ra sammAnabAre jAneko bhae tinIharUle pani ma jastai ImAna lyAune thie ra maile pAeko pratidAna jastai pratidAna pAune thie |

28 jhUTo Thahara garne ra hatyA hiMsA garne samudAyalAI sarvanAza pArnako lAgi AkAzabATa phariztAharUko sainya dala paThAune AvazyatA hAmIlAI pardaina | jaba hAmI kunai samudAyalAI sarvanAza pArchauM taba tyasako lAgi phariztAharU paThAu~dainauM | hAmro lAgi tyo bhandA sajilo unIharUlAI Adeza dinu ho | hAmIle tinIharUlAI AkAzabATa bhayaGkara AvAja paThAera sarvanAza pAryauM na ki prakopakA phariztAharU paThAera |

29 ani hAmIle tyasako samudAyalAI euTA bhayaGkara AvAja paThAera sarvanAza pAryauM | tinIharU sabai pachArie, kohI pani bA~kI bacena | tinIharUko udAharaNa tyasa Ago jasto cha, jo dankiraheko thiyo, acAnaka nibhyo ani kehI pani bA~kI rahena |

30 jhUTo Thahara garneharUle mahApralayako dina yAtanAlAI dekhepachi dherai pachutAune chan kinabhane sAMsArika jIvanamA tinIharUle allAhako tarphabATa paThAiekA rasUlaharUlAI jhUTo Thahara garekA thie ra unIharUko upahAsa garekA thie | allAhako zAnamA kamI gareko kAraNale mahApralayako dina tinIharUlAI yasto sajAya diinecha |

31 ke yI rasUlaharUlAI jhUTA Thahara garne ra unIharUko upahAsa garneharUle vigatakA samudAyaharUko pariNAmabATa pATha sikenan? tinIharUko sarvanAza bhayo ra punaH saMsAramA phirtA Aenan | tinIharU AphnA karmakA pariNAmatarpha pharkAie ra allAhale cA~Dai nai tyasako sajAya dinuhunecha |
32 mahApralayako dina sabai samudAyaharUlAI punaH jIvita pArera hAmI samakSa hAjira garinecha ra hAmIle tinIharUkA karmaharUko badalA dinechauM |

33 mRtyu pazcAta punaH jIvita garine kurAlAI jhUTA Thahara garneharUkA lAgi pramANa ke cha bhaneH hAmIle yasa sukeko bhUmimAthi AkAzabATa pAnI barsAyauM ra tyasamA nAnA prakArakA bAlInAlI umAryauM ra mAnisaharUko bhojanako lAgi tyasamA vibhinna prakArakA anna sRSTi garyauM | ataH juna allAhale yasa mRta bhUmilAI jIvita pArne zakti rAkhnuhuncha, uhA~ mRtaharUlAI punaH jIvita pArne zakti pani rAkhnuhuncha |
34 hAmIle varSA barsAeko bhUmimAthi khajura ra aGgurakA bagai~cAharU sRSTi garyauM, tyasako siMcAiko lAgi pAnIkA mUlaharU phuTAyauM |

35 tAki mAnisaharU allAhale pradAna garnubhaekA tI bagai~cAharUkA phala khAun | tI bagai~cAharU umArnamA tinIharUko kunai prayAsa chaina | ani tinIharU mAtra allAhako bhakti garera ra uhA~kA rasUlaharUmAthi ImAna lyAera uhA~kA varadAnaharUkA lAgi uhA~prati AbhAra kina prakaTa gardainan?|

36 pavitra hunuhuncha allAha; jasale vibhinna prakArakA boTa biruvA ra rukhaharU umArnubhayo, mAnavabATa puruSa ra mahilA banAunuyo | thala ra jala ityAdimA allAhakA anya dherai sRSTiharU chan jasalAI mAnisaharU jAndainan |

37 eka allAha mAtra vAstavika pUjya hunuhuncha bhanne kurAko euTA pramANa mAnisaharUkA lAgi yo pani ho ki yadi hAmIle prakAzalAI samApta pArera sadhaiMko lAgi dinalAI andhakAra rAtamA pariNata garchauM bhane mAnisaharU sadhaiMko lAgi andhakAramA hunechan |

38 mAtra eka allAha pUjya hunuhuncha bhanne kurAko euTA pramANa yo pani ho ki yo sUrya Aphno gantabyatarpha dagurdaicha jasako sImAko jJAna allAhalAI mAtra cha, U tyasabhandA agADi baDhdaina | yo bhAgya nirdhAraNa prabhutvazAlI allAhako tarphabATa cha jasamAthi kohI vijaya prApta garna sakdaina | allAha sarvajJa hunuhuncha, sRSTiharUbAre kehI pani uhA~bATa lukeko chaina |

39 eka allAha mAtra upAsanA yogya hunuhuncha bhanne kurAko euTA pramANa yo candramA pani ho jasako pratyeka rAtako gantavya hAmIle nirdhAraNa garekAchauM | surumA sAno rahancha, ani ThUlo huncha ra pheri khajurako sukeko pAta jhaiM sAno, pahelo ra bAGgo huna pugcha |

40 sUrya, candramA, rAta ra dina jastA nizAnIharU allAhako tarphabATa nirdhArita gariekA chan | yinIharUle nirdhArita niyamako alikati pani ullaGghana garna sakdainan | sUryako lAgi candramAsamma pugna ra tyasako gati ra jyotilAI samApta pArna sambhava chaina | rAtako lAgi dinabhandA agADi baDhna ra nizcita samayabhandA aghi nai tyasasamma pugna asambhava cha | yI bAheka anya sabai niyantraNamA liiekA tArA, nakSatra ityAdi sRSTiharUkA lAgi allAhale hi~Dne mArga nirdhAraNa garnubhaeko cha |

41 eka allAha mAtra vAstavika upAsya hunuhuncha ra uhA~le AphnA bhaktaharUlAI dherai varadAna pradAna garnubhaeko cha bhanne kurAko euTA pramANa yo pani ho ki uhA~le sandeSTA nUha (alaihissalAma) ko yugamA Adama (alaihissalAma) kA santAnaharUlAI vibhinna prANIharUle bharieko DuGgAmA savAra garAera bADhIbATa surakSita rAkhnubhayo | tyasa DuGgAmA allAhale pratyeka prANIkA joDA-joDA rAkhnubhayo |

42 eka allAha mAtra vAstavika bhakti-yogya hunuhuncha ra uhA~le AphnA bhaktaharUlAI dherai varadAna pradAna garnubhaeko cha bhanne kurAko euTA pramANa yo pani ho ki uhA~le nUha (alaihissalAma) ko DuGgA jhaiM arU savArIharU pani sRSTi garnubhayo |
43 yadi hAmIle tinIharUlAI pAnImA DubAera nAza pArna cAhemA kasaile pani bacAuna sakdaina |
44 hAmIle kRpA garera DubnabATa bacAemA mAtra tinIharU bacna sakchan, tAki hAmIle nirdhArita gareko samayasamma mAtra tinIharUle lAbha uThAun | AzA cha tinIharUle pATha sikera ImAna lyAunechan |

45 ImAna lyAunabATa bhAgne bahudevavAdIharUlAI jaba bhaninchaH paraloka tathA tyasakA kaSTaharUbATa sAvadhAna hoU ra lokabATa pani sAvadhAna hoU! AzA cha allAhale timIharUmAthi kRpA garnuhunecha, taba tinIharU sAvadhAna hu~dainan, baru yasako parvAha nagarikana piThyU~ pharkAera bhAgne garchan |

46 jaba-jaba yI zatrutA prakaTa garne bahudevavAdIharU samakSa eka allAha mAtra bhakti-yogya hunuhuncha bhanne kurAkA nizAnIharU Au~chan taba taba tinIharU tyasabATa pATha naliera piThyU~ pharkAera bhAgne garchan |

47 jaba yI zatrutA prakaTa garne bahudevavAdIharUlAI gariba guruvAharUlAI Arthika sahayoga garna bhanincha taba tinIharU mominaharUlAI bhanchan: ke hAmIle tyastA mAnisaharUlAI khuvAu~, jasalAI allAhale khuvAuna cAhemA khuvAunu hune thiyo?! hAmIharU allAhako cAhanA viparIta gardainauM | he mominaharU ho! timIharU spaSTa galtImA ra satyabATa TADhA chau |

48 mRtyu pazcAta punaH jIvita garine kurAlAI inkAra gardai ra tyasalAI asambhava ThAndai kAphiraharUle bhanchan: he mominaharU ho! punaH jIvita garine cha bhanera timIharUle gareko vAcA kahile pUrA huncha?!

49 yI punaH jIvita garine kurAlAI jhUTA Thahara garneharU pahilo paTaka sUramA phukine pratIkSA gardaichan, jabaki sUramA pahilo paTaka tyatikhera phukinecha jaba tinIharU kina beca, khetIko si~cAi ra caupAyAko rekhadekha jastA sAMsArika kAryaharUmA vyasta hunechan |
50 pahilo paTaka yati akasmAta phu~kinecha ki tinIharU nata eka arkAlAI upadeza dina saknechan ra na AphnA ghara parivAratarpha pharkana saknechan, juna vyastatAmA rahanechan tyasaimA marnechan |
51 jaba dosro paTaka sUramA phukinecha taba tinIharU jIvita hunechan ra A-AphnA cihAnabATa niskera karmako hisAba kitAbako lAgi allAhatarpha dagurnechan |

52 mRtyu pazcAtako punaH jIvanalAI jhUTA Thahara garneharUle pachuto gardai bhannechan: hAya apasoca! hAmIharUlAI kasale hAmrA cihAnaharUbATa jIvita pArera nikAlyo?! tinIharUle javApha pAunechan− yo allAhale garnubhaeko vAcA ho, jo avazya pUrA hunuthiyo ra rasUlaharUle bhanekA kurA satya thie |
53 mahApralayako dina mAtra dosro paTakako phU~kale gardA sabai prANIharU cihAnaharUbATa niskera hAmI samakSa hisAbako lAgi jammA hunechan |
54 tyasa dina nisAphakA sAtha nirNaya garinecha | he bhaktaharU ho! timIharUmAthi atyAcAra garine chaina | timIharUle lokamA garekA sabai karmaharUko pUrA-pUrA badalA pAunechau |
55 mahApralayako dina svargabAsIharU sadhaiM rahane varadAna ra mahAna saphalatA dekhepachi arUko bAremA nizcinta hunechan ra khusImA magna hunechan |
56 unIharU ra unakA patnIharU svargako vistRta chAyA~mA palaGgamA sirAnI lagAera basekA hunechan |

57 unIharUkA lAgi tyasa svargamA aGgura, aJjIra ra anAra jastA anekauM prakArakA phalaphUlaharU hunechan | unIharUkA lAgi mojamastIkA sabai sAmAna ra nAnA prakArakA varadAnaharU hunechan | unIharU jasako cAhanA garnechan pAunechan |
58 thapa varadAnaharUmadhye unIharUkA lAgi zAnti hunecha | atyanta dayAvAna allAhako tarphabATa salAma bhaninecha, ani cAraitirabATa zAnti ra bhabya salAma pAunechan |
59 mahApralayako dina bahudevavAdIharUlAI bhaninechaH mominaharUdekhi alaga hoU | timIharU duvaiko badalA ra guNamA ThUlo antara rahekole ekasAtha basna pAu~dainau |

60 ke maile timIharUlAI rasUlaharUko mAdhyamabATa upadeza dieko thiina~; he Adama (alaihissalAma) kA santAna ho! vibhinna kisimakA kuphra ra avajJA garera zaitAnako anusaraNa nagara | nissandeha zaitAna timIharUko spaSTa zatru ho | buddhimAnale kasarI spaSTa zatruko anusaraNa garna sakcha?!

61 he Adama (alaihissalAma) kA santAna ho! mAtra mero bhakti gara ra masa~ga anya kasailAI sAjhedAra nabanAU bhanne Adeza maile dieko thie~ | mAtra mero bhakti ra AjJApAlana nai sIdhA mArga ho jasabATa timIharU mero prasannatA ra svarga prApta garna sakchau | tara timIharUle mero Adezako pAlanA garenau |

62 zaitAnale timIharUmadhye dherai janAlAI bahakAyo | timIharUlAI Aphno ekamAtra pAlanakartA allAhako AjJApAlana ra bhaktiko Adeza dine ani timIharUko khullama khullA zatru zaitAnako AjJApAlanabATa sAvadhAna garAune ke timIharUko buddhi thiena ra?!

63 yadi timIharU saMsAramA kuphrako avasthAmA marchau bhane narkamA jAnechau bhanne vAcA timIharUsita garieko thiyo | saMsAramA yo narka parokSamA (adRSya) thiyo tara Aja timIharU Aphno A~khAle dekhdaichau |
64 Aja yasa narkamA praveza gara ra saMsAramA gareko kuphrale gardA yasako garmIlAI sahana gara |

65 tinIharUko kuphra ra avajJAle gardA Aja tinIharUko mukhaharUmAthi mohara lagAidinechauM jasale gardA lATA bannechan, tinIharUle gareko kAryabAre tinIharUkA hAtaharUle kurA garnechan ra tinIharUle gareko pApako bAremA tinIharUkA khuTTAharUle gavAhI dinechan |

66 yadi hAmIle tinIharUkA dRSTiharU khosna cAhemA khosna sakchauM, ani tinIharUle dekhna sakne chainan ani svargasamma pugnako lAgi pula pAra garna dagurnechan tara andho bhaekole pAra garna sakne chainan |

67 yadi hAmIle tinIharUko sRSTimA pherabadala garna cAhemA tinIharUlAI tinIharUko khuTTAko bala basAuna sakchauM, ani tinIharU Aphno sthAna choDna sakne chainan, na agADi jAna saknechan ra na pachADi haTna saknechan |

68 mAnisaharUmadhye jasalAI hAmIle lAmo umera dinchauM, usalAI kamajora pArchauM | ke tinIharUle buddhi prayoga garenan ra yo loka sadhaiMko ghara hoina bhanne kurA bujhenan | sadhaiMko ghara ta paralokako ghara ho |

69 hAmIle muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) lAI kavitA sikAenauM ra yo uhA~ (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) ko lAgi ucita pani chaina | kinabhane yo uhA~ (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) ko svabhAva hoina | tAki timIharU yo bhanna nasaka ki uhA~ (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) kavi hunuhuncha | hAmIle vicAra garneharUkA lAgi uhA~ (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) lAI jikra ra spaSTa kurAna sikAekAchauM |

70 tAki uhA~ (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) le tI mAnisaharUlAI DarAun jasakA hRdaya jIvita chan ra A~khAle dekhirAkhekA chan | kinabhane yastA mAnisaharU nai phAidA uThAuna sakchan | kAphiraharUmAthi yAtanA anivArya bhayo, kinabhane tinIharUsamma AhvAna pugyo ani pramANa pramANita bhayo ra tinIharUsa~ga kunai bahAnA bacena |
71 ke tinIharUle yasa kurAmA vicAra garenan− hAmIle tinIharUkA lAgi caupAyAharU sRSTi garyauM, ani tinIharU tyasakA mAlika hun ra tyasalAI AphnA phAidAko lAgi prayoga garchan |
72 hAmIle caupAyAharUlAI tinIharUkA adhinamA garidiyauM | ani tinIharU kehIkA piThyU~mAthi yAtrA garchan, kehIkA piThyU~mAthi sara-sAmAnako DhuvAnI garchan ra kehIkA mAsu khAnchan |

73 savArI sAdhana ra mAsu khAne bAheka tinIharU yI janAvaraharUbATa anya phAidA pani uThAu~chanH jastai tinIharU tI janAvarakA Una, rauM, gobara ra mUlyabATa phAidA uThAu~chan | Una ra rauMbATa galai~cA ra lugA banAu~chan | tinIharU tI caupAyAkA dUdha khAnchan | allAhakA yI varadAnaharUkA lAgi ke tinIharUle uhA~prati AbhAra vyakta gardainan?!
74 bahudevavAdIharUle allAhalAI choDera anya upAsyaharU banAe | tinIharUle maddata garnechan ra allAhako yAtanAbATa bacAunechan bhanne AzA liera tinIharUko pUjA garchan |

75 tinIharUle mAnne garekA pUjyaharUle nata svayam Aphno maddata garna sakchan na AphnA upAsakaharUko maddata garna sakchan | tI mUrtiharU ra tyasakA pUjArIharU yAtanAkA lAgi hAjira garinechan | tyahA~ duvai pakSaharU eka arkAkA vipakSI banera eka arkAsita kunai sarokAra naraheko dAbI garnechan |

76 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! tapAIM rasUla hunuhunna bhanne vA tapAIM kavi hunuhuncha bhanne jastA tinIharUkA Aropale tapAIM cintita nahunuhos | tinIharUle lukAune ra vyakta garne kurAsita hAmI avagatachauM | hAmIbATa kunai kurA lukeko chaina ra hAmIle cA~Dai nai tyasako badalA dinechauM |

77 ke mRtyu pazcAta punaH jIvita garine kurAlAI inkAra garne vyaktile yasa kurAmA vicAra garena- hAmIle usalAI viryabATa sRSTi garyauM ani U vibhinna caraNaharUbATa gujriyo ani zizuko rUpamA janma liyo ra hurkiyo, tyasapachi U dherai jhagaDAlu banyo? ke usale yasa kAryamA vicAra garena, jasale punaH jIvita garnu sambhava cha bhanne kurAlAI pramANita garcha?!

78 saDeko haDDIbATa punaH jIvita garnu asambhava cha bhanne kurAko tarka diera AphU asAvadhAna ra ajJAnI cha bhanne kurA yasa kAphira (avajJAkArI) le pramANita garyo | usale bhanyoH kasale punaH jIvita garnasakcha? yo prazna garera usale svayam Aphno sRSTilAI birsidiyo, jo pahilA kehI pani thiena |

79 he muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! yinIharUlAI bhannuhos: yI saDekA haDDIlAI uhA~ allAhale sRSTi garnuhunecha jasale pahilo paTaka tyasako sRSTi garnubhayo | jo pahilo paTaka sRSTi garne sAmarthyavAn hunuhuncha uhA~le dosro paTaka pani tyasamA punaH prANa hAlna saknuhuncha | uhA~ hareka sRSTikA jJAtA hunuhuncha | uhA~bATa kehI pani lukeko chaina |

80 he mAnava! uhA~le timIharUkA lAgi hariyo ra kA~co rukhabATa Ago sRSTi garnubhayo, jasabATa timIharU Ago bAlchau | juna allAhale duIvaTA viparIta vastu- kA~co rukha ra baldo Ago- eka sAtha jammA garne sAmarthya rAkhnuhuncha uhA~ mRtaharUlAI jIvita pArne sAmarthya pani rAkhnuhuncha |

81 ke juna allAhale mahAna AkAzaharU ra pRthvI sRSTi garne sAmarthya rAkhnuhuncha uhA~ mRtaharUlAI punaH jIvita pArne sAmarthya rAkhnuhunna? kina nahunu, uhA~ avazya yasa kAryako sAmarthya rAkhnuhuncha | uhA~ sabai cIjaharUkA sRSTikartA hunuhuncha | uhA~le nai sRSTikA sampUrNa cIjaharUlAI sRSTi garnubhayo, uhA~ sabaikA jJAtA hunuhuncha, kehI pani uhA~bATa lukeko chaina |

82 jaba uhA~le kunai vastu sRSTi garne nIyata garnuhuncha taba bhannuhunchaH bhai hAla, ani tyo huna pugcha | yasai prakAra uhA~le jIvita garnuhuncha, mArnuhuncha ra punaH jIvita garnuhuncha ityAdi garnuhuncha |

83 bahudevavAdIharUle bhaneko yasa kurAbATa allAha pavitra tathA ucca hunuhuncha ki uhA~ yo kArya garne sAmarthya rAkhnuhunna | uhA~ nai sabai vastuharUkA mAlika hunuhuncha, jasarI cAhanuhuncha saJcAlana garnuhuncha, hareka vastukA sA~cAharU uhA~ kai hAtamA chan | AkhiratamA timIharU uhA~tarpha nai pharkAera laginechau | uhA~le timIharUkA karmaharUko badalA dinuhunecha |
1 ma tI phariztAharUko kasama khAnchu jo paGktibaddha bhaera allAhako bhakti garchan |

7 hAmIle pRthvI najikako AkAzalAI ghamaNDI avajJAkArI zaitAnabATa surakSita garekAchauM, tinIharU najika AemA tArAharUbATa prahAra garincha |

8 tI zaitAnaharUle AkAzamA bhaekA phariztAharUkA tyastA kurAharU sunna sakdainan, juna kurAharU unIharUkA pAlanakartA allAhako tarphabATa zarIata (islAmI kAnuna) vA bhAgyako bAremA avataraNa bhaepachi tyasa sambandhamA unIharUle ApasamA kurA garchan | tinIharUmAthi cAraitirabATa tArAdvArA prahAra garincha |
9 tinIharUlAI sunnabATa TADhA pArnako lAgi cAraitirabATa prahAra garera dhapAincha | tinIharUkA lAgi AkhiratamA sadhaiMko lAgi pIDAdAyI yAtanA cha |

10 yadi zaitAnaharUmadhye kunaile phariztAharUbATa kunai kurA sunna saphala huncha bhane tArAle usalAI pachyAu~dai gaera pRthvIsamma pugnuaghi nai prahAra garcha | kahilekAhI~ prahAra garnubhandA pahile adhuro kurA AphnA sAthI bhAiharUsamma puryAuna saphala huncha tyasapachi tyo kurA jyotiSIsamma pugcha ra jyotiSIharU tyasamA sayavaTA jhUTo kurA misAu~chan |

11 he muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! mRtyu pazcAtako punaH jIvanalAI inkAra garne kAphiraharUlAI sodhnuhos: ke tinIharUko sRSTi gAhro cha ra tinIharUko zarIrakA aGgaharU ThUlA chan vA AkAzaharU, pRthvI ra phariztAharUko sRSTi gAhro cha? hAmIle mAnavako sRSTi TAsine mATobATa garyauM | tinIharUle kasarI punaH jIvita pArine kurAlAI inkAra gardaichan jabaki tinIharUko sRSTi TA~sine mATobATa garieko cha?

12 he muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) tapAIMle allAhako sAmarthya, sRSTiko saJcAlana ra bahudevavAdIharUko punaH jIvita pArine kurA inkAralAI acamma mAnnubhayo tara yI bahudevavAdIharU punaH jIvanako pakkA inkArale gardA tapAIMle bhaneko kurAko ThaTTA gardaichan |
13 jaba yI bahudevavAdIharUlAI upadeza diincha taba tinIharUle upadezalAI grahaNa gardainan | tinIharUkA hRdaya kaThora bhaekAle tyasabATa phAidA uThAu~dainan |

14 jaba tinIharU nabI (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) kA nizAnIharUmadhye kunai nizAnI dekhchan jasale uhA~ (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) satya hunuhuncha bhanne kurAko puSTi gardacha taba khubai ThaTTA garchan ra acamma mAnchan |
15 tinIharU bhanchan: muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) le je jati lyAekAchan sabai jAdU hun |
16 ke jaba hAmI marchauM ra saDera mATomA misinchauM taba pheri hAmI jIvita pArinechauM?! yo asambhava kurA ho |
17 ke hAmIharUbhandA pahile marekA hAmrA pUrvajaharU pani jIvita pArinechan ra?!
18 he muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! yinIharUlAI javAphamA bhannuhos: a~ saDe-galepachi timIharU ra timrA pUrvajaharUlAI pani punaH jIvita pArinecha | timIharU lAcAra ra vivaza hunechau |
19 (dosro paTaka) sUramA phU~kidA tinIharU akasmAta mahApralayako bhayAvaha dRzya dekhnechan, allAhale tinIharUsa~ga ke garnuhunecha bhanne kurAko pratIkSA garnechan |

20 mRtyupachiko punaH jIvanalAI inkAra garne bahudevavAdIharUle bhannechan: hAya hAmro barbAdI! yo badalA diine dina ho jasamA allAhale bhaktaharUlAI tinIharUle sAMsArika jIvanamA garekA karmako badalA dinuhunecha |
21 tinIharUlAI bhaninechaH Aja bhaktaharUbIca nirNayako dina ho jasako inkAra timIharU saMsAramA gardai thiyau |

22-23 tyasa dina phariztAharUlAI bhaninechaH atyAcArI bahudevavAdIharU, tinIharU jastai zirka garne tathA jhUTalAune anya mAnisaharU ra tinIharUle allAhalAI choDera pUjA garne mUrtiharUlAI jammA gara, tyasapachi tinIharUlAI narkatarpha DoryAU | yahI tinIharUko bAsa-sthAna ho |

22-23 tyasa dina phariztAharUlAI bhaninechaH atyAcArI bahudevavAdIharU, tinIharU jastai zirka garne tathA jhUTalAune anya mAnisaharU ra tinIharUle allAhalAI choDera pUjA garne mUrtiharUlAI jammA gara, tyasapachi tinIharUlAI narkatarpha DoryAU | yahI tinIharUko bAsa-sthAna ho |
24 narkamA hAlnubhandA pahile tinIharUlAI hisAbako lAgi roka | tinIharUsa~ga sodhapUcha hunecha, tyasapachi tinIharUlAI narkatarpha DoryAU |

25 tinIharUko nindA gardai bhaninechaH jasarI timIharUle saMsAramA eka arkAlAI maddata garne garthyau ra mUrtiharUle timIharUlAI maddata garnechan bhanne ThAnekA thiyau tyasarI Aja pani eka arkAlAI maddata kina garirahekA chainau?!
26 baru tyasa dina tinIharU allAhako Adezaprati pUrNa samarpita ra AjJApAlaka hunechan | tinIharUle Aphno kamIkamajorI ra sAdhanako kamIle gardA eka arkAlAI maddata garna avasthAmA hune chainan |
27 tinIharU eka arkAko nindA gardai ra paraspara jhagaDA gardai eka arkAtarpha baDhnechan | jabaki tinIharUlAI yasa nindA ra jhagaDAle kunai phAidA hune chaina |

28 anuyAyIharUle aguvAharUlAI bhannechan: timIharU hAmI samakSa dharma ra satyako nAma liera Aune garthyau ra kuphra, zirka ra avajJAlAI AkarSaka banAera prastuta garne garthyau | timIharU rasUlaharUle lyAekA satya kurAharUmA ghRNA utpanna garne garthyau |
29 aguvAharUle javApha dinechan: mAmilA timIharUle ThAne jasto chaina | baru timIharU AphaiM kuphra ra inkAramA lipta thiyau ani ImAna lyAekA thienau |
30 he anuyAyIharU ho! timIharUlAI kuphra, zirka ra avajJAmA hAlne zakti hAmImA thiena baru timIharU AphaiM kuphra ra pathabhraSTatAmA hada pAra garekA thiyau |

31 hAmIharU ra timIharU duvaimAthi allAhako yo vacana siddha bhaeko cha- maile avazya nai narkalAI ta~ zaitAna ra timrA sabai anuyAyIharUbATa bharnechu | (sUraha sAdaH85) | allAhale dinubhaeko dhamkIko svAda hAmIharUle avazya cAkhnuparcha |
32 hAmIle timIharUlAI pathabhraSTatA ra kuphratarpha bolAekA thiyauM ra hAmI AphaiM sIdhA mArgabATa pathabhraSTa thiyauM |
33 mahApralayako dina anuyAyIharU ra aguvAharU duvai ekasAtha yAtanA grasta hunechan |
34 jasarI hAmIle yinIharUlAI yAtanA diyauM tyasarI nai anya aparAdhIharUlAI pani yAtanA dinechauM |

35 jaba yI bahudevavAdIharUlAI saMsAramA bhaninthyoH allAha mAtra satya pUjya hunuhuncha bhanne kurAmA ImAna lyAU, yasako mAga tathA Adeza anusAra kArya gara ra yasakA viparIta kAryaharUlAI tyAga, taba tinIharUle ghamaNDa gardai yI kurAharU mAnna inkAra garekA thie |

36 tinIharU kuphrako pakSamA pramANa diMdai bhanthe: ke hAmIle eka janA baulAhA kaviko kurAmA Aera AphnA bhagavAnaharUko pUjA garna choDi deauM?! tinIharUko tAtparya rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) hunuhunthyo |

37 tinIharUle rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) lAI baulAhA ra kavi bhanera ThUlo Aropa lagAe | rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) nata baulAhA hunuhunthyo na kavi nai | baru uhA~ (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) le yasto kurAna liera Aunubhaeko cha, jasale eka allAhako bhakti ra uhA~ (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) ko AjJApAlanako AhvAna gardacha | yo kurAna vigatamA AekA rasUlaharUko yasa AhvAna ko pani puSTi gardacha ki mAtra eka allAhako bhakti gara ra AkhiratamAthi ImAna lyAU | yo kurAna tinIharUko virodha gardaina |
38 he bahudevavAdIharU ho! timIharUle kuphra garekole ra rasUlaharUlAI jhUTA Thahara garekole mahApralayako dina avazya nai pIDAdAyI yAtanA bhognechau |
39 he bahudevavAdIharU ho! timIharUlAI timIharUle saMsAramA garekA kuphra ra avajJAko sajAya mAtra diinecha |
40 ekAgratAkA sAtha allAhako bhakti garne viziSTa momina bhaktaharUlAI yAtanAbATa surakSita rAkhinecha |
41 tI viziSTa bhaktaharUlAI ati uttama ra sadhaiM rahane jIvikA pradAna garinecha |

42 unIharUlAI vibhinna prakArakA ati uttama phalaphUlaharU pradAna garinecha jasalAI unIharUle svAda liera khAnechan | yati mAtra hoina baru unIharUlAI padonnatI garera ra allAhako pratiSThita anuhArako darzana garAera sammAnita garinecha |
43 yI sabai varadAnaharU unIharUle sadhaiM rahane svargamA pAunechan, jahA~ tI varadAnaharU kahilyai samApta hune chainan |
44 unIharU eka arkAtarpha pharkera palaGgamA aDesa lagAera basnechan |
45 bagiraheko svaccha pAnI jastai madirAle bharieko pyAlA unIharU samakSa peza garinecha |
46 seto raGgako peya padArtha, jasalAI piepachi unIharUle bharapUra svAda mahasusa garnechan |

47 tyo peya padArtha saMsArako madirA jasto hunechaina | tyasalAI piepachi svargabAsIharU nasA lAgera mAttine chainan | tyasalAI piepachi unIharUko TAuko pani dukhne chaina | unIharUko zarIra ra dimAga duvai svasthya rahanechan |
48 unIharUsa~ga svargamA pavitra apsarAharU hunechan | unIharUle AphnA patiharU bAheka anya puruSaharUtarpha dekhne chainan | unIharUkA A~khAharU ati sundara hunechan |
49 mAnauM unIharU carAkA aNDA jastA pahe~lopana sahitakA setA hunechan, jasalAI kasaile choeko nahos |
50 svargabAsIharU eka arkatarpha baDhdai saMsAramA bitekA ghaTanAharUbAre sodhapucha garnechan |
51 mominaharUmadhye ekajanAle bhannechaH saMsAramA mero ekajanA sAthI thiyo jasale mRtya pazcAta punaH jIvita hune kurAlAI inkAra garthyo |
52 tyo sAthIle inkAra gardai ra ThaTTA gardai bhanne garthyoH he mero sAthI! ke timI mRtya pazcAtako punarjIvanamA AsthA rAkhneharU madhyekA hau?
53 ke jaba hAmI marepachi saDera dhulo mATo banna pugnechauM taba hAmI punaH jIvita pArinechauM ra saMsAramA garekA kAryaharUko badalA pAunechauM?
54 momina sAthIle AphnA svargabAsI sAthIharUlAI bhannechaH AU, mRtyu pazcAtako punaH jIvanalAI inkAra garne sAthIko bAsa-sthAnalAI niyAlauM |
55 usale punaH jIvita hune kurAlAI inkAra garne sAthIlAI niyAldA usalAI narkako bIcauM bIca pAunecha |

56 momina sAthIle bhannecha: he sAthI, allAhako kasama! timIle punaH jIvita pArine kurAlAI inkAra garne AhvAna garera malAI barbAdai pArna lAgekA thiyau | yadi maile timro kurA mAneko bhaeM ma pani narkamA hune thieM |

momina sAthIle Aphno narkabAsI sAthIlAI sambodhana garepachi AphnA svargabAsI sAthIharUlAI sambodhana gardai bhannechaH
58 aba hAmI svargabAsIharU kahilyai marne chainauM,
59 sivAya pahilo paTaka sAMsArika jIvanamA bhaeko mRtyuko | aba hAmIharU sadA sarvadAko lAgi svargamA basnechauM | hAmIharUlAI kunai yAtanA diine chaina jasarI kAphiraharUlAI yAtanA dii~daicha |
60 allAhale hAmIharUlAI sadhaiMko lAgi svargamA praveza garAera ra narkabATa jogAera juna pratidAna dinubhayo tyo mahAna saphalatA ho, yo jasto arU kunai saphalatA huna sakdaina |

63 hAmIle yasa rukhalAI atyAcArIharUkA lAgi parIkSAko sAdhana banAekAchauM | tinIharUle bhaneH narkako Agole tyasa rukhalAI khAidinecha, tyasamA kunai rukha umrana sakdaina |

65 tyasako phala pani narAmro dekhincha, mAnauM tyo zaitAnako TAuko | yo phala jasarI dekhnamA narAmro dekhincha tyasarI nai svAdamA pani ati narAmro huncha |

71 yinIharUbhandA pahile pani vigatakA adhikAMsa samudAyaharU pathabhraSTa bhae | he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! tapAIMko samudAya pathabhraSTa huneharUmadhye pahilo samudAya hoina |
72 vigatakA samudAyaharUlAI allAhako yAtanAbATa sAvadhAna garAunako lAgi pani hAmIle vibhinna rasUlaharU paThAyauM, tara tinIharUle inkAra gare |

73 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! vicAra garnuhos, kasto narAmro pariNAma bhayo vigatakA tI samudAyaharUko jasalAI rasUlaharUle sAvadhAna garAekA thie tara tinIharUle rasUlaharUkA kurA mAnenan | tinIharUle allAhalAI inkAra ra rasUlaharUlAI jhUTo Thahara garekAle sadhaiMko lAgi narkamA jAnechan |

75 hAmro sandeSTA nUha (alaihissalAma) le tyatikhera Aphno samudAyalAI zrApa die jaba tinIharUle unalAI jhUTo Thahara gare | hAmIle ati rAmro tarikAle tatkAlai unako mAgalAI svIkAra garyauM |
76 hAmIle unalAI, unakA parivArakA sadasyaharUlAI ra mominaharUlAI unako samudAyako kaSTa ra tyasa bADhIbATa surakSita rAkhyauM jo unako samudAyakA kAphiraharUtarpha paThAieko thiyo |
77 hAmIle nUha (alaihissalAma), unakA parivAra ra momina anuyAyIharUlAI surakSita rAkhyauM ra kAphiraharUlAI sarvanAza pAryauM |
78 hAmIle unIpachi Aune samudAyaharUmA unako rAmro prazaMsA bA~kI rAkhyauM, jasadvArA mAnisaharUle unako prazaMsA gardai rahanechan |
79 nUha (alaihissalAma) ko lAgi unIpachi Aune samudAyaharUmA kunai badanAmI hoina baru zAnti, santuSTi ra prazaMsA choDyauM |
80 nUha (alaihissalAma) lAI dieko badalA jastai hAmIle sukarmIharUlAI badalA dine garchauM, jasale rAmrosa~ga allAhako upAsanA garchan ra uhA~ko AjJApAlana garchan |
81 nissandeha nUha (alaihissalAma) hAmrA AjJAkArI momina bhakta thie |
82 tyasapachi hAmIle mominaharU bAheka sabailAI bADhI paThAera DubAidiyauM, kohI pani jIvita bacena |
83 nissandeha ibrAhIma (alaihissalAma) eka allAhako bhaktiko lAgi AhvAna garneharUmadhye thie |
84 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! tyasa samayalAI yAda garnuhos, jaba ibrAhIma (alaihissalAma) zirkabATa pavitra tathA svaccha ani sRSTiprati hidaiSI hRdaya liera allAha najika Ae |

2 tara kAphiraharUle ghamaNDale gardA eka allAhako bhakti garirahekA chainan | tinIharU muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) sita zatrutAle gardA virodha garchan |

3 tinIharUbhandA pahile pani rasUlaharUlAI jhUTA Thahara garne katipaya samudAyaharUlAI hAmIle sarvanAza garyauM | prakopa Au~dA tinIharUle maddatako lAgi pukAre | tara tyo samaya prakopabATa bacne samaya thiena, tyasaile maddatako lAgi pukArale tinIharUlAI kunai phAidA diena |

4 jaba tinIharU samakSa tinIharU madhyebATa rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) ko cayana bhayo taba tinIharUle acamma mAne | rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) le tinIharUlAI allAhako prakopabATa DarAunubhayo tara tinIharU kuphramai DaTera lAgirahe | muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) le lyAunu bhaeko sandeza satya ho bhanne kurAko puSTi garne pramANaharU dekhepachi tinIharUle bhaneH yo jAdUgara vyakti ho, yasale mAnisaharUmAthi jAdU garcha | U allAhako rasUla ho ra usamAthi vahI (IzavANI) avataraNa huncha bhanne jhUTo dAbI garcha |
5 ke yasa vyaktile vibhinna pUjyaharUlAI euTai pUjya banAidiyo, jasa bAheka anya kohI satya pUjya Izvara chaina? usale ta acamma kAma gareko cha |

6 ThUlA baDAharUle AphnA anuyAyIharUlAI bhaneH timIharU Aphno dharmamA kAyama raho, jasamA pahile thiyau ra muhammadako dharmamA praveza nagara | timIharU AphnA pUjyaharUko pUjAmA kAyama raho | muhammadale juna eka allAhako bhaktitarpha bolAu~daicha, tyo usako cAla ho, U hAmIharU bhandA ThUlo banna cAhancha ra mAnisaharUlAI Aphno anuyAyI banAuna cAhancha |

7 muhammadale gareko ekamAtra allAhako bhakti (ekezvaravAda) ko kurA hAmIle AphnA pUrvajaharUmA ra IsA (alaihissalAma) ko samudAyamA sunekA chainauM | usabATa hAmI je sundaichauM tyo jhUTo ra raceko kurA ho |

8 ke yo kurA ThIka hunasakcha ki hAmIharUbIca vizeSarUpamA usamAthi kurAna avataraNa bhayo jabaki hAmIharU aguvA ra pramukha mAnisaharU hauM | he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! tapAIMmAthi avataraNa bhaeko vahI (prakAzanA) bAre yI bahudevavAdIharU zaGkAmA chan | yinIharUle ahilesamma allAhako prakopako svAda cAkhekA chainan, tyasaile hAmIle dieko avasarale gardA tinIharU dhokAmA chan | yadi tinIharUle prakopako svAda cAkhekA bhae tinIharUle kuphra, zirka ra zaGkAmA parne thienan |

9 ke yI jhUTA Thahara garne bahudevavAdIharUsa~ga allAhako varadAnako khajAnA cha? allAha prabhutvazAlI hunuhuncha, uhA~mAthi kohI vijayI huna sakdaina, uhA~le jasalAI cAhanuhuncha ra je cAhanuhuncha pradAna garnuhuncha | allAhakA khajAnAharUmadhye IzdUtatva (nubUvvata) pani ho | uhA~ jasalAI cAhanuhuncha IzdUtatva pradAna garnuhuncha | yo tinIharUko adhikAra hoina ki jasalAI cAhun pradAna garun ra jasalAI cAhun vaJcita rAkhun |

10 ke tinIharU AkAzaharU, pRthvI ra yI duvaibIca rahekA vastuharUkA mAlika hun ki jasalAI cAhun pradAna garun ra jasalAI cAhun vaJcita rAkhun? yadi tinIharU yasto ThAnchan bhane tinIharUle AkAzasamma pugne bharyAGa athavA DorI tAnun ani tyahA~ caDhera kehI dine vA nadine Adeza deun | tinIharU yasako zakti rAkhdainan |
11 muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) lAI jhUTA Thahara garneharU parAjita bhaekA sainikaharU hun | jasarI vigatamA rasUlaharUlAI jhUTA Thahara garneharU parAjita bhaekA thie |

12 jhUTA Thahara garneharUmadhye yI pahilA hoinan | yasaaghi nUha (alaihissalAma) ko samudAya ra Adale pani jhUTA Thahara gare | phiraunale pani jhUTA Thahara gareko thiyo, jo mAnisaharUko zarIramA killA gADera pIDA dine garthyo |

13 samUda, lUta (alaihissalAma) ra zueba (alaihissalAma) kA samudayaharUle pani jhUThA Thahara garekA thie | yahI samudAyaharUle rasUlaharUlAI jhUThA Thahara garekA thie ra unIharUle lyAeko sandezalAI inkAra garekA thie |
14 yI samudAyaharUle rasUlaharUlAI jhUTA Thahara gare ani tinIharUmAthi allAhako prakopa avatarita bhayo, yadyapi tinIhalAI avasara diiyo |

15 muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) lAI jhUTA Thahara garneharU dosro paTaka sUramA phukine pratIkSA gardaichan | jahA~bATa pharkane kunai maukA hune chaina | jhUTo Thahara gareko avasthAmA marepachi tinIharUlAI yAtanA diinecha |
16 tinIharUle ThaTTA gardai bhaneH hAmIharUlAI hAmro bhAgyako yAtanA mahApralayabhandA pahile nai sAMsArika jIvanamA nai tatkAlai dinuhos |

17 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! yI jhUTA Thahara garneharUle bhaneko tapAIMlAI mana naparne kurAmA dhairya garnuhos | hAmro bhakta dAUda (alaihissalAma) lAI yAda garnuhos, jo AphnA zatruharUsa~ga laDna sakSama tathA zaktizAlI thie, aDiga bhaera allAhako AjJApAlana garthe, taubA garera allAhatarpha pharkane garthe ra allAhalAI khuzI pArnako lAgi satkarma garthe |
18 hAmIle pahADalAI unako adhinamA garidiekA thiyauM | jaba unI belukA ra bihAna allAhako pavitratAko guNagAna garthe taba unako sAthamA pahADale pani allAhako guNagAna garthyo |
19 hAmIle hAvAmA uDirahekA carAharUlAI pani unako adhinamA garidiyauM, jo AjJApAlana gardai unako sAthamA allAhako pavitratAko guNagAna garthe |

20 hAmIle unalAI zAna, zakti ra zatruharUmAthi vijaya pradAna garera unako sattA-zAsanalAI sudRDha pAryauM | hAmIle unalAI IzdUtatva, mAmilAharUko samajha, spaSTa kurA garne zakti, vaktavya kalA ra nirNaya zakti pradAna garyauM |
21 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! ke tapAIMlAI paraspara jhagaDA garne duI guTaharUko bAremA samAcAra prApta bhayo, jaba tinIharU dAUda (alaihissalAma) ko upAsanA-sthalamA caDhe |

22 tinIharU akasmAta unI samakSa puge | tinIharU akasmAta ra anucita tarikAle pasdA unI DarAe | jaba unI DarAeko kurA tinIharUle mahasusa gare taba bhaneH naDarAunuhos, hAmIharU duvai pratipakSI hauM, ekale arkomAthi atyAcAra gareko cha | hAmIharUbIca nisAphakA sAtha nirNaya garidinuhos, nirNaya gardA kasaimAthi jyAdatI nagarnuhos ra hAmIharUlAI ThIka mArga dekhAunuhos |

23 eka pakSale dAUda (alaihissalAma) lAI bhanyo− yo vyakti mero bhAi ho ra yosa~ga 99vaTA bheDIharU chan ra masa~ga euTA bheDI mAtra cha | mero bhAi tyasalAI pani mAgdaicha ra tarka vitarkamA malAI parAjita gareko cha |

24 dAUda (alaihissalAma) le nirNaya gardai dAbI garnelAI bhaneH timro bhAile timIsa~ga raheko euTA bheDI mAgera timImAthi jyAdatI gareko cha | dherai sAjhedAraharU arkAko haka mArera ra nisApha nagarera jyAdatI garne garchan | tara satkarmI mominaharU sAjhedAraharUsa~ga nisApha garchan ra jyAdatI gardainan | tara yastA mAnisaharUko saGkhyA kama cha | yasa jhagaDAdvArA hAmIle dAUda (alaihissalAma) lAI parIkSAmA hAlekAchauM bhanne kurAmA unalAI vizvAsa bhayo | ani unale allAhasita mAphI mAge, sajdAmA natamastaka bhae ra taubA (kSamayAcanA) gare |
25 hAmIle unako taubAlAI svIkAra garyauM ra unalAI mApha garyauM | unI hAmrA nikaTatama bhaktaharUmadhye thie | AkhiratamA pani unako lAgi rAmro vAsasthAna cha |

26 he dAUda (alaihissalAma)! hAmIle timIlAI dhartImA AdezaharU ra sAMsArika nirNaya lAgu garnako lAgi khalIphA (uttarAdhikArI) banAyauM | ataH mAnisaharUbIca nisAphakA sAtha nirNaya gara | mAnisaharUbIca nirNaya gardA icchAko anusaraNa nagara | nAtedArI, mitratA vA zatrutAle gardA pakSapAta nagara | icchAko anusaraNale timIlAI sIdhA mArgabATa pathabhraSTa pArnecha | nissandeha juna mAnisaharU sIdhA mArgabATa pathabhraSTa hunchan hisAbako dina tinIharUlAI yasa bhUlako kAraNale kaDA yAtanA bhognu parnecha | yadi tinIharUle yAda rAkhekA bhae ra DarAekA bhae tinIharUle icchAko anusaraNa garne thienan |

27 hAmIle AkAza ra pRthvIlAI binA uddezya sRSTi garekA chainauM | yasto soMcAi kAphiraharU rAkhchan | yasto socAi rAkhneharUmAthi dhikkAra cha | yadi tinIharU yasai kuphra ra allAhako bAremA galata soMcAimA marchan bhane tinIharU narkamA jAnechan |

28 hAmIle kunai hAlatamA allAhamAthi ImAna rAkhne, uhA~kA rasUlaharUko anusaraNa garne ra satkarma garne mominaharUlAI kuphra ra pApako sAthasAthai dhartImA phasAda maccAune phasAdI jasto banAune chainauM | hAmIle kunai pani hAlatamA AjJApAlana garne ra Izabhaya (takvA) rAkhneharUlAI kAphira (avajJAkArI) ra munAphika (kapaTI) jastA banAune chainauM | duvai khAlakA mAnisaharUlAI ekanAsa banAunu allAhako lAgi ucita chaina | baru allAhale Izabhaya rAkhne mominaharUlAI svargamA praveza garAera pratidAna dinuhunecha bhane abhAgI kAphiraharUlAI narkako yAtanA diera sajAya dinuhunecha | duvai khAlakA mAnisaharUmA ThUlo antara bhaekole duvaikA badalAmA pani ThUlo antara hunecha |
29 hAmIle dherai bhalAI ra phAidAjanaka kurAna tapAIMmAthi avataraNa garekAchauM, tAki mAnisaharUle tyasakA AyataharUmA cintana manana garun ra buddhimAnaharUle tyasabATa pATha sikun |

30 hAmIle dAUda (alaihissalAma) mAthi kRpA gardai choro sulaimAna (alaihissalAma) pradAna garyauM, tAki unako A~khAlAI zitalatA prApta hos | sulaimAna (alaihissalAma) kati rAmrA bhakta thie, sadhaiM taubA garne ra allAhatarpha pharkane bhakta |

31 yAda garnuhos, jaba unI samakSa asrako salAha (namAja) ko samayamA asalI, teja dagurne ra tInavaTA khuTTAmA ubhine ra cautho khuTTA uThAera rAkhne ghoDAharU prastuta garie | tI ghoDAharUko pradarzana herdA herdai sUrya asta bhayo |

32 sulaimAna (alaihissalAma) le bhaneH maile allAhako smaraNamAthi sAMsArika dhana-sampatti, jasamadhye yI ghoDAharU pani hun, lAI prAthamikatA dieko chu | yahA~samma ki sUrya asta bhayo ra asrako salAha (namAja) ko samaya bityo |
33 unale tI ghoDAharUlAI phirtA lyAune Adeza die | ghoDAharU phirtA Aepachi unale taravArale tyasako pi~DulA ra gardhana kATna thAle |

34 hAmIle sulaimAna (alaihissalAma) ko parIkSA liyauM ra mAnavako rUpamA zaitAnalAI kehI dinako lAgi unako rAja siMhAsanamA baiThAyauM, jasale kehI dina rAja kAja calAyo | pheri hAmIle sulaimAna (alaihissalAma) lAI unako sattA ra rAja siMhAsana phirtA diyauM ra zaitAnaharUmAthi niyantraNa pradAna garyauM |

35 sulaimAna (alaihissalAma) le bhaneH he mero pAlanakartA! merA pApaharUlAI mApha garnuhos, malAI yasto sattA-zAsana pradAna garnuhos ki mero jasto sattA-zAsana ma pazcAta anya kasailAI pradAna nagarnuhos | nissandeha tapAIM anagintI pradAna garne mahAna dAtA hunuhuncha |
36 hAmIle unako prArthanAlAI svIkAra garyauM ra vAyumAthi unalAI niyantraNa pradAna garyauM, jo unako Adezale namra hune garthyo ra teja gatimA unako icchA anusAra liera hi~Dne garthyo |
37 hAmIle zaitAnaharUlAI unako niyantraNamA diyauM, jo unako Adeza anusAra kAma garthe | tinIharUmadhye kehI nirmANako kAma garne mistrI thie ra kehI samudramA DubkI lagAera motI nikAlne garthe |
38 uddaNDa zaitAnaharU pani unako adhinamA diiekA thie | tinIharU jakaDera rAkhiekA thie, jasale gardA hallina pani sakdainathe |

39 he sulaimAna! yo hAmro varadAna ho, jo timIle gareko prArthanAlAI svIkAra garera hAmIle pradAna garekAchauM | timIle jasalAI dina cAhanchau deU ra jasalAI vaJcita rAkhna cAhanchau vaJcita rAkha | yasa bAremA timro sodhapUcha hu~daina |
40 nissandeha sulaimAna (alaihissalAma) hAmrA nikaTatama bhaktaharUmadhye thie | unako vAsasthAna svarga ho |
41 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! hAmrA bhakta ayyUba (alaihissalAma) lAI yAda garnuhos, jaba unale allAhasa~ga prArthanA gardai pukAreH malAI zaitAnale kaSTa puryAeko cha |
42 hAmIle Adeza diyauH khuTTAle jaminamA hirkAU | unale khuTTAle jaminamA hirkAu~dA pAnIko mUla phuTyo, ani unale tyasabATa piuna thAle ra nuhAuna thAle | ani unakA sabai kaSTako nivAraNa bhayo |

43 pheri hAmIle unako prArthanAlAI svIkAra garyauM ra unako kaSTalAI nivAraNa garyauM | hAmIle kRpA gardai ra dhairyako badalA diMdai unalAI parivAra, santAna ra nAtI pradAna garyauM ra tyasamA thapera diyauM | tAki dhairya garneharUle pATha leun ki dhairyako badalA vRddhi ra baDhottarI ho |

44 ayyUba (alaihissalAma) le risamA AphnI patnIlAI 100 korrA hirkAune kasama khAe | hAmIle bhanyauH he ayyUba! timI Aphno kasama pUrA garnako lAgi narama DAlIharUko gucchA (jhADU) le patnIlAI hirkAU | Aphno kasama natoDa | ani unale masinA ra narama DAlIharUko gucchAle AphnI patnIlAI hirkAe | hAmIle unalAI parIkSAmA dhairyavAna pAyauM | unI ati rAmro bhakta thie | allAhasita dherai taubA garne bhakta thie |

45 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! yAda garnuhos, hAmIle cayana garekA bhaktaharUlAI ra hAmIle paThAekA rasUlaharUH ibrAhIma, isahAka ra yAkUba (alaihimussalAma) lAI | unIharU allAhako AjJApAlana ra uhA~ko khuzI prApta garnamA zaktizAlI thie ra satyamA vivekazIla thie |
46 Akhiratako smaraNabATa unIharUko hRdayaharUlAI AbAda garera, satkarmabATa tayAra pArera ra mAnisaharUlAI satkarmako AhvAna garera hAmIle unIharUlAI viziSTa pArera unIharUmAthi upakAra garyauM |
47 unIharUlAI hAmIle Aphno AjJApAlana, bhakti ra sandezalAI mAnisaharUsamma puryAunako lAgi cayana garekA thiyauM |

48 he nabI (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! ibrAhIma (alaihissalAma) ko putra ismAIla (alaihissalAma) ra yasaa tathA jula-kiphla (alaihimassalAma) lAI yAda garnuhos ra prazaMsA garnuhos | unIharU prazaMsAkA pAtra chan ra allAhako tarphabATa cayana gariekA chan |
49 yo ho unIharUko prazaMsA kurAnamA | yastA Izabhaya rAkhneharUkA lAgi Akhiratako rAmro ghara cha jo allAhako Adezako pAlanA garchan ra uhA~le manAhI gareko kAryabATa bacne garchan |
50 Akhiratako rAmro ghara ho- sadhaiM rahane bagaiMcAharU, jasamA unIharU mahApralayako dina praveza garnechan | svargakA DhokAharU unIharUko svAgatako lAgi khullA rahanechan |
51 unIharU sajiekA palaGgamA aDesa lAgera basekA hunechan ra nokaraharUlAI vibhinna prakArakA phalaphUla ra peya padArtha lyAune Adeza dirahekA hunechan |
52 unIharUkA lAgi yastA patnIharU hunechan, jasakA najara AphnA patiharUtarpha mAtra hunechan, unIharU bAheka anya kasailAI hernechainan ra unIharU samAna umerakA hunechan |
53 he Izabhaya rAkhneharU ho! yo ho timIharUle sAMsArika jIvanamA garekA satkarmaharUko rAmro badalA, juna timIharUlAI mahApralayako dina pratiphalako rUpamA diine vAcA garieko thiyo |
54 varNana garieko badalA hAmIle pradAna gareko jIvikA ho, jo hAmIle Izabhaya rAkhneharUlAI mahApralayako dina dinechauM | yo kahile samApta nahune tathA nirantara calirahane jIvikA ho |

55 uparyukta badalA Izabhaya rAkhneharUkA lAgi ho, jabaki yasako viparIta kuphra ra pApa garera sImA ullaGghana garekA mAnisaharUko badalA pharaka cha, tinIharUkA lAgi ati narAmro vAsasthAna hunecha jasamA tinIharU mahApralayako dina jAnechan |
56 yo narka, jasale tinIharUlAI Aphno gherAmA linecha | narkako AgobATa tinIharU polinechan | tinIharUkA lAgi Ago kai ati narAmro bichyaunA hunecha |
57 tinIharUlAI umliraheko pAnI ra ghAubATa niskane pIpa piunako lAgi diinecha, jasabATa tinIharUkA tirkhA meTine chaina |
58 AkhiratamA tinIharUlAI yI jastai anya dherai prakArakA yAtanAharU diinecha |

59 narkamA gaepachi tinIharUbIca jhai-jhagaDA suru hunecha | tinIharUle eka arkAsita kunai sarokAra naraheko dAbI garnechan | tinIharUmadhye kehIle bhannechan: narkamA jAne yo giroha timIharUsa~gai narkamA gaekA chan | tinIharUle javApha dinechan: tinIharUkA lAgi svAgata chaina | tinIharUle pani hAmIharU jastai narkako yAtanA bhognechan |

60 anuyAyIharUle AphnA aguvAharUlAI bhannechan: he aguvAharU ho! baru timIharUko svAgata yahA~ chaina | kinabhane timIharUko bahakAumA Aeko kAraNale hAmIharU narkako yAtanA bhogdaichauM | tI sabaikA lAgi narkako Ago kati narAmro vAsasthAna ho |
61 aguvAharUkA anuyAyIharUle bhannechan: he hAmrA pAlanakartA! mArgadarzana Aisakepachi pani jasale hAmIharUlAI pathabhraSTa pArekA hun tinIharUlAI narkako duIgunA yAtanA dinuhos |
62 ghamaNDIharUle bhannechan: hAmI kina tI mAnisaharUlAI narkamA dekhi rahekA chainauM, jasalAI hAmIle saMsAramA abhAgI ra yAtanAko hakadAra ThAndathyauM |

63 ke hAmIharU unIharUko ThaTTA garera galatI garekA thiyauM ki tinIharU yAtanAko hakadAra hoinan, vA hAmIharUle ThaTTA garera ThIka garekA thiyauM ki tinIharU narkamA chan tara hAmIharU tinIharUlAI dekhirahekA chainauM?!
64 mahApralayako dina narka bAsIharU sA~ccikai ApasamA jhagaDA garnechan, jasako varNana hAmIle garekAchauM |

65 he muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! kAphiraharUlAI bhanidinuhos: ma timIharUlAI tyasa yAtanAbATa sAvadhAna garnako lAgi Aekochu jo timIharUlAI kuphra (avajJA) ko kAraNale samAtnecha | allAha bAheka kohI pani upAsanAko yogya chaina | uhA~ Aphno mahAnatA, guNaharU ra nAmaharUmA advitIya hunuhuncha, uhA~ jasto kohI pani chaina | uhA~ prabhutvazAlI hunuhuncha, uhA~le nai sabai vastuharUlAI Aphano niyantraNamA linubhaeko cha |

66 allAha nai AkAzaharU, pRthvI ra yI duvaibIca rahekA vastuharUkA pAlanakartA hunuhuncha | uhA~ Aphno zAsana-sattAmA prabhutvazAlI hunuhuncha, kohI pani uhA~mAthi vijayI huna sakdaina | uhA~ ati kSamAzIla hunuhuncha, taubA (kSamAyAcanA) garne bhaktaharUlAI mApha garnuhuncha |
67 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! yI jhUTA Thahara garneharUlAI bhanidinuhos: nissandeha kurAna mahattvapUrNa sUcanA bhaeko kitAba ho |
68 tara timIharU yasa mahAna sUcanAbATa vimukha hunchau ra tyasatarpha dhyAna diMdainau |

69 yadi allAhale ma tarpha vahI (prakAzanA) napaThAeko bhae ra malAI nasikAeko bhae; Adamako sRSTiko sambandhamA phariztAharUbIca juna kurA caliraheko thiyo tyasako bAremA malAI jAnakArI hune thiena |
70 allAhale nai ma tarpha vahI paThAunuhuncha, kinabhane ma timIharUlAI allAhako yAtanAbATa spaSTarUpamA sAvadhAna garchu |
71 yAda garnuhos, jaba allAhale phariztAharUlAI bhannubhayoH ma mATobATa ekajanA mAnava Adama (alaihissalAma) lAI sRSTi garnechu |
72 jaba ma pUrNarUpamA Adama (alaihissalAma) lAI sRSTi garnechu, unako rUparekhA ThIka pArnechu ra unIbhitra AtmA phuknechu taba timIharUle unalAI sajdA (daNDavat) garnu |
73 phariztAharUle allAhako yasa Adezako pAlanA gare ra sabaile unalAI sammAnako lAgi daNDavAt (sajdA) gare |
74 tara iblIsale ghamaNDale gardA unalAI sajdA garena | ghamaNDale gardA allAhako Adezako ullaGghana garera U kAphira (avajJAkArI) banyo |

75 allAhale bhannubhayoH he iblIsa! timIle kuna kAraNale Adama (alaihissalAma) lAI daNDavat (sajdA) garenauM, jasalAI maile Aphno hAtale sRSTi gareM?! ke timIle ghamaNDale gardA sajdA garenauM, ke timI pahilA dekhi nai mero agADi ghamaNDI thiyau?!

76 iblIsale javApha diyoH ma Adama (alaihissalAma) bhandA zreSTha chu | tapAIMle malAI AgobATa sRSTi garnubhayo ra unalAI mATobATa sRSTi garnubhayo | usako vicAramA Ago mATobhandA zreSTha tatva thiyo |
77 allAhale iblIsalAI bhannubhayoH timI svargabATa niska | timImAthi dhikkAra cha |
78 timIlAI pratiphala diine dina arthAta mahApralayako dinasammako lAgi jannatabATa niSkAsana garincha |
79 iblIsale bhanyoH tapAIMle AphnA bhaktaharUlAI punaH jIvita pArera uThAune dinasamma malAI avasara dinuhos, mRtyu nadinuhos |
80 allAhale bhannubhayoH timIlAI avasara diincha |
81 timIlAI euTA nizcita dinasamma avasara diincha juna dina timro sarvanAza garinecha |
82 iblIsale bhanyoH tapAIMko prabhutvako kasama! maile AdamakA sabai santAnaharUlAI pathabhraSTa pArnechu |
83 mAtra tI mAnisaharUlAI pathabhraSTa pArna sakdina jasalAI tapAIMle surakSita rAkhnuhanecha ra mAtra Aphno bhaktiko lAgi viziSTa pArnuhunecha |
84 allAhale bhannubhayoH ma Aphno tarphabATa satya kurA mAtra bhanchu, satya bAheka kehI bhandina |
85 mahApralayako dina timI ra timro anusaraNa garne sabai avajJAkArIharUdvArA ma avazya nai narkalAI bharnechu |

86 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! yI bahudevavAdIharUlAI bhanidinuhos: mele je jati upadeza timIharUlAI diiraheko chu, tyasako kunai badalA timIharUsita mAgdina ra malAI juna kurAko jimmedArI diieko cha, tyasabhandA baDhI pani batAu~dina |
87 kurAna mAnava ra jinna lagAyata sampUrNa saMsArakA lAgi upadeza ho |
88 kurAnale dieko sUcanA satya ho bhanne kurA cA~Dai nai mRtyuko samayamA timIharUle avazya nai jAnnechau |

1 kurAnalAI allAhale avatarita garnubhayo | uhA~ prabhutvazAlI hunuhuncha kohI pani uhA~mAthi vijayI huna sakdaina | uhA~ sRSTi garna, bhAgya nirdhAraNa garna ra kArya saJcAlana garnamA tatvadarzI hunuhuncha | uhA~ bAheka anya kasaile yasalAI avataraNa gareko hoina |

2 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! hAmIle tapAIMmAthi yo kurAna avataraNa garekAchauM jo satyamA AdhArita cha | yasamA rahekA sabai sUcanA ra AdezaharU satya hun | mAtra eka allAhako bhakti gara ra uhA~sa~ga anya kasailAI sAjhedAra nabanAU |

3 jAnirAkha! allAhakai lAgi zirkabATa svaccha ra pavitra dharma ho | jasale allAhalAI choDera mUrtiharU ra tAgUta (anya asatya pUjya) harUlAI mitra banAera pUjA garne mAnisaharUle tarka dinchan: hAmIharU yasa kAraNale yinIharUko pUjA garchauM ki yinIharUle hAmIharUlAI allAhasa~ga najika pArun, hAmrA AvazyaktAharUlAI uhA~samakSa rAkhun ra uhA~samakSa hAmro siphArisa garun | eka allAhako bhaktiko bAremA yinIharU juna vibheda garchan tyasako bAremA allAhale yI bahudevavAdIharU ra asala mominaharUbIca avazya nai mahApralayako dina nirNaya garnuhunecha | allAha jhUTo Thahara garne, zirka garne ra uhA~kA varadAnaharUprati kRtaghna garneharUlAI sIdhA mArga dekhAunuhunna |

4 yadi allAhale kasailAI Aphno putra banAuna cAhemA AphnA prANIharUmadhye kasailAI pani putra banAuna saknu hunthyo | tara bahudevavAdIharUle bhaneko yasto kurAbATa allAha pavitra hunuhuncha | allAha Aphno astitva, guNa ra kAryaharUmA ekamAtra hunuhuncha, yI kurAharUmA kasaiko sAjhedArI chaina | uhA~ sabai sRSTiharUmAthi prabhutvazAlI hunuhuncha |

5 allAhale nai AkAzaharU ra pRthvIlAI ati vivekakA sAtha sRSTi garnubhayo | uhA~le yI vastuharUlAI binA uddezya sRSTi garnubhaena, jasto ki atyAcArIharU bhanchan | uhA~le rAtalAI dinamA ra dinalAI rAtamA praveza garAunuhuncha, euTA Aepachi arko samApta huncha | uhA~le sUrya ra candramAlAI Aphno adhInamA rAkhnubhayo | yI duvai Aphno nizcita ra antima samayasamma gatizIla rahanechan | jAnirAkha, allAha prabhutvazAlI hunuhuncha jasale AphnA zatruharUsa~ga badalA linuhunecha | uhA~mAthi kohI pani vijayI huna sakdaina | uhA~le AphnA pApaharUbATa taubA garne bhaktaharUlAI mApha garnuhuncha |

6 he mAnava! allAhale timIharUko sRSTi Adama (alaihissalAma) bATa garnubhayo | Adama (alaihissalAma) lAI sRSTi garepachi unIbATai unakI patnI havvA (alaihassalAma) lAI sRSTi garnubhayo | uhA~le nai timIharUkA lAgi U~Ta, gAI, bheDI, bAkhrIkA AThavaTA joDI sRSTi garnubhayo | pratyekakA bhAle ra pothI banAunubhayo | allAhale timIharUko sRSTi vibhinna caraNaharUmA ra AmAharUkA garbhaharUmA tInavaTA andhakAraharUmA garnubhayo, euTA peTa, dosro garbha ra tesro jhillIkA andhakAraharU | yI sabaiko sRSTi mAtra timIharUko sRSTikartA allAhale garnubhayo, uhA~ samrATa hunuhuncha, uhA~ bAheka kohI pani bhakti-yogya chaina | ani timIharU kina allAhako bhakti tyAgera yastA vastuharUko bhakti garchau jasale kehI pani sRSTi gareko chaina baru sRSTi gariekA chan?!

7 he mAnava! yadi timIharUle AphnA pAlAkartAlAI inkAra garchau bhane allAhalAI timIharUko ImAnako AvazyaktA chaina | timIharUko kuphrale uhA~lAI kunai hAni puryAu~daina | timIharUko kuphrale timIharUlAI nai hAni puryAunecha | bhaktaharUle allAhalAI inkAra garuna bhanne kurA uhA~le mana parAunuhunna, uhA~ tinIharUlAI kuphra garne Adeza dinuhunna, kinabhane uhA~ azlIla ra narAmro karma garne Adeza dinuhunna | yadi timIharU allAhakA varadAnaharUprati AbhAra vyakta garchau ra uhA~mAthi ImAna lyAu~chau bhane uhA~le timIharUko AbhArabATa khuzI hunuhuncha ra tyasako pratidAna dinuhuncha | kunai pani vyaktile arko vyaktiko pApako bhAra bokne chaina | baru pratyeka vyaktile AphUle gareko kAryako AphaiM jimmevAra huncha | pheri timIharU sabai mahApralayako dina allAhatarpha nai pharkAinechau, ani timIharUle saMsAramA garekA kAryaharUbAre uhA~le sUcita garnuhunecha ra timIharUle garekA kAryaharUko badalA dinuhunecha | uhA~ bhaktaharUkA hRdayaharUmA rahekA kurAharUlAI jAnnuhuncha, uhA~bATa kehI pani lukeko chaina |

8 jaba kAphiralAI kunai roga lAgcha vA dhana-sampatti Dubne Dara huncha taba mAtra allAhalAI pukArcha ra tyasako nivAraNako lAgi prArthanA garcha | jaba allAhale tyasako nivAraNa garera kRpA garnuhuncha taba allAhalAI pukArna choDcha | allAhalAI choDera arUlAI pukArna thAlcha tAki mAnisaharUlAI uhA~samma pugne mArgabATa pherna sakun | he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! yastA mAnisaharUlAI bhannuhos: timIharU thorai dinako lAgi bA~cunajelasamma kuphra gara | timIharU mahApralayako dina narkamA jAnechau | jasarI eka mitra arko mitrasa~ga TAsincha tyasarI nai timI narkasa~ga TAsinechau |

9 ke rAtamA Aphno pAlanakartA allAhalAI sajdA garera ra kayAma garera upAsanA bitAune, Akhiratako yAtanAbATa DarAune ra allAhako kRpAko AzA rAkhne allAhako AjJAkArI vyakti rAmro cha vA kAphira rAmro cha jo kaThinAImA allAhalAI pukArcha, sukhamA allAhalAI inkAra garcha ra allAhakA lAgi sAjhedAraharU banAu~cha?! he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! ke allAhalAI jAnne ra uhA~le anivArya garnubhaeko kArya garne mAnisaharU rAmrA chan vA najAnne mAnisaharU rAmrA chan?! duvai kisimakA jamAtabIca raheko pharakalAI buddhimAnaharU jAndachan |

10 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! mominaharUlAI bhanidinuhos: allAhakA AdezaharUko pAlanA garera ra uhA~le manAhI garnubhaekA kAryaharUlAI tyAgera uhA~sita Dara | juna mAnisaharUle saMsAramA satkarma garnechan unIharU lokamA pani sahayoga, svAsthya, dhana-sampatti pAera rAmro jIvana pAunechan ra paralokamA pani svarga pAera rAmro jIvana pAunechan | allAhako dhartI dherai pharAkilo cha tyasamA hijrata (basAi~-sarAI) gara, yahA~samma ki timIharU rAmro sthAna pAuna saka jahA~ timIharUlAI allAhako bhaktibATa kohI pani rokna nasakos | dhairyavAnaharUlAI mahApralayako dina anaganti ra vibhinna prakArakA pratidAna diinecha |
11 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! bhanidinuhos: malAI allAhale ke Adeza dinubhaeko cha bhane ma uhA~kai lAgi bhaktilAI viziSTa pAru~, uhA~ bAheka anya kasaiko bhakti nagaru~ |
12 malAI yo Adeza pani mileko cha ki yasa samudAyabATa sarvaprathama ma nai uhA~samakSa samarpita hou~ ra AjJApAlana garu~ |
13 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! bhanidinuhos: yadi ma allAhako avajJA garchu bhane malAI mahApralayako dina uhA~ko yAtanAbATa Dara lAgcha |
14 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! bhanidinuhos: ma bhaktilAI uhA~kai lAgi viziSTa pArchu | uhA~ko bhaktimA kasailAI sAjhedAra banAu~dina |

15 he bahudevavAdIharU ho! timIharU juna mUrtiko pUjA garna cAhanchau gara | (yo Adeza dhamakIko lAgi diieko cha |) he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! bhanidinuhos: vAstavika ghATA khAneharU tI mAnisaharU hun, jasale AphUlAI ra AphnA parivAralAI ghATAmA pAre | tinIharU chinna bhinna hunechan, eka arkAsa~ga bhe~Tane chainan | jAnirAkha, yo vAstavika ghATA ho jasamA kunai sandeha chaina |

16 tinIharUko mAthi ra muni duvaitirabATa dhuvA~, Ago ra tAto hunecha | yasa yAtanAbATa allAhale AphnA bhaktaharUlAI DarAunuhuncha | he merA bhaktaharU ho! merA AdezaharUko pAlanA garera ra maile manAhI garekA kurAharUbATa jogiera masita DarAU |

allAhale aparAdhIharUko varNanapachi satkarmI bhaktaharUko varNana gardai bhannubhaeko chaH
17 allAha bAheka anya sabai pUjyaharU tathA mUrtiharUko pUjAbATa jogiera ra taubA garera allAhatarpha pharkane mAnisaharUkA lAgi mRtyu hu~dA, cihAnamA ra mahApralayako dina svargako zubhasUcanA cha | he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! merA bhaktaharUlAI yasa kurAko zubhasUcanA dinuhos |
18 juna mAnisaharU kurAlAI sunchan, rAmro narAmrobIca pharaka chuTyAu~chan ra phAidAjanaka rAmro kurAko pAlanA garchan unIharU nai mArgadarzanamA chan ra unIharU nai buddhimAna hun |

19 juna mAnisaharUmAthi tinIharUko lagAtAra kuphra ra pathabhraSTatAko kAraNale yAtanAko nirNaya lAgu bhayo, he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! tapAIMle juna sukai upAya garepani tinIharUlAI mArdarzana milne chaina | he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! ke tapAIM yastA khAle mAnisaharUlAI narkabATa mukti dina sakanuhuncha ra?!

20 tara juna mAnisaharUle allAhakA AdezaharUko pAlanA garera ra uhA~le manAhI garnubhaekA kAryaharUlAI tyAgera uhA~sita DarAe unIharUkA lAgi dherai tallA bhaekA svargakA ucca mahalaharU hunechan, jasako tala naharaharU bagirahekA hunechan | allAhako tarphabATa yasako vAcA cha ra uhA~le kahilyai pani vacana bhaGga garnuhunna |

21 timIharUle dekhera jAneko kurA ho ki nissandeha allAhale AkAzabATa pAnI barsAunubhayo, ani tyasalAI mUlaharU ra kholA nAlAmA hAlnubhayo pheri tyasa pAnIbATa nAnA prakArakA bAlInAlI umArnubhayo | pheri tyo sukyo ra sukepachi hariyo raGgabATa pahelo bhayo | sukepachi tyasalAI TukrA-TukrA pAriyo | jIvita hRdaya bhaekAharUkA lAgi tyasamA upadeza cha |

22 ke yasto vyakti jasako hRdayalAI allAhale islAmako lAgi kholnubhaeko cha ra U mArgadarzana ra allAhako tarphabATa prakAzamA cha; tyasa vyakti jasto hunasakcha jasako hRdaya allAhako smaraNaprati kaThora bhaeko cha?! yI duI prakArakA mAnisaharU kahilyai ekasamAna huna sakdainan | mArgadarzana pAekA mAnisaharUkA lAgi saphalatA cha bhane allAhako smaraNabATa khAlI mAnisaharUkA lAgi ghATA cha, kinabhane yastA mAnisaharU spaSTa pathabhraSTatAmA chan |

23 allAhale Aphno rasUla muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) mAthi uttama vANI kurAna avataraNa garnubhayo | yasakA AyataharU satyatA ra sundaratAmA mildA juldA chan | tyasamA virodhAbhASa chaina | yasa kitAbamA vibhinna kisimakA kathA, Adeza, vAcA, dhamkI, satyavAdI ra asatyavAdIharUkA guNaharU ityAdi chan | yasamA rahekA dhamkI sunera allAhasita DarAuneharUkA AGa jiriGga huna thAlcha | tyasamA rahekA AzA ra zubhasUcanAharU sunepachi tinIharUkA chAlA ra hRdaya namra huna pugchan | kurAnako yo prabhAva allAhako tarphabATa mArgadarzana ho | uhA~le jasalAI cAhanuhuncha mArgadarzana garnuhuncha | jasalAI allAha apamAnita garna cAhanuhuncha ra mArgadarzana garnuhunna usalAI kohI pani mArgadarzana garna sakdaina |

24 ke lokamA allAhako tarphabATa mArgadarzana pAekA ra paralokamA svargamA jAne mAnisaharU ra marunjela kuphramA lipta rahane ra paralokamA duvai hAta khuTTA bA~dhera anuhArako bala narkamA phyA~kine mAnisaharU ekasamAna hunasakchan?! kuphra ra avajJA garera AphUmAthi atyAcAra garekA mAnisaharUko nindA gardai bhaninechaH cAkha narkako yAtanAko svAda | yo ho timIharUko sajAya |

25 yI bahudevavAdIharUbhandA aghi pani dherai samudAyaharUle pani jhUTA Thahara gare | tinIharUmAthi yati akasmAta allAhako prakopa Ayo ki tinIharUle mahasusa garenan ra taubA garne avasara pani pAenan |
26 tyasa prakopabATa allAhale lokamA apamAnita ra beijjatako svAda cakhAunubhayo | tyasabhandA bhayAvaha paralokako yAtanA tinIharUko parkhAimA cha, yadi yo kurA tinIharUlAI thAhA cha bhane |

27 muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) mAthi avatarita kurAnamA hAmIle bhalAi tathA duSTatA, satya tathA asatya ra ImAna tathA kuphra ityAdikA dherai udAharaNaharU varNana garekAchauM | AzA cha tinIharUle upadeza grahaNa garun, satya anusAra karma garun ra asatyalAI tyAgun |

28 hAmIle kurAnalAI arabI bhASAmA avataraNa garyauM, yasamA kunai TeDhopana ra zaGkA chaina | yasa AzAkA sAtha ki tinIharUle allAhakA AdezaharUko pAlanA garera ra uhA~le manAhI garnubhaekA kAryaharUlAI tyAgera uhA~sita DarAun |

29 allAhale bahudevavAdIko udAharaNa tyasto vyaktisa~ga tulanA gardai dinuhuncha jo paraspara virodhI mAlikaharUko sAjhA nokara ho | usale mAlikaharUmadhye kehIlAI khuzI pArcha bhane anya kehIlAI ruSTa pArcha | ani U sadhaiM hairAna ra saGkaTamA huncha | tyasaigarI allAha ekezvaravAdI bhaktako udAharaNa yasto vyaktisa~ga tulanA gardai dinuhuncha jo mAtra ekajanA mAlikako adhinamA huncha jasako cAhanAko bAremA usalAI thAhA huncha | ani U nizcinta ra sukhI jIvana bitAu~cha | yI duI kisimakA bhaktaharU ekasamAna huna sakdainan | sabai prazaMsAharU allAhakA lAgi mAtra hun | baru adhikAMza mAnisaharU jAndainan | tyasaile anyalAI allAhako sAjhedAra banAu~chan |
30 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! eka dina tapAIMko pani nidhana hunecha ra yinIharUko pani nidhana hunecha |
31 tyasapachi he mAnava! timIharU mahApralayako dina allAha najika vivAdita kurAmA paraspara jhagaDA garnechau | ani satyavAdI ra asatyavAdIbIca pharaka spaSTa hunecha |

32 allAhako kohI sAjhedAra cha vA patnI vA santAna chan bhanne vyakti sabaibhandA ThUlo atyAcArI ho | yo allAhako lAgi ucita chaina | rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) le lyAunubhaeko vahI (prakAzanA) lAI jhUTA Thahara garne vyakti pani sabai bhandA ThUlo atyAcArI ho | allAha ra uhA~ko vahI (IzavANI) lAI inkAra garneharUko vAsasthAna narka hoina ra?! avazya nai tinIharUko bAsa­sthAna narka ho |

allAhale jhUTA ra jhUTo Thahara garneharUko varNana garepachi satyavAdI ra satyako puSTi garneharUko varNana gardai bhannubhaeko chaH
33 yastA sandeSTAharU ra anya mAnisaharU nai vAstavika rUpamA Izabhaya rAkhneharU hun jo satya bolchana, satkarma garchan, ImAna lyAu~chan, ImAnako marma anusAra kArya garchan, allAhako Adezako pAlanA garchan ra manAhI garieko kAryalAI tyAgchan |
34 unIharUle Aphno pAlanakartA allAhako pAsamA sadhaiMko lAgi bA~kI rahirahane manapardA sabai AnandadAyaka cIjaharU pAunechan | yo allAhasa~ga ra uhA~kA bhaktaharUsa~ga rAmro vyavahArako badalA ho |
35 tAki unIharUle saMsAramA garekA pApaharUlAI unIharUle taubA gareko kAraNale allAhale mApha garun ra unIharUle garekA satkarmako badalA deun |

36 ke allAha Aphno bhakta muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) ko lAgi uhA~ko dhArmika, sAMsArika ra surakSA dine mAmilAmA paryApta hunuhunna?! nissandeha allAha uhA~ko lAgi paryApta hunuhuncha | he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! mUrtiharUle tapAIMlAI kaSTa puryAunechan bhanne kurAbATa kAphiraharU Aphno ajJAnatAle gardA tapAIMlAI DarAu~chan | allAha mArgadarzana pradAna nagarera jasalAI apamAna garna cAhanuhuncha usalAI kohI pani mArgadarzana garna sakdaina |

37 allAhale jasalAI mArgadarzana garna cAhanuhuncha usalAI kohI pani pathabhraSTa pArna sakdaina | ke allAha yasto prabhutvazAlI ra badalA linevAlA hunuhunna, jasamAthi kohI pani vijayI huna nasakos?! uhA~ avazya nai prabhutvazAlI ra badalA linevAlA hunuhuncha |

38 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! yadi tapAIMle yI bahudevavAdIharUlAI sodhnuhunchaH AkAzaharU ra pRthvIlAI kasale sRSTi garyo? tinIharUle avazya bhannechan: allAhale sRSTi garnubhayo | tinIharUkA pUjyaharUko vivazatAlAI spaSTa pArdai sodhnuhos: timIharUle pUjdai garekA mUrtiharUko bAremA batAU | yadi allAhale malAI kunai kaSTa diemA ke timIharUkA mUrtiharUle tyasalAI nivAraNa garna sakchan?! yadi allAhale mamathi kunai kRpA garna cAhanubhaemA ke timIharUkA mUrtiharUle tyasalAI rokna sakcha?! tinIharUlAI bhanidinuhos: mero lAgi allAha nai paryApta hunuhuncha | ma AphnA sabai mAmilAmA uhA~mAthi nai bharosA garchu | bharosA garneharUle uhA~mAthi mAtra bharosA garnuparcha |

39 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! bhanidinuhos: he merA samudAya! timIharUle mana parAeko zirka gara, ma allAhako Adezako pAlanA gardai eka allAhako bhaktiko AhvAna ra mAtra uhA~ kai bhakti garirAkhnechu, timIharUle pratyeka samUhako pariNAma cA~Dai nai jAnnechau |
40 kasamAthi lokamA apamAnita garne prakopa Aunecha ra paralokamA sadhaiM rahane yAtanA hunecha bhanne kurA pani timIharUle cA~Dai nai jAnnechau |

41 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! hAmIle tapAIMmAthi satyakA sAtha kurAna avataraNa garekAchauM, tAki tapAIMle mAnisaharUlAI sAvadhAna garAunuhos | jasale yasabATa mArgadarzana prApta garcha tyasako lAbha usailAI prApta huncha | allAhalAI tyasako AvazyaktA chaina | jo pathabhraSTa huncha tyasako hAni usailAI pugcha, allAhalAI tyasako hAni pugne chaina | tapAIM tinIharUmAthi nirIkSaka hunuhunna ki tinIharUlAI mArgadarzana grahaNa garna vivaza pArnuhos | tapAIMko jimmevArI sandeza puryAunu mAtra ho |

42 AtmAharUko antima samaya Aepachi allAhale nai tyasalAI niyantraNamA linuhuncha ra samAtnuhuncha | uhA~le nindramA rahekA tI AtmAharUlAI pani Aphno niyantraNamA linuhuncha jasako antima samaya Aeko hu~daina, ani tyasalAI euTA nizcita samayako lAgi phirtA dinuhuncha jasako jJAna uhA~lAI mAtra cha | AtmAharU niyantraNamA line, choDne, mRtyu dine ra jIvana dine kAryaharUmA buddhimAnaharUkA lAgi yasa kurAko pramANa cha ki juna allAha yI sabai garne zakti rAkhnuhuncha uhA~ mAnisaharUlAI hisAba ra badalAko lAgi punaH jIvita pArne zakti pani rAkhnuhuncha |

43 bahudevavAdIharUle allAhalAI choDera mUrtiharUlAI siphArisakartA banAe, yasa AzAkA sAtha ki tinIharUle phAidA puryAunechan | he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! tinIharUlAI bhannuhos: ke timIharU mUrtiharUlAI siphArisakartA banAekA chau jabaki tinIharUle na timIrUkA lAgi kehI garne zakti rAkhchan na svayamakA lAgi, tinIharUmA soca vicAra garne kSamatA pani chaina? yinIharU nirjIva bhaekole lATA, bahirA ra andhA hun, na kunai phAidA puryAuna sakchan na hAni nai!

44 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! yI bahudevavAdIharUlAI bhannuhos: siphArisako adhikAra allAhalAI mAtra cha | uhA~ko anumati binA kohI pani kasaiko lAgi siphArisa garna sakdaina | AkAzaharU ra pRthvIko sattA zAsana pani uhA~kai hAtamA mAtra cha | mahApralayako dina hisAba ra badalAko lAgi timIharUlAI allAhatarpha nai pharkAera laginecha | uhA~le timIharUlAI timIharUkA karmaharUko badalA dinuhunecha |

45 jaba allAhako mAtra smaraNa garincha ta AkhiratamAthi ImAna narAkhne bahudevavAdIharUkA hRdaya ghRNAle saMkIrNa hunchan | tara jaba tinIharU samakSa tinakA pUjya mUrtiharUko varNana garincha taba tinIharU khusI hunchan |

46 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! bhanidinuhos: he allAha! he binA kunai aghillo udAharaNa AkAzaharU ra pRthvIlAI sRSTi garne sRSTikartA, upasthita ra anupasthitakA jJAtA! tapAIMbATa kunai pani vastu lukeko chaina | sAMsArika mAmilAmA bhaktaharUbIca raheko matabhedabAre mahApralayako dina tapAIMle nai nirNaya garnuhunecha | ani satyavAdI tathA asatyavAdIbIca ra bhAgyazAlI ra abhAgIbIca pharaka spaSTa hunecha |

47 yadi zirka ra avajJA garera AphUmAthi atyAcAra garneharUsa~ga pRthvI barAbara jana­zakti ra dhana­sampatti bhae pani baru tyasako duI guNA bhae pani ra tI sabailAI tinIharUle kaDA yAtanAbATa joginako lAgi jarimAnA svarUpa die pani svIkArya garinechaina ra tinIharU yAtanAbATa bacna sakne chainan | baru tinIharUkA lAgi tinIharUle kalapanA sameta nagarekA vibhinna prakArakA yAtanAharU prakaTa hunechan |
48 tinIharUle gareko zirka ra avajJAko duSpariNAma prakaTa bhayo | tinIharUlAI tyasa yAtanAle gheryo jasabATa lokamA DarAu~dA tyasako ThaTTA garne garthe |

49 kAphiralAI roga vA garibI jasto kunai saGkaTa hu~dA tyasako nivAraNako lAgi usale allAhalAI pukArcha | jaba allAhale tyasako kaSTalAI nivAraNa garnuhuncha ani svAsthya ra dhana-sampatti dinuhuncha taba bhanna thAlchaH yo allAhale mero jJAnako kAraNale dinubhaeko cha, ma yasako hakadAra chu | vAstavamA allAhale tyo parIkSA lina ra DorI khukulo pArnako lAgi dinubhayo | tara adhikAMsa kAphiraharU yo kurA jAndainan ra allAhako yasa varadAnako bAremA dhokAmA parekA chan |
50 yo kurA yinIharUbhandA pahilekA kAphiraharUle pani bhanekA thie tara tinIharUle Arjana garekA dhana­sampatti ra padale tinIharUlAI kunai phAidA puryAenan |

51 tinIharUlAI tinIharUle gareko zirka ra avajJAko sajAya diiyo | hAlakA bahudevavAdI ra avajJAkArIharUlAI pani tyastai sajAya diinecha | yinIharU tyasabATa na bacna saknechan ra na allAhamAthi vijayI huna saknechan |

52 yI bahudevavAdIharUle je bhane pani ke tinIharUlAI thAhA chaina– allAhale jasalAI cAhanuhuncha dherai jIvikA pradAna garnuhuncha, unIharUko parIkSAko lAgi ki allAhaprati AbhAra vyakta garchan ki kRtaghna garchan?! allAha jasalAI cAhanuhuncha kama jIvikA pradAna garnuhuncha, yasa kurAko parIkSAko lAgi ki tinIharU dhairya garchan vA bhAgyaprati risAu~chan?! jIvikA pharAkilo pArne ra saJkucita pArne kAryamA yasa kurAko pramANa cha ki allAhale mominaharUkA lAgi kArya saJcAlana garnuhuncha, kinabhane unIharU nai allAhakA nizAnIharUbATa phAidA uThAu~chan | jabaki kAphiraharU yI pramANaharUbATa vimukha hunchan |

53 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! zirka ra kuphra (avajJA) garera sImA ullaGghan garne bhaktaharUlAI bhanidinuhos: timIharU allAhako kRpA ra kSamAdAnabATa nirAza nahoU | yadi timIharU taubA garchau bhane uhA~le timIharUkA sabai pApaharU mApha garnuhunecha | nissandeha uhA~ kSamAzIla ra kRpAvAna hunuhuncha |

54 mahApralayako yAtanA AipagnubhandA pahile nai timIharU taubA garera ra satkarma garera allAhako nikaTatA prApta gara ra uhA~samakSa Atma­samarpaNa gara | mahApralaya Aepachi timIharUle AphnA mUrti ra nAtedAraharUmadhye kasailAI pani yasa yAtanAbATa jogAune sahayogIko rUpamA pAune chainau |

55 timIharU yasa utkRSTa kurAnako anusaraNa gara jasalAI allAhale AphnA rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) mAthi avataraNa garnubhayo | akasmAta allAhako prakopa AunubhandA pahile nai timIharU allAhakA AdezaharUko pAlanA gara ra uhA~le manAhI garnubhaekA kAryaharUlAI tyAga | yo prakopa yati akasmAta Aunecha ki timIharU na mahasusa garna saknechau ra na taubA garne tayArI garna saknechau |

56 yI kAryaharU garna yasa kAraNale bhanieko cha ki kunai pani vyaktile mahApralayako dina ati cintAle yo nabhanos ki hAmIle lokamA kuphra tathA avajJA garera ra mominaharUko ThaTTA garera allAhako hakamA kamI nagareko bhae besa hunthyo | jabaki tinIharUle lokamA mominaharUko ThaTTA garthe |

57 vA tyo vyaktile bhAgyako bahAnA nabanAos ki yadi bhAgyamA lekheko bhae hAmI avazya nai Izabhaya rAkhneharUmadhye hune thiyauM, allAhakA AdezaharUko pAlanA garne thiyauM ra uhA~le manAhI garnubhaeko kAryalAI tyAgne thiyauM |
58 vA tyo vyaktile yAtanA dekhepachi kAmanA gardai yo nabhanos: yadi malAI punaH saMsAramA pharkAine bhae maile taubA garera satkarma garne thie~ |

59 timIle gareko mArgadarzanako kAmanA pUrA hune chaina | kinabhane timIsamakSa merA nizAnIharU AekA thie, tara timIle jhUTo Thahara garekA thiyau, ghamaNDa garekA thiyau ra allAha, uhA~kA nizAnI ra rasUlaharUko inkAra garekA thiyau |

60 tapAIMle mahApralayako dina yastA jhUTA Thahara garneharUkA anuhAra kAlA dekhnuhunecha; jasale allAhako lAgi santAna ityAdi Thahara garera zirka gare | tinIharU abhAgI hun bhanne nizAnI svarUpa tinIharUkA anuhAra kAlA hunecha | ghamaNDIharUko vAsasthAna narka hoina ra?! nissandeha tinIharUko vAsasthAna narka hunecha |

61 yastA Izabhaya rAkhneharU yAtanAbATa surakSita rahanechan jo allAhakA AdezaharUko pAlanA garchan, uhA~le manAhI garnubhaekA kAryaharUbATa bacchan | unIharUlAI saphalatAko sthAna svargamA praveza garAinecha | tyahA~ tinIharUlAI yAtanAle chune pani chaina | unIharUle gumAekA sAMsArika varadAnaprati cintita hune chainan |
62 allAha pratyeka vastukA sRSTikartA hunuhuncha | uhA~ bAheka kohI sRSTikartA chaina | uhA~ pratyeka vastulAI surakSita rAkhnuhuncha | uhA~ Aphno Adeza jasarI cAhanuhuncha calAunuhuncha |

63 AkAzaharU ra pRthvIkA khajAnAkA sA~cAharU uhA~ kai hAtamA chan | uhA~ jasalAI cAhanuhuncha pradAna garnuhuncha ra jasalAI cAhanuhuncha vaJcita rAkhnuhuncha | allAhakA nizAnIharUlAI jhUTA Thahara garneharU nai ghATAmA parneharU hun | kinabhane tinIharU lokamA ImAnabATa vaJcita bhae ra paralokamA sadhaiMko lAgi narkamA jAnechan |

64 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! tapAIMlAI mUrtiharUko pUjAtarpha Amantrita garne bahudevavAdIharUlAI bhannuhos: he ajJAnIharU ho! ke timIharU malAI allAha bAheka arUko upAsanAko Adeza diMdaichau?! allAha bAheka kohI pani upAsanA­yogya chaina | ma allAha bAheka kasaiko upAsanA gardina |

65 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! allAhale tapAIMmAthi vahI (prakAzAnA) garnubhayo ra tapAIMbhandA aghikA rasUlaharUmAthi pani vahI garnubhayo | yadi allAha bAheka anya kasaiko upAsanA garnuhuncha bhane uhA~le tapAIMkA karmaharUko pratiphalalAI barbAda pArnuhuncha | Aphno dharmalAI barbAda pArera lokamA ra yAtanAko bhAgIdAra banera paralokamA ghATA khAneharUkadhye nabana |
66 baru allAhako mAtra bhakti gara ra uhA~sa~ga kasailAI sAjhedAra nabanAU | allAhale timIlAI pradAna gareko varadAnako lAgi uhA~prati AbhAra vyakta gara |

67 bahudevavAdIharUle kamajora sRSTiharUlAI allAhasa~ga sAjhedAra Thahara garera ra pRthvImA rahekA uhA~kA sAmarthyakA nizAnIharUbATa aceta rahera allAhako tyasto kadara garenan jasto garnuparne thiyo | mahApralayako dina pRthvI, tyasa bhitra rahekA pahADa, rUkha, nadI, nAlA ra samudrasameta allAhako muThThImA hunechan ra sAtavaTai AkAzaharU allAhako dAhine hAtamA berieko bahI khAtA jasto hunecha | bahudevavAdIharUle bhaneko kurAbATa allAha pavitra hunuhuncha |

68 tyasa dina jaba sUra phuknako lAgi niyukta phariztAle sUramA phuknechan | ta AkAzaharU ra pRthvImA rahekA sabai prANIharU marnechan, sivAya tyasako jasalAI allAhale surakSita rAkhnuhunecha | pheri phariztAle dosro paTaka sUramA phuknechan jasale gardA sabai mRtaharU jIvita bhaera ubhinechan ani allAhale garnubhaeko kAryalAI dekhnechan |

69 jaba bhaktaharUbIca nirNayako lAgi allAha prakaTa hunuhunecha taba pRthvI prakAzamaya hunecha | mAnisaharUbIca tinIharUkA karma­patraharU kholinechan | sabai sandeSTAharU ra muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) kA samudAyalAI hAjira garAinecha | sandeSTAharUle AphnA samudAya viruddha gavAhI dinechan | allAhale tinIharUbIca nisAphakA sAtha nirNaya garnuhunecha | nata tinIharUko pApamA vRddhi garinecha na puNyamA kamI garinecha |

70 duSkarma ra puNya karma garne sabailAI tinIharUkA karmaharUko pUrA-pUrA badalA diinecha | tinIharUle garne duSkarma ra satkarma sabailAI allAhale jAnnuhuncha, uhA~bATa kehI pani lukeko chain | uhA~le cA~Dai nai tyasa dina tinIharUlAI tinIharUkA kAryako badalA dinuhunecha |

71 phariztAharUle kAphiraharUlAI apamAnita samUhako rUpamA narkatarpha hA~knechan | jaba tinIharU narkanajika pugnechan taba phariztAharUle narkakA DhokAharU kholnechan | phariztAharUle tinIharUko nindA gardai bhannechan: ke timIharUsamma timIharU madhyebATa rasUlaharU AekA thienan, jo timIharU samakSa allAhakA AyataharU paDhathe, mahApralayako yAtanAbATa DarAu~the?! kAphiraharUle AphnA galtI svIkAra gardai bhannechan: ho, unIharU AekA thie tara hAmIharUmAthi allAhako tarphabATa kAphiraharUmAthi lAgu hune yAtanAko nirNaya lAgu bhayo |

72 tinIharUlAI apamAnita gardai ra allAhako dayAle narkabATa bAhira nikAlnebAre nirAza pArdai bhaninecha: timIharU sadhaiM narkamA basne garI tyasamA pasa | kati narAmro hunecha satyalAI inkAra garera ghamaNDa garneharUko bAsa­sthAna |

74 mominaharU svargamA praveza garepachi bhannechan: sabai prazaMsAharU allAhakai lAgi chan, jasale hAmIharUlAI svargamA praveza garAune vAcA pUrA garnubhayo | yo vAcA uhA~le rasUlaharUko mAdhyamabATa garnubhaeko thiyo | uhA~le hAmIharUlAI svargakA dhartIko vArisa (uttarAdhikArI) banAunubhayo | hAmIharU svargamA jahA~ cAhanchauM rahana sakchauM | allAhako prasannatA prApta garnako lAgi karma garneharUko badalA kati rAmro cha |

75 tyasa gavAhI diine dinamA phariztAharUle allAhako siMhAsanalAI gherekA hunechan | phariztAharUle allAhako pavitratAko guNagAna garirahekA hunechan, tI anucita kurAharUbATa jo kAphiraharUle allAhako bAremA bhanekA thie | allAhale sabai prANIharUbIca nisAphakA sAtha nirNaya garnuhunecha ani jasamAthi cAhanuhunecha kRpA garnuhunecha ra jasalAlAI cAhanuhunecha yAtanA dinuhunecha | bhaninecha: sabai prazaMsAharU allAhakai lAgi hun, jo sabai sRSTiharUkA sRSTikartA hunuhuncha | uhA~le momina bhaktaharUkA lAgi kRpAko nirNaya ra kAphiraharUkA lAgi yAtanAko nirNaya garnubhaeko cha |
