3 allAha pApIharUkA pApaharUlAI mApha garnevAlA, taubA garneharUkA taubA svIkAra garnevAlA, taubA nagarneharUlAI sajAya dinevAlA ra paropakArI hunuhuncha | uhA~ bAheka kohI vAstavika pUjya chaina | mahApralayako dina sabai bhaktaharUle pharkera uhA~tarpha nai jAnuparcha | ani allAhale tinIharUlAI ucita badalA dinuhunecha |

4 kAphiraharU nai allAhakA AyataharUbAre vAdavivAda garchan | kAphiraharU yastA AyataharUbAre vAdavivAda garchan jasale yasa kurAlAI pramANita garchan ki allAha mAtra upAsanAko yogya hunuhuncha ra rasUlaharU satya hun | tapAIM tinIharUbAre cintA nalinuhos | tinIharUkA dhana sampattile tapAIMlAI dhokAmA napArun | tinIharUlAI samAtnako lAgi chuTa dii~daicha |

5 yinIharUaghi nUha (alaihissalAma) ko samudAya, tyasapachi Ada, samUda, lUta (alaihissalAma) ko samudAya, madayana bAsIharU ra phiraunale pani jhUTA Thahara gare | sabai samudAyaharUle AphnA rasUlalAI samAtne ra hatyA garne prayAsa gare | satyalAI samApta pArnako lAgi tinIharUle asatyako mAdhyamadvArA jhagaDA gare | ani maile tI sabai samudAyaharUlAI samAteM | ani vicAra garnuhos, maile tinIharUlAI kasto sajAya die~ | unIharUlAI ati kaDA sajAya diiyo |

6 jasarI allAhale yI jhUTA Thahara garne samudAyaharUlAI sarvanAza garne Adeza dinubhayo, tyasarI nai he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! tapAIMkA pAlanakartAko yo nirNaya lAgu bhayo– nissandeha kAphiraharU narkabAsI hun |

7 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! tapAIMkA pAlanakartAkA siMhAsana uThAera rAkhekA ra tyasako varipari rahekA phariztAharU allAhakA pavitratAko guNagAna gardaichan, uhA~mAthi AsthA rAkhchan, mominaharUkA lAgi kSamAko prArthanA gardai bhanchan: he hAmrA pAlanakartA! tapAIMko jJAna ra kRpA hareka vastumAthi chAeko cha, AphnA pApaharUbATa taubA garne ra tapAIMko dharmako pAlanA garneharUlAI mApha garnuhos ra unIharUlAI narkako AgobATa surakSita rAkhnuhos |

8 phariztAharU bhanchan: he hAmrA pAlanakartA! Aphno vAcA anusAra mominaharUlAI sadhaiM rahane svargamA praveza garAunuhos | unIharUsa~ga unIharUkA satkarmI purkhA, patnI ra santAnaharUlAI pani svargamA praveza garAunuhos | tapAIM prabhutvazAlI hunuhuncha, kohI pani tapAIMmAthi vijayI huna sakdaina | tapAIM bhAgya nirdhAraNa ra kArya saJcAlanamA tatvadarzI hunuhuncha |

9 unIharUlAI unIharUle garekA duSkarmabATa jogAunuhos ra tyasako kAraNale sajAya nadinuhos | mahApralayako dina tapAIMle jasalAI unIharUkA duSkarmaharUkA duSkarmako sajAyabATa jogAunuhuncha ra svarga pradAna garera kRpA garnuhuncha tyo unIharUkA lAgi mahAna saphalatA ho | yo jasto arU kunai saphalatA huna sakdaina |

10 kAphiraharUle mahApralayako dina Aphnai nindA garnechan, tinIharUlAI narkamA praveza gardai gareko belA pukArera bhaninechaH timIharUmAthi allAhako roSa baDhI cha tyasa roSabhandA jo AphUmAthi garne garthyau | timIharUlAI ImAnatarpha bolAu~dA kuphra garthyau ra allAhako sAthamA arUlAI sAjhedAra banAune garthyau |

11 kAphiraharUle Aphno pApalAI svIkAra garnechan jabaki svIkAra ra taubAle kunai phAidA dine chaina | tinIharUle bhannechan: tapAIMle hAmIlAI duI paTaka mRtyu dinubhayo | euTA jaba hAmI astitvamA AekA thienauM, dosro hAmIharUlAI astitvamA lyAepachi mRtyu dinubhayo | tapAIMle hAmIlAI duI paTaka jIvana dinubhayo | euTA hAmIlAI astitvamA lyAera ra dosro mRtyupachi punaH jIvita pArera | hAmIle AphnA pApaharU svIkAra garyauM | ke yasa yAtanAbATa niskera saMsAramA pharkera jAne kunai upAya cha, tAki hAmI tapAIMlAI prasanna pArna AphnA karmalAI ThIka pArauM?!

13 allAhale nai timIharUlAI jagatamA ra timIharUbhitra AphnA nizAnIharU dekhAunuhuncha, jo yasa kurAko pramANa ho ki uhA~ zaktizAlI ra eka mAtra hunuhuncha | uhA~ AkAzabATa varSAko pAnI barsAunuhuncha tAki yo timIharUko jIvikA bAlInAlI ityAdi umrane mAdhyama banos | ekAgratAkA sAtha allAhatarpha pharkane vyaktile mAtra allAhakA nizAnIharUbATa upadeza grahaNa garcha |
14 he mominaharU ho! AjJApAlana ra prArthanAlAI allAhako lAgi ekAgratAkA sAtha zuddharUpamA gara | allAhasa~ga kasailAI sAjhedAra Thahara nagara, yadyapi kAphiraharUle mana naparAun |

15 prArthanA arthAta duA ra AjJApAlanako yogya allAha mAtra hunuhuncha | uhA~ ucca darjAmA hunuhuncha | sabai sRSTiharUbATa pRthaka ra mahAna siMhAsanakA mAlika hunuhuncha | AphnA bhaktaharUmadhye jasamAthi cAhanuhuncha vahI (prakAzanA) avataraNa garnuhuncha, tAki unIharU svayam pani jIvita rahun ra arUlAI pani jIvita pArun ra mahApralayako dinabATa sAvadhAna pArun jahA~ aghillA ra pachillA sabaiko bheTa hunecha |

16 mahApralayako dina tinIharU euTA ucca sthAnamA jammA hunechan ra spaSTa dekhinechan | tinIharUkA zarIra, karma ra badalA kehI pani allAhabATa lukeko hune chaina | allAhale sodhnuhunechaH sattA zAsana kasako lAgi ho?! eka mAtra javApha hunechaH mAtra allAhako lAgi, jo Aphno astitva, guNa ra karmamA eklo evam advitIya hunuhuncha | uhA~ prabhutvazAlI ra sabai vastumAthi hAvI hunuhuncha ra sabai vastuharU uhA~ko adhinamA cha |

17 tyasa dina pratyeka vyaktilAI usako karmako badalA diinecha, rAmro karmako rAmro ra narAmro karmako narAmro badalA, kasaimAthi atyAcAra hune chaina | kinabhane allAhale nisAphakA sAtha nirNaya garnuhunecha | allAha bhaktaharUko bAremA pUrNa jAnakAra hunubhaekole turuntai nirNaya garnuhunecha |

18 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! tinIharUlAI mahApralayabATa sAvadhAna garAunuhos, mahApralaya ati najika cha jo avazya Aunecha | kinabhane sabai Aune kArya najika huncha | tyasa dina bhayAnaka trAsale gardA mAnisaharUkA muTu ghA~TIsamma pugnechan | tyasa dina sabai cupacApa ubhiekA hunechan, karuNAmaya allAhale jasalAI anumati dinuhunecha usale mAtra kurA garnecha | zirka ra avajJA garera AphUmAthi atyAcAra garekA mAnisaharUkA lAgi kunai mitra, nikaTatama ra siphArisakartA hune chaina |
19 A~khAle garne chala ra hRdayaharUle lukAekA rahasyaharUlAI allAhale jAnnuhuncha | uhA~bATa kehI pani lukeko chaina |

20 allAhale nisAphakA sAtha nirNaya garnuhunecha | kasaikA puNyamA kamI garera ra pApamA thapera atyAcAra garine chaina | bahudevavAdIharUkA pUjyaharUle kunai nirNaya garne zakti rAkhne chainan | allAhale bhaktaharUkA kurAharU sunnuhuncha, unIharUkA nIyata ra karmaharUlAI dekhnuhuncha | allAhale unIharUlAI cA~Dai nai badalA dinuhunecha |

22 tinIharU samakSa rasUlaharU spaSTa pramANaharU liera Ae tara tinIharUle allAhalAI inkAra gare ra uhA~kA rasUlaharUlAI jhUTA Thahara gare | tinIharU zaktizAlI bhae pani allAhale tinIharUlAI samAtnubhayo ra sarvanAza pArnubhayo | allAha zaktizAlI hunuhuncha ra kAphiraharUlAI kaDA sajAya dinuhunecha |

jaba muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) lAI Aphno samudAyako tarphabATa virodhako sAmanA garnuparyo taba allAhale mUsA (alaihissalAma) ra phiraunako satya kathA sunAunubhayo | yasako uddezya uhA~ (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) lAI yo zubhasUcanA dinu ho ki allAhako tarphabATa sahayoga prApta hunecha | allAhale bhannubhayoH
23 hAmIle mUsA (alehissalAma) lAI spaSTa nizAnIharU diera paThAyauM |
24 unalAI hAmIle phirauna, usako mantrI hAmAna ra kArUnatarpha paThAyauM | tinIharUle bhaneH mUsA jAdUgara ho ra AphU rasUla hune dAbImA jhUTA ho |

25 jaba mUsA (alaihissalAma) tinIharU samakSa camatkAra liera Ae taba phiraunale bhanyoH usamAthi ImAna lyAune puruSaharUlAI hatyA gara ra tinIharUlAI apamAnita garnako lAgi mahilAharUlAI jIvita choDa | tara mominaharUko saMkhyA kama garnako lAgi kAphiraharUle gareko SaDayantra viphala bhayo |

26 phiraunale bhanyoH malAI mUsAlAI hatyA garna deU, usale AphUlAI bacAunako lAgi Aphno pAlanakartAlAI pukArera heros, malAI yasako kunai parvAha chaina | usale timIharUko dharmalAI parivartana garnecha ra hatyA hiMsA garera AtaGka phailAunecha bhanne malAI AzaGkA cha |

27 mUsA (alaihissalAma) le usako dhamkI sunera bhaneH ma pratyeka ghamaNDIbATa allAhako zaraNa cAhanchu | yasto ghamaNDIbATa jo satya dharma ra mahApralayako dina hune hisAba ra badalAmAthi ImAna rAkhdaina |

28 Aphno ImAna lukAeko ekajanA mominale phiraunako yojanAprati virodha prakaTa gardai bhaneH ke timIle eka janA vyaktilAI mAtra yasa kAraNale hatyA garnechau ki unale mero pAlanakartA allAha hunuhuncha bhandachan | jabaki unI allAhako tarphabATa paThAieko rasUla hune dAbI gardachan ra Aphno dAbIlAI satya siddha garne pramANaharU pani liera AekA chan | yadi unI jhUTA hun bhane unako jhUTako hAni unailAI pugnecha | yadi unI satya hun bhane unale sAvadhAna gareko prakopa tatkAlai timImAthi Aunecha | allAha yasto vyaktilAI satya apanAune avasara dinuhunna jo sImA ullaGghan garcha ra allAha tathA uhA~kA rasUlaharU viruddha jhUTo kurA raccha |

29 he merA samudAya! Aja timIharU ijipTamA sattAmA chau | yadi mUsA (alaihissalAma) ko hatyAko kAraNale allAhako prakopa Au~cha bhane tyasa avasthAmA kasale hAmIlAI sahayoga garna sakcha?! phiraunale bhanyoH yahA~ mero Adeza calcha, ma kharAbI ra phasAdalAI samApta pArnako lAgi mUsAlAI hatyA garne nirNaya garisakeko chu | ma timIharUlAI ThIka kAma garne nirdezana diMdaichu |

30 momina vyaktile Aphno samudAyalAI upadeza diMdai bhaneH yadi timIle atyAcAra gardai mUsA (alaihissalAma) ko hatyA garchau bhane malAI ke AzaGkA cha bhane timImAthi tyastai prakopa Aunecha jasto vigatamA rasUlaharUkA virodhI samUhaharUmAthi Aeko thiyo ra allAhale tinIharUlAI sarvanAza garnubhaeko thiyo |

31 nUha (alaihissalAma) ko samudAya, Ada, samUda ra tinIharUpachi AekA samudAyaharUle pani jhUTA Thahara gare ani allAhale tinIharU sabailAI tinIharUko kuphrako kAraNale sarvanAza pArnubhayo | allAha bhaktaharUmAthi atyacAra garna cAhanuhunna tara tinIharUle gareko kuphrako pUrA-pUrA badalA dinuhunecha |

32 he merA samudAya! ma timIharUko bAremA mahApralayasita DarAu~chu, tyasa dina mAnisaharUle eka arkAlAI nAtedArI ra padale gardA yo AzA liera pukArnechan ki yaso gardA yasto kaDA samayamA tinIharUlAI kehI phAidA hunecha |

33 tinIharU tyasa dina narkako Darale bhAgnechan tara allAhako yAtanAbATa jogAune kohI pani hune chaina | jasalAI allAha apamAnita garna cAhanuhuncha ra ImAna lyAune avasara dinuhunna usalAI kohI pani mArgadarzana dina sakdaina | kinabhane mArgadarzana dinu allAhako hAtamA cha |

34 mUsA (alaihissalAma) aghi yUsupha (alaihissalAma) timIharU samakSa allAha mAtra bhakti­yogya hunuhuncha bhanne kurAko spaSTa nizAnIharU liera AekA thie | tara timIharU nirantara zaGkAmA rahayau | jaba unako nidhana bhayo taba timIharUko zaGkA jhana baDhyo | timIharUle bhanekA thiyauH yUsupha (alaihissalAma) pachi kunai rasUla Aune chaina | sImA ullaGghanakArI ra ekezvaravAdamA zaGkA garneharUlAI allAhale mArgadarzana garnuhunna |

35 allAhakA nizAnIharUlAI asatya Thahara garnako lAgi binA pramANa vAda vivAda garneharUlAI allAha ra mominaharU mana parAu~dainan | jasarI allAhale yastA vAda vivAda garneharUkA hRdayaharUmAthi mohara lagAunubhayo tyasarI nai pratyeka ghamaNDIko hRdayamAthi mohara lagAunu hunecha | ghamaNDIle satya ra bhalAiko mArga pAune chaina |
36 phiraunale Aphno mantrI hAmAnalAI bhanyoH mero lAgi ucca bhavana banAU, tAki ma bATo pAuna saku~ |

37 AzA cha ma AkAzaharUko mArga pAera mUsAko upAsyasamma pugna saku~, jasalAI U vastavika Izvara ThAndacha | mero vicAramA mUsA Aphno dAbImA jhUTo cha | yasarI usale hAmAnasita je mAga garyo tyasa narAmro karmalAI sundara banAiyo, yasarI usalAI satmArgabATa pathabhraSTatAtarpha pheriyo | phiraunale asatyalAI vijayI pArna ra mUsA (alaihissalAma) le lyAeko satyalAI asatya Thahara garnako lAgi gareko calakhela viphala bhayo | antataH U Aphno prayAsamA viphala bhayo ra sadhaiMko lAgi abhAgI bhayo |
38 phiraunako parivArabATa ImAna lyAune vyaktile upadeza diMdai bhaneH he merA samudAyakA mAnisaharU! timIharU mero anusaraNa gara, ma timIharUlAI sIdhA mArga dekhAunechu |

39 he merA samudAya! yo sAMsArika jIvana kSaNika mojamastI mAtra ho | yahA~ko kSaNika sAmagrIbATa dhokA nakhAU | nissandeha paralokako ghara ra tyasamA rahekA sadhaiM rahane varadAna nai sadhaiM rahane sthAna ho | allAhako AjJApAlana garera tyasako lAgi satkarma gara | paralokalAI choDera mAtra lokako lAgi kArya nagara |

40 duSkarmIle usale gareko duSkarmako sajAya mAtra pAunecha, tyasabhandA baDhI sajAya pAune chaina | jabaki mAtra allAhako prasannatA prApta garnako lAgi puNya karma garekA momina puruSa ra mahilAharUle mahApralayako dina svarga pAunechan | allAhale unIharUlAI anagintI phalaphUlaharU ra sadhaiM rahane varadAnaharU pradAna garnuhunecha |

41 he mero samudAyakA mAnisaharU! Akhira kina yasto hu~daicha ki ma ta timIharUlAI ImAna lyAera loka ra paralokako saphalatAtarpha AhvAna gardaichu tara timIharU malAI kuphra ra avajJAtarpha AhvAna garera narkatarpha bolAu~daichau?!

42 timIharU malAI Aphno asatya mArgatarpha bolAu~daichau, tAki ma allAhako inkAra garu~ ra uhA~sa~ga anya ajJAta bhagavAnaharUko pUjA garu~, jabaki ma timIharUlAI eka allAhako bhaktitarpha bolAu~daichu, jo prabhutvazAlI hunuhuncha, jasamAthi kohI vijayI huna sakdaina | uhA~ AphnA bhaktaharUlAI dherai mApha garnuhuncha |

43 timIharU jasamAthi ImAna lyAuna ra jasako AjJApAlana garna AhvAna gardaichau, tinIharU nata lokamA pukArine hakadAra chan na paralokamA | tinIharU pukArako javApha pani diMdainan | hAmIharU sabai pharkera mAtra eka allAhatarpha nai jAnucha | kuphra ra avajJAmA lipta huneharU narkabAsI hun, jasamA tinIharU anivAryarUpamA jAnechan |

44 unako samudAyale unako upadezalAI mAnna inkAra gardA unale thapa bhaneH maile gareko upadeza timIharUle cA~Dai nai yAda garnechau ra yasalAI asvIkAra garekomA pachutAunechau | ma Aphno mAmilA eka allAhalAI mAtra hastAntaraNa garchu | allAhabATa bhaktaharUkA karmaharU lukekA chainan |
45 unalAI unako samudAyale hatyA garna khojdA allAhale jogAunubhayo | allAhale phirauna ra usakA sainikaharUlAI samudramA DubAera yAtanA dinubhayo |

46 mRtyupachi tinIharUko cihAna (kabra) mA dinako pahilo ra antima bhAgamA tinIharUlAI Ago samakSa peza garinecha | ani mahApralayako dina bhaninechaH phiraunakA anuyAyIharUlAI kuphra gareko ra sIdhA mArgabATa rokeko kAraNale kaDA yAtanAmA hAla |

47 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! tyasa samayalAI yAda garnuhos, jaba narkabAsIharUmadhye anuyAyIharU ra aguvAharU paraspara vAda vivAda garnechan | kamajora pAriekA anuyAyIharUle ghamaNDI aguvAharUlAI bhannechan: hAmIharU lokamA timIharUkA anuyAyI thiyauM, ke yahA~ timIharUle hAmro bhAgako yAtanA sahana garera hAmIlAI tyasabATa bacAuna sakchau?!

48 ghamaNDI aguvAharUle bhannechan; hAmI sabai yahA~ narkamA ekasamAna chauM, yahA~ kasaile kasaiko yAtanAko bhAga sahana garna sakdaina | allAhale bhaktaharUbIca nirNaya garisaknu bhaeko cha ra jo jati yAtanAko hakadAra thiyo tyo diI saknubhaeko cha |

49 anuyAyI ra aguvA duvai narkabATa niskera sAMsArika jIvanamA AunabATa nirAza bhaepachi narkako vyavasthApanamA rahekA phariztAharUlAI bhannechan: Aphno pAlanakartAlAI eka dinako lAgi bhae pani yasa sadhaiMko yAtanAlAI kama garna bhannus na |

50 narkakA rekhadekha garne phariztAharUle kAphiraharUlAI javApha dinechan: ke rasUlaharU timIharU samakSa spaSTa pramANakA sAtha AekA thienan?! tinIharUle bhannechan: unIharU spaSTa pramANakA sAtha avazya AekA thie | phariztAharUle bhannechan: timIharU AphaiM allAhalAI pukAra, hAmIharU kAphiraharUko lAgi siphArisa gardainauM | kAphiraharUko pukAra khera jAnecha, kuphrako kAraNale svIkAra garine chaina |

phirauna ra usakA anuyAyIharUkA kathA ani loka ra paralokamA tinIharUko pariNAmako varNana garepachi rasUlaharU, mominaharUkA mAmilAharU ra unIharUlAI loka ra paralokamA milne varadAnaharUko varNana gardai allAhale bhannubhaeko chaH
51 hAmIle avazya nai rasUlaharU ra mominaharUlAI maddata lokamA unIharUlAI vijaya pradAna garera garnechauM, paralokamA unIharUlAI svargamA praveza garAera maddata garnechauM ra unakA zatruharUlAI narkamA hAlera garnechauM | sandeSTAharU, phariztAharU ra mominaharUle tinIharU samakSa allAhako sandeza puryAera tinIharU viruddha gavAhI diepachi yaso garnechauM |

52 tyasa dina kuphra ra avajJA garera AphUmAthi atyAcAra garneharUlAI tinIharUko bahAnAle kunai phAidA puryAune chaina | tinIharUlAI allAhako kRpAbATa TADhA rAkhinecha | tinIharUkA lAgi paralokamA narAmro vAsasthAna hunecha, tyahA~ tinIharUle pIDAdAyI yAtanA pAunechan |
53 hAmIle mUsA (alaihissalAma) lAI tyo jJAna pradAna garyauM jasabATa banI isrAIlale satya mArga pAune garthe | hAmIle taurAtalAI banI isrAIlakA eka pIDhIdekhi arko pIDhIsamma pugne kitAba banAyauM |
54 yasa kitAbalAI sIdhA mArgadarzana ra vivekazIlaharUkA lAgi upadeza banAyauM |

55 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! tapAIMko samudAyale tapAIMlAI jasarI jhUTo Thahara gardaichan ra kaSTa puryAu~daichan tyasamA dhairya garnuhos | tapAIMlAI maddata garne allAhako vAcA satya ho, yasamA kunai sandeha chaina | Aphno pApako mAphI mAgnuhos ra dinako pahilo ra antima bhAgamA allAhako pavitratAko guNagAna garnuhos |

56 juna mAnisaharU ghamaNDale gardA allAhakA AyataharUlAI asatya Thahara garnako lAgi allAhako tarphabATa Aeko pramANa binA vAda vivAda garchan tinIharUle AphU ThUlo banne cAhanA garepani tyasalAI prApta garna sakdainan | he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! pUrNarUpamA allAhako zaraNamA Aunuhos | nissandeha uhA~le AphnA bhaktaharUkA kurA sunnuhuncha ra unIharUkA karmaharUlAI dekhnuhuncha, uhA~bATa kehI pani chuTdaina | cA~Dai nai uhA~le yasako badalA dinuhunecha |

57 nissandeha vizAla AkAzaharU ra pRthvIko sRSTi mAnavako sRSTibhandA kaThina kArya ho | juna allAhale yI vizAla AkAzaharU ra pRthvI sRSTi garne sAmarthya rAkhnuhuncha uhA~ mAnavalAI mRtyupachi cihAnabATa punaH jIvita pArne sAmarthya pani rAkhnuhuncha, tAki tinIharUko hisAba liera badalA diiyos | tara adhikAMsa mAnisaharU jAndainan ra pATha li~dainan | AkAza ra pRthvIko sRSTi punaH jIvita hune kurAlAI pramANita garcha, tara tinIharU yasa pramANalAI mAndainan |

58 andho ra dekhne vyakti eka samAna huna sakdainan | satkarmI mominaharU ra pApI kAphiraharU ekasamAna huna sakdainan | timIharUmadhye kamai mAnisaharU upadeza grahaNa garchan | timIharUle pATha lieko bhae duvai samUhabIca pharaka dekhne thiyau ra allAhako prasannatA prApta garna satkarmI mominaharUmA sAmela hune prayAsa garne thiyau |

59 nissandeha mahApralayako dina Aunecha, jasamA allAhale mRtaharUlAI hisAba ra badalAko lAgi avazya jIvita pArnuhunecha | yasako AgamanamA kunai zaGkA chaina, tara adhikAMsa mAnisaharU tyasako AgamanamA ImAna rAkhdainan ra tyasako lAgi tayArI gardainan |

60 allAhale bhannuhunchaH he mAnava! mero mAtra upAsanA gara ra masa~ga mAtra mAga, ma timIharUko prArthanA svIkAra garnechu, timIharUlAI mApha garnechu ra timIharUmAthi kRpA garnechu | jasale pani mero bhakti garne mAmilAmA ghamaNDa garnechan mahApralayako dina apamAnita bhaera narkamA pasnechan |

61 allAhale nai rAtalAI andhakAramaya banAunubhayo tAki timIharU tyasamA ArAma gara ra dinalAI prakAzamaya banAunubhayo tAki tyasamA jIvikopArjana gara | allAha mAnisaharUmAthi ati kRpAvAna hunuhuncha tyasaile unIharUlAI vAhya tathA Antarika duvai kisimakA varadAnaharU pradAna garnubhayo tara adhikAMsa mAnisaharU uhA~prati AbhAra vyakta gardainan |

62 timIharUlAI dherai varadAna pradAna garne allAha pratyeka vastukA sRSTikartA hunuhuncha | uhA~ bAheka kohI sRSTikartA hoina | uhA~ nai vAstavika pUjya hunuhuncha | ani timIharU kina uhA~ko bhakti nagarera arUko bhakti garchau? jo nata lAbha puryAuna sakcha na hAni nai |

63 jasarI yinIharU eka allAhamAthi ImAna ra uhA~ko bhaktibATa pherie, tyasarI nai yI nizAnIharUlAI jhUTA Thahara garneharU pani hareka yuga ra sthAnamA eka allAhamAthi ImAnabATa vaJcita rahanchan ra satya mArga pAu~dainan |

64 he mAnava! allAhale nai timIharUko basobAsako lAgi pRthvI banAunubhayo ra timIharUmAthi nakhasne garI Thosa ra baliyo AkAza banAunubhayo | uhA~le nai AmAko garbhamA timIharUko sundara rUparekhA banAunubhayo | uhA~le nai timIharUlAI halAla ra pavitra jIvikA pradAna garnubhayo | yI varadAnaharU pradAna garne allAha nai timIharUkA vAstavika pAlanakartA hunuhuncha | sabai sRSTiharUkA pAlanakartA barakatavAlA hunuhuncha | uhA~ bAheka tinIharUkA kohI pAlanakartA chaina |

65 allAha jIvanta hunuhuncha, uhA~lAI kahilyai mRtyu Au~daina | uhA~ bAheka kohI vAstavika pUjya hoina | uhA~kai prasannatA khojdai uhA~ko mAtra bhakti gara ra uhA~sita mAga | uhA~sa~ga sRSTiharUmadhye kasailAI sAjhedAra nabanAU | sabai sRSTiharUkA pAlanakartA allAhakai lAgi sabai prazaMsAharU hun |

66 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! bhanidinuhos: allAhale malAI yasa kurAbATa manAhI garnubhaeko cha ki ma timIharUle pUjA garne mUrtiharUko pUjA garu~, jo na phAidA puryAuna sakchan na hAni nai | yasako pUjA galata ho bhanne pramANaharU pani ma samakSa AisakekA chan | ma allAhako mAtra AjJApAlana garu~ bhanne Adeza malAI mileko cha | kinabhane uhA~ sabai prANIharUkA pAlanakartA hunuhuncha, uhA~ bAheka kohI pAlanakartA hoina |

67 allAhale nai timIharUkA purkhA Adama (alaihissalAma) lAI mATobATa sRSTi garnubhayo | pheri timIharUko sRSTiko krama viryabATa calAunubhayo | uhA~le viryabATa ragatako Dallo banAunuhuncha, pheri timIharUlAI AmAko garbhabATa sAno zizuko rUpamA nikAlnuhuncha | pheri timIharUkA zarIralAI baliyo pArnuhuncha ani ThUlo banAera buDhesakAlamA puryAunuhuncha | timIharUmadhye kohI tyasaaghi nai marcha, kohI euTA nizcita avadhi pUrA garepachi marcha, jasako jJAna allAhalAI mAtra cha | tyasa nizcita avadhibhandA na kama huncha na baDhI | AzA cha timIharU yI pramANaharUbATa pATha liera allAhako zakti ra ekatvalAI svIkAra garnechau |
68 allAhakai hAtamA jIvana ra mRtyu cha | jaba uhA~ kunai kAryako nirNaya garnuhuncha taba bhannuhuncha: “kun” (bhai hAla), ani tyo bhaihAlcha |

69 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! yadi tapAIMle AyataharUbAre vAdavivAda garneharUko mAmilAmA vicAra garnuhuncha bhane tinIharUko avasthAmA Azcarya garnuhuncha, kinabhane satya spaSTa bhae pani tinIharU tyasabATa vimukha hunchan |
70 kurAna ra rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) ko satya sandezalAI jhUTo Thahara garneharUle yasako pariNAmalAI cA~Dai nai jAnnechan ra Aphno narAmro pariNAma dekhnechan |
71 tinIharUle Aphno pariNAma tyatikhera dekhnechan, jaba tinIharUkA ghA~TImA DorI ra pAumA janjIra bA~dhera tinIharUlAI ghisArdai yAtanAtarpha laginecha |
72 tinIharUlAI tAto umleko pAnImA hAlinecha; tyasapachi pheri tinIharUlAI narkako AgomA hAlinecha |
73 pheri tinIharUlAI nindA gari~dai bhaninechaH kahA~ chan timIharUkA tI pUjyaharU jasalAI timIharUle allAhako sAtha bhaktimA sAjhedAra banAekA thiyau?!

74 kahA~ chan timIharUle ThAnekA allAha bAhekakA mUrtiharU, jo nata phAidA dina sakchan, na hAni nai puryAuna sakchan?! kAphiraharUle javApha dinechan: tinIharU hAmIharUbATa harAe | hAmI tinIharUlAI dekhirahekA chainauM | baru hAmIharUle duniyA~mA vAstavika upAsyako upAsanA tathA bhakti nai garenauM | allAhale jasarI yinIharUlAI pathabhraSTa pArnubhayo tyasarI nai hareka yuga ra hareka sthAnamA kAphiraharUlAI pathabhraSTa pArnuhuncha |
75 tinIharUlAI bhaninechaH yo ho tyo yAtanA | timIharU zirkamA khuzI rahane garthyau tyasaile yo yAtanA bhogdaichau |
76 sadhaiM narkamA basne garI tyasamA pasa | vAstavamai ghamaNDIharUko vAsasthAna kati narAmro cha |

jaba rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) lAI uhA~ko samudAyabATa kaSTa pugyo taba allAhale dhairya garne upadeza dinubhayo ra maddata garne vAcA gardai bhannubhayoH
77 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! Aphno samudAyako tarphabATa Aeko kaSTa ra jhUTo Thahara gariekomA dhairya garnuhos | allAhako tarphabATa maddata garine vAcA satya ho, yasamA kunai sandeha chaina | tinIharUlAI diine yAtanAmadhye hAmIle kehI tapAIMko jIvanamai dekhAunechauM, jasto ki badrako dina dekhAyauM vA tyasaaghi nai tapAIMlAI mRtyu dinechauM | mahApralayako dina tinIharU hAmItarpha nai pharke Aunechan | ani hAmIle cA~Dai nai tinIharUlAI tinIharUkA karmaharUko badalA dinechauM ra sadhaiMko lAgi narkamA hAlnechauM |

78 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! hAmIle tapAIMaghi dherai sandeSTArUlAI unIharUkA samudAyatarpha paThAyauM, tara tinIharUkA samudAyaharUle unIharUlAI jhUTA Thahara gare ra kaSTa puryAe | tI rasUlaharUle tinIharUko jhUTo Thahara garekomA ra kaSTa puryAekomA dhairya dhAraNa gare | tI sandeSTAharUmadhye kasaiko satya kathA tapAIMlAI sunAekAchauM ra kasaiko sunAekA chainauM | allAhako cAhanAbinA kunai pani rasUlale camatkAra prastuta garna sakdainan | kAphiraharUle tI rasUlaharUlAI camatkAraharU liera Aune mAga gare, jo atyAcArapUrNa mAga thiyo | rasUlaharU ra unIharUkA samudAyaharUbIca nirNaya vA vijayabAre jaba allAhako Adeza Ayo taba allAhale nisAphakA sAtha nirNaya garnubhayo | kAphiraharUlAI sarvanAza pArnubhayo ra rasUlaharUlAI jogAunubhayo | kAphiraharUle kuphra garera AphUlAI barbAdImA hAlekole tinIharU nai ghATAmA pare |
79 allAhale nai timIharUkA lAgi U~Ta, gAI ra bheDAbAkhrA sRSTi garnubhayo, tAki tImadhye kasaimAthi savArI gara ra kasaiko mAsu khAU |

80 timIharUkA lAgi yI prANIharUmA dherai phAidA chan | yI phAidAharU hareka yugamA baDhadai jAnchan | yI savArIharU sAdhanaharU samaya anusAra vikasita hu~dai jAnchan | yasakA anekauM phAidAharU madhye yo pani ho ki timIharU Aphno manokAmanA pUrA garchau ra jala ra thalamA AphnA sara­sAmAnako DhuvAnI garchau |

81 allAhale timIharUlAI AphnA nizAnIharU dekhAunuhuncha | yI nizAnIharU yasa kurAlAI pramANita garchan ki allAha sAmarthyavAna ra eka mAtra hunuhuncha | ani timIharU allAhakA kuna-kuna nizAnIharUlAI cinisakepachi pani inkAra garchau?!

82 ke yI jhUTA Thahara garneharUle dhartImA ghumaphira garenan ra yasa kurAmA vicAra garenan ki vigatamA jhUTA Thahara garneharUko ke pariNAma bhayo tAki tyasabATa pATha leun?! vigatakA samudAyaharU yinIharUbhandA baDhI dhanI, zaktizAlI ra dhartImA baDhI prabhAvavAlA thie | tara jaba allAhako prakopa Ayo taba tinIharUlAI yI zaktile kunai phAidA puryAena |

83 jaba tinIharU samakSa rasUlaharU spaSTa pramANakA sAtha Ae taba tinIharUle unIharUlAI jhUTo Thahara gare ra Aphnai galata jJAnalAI sahI samjhera khusI rahe | ani tinIharUmAthi allAhako tyo prakopa Ayo jasako tinIharU ThaTTA garne garthe ra jasabATa rasUlaharUle tinIharUlAI DarAekA thie |

84 hAmro prakopa dekhepachi tinIharUle imAna lyAe, jabaki tyasa imAnale tinIharUlAI phAidA puryAena | tinIharUle bhaneH hAmIle mAtra eka allAhamAthi ImAna lyAyauM ra pUjdai garekA sAjhedAra ra mUrtIharUlAI tyAgyauM |

85 hAmro prakopalAI A~khAle dekhepachi lyAeko ImAnale phAidA diMdaina | yo allAhako nIti ho jo vigatakA bhaktaharUmA lAgu bhaisakeko cha | jaba tinIharUle prakopalAI Aphno A~khAle avatarita hu~dai dekhe ra ImAna lyAe taba tyasa ImAnale tinIharUlAI kunai phAidA puryAena | allAhalAI inkAra garera ra prakopa dekhnuaghi ImAna nalyAera kAphiraharUle AphUlAI barbAdImA hAle ra prakopamA parera ghATA khAe |
1 hA. mIma. | yastA akSaraharUko bAremA sUraha al-bakarahako ArambhamA varNana bhaisakeko cha |
2 yo kurAna allAhale avataraNa garnubhayo; jo ati karuNAmaya ra kRpAvAna hunuhuncha |

3 yo yasto kitAba ho jasakA AyataharU pUrNarUpamA spaSTa pAriekA chan | yo kitAba arabI bhASAmA jJAnI mAnisaharUkA lAgi prastuta garieko cha | kinabhane unIharU nai yasakA arthaharU ra yasamA raheko satyatarpha garieko mArgadarzanabATa phAidA uThAuchan |

4 yasamA mominaharUlAI unIharUkai lAgi tayAra pArieko rAmro badalAko zubha­sUcanA diieko cha | kAphiraharUlAI pIDAdAyI yAtanAbATa DarAieko cha, kinabhane tinIharUmadhye adhikAMsa mAnisaharU yasabATa vimukha bhae | tinIharU yasamA rahekA mArgadarzanalAI svIkAra garne garI sunirahekA chainan |

5 tinIharUle bhaneH hAmrA hRdayaharU pardAmA beriekA chan, tyasaile timIle dieko AhvAna bujhirahekA chainauM, hAmro kAnamA buco cha, jasale gardA sunirahekA chainauM, hAmIharU ra timIbIca pardA bhaekole timro kunai kurA hAmI samakSa pugiraheko chaina | timI Aphno tarikA anusAra kArya gara hAmIharU Aphno tarikA anusAra kArya gardaichauM | hAmIharU kadApi timro anusaraNa gardainauM |

6 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! yI zatruharUlAI bhanidinuhos: ma timIharU jastai mAnava hu~, allAhale matarpha prakAzanA garnubhayo, allAha bAheka kohI bhakti­yogya chaina, ani uhA~samma pugne mArga avalambana gara ra AphnA pApako kSamAyAcanA gara | allAhalAI choDera arUko bhakti garne vA allAhako bhaktimA sAjhedAra Thahara garne bahudevavAdIharUkA lAgi vinAza ra yAtanA cha |
7 jo Aphno dhana sampattiko jakAta adA gardainan baru Akhirata ra tyasamA raheko sadhaiM rahane varadAna ra kaDA yAtanAko inkAra garchan |
8 nissandeha allAha ra uhA~ko rasUlamAthi ImAna lyAune ra satkarma garne mominaharUkA lAgi kahilyai samApta nahune ra sadA sarvadA rahane badalA svarga ho |

9 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! bahudevavAdIharUko nindA gardai bhannuhos: timIharUle allAhalAI inkAra kina gardaichau? jasale timIharUkA lAgi duI dina aitavAra ra somavArako dina pRthvIko sRSTi garnubhayo! ke timIharU allAhako lAgi samakakSI banAu~chau ra tinIharUko bhakti garchau?! allAha nai sabai sRSTiharUkA pAlanakartA hunuhuncha |

10 allAhale nai pRthvIlAI aDiga rAkhna ThUlA-ThUlA pahADaharU banAunubhayo, jasale pRthvIko santulana kAyama rAkheko cha ra tyasalAI hallinabATa bacAeko cha | uhA~le pRthvIlAI barakata vAlA banAunubhayo ra tyasakA bAsIharUlAI bhalAi pradAna garnubhayo | cAra dinamA mAnisaharU ra janAvaraharUko jIvikA nirdhAraNa garnubhayo | yI cAra dinamA aitavAra somavArasahita thapa maGagalavAra ra budhavAra zAmela chan | yasako bAremA praznakartAharUkA lAgi sahI javApha ho |

11 pheri allAhale AkAzalAI sRSTi garne nIyata garnubhayo, jo dhuvA~ thiyo | allAhale AkAza ra pRthvIlAI bhannubhayoH cAhera hos vA nacAhera hos, timIharU mero Adezako pAlanA gara | timIharUko lAgi arU kunai upAya chaina | duvaile bhaneH hAmIharUle cAhera AjJApAlana garyauM | he hAmrA pAlanakartA! tapAIMko cAhanA anusAra nai hAmro cAhanA cha |

12 allAhale AkAzako sRSTi 2 dina bihivAra ra zukravArako dina pUrA garnubhayo | yasarI AkAzaharU ra pRthvIko sRSTi cha dinamA pUrA bhayo | allAhale pratyeka AkAzako bhAgya, bhakti ra AjJApAlana tyasatarpha vahI garnubhayo | hAmIle sAMsArika AkAzalAI tArAharUbATa susajjita garyauM ra zaitAnale lukichipI kehI sunna napAos bhanera tArAharUdvArA surakSita pAryauM | uparyukta sabai kurAharU allAhale bhAgyamA lekhnubhayo, jo prabhutvazAlI hunuhuncha, jasamAthi kohI vijayI huna sakdaina | uhA~ sRSTiharUkA sabai kurAharU jAnnuhuncha |

13 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! tapAIMle lyAunubhaeko sandezamAthi ImAna lyAunabATa yadi yinIharU vimukha hunchan bhane bhanidinuhos: maile timIharUlAI tyasto prakopabATa sAvadhAna garisakeko chu, jasto prakopa hUda (alaihissalAma) ko samudAya Ada ra sAleha (alaihissalAma) ko samudAya samUdamAthi Aeko thiyo jaba tinIharUle jhUTo Thahara garekA thie |

14 tinIharU samakSa eka pachi arko rasUla euTai sandeza liera Ae, unIharU sabaile Adeza die– mAtra eka allAhako bhakti gara | tinIharUmadhye kAphira (avajJAkArI) harUle bhaneH yadi allAhale rasUla paThAunu nai thiyo bhane uhA~le phariztAharUmadhye paThAunu parne thiyo | timI hAmIharU jastai mAnava hau, tyasaile hAmI timIle lyAeko sandezako inkAra garchauM |

15 hUda (alaihissalAma) ko samudAya Adale allAhako inkArako sAtha sAthai dhartImA binA adhikAra ghamaNDa garyo ra AphnA varipari rahekA mAnisaharUmAthi atyAcAra pani garyo | Aphno zaktibAre dhokA khA~dai bhanyoH hAmIbhandA zaktizAlI kohI pani chaina | allAhale yinIharUlAI javApha dinubhayoH ke yinIharUle jAnenan ra dekhenan ki allAhale nai tinIharUlAI sRSTi garnubhayo ra tinIharU juna zaktimAthi ghamaNDa gardaichan tyo zakti pradAna garnubhayo; yasarI allAha tinIharUbhandA baDhI zaktizAlI hunuhuncha?! hUda (alaihissalAma) le lyAekA camatkAraharUko tinIharUle inkAra gare |

16 hAmIle tinIharUmAthi Dara lAgdo AvAja bhaeko hAvAhurIko prakopa paThAyauM; tI dinaharU unIharUkA lAgi yAtanAko kAraNa azubha thie | tAki hAmIle lokamA tinIharUlAI apamAnajanaka prakopako svAda cakhAauM | paralokamA tinIharUkA lAgi yasabhandA baDhI apamAnajanaka yAtanA cha, jasako tinIharU pratIkSA gardaichan | yasa yAtanAbATa nikAlne kunai sahayogI tinIharUle pAune chainan |

17 sAleha (alaihissalAma) ko samudAya samUdalAI hAmIle satyalAI spaSTa pArera mArgadarzana diyauM, tara tinIharUle satyamAthi asatyalAI grAhayatA diera pathabhraSTa bhae | ani apamAnajanaka prakopako ThUlo svarale tinIharUlAI sarvanAza pAryo, kinabhane tinIharU kuphra ra avajJA gardai thie |

18 hAmIle tI mAnisaharUlAI tinIharUko samudAyamAthi Aeko prakopabATa jogAyauM, jo allAha ra uhA~kA rasUlaharU (alaihimussalAma) mAthi ImAna rAkhdathe ra allAhakA AdezaharUko pAlanA garera tathA uhA~le manAhI garnubhaekA kAryaharUbATa bacera Izabhaya rAkhekA thie |
19 tyasa dina allAhale AphnA zatruharUlAI narkatarpha jammA garnuhunecha | tinIharUle narkakA phariztAlAI surudekhi antasamma pukArnechan, tinIharU narkabATa bhAgne sthitImA hune chainan |

20 jaba tinIharU hA~kiera narkasamma lyAinechan taba saMsAramA garekA kAryabATa inkAra garnechan, tara tinIharUle lokamA garekA kuphra ra avajJAko bAremA tinIharUkA kAna, A~khAharU ra chAlAharUle tinIharU viruddha gavAhI dinechan |

21 kAphiraharUle AphnA chAlAlAI bhannechan: hAmIle lokamA garekA kAryaharUko bAremA timIharU kina gavAhI diMdaichau?! chAlAharUle javApha dinechan: pratyeka vastulAI bolne zakti dine allAhale nai hAmIlAI bolne zakti pradAna garnubhayo | uhA~le nai pahilo paTaka lokamA timIharUlAI sRSTi garnubhayo ra dosro paTaka uhA~tarpha nai paralokamA hisAba ra badalAko lAgi pharkAinechau |

22 timIharU mRtyupachi hune hisAba, sajAya ra badalAmA ImAna narAkheko kAraNa lokamA avajJA gardA tyasalAI lukAune garthyau, tAki timIharUviruddha timIharUkA kAna, A~khA ra chAlAharUle gavAhI nadeun | sAthai timIharU ke ThAnekA thiyau bhane timIharUle garne kAryaharUlAI allAha dekhirahanubhaeko chaina, baru uhA~bATa lukekAchan, yasarI timIharU dhokAmA thiyau |
23 allAhako bAremA timIharUle rAkheko yahI galata dhAraNAle timIharUlAI barbAda pAryo, ani timIharU loka ra paraloka duvaimA ghATA khAneharUmadhye bhayau |

24 tI mAnisaharU jasako viruddhamA tinIharUkA kAna, A~khA ra chAlAle gavAhI dinechan; yadi tinIharUle sahana garchan bhane pani tinIharUko bAsa­sthAna ra zaraNa­sthala narka hunecha | yadi tinIharUle yAtanA haTAune ra allAhako khuzI prApta garne mAga garchan bhane pani tinIharUlAI tyo prApta hune chaina ra tinIharU kahilyai svargamA jAne chainan |

25 hAmIle yI kAphiraharUkA lAgi zaitAnaharU madhyebATa yastA sAthIharU banAekAchauM, jo sadhaiM tinIharUsa~ga rahane garchan | zaitAnaharUle nai saMsAramA garekA duSkarmaharUlAI sundara banAera dekhAu~chan, ani pachi Aune paralokalAI pani zaitAnaharUle tinIharUkA lAgi sundara banAera dekhAu~chan | ani zaitAnaharU tinIharUlAI AkhiratabATa ra tyasako lAgi karma garnabATa birsAi dinchan | ani tinIharUmAthi prakopa anivArya bhayo jasarI tinIharUaghi mAnava ra jinnako samUhamAthi yo prakopa anivArya bhaeko thiyo | tinIharU mahApralayako dina narkako bhAgidAra AphU pani ghATAmA pare ra AphnA parivAralAI pani ghATAmA pAre |

26 jaba kAphiraharU yI pramANaharUko uttara pramANabATa dina sakenan taba paraspara eka arkAlAI upadeza diMdai bhanna thAleH muhammadale paDhne yasa kurAnalAI nasuna | yasamA raheko kurAko anusaraNa nagara | jatikhera unale kurAna paDhchan tyatikhera hohallA gara | AzA cha yasarI timIharU unI mAthi vijayI hunechau | yasarI unale yasako pATha ra yasatarpha AhvAna choDnechan ra hAmIlAI rAhata milnecha |
27 hAmIle avazya nai mahApralayako dina kAphiraharUlAI kaDA yAtanAko svAda cakhAunechauM | tinIharUle gareko kuphra ra avajJAbhandA pani narAmro badalA hAmIle sajAya svarUpa dinechauM |

28 ukta sajAya allAhakA zatruharUko sajAya ho, jasale kuphra gare ra rasUlaharUlAI jhUTho Thahara gare | tinIharU sadhaiMko lAgi narkamA rahanechan | kinabhane tinIharUle allAhakA AyataharUlAI inkAra gerakA thie ra spaSTa tathA pramANita bhae pani tyasamA ImAna lyAekA thienan |

29 allAha ra rasUlalAI inkAra garekA kAphiraharUle bhannechan: he hAmrA pAlanakartA! hAmIharUlAI pathabhraSTa pArne jinna ra mAnavalAI dekhAunuhos, tyasa iblIsalAI dekhAunuhos jasale kuphra ra tyasatarpha AhvAnako paramparA suru garyo ra Adama (alaihissalAma) ko tyasa santAnalAI dekhAunuhos jasale ragata bagAune paramparA zuru garyo, hAmIle narkamA Aphno khuTTAmuni kulcanechauM tAki narkako sabaibhandA tallo staramA pugun, jahA~ sabai bhandA kaDA yAtanA diinecha |

allAhale AphnA zatruharUko sajAyako varNanapachi AphnA mitraharUko badalAko varNana gardai bhannubhaeko chaH
30 nissandeha juna mAnisaharUle bhaneH hAmrA pAlanakartA allAha nai hunuhuncha, uhA~ bAheka arU kohI chaina, ani aDiga bhaera uhA~kA AdezaharUko pAlanA gare ra uhA~le manAhI garnubhaeko kAryalAI choDe, unIharUmAthi phariztAharU yo bhandai avataraNa hunchan– mRtyu ra tyasapachiko kurAbATa naDarAu, saMsAramA choDeko kurAprati cintA nagara | saMsAramA lyAeko ImAna ra gareko satkarmale gardA timIharUsita vAcA garieko svargako zubhasUcanA cha |

31 hAmI lokamA timIharUkA mitra thiyauM ra tyasaile timIharUlAI sahI bATo dekhAu~thyauM ani timIharUlAI rakSA garthyauM | hAmI paralokamA pani timIharUkA mitra hauM ra hAmro mitratA sadhaiMko lAgi ho | svargamA timIharUle mana parAune, icchA garne ra mAga garne sabai vastuharU hunechan |

32 kSamAzIla pAlanakartAko tarphabATa timIharUko pAhunA­satkArako lAgi khAnekurA tayArI avasthAmA hunechan | nissandeha allAha taubA garne bhaktaharUlAI mApha garnuhuncha ra unIharUmAthi dayA garnuhuncha |

33 tyo vyaktibhandA rAmo kasaiko bhanAi huna sakdaina jo eka allAhako bhakti ra islAmI kAnunako pAlanAtarpha mAnisaharUlAI AhvAna garchan, allAhalAI khuzI pArna satkarma garchan ra bhanchan hAmI AjJAkArI muslima hauM | yI kAryaharU garne vyaktiko kurA nai sarvottama kurA ho |

34 allAhalAI prasanna pArne satkarma tathA AjJApAlana ra uhA~lAI roSa dilAune pApa ra avajJA ekasamAna huna sakdainan | narAmro vyavahAra garne mAnisaharUko duSkAryako javAphamA rAmro vyavahAra gara | yasa prakArako rAmro vyavahArale zatruharUlAI nikaTatama mitra banAi dinecha |
35 yasto sadavyavahAra garne avasara tyastA dhairyavAna ra bhAgyazAlIharUlAI mAtra prApta huncha jo duHkha ra kaSTamA dhairya garchan | kinabhane yasamA dherai bhalAi ra phAidA chan |
36 jahile pani zaitAnale duSkarma garna prerita garcha bhane allAhalAI rAmrarI yAda gara ra uhA~ko zaraNa khoja | uhA~ timro kurA sunnuhuncha ra timro avasthAlAI jAnnuhuncha |

37 allAha mahAna ra ekamAtra hunuhuncha bhanne kurAko nizAnIharUmadhye– rAta ra dina pAlaipAlo Aunu, ani sUrya ra candramA pani hun | he mAnava ho! timIharUle na sUryako upAsanA (sajdA) gara na candramAko upAsanA (sajdA) gara, baru mAtra tyasa allAhako upAsanA tathA sajdA gara jasale yI sabailAI sRSTi garnubhayo, yadi timIharU allAhako vAstavika bhakta hau bhane |

38 yadi tinIharU ghamaNDa garchan, vimukha hunchan ra vAstavika sRSTikartA allAhako bhakti gardainan bhane allAhanajika rahekA phariztAharU dina rAta ekasAtha allAhako pavitratAko guNagAna ra prazaMsA gardaichan | unIharU kahilye dikka mAndainan |

39 allAha mahAna tathA ekamAtra hunuhuncha ra uhA~le mRtyu pazcAta pani punaH jIvita pArne sAmarthya rAkhnuhuncha bhanne kurA pramANita garne nizAnIharUmadhye hun– tapAIM AphnA A~khAle sukhkhA bhUmi dekhnuhuncha, varSA bhaepachi tyasamA bAlInAlI lahalahAuna thAlchan | juna allAha yI bAlInAlIlAI jIvita pArne sAmarthya rAkhnuhuncha, uhA~le mAnavalAI hisAba ra badalAko lAgi punaH jIvita garna saknuhunecha | uhA~ hareka kAryako sAmarthya rAkhnuhuncha | mRta bhUmilAI jIvita pArna ra mRta mAnisaharUlAI jIvita pArera unIharUkA cihAnabATa nikAlnabATa uhA~lAI kasaile rokna sakdaina |

40 jo mAnisaharUle hAmrA AyataharUlAI inkAra garera, tinalAI jhUTo Thahara garera ra tinamA pherabadala garera tinalAI baGgyAuna cAhanchan hAmI tyastA mAnisaharUko avasthAsita avagata chauM | ke mahApralayako dina narkamA jAneharU uttama chan vA yAtanAbATa surakSita rahaneharU uttama chan? he mAnava ho! hAmIle timIharU samakSa bhalAi ra nikRSTatA spaSTa pArisakekA chauM, aba timIharUko icchA, bhalAiko kArya gara vA duSkarma gara | timIharU yI kAryaharUmadhye je gare pani allAhale tyasalAI dekhirahanu huncha | timIharUko kunai pani kArya uhA~bATa lukeko chaina |

41 allAhako tarphabATa Aeko kurAnalAI inkAra garneharUlAI mahApralayako dina yAtanA diinecha | nissandeha yo pratiSThata ra surakSita kitAba ho | kunai pherabadala garnele tyasamA pherabadala garna sakdaina |

42 tyasamA kamI garne vA thapane vA pherabadala garne kunai pani asatya nata agADibATa Auna sakcha, na pachADibATa | yasalAI tyasa allAhale avataraNa garnubhayo jo sRSTi garna, bhAgya nirdhAraNa garna ra kAnuna banAunamA tatvadarzI ra hareka avasthAmA prazaMsanIya hunuhuncha |

kitAbalAI jhUTo Thahara garneharUko varNana garepachi allAhale Aphno rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) lAI dhairya ra AsvAzana dilAuna vigatakA rasUlaharU ra unIharUle sAmanA garekA jhUTo Thahara garine, ThaTTA garine ra jhUTo kurA racanA garinebAre batAunu bhayo | allAhale bhannubhayoH
43 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! jasarI tapAIMlAI jhUTo Thahara garidaicha, tyasarI nai tapAIMbhandA aghikA rasUlaharU jhUTo Thahara garie | ataH dhairya dhAraNa garnuhos, nissandeha taubA garne bhaktaharUlAI allAhale mApha garnuhuncha ra Aphno pApamA jiddI garera aDiga rahane ra taubA nagarneharUlAI sajAya dinuhuncha |

44 yadi hAmIle kurAnalAI arabI bhASAmA avataraNa nagarera anya kunai bhASAmA avataraNa gareko bhae, yI kAphiraharUmadhye kasaile bhanne thieH yo kurAna kina spaSTa pAriena tAki hAmI bujhne thiyauM | ke yo kurAna gairaarabI bhASAmA ani yasalAI lyAune arabI hun? he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! yinIharUlAI bhannuhos: yasa kurAnale mominaharUlAI pathabhraSTatAbATa nikAlera sIdhA mArga dekhAu~cha ra unIharUkA hRdayamA rahekA ajJAnatAko rogako nivAraNa garcha | kAphiraharUko kAnamA buco cha ra tinIharU andhA chan tyasaile tinIharUle yasa kurAnalAI bujhdainan | yastA mAnisaharU tI mAnisaharU jastai hun jasalAI TADhAbATa pukArincha ani tinIharU pukArne vyaktiko pukAra kasarI sunna sakchan!

45 hAmIle mUsA (alaihissalAma) lAI taurAta pradAna garyauM, tara tinIharUle tyasamA matabheda gare | tinIharUmadhye kehIle tyasamA ImAna lyAe ra kehIle kuphra gare | yadi allAhako tarphabATa bhaktaharUbIca mahApralayako dina nirNaya garne kurAko vAcA nabhaeko bhae allAhale satyavAdIharUlAI sammAnita garnuhunthyo ra asatyavAdIharUlAI apamAnita garnuhunthyo | nissandeha kAphiraharU kurAnako bAremA hairAna pArne zaGkAmA chan |

46 jasale pani satkarma garcha, tyasako lAbha usailAI prApta huncha | allAhalAI kasaiko satkarmale phAidA puryAu~daina | jasale pani duSkarma garcha, tyasako hAni usaile behornuparcha | sRSTiharUmadhye kasaiko avajJAle uhA~lAI kunai hAni puryAuna sakdaina | allAhale cA~Dai nai sabailAI tinIharUko karmako badalA dinuhunecha | he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! tapAIMkA pAlanakartAle bhaktaharUmAthi atyAcAra garnuhunna, na tinIharUko puNyakarmamA kamI garnuhuncha ra na tinIharUko pApamA thapnuhuncha |

47 mahApralayako jJAna allAhatarpha nai pharkAincha | mahApralaya kahile Aunecha bhanne kurAko jJAna allAhalAI mAtra cha | uhA~ bAheka arU kasailAI yasako jJAna chaina | gAbhAharUbATa niskane phalako jJAna pani allAhalAI mAtra cha | strIle garbha dhAraNa gareko ra zizulAI janma dieko pUrNa jJAna allAhalAI mAtra cha | mahApralayako dina mUrtiharUko pUjA garneharUlAI allAhale sodhnuhunechaH kahA~ chan timIharUle mero bhaktimA sAjhedAra Thahara garekA mUrtiharU? tinIharUle javApha dinechan– tapAIMsa~ga kohI sAjhedAra cha bhanne kurAko gavAhI kasaile pani dina sakdaina |
48 tinIharUle pukArne garekA sabai mUrtiharU harAera jAnechan | tinIharU allAhako yAtanAbATa bhAgera jAna sakdainan bhanne kurAko tinIharUlAI vizvAsa hunecha |
49 mAnava svAsthya, dhana­sampatti, santAna ityAdi jastA varadAnaharU mAgna thakita hu~daina, tara garibI, roga ityAdi lAgemA U allAhako kRpAbATa dherai nirAza huncha |

50 jaba hAmIle mAnavalAI saGkaTa ra rogapachi svAsthya ra dhanasampatti pradAna garchauM taba usale bhanchaH yo mero lAgi ho, kinabhane ma yasako hakadAra chu | ani mero vicAramA mahApralaya Aune chaina | mAnauM yadi mahApralaya Au~cha bhane allAha najika sampannatA ra dhana­samtti pAunechu | ma hakadAra bhaekole jasarI uhA~le yasa lokamA varadAna dinubhayo tyasarI nai malAI paralokamA pani dinuhunecha | allAhale avazya nai kAphiraharUlAI tinIharUle gareko kuphra ra avajJAko bAremA sUcita garnuhunecha ra avazya nai kaDA yAtanA dinuhunecha |

51 jaba allAhale mAnavalAI svAsthya ra vilAsI jIvanako svAda cakhAunuhuncha taba usale uhA~ko smaraNa ra AjJApAlana garna choDcha ra ghamaNDa gardai vimukha huncha | usalAI garibI, roga ityAdi lAgemA allAhasita lAmo prArthanA garna thAlcha ra AphUlAI pugeko saGkaTako nivAraNako lAgi mAga garna thAlcha | allAhale usamAthi kRpA garemA uhA~prati AbhAra vyakta gardaina ra uhA~le kunai saGkaTamA hAlepachi dhairya gardaina |

52 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! yI jhUTA Thahara garne bahudevavAdIharUlAI bhanidinuhos: timIharU malAI batAU, yadi yo kurAna allAhale avataraNa garnubhaeko satya grantha ho ra timIharU inkAra garchau tathA yasalAI jhUTA Thahara garchau bhane allAhako samakSa timIharUko ke hAla holA?! spaSTa ra satya-tathya pramANita bhaisakepachi pani satyasita zatrutA garneharUbhandA ThUlo pathabhraSTa arU ko huna sakcha?!

53 kuraizakA kAphiraharUlAI allAhale cA~Dai nai jagatamA sarvatra phailiekA nizAnIharU dekhAunuhunecha | makkAlAI muslimaharUkA lAgi vijaya garAera uhA~le tinIharUbhitra rahekA nizAnIharU pani dekhAunuhunecha | yahA~samma ki tinIharU samakSa yo kurA spaSTa huncha ki kurAna satya ho, yasamA kunai zaGkA chaina | ke bahudevavAdIharUkA lAgi yo paryApta chaina ki allAhale svayam kurAnako satyatAko bAremA gavAhI dinuhuncha?! allAhako gavAhIbhandA ThUlo gavAhI kasako huna sakcha ra?! yadi tinIharU satyako khojImA chan bhane tinIharUkA lAgi allAhako gavAhI paryApta hunuparcha |

54 jAnirAkha bahudevavAdIharU mahApralayako dina allAhasita bheTa hune bAremA zaGkAmA chan, kinabhane tinIharUle mRtyu pazcAta punaH jIvita pArine kurAlAI inkAra garchan | mahApralayako dinamAthi tinIharUko ImAna chaina | tyasaile satkarma garera tyasako tayArI garirahekA chainan | jAnirAkha, allAha Aphno jJAna ra zaktile sabai vastuharUbAre avagata hunuhuncha |
1 hA. mIma. 2 aina. sIna. kApha. yastA akSaraharUko bAremA sUraha al-bakarahako ArambhamA varNana bhaisakeko cha |

3 he muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! tapAIMtarpha ra tapAIMaghikA sandeSTAharUtarpha allAhale vahI avataraNa garnuhuncha | uhA~ zatruharUsasita badalA linamA prabhutvazAlI evam kArya saJcAlana ra sRSTi garnamA tatvadarzI hunuhuncha |

4 AkAzaharU ra pRthvImA rahekA sabai vastuharUkA sRSTikartA allAha nai hunuhuncha | yI sabaimAthi uhA~kai sattA­zAsana cha | uhA~le nai sabailAI saJcAlana garirahanubhaeko cha | uhA~ Aphno astitva, zakti ra prabhutvamA mahAna hunuhuncha |

5 allAhako mahAnatAle gardA vizAla AkAhazarU cirA parI pRthvIharUmAthi jharna A~TekA chan | phariztAharU bintI gardai uhA~ko pavitratAko guNagAna gardaichan | dhartI bAsIharUkA lAgi allAhasita kSamAyAcanA gardaichan | jAnirAkha allAha taubA garne bhaktaharUkA lAgi ati kSamAzIla ra dayAvAna hunuhuncha |

6 juna mAnisaharUle allAhalAI choDera mUrtiharUlAI AphnA saMrakSaka ra pUjya banAe; allAha nigarAnI gardai tinIharUkA lAgi parkhirahanubhaeko cha | uhA~ tinIharUkA karmaharUlAI lekhdai hunuhuncha ra tyasako cA~Dai badalA dinuhunecha | he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! tapAIM tinIharUkA saMrakSaka hunuhunna | tinIharUle garekA karmaharUko hisAba tapAIMsita liine chaina | tapAIMko jimmevArI sandeza puryAunu mAtra ho |

7 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! jasarI hAmIle tapAIMbhandA aghikA sandeSTAharUmAthi vahI (prakAzanA) paThAyauM tyasarI nai tapAIMmAthi pani arabI bhASAmA kurAna avataraNa garyauM, tAki tapAIM makkA bAsI ra tyasakA varipari rahekA arabakA gAu~ bAsIharU ani tyasapachi saMsArakA sabai mAnisaharUlAI DarAunuhos | tapAIMle mAnisaharUlAI mahApralayako dinabAre sAvadhAna garAunuhos, juna dina allAhale aghillA pachillA sabai mAnisaharUlAI euTA ucca sthAnamA hisAba lina ra badalA dinako lAgi jammA garnuhunecha | mahApralayako dinako AgamanamA kunai sandeha chaina | tyasa dina mAnisaharU duI jamAtamA vibhAjita hunechan | euTA svargamA jAne mominaharUko jamAta ra arko narkamA jAne kAphiraharUko jamAta |

8 allAhale cAhanubhaemA sabai mAnisaharUlAI islAma dharmamA jammA garera euTai samudAya banAunuhunthyo ra sabailAI svargamA praveza garAunuhunthyo | tara allAhako vivekako yo cAhanA bhayo ki uhA~le jasalAI cAhanubhayo islAmamA praveza garAera svargamA praveza garAunubhayo | kuphra ra avajJA garera AphUmAthi atyAcAra garneharUko na kunai mitra hunecha ra na allAhako yAtanAbATa jogAune kunai sahayogI |

9 yI bahudevavAdIharUle allAhalAI choDera anyalAI mitra tathA saMrakSaka banAe | jaba ki allAha nai vAstavika saMrakSaka hunuhuncha | uhA~ bAheka arU kasaile kunai phAidA ra hAni puryAuna sakdaina | uhA~le hisAba ra badalAko lAgi mRtaharUlAI jIvita pArnuhunecha | allAhalAI kasaile vivaza pArna sakdaina |

10 he mAnava! timIharU islAma dharmako maulika vidhAna vA upa vidhAnamA matabheda garchau bhane tyasako nirNAya allAhale nai garnuhuncha | yasako bAremA uhA~ko kitAba kurAna ra uhA~kA rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) ko tarikA sunnatako anusaraNa gara | merA pAlanakartAkA rAmrA guNaharU chan | ma AphnA sabai mAmilAharUmA uhA~mAthi nai bharosA garchu ra taubA garera uhA~tarpha nai pharkanchu |

11 allAhale nai binA kunai aghillo udAharaNa AkAzaharU ra pRthvIlAI sRSTi garnubhayo | uhA~le timIharUkai jAtibATa timIharUkA joDIharU sRSTi garnubhayo | uhA~le timIharUkA lAgi U~Ta, goru ra bheDAbAkhrAko pani joDI banAunubhayo, jasako kAraNa timIharUkA lAgi tinako saMkhyA baDhiraheko cha | allAhale timIharUko sRSTi (vaMza vRddhi) timIharUko eka arkAsa~ga biheko mAdhyamale garnuhuncha | uhA~le timIharUko poSaNa caupAyAharUkA mAsu ra dUdhabATa garnuhuncha | allAha jasto uhA~ko kunai pani sRSTi chaina | uhA~le AphnA bhaktaharUkA kurAharU sunnuhuncha ra unIharUkA karmaharUlAI dekhnuhuncha | uhA~bATa kehI pani lukeko chaina | uhA~le cA~Dai nai sabaikA karmaharUko badalA dinuhunecha, rAmro karmako rAmro badalA ra narAmro karmako narAmro badalA |

12 AkAzaharU ra pRthvIkA khajAnAkA sA~cAharU uhA~ kai hAtamA chan | uhA~ AphnA bhaktaharUmadhye jasalAI cAhanuhuncha dherai jIvikA pradAna garnuhuncha, yasa kurAko parIkSAko lAgi ki unIharU uhA~prati AbhAra vyakta garchan ki kRtaghna garchan? uhA~ jasalAI cAhanuhuncha kama jIvikA pradAna garnuhuncha, yasa kurAko parIkSako lAgi ki tinIharU dhairya garchana ki uhA~le banAeko bhAgyaprati roSa prakaTa garchan | uhA~ hareka kurAkA jJAtA hunuhuncha | bhaktaharUkA hItakA kunai kurA uhA~bATa lukeko chaina |

13 allAhale timIharUkA lAgi tyahI dharma nirdhAraNa garnubhaeko cha, jasako AhvAna ra pAlanAko Adeza uhA~le nUha (alaihissalAma) lAI dinubhaeko thiyo | he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! tapAIMtarpha pani uhA~le yahI sandeza vahI (prakAzanA) garnubhayo | allAhale timIharUkA lAgi tyahI dharma nirdhAraNa garnubhayo jasako AhvAna ra pAlanAko Adeza uhA~le ibrAhIma, mUsA ra IsA (alaihimussalAma) lAI dinubhaeko thiyo | tyo sandezako sArAMza yasa prakAra chaH timIharU dharmalAI kAyama gara ra matabheda nagara | mAtra eka allAhako bhakti garne ra uhA~ bAheka anya pUjyaharUkA pUjA tyAgne tapAIMko AhvAnalAI yI bahudevavAdIharUle mana parAu~dainan | allAha AphnA bhaktaharUmadhye jasalAI cAhanuhuncha cayana garnuhuncha ra Aphno bhakti ra AjJApAlanako avasara pradAna garnuhuncha | AphnA pApaharUbATa taubA garera uhA~tarpha pharkaneharUlAI uhA~ sIdhA mArga dekhAunuhuncha |

14 muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) ko Agamana pazcAta satya-tathya pramANita bhaepachi kAphira ra bahudevavAdIharU vibhinna girohamA vibhAjita bhae | tinIharU atyAcArako kAraNale guTabandI gare | tinIharUko yAtanA euTA nizcita samaya arthAt mahApralayasamma sthagita nagarieko bhae, tinIharUko kuphra ra jhUTo Thahara garnuko kAraNa allAhale pahilA nai tinIharUlAI yAtanA dinuhune thiyo | taurAtakA vArisa yahUdIharU, injIlakA vArisa IsAIharU ra tinIharUpachi yI bahudevavAdIharU muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) mAthi avatarita kurAnako bAremA zaGkAmA chan |

15 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! yasai sIdhA dharmatarpha AhvAna garnuhos ra allAhako Adeza anusAra yasamA aDiga rahanuhos | tinIharUkA galata icchAharUko anusaraNa nagarnuhos | tinIharUsa~ga vAdavivAda hu~dA bhannuhos: maile ImAna lyAe~; allAhamAthi ra tI kitAbaharUmAthi jasalAI allAhale AphnA rasUlaharUmAthi avataraNa garnubhayo | malAI allAhale timIharUbIca nisAphakA sAtha nirNaya garne Adeza dinubhaeko cha | allAha hAmIharU ra timIharU sabaikA pAlanakartA hunuhuncha | hAmIle garne garekA rAmrA vA narAmrA karmaharU hAmrA lAgi chan ra timIharUle garne garekA rAmrA vA narAmrA karmaharU timIharUkA lAgi chan | satya-tathya pramANita bhaepachi hAmIharU ra timIharUbIca kunai jhagaDA chaina | allAhale hAmI sabailAI jammA garnuhunecha | mahApralayako dina hAmI sabai pharkera uhA~tarpha nai jAnucha | uhA~le hAmIlAI hAmrA karma anusAra cA~Dai nai badalA dinuhunecha | ani tyasa dina jhUTA tathA saccA ra satyavAdI tathA asatyavAdIbIca pharaka spaSTa hunecha |

16 juna mAnisaharU jhUTA tarkaharUdvArA muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) mAthi avatarita dharma viruddha bahasa garchan, jabaki mAnisaharU yasalAI svIkAra garisakekA chan; allAha ra mominaharU najika tinIharUkA tarkaharU radda hunechan, kAma lAgne chainan | tinIharUkA kuphra ra inkArale gardA tinIharUmAthi allAhako roSa prakaTa hunecha | mahApralayako dinako kaDA yAtanAle tinIharUkA lAgi parkhiraheko cha |

kAphiraharUkA tarkaharUlAI radda garepachi allAhale kurAnako varNana garnubhayo, jasabATa muslimaharU tarka evam pramANaharU prastuta garchan | allAhale bhannubhayoH
17 allAhale nai satyakA sAtha kurAna avataraNa garnubhayo | yasamA kunai sandeha chaina | uhA~le mAnisaharUbIca nirNaya garnamako lAgi nisApha avataraNa garnubhayo | yinIharUle jhUTA Thahara gareko mahApralaya najika cha, kinabhane hareka Aune vastu najika huncha |

18 mahApralayamAthi AsthA (ImAna) narAkhneharU yasako lAgi hatAra garchan | kinabhane tinIharU hisAba kitAba, badalA ra sajAyamA AsthA rAkhdainan | allAhamAthi ImAna rAkhneharU tyasabATa DarAu~chan | kinabhane unIharU tyahA~ jAnabATa DarAu~chan | yo satya ho bhanera unIharUlAI pUrNa vizvAsa cha, yasamA kunai zaGkA chaina | nissandeha mahApralayako bAremA vAdavivAda garne, jhagaDA garne ra tyasako AgamAmA zaGkA garneharU spaSTa pathabhraSTatAmA chan |

19 allAha AphnA bhaktaharUprati snehI hunuhuncha, jasalAI cAhanuhuncha prazasta jIvikA pradAna garnuhuncha ra jasalAI cAhanuhuncha kama jIvikA dinuhuncha, allAhale yo nirNaya Aphno tatvadarzitA evam dayAko AdhAramA garnuhuncha | uhA~ zaktizAlI hunuhuncha, kohI uhA~mAthi vijayI huna sakdaina | uhA~ prabhutvazAlI hunuhuncha ra AphnA zatruharUsa~ga badalA linuhuncha |

20 jo vyakti satkarma garera paralokako badalA cAhancha, hAmI usako puNyalAI kaiyauM guNA baDhAu~chauM | kinabhane puNya karma dasa guNA dekhi sAta zaya guNA baDhI vA tyasabhandA pani baDhI baDhAincha | jo vyakti saMsAramA mAtra cAhancha tyasalAI usako bhAgyamA lekhieko sabai thoka dinchauM | yasto vyaktiko lAgi paralokamA kunai aMza rahadaina |

21 ke yI bahudevavAdIharUkA lAgi allAha bAheka anya pUjyaharU chan, jasale tinIharUkA lAgi chuTTai dharma banAekA chan, tinIharU zirka garne, halAlalAI harAma garne ra harAmalAI halAla garne kAma garchan jasako anumati allAhale dinubhaeko chaina? vibheda garneharUbIca nirNaya garnako lAgi yadi allAhale euTA samaya nirdhArita nagareko bhae uhA~le tinIharUbIca nirNaya garidinuhunthyo | tara uhA~ tyasa dina nirNaya garnako lAgi sthagita garnuhuncha | zirka ra avajJA garera AphUmAthi atyAcAra garneharUkA lAgi mahApralayako kaDA yAtanA parkhiraheko cha |

22 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! zirka ra avajJA garera AphUmAthi atyAcAra garneharUlAI tapAIMle yAtanAbATa DarAirahekA dekhnuhunecha | pApa garekAle tinIharUlAI avazya nai sajAya milnecha | Darale mAtra tinIharUlAI kunai phAidA puryAune chaina | juna mAnisaharUle allAha ra uhA~kA rasUlaharUmAthi ImAna lyAe, satkarma gare ra duSkarma garenan, unIharU svargakA bagaiMcAharUmA mojamastImA hunechan | unIharU je icchA garnechan allAhako samakSa kahile samApta nahune varadAna pAunechan | tyo mahAna kRpA ho, tyo jasto kRpA arU kunai huna sakdaina |

23 yo ho mahAna zubhasUcanA, jo allAhale AphnA rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) ko mAdhyamabATa satkarmI momaminaharUlAI dinubhaeko cha | he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! bhanidinuhos: maile gareko AhvAnako badalAmA timIharUsita kunai pratidAna mAgdina | a~ timIharUkai euTA phAidA ke cAhanchu bhane nAtedArIle gardA timIharU masa~ga mAyA gara | jasale puNyakarma garcha maile usako pratidAnalAI kaiyauM guNA baDhAidinechu, euTA puNyalAI dasa guNA baDhAunechu | allAhale taubA garne bhaktaharUkA pApaharU mApha garnuhunecha | allAhako prasannatA prApta garnako lAgi unIharUle garekA satkarmaharUko kadara garnuhuncha |

24 bahudevavAdIharUle bhanne garthe ki muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) le AphaiM yo kurAna racera yasalAI allAhako tarphabATa avataraNa bhaeko ho bhanchan | allAhale yasa kurAlAI khaNDana gardai bhannubhayoH yadi tapAIMle AphaiM racanA garne kosisa gareko bhae pani maile tapAIMko hRdayamAthi mohara lagAune thie~, tapAIMle racanA gareko asatya kurAlAI meTAune thie~ ra satyalAI kAyama rAkhne thie~ | tara allAhale yasto garnu bhaena, jasabATa yo kurA pramANita huncha ki nabI (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) satya hunuhuncha ra uhA~tarpha avatarita kurAna allAhale vahI (prakAzanA) garnubhae ho | nissandeha uhA~ bhaktaharUkA manakA kurAharU jAnnuhuncha, uhA~bATa kehI pani lukeko chaina |

25 allAha nai bhaktaharUkA taubA (pazcAttApa) svIkAra garnuhuncha, jaba unIharU kuphra ra avajJAbATa taubA garchan | uhA~le nai unIharUle garekA pApaharUlAI mApha garnuhuncha | uhA~ timIharUle garekA kAryaharU jAnnuhuncha ra tyasako badalA dinuhunecha |

26 allAhale uhA~ ra uhA~ko rasUlaharUmAthi ImAna lyAera satkarma garne satkarmI mominaharUko duA sunnuhuncha ra unIharUle namAgekA kRpA pani thapera dinuhuncha | jabaki allAha ra uhA~kA rasUlaharUlAI inkAra garne kAphiraharUkA lAgi mahApralayako dinako kaDA yAtanA parkhirAkheko cha |

27 yadi allAhale sabai bhaktaharUlAI dherai jIvikA dinubhaemA tinIharUle dhartImA atyAcAra garera AtaGka maccAune thie | tara allAha jasarI cAhanuhuncha dherai vA thorai jIvikA avataraNa garnuhuncha | allAhale bhaktaharUkA avasthAlAI jAnnuhuncha ra dekhnuhuncha ani Aphno viveka anusAra kasailAI dherai ra kasailAI thorai jIvikA pradAna garnuhuncha |

28 allAhale nai bhaktaharUmAthi pAnI barsAunuhuncha jabaki tinIharU tyasabATa nirAza bhaisakekA hunchan | allAhale yo varSA barsAepachi dhartIle bAlInAlI umArcha | uhA~ nai bhaktaharUkA mAmilAharUkA mAlika hunuhuncha ra hareka avasthAmA prazaMsanIya hunuhuncha |

29 allAhako zakti ra uhA~ nai eka mAtra upAsya hunuhuncha bhanne kurAkA pramANaharU madhyeko AkAzaharU ra pRthvIko sRSTi ani tyasamA rahekA nAnAtharIkA prANIharU pani hun | uhA~ tinIharUlAI jammA garna ra badalA dina jahile cAhanuhuncha tyasako sAmarthya rAkhnuhuncha | jasarI pahile paTaka sRSTi garnabATa uhA~lAI kasaile viphala pArna sakena tyasarI nai yasabATa pani kasaile viphala pArna sakdaina |

30 he mAnava ho! timIharUko jIudhanamA je jati hAni pugcha tyo timIharUko pApale gardA nai pugcha | allAhale timIharUkA dherai pApaharU mApha garnuhuncha | tI pApaharUle gardA timIharUko pakaDa garnuhunna |
31 allAhale timIharUko pakaDa garna cAhemA timIharU katai bhAgera bacna sakdainau | timIharUle AphnA mAmilAharUko jimmevArI line kunai mitra ra yAtanAbATa jogAune kunai sahayogI pAu~dainau |
32 allAhako zakti ra uhA~ nai eka mAtra upAsya hunuhuncha bhanne kurAkA pramANaharU madhyeko samudramA calirahekA pahADa jastA aglA pAnI­jahAjaharU pani hun |

33 allAhale cAhanubhaemA yI jahAjaharUlAI calAune hAvAlAI banda garna saknuhuncha, ani tI jahAjaharU samudramA nai rokinechan | nissandeha jahAjako sRSTi ra hAvAko niyantraNamA duHkha ra kaSTamA dhairya garne ra varadAnamA AbhAra vyakta garneharUkA lAgi allAhako prabhutvakA spaSTa pramANaharU chan |

34 allAhale cAhanubhaemA mAnisaharUko pApale gardA hAvAhurI paThAera tI jahAjaharUlAI naSTa garna saknuhuncha | tara uhA~ dherai mAnisaharUkA pApaharUlAI mApha garnuhuncha, tyasako kAraNale sajAya dinuhunna |

35 allAhakA nizAnIharUlAI inkAra garnako lAgi tyasako bAremA vAdavivAda garneharUle tI jahAjaharU naSTa hu~dA yasa kurAlAI jAnnechan ki yasa sarvanAzabATa jogina kunai bhAgne sthAna chaina | ani tyatikhera tinIharUle allAhalAI mAtra pukArnechan ra bA~kI sabailAI choDnechan |

36 he mAnava ho! timIharUlAI je jati dhana­sampatti, sammAna ra santAna diieko cha tI sabai sAMsArika sara­sAmAna mAtra hun, jo eka dina samApta hunechan | sadhaiM rahane varadAna ta svargakA varadAnaharU hun jasalAI allAhale tyastA mAnisaharUkA lAgi tayAra pArnubhaeko cha jo allAha ra uhA~kA rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) mAthi ImAna rAkhchan ra sabai mAmilAmA allAhamAthi mAtra bharosA garchan |

37 jo ThUlA pApaharUbATa bacne garchan, kasaile Aphno kurA vA karmabATa kaSTa puryAemA risa uThdA uThdai pani usalAI mApha garchan, tyasako sajAya di~dainan | tinIharUle kRpA gardai mApha garchan, yadi tyasamA bhalAI ra hita huncha bhane |

38 yastA mAnisaharU allAhakA Adezako pAlanA garera ra uhA~le manAhI garnubhaekA kArya tyAgera uhA~kA AjJApAlana garchan | unIharU pUrNarUpamA salAha (namAja) kAyama garchan | unIharU mahatvapUrNa mAmilA paraspara sara­sallAhale garchan | allAhako prasannatA prApta garnako lAgi allAhale pradAna garnubhaekA dhana­sampattibATa kharca garchan |

39 unIharUmAthi kasaile atyAcAra garemA Atma sammAnako lAgi satyakA sAtha badalA linchan, yadi atyAcArI mAphIko yogya hu~daina bhane Usa~ga badalA linu ucita cha, vizeSarUpamA jaba mApha garnamA hita hu~daina |

40 jasale Aphno haka (badalA) lina cAhancha tyasalAI yasako adhikAra cha tara jati atyAcAra garieko cha tyati mAtra lina milcha, tyasabhandA baDhI lina mildaina | jasale atyAcArIlAI mApha garcha, tyasako badalA li~daina, bhAi bhAibIca sandhi garcha bhane tyasako pratidAna allAhakahA~ pAunecha | nissandeha allAhale atyacArIharUlAI mana parAunuhunna jo mAniharUharUmAthi, tinIharUkA dhana­sampattimAthi ra tinIharUkA sammAnamAthi atyAcAra garchan |
41 juna mAnisaharUle AphUmAthi bhaeko atyAcArako badalA linchan, badalA lieko kAraNa unIharUko pakaDa tathA sajAya hune chaina |
42 pakaDa tathA sajAya tI atyAcArIharUko hunecha jo mAnisaharUmAthi atyAcAra garchan ra dhartImA pApa garchan | yastA mAnisaharUkA lAgi AkhiratamA kaDA yAtanA cha |

43 juna mAnisaharUle arUko atyAcAralAI sahana garchan ra atyAcArIlAI mApha garchan, unIharUko dhairyako rAmro pariNAma samAjamA pani huncha | yo prazaMsanIya kArya ho, yo avasara bhAgyamAnIharUle mAtra pAune garchan |

44 allAhale jasalAI mArgadarzanabATa vaJcita garera apamAnita ra pathabhraSTa garnuhuncha usako kohI mitra hu~daina | kuphra ra avajJA garera AphUmAthi atyAcAra garneharUle jaba mahApralayako dina yAtanAlAI dekhnechan taba kAmanA garnechan– ke saMsAramA punaH pharkera jAne kunai upAya cha, tAki hAmI taubA garauM? he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! tapAIMle yastai gardai gareko tinIharUlAI dekhnuhunecha |

45 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! tapAIMle yI atyAcArIharUlAI narkaagADi ubhyAieko dekhnuhuncha, jaba tinIharU apamAnita hunechan | Darale gardA terso A~khAle mAnisaharUlAI herirahekA hunechan | tyasabelA mominaharUle bhannechan: vAstavamA yinIharU hun ghATA khAneharU, jasale mahApralayako dinako yAtanAmA parera AphUlAI ra AphnA parivAralAI ghATAmA pAre | jAnI rAkha, kuphra ra avajJA garera AphUmAthi atyAcAra garneharU sadA sarvadAko yAtanAmA hunechan |

46 tinIharUkA lAgi mahApralayako dina allAhako yAtanAbATa jogAuna sahayoga garne kohI mitra hune chaina | jasalAI allAhale apamAnita garna cAhanuhuncha usalAI pathabhraSTa garnuhuncha, ani usale satyasamma nirdezana garne kunai mArga kahilyai pAu~daina |

47 he mAnava! DhIlA sustI nagarikana allAhako Adezako pAlanA gara | mahApralayako AgamanabhandA pahile yo kArya gara, kinabhane jaba mahApralaya Aunecha taba kasaile tyasalAI rokna sakne chaina | tyasa dina timIharUlAI zaraNa line ThAu~ milnechaina | timIharU lokamA garekA pApaharUko pani inkAra garna sakne chainau |

48 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! yadi tinIharU hAmro AdezabATa vimukha hunchan bhane hAmIle tapAIMlAI tinIharUkA lAgi saMrakSaka banAera paThAekA chainauM | tapAIMko jimmebArI hAmro sandeza puryAunu mAtra ho | hisAba lene jimmA hAmImAthi cha | jaba hAmI mAnavalAI sampannatA ra svAthya ityAdi jastA dayA garchauM taba U prasanna huncha | jaba mAnavalAI usako pApale gardA kunai kaSTa pugcha taba U allAhakA varadAnaprati kRtaghna huncha, AbhArI hu~daina | allAhale je jati roSa prakaTa garnu bhAgyamA lekhnubhayo tyasamA pani kunai rahasya lukeko cha |

49­50 AkAzaharU ra pRthvIko sattA­zAsana allAhakai hAtamA cha | uhA~le je cAhanuhuncha, puliGga, strIliGaga vA anya sRSTi garnuhuncha | jasalAI cAhanuhuncha chorIharU mAtra pradAna garnuhuncha ra chorAharUbATa vaJcita rAkhnuhuncha ra jasalAI cAhanuhuncha chorAharU mAtra pradAna garnuhuncha ra chorIharUbATa vaJcita rAkhnuhuncha | vA jasalAI cAhanuhuncha chorA ra chorI duvai pradAna garnuhuncha | uhA~ jasalAI cAhanuhuncha bA~jho banAunuhuncha, kunai santAna janma dina sakdaina | je jati hu~daicha ra je jati bhaviSyamA hunecha sabai kurAko jJAna allAhalAI cha | yI sabai uhA~ko pUrNa jJAna ra tatvadarzitAle huncha | uhA~bATa kehI lukeko chaina ra uhA~lAI kasaile vivaza pArna sakdaina |

49­50 AkAzaharU ra pRthvIko sattA­zAsana allAhakai hAtamA cha | uhA~le je cAhanuhuncha, puliGga, strIliGaga vA anya sRSTi garnuhuncha | jasalAI cAhanuhuncha chorIharU mAtra pradAna garnuhuncha ra chorAharUbATa vaJcita rAkhnuhuncha ra jasalAI cAhanuhuncha chorAharU mAtra pradAna garnuhuncha ra chorIharUbATa vaJcita rAkhnuhuncha | vA jasalAI cAhanuhuncha chorA ra chorI duvai pradAna garnuhuncha | uhA~ jasalAI cAhanuhuncha bA~jho banAunuhuncha, kunai santAna janma dina sakdaina | je jati hu~daicha ra je jati bhaviSyamA hunecha sabai kurAko jJAna allAhalAI cha | yI sabai uhA~ko pUrNa jJAna ra tatvadarzitAle huncha | uhA~bATa kehI lukeko chaina ra uhA~lAI kasaile vivaza pArna sakdaina |

51 allAhale mAnavasa~ga ki ta vahI (prakAzanA) dvArA kurA garnuhuncha ki ta saGketadvArA, vA mAnavale allAhalAI nadekhikana mAtra uhA~ko kurA sunna sakcha, vA uhA~le jibrIla (alaihissalAma) jasto phariztA dUtako rUpamA paThAuna saknuhuncha, jasale allAhako anumatile mAnava rasUlalAI vahI garchan | allAha je cAhanuhuncha vahI garnuhuncha, uhA~ Aphno astitva ra guNaharUmA mahAna hunuhuncha ra uhA~ sRSTi garna, bhAgya nirdhAraNa garna ra kAnuna banAunamA tatvadarzI hunuhuncha |

52 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! hAmIle vigatakA sandeSTAharUtarpha vahI (prakAzanA) gare jhaiM tapAIMtarpha pani kurAna vahI garyauM | yasaaghi tapAIMlAI thAhA thiena AkAzabATa avataraNa bhaeko kitAba bhaneko ke ho ra ImAna bhaneko ke ho? tara hAmIle yasa kurAnalAI prakAza banAyauM | AphnA bhaktaharUmadhye jasalAI cAhanchauM yasabATa mArgadarzana garchauM | tapAIM mAnisaharUlAI sIdhA mArga islAmatarpha AhvAna garnuhos |

53 yo allAhako mArga ho; uhA~ AkAzaharU ra pRthvImA rahekA sabai vastuharUko sRSTikartA hunuhuncha ra yI sabailAI saJcAlana garnuhuncha | antataH sabai mAmilAharU pharkera allAhatarpha nai jAnechan, uhA~le nai yI sabaiko bhAgya nirdhAraNa garnuhuncha ra sabaiko saJcAlana garnuhuncha |
1 hA. mIma. yastA akSaraharUko bAremA sUraha al-bakarahako ArambhamA varNana bhaisakeko cha |
2 allAhale kurAnako kasama khAnu bhayo, jasale satyatarpha spaSTa mArgadarzana garcha |

3 he tI mAnisaharU jasako bhASAmA yo kurAna avataraNa gariyo! hAmIle arabI bhASAmA yo kurAna avataraNa garyauM tAki timIharU yasakA arthaharUmA vicAra garna saka, bujhna saka ra yasalAI anya samudAyaharUsamma puryAuna saka |
4 yo kurAna ucca sthAnamA raheko lauhe mahaphUja (surakSita peTikA) mA cha | kurAna vivekale bharipUrNa cha ra yasakA AdezaharU ra manAhi gariekA kurAharU spaSTa chan |
5 ke timIharUle dherai zirka ra avajJA garchau bhanera hAmI kurAnalAI avataraNa nagarauM? hoina, hAmI timIharUmAthi dayA gardai avataraNa garirahanechauM |
6 hAmIle vigatakA samudAyaharUmA kati dherai sandeSTAharU paThAyauM |
7 vigatakA samudAyaharUtarpha junasukai nabI allAhako tarphabATa Ae, tinIharUle unako upahAsa nai gare |

8 antataH hAmIle zaktizAlI samudAyaharUlAI sarvanAza garyauM | ataH unIharUbhandA kama zaktizAlIharUlAI sajilai sarvanAza garna sakchauM | vigatakA samudAyaharUko sarvanAzako varNana kurAnamA bhaisakeko cha; jastaiH Ada, samUda, lUta (alaihissalAma) ko samudAya ra madayana bAsI |

9 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! yadi tapAIMle jhUTA Thahara garne yI bahudevavAdIharUlAI sodhnuhunchaH AkAzaharU ra pRthvIlAI sRSTi kasale gareko ho? tinIharUle avazya yahI javApha dinechan, prabhutvazAlI ra sarvajJa allAhale sRSTi garnubhaeko ho |
10 allAhale nai pRthvIlAI samatala evam upayukta banAunubhayo jasamAthi timIharU khuTTAle hi~Dchau | yasakA pahADaharU ra upatyakAharUmA bAToghATo banAunubhayo, tAki timIharU mArga bheTAuna saka |

11 jasale AkAzabATa pAnI barsAunuhuncha jo timIharU, timIharUkA caupAyAharU ra khetIharUko lAgi paryApta huncha | tyasai pAnIbATa uhA~le sukeko dhartIlAI jIvita pArnuhuncha | jasarI uhA~le yI mRta dhartIharUkA bAlI-nAlIharUlAI jIvita pArnubhayo tyasarI nai timIharUko mRtyupachi timIharUlAI pani punaH jIvita garnuhunecha |

12 jasale vibhinna tharIkA vastuharU sRSTi garnubhayo; jastaiH rAta, dina, bhAle, pothI ityAdi | uhA~le timIharUkA lAgi pAnI jahAja, caupAyAharU sRSTi garnubhayo jasamA timIharU savAra bhaera yAtrA garchau | pAnI jahAjabATa jalamA ra caupAyAharUmAthi thalamA |

13 yI sabai allAhale garnubhayo tAki timIharU tyasamA basera yAtrA gara | yAtrAko lAgi tinIharUmA savAra hu~dA allAhako yasa varadAnalAI smaraNa gara ki uhA~le timIharUkA lAgi yI savArIharU niyantraNamA garidinubhayo ra Aphno mukhale prArthanA gara– pavitra hunuhuncha allAha, jasale yasa savArIlAI mero niyantraNamA dinubhayo, jasale gardA hAmI cAhanA anusAra prayoga garchauM | uhA~le niyantraNamA nagaridieko bhae hAmI yasamAthi niyantraNa garna sakne thienauM |
14 nissandeha, mRtyupachi hisAba kitAba ra badalAko lAgi hAmI pharkera AphnA pAlanakartAtarpha nai jAnucha |

15 bahudevavAdIharUle ke ThAnekA thie bhane kehI prANIharU allAhadvArA janma liekA chan | ani tinIharUle bhaneH phariztAharU allAhakI chorIharU hun | nissandeha yasto bhanne vyaktile spaSTarUpamA kuphra garcha ra U pathabhraSTa pani cha |

16 he bahudevavAdIharU ho! ke allAhale Aphno sRSTikA cIjaharUlAI Aphno chorI banAunubhayo ra timIharUlAI vizeSarUpa chorAharU dinubhayo bhanne kurA garchau?! timIharUle dAbI gareko yo kasto vibhAjana ho?!
17 jaba tinIharUmadhye kasailAI chorI janmeko zubhasUcanA diincha taba usako anuhAra cintAle kAlo huncha ra usalAI bessarI risa uThcha | ani kuna AdhAramA usale allAhako lAgi chorI hune kurA bhancha?
18 ke tinIharU allAhako lAgi chorI banAu~chan jasako pAlana poSaNa garagahanAmA huncha ra jo vAda vivAda hu~dA strI bhaekole Aphno kurA spaSTa garna sakdaine?!

19 tinIharUle karuNAmaya allAhakA bhakta phariztAharUlAI chorI bhane | ke tinIharU unIharUko sRSTi hu~dA tyahA~ upasthita thie jasale gardA unIharU chorI hun bhanne kurA thAhA pAe?! phariztAharUle tinIharUko yo gavAhI lekhnechan, mahApralayako dina tinIharUsa~ga sodhapUcha garnechan ra yasa jhUTako lAgi sajAya dinechan |

20 unIharUle bhAgyako kurAlAI bahAnA banAu~dai bhaneH yadi allAhale nacAheko bhae hAmIle phariztAharUko pUjA garne thienauM | allAhale cAhanubhayo arthAta uhA~le yasailAI mana parAunubhayo | tinIharUsa~ga kunai jJAna chaina, mAtra jhUTo kurA boldaichan |

21 ke hAmIle yI bahudevavAdIharUlAI kurAnabhandA pahile kunai kitAba diekA chauM, jasamA allAha bAheka arUko bhaktilAI jAyaja bhanieko cha?! ani tinIharU tyasa kitAbalAI AtmasAta garekA chan ra tyasabATa pramANa di~daichan |

22 hoina, tyasto kunai kurA chaina | baru tinIharU pUrvajako andho anusaraNalAI pramANa banAu~dai bhanchan: hAmIle AphnA pUrvajaharUlAI euTA dharma tathA mArgamA pAyauM, tinIharUle mUrti pUjA garnegarthe | ani hAmIharU pani tinIharUkai padacinhako anusaraNa gardai yinIharUko pUjA garirAkhnechauM |

23 jasarI yinIharUle jhUTA Thahara gare ra pramANasvarUpa AphnA pUrvajako anusaraNa batAe; tyasarI nai he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! tapAIMbhandA aghikA juna bastimA pani hAmIle rasUla paThAyauM tyasa rasUlakA samudAyakA dhanI aguvAharUle bhaneH hAmIle AphnA pUrvajaharUlAI euTA dharmamA pAyauM | hAmIharU pani tinIharUkai padacinhako anusaraNa garnechauM | yasto kurA bhanne tapAIMko samudAya nayA~ athavA pahilo hoina |

24 tinIharUkA rasUlale bhaneH ke maile timIharUkA pUrvajakA dharmabhandA rAmro dharma lyAe pani timIharUle tinIharUkai anusaraNa garnechau? tinIharUle javApha dieH timI ra timIbhandA aghikA rasUlaharUle lyAeko sandezako hAmI inkAra gardaichauM |

25 tapAIMbhandA aghikA rasUlaharUlAI jhUTA Thahara garne samudAyaharUsita badalA li~dai tinIharUlAI hAmIle sarvanAza garyauM | vicAra garnuhos, kasto pIDAdAyI pariNAma bhayo rasUlaharUlAI jhUTA Thahara garneharUko |

26 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! tyasa samayalAI smaraNa garnuhos; jaba ibrAhIma (alaihissalAma) le Aphno buvA ra samudAyakA mAnisaharUlAI bhaneH allAhalAI choDera timIharU juna mUrtiharUko pUjA garchau tyasasa~ga mero kunai sarokAra chaina |
27 merA sarokAra ta mAtra allAhasa~ga cha, jasale malAI sRSTi garnubhayo | uhA~le cA~Dai nai tyasa sIdhA dharmatarpha malAI mArgadarzana garnuhunecha, jasamA mero hita cha |

28 ibrAhIma (alaihissalAma) le AphUpachi ekezvaravAdako vANI (allAha bAheka kohI pUjya chaina) Aphno pi~DhImA choDe | allAhalAI eka mAnne ra uhA~sa~ga kasailAI sAjhedAra Thahara nagarne mAnisaharU nirantara bA~kI rahe | yasa AzAkA sAtha ki tinIharU zirka ra avajJAbATa taubA garera eka allAhako bhaktitarpha pharkun |

29 yI jhUTA Thahara garne bahudevavAdIharUlAI sarvanAza pArna hAmIle hatAra garenauM, baru lokamA jIvana bitAune avasara diyauM ra tinIharUkA pUrvajaharUlAI pani avasara diyauM, yahA~ samma ki spaSTa kurAna ra rasUla muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) ko Agamana bhayo |

30 jaba yo satya kurAna Ayo, jasamA kunai sandeha chaina; taba tinIharUle bhaneH yo jAdU ho jasabATa muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) le hAmIharUmAthi jAdU gardaichan | hAmIharU yasalAI inkAra gardaichauM, yasamAthi kadApi ImAna lyAune chainauM |

31 jhUTA Thahara garne bahudevavAdIharUle bhaneH allAhale yo kurAna makkA ra tAephakA kunai mahAna vyaktimAthi kina avataraNa garnubhaena, gariba ra anAtha muhammadamAthi nai kina avataraNa garnubhayo?

32 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! ke allAhako kRpAlAI yinIharUle vitaraNa garchan, vA allAha svayaMle? yinIharUle jasalAI cAhun pradAna garun ra jasalAI cAhun vaJcita rAkhun? allAhale nai yinIharUbIca saMsAramA jIvikAlAI vitaraNa garnubhayo ra kasailAI dhanI ra kasailAI gariba banAunubhayo | tAki kehI mAnisaharU anya kehI mAnisaharUko adhinamA rahun | bhaktaharUkA lAgi paralokamA rahekA allAhako kRpA yinIharUle lokamA jammA garirahekA kSaNika dhanabhandA uttama cha |
33 sabai mAnisaharU kuphramA ekamata bhaera euTai samudAya hune AzaGkA nabhaeko bhae hAmIle kAphiraharUko gharako chAnA ra bharyAGlAI cA~dIko banAune thiyauM tAki tinIharU tyasamAthi caDhun |
34 tinIharUlAI chuTa dina ra parIkSAko lAgi hAmIle tinIharUkA gharakA DhokA ra tinIharUle aDesa lAgne sophAlAI pani cA~dIkA banAune thiyauM |

35 tinIharUkA lAgi suna pani banAune thiyauM | yI sabai sAMsArika jIvanakA sara­sAmAna mAtra hun | yI vastuharU TikAu nabhaekAle yinakA phAidA pani thorai hunechan | he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! allAhakA AdezaharUko pAlanA garne ra uhA~le manAhI garnubhaekA kAryaharUbATa bacne Izabhaya rAkhekA mAnisaharUkA lAgi AkhiratakA varadAnaharU uttama chan |
36 jo kurAnabATa vimukha huncha hAmIle tyasamAthi euTA zaitAna tainAta garidinchauM jo usako mitra banna pugcha ra usako pathabhraSTatAmA vRddhi garirahancha |

37 kurAnabATa vimukha huneharUkA zaitAna sAthIharUle tinIharUlAI allAhako dharmabATa rokchan jasale gardA tyastA mAnisaharU allAhakA AdezaharUko pAlanA gardainan ra uhA~le manAhI garnubhaekA kAryaharUbATa bacdainan, tara AphU mArgadarzana pAekA ThAndachan | yasarI tinIharU Aphno pathabhraSTatAbATa taubA gardainan |

38 allAhako smaraNabATa vimukha vyakti mahApralayako dina jaba hAmIkahA~ Aunecha taba kAmanA gardai bhannechaH he mitra! ma ra timIbIca pUrva ra pazcimabIca raheko dUrI bhaemA besa hunthyo | usale tyasa mitrasita ghRNA garnecha |

39 allAhale mahApralayako dina kAphiraharUlAI bhannuhunechaH timIharUle zirka ra avajJA garera AphUmAthi atyAcAra garekole aba kehI hunevAlA chaina | timIharU sabai yAtanAmA eka sAtha hunechau | timIharUle banAekA sAjhedAraharUle timIharUko aMzako yAtanA bhogne chainan |

40 yinIharU sabai satya sunnabATa bahirA thie, satya dekhnabATa andhA thie | he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! ke tapAIM bahirAlAI sunAuna saknuhuncha vA andhAlAI mArga dekhAuna saknuhuncha vA sIdhA mArgabATa khullA rUpamA pathabhraSTalAI mArdarzana garna saknuhuncha?!
41 tapAIMlAI mRtyu diera lagepachi pani tinIharUlAI loka ra paralokamA yAtanA liera badalA line nai chauM |
42 vA tinIharUsa~ga vAcA garieko yAtanAko kehI aMza tapAIMlAI dekhAunechauM | hAmI yinIharUmAthi pUrNa sAmarthya rAkhchauM, kasaile hAmIlAI yasabATa rokna sakdaina |

43 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! allAhale tapAIMtarpha juna vahI (IzavANI) garnuhuncha tyasalAI balapUrvaka samAtnuhos ra tyasa anasAra karma garnuhos | tapAIM satya mArgamA hunuhuncha, yasamA kunai sandeha chaina |
44 yo kurAna tapAIMko lAgi ra tapAIMko samudAyako lAgi sammAna ho | cA~Dai mahApralayako dina yasamAthi ImAna, yasako anusaraNa ra yasatarpha AhvAnako bAremA timIharUsita sodhapUcha hunecha |

45 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! tapAIM AphUbhandA pahile paThAiekA rasUlaharUlAI sodhnuhos: ke rahamAna (allAha) le AphU bAheka anya kunai pUjya IzvaraharU banAunubhayo jasako bhakti gariyos?!

46 hAmIle mUsA (alaihissalAma) lAI camatkAraharU diera phirauna ra usako samudAyakA aguvAharUsamakSa paThAyauM | mUsA (alaihissalAma) le bhaneH ma sabai sRSTiharUkA pAlanakartAko tarphabATa paThAieko rasUla hu~ |
47 jaba mUsA (alaihissalAma) hAmrA camatkAraharU liera tinIharUsamakSa puge taba tinIharUle unako ThaTTA gardai hA~sna thAle |

48 mUsA (alaihissalAma) le lyAekA sandeza satyamA AdhArita chan bhanne kurAkA yastA camatkAraharU hAmIle phirauna ra usakA samudAyakA aguvAharUlAI dekhAyauM, jo vigatakA camatkAraharUbhandA ThUlA thie | hAmIle tinIharUlAI saMsAramA prakopamA grasta garyauM, tAki tinIharUle kuphra tyAgnechan | tara yasako kehI phAidA bhaena |

49 kehI prakopako svAda cAkhepachi tinIharUle mUsA (alaihissalAma) lAI bhaneH he jAdUgara! timI AphnA pAlanakartAsita prArthanA gara | kinabhane timrA pAlanakartAle batAunubhaeko cha, yadi hAmIharU ImAna lyAu~chauM bhane uhA~le prakopalAI samApta pArnuhunecha | yadi uhA~le yasa prakopalAI samApta pArnuhunecha bhane hAmI ImAna lyAunechauM |
50 jaba hAmIle prakopalAI samApta pAryauM taba tinIharUle vacana bhaGga gare ra tyasalAI pUrA garenan |

51 phiraunale Aphno zAsanako dhAka jamAu~dai bhanyoH he merA samudAya! ke ijipTamAthi mero sattA chaina? ani yo nIla nadI mero mahalako talatirabATa bagiraheko chaina? ke timIharU mero sattAlAI dekhdainau ra mero mahAnatAlAI jAndainau?!
53 AphUle paThAeko rasUlalAI allAhale sunakA curAharU kina pradAna garnubhaena, vA phariztAharU unIsa~ga kramabaddha bhai kina avataraNa bhaenan |
54 yasarI phiraunale Aphno samudAyalAI murkha banAyo, ani tinIharUle usako pathabhraSTatAmA usako AjJApAlana gare | tinIharU allAhako AjJApAlanabATa bAhira niskekA mAnisaharU thie |
55 jaba tinIharUle nirantara kuphra garera hAmIlAI krodhita gare taba hAmIle tinIharUsita badalA liyauM ra sabailAI samudramA DubAi diyauM |

56 hAmIle phirauna ra usako samudAyakA aguvAharUlAI pahilA sarvanAza garyauM ra tapAIMko samudAyamA rahekA kAphiraharUko pachi tyastai sarvanAza huncha | ani tinIharUlAI upadeza grahaNa garneharUkA lAgi pATha banAidiyauM | tAki tinIharUle tyastai kArya garera prakopako bhAgI nabanun |

57 jaba allAhale bahudevavAdI ra IsAIharUlAI timIharU ra allAha bAhekakA timrA upAsyaharU narkako indhana bannechau, bhanne kurA bhannubhayo taba he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) tapAIMko samudAyale yo bhandai hohallA garna thAle– hAmIharU yasabATa khusI chauM ki hAmrA upAsyaharU IsA (alaihissalAma) kai darjAmA rahun | tinIharUle IsA (alaihissalAma) pani mUrtiharU jhai~ narkamA jAnechan bhanne kurA ThAne | taba allAhale tinIharUko khaNDana gardai yo Ayata avataraNa garnubhayo– tI mAnisaharU jasako bAremA bhalAiko nirNaya pahilA nai bhaisakyo unIharU (sandeSTAharU) lAI narkabATa TADhA rAkhinecha | allAhako tAtparya mUrtiharUko pUjA jastai unako pUjAbATa pani manAhI garnu thiyo |

58 bahudevavAdIharUle bhaneH ke hAmrA pUjyaharU uttama chan vA IsA (alaihissalAma)?! ibnujjibaarA ra U jastA bahudevavAdIharUle yo prazna satyasamma pugnako lAgi garenan baru vAdavivAda garnako lAgi gare | yinIharU janmajAta nai jhagaDAlu chan |
