59 maryama putra IsA (alaihissalAma) allAhakA euTA bhakta hun | hAmIle unalAI sandeSTA ra rasUla banAera unImAthi varadAna garekA thiyauM | unalAI banI isrAIlako lAgi udAharaNa banAekA thiyauM | yasabATa allAha sAmarthyavAna hunuhuncha bhanne kurA pramANita huncha | jasarI allAhale Adama (alaihissalAma) lAI binA AmAbuvAko sRSTi garnubhayo tyasarI nai IsA (alaihissalAma) lAI binA buvAko sRSTi garnubhayo |

60 he AdamakA santAna! yadi hAmIle timIharUlAI sarvanAza garna cAhemA sarvanAza garna sakchauM ra timIharUko sthAnamA phariztAharU sRSTi garna sakchauM | jo timIharUko vArisa banera allAhako mAtra bhakti garnechan ra uhA~sa~ga kasailAI sAjhedAra banAune chainan |

61 IsA (alaihissalAma) Akhira jamAnAmA mahApralaya Agamanako ThUlo nizAnI hunechan | jaba unI antima samayamA avataraNa hunechan | mahApralayako AgamanamA kunai zaGkA nagara | ma allAhako tarphabATa je jati liera Aeko chu tyasamA mero anusaraNa gara | ma allAhako tarphabATa sIdhA mArga liera Aeko chu jasamA kunai TeDhopana chaina |
62 zaitAnale timIharUlAI bahakAera ra dhokA diera sIdhA mArgabATa pathabhraSTa napAros | nizcaya nai tyo timIharUko khullA zatru ho |

63 jaba IsA (alaihissalAma) AphU rasUla bhaeko spaSTa pramANaharU liera Ae ra Aphno samudAyalAI bhaneH ma allAhako tarphabATa hikmata (tatvajJAna) liera Aeko chu, tAki ma timIharUkA lAgi tI kehI dhArmika kurAharU spaSTa pAru~ jasamA timIharU matabheda garchau | ataH timIharU allAhakA AdezaharUko pAlanA garera, uhA~le manAhI garnubhaekA kAryaharUlAI choDara uhA~sa~ga Dara ra mero Adezako pAlanA gara |

64 allAha nai mero pani pAlanakartA hunuhuncha ra timIharUko pani | uhA~ bAheka kohI pani pAlanakartA chaina | tasartha ekAgratAkA sAtha uhA~kai bhakti gara | eka allAhamAthi ImAna lyAunu nai sIdhA mArga ho jasamA kunai TeDhopana chaina |

65 IsA (alaihissalAma) ko bAremA kehI IsAIharUle matabheda gare | tinIharUmadhye kehIle bhanchan: IsA (alaihissalAma) svayam pUjya paramezvara hun | kohI bhanchan: unI allAhakA putra hun | kohI bhanchan: unI ra unakI AmA paramezvara hun | yastA mAnisaharUkA lAgi mahApralayako dina pIDAdAyI yAtanA cha, jo IsA (alaihissalAma) lAI pUjya paramezvara bhanchan, vA allAhakA putra bhanchan, vA tIna pUjya paramezvaraharU madhyekA tesrA mAnchan |

67 kuphra ra pathabhraSTatAko AdhAramA rahekA mitraharU mahApralayako dina eka arkAkA zatru bannechan | allAhakA AdezaharUko pAlanA garera ra uhA~le manAhI garnubhaekA kAryaharUlAI tyAgera uhA~ko bhaya rAkhneharU bIcako mitratA sadhaiM kAyama rahanecha |
68 unIharUlAI allAhale bhannuhunechaH he merA bhaktaharU! aba timIharU bhaviSyaprati cintita nahoU | timIharUle vigatamA gumAeko sAMsArika aMzako cintA nagara |
70 timIharU ra timIharUkA AsthAvAna sAthIharU svargamA praveza gara | tyasamA sadhaiM rahane varadAnaharUmA ramAU, jo kahile samApta hune chaina |

71 unIharUkA sevakaharU sunakA thAla ra kacaurA liera unIharUkA varipari ghumirahanechan | unIharUkA lAgi svargamA unIharUle mana parAune ra A~khAlAI zItala pArne vastuharU hunechan | timIharU tyasamA sadhaiM rahanechau, kahilyai pani niskane chainau |
72 yahI tyo svarga ho jo allAhale timIharUko satkarmako kAraNale Aphno kRpAle pradAna garnubhayo |
73 tyasamA timIharUkA lAgi kahilyai samApta nahune vibhinna phalaphUla hunechan jo timIharU khAnechau |

allAhale Izabhaya rAkhneharUko varNana garepachi unIharUkA virodhi aparAdhIharUko varNana gardai bhannubhayoH
74 kuphra ra avajJA garekA aparAdhIharU mahApralayako dina sadhaiMko lAgi narkako yAtanAmA rahanechan |
75 tinIharUko yAtanAmA kamI garine chaina | tinIharU allAhako kRpAbATa nirAza hunechan |
76 hAmIle tinIharUlAI narkamA hAlera tinIharUmAthi atyAcAra garenauM baru tinIharUle kuphra garera AphaiMmAthi atyAcAra gare |

77 tinIharUle narkako vyavasthApanamA tainAta phariztA mAlikalAI bhannechan: he mAlika! tapAIMkA pAlanakartAle hAmIlAI mRtyu nai deun, tAki yAtanAbATa mukti milos | mAlikale javApha dinechan: timIharU namarikana sadhaiM nirantara yAtanAmA rahanechau |
78 hAmI saMsAramA timIharUkA lAgi satya liera AekA thiyauM, jasamA kunai zaGkA thiena, tara timIharUmadhye adhikAMsale tyasalAI mana parAenan |
79 yadi tinIharU nabI (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) viruddha calakhela gardaichan bhane hAmIle tinIharU viruddha tyasabhandA ThUlo yojanA banAunechauM |

80 ke tinIharUle Aphno hRdayamA lukAeko bheda vA kAnekhusI gareko bheda hAmI jAndainauM bhanne ThAndachan? kina najAnnu, hAmI tI sabai kurAharU sundachauM ra tinIharUle garirAkhekA kArya phariztAharU lekhi rAkhekAchan |

81 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! allAhakA chorIharU chan bhanneharUlAI bhannuhos: allAhakA kohI santAna chainan, allAha yasto kurAbATa pavitra hunuhuncha | ma sarvaprathama allAhako bhakti garne ra uhA~ko pavitratAko varNana garne vyakti hu~ |
82 AkAzaharU ra pRthvIkA pAlanakartA yI bahudevavAdIharUle bhanne kurAbATa pavitra hunuhuncha | uhA~ko kohI sAjhedAra, patnI ra santAna chaina |

83 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! tinIharUlAI asatyamA magna rahana ra khelakudamA vyasta rahana choDidinuhos yahA~samma ki tinIharU mahApralayako dinalAI dekhnechan jasako vAcA tinIharUsita garieko cha |

84 allAha nai AkAzaharU ra pRthvIkA satya Izvara hunuhuncha | uhA~ sRSTi garna, kAnuna banAuna ra kArya saJcAlana garnamA tatvadarzI hunuhuncha ra bhaktaharUkA avasthAbAre avagata hunuhuncha | uhA~bATa kunai pani kurA lukeko chaina |

85 allAha barkatayukta hunuhuncha mAtra uhA~kai hAtamA AkAzaharU, pRthvI ra yI duvaibIca rahekA sabai vastuharUko sattA cha | mahApralayako jJAna pani mAtra uhA~lAI cha | uhA~ bAheka arU kasailAI yasako jJAna chaina | hisAba ra badalAko lAgi timIharU sabai pharkera uhA~tarpha nai jAnechau |

86 bahudevavAdIharUle pUjA garirahekA pUjyaharU allAha najika siphArisa garne adhikAra rAkhne chainan | allAha bAheka kohI satya pUjya chaina bhanne kurAko gavAhI dineharU mAtra siphArisa garne adhikAra rAkhchan | uhA~ gavAhI dineharUlAI jAnnuhuncha; jastai IsA (alaihissalAma), ujaira (alaihissalAma) ra phariztAharU |

87 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! yadi tapAIMle tinIharUlAI kasale sRSTi garnubhayo bhanne sodhnuhunecha bhane tinIharUle yahI javApha dinechan– allAhale | ani tinIharUle yo svIkAra garepachi kina allAhako bhaktibATa pheridaichan?!

88 rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) le Aphno samudAyaprati garnubhaeko gunAsolAI allAhale rAmrarI jAnnuhuncha | tImadhye yo kurA pani ho– he merA pAlanakartA! tapAIMle malAI juna sandeza diera paThAunubhayo tyasamA yinIharU ImAna lyAirahekA chainan |

89 tapAIM tinIharUlAI vAstA nagarnuhos ra yasto kurA bhannuhos jasale gardA tinIharUko duSTatAbATa surakSA hos | yo makkAmA ghaTeko kurA ho | tinIharUlAI pugne yAtanAlAI tinIharUle cA~Dai nai jAnnechan |
1 hA. mIma. yastA akSaraharUko bAremA sUraha al-bakarahako ArambhamA varNana bhaisakeko cha |
2 allAhale satyasamma puryAune sIdhA mArga spaSTa pArne kurAnako kasama khAnubhaeko cha |
3 nissandeha hAmIle kurAnalAI lailatul-kadrako (sammAnita rAta) mA avataraNa garyauM | yasa rAtamA dherai bhalAi chan | hAmI yasa kurAnadvArA sAvadhAna garchauM |
4 yasa rAtamA varSabharI hune jIvikA, mRtyu ityAdi mAmilAbAre pakkA nirNaya garincha |
5 sabai pakkA nirNaya hAmI Aphno tarphabATa garchauM | nissandeha hAmIle nai rasUlaharUlAI paThAu~chauM |

6 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! tapAIMko pAlanahAra allAhale Aphno kRpA svarUpa mAnisaharUkA lAgi rasUlaharU paThAunuhuncha | nissandeha uhA~ AphnA bhaktaharUko kurAharU sunnuhuncha ra unIharUkA kArya ra nIyatalAI jAnnuhuncha |
7 uhA~ AkAzaharU ra pRthvIkA pAlanakartA hunuhuncha | yadi timIharU yasa kurAmA vizvAsa rAkhchau bhane mero rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) mAthi ImAna lyAU |

8 uhA~ bAheka kohI pani vAstavika pUjya chaina | uhA~le nai jIvana ra mRtyu dinuhuncha | uhA~ bAheka anya kasaile jIvana ra mRtyu di~daina | uhA~ timIharU ra timIharUkA pUrvajaharUko pAlanakartA hunuhuncha |
9 yI bahudevavAdIharU yasa kurAmA vizvAsa rAkhdainan | baru yasako bAremA zaGkAmA chan | tinIharU asatyamA rahekole yasabATa asAvadhAna chan |

10 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! Aphno samudAyamAthi cA~Dai Aune prakopako pratIkSA garnuhos | tyasa dina AkAzale spaSTa dhuvA~ liera Aunecha, jasalAI tinIharUle dherai bhokale gardA AphnA A~khAle dekhnechan |
11 yasa pIDAdAyI prakopale tapAIMko samudAyakA sabai mAnisaharUlAI ghernecha | tinIharUlAI bhaninechaH timIharUmAthi Aipugeko prakopa ati pIDAdAyI cha |

12 ani timIharU tyatikhera bintI gardai bhannechauH he hAmrA pAlanakartA! tapAIMle paThAunubhaeko prakopa hAmIharUbATa haTAi dinuhos | yadi tapAIMle yasalAI haTAunuhuncha bhane hAmIharU tapAIM ra tapAIMkA rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) mAthi ImAna lyAunechauM |

13 aba tinIharU kuna AdhAramA upadeza grahaNa gardaichan ra allAhatarpha pharkadaichan? jaba ki yasaaghi tinIharUsamakSa rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) Aera sandeza spaSTa pArnubhayo, tinIharUle rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) lAI saccA ra amAnatadArako rUpamA pahicAna garisakekA thie!

14 pheri tinIharUle uhA~ (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) ko vizvAsa garnabATa inkAra gare | tinIharUle rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) ko bAremA bhaneH unalAI kasaile paDhAekA chan ra rasUla hoinan | unI baulAhA hun |
15 jaba hAmI timIharUbATa ali yAtanA haTAu~chauM bhane timIharU pheri Aphno kuphra ra jhUDo Thahara garnetarpha pharkanechau |

16 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! tinIharUlAI parkhanuhos, badrako dina tapAIMkA samudAyakA kAphiraharUlAI kaDAikA sAtha samAtnechauM | hAmIle tinIharUsita tinIharUle gareko allAhako inkAra ra rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) lAI jhUTo Thahara gareko badalA linechauM |
17 hAmIle yinIharUaghi phiraunako samudAyako parIkSA liyauM, tinIharU samakSa allAhakA pratiSThata rasUla mUsA (alaihissalAma) Aera tinIharUlAI eka allAhako bhaktiko AhvAna gare |

18 mUsA (alaihissalAma) le phirauna ra usako samudAyalAI bhaneH banIisrAIlalAI masa~ga jAnadeU, unIharU allAhakA bhaktaharU hun | unIharUlAI dAsa banAune adhikAra timIharUlAI chaina | ma allAhako tarphabATa paThAieko rasUla hu~ | malAI juna Adeza puryAune jimmA diieko cha tyasalAI puryAune mAmilAmA ma amAnatadAra chu | ma tyasamA kunai thapaghaTa gardina |
19 allAhako AdezalAI choDera ra uhA~kA bhaktaharUmAthi baDappana garera ghamaNDa nagara | ma timIharU samakSa spaSTa pramANa liera Aeko chu |
20 timIharUle malAI DhuGgA prahAra garera mArnabATa ma mero ra timIharUko pAlanakarta allAhako zaraNa cAhanchu |
21 yadi timIharU maile lyAeko sandezamA vizvAsa gardainau bhane mabATa alaga hoU ra malAI kaSTa napuryAU |
22 mUsA (alaihissalAma) le allAhasita duA gare– phirauna ra usakA samarthakaharU aparAdhI hun ra cA~Dai prakopakA hakadAra hun |

23 allAhale mUsA (alaihissalAma) lAI rAtA-rAta Aphno samudAyalAI liera tyahA~bATa niskane Adeza dinubhayo | phirauna ra usako samudAyale unIharUlAI pachyAune kurAbAre pani unalAI sUcita garAunubhayo |
24 allAhale Adeza dinubhayo– jaba timIharU samudralAI pAra garchau taba dUI bhAgamA bA~Dieko avasthAmA nai choD, kinabhane phirauna ra usako sainika samudramA Dubera sarvanAza hunechan |
25 phirauna ra usako samudAyale katipaya bagai~cA ra bagirahekA mUlaharU choDera gae!
26 tinIharU katipaya khetIharU ra rAmrA sabhAharU choDera gae!
27 tinIharUle katipaya mojamastIkA sAmAnaharU choDera gae, jasabATa tinIharU lAbha uThAune garthe!
28 yasarI tinIharUsa~ga bhayo | tinIharUkA bagaiMcA, mUla, khetI ra sthAnaharUko vArisa banI isrAIlalAI banAyauM |
29 phirauna ra usako samudAya jaba samudramA Dubera sarvanAza bhae taba tinIharUmAthi nata AkAza royo, na dhartI ra na tinIharUlAI taubA (pazcAttApa) garne avasara milyo |
30 hAmIle banI isrAIlalAI apamAnajanaka yAtanAbATa nikAlyauM; jastaiH phirauna ra usako samudAyale unIharUkA chorAharUlAI mArne garthe ra mahilAharUlAI jIvita choDne garthe |
31 hAmIle unIharUlAI phiraunako yAtanAbATa jogAyauM, jo ghamaNDI ra allAhako Adeza ani kAnunako sImA ullaGghanakartA thiyo |
32 hAmIle banI isrAIlalAI Aphno jJAnako AdhAramA unIharUmA dherai sandeSTAharU Aekole unIharUkA yugakA mAnisaharUmAthi prAthamiktA diyauM |
33 hAmIle unIharUlAI pramANaharU diyauM | mUsA (alaihissalAma) lAI spaSTa dekhine pramANaharU; jastaiH manna ra salvA ityAdi varadAnaharU tathA jIvikA pradAna garera maddata garyauM |
34 yI jhUTA Thahara garne bahudevavAdIharUle mutyu pazcAtako punaH jIvanalAI inkAra gardai bhanchan:
35 yo hAmro sadhaiMko mRtyu ho | yasapachi kunai jIvana chaina ra yasa mRtyupachi hAmIlAI punaH jIvita garine chaina |

36 he muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! yadi tapAIM mRtyu pazcAta punaH jIvita hune dAbImA saccA hunuhuncha bhane tapAIM ra tapAIMkA anuyAyIharUle hAmrA pUrvajaharUlAI jIvita pArera lyAunuhos, yadi tapAIMharU allAhale hisAba ra badalAko lAgi tinIharUlAI punaH jIvita pArnuhunecha bhanne dAbImA saccA hunuhuncha bhane |

37 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! ke tapAIMlAI jhUTo Thahara garne yI bahudevavAdIharU baDhI zaktizAlI chan vA tubbaa samudAya ra tinIharUbhandA aghikA samudAya jastaiH Ada, samUda samudAyaharU yinIharUbhandA baDhI zaktizAlI thie, jasalAI hAmIle sarvanAza garyauM, kinabhane tinIharU aparAdhI thie |
38 hAmIle AkAzaharU, pRthvI ra yI duvaibIca rahekA vastuharUlAI vyarthaimA sRSTi garekA chainauM |
39 baru hAmIle yinIharUlAI euTA uddezyako lAgi sRSTi garekA chauM, tara yasa kurAlAI adhikAMsa bahudevavAdIharU jAndainan |
40 nissandeha bhaktaharUbIca nisApha garine vAcA mahApralayako dina ho | tyasadina yinIharU sabailAI allAhale jammA garnuhunecha |

41 tyasa dina ekadamai najikako nAtedArale Aphno nAtedAralAI ra mitrale mitralAI kunai phAidA puryAuna saknechaina ra eka arkAlAI yAtanAbATa bacAuna saknechaina, kinabhane tyasa dina zAsana allAhako mAtra calnecha, kasaile yasako dAbI garna saknechaina |

42 tI mAnisaharUko kurA beglai cha jasamAthi allAhako kRpA hunecha | unIharUle AphnA satkamarbATa phAidA uThAunechan | nissandeha allAha prabhutvazAlI hunuhuncha | kasaile uhA~lAI viphala pArna sakdaina | uhA~ taubA garne bhaktaharUprati dayAvAna hunuhuncha |

mahApralayako varNanapachi tyahA~ mAnisaharUko Aphno karma anusAra vibhAjita hune kurAko varNana gardai allAhale bhannubhaeko chaH
43 nissandeha narkako pi~dhamA allAhale umArnubhaeko jakkuma (siu~DI jasto eka kisimako rUkha) |
44 mahApApI kAphirako lAgi bhojana hunecha, usale yo ghRNita tathA narAmro phala khAnecha |
45 yo phala kAlo tela jasto hunecha jo dherai tAto bhaekole kAphiraharUko peTamA umlanecha |
46 jasarI ati tAto pAnI umlane garcha |
47 narkako vyavasthApanamA tainAta phariztAlAI bhaninechaH yasalAI rAmrarI samAta ra ghisArera narkako bIcamA hAlideU |
48 pherI yasako TAukomAthi tAto pAnI nirantara khanyAU |
49 usalAI apamAnita gardai bhaninechaH cAkha yo pIDAdAyI yAtanA | timI Aphno samudAyamA baDo sammAnita thiyau |
50 mahApralayako dina hune yasa yAtanAko bAremA zaGkAmA thiyau | aba yasalAI dekhepachi timIharUko zaGkA sAmApta bhayo |
51 nissandeha allAhakA AdezaharUko pAlanA garera ra uhA~le manAhI garnubhaekA kAryaharU tyAgera Izabhaya rAkhneharU AphnA bAsa­sthAnamA sabai kisimakA kaSTabATa surakSita ra zAntipUrvaka basnechan |
52 bagaiMcAharUmA ra bagirahekA mUlaharUmA |
53 unIharU svargamA pAtalA ra moTA rezama lagAera Amunne sAmunne basekA hunechan | unIharUle eka arkAkA piThyU~ dekhne chainan |

54 yI sammAnaharU bAheka hAmIle unIharUko bihe svargamA ati sundara mahilAharUsa~ga garAunechauM | jo ThUlA-ThUlA A~khAharU bhaekA hunechan, ani tI A~khAkA setA bhAgaharU ati setA ra kAlA bhAgaharU ati kAlA hunechan |
55 unIharUle AphnA nokaraharUlAI manaparAekA phalaharU lyAuna DAkIrahekA hunechan | unIharUlAI kunai kamI ra hAniko Dara hunechaina |
56 unIharU tyasamA sadhaiM rahanechan | unIharUlAI mRtyule samAtne chaina | pahilo mRtyu juna sAMsArika jIvanamA Ayo | allAhale unIharUlAI narkako yAtanAbATa jogAunuhunecha |
57 svargamA praveza ra narkabATa mukti allAhako tarphabATa kRpA ra upakAra hunecha | yo sabaibhandA ThUlo saphalatA hunecha jasako barAbara saphalatA arU kunai hunechaina |
58 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! tapAIMko arabI bhASAmA yasa kurAnalAI avataraNa garera hAmIle sajilo pArekA chauM, AzA cha tinIharUle yasabATa upadeza grahaNa garnechan |
59 tapAIM Aphno sahayoga tathA vijaya ra tinIharUko vinAzako pratIkSA garnuhos, tinIharU tapAIMko vinAzako pratIkSA gardaichan |
1 hA. mIma. yastA akSaraharUko bAremA sUraha al-bakarahako ArambhamA varNana bhaisakeko cha |

2 kurAnako avataraNa allAhale garnubhayo | uhA~ prabhutvazAlI hunuhuncha kohI pani uhA~mAthi vijayI huna sakdaina | uhA~ sRSTi garna, bhAgya nirdhAraNa garna ra kArya saJcAlana garnamA tatvadarzI hunuhuncha |

3 allAha prabhutvazAlI hunuhuncha ra eka mAtra hunuhuncha bhanne kurAkA kaiyauM pramANaharU mominaharUkA lAgi AkAzaharU ra pRthvImA chan | kinabhane unIharU nai nizAnIharUbATa upadeza grahaNa garne garchan |

4 he mAnava! timIharUlAI viryabATa, tyasapachi ragatako DallobATa, tyasapachi mAsuko cokTobATa sRSTi garnumA ra dhartImA hi~Dne prANIharUmA pani vizvAsa garne mAnisaharUkA lAgi allAha eka mAtra hunuhuncha ra uhA~ nai sRSTikartA hunuhuncha bhanne kurAkA dherai pramANaharU chan |

5 nissandeha dina ra rAtako ekapachi arko pAlaipAlo AvatajAvatamA, allAhale AkAzabATa varSA garAera sukkhA tathA mareko dhartImA boTabiruvAharU umArera punaH jIvita tathA harAbharA pArnumA, tyasaigarI timIharUko phAidAko lAgi kahile eka dizA ra kahile arko dizAbATa hAvA calAunumA buddhimAnaharUkA lAgi yasa kurAkA pramANaharU chan ki allAha eka mAtra hunuhuncha, uhA~le mRtyu pazcAta punaH jIvita pArna sakSama hunuhuncha ra sabai kAryako sAmarthya rAkhnuhuncha |

6 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! hAmI yI nizAnI ra pramANaharU tapAIMlAI satyakA sAtha sunAu~chauM | yadi tinIharU allAhakA vANI ra pramANaharUmA ImAna lyAune chainan bhane yasapachi tinIharU kuna vANI ra pramANaharUmA ImAna lyAunechan ta?!
7 hareka jhUThA ra pApIkA lAgi allAhako tarphabATa yAtanA ra sarvanAza cha |

8 yo kAphirale allAhakA AyataharUlAI suncha; taipani nirantara kuphra ra pApa nai garcha, satyako anusaraNabATa ghamaNDa garcha, mAnauM U samakSa AyataharUko pATha gariekai chaina | he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! usalAI AkhiratamA kaSTa puryAune yAtanAbATa sUcita garidinuhos jo usako lAgi parkhiraheko cha |
9 yastA mAnisaharU kurAnako kehI kurA sunepachi tyasako ThaTTA garchan, yastA mAnisaharUkA lAgi mahApralayako dina apamAnajanaka yAtanA cha |

10 AkhiratamA narkako yAtanAle tinIharUlAI parkhiraheko cha | allAhako mukAbilAmA nata tinIharUlAI tinIharUle Arjana garekA dhana­sampattile phAidA puryAuna sakcha na tI mUrtiharUle tyasa yAtanAbATa bacAuna sakchan jasako pUjA tinIharU garne garchan | mahApralayako dina tinIharUkA lAgi ThUlo yAtanA hunecha |

11 hAmIle Aphno rasUla muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) mAthi avataraNa gareko yo kitAbale satya mArga batAu~cha | uhA~ (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) mAthi avatarita AyataharUko inkAra garneharUkA lAgi kaSTakara yAtanA cha |

12 he mAnava! allAhale nai samudralAI timIharUko niyantraNamA dinubhayo, tAki uhA~ko Adezale tyasamA DuGgA tathA pAnI jahAja calun, tAki timIharU tyasamA halAla jIvikA khoja ra allAhakA varadAnako lAgi uhA~prati AbhAra vyakta gara |

13 allAhale nai AkAzamA rahekA sUrya, candramA tathA tArAharUlAI ra pRthvImA rahekA nadI, rUkha, pahADa ityAdilAI timIharUko sevAmA khaTAunubhayo | yI sabai allAhakA varadAna ra upakAra hun | yI sabailAI timIharUko sevAmA khaTAune kAryamA cintana manana garne ra upadeza grahaNa garne mAnisaharUkA lAgi allAha prabhutvazAlI ra eka mAtra hunuhuncha bhanne kurAko pramANa cha |

14 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! mominaharUlAI bhanidinuhos: allAhakA varadAnaharUko paravAha nagarne kAphiraharUko tarphabATa pugne kaSTalAI vAstA nagarun | nissandeha allAhale dhairya garne mominaharUlAI pani unIharUle saMsAramA garekA satkarmaharUko pratidAna dinuhunecha ra atyAcArI kAphiraharUlAI pani tinIharUle garekA kukarmako sajAya dinuhunecha |

15 jasale satkarma garcha usako satkarmako pratiphala usaile pAunecha | allAhalAI tyasako AvazyaktA chaina | jasale duSkarma garnecha tyasako sajAya usaile pAunecha | tyasako hAni allAhalAI pugne chaina | pheri timIharU sabai AkhiratamA pharkera hAmItarpha nai Aunechau | ani hAmIle timIharU sabailAI timIharUle garekA karmako badalA dinechauM |

16 hAmIle banI isrAIlalAI taurAta, ani tyasa anusAra mAnisaharUbIca nirNaya garne zakti pradAna garyauM, unakA adhikAMsa sandeSTAharU unIharUmadhye ibrAhIma (alaihissalAma) ko santAnabATa banAyauM | unIharUlAI pavitra jIvikA pradAna garyauM ra unIharUlAI unIharUkA yugakA mAnisaharUmAthi prAthamikatA pradAna garyauM |

17 hAmIle unIharUlAI satya asatyabIca pharaka garne pramANaharU pradAna garyauM | hAmrA nabI muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) ko Agamanapachi tathA pramANaharU spaSTa bhaepachi tinIharUle matabheda gare | tinIharUle yo matabheda mAtra pada ra sammAna jogAunako lAgi ani eka arkAmAthi gareko atyAcArale gardA gare | he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! tinIharUle paraspara lokamA garekA vibhedako nirNaya tapAIMkA pAlanakartAle mahApralayako dina tinIharUbIca garnuhunecha | ani ko satyavAdI ra ko asatyavAdI ho bhanne kurA uhA~le spaSTa pArnuhunecha |

18 pheri hAmIle tapAIMlAI tyasa zarIata, kAnuna ra tarikAmA kAyama garyauM jasako Adeza hAmIle tapAIMbhandA pahilekA rasUlaharUlAI diekA thiyauM | tAki tapAIMle ImAna ra satkarmako AhvAna garnuhos | tasartha tapAIM yasai zarIatako anusaraNa garnuhos | satyako jJAna nabhaekAharUko icchAko anusaraNa nagarnuhos | tinIharUko icchAle satyabATa pathabhraSTa pArcha |

19 yadi tapAIMle satyako jJAna nabhaekAharUko icchAko anusaraNa garnuhuncha bhane yasale tapAIMlAI allAhako yAtanAbATa ali pani jogAuna sakdaina | sabai samudAya ra guTakA atyAcArIharU mominaharU viruddha eka arkAkA sahayogI tathA samarthaka hun | allAhakA AdezaharUko pAlanA garera ra uhA~le manAhI garnubhaekA kAryaharUbATa bacera uhA~ko bhaya rAkhneharUkA sahayogI allAha hunuhuncha |

20 hAmro rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) mAthi avatarita yo kurAna vivekapUrNa cha, jasabATa mAnisaharU satya ra asatyabIca pharaka dekhchan | yasale satyasamma mArgadarzana garcha | jo yasamAthi vizvAsa rAkhchan unIharUkA lAgi kRpA ho, kinabhane unIharUle nai yasadvArA allAhalAI khusI pArne sIdhA mArga pAu~chan | ani allAhale unIharUlAI svargamA praveza garAunuhuncha ra narkabATa jogAunuhuncha |

21 ke kuphra ra avajJA garneharUle yo ThAnekA chan ki hAmIle tinIharUlAI tyastai badalA dinechauM jasto badalA hAmIle allAhamAthi ImAna lyAune ra satkarma garneharUlAI dinechauM, ani tinIharU loka ra paraloka duvaimA ekasamAna hunechan?! tinIharUle kati narAmro kurA ThAnekA chan |

22 allAhale AkAzaharU ra pRthvIko sRSTi euTA uddezyako lAgi garnubhaeko cha, binA uddezya garnubhaeko chain | tAki pratyeka vyaktilAI tinIharUle gareko rAmro tathA narAmro kAryako badalA diiyos | allAhale unIharUkA puNya karmamA kamI garera vA duSkarmamA thapera atyayAcAra garnuhune chaina |

23 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! tyasa mAnisalAI hernus tathA vicAra garnus ta, jo Aphno icchAko pUjArI cha ra usale tyasailAI Aphno pUjya Izvara banAeko cha, usale tyasako viparIta kehI gardainan | allAhale Aphno jJAnako AdhAramA yastA mAnisalAI pathabhraSTa pArnubhayo | kinabhane U yasaiko hakadAra thiyo | allAhale tyako kAnamA mohara lagAunubhayo, ani usale tyasabATa phAidA uThAunegarI sundainan | uhA~le usako A~khAmA pardA hAlnubhayo, jasale gardA usale satyalAI dekhdaina | allAhale nai usalAI pathabhraSTa garepachi kasale usalAI satya apanAune avasara dina sakcha ta? ke timIharU icchAko anusaraNakA hAnilAI ra zarIatako anusaraNako phAidAlAI manana gardainau?!

24 mRtyu pazcAta punaH jIvita pArine kurAlAI inkAra garne kAphiraharUle bhaneH hAmIharUko jIvana sAMsArika jIvana mAtra ho | yasapachi kunai jIvana chaina | euTA pi~DhI marepachi pheri jIvita hu~daina | baru arko pi~DhI Aunecha | rAta ra dinako ekapachi arko pAlaipAlo AvatajAvatale hAmIharUlAI mArcha | tinIharU kunai jJAnako AdhAramA punaH jIvita pArine kurAlAI inkAra garirahekA chainan, baru anumAnako bharamA mAtra kurA gardaichan ra anumAnale satyako bAremA kunai phAidA puryAuna sakdaina |

25 mRtyu pazcAtako punaH jIvanalAI inkAra garne bahudevavAdIharU samakSa jaba hAmrA spaSTa AyataharUko pATha garincha taba tinIharU samakSa kunai pramANa hu~daina | tinIharU rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) ra sahAbA (rajiyallAhu anhuma) lAI mAtra yahI bhanchan: yadi timIharU mRtyu pazcAta punaH jIvita garinechauM bhanne dAbImA saccA chau bhane hAmrA marekA pUrvajaharUlAI jIvita pAra |

26 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! tinIharUlAI bhannuhos: allAhale nai timIharUlAI sRSTi garera jIvana dinuhuncha, uhA~le nai mRtyu dinuhuncha ra uhA~le nai mahApralayako dina pheri jIvita pArera hisAba ra badalAko lAgi jammA garnuhunecha | tyasa dinako AgamanamA kunai zaGkA chaina | tara adhikAMsa mAnisaharU yasa kurAlAI jAndainan tyasaile satkarma garera tyasako lAgi tayArI gardainan |

27 AkAzaharU ra pRthvImA mAtra allAhako sattA­zAsana caldaicha | yI duvaimA uhA~ mAtra bhakti­yogya hunuhuncha | juna dina mahApralaya kAyama huncha tyasa dina allAhale sabai mRtaharUlAI hisAba ra badalAko lAgi jIvita pArnuhunecha | allAhabAhekakA bhakti garneharU, satyalAI asatya Thahara garneharU ghATA khAnechan |

28 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! tapAIMle tyasa dina hareka samudAyalAI ghu~DA Tekera basera Aphno pariNAmako pratIkSA gariraheko pAunuhunecha | pratyeka samudAyalAI usako karma­patra linako lAgi bolAinecha | jasalAI karmako lekhA jokhA rAkhne phariztAharUle tayAra pArekA hunechan | he mAnava! Aja timIharUlAI timIharUle saMsAramA gareko rAmro tathA narAmro karmako badalA diinecha |

29 yo hAmIle pradAna gareko karma­patra ho, hAmrA phariztAharU timIharUkA karmaharU lekhne garthe | yasale satyako gavAhI dincha | yasalAI paDha | hAmI phariztAharUlAI saMsAramA timIharUkA karmaharU lekhne Adeza dine garthyauM |
30 satkarmI mominaharUlAI unIharUkA pAlanakartA allAhale Aphno kRpAle svargamA praveza garAunuhunecha | allAhale dinubhaeko badalA spaSTa saphalatA ho, jo jasto arU kunai saphalatA huna sakdaina |

31 allAhalAI inkAra garneharUlAI nindA gadai bhaninechaH ke timIharU samakSa hAmrA AyataharUko pATha garidainathyo, ani timIharUle ImAna lyAunabATa ghamaNDa garyau | timIharU aparAdhI thiyau | kuphra ra pApako khetI garthyau |

32 jaba timIharUlAI bhaninchaH timIharUlAI punaH jIvita garera badalA dine allAhako vAcA satya ho, yasamA kunai sandeha chaina, mahApralaya satya ho yasamA kunai sandeha chaina, yasako lAgi tayArI gara; taba timIharU bhanchauH mahApralaya bhaneko ke ho hAmIharUlAI thAhA chaina, hAmro vicAramA yasako Agamana hu~daina, hAmI yasamA vizvAsa gardainauM |

33 ani unIharUle saMsAramA garekA kuphra ra avajJAkA kAraNale unIharU samakSa narAmro pariNAma jAhera huna gayo | unIharUmAthi tyo yAtanA avatarita bhayo jasako viSayamA unIharUlAI Dara dekhAu~dA unIharU ThaTTA garne garthe |

34 allAhale unIharUlAI bhannubhayoH Aja hAmI timIharUlAI narkamA tyasarI nai choDnechauM jasarI timIharUle Ajako dinako bheTalAI birsekA thiyau | timIharUle yasadinako tayArIko lAgi AsthA rAkhI rAmro karma garenau | timIharUko vAsasthAna narka ho ra timIharUlAI allAhako yAtanAbATa jogAune kohI sahayogI chaina |

35 timIharUle allAhakA nizAnIharUlAI ThaTTAko sAdhana banAeko kAraNale ra sAMsArika jIvanako mojamastI ra icchAharUle timIharUlAI dhokAmA rAkheko kAraNale timIharUle yo yAtanA bhogyau | Aja allAhakA nizAnIharUlAI ThaTTAko sAdhana banAune yI kAphiraharU narkabATa niskane chainan | unIharU tyasamA sadAkA lAgi rahanechan | unIharU satkarma garnako lAgi saMsArako jIvanamA pharkane chainan ra unIharUko pAlanakartA unIharUbATa prasanna hunuhune chaina |
36 sampUrNa prazaMsAharU kevala allAhako lAgi mAtra rahekA chan | uhA~ AkAzaharU ra pRthvIkA mAlika ra sampUrNa sRSTiharUkA pAlanakartA hunuhuncha |

37 AkAzaharU ra pRthvImA sabai prakArakA mahAnatA ra mahimA uhA~kai lAgi raheko cha | uhA~ zaktizAlI hunuhuncha, jasalAI kasaile parAjita garna sakdaina | uhA~ AphnA sRSTi, bhAgya lekhna ra kAnunamA tatvadarzI hunuhuncha |
1 hA0 mIma0! yastA akSaraharUko vyAkhyA sUraha al-bakarahako ArambhamA bhaisakeko cha |
2 yasa kurAnako avataraNa sarvazaktimAna allAhako tarphabATa bhaeko ho, jasalAI kasaile pani parAjita garna sakdaina | uhA~ AphnA sRSTi, bhAgya lekhna ra kAnuna banAunamA tatvadarzI hunuhuncha |

3 hAmIle AkAzaharU, pRthvI ra yI duI bIcakA sampUrNa vastuharUlAI vyarthamA sRSTi garekA chainauM | baru hAmIle nitAnta satyakA sAtha vizeSa uddezyakA lAgi yasalAI sRSTi garekA chauM | tAki bhaktaharUle Aphno pAlanakartAlAI cinna sakUn ani uhA~ko mAtra upAsanA garUn, uhA~sa~ga kasailAI sAjhedAra Thahara nagarUn ra allAhalAI mAtra thAhA bhaeko nizcita avadhisamma dhartImA uttarAdhikArIko jimmevArI pUrA garUn | tara allahako kitAbamA diieko cetAvanIbATa vimukha bhaera allAhalAI nakArneharUle yasalAI vAstA gardainan |

4 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! nitAnta satyabATa vimukha hune muzrikaharUlAI bhannuhos: timIharU allAhalAI chADi juna mUrtiharUko upAsanA garchau, bhana ta ke unIharUle dhartIko kunai bhAgalAI sRSTi garekA chan? ke unIharUle pahADalAI sRSTi garekA chan? ke unIharUle naharalAI sRSTi garekA chan? vA ke AkAzaharUko sRSTimA allAhasa~ga unIharUle sAjhedArako rUpamA kunai bhAga liekA chan? timIharUkA mUrtiharU upAsanAko haka rAkhchan bhanne dAbImA timIharU saccA chau bhane kurAnabhandA pahile allAhako tarphabATa avatarita kunai kitAba vA pahilekA mAnisaharUle choDeko jJAnabATa bA~kI raheko kunai aMza liera AU |

5 allAhalAI choDi kunai mUrtiko upAsanA garne vyaktibhandA baDhI kohI pathabhraSTa chaina jo kiyAmata (mahApralaya) samma pani usako duAko javApha dina sakdaina | yI mUrtiharU jasako upAsanA unIharU garchan yinIharU ta AphnA jhUTA bhaktaharUko duAbATa pani anabhijJa chan | yinIharUle kunai phAidA vA hAnI puryAunu TADhai jAos |

6 yI mithyA bhagavAnaharU saMsAramA AphnA bhaktaharUlAI kunai phAidA puryAuna saknechainan bhanne vAstavikatAkA sAtha jaba yinIharUlAI kiyAmatako dina bhelA pArinecha yinIharU AphnA upAsanA garne garekAharUko zatru hunechan, unIharUsa~ga kunai samvandha naraheko ra unIharUle yinIharUko upAsanA gareko kurAko jJAna nai nabhaeko bhanI unIharUlAI nakArnechan |

7 jaba hAmrA rasUlamAthi avatarita AyataharU unIharUlAI paDhera sunAincha, kurAnalAI namAnneharU unIharUkA rasUlamArphata unIharU samakSa je Ayo tyasa viSayamA bhanchan- yo ta praSTa jAdU ho | yo allAhako tarphabATa Aeko vahI (IzavANI) hoina |

8 ke yI muzrikaharU bhanchan: vAstavamA, svayaM muhammadale yasa kurAnalAI racekaf hun ra tyasalAI allAhako jimmA lagAe? he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! yinIharUlAI bhannuhos: yadi maile yo svayaM nai raceko khaNDamA allAhale malAI yAtanA dina cAhanubhaeko bhae timIharUle malAI bacAuna sakdainau | tasartha, ma yo racera kasarI yAtanA pAune jokhima lina sakchu? timIharUle allAhako kurAnako viSayamA nindA gareko ra malAI tiraskAra gareko kurA uhA~lAI rAmrarI avagata cha | mero ra timIharUbIca sAkSIko lAgi allAha nai paryApta hunuhuncha | uhA~ AphnA bhaktaharUmadhye pazcAttApa garne vyaktikA pApaharUlAI kSamA garnuhuncha ra unIharUmAthi dayA garnuhuncha |

9 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! tapAIMko nubUvata (dUtatva) lAI jhUTo Thahara garne muzrikaharUlAI bhannuhos: maile timIharUlAI AhvAna gareko kurA timIharUlAI acamma lAgeko cha bhane suna allAhale rasUla banAera paThAunubhaeko ma pahilo vyakti hoina | mabhandA pahile dherai rasUlaharU AisakekA chan | malAI thAhA chaina, saMsAramA allAhale masa~ga ra timIharUsa~ga ke garnuhunecha | allAha matira je vahI garnuhuncha ma ta tyasako mAtra anusaraNa garchu | maile boleko ra gareko uhA~ko vahI anusAra nai huncha | ma timIharUlAI allAhako yAtanAbATa spaSTarUpamA sAvadhAna garAu~chu |

10 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! yI jhUTA Thahara garneharUlAI bhannuhos: bhana ta, yadi yo kurAna allAhako tarphabATa Aeko ho tara timIharUle tyasalAI nakAryau ra yo allAhako tarphabATa ho bhanI taurAtamA tyasako viSayamA ullekha bhaekole banI isrAIlakA ekajanAle sAkSI pani diyo | ani AsthA pani rAkhyo tara timIharUle ghamaNDa garyau bhane tyasabelA timIharU atyAcArI hunechau, hoina ra? vAstavamA, allAhale atyAcArI mAnisaharUlAI satya mArga dekhAunuhunna |

11 kurAna ra rasUlale lyAunubhaeko sandezalAI nakArneharUle mominaharUlAI bhaneH yadi muhammadale lyAeko sandezale bhalAiko mArgadarzana dincha bhane tyasalAI hAmIbhandA pahile yI garibaharU, dAsaharU ra kamajoraharUle apanAune thienan | unIharUle AphnA rasUlale lyAunubhaeko sandezalAI mAnekA chainan tyasai kAraNale unIharUle bhannechan: juna kurA unale lyAekA chan tyo jhUTo kathA mAtra ho ra hAmIle jhUTo kurAlAI anusaraNa gardainauM |

12 yasa kurAnabhandA pahile allAhale mUsA (alaihissalAma) mAthi taurAta avataraNa garnubhayo jasalAI uhA~le satya mArgadarzana dine ra banI isrAIlamadhye tyasamAthi AsthA rAkhne ra tyasako anusaraNa garne vyaktiko lAgi dayA banAunubhayo | muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) mAthi avatarita yo kurAna yasabhandA pahilekA kitAbaharUko puSTi garne kitAba ho juna arbI bhASAmA raheko cha | tAki allAhako sAthamA sAjhedAra Thahara garI ra pApamA lipta bhaI AphUmAthi atyAcAra garneharUlAI cetAvanI diiyos | ani yo satkarmIharUko lAgi zubha-sUcanA ho jasale AphnA pAlanakartA ra uhA~kA anya sRSTiharUsa~gako sambandhalAI sudRDha banAekA chan |

13 vAstavamA, allAha hAmrA pAlanakartA hunuhuncha bhanneharU ani ImAna (AsthA) mA ra satkarmamA aDiga rahaneharUlAI AkhiratamA kunai kurAko Dara hunechaina ra unIharUle lAbha lina napAekA sAMsArika aMzaharUprati ra pachADi choDidiekA kurAharUprati duHkhI hunechainan |
14 yI guNaharU bhaekA vyaktiharU svargakA bAsindAharU hun jo tyahA~ sadAkA lAgi rahanechan | yo unIharUle saMsAramA garekA satkarmaharUko badalA ho |

15 hAmIle mAnisalAI AphnA mAtApitAprati jIvanamA rAmro vyavahAra garne ra unIharUko mRtyupazcAta dharma viparIta kAma nagarne spaSTa Adeza diyauM | vizeSagarI usakI AmAsa~ga kinaki unale kaThinAikA sAtha garbhamA rAkhin ra kaThina avasthAmA usalAI janma diin | usalAI garbhamA rAkhne ra dUdha chuTAune avadhi tIsa mahinA raheko cha | ani usako mAnasika ra zArIrika vikAsa huncha ra usako umera cAlIsa varSako huna pugcha ra bhanchaH he merA pAlanakartA! tapAIMle mamAthi ra merA mAtApitAmAthi garnubhaeko kRpAko lAgi tapAIMlAI dhanyAvAda dina malAI prerita garnuhos | ani tapAIMlAI mana parne satkarma garna prerita garnuhos ra tyasalAI svIkAra garnuhos | merA santAnalAI satmArgamA rAkhnuhos | vAstavamA, ma merA pApaharUkA lAgi tapAIMsa~ga kSamA mAgdachu ra ma tapAIMko anusaraNako lAgi ra tapAIMkA Adezako pAlanAkA lAgi samarpita chu |

16 yinIharU kai satkarmaharU hAmI svIkAra garnerchauM, yinIharUkA kharAba kAmaharUlAI najara andAja garnerchauM ra yinIharUlAI tyasako javAphadehI banAunechainauM | yinIharU svargakA bAsindAharUsa~ga hunechan | hAmIle unIharUsa~ga gareko yo vAcA eka satya vAcA ho juna nizcita rUpamA pUrA hunecha |

jasarI allAhale mAtApitAsa~ga rAmro vyavahAra garna prerita garnako lAgi AphnA mAtApitAsa~ga utkRSTa vyavahAra garne vyaktiko udAharaNa dinubhayo tyasarI nai avajJAkArItAbATa TADhA rahana prerita garnako nimti kRtaghna vyaktiko udAharaNa dinubhaeko cha | uhA~le bhannubhaeko chaH
17 jasale AphnA mAtApitAlAI bhanyoH dhikkAra cha timIharUlAI! mRtyupazcAta ma cihAnabATa jIvita bhaera niskanechu bhanI timIharU malAI Dara dekhAirahekA chau? vAstavamA, pustauM pustA bitisakekA chan ra mAnisaharU marisakekA chan, tara tinIharU madhyebATa kohI pani punaH jIvita bhaera pharkekA chainan | jabaki usakA mAtApitAle hAmro chorAle mArgadarzana prApta garos bhanI allAhasa~ga duA garirahekA hunchan ra Aphno chorAlAI bhanchan: yadi timIle punaH jIvita pArine kurAmA AsthA rAkhenau bhane barbAda hunchau | tasartha punaH jIvanamA AsthA rAkha | vAstavamA, allAhale punaH jIvita pArine viSayamA garnubhaeko vAcA satya ho jasamA kunai zaGkA chaina | ani U punaH jIvita pArine kurAlAI dohoryAera nakArdai bhanchaH punaH jIvita pArine viSayamA bhaniekA yI kurAharU aghillA kitAbaharUbATa ra unIharUle lekhekobATa nakkala garieko ho | tyo allAhako tarphabATa Aeko hoina |

18 yinIharU nai tI vyaktiharU hun jasalAI unIharUbhandA pahile bitekA jinna ra manuSyaharUsa~ga nai yAtanA diine vAcA purA bhaeko cha kinaki unIharU AphailAI ra AphnA parivAralAI narkamA hAlera ghATA behorneharU hun |

19 svarga jAne ra narka jAne dubai samUhale garekA kAryaharU anusAra nai darjA prApta hunecha | tasartha svargakA bAsindAharUko ucca darjA raheko cha ra narkakA bAsindAharUko tuccha darjA raheko cha | allAhale unIharUkA karmaharUko pUrA-pUrA badalA dinuhunecha | kiyAmatako dina unIharUkA rAmrA kAmaharU ghaTAera ra narAmrA kAmaharU baDhAera unIharUmAthi atyAcAra garine chaina |

20 tyasa dina allAhalAI nakArne ra uhA~kA rasUlaharUlAI jhUTo Thahara garneharUlAI yAtanA dinako nimti narkamA upasthita garinecha | unIharUlAI apamAnita tarikAle hapkAu~dai bhaninechaH timIharUle saMsArako jIvanamA nai Aphno bhAga liisakekA chau ra tyahA~kA sukhako bhoga garisakekA chau | pRthvImA gareko anAhaka ghamaNDa, kuphra ra avajJAle gardA Ajako dina timIharUlAI kaDA ra apamAnita garine yAtanA diinecha |

21 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! Adako vaMzabhAI hUdalAI samjhanuhos | jaba unale Aphno samudAyalAI araba dvIpako dakSiNa bhega al-ahkApha mA Aphno nivAsamA bhaeko belA unIharUmAthi allAhako yAtanA Aiparne viSayamA cetAvanI die | hUdabhandA pahile ra unIpachi dherai rasUlaharUle Aphno samudAyalAI cetAvanI di~dai AisakekA chan | unIharUle AphnA samudAyalAI bhaneH allAhako mAtra upAsanA gara | uhA~sa~ga arU kasaiko upAsanA nagara | he mero samudAya! vAstavamA, malAI timIharUko viSayamA euTA mahAna dinako yAtanAko Dara lAgeko cha; juna kiyAmatako dina ho |

22 unalAI unako samudAyale bhanyoH ke timIle hAmIharUlAI hAmrA upAsyaharUko upAsanAbATa TADhA rAkhna AekA hau? yasto kadApi hune chaina | timIle vAcA gareko yAtanA liera AU yadi timI Aphno vAcAmA saccA chau bhane |

23 unale bhaneH yAtanA Aune samaya allAhalAI mAtra thAhA cha | malAI yasako samayako jJAna chaina | ma euTA rasUla mAtra hu~ | malAI je diera timIharUtira paThAieko cha ma tyahI puryAiraheko chu | tara mero hisAbale timIharU ajJAnI mAnisaharU hau kinaki timIharUlAI phAidA dine kAmaharUlAI timIharU choDchau ra timIharUlAI hAni garne kAmaharUlAI timIharU garchau |

24 unIharUle hatAra gareko yAtanA jaba unIharU samakSa Ayo unIharUle tyasalAI bAdalako rUpamA dekhe juna AkAzabATa unIharUkA upatyakAtira Au~dai thiyo | unIharUle bhaneH yo Aune bAdalale hAmImAthi varSA huncha | hUdale unIharUlAI bhaneH timIharUle soMce jasto tyo varSA hune bAdala hoinan | baru tyo yAtanA ho jasako lAgi timIharUle hatAra garekA thiyau | tyo hAvAhurI ho jasamA pIDAdAyI yAtanA raheko cha |

25 allAhako Adeza anusAra usale hareka kurAlAI dhvasta pArnecha | ani tyo sabai dhvasta hunecha | aba unIharUle basobAsa garne garekA gharaharU bAheka tyahA~ kehI dekhidaina | tyasamA pahile unIharU raheko sAkSI tyasale dincha | kuphra ra avajJAmA aDiga rahane aparAdhIharUlAI hAmI yastai prakArako pIDAdAyI yAtanA dinechauM |

26 hAmIle hUdako samudAyalAI zaktikA juna sAdhanaharU diekA thiyauM tyasatA sAdhanaharU hAmIle timIharUlAI diekA chainauM | hAmIle unIharUlAI sunne zakti diekA thiyauM jasabATa unIharU sunthe, herne zakti diekA thiyauM jasale unIharU herthe ra hRdaya diekA thiyauM jasabATa unIharU so~cthe | unIharUlAI unIharUkA sunne zakti, herne zakti ra hRdayaharUle kunai phAidA puryAena | jaba unIharU samakSa allAhako yAtanA Ayo ta yI sabai cIjale tyasalAI haTAuna sakenan kinaki unIharUle allAhakA nizAnIharUlAI nakArne garthe | ani unIharUkA nabI hUda (alaihissalAma) le unIharUlAI juna yAtanAko Dara dekhAekA thie tyasa viSayamA ThaTTA garne garthe tara tyahI ThaTTA garieko cIjale unIharUlAI samAtyo |

27 he makkAkA bAsindAharU ho! hAmIle timIharUkA variparIkA nagaraharU naSTa pArisakekA chauM | hAmIle Ada, samUda, lUtako samudAya ra madayanakA bAsiharUlAI naSTa garisakekA chauM | unIharUle kuphrabATa choDnechan bhanne AzAle hAmIle unIharUlAI vibhinna tarkaharU ra pramANaharU prastuta garyauM |

28 allAhalAI chADi juna mUrtiharUko tinIharUle upAsanA garera ra balI caDhAI upAsya banAekA thie unIharUle tinIharUlAI kina sahayoga garenan ta? tI mUrtiharUle kadApi sahayoga garnechainan | baru baDhI AvazyakatA bhaeko belA unIharU harAe | baru yI mUrtiharUle tinIharUlAI phAidA dinechan ra allAha samakSa siphArisa garnechan bhanne kurA jhUTo ra Aropa mAtra ho; jasadvArA unIharUle AphailAI dhokAmA pArekA chan |

29 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! tyasa samayalAI samjhanuhos; jaba hAmIle tapAIMtira jinnaharUko euTA samUha paThAekA thiyauM, jasale tapAIMmAthi Avatarita kurAna sunyo | jaba unIharU kurAna sunnako lAgi upasthita bhae taba eka arkAlAI bhaneH cupa lAga! hAmI tyasalAI sunnauM | jaba rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) le tyasako pATha (telAvata) saknubhayo taba unIharU Aphno samudAyamA AhvAnakartA banera pharkera gae ra unIharUle kurAnamAthi AsthA narAkheko khaNDamA allAhako yAtanA Aune kurAko Dara dekhAe |

30 unIharUle Aphno samudAyalAI bhaneH he hAmro samudAya! hAmIle euTA yasto kitAbako pATha sunekA chauM jasalAI allAhale mUsApachi avataraNa garnubhaeko cha | yasale allAhako tarphabATa avataraNa bhaekA aghillA kitAbaharUko puSTi garcha | satya bATo dekhAu~cha ra sIdhA mArgadarzana garcha ra tyo mArga islAma ho |

31 he hAmro samudAya! muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) le garnubhaeko satyako AhvAnalAI mAna ra uhA~ AphnA pAlanakartAkA rasUla hunuhuncha bhanne kurAmA AsthA rAkha | pariNAma svarUpa allAhale timIharUkA pApaharUlAI kSamA garnuhunecha ra timIharUlAI pIDAdAyI yAtanAbATa surakSita rAkhnuhunecha juna timIharUko pratikSAmA raheko cha | yadi timIharUle uhA~ko satya AhvAnalAI mAnenau ra uhA~ rasUla hunuhuncha bhanne kurAmA AsthA rAkhenau bhane |

32 ani muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) ko satya AhvAnalAI mAnenau bhane dhartImA jahA~ gaepani allAhabATa bacna sakdainau ra allAha bAheka usako arU kohI sahayogI chaina jasale usalAI yAtanAbATa jogAuna sakos | unIharU spaSTa satyabATa pathabhraSTa bhaekA chan |

33 ke punaH jIvita pArine satyalAI jhUTo Thahara garne muzrikaharUle so~cdainan? jaba allAhale vizAla AkAzaharU ra ThUlo pRthvIlAI sRSTi garnubhayo ra tyasako sRSTi garna uhA~ vivaza tathA asakSama hunuhunna bhane ke uhA~ mRtyupazcAta hisAba lina ra badalA dinako lAgi punaH jIvita pArna sakSama hunuhunna ra? | vAstavamA uhA~ unIharUlAI jIvita pArna sakSama hunuhuncha kinaki uhA~ hareka kurAko sAmarthya rAkhnuhuncha ra uhA~ mRtyupazcAta jIvita pArna vivaza hunuhunna |

34 allAhalAI ra uhA~kA rasUlaharUlAI nakArnelAI yAtanA dinako lAgi narka samakSa upasthita garinechan | unIharUlAI apamAnita gardai bhaninechaH timIharUle dekhiraheko yo yAtanA nitAnta satya hoina ra? vA timIharUle saMsAramA bhane jhai~ yo jhUTa ho? kina na hunu, he hAmrA pAlanakartA yo nitAnta satya ho | ani unIharUlAI bhaninechaH timIharUle allAhalAI nakAreko kAraNale yo yAtanA cAkha |

35 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! tapAIMko samudAyale jhUTo Thahara garekomA tapAIM dhairya dhAraNa garnuhos | nUha, ibrAhIma, mUsA ra IsA (alaihimussalAma) jastA dRDha saMkalpa bhaekA rasUlaharUle dhairya gare | juna dina tapAIMko samudAyakA jhUTAharUle Akhiratako yAtanA dekhnechan jasako cetAvanI unIharUlAI dii~daicha | unIharUlAI diine nirantara yAtanAko kAraNale unIharU saMsAramA eka kSaNa mAtra baseko kurAko AbhAsa hunecha | muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) mAthi avatarita yo kurAna sandeza ra manuSyaharU ra jinnaharUko lAgi paryApta raheko cha | vAstavamA, kuphra ra pApamA lipta bhaI allAhako AjJApAlana nagarekAharUlAI mAtra yAtanA diinecha |
1 jasale allAhalAI nakAre ra mAnisaharUlAI dharmabATa TADhA rAkhe unIharUkA karmaharUlAI allAhale naSTa pArnubhayo |

2 jasale allAhamAthi AsthA rAkhe, satkarma gare ra uhA~kA rasUla muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) mAthi allAhako tarphabATa avatarita nitAnta satya kurAmAthi AsthA rAkhe | allAhale unIharUkA pApaharUlAI kSamA garnubhayo ani unIharUkA saMsArakA ra AkhiratakA avasthAharUlAI sudhArnubhayo |

3 duIvaTai samUhale karma anusAra badalA pAe | allAhalAI nakArneharUle asatyako anusaraNa gare tathA allAhamAthi ra uhA~kA rasUlamAthi AsthA rAkhneharUle satyako anusaraNa gare | tasartha unIharUkA karmaharUmA bhinnatA bhaeko hunAle unIharUko badalAmA bhinnatA bhaeko pAincha | jasarI allAhale duI samUhaharU arthAta mominaharU ra kAphiraharUko viSayamA Aphno AdezalAI praSTa pArnubhaeko cha tyasarI nai allAhale unIharUko udAharaNa dinubhaeko cha |

4 he mominaharU ho! yuddhako maidAnamA yoddhA kAphiraharUsa~ga bhiDanta hudA~ timIharU AphnA taravArale unIharUko gardhana kATa | unIharUsa~ga yuddha garirAkha ra unIharUko zakti samApta pAra | dheraijanAlAI mArisakepachi kaidIharUlAI bA~dha | timIharUle unIharUlAI bandhaka banAisakepachi avasthAko AvazyakatA anusAra phaisalA gara | yA phirautI mAga nagarikana unIharUlAI jAna deU yA phirautImA dhana vA arU kehI mAga | kAphiraharUle islAma nagaresamma vA yuddha samApta garne samjhautA nagaresamma yuddha garirAkha ra unIharUlAI bandhaka banAirAkha | kAphiraharUdvArA mominaharUko parIkSA hunu ra kehI virUddha kehIle jitnu bhaneko allAhako nIti ho | yadi allAhale kAphiraharU virUddha yuddha binA nai vijaya cAhanubhayo bhane vijaya prApta hunecha | tara uhA~le kehI mAnisaharUdvArA anya kehIko parIkSA linako lAgi yuddhako Adeza dinubhayo | uhA~le yuddha garne mominaharU ra yuddha nagarne mominaharUko parIkSA linuhuncha ra kAphiradvArA mominako parIkSA linuhuncha | yadi usale mominako hatyA garcha bhane momina svargamA praveza garnecha ra yadi mominale kAphirako hatyA garyo bhane U narkamA jAnecha | allAhako mArgamA yuddha garneharUko karmaharUlAI allAhale barbAda garnuhunechaina |
5 uhA~le unIharUlAI saMsArako jIvanamA satyako anusaraNa garna sahayoga garnuhunecha ra unIharUko avasthAmA sudhAra lyAunuhunecha |

6 kiyAmatako dina unIharUlAI svargamA praveza garAinecha | saMsAramA tyasakA guNaharUko varNana gariekole unIharUle tyasalAI cinne chan | ani AkhiratamA unIharUko darjAharUko viSayamA batAunu hunecha |

7 he allAhamAthi AsthA rAkhne ra uhA~kA AdezaharUko pAlanA garneharU ho! yadi timIharUle allAhako nabI ra uhA~ko dharmalAI sahayoga garI ra kAphiraharUsa~ga yuddha garI allAhalAI sahayoga garyau bhane uhA~le unIharUmAthi vijaya pradAna garI timIharUlAI sahayoga garnuhunecha ra yuddhamA unIharUsa~ga bhiDanta hunebelA timIharUko pAilAlAI baliyo pArnuhunecha |
8 allAhalAI ra uhA~kA rasUlalAI nakArneharU parAjita ra naSTa hunechan | ani uhA~le unIharUko puNyaharUlAI barbAda pArnuhunecha |

9 unIharUle rasUlamAthi avatarita ekezvaravAdalAI ghRNA gareko hunAle unIharUmAthi yAtanA Aunecha | tasartha allAhale unIharUkA karmaharUlAI naSTa pArnuhunecha ani unIharUle yasa saMsAramA ra AkhiratamA ghATA behornechan |

10 ke yI jhUTo Thahara garneharUle pRthvImA ghumaphira garI AphUbhandA pahile jhUTo Thahara garneharUko pariNAmamA mAnan garenan ra? unIharUko pariNAma atyantai pIDAdAyI thiyo | allAhale unIharUkA gharaharU, santAna ra dhana-sampattilAI naSTa pArnubhayo | hareka yuga ra ThAu~kA kAphiraharUkA lAgi yastai yAtanA raheko cha |
11 dubai samUhalAI diine badalA ullekha bhaeko cha | allAhamAthi AsthA rAkhneharUko lAgi allAha sahayogI hunuhuncha bhane kAphiraharUko kohI sahayogI hunechaina |

12 vAstavamA, allAhamAthi ra uhA~kA rasUlamAthi AsthA rAkhneharU ra satkarma garneharUlAI allAhale bagaiMcAharUmA praveza garAunuhunecha jasakA mahalaharU ra rUkhaharUko talatirabATa naharaharU bagirahekA hunechan | tara allAha ra uhA~kA rasUlalAI nakArneharU inkArIle Aphnai icchAko anusaraNa saMsAramA Ananda linchan ra janAvaraharU jhaiM khAnchan ra kevala Aphnai peTa ra bhoga-vilAsalAI mAtra mahatva dinchan | kiyAmatako dina unIharUko vAsasthAna narka hunecha |

13 pahile bitekA kaiyauM nagaraharU tapAIMlAI nikAlne makkAkA bAsindAharUbhandA dherai zaktizAlI, dherai dhanavAna ra dherai santAnaharU bhaekA thie | tara AphnA rasUlalAI jhUTo Thahara gareko kAraNale hAmIle unIharUlAI naSTa pAryauM | unIharUmAthi allAhako yAtanA Aeko belA unIharUlAI tyasabATa bacAune kohI sahayogI bhaena | yadi hAmIle makkAkA bAsindAharUlAI naSTa pArna khojyauM bhane kohI hAmIlAI vivaza pArna sakdaina |

14 josa~ga AphnA pAlanakartAko praSTa pramANa ra tarkaharU chan ra U pUrNa jJAnamA AdhArita bhaI uhA~ko upAsanA garcha | ke U tyasa vyakti saraha hunasakcha jasalAI usakA narAmrA karmaharUlAI zaitAnale rAmro banAera prastuta gareko cha ra mUrtiharUko upAsanA garne, pApamA lipta rahane ra rasUlaharUlAI jhUTo Thahara garne lagAyatakA narAmrA icchAharUko anusaraNa garcha?

15 allAhakA AdezaharUko pAlanA garI ra uhA~le manAhI garnubhaekA kurAharUbATa bacera uhA~ko bhaya rAkhneharUlAI juna svargamA praveza garAune vAcA garieko cha; tyasakA guNaharU yI rahekA chan– tyahA~ pAnIkA naharaharU chan juna lAmo samayasamma rahe tApani tyasako bAsnA ra svAdamA parivartana Au~daina | tyahA~ dUdhakA naharaharU chan jasako svAda parivartana hu~daina | tyahA~ piuneharUlAI svAdiSTa madirAkA naharaharU hunechan | tyahA~ vibhinna azuddhatAbATa pavitra pAriekA mahakA naharaharU hunechan | ani tyahA~ unIharUle cAhekA hareka prakArakA phalaphUlaharU hunechan | sabaibhandA mahatvapUrNa kurA, allAhale unIharUkA pApaharUlAI kSamA garnuhunecha ani unIharUlAI tyasako lAgi yAtanA dinuhunechaina | jasako lAgi yo pratidAna raheko cha ke tyo vyakti tyasa vyakti saraha hunasakcha jo sadAkA lAgi narkamA rahanecha ra usalAI atyantai tAto pAnI pilAinecha jasako kAraNale usakA peTakA AndrAharU nai kATidinechan?

16 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! tapAIMko kurA sunne kehI munAphikaharUle tapAIMko kurA sunera svIkAra gardainan baru vimukha hunchan | jaba unIharU tapAIMbATa TADhA jAnchan taba jasalAI allAhale jJAna dinubhaeko cha unIharUlAI anabhijJa ra anjAna jhaiM bhaera sodhchan– usale bharkharai ke bhanyo? yinIharUko hRdayaharUmAthi allAhale mohara lagAidinu bhaeko cha | tasartha unIharUle kunai bhalAi pAunechainan | unIharUle Aphno narAmro icchAko anusaraNa gare jasale unIharUlAI satya dekhnabATa andho banAyo |

17 jasale satya mArga prApta gare ra rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) le lyAunubhaeko kurAko anusaraNa gare, allAhale unIharUlAI ajhai mArgadarzana ra rAmro kAma garna sahayoga garnuhuncha | ani unIharUlAI narkabATa jogine cetanA pradAna garnuhuncha |

18 ke kAphiraharU akasmAta kiyAmata Aune pratIkSAmA chan? tyasakA nizAnIharU AisakekA chan jasamadhye nabI (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) ko Agamana ra candramA phuTnu ho | jaba kiyAmata Aunecha taba unIharU kasarI phAidA lina sakchan?

19 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! vizvAsa garnuhos, allAha bAheka arU kohI vAstavika upAsya chaina | tapAIM AphnA pApaharUkA lAgi allAhasa~ga kSamA mAgnuhos | ani momina purUSa tathA mahilAharUkA pApaharUkA kSamA mAgnuhos | allAha timIharUko dinakA kriyAkalApa ra rAtako basAIko viSayamA avagata hunuhuncha | uhA~bATa kehI pani lukeko chaina |

20 allAhamAthi AsthA rAkhneharUle bhaneH allAhale yuddha ullekha bhaeko sUraha kina avataraNa garnubhaena? jaba allAha yuddha ullekha bhaeko spaSTa sUraha avataraNa garnubhayo, he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! Aphno hRdayamA roga pAlekA munAphikaharUlAI tapAIMle dekhnuhunecha DarAekA vyaktiharUle here jhaiM unIharUle tapAIMtira hernechan | unIharU yuddhabATa bhAgeko ra DarAekole allAhako yAtanA unIharUko najika Aisakeko cha bhanI cetAvanI dinubhayo |

21 unIharUle allAhako anusaraNa garnu ra narAmro kurAbATa bacI asala kurA garnu unIharUko lAgi rAmro raheko cha | ani jaba yuddha anivArya garincha ra avasthA gambhIra huncha | yadi unIharU allAhamAthiko AsthA ra uhA~ko anusaraNamA saccA hunu unIharUko kapaTa ra allAhakA AdezaharUko ullaGghanabhandA rAmro hune thiyo |

22 yadi timIharU allAhamAthiko AsthA ra uhA~prati AjJAkArI hunabATa TADhA rahanchau bhane kuphra ra avajJA garI timIharUle pRthvImA azAnti sRjanA garnechau ra sambandha toDnechau bhanne AzaGkA cha | islAma pUrva yahI timIharUko avasthA thiyo |

23 pRthvImA azAnti sRjanA garne ra sambandha toDneharU unIharU nai hun, jasalAI allAhale Aphno dayAbATa TADhA pArnubhaeko cha, ani unIharUko sunne zakti khosnubhaeko cha jasale gardA unIharU nitAnta satyalAI sunera svIkAra garna sakdainan ra unIharUko herne zakti khosnubhaeko cha jasale gardA unIharU pATha lina sakdainan |

24 ke yI vimukha huneharUle kurAnamA dhyAna di~dainan ra tyasamA so~ca vicAra gardainan? yadi unIharUle tyasamA dhyAna dieko bhae tyasale unIharUlAI hareka prakArakA bhalAiko mArgadarzana garnethiyo ra hareka prakArakA adharmabATa unIharUlAI TADhA rAkhnethiyo | ke yinIharUko hRdayaharUmA tAlcA lAgeko cha, jasakAraNa tyasamA upadeza praveza gardaina ra cetAvanI kunai phAidA puryAu~daina?

25 vAstavamA, satya-tathya pramANita bhaepachi ra nabI (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) ko satyatA spaSTa bhaepachi ImAna tyAgera kuphra ra kapaTa apanAuneharUkA lAgi zaitAnale kuphra ra kapaTalAI sundara banAeko cha ra tyasamA lipta rahana sahaja banAeko cha | ani unIharUlAI lAmo samayasamma bA~cne AzA dieko cha |

26 unIharUko pathabhraSTatAko kAraNa ke cha bhane unIharUle tI muzrikaharU, jasalAI rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) mAthi vahI avataraNa bhaeko kurA mana pardaina tinIharUlAI gopya rUpamA bhaneH hAmI kehI avasthAharUmA timIharUko anusaraNa garnechauM, jastai yuddhabATa nirUtsAhita garnu | unIharUkA gopya kurAharU ra unIharUle lukAekA kurAharUlAI allAha jAnnuhuncha | uhA~bATa kehI pani lukeko chaina | ani uhA~le tyasabATa je cAhanubhayo tyasako jAnakArI Aphno rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) lAI dinubhayo |

27 unIharUle bhogne yAtanA ra pIDAdAyI avasthA kasto holA! | jaba prANa nikAlna niyukta gariekA phariztAharUle unIharUkA anuhAra ra piThyU~mA phalAmako DanDAle hirkAera unIharUko prANalAI nikAlnechan |

28 kuphra, kapaTa, allAha ra uhA~kA rasUlasa~gako zatrutAko kAraNale unIharUlAI yo yAtanA diieko ho | ani unIharUle tyasa kurAlAI mana parAenan jasale unIharUlAI AphnA pAlanakartAko najika lAncha ra unIharUlAI uhA~ko prasannatAko yogya banAu~cha jastai allAhamAthi AsthA rAkhnu ra uhA~kA rasUlako anusaraNa garnu | tasartha uhA~le unIharUkA karmaharUlAI barbAda pArnubhayo |

29 hRdayamA zaGkA bhaekA munAphikaharUlAI ke lAgcha, allAhale unIharUko irSyA ra ghRNAlAI jAhera garnuhunechaina? uhA~le tyasalAI parIkSA ra jA~cadvArA jAhera garnuhunecha | yasako uddezya saccA ImAnavAlAlAI jhUTo ImAnavAlAbATa pharaka pArnu ho | tAki momina spaSTa hos ra munAphikako pardAphAsa hos |

30 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! yadi hAmIle tapAIMlAI munAphikaharUko pahicAna garAuna cAheko bhae avazya garAuna sakthyauM | ani tapAIMle unIharUlAI unIharUko nizAnIle cinna saknuhune thiyo | taipani tapAIM unIharUlAI unIharUko bhASA zailIle cinnuhunecha | allAha timIharUkA kArmasita avagata hunuhuncha | uhA~bATa kehI pani lukeko chaina ani tyasai anusAra badalA dinuhunecha |

31 he mominaharU ho! hAmI jihAda, zatruharUsa~gako yuddha ra marne ra mArne kAryabATa timIharUko parIkSA linechauM | tasartha timIharU madhyebATa allAhako mArgamA jihAda garneharU ra zatruharUsa~gako yuddhamA dhairya garneharUko viSayamA thAhA pAunechauM | timIharUmA saccA ra jhUTAharUko pahicAna garnako lAgi hAmIle timIharUko parIkSA linchauM |

32 vAstavamA, jasale allAhalAI ra uhA~ko rasUlalAI inkAra gare, svayaMlAI ra arUharUlAI allAhako dharmabATa roke, uhA~kA rasUlako virodha gare ra uhA~ nabI bhaeko kurA praSTa bhaepachi uhA~sa~ga zatrutA apanAe unIharUle allAhalAI kunai hAnI puryAuna sakdainan | vAstavamA, unIharUle svayaMlAI hAnI puryAirahekA chan ra allAhale unIharUkA karmaharUlAI barbAda pArnuhunecha |

33 he allAhamAthi AsthA rAkhneharU ra uhA~kA Adezako pAlanA garneharU ho! allAhako AjJApAlana gara, rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) ko AjJapAlana gara dubaikA AdezakA pAlanA garera ra uhA~le manAhI garnubhaekA kurAharUbATa baca | kuphra, dekhAvaTI, Adi kAmaharU garI AphnA rAmrA kAmaharUlAI barbAda nagara |

34 vAstavamA, jasale allAhalAI inkAra gare, svayaMlAI ra mAnisaharUlAI allAhako dharmabATa TADhA rAkhe ani pazcAttApa nai nagarI kuphrako avasthAmA mare | allAhale unIharUkA pApaharUlAI lukAera kSamA garnuhunechaina | baru unIharUlAI yAtanA dinuhunecha ra unIharUlAI narkamA sadAkA lAgi hAlnuhunecha |

35 he mominaharU ho! Aphno zatruko sAmanA garnebelA unIharUbhandA pahile samjhautAko kurA garera kamajora nahoU | timIharU zaktizAlI chau ra unIharUmAthi vijaya prApta garnechau | allAha Aphno sahAyatA ra samarthanakA sAtha timIharUsa~ga hunuhuncha | uhA~le timIharUkA pratiphalamA rattibhara pani kamI garnuhunechaina | uhA~le Aphno anugraha ra udAratAkA kAraNa tyasalAI baDhAunuhunecha |

36 saMsArako jIvana ta khela ra manoraJjana mAtra ho | tasartha buddhimAna vyakti Akhiratako lAgi karma garna choDera tyasamA mAtra lAgdaina | yadi timIharUle allAhamAthi ra uhA~ko rasUlamAthi AsthA rAkhyau ra allAhakA AdezaharUko pAlanA garI ra uhA~le manAhI garnubhaeko kurAharUbATa bacI uhA~sa~ga Darde rahayau bhane uhA~le timIharUkA karmaharUko pUrA-pUrA pratidAna dinuhunecha | uhA~le timIharUlAI pUrai sampatti dAna garna AhvAna garnubhaeko chaina | uhA~le ta tyasabATa anivArya bhAga jakAta mAtra dina AhvAna garnubhaeko cha |

37 yadi uhA~le timIharUlAI pUrai sampatti dina AhvAna garnubhayo ra Aphno AhvAnamA joDa dinubhayo bhane timIharUle kanjusyAi~ garna thAlnechau | uhA~le timIharUko hRdayamA bhaeko uhA~ko mArgamA kharca garne anicchAlAI jAhera garnuhunecha | tasartha uhA~le timIharUmAthi dayA gardai tyasako lAgi AhvAna garnubhaena |

38 suna, timIharUlAI allAhako mArgamA Aphno sampattiko euTA bhAga kharca garna AhvAna garieko cha | timIharUlAI pUrai sampatti kharca garna bhanieko chaina | timIharUmadhye kasaile kanjusyAi~ garI kharca garna AhvAna garieko bhAgalAI rokchan | jo allAhako mArgamA Aphno sampattiko kehI bhAga kharca garna kanjusyAi~ garcha, vAstavamA U kharca gardA prApta hune pratidAnabATa vaJcita bhaI AphaimAthi kanjusyAi~ garcha | allAha sampanna hunuhuncha, uhA~lAI timIharUle kharca gareko dhanako AvazyakatA chaina | timIharUlAI uhA~ko AvazyakatA cha | yadi timIharU islAmabATa pharkera kuphratira jAnchau bhane uhA~le timIharUlAI naSTa pArnuhunecha | ani arUlAI timIharUko ThAu~mA lyAunuhunecha jo timIharUsaraha hunechainan | baru unIharU uhA~kA anusaraNa garnechan |
1 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! vAstavamA, hAmIle hudaibiyAko samjhautAdvArA tapAIMlAI spaSTa vijaya pradAna garyauM |

2 tAki allAhale yasa vijaya aghikA ra pachikA tapAIMkA pApaharUlAI kSamA garnuhunecha | tapAIMko dharmalAI sahayoga garI tapAIMmAthi AphnA anugrahaharUlAI pUrA garnuhunecha ra tapAIMlAI sIdhA mArga dekhAunuhunecha jasamA kunai TeDhopana chaina ra tyo islAmako sIdhA mArga ho |
3 ani allAhale tapAIMkA zatruharU virUddha tapAIMlAI prabhAvakArI sahayoga pradAna garnuhunecha, jasalAI kasaile chekne chaina |

4 allAhale nai mominaharUkA hRdayamA unIharUko AsthAmA thapa AsthA vRddhi garnako lAgi dRDhatA ra zAnti avataraNa garnubhayo | AkAzaharU ra pRthvIkA sampUrNa senAharU kevala uhA~kA hun | tyasadvArA uhA~le AphnA bhaktaharUmadhye jasalAI cAhanuhuncha sahayoga garnuhuncha | allAhalAI AphnA bhaktaharUkA avasthAharUko jJAna cha ra vijaya ra samarthana pradAna garnamA tatvadarzI hunuhuncha |

5 allAhamAthi ra uhA~kA rasUlamAthi AsthA rAkhne purUSaharU ra mahilAharUlAI yastA bagaiMcAharUmA praveza garAunuhunecha jasakA mahalaharU ra rUkhaharUko talatirabATa naharaharU bagirahekA hunechan | ani unIharUkA pApaharUlAI kSamA garnuhunecha jasako kAraNale unIharUlAI yAtanA dinuhunechaina | svarga prApta garnu ra pApaharUko kAraNale yAtanA nadiine bhanieko kurA allAhako najaramA ThUlo saphalatA ho, jasako barAbara arU kunai saphalatA nai chaina |

6 munAphika purUSaharU ra mahilAharU, allAhako sAthamA sAjhedAra Thahara garne purUSaharU ra mahilAharUlAI ani allAhale Aphno dharmako rakSAko lAgi sahayoga garnuhunna ra Aphno vANIlAI ucca pArnuhunna bhanI so~cneharUlAI allAhale yAtanA dinuhunecha | yinIharUko kuphra ra narAmro so~cako kAraNale allAhako krodha unIharUmAthi Aiparyo ra unIharUlAI Aphno dayAbATa TADhA pArnubhayo | unIharUko lAgi AkhiratamA narka tayAra pArera rAkhnubhaeko cha jasamA unIharUlAI sadAkA lAgi praveza garAunuhunecha | tyo dherai nai narAmro vAsasthAna ho |

7 AkAzaharU ra pRthvIkA sampUrNa senAharU kevala allAhakA hun | tyasadvArA uhA~ AphnA bhaktaharUmadhye jasalAI cAhanuhuncha sahayoga garnuhuncha | allAha zaktizAlI hunuhuncha | uhA~lAI kasaile parAjita garna sakdaina ra uhA~ AphnA sRSTimA, bhAgya lekhnamA ra prazAsanamA tatvadarzI hunuhuncha |

8 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! hAmIle tapAIMlAI sAkSIko rUpamA paThAekA chauM | kiyAmatako dina Aphno samudAyako bAremA sAkSI dinuhunecha | ani mominaharUlAI unIharUko lAgi saMsAramA tayAra pArieko vijaya ra saphalatAko ani AkhiratamA unIharUkA lAgi tayAra pariekA anugrahaharUko zubha-sUcaka banAera paThAekA chauM | ani kAphiraharUlAI saMsAramA mominaharUko hAtabATa prApta hune apamAna ra parAjayako ani AkhiratamA unIharUko parkhAimA baseko pIDAdAyI yAtanAko Dara dekhAune banAera paThAekA chauM |
9 AzA cha, timIharUle allAhamAthi ra uhA~kA rasUlamAthi AsthA rAkhnechau | ani uhA~kA rasUlako sammAna ra satkAra garnechau | ani timIharUle bihAna belukA allAhako mahimAgAna garnechau |

10 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! jasale makkAkA muzrikaharUsa~ga yuddha garne rijavAna nAmI sandhi tapAIMsita gare, vAstavamA unIharUle allAhasa~ga sandhi garekA hun kinaki uhA~le nai unIharUlAI muzrikaharUsa~ga yuddha garne Adeza dinubhaeko ho | uhA~le nai unIharUlAI badalA dinuhunecha | sandhiko samayamA unIharUko hAtamAthi allAhako hAta thiyo | uhA~ unIharUkA kriyAkalApaharUbATa avagata hunuhuncha ra uhA~bATa kehI pani lukeko chaina | ani jasale Aphno sandhi toDyo ra allAhako dharmako sahayoga garne viSayamA uhA~sa~ga juna vAcA gareko thiyo tyasalAI pUrA garena, usale sandhi toDeko ra vAcA virUddha gareko hAni usaimAthi Aiparnecha | yasale allAhalAI hAni puryAune chaina | ani jasale allAhako dharmako sahayoga garne vAcA pUrA garyo uhA~le usalAI mahAna badalA dinuhunecha ra tyo svarga ho |

11 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! juna gAu~leharUlAI allAhale makkAko yAtrAmA tapAIMko sAtha jAnabATa roknubhaeko thiyo; jaba tapAIM unIharUko nindA garnuhunecha unIharUle bhannechan: hAmro sampatti ra hAmrA santAnako heravicAra garne kAryale hAmIlAI tapAIMsa~ga jAnabATa rokyo | tasartha allAhasa~ga hAmro lAgi kSamA mAgnuhos | unIharUle nabI (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) lAI kSamAko lAgi gareko anurodha unIharUle bAhirI mukhabATa mAtra garekA hun yo kurA unIharUko hRdayamA chaina | kinaki unIharUle AphnA pApaharUko lAgi pazcAttApa garekA chainan | unIharUlAI bhannuhos: yadi allAhale timIharUlAI phAidA dina cAhanubhayo vA timIharUlAI hAnI puryAuna cAhanubhayo bhane kasaile pani uhA~lAI rokna sakdaina | baru allAha timIharUko kriyAkalApaharUlAI jAnnuhuncha | timIharUle AphnA kriyAkalApaharUlAI lukAuna khoje pani tyo uhA~bATa lukeko chaina |

12 timIharU dhana-sampatti ra santAnaharUko heracAhamA vyasta raheko bhanI gareko bahAnA uhA~sa~ga najAnuko kAraNa hoina | baru rasUla ra uhA~kA sAthIharU sabaijanA samApta hunechan ra unIharU AphnA gharaharUmA pharkera Aunechainan bhanI timIharUle ThAnekA thiyau | tyasalAI zaitAnale timIharUko hRdayamA sundara banAeko thiyo ra timIharUkA pAlanakartAle Aphno nabIlAI sahayoga garnuhunna bhanI timIharUle uhA~ko viSayamA narAmro so~ca rAkhyau | allAhako viSayamA narAmro so~ca rAkhne timIharUko dussAhasa ra uhA~kA rasUlasa~ga nagaeko kAraNale timIharU naSTa hune bhayau |
13 jasale allAhamAthi ra uhA~ko rasUlamAthi AsthA rAkhena U kAphira (anAsthAvAn) ho | allAhalAI nakArneharUlAI kiyAmatako dina yAtanA dina hAmIle dankado Ago tayAra pArera rAkhekA chauM |

14 AkAzaharU ra pRthvIko sattA kevala allAhako lAgi raheko cha | uhA~ AphnA bhaktaharUmadhye jasalAI cAhanuhuncha kSamA garnuhuncha ra Aphno kRpAle usalAI svargamA praveza garAunuhuncha | ani AphnA bhaktaharUmadhye jasalAI cAhanuhuncha nyAyakA sAtha yAtanA dinuhuncha | allAhale pazcAttApa garne bhaktaharUkA pApaharU kSamA garnuhuncha ra unIharUmAthi dayA garnuhuncha |

15 he mominaharU ho! jaba timIharU khaibara yuddhamA prApta sampatti lina jAnechau jasalAI allAhale hudaibiyAko samjhautApachi dine vAcA garnubhaeko thiyo taba pachi rahekAharUle bhannechan: tyasabATa aMza lina hAmIlAI pani sa~gai jAna deU | yI pachi rahekA mAnisaharU yo anurodha garI allAhale khaibarako yuddhamA prApta sampatti mominaharUlAI mAtra dine bhanI garnubhaeko vAcAlAI parivartana garna cAhanchan | he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! unIharUlAI bhannuhos: timIharU tyo sampatti lina hAmIsa~ga jAnechainau | hudaibiyAmA upasthitaharUko lAgi mAtra khaibarako yuddhamA prApta hune sampatti raheko kurAko vAcA allAhale masa~ga garnubhaeko cha | ani unIharUle bhannechan: allAhale hAmIlAI timIharUsa~ga khaibara jAna roknubhaeko chaina | baru yo kurA timIharUle hAmro DAhako kAraNale garekA hau | yI pachi rahekAharUle so~ceko kurA vAstavikatAsa~ga mela khA~daina | baru unIharU allAhakA AdezaharU ra uhA~le manAhI garnubhaekA kurAharUlAI thorai mAtrai bujhchan | yasai kAraNale unIharU uhA~ko avajJAmA lipta bhae |

16 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! tapAIMsa~ga makkA jAnebelA pachi rahekA gAu~leharUlAI unIharUko parIkSA liine hisAbale bhannuhos: cA~Dai nai timIharUlAI euTA ati nai zaktizAlI samudAyasa~ga yuddha garna AhvAna garinecha | timIharUle unIharUsa~ga yuddha garnechau vA unIharUle yuddha binA nai islAmamA praveza garnechan | unIharUsa~ga yuddha garna allAhale AhvAna gareko belA yadi timIharUrale uhA~ko anusaraNa garyau bhane uhA~le timIharUlAI rAmro pratidAna dinuhunecha juna svarga ho | yadi timIharU jasarI makkA jAna pachi rahekA thiyau tyasarI nai uhA~ko anusaraNabATa vimukha bhayau bhane uhA~le timIharUlAI pIDAdAyI yAtanA dinuhunecha |

17 vaidha bahAnA bhaekAharU jastai andho, laGgaDo ra birAmIle allAhako mArgamA yuddha garna sahabhAgI nahu~dA unIharUlAI kunai pApa lAgne chaina | ani jasale allAhako ra uhA~kA rasUlaharUko anusaraNa garnecha usalAI uhA~le bagaiMcAharUmA praveza garAunuhunecha jasako mahalaharU ra rUkhaharUko talatirabATa naharaharU bagirahekA hunechan | ani jo yI dubaiko anusaraNabATa vimukha huncha usalAI allAhale pIDAdAyI yAtanA dinuhunecha |

18 vAstavamA, allAha mominaharUsita tyasa samaya ati prasanna hunubhayo jaba unIharU hudaibiyAmA rUkhamuni rijavAna nAmI pratijJA gardai thie | unIharUko hRdayamA rahekA AsthA, ekAgratA ra satyatAko viSayamA uhA~lAI thAhA thiyo | ani uhA~le unIharUko hRdayamA zAnti avataraNa garnubhayo ra tyasako lAgi uhA~le unIharUko lAgi khaibarako saphalatAko rUpamA najikako saphalatA pradAna garera badalA dinubhayo | juna unIharU makkAmA praveza garna nasakekA hunAle tyasako badalA svarUpa uhA~le pradAna garnubhayo |

19 ani uhA~le unIharUlAI khaibarakA bAsindAharUkA dherai sampattiharU pradAna garnubhayo | allAha zaktizAlI hunuhuncha jasalAI kasaile pani parAjita garna sakdaina ra uhA~ AphnA sRSTi, bhAgya lekhna ra kAnunamA tatvadarzI hunuhuncha |

20 he mominaharU ho! bhaviSyamA islAmalAI prApta hune vijayaharUmA timIharUle dherai nai dhanaharU prApta garnechau bhanI allAhale timIharUsita vAcA garnubhaeko cha | ani uhA~le khaibarako sampatti cA~Dai nai pradAna garnubhayo ra timIharUko anupasthitimA yahUdIharUle timIharUkA parivAralAI hAnI puryAuna khojdA uhA~le unIharUko hAta roknubhayo | ani uhA~le cA~Dai pradAna garnubhaeko yo sampattilAI allAhako sahayoga ra timIharUlAI uhA~ko samarthanako nizAnI banAunubhaeko cha ra timIharUlAI allAhale sIdhA mArga dekhAunubhayo jasamA kunai TeDhopana chaina |

21 ani uhA~le timIharUsita anya dherai sampattiharUko vAcA garnubhaeko cha, jasalAI tatkAla timIharUle pAune chainau | allAhamAtra tyasako sAmarthya rAkhnuhuncha ra yo uhA~ko jJAnamA ra vyavasthApanamA nirdhArita raheko cha | allAha hareka kAryako sAmarthya rAkhnuhuncha ra uhA~lAI kunai kurAle vivaza pArna sakdaina |

22 he mominaharU ho! yadi kAphiraharUle timIharUsita yuddha garekA bhae unIharU parAjita bhaera ani piThyU~ pharkAera bhAgne thie | ani unIharUle timIharU virUddha yuddhamA sahayoga puryAune kohI pAune chainan |

23 mominaharU vijayI hunu ra kAphiraharU parAjita hunu hareka samayamA ra sthAnamA nizcita raheko cha | yI jhUTA Thahara garneharUbhandA pahilekA samudAyamA allAhako yo nIti lAgu bhaisakeko cha | he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! tapAIMle allAhako nItilAI parivartana bhaeko dekhnuhunechaina |

24 uhA~le nai muzrikaharUbATa timIharUlAI jogAunubhayo | lagabhaga assI janAle timIharUlAI hudaibiyAmA hAnI puryAuna khojekA thie | ani timIharUko hAtabATa unIharUlAI bacAunubhayo; timIharUle unIharUlAI hatyA garenau ra unIharUlAI hAnI puryAenau | unIharUlAI bandhaka banAuna allAhale timIharUlAI sahayoga garnubhayo taipani timIharUle unIharUlAI jAna diyau | timIharU je garirahekA chau tyo allAhale herirahanubhaeko cha | timIharUko kriyAkalApa uhA~bATa lukeko chaina |

25 unIharUle nai allAhalAI ra uhA~kA rasUlalAI inkAra gare ani timIharUlAI masjide haramamA praveza garnabATa ani kurbAnIkA janAvaraharUlAI harama athavA kurbAnI dine sthAnasamma pugnabATa roke | makkAmA allAhamAthi AsthA rAkhne purUSa ra mahilAharUko upasthiti raheko cha | timIharUlAI unIharUko pahicAna nai chaina | kAphiraharUsa~ga unIharUlAI pani hatyA gareko khaNDamA anjAnamA timIharUmAthi pApa lAgne ra raktamulya tirnuparne AzaMkA nabhaeko bhae timIharUlAI makkAmAthi vijaya prApta garne anumati dinuhune thiyo | uhA~ jasalAI cAhanuhuncha makkAkA mominaharU saraha Aphno dayAmA samAveza garnuhuncha | yadi makkAmA kAphiraharU ra mominaharUmA pharaka bhaeko bhae hAmIle allAhalAI ra uhA~kA rasUlalAI nakArneharUlAI pIDAdAyI yAtanA dine thiyauM |

26 jaba allAha ra uhA~ko rasUlalAI nakArneharUle Aphno hRdayamA mUrkhatAle bharieko pakSapAta utpanna gare jasako sambandha satyasa~ga chaina baru tyasako sambandha icchAsa~ga raheko cha | allAhakA rasUlale unIharUmAthi vijaya prApta garnubhayo bhanne Darale unIharUle uhA~lAI hudaibiyAko dina praveza garnabATa roka lagAe | ani allAhale Aphno rasUlamAthi ra mominaharUmAthi Aphno tarphabATa zAnti avataraNa garnubhayo | tyasaile krodhale unIharUlAI muzrikaharUle garejasto vyavahAra garna prerita garena | allAhale mominaharUlAI satyako vANIko pratibaddha garAunubhayo juna lA ilAha illallAha (allAhabAheka arU kohI vAstavika upAsya chaina) ho ra tyasako sammAna garna prerita garnubhayo tasartha unIharUle sammAna gare | mominaharU yasa vANIko arUbhandA baDhI adhikAra rAkhchan | kinaki allAhalAI unIharUko hRdayamA raheko bhalAiko jJAna cha | allAha hareka kurAko sAmarthya rAkhnuhuncha ra uhA~bATa kehI pani lukeko chaina |

27 vAstavamA, allAhale Aphno rasUlalAI nidrAmA satyamA AdhArita sapanA dekhAunubhayo | ani uhA~le AphnA sAthIharUlAI tyasako viSayamA bhannubhayo | tyo kurA ho- uhA~ ra uhA~kA sAthIharU allAhako ghara haramamA zatruharUbATa surakSita avasthAmA praveza garnuhunecha | umarA pUrA bhaeko saGketako rUpamA kehIle kapAla khauranechan ra kehIle kapAla choTo pArnechan | he mominaharU ho! allAhalAI timIharUko bhalAiko jJAna cha jasako jJAna timIharUlAI chaina | ani uhA~le tyasa varSa makkA praveza garne sapanAlAI satya pramANita garnu bAheka hudaibiyAko samjhautAlAI najikako vijayako rUpamA banAunubhayo | ani tyasalagattai hudaibiyAmA upasthita mominaharUlAI uhA~le khaibaramAthi vijaya pradAna garnubhayo |

28 allAhale nai Aphno rasUla muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) lAI spaSTa sandeza ra satya dharma diera paThAunubhayo juna islAma dharma ho | uhA~le yasa dharmalAI sampUrNa dharmaharUbhandA ucca banAunuhunecha | allAhale yasako sAkSI dinubhaeko cha ra sAkSIko lAgi uhA~ paryApta hunuhuncha |

29 allAhako rasUla muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) ra uhA~kA sAthamA rahekA sahAbIharU yoddhA kAphiraharUko lAgi kaThora chan ra eka ApasamA dayAlu, sahAnubhutI dekhAune ra mAyA garne chan | he herne vyakti! timI unIharUlAI allAhabATa kSamA, pratidAna ra uhA~ko prasannatA pAunako lAgi rUkU ra sajdA gareko dekhchau | unIharUko anuhAramA sajdA, mArgadarzana, laganazIlatA ra namAjako prakAzako cinha cha | unIharUkA yI guNaharUko ullekha mUsA (alaihissalAma) mAthi avatarita taurAtamA bhaeko cha | IsA (alaihissalAma) mAthi avatarita injIlamA unIharUle eka arkAlAI sahayoga garne ra unIharUko pUrNatAko viSayamA khetIko udAharaNa diieko cha | jasale pahile Aphno aMkura nikAlcha juna tyasapachi baliyo ra paripakva huncha ani DA~ThamAthi sIdhA khaDA huncha | tyasako zakti ra pUrNatAle kRSakaharUlAI prasanna tulyAu~cha | ani unIharUmA raheko zakti, dRDhatA ra pUrNatA jAhera garera allAhale kAphiraharUlAI krodhita pArnuhuncha | unIharUmadhye allAhamAthi AsthA rAkhneharU ra satkarma garneharUkA pApaharUlAI kSamA garne, unIharUlAI yAtanA nadine ra uhA~ko tarphabATa mahAna pratidAna arthAta svarga pradAna garne vAcA uhA~le garnubhayo |

1 he AsthAvAnaharU ho! kurA ra karmamA allAha ra uhA~kA rasUlabhandA agADi nabaDha ra allAhakA AdezaharUko pAlanA garI ra uhA~le manAhI garnubhaekA kurAharUbATa bacI uhA~ko bhaya rAkha | vAstavamA, allAhale timIharUkA kurAharU sunnuhuncha ra timIharUkA kriyAkalApaharUlAI hernuhuncha | uhA~bATa kehI pani lukeko chaina ra tyasakai AdhAramA timIharUlAI badalA diinecha |

2 he allAhamAthi ImAna rAkhneharU ho! uhA~ko rasUlasa~ga sabhya vyavahAra gara ra nabI (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) lAI sambodhana gardA uhA~ko svarabhandA Aphno svara ucca napAra | jasarI timIharU eka arkAlAI bolAuchau tyasarI nAma liera uhA~lAI nabolAU | baru namra zailImA uhA~lAI nabI ra rasUla bhanera bolAU | natra timIharUkA kAryaharU pratidAna barbAda hunechan | tara timIharUlAI Aphno pratidAna barbAda bhaeko AbhAsa hunechaina |

3 vAstavamA, allAhako rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) samakSa Aphno svaralAI sAno pArneharUlAI nai allAhale unIharUkA hRdayaharUlAI Aphno bhayako lAgi vizuddha ra imAnadAra banAunubhaeko cha | unIharUkA pApaharUlAI kSamA garnuhunecha ani yAtanA dinuhunechaina | ani kiyAmatako dina unIharUlAI mahAna pratidAna pradAna garnuhunecha arthAta unIharUlAI svargamA praveza garAunuhunecha |
4 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! vAstavamA, tapAIMkA patnIharUko koThA bAhirabATa tapAIMlAI AvAja dine gAu~leharU hun | unIharUmadhye dheraijanA anjAna chan |

5 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! tapAIMkA patnIharUko koThAharUko pachADibATa tapAIMlAI bolAuneharUle tapAIM naAuJjela nabolAI dhairya dhAraNa garekA bhae ani tapAIMlAI namra zailImA sambodhana garekA bhae rAmro kArya hune thiyo kinaki yasamA maryAdA ra sammAna raheko cha | unIharU madhyebATa ra unIharU bAheka pazcAttApa garne sampUrNakA pApaharU ra ajJAnatAlAI allAhale kSamA garnuhunecha ani unIharUmAthi dayA garnuhunecha |

6 he AsthAvAnaharU ho! yadi kunai avajJAkArIle timIharU samakSa kehI mAnisaharUko viSayamA kehI sUcanA dincha bhane pahilA tyasako satyatAko chAnabina gara ra tyasalAI puSTi garna hatAra nagara | yadi timIharUle usako sUcanAlAI chAnabina binA nai puSTi garyau bhane AzaGkA cha, timIharUle kunai samudAyamAthi unIharUko vAstavika AvasthAbATa anavijJa rahI AkramaNa garna pugnechau | ani pachi unIharUko viSayamA prApta sUcanA jhUTo bhaeko thAhA pAera apazoca garnechau |

7 he mominaharU ho! jAnI rAkha, timIharUmAjha allAhakA rasUla hunuhuncha ra uha~mAthi vahI avataraNa garincha | timIharU jhUTa bolnabATa baca kinaki uhA~mAthi vahI avataraNa garI uhA~lAI timIharUko jhUTako viSayamA jAnakArI diinecha | uhA~lAI timIharUko bhalAiko jJAna cha | yadi uhA~le adhikatama viSayamA timIharUko prastAva mAnnubhayo bhane timIharU nai saGkaTamA parnechau juna uhA~le timIharUko lAgi rojnubhaeko chaina | tara allAhale Aphno kRpAle timIharUko lAgi AsthAlAI rojnubhaeko cha ra timIharUko hRdayamA tyasalAI sundara banAera prastuta garnubhayo ani timIharUle AsthA rAkhyau | ani timIharUko lAgi kuphra ra uhA~ko avajJA garnulAI mana parAunubhaeko chaina | yI guNaharU bhaekA nai sIdhA ra sahI bATo hi~DneharU hun |

8 timIharUmAthi allAhako anugrahako kAraNale nai timIharUko hRdayamA puNyalAI sundara ra pApalAI apriya banAieko cha | allAhale AphnA bhaktaharUmA kRtajJa tathA uhA~lAI dhanyavAda dinelAI rAmrarI jAnnuhuncha ani usalAI sahayoga pradAna garnuhuncha | ani hareka kurAlAI usako sahI ThAu~mA rAkhnuhuncha kinaki uhA~ tatvadarzI hunuhuncha |

9 he mominaharU ho! yadi mominaharUkA duI samUha ApasamA jhagaDA garchan bhane unIharUlAI Aphno vivAdamA allAhako Adezako pAlanA garne AhvAna garI unIharUbIca melamilApa garAU | yadi kunai euTA samUhale melamilApa garna asvIkAra garyo ra tyasako ullaGghana garyo bhane tyasa ullaGghana garnesa~ga allAhako Adeza mAnne nabhaesamma yuddha gara | yadi tyo samUha allAhako Adezako adhInamA Ayo bhane unIharUbIca nyAya ra niSpakSatAkA sAtha melamilApa garAU | unIharUbIca Adeza di~dA nyAyakA sAtha deU | vAstavamA, allAhale nyAya-nisApha garneharUlAI mana parAunuhuncha |

10 mominaharU islAmako nAtAle eka-arkAkA dAjubhAi hun | he mominaharU ho! matabheda bhaekA dAjubhAiharUbIca timIharUle melamilApa garAU | allAhakA AdezaharUko anusaraNa garI ra uhA~le manAhI garnubhaekA kurAharUbATa bacI uhA~ko bhaya rAkha | AzA cha, timIharUmAthi dayA garinecha |

11 he allAhamAthi AsthA rAkhne ra uhA~kA Adezako pAlanA garneharU ho! puruSaharUko kunai samUhale arko samUhako ThaTTA nagaros | sambhava cha, allAhako najaramA ThaTTA gariekAharU nai uttama houn | allAhako najaramA je rAmro cha tyahI nai mahatva rAkhcha | ani mahilAharUle pani arU mahilAharUko ThaTTA nagarUn | sambhava cha, allAhako najaramA ThaTTA gariekAharU nai uttama houn | AphnA dAjubhAiko nindA nagara kinaki unIharU pani timIharU jastai chan | eka arkAlAI narAmro nAmale napukAra jasalAI unIharU mana parAu~dainan | nabI (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) Aunu aghi kehI ansAraharUko avasthA yastai thiyo | timIharUmadhye jo yaso gardacha U pApI ho | ImAna lyAepachi avajJAkArI hunu dherai narAmro guNa ho | jo yasa avajJAbATa pazcAttApa gardainan unIharUle AphUmAthi atyAcAra garekA chan |

12 he allAhamAthi AsthA rAkhne ra uhA~kA Adezako pAlanA garneharU ho! nirAdhAra anumAnaharUbATa TADhA basa | vAstavamA, kehI anumAnaharU pApa hunchan jastai rAmro mAnisako bAremA narAmro so~ca rAkhnu | ani mominaharUko pachADi unIharUko gopya kurAharUko khojI nagara | timIharUmadhye kohI pani Aphno dAjubhAiko bAremA tyo kurA nabhana juna usalAI mana pardaina | kinaki usalAI mana naparne tarikAle usako kurA kATnu mareko mAsu khAnu ho | ke timIharUmadhye kohI Aphno dAjubhAiko mRta zarIrako mAsu khAna cAhancha? tasartha usako kurA nakATa kinaki yo pani tyahI kurA ho | allAhako AdezaharUko pAlanA garI ra uhA~le manAhI garnubhaekA kurAharUbATa baca uhA~sa~ga Dara | vAstavamA, allAhale AphnA bhaktaharU madhyebATa pazcAttApa garneharUlAI kSamA garnuhuncha ra unIharUmAthi dayA garnuhuncha |

13 he mAnisaharU ho! hAmIle timIharUlAI euTA purUSa arthAta timIharUko purkhA AdamabATa ra euTI mahilA arthAta havvAbATa janma diyauM | timIharUko vaMza euTai ho | tasartha timIharU vaMzalAI AdhAra banAera eka arkAmAthi ghamaNDa nagara | tyasapachi timIharUlAI dherai jAtiharUmA ra pharaka pharaka vaMzaharUmA banAyauM tAki eka arkAlAI cinna saka tara yasako AdhAramA ghamaNDa nagara | timIharUmA bhinnatA bhaneko Izabhayako kAraNale ho | yasakAraNale uhA~le bhannubhayoH vAstavamA, allAhako dRSTimA timIharUmadhye sabaibhandA dherai sammAnita tyahI vyakti cha jo timIharUmadhye sabaibhandA dherai Izabhaya rAkhcha | allAhalAI timIharUko avasthA, zakti ra kamajorIharUko jJAna cha ra uhA~bATa kehI pani lukeko chaina |

14 kehI gAu~leharUle nabI (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) samakSa Aera bhaneH hAmIle allAha ra uhA~kA rasUlamAthi ImAna lyAyauM | he nabI! unIharUlAI bhannuhos: timIharUle ImAna lyAekA chainau; tara timIharU bhanaH hAmIle islAma lyAyauM arthAt Atma samarpaNa garyauM | ImAna ahilesamma timIharUko hRdayamA paseko chaina ra AzA cha, tyo praveza garnasakcha | he gAu~leharU ho! yadi timIharUle ImAna, satkarma ra avaidha kurAharUbATa bacnamA allAha ra uhA~kA rasUlako anusaraNa garyau bhane allAhale timIharUkA satkarmaharUko pratidAnabATa kehI pani kama garnuhunechaina | vAstavamA, allAha AphnA bhaktaharUmadhye pazcAttApa garneharUlAI kSamA pradAna garnuhunecha ra unIharUmAthi dayA garnuhuncha |

15 jasale allAhamAthi ra uhA~kA rasUlamAthi ImAna (AsthA) rAkhe ani AphnA ImAnalAI zaMkAsa~ga misAera duSita pArenan, allAhako mArgamA AphnA jIu-dhanakA sAtha jihAda gare ra rattI bhara pani kanjusyAi~ garenan | yI guNa bhaekAharU AphnA ImAna (AsthA) mA saccA chan |

16 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! yI gAu~leharUlAI bhannuhos: ke timIharU allAhalAI sikAuna cAhanchau, Aphno dharmako viSayamA jAnakArI dina cAhanchau? allAhalAI AkAzaharU ra pRthvImA rahekA sampUrNa kurAharUko jJAna cha ra uhA~ sampUrNa kurAharUko jJAna rAkhnuhuncha | uhA~bATa kehI pani lukeko chaina ani timIharUko dharmako viSamayA uhA~lAI kehI jAnakArI dinuparnechaina |
