17 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! yI gAu~leharUle islAma apanAe bhanI tapAIMmAthi upakAra jatAuchan | unIharUlAI bhannuhos: allAhako dharma apanAera mamAthi upakAra najatAU | yadi yasako kehI phAidA cha bhane tyo timIharUle nai pAunechau | baru allAhale timIharUlAI ImAna lyAune kSamatA pradAna garera timIharUmAthi upakAra garnubhaeko cha, yadi timIharUle islAma apanAeko dAbImA saccA chau bhane |

18 vAstavamA, allAhalAI AkAzaharU ra pRthvIkA sabai adRzya kurAharUko jJAna cha | uhA~bATa kehI pani lukeko chaina | allAhale timIharUkA kriyAkalApaharUlAI herirahanubhaeko cha | timIharUkA kunai pani karma uhA~bATa lukeko chaina | uhA~le rAmro ra narAmro karma anusAra timIharUlAI badalA dinuhunecha |

1 kApha0! yastA akSaraharUko vyAkhyA sUraha al-bakarahako ArambhamA bhaisakeko cha | allAhale kurAnako kasama khAnubhaeko cha kinaki yasamA atyAdhika arthaharU, bhalAi ra kRpAkA rahekA chan | timIharUlAI kiyAmatako dina nizcaya nai hisAba lina ra badalA dinako lAgi punaH jIvita pArinechau |

2 tapAIM jhUTo bolnuhuncha bhanera unIharUle asvIkAra garekA thienan | tapAIM sA~co hunuhuncha bhanne kurA unIharUlAI thAhA cha | baru unIharU kai jAtIbATa unIharU samakSa cetAvanI dine rasUla Ayo ra phariztAharUko jAtIbATa Aenan bhanI unIharUlAI acamma lAgeko cha | Azcarya hu~dai unIharUle bhaneH hAmItira manuSya rasUla bhaera Aunu euTA acammako kurA ho |
3 hAmI marera mATo bhaepachi ke hAmI punaH jIvita bhaera uThnechauM? hAmI marisakepachi hAmrA zarIramA pherI jIvana hAlinecha bhannu asambhava kurA ho | yastu hunu sambhava nai chaina |

4 mRtyupazcAta dhartIle zarIralAI khAera samApta pArnecha bhanne kurA hAmIlAI rAmrosa~ga thAhA cha | tyo hAmIbATa lukeko chaina | unIharUko jIvanamA ra mRtyupazcAta hune parivartanalAI surakSita rAkhne euTA kitAba hAmIsa~ga cha |

5 rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) le yI muzrikaharU samakSa kurAna prastuta gardA yinIharUle jhUTo Thahara gare | yinIharU cintita chan | yinIharUsita kurAnako viSayamA kunai Thosa dRSTikoNa chaina |

jaba muzrikaharUle punaH jIvita pArne satyatAlAI inkAra garne kurAko ullekha garnubhayo taba uhA~le unIharUlAI tyo nizcita rUpale ghaTne kurAkA pramANaharU prastuta garnubhayo | uhA~le bhannubhayoH
6 mRtyu pazcAta punaH jIvita pArine kurAlAI jhUTo Thahara garneharUle ke AphUmAthi raheko AkAzako bAremA cintana manana gardainan? hAmIle kasarI tyasalAI sRSTi garyauM, rAmrosa~ga nirmANa garyauM, vibhinna tArAharU rAkhera sajAyauM ra tyasamA pvAla vA cirA kehI chaina bhanne kurAmA dhyAna didainan? jasale yo AkAzako sRSTi garnubhaeko cha uhA~lAI mRtakalAI punaH jIvita pArna kohI vivaza pArna sakdaina |

7 hAmIle pRthvIlAI basobAsa garna yogya samatala banAyauM | ani khaskana ra hallinabATa roknako lAgi hAmIle tyahA~ baliyA parvataharUlAI jamAyauM | ani hAmIle tyasamA hareka prakArakA sundara boTabirUvA ra rUkhaharU umAryauM |
8 Aphno pAlanakartAko anusaraNa garI uhA~tira pharkane hareka bhaktako lAgi hAmIle yI sampUrNalAI A~khA kholne ra pATha sikAune sAdhana banAekA chauM |
9 hAmIle AkAzabATa dherai phAidA ra bhalAi bhaeko pAnI varSAyauM | ani tyasa pAnIdvArA hAmIle bagaiMcAharU umAryauM ra gahu~- jau jastA anya kATine annaharU umAryauM |
10 ani tyasadvArA hAmIle ekamAthi arko garI jhuNDiekA phalakA jhuppAharU bhaekA aglA-aglA khajUrakA rUkhaharU umAryauM |

11 hAmIle tyasadvArA bhaktaharUle khAne jIvikAko lAgi annaharUko vyavasthA garyauM | hAmIle yasadvArA boTabirUvA nabhaekA sukekA kSetralAI jIvita pAryauM | jasarI yasa pAnIdvArA hAmI boTabirUvA nabhaeko kSetralAI jIvita pArchauM tyasarI nai hAmI mRtakalAI jIvita pArnechauM | tasartha unIharU jIvita bhaera niskanechan |

12 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! tapAIMlAI jhUTo Thahara garneharUbhandA pahile pani nabIharUlAI unIharUkA samudAyaharUle jhUTo Thahara garisakekA chan | nUha (alaihissalAma) lAI unako samudAyale, inAravAlAharUle ra samUdale jhUTo Thahara gare |
13 Adale, phiraunale ra lUtako samudAyale jhUTo Thahara gare |

14 zuaiba (alaihissalAma) ko samudAya, aikAbAsIharU ra yamanako rAjA tubbAkA samudAya Adi sabaile AphUtarpha paThAiekA rasUlaharUlAI jhUTo Thahara gare, ani tinIharU allAhale cetAvanI dinubhaeko yAtanAko zikAra bhae |

15 ke hAmI timIharUlAI pahilo paTaka sRSTi garna asamartha thiyauM jasakAraNale hAmI timIharUlAI dosro paTaka jIvita pArna asamartha hunechauM? baru unIharU Aphno pahilo sRSTipachi nayA~ sRSTibAre sandehamA chan |
16 hAmIle manuSyako sRSTi garyauM ra hAmI usakA icchA ra vicAraharU jAndachauM | hAmI usako muTusa~ga joDieko usako ghA~TIko nasAbhandA najika chauM |
17 jaba usakA karmalAI duIjanA phariztAharUle lekhchan | pahilo usako dAhine tira baseko huncha ra dosro usako debre tira |
18 usale boleko hareka zabdako lAgi Usa~ga saMrakSaka phariztA upasthita huncha |
19 ani mRtyuko kaSTa nizcaya nai Aunecha jasabATa bacera bhAgne ThAu~ nai chaina | he aceta manuSya! timI yasaibATa bhAgna cAhanthyau |
20 ani sUra phUkna niyukta garieko phariztAle dosro sUra phuknecha | tyo kiyAmatako dina hunecha arthAta cetAvanIko dina juna dina kAphiraharU ra pApIharUlAI yAtanA diinecha |
21 hareka prANIlAI euTA phariztAle liera Aunecha ra arko phariztAle usakA karmaharUko gavAhI dinecha |

22 lyAieko tyasa mAnisalAI bhaninechaH timI saMsAramA yasa dinako viSayamA asAvadhAna thiyau kinaki timI timrA icchAharU ra cAhanAharUko dhokAmA thiyau | ani hAmIle timIharUlAI yAtanA ra kaSTako svAda cakhAera timIharUko asAvadhAnI prakaTa garekA chauM | Aja timIharUko dRSTi tejilo cha jasale timIharUkA atitakA asAvadhAnIharUlAI dekhnecha |
23 Usa~gai khaTAieko phariztAle bhannechaH yI usakA karmaharU hun | yasamA kunai kamI vA vRddhi garieko chaina |
24 allAhale sa~gai lyAune ra sAkSI dine dubai phariztAharUlAI bhannuhunechaH satyalAI nakArne hareka zatrulAI narkamA hAla |
25 allAhakA satya AdezaharUlAI asvIkAra garne, allAhakA sImAharU ullaGghana garne ra usalAI sUcita gariekA vAcA vA cetAvanIko viSayamA zaGkA garnelAI pani |
26 allAhasa~gai anya upAsyaharUko upAsanA garnelAI pani timIle pIDAdAyI yAtanA deU |

27 usako zaitAna sAthIle Usa~ga mero kunai sambandha chaina bhanne ghoSaNA gardai bhannechaH he hAmrA pAlanakartA! maile usalAI bahakAeko hoina | baru U AphaiM satyabATa dherai TADhA bhai pathabhraSTa bhayo |

28 allAhale bhannuhunechaH timIharU mero sAmu jhagaDA nagara kinaki jhagaDAko kehI phAidA chaina | malAI inkAra garne ra mero avajJA garne vyaktiko viSayamA merA rasUlaharUle lyAekA mero kaDA cetAvanI Aisakeko cha |

29 merA kurA parivartana hu~dainan ra mero vAcA asaphala hu~daina | ma bhaktaharUkA satkarmalAI ghaTAera ra unIharUkA kukarmalAI baDhAera unIharUmAthi atyAcAra gardina | baru ma unIharUlAI unIharUkA karmaharUko badalA dinchu |

30 tyasa dina hAmI narkalAI bhannechauH timI bhitra hAliekA kAphiraharU ra avajJAkArIharUle timI bhariyau ta? usale ajhai mAga gardai Aphno pAlanakartAlAI bhannechaH ke arU pani chan ra? tyasale Aphno pAlanakartAko tarphabATa rIsa pokhdai bhannecha |

jaba allAhale kAphiraharUko viSayamA kaThora yAtanAko ullekha garnubhayo taba uhA~le AphnA momina bhaktaharUkA lAgi tayAra pArera rAkhnubhaekA kurAharUko ullekha garnubhaeko cha | uhA~le bhannubhaeko chaH
31 Aphno pAlanakartAkA AdezaharUko palanA garI ra uhA~le manAhI garnubhaekA kurAharUbATa bacI uhA~ko bhaya rAkhneharUko najika svarga hunecha | ani unIharUle tyasamA rahekA anugrahaharUlAI dekhnechan juna TADhA hunechaina |
32 unIharUlAI bhaninechaH pAlanakartAle jimmA dinubhaeko kurAmA aDiga rahI Aphno pAlanakartAtira pharkera pazcAttApa garne harekalAI garieko vAcA yahI ho |

33 jo gopya rUpamA allAhasa~ga DarAu~cha, jahA~ kevala allAha mAtra usalAI dekhne hunuhuncha | ani allAhalAI saccA hRdayakA sAtha bheTcha ra allAhatarpha dhyAna diera dheraibhandA dherai uhA~tarpha pravRta huncha |
34 unIharUlAI bhaninechaH timIharU mana naparne sampUrNa kurAharUbATa surakSita bhaera salAmatIko sAtha svargamA praveza gara | tyo sadA rahane dina hunecha juna kahile samApta hunechaina |

35 tyahA~ unIharUle cAhekA anugrahaharU asImita rUpamA pAunechan ra hAmIsa~ga ajhai anugrahaharU chan jasalAI kunai A~khAle dekheko chaina, kunai kAnale tyasako viSayamA suneko chaina ra kasaiko manamA tyasako viSayamA so~ca Aeko chaina | tyasaigarI allAhako sAkSAtkAra darzana garne avasara pani |

36 yI makkAkA jhUTA Thahara garne muzrikaharUbhandA pahile yinIharUbhandA jhana zaktizAlI katipaya samudAyalAI hAmIle naSTa pArisakekA chauM | yAtanAbATa bacera bhAgne ThAu~ko khojImA unIharUle dezaharUmA ghumaphira gare tara unIharUle kunai ThAu~ pAenan |
37 vAstavamA, aghillA samudAyaharUlAI naSTa pArieko kathAmA so~cna sakne hRdaya bhaeko vA ekAgra bhaera anabhijJa nabhaI sunne vyaktiko lAgi smaraNa ra upadeza raheko cha |

38 hAmIle AkAzaharU, pRthvI ra jejati yI dubaiko bIcamA rahekA chan sampUrNalAI 6 dinamA sRSTi garyauM yadyapi hAmI eka kSaNamA nai tyasalAI sRSTi garne sAmarthya rAkhchauM | tara hAmI thAkenauM juna Aropa yahUdIharUle lagAekA chan |

39 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! yahUdIharU ra arUharUko bhanAimA dhairya garnuhos | ani AphnA pAlanakartAko prazaMsAkA sAtha sUryodayaaghi phajrako namAja paDhnuhos ra sUryAstapachi asrako namAja paDhnuhos |
40 ani rAtamA namAja paDhnuhos ra namAja paDhepachi uhA~ko guNagAna garnuhos |
41 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! desro sUra phUkna niyukta gariekA phariztAle juna dina najikako ThAu~bATa pukArnecha tyasalAI sunnuhos |

42 tyasa dina sampUrNa sRSTile punaH jIvita bhaera uThne bhayaGkara svara sunnechan ra yasamA kunai zaGkA chaina | juna dina unIharU yasalAI sunnechan tyo dina hisAba ra badalAko lAgi cihAnaharUbATa mRtakaharU bAhira niskane dina ho |

43 vAstavamA, hAmI nai jIvita pArchauM ra mRtyu dinchauM | hAmI bAheka kohI pani jIvita pArne ra mRtyu dine chaina | kiyAmatako dina hisAba ra badalAko lAgi sampUrNa bhaktaharU hAmItira nai pharkera Aunechan |
44 tyasa dina unIharUmAthi dhartI phATnecha ani unIharU hatAramA bAhira niskanechan | yo bhelA pArne kAma hAmro lAgi sahaja raheko cha |

45 yI muzrikaharUle bhaneko kurAko jJAna hAmIlAI cha | he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! tapAIMle unIharUlAI ImAna lyAunako lAgi vivaza garna saknuhunna | tapAIMko kAma bhaneko allAhako sandezalAI puryAidine mAtra ho | kAphiraharU ra avajJAkArIharUlAI kurAnako sahayogale upadeza dinuhos | kinaki Dara rAkhne nai upadeza grahaNa garcha ra jaba smaraNa garAincha U smaraNa garcha |
1 allAhale dhUlo uDAune hAvAko kasama khAnubhaeko cha |
2 ani paryApta pAnI bokne bAdalako kasama khAnubhaeko cha |
3 ani samudramA sahajatA ra namratAkA sAtha calne jahAjaharUko kasama khAnubhaeko cha |
4 ani allAhako Adeza anusAra bhaktaharUkA mAmilAharU vitaraNa garne phariztAharUko kasama khAnubhaeko cha |
5 timIharUkA pAlanakartAle hisAba ra badalAko viSayamA dinubhaeko cetAvanI nitAnta satya ho jasamA kunai zaMkA chaina |
6 vAstavamA, kiyAmatako dina bhaktaharUko hisAba hune nai cha ra yasamA kunai zaGkA chaina |
7 allAhale mArgaharU bhaeko sundara AkAzako kasama khAnubhaeko cha |

8 he makkAbAsIharU ho! timIharUko kurAmA virodhAbhASa cha | kahile bhanchauH kurAna jAdU ho ra kahile bhanchau yo kavitA ho | ani timIharU bhanchau muhammada jAdUgara ho ra kahile bhanchau U kavi ho |

9 kurAna ra nabI (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) mAthiko AsthA lyAunabATa tyahI vyakti TADhA huncha jasalAI allAhale Aphno jJAnako AdhAramA TADhA garnuhuncha | kinabhane allAhalAI pahiledekhi nai thAhA cha ki usale ImAna lyAunechaina, tyasaile uhA~le usalAI mArgadarzana pradAna garnuhunna |
10 kurAna ra Aphno nabIko viSayamA yasto bhanne jhUTA Thahara garneharUko vinAza hunecha |
11 jo Akhiratako viSayamA anabhijJa chan ra yinIharUlAI tyasako cintA nai chaina |
12 yinIharU sodhchan- badalA diine dina kahile Aunecha? tara yinIharU tyasako lAgi karma gardainan |
13 ani allAhale unIharUko praznako jabApha dinuhunchaH juna dina yinIharUlAI narkamA yAtanA diinecha |
14 unIharUlAI bhaninechaH Aphno yAtanA bhoga | yasakai viSayamA timIharUlAI cetAvanI diinebelA timIharUle yasako lAgi hatAra garyau ra yasako khillI uDAyau |

15 vAstavamA, AphnA pAlanakartAkA AdezaharUko pAlanA garI ra uhA~le manAhI garnubhaekA kurAharUbATa bacI uhA~ko bhaya rAkhneharUkA lAgi kiyAmatako dina bagaiMcAharU ra bagirahane mUlaharU rahekA chan |
16 unIharUkA pAlanakartAle dinubhaekA badalA tathA pratiphalaharU liirahekA hunechan, kinaki yo badalA pAunubhandA pahile unIharU saMsAramA satkarmI thie |
17 unIharU rAtamA salAha (namAja) paDhthe ra rAtamA thorai mAtrai sutthe |
18 ani bihAnako samayamA allAha samakSa AphnA pApaharUko kSamA yAcanA garthe |
19 ani mAgne, namAgne ra kunai kAraNa jIvikAbATa vaJcita bhaekA hakadAraharU sabailAI svecchAle AphnA dhana-sampattibATa dAna dine garthe |
20 pRthvI ra tyasamA bhaekA parvataharU, samudraharU, nadIharU, rUkhaharU, boTa birUvAharU ra janAvaraharU allAha nai sRSTikartA hunuhuncha bhanne kurAko pramANa hun | AsthA rAkhneharUko lAgi |
21 he manuSyaharU ho! timIharUko astitvamA allAhako zaktikA pramANaharU rahekA chan | ke timIharU vicAra garnako lAgi herdainau?
22 ani AkAzamA pani timIharUkA sAMsArika ra dhArmika jIvikA chan ra timIharUlAI dine bhanI vAcA gariekA rAmrA vA narAmrA kurA pani chan |

23 AkAza ra pRthvIkA mAlikako kasama, vAstavamA, punaH jIvita pArinu nitAnta satya ho jasamA kunai zaGkA chaina jasarI timIharUle kurA garnebelA timIharU kurA garna sakSama hunumA kunai zaGkA chaina |
24 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! ke tapAIMlAI ibrAhIma (alaihissalAma) kA phariztA pAhunAharUko khabara prApta bhayo jasalAI unale satkAra garekA thie?
25 jaba unIharU ibrAhImakahA~ puge ani bhaneH tapAIMmAthi salAma hos | ibrAhImale javApha di~dai bhaneH timIharUmAthi salAma hos | ani Aphno manamA bhaneH ma yinIharUlAI ta cindi~na |
26 unI suTukka Aphno parivArakahA~ gae ani euTA siGgai moTo bAchA bhuTera liera Ae | unIharU manuSya hun bhanI unalAI lAgyo |
27 ani bAchA unIharU samakSa peza gare ra unIharUlAI namratAkA sAtha bhaneH timIharUlAI maile dieko khAnA kina na khAeko ta?

28 jaba unIharUle khAenan yo dekhera unako manamA Dara utpanna bhayo | unIharUlAI ibrAhIma DarAeko AbhAsa bhayo ra unalAI zAnta banAunako lAgi bhaneH naDarAU | hAmI allAhako tarphabATa AekA hauM | ani unalAI khuzI pArne samAcAra sunAe arthAta unako gharamA euTA dherai jJAnI chorA arthAt ishAka (alaihissalAma) ko janma hunecha bhanne zubha-sUcanA die |

29 jaba unakI patnIle yo zubha-sUcanA sunin unI khuzIle ciccAu~dai Aina, ani Aphno anuhAramA thappaDa hAndai acammita bhaera bhanin– ke yo bUDhIle pani baccA janmAuneche, jabaki U ta vAstavamai bA~jhI che |

30 phariztAharUle unalAI bhaneH hAmIle bhaneko kurA timro pAlanakartAle bhannubhaeko ho | vAstavamA, uhA~ AphnA sRSTiko bAremA, bhAgya lekhna ra kAnuna banAunamA tatvadarzI hunuhuncha | uhA~ AphnA sRSTiharUko avasthA ra unIharUlAI phAidA dine kurAbATa avagata hunuhuncha |
31 ibrAhIma (alaihissalAma) le bhaneH he phariztAharU ho! timIharUko uddezya ko ho? timIharU kahA~ jA~daichau?
32 unalAI javApha diMdai phariztAharUle bhaneH allAhale hAmIlAI sabaibhandA narAmrA pApa garne aparAdhIharUtarpha paThAunubhaeko cha |
33 unIharUmAthi kaDA mATokA DallA tathA DhuGgA barsAunakA lAgi |

34 he ibrAhIma! jo timrA pAlanakartA samakSa cinha lagAiekA hunechan | jo allAhale nirdhAraNa garnubhaekA sImA ullaGghana garneharUmAthi, kuphra garnamA ra avajJAmA sImA nAghekAharUmAthi barsAinecha |
35 lUta (alaihissalAma) ko samudAyakA mominaharUlAI hAmIle nikAlyauM | tAki aparAdhIharUmAthi AI lAgne yAtanAbATa unIharU surakSita rahun |
36 hAmIle ta tyasa nagaramA muslima (AjJApAlaka) harUko euTA mAtra ghara parivAra bheTyauM juna lUta (alaihissalAma) ko ghara parivAra thiyo |

37 lUtako samudAyamA hAmIle yAtanAko nizAnI choDyauM juna unIharUmAthi AI pareko yAtanAko pramANa thiyo | jasale gardA tinIharUmAthi AI lAgeko pIDAdAyI yAtanAko Dara rAkhneharUle pATha sikna sakun | tAki tinIharU jasto pApa nagarun |
38 ani mUsA (alaihissalAma) ko kathAmA pani upadeza cha | jaba hAmIle unalAI spaSTa tarkaharUkA sAtha phiraauna samakSa paThAyauM | pIDAdAyI yAtanAko Dara rAkhneharUko lAgi yo euTA nizAnI ho |

39 tara phirauna Aphno zakti ra sainikamAthi ghamaNDa gardai satyatAbATa vimukha bhayo | usale mUsA (alaihissalAma) ko viSayamA bhanyoH U mAnisaharUmAthi jAdU garne euTA jAdUgara ho vA vyartha kurA garne euTA pAgala vyakti ho |

40 ani hAmIle usalAI ra usakA sabai sainikaharUlAI samAtera samudramA phyA~kyauM ra unIharU Dubera naSTa bhae | phiraunale apamAna yogya kAma garyo arthAta jhUTo Thahara garnu ra AphUlAI Izvara ghoSaNA garnu |

41 hUdako samudAya AdamA pani pIDAdAyI yAtanAdekhi Dara mAnneharUkA lAgi nizAnI raheko cha | unIharUmAthi hAmIle pAnI napArne, rUkhaharUmA parAga zecana nagarAune ra barakata tathA kalyANa nabhaeko hAvA paThAyauM |
42 tyo jasamAthi calthyo cAhe tyo prANI hos, sampatti hos, vA anya je bhae pani tyasalAI dhvasta ra TukrA-TukrA napArI chADdaina thiyo |

43 ani sAleha (alaihissalAma) ko samudAya samUdamA pani pIDAdAyI yAtanAko Dara rAkhneharUkA lAgi nizAnI raheko cha | jaba unIharUlAI bhaniyoH timIharUko avadhi purA nabhaesamma Aphno jIvanabATa lAbhAnvita hoU |

44 ani unIharUle Aphno pAlanakartAko Adezako sandarbhamA ghamaNDa gare, AsthA ra AjJAkAritAko sandarbhamA ahaMkArI bhae | jaba unIharU yAtanA Aune pratIkSAmA thie unIharUlAI karkaza dhvanIle samAtyo | yAtanA AunubhandA tIna dina pahile nai unIharUlAI tyasako cetAvanI diieko thiyo |
45 unIharU AphUmAthi Aeko yAtanAlAI rokna asamartha thie ra unIharUsa~ga tyasabATa bacna sakne kunai zakti thiena |

46 yI ullekha bhaekAharUbhandA pahile hAmIle nUha (alaihissalAma) ko samudAyalAI DubAera naSTa garisakekAchauM kinaki unIharUle allAhako AjJAkArI huna mAnenan | yasa kAraNale unIharU allAhako yAtanAko hakadAra hunapuge |
47 hAmIle AkAzako sRSTi garyauM ra tyasako sRSTilAI Aphno balale pUrNa rUpa diyauM | ani tyasakA kinArAharUlAI hAmI nirantara vistAra gardaichauM |
48 hAmIle pRthvIlAI tyahA~ basobAsa garneharUkA lAgi ochyAna jastai bichAekAchauM | hAmI dherai uttama tarikAle samatala garchauM | hAmIle yasalAI unIharUko lAgi bichAyauM |

49 hAmIle hareka kurAlAI joDImA sRSTi garekAchauM, jastai- purUSa ra mahilA, AkAza ra pRthvI ra jamina ra samudra | AzA cha, timIharU yasabATa allAha nai vAstavika pUjya hunuhuncha bhanne kurAlAI smaraNa garna saka |

50 tasartha allAhako anusaraNa garI, uhA~ko avajJA tyAgI ra uhA~ko yAtanAbATa bacI uhA~ko puNyatira dauDa | he manuSyaharU ho! vAstavamA, ma pratyakSa cetAvanIkA sAtha timIharUkA lAgi uhA~ko yAtanAko bAremA saceta garne sacetaka hu~ |
51 allAhako upAsanA chADi arUko upAsanA garnakA nimti uhA~sa~ga anyalAI upAsya nabanAU | vAstavamA, ma pratyakSa cetAvanIkA sAtha yasa viSayamA saceta garAune hu~ |

52 makkAbAsIharUle jhUTo Thahara gare saraha pahilekA samudAyaharUle pani jhUTo Thahara garisakekA chan | allAhako tarphabATa unIharU samakSa rasUla Au~dA unIharUle unako viSayamA bhaneH U jAdUgara vA pAgala ho |
53 ke vigatakA kAphiraharUle pachi AekAharUlAI rasUlaharUlAI jhUTo Thahara garne upadeza diekA chan ra?! hoina, baru yI sabai atyAcAramA ekatAbaddha chan |

54 tasartha, he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! yI jhUTA Thahara garneharUlAI bevAstA garnuhos | tapAIMmAthi kunai doSa lAgne chaina | vAstavamA, tapAIMlAI je diera paThAieko cha, tapAIMle tyo puryAI saknubhayo |

55 unIharUko bevAstAle tapAIMlAI upadeza dina ra samjhanA garAunabATa narokos | tasartha unIharUlAI upadeza dinuhos ra samjhAunuhos, kinaki upadezale allAhamAthi AsthA rAkhneharUlAI phAidA puryAu~cha |
56 maile kevala Aphno upAsanAko lAgi jinaharU ra manuSyaharUlAI sRSTi gareko hu~ | unIharUle arUlAI mero sAjhedAra Thahara garUn bhanI maile unIharUko sRSTi gareko hoina |
57 malAI unIharUbATa jIvikAko cAhanA chaina ra unIharUle malAI khuvAUn bhanne cAhanA pani chaina |

58 vAstavamA, allAha nai AphnA bhaktaharUlAI jIvikA pradAna garnuhuncha | tyasaile sampUrNa prANIharU uhA~ko jIvikAmA nirbhara chan | uhA~ ati zaktizAlI hunuhuncha ra uhA~lAI kasaile pani parAjita garna sakdaina | sampUrNa jinaharU ra mAnisaharU uhA~ko zaktiko adhInamA chan |

59 vAstavamA, he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! tapAIMlAI jhUTo Thahara garI AphaimAthi atyAcAra garneharUkA lAgi yAtanAko euTA bhAga raheko cha jasarI unIharUkA vigatakA sAthIharUko bhAga thiyo | yAtanAko samaya nirdhArita raheko cha | tasartha tyasako samaya Aunu aghi tyasako lAgi unIharUle masa~ga hatAra nagarUn |

60 tasartha allAhalAI nakArneharU ra uhA~kA rasUlalAI jhUTo Thahara garneharUkA lAgi kiyAmatako dina vinAza ra ghATA raheko cha juna dina unIharUlAI yAtanA diine cha bhanne Dara unIharUlAI dekhAi~daicha |
2 ani uhA~le lekhieko kitAbako kasama khAnubhaeko cha |
3 avatarita kitAbaharU saraha khullA pAnAmA |
4 AkAzamA allAhako upAsanAko lAgi phariztAharUle banAeko gharako uhA~le kasama khAnubhaeko cha |
5 uhA~le ucca AkAzako kasama khAnubhaeko cha, juna pRthvIko chAnA ho |
6 uhA~le pAnIle bharieko samudrako kasama khAnubhaeko cha |
7 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! vAstavamA, kAphiraharUmAthi tapAIMko pAlanakartAko yAtanA avazya Aunecha |
8 unIharUlAI tyasa yAtanAbATa jogAune kohI saMrakSaka chaina ra tyasalAI ghaTnabATa rokna sakne kohI chaina |
9 tyasa dina AkAza kAmnecha ra kiyAmatako prArambhako rUpamA tyo hallinecha |
10 parvataharU Aphno ThAu~bATa tibra gatile calnechan |
11 tasartha tyasa dina jhUTo Thahara garneharUkA lAgi vinAza ra ghATA raheko cha juna dina kAphiraharUlAI yAtanAko cetAvanI diieko thiyo |
12 yinIharU nai vyartha kurAharUmA masta rahanchan | yinIharU punaH jIvita pArera uThAine ra bhelA pArine satyatAlAI vAstA gardainan |
13 tyasa dina unIharUlAI bala ra hiMsApUrvaka narakako AgomA dhakelera phAlinecha |
14 unIharUlAI nindA gardai bhaninechaH timIharUkA rasUlaharUle timIharUlAI yasai narkako Dara dekhAu~dA timIharUle tyasalAI jhUTo Thahara garekA thiyau |
15 ke timIharUle dekhiheko yAtanA jAdu ho? vA timIharU yasalAI dekhirahekA chainau?

16 yasa narkako garmI sahana gara ra tyasalAI mahasusa gara | tyasa jalanalAI mahasusa garna cAhe dhairya gara vA nagara | timIharUle dhairya garnu ra nagarnu samAna raheko cha | timIharUle saMsAramA garne garekA kuphra ra avajJAko badalA mAtra Aja timIharUlAI diinecha |

jaba allAhale jhUThA Thahara garneharUko badalAko ullekha garnubhayo taba uhA~le satya pramANita garneharU ra Izabhaya garneharUko badalAko ullekha garnubhayo | uhA~le bhannubhayoH
17 vAstavamA, AphnA pAlanakartAkA AdezaharUko pAlanA garI ra uhA~le manAhI garnubhaekA kurAharUbATa bacI uhA~ko bhaya rAkhneharU bagaiMcAharUmA ra kahile samApta nahune mahAna anugrahamA hunechan |

18 unIharU allAhale pradAna garnubhaekA khAnapinakA cijaharU ra vivAhako sukhako Ananda linechan | allAhale unIharUlAI narkako yAtanAbATa jogAunubhayo | tasartha unIharUle cAhekA sukha prApta gare ani nacAhekA duHkhabATa bacera saphala hunechan |

19 unIharUlAI bhaninechaH timIharUle cAhekA kurAharU Anandale khAU ra piU | timIharUle khAekA vA piekA cijaharUle gardA timIharUlAI hAnI ra sAstI holA bhanI naDarAU | timIharUle saMsAramA garekA rAmrA kAmaharUko badalA ho yo |
20 eka arkAko agADi vyavasthita rUpale sajAiekA sirAnIharUmA unIharU aDesa lAgekA hunechan | ani hAmI unIharUko vivAha gorA ra ThUlo ThUlo A~khA bhaekA mahilAharUsa~ga garAunechauM |

21 juna mAnisaharUle ImAna lyAe ra unIharUkA santAnale pani unako anusaraNa gardai ImAna lyAe, yadyapI unIharUle samAna satkarma nagareko bhae pani unIharUko A~khAko zItalatAko lAgi hAmI unIharUkA santAnalAI unIharUsa~ga milAunechauM | hAmI unIharUkA satkarmabATa rattI bhara pani kama garne chainauM | AphnA narAmrA karmaharUko hareka vyakti Aphai jimmevAra hunecha | usako narAmro karmabATa kunai pani karmako kohI pani jimmevAra hunechaina |
22 hAmIle yI svargabAsIharUlAI vibhinna prakArakA phalaphUlaharU dinechauM ra hAmIle unIharUle cAheko hareka kisimako mAsu dinechauM |
23 unIharUle svargamA yasto peya padArtha piunechan jasako prabhAva pRthvImA parne prabhAva jastaiH gAlIgalauja ra nazA saraha hunechaina |
24 unIharUko sevAmA baccAharU unIharUko varipari ghumirahekA hunechan | yinIharUko seto ra saphA tvacAle gardA lAgnecha mAnauM ki yinIharU sipImA chopera rAkhiekA motI hun |
25 svargabAsIharU eka arkAtira pharkanechan ra saMsAramA unIharUko avasthA kasto thiyo bhanI sodhnechan |
26 unIharUle bhannechan– vAstavamA, saMsAramA hAmI hAmrA parivAramAjha allAhako yAtanA dekhi DarAu~ne garthyauM |
27 tasartha allAhale hAmIlAI islAmako mArgadarzana garI hAmImAthi kRpA garnubhayo ra hAmIlAI atyAdhika tAto tathA polne narkako yAtanAbATa jogAunubhayo |

28 hAmIle sAMsArika jIvanamA uhA~ko upAsanA garthyauM ra narkako yAtanAbATa jogina uhA~lAI pukArne garthyauM kinaki uhA~ paropakArI hunuhuncha, AphnA bhaktaharUsa~ga gareko vAcAlAI pUrA garnuhuncha ra unIharUmAthi dayA garnuhuncha | uhA~ hAmIprati paropakArI ra dayAvAna hunu bhaneko uhA~le hAmIlAI islAmako mArgadarzana garnu, hAmIlAI svargamA praveza garAunu ra hAmIlAI narkabATa jogAunu ho |

29 tasartha, he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! kurAnadvArA upadeza dinuhos | allAhale tapAIMlAI pradAna garnubhaekA ImAna ra buddhikA kAraNa tapAIM jyotiSI hunuhunna jasalAI jinaharU dekhA pardachan ra tapAIM pAgala pani hunuhunna |
30 vA yI jhUTA Thahara garneharU bhanchan: vAstavamA, muhammada rasUla hoinan | baru unI kavi hunuhuncha ra hAmI unako mRtyuko pratIkSAmAchauM | tyasapachi hAmI unIbATa chuTakArA pAunechauM |
31 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! unIharUlAI bhannuhos: timIharU mero mRtyuko pratIkSA gara ra ma timIharUle malAI nakAreko kAraNale timIharUle bhognuparne yAtanAko parkhAimA chu |

32 ke yinIharUko buddhile uhA~ jyotiSI vA pAgala hunuhuncha bhanne kurA bhanna sikAu~cha? unIharU ekajanAmA pAina nasakne kurAharUlAI jammA pArna khojirahekA chan | baru unIharU sImA ullaGghanakArI hun | unIharU kAnuna ra tarkamA nirbhara chainan |

33 vA unIharU bhanchan: muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) le yo kurAna racnubhaeko ho | yo uha~lAI vahI mArphata diieko hoina | uhA~le yasalAI racnubhaeko hoina baru unIharU tyasamAthi ImAna nalyAuna ghamaNDa garirahekA chan | ani unIharU bhanchan: uhA~le tyasalAI racnubhaeko ho |
34 uhA~le yo racnubhaeko ho bhanne Aphno dAbImA unIharU saccA chan bhane unIharUle yastai kisimako euTA vANI banAera lyAUn |

35 ke unIharU sRSTikartA binA nai sRSTi bhaekA hun ta? vA unIharU svayaMkA sRSTikartA hun? sRSTikartAko astitva binA sRSTiko astitva asambhava cha ra sRSTile sRjanA garna sakdaina | tasartha unIharU Aphno sRSTikartAko upAsanA kina gardainan ta?

36 ke yinIharUle AkAzaharU ra pRthvIlAI sRSTi garekA hun? baru allAha yinIharUkA sRSTikartA hun bhanne kurAmAthi yinIharUlAI vizvAsa nai lAgdaina | yadi unIharUle yasa kurAmAthi vizvAsa rAkhekA bhae unIharUle kevala allAhako upAsanA garne thie ra uhA~kA rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) mAthi AsthA (ImAna) rAkhne thie |

37 vA ke unIharUle jasalAI cAhanchan tyasalAI jIvikA dinakA nimti tapAIMkA pAlanakartAko bhaNDAra unIharUko niyantraNamA cha? jasalAI cAhanchan usalAI nabI banAuna ra jasalAI cAhanchan usalAI tyasabATa vaJcita garnako lAgi ke IzadUtatva unIharUko niyantraNamA cha? vA unIharU zAsana garirahekA chan ra Aphno icchA anusAra garna sakSama chan?

38 unIharU satya chan bhanI allAhale garnubhaeko vahI sunnako lAgi caDhera AkAzasamma pugna unIharUsa~ga bharyAGa cha ra? timIharU satya chau bhanne timIharUko yasa dAbIlAI satya pramANita garnako lAgi timIharUmadhye jasale tyasa vahIlAI suneko cha usale spaSTa pramANa prastuta garos |
39 ke uhA~kA chorIharU chan, jasalAI timIharU svayam mana parAu~dainau ra timIharUkA chorAharU chan jasalAI timIharU mana parAu~chau?
40 he rasUla (salllAhu alaihi va sallama)! tapAIMko pAlanakartAko sandeza puryAe bApata ke tapAIM jyAlA linuhuncha? jasa kAraNa unIharUle thAmnai nasakne bojha bokna pugekA chan |
41 vA unIharUsa~ga adRzyako jJAna cha, juna thAhA pAepachi unIharUle mAnisaharUko lAgi lekhchan? ani unIharU je cAhanchan tyo unIharUlAI bhanchan |

42 vA yI jhUTA Thahara garneharU tapAIM vA tapAIMko dharma virUddha SaDyantra garna cAhanchan? allAhamAthi bharosA garnuhos kinaki allAha ra uhA~kA rasUlamAthi AsthA (ImAna) narAkhneharU nai SaDyantrakA zikAra hunechan, tapAIM hoina |

43 vA allAha bAheka unIharUko kohI vAstavika upAsya cha? unIharUle allAhako sAjhedAra cha bhanI lagAeko AropabATa uhA~ pavitra hunuhuncha | ullekha bhaekA kunai pani avasthAmA kalpanA pani garna saki~daina |

44 yadi unIharUle AkAzako TukrA jhardai gareko dekhe bhane tyasa viSayamA unIharUle bhannechan: yo sadhai jhaiM bAdalaharU tahai-taha parekA hun | unIharU upadeza grahaNa gardainan ra AsthA rAkhdainan |
45 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! yinIharUle yAtanA diine dina arthAta kiyAmata nadekhunjela Aphnai haThadharmamA choDnuhos |
46 tyasadina unIharUko SaDyantrale unIharUlAI nata kunai phAidA puryAunecha na unIharUlAI yAtanAbATa bacAune kohI sahayogI hunecha |

47 vAstavamA, zirka ra avajJA garera AphUmAthi atyAcAra garneharUkA lAgi Akhiratako yAtanAbhandA pahile pani yAtanA cha | juna saMsAramA hatyA hunu ra kaida garinu raheko cha bhane cihAnamA kabrako yAtanA raheko cha | tara adhikAMzalAI yasako jJAna chaina tyasaile unIharU Aphno kuphramA aDiga chan |

jaba allAhale muzrikaharUle gareko kAma avaidha bhaeko kurAko ullekha garnubhayo taba uhA~le AphnA rasUlalAI unIharUmAthi dhyAna nadina ra unIharUle jhUTo Thahara gardA dhairya garna Adeza dinubhayo | uhA~le bhannubhayoH
48 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! tapAIMko pAlanakartAko phaisalAmA ra uhA~kA zarIatakA AdezaharUmA dhairya dhAraNa garnuhos | vAstavamA, tapAIM hAmrA nigarAnI ra surakSAmA hunuhuncha | ani tapAIM sutera uThane belA Aphno pAlanakartAko prazaMsAkAsAtha mahimAgAna garnuhos |
49 ani rAtamA uhA~ko mahimAgAna garnuhos ra uhA~ko lAgi namAja (salAha) paDhnuhos | ani bihAnIko prakAzakA sAtha tArAharU astAune samayamA phajrako salAha paDhnuhos |
1 allAhale tArAko kasama khAnubhaeko cha, jaba tyo khascha |
2 allAhakA rasUla muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) na pathabhraSTa hunubhaeko cha na ta bahakinubhaeko cha | baru uhA~ sIdhA mArgamA hunuhuncha |
3 uhA~le Aphno icchAko anusaraNa garera kurAnako viSayamA kehI bhannuhunna |
4 kurAna ta euTA vahI (sandeza) mAtra ho juna jibrIla (alaihissalAma) dvArA allAhale uhA~tarpha paThAunubhaeko ho |
5 uhA~lAI ekajanA zaktizAlI phariztA jibrIla (alaihissalAma) le allAhadvArA paThAieko vahI sikAekA hun |
6 jibrIla (alaihissalAma) ko rAmro svarUpa raheko cha | allAhale unalAI juna rUpamA banAunubhaeko cha tyahI rUpamA unI nabI (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) samakSa jAhera bhae |
7 jibrIla AkAzako mAthillo kSitijamA thie |
8 ani jibrIla (alaihissalAma) nabI (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) ko najika bhae, ani ajha najika Ae |
9 unI uhA~dekhi duI dhanuSa barAbara vA tyasabhandA pani kama dUrImA thie |
10 ani jibrIla (alaihissalAma) le allAhakA bhakta muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) lAI juna vahI (sandeza) puryAunu parne thiyo tyo unale puryAe |
11 muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) ko A~khAle je dekhyo tyasalAI uhA~ko hRdayale jhUTo Thahara garena |
12 he muzrikaharU ho! allAhale uhA~lAI isrAko rAtamA jo dekhAunubhayo, tyasako bAremA timIharU vAdavivAda garchau?
13 muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) le isrAko rAtamA jibrIla (alaihissalAma) lAI dosro paTaka unako vAstavika rUpamA dekhnubhayo |
14 sAtauM AkAzamA raheko sabaibhandA ThUlo rUkha sidratul muntahA najika |
15 yasa rUkhako najika jannatul mAvA avasthita cha |
16 euTA ThUlo vastule sidralAI allAhako Adezale DhAkeko thiyo | allAhalAI mAtra tyasako uddezya thAhA cha |
17 uhA~ko A~khA na dAhine tira moDiyo ra na debre tira | ani tyo sImAbhandA agADi pani baDhena |
18 isrAko rAtamA muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) le Aphno pAlanakartAko zaktilAI pramANita garne ThUlA-ThUlA nizAnIharU dekhnubhayo | uhA~le svarga, narka ra anya kurAharU dekhnubhayo |
19 he muzrikaharU ho! timIharUle allAhalAI chADi upAsanA garne lAta ra ujjAkA yI mUrtiharUko viSayamA timIharU ke so~cchau?
20 ani timIharUko tesro mUrti manAtako viSayamA pani; bhana ta ke yinIharU timIharUko lAbha ra hAniko sAmarthya rAkhchan ra?
21 he muzrikaharU ho, ke timIharUle Aphno lAgi chorA rojekA chau, kinaki timIharU tyasalAI mana parAu~chau ra allAhako lAgi chorI rojekA chau jasalAI timIharU mana parAu~dainau |
22 timIharUle Aphno icchA anusAra gareko yo vibhAjana anyAyapUrNa cha |

23 yI mUrtiharU arthahIna nAmaharU bAheka kehI hoinan | yinIharUmA IzvarIya vizeSatAko kunai aMza chaina | timIharUle ra timIharUkA purkhAharUle Aphai tinIharUlAI yo nAma diekA chau | allAhale yasa viSayamA kunai pramANa avataraNa garnubhaeko chaina | muzrikaharU Aphno AsthAko viSayamA kevala anumAnako ra zaitAnale unIharUko hRdayamA sundara pAreko kurAharUko anusaraNa garchan | unIharUko pAlanakartAko tarphabATa mArgadarzana uhA~kA nabI (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) ko mAdhyamabATa unIharU samakSa Ayo tara unIharUle mArgadarzana prApta garenan |
24 mUrtiharUle allAha samakSa siphArisa garnechan bhanne mAnisako kAmanA pUrA huncha ra?
25 hoina, usako kAmanA pUrA hunechaina | Akhirata (paraloka) ra saMsAra kevala allAhako ho | tyasabATa uhA~ je cAhanuhuncha pradAna garnuhuncha ra je cAhanuhuncha tyo roknuhuncha |

26 AkAzaharUmA katipaya yastA phariztAharU chan yadi unIharUle kasaiko viSayamA siphArisa garchan bhane unIharUko siphArisale kunai phAidA puryAuna saknechaina | tara yadi unIharUmadhye kasailAI allAha siphArisa garne anumati dinuhuncha ra kasaiko viSayamA siphArisa garinu mana parAunuhuncha bhane kurA beglai ho | ani allAhako sAjhedAra Thahara garnelAI uhA~le anumati dinuhunechaina | ani allAhalAI chADi jasako upAsanA garcha usako viSayamA uhA~le kahilyai siphArisa garinu mana pAraunuhunna |

27 vAstavamA, mRtyupazcAta paralokamA punaH jIvita pArine kurAmAthi AsthA (ImAna) narAkhneharUle phariztAharUlAI strIko saMjJA dinchan kinaki unIharUko AsthA anusAra unIharU allAhakA chorIharU hun | unIharUko yasa kurAbATa allAha ati ucca, mahAna ra pavitra hunuhuncha |

28 yinIharUlAI strIko saMjJA dinako lAgi unIharUsa~ga kunai AdhAra nai chaina | yasa viSayamA unIharU kevala aDkalabAjI ra bhramako anusaraNa garchan | vAstavamA, aDkalabAjIle satya pramANita hu~dainan |

29 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! allAhako smaraNabATa vimukha hune, tyasalAI mahatva nadine, sAMsArika jIvanako cAhanA rAkhne ra Akhiratako lAgi mehineta nagarnelAI bevAstA garnuhos kinaki U tyasamAthi AsthA rAkhdaina |

30 phariztAharUlAI strIko saMjJA dinu muzrikaharUko jJAnako sImA ho kinaki unIharU anabhijJa chan ra nizcita chainan | vAstavamA, he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! tapAIMko pAlanakartA satyako bATobATa haTekAlAI ra uhA~ko bATomA hi~DnelAI rAmrarI jAnnuhuncha | uhA~bATa kehI pani lukeko chaina |

31 AkAzaharU ra pRthvImA bhaekA sabai cIjaharU allAhakai hun | uhA~ nai tI sabaikA mAlika, sRSTikartA ra pravandhaka hunuhuncha | uhA~le yasa saMsAramA narAmrA karma garneharUlAI yAtanA dinuhunecha ra satkarma garne mominaharUlAI svarga pradAna garnuhunecha |

32 unIharU ThUlAThUlA pApaharUbATa AphUlAI jogAu~chan, allAhale unIharUkA sAnAtinA galtIlAI kSamA garnuhuncha | he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) tapAIMko pAlanakartA ati kSamAzIla hunuhuncha | uhA~kA bhaktaharUle kSamA mAgeko belA uhA~le kSamA garnuhuncha | uhA~ timIharUko avasthA ra mAmilAharUko bAremA baDhI jJAnI hunuhuncha | uhA~le timIharUkA purkhA Adama (alaihissalAma) lAI mATobATa sRSTi garnubhayo ra timIharU AmAko garbhamA thiyau ta uhA~le timIharUlAI ekapachi arko caraNamA garI sRSTi garnubhayo | uhA~bATa kehI lukeko chaina | AphUlAI Izabhaya rAkhne bhanera svayaMko prazaMsA nagara | ko uhA~kA AdezaharUko pAlanA garI ra uhA~le manAhI garnubhaekA kurAharUbATa bacI Izabhaya rAkhne ho bhanne kurA uhA~lAI rAmrarI thAhA cha |
33 ke tapAIMle usako durbhAgyapUrNa avasthA dekhnu bhayo jo islAmako najika Aera pani tyasako virodhI bhayo?
34 jasale thorai dhana kharca garyo pherI rokyo kinaki kanjusyAi~ usako prakRti ho | yasasa~gai usale svayaMlAI pavitra ThAnyo |
35 ke usalAI adRzyako jJAna cha | ani U adRzyalAI dekhcha ra tyasako kurA garcha?

36 ke U allAhako viSayamA jhUTo boldaicha? ke allAhako viSayamA jhUTo bolne tyasa vyaktilAI pahilekA kitAbamA ke cha bhanera thAhA chaina juna allAhale mUsA (alaihissalAma) mAthi avataraNa garnubhaeko thiyo |
37 ani ibrAhIma (alaihissalAma) ko kitAbamA jasale unakA pAlanakartA allhale unalAI diekA jimmevArIharUlAI nirvAha gare ra tyasalAI pUrA gare |
38 arthAta kasaile pani arUko pApako bojha bokne chaina |
39 ani harekale usako Aphnai karmako badalA pAunecha |
40 kiyAmatako dina usako karma sArvajanika rUpale dekhAinecha |
41 ani usalAI usako karmako pUrA-pUrA badalA diinecha |
42 ani, he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! mRtyupazcAta tapAIMko pAlanakartAkahA~ nai pharkera sabai bhaktaharU jAnu parnecha |
43 ani uhA~le jasalAI cAhanu hunecha prasanna pArera ha~sAunu hunecha ra jasalAI cAhanu hunecha dukhI pArera ruvAunu hunecha |
44 ani uhA~le saMsAramA jIvitalAI mRtyu dinuhuncha ra kiyAmatako lAgi mRtakalAI jIvita pArnuhunecha |
45 ani uhA~le nai purUSa ra mahilAko joDI sRSTi garnubhayo |
46 euTA vIryako thopAbATa jaba tyasalAI garbhamA khasAlincha |
47 yI duIko mRtyupazcAta dubailAI kiyAmatako lAgi sRSTi garne jimmevArI uhA~ kai raheko cha |

48 ani uhA~le nai AphnA bhaktaharUmadhye jasalAI cAhanuhuncha tyasalAI dhana pradAna garera sampanna pArnuhuncha ra uhA~ yasto dhana pradAna garnuhuncha jasadvArA manuSyaharU santuSTi prApta garchan |
49 ani uhA~ nai ziarA nAmI tArAko mAlika hunuhuncha | tyo yasto tArA ho jasalAI kehI muzrikaharU allAhako saTTAmA pUjne garthe |
50 ani uhA~le hUda (alaihissalAma) ko samudAya AdalAI naSTa pArnubhayo | tinIharU Aphno kuphramA aDiga raheko hunAle yaso bhayo |
51 uhA~le sAleha (alaihissalAma) ko samudAya samUdalAI pani naSTa pArnubhayo ra jasamA ekajanA pani bacena |

52 Ada ra samUdabhandA pahile uhA~le nUha (alaihissalAma) ko samudAyalAI naSTa pArnubhayo | nUha (alaihissalAma) ko samudAya nikai atyAcArI thiyo ra Ada ra samUdabhandA dherai udaNDa thiyo | kinaki nUha (alaihissalAma) le unIharU mAjha nauM saya pacAsa varSa ekezvaravAdako AhvAna garirahe tara unIharUle svIkAra garenan |
53 uhA~le lUta (alaihissalAma) ko bastIlAI mAthi AkAzamA uThAunubhayo ani ulTo pArI khasAlnubhayo |
54 tyasalAI AkAzamA ucAlera pRthvImA khasAlepachi uhA~le DhuGgA barsAera tyasalAI DhAkdinubhayo |
55 tasartha, he manuSya ho! timrA pAlanakartAkA zaktiko pramANa prastuta garne kuna-kuna nizAnIharUko viSayamA timI jhagaDA garchau ra tyasabATa upadeza grahaNa gardainau?
56 yI rasUla jo timIharUtira paThAiekA hun pahilekA rasUlaharUmadhye kai hun |
57 kiyAmata najika Aipugeko cha |
58 yasalAI roknasakne kohI chaina ra allAha bAheka tyasako sUcanA dine kohI chaina |
59 ke timIharUlAI pATha garera sunAine yo kurAna allAhako tarphabATa ho bhanne kurAmA timIharU Azcarya mAnchau ta?
60 timIharU tyasalAI sunera apamAna gardai hA~schau tara tyasakA cetAvanIharU sunera rU~dainau |
61 timIharU tyasako viSayamA bevAstA garchau ra tyasalAI mahatva didainau |
62 tasartha kevala allAhako upAsanA gara ra uhA~ko mAtra upAsanA gara |

1 kiyAmatako Agamanako ghaDI najika Aipugyo ra candramA nabI (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) ko samayamA alaga-alaga bhayo | candramA alaga-alaga duI bhAgamA vibhAjana hunu nabI sallallAhu alaihi vasallamakA nizAnIharU madhyeko eka thiyo | yo sapaSTa rUpamA dekhieko nizAnI thiyo |

2 yadi muzrikaharUle uhA~ (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) ko satyatAko kunai pani pramANa ra nizAnI dekhchan ta tyasalAI svIkAra nagarera vimukha hunchan, ani bhanchan: juna tarka ra pramANaharU hAmIle dekhyauM tyo kevala asatya jAdU ho |

3 unIharU samakSa Aeko satyalAI unIharUle jhUTo Thahara gare ra jhUTo Thahara garnako lAgi unIharUle Aphno icchAko anusaraNa gare | kiyAmatako dina rAmro vA narAmro kurA avazya nai tyasako hakadAra samakSa ghaTita hunecha |
4 unIharU samakSa tI samudAyaharUko sUcanA Aipugyo jasalAI allAhale unIharUko kuphra ra atyAcArale gardA naSTa pArnubhayo | yo unIharUlAI unIharUko kuphra ra atyAcArabATa roknako lAgi paryApta cha |
5 aba kunai bahAnA bA~kI narahanako lAgi unIharU samakSa spaSTa pramANa Aeko cha | allAha ra antima dinamAthi AsthA narAkhneharUlAI cetAvanIle phAidA puryAuna sakdaina |

6 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! yadi unIharU mArgadarzana apanAu~dainan bhane unIharUlAI chADidinuhos ra bevAstA garnuhos | ani tyasa dinako pratIkSA garnuhos juna dina sUra phukne jimmevArI pAeko phariztAle euTA ati bhayAnaka mAmilAtira AhvAna garnecha jasalAI sRSTiharUle pahile jAnekA thienan |
7 unIharU A~khAlAI jhukAera kabraharUbATa niskanechan ra chariekA salahaharU saraha unIharU hisAba hune ThAu~tira bhAgnechan |
8 unIharU AhvAnakartAtira bhAgera jAnechan | kAphiraharUle bhannechan: yo ekadamai kaThina dina ho kinaki tyasamA kaSTakara ra bhayAnaka ghaTanAharU hunechan |

jaba allAhale hAmrA rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) ko AhvAnabATa kAphiraharU vimukha hune kurAlAI ullekha garnubhayo taba uhA~le uhA~lAI AzvAsana diMdai pahilekA samudAyaharUle AphnA rasUlaharUlAI jhUTo Thahara gareko khabara batAu~dai bhannubhayo:
9 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! tapAIMko AhvAnalAI jhUTo Thahara garneharUbhandA pahile nUhako samudAyale jhUTo Thahara gare | jaba hAmIle nUha (alaihissalAma) lAI unIharUtarpha paThAyauM unIharUle unalAI jhUTo Thahara gare | unIharUle unako viSayamA bhaneH tyo ta pAgala ho | ani unale pracAra garna banda nagareko khaNDamA unIharUle nAnAtharIkA gAlI, nindA ra dhamkI diera unalAI tarsAe |
10 ani nUhale AphnA pAlanakartAsa~ga yo bhandai duA gareH mero samudAyale malAI dabAe ra mero AhvAnalAI svIkAra garenan | tinIharUlAI yAtanA diera malAI sahayoga garnuhos |
11 ani hAmIle musaladhAre ra nirantara varSAkA sAtha AkAzakA dvAra kholidiyauM |

12 ani hAmIle pRthvImA mUlaharU phuTAyauM jasabATa pAnI niskanthyo | tyasapachi AkAzabATa pareko pAnI allAhako Adezale pRthvIko pAnIsa~gai misiyo ra yasako phaisalA surUmai bhaisakeko thiyo | pariNAma svarUpa allAhale jasalAI jogAunubhayo tyasa bAheka sabaijanA Dubna puge |
13 hAmIle nUhalAI takhtA ra kA~TIdvArA nirmita Du~gAmA savAra garAyauM | ani hAmIle unalAI ra jo unakA sAthamA thie tI sabailAI DubnabATa jogAyauM |
14 DuGgA hAmro nigarAnI ra surakSAmA bhISaNa chAlaharUmA caliraheko thiyo | nUhalAI jhUTo Thahara garne ra unale allAhako tarphabATa lyAeko sandezalAI nakArne samudAya virUddha yo sahayoga ho |
15 unIharUlAI dieko yo yAtanAlAI hAmIle pATha ra cetAvanI banAyauM | yasabATa pATha line kohI cha ra?
16 jhUTo Thahara garneharUlAI dieko mero yAtanA kasto thiyo? ani maile unIharUlAI naSTa pArI dieko cetAvanI kasto thiyo?
17 vAstavamA, hAmIle yAda garna ra upadeza grahaNa garnako lAgi kurAnalAI sajilo banAekAchauM | yasamA rahekA pATha ra upadezaharUlAI grahaNa garne kohI cha?

18 Adale Aphno nabI hUda (alaihissalAma) lAI jhUTo Thahara garyo | tasartha, he makkAbAsIharU ho! so~ca, maile unIharUlAI dieko yAtanA kasto thiyo? ani unIharUlAI dieko yAtanA unIharU bAhekakA mAnisaharUko lAgi kasto cetAvanI thiyo ta?
19 euTA narAmro ra durbhAgyapUrNa dinamA hAmIle tinIharUmAthi ciso A~dhI paThAyauM ra tyo dina unIharU narkamA napuguJjela samApta bhaena |
20 tyasale mAnisaharUlAI pRthvIbATa ucAlera TAuko talatira pArI phyA~kdai thiyo mAnauM unIharU jaraisita ukheliekA khajUrakA rUkhaharU hun |
21 tasartha, he makkAbAsIharU ho! so~ca, maile unIharUlAI dieko yAtanA kasto thiyo? ani unIharUlAI yAtanA diI unIharU bAhekakA mAnisaharUlAI dieko cetAvanI kasto thiyo?
22 vAstavamA, hAmIle kurAnalAI yAda garna ra upadeza grahaNa garnako lAgi sajilo banAekAchauM | yasamA rahekA pATha ra upadezaharUlAI grahaNa garne kohI cha?
23 samUdale Aphno rasUla sAleha (alaihissalAma) le diekA cetAvanIlAI jhUTo Thahara gare |
24 ani nakArneharUle bhaneH ke hAmIle hAmI jastai mAncheko anusaraNa garne ta? yadi hAmIle yasa viSayamA usako anusaraNa garyauM bhane hAmI sIdhA bATobATa TADhA hunechauM ra kaSTa bhognechauM |
25 ke hAmI sabailAI chADi UmAthi mAtra vahI avataraNa gariyo ta? hoina, baru U jhUTo ra ghamanDI ho |
26 sAleha (alaihissalAma) vA unIharUmadhye ko jhUTo ra ghamanDI ho bhanne kurA unIharUle kiyAmatako dina thAhA pAunechan |

27 vAstavamA, hAmI euTA U~TanIlAI caTTAnabATa nikAlera unIharUko parikSAko lAgi paThAunechauM | tasartha, he sAleha! pratIkSA gara, unIharUle tyasasa~ga ke garnechan ra unIharUsita ke hunecha tyo hera ra unIharUle dieko kaSTamA dhairya dhAraNa gara |

28 unIharUko kuvA~ko pAnI unIharUko ra U~TanIko mAjhamA bA~Dinecha bhanI unIharUlAI bhanideU | eka dina unIharUko pAlo ra eka dina U~TanIko pAlo hunecha | pratyekale kevala Aphnai pAlomA Aphno bhAga lina upasthita hunupardacha |
29 unIharUle Aphno sAthIlAI U~TanIko hatyAko lAgi bolAe | ani Aphno samudAyako Adezako pAlanA gardai usale taravAra liera hatyA garyo |
30 tasartha, he makkAbAsIharU ho! so~ca, maile unIharUlAI dieko yAtanA kasto thiyo? ani unIharUlAI yAtanA diI unIharU bAhekakA mAnisaharUlAI dieko cetAvanI kasto thiyo?

31 vAstavamA, hAmIle unIharUmAthi euTA dhamAkA paThAyauM jasale unIharUlAI naSTa garyo | ani unIharU sukhkhA boTabirUvA jastA bhae juna gherAbandI banAunele AphnA bheDAharUko rakSAko lAgi kATeko huncha |
32 vAstavamA, hAmIle kurAnalAI yAda garna ra upadeza grahaNa garnako lAgi sajilo banAekAchauM | yasamA rahekA pATha ra upadezaharUlAI grahaNa garne kohI cha?
33 lUta (alaihissalAma) le Aphno samudAyalAI dieko cetAvanI unIharUle jhUTo Thahara gare |

34 hAmIle lUtakA parivAra bAheka arUharUmAthi DhuGgA barsAune A~dhI paThAyauM | hAmIle lUtakA parivAraharUlAI jogAyauM | unI rAtako antima praharamA saparivAra yo yAtanA Aunu aghi nai gaisakekA thie |
35 hAmIle yinIharUlAI kRpAko pAtra banAera yasa yAtanAbATa jogAyauM | hAmIle lUtalAI dieko badalA jasto badalA tyasalAI dinchauM jo AllAhakA kRpAharUko lAgi uhA~lAI dhanyavAda dincha |
36 lUtale unIharUlAI hAmro yAtanAko Dara dekhAisakekA thie tara unIharUle unako cetAvanIko viSayamA vAdavivAda gare ra unalAI jhUTo Thahara gare |

37 lUtako samudAyale unakA phariztA pAhunAharUsa~ga azlIla kriyAkalApa garne kramamA dakhala nadine cetAvanI die | tara hAmIle unIharUkA A~khA andhA banAyauM tasartha unIharUle tinIharUlAI dekhenan | hAmIle unIharUlAI bhanyauH mero yAtanAko svAda cAkha juna maile timIharUlAI dieko cetAvanIko pariNAma ho |
38 bihAnako samayamA unIharUlAI yAtanAle samAtyo juna unIharU Akhirata pugunjelasamma unIharUsa~ga rahanecha | ani yAtanAle unIharUlAI samAtnecha |
39 unIharUlAI bhaniyoH maile timIharUko lAgi paThAeko yAtanAko svAda cAkha juna lUtale timIharUlAI dieko cetAvanIko pariNAma ho |
40 vAstavamA, hAmIle kurAnalAI yAda garna ra upadeza grahaNa garnako lAgi sajilo banAekAchauM | yasamA rahekA pATha ra upadezaharUlAI grahaNa garne kohI cha?
41 mUsA ra hArUna (alaihimassalAma) mArphata hAmro cetAvanI phiraunako samudAya samakSa pugyo |

42 hAmro tarphabATa AekA pramANaharU ra tarkaharUlAI unIharUle jhUTo Thahara gare | unIharUle jhUTo Thahara gareko kAraNale unIharUlAI tyasarI yAtanA diyauM jasarI kasaile parAjita garna nasakne zaktizAlI ra kasaile vivaza garna nasakne sarvazaktimAnale yAtanA dincha |

43 he makkAbAsIharU ho! ke timIharUkA kAphiraharU nUhako samudAya, Ada, samUda, lUtako samudAya, phirauna ra usako samudAya jastA kAphiraharUbhandA uttama chan ra? vA IzvarIya granthaharUmA timIharUko lAgi allAhako yAtanAbATa mukti lekhieko cha?
44 baru yI makkAkA kAphiraharU bhanchan- jo hAmIlAI coTa puryAuna cAhancha ra hAmIlAI vibhAjita garna cAhancha U virUddha hAmro jIta hunecha |
45 yI kAphiraharUko samUha cA~Dai nai parAjita hunecha ra mominadekhi piThyU~ pharkAera bhAgnechan | badrako dinamA yastai bhayo |

46 baru unIharUle jhUTo Thahara garne kiyAmatako vAcA unIharUsita garieko cha juna dina unIharUlAI yAtanA diinecha | unIharUlAI saMsAramA diieko badrako dinako yAtanAbhandA baDhI ThUlo ra kaDA yAtanA kiyAmatako hunecha |
47 vAstavamA, kuphra ra avajJA garI aparAdha garneharU satyabATa pathabhraSTa bhaekA chan, yAtanAmA ra kaSTamA chan |
48 tyasa dina unIharUlAI narkamA ghopTo pArI anuhArako bharale ghisArinecha | ani unIharUlAI nindA gardai bhaninechaH aba cAkha narkako yAtanA |
49 hAmIle vigatamA lekheko bhAgya, hAmro jJAna, icchA ra surakSA peTikAmA lekhe anusAra brahmANDalAI sRSTi garyauM |
50 jaba hAmI kunai kurAko cAhanA garchauM taba hAmI euTA zabda mAtra bhanchauM ra tyo hoH hoijA | ani A~khA jhimkAune gatimA tyo kAma pUrA huncha |
