65 yadi hAmIle tyasa khetIlAI bhusA banAuna cAheko bhae tyo paripakva ra pUrNa hunai lAgeko belA hAmIle tyasalAI bhusA banAune thiyauM | ani yo ke bhayo bhanI timIharU vilApa gardai basne thiyau |
66 timIharUle bhanne thiyauH hAmIle kharca gareko jati ghATAmA gaera yAtanA bhogyauM |
67 vAstavamA, hAmIlAI jIvikAbATa vaJcita pArieko cha |
68 timIharUlAI tirkhA lAgeko belA piune pAnIko viSayamA timIharUle ke so~cekA chau?
69 ke tyasalAI AkAzamA raheko bAdalabATa timIharU barsAu~chau vA hAmI barsAu~chau~?

70 yadi hAmIle tyo pAnIlAI dherai nai nunilo banAuna khojeko bhae hAmIle tyasalAI nunilo banAune thiyauM | tara timIharUmAthi dayA garnako nimti allAhale mITho pAnI barsAeko kAraNale timIharU uhA~lAI dhanyavAda kina didainau?
71 timIharUle Aphno phAidAko lAgi bAlne Agoko viSayamA ke so~cekA chau?
72 tyo bAlnako lAgi rUkhaharUko sRSTi timIharUle garekA hau vA timIharUkA lAgi hAmro anukampAko kAraNa hAmIle tyasako sRSTi garyauM?
73 hAmIle yo Ago timIharUko lAgi cetAvanI svarUpa banAekAchauM jasale timIharUlAI Akhiratako Agoko samjhanA garAu~cha | ani timIharUmadhye yAtruharUko lAgi phAidA svarUpa banAekAchauM |
74 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! tapAIM Aphno pAlanakartAlAI uhA~ko lAgi ayogya kurAharUbATa pavitra rakhera uhA~ko prazaMsA garnuhos |
75 allAhale tArAharUkA astAune ThAu~ ra sthAnaharUko kasama khAnubhayo |
76 vAstavamA, yadi timIharUlAI thAhA bhae sthAnaharUko kasama khAnuko mahatva nikai nai ThUlo raheko cha kinaki tyasamA anagintI nizAnIharU ra pAThaharU rahekA chan |
77 he manuSyaharU ho! vAstavamA, timIharUlAI pATha garera sunAine kurAna euTA pratiSThita kurAna ho kinaki yasamA ThUlA phAidAharU rahekA chan |
78 juna mAnisaharUko najarabATa lukeko kitAbamA cha ra tyo lauhe mahphUja ho |
79 yasalAI pApaharUbATa ra kamI-kamajorIharUbATa pavitra phariztAharUle mAtra chunchan |
80 yo sampUrNa sRSTiharUko pAlanakartAko tarphabATa nabI muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) mAthi avataraNa garieko ho |
81 he muzrikaharU ho! ke timIharU yasa vANIlAI svIkAra nagarI jhUTo Thahara garirahekA chau?

82 allAhale timIharUlAI anugrahaharU dinubhaeko kAraNale uhA~lAI dhanyavAda dinuko saTTA timIharU uhA~lAI jhUTo Thahara garchau ra varSA hunulAI tArAsa~ga joDchau | ani timIharU bhanchauH yasa tArAko kAraNa ra tyasa tArAko kAraNa varSA bhayo |

jaba uhA~le punaH jIvita pArne kurAkA kehI pramANaharU prastuta garnubhayo | taba uhA~le puna: jIvita pArne Aphno zaktiko viSayamA khabara dinubhayo | jasale mRtyu dina sakcha usale jIvita pArna pani sakSama cha | tara unIharU Aphno mRtyu rokna vivaza chan |
83 tyasobhae kina, jaba AtmA ghA~TIsamma Aipugnecha |
84 tyasa samaya timIharU marne vyaktilAI dekhirahekA hunchau |
85 ani hAmI hAmrA jJAna, zakti ra phariztAharUkA sAtha timIharUbhandA pani baDhI timIharUko mRtakako najika hunchauM tara timIharU tI phariztAharUlAI dekhdainau |
86 tyasobhae kina, timIharUko so~ca anusAra timIharUko karmako badalA dinako lAgi timIharUlAI punaH jIvita pArI uThAine chaina |
87 yadi timIharU Aphno dAbImA saccA chau bhane timro mRtakalAI choDne prANalAI timIharU pharkAu~dainau?! timIharU tyasako sAmarthya rAkhdainau |
88 ani, yadi mRtaka rAmrA kAryaharU aghi baDhera garne vyakti ho bhane |
89 usale ArAma pAunecha ra kahilyai thAkne chaina | rAmro jIvikA ra dayA pAunecha | ani svarga usako hunecha jahA~ usale usako manale cAheko kurAko Ananda linecha |
90, 91 ani, yadi mRtaka dAhine hAtavAlAharU madhyeko ho bhane unIharUko cintA nagara | unIharUle zAnti ra surakSA pAunechan |
90, 91 ani, yadi mRtaka dAhine hAtavAlAharU madhyeko ho bhane unIharUko cintA nagara | unIharUle zAnti ra surakSA pAunechan |
92 ani, yadi mRtaka rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) le lyAunubhaeko sandezalAI jhUTo Thahara garneharU ra sIdhA mArgabATa vimukha huneharU madhyeko ho bhane |
93 unIharUko Atithya satkAramA unIharUlAI atyAdhika tAto pAnIle svAgata garinecha |
94 ani U narkako AgomA jalnecha |
95 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! vAstavamA, hAmIle tapAIMlAI bhaneko yo kurA nitAnta satya ho jasamA kunai zaGkA chaina |
96 tasartha, tapAIM AphnA pAlanakartAko nAmako pavitratA varNana garnuhos ra kamI-kamajorIharUbATa uhA~lAI pavitra Thahara garnuhos |

1 AkAzaharU ra pRthvImA rahekA sampUrNa sRSTiharUle allAhako pavitratAko varNana garchan | uhA~ zaktizAlI hunuhuncha, uhA~lAI kasaile parAjita garna sakdaina | uhA~ Aphno sRSTimA ra bhAgya lekhnamA tatvadarzI hunuhuncha |

2 AkAzaharU ra pRthvIko rAjya kevala uhA~ko mAtra ho | uhA~ jasalAI cAhanuhuncha jIvita pArnuhuncha ra jasalAI cAhanuhuncha mRtyu dinuhuncha | uhA~ hareka kurAko sAmarthya rAkhnuhuncha ra uhA~lAI kunai kurAle vivaza pArna sakdaina |

3 uhA~ prathama hunuhuncha, uhA~bhandA pahile kehI thiena | ani uhA~ nai antima hunuhuncha, uhA~pachi kehI hunechaina | uhA~ jAhira (pratyakSa) hunuhuncha, uhA~bhandA mAthi kehI chaina | ani uhA~ bAtina (apratyakSa) hunuhuncha ra uhA~bhandA nikaTa kehI chaina | uhA~lAI hareka kurAko jJAna cha ra uhA~ko jJAnako paridhIbhandA bAhira kehI pani chaina |

4 uhA~le nai AkAzaharU ra pRthvIlAI sRSTi 6 dinamA garnubhayo | AitabAra pahilo dina thiyo ra zukrabAra antima dina | vAstavamA, uhA~le A~khA jhimkyAunubhandA pani kama samayamA yI sabailAI sRSTi garna sakSama hunuhuncha | ani uhA~ suhAu~do tarikAle Aphno arza (siMhAsana) mA virAjamAna hunubhayo | pAnI, bIu, Adi jastA jejati pRthvImA praveza garchan tinako jJAna ani boTabirUvA, khAnI, Adi jastA jejati pRthvIbATa niskanchan tinako jJAna ani varSA, vahI, Adi jastA jejati AkAzabATa avataraNa hunchan tinako jJAna ani phariztAharU, bhaktaharUkA kArya ra unIharUkA AtmA jastA jejati AkAzatira caDhera jAnchan tinako jJAna allAhalAI huncha | he mAnisaharU ho! timIharU jahA~ hunchau uhA~ Aphno jJAnakA sAtha timIharUsita hunuhuncha | timIharUko kunai pani kurA uhA~bATa lukeko chaina | allAhale timIharUkA kAryaharUlAI dekhirahanubhaeko cha | uhA~bATa kehI pani lukeko chaina | ani tyasai anusAra timIharUlAI badalA diinecha |

5 AkAzaharU ra pRthvIko rAjya kevala uhA~ko ho | mAmilAharU uhA~tira nai pharkera jAnchan | tasartha kiyAmatako dina sRSTikA prANIharUko hisAba liinecha ra unIharUko kArya anusAra nai unIharUlAI badalA diinecha |

6 uhA~le rAtalAI dinamA praveza garAunuhuncha ani andhakAra chAu~cha ra mAnisaharU sutchan | uhA~ rAtalAI dinamA praveza garAunuhuncha ani prakAza phailincha ra mAnisaharU AphnA kAmako lAgi niskanchan | uhA~le AphnA bhaktaharUko manamA rahekA kurAharU jAnnuhuncha | uhA~bATa kehI pani lukeko chaina |

7 timIharU allAhamAthi ra uhA~kA rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) mAthi AsthA (ImAna) rAkha | ani allAhale timIharUlAI juna dhanako uttarAdhikArI banAunubhaeko cha tyasabATa kharca gara | timIharU tyasalAI uhA~le nirdhAraNa garnubhaeko tarikA anusAra kharca gara | tasartha timIharUmadhye allAhamAthi AsthA rAkhneharU ra allAhako mArgamA Aphno sampatti kharca garneharUkA lAgi uhA~sa~ga mahAna pratidAna raheko cha, juna svarga ho |

8 timIharUlAI allAhamAthi AsthA rAkhnabATa kuna karAle rokcha? vAstavamA, rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) le timIharUlAI allAhatarpha AhvAna garnuhuncha | timIharU AphnA pAlanakartAmAthi AsthA rAkhnechau bhanne uhA~le AzA garnuhuncha | yadi timIharUlAI vizvAsa cha bhane allAhale timIharUlAI AphnA buvAharUko piThyU~ (karaGa) bATa nikAlne belA timIharUle uhA~ko mAtra upAsanA garnechau bhanI timIharUbATa bAcA linubhaeko thiyo |

9 uhA~le nai AphnA bhakta muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) mAthi spaSTa AyataharU avataraNa garnuhuncha | yasako uddezya timIharUlAI kuphra ra ajJAnatAko andhakArabATa AsthA ra jJAnako prakAzatira liera jAnu ho | vAstavamA, allAha timIharUprati komala ra dayAvAna hunuhuncha kinaki uhA~le timIharUtira Aphno nabIlAI mArgadarzaka ra zubha-sUcaka banAera paThAunubhayo |

10 timIharUlAI allAhako mArgamA kharca garnabATa kuna kurAle rokcha? jaba ki allAha AkAzaharU ra pRthvIkA uttarAdhikAra hunuhuncha | he mominaharU ho! timIharUmadhye makkA vijaya hunu aghi allAhako prasannatA prApta garnako nimti uhA~ko mArgamA kharca garne, islAmako sahayogako lAgi yuddha garne vyaktiharU ra makkA vijaya bhaepazcAta kharca garne ani kAphiraharUsa~ga yuddha garne vyaktiharU barAbara huna sakdainan | allAhako najaramA makkA vijaya hunu aghi kharca garneharU ra allAhako mArgamA yuddha garneharUko zreNI makkA vijayapazcAta allAhako mArgamA kharca garne ra kAphiraharUsa~ga yuddha garneharUko zreNIbhandA ucca cha | tara allAhale dubai samUhasa~ga svargako vAcA garnubhaeko cha | allAha timIharUkA kAryaharUbATa avagata hunuhuncha | timIharUkA kAryaharU uhA~bATa lukeko chaina ra tyasai anusAra timIharUlAI badalA dinuhunecha |

11 kohI cha jo allAhako khuzIko lAgi svayaMlAI pavitra pArna Aphno dhanalAI kharca garos? pariNAma svarUpa, allAhale usalAI Aphno dhanabATa kharca gare bApata dherai guNA baDhAera pratidAna dinuhunecha | ani usako lAgi kiyAmatako dina mahAna pratidAna raheko cha, juna svarga ho |

12 kiyAmatako dina tapAIMle momina purUSaharU ra mahilAharUko agADi ra dAhinetarpha unIharUko prakAza hi~Diraheko dekhnuhunecha | tyasadina unIharUlAI bhaninechaH Aja timIharUlAI tyasatA bagaiMcAharUko zubhasUcanA cha jasakA mahalaharU ra rUkhaharUkA talatirabATa naharaharU bagirahekA hunechan, jahA~ unIharU sadAkA lAgi rahanechan | yo badalA bhaneko mahAna saphalatA ho, yo jasto arU kunai saphalatA hunechaina |

jaba allAhale tyasadina ImAna lyAuneharUko sthiti bayAna garnubhayo, ta munAphika (kapaTI) harUko sthiti pani bayAna gardai bhannubhaeko chaH
13 munAphika purUSaharU ra mahilAharUle mominaharUlAI bhannechan: hAmro pratIkSA gara, AzA cha timIharUko prakAzabATa hAmI pani prakAza pAu~na sakauM | tyasale hAmIlAI narkamAthiko pula pAra garna sahayoga milnecha | munAphikaharUlAI ThaTTA gardai bhaninechaH timIharU pachADi pharkera jAU ra timIharUlAI jyotI dine prakAza khoja | ani yI dubaibIca euTA Aglo parkhAla khaDA garinecha | tyasa parkhAlamA DhokA hunecha | mominaharUtarphako bhitrI bhAgamA dayA hunecha ra munAphikaharUtarphako bAhirI bhAgamA yAtanA hunecha |

14 munAphikaharUle mominaharUlAI karAera bhannechan– ke hAmI islAma ra AjJApAlanamA timIharUko sAthamA thienauM ra? unIharUlAI mominaharUle bhannechan: kina na hunu, timIharU hAmIsa~gai thiyau | tara timIharUle kapaTa garI Aphai~lAI parikSAmA pAryau ani svayaMlAI naSTa pAryau | timIharUle mominaharU parAjaya hune ani Aphno kuphrako ghoSaNA garne kurAko pratIkSA garyau | mominaharUle allAhako sahayoga pAunechan ra mRtyupazcAta punaH jIvita hune bhanne kurAmA zaMkA garyau | timIharUlAI jhUTA cAhanAharUle mRtyu Aune belAsamma dhokAmA rAkhyo ra timIharU tyasai avasthAmA rahayau | ani zaitAnale allAhako viSayamA dhokAmai rAkhyo |

15 he munAphikaharU ho! Aja timIharUlAI allAhako yAtanAbATa bacAunakA lAgi timIharUbATa kunai mUlya svIkArya hunechaina | ani sArvajanika rUpamA allAhalAI nakArneharUbATa pani phirauti svIkAra garinechaina | timIharUko ra kAphiraharUko vAsasthAna narka ho | tyahI timIharUko lAgi upayukta cha ra timIharU tyasako lAgi upayukta chau | dherai nai narAmro vAsasthAna ho tyo |

16 allAhamAthi ra uhA~kA rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) mAthi AsthA (ImAna) rAkhneharUkA hRdayaharU allAhako smaraNale ra uhA~le kurAnamA avataraNa garnubhaekA bAcA ra cetAvanIko lAgi namra ra santuSTa hune samaya bhaeko chaina ra? unIharU taurAta pradAna gariekA yahUdIharU ra injIla pradAna gariekA IsAIharU saraha kaThora hRdaya bhaekA nahoun | unIharU ra unIharUtira Aune nabIharUko samaya lAmo bhaeko kAraNale unIharUkA hRdaya kaThora bhae | unIharUmadhye adhikAMsale allAhako anusaraNa tyAgI uhA~ko avajJAlAI apanAekA chan |

17 jAni rAkha, pRthvI sukhkhA bhaepachi tyasamA boTabirUvA umArera allAhale tyasalAI punaH jIvita pArnuhuncha | he mAnisaharU ho! hAmIle timIharUsamakSa allAhako zakti ra uhA~ nai vAstavika pUjya hunuhuncha bhanne kurAkA pramANaharU prastuta garekAchauM, AzA cha timIharUle bujhnechau | jAni rAkha, pRthvIko mRtyupazcAta tyasalAI punaH jIvita pArnele timIharUko mRtyupazcAta punaH jIvita pArna ra timIharUkA hRdaya kaThora bhaepachi tyasalAI namra pArna sakSama hunuhuncha |

18 vAstavamA, AphnA kehI sampattilAI dAna dine purUSa ra mahilAharU jo svayaMlAI pavitra pArna upakAra najatAI ra kaSTa nadiI tyasalAI kharca garchan bhane unIharUkA karmaharUko badalAlAI uhA~le dherai guNA baDhAunuhunecha | euTA rAmro karmalAI dasadekhi sAta saya guNAsamma baDhAinecha ra tyasabhandA pani baDhI | yasasa~gai allAhakahA~ unIharUkA lAgi sammAnajanaka pratidAna raheko cha ra tyo svarga ho |

19 allAhamAthi ra uhA~kA rasUlaharUmAthi kunai vibheda binA AsthA rAkhneharU nai AphnA pAlanakartAko najaramA saccA (siddIka) ra zahIda hun | unIharUko lAgi sammAnita pratidAna tayAra pArieko cha | kiyAmatako dina unIharUkA agADi ra dAhinetira prakAza hi~Diraheko hunecha | ani allAhalAI ra uhA~kA rasUlaharUlAI nakArneharU, hAmrA rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) mAthi avatarita hAmrA AyataharUlAI jhUTo Thahara garneharU nai narkakA bAsindAharU hun | kiyAmatako dina unIharU narkamA praveza garnechan jahA~ unIharU sadAkA lAgi rahanechan | tyahA~bATa unIharU niskana saknechainan |

20 jAni rAkha, sAMsArika jIvana ta zarIraharUle khelne kevala khela, hRdayaharU bahakine manoraJjana, timIharUle apanAune sajAvaTa, sampatti ra sAmAnako viSayamA paraspara sekhI jhArnu, sampatti ra santAna baDhAunako nimti paraspara pratispardhA garnu mAtra ho | yasako udAharaNa tyasa varSA saraha ho jasabATa umrekA boTabirUvAle kisAnaharUlAI khusI pArchan | tyasapachi tyo hariyo boTabirUvA sukcha | he herne vyakti! timIle tyasalAI hariyo bhaepachi paheMlo bhaeko dekhchau | tyasapachi allAhale tyasalAI dhulo pArnuhuncha | AkhiratamA kAphiraharU ra munAphikaharUko lAgi kaThora yAtanA cha | ani AphnA momina bhaktaharUko lAgi unIharUkA pApaharUko kSamA ra uhA~ko prasannatA cha | sAMsArika jIvana ta kevala samApta hune sAmAna ho jasamA sthiratA chaina | jo tyasako samApta hune sAmAnalAI Akhiratako anugrahamAthi prAthamikatA dincha tyo ghATA behorne ra duHkhI hunecha |

21 he mAnisaharU ho! pazcAttApa ra anya upAsanAharUdvArA satkarmaharUko lAgi pratispardhA gara jasadvArA timIharUle AphnA pApaharUko kSamA ra svarga prApta garnechau, jasako cauDAi AkAzaharU ra pRthvIkA cauDAi barAbara raheko cha | yahI tyo svarga ho juna allAhale uhA~mAthi AsthA rAkhne ra uhA~kA rasUlaharUmAthi AsthA rAkhneharUko lAgi tayAra pArnubhaeko cha | yo badalA allAhako anukampA ho juna uhA~le AphnA bhaktaharUmadhye jasalAI cAhanuhuncha pradAna garnuhuncha | allAhale nai AphnA momina bhaktaharUmAthi apAra anukampA pradAna garnuhuncha |
22 pRthvImA mAnisaharUmAthi anikAla ra yastai khAlakA Aiparne saGkaTaharU sRSTiharUko sRjanA garnu aghidekhi nai lauhe mahaphUjamA surakSita chan | vAstavamA, yo allAhako lAgi sahaja raheko cha |

23 he mAnisaharU ho! tAki, timIharUle gumAekA kurAharUprati duHkhI nahoU ra uhA~le pradAna garnubhaeko anugrahaharUprati ghamaNDa nagara | vAstavamA, allAhale tyasato vyaktilAI mana parAunuhunna jo uhA~le nai dinubhaekA anugrahaharUko viSayamA mAnisaharU samakSa ghamaNDa garcha ra phurtI dekhAu~cha |

24 kharca garna jarUrI bhaeko ThAu~mA jo kanjusyAi~ garchan ra arUharUlAI kanjusyAi~ garne upadeza dinchan unIharU ghATAmA chan | jo allAhako anusaraNabATa vimukha huncha usale allAhako kehI hAnI gardaina baru usale svayaMlAI nai hAnI puryAu~cha | vAstavamA, allAha nispRha ra sampanna hunuhuncha, uhA~lAI bhaktako anusaraNako AvazyakatA chaina ani uhA~ hareka avasthAmA prazaMsanIya hunuhuncha |

25 hAmIle hAmrA rasUlaharUlAI prasTa tarkaharU ra spaSTa pramANaharU diera paThAyauM | hAmIle unIharUtarpha kitAbaharU ra tarAju avataraNa garyauM | mAnisaharU nyAyamA dRDha rahanu yasako uddezya thiyo | ani hAmIle phalAma avataraNa garyauM jasamA ati dherai zakti cha | tyasabATa hAtahatiyArako nirmANa garincha | ani tyasamA mAnisaharUkA udyogaharU ra pezAharUsa~ga sambandhita phAidAharU chan | ani allAhakA bhaktaharUmadhye uhA~lAI ra uhA~kA rasUlalAI adRzyamA sahayoga garne ko hun bhanne kurA allAhale thAhA pAunuhunecha bhanne uddezyale ho | vAstavamA, allAha zaktizAlI hunuhuncha uhA~lAI kasaile parAjita garna sakdaina | ani uhA~lAI kasaile vivaza pArna pani sakdaina |

26 hAmIle nUha ra ibrAhIma (alaihimassalAma) lAI paThAyauM ra unI duIko santAnaharUmA IzadUtatva ra avataraNa gariekA kitAbaharUlAI rAkhyauM | dubaikA santAnaharUmadhye kehIle satmArga pAe bhane adhikAMsale allAhako anusaraNa tyAge |

27 ani hAmIle eka pachi arko garI hAmrA rasUlaharUlAI unIharUko samudAyatira paThAyauM | unIharU pachADi hAmIle IsA bina maryamalAI injIla diera paThAyauM | unImAthi ImAna rAkhneharU ra unako anusaraNa garneharUko hRdayamA hAmIle karUNA ra dayA utpanna garyauM | unIharU eka ApasamA mAyA ra dayA garne gardathe | ani unIharUle dharmako nAmamA atazayokti tathA jyAdatI gare | unIharUle vivAha ra Ananda jastA allAhale vaidha rAkhnubhaekA kehI kurAharUlAI choDe | hAmIle unIharUbATa yo cAhekA thienauM | baru unIharUle Aphai dharmamA nayA~ kurA banAu~dai tyasalAI AphUmAthi anivArya gare | baru hAmIle unIharUlAI allAhako prasannatAko anusaraNa garne Adeza diyauM tara unIharUle mAnenan | ani hAmIle unIharUmadhye momina (AsthAvAna) harUlAI pratidAna diyauM | adhikAMsa mAnisaharUle muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) le unIharU samakSa liera Aunubhaeko kurAlAI nakArera allAhako anusaraNa garna tyAge |

28 he allAhamAthi AsthA rAkhne ra uhA~ko Adezako anusaraNa garneharU ho! allAhakA AdezaharUko anusaraNa garI, uhA~le manAhI garnubhaeko kurAharUbATa bacI uhA~ko bhaya rAkha ra uhA~kA rasUlamAthi AsthA rAkha | pariNAma svarUpa uhA~le timIharUlAI dohoro pratidAna pradAna garnuhunecha | ani muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) mAthi AsthA rAkhnuko kAraNale ra aghillA rasUlaharUmAthi AsthA rAkhnuko kAraNale uttama badalA dinuhunecha | ani uhA~le timIharUlAI jyoti (nUra) pradAna garnuhunecha, jasabATa timIharUle Aphno sAMsArika jIvanamA mArgadarzana prApta garnechau ra kiyAmatako dina tyasabATa narkako mAthiko pulalAI ujyAlo banAunechau | uhA~le timIharUkA pApaharUlAI kSamA garnuhunecha arthAta tyasalAI lukAunuhunecha ra tyasako kAraNale yAtanA dinuhunechaina kinaki allAhale AphnA bhaktaharUlAI kSamA garnuhuncha ra unIharUmAthi dayA garnuhuncha |

29 he mominaharU ho! hAmIle timIharUkA lAgi dherai pratidAnalAI kaiyauM guNA garne kurAko ullekha garI Aphno mahAna kRpAko varNana garisakyauM | tAki yahUdIharU ra IsAIharUlAI allAhako kRpAmA kunai adhikAra prApta chaina bhanne kurA thAhA hos | unIharU jasalAI cAhanchan tyasalAI tyo dina sakdainan ra jasalAI cAhanchan usalAI tyasabATa vaJcita garna sakdainan | kRpA ta kevala allAhako hAtamA cha ra uhA~le AphnA bhaktaharUmadhye jasalAI cAhanuhuncha tyo dinuhuncha bhanne kurA unIharUle thAhA pAun | allAha apAra kRpAko mAlika hunuhuncha ra uhA~ AphnA bhaktaharUmadhye jasalAI cAhanuhuncha dinuhuncha |

1 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! allAhale tyasa mahilA (arthAta khaulA binta sAlabA) ko kurA sunisaknubhayo jasalAI usako pati (arthAta ausa bina sAmita) le jihAra gareko (usalAI AmA saraha bhaneko) viSayamA unale tapAIM samakSa vAdavivAda garin | ani allAha samakSa usako patile Usa~ga je garyo tyasa viSayamA gunAso garin | allAhale tapAIM dubaiko vAdavivAda sunnubhayo | allAhale AphnA bhaktaharUkA kurA sunnuhuncha ra unIharUkA karma pani dekhnuhuncha | allAhabATa kehI pani lukeko chaina |

2 AphnI patnIlAI timI merI AmA hau bhanI Usa~ga jihAra garneharUko yo kurA jhUTamA AdhArita cha | unIharUkA patnI unIharUkA AmA hoinan | unIharUlAI janma dineharU mAtra unIharUkA AmA hun | vAstavamA, yasto kurA garI unIharU nindanIya ra jhUTo kurA garchan | vAstavamA, allAha mAphI dine ra kSamA garne hunuhuncha | yasa pApabATa mukta hunakA nimti allAhale unIharUkA lAgi prAyazcita garne avasara (kaphphArA) pradAna garnubhaeko cha |

3 jihAra gariekI AphnI patnIsa~ga sambandha rAkhna cAhanchan bhane unIharUle sambandha sthApanA garnu aghi nai euTA dAsa mukta garAunu jarUrI cha | jihAra tyAgna prerita garnako nimti yo Adeza timIharUlAI diieko ho | allAha timIharUkA karmasita avagata hunuhuncha | timIharUko kunaipani karma uhA~bATa lukeko chaina |

4 tara yadi kasaile mukta garna dAsa bheTAena bhane jihAra gareko patnIsa~ga sambandha sthApanA garnu aghi usale lagAtAra duI mahinA rojA (vrata) basos | yadi kasaile lagAtAra duI mahinA rojA rAkhna sakdaina bhane usale 60 janA gariba-guruvAlAI khAnA khuvAos | yo allAhako Adeza ho bhanI timIharUle AsthA rAkhnechau, uhA~ samakSa samarpita hunechau ra uhA~kA rasUlako anusaraNa garnechau | hAmIle timIharUkA lAgi diekA AdezaharU allAhakA kAnunaharU hun, juna uhA~kA bhaktaharUkA lAgi hun | tasartha tyasako ullaGghana nagarnu | allAhakA AdezaharU ra uhA~le nirdhAraNa garnubhaekA kAnunaharUlAI namAnneharUkA lAgi kaThora yAtanA raheko cha |

5 vAstavamA, allAha ra uhA~kA rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) kA zatruharU apamAnita ra lajjita hunechan jasarI yinIharUbhandA pahilekA samudAyakA zatruharU apamAnita ra lajjita bhaekA thie | hAmIle spaSTa nizAnIharU avataraNa garisakekAchauM | allAha, uhA~kA rasUlaharU ra nizAnIharUlAI nakArneharUlAI apamAnita garne yAtanA raheko cha |

6 tyasadina allAhale sabailAI punaH jIvita pArnuhunecha ra kasailAI pani bA~kI rAkhnuhunechaina | unIharUle saMsAramA garekA ghRNita kAmaharUko viSayamA unIharUlAI sUcita garnuhunecha | allAhale unIharUko karma lekhnubhaeko cha ra unIharUko kunaipani karma chuTeko hunechaina | unIharUle tyasalAI birsekA hunechan tara unIharUle tyasalAI AphnA tI karma-patraharUmA lekhieko pAunechan jasamA pratyeka sAno ra ThUlo kArya lekhieko hunecha | allAha saceta hunuhuncha ra kunaipani kArya uhA~bATa lukeko chaina |

7 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! pRthvI ra AkAzaharUmA bhaekA kurAharUbATa allAha avagata hunuhuncha bhanI tapAIMlAI thAhA chaina ra? tyasamA rahekA kunaipani kurA uhA~bATa lukeko chaina | jahA~ tIna janA kAnekhusI garchan tyahA~ allAha Aphno jJAnakA sAtha unIharU madhyeko cautho hunuhuncha | jahA~ pA~ca janA gopya kurA garchan tyahA~ allAha Aphno jJAnakA sAtha unIharU madhyeko chaiThauM hunuhuncha | tyobhandA kama vA tyobhandA dherai saMkhyAmA unIharU jahA~ bhaepani allAha AphnA jJAnakA sAtha unIharUsa~ga hunuhuncha | unIharUko kunaipani kurA uhA~bATa lukeko chaina | ani kiyAmatako dina unIharUle ke garekA thie bhanI allAhale sUcita garnuhunecha | vAstavamA, allAhalAI hareka kurAko jJAna cha ra uhA~bATa kehIpani lukeko chaina |

8 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! ke tapAIMle yahUdIharUlAI dekhnubhaena jaba unIharUle mominalAI dekhera ApasamA kAnekhusI gare | ani allAhale unIharUlAI kAnekhusI garna manAhI garnubhayo | pherI unIharUle allAhale manAhI garnubhaeko kurA gare | ani unIharUle ApasamA pApale bharieko kAnekhusI gare jastai mominaharUko kurA kATnu, unIharUko viSayamA Akramaka rUpale kurA garnu ra rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) ko avajJAko kurA garnu | he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! jaba unIharU tapAIM samakSa Au~chan, yasto tarikAle salAma garchan juna tarikAle allAhale tapAIMlAI abhivAdana garnubhaeko chaina | unIharU bhanchan: assAma alaika | yasabATa unIharUko tAtparya mRtyu ho | unIharU nabI (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) lAI jhUTo Thahara garI bhanchan: hAmrA zabdaharUkA kAraNa allAhale hAmIlAI kina yAtanA didainan | yadi uhA~ nabI bhaeko Aphno dAbImA satya hunuhuncha bhane hAmIle bhaneko kurAko kAraNale allAhale hAmIlAI yAtanA dinuhunthyo | unIharUle bhaneko kurAko yAtanAko lAgi narka nai unIharUlAI paryApta raheko cha | unIharUle narkako tApa sahanuparne cha | unIharUko vAsasthAna ati narAmro raheko cha |

9 he allAhamAthi AsthA rAkhneharU ra uhA~kA AdezaharUko pAlanA garneharU ho! timIharU kadApi pApa, atyAcAra ra rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) ko avajJAko viSayamA eka ApasamA gopya sarasallAha nagara anyathA timIharU yahUdIharU saraha hunechau | baru allAhako AjJApAlana ra pApabATa bacne viSayamA sarasallAha gara | allAhakA AdezaharUlAI mAnera ra uhA~le manAhI garnubhaekA kurAharUbATa bacera uhA~ko bhaya rAkha kinaki timIharU kiyAmatako dina kevala uhA~tarpha hisAba kitAba ra badalAko lAgi pharkera jAnechau |

10 vAstavamA, pApa, atyAcAra ra rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) ko avajJAmA AdhArita kAnekhusI garnulAI zaitAnale sundara banAeko cha ra tyasabATa AphnA anuyAyIharUlAI bahakAu~cha | unIharUlAI zaitAnale dhokA dieko bhanne bhAvanA utpanna garAI usale mominaharUlAI duHkha dina cAhancha | tara zaitAnale sundara banAu~daimA ra AphnA anuyAyIharUlAI bahakAu~daimA allAhako cAhanA ra icchA binA tyasale mominaharUlAI kehI hAnI garna sakdaina | tasartha mominaharUle AphnA sampUrNa mAmilAharUmA allAhamAthi nai bharosA garnu pardacha |

allAhale kurAkAnImA apanAunu parne saMskArako ullekha garepachi sabhAmA apanAunu parne saMskArako ullekha garnubhaeko cha | uhA~le bhannubhaeko chaH
11 he allAhamAthi AsthA rAkhneharU ra uhA~kA AdezaharUko pAlanA garneharU ho! yadi timIharUlAI sabhAmA sthAna pharAkilo pArna bhanincha bhane timIharU pharAkilo pArnu | pariNAma svarUpa, allAhale sAMsArika jIvanamA ra AkhiratamA timIharUko lAgi pharAkilo pArnuhunecha | yadi timIharUlAI bhaninchaH buddhijIviharUlAI basnakA nimti timIharU Aphno ThAu~bATa uTha, bhane timIharU tyahA~bATa uTha | timIharUmadhye momina ra jJAna pradAna gariekA vyaktiharUko sthAnalAI allAhale ucca pArnuhunecha | allAha timIharUkA kAryaharUbATa avagata hunuhuncha | timIharUko kunaipani kArya uhA~bATa lukeko chaina ra tyasai anusAra timIharUlAI badalA diinecha |

12 jaba sahAbIharUle nabI (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) sa~ga dherai gopya sarasallAha garnathAle taba allAhale bhannubhayoH he mominaharU ho! yadi timIharU rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) sa~ga gopya sarasallAha garna cAhanchau bhane tyasabhandA pahile sadakA deU | sadakA dinu timIharUko hakamA uttama ra pavitra raheko cha kinaki yasamA allAhako AjJApAlana raheko cha ra yasale hRdayalAI svaccha pArdacha | yadi timIharUsita sadakA dinako lAgi kehI chaina bhane timIharUle binA sadakA gopya sarasallAha garna milcha kinaki allAha AphnA bhaktaharUko pApaharUlAI kSamA garnuhuncha ra unIharUprati ati dayAvAna hunuhuncha kinaki unIharUko sAmarthyabhandA baDhI bhAra bokAunuhunna |

13 ke timIharUle rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) sa~ga gopya sarasallAha garnu aghi sadakA dinAle gariba hunechau bhanne Darale timIharUlAI satAeko cha?! yadi timIharUle yaso garna sakenau bhane allAhale kSamA garnuhuncha | timIharU pUrNa rUpale namAja paDha, Aphno dhanabATa jakAta deU ra allAha ra uhA~kA rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) ko anusaraNa gara | allAha timIharUko kAryabATa avagata hunuhuncha | timIharUkA kunaipani kArya uhA~bATa lukeko chaina ra tyasai anusAra timIharUlAI badalA diinecha |

14 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! ke tapAIMle dekhnubhaena, yI munAphikaharUle yahUdIharUsa~ga mitratA gA~sekA chan jasako kuphra ra duSkarmako kAraNale allAha unIharUsa~ga risAunubhaeko cha | yI munAphikaharU momina ra yahUdI hoinan | baru unIharU duvidhAmA chan, na yatA chan na utA | unIharU muslima hun ra muslimaharUko khabara yahUdIharUlAI didainan bhanI kasama khAera bhanchan | vAstavamA, unIharUle jhUTo kasama khAekA chan |

15 AkhiratamA unIharUkA lAgi allAhale kaThora yAtanA tayAra pArera rAkhnubhaeko cha | unIharUlAI narkako tallo tahamA praveza garAinecha | vAstavamA, unIharUle saMsAramA garekA kuphrakA kAryaharU dherai narAmrA chan |

16 kuphrako kAraNa hatyA garinubATa joginako lAgi unIharUle kasama khAe | tyasakAraNa unIharUle Aphno jIvana ra sampatti bacAuna musalamAna bhaeko nATaka gare ra mAnisaharUlAI satyabATa bahakAe kinaki unIharUle muslimaharUko dRDha saMkalpalAI kamajora pArna khojekA thie | unIharUle apamAnajanaka yAtanA bhognechan |

17 unIharUlAI unIharUkA dhana-sampatti tathA santAnaharUle allAhakahA~ kunai lAbha puryAuna sakdainan | unIharU narkabAsI hun jo tyahA~ sadAkA lAgi narkamai rahanechan | ani unIharUko yAtanA kahile samApta hunechaina |

18 tyasadina allAhale unIharU sabailAI badalA dinakA lAgi punaH jIvita pArnuhunecha ra kasailAI pani choDnuhunechaina | unIharU kAphira (avajJAkArI) ra munAphika (kapaTI) thienan bhanI allAha samakSa kasama khAnechan | baru unIharU momina thie ra allAhalAI mana parne kAma garthe bhannechan | he mominaharU ho! unIharU muslima hun bhanI jasarI saMsAramA kasama khAne garthe tyasarI nai AkhiratamA pani allAha samakSa kasama khAnechan | allAha samakSa momina bhaeko kasama khAera unIharUlAI lAgnecha, unIharUle kunai phAidA pAunechan vA hAnI hunabATa bacAunecha | jAnI rAkha, vAstavamA, saMsAramA ra AkhiratamA AphnA kasamaharUko viSayamA unIharU nai jhUTA hun |

19 zaitAnale unIharUlAI vazamA pAreko cha ra unIharUlAI bahakAera allAhako smaraNa garna birsAidieko cha | unIharUle uhA~lAI mana parne kAma garenan baru uhA~lAI krodhita banAune kAma mAtra gare | yI avaguNa bokekAharU iblIsa (zaitAna) ko senA ra usakA anuyAyIharU hun | jAnI rAkha, vAstavamA, iblIsako senA ra usakA anuyAyIharU nai saMsAramA ra AkhiratamA ghATAmA hunechan | unIharUle mArgadarzanako tulanAmA pathabhraSTatA ra svargako badalAmA narka sATekA chan |
20 vAstavamA, allAha ra uhA~kA rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) kA zatruharUko gaNanA saMsAra ra AkhiratamA baDhI apamAnita ra lajjita huneharUmA chan |

21 vAstavamA, ma ra merA rasUlaharU hAmrA zatruharUmAthi tarka ra zaktidvArA vijaya prApta garnechauM bhanI allAhale Aphno pUrNa jJAna anusAra phaisalA sunAunubhayo | vAstavamA, allAha AphnA rasUlaharUko sahayoga garne zakti rAkhnuhuncha ra unIharUko zatrusa~ga badalA lina sakSama hunuhuncha |

22 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! tapAIMle allAhamAthi ra AkhiratamAthi AsthA rAkhneharUlAI allAha ra uhA~kA rasUlako zatrulAI mana parAune ra unIharUprati vaphAdAra dekhnuhunna | yadyapi allAha ra uhA~kA rasUlakA zatruharU unIharUkA pitA, chorA, dAjubhAI ra nAtedAraharU nai kina nahoun | kinaki allAha ra uhA~kA rasUlakA zatruharUsa~ga mitratA gA~snakA lAgi AsthA (ImAna) le rokdacha | ani AsthAko nAtA arU sabai nAtAbhandA ucca huncha ra matabhedako samayamA yasailAI prAthamikatA diincha | Aphanta bhaetApani allAha ra uhA~kA rasUlakA zatruharUsa~ga mitratA nagA~sneharUko manamA allAhale kahilyai parivartana nahune AsthA sthApita garnubhaeko cha | allAhale unIharUlAI Aphno tarphabATa pramANa ra prakAzadvArA zakti pradAna garnubhaeko cha | ani kiyAmatako dina unIharUlAI sadA rahane bagaiMcAharUmA praveza garAunuhunecha, jasamA rahekA mahalaharU ra rUkhaharUkA talatirabATa naharaharU bagirahekA hunechan | unIharU tyahA~ sadA rahanechan | tyahA~kA anukampAharU kahilyai samApta hunechainan ra unIharU marne pani chainan | allAha unIharUsita prasanna hunuhuncha ra aba kahilyai risAunuhune chaina | ani kahilyai samApta nahune anukampA pradAna garnubhaekomA unIharU pani uhA~sita prasanna hunechan ra tI anukampAharUmadhye euTA uhA~ko anuhAra dekhnu ho | uparyukta guNaharU bhaekAharU nai allAhakA sipAhIharU hun jo uhA~kA AdezaharUko pAlanA garchan ra uhA~le manAhI garnubhaekA kurAharUbATa bacchan | jAnI rAkha, allAhakA sipAhIharU nai AphUle cAhekA kurAharU pAuna ra saMsAra tathA AkhiratakA DarabATa bacna saphala hunechan |

1 pRthvI ra AkAzaharUkA sampUrNa sRSTiharUle allAhako mahimAgAna garchan ra uhA~lAI zobhA nadine tathA ayogya guNaharUbATa uhA~lAI pavitra ThAnchan | uhA~ yasto zaktizAlI hunuhuncha jasalAI kasaile harAuna sakdaina ra uhA~ Aphno sRSTimA, zarIata (vidhAna) mA ra bhAgya lekhnamA tatvadarzI hunuhuncha |

2 uhA~le nai allAhalAI namAnne ra uhA~kA rasUla muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) lAI jhUTho Thahara garne samudAya banI najIralAI pahilo paTaka madInAbATa niSkAsana garera zAma paThAunubhaeko belAmA madInAmA rahekA unIharUko Aphnai gharaharUbATa nikAlnubhayo | unIharU taurAta mAnne yahUdIharU hun | unIharUle AphnA vacanaharUko ullaGghana garepachi ra muzrikaharUsita milna gaepachi uhA~le unIharUlAI niSkAsana garera zAma paThAidinubhayo | he mominaharU ho! unIharU gaurava ra zaktiko mAlika bhaeko kAraNale unIharU niskanechan bhanI timIharUle so~cekA thienau | ani unIharUle so~ce, unIharUle banAekA baliyA killAharUle unIharUlAI allAhako yAtanAbATa bacAunecha | tasartha unIharUle nasoceko ThAu~bATa allAhako yAtanA AilAgyo, uhA~le Aphno rasUlalAI unIharUsa~ga yuddha garne ra unIharUlAI gharaharUbATa niSkAsana garne Adeza dinubhayo ra allAhale unIharUko hRdayamA gambhIra Dara hAldinubhayo | muslimaharUle phAidA lina nasakun bhanI unIharUle Aphnai hAtale AphnA gharaharUkA bhitrako bhAga bhatkAe ra muslimaharUle bAhirako bhAga bhatkAe | tasartha he bujhna sakne kSamatA bhaekAharU ho! unIharUle kuphra gareko kAraNale unIharUsita je bhayo tyasamA dhyAna deU | unIharU saraha nahoU anyathA timIharUle pani tyahI badalA pAunechau ra unIharUle bhogeko yAtanA bhognechau |

3 yadi allAhale unIharUko gharabATa unIharUlAI niSkAsana garine nalekhnubhaeko bhae allAhale unIharUlAI saMsAramA mRtyu ra dAsatvako yAtanA dinuhunthyo ra AkhiratamA pani unIharUko lAgi narkako yAtanA kuriraheko cha jahA~ unIharU sadAkA lAgi rahanechan |

4 kuphra, vAcA ullaGghana tathA allAha ra uhA~kA rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) sa~ga gareko zatrutAle gardA unIharUlAI sajAya diiyo | jasale allAhasa~ga zatrutA garcha, usalAI thAhA hunuparcha allAha kaThora yAtanA dinuhuncha | tasartha usale uhA~ko kaThora yAtanA bhognecha |

5 he mominaharUko samudAya! timIharUle banI najIrasa~gako yuddhamA zatruharUlAI krodhita garnako lAgi jati rUkha kATyau ra jatilAI phAidA linakA lAgi bA~kI rAkhyau tyo allAhako Adezale garekA hau | unIharUle dAbI garejasto yo dhartImA vidhvaMsa maccAunako lAgi hoina ra uhA~ko anusaraNa nagarne yahUdIharUlAI apamAnita garnako lAgi ho jasale vAcAko viparIta gare ra vizvAsaghAtako bATolAI prAthamikatA die |

6 banI najIra samudAyako juna sampatti allAhale AphnA rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) lAI pradAna garnubhayo tyasako lAgi timIharUle ghoDA ra u~Ta caDhera kunai mehanata garenau ra timIharUlAI kunai prakArako kaThinAI bhognu parena | baru allAhale AphnA rasUlaharUlAI jasamAthi cAhanuhuncha adhikAra pradAna garnuhuncha | tasartha uhA~le rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) lAI banI najIra samudAyamAthi adhikAra pradAna garnubhayo ani uhA~le yuddha binA nai unIharUko bhUmimA vijaya pradAna garnubhayo | allAha hareka kAmako sAmarthya rAkhnuhuncha ra uhA~lAI kunai kurAle vivaza banAuna sakdaina |

11 jaba timIharUkA kehI patnIharU islAma tyAgI kAphiraharUmA jAna bAdhya bhae ra timIharUle mAgeko mahara unIharUle dienan, ani timIharUle kAphiraharUbATa yuddhamA sampattI lina saphala bhayau bhane jasakA patnIharU islAma tyAgI gaekI chan unIharUle maharamA kharca gare jati unIharUlAI deU | juna allAhamAthi timIharU AsthA (ImAna) rAkhchau uhA~kA AdezaharUko pAlanA garI ra uhA~le manAhI garnubhaekA kurAharUbATa bacI uhA~ko bhaya rAkha |

12 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! (makkA vijaya bhaeko dina saraha) jaba momina mahilAharUle allAhako sAthamA arUlAI sAjhedAra Thahara garnechainan baru uhA~ko mAtra upAsanA garnechan, unIharUle corI garnechainan, vyabhicAra garnechainan, unIharUle AphnA santAnako hatyA garnechainan, unIharUle vyabhicArabATa janmekA santAnaharUlAI patiharUko ho bhanI bhannechainan, ani zoka nagarnu, kapAla nakATnu ra lugA nacyATnu jastA tapAIMkA AdezaharUko avajJA garnechainan bhanI zapatha linchan bhane unIharUko zapathalAI svIkAra garnuhos | tapAIM samakSa zapatha liepazcAta tapAIM unIharUko lAgi kSamA mAgnuhos | vAstavamA, allAhale AphnA kSamA mAgne bhaktaharUlAI kSamA garnuhuncha ra unIharUmAthi dayA garnuhuncha |

yo sUraha suru bhaeko belA allAhakA zatruharUlAI saMrakSaka tathA mitra banAune viSayamA cetAvanI diieko thiyo ra antyamA pherI tyasai kurAmA joDa dinako lAgi sohI cetAvanI ullekha bhaeko cha | allAhale bhannubhaeko chaH
13 he allAhamAthi AsthA (ImAna) rAkhneharU ra uhA~kA Adezako anusaraNa garneharU ho! juna mAnisaharUsita allAha risAunubhaeko cha ra jasale AkhiratamAthi vizvAsa gardaina usalAI sAthI nabanAU | baru unIharU tyasabATa nirAza bhaekA chan jasarI mRtyupazcAta unIharU AphnA mRtakaharU pharkane kurAbATa nirAza bhaekA chan, kinaki unIharUle punaH jIvita pArine kurAlAI mAndainan |

1 pRthvI ra AkAzaharUmA rahekA sampUrNa sRSTiharUle allAhako guNagAna garchan ra asuhAu~do kamI-kamajorIbATa uhA~ko pavitratAko varNana garchan | uhA~ ati zaktizAlI hunuhuncha, uhA~lAI parAjita garne kohI chaina | uhA~ AphnA sRSTi, zarIata ra bhAgya lekhnamA tatvadarzI hunuhuncha |

2 he allAhamAthi ImAna (AsthA) rAkhneharU! timIharUle nagareko kArya hAmIle garyauM bhanera kina bhanchau | timIharUmadhye kasaile bhane jastaiH maile Aphno tarabArale yuddha gareM ra tyasabATa hirkAe~ | jabaki, nata U tarabArale yuddha garyo na tarabAra kasailAI hirkAyo |

3 timIharU svayaM nagarne ra arUlAI arti dine kurA allAhako najaramA ati ghRNita raheko cha | mominalAI allAhaprati imAnadAra hunu zobhA dincha arthAta usako bhanAi ra garAIharUmA samAnatA hunupardacha |

4 allAhako mArgamA paGktibaddha bhaI eka arkAko kA~dhamA kA~dha milAI ekasa~ga arko joDiera baneko parkhAla saraha allAhako prasannatA prAptiko lAgi yuddha garne mominaharUlAI uhA~le mana parAunuhuncha |

jaba allAhale yuddhako ullekha garnubhayo ra Aphno lAgi yuddhamA sAmela bhaekA mominaharUko prazaMsA garnubhayo taba uhA~le mominaharUlAI Aphno nabI (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) ko avajJA garnabATa cetAvanIko lAgi mUsA ra IsA (alaihimassalAma) kA samudAyale AphnA dubai rasUlako avajJA gareko kurAko ullekha garnubhayo | uhA~le bhannubhayoH
5 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama), tyasa samayalAI samjhanuhos, jaba mUsA (alaihissalAma) le Aphno samudAyalAI bhaneH he mero samudAya! timIharU mero Adezako ullaGghana garI kina malAI satAu~chau? vAstavamA, timIharUlAI thAhA cha, ma timIharUko lAgi allAhako rasUla hu~ | tara jaba unIharU unale lyAeko sandezabATa vimukha bhae pariNAma svarUpa allAhale unIharUko hRdayalAI satya svIkArnabATa vaJcita garnubhayo | allAhako anusaraNa nagarneharUlAI uhA~le satya mArgadarzana garnuhunna |

6 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama), tyasa samayalAI samjhanuhos, jaba maryamakA chorA (alaihimassalAma) le bhaneH he isrAIlakA santAnaharU ho! vAstavamA, ma allAhako rasUla hu~ | uhA~le malAI timIharUtira taurAtako puSTi garna ra mapachi Aune rasUlako subha-sUcanA dina paThAunubhaeko cha jasako nAma ahamada hunecha | jaba IsA unIharU samakSa Aphno satyatAko spaSTa pramANaharU liera Ae, unIharUle bhaneH yo ta praSTa jAdU ho, hAmI yasako anusaraNa gardainauM |

7 tyasa vyaktibhandA baDhI atyAcArI kohI chaina, jasale allAhako viSayamA jhUTo bolcha, uhA~ko sAthamA arUlAI sAjhedAra Thahara garcha ra allAhalAI chADI arUko upAsanA garcha | jabaki, usalAI islAmatira bolAincha juna vizuddha ekezvaravAdako dharma ho | zirka ra avajJA garI AphUmAthi atyAcAra garneharUlAI allAha mArgadarzana prApta garna sahayoga garnuhunna |

8 yI jhUTAharUle anucita kurA garI ra satyako viSayamA bhrama utpanna garera allAhako prakAzalAI nibhAuna khojchan, tara allAhale Aphno dharmalAI pUrvadekhi pazcimasamma phailAI ra tyasako vANIlAI ucca pArI Aphno prakAzalAI purA garnuhunecha yadyapi yinIharUlAI jatisukai mana naparos |

9 allAhale nai muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) lAI islAma dharma arthAta bhalAiko lAgi mArgadarzana garne, phAidA dine jJAna ra satkarmako dharma diera paThAunu bhaeko ho | pariNAma svarUpa uhA~le islAmalAI sampUrNa dharmaharUbhandA mAthi rAkhnuhunecha | yadyapi yo muzrikaharUko icchA virUddha kina na hos, jo yasa dharmale dhartImA adhikAra prApta gareko dekhna sakdainan |
10 he allAhamAthi ImAna (AsthA) rAkhneharU ra uhA~kA Adezako anusaraNa garneharU! ke ma timIharUlAI phAidA dine vyApArako viSayamA batAu~, jasale timIharUlAI pIDAdAyaka yAtanAbATa mukta garnecha?

11 phAidA dine vyApAra bhannuko tAtparya timIharUle allAha ra uhA~kA rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) mAthi AsthA rAkhnu ra uhA~ko prasannatA prAptiko lAgi uhA~ko mArgamA Aphno jIudhanale jihAda gara | yadi timIharUlAI thAhA cha bhane ullekha gareko yo kArya timIharUko lAgi uttama raheko cha | tasartha tyasako lAgi hatAra gara |

12 yasa vyApArako phAidA bhaneko allAhale timIharUko pApalAI kSamA garnuhunecha, timIharUlAI svargakA tyastA bagaiMcAharUmA praveza garAunuhunecha jasakA mahalaharU ra rUkhaharUko talatirabATa nadIharU bagirahekakA hunechan ra timIharUlAI svargakA uttama gharaharUmA basAunuhunecha jo sadAko lAgi rahanechan | yo ullekha garieko badalA ThUlo saphalatA ho juna atulanIya raheko cha |

13 yasa vyApArika phAidAkA anya vizeSatAharU pani chan, jasalAI timIharUle mana parAu~nechau ra tyasalAI DhilA nagarI saMsAramA diinecha | arthAta allAhale timIharUlAI zatruko virUddhamA sahayoga garnuhunecha ra tatkAla nai timIharUlAI vijaya pradAna garnuhunecha ra tyo ho makkAko vijaya lagAyata anya vijaya | he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! mominaharUlAI khusI pArne arthAta saMsAramA prApta hune sahayoga ra AkhiratamA svarga pAune sUcanA dinuhos |

14 he allAhamAthi AsthA rAkhneharU ra uhA~le dinubhaekA AdezaharUko pAlanA garneharU! allAhako dharmako sahayoga garI allAhako sahayogI bana juna timIharUkA rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) le lyAunubhaeko ho | havArIharUle sahayoga gare saraha; jaba IsA (alaihissalAma) le unIharUlAI sodheH allAhako lAgi merA sahayogIharU ko-ko chau? unIharUle javApha dieH hAmI allAhakA sahayogI chauM | tasartha IsA (alaihissalAma) mAthi banI isrAIlako euTA samUhale AsthA (ImAna) rAkhyo ra arko samUhale unalAI inkAra garyo | tasartha IsAmAthi AsthA rAkhne samUhalAI hAmIle unalAI inkAra garne samUhako virUddha sahayoga garyauM, pariNAma svarUpa unIharUle unIharUlAI parAjita gare |

1 pRthvI ra AkAzaharUmA rahekA sampUrNa sRSTiharUle allAhako guNagAna garchan ra asuhAu~do kamI-kamajorIbATa uhA~ko pavitratAko varNana garchan | uhA~ Aphno rAjyakA eklo rAjA hunuhuncha | uhA~ hareka prakArakA kamI-kamajorIbATa pavitra hunuhuncha | uhA~ ati zaktizAlI hunuhuncha ra uhA~lAI kasaile parAjita garna sakdaina | uhA~ AphnA sRSTimA, kAnunamA ra bhAgya lekhnamA tatvadarzI hunuhuncha |

2 uhA~le nai paDhna ra lekhna najAnne arabIharUmA unIharU madhyebATa rasUla paThAunubhayo | jo unIharUlAI AphUmAthi avatarita AyataharUko pATha garera sunAunuhuncha | unIharUlAI kuphra ra narAmro AcaraNabATa pavitra pArnuhuncha | unIharUlAI kurAna ra sunnatako jJAna dinuhuncha, kinaki uhA~ rasUla bhaera Aunuaghi unIharU satyabATa spaSTa rUpamA pathabhraSTa thie | unIharUle mUrtiharUko pUjA gardathe, ragata bagAu~the ra Aphantasa~ga sambandha toDthe |

3 uhA~le yasa rasUlalAI arabI gaira arabIharU; jo ahile AekA chainan ra kiyAmatasamma Aunechan sabaikA lAgi rasUla banAera paThAunubhaeko cha | uhA~ ati zaktizAlI hunuhuncha ra uhA~lAI kasaile parAjita garna sakdaina | uhA~ AphnA sRSTimA, kAnunamA ra bhAgya lekhnamA tatvadarzI hunuhuncha |

4 rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) lAI arabI gaira arabIharUko lAgi paThAinu allAhako varadAna ho, juna varadAna uhA~le jasalAI cAhanuhuncha pradAna garnuhuncha | allAha mahAna kRpAkA mAlika hunuhuncha ra uhA~ko mahAna kRpA bhaneko yasa samudAyako rasUlalAI sampUrNa mAnavajAtiko lAgi paThAunu ho |

jaba allAhale rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) lAI paThAera ra kurAna avataraNa garera garnubhaeko kRpAko ullekha garnubhayo taba uhA~le mUsA (alaihissalAma) kA kehI anuyAyIharUle taurAtako anusaraNa garnabATa vimukha bhaeko kurA pani ullekha garnubhayo | unIharUko anusaraNa nagarnakA lAgi uhA~le yasa samudAyako nimti cetAvanIko rUpamA yasalAI ullekha garnubhayo | uhA~le bhannubhayoH
5 yahUdI samudAyalAI taurAtako anusaraNako jimmevArI diieko thiyo tara unIharUle tyasako anusaraNa garenan | tinIharUko udAharaNa tyasa gadhA saraha ho jasale ThUlA kitAbaharUko bhAra bokeko huncha tara usale ke bokeko cha bhanne kurAko jJAna usalAI hu~daina, ke yI kitAbaharU hun vA arU kehI? allAhakA nizAnIharUlAI jhUTo Thahara garneharUko udAharaNa nikai narAmro cha | allAhale atyAcArI samudAyaharUlAI satyasamma pugna sakne kSamatA pradAna garnuhunna |

6 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama), bhannuhos: he dharmamA bhaisakepachi pani yahUdI nai banera rahekAharU ho! yadi allAhale mAnisaharUlAI chADI timIharUlAI priyapAtra banAunubhaeko cha bhanne timIharUlAI lAgcha bhane mRtyuko kAmanA gara | tasartha allAhale timIharUlAI juna pratiSThAko lAgi cunnubhaeko cha tyo dinako lAgi uhA~le hatAra garnuhunecha | yadi timIharUko so~ca anusAra timIharU allAhako priyapAtra bhaeko dAbImA saccA chau bhane yaso gara |

7 unIharUle kahilyai mRtyuko cAhanA rAkhnechainan | baru unIharUle garekA kuphra, pApa, atyAcAra, taurAtamA vikRti ra parivartanakA kAraNa unIharU saMsAramA sadA rahane cAhanA rAkhnechan | allAhalAI atyAcArIharUko jJAna cha | unIharUko kunaipani kriyAkalApa uhA~bATa lukeko chaina ra unIharUlAI tyasai anusAra badalA diinecha |

8 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! yI yahUdIharUlAI bhannuhos: vAstavamA, timIharU juna mRtyudekhi bhAgchau tyasako sAmanA Dhilo vA cA~Do timIharUle garnuparne nai cha | ani kiyAmatako dina adRzya ra dRzyakA jJAtA allAhatira timIharU pharkera jAnechau | uhA~bATa kunaipani kurA lukeko chaina | ani timIharUle saMsAramA garne garekA kriyAkalApaharUko viSayamA timIharUlAI bhannuhunecha ra tyasai anusAra timIharUlAI badalA dinuhunecha |

9 he allAhamAthi AsthA rAkhne ra uhA~kA AdezaharUko anusaraNa garneharU ho! zukrabArako dina jaba imAma khutbAko lAgi mimbaramA caDhchan ra muajjina namAjako lAgi ajAna dinchan taba timIharU khutbA sunna ra namAja paDhna masjida jAU ra vyApAra garna choDa, natra yasale timIharUlAI allAhako anusaraNabATa roknecha | he mominaharU ho! jumAko namAjako ajAna pazcAta timIharUlAI masjida jAna ra vyApAra choDna diieko Adeza timIharUko lAgi uttama raheko cha, yadi timIharUlAI yo thAhA cha bhane | tasartha allAhako Adezako pAlanA gara |

10 jaba timIharU jumAko namAja (salAha) paDhisakchau taba dhartImA halAla jIvikAko khojI ra AphnA AvazyakatA pUrtikA lAgi phailiU | halAla jIvikA ra halAla nAphAko kramamA allAhako kRpA mAga ra jIvikAko khojiko samayamA dheraibhandA dherai allAhako smaraNa gara | ani timIharUle jIvikAko khojimA lAgne kAmale timIharUlAI allAhako smaraNa nabirsAos | AzA cha, timIharUle mana parAune kurA pAune chau ra Dara rAkhne kurAharUbATa bacna saknechau |

11 jaba kehI muslimaharU kunai vyApAra vA manoranjanako sAmAgrI dekhchan unIharU chariera tyatAtira jAnchan ra tapAIMlAI mimbaramA ubhieko avasthAmA choDchan | he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! bhannuhos: tyo vyApAra ra manoranjana jasatira timIharU jAnchau tyasabhandA uttama satkarmako pratidAna cha juna allAhasa~ga cha | allAha sarvottama jIvikA pradAnakartA hunuhuncha |

1 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! jaba tapAIMko sabhAmA munAphikaharU Au~chan, jo islAmako pradarzana garchan ra kuphralAI lukAera rAkhnachan ra bhanchan: tapAIM sA~ccai nai allAhako rasUla hunuhuncha bhanI hAmI gavAhI dinchauM | tapAIM sA~ccai nai uhA~kA rasUla hunuhuncha bhanne kurA allAhalAI thAhA cha | tara unIharUle bhitrI manabATa tapAIM rasUla hunuhuncha bhanI dieko gavAhIko dAbImA jhUTA chan bhanne kurAko gavAhI allAhale dinuhuncha |

2 AsthA (ImAna) lAI pramANita garnako lAgi unIharUle juna kasama khaekA chan, tyasako prayoga unIharUle hatyA ra kaida hunabATa bacnako lAgi kavacako rUpamA garekA chan | unIharUle mAnisaharUmA zaGkA ra bhrama utpanna garI unIharUlAI ImAnabATa TADhA gare | vAstavamA, kapaTa ra jhUTA kasamale gardA unIharU ati ghRNita kisimakA mAnisaharU hun |

3 unIharUle ImAna (AsthA) ko DhoMga gareko kAraNale yaso bhaeko ho | ImAna unIharUko hRdayamA praveza gareko chaina | ani unIharUle gopya rUpale allAhako sAtha kuphra gare | tasartha unIharUko kuphrale gardA unIharUko hRdayamA uhA~le sila lagAidinubhayo | aba tyasamA ImAna praveza garnechaina | tyasa silako kAraNale lAbha ra mArgadarzana kuna kurAmA cha unIharUle bujhna sakekA chainan |

4 he dekhne vyakti! timIle unIharUlAI dekhchau ta unIharUko upasthiti ra rUpa-raGga timIlAI mana parcha kinaki unIharU sundara ra sampanna chan | jaba unIharU bolchan timI unIharUko kurA sunchau kinaki unIharU kuzala vaktA hun | he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! mAnauM unIharU tapAIMko sabhAmA parkhAlamA TA~siekA kAThakA takhtA hun | unIharU kehI pani bujhdainan ra jAndainan | unIharU bhitradekhi kAyara bhaeko hunAle hareka kurAlAI AphaimAthi prahAra garieko ho bhanI ThAnchan | unIharU sA~ccikai zatru hun | tasartha, he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! unIharUbATa bacera basnuhos | unIharUle tapAIMkA gopya kurAharU phailAunechan ra tapAIM virUddha SaDyantra garnechan bhanne AzaGkA cha | unIharUmAthi allAhako zrApa hos! spaSTa pramANaharU bhaetA pani unIharU ImAnabATa vimukha bhaera kahA~ gairahekA chan?!

5 jaba yI munAphikaharUlAI bhaninchaH allAhakA rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) samakSa AU | uhA~le timIharUko pApaharUko kSamA yAcanA allAhasita garnuhunecha | unIharUle khillI uDAu~dai TAuko hallAu~chan | unIharUlAI diieko AdezabATa unIharU vimukha bhaeko tapAIM dekhnuhuncha kinaki unIharU satyalAI svIkArna garna ra pAlanA garna ghamaNDa garchan ra tyasaprati samarpita hu~dainan |

6 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! tapAIMle unIharUkA pApaharUko kSamA yAcanA garnu ra nagarnu samAna cha | allAhale unIharUkA pApa kSamA garnuhunechaina | vAstavamA, allAhako anusaraNa tyAgneharU ra pApa garirahaneharUlAI uhA~le kahilyai mArgadarzana pradAna garnuhunna |

7 unIharU nai bhanchan- allAhakA rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) sa~ga bhaekA garibaharU ra madInA variparI basne gAu~leharUle uhA~lAI nachoDesamma unIharUmAthi kharca nagara | AkAzaharUkA ra pRthvIkA khajAnAharU kevala allAhakA hun | tyo uhA~ AphnA bhaktaharUmadhye jasalAI cAhanuhuncha dinuhuncha | tara jIvikAko khajAnA uhA~ko hAtamA cha bhanne kurA munAphikaharUlAI thAhA chaina |

8 unIharUko aguvA abdullAha bina ubaile bhanyoH yadi hAmI madInA pharkera gayauM bhane tyahA~bATa pratiSThitaharU arthAta ma ra mero samudAyale ati tucchaharU arthAta muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) ra uhA~kA sAthIharUlAI nikAlnechauM | pratiSThA ta kevala allAhako, rasUlako ra mominaharUko ho | abdullAha bina ubai ra usakA sAthIharUko hoina | tara pratiSThA kevala allAha, uhA~kA rasUla ra mominaharUko lAgi ho bhanne kurA munAphikaharUlAI thAhA chaina |

jaba allAhako bATobATa roknako lAgi munAphikaharUle kharca garna kanjusyAi~ garnuko utsukatAko ullekha garnubhayo | uhA~le mominaharUlAI yasabATa roknubhayo ra unIharUlAI allAhako mArgamA kharca garne Adeza dinubhayo | uhA~le bhannubhayoH
9 he AsthAvAnaharU ho! timIharUko dhana ra santAnaharUle timIharUlAI salAha (namAja) vA anya anivArya kAryaharUbATa narokos | jasalAI usako dhana ra santAnale allAhale anivArya garnubhaeko namAja vA anya kAryaharUbATa rokyo unIharU sA~ccai nai ghATA behorneharU hun, jasale kiyAmatako dina Aphno ra Aphno parivArako ghATA behornechan |

10 allAhale timIharUlAI pradAna garnubhaeko dhanabATa mRtyu hunu aghi nai kharca gara | ani usale Aphno pAlanakartAlAI bhanne chaH he merA pAlanakartA! malAI thorai samaya pradAna garnuhos | jasale gardA ma Aphno dhanabATa allAhako mArgamA kehI kharca garna sakU~ ra allAhakA asala bhaktaharUmadhye huna sakU~ jasale AphnA kAryaharUlAI sudhArekA chan |

11 tara kunai prANIko mRtyuko samaya Aepachi ra usako umera samApta bhaepachi allAhale usalAI samaya pradAna garnuhunechaina | timIharU je garchau tyasako jJAna allAhalAI cha | timIharUko kunaipani kArya uhA~bATa lukeko chaina ra tyasai anusAra timIharUlAI badalA dinuhunecha | yadi karmaharU rAmrA chan bhane badalA rAmro hunecha ra karmaharU narAmrA chan bhane badalA narAmro hunecha |

1 allAha sabai kisimakA kamI kamajorI, apUrNatA ra uhA~ko lAgi ayogya guNaharUbATa pavitra hunuhuncha bhanI pRthvI ra AkAzaharUmA rahekA sampUrNa sRSTiharUle uhA~ko guNagAna garchan | rAjyasattA kevala uhA~ko mAtra ho | uhA~ bAheka arU kohI zAsaka chaina | rAmrA prazaMsAharU kevala uhA~ko lAgi mAtra raheko cha | uhA~ hareka kurAko sAmarthya rAkhnuhuncha |

2 he manuSyaharU ho! uhA~le nai timIharUlAI sRSTi garnubhaeko ho | timIharUmadhye kasaile uhA~ko sAthamA kuphra garchan ta unIharUko vAsasthAna narka ho | ani timIharUmadhye kohI uhA~mAthi AsthA rAkhchan, ta unIharUko vAsasthAna svarga ho | timIharUle garne kAryaharUko jJAna allAhalAI cha | timIharUko kunai pani kriyAkalApa uhA~bATa lukeko chaina ra tyasai anusAra uhA~le timIharUlAI badalA dinuhunecha |

3 uhA~le pRthvI ra AkAzaharUlAI satyakA sAtha sRSTi garnubhaeko ho, vyarthai sRSTi garnubhaeko hoina | he manuSyaharU ho! uhA~le Aphno dayA ra udAratAkA kAraNa timIharUlAI uttama rUpa pradAna garnubhayo | yadi uhA~le cAhanubhaeko bhae kurUpa banAunu hunethiyo | kiyAmatako dina uhA~tira nai pharkera jAnuparnecha | timIharUkA kArya anusAra nai uhA~le timIharUlAI badalA dinuhunecha | yadi kAryaharU rAmrA chan bhane badalA rAmro hunecha ra kAryaharU narAmrA chan bhane badalA narAmro hunecha |

4 uhA~lAI pRthvI ra AkAzaharUkA sampUrNa kurAharUko jJAna cha | uhA~lAI timIharUle jAhera garne ra lukAune sampUrNa kAryaharU thAhA cha | allAhalAI hRdayamA rahekA rAmrA vA narAmrA kurAharUko jJAna cha | uhA~bATa kehI pani lukeko chaina |

5 he muzrikaharU ho! timIharUbhandA pahilekA jhUTo Thahara garne samudAyaharU; jastaiH nUha (alaihissalAma) ko samudAya, Ada, samUda Adiko khabara timIharU samakSa Aipugena ra? unIharUle saMsAramA gareko kuphrako yAtanA cAkhisakekA chan | ani unIharUko lAgi AkhiratamA pIDAdAyI yAtanA raheko cha | kina nahunu, baru timIharU samakSa tI khabaraharU AisakekA chan | unIharUlAI je bhayo tyasabATa pATha grahaNa gara ra unIharUlAI jastai timIharUlAI pani kaSTa hunu aghi allAha samakSa pazcAttApa gara |

6 unIharUle yAtanA bhognuko kAraNa unIharU samakSa allAhako tarphabATa rasUlaharU spaSTa tarka ra pramANaharUkA sAtha AekA thie | tara manuSyaharU rasUla huna nasakne kurA gardai unIharUle bhaneH ke manuSyale hAmIlAI satya mArga dekhAune ho ta? tasartha unIharUle kuphra gare ra unIharUmAthi AsthA rAkhnabATa vimukha bhae | yaso garera unIharUle allAhalAI hAnI puryAuna sakenan | allAhalAI unIharUko AsthAko ra anusaraNako AvazyakatA chaina kinaki unIharUko anusaraNale uhA~lAI kehI phAidA pugnechaina | allAhalAI AphnA bhaktaharUko AvazyakatA chaina | uhA~ AphnA kurAharUmA ra kAryaharUmA prazaMsita hunuhuncha |

7 allAhalAI inkAra garneharUko so~ca anusAra allAhale unIharUko mRtyupazcAta unIharUlAI punaH jIvita pArera uThAunuhunechaina | he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! punaH jIvita pArera uThAine kArya nakArneharUlAI bhannuhos: avazya, kiyAmatako dina merA pAlanakartAle timIharUlAI punaH jIvita pArI uThAunuhunecha | ani timIharUle saMsAramA garekA kAryaharUko viSayamA timIharUlAI batAunuhunecha | tyasarI punaH jIvita pArI uThAunu allAhako lAgi sahaja kAr cha kinaki uhA~le timIharUlAI pahilo paTaka sRSTi garisaknubhaeko cha | tasartha timIharUko mRtyupazcAta timIharUlAI hisAba lina ra badalA dina punaH jIvita pArI uThAuna sakSama hunuhuncha |

8 he manuSyaharU ho! allAhamAthi ra uhA~kA rasUlamAthi ImAna lyAU ani hAmIle hAmrA rasUlamAthi avatarita gareko kurAnamAthi ImAna lyAU | timIharUle garne kAryaharUbATa allAha avagata hunuhuncha | timIharUkA kAryaharUmadhye kunai pani kurA uhA~bATa lukeko chaina ra tyasai anusAra uhA~le timIharUlAI badalA dinuhunecha |

9 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! kiyAmatako dinalAI samjhanuhos juna dina allAhale timIharUlAI timIharUko kAryaharUko badalA dinako lAgi bhelA pArnuhunecha | tyasa dina kAphiraharUko hAra ra ghATA spaSTa hunecha kinaki mominaharU svargamA narkabAsIharUkA gharakA hakadAra hunechan ra narkabAsIharU narkamA mominaharUkA gharakA hakadAra hunechan | jasale allAhamAthi AsthA rAkhnecha ra satkarma garnecha allAhale usakA pApaharUlAI kSamA garnuhunecha ra usalAI bagaiMcAharUmA praveza garAunuhunecha jahA~kA mahalaharU ra rUkhaharUko talatirabATa naharaharU bagirahekA hunechan | unIharU tyahA~ sadAkA lAgi rahanechan | unIharU tyahA~bATa niskane chainan ra tyahA~kA anugraha tathA varadAnaharU kahilyai samApta hune chaina | unIharUle mahAna saphalatA prApta garnechan jasto arU kunai saphalatA hune chaina |

10 allAhalAI nakArneharU, hAmIle hAmrA rasUlamAthi avatarita garekA AyataharUlAI jhUTo Thahara garneharU nai narka praveza garneharU hun, tyahA~ unIharU sadAkA lAgi rahanechan | kati narAmro unIharUko vAsasthAna raheko cha |

11 kasailAI pani usako jIudhana vA santAnalAI allAhako phaisalA ra uhA~le lekhnubhaeko bhAgyale gardA mAtra kaSTa Au~cha | jasale allAhamAthi, uhA~kA phaisalAmAthi ra uhA~kA bhAgyamAthi AsthA rAkhcha allAhale usalAI Aphno Adeza, prasannatA ra phaisalAlAI svIkAra garna usako hRdayalAI sahaja banAi dinuhuncha | allAhalAI sabai kurAko jJAna cha ra uhA~bATa kehI pani lukeko chaina |

12 allAhako anurasaNa gara ra uhA~kA rasUlako anusaraNa gara | yadi uhA~kA rasUlale lyAunubhaeko sandezabATa timIharU vimukha bhayau bhane tyasa vimukha hunuko pApa timIharUmAthi nai Aunecha | hAmro rasUlamAthi hAmIle dieko sandeza puryAidine jimmevArI mAtra cha ra uhA~le timIharUlAI puryAunuparne sandeza puryAisaknu bhaeko cha |
13 allAha nai vAstavika upAsya hunuhuncha, uhA~ bAheka arU kohI upAsya chaina | tasartha, mominaharUle AphnA sampUrNa mAmilAmA allAhamAthi mAtra nirbhara hunupardacha |

14 he allAhamAthi AsthA rAkhne ra uhA~kA AdezaharUko pAlanA garneharU ho! vAstavamA, timIharUkA kehI patnIharU ra kehI santAnaharU timIharUkA zatru hun kinakI unIharU timIharUlAI allAhako samjhanAbATa ra uhA~ko mArgamA yuddha garnabATa rokdachan ra timIharUlAI nirUtsAhita garchan | sAvadhAna, timIharUmAthi unIharUko prabhAva naparos | yadi timIharUle unIharUko bhulalAI mApha garyau, tyasabATa TADhA rahyau ra unIharUbATa tyasalAI lukAera rAkhyau bhane allAhale timIharUkA pApaharUlAI kSamA garnuhunecha ra timIharUmAthi dayA garnuhunecha | kAma anusArako badalA huncha |

15 timIharUko sampatti ra santAna timIharUko lAgi parIkSA ho | kahile unIharUle avaidha jIvikopArjana garna lagAu~chan ra allAhako anusaraNa choDna lagAu~chan | tara jo AphnA santAnako anusaraNa ra sampattimA vyasta rahanubhandA allAhako AjJApAlanalAI prAthamikatA dincha, usako lAgi allAhasa~ga mahAna pratidAna raheko cha | tyo mahAna pratidAna svarga ho |

16 allAhakA AdezaharUko pAlanA garI ra uhA~le manAhI garnubhaekA kurAharUbATa sakesamma bacera uhA~ko bhaya rAkha | allAhako ra uhA~kA rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) ko kurA suna ra anusaraNa gara | rAmrA kAmakA lAgi allAhale pradAna garnubhaeko sampattilAI kharca gara | jasalAI allAhale kanjusyAi~ garnabATa surakSita rAkhnubhayo unIharUle cAheko kurA pAuna ra juna kurAko Dara cha tyasabATa bacna saphala hunechan |

17 yadi allAhako mArgamA kharca garI timIharUle allAhalAI rAmro RNa diyau bhane allAhale timIharUko pratidAnalAI dasa guNA dekhi sAta saya guNA ra tyo bhandA pani dherai guNA garnuhunecha ra timIharUko pApaharUlAI kSamA garnuhunecha | allAha guNagrAhI hunuhuncha, thorai kAryako badalAmA dherai pratidAna dinuhuncha | uhA~ sahanazIla hunuhuncha, yAtanA dina hatAra garnuhunna |

18 allAha adRzya ra dRzyako jJAtA hunuhuncha | uhA~bATa kehI pani lukeko chaina | uhA~ zaktizAlI hunuhuncha, uhA~lAI kasaile parAjita garna sakdaina | uhA~ AphnA sRSTimA, kAnunamA ra bhAgya lekhnamA tatvadarzI hunuhuncha |

1 he nabI (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! yadi tapAIM vA tapAIMko anuyAyImadhye kasaile pani AphnI patnIlAI talAka dina cAhancha bhane usako pahilo iddatamA talAka deU arthAta patile Usa~ga sambhoga nagareko pavitratAko samayamA talAka deU | ani iddatako gantI rAkha, tAki timIharUle AphnA patnIharUlAI phirtA lina cAheko khaNDamA unIharUlAI phirtA lina sambhava hos | allAhakA AdezaharUko pAlanA garera ra uhA~le manAhI garnubhaekA kurAharUlAI tyAgera allAhako bhaya rAkha | iddatako avadhi samApta nabhaesamma talAka diiekI mahilAharUlAI Aphno gharabATa nanikAla ra svayaM unIharU pani naniskiun | tara unIharUle vyabhicAra jastA khullA azlila kArya gareko khaNDamA nikAlnu beglai kurA ho | yI niyamaharU allAhakA sImA hun juna uhA~le AphnA bhaktaharUkA lAgi nirdhAraNa garnubhaeko ho | jasale allAhakA sImAharUko ullaGghana garcha usale AphUmAthi atyAcAra garcha, usale AphnA pAlanakartAko ullaGghana garI svayaMlAI vinAzako srotasamma puryAu~cha | he talAka dine vyakti! timIlAI thAhA chaina, hunasakcha allAhale tyasa talAka pazcAta kunai bATo nikAlnuhunecha jasako timIharUlAI AzA thiena ra timIharUle unIharUlAI phirtA linechau |

2 ani jaba unIharU Aphno iddatako antamA pugchan ki ta unIharUlAI Aphno cAhanAle ra rAmro tarikAle phirtA liU vA unIharUko iddata pUrA hunjela unIharUlAI choDa | pariNAma svarUpa unIharU AphnA mAmilAbAre Aphai socne chan | unIharUle pAunu parne adhikAraharU unIharUlAI deU | timIharUle unIharUlAI phirtA line vA pharkAune so~ca banAe pazcAta AphnA mAnisaharUmadhye duIjanA nisApha garnelAI vivAda samAdhAna garnakA nimti sAkSI banAU | he sAkSI basekAharU ho! allAhako prasannatA prAptikA lAgi sAkSI deU | yI niyamaharUko ullekha garnu allAhamAthi ra kiyAmatakA dinamAthi AsthA rAkhnele upadeza grahaNa garnako nimti ho kinaki usale nai upadeza ra cetAvanIbATa phAidA prApta garcha | tasartha jo allAhale dinubhaeko Adezako pAlanA garI ra uhA~le manAhI garnubhaeko kurAharUbATa bacI uhA~ko bhaya rAkhnecha, allAhale usalAI pratyeka kaSTa ra bAdhAbATa bacnako nimti nikAsa nikAlnuhunecha |

3 ani uhA~le AzA nagarieko ra akalpanIya ThAu~bATa jIvikA pradAna garnuhuncha | ani jo AphnA mAmilAharUmA allAhamAthi nirbhara huncha usako lAgi uhA~ paryApta hunuhuncha | vAstavamA, allAhale Aphno phaisalAlAI lAgu garnuhuncha | uhA~lAI kunai kurAko lAgi bAdhya pArna saki~daina ra uhA~bATa kunai kurA umkana sakdaina | allAhale hareka vastuko samAptiko lAgi samaya sImA nirdhArita garnubhaeko cha | duHkhako samayasImA cha ra samRddhiko pani samayasImA cha | mAnisa yI duImadhye kunai avasthAmA pani sadA raha~daina |

4 buDhesakAlako kAraNale rajasvalAbATa mukta bhaisakekI talAka pAekI mahilAharUko iddatako viSayamA yadi timIharUlAI zaGkA cha bhane jAnI rAkha unIharUko iddata tIna mahinA ho | tyasarI nai bAlyakAlako kAraNale rajasvalAko samaya nabhaekA mahilAharUko iddata tIna mahinA ho | ani garbhavatI mahilAharUko talAkako ra patiko mRtyu pazcAtako iddata unIharUle baccA janmAunu ho | jo allAhako AdezaharUko pAlanA garI ra uhA~le manAhI garnubhaeko kurAharUbATa bacI uhA~ko Dara rAkhcha usakA mAmilAlAI allAhale sahaja banAunuhunecha ra usalAI hareka kaThina avasthAmA rAhata pradAna garnuhunecha |

5 he mominaharU ho! talAka dine, phirtA line ra iddatakA ullekha gariekA niyamaharU allAhakA Adeza hun jasa anusAra timIharUle kArya garna saka bhanI uhA~le timIharUkA lAgi avataraNa garnubhaeko ho | jasale allAhakA AdezaharUko pAlanA garI ra uhA~le manAhI garnubhaekA kurAharUbATa bacI uhA~ko bhaya rAkhyo allAhale usale garekA pApaharUlAI kSamA garnuhunecha ra AkhiratamA mahAna pratidAna dinuhunecha arthAta usale svargamA praveza pAunecha ra kahile samApta nahune anugraha prApta garnecha |

jaba allAhale talAka ra phirtA line viSayamA niyamaharUko ullekha garnubhayo taba uhA~le gA~sa ra bAsako niyama ullekha garnubhayo | uhA~le bhannubhayoH
6 he patiharU ho! unIharUlAI Aphno haisiyata ra zakti anusAra timIharU basne ThAu~mA nai rAkha | gA~sa, bAsa ra anya kurAharUko nAmamA unIharUko jIvanalAI gAhro banAunakA lAgi unIharUlAI nasatAU | yadi talAka pAekI mahilAharU garbhavatI chan bhane unIharUle baccA najanmAesamma unIharUmAthi kharca gara | yadi unIharUle timIharUkA santAnalAI stanapAna garAu~chan bhane unIharUlAI stanapAna garAe bApata pArizramika deU | ani pArizramikako viSayamA ApasamA rAmro tarikAle sarasallAha gara | pArizramikako viSayamA patnIle cAheko jati dina patile kanjusyAi~ garcha tara usale AphUle cAheko pArizramika nai lina cAhanche bhane buvAle Aphno santAnalAI stanapAna garAunakA nimti arUlAI rAkhna sakcha |

7 sampanna vyaktile AphUle talAka dieko mahilA ra baccAmAthi Aphno sAmarthya anusAra kharca garnupardacha | ani jasalAI sImita jIvikA pradAna garieko cha usale allAhale dinubhaeko madhyebATa kharca garos | allAle kasailAI pani uhA~le dinubhaeko bhandA baDhI kharca garna bAdhya garnuhunna, usalAI adhika jimmevArI dinuhunna ra usale sahana saknebhandA baDhI bojha UmAthi hAlnuhunna | allAhale usalAI cA~Dai nai sImita jIvikA ra kaThina avasthApachi sahajatA ra prazasta dhana-sampatti pradAna garnuhunecha |

jaba allAhale pUrai niyamaharUko ullekha garnubhayo taba uhA~le tI niyamaharUbATa vimukha nahuna cetAvanI dinubhayo ra tyasako narAmro pariNAmalAI praSTa pArnubhayo | ani uhA~le bhannubhayoH
8 katipaya bastIharUle Aphno pAlanakartAko Adeza ra uhA~kA rasUlaharUko AdezalAI asvIkAra gare | pariNAma svarUpa hAmIle unIharUkA narAmrA kAryaharUko kaDA hisAba liyauM ra unIharUlAI saMsAramA ra AkhiratamA DaralAgdo daNDa diyauM |
9 tasartha unIharUle AphnA narAmrA kAryaharUko yAtanA bhoge | unIharUle saMsAramA ra AkhiratamA ghATA behornu parne bhayo |

10 allAhale unIharUkA lAgi kaDA yAtanA tayAra pArnubhaeko cha | he allAhakA AdezaharUko pAlanA garne ani uhA~le manAhI garnubhaekA kurAharUbATa bacne ani uhA~mAthi ra uhA~kA rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) mAthi AsthA rAkhne buddhimAnaharU ho! allAhako bhaya rAkha natra unIharUmAthi Aeko Apata timIharUmAthi pani Auna sakcha | allAhale timIharUlAI cetAvanI dinubhaeko cha | jasale uhA~ko AjJApAlana nagardAko durbhAgyapUrNa pariNAmaharU ra uhA~ko AjJApAlana gardA rAmrA pariNAmaharUko samjhanA garAu~cha |

11 yo cetAvanI bhaneko uhA~ko rasUla hunuhuncha, jo timIharU samakSa allAhakA spaSTa AyataharUko pATha garnuhuncha jasamA kunai sandeha chaina | AzA cha, allAhamAthi AsthA rAkhneharU, uhA~kA rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) lAI satya mAnneharU ra satkarma garneharUlAI pathabhraSTatAko andhakArabATa nikAlera mArgadarzanako prakAzatira lAnuhunecha | jo allAhamAthi AsthA rAkhcha ra satkarma garcha allAhale usalAI bagaiMcAharUmA praveza garAunuhunecha jasakA mahalaharU ra rUkhaharUkA talatirabATa naharaharU bagirahekA hunechan | jasamA unIharU sadAsarvadA rahanechan | allAhale usalAI svargamA praveza garAera euTA rAmro prabandha milAunubhaeko cha jasako anugraha kahilyai samApta hunechaina |

12 allAhale nai sAtavaTA AkAzaharUlAI sRSTi garnubhayo ra sAtavaTA AkAzaharU jastai sAtavaTA pRthvIharU pani sRSTi garnubhayo | uhA~kA dubai kAnunaharU, prakRtiko kAnuna ra dharmako kAnuna yI dubaiko bIcamA avataraNa hunchan | AzA cha, allAha hareka kurAko sAmarthya rAkhnuhuncha bhanne kurA timIharUle thAhA pAunechau | uhA~lAI kasaile pani bAdhya pArna sakdaina | uhA~le hareka kurAlAI Aphno jJAnale ghernubhaeko cha | pRthvI ra AkAzaharUmA uhA~bATa kunai pani kurA lukeko chaina |

1 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! allAhale tapAIMko lAgi vaidha garnubhaeko kurA arthAta AphnI dAsI mAriyAsa~ga sambhoga garna kina avaidha garnubhayo? tyo pani patnIharUlAI khuzI pArnako lAgi kinabhane tinIharUle IrSyA garin | allAha ta tapAIMko lAgi kSamAzIla ra dayAvAna hunuhuncha |

2 timIharUle kasamabhandA rAmro vikalpa pAeko vA kasama pUrA garna nasakne avasthAmA allAhale timIharUlAI prAyazcita garI kasama bhaGga garna vaidha garnubhaeko cha | allAha timIharUkA sahayogI hunuhuncha | uhA~lAI timIharUko avasthAko ra timIharUlAI phAidA dine kurAko viSayamA rAmrosa~ga thAhA cha | ani uhA~ Aphno kAnuna ra bhAgya lekhnamA tatvadarzI hunuhuncha |

3 yAda gara, jaba nabI (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) le AphnI dAsI mAriyAko najika najAne kurA haphsAlAI mAtra batAunubhayo | ta haphsAle AizAlAI tyasa kurAko jAnakArI garAin, taba allAhale Aphno nabIlAI tyo khabara phailieko viSayamA sUcita garnubhayo | uhA~le haphsAlAI nasihata garnubhayo ani kehI kurA bhannubhayo ra kehI bhannubhaena | ani haphsA rajiyallAhu anhAle uhA~sa~ga sodhnubhayoH tapAIMlAI kasale bhanyo? uhA~le bhannubhayoH sabai kurAko jJAtA ra hareka gopya sUcanA dine (allAha) le malAI bhannubhayo |

4 timI dubaijanAle pazcAttApa garnu anivArya cha kinaki timIharUko hRdaya tyasa kurAko premamA phasyo jasalAI allAhakA rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) le mana parAunuhunna arthAta uhA~kI dAsIbATa TADhA basnu ra usalAI AphUmAthi avaidha garnu | yadi timIharUle uhA~ viruddha yo kAma garirahayau bhane jAnI rAkha allAha uhA~ko saMrakSaka ra sahayogI hunuhuncha | tyasarI nai jibrIla ra satkarmI mominaharU uhA~kA saMrakSaka ra sahayogI chan | ani uhA~lAI coTa puryAuneharU viruddha allAhako sahayoga pazcAta phariztAharU saMrakSaka ra sahayogI chan |

5 yadi nabI (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) le timIharUlAI talAka dinubhayo bhane AzA cha, uhA~kA pAlanakartAle uhA~lAI timIharUko badalAmA timIharUbhandA baDhI rAmrA patnIharU pradAna garnuhunecha; jo uhA~kA Adeza mAnne, uhA~mAthi ra uhA~kA rasUlamAthi AsthA rAkhne, ani allAhakA AjJAkArI, AphnA pApaharUko lAgi pazcAttApa garne, AphnA pAlanakartAko upAsanA garne, rojA rAkhne, vivAhitA ra kanyA hunechin | tara uhA~le unIharUlAI talAka dinubhaena |

6 he allAhamAthi AsthA (ImAna) rAkhneharU ra uhA~kA AdezaharUko pAlanA garneharU ho! AphUlAI AphnA parivArakA sadasyaharUlAI tyasa mahAna AgobATa bacAU jasalAI mAniharU ra DhuGgAharUdvArA bAlinecha | tyasa AgomAthi tyahA~ praveza garneharUkA lAgi kaThora ra balavAna phariztAharU niyukta chan | unIharUle allAhale dinubhaeko Adezako avajJA gardainan | uhA~le dinubhaeko Adezako pAlanA garna unIharU sustI ra AnAkAnI pani gardainan |

7 ani kiyAmatako dina kAphiraharUlAI bhaninechaH he kuphra garneharU ho! timIharUle gareko kuphra ra pApako lAgi Aja bahAnA nabanAU | timIharUko bahAnA mAnya hunechaina | timIharUle saMsAramA allAhalAI nakArne ra uhA~kA rasUlaharUlAI jhUTo Thahara garne gareko kAryako timIharUlAI Aja badalA diinecha |

8 he allAhamAthi AsthA rAkhne ra uhA~kA AdezaharUko pAlanA garneharU ho! allAha samakSa AphnA pApaharUko sA~co pazcAttApa gara | AzA cha, timIharUkA pAlanakartAle timIharUkA pApaharUlAI kSamA garnuhunecha ra timIharUlAI kiyAmatako dina svargamA praveza garAunuhunecha, jasakA mahalaharUko talatirabATa nadIharU bagirahekA hunechan | tyasa dina allAhale nabI (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) lAI ra uhA~sa~ga bhaekA mominaharUlAI narkamA hAlera apamAnita garnuhune chaina | tyasa bATomA unIharUko agADi ra dAyA~tarpha unIharUko prakAza jAnecha | unIharUle bhannechan: he hAmrA pAlanakartA! hAmro prakAzalAI hAmro lAgi pUrNa garidinuhos, jasale gardA hAmI svargamA praveza garnasakauM | hAmI munAphikaharU saraha nahoauM, jasako prakAza pula sirAtamA nibhnecha | hAmrA pApaharUlAI kSamA garnuhos kinaki tapAIM sampUrNa kurAharUko sAmarthya rAkhnuhuncha | hAmrA prakAzalAI pUrNa rUpa dina ra hAmrA pApaharUlAI kSamA garna tapAIM asakSama hunuhunna |

9 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! kAphiraharUsa~ga taravArako sAtha ra munAphikaharUsa~ga maukhika rUpamA ra sajAya diera yuddha gara | ani unIharU tapAIMsa~ga naDaresamma unIharUsa~ga kaDA vyavahAra garnuhos | kiyAmatako dina unIharUle narkamA basobAsa apanAunechan | unIharUko vAsasthAna ati narAmro vAsasthAna ho jahA~ unIharU pharkera jAnechan |

10 allAhalAI ra uhA~kA rasUlaharUlAI nakArneharUkA lAgi, mominaharUsa~gako sambandhale unIharUlAI kunai phAidA puryAune chaina bhanne kurAlAI spaSTa pArdai, allAhakA nabIharU madhyekA duIjanA nabIharU arthAta nUha ra lUta (alaihimassalAma) kA patnIharUko udAharaNa allAhale prastuta garnubhayo | tI dubai hAmrA duIjanA asala bhaktaharUkA patnI thiin | tara dubai janAle allAhako mArgabATa rokera ra kAphiraharUko sahayoga garI dhokA diin | yI duI asala bhaktaharUkA patnI bhaera pani unIharUlAI kunai phAidA prApta bhaena | yI dubailAI bhaniyoH narkamA praveza hune sampUrNa kAphira ra munAphikaharUko sAthamA timIharU pani jAU |

11 allAhamAthi ra uhA~kA rasUlaharUmAthi AsthA rAkhneharU hareka avasthAmA sIdhA mArgamA aDiga rahane ho bhane unIharUlAI kAphiraharUsa~gako sambandhale kunai hAni garnechaina ra unIharUmAthi tyasako kunai prabhAva parnechaina bhanne kurAlAI praSTa pArnakA lAgi allAhale unIharUlAI phiraunakI patnIko udAharaNa prastuta garnubhayo | unale bhaninaH he merA pAlanakartA! svargamA mero lAgi euTA ghara banAunuhos ra malAI phiraunako kruratA, zakti ra usakA narAmrA karmaharUbATa surakSita rAkhnuhos | ani usako tAnAzAhI ra atyAcAramA usako anusaraNa garI AphUmAthi atyAcAra garneharUbATa surakSita rAkhnuhos |
1 allAhako bhalAI mahAna ra apAra raheko cha | uhA~kai hAtamA siGgo saMsArako zAsasattA cha | uhA~ hareka kurAko sAmarthya rAkhnuhuncha ra uhA~lAI kasaile pani vivaza pArna sakdaina |

2 he mAnisaharU ho! timIharUmadhye kasale rAmro kAma garcha bhanI timIharUko parIkSA linako lAgi uhA~le mRtyu ra jIvanako sRSTi garnubhayo | uhA~ yati prabhutvazAlI hunuhuncha ki uhA~lAI kasaile harAuna sakdaina ra uhA~ pazcAttApa garne bhaktaharUlAI kSamA garnuhuncha |

3 uhA~le sAtavaTA AkAzaharU tahataha garI banAunubhayo tara ekale arkolAI chu~daina | he darzaka! timIle allAhako sRSTimA kunai prakArako avyavasthatA ra bekAidA dekhnechainau | rAmrarI hera ta, ke timIle katai carkeko vA pvAla dekhyau?! timIle kevala vyavasthita ra paripUrNa sRSTi dekhnechau |
4 bArambAra hera, timrA kamajora A~khAharUle AkAzako sRSTimA kunai prakArako truTi vA asantulanako avalokana garna asamartha bhaI timItira pharkanechan |
6 kiyAmatako dina Aphno pAlanakartAlAI nakArneharUlAI narkako dankado Agoko yAtanA diinecha | tyo ati narAmro ThAu~ ho |

8 tyasamA praveza garneharUlAI dekhera krodhale tyasako eka bhAga arko bhAgabATa phATera alaga holA jhai~ pratIta hunecha | jaba tyasamA kAphiraharUlAI hAlinecha tyahA~ khaTAiekA phariztAharUle unIharUlAI nindA gardai sodhnechan– ke saMsAramA timIharUlAI allAhako yAtanAbATa DarAuna kunai rasUla Aenan ra?!

10 kAphiraharUle pherI bhannechan: yadi hAmIle lAbhAnvita hune uddezyale sunekA bhae hAmIlAI phAidA hunethiyo vA satya ra asatya bIcako pharakalAI bujheko bhae hAmI narkamA parne thienauM | baru hAmI rasUlaharUmAthi AsthA rAkhne, unIharUle lyAekA sandezalAI mAnne ra svarga jAneharU madhyekA hunethiyauM |
11 unIharUle AphnA kuphra ra jhUTo Thahara gareko kurAlAI svIkAra garnechan ani narkako hakadAra hunechan | tasartha narkabAsIharUmAthi dhikkAra cha!

13 he mAnisaharU ho! cAhe timIharUle AphnA kurAlAI lukAU vA jAhera gara allAhalAI tyasako jJAna huncha | uhA~lAI bhaktaharUkA hRdayamA rahekA kurAharUko pani jJAna huncha | uhA~bATa kunai pani kurA lukna sakdaina |

14 jasale sampUrNa sRSTilAI astitva dinubhayo ke uhA~lAI gopya kurA ra tyobhandA pani dherai lukekA kurAharUko jJAna na holA ta?! uhA~ bhaktaharUkA lAgi komala hunuhuncha ra unIharUko kriyAkalApaharUbATa avagata hunuhuncha kinaki uhA~bATa kehI pani lukeko chaina |

16 yo dhartI basnayogya hu~dA hu~dai pani jasarI AkAzamA hunubhaekA allAhale kArUnalAI dhartImA dhasAidinubhayo ke uhA~le yasa sthira dhartIlAI hallAera timIharUlAI yasamA dhasAunuhunna bhanI timIharU nirdhakka chau?!

17 vA AkAzamA hunubhaekA allAhale lUta (alaihissalAma) ko samudAyamAthi DhuGgA khasAe jhaiM timIharUmAthi AkAzabATa DhuGgA khasAlnuhunna bhanI nirdhakka chau? jaba timIharU mero yAtanAko svAda cAkhchau timIharUle mero cetAvanIlAI thAhA pAunechau | tara mero yAtanA dekhisakepachi timIharUlAI tyasako kunai phAIdA hunechaina |

18 yI muzrikaharUbhandA pahilekA mAnisaharUle jhUTo Thahara garisakekA chan | ani unIharU kuphra ra jhUTamA aDiga bhaeko kAraNale unIharUmAthi allAhako yAtanA avatarita bhayo | kasto rahyo ta unIharUmAthi hAmro tiraskAra? tyo nikai kaThora tiraskAra thiyo |

19 ke yI inkAra garneharUle unIharUmAthi havAmA carAharUlAI uDnebelA eka paTaka pakheTA hAvAmA phailAune ra arko paTaka pakheTA banda garne gareko dekhdainan?! allAha bAheka arU kohI pani unIharUlAI dhartImA khasnabATa rokdaina | uhA~le hareka kurAlAI dekhirahanubhaeko cha ra uhA~bATa kehI pani lukeko chaina |

20 he kAphiraharU ho! allAhale timIharUlAI yAtanA dine phaisalA garepachi timIharUlAI uhA~ko yAtanAbATa bacAuna kunai senA hunechaina | kAphiraharU zaitAnako dhokAmA parnu bAheka arU kehI gardainan ani zaitAnako dhokAle unIharU bhramita hunchan |

21 yadi allAhale Aphno jIvikA timIharUlAI dina cAhanubhaena bhane kasaile pani tyasalAI timIharUlAI dina saknechaina | baru vAstavikatA yo ho ki kAphiraharU Aphno jiddI ra ahaGkArako kAraNa satyabATa dherai TADhA bhaekA chan |
22 ke Aphno anuhArako bharamA ghamaNDakA sAtha hi~Dne muzrika vyaktile mArgadarzana prApta gareko cha vA sIdhA mArgamA sIdhA hi~Dne mominale?!

23 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! yI nakArne muzrikaharUlAI bhannuhos: timIharUko sraSTA allAha hunuhuncha | uhA~le timIharUlAI sunnakA lAgi kAna, hernakA lAgi A~khA ra so~cnako lAgi hRdaya banAunubhayo | uhA~le timIharUlAI pradAna garnubhaeko kRpAko lAgi timIharU uha~lAI nai dhanyavAda diMdainau |

24 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! yI nakArne muzrikaharUlAI bhannuhos: allAhale nai timIharUlAI dhartImA phailAunubhayo, tI mUrtiharUle phailAekA hoinan, unIharUle kehI pani sRSTi garekA chainan | uhA~ samakSa nai timIharU kiyAmatako dina hisAba kitAba garna ra badalA lina bhelA hunechau, timIharUkA mUrti samakSa hoina | tasartha uhA~ko bhaya rAkha ra uhA~ko mAtra upAsanA gara |

25 punaH jIvita hune kurAlAI nakArneharU bhanchan: he muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! yadi timIharU saccA hau bhane bhana ta timIle ra timrA sAthIharUle kiyAmata Aunecha bhanI bhaya dekhAeko tyo vAcA kahile purA hunecha?

26 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! bhannuhos: vAstavamA, kiyAmatako jJAna ra tyo kahile Aune bhanne viSayamA allAhalAI mAtra thAhA cha | ma ta timIharUlAI tyasako viSayamA spaSTa rUpamA saceta garne mAtra hu~ |

27 jaba vAcA purA hunecha ra kiyAmatako dina yAtanA unIharUko najika pugeko unIharUle dekhnechan, ta allAhalAI nakArneharUko anuhAra bigrinecha ra kAlo hunecha | ani unIharUlAI bhaninechaH timIharUle saMsAramA yasalAI nai mAgekA ra yasako lAgi nai hatAra garekA thiyau |

28 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! yI nakArne muzrikaharUlAI nindA gardai bhannuhos: yadi allAhale malAI ra merA momina sAthIharUlAI mRtyu dinubhayo vA hAmImAthi dayA garnubhayo ra hAmIlAI thapa samaya dinubhayo bhane bhana, kAphiraharUlAI allAhako pIDAdAyI yAtanAbATa kasale bacAunecha? kasaile pani uhA~bATa bacAuna saknechaina |

29 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! yI muzrikaharUlAI bhannuhos: uhA~ dayAvAna hunuhuncha, uhA~le timIharUlAI Aphno mAtrai upAsanAko AhvAna garnubhaeko cha | hAmI uhA~mAthi nai AsthA rAkhchauM ra hAmrA mAmilAharUbAre uhA~mAthi nai bharosA garchauM | nissandeha ko spaSTa pathabhraSTamA cha ra ko satmArgamA cha bhanI timIharUle thAhA pAunechau |

30 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! yI muzrikaharUlAI bhannuhos: malAI bhana, yadi timIharUle piune pAnI sukyo ra timIharU tyasasamma pugna sakenau bhane kasale timIharUlAI prazasta pAnIko srota dina sakcha? allAha bAheka arU kasaile sakdaina |

1 nUna0! yastA akSaraharUko vyAkhyA sUraha al-bakarahako ArambhamA bhaisakeko cha | allAhale kalamako kasama khAnubhaeko cha ra mAnisaharUle kalamako sahAyatAle je lekhchan tyasako kasama khAnubhaeko cha |

2 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! tapAIM pAgala hunuhunna kinaki allAhale tapAIMlAI Aphno kRpAle nabI banAunubhaeko cha | baru muzrikaharUle tapAIMmAthi lagAeko pAgalako AropabATa mukta hunuhuncha |
3 vAstavamA, tapAIMle hAra namAnI mAnisaharUsamma sandeza puryAunu bhaekole tapAIMle puNya pAunuhunecha | tapAIMlAI puNya pradAna garne zreya arU kasaile lina sakdaina |
4 vAstavamA, tapAIM kurAnale lyAeko mahAna naitikatAmA hunuhuncha | ani tapAIM tyasalAI uttama tarikAle lAgu garnuhuncha |
5 cA~Dai nai tapAIMle pani dekhnuhunecha ra yI jhUTo Thahara garneharUle pani dekhnechan |
6 satyatA jAhera bhaepachi timIharUmadhye ko pAgala ho bhanI praSTa hunecha |

7 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! vAstavamA tapAIMko pAlanakartAle uhA~ko mArgabATa haTeko vyaktilAI cinnuhuncha | ani uhA~ko mArgadarzana anusAra hi~DnelAI pani | tasartha, ko pathabhraSTa cha ra kasale mArgadarzana prApta gareko cha bhanI uhA~lAI thAhA cha |
8 tasartha he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! yI jhUTo Thahara garneharUle lyAeko kurAko anusaraNa nagarnuhos |
9 unIharU tapAIMlAI lacilo bhaeko ra dharmako viSayamA unIharUko pakSamA bhaeko dekhna cAhanchan | badalAmA unIharU pani tapAIMko lAgi lacilo hunechan ra tapAIMko pakSamA kAma garnechan |
10 tasartha dherai jhUTA kasama khAneharU ra nIca vyaktiharUko kurA namAnnuhos |
11 jasale prAyaH arUko kurA kATcha ra arUlAI vibhAjana garne kosisa gardai unIharUko cuklI lagAudai hi~Dcha |
12 bhalAibATa rokna prayAsarata rahanchan | mAnisaharUko sampatti, pratiSThA ra jyAnamAthi AtyAcAra garchan ra dherai pApamA lipta rahanchan |
13 atyantai asabhya ra AphnA mAnisaharUmA harAmIko saMjJAle paricita |
14 unIharUsa~ga sampatti ra santAnaharU bhaeko bhaera unIharUle allAha ra uhA~ko rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) mAthi AsthA rAkhna inkAra gare |
15 jaba unIharU samakSa hAmrA AyataharUko pATha garincha, ta unIharU bhanchan: yI atItakA mithyA kathAharU hun |
16 hAmI usako nAkamA cinha lagAI dinechauM jasale gardA U narAmro dekhinecha ra usale tyo haTAuna sakne chaina |
17 hAmIle yI muzrikaharUko parIkSA anikAla ra bhokale liyauM jasarI bagaiMcAvAlAko parIkSA liekA thiyauM; jaba unIharUle bihAna tyasakA phalaharU kATne ra garibaharUlAI nadine kasama khAekA thie |
18 ani unIharUle Aphno kasamamA “in zA allAha” (allAhale cAhanubhaemA) samAveza garenan |
19 ani allAhale Ago paThAunubhayo jasale unIharU sutiraheko belA tyasalAI naSTa pAryo | unIharUle tyasalAI AgobATa bacAuna sakenan |
20 ani a~dhyAro rAta saraha tyo pani kAlo bhayo |
21 bihAna unIharUle eka arkAlAI bolAe |
