22 unIharUle bhaneH yadi timIharU phalaharU Tipna cAhanchau bhane garibaharU Aunu aghi bihAnai Aphno kheta jAU |
23 unIharU hatAriera Aphno bagaiMcA bhitra gae ani eka arkAsa~ga bistArai kurA gardai thie |
24 unIharUle eka arkAlAI bhaneH Aja timIharUko bagaiMcAmA kunai gariba pasna napAos |
25 unIharU bihAna cA~Dai bAhira niske ra phalabATa kehI dAna nadine irAdA gare |
26 jaba unIharUle tyasamA Ago lAgeko dekhe ta unIharUle ApasamA bhanna thAleH pakkai pani hAmIle bagaiMcAko bATo birAyauM |
27 hoina, hAmIlAI tyasakA phalaharU TipnabATa rokieko cha kinaki hAmIle garibaharUlAI unIharUko aMza nadine praNa garekA thiyauM |
28 unIharUmadhye sarvazreSThale bhanyoH ke timIharUlAI allAhako mahimA garne ra uhA~ samakSa pazcAttApa garne bhaneko thiina jaba timIharUle garibaharUlAI vaJcita garne nirNaya garekA thiyau?
29 unIharUle bhaneH hAmrA pAlanakartA pavitra hunuhuncha | hAmro bagaiMcAkA phalaharU garibaharUlAI nadine so~ca banAera hAmIle AphaimAthi atyAcAra garyauM |
30 tyasapachi unIharUle eka arkAlAI doSa dina thAle |
31 unIharUle pazcAttApa gardai bhaneH kasto durbhAgya hAmro! vAstavamA, hAmIle garibaharUlAI unIharUko adhikArabATa vaJcita garera sabai sImA ullaGghana garekAchauM |

32 AzA cha, hAmro pAlanakartAle hAmIlAI hAmro bagaiMcAbhandA uttama kRpA dinuhunecha | vAstavamA, hAmI allAhatirai pharkanchauM, uhA~sa~ga kSamAko AzA ra kAmanA garchauM ani uhA~ko anugraha mAgchauM |

33 jasale hAmro avajJA garchan hAmI unIharUlAI yasarI nai jIvikAbATa vaJcita garera yAtanA dinchauM | tara Akhiratako yAtanA jhan kaThora hunecha | yadi unIharUlAI tyasa yAtanAko kaThoratA ra tyasako nirantaratAko viSayamA thAhA bhae kati rAmro hunethyo |

34 vAstavamA, allAhako Adezako pAlanA garera ra uhA~le manAhI garnubhaekA kurAharUbATa bacera uhA~ko Dara rAkhneharUkA lAgi unIharUko pAlanakartAkahA~ anugrahale bharieko svarga raheko cha, jahA~ unIharU ananta anugrahako Ananda linechan |
35 makkAkA muzrikaharUle so~ce jhaiM hAmI muslimaharUlAI ra kAphiraharUlAI samAna pratidAna dine chainauM |
36 he muzrikaharU ho! timIharUlAI ke bhayo, timIharUle yo anyAyapUrNa nirNaya kasarI gareko?
37 ke timIharUsa~ga yasto kitAba cha jasamA AjJAkArI ra avajJAkArIharU barAbara hun bhanI lekheko timIharUle paDhekA chau?!
38 ke sA~ccikai tyasa kitAbamA Akhiratako viSayamA timIharUle Aphno lAgi rojeko kurAharU chan?
39 vA timIharUle rojeko kurA pAunechau bhanI timIharUle hAmIsita samajhautA garekA chau jasalAI kasamadvArA puSTi garieko cha?
40 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! yasto kurA garneharUlAI sodhnuhos: kasale yasako jimmevArI bokeko cha?

41 ke allAha bAheka unIharUko arU sahayogIharU chan jo unIharUlAI mominaharU jati nai pratidAna dinchan | tyaso bhae unIharUle tI sahayogIharUlAI lyAun yadi mominaharU jati nai unIharUle pani pratidAna pAune dAbImA unIharU saccA chan bhane |

42 kiyAmatako dina atyantai bhayAvaha hunecha ra allAhale Aphno khuTTAlAI jAhera garnuhunecha | ani jaba mAnisaharUlAI sajdA garna bhaninecha taba mominaharUle sajdA garnechan tara kAphiraharU ra kapaTIharU sajdA garna saknechainan |

43 tinIharUko A~khA jhukeko ra tinIharUlAI apamAna ra pazcAttApako bhAvale DhAkeko hunecha | vAstavamA, sAMsArika jIvinamA unIharUlAI allAha samakSa sajdA garna bhanieko thiyo ra vartamAna avasthAbhandA rAmro avasthAmA thie |

44 tasartha, he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! tapAIMmAthi avatarita kurAnalAI nakArneharUlAI mero jimmAmA choDnuhos | hAmI bistArai-bistArai unIharUlAI tyahA~bATa sajAya dinechauM jahA~bATa unIharUle yasako AzA garekA hunechainan | vAstavamA, yo tinIharU virUddha yojanA ra parIkSA ho |

45 ani ma unIharUlAI thapa samaya pradAna gardachu jasa kAraNale unIharU lagAtAra pApa garirahanechan | vAstavamA, kAphira ra jhUTAharU virUddha mero yojanA baliyo raheko cha | unIharU mabATa umkana ra mero yAtanAbATa bacna saknechainan |

46 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! ke tapAIMle satyatarpha AhvAna gare bApata unIharUsa~ga kunai badalA mAgnubhaeko cha? tyasakAraNa yo unIharUko lAgi bojhilo kurA bhaeko cha ra unIharUle tapAIMlAI nakArnuko kAraNa baneko cha? tara vAstavikatA yasako viparIta cha | tapAIMle unIharUsa~ga kunai badalA mAgnuhunna | tyaso bhae, unIharUlAI tapAIMko anusaraNa garnabATa kuna kurAle rokeko cha?
47 vA unIharUsa~ga adRzyako jJAna cha jasalAI unIharU lekhirahekA chan ra tyasalAI prayoga garI tapAIMsa~ga vivAda gardachan?

48 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! tapAIMko pAlanakartAle unIharUlAI avasara pradAna garne phaisalA garnubhaekomA dhairya garnuhos | mAchAvAlA yUnusa (alaihissalAma) jasto nahunuhos, jaba unale Aphno samudAyako viSayamA gunAso gare | unale samudrako ra mAchAko peTako andhakAramA duHkhita bhaeko belA AphnA pAlanakartAlAI pukAre |
49 yadi unImAthi allAhako kRpA nabhaeko bhae, mAchAle unalAI nindanIya avasthAmA ujADa bhUmimA phyA~kne thiyo |
50 ani unakA pAlanakartAle unalAI rojnubhayo ra unalAI sadAcArI bhaktaharU madhyeko banAunubhayo |

51 jasale allAhamAthi AsthA (ImAna) rAkhdainan ra uhA~kA rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) lAI jhUTo Thahara garchan unIharUle jaba tapAIMmAthi avatarita kurAna sunchan ta A~khA tarera herchan ani Aphno cAhanAko anusaraNa garera ra satyatAbATa anuhAra pherera bhanchan: kurAna sAthamA lyAune rasUla ta pAgala ho |
52 tapAIMmAthi avatarita kurAna manuSya ra jinnako lAgi ekamAtra upadeza ra samjhanA ho |
1 allAhale sabaiko lAgi Aune kiyAmatako palako ullekha garnubhaeko cha |
2 avazya AichADne ghaTnA ke ho? yo prazna garI uhA~le tyasako mahatvalAI darzAunubhaeko cha |
3 tapAIMlAI yasa ghaTanAko viSayamA ke thAhA cha?
4 sAleha (alaihissalAma) ko samudAya samUda ra hUda (alaihissalAma) ko samudAya Adale kiyAmatalAI asatya Thahara gare, jasale dherai nai bhayAvaha bhaeko kAraNale mAnisaharUlAI AghAta puryAunecha |
5 samUdalAI allAhale ati nai carko svaradvArA naSTa pArnubhayo |
6 AdalAI allAhale ati nai ciso ra DaralAgdo A~dhIle naSTa pArnubhayo |

7 allAhale tyasa A~dhIlAI sAta rAta ra ATha dina calAunubhayo | tyasale sabailAI naSTa pAryo | tapAIMle tinIharU AphnA gharako bhui~mA dayanIya avasthAmA pachArieko dekhnuhunecha | mAnauM, unIharU Aphno vinAzapachi jaminamA phAliekA jirNa khajUrakA rUkhaharU jastA thie |
8 unIharUmAthi Aeko yAtanApachi ke tapAIMle unIharUmadhye kasailAI pani baceko dekhnubhayo?
9 phirauna, UbhandA pahilekA samudAyaharU ra bastIlAI ulTo pArera yAtanA diiekA lUta (alaihissalAma) ko samudAyale zirka ra avajJA jastA narAmrA AcaraNa apanAekA thie |
10 tI sabaile unIharUtarpha paThAiekA rasUlako avajJA gare ra unalAI jhUTo Thahara garekA thie | allAhale unIharUlAI ghora yAtanAle samAtnubhayo jasale unIharUlAI naSTa pAryo |

11 vAstavamA, jaba pAnIle ucAIko sImA nAghyo, hAmIle tapAIMkA purkhAharUlAI DuGgAmA caDhAyauM jasako nirmANa nUha (alaihissalAma) le hAmro Adezale gare ra tyo timIharUko pani savAra hune sAdhana banyo |
12 ani tyasa DuGgAlAI ra tyasako kathAlAI kAphiraharUlAI naSTa pArne ra mominaharUlAI surakSA pradAna garne pramANa svarUpa upadeza banAiyo ra tyasalAI kAnale sunneharUko lAgi surakSita pArnecha |
13 jaba sUra phukne jimmA pAeko phariztAle dosro paTaka sUra phuknecha |
14 pRthvI ra pahADaharUlAI mAthi uThAinecha ani sabailAI ekai paTakamA dhulo pArinecha |
15 juna dina yo sabai hunecha tyo dina nai kiyAmatako dina hunecha |
16 tyasadina phariztAharUko avataraNale AkAza cirinecha | AkAza dRDha ra kaDA bhaetApani tyasadina sajilai cyatinecha |
17 phariztAharU tyasako kinArAmA hunechan | tyasa mahAna dina ATha janA najikakA phariztAharUle tapAIMko pAlanakartAko siMhAsanalAI uThAekA hunechan |
18 he mAnisaharU ho! tyasadina timIharUlAI allAha samakSa peza garinecha | timIharUkA rahasyaharUmadhye kunai pani allAhabATa lukeko hunechaina | baru allAhalAI sabai kurAharUko jJAna cha |
19 jasalAI usako karma-patra usako dAhine hAtamA diinecha usale khuzI ra harSale bhannechaH liU, mero karma-patra paDha |
20 malAI punaH jIvita pArinecha ra badalA diinecha bhanI malAI saMsAramA thAhA thiyo ra vizvAsa thiyo |
21 usale prApta garne anugrahako kAraNa antataH U sukhada jIvanamA hunecha |
22 U ucca ra pratiSThita svargamA hunecha |
23 tyasakA phalaharU khAneharUkA lAgi dherai najika hunechan |

24 unIharUko sammAnamA bhaninechaH khAU ra piU | tyahA~ khAnA ra piunAle kunai noksAna gardaina | bitekA dinaharUmA saMsAramA timIharUle garekA asala kAryaharUko pariNAma svarUpa yo timIharUlAI diieko ho |

25 ani jasalAI karma-patra usako debre hAtamA diinecha, unIharUle pachutAera bhannechan: yadi maile mero karma-patra prApta nagareko bhae hunethiyo kinaki yasamA malAI yAtanAko hakadAra banAune merA duSkarmaharUko ullekha garieko cha |
26 yadi malAI mero hisAbako viSayamA kehI pani thAhA nabhaeko bhae rAmro hunethiyo |
27 yadi mero anta bhaeko mRtyu nai nirNAyaka mRtyu bhaeko bhae ra malAI punaH jIvita napArieko bhae rAmro hunethiyo |
28 mero sampattile malAI allAhako yAtanAbATa rattI bhara pani bacAuna sakena |
29 mero pramANa ra maile bhara pareko zakti ra pratiSThA harAyo |
30 ani bhaninechaH he phariztAharU ho! usalAI samAta ra usakA hAtalAI usako gardhanasa~ga bA~dha |
31 ani usalAI narkamA hAla ra usalAI tyasako garmI sahana deU |
32 tyasapachi usalAI sattarI hAta lAmo janjiramA jakaDideU |
33 vAstavamA, usale mahAna allAhamAthi AsthA rAkhdaina thiyo |
34 arUlAI garibaharUlAI khAnA khuvAuna protsAhita gardainathyo |
35 kiyAmatako dina usalAI yAtanAbATa bacAune kohI nAtedAra hunechaina |
36 usale narkabAsIharUko zarIrabATa niskeko tarala padArtha arthAta pIpa mAtra khAna pAunecha |
37 yo khAnA pApIharU ra avajJAkArIharUle mAtra khAnechan |
38 timIharU je dekhchau allAhale tyasako kasama khAnubhaeko cha |
39 ani timIharU je dekhdainau allAhale tyasako pani kasama khAnubhaeko cha |
40 vAstavamA, kurAna allAhako vANI ho | uhA~kA pratiSThita rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) le mAnisaharUlAI tyasako vAcana garera sunAunuhuncha |
41 yo kaviko kathana pani hoina kinaki yo kavitAko zailimA bhanieko chaina | timIharU kamai AsthA (ImAna) rAkhchau |
42 ani yo jyotiSIko kathana pani hoina | jyotiSIko kathana kurAnabhandA bhindai huncha | timIharU kamai vicAra garchau |
43 baru yasalAI sampUrNa sRSTiko pAlanakartAko tarphabATa avataraNa garieko ho |
44 yadi hAmIle nabhaneko kurA muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) le svayaM racera lyAunubhaeko bhae |
45 hAmI uhA~sa~ga badalA line thiyauM ra uhA~lAI bala ra zaktikA sAtha samAtne thiyauM |
46 ani hAmI uhA~ko muTuko nasA nai kATne thiyauM |
47 ani timIharUmadhye kasaile pani hAmIlAI rokna sakdaina | uhA~le hAmro nAma lagAera Aphno manabATa kunai kurA racnu asambhava cha |
48 vAstavamA, Aphno pAlanakartAko kurAharUko anusaraNa garera ra uhA~le roknubhaeko kurAbATa bacera uhA~sa~ga DarAuneharUko lAgi yo kurAna euTA upadeza ho |
49 vAstavamA, timIharUmadhye yasa kurAnalAI jhUTo Thahara garneharUlAI allAhale rAmrarI jAnnuhuncha |
50 kiyAmatako dina kurAnalAI jhUTo Thahara garnu sabaibhandA ThUlo pazcAttApako kAraNa hunecha |
51 vAstavamA, kurAna ati vizvasanIya satya cha ra yo allAhako tarphabATa Aeko kurAmA kunai zaGkA chaina |
52 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! Aphno pAlanakartAlAI zobhA dine tarikAle uhA~ko pavitratA bayAna garnuhos ra Aphno mahAna pAlanakartAko nAmako bakhAna garnuhos |
1 muzrikaharUmadhye ekajanAle AphUmAthi ra Aphno samudAyamAthi yAtanA Aune nimto diyo yadi yAtanA Aunecha bhane | yo kurA usale ThaTTA gardai bhanyo | vAstavamA, yo yAtanA kiyAmatako dina Aunecha |
2 allAhamAthi AsthA narAkhneharUlAI kasaile pani tyasa yAtanAbATa bacAuna saknechaina |
3 mahAnatA, pratiSThA, satguNa ra kRpAko mAlika allAhako tarphabATa Aune yAtanA |
4 kiyAmatako dina phariztAharU ra jibrIla uhA~tarpha tyasa darjAharUmA caDhnechan | tyo dina pacAsa hajAra varSa lAmo dina hunecha |
5 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! cintita nabhaI ra gunAso nagarI dhairya garnuhos |
6 unIharU yasa yAtanAlAI TADhA ra asambhava dekhchan |
7 tara hAmI yasalAI najika ra avazya ghaTne ghaTanA dekhchauM |
8 tyasadina AkAza paglieko tAmA, suna ra anya dhAtuharU jasto hunecha |
9 ani pahADaharU Una jasto halkA hunechan |
10 kunai Aphantale Aphantako viSayamA sodhnechaina | sabaijanA AphaimA vyasta hunechan |

11 hareka vyaktile Aphno AphantalAI dekhnecha, kohI lukeko hunechaina | taipani avasthAko gambhiratAko kAraNa kasaile kasailAI sodhnechaina | jo narkakA yogya hunechan unIharUle AphnA santAnalAI Aphno badalAmA yAtanA bhogna AgADi sArna khojnechan |
12 unIharUle AphnI patnI ra dAjubhAilAI AphU bacnako lAgi peza garnechan |
13 Aphno najika huneharUlAI ra sadhaiM vipattimA unIharUsa~ga huneharUlAI AphU bacnako lAgi peza garnechan |
14 pRthvIkA manuSya, jinna ra sampUrNalAI peza garnechan | tAki tyasale unIharUlAI narkako AgobATa surakSita rAkhos ra allAhako yAtanAbATa bacAos |
15 tara vAstavikatA yI aparAdhIharUle socejasto hunechaina | nizcayana nai yo dankiraheko Akhiratako Ago ho, jasale jalAera chADnecha |
16 tyasako tAtole gardA TAukoko chAlA nai chilinecha |
17 satyabATa vimukha hune, tyasabATa TADhine, tyasamAthi AsthA narAkhne ra tyasako anusaraNa nagarne sabailAI tyasale bolAunecha |
18 dhana jammA pArne ra tyasalAI allAhako mArgamA kharca garna lobha garne sabailAI |
19 vAstavamA, manuSyalAI dherai lobha garne svabhAvamA sRSTi garieko cha |
20 yadi U roga ra garibI jastA durbhAgyale grasta huncha bhane U thorai dhairya garcha |
21 yadi usalAI apAra sampatti diera samapanna banAincha bhane U tyasalAI allAhako mArgamA kharca nai gardaina |
22 tara salAha (namAja) paDhneharU bAheka kinaki unIharU yI ghRNita guNaharUbATa surakSita rahanchan |
23 jo niyamita rUpamA salAha (namAja) paDhchan, yasabATa unIharUko dhyAna bhaGga hu~daina ra nirdhArita samayamA paDhne garchan |
24 jo Aphno dhana-sampattibATa nizcita bhAga rAkhekA chan |
25 sahayoga mAgneharUlAI ra namAgneharUlAI dinchan |
26 jo kiyAmatako dinalAI satya mAnchan juna dina allAhale sabailAI unIharU yogya bhaeko kurAko phaisalA garnuhunecha |
27 jo satkarma gare tApani AphnA pAlanakartAko yAtanAbATa DarAuchan |
28 vAstavamA, unIharUko pAlanakartAko yAtanA DaralAgdo cha | jasabATa kunai pani buddhimAna vyakti nizcinta hunai sakdaina |
29 jo AphnA guptAGgalAI chopera ra tyasalAI azlIla kAryaharUbATa TADhA rAkhera tyasako surakSA garchan |
30 AphnI patnIharU ra dAsIharU bAheka kinaki unIharUsa~ga sambandha rAkhnAle unIharU nindAbATa mukta chan |
31 tara jo AphnI patnIharU ra dAsIharU bAheka arUsa~ga sambandha rAkhne cAhanA rAkhchan unIharU allAhale nirdhAraNa garnubhaeko sImAharU nAghneharU hun |
32 jo unIharUlAI sumpiekA dhana, rahasya ra anya kurAharUko surakSA garchan ra mAnisaharUsa~ga garekA pratijJAharU pUrA garchan | unIharU nAso hinAminA gardainan ra pratijJAharU toDdainan |
33 jo ImAnadArIkAsAtha gavAhI dinchan ra unIharU mitratA ra zatrutAbATa prabhAvita hu~dainan |
34 jo samayamA, pavitratA ra ArAmakA sAtha salAha (namAja) paDhchan | ani salAha paDhnabATa unIharUlAI kasaile bahakAuna sakdaina |
35 yI guNaharU bhaekAharUlAI svargamA sadAko anugraha ra allAhako anuhAra darzana garne avasara pradAna garI sammAna garinecha |
36 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! tapAIMko samudAyakA yI muzrikaharU kuna kAraNale tapAIMko variparI tapAIMlAI jhUTo Thahara garna bhelA bhae?
37 tinIharUle tapAIMlAI dAyA~ ra bA~yAbATa vibhinna samUhamA gherekA chan |

38 ke yinIharUmadhye pratyekale kAphira hu~dA hu~dai pani allAhale usalAI anugrahale bhariekA svargamA praveza garAunuhunecha ra tyahA~kA sadA rahane anugrahaharUbATa phAidA linecha bhanI AzA rAkheko cha?

39 paristhiti unIharUle so~ce jasto hoina | vAstavamA, unIharUlAI thAhA bhaeko kurAbATa hAmIle unIharUko sRSTi garyauM | hAmIle unIharUlAI mahatvahIna pAnIdvArA sRSTi garyauM | unIharU kamajora chan ra unIharU AphnA lAgi phAidA vA hAnIko kSamatA rAkhdainan | tasartha unIharU kasarI ghamaNDa garna sakchan ta?
40 sUrya, candramA ra sampUrNa grahaharU udAune ra astAune ThAu~harUko mAlika allAhale Aphno kasama khAera bhannubhayoH vAstavamA hAmI sakSama chauM |

41 unIharUlAI naSTa garera unako saTTAmA allAhako anusaraNa garneharUlAI lyAuna ra hAmI sakSamachauM | yo hAmro lAgi asambhava kurA hoina | yadi hAmIle unIharUlAI naSTa pArne ra unIharUko saTTA arUlAI lyAune nirNaya garyauM bhane hAmI parAjita hunechainauM |

42 tasartha, he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! unIharUlAI tabasamma Aphnai asatyatA ra pathabhraSTatAmA choDnuhos ra saMsArako jIvanamA ramAuna dinuhos, jabasamma unIharUle kurAnamA dieko kiyAmatako dinako cetAvanI dekhnechan |
43 unIharU AphnA cihAnaharUbATa yasarI niskanechan mAnauM unIharU euTA jhanDAtira dauDirahekA chan |
44 unIharUko A~khA lAjale jhukekA hunechan ra unIharU apamAnamA DubekA hunechan | yahI tyo dina ho jasako vAcA saMsAramA unIharUsa~ga garieko thiyo tara unIharUle tyasako matalaba rAkhdaina thie |

1 hAmIle nUha (alaihissalAma) lAI unako samudAyatira unIharUlAI allAhatarpha AhvAna garna ra pIDAdAyaka yAtanA Aunu agADi tyasako Dara dekhAuna paThAyauM kinaki unIharUle allAhako sAthamA arUlAI sAjhedAra Thahara gardathe |

2 nUha (alaihissalAma) le Aphno samudAyalAI bhaneH he mero samudAya! vAstavamA, ma timIharUko lAgi sacetaka hu~ | yadi timIharUle allAha samakSa pazcAttApa garenauM bhane ma timIharUlAI parkhiraheko yAtanAko viSayamA saceta gardaichu |

3 mero cetAvanIko uddezya timIharUlAI yo bhannu hoH kevala allAhako upAsanA gara ra uhA~sa~ga kunai pani cIjalAI sAjhedAra nabanAU | uhA~kA AdezaharUko pAlanA garI ra uhA~le manAhI garnubhaekA kurAharUbATa bacera uhA~ko bhaya rAkha ra maile diekA AdezaharUmA mero anusaraNa gara |

4 yadi timIharUle yaso garyau bhane bhaktaharUko adhikArasa~ga sambandha nabhaekA pApaharUlAI allAhale mApha garnuhunecha | ani uhA~ko jJAnamA raheko timIharUko sImita samaya naAuJjela saMsArako jIvanamA timIharUko lAgi thapa avasara pradAna garnuhunecha | jabasamma timIharU yaso garirahanechau, timIharU pRthvImA basobAsa garnechau | ani jaba mRtyu Aunecha tyo sthagita hunechaina | yadi yo timIharUlAI thAhA bhaeko bhae timIharU allAhamAthi AsthA rAkhna ra Aphno zirka ra pathabhraSTatAbATa pazcAttApa garna hatAra garne thiyau |
5 nUha (alaihissalAma) le bhaneH he merA pAlanakartA! maile mero samudAyalAI rAtadina tapAIMko mAtra upAsanA garna AhvAna garirAkheM |
6 tara mero AhvAnale unIharUlAI jhan namAnne ra mero AhvAnabATa jhan TADhA banAyo |

7 vAstavamA, jaba ma unIharUlAI unIharUkA pApaharUko kSamAko lAgI kevala tapAIMko upAsanA garna ani tapAIM ra tapAIMkA rasUlako anusaraNa garna AhvAna garchu, unIharU mero AhvAna nasunnakA lAgi auMlAharUle AphnA kAna banda garchan ra malAI nahernakA nimti AphnA lugAle AphnA anuhAraharU chopchan | unIharU zirkamA nai aDiga rahe, maile AhvAna gareko kurAlAI apanAuna ra tyasako lAgi samarpita huna ghamaNDa gare |
8 ani, he merA pAlanakartA! maile unIharUlAI sArvajanika rUpamA AhvAna gareM |
9 ani maile ThUlo svarale, gopya rUpamA ra sAno svarale unIharUlAI AhvAna gareM | maile unIharUlAI vibhinna tarikAle AhvAna gareM |
10 ani maile unIharUlAI bhaneH he mero samudAya! allAha samakSa pazcAttApa garI uhA~sa~ga kSamAyAcanA gara kinaki uhA~le AphnA pazcAttApa garne bhaktaharUko pApaharUlAI kSamA garnuhuncha |
11 yadi timIharUle yaso garyau bhane allAhale timIharUko AvazyakatA anusAra timIharUmAthi pAnI varSAunuhunecha | ani timIharUle kahilyai anikAlako sAmanA garnuparnechaina |

12 ani timIharUlAI paryApta mAtrAmA sampatti ra santAna pradAna garnuhunecha ra timIharUkA lAgi bagaiMcAharU banAunuhunecha jasakA phalaphUlaharU timIharUle khAnechau | timIharUko lAgi naharaharU banAunuhunecha jasabATa timIharUle piunechau, khetI garnechau ra AphnA gAIvastuharUlAI pilAunechau |
13 he mero samudAya mAnisaharU! timIharUlAI ke bhaeko cha? timIharU allAhako mahAnatAdekhi DarAudainau ra uhA~ko mahAnatAko vAstA nai nagarI uhA~ko avajJA garirahekA chau?!
14 uhA~le timIharUlAI pAnIko thopA, tyasapachi ragatako Dhikko ra tyasapachi capAeko mAsu garI vibhinna caraNamA sRSTi garnubhayo |
15 allAhale ekamAthi arko garI sAtavaTA AkAzaharU kasarI banAunubhaeko bhanI timIharU dekhnadainau?!
16 tyasamadhye najikako AkAzamA pRthvIbAsIharUkA lAgi uhA~le camkilo candramA banAunubhayo ra prajvalita sUryalAI banAunubhayo |
17 allAhale timIharUlAI mATobATa sRjanA garnubhayo | kinabhane hAmro purkhA AdamalAI mATobATa sRjanA garnubhayo | ani timIharU jaminale umArekA annaharU khAnchau |
18 ani mRtyupazcAta timIharUlAI tyasamai pharkAinecha ra timIharUlAI punaH jIvita pArna tyasaibATa nikAlinecha |
19 ani timIharUkA lAgi allAhale dhartIlAI vistAra garnubhaeko cha ra basna yogya banAunubhaeko cha |
20 tAki halAla jIvikA Arjana garna timIharU tyasakA khullA bATAharUko prayoga garna saka |

21 nUha (alaihissalAma) le bhaneH he merA pAlanakartA! kevala tapAIMko upAsanA garne maile dieko AdezalAI mero samudAyale mAnena | tinIharUmadhye tallo vargakA mAnisaharUle AphnA aguvAharUko anusaraNa garchan, jasalAI tapAIMle dhana ra santAna dinubhaeko cha | tapAIMle unIharUlAI dinubhaekA kurAharUle unIharUlAI thapa pathabhraSTa banAeko cha |
22 ani unakA aguvAharUle nUha (alaihissalAma) virUddha tallo vargakAharUlAI uksAera ThUlo SaDayantra gare |
23 unIharUle AphnA anuyAyIharUlAI bhaneH timIharU AphnA bhagavAnaharUko upAsanA garna nachoDa ra AphnA mUrtiharU vada, suvAa, yagUsa, yaUka ra nasrako upAsanA garna nachoDa |

24 unIharUle AphnA mUrtiharUdvArA dherai mAnisaharUlAI pathabhraSTa garekA chan | he merA pAlanakartA! svayaMmAthi atyAcAra garneharUle AphnA kuphra ra avajJAmA jiddI garera satyatAbATa jhan pathabhraSTa bhaekA chan |

25 unIharUle garekA galtIharUle gardA unIharU saMsAramA jalapralayamA DubAie | ani mRtyupazcAta unIharUlAI sIdhA narkamA hAlinecha | tyasabelA unIharUlAI Dubna ra narkabATa jogAuna unIharUle allAha bAheka arU kohI sahayogI pAenan |

26 yI AsthAvAna (ImAna lyAekA) bAheka arUle ImAna lyAunechainan bhanI allAhale sUcanA diepachi nUha (alaihissalAma) le bhaneH he merA pAlanakartA! tyasobhae yasa dhartImA euTA pani kAphiralAI Dulna vA hi~Dna nachoDnuhos |

27 he pAlanakartA! yadi tapAIMle unIharUlAI choDnuhuncha ra unIharUlAI avasara pradAna garnuhuncha bhane unIharUle tapAIMkA AsthAvAna (ImAnavAlA) bhaktaharUlAI pathabhraSTa garnechan | unIharUle kevala bhraSTaharUlAI janmAunechan jasale tapAIMko anusaraNa garnechainan ra kaThora kAphiraharUlAI janmAunechan jasale tapAIMko tapAIMkA anugrahako lAgi dhanyavAda dinechainan |

28 he merA pAlanakartA! merA pApaharUlAI, merA AmAbubAlAI, mero gharamA Aune mominaharUlAI, muslima purUSa ra mahilAharUlAI mApha garidinuhos | ani avizvAsa ra avajJAkA garera AphaimAthi atyAcAra garneharUko vinAza ra parAjayalAI baDhAunuhos |

1 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! Aphno samudAyalAI bhannuhos: allAhale mamAthi vahI garnubhaeko cha, nakhlA nAmako upatyakAmA jinnako euTA samUhale mero kurAnako vAcana sune | ani jaba unIharU Aphno samudAyamA pharkera gae, ta unIharUle bhaneH vAstavamA, hAmIle atyantai spaSTa, ucca zailI ra utkRSTa vANIko vAcana sunyauM |

2 hAmIle suneko tyo vANIle sahI AsthA, vacana ra kAryako mArganirdezana garcha | tasartha hAmIle tyasamA AsthA rAkhyauM ra tyasalAI avataraNa garne hAmro pAlanakartAsa~ga arUlAI sAjhedAra Thahara garne chainauM |
3 hAmIlAI vizvAsa cha, muzrikaharUle lagAeko Aropa viparIta ucca mahimA ra garimAko mAlika hAmrA pAlanakartAkA kunai patnI ra chorA pani chainan |
4 allAhakA patnI ra santAna chan bhanI iblIsa (zaitAna) le vikRta kurA garne garthyau |
5 hAmIle yo ThAnekA thiyauM, muzrika manuSya ra jinnale allAhakA patnI ra santAna chan bhanI garekA dAbI sA~co ho | hAmIle tyasalAI vizvAsa gardai unIharUko anusaraNa garyauM |

6 vAstavamA, ajJAnatAkA dinaharUmA manuSyamadhyekA kehI vyaktiharU katai jAne belAmA unIharUle jinnamadhyekA kehI vyaktiharUko zaraNa mAgekA thie kinaki unIharU DarAekA thie | unIharUmadhye ekajanAle bhanyoH ma yasa upatyakAmA raheko duSTaharUko kukarmabATa yahA~ko mAlikako zaraNa linchu | yasale gardA mAnisaharUmA jinako Dara ra AtaGkalAI baDhAyo |
7 he jinnaharU ho! vAstavamA, allAhale mRtyupazcAta kasailAI pani hisAba lina ra badalA dinakA nimti jIvita pArnuhunna bhanne timIharUko so~ca jastai mAnisaharUle pani so~cekA thie |

8 vAstavamA, hAmIle AkAzabATa samAcAraharU prApta garne prayAsa garyauM tara hAmIle AkAzamA zaktizAlI phariztAharUle bharieko bheTTAyauM jasale gopya rUpamA kurAharU sunnabATa rokthyo juna hAmIle garne garekA thiyauM | ani AkAzako najika pugne sabailAI bhasma pArne Agoko jvAlAle tyasalAI bharieko pAyauM |

9 phariztAharUko kurA sunnakA nimti hAmI yasaaghi AkAzakA vibhinna ThAu~harUmA basne garthyauM ra tyo sUcanA hAmI dhartImA purohitaharUlAI dine garthyauM | tara ahile avasthA badalieko cha | aba jo kohI sunna khojcha usale Agoko jvAlAlAI Aphno tAkamA tayAra pAu~cha | yadi U najika huncha bhane tyasale hirkAera usalAI jalAincha |

10 vAstavamA, yasa kaDA surakSAko kAraNa hAmIharUlAI thAhA chaina | ke dhartIbAsIharUsa~ga narAmro hunecha vA allAhale unIharUko lAgi bhalAIko mAmilA garne so~cnubhaeko cha | hAmIle AkAzako sUcanA pAuna choDekAchauM |
11 hAmro jinnako samudAyamA kohI Izabhaya rAkhne ra asala chan bhane kohI kAphira ra pApI | hAmImA vibhinna samUhaharUmA chauM ra hAmrA pharaka cAhanAharU chan |
12 yadi allAhale hAmro viSayamA kehI so~cnuhuncha bhane hAmI uhA~lAI chalna sakdainauM ra hAmI bhAgera uhA~lAI vivaza pArna sakdainauM bhanne kurA hAmIlAI thAhA cha |

13 jaba hAmIle sidhA bATo dekhAune kurAnako vAcana sunyauM taba hAmIle tyasamAthi AsthA (ImAna) rAkhyauM | yadi kohI AphnA pAlanakartAmAthi AsthA rAkhcha bhane U AphnA satkarmaharUmA hune kamIko DarabATa mukta huncha ra usakA pahilekA pApaharUmA thapa pApaharU thapinechainan |

14 vAstavamA, hAmImadhye kohI muslima ra allAhakA AjJA pAlana garneharU chan bhane kohI vAstavika uddezya ra sidhA bATobATa haTekA chan | tasartha jasale allAhako AjJApAlana garcha ra satkarma garcha usale nai mArgadarzana ra sidhA bATo rojyo |
15 ani vAstavika uddezya ra sidhA bATobATa haTekAharU narkako indhana hun, jo unIharU jastai mAnisaharUkA sAthamA jalAinechan |

17 unIharU yasa neamata (anugraha) ko lAgi dhanyavAda dinchan vA tyasalAI nakArchan bhanI unIharUko parIkSA linakA nimti hAmIle yo neamata unIharUlAI dinechauM | ani jo kurAna ra tyasamA ullekha upadezabATa vimukha hunecha usako pAlanakartAle usalAI usale sahana nasakne kaThora yAtanA dinuhunecha |

18 masjidaharU allAhakA lAgi mAtra hun, arUkA lAgi hoinan | tasartha tyahA~ allAhako sAtha arU kasailAI napukAra | natra timIharUle yahUdIharU ra IsAIharUle girjAgharaharUmA ra sabhAgharaharUmA gare saraha garna pugnechau |

19 ani jaba allAhako bhakta muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! nakhlA nAmaka upatyakAmA upAsanAkA nimti ubhinubhayo, kurAnako pATha sunepachi jinnaharU uhA~kA varipari ThUlo bhiDamA bhelA bhae |
20 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! yI muzrikaharUlAI bhannuhos: ma AphnA palanakartAko mAtra upAsanA garchu | ma upAsanA garnamA uhA~ko sAjhedAra Thahara gardina cAhe jo kohI hos |
21 unIharUlAI bhannuhos: allAhale timIharUkA lAgi lekhidinubhaeko sajAyalAI ma rokna sakdina | ani timIharUko lAgi uhA~le nalekhnubhaeko phAidA ma timIharUlAI puryAuna sakdina |
22 unIharUlAI bhannuhos: yadi maile allAhako avajJA gareM bhane malAI uhA~bATa kasaile bacAuna sakdaina, ani uhA~ bAheka arU kasaiko zaraNa chaina |

23 baru allAhale puryAuna Adeza dinubhaeko kurA ra uhA~le malAI jimmA diera paThAunubhaeko sandezalAI mAtra timIharU samakSa puryAuna sakchu | jasale allAha ra uhA~ko rasUlako avajJA garnecha usako bhAgyamA sadAkA lAgi narkamA jAne lekhieko cha | U tyahA~bATa kahile pani niskana sakne chaina |

24 kAphiraharUle saMsAramA unIharUlAI vAcA garieko yAtanAlAI nadekhuJjela Aphno kuphramA aDiga rahanechan | kasakA sahayogIharU ra samarthakaharU kamajora chan bhanne kurA unIharUle tyasabelA thAhA pAunechan |

25 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! punaH jIvita pArine vAstavikatAlAI nakArne muzrikaharUlAI bhannuhos: timIharUlAI cetAvanI diieko yAtanA najika cha vA tyasako lAgi lAmo samaya bA~kI cha bhanne kurA malAI thAhA chaina, allAhalAI mAtra thAhA cha |
26 uhA~lAI sampUrNa gaiba (adRzya) ko jJAna cha, uhA~bATa kunai kurA pani lukeko chaina | uhA~le Aphno gaibako jJAnalAI kasaimAthi prakaTa garnuhunna baru tyo uhA~ko jJAnamA mAtra rahancha |

27 tara, uhA~le AphnA juna rasUlalAI jejati cAhanuhuncha, batAunuhuncha | uhA~ rasUlako agADi ra pachADibATa surakSAko lAgi phariztAharU paThAunuhuncha jasale unako surakSA garchan ra tyasalAI rasUla bAheka arU kasaiko sAmu prakaTa huna didainan |

28 tAki rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) le thAhA hos ki uhA~bhandA aghikA rasUlaharUle pani AphnA pAlanakartAko sandeza puryAe | allAha phariztAharU ra rasUlaharUko pAsamA bhaeko jJAnabATa avagata hunuhuncha | uhA~bATa kehI pani lukeko chaina | uhA~le hareka kurAko gaNanA surakSita rAkhnubhaeko cha | kunaipani kurA uhA~ko gaNanAbATa chuTeko chaina |
1 he Aphno lugAmA beriera baseko vyakti arthAtaH nabI (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) |
2 rAtako kehI bhAgamA uThera salAha (namAja) paDhnuhos |
3 yadi tapAIM cAhanuhuncha bhane AdhA rAta salAha (namAja) paDhnuhos, vA tyasabhandA ali kama samaya paDhnuhos juna tIna bhAgako eka bhAgasammako hos |
4 vA tyasamA ali vRddhi garera tIna bhAgako duI bhAga jati namAja paDhnuhos | kurAnalAI spaSTasa~ga ra bistArai pATha garnuhos |

5 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! hAmI tapAIMmAthi kurAna avatarita garnechauM juna euTA bhArI vANI ho kinaki tyasamA anivArya kAmaharU, daNDa, zaraI AdezaharU ra rAmrA AcaraNaharU Adi ullekha chan |
6 vAstavamA, rAtakA praharaharUmA pATha (telAvata) ko lAgi hRdaya baDhI tayAra huncha ra dherai rAmro uccAraNa huncha |
7 vAstavamA, tapAIM dinamA Aphnai vyavasAyamA vyasta hunuhuncha jasale gardA tapAIM kurAnako pATha garna saknuhunna | tasartha tapAIM rAtamA salAha (namAja) paDhnuhos |
8 ani vibhinna prakArakA stuti (ajkAra) ko sAtha allAhako guNagAna garnuhos | pUrNa rUpamA uhA~ko lAgi samarpita bhaI uhA~ko mAtra upAsanA garnuhos |
9 uhA~ pUrva ra pazcimakA pAlanakartA hunuhuncha | uhA~ bAheka kohI vAstavika upAsya chaina | tasartha uhA~lAI saMrakSaka banAunuhos ra AphnA sampUrNa mAmilAharUmA uhA~mAthi nai nirbhara hunuhos |
10 ani jhUTo Thahara garneharUko upahAsa ra nindA sahanuhos ra kunai hAni napuryAI unIharUbATa TADhA rahanuhos |
11 yI jhUTo Thahara garneharUko bAremA cintA nagarnuhos jasale sAMsArika sukha khojchan | baru unIharUlAI mero jimmAmA choDnuhos | unIharUko avadhi pUrA hunako lAgi kehi samaya parkhanuhos |
12 ani Akhiratako lAgi hAmIsa~ga ThUlo janjira ra danka~do Ago cha |
13 ani tyasato khAnA cha juna ati tIto bhaeko kAraNale nilna sakne chainan ra pIDAdAyI yAtanA pani juna mAthi ullekha gariekomA thapa garera diinecha |
14 yo yAtanA jhUTo Thahara garneharUle tyasa dina pAunechan juna dina dhartI ra parvataharU hallinechan | parvataharU tyasadinako bhayAvaha avasthAle gardA charieko bAluvA jhai~ hunechan |

15 vAstavamA, hAmIle timIharUtarpha kiyAmatako dina timIharUkA karmaharUko gavAhI dine euTA rasUla paThAekAchauM jasarI hAmIle phiraunatarpha mUsA (alaihissalAma) lAI rasUla banAera paThAekA thiyauM |

16 tara phiraunale Utarpha paThAieko rasUlako avajJA garyo | tasartha hAmIle usalAI yasa saMsAramA DubAera kaThora yAtanA diyauM ra AkhiratamA usako lAgi narkako yAtanA raheko cha | timIharU Aphno rasUlako avajJA nagara natra timIharUle pani usale bhogeko jhai~ yAtanA bhognuparne huncha |

17 yadi timIharU allAhalAI inkAra garchau ra uhA~kA rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) lAI jhUTo Thahara garchau bhane lAmo ra kaThina dinabATa timIharU kasarI svayaMlAI bacAuna sakchau?! tyasa dinako bhayAvaha avasthA ra lambAiko kAraNale sAno baccAko kapAla pani phulnecha |
18 tyasako bhayAvaha avasthAle gardA AkAza phuTnecha ra allAhako vAcA pUrA bhaerai chADnecha |

19 vAstavamA, kiyAmatako dinako bhayAvaha avasthA ra kaThinAiko varNana garieko yo upadeza ra cetAvanI ho | yasabATa kevala mominaharU mAtra phAidA lina sakchan | jasale usako pAlanakartAsamma puryAune bATo rojna cAhancha usale rojos |

20 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! tapAIM kahile rAtako duI tihAibhandA kama salAha (namAja) paDhnuhuncha, kahile AdhA rAta, kahile eka tihAi upAsanA garnuhuncha ra mominaharUko euTA samUha tapAIMsa~ga upAsanA garcha bhanne kurA tapAIMko pAlanakartAlAI thAhA cha | allAhale nai rAta ra dinalAI nirdhAraNa garnuhuncha ra tyasakA praharaharUko hisAba rAkhnuhuncha | timIharU tyasakA praharaharUko hisAba rAkhna asakSama chau bhanne kurA allAhale rAmrarI jAnnuhuncha | ani tyasakA adhikatama samaya timIharUle khoja garna kaThina huncha | tyasakAraNa uhA~le timIharUlAI kSamA garnubhaeko cha | tasartha timIharUlAI rAtamA jati sajilo huncha salAha (namAja) paDha | he mominaharU ho! allAhalAI thAhA cha, timIharUmadhye kehI birAmI hunechan, kehI allAhale diekA jIvikA Arjana garnakA nimti yAtrAmA hunechan ra kehI allAhako prasannatA prApta garna ra uhA~ko vANIlAI ucca pArnakA nimti kAphiraharUsa~ga yuddha garnechan | tyasakAraNa yinIharU rAtabhara upAsanA garna sakSama hunechainan | tasartha yinIharUlAI jati sahaja huncha rAtako tyati bhAga salAha paDhun | rAmro tarikAle anivArya salAhaharU paDha, Aphno sampattibATa jakAta cuktA gara ra Aphno sampattibATa AllAhako mArgamA kharca gara | timIharUle je bhalAiko kAma garepani tyasako uttama ra mahAna badalA pAunechau | tasartha allAhasa~ga kSamA yAcanA gara kinaki allAhale AphnA kSamA mAgne bhaktaharUlAI kSamA garnuhuncha ra unIharUmAthi dayA garnuhuncha |
1 he Aphno lugAmA beriera baseko vyakti arthAtaH nabI (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) |
2 uThnuhos ra allAhako yAtanAko Dara dekhAunuhos |
3 Aphno pAlanakartAko mahimAgAna garnuhos |
4 svayaMlAI pApaharUbATa ra AphnA lugAharUlAI apavitratAbATa pavitra rAkhnuhos |
5 mUrtiharUko upAsanAbATa TADhA rahanuhos |
6 rAmrA kAmaharU garera tapAIMle allAhamAthi upakAra garnubhaeko chaina ra tapAIM dherai pAune yogya hunuhuncha bhanera nasocnuhos |
7 tapAIMle bhognubhaekA kaSTaharUlAI allAhako lAgi sahanuhos |
8 ani jaba dosro paTaka sUra phukinecha |
9 tyo dina kaThina dina hunecha |
10 allAhalAI ra uhA~kA rasUlaharUlAI nakArneharUko lAgi gArho hunecha |
11 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! malAI ra tyasa vyaktilAI choDnuhos jasalAI maile eklai usako AmAko peTamA sampatti ra santAnabinA sRSTi gare | (tyo vyakti al-valIda bina mugIrA ho |)
12 maile usalAI apAra dhana die~ |
13 maile usalAI dherai chorAharU die~ jo Usa~ga rahanthe, Usa~ga sabhAharUmA jAnthe ra usako dherai dhana bhaekole unIharU kunai pani yAtrAmA usako sAtha choDenan |
14 usalAI maile eka ArAmadAyI jIvana, prazasta jIvikA ra baccAharU pradAna gareM |
15 ani usale malAI nakAre pani maile usalAI je dieko chu tyasamA vRddhi garchu bhanne cAhancha |
16 vAstavikatA usale so~ce jasto hoina | vAstavamA, U hAmrA rasUlamAthi avatarita AyataharUko zatru thiyo kinaki usale tyasalAI nakAryo |
17 ma usalAI kaThIna yAtanA dinechu jasalAI U sahana sakne chaina |
18 vAstavamA, tyo kAphira (avajJAkArI) jasalAI maile yI anugrahaharU pradAna gareM usale kurAnalAI ke bhanera nakArne bhanI so~cyo ra manamA saGkalpa garyo |
19 usako sarvanAza hos, usale kasto saGkalpa garyo!
20 pherI usako sarvanAza hos, usale kasto saGkalpa garyo!
21 ani usale pherI so~cyo ra usale bhaneko kurAmAthi punarvicAra garyo |
22 ani kurAnako viSayamA nindA garne kunai AdhAra nabheTdA usale A~khA taryo |
23 ani AsthA (ImAna) bATa vimukha bhayo ra nabI (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) ko anusaraNa garnabATa ghamaNDa garyo |
24 ani bhanyoH muhammadale jo lyAekA chan tyo allAhako vANI hoina | baru tyo jAdU ho juna unale arUbATa ullekha garchan |
25 (bhanchaH) yo allAhako vANI hoina | baru yo manuSyako vANI ho |
26 ma tyasa kAphiralAI narkakA tahaharUmadhye euTA tahamA praveza garAunechu | jasalAI sakara bhanincha ra usale tyasako tApa sahanecha |
27 he muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! tapAIMlAI kasale sakarako viSayamA batAyo?
28 jasalAI yAtanA diinecha, Agole usako aGga-aGgalAI polnecha | ani pherI U purAnai avasthAmai pharkanecha ra pherI usalAI yAtanA diinecha | yastai nai silasilA calirahanecha |
29 tyasale chAlAlAI narAmrosa~ga jalAera tyasako raGga parivartana garnecha |
30 tyasamAthi unnAIsavaTA phariztAharU chan jo tyasako surakSA garchan |

31 hAmIle phariztAharUlAI narkakA surakSAkarmI banAekAchauM | mAnisaharUsa~ga unIharUko sAmanA garne kSamatA hunechaina | hAmIle unIharUko saMkhyA kAphiraharUkA lAgi parIkSA banAyauM tAki unIharUle vyakta gareko kurAle gardA unIharUko yAtanA dobbara gariyos | ani taurAta pradAna gariekA yahUdIharU ra injIla pradAna gariekA IsAIharUlAI unIharUko kitAbamA rahekA kurAharUlAI puSTi gardai avataraNa bhaeko kurAnamA vizvAsa hos | ani ahle kitAbaharU mominaharUko kurAsa~ga sahamata bhaeko dekhera unIharUko AsthAmA vRddhi hos | yahUdI, IsAI ra mominaharUle zaGkA nagarun | AsthA (ImAna) mA zaGkA bhaekAharU ra kAphiraharUle bhannechan: kuna uddezyako lAgi allAhale yo anauTho saMkhyAko ullekha garnubhaeko cha?! yasa saMkhyAlAI nakArne pathabhraSTa cha ra yasamAthi vizvAsa rAkhne mArgadarzanamA cha | allAhale jasalAI cAhanuhuncha pathabhraSTa garnuhuncha ra jasalAI cAhanuhuncha mArgadarzana dinuhuncha | tapAIMko pAlanakartAko phaujako saMkhyA kevala allAhalAI mAtra thAhA cha | narka bhaneko manuSyako lAgi cetAvanI mAtra ho, tAki usale allAhako mahAnatAko jJAna prApta garna sakos |

32 usale AphnA sAthIharUlAI narkakA surakSAkarmIharUmAthi vijaya prApta garI unIharUlAI narkabATa bAhira nikAlnecha bhanne kehI muzrikaharUko dAbI vAstavikatAsa~ga mela khA~daina | allAhale candramAko kasama khAnubhayo |
33 ani uhA~le rAtako kasama khAnubhayo jaba tyo pharkancha |
34 uhA~le bihAnako kasama khAnubhayo jaba tyo prakAzamaya huncha |
35 vAstavamA, narkako Ago ThUlA saGkaTaharU madhyeko eka ho |
36 mAnisaharUlAI Dara ra bhayako rUpamA |
37 he mAnisaharU ho! timIharUmadhye jo allAhamAthi AsthA rAkhI ra satkarma garI agADi baDhna cAhancha U agADi baDhos vA kuphra ra avajJA garI pachADi rahana cAhancha bhane usale yastai garos |
38 hareka vyakti AphUle gareko karmako jimmevAra cha | yA ta usako karmale usalAI naSTa pArnecha vA mukta garnecha ra usalAI naSTa hunabATa bacAunecha |
39 tara mominaharU bAheka kinaki unIharUlAI pApako kAraNale samAtine chaina | baru unIharUle garekA satkarmakA kAraNale unIharUkA pApalAI kSamA garinecha |
40 ani kiyAmatako dina unIharU bagaiMcAharUmA hunechan, jahA~ unIharUle eka ApasamA sodhnechan |
41 kAphiraharUko viSayamA sodhnechan jasale pApamA lipta bhaI svayaMlAI naSTa pAre |
42 unIharUlAI bhannechan: timIharUlAI narkamA kasale praveza garAyo?
43 kAphiraharUle unIharUlAI bhannechan: hAmIle saMsAramA anivArya salAha (namAja) paDhdainathyauM |
44 allAhale hAmIlAI pradAna garnubhaeko jIvikAbATa garibaharUlAI khuvAu~dainathyauM |
45 asatyavAdIharU jahA~ bhae pani hAmI unIharUsa~ga hune garthyauM ra hAmIle pathabhraSTa ra pApIharUsa~ga kurA garne garthyauM |
46 ani badalA diine dinalAI jhUTo Thahara garne garthyauM |
47 hAmIharU samakSa mRtyu Aune belAsamma hAmIle tyasalAI jhUTo Thahara garne kAmamA dherai agADi baDhisakekA thiyauM | tyasale hAmIlAI pazcAttApa garnabATa rokyo |

48 kiyAmatako dina unIharUlAI phariztAharU, nabIharU ra satkarmIharU madhyekA siphArisakartAharUko siphArisale kunai phAidA dine chaina kinabhane siphArisa tyatikhera mAtra mAnya huncha jaba siphArisa garieko vyaktisa~ga allAha khusI hunuhuncha |
49 kuna kurAle yI muzrikaharUlAI kurAnabATa vimukha banAyo?
50 mAnauM unIharU vimukha hunumA ra tyasabATa bhAgnumA bhaDkekA jaMgalI gadhAharU jastai hun |
51 jo siMhasa~ga DarAera bhAgekA hunchan |

52 baru yI muzrikaharUmadhye harekako cAhanA anusAra Usa~ga euTA kholieko kitAba hunuparcha jasale muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) allAhako tarphabATa Aunubhaeko ho bhanI sUcanA deos | yasa cAhanAko kAraNa pramANaharUko abhAva ra kamajora tarka hoina baru yasako ekamAtra kAraNa haTha ra ghamaNDa garnu ho |
53 kurA yasto hoina! baru unIharU pathabhraSTatAmA sImA nAghnuko kAraNa unIharUle Akhiratako yAtanAmAthi AsthA narAkhnu ra Aphnai kuphramA aDiga rahanu ho |
54 suna! vAstavamA, yo kurAna upadeza ra smaraNa ho |
55 tasartha jasale kurAna paDhna ra tyasabATa upadeza lina cAhancha, usale paDhos ra upadeza lios |

56 allAhale nacAhesamma unIharUrale upadeza lina saknechainan | uhA~ko Adeza mAnera ra uhA~le manAhI garnubhaeko kurAbATa bacera uhA~ko bhaya rAkhine ra uhA~kA bhaktaharUmadhye pazcAttApa garneharUlAI kSamA garne adhikAra uhA~lAI mAtra cha |
1 allAhale kiyAmatako dinako kasama khAnubhaeko cha, juna dina mAnisaharU sampUrNa jagatakA pAlanakartA samakSa ubhinechan |

2 uhA~le rAmro AtmAko kasama khAnubhaeko cha, jasale svayaMlAI satkarmamA kamI gareko ra narAmro kAma gareko bhanI nindA garcha | uhA~le mAnisaharUlAI punaH jIvita pArnuhuncha bhanne kurAlAI pramANita garna yI duI kurAko kasama khAnubhayo |
3 ke manuSyalAI lAgcha, usako mRtyupazcAta hAmIle usakA hADaharUlAI punaH jIvita pArnakA nimti ekatrita garne chainauM?!
4 avazya, hAmI tyasalAI jammA pArnukA sAthai unIharUkA au~lAharUlAI pahile jastai pUrNa rUpale banAune sAmarthya rAkhdachauM |
5 tara bhaviSyamA pratirodha binA Aphno pApamA lipta rahanako lAgi manuSyale punaH jIvita hune kurAlAI nakArcha |
6 usale kiyAmatako dinalAI asambhava ThAnera sodhcha- tyo kahile Aunecha?
7 jaba saMsAramA jhUTo Thahara garne gareko kurAlAI dekhera A~khAharU tiramirAune chan ra bhayabhIta hunechan |
8 ani candramAko prakAza harAunecha |
9 ani candramA ra sUryalAI ekatrita pArinecha |
10 tyasadina pApIle bhannechaH bhAgne ThAu~ kahA~ cha?
11 tyasadina bhAgne ThAu~ nai hunechaina | ani pApIle zaraNa line ThAu~ hunechaina ra na surakSA prApta garna vA bacnakA lAgi kunai killA pani hunechaina |
12 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! tyasadina tapAIMko pAlanakartAkahA~ nai pharkane ra hisAba kitAba tathA badalA diine ThAu~ cha |
13 tyasadina manuSyalAI usale garekA ra nagarekA sabai kAmaharUko viSayamA sUcanA diinecha |
14 baru manuSyale Aphnai virUddha gavAhI dinecha kinaki usale garekA pApaharUko virUddha usakA aGgaharUle gavAhI dinechan |
15 yadyapi usale pApaharU gareko chaina bhanI Aphno pakSamA bahAnAharU prastuta gare tApani tyasale usalAI kunai phAidA puryAune chaina |
16 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! kurAna bhulne Darale tapAIM chiTo chiTo kurAnako pATha nagarnuhos |
17 vAstavamA, tyasalAI tapAIMko manamA surakSita garne ra tapAIMlAI tyasako nirantara pATha garAune jimmA hAmro ho |
18 jaba hAmro dUta jibrIlale tapAIM samakSa tyasako vAcana garchan, tapAIM maunatAkA sAtha unako vAcana sunnuhos |
19 ani tapAIMlAI tyasako bAremA vyAkhyA garne jimmevArI hAmro ho |

20 hoina, timIharUle bhane jhaiM punaH jIvita pArne kAma asambhava chaina | timIharUlAI thAhA cha, timIharUlAI pahilo paTaka sRSTi garna sakSama zaktilAI timIharUko mRtyupazcAta punaH jIvita pArna kunai gAhro chaina | tara timIharUle punaH jIvita pArne kAmalAI cA~Dai samApta hune sAMsArika jIvanako premako kAraNale nakArekA hau |
21 ani timIharUle Akhiratako jIvanako viSayamA dekhAeko lAparavAhIko kAraNale ho jasako bATo bhaneko allAhale dinubhaeko Adezako pAlanA garnu ra avaidha garnubhaeko kurAbATa bacnu ho |
22 tyasadina mominaharUko anuhAra camkilo ra ujyAlo hunecha |
23 unIharU Anandita bhaI AphnA pAlanakartAtarpha herirahekA hunechan |
24 tyasadina abhAgI kAphiraharUko anuhAra nirAsa hunechan |
25 unIharUlAI mahAna sajAya ra kaSTakara yAtanA diinecha bhanne kurA unIharU nizcita rUpamA jAnnechan |
26 mRtyu pazcAta unIharUlAI yAtanA diinechaina bhanne muzrikaharUko so~ca vAstavikatAsa~ga mela khA~daina | jaba tinIharUmadhye harekako prANa usako ghA~TIsamma Aipugnecha |
27 kehI vyaktile arUlAI bhannechan: kasale usalAI paDhera jhAraphuka garnecha? AzA cha, U niko huncha holA!
28 jasale piDA saha~daicha aba usale marera saMsAralAI choDnuparnecha bhanI U nizcita hunecha |
29 sAMsArika jIvana samApta hune ra Akhiratako jIvana surU hune belA avasthA kaThIna hunecha |
30 jaba yasto huncha, mRtakalAI usako pAlanakartA samakSa laginecha |
31 yasa kAphirale rasUlako sandezalAI satya ThAnen ra Aphno pAlanakartAko lAgi salAha (namAja) paDhena |
32 baru usale jhUTo Thahara garyo ra tyasabATa vimukha bhayo |
33 ani yo kAphira ahaGkAra ra ghamanDakA sAtha hi~Ddai Aphno parivAramA gayo |
34 tasartha allAhale tyasa kAphiralAI yAtanA usako dherai najika Aisakeko bhanI cetAvanI dinubhayo |
35 ani yasa kurAmA joDa dinako lAgi uhA~le dohoryAunu bhayo, ani bhannubhayoH pherI timro vinAza hos, timro vinAza |
36 allAhale manuSyalAI yastai choDnubhaeko cha ra usalAI dharmako anusaraNako jimmA dinubhaeko chaina bhanI ke U so~cdacha?
37 ke yo manuSya eka dina vIryako thopA thiena ra jasalAI garbhamA hAlieko thiyo?
38 tyasapachi U ragatako DhikkomA pariNata bhayo | ani allAhale usako sRjanA garnubhayo ra usakA aGga ThIka pArnubhayo |
39 tyasapachi uhA~le tyasabATa purUSa ra mahilA banAunubhayo |
40 manuSyalAI vIrya ani ragatako DhikkobATa sRSTi garne allAhale ke mRtakalAI hisAba ra badalA dinakA nimti pherI jIvita pArna sakSama hunuhunna ra? avazya, sakSama hunuhuncha |
1 nissandeha lAmo samayasamma manuSyako astitvako kunai nizAnI thiena ra U ullekhanIya pani thiena |

2 hAmIle manuSyalAI puruSa ra mahilAko mizrita vIryabATa sRSTi garyauM | hAmI usalAI jimmevArI vahana garAera usako parIkSA linchauM | hAmIle usalAI dieko zaraI jimmevArI vahana garnakA nimti usalAI sunne ra dekhne zakti pradAna garyauM |

3 hAmIle mAnavalAI hAmrA rasUlaharUdvArA mArgadarzanalAI pradAna garyauM | tasartha yasako sahayogale U samakSa pathabhraSTatA ujAgara bhayo | tyasapazcAta U ki ta mArgadarzanako anusaraNa garI euTA momina bhakta hunecha jo allAhako prazaMsA garnecha vA U pathabhraSTa bhaI euTA kAphira bhakta hunecha jo allAhakA nizAnIharUlAI inkAra garnecha |

jaba allAhale mArgadarzana prApta garne vyakti ra pathabhraSTa vyaktiko ullekha garnubhayo, ta uhA~le unIharUle pAune badalA pani bayAna garnubhayo ra bhannubhayoH
4 allAha ra uhA~kA rasUlaharUlAI nakArneharUkA lAgi hAmIle janjira tayAra pArekAchauM jasale tinIharU AgomA tAnine chan, nelaharU jasale unIharU bA~dhinechan ra danka~do Ago tayAra pArekAchauM |
5 vAstavamA, kiyAmatako dina allAhakA AjJAkArI mominaharU madirA piunechan jasalAI kapUra misAI sugandhita banAieko hunecha |

6 AjJAkArI bhaktaharUkA lAgi tayAra pArieko yo peya sajilai pugna sakne ra kahilyai samApta nahune srotabATa Au~cha | juna allAhakA bhaktaharUlAI pilAinecha | unIharU jatA cAhanchan tyasalAI liera jAnechan |

7 tyasabATa piune bhaktaharUkA vizeSatAharU ke cha bhane unIharU AphUmAthi anivArya garekA upAsanAlAI pUrA garchan | unIharU kiyAmatako dinadekhi DarAu~chan jasako saGkaTa cAraitira phailieko hunecha |
8 unIharUle AphailAI khAnAko AvazyakatA ra cAhanA bhae tApani tyasalAI gariba, Tuhuro ra bandI jastA abhAvagrastaharUlAI khuvAu~chan |

9 unIharU kevala allAhalAI prasanna pArnako lAgi yinIharUlAI khuvAu~chan bhanne kurA Aphnai manamA lukAera rAkhchan | tasartha unIharU yinIharUlAI khuvAe bApata kunai prakArako badalA ra prazaMsAko cAhanA rAkhdainan |
10 hAmIlAI hAmrA pAlanakartAko tyasadinako yAtanAko Dara lAgeko cha juna dina kaThinAi ra nirdayatAko kAraNale pApIharUko anuhAra kAlo hunecha |
11 allAhale Aphno dayAdRSTile tyasa mahAna dinako bipadabATa unIharUlAI bacAunu hunecha | ani unIharUko sammAnamA unIharUko anuhAramA khusI evaM prakAza ra manamA prasannatA pradAna garnu hunecha |

12 unIharUle allAhako AjJApalana gareko, bhAgyamAthi AsthA rAkheko ra pApabATa jogiekole allAhale unIharUlAI pratiphala svarUpa svarga pradAna garnuhunecha jasamA unIharU anugrahabATa lAbhAnvita hunechan ra lagAunakA lAgi rezama pradAna garnuhunecha |

13 tyahA~ unIharU sajAiekA palaGaharUmA aDesa lagera basekA hunechan | unIharU yasa svargamA kunai sUrya dekhne chainan jasako prakAzale unIharUlAI satAos ra dherai ciso pani hunechaina | baru unIharU tApa ra ciso binA sadhaiM chAyA~mA hunechan |

14 tyasako chAyA~ unIharUko cheumA hunecha ra tyasakA phalaphUlaharU jasale cAhancha usako lAgi upalabdha hunechan | sajilaisa~ga phala Tipna ra khAna sakinecha | tI phalaphUlaharU palTeko, baseko ra ubhieko sabaiko pahu~camA hunechan |
15 jaba unIharUle piune icchA garnechan taba unIharU samakSa sevakaharU cA~dIkA bhA~DAharU ra saphA raGgakA pyAlAharU liera ghumirahekA hunechan |
16 tyo zIzA jasto spaSTa raGgako cA~dIko bhA~DAmA hunecha | unIharUle cAheko mAtrA paskiinecha | tyasamA kehI thapine vA ghATAine chaina |
17 tI sammAnita vyaktiharUlAI piunakA lAgi aduvA misAieko madirAko pyAlA diinecha |
18 unIharU svargamA salsabIla nAma gareko mUlabATa piunechan |

19 svargamA unIharUko sevAmA sadA yuvA nai rahane sevakaharU ghumirahanechan | yadi tapAIMle unIharUlAI dekhnubhayo bhane, unIharUko anuhArako camaka, raGgako saundarya, unIharUko saMkhyA ra unIharUko bhinnatAle tapAIMlAI titara-bitara bhaera chariekA motIharUko samjhanA garAunecha |
20 yadi tapAIMle svargamA rahekA varadAnaharU dekhnubhayo bhane, tyasako varNana garna saknuhunna | anugraha (varadAna) ra ThUlo atulanIya rAjya dekhnuhunecha |
21 unIharUle pAtalo ra bAklo rezamako utkRSTa hariyo pozAka ra cA~dIko bAlA lagAunechan | ani allAhale unIharUlAI hAni nagarne peya padArtha pradAna garnuhunecha |
22 ani unIharUlAI sammAna gardai bhaninechaH vAstavamA, timIharUlAI pradAna gariekA yI anugrahaharU timIharUle garekA satkarmakA badalA hun | allAhako najaramA timIharUkA satkarma svIkArya thie |
23 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! hAmIle nai tapAIMmAthi kurAnalAI kramasa~ga avataraNa garyauM | hAmIle ekai paTakamA pUrA avataraNa garekA chainauM |

24 allAhale bhAgya ra zarIatako viSayamA dinubhaeko Adezaprati dhairya dhAraNa garnuhos | ani tyasa pApIko anusaraNa nagarnuhos jo Aphno pApako nimto dincha ra tyasa kAphirako anusaraNa nagarnuhos jo kuphrako nimto dincha |
25 dinako prarambhamA phajra salAha (namAja) paDhera ra tyasako antimamA juhara ra asra salAha paDhera Aphno pAlanakartAlAI smaraNa garnuhos |
26 rAtako samayakA duIvaTA namAjaharU arthAta magriba ra IzAkA namAjaharUmA uhA~ko smaraNa garnuhos ra tyasa pazcAta tahajjuda paDhnuhos |

27 vAstavamA, yI muzrikaharUle saMsArako jIvanalAI mana parAu~chan ra tyasako cAhanA rAkhchan | ani kiyAmatako dinalAI bevAstA garchan, vAstavamA tyasa dinako duHkha ra kaSTako kAraNa tyo dina dherai kaThina hunecha |

28 hAmIle unIharUlAI sRSTi garekA hauM ra unIharUkA aGgaharU, haDDIharU, AdilAI baliyo banAera unIharUko sRSTilAI sudRDha pArekAchauM | yadi hAmIle unIharUlAI naSTa garI unIharU jastai arUlAI pratisthApana garna cAhyauM bhane hAmI unIharUlAI naSTa garera pratisthApana garnechauM |
29 vAstavamA, yo sUraha upadeza ra smaraNa ho | tasartha jo Aphno pAlanakartAlAI prasanna pArna cAhancha usale yasalAI apanAos |

30 allAhale nacAhesamma timIharUle uhA~lAI prasanna pArne bATo apanAuna saknechainau | nirNaya pUrNa rUpale uhA~kai hAtamA cha | allAhakA bhaktaharUkA lAgi ke upayogI cha ra ke chaina bhanne kurAlAI uhA~ rAmrarI jAnnuhuncha | uhA~ sRSTi garna, bhAgya nirdhAraNa garna ra zarIatako viSayamA tatvadarzI hunuhuncha |

31 uhA~le AphnA bhaktaharUmadhye jasamAthi cAhanuhuncha dayA garnuhuncha ra unIharUlAI ImAna lyAuna ra satkarma garnasakne sAmarthya pradAna garnuhuncha | ani Aphno lAgi kuphra ra pApa rojera AphUmAthi atyAcAra garneharUko lAgi uhA~le AkhiratamA pIDAdAyI yAtanA tayAra pArera rAkhnubhaeko cha ra tyo narkako yAtanA ho |
1 allAhale ghoDAko ghA~TImA raheko kapAla saraha eka pachi arko garI calne havAko kasama khAnubhaeko cha |
2 uhA~le hiMsAtmaka DhaMgale teja calne havAko kasama khAnubhaeko cha |
3 varSAlAI phailAune havAko kasama khAnubhaeko cha |
4 satya ra asatya bIca pharaka garne kurAlAI liera orlane phariztAharUko kasama khAnubhaeko cha |
5 vahI liera orlane phariztAharUko kasama khAnubhaeko cha |
6 unIharU mAnisaharUko lAgi allAhako tarphabATa tarka ra allAhako yAtanAko cetAvanI svarUpa vahI liera orlanchan |
7 vAstavamA, punaH jIvita pArne, hisAba kitAba hune ra badalA diine viSayamA diieko cetAvanI anivArya rUpale pUrA hunecha |
8 jaba tArAharUko camaka phikkA hunecha ra prakAza harAunecha |
9 jaba phariztAharUko avataraNako kAraNale AkAza carkinecha |
10 jaba pahADaharU Aphno ThA~ubATa ukhelinechan ra naSTa pArI dhulo banAinechan |
11 jaba tokieko samayamA rasUlaharU bhelA hunechan |
12 mahAna dinako lAgi unIrUlAI AphnA anuyAyIharU virUddha gavAhI dina sthagita garieko cha |
13 bhaktaharUko bIca phaisalA hune dinako lAgi juna dina satya evaM asatya ra khuzI evaM dukhI bIca pharaka chuTTAinecha |
14 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! tapAIMlAI phaisalA hune dinako viSayamA kasale sUcita garyo?!
15 allAhako tarphabATa sandeza liera AekA rasUlaharUlAI jhUTo Thahara garneharUko lAgi tyasadina vinAza, yAtanA ra hAra raheko cha |
16 ke hAmIle pahilekA samudAyaharUlAI unIharUle allAhalAI nakAreko ra rasUlaharUlAI jhUTo Thahara gareko kAraNale naSTa pArenau ra?
17 pherI pachikA jhUTAharUle pani unIharU kai anusaraNa gare | unIharUlAI jastai hAmI yinIharUlAI pani naSTa pArnechauM |
18 jasarI hAmIle tI samudAyaharUlAI naSTa pArekAchauM tyasarI nai muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) le lyAunubhaeko sandezalAI jhUTo Thahara garneharUlAI pani naSTa pArnechauM |
19 pApIharUlAI daNDa dine allAhako cetAvanIlAI jhUTo Thahara garneharUkA lAgi tyasadina vinAza, yAtanA ra hAra cha |
20 he mAnava! ke hAmIle timIharUlAI euTA mahatvahIna pAnI arthAta vIryadvArA sRSTi gareko hoina ra?!
21 ani tyasa mahatvahIna pAnIlAI hAmIle euTA surakSita ThAu~ arthAt mahilAko garbhamA rAkhyauM |
22 euTA nirdhArita avadhisamma rAkhyauM juna garbhAvasthAko avadhi ho |
23 ani hAmIle navajAta zizuko vizeSatA, usako bhAgya, raGga ra yastai anya kurAharUlAI nirdhArita garyauM | hAmI kati rAmrarI yI sabailAI nirdhAraNa garchauM |
24 tyasadina allAhako zaktilAI nakArneharUko lAgi vinAza, yAtanA ra hAni raheko cha |
25 ke hAmIle dhartIlAI sabai mAnisaharU aTne banAenauM ra?
26 yasakA bhavanaharUmA jIvita mAnisaharU basobAsa garchan bhane yasaiko garbhamA mRtakaharUlAI gADincha |

27 hAmIle yasamA Thosa ra aglA pahADaharU sthApita garekAchauM jasale yasalAI khaskanabATa jogAu~dacha | he mAnisaharU ho! hAmIle timIharUlAI svaccha pAnI pradAna garyauM | jo yI kurAharU sRSTi garna saknuhuncha uhA~ timIharUlAI punaH jIvita garnabATa asakSama hunuhunna |
28 allAhako anugrahaharUlAI nakArneharUko lAgi tyasadina vinAza, yAtanA ra hAni raheko cha |
29 rasUlaharUle lyAeko sandezalAI nakArneharUlAI bhaninechaH he nakArneharU ho! timIharUle nakArne garekA yAtanAtira jAU |
30 narkako dhuvA~ko chAyA~mA hi~Da juna tIna zAkhAmA vibhAjita cha |
31 tyasamA chAyAko zItalatA chaina ra tyasale Agoko jvAlA ra tAtolAI timIharUsamma pugnabATa rokdaina |
32 vAstavamA, narkale tAto jvAlAharU phyA~knecha ra hareka jvAlA mahala jati ThUlo hunecha |
33 tyasale phyA~kne jvAlAharU mAnauM kAlo u~TaharU jastai kAlo ra ThUlo hunecha |
34 allAhako yAtanAlAI nakArneharUko lAgi tyasadina vinAza, yAtanA ra hAni hunecha |
35 tyasadina unIharU kehI bolna sakne chainan |
36 unIharUko kuphra ra avajJAko lAgi unIharUle AphnA pAlanakartA sAmu kSamA mAgna pAunechainan |
37 tyasa dinako samAcAra nakArneharUkA lAgi tyasadina vinAza, yAtanA ra hAni raheko cha |
38 Aja sRSTiharU mAjha nirNaya garne dina ho | hAmIle timIharUlAI ra pahilekA samudAyaharUlAI euTai ThAu~mA bhelA pArekAchauM |
39 yadi allAhako yAtanAbATa bacna sakne kunai cAla timIharUsita cha bhane calera hera |
40phaisalAko dinalAI jhUTo Thahara garneharUkA lAgi tyasadina vinAza, yAtanA ra hAni hunecha |

41 vAstavamA, Aphno pAlanakartAko AdezaharUko pAlanA garI ra uhA~le manAhI garnubhaeko kurAharUbATa bacera uhA~ko Dara rAkhneharU svargakA rUkhaharUko chAyA ra bagirahane svaccha pAnIko mUlaharUbIca hunechan |
42 unIharUle khAna mana parAune phalaphUlaharUmA hunechan |
43 unIharUlAI bhaninechaH pavitra khAnekurA khAU ra dUSita nabhaeko svaccha peya padArtha piU kinaki timIharUle saMsAramA satkarma garekA thiyau |
44 vAstavamA, timIharUlAI dieko pratidAna jasto pratidAna hAmI satkarmIharUlAI dinchauM |
45 Izabhaya rAkhneharUkA lAgi tayAra pAreko pratidAnalAI jhUTo Thahara garneharUkA lAgi tyasadina vinAza, yAtanA ra hAni raheko cha |

46 jhUTo Thahara garneharUlAI bhaninechaH yasa saMsAramA choTo samayako lAgi khAU ra jIvanako mojamastIko Ananda liU kinaki allAhalAI nakArekole ra uhA~kA rasUlaharUlAI jhUTo Thahara garekole timIharU aparAdhI hau |
47 jhUTo Thahara garneharUko lAgi vinAza, yAtanA ra hAni raheko cha kinaki unIharUle badalA diine dina unIharUlAI diine yAtanAlAI jhUTo Thahara gare |
48 jaba yI jhUTo Thahara garneharUlAI bhaninchaH allAhako lAgi namAja paDha tara yinIharU uhA~ko lAgi namAja paDhdainan |
49 allAhako tarphabATa rasUlaharUle lyAekA sandezalAI nakArneharUlAI tyasadina vinAza, yAtanA ra hAni raheko cha |
50 yadi yinIharUko pAlanakartAko tarphabATa avatarita kurAnamAthi yinIharUle ImAna rAkhenan bhane aba yasapachi yinIharU kuna kurAmAthi AsthA rAkhnechan?!
1 yI muzrikaharU rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) ko Agamanapachi kuna viSayamA sodhdaichan?!

2 unIharU ApasamA euTA ThUlo sUcanAko viSayamA sodhdaichan | tyo unIharUkA rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) mAthi avatarita yo kurAna ho jasamA punaH jIvita pArne viSayamA jAnakArI samAveza garieko cha |
3 yo kurAna ho, yasalAI ke bhanera sambodhana tathA varNana garne bhanne viSayamA yinIharUle matabheda garchan; yasalAI jAdU, kavitA, jyotiSako kurA vA pahilekA mAnisaharUko kathA |
4 unIharUle so~ce jasto kadApi hoina | kurAnalAI jhUTo Thahara garne duSprayAsa garneharUle cA~Dai nai Aphno jhUTako pariNAma thAhA pAunechan |
tyasapachi yo tinIharUko lAgi puSTi hunecha|
6 ke hAmIle unIharUko lAgi dhartIlAI samatala banAera tyasalAI basne yogya banAekA chainauM?
