15 tinIharU badalAko dina tyasamA praveza garnechan ra tyasako Agoko kaSTa bhognechan |
16 kahile pani tyasabATa bacna saknechainan baru sadAkA lAgi tyasamA rahanechan |
17 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! tapAIMlAI ke thAhA, badalAko dina ke ho bhanera?
18 tapAIMlAI ke thAhA, badalAko dina ke ho bhanera?
19 tyasadina kasaile kasailAI phAidA puryAuna saknechaina | tyasadina hareka mAmilA kevala allAhako hAtamA hunecha | uhA~le je cAhanuhunecha garnuhunecha, yo adhikAra kevala uhA~sa~ga hunecha |
1 dhokA dineharUko vinAza hos |
2 yI tinIharU hun jo arUbATa li~dA pUrA-pUrA taula garera linchan ra tyasamA kunai kamI gardainan |

3 ani jaba arUlAI nApera vA taulera dinchan nApamA ra taulamA kamI garera dinchan | nabI (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) madInA basAi sarAi (hijarata) garera jAne samayamA madInAbAsIharUko avasthA yastai thiyo |
4 yastA kukarma garneharUlAI allAhatarpha nai punaH jIvita pArera laijAnecha bhanne kurA thAhA chaina ra?!
5 durbhAgya ra trAsale bharieko gambhIra dinamA hisAba lina ra badalA dinakA lAgi unIharUlAI punaH jIvita pArinecha |
6 tyasadina mAnisaharU sampUrNa sRSTikA pAlanakartA samakSa hisAbako lAgi ubhinechan |

7 mRtyu pazcAta punaH jIvita pArine chaina bhanne timIharUko so~ca vAstavikatAsa~ga mela khA~daina | vAstavamA, kAphira ra kapaTI pApIharUko karma-patra sabaibhandA tallo dhartImA bhaekole ghATAmA cha |
8 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! tapAIMlAI ke thAhA sijjIna ke ho?
9 vAstavamA, unIharUko karma-patra lekhieko cha ra tyo harAunechaina | na tyasamA vRddhi garinecha na kamI nai |
10 tyasadina jhUTAharUko vinAza hos |
11 jasale badalA diine dinalAI jhUTo Thahara gare | juna dina allAhale AphnA bhaktaharUlAI unIharUle saMsAramA garekA karmaharUko badalA dinuhunecha |
12 allAhakA sImAharUko ullaGghana garne ra dherai pApa garnele mAtra tyasa dinalAI inkAra garcha |
13 jaba usalAI hAmrA rasUlamAthi avatarita AyataharU sunAincha, usale bhanchaH yo vigatakA mAnisaharUko kathA ho ra yo allAhako tarphabATa Aeko hoina |
14 vAstavikatA yI jhUTAharUle soMce jasto hoina | baru unIharUle gareko pApa unIharUko mastiSkamA chAekole unIharUkA viveka DhAkieko cha | ani Aphno hRdayale satyalAI herna sakenan |
15 kiyAmatako dina unIharUle sA~ccai nai AphnA pAlanakartAlAI dekhna sakne chainan |
16 ani unIharU narkamA praveza garnechan ra tyasako Agoko kaSTa bhognechan |

17 ani kiyAmatako dina unIharUlAI nindA gardai bhaninechaH juna yAtanAko viSayamA timIharUkA rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) le timIharUlAI sUcita garnubhaeko thiyo ra tyasalAI timIharUle jhUTo Thahara garekA thiyau yo tyahI yAtanA ho jasalAI timIharU ahile bhogirahekA chau |
18 hisAba hunechaina ra badalA diine chaina bhanne timIharUko soMca vAstavikatAsa~ga kunai sambandha chaina | vAstavamA, anusaraNa garneharUko karma-patra illiyInamA cha |
19 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! tapAIMlAI thAhA cha illiyIna ke ho?!
20 vAstavamA, unIharUko karma-patra lekhieko cha ra tyo harAunechaina | na tyasamA vRddhi garinecha na kamI nai |
21 yasa karma-patrako sAthamA pratyeka svargakA sabai phariztAharU upasthita hunechan |
22 kiyAmatako dina dherai puNyakArya garneharU sadAkA kRpAmA rahanechan |
23 sajAiekA AsanaharUmA basera unIharUle AphnA pAlanakartAlAI ra tI sabai kurAharUtira hernechan jasale unIharUlAI santuSTa pArchan ra jasabATa unIharU khusI hunchan |
24 jaba tapAIM unIharUtira hernuhunecha tapAIMle unIharUko anuhAramA AnandakA saMketaharU dekhnuhunecha |
25 unIharUkA nokaraharUle unIharUlAI botalamA silabanda lagAieko madirA pilAunechan |

26 tyasako antima thopAsamma kastUrIko bAsnA Airaheko hunecha | yo sammAnajanaka puraskAra prApta garna allAhalAI khusI pArne kAryaharU garera ra uhAle manAhI garnubhaekA kurAharUlAI tyAgera pratispardhIharUsa~ga pratispardhA garnu anivArya cha |
27 tyasa silabanda lAgeko peyamA tasnIma nAmI utkRSTa mUlako pAnIko mizraNa hunecha |
28 yo svargako mAthillo bhAgamA rAkhieko ekadamai zuddha kuvA~ ho, jahA~bATa allAhakA nikaTatama bhaktaharUle piunechan | anya mominaharUle misieko muhAnabATa piunechan |
29 nissandeha, jasale kuphramai kAyama rahera aparAdha gare | unIharUle mominaharUko khillI uDAu~dai hA~sne gardathe |
30 ani unIharUle mominaharUko cheubATa hi~DdA unIharU eka arkAlAI TAuko hallAI saGketa diera mominaharUko upahAsa garchan ra khillI uDAu~chan |
31 ani jaba unIharU Aphno parivAramA pharkanchan, unIharU mominaharUko khillI uDAudai ani kuphra gardai santuSTa bhaera pharkanchan |
32 jaba unIharU muslimaharUlAI dekhchan, bhanchan- yinIharUle AphnA pUrvajako dharma tyAgera sIdhA mArgabATa pathabhraSTa bhaekA chan |
33 yinIharUle yo kurA garnako lAgi allAhale yinIharUlAI unIharUkA karmaharUko nirIkSaNa garne jimmevArI dinubhaeko chaina |
34 tara kiyAmatako dina mominaharUle kAphiraharUko khillI uDAunechan jasarI saMsAramA kAphiraharU mominaharUko khillI uDAune gardathe |
35 ani sajAiekA AsanaharUmA basI allAhale unIharUkA lAgi tayAra pArnubhaeko sadA rahirahane kRpAlAI herirahekA hunechan |
36 kAphiraharUle saMsAramA garekA kAryaharUkA badalAmA unIharUlAI apamAnajanaka yAtanA diiyo |
1 jaba AkAza phariztAharUko avataraNako lAgi phATnecha |
2 AjJAkArI bhaI Aphno pAlanakartAko kurA sunnecha | yahI nai usako lAgi ucita cha |
3 jaba allAhale dhartIlAI chAlAlAI phailAe jhai~ phailAunu hunecha |
4 ani dhartIle AphUbhitra rahekA kharakhajAnA ra mRtakaharUlAI bAhira phyA~knecha ra ritto hunecha |
5 usale AjJAkArI bhaI Aphno pAlanakartAko kurA sunera pAlanA garnecha, yahI nai usako lAgi ucita cha |
6 he mAnava! nissandeha, timIle rAmro kAma yA narAmro kAma jo pani garirahekA chau, tyasalAI timIle kiyAmatako dina dekhnechau | tyasa anusAra allAhale timIlAI badalA dinuhunecha |

jaba uhA~le samagramA mAnisako karmako varNana garnubhayo, ta uhA~le kiyAmatako dina hune mAnisaharUko avasthAlAI spaSTa pArdai bhannubhayoH
7 jasako dAhine hAtamA usako karma-patra diinecha |
8 allAhale usako hisAba sahaja tarikAle linuhunecha ra usalAI daNDita nagarI usako karmalAI prastuta garinecha |
9 ani U Aphno parivAramA prasanna bhaI pharkanecha |
10 ani jasalAI usako karma-patra usako piThyU~ pachADibATa debre hAtamA diinecha |
11 usale svayaMko vinAzako lAgi pukArnecha |
12 U narkako AgomA praveza garnecha jahA~ usale tyasako rApako kaSTa bhognecha |
13 vAstavamA, saMsAramA U kuphra ra avajJAkA sAtha Aphno parivArasa~ga santuSTa thiyo |
14 usale mRtyu pazcAta punaH jIvita hunechaina bhanI so~coko thiyo |

15 baru allAhale usalAI pherI jIvita pArnuhunecha jasarI usalAI pahilo paTaka sRSTi garnubhaeko thiyo | vAstavamA, usakA pAlanakartAle usako avasthAlAI herirahanu bhaeko thiyo | uhA~bATa kunaipani kurA lukeko chaina ra tyasa anusAra nai usalAI badalA dinuhunecha |
16 allAhale rAto raGgako kasama khAnubhayo, juna sUryAstapachi kSitijamA dekhincha |
17 ani uhA~le rAtako ra tyasamA jammA hune cijaharUko kasama khAnubhayo |
18 ani candramAko kasama khAnubhayo juna pUrA huncha ra purNimAmA pariNata huncha |
19 he mAnava! timIharU eka caraNabATa arko caraNamA jAnechau jastai vIryako thopAbATa ragatako Dhikko, tyasabATa capAeko mAsuko Dallo, ani jIvana, mRtyu ani pherI jIvita hunu |
20 tara yI kAphiraharUlAI ke bhayo, yinIharU allAhamAthi ra Akhiratako dinamAthi AsthA (ImAna) kina rAkhdainan?!
21 ani jaba yinIharU samakSa kurAnako pATha garincha, ta unIharUle AphnA pAlanakartA samakSa sajdA gardainan?!
22 baru kAphiraharUle unIharUko rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) le lyAunubhaeko kurAlAI jhUTo Thahara garchan |
23 yinIharUko manale lukAune kurAharUlAI allAha rAmrarI jAnnuhuncha | unIharUko kunaipani kurA uhA~bATa lukeko chaina |
24 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! unIharUlAI pIDAdAyI daNDale parkhiraheko kurAbATa sUcita garnuhos |
25 tara allAhamAthi AsthA rAkhneharU ra satkarma garneharUle kahilyai samApta nahune puNya prApta garnechan ra tyo svarga ho |
1 uhA~le sUrya, candramA ra anya grahaharUko kakSa bhaeko AkAzako kasama khAnubhayo |
2 allAhale sRSTiharUlAI bhelA pArne bAcA garnubhaeko kiyAmatako dinako kasama khAnubhayo |

3 allAhale sabai gavAhako kasama khAnu bhayo, jastai nabI (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) le Aphno samudAyako bAremA gavAhI dinuhunecha ra anya sandeSTAharUle AphnA samudAyaharUko bAremA gavAhI dinechan |
4 jamInamA ThUlo khADala banAuneharUmAthi dhikkAra hos |
5 tyasamA Ago dankAera tyasa AgomA jIvita mominaharUlAI phAle |
6 unIharU Agole bharieko khADalako cheumA basekA thie |
7 unIharU mominaharUmAthiko yAtanA ra pIDAko svayaM nai sAkSI hun kinaki unIharU tyahA~ upasthita thie |
8 tI kAphiraharUle mominaharUlAI sarvazaktimAn allAhamAthi ImAna rAkhekole doSI Thahara gare | uhA~lAI kohI pani parAjita garna sakdaina | uhA~ hareka kAmako lAgi prazaMsita hunuhuncha |
9 AkAzaharU ra pRthvIko mAlika uhA~mAtra hunuhuncha | uhA~ hareka kurAbATa avagata hunuhuncha ra uhA~kA bhaktaharUkA kunaipani kurA uhA~bATa lukeko chaina |

10 vAstavamA, momina purUSa ra mahilAharUlAI eka mAtra allAhamAthi AsthA rAkhnabATa haTAunako lAgi Agoko yAtanA dineharU ra AphnA pApaharUbATa allAha samakSa pazcAttApa nagarneharUlAI kiyAmatako dina narkako yAtanA diinecha ra unIharUlAI tyasto Agoko yAtanA diinecha jasale unIharUlAI jalAunecha | unIharUle mominaharUlAI Agole jalAeko badalAmA unIharUlAI yo yAtanA diinecha |

11 vAstavamA, allAhamAthi AsthA rAkhneharU ra satkarma garneharUkA lAgi yastA bagaiMcAharU rahekA chan jasakA mahalaharU ra rUkhaharUkA munitirabATa nadIharU bagirahekA hunechan | yahI tyo badalA ho juna unIharUkA lAgi tayAra pArera rAkhieko cha | yo ThUlo saphalatA ho ra yasa jasto arU kunai saphalatA chaina |
12 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! vAstavamA, atyAcArIharUkA lAgi tapAIMko pAlanakartAko pakaDha atyantai kaDA cha, yadyapi uhA~le unIharUlAI kehI samayako lAgi chuTa dinubhaeko cha |
13 uhA~le nai prathama paTaka sRSTi ra yAtanAko prArambha garnuhuncha ra tyasalAI punaH dohoryAunu hunecha |
14 ani pazcAttApa garne uhA~kA bhaktaharUlAI uhA~le kSamA garnuhuncha kinaki uhA~ AphnA parahejagAra tathA takavAvAlA mitraharUlAI prema garnuhuncha |
15 uhA~ mahAna siMhAsanako mAlika hunuhuncha |
16 uhA~ jasalAI jAhanuhuncha usako pApaharUlAI kSamA garnuhuncha ra jasalAI cAhanuhuncha daNDa dinuhuncha | uhA~lAI kasaile pani jabarajastI garna sakdaina |
17 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! ke tapAIMle tI sainikaharUko samAcAra pAunubhayo jasale satyasa~ga laDe ra tyasamA bAdhA puryAekA thie?!
18 phirauna, samuda ra sAleha (alaihissalAma) ko samudAya |

19 unIharUle ImAna nalyAunuko kAraNa jhUTo Thahara garneharU ra unIharUko vinAzako samAcAra naAunu hoina baru Aphno icchAko anusaraNa garnu nai unIharUko rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) le lyAunubhaeko sandezalAI jhUTo Thahara garnuko kAraNa ho |
20 allAhale unIharUko karmaharUlAI gherera rAkhnubhaeko cha, tyasabATa kunai kurA pani uhA~bATa lukeko chaina ra tyasa anusAra nai unIharUlAI badalA diinecha |
21 jhUTAharUle bhane jastai yo kurAna kavitA ra zleSa hoina baru yo mahAna kurAna ho |
22 juna lauhe mahphUja (surakSita peTikA) mA cha | juna parivartana, SaDyantra ra tyasabATa kunai kurA ghaTna ra tyasamA thapnabATa surakSita raheko cha |
1 allAhale AkAzako ra rAtamA dekhA parne tArAko kasama khAnubhaeko cha |
2 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! yasa ThUlo tArAko viSayamA tapAIMlAI ke thAhA cha?!
3 yo euTA tArA ho jasale AkAzalAI Aphno camakale camkilo pAreko cha |
4 allAhale kiyAmatako dina hisAba linako nimti hareka prANImAthi usakA karmaharU lekhera surakSita pArna euTA phariztAlAI khaTAunubhaeko cha |
5 tasartha allAhale manuSyalAI kuna tatvale sRSTi garnubhaeko ho bhanI usale socnupardacha, tAki allAhako zakti ra manuSya zaktihIna bhaeko kurA spaSTa huncha |
6 uhA~le mahilAko garbhamA hAlieko mahatvahIna pAnI (vIrya) bATa usalAI sRSTi garnubhayo |
7 yo tarala padArtha puruSako merUdaNDa ra chAtIko haDDIko bIcabATa niskancha |
8 yadi allAhale usalAI yasa mahatvahIna pAnIbATa sRSTi garna saknuhuncha bhane usako mRtyu pazcAta hisAba lina ra badalA dinakA nimti punaH jIvita pArna pani saknuhuncha |
9 tyasa dina rahasyaharUko parikSaNa garinecha ani tinIharUkA manamA lukekA gopya irAdA, vizvAsa Adi prakAzamA Aunechan ani tyasamadhye asala ra duSTalAI alaga alaga chuTyAinecha |
10 tyasadina manuSyasita allAhako yAtanAbATa bacne zakti hunechaina ra usale kohI sahayogI pani pAune chaina |
11 allAhale pAnI bhaeko AkAzako kasama khAnubhaeko cha, jasabATa varSA Au~cha kinaki samaya-samayamA tyahA~bATa pAnI parcha |
12 ani uhA~le dhartIko kasama khAnubhaeko cha, kinaki tyahA~bATa biruvA, phalaphUla ra rUkhaharU umranchan |
13 vAstavamA, muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) mAthi avatarita kurAna sahI ra galata ani satya ra asatya bIca pharaka chuTyAune vANI ho |
14 yo khela vA asatya hoina baru gambhIratA ra satya ho |
15 vAstavamA, jo unIharUkA rasUlaharUle lyAeko sandezalAI nakArchan, unIharU tinIharUko AhvAnalAI rokna ra tyasalAI radda garna dherai SaDayantra garchan |
16 tara ma dharmalAI mAthi uThAune ra jhUTalAI naSTa pArne yojanA banAu~daichu |
17 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! yI kAphiraharUlAI samaya dinuhos | unIharUlAI thorai samaya dinuhos ra unIharUko yAtanA ra vinAzamA hatAra nagarnuhos |
1 tapAIM Aphno pAlanakartAko mahimA garnuhos jo Aphno sRSTibhandA ucca hunuhuncha | ani jaba tapAIM uhA~ko nAma ullekha garnuhuncha ra uhA~ko mahimA garnuhuncha, uhA~ko nAmako uccAraNa garnuhos |
2 jasale mAnisalAI uttama rUpamA sRSTi garnubhayo ra AkAralAI santulanamA rAkhnubhayo |
3 jasale sRSTiharUlAI vibhinna liGga, prakAra ra caritramA vibhAjita garnubhayo | ani pratyeka sRSTilAI usalAI ucita ra upayukta kurAharUko mArgadarzana garnubhayo |
4 jasale dhartIbATa timIharUko janAvaraharUko AhAra umArnubhayo |
5 ani uhA~le tyasalAI kAlo sukkhA jhAramA pariNata garnubhayo, jabaki tyo pahile hariyo ra tAjA thiyo |

6 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! hAmI tapAIMlAI kurAna paDhAunechauM ra tyasalAI tapAIMko chAtImA surakSita pArnechauM tyasapachi tapAIMle bhulnuhune chaina | tasartha tyasalAI bhulne Darale tapAIM jibrIla (alaihissalAma) sa~ga paDhna hatAra nagarnuhos |
7 tyasa bAheka juna allAha tapAIMlAI vizeSa uddezyale birsAunuhuncha kinaki uhA~ jAhera gariekA ra lukAiekA sabai kurA jAnnuhuncha ra uhA~bATa kehI pani lukeko chaina |
8 hAmI tapAIMko lAgi allAhalAI prasanna pArne ra svarga liera jAne karmalAI sahaja banAunechauM |
9 tasartha hAmIle tapAIMlAI vahI gareko kurAnabATa arUlAI upadeza dinuhos ra unIharUle sallAha sunna jArI rAkhesamma unIharUlAI sallAha dinuhos |
10 jo allAhasa~ga DarAu~chan unIharUle upadeza grahaNa garnechan kinaki unIharU tyasa upadezabATa phAidA lina sakchan |
11 ani kAphirale upadeza grahaNa garnabATa baccha ra tyasalAI asvIkAra garcha kinaki U AkhiratamA sabaibhandA abhAgI mAnisa hunecha ra narkamA praveza garnecha |
12 Akhiratako jIvanamA vizAla AgomA praveza garera usale sadAko lAgi tyasako rApako pIDA ra kaSTa sahanecha |
13 tyasapachi U sa~dhai AgomA rahanecha, sajAyako kaSTabATa AphaiMlAI mukta pArnako nimti mRtyuvaraNa garna saknechaina ra maryAdita jIvana jiuna saknechaina |
14 zirka ra pApabATa zuddha bhaekA vyaktiharUle AphUle cAheko kurA pAuna saphala hunechan |
15 dharmale nirdhAraNa gareko tarikAle usale Aphno pAlanakartAlAI samjhyo ra tokieko tarikA bamojima salAha (namAja) paDhyo |
16 baru timIharU saMsArako jIvanalAI prAthamikatA dinchau ra tyasalAI AkhiratabhandA ucca darjAmA rAkhchau | yadyapi tI duIko bIcamA ThUlo bhinnatA cha |
17 baru Akhirata saMsArabhandA uttama ra utkRSTa cha kinaki tyasamA nirantara sukha ra kahile samApta nahune Ananda raheko cha |
18 vAstavamA, hAmIle ullekha garekA yI AdezaharU ra sUcanAharU kurAnabhandA pahile avatarita pustakaharUmA pani ullekha chan |
19 tI ibrAhIma ra mUsA (alaihimassalAma) mAthi avataraNa bhaekA kitAbaharU hun |
1 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! ke tapAIM samakSa kiyAmatako kathA Aipugyo jasale mAnisaharUlAI bhayabhIta pArnecha?!
2 kiyAmatako dina mAnisaharU saubhAgyazAlI hunechan vA durbhAgyazAlI hunechan | durbhAgyazAlIharUkA anuhAra apamAnita ra jhukekA hunechan |
3 unIharU thakita bhaekA ra janjiramA bA~dhiekA hunechan, jasadvArA unIharUlAI ghisArinecha ra hatakaDIle bA~dhiekA hunechan |
4 tI anuhAraharU dankeko AgomA praveza garnechan ra tyasako tApa bhognechan |
5 unIharUlAI ekadamai umliekA kuvA~bATa tAto pAnI pilAinecha |
6 unIharUkA lAgi zibrika nAmako biruvAko ati narAmro ghinalAgdo khAnekurA bAheka arU kunai khAnekurA hunechaina, jo sukepachi viSAlu huncha |
7 tyasale khAnelAI na ta moTo garAunecha, na usako bhoka meTAunecha |
8 tyasadina saubhAgyazAlIharUkA anuhAra unIharUle prApta garekA anukampAkA kAraNa Anandita ra khusI hunechan |
9 yo unIharUle saMsAramA khusI khusI garekA satkarmakA kAraNa hunecha | ani unIharUko satkarmako puNya surakSita ra kaiMyau guNA baDheko hunecha |
10 unIharU ucca ra pratiSThita svargamA hunechan |
11 unIharUle svargamA jhUTA ra bekArakA zabdaharU pani sunnechainan, avaidha kurAharU ta parai jAos |
12 tyasa svargamA bagirahekA pAnIkA srotaharU hunechan, juna unIharU jasarI cAhanchan prayoga garnechan |
13 tyahA~ aglA-aglA palaGaharU hunechan |
14 piunako lAgi tayAra peya padArtha hunecha |
15 ani eka pachi arko garI sirAnIharU lagAiekA hunechan |
16 tyahA~ jatAtatai galaiMcAharU bichAiekA hunechan |

jaba allAhale AkhiratamA durbhAgyazAlI ra saubhAgyazAlI huneharUkA vibhinna avasthAharUko ullekha garnubhayo taba uhA~le kAphiraharUko dhyAnAkarSaNa sRSTikartAko kSamatA ra uhA~ko uttama saMracanAtarpha saMketa garnubhaeko cha, tAki unIharUle ImAnako bATo pAuna sakun ani jannatamA praveza garera saubhAgyazAlI mAnisaharUmA samAveza huna sakun | ani uhA~le bhannubhayoH
17 ke yinIharUle dekhdainan, allAhale u~TalAI kasarI sRSTi garnubhaeko cha ra tyasalAI AdamakA santAnakA lAgi khaTAunubhaeko cha?!
18 ke yinIharUle dekhdainan, allAhale AkAzalAI kasarI ucca pArera uThAunubhaeko cha ra tyasalAI surakSita chata banAunubhaeko cha ani tyo unIharUmAthi khasdaina?!
19 ke yinIharUle dekhdainan, uhA~le pahADaharUlAI kasarI dhartImA sthApita garnubhaeko cha ra tyasako sahayogale dhartIlAI hallinabATa roknubhaeko cha?!
20 ke yinIharUle dekhdainan, uhA~le dhartIlAI kasarI phailAunubhaeko cha ra tyasalAI mAnisaharUlAI basnako lAgi yogya banAunubhaeko cha?!

jaba allAhale unIharUlAI Aphno zaktiko pramANaharUmAthi dhyAna dina AhvAna garnubhayo, uhA~le AphnA rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) lAI dhyAnAkarSaNa garera bhannubhayoH
21 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! unIharUlAI upadeza dinuhos ra allAhako yAtanAdekhi DarAunuhos kinaki tapAIM kevala sacetaka hunuhuncha | unIharUlAI cetAvanI dine bAheka anya viSayamA tapAIMlAI sodhine chaina | unIharUlAI ImAna lyAune kSamatA pradAna garne kAma allAhako mAtra ho |
22 tapAIMlAI unIharUmAthi kunai adhikAra chaina ra tapAIM unIharUlAI ImAna lyAunako lAgi bAdhya pArna saknuhunna?
23 tara jasale allAhamAthi ImAna lyAuna asvIkAra gardacha ra allAha ra uhA~ko rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) lAI mAndaina |
24 kiyAmatako dina allAhale usalAI sadAkA lAgi narkamA praveza garAI ThUlo yAtanA dinuhunecha |
25 nissandeha mRtyu pazcAta unIharU hAmItira nai pharkera Aunechan |
26 ani kevala hAmIle nai unIharUkA karmaharUko hisAba linechauM | tapAIM ra tapAIM bAheka arU kasaiko yo jimmevArI hoina |
1 allAhale prabhAtako kasama khAnubhayo |
2 uhA~le jil-hijjAkA surukA dasa rAtako kasama khAnubhaeko cha |
3 uhA~le joDA ra bijoDA vastuharUko pani kasama khAnubhaeko cha |
4 ani rAtako Agamana, tyasako nirantaratA ra antyako pani kasama khAnubhaeko cha | yI kasamaharUko uttara hunchaH timIharUkA kAryaharUko badalA diinecha |
5 ke yahA~ ullekha yasto kasama chaina jasale so~cneharUlAI vizvasta pArne cha?
6 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! jaba hUdako samudAya Adale AphnA rasUlalAI inkAra gare tapAIMkA pAlanakartAle unIharUsita kasto vyavahAra garnubhayo bhanI tapAIMle dekhnubhaena?
7 Ada samudAyako nAma unIharUko pUrvaja iramako nAmamA rAkhieko ho ra unIharU nikai baliyA ra aglA mAnisaharU thie |
8 unIharU saraha allAhale kunai pani zahara tathA dezamA arko samudAya sRSTi garnubhaeko chaina |

9 sAleha (alaihissalAma) ko samudAya samUdasita allAhale kasto vyavahAra garnubhayo bhanI tapAIMle dekhnubhaena? unIharUle hijra nAmI pahADako caTTAna kATera DhuGgAko caTTAnamA gharaharU banAekA thie |
10 tapAIMkA pAlanakartAle phiraunasita kasto vyavahAra garnubhayo bhanI tapAIMle dekhnubhaena? U sainya dalako mAlika thiyo jasadvArA mAnisaharUlAI yAtanA dinthyo |
11 tI sabaile atyAcAra ra anyAyakA sabai sImAharU pAra garekA thie | tinIharUmadhye pratyekale Aphno nagaramA dherai atyAcAra gare |
12 ani kuphra ra pApaharU phailAera tinIharUle tyahA~ nikai vidhvaMsa maccAe |
13 allAhale tinIharUlAI kaThora sajAya dinubhayo ra pRthvIbATa naSTa pArnubhayo |

14 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! vAstavamA, tapAIMkA pAlanakartAle mAnisaharUkA kAryaharU dekhirahanu bhaeko ra nirikSaNa garirahanu bhaeko cha | uhA~le satkarma garneharUlAI pratidAna svarUpa svarga ra duSkarma garneharUlAI yAtanA svarUpa narka pradAna garnuhunecha |

allAhale juna-juna samudAyalAI naSTa garnubhayo tinIharU zakti, dhana daulata tathA aparAjayatAle sampanna thie | unIharUlAI hareka cIjale sampanna garAunu allAha unIharUsita rAjI bhaeko pramANa hoina bhanera uhA~le spaSTa pArnubhaeko cha |
15 jaba allAha manuSyalAI jA~cnuhuncha ra usalAI dhana, baccAharU ra zakti diera sammAna dinuhuncha taba usalAI usako vizeSatAko kAraNa yo sabai U allAhako najaramA sammAnita bhaeko saMketa ho jasto lAgcha ra bhanchaH ma merA pAlanakartAko sammAnako lAyaka bhaekole uhA~le mero sammAna garnubhayo |
16 ani jaba usako parikSA linuhuncha ra usako jIvikA sImita garnuhuncha taba usako pAlanakartAle usalAI apamAnita garnubhaeko jasto lAgcha ra bhanchaH merA pAlanakartAle malAI apamAnita garnubhayo |

17 kadApi hoina, tyasa mAnchele so~ceko jasto hoina | allAhale kRpA garnu Aphno bhaktasa~ga prasanna bhaeko pramANa hoina ra uhA~le vipatti dinu Aphno bhaktalAI apamAnita garnu hoina | vAstavamA, allAhale timIharUlAI pradAna garnubhaeko jIvikAbATa timIharUle anAthako satkAra gardainau |
18 ani timIharU eka arkAlAI asahAyalAI khuvAuna prerita gardainau josa~ga khAnako lAgi kehI pani hu~daina |
19 mahilAharU, anAthaharU jastA kamajoraharUko adhikAralAI tyasako vaidhatAlAI dhyAnamA narAkhI haDapera khAnchau |
20 timIharUmA dhanako apAra prema cha ra yasako lobhale allAhako mArgamA kharca gardainau |
21 yasto vyavahAra timIharUle apanAunu hu~daina | yAda gara, jaba dhartIlAI hallAinecha ra bhUkampa Aunecha |
22 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! jaba allAha AphnA bhaktaharUko phaisalA garna Aunuhunecha ra phariztAharU pani paGktibaddha bhaera Aunechan |

23 tyasadina narkalAI sattara hajAra lagAmadvArA lyAinecha ra pratyeka lagAmako lAgi sattara hajAra phariztAharU hunechan jasale tyasalAI tAnnechan | tyasadina mAnisa allAhako sambandhamA usale bevAstA gareko samjhanecha | tara tyasadina samjhanAle ke phAidA?! tyo dina badalA dine dina ho, kAma garne dina hoina |
24 tyasadina dherai pazcAttApako bhAvanAle usale bhannechaH yadi maile Akhiratako jIvana juna vAstavika jIvana ho tyasako lAgi satkarmaharU gareko bhae rAmro hunethyo |
25 tyasadina allahako yAtanA jasto kasaiko yAtanA hunechaina kinaki allAhako yAtanA kaThora ra sadA rahirahane yAtanA ho |
26 jasarI tyasa dina kAphiralAI sAGlole bA~dhine cha tyasarI kasaile kahilyai pani bA~dheko hunechaina |

jaba allAhale kAphiraharUko yAtanAko ullekha garnubhayo ta uhA~le mominaharUko pratidAnako pani ullekha gardai bhannubhaeko chaH
27 ani mRtyuko samaya ra kiyAmatako dina mominako prANalAI bhaninechaH he ImAna ra satkarmabATa santuSTa AtmA |
28 AphnA pAlanakartAko ThUlo pratidAnabATa prasanna bhaera ra uhA~le satkarma garne avasara pradAna garnubhaekomA uhA~bATa AtmasantuSTa bhaera uhA~tarpha pharka |
29 timI merA satkarmI bhaktaharUmA sAmela hoU |
30 ani unIharUko sAthamA maile tayAra pAreko mero svargamA praveza gara |
1 allAhale pavitra nagarako kasama khAnubhayo juna makkaha mukarramaha ho |
2 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! jo hatyA garna yogya rahekA chan unIharUko hatyA garne ra jo kaida hune yogya chan unIharUlAI kaida garne anumati tapAIMlAI cha |
3 ani allAhale manuSyako pitA ra usako santAnako kasama khAnubhayo |
4 hAmIle mAnisalAI kaSTa ra pIDAmA sRjanA garekAchauM kinaki U saMsAramA kaSTa bhogne gardacha |

5 ke jaba mAnisale pApa garcha, usalAI kasaile rokna sakdaina, kasaile pani UbATa badalA lina sakdaina ra usako pAlanakartA jasale usalAI sRSTi garnubhayo uhA~le pani yasako sAmarthya rAkhnuhunna bhanne usalAI lAgcha?!
6 usale bhanchaH maile eka pachi arko garI dherai dhana kharca gareM |
7 ke allAhale usalAI dekhnubhaeko chaina ra usale Aphno sampatti kahA~bATa kamAeko ra kahA~ kharca gareko bhanI sodhnu hunechaina bhanera Aphno kharcako bAremA phurtI lagAunele socdacha?
8 ke hAmIle usalAI hernako lAgi duITA A~khA dienauM ra?
9 bolnako lAgi euTA jibro ra duIvaTA oTha dienauM ra?
10 hAmIle usalAI rAmro bATo ra narAmro bATo dekhAenauM ra?
11 usale tyasa ghATI (avarodha) lAI pAra garnuparne thiyo jasale usalAI svargabATa alaga gardacha | tasartha usale tyo bATo pAra garnu parcha |
12 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) tapAIMlAI ghATI (avarodha) ko viSayamA ke thAhA cha jasalAI pAra garera usale svargamA praveza pAunecha |
13 tyo puruSa vA mahilAlAI dAsatvabATa mukta garnu ho |
14 athavA khAnAko abhAva bhaeko anikAlako samayamA khAnA khuvAunu ho |
15 kunai euTA tyasto baccAlAI jasale Aphno bubA gumAeko cha ra jo usako Aphanta pardacha |
16 vA abhAvagrastalAI khuvAunu ho josa~ga kehI pani chaina |

17 ani tyasa vyaktiharUmadhye hoos jo allAhamA ImAna rAkhchan, eka arkAlAI anusaraNamA dRDha rahana ra pApa ra pralobhanabATa AphUlAI TADhA rAkhna ra eka arkAlAI allAhako bhaktaharUkA sahayogI huna sujhAva dinchan |
18 yI guNaharU bhaekA vyaktiharU nai dAhine hAtavAlA hun |
19 jasale hAmrA rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) mAthi avatarita AyataharUlAI inkAra gare unIharU nai debre hAtavAlA hun |
20 kiyAmatako dinamA unIharU Agole gheriekA hunechan ra tyasamA unIharUlAI yAtanA diinecha |
1 allAhale sUryako kasama khAnubhaeko cha ra sUryodayapachi pUrvabATa mAthi uThne samayako kasama khAnubhaeko cha |
2 uhA~le candramAko kasama khAnubhaeko cha, jaba tyo sUryAstapachi tyasako pachi-pachi jAncha |
3 allAhale dinako kasama khAnubhaeko cha, jaba tyasako prakAzale uhA~le pRthvImA rahekA kurAharUlAI dekhine banAunuhuncha |
4 ani rAtako kasama khAnubhaeko cha, jaba tyasale pRthvIlAI chopcha ra andhakAra chAu~cha |
5 ani AkAzako kasama khAnubhaeko cha ra tyasako baliyo nirmANako pani kasama khAnubhaeko cha |
6 ani dhartIko kasama khAnubhaeko cha ra tyasamA mAnisaharU basna yogya banAunakA lAgi tyasalAI samatala banAunuko kasama khAnubhaeko cha |
7 uhA~le hareka prANako kasama khAnubhaeko cha ra allAhale tyasalAI ThikaThAka sRSTi gareko kasama khAnubhaeko cha |
8 kuna narAmro kAmabATa bacnupardacha ra asala kAma kuna ho bhanera uhA~le zikSA binA nai usalAI sikAunubhaeko cha |
9 sadguNaharUle sajAI ra avaguNaharUbATa mukta garI jasale Aphno AtmAlAI zuddha pAryo U Aphno uddezyamA saphala bhayo |
10 ani jasale tyasalAI avajJA ra pApaharUle apavitra banAyo U asaphala bhayo |

jaba allAhale avajJA ra pApaharUle prANalAI apavitra banAera asaphala hune kurAko ullekha garnubhayo uhA~le yasako udAharaNamA samUda samudAyalAI ullekha garnubhayo ra bhannubhayoH
11 samUdale avajJA ra pApaharU garnamA simA ullaGghana garI AphnA nabI sAleha (alaihissalAma) lAI jhUThA Thahara gare |
12 jaba unIharUmadhye dherai abhAgI vyakti unIharUle cayana garepachi ubhiyo |
13 unIharUlAI allAhako rasUla sAleha (alaihissalAma) le bhaneH allAhako u~TanIlAI nachunu, usale Aphno ArakSita dinamA pAnI piunecha ra usalAI hAnI napuryAunu |

14 tara unIharUle u~TanIko viSayamA AphnA rasUlako kurA mAnenan | ani unIharUmadhye dherai abhAgIle unIharUko sahamatImA tyasako hatyA garyo | unIharU tyasa pApamA sahabhAgI thie | tasartha allAhale unIharUmAthi Aphno yAtanA paThAunubhayo | unIharUko pApako kAraNale unIharUlAI ThUlo garjanale naSTa pArnubhayo | ani unIharUlAI yasto yAtanA dinubhayo jasabATa unIharUlAI naSTa pArnubhayo |
15 allAhale pariNAmaharUko Dara narAkhI yasa yAtanAbATa unIharUlAI naSTa pArnubhayo |
1 allAhale rAtako kasama khAnubhaeko cha, jaba tyasale AkAza ra pRthvIko bIcako bhAgalAI andhakArale chopcha |
2 ani uhA~le dinako kasama khAnubhaeko cha, jaba tyasale svayaMlAI jAhira garcha ra prakaTa huncha |
3 ani uhA~le AphnA sRSTiko duI prakAra arthAta puruSa ra mahilAko sRjanAko kasama khAnubhaeko cha |

4 he mAnisaharU ho! vAstavamA timIharUkA kriyAkalApaharU vibhinna prakArakA chan | tyasamadhye satkarmaharU hun jasako kAraNale svargamA praveza pAunecha ra arko kukarmaharU hun jasako kAraNale narkamA praveza pAunecha |
5 ataH jasale anivArya kharca; jastai- jakAta, sadakA (dAna-puNya) ra jarivAnA diyo ra allAhale manAhI garnubhaekA kurAharUbATa bacyo |
6 ani allAhale vAcA garekA pratidAnalAI satya mAnyo |
7 usako lAgi hAmI satkarma garna ra allAhako bATomA kharca garna sahaja garnechauM |
8 tara jasale kanjusyAi~ garyo, anivArya garieko kharca garena, svayaMlAI allAhako AvazyakatAbATa mukta ThAnyo ra allAhako kRpAbATa kehI pani mAgena |
9 ani allAhako mArgamA kharca garnAle allAhale pratidAna dinuhunecha bhanne vAcAlAI asatya mAnyo |
10 usako lAgi hAmI duSkarma garna sahaja garnechauM ra satkarma garna kaThina banAidinechauM |
11 jaba U naSTa hunecha ra narkamA praveza pAunecha taba usale kharca garna kanjusyAi~ gareko sampattile usalAI kehI pani phAidA puryAunechaina |
12 hAmro jimmevArI bhaneko satyako bATolAI asatyabATa chuTyaera dekhAidinu ho |
13 vAstavamA, Akhiratako jIvana ra sAMsArika jIvana hAmrai adhikAramA chan | hAmI jasarI cAhanchauM tyasamA calakhela garchauM | tI hAmI bAheka arU kasaikA pani hoinan |
14 he mAnisaharU ho! timIharUle allAhako avajJA gareko khaNDamA maile timIharUlAI danka~do AgobATa sAvadhAna garidieko chu |
15 tyasa AgomA kevala AbhAgI mAtra praveza garnecha ra U kAphira ho |
16 jasale rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) le lyAunubhaeko sandezalAI nakAryo ra allAhako Adeza mAnnabATa vimukha bhayo |
17 tyasabATa mAnisaharUmA sabaibhandA dherai Izabhaya rAkhne abU bakra (rajiyallAhu anhu) lAI TADhA rAkhinecha |
18 jo pApaharUbATa mukta hunako lAgi rAmro kAmamA Aphno sampatti kharca garchan |
19 unale gareko kharca kasaile unImAthi gareko kRpAko badalAmA gareko hoina |
20 unI sampatti kharca garera kevala Aphno pAlanakartAlAI prasanna pArna cAhanchan, jo AphnA bhaktaharUbhandA ucca hunuhuncha |
21 allAhale unalAI dinuhune udAra pratidAnabATa unI santuSTa hunechan |
1 allAhale dinako prArambhako kasama khAnubhaeko cha |
2 allAhale rAtako kasama khAnubhaeko cha, jaba tyasale andhakAra lyAu~cha ra mAnisaharU kriyAkalApaharU banda garchan |
3 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! vahI Auna samaya lAgekomA muzrikaharUle bhanejhai~ tapAIMko pAlanakartAle tapAIMlAI eklai choDnubhaeko chaina ra tapAIMsa~ga risAunubhaeko pani chaina |
4 tapAIMko lAgi saMsArabhandA Akhirata nai uttama cha, kinaki tyahA~ kahilyai samApta nahune kRpA tathA varadAna cha |
5 uhA~le tapAIMlAI ra tapAIMko samudAyalAI paryApta mAtrAmA pratidAna pradAna garnuhunecha, ani tapAIM tyasabATa santuSTa hunuhunecha |

6 uhA~le tapAIMlAI sAno cha~dA arthAta tapAIMko bubA bitisakekA belA zaraNa sthala pradAna garnubhayo | tapAIMmAthi tapAIMko hajurabubA abdul muttalibale ani unIpachi tapAIMko kAkA abU tAlibale dayA tathA sahAnubhUti vyakta gare |
7 uhA~le tapAIMlAI kitAba ra ImAna ke ho bhanne kurA thAhA nabhaeko avasthAmA pAunubhayo, ani tapAIMlAI thAhA nabhaekA kurAharU uhA~le tapAIMlAI sikAunubhayo |
8 uhA~le tapAIMlAI nirdhana pAunubhayo ani tapAIMlAI dhanI banAunubhayo |
9 baccA cha~dA Aphno bubA gumAekAharUlAI durvyavahAra nagarnuhos ra tinIharUlAI apamAna nagarnuhos |
10 garibaguruvAlAI nahapkAunuhos |
11 tapAIMmAthi allAhako kRpAko lAgi dhanyavAda dinuhos ra tyasako carcA garirahanuhos |
1 nissandeha, hAmIle tapAIMko chAtI arthAta hRdayalAI kholidiryauM ani vahI prApta garne kAryalAI priya banAryauM |
2 ani hAmIle tapAIMlAI pApabATa mukta garyauM ra islAma pUrva juna bojhamuni dabnubhaeko thiyo tyasalAI samApta pAryauM |
3 juna bojhale tapAIMlAI yati thakAyo mAnauM tapAIMko DhADa bhA~ciraheko thiyo |
4 hAmIle tapAIMko carcAlAI tapAIMko lAgi ucca pAryauM | tasartha tapAIMko nAmako carcA ajAna, ikAmaha AdimA huna thAlyo |
5 vAstavamA, kaThinAi ra du:kha pachi rAhata ra sukha raheko cha |

6 vAstavamA, kaThinAi ra du:kha pachi rAhata ra sukha raheko cha | yadi tapAIM yasa kurAlAI jAnnuhuncha bhane tapAIMko samudAyako kaSTale tapAIMlAI duHkhI pArna sakne chaina ra allAhatira AhvAna garnabATa rokna sakne chaina |
7 tapAIMle AphnA kAmaharUbATa phursata pAepachi AphnA pAlanakartAko upAsanAmA ekAgra bhaera lAgnuhos |
8 ani Aphno icchA ra uddezyalAI kevala allAhakA lAgi kendrita garnuhos |

1 allAhale aJjIra ra tyasako biruvA umrane ThAu~ko kasama khAnubhaeko cha, ani jaituna ra yo umrane ThAu~ philistinako kasama khAnubhaeko cha | tyahA~ uhA~le IsA (alaihissalAma) lAI paThAunubhaeko thiyo |
2 ani sInA pahADako kasama khAnubhaeko cha, jasako najikamA uhA~le mUsA (alaihissalAma) sa~ga kurA garnabhaeko thiyo |

4 hAmIle mAnuSyalAI sabaibhandA uttama saMracanAmA ra uttama svarupamA sRSTi garekAchauM |

5 tyasapachi hAmIle usalAI saMsAramA vRddha ra kamajora avasthAmA puryAyauM, ani U Aphno mAnava zarIrale phAidA lina asamartha huncha | jastai- Aphno svabhAvalAI bigArera narkamA gayo bhane usale tyasabATa phAidA lina sakdaina |

6 allAhamAthi AsthA rAkhne ra satkarma garneharU bAheka; unIharU buDhA bhaepani unIharUkA lAgi kahile samApta nahune puNya raheko cha, tyo svarga ho | kinabhane, unIharUle Aphno prakRti arthAta svabhAvalAI zuddha pArekA chan |
7 he mAnisaharU ho! timIharUle uhA~ko zaktiko paryApta nizAnIharU dekhisakepachi timIharUlAI kuna kurAle badalAko dinalAI nakArna protsAhita garyo?

8 kiyAmatako dinalAI badalAko dina banAera ke allAha samasta zAsakaharUbhandA ThUlo zAsaka ra unIharUbhandA dherai nirNAyaka hunuhunna ra? ke tapAIMlAI lAgcha, allAhale AphnA bhaktaharUlAI yattikai jAna dinuhunecha ra unIharUbIca phaisalA garnuhunechaina? uhA~le satkarmIlAI usako satkarmako ra duSkarmIlAI usako duSkarmako badalA dinuhunecha |
1 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! allAhale tapAIMtira vahI garnubhaeko kurAlAI paDhnuhos | surumA Aphno pAlanakartAko nAmako uccAraNa garnuhos, jasale sRSTiko sRjanA garnubhayo |
2 uhA~le manuSyako sRSTi ragatako jameko DallobATa garnubhayo juna pahile vIrya (pAnIko thopA jasto) thiyo |

3 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! allAhale tapAIMtira vahI garnubhaeko kurAlAI paDhnuhos | vAstavamA, tapAIMko pAlanakartA atulaniya dayAlu hunuhuncha | uhA~ dherai udAra ra upakArI hunuhuncha |
4 uhA~le kalamale varNamAlA ra lekhna sikAunubhayo |
5 uhA~le munaSyale najAneko kurA sikAunubhayo |
6 vAstavamA, abU jahala jasto anaitika vyaktile mAtra allAhako sImAko ullaGghana garcha |
7 jo Aphno ohodA ra sampattiko kAraNale AphUlAI dhanI ThAncha |
8 he manuSya! kiyAmatako dina timro pAlanakartAtira pharkanu parnecha ani uhA~le jo jasako hakadAra ho tyasalAI tyo badalA dinuhunecha |
9 ke tapAIMle abu jahalabhandA baDhI acammako kurA garne dekhnubhaeko cha, jasale rokcha?
10 hAmro bhakta muhammada (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) le kAbA najika salAha (namAja) paDhne samayamA rokcha |
11 timIlAI ke lAgcha, yadi yo rokieko vyaktile Aphno pAlanakartAko mArgadarzana ra antaradRSTi prApta garoko cha bhane?
12 vA usale mAnisaharUlAI allAhako Adeza mAnera ra uhA~le pratibandha lagAekA kurAharUbATa bacera uhA~ko bhaya rAkhna bhancha bhane ke yasto kAma garnelAI rokna milcha?
13 timro ke vicAra cha yadi roknele rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) le lyAunubhaeko sandezalAI nakAryo, uhA~bATa vimukha bhayo ra allAhako bhaya rAkhdaina bhane?

16 tyasa nidhArako mAlika jhUTho kurA garcha ra galata kAma garcha |
17 jaba usalAI usako nidhAra samAtera AgomA tAnera laginecha tyasa belA usale yAtanAbATa bacAunakA nimti AphnA sAthIharU ra usako sabhAmA sahabhAgI huneharUlAI bolAos |

18 ani hAmIn] narkakA kaThora phariztAharUlAI bolAunechauM, jo hAmrA AdezalAI inkAra gardainan ra unIharUlAI je bhanincha tyahI garchan | ani usale heros, yI duImadhye kuna samUha baDhI zaktizAlI ra sakSama cha |

19 tyasa atyAcArIle tapAIMlAI hAni puryAune so~ceko jasto mAmilA hunechaina | usako kurA namAnnuhos | kevala allAhalAI sajdA garnuhos ra uhA~ko anusaraNa apanAera uhA~ko nikaTa hunuhos kinaki tyasale uhA~ko nikaTa puryAu~cha |

1 hAmIle pUrai kurAnalAI ramajAna mahinAmA parne lailatul kadrako rAtamA ekasAtha pahilo AkAzamA avatarita garyauM | tyasaigarI yasalAI nabI (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) mAthi avataraNa pani yasai rAtamA suru garyauM |
2 he nabI (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! ke tapAIMlAI thAhA cha yasa rAtamA ke kati upakAra ra kRpA raheko cha?
3 yo rAta mahAna upakAra bhaeko rAta ho | jo ImAnako sAtha ra puNya prAptiko uddezyale yasa rAtamA upAsanA garcha tyo eka hajAra mahinAbhandA pani uttama cha |

5 yasa kRpAle bharipUrNa rAtamA surudekhi antima arthAta phajrako Agamanasamma upakAra nai upakAra raheko cha |
1 yahUdI, IsAI ra muzrika kAphiraharUle kuphramA AphnA sahamati ra samjhautAlAI spaSTa pramANa ra tarka naAuJjela tyAgnechainan |

2 yo spaSTa pramANa ra tarka bhaneko allAhakA rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) hunuhuncha | uhA~lAI pavitra granthako vAcanako lAgi paThAieko ho | jasalAI pavitra bhaktaharUle mAtra chune garchan |
3 tI pAnAharUmA satya khabaraharU ra nisAphamA AdhArita AdezaharU chan | tyasale mAnisaharUlAI unIharUko bhalo ra mArgadarzanako bATo dekhAu~cha |

4 taurAta pAekA yahUdIharU ra injIla pAekA IsAIharUmA allAhale unIharUtira Aphno nabI paThAepachi matabhinnatA bhayo | tinIharUmadhye kehIle islAma apanAe ra kehIle unakA nabIko satyatAko viSayamA thAhA bhaepani kuphra (avajJA) mA nai aDiga rahe |

5 yahUdI ra isAIharUko aparAdha ra haThadharma spaSTa bhayo kinaki unIharUlAI kurAnamA pani tyahI Adeza diieko cha juna unIharUko kitAbamA diieko thiyo ra tyo ho ekamAtra allAhako upAsanA garnu, zirkabATa joginu, namAja paDhnu ra jakAta dinu | juna kurAko unIharUlAI Adeza diiyo tyo sidhA dharma ho ra yasamA kunai TeDhopana chaina |

6 yahUdI, IsAI ra muzrika kAphiraharU kiyAmatako dina narkamA praveza garnechan ra sadAkA lAgi tyahI~ rahanechan | unIharU atyantai narAmrA sRSTi hun kinaki unIharUle allAhasa~ga kuphra gare ra rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama) lAI jhUTo Thahara gare |
7 vAstavamA, allAhamAthi AsthA rAkhne ra satkarma garneharU nai uttama sRSTi hun |

8 unIharUko pratidAna unIharUkA pAlanakartAsa~ga cha | unIharUkA lAgi bagaiMcAharU rahekA chan | tyahA~ unIharUkA mahalaharU ra rUkhaharUko talatirabATa naharaharU bagirahekA hunechan ra unIharU tyahA~ sadAkA lAgi rahanechan | unIharUko ImAna ra anusaraNako kAraNale allAha unIharUsita khusI hunuhuncha ra uhA~ko dayAkA kAraNa unIharU pani uhA~sa~ga khusI bhae | AphnA pAlanakartAbATa DarAune, uhA~ko anusaraNa garne ra uhA~le manAhI garnubhaeko kurAharUbATa bacneharUko nimti yo dayA raheko cha |
1 jaba dhartIlAI joDadAra tarikAle hallAinecha ra yo kiyAmatako dina hunecha |
2 ani dhartIle AphU bhitra rahekA mRtakaharU ra anya sabai kurAlAI bAhira nikAlnecha |

4 tyasa mahAna dinamA dhartIle tyasamAthi bhaekA rAmrA ra narAmrA kAmaharUlAI batAunecha |

9 vAstavikatA usale kalpanA gare jasto hunechaina bhanI ke yasa mAnisalAI thAhA chaina jasalAI saMsArako jIvanale dhokAmA pAreko cha | jaba allAhale cihAnabATa mRtakaharUlAI jIvita pArera uThAunuhunecha ani unIharUlAI hisAba kitAba ra badalA dinako lAgi dhartIbATa nikAlnuhunecha |

11 vAstavamA, unIharUkA pAlanakartAle tyasadina unIharUkA avasthAko pUrai jAnakArI rAkhnuhunecha | uhA~ko bhaktako kunaipani kurA uhA~bATa lukeko hunechaina ra tyasa anusAra nai unIharUlAI badalA dinuhunecha |

1 allAhale aparAnha (asra) ko samayako kasama khAnubhaeko cha |
2 vAstavamA manuSya ghATAmA ra vinAzako nikaTa cha |

3 tara allAha ra uhA~kA rasUlaharUmAthi AsthA (ImAna) rAkhne, satkarma garne, eka arkAlAI satyako upadeza dine ra satyamA aDiga rahana AzvAsana dineharU bAheka | tasartha yI guNa bhaekAharU saMsAramA ra AkhiratamA saphala huneharU hun |
1 jo mAnisaharUlAI apamAna garcha ra galata Aropa lagAu~cha UmAthi kaThora yAtanA AI paros |
2 jasale dhana jammA pArna ra gandai rAkhne bAremA mAtra socdacha ra arU kehI socdainan |
3 usako dhanale usalAI mRtyubATa jogAunecha ra yasa saMsAramA U sadA jIvita rahanecha bhanI usalAI lAgcha |
4 vAstavikatA yasa ajJAnIle so~ce jasto hoina | usalAI narkamA phAlinecha ra jasalAI narkamA phAlincha usalAI narkale Aphno zaktile barbAda pArdincha |
5 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! tapAIMlAI ke thAhA tyo narka ke ho jasale tyasamA phAlineharUlAI TukrA TukrA pArdincha?!
6 yo ta allAhako danka~do Ago ho |
7 juna mAnisaharUko zarIrabATa unIharUko hRdayasamma pugnecha |
8 vAstavamA, yasale yAtanAkA bhAgidAra sabailAI kaida garnecha |
9 aglA-aglA stambhaharUle gheriekA hunechan, jahA~bATa unIharU niskana saknechainan |

1 he rasUla (sallallAhu alaihi va sallama)! ke tapAIMlAI thAhA chaina abarahA ra usakA hAttIvAlA sAthIharUko bAremA; unIharUle kAbAlAI naSTa pArne SaDyantra garekAle tapAIMko pAlanakartAle unIharUsita kasto vyavahAra garnubhayo?
2 kAbAlAI naSTa pArna gariekA SaDyantralAI allAhale viphala pAridinubhayo | mAnisaharUlAI kAbAbATa TADhA rAkhne Aphno uddezyamA unIharU asaphala bhae | unIharU narAmrosita asaphala bhae |
3 allAhale unIharUmAthi jhunDakA jhunDa carAharU paThAunubhayo |
4 jo tinIharUlAI mATolAI AgomA pakAera banAiekA DhuGgA jastA TukrAharUle hAnirahekA thie |
5 allAhale unIharUlAI janAvaraharUle khAera ra kulcera barbAda gareko ghA~sa jasto banAidinubhayo |

2 ani tyo jADomA yamanako ra garmImA siriyAko surakSita yAtrA garnu ho |
3 tasartha yasa pavitra gharako mAlika eka mAtra allAhako upAsanA garnuhos, jasale yasa yAtrAlAI sahaja banAunubhayo ra uhA~sa~ga kasailAI pani sAjhedAra nabanAunuhos |
4 jasale unIharUlAI bhokako belA khuvAunubhayo ra unIharUlAI DarabATa mukta garnubhayo kinaki uhA~le arababAsIharUko hRdayamA yasa pavitra sthAna ra yahA~kA bAsindAharUko sammAna rAkhnubhayo |
1 kiyAmatako dina badalA diine viSayalAI jhUTo Thahara garnelAI tapAIMle cinnuhuncha?
2 yo tyahI vyakti ho jasale abhAvagrasta TuhurolAI kruratAkA sAtha hapkAune gardacha |
3 garibaharUlAI khuvAuna nata AphailAI protsAhita garcha nata arUlAI nai |
4, 5 ani tyasatA namAja paDhneharUko lAgi vinAza ra yAtanA cha, jo AphnA namAjaprati lAparavAhI garchan ra tyasatira dhyAna diMdainan; yahA~samma ki tyasako samaya samApta huncha |
4, 5 ani tyasatA namAja paDhneharUko lAgi vinAza ra yAtanA cha, jo AphnA namAjaprati lAparavAhI garchan ra tyasatira dhyAna diMdainan; yahA~samma ki tyasako samaya samApta huncha |
